“Kyaaaaa!” Carly checked again, but it clearly was Lee Gun, who had come here with Hugo. That was why Carly screamed as her face turned pale from fright.
The others were shocked for a different reason. After all, they were talking about Lee Gun being the father in this situation.
“Wait a moment. The father you were referring to…”
The Abundance general snorted when it saw Yooha’s gaze.
[That’s right. I’m talking about the snake bastard— Kuh-huhk!]
The Abundance general was pinned under the Demigod state Sungjae. It screamed when Heaven’s Punishment fell on its shoulder.
“You wanna die?” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. Heaven’s Punishment also raged. It had transformed into its second form.
[Heaven’s Punishment is reacting to its owner’s anger.]
[Heaven’s Punishment lashes out that its owner never got to use his junior.]
The general looked aggrieved.
[You can already perceive it! Your gene was used—]
“You dare say that again?” Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment again in anger!
Kwah-jeek!
After shutting up the general, he said to the others, “That’s the end of it. Nothing happened.”
However, everyone’s expression differed after. This included Haily and the Chun siblings. They were having a mental breakdown, especially Sungjae, who was in a state of shock.
Chun Sungjae was proud of the fact that he knew almost every information related to his uncle.
Moreover, they were the Zodiac Saints that were closest to their Zodiac.
He wondered if they did enjoy his confidence, but it was still an honor to find out about it right now.
Tears welled up in Chun Sungjae’s eyes. “Uncle…! I’m glad you had someone you dated before…”
Lee Gun turned to look at him.
Sungjae flinched when he saw his uncle’s expression. Clearly, they were under a misconception.
This was proven true when the Abundance general furrowed its brows.
[Hmmph! There is no way she’s the child of a human! If she was produced through the mating of lowly humans, do you really think she would have the ability to threaten a general rank?]
“!”
The general seemed to dislike that they were putting a human so high on a pedestal.
[She was made through the wisdom of our Abundance monarch.]
The Time faction might have known about Carly only now, but that wasn’t the case with the Abundance faction. This was to be expected since Abundance was in charge of creating and producing the monsters.
[The magical energy of a monarch, the Chalice, and Lee Gun’s data were used to create her. She possesses the magical energy of a monarch even if that monarch was kicked out. Of course, she’s amazing— Kuh-huhk!]
This time, Carly screamed as she stabbed the general. Her expression said that she wanted the general to stop saying useless things. However, she soon started to sweat.
“Ah! Chalice? Is that what it was?”
“Is that why she called him dad?”
The Chun siblings already had enough of an explanation. Their expression was fierce.
“I’m already angry that the Saintess stole our uncle’s DNA, yet…”
“Monarch’s magical energy? You dare mix Uncle’s data with something so insignificant?”
At the same time, Lee Gun approached Carly. When Lee Gun reached out his hand over her head, Carly clenched her eyes shut. The reason for her reaction was the magical energy infused with murderous intent coming from his hand.
At the end of the day, Carly didn’t want Lee Gun to hate him. So she had never planned on revealing the truth. She just wanted to have a conversation with Lee Gun, who had come back from the dead.
Of course, she thought he was cooler than she had expected after interacting with him. Since he looked similar in age to her, she did have some indecent desires toward him…
“I’m sorry for being born! I’m sorry for coming to meet you! I’m sorry for having bad intentions—”
Kwah-jeek!!
“!”
Carly had been ready for death, but she was surprised. The hand she thought was going to kill her unexpectedly headed toward the general.
[Kuh— Kuh-huhk!]
As expected of a general rank, the monster was still alive. The general tried to extend its hand, but Lee Gun’s fist flew toward its face.
Bbah-gahk!
The general’s face was instantly crushed.
[You have acquired data.]
[Hate grown by Abundance!]
The general was shaking with anger as its jaw broke.
[#$*#…!]
The general was as mad as it could be, but it couldn’t move at all. Although the power of a monarch flowed into the general, this place was the holy ground of a Zodiac. Moreover, the general was in the middle of a trap intended to stop the intruders from using their power!
The general shook as it felt its body get damaged, but suddenly, a warm light surrounded it.
[The opponent’s body is recovering through Super Regeneration(S)]
“!”
Everyone was surprised by the light. There was a reason both the Zodiacs and the Monarchs coveted this skill.
The broken mouth and jaw that needed at least a month to heal had healed in an instant.
Lee Gun let out a menacing laugh as he grabbed the Abundance general by the neck. “Is that so? Giselle was a monarch?”
Lee Gun had healed the general to hear its story. “So one of you hid amongst the Zodiacs and acted as a spy?”
He finally felt some of the clues come together. In the past couple of days, Lee Gun had found something odd as he had killed the monsters.
Those monsters possessed the transformation ability of the Pisces and the healing ability of the Aquarius. As if to make things worse, they had boldly invaded the holy ground of the Archer Saint. It seemed their side possessed data of the Zodiacs.
“Giselle stole the data of the Zodiacs, and she sent them to your side?”
Of course, Lee Gun had realized something like this was going on when he found out Giselle was in contact with the unknown civilization.
“You guys used that to attack human civilization, right? It’s the same reason the Zodiac Saints’ attacks don’t work well against the unknown civilization.”
The general was taken aback, but Lee Gun laughed in contempt. “It seems you guys can’t do much without the spy.”
The Abundance general became angry as it snorted.
[That is nonsense. That turncoat likes your side better, so we cut ties with her long ago.]
Giselle had acquired the power of a Zodiac as she hid amongst the Zodiacs, but she had become a turncoat at that point. She had stopped stealing the data of the Zodiacs.
[The only thing we acquired from that loser was the data of the Aquarius. The rest was done through the great power of our monarchs!]
Lee Gun was quite interested in the general’s words.
Of course, Giselle didn’t ignore the other side because she wanted to be on the side of the humans.
‘It means she liked the power of a Zodiac and didn’t plan on returning.’
It seemed Giselle hadn’t been the one to steal the rest of the Zodiacs’ data. The other culprit could be the Crab Saint, Jean-Louis.
‘The probability is high. It seemed he was a part of the unknown civilization too.’
However, it wouldn’t be easy for a Zodiac Saint to steal the data of the Zodiacs. Moreover, the other Zodiacs avoided the Cancer. It wouldn’t be easy for Jean-Louis to steal power from beings that had their guards up. That meant…
‘Couldn’t there be another traitor amongst the Zodiacs?’
It was a possibility. Moreover, the probability was high that it was one of the Zodiacs that wanted Lee Gun dead.
‘I guess it doesn’t matter since I plan on crushing all the Zodiacs.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“How dare you bastards use Uncle’s DNA like that?”
His Zodiac Saints seemed furious regarding the Carly problem. And they weren’t the only ones.
[The power of the Scorpio is going berserk.]
The magical energy of Hailey, who had been holding the Time general, became tumultuous. “You said it was a plan devised by the Abundance monarch?”
Magical energy was infused within her cold voice.
The two generals flinched at the overwhelming power. It was to be expected.
‘As expected, she’s of the Red Monarch’s bloodline…!’
It was said that all of her useful abilities had been sealed and she had been taken hostage by a different monarch. Then she had been abandoned in human territory.
‘She had that much power…!’
As if to make matters worse, she was on Lee Gun’s side.
In a rarity, Lee Gun was also surprised. Of course, it had nothing to do with Hailey’s power.
‘I get why Sungjae and Yooha are reacting that way. But why is Hailey angry?’
It was the first time he had seen her angry. Well, he didn’t hate it since she wasn’t angry at him.
On the other hand, Carly trembled at their reactions. If the people around Lee Gun reacted this poorly, she was sure Lee Gun would get rid of her.
Boom!!
“!!!!”
Lee Gun seemed to have heard everything he wanted to hear from the generals. A chaotic magical energy emanated from his body.
[The second stage of Death’s Divine state has been activated.]
The menacing black magical energy turned into a shadow tentacle and headed toward Carly’s neck.
Was he trying to pierce her neck with it? Sungjae and Yooha flinched at the sight.
“Uncle!”
The shaking Carly clenched her eyes in resignation.
Clank!
“!”
However, the sharp tentacle didn’t end her life. It cut away her necklace. It was the necklace that she had stolen from Giselle.
[Authority of Absolute Order]
The necklace was an important item containing the authority of the Libra.
Hailey looked a bit surprised when she saw this. She asked Lee Gun, “Are you letting the child be?”
Carly was a homunculus created through the schemes of Giselle and the Abundance monarch. If left alone, she might become a threat to Lee Gun.
“It’s fine. She’s done nothing wrong.”
“!”
Lee Gun patted Carly’s head. “There is no sin in being born.”
Carly was surprised by those words.
“Uncle…!”
The Chun siblings were surprised, too.
“Also, I’m not interested in killing a kid.”
“…!”
It was as if Hailey was suddenly hit in the heart. She covered her face, looking like she was about to fall. He had said something similar to her in the past, and it had made her heart tremble. Once again, his words made her…!
Oblivious to Hailey’s reaction, Lee Gun patted Carly on the back. “Anyway, I’m not going to kill you. Don’t worry about it.”
Hugo smirked as if to say Lee Gun should stop pretending to be kind. “Are you sure you aren’t killing her because she’s your daughter instead of a son?”
Hugo received a hit.
“If it were a son that looked like me, I probably would have. Whatever.”
It was the same concept as having a clone. There might be many ways to use this.
“On the other hand, I’ll burn everyone who participated in the act.” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
Then, the power of death hit the Abundance general.
Flash!
It started from the feet. Then, it moved to the legs, arms, and chest. The power of death was turning the general’s skin black and soon reached its neck.
[It’ll be useless even if you kill me! The Abundance monarch won’t stand back now that it has lost all its generals!]
Lee Gun smirked menacingly. “Like you guys won’t invade us if I spare you.”
As soon as he spoke those words, the Abundance general screamed.
[You have acquired data.]
– Life harvested by Abundance
[You have gained EXP.]
[You have leveled up.]
Lee Gun then gestured with his hand. “Guisoon”
The Secretary had been hiding behind Hugo, about to run away.
Lee Gun grabbed her as if he were grabbing a cat. “Stop the nonsense. Hurry up and take out the bible or whatever it is. This is the general of the Abundance monarch. You said you can read the past or the abilities through those that are connected to the monarch, right?”
The Secretary had to be dragged along. She shook as she spoke. “Hey! I really have to put my life on the line to do it!”
“It’s fine. If you get hurt, I’ll heal you.”
“Damn it!”
In the end, the Secretary stabbed her hand into the Abundance general’s stomach.
[Kuh-huhk!!!]
Light exploded forth!
The Time general, who was caught in Hailey’s hands, couldn’t believe what it was seeing.
‘That is…!’
There was no mistaking it. The monarch’s data was being extracted through the general, who was connected to the monarch. This was like an information history.
The Time general’s surprise lasted only a moment. Lee Gun looked at him.
“You are next.”
The Time general shook when Lee Gun came closer to it. It didn’t know the reason, but its owner had its eyes on Lee Gun. The Time general had to kill Lee Gun and take him back to the Time Monarch. But…
‘This Zodiac is dangerous’
At that moment…
“Ahhk! Stop! I’m not doing it!”
“I said I’ll heal you if you start to die.” Lee Gun took Guisoon’s shaking hand and stabbed her hand into the body of the blue shadow figure.
Kwah-jeek!
[The Extracting Information ability of the Secretary has been activated.]
[The information of the Time Monarch, who is connected to the Time general, will be extracted now.]
[Past information is being recalled.]
Suddenly, Lee Gun saw something within the light. It was a scene from twenty-four years ago, when he had awakened.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Ah, That was You? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Ah, That was You? (1)
Lee Gun saw a familiar sight unfolding in front of his eyes. Of course, his perspective was akin to someone watching a movie.
‘It’s a bird’s point of view.’
He wondered whether this would be the scene a bird would see if it looked down at a pity.
Lee Gun saw the clear sky and the buildings that were yet to be destroyed. He saw the peaceful Jongno streets in Seoul. At first, his gaze fell on the Seoul Plaza. And when the bird turned its head, he saw the Deoksugung Palace, which was no longer there. This sight surprised Lee Gun.
‘This is when…’
He was sure of it. This scene was from a time when everyone was frightened because of the monsters’ invasion. It was the year 2001, when the presence of the twelve awakened beings gave people hope.
Suddenly, Lee Gun heard a sound.
[Breaking news! The Taurus Saint Ivant, who had appeared six months ago to kill the monsters in Washington…]
[The US government is going forward with making an exclusive mercenary contract with the Taurus Saint Ivant…]
Although he couldn’t see it, it was surely the news coverage being broadcasted in the streets.
Moreover, Lee Gun vividly remembered the events of that day. It was understandable since that was the day he had awakened as the thirteenth.
The news coverage continued. It was the voice of the Taurus Saint Ivant.
[Do not worry. I will show up wherever the monsters appear. My Zodiac gave power to a mercenary like me, and it will protect us from all evil.]
[Did you hear that? The entire world is raising money to donate toward that great warrior.]
[The Korean government gave a sizable amount to him.]
[There is nothing to fear now that we have the Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints!]
However, Lee Gun knew. It was currently 4 o’clock. In two hours, Seoul would collapse. And the Zodiac Saints, who told everyone to look for them, never showed up. The Zodiacs had also been missing in action.
This was how everyone at Jongno had died, and Lee Gun knew it very well. He wondered why he was seeing this again, but he soon knew the reason.
[The Record Extraction of the Secretary is active]
[Record Extraction (S)]
– The hand touching the opponent’s soul creates a connection. All the past engraved in the soul will be extracted.
– In the process of extracting information, one can read memories.
In other words, this vision was the general’s memory.
The Secretaries had to record events they hadn’t witnessed. They were able to read the memories of any person and the memories were extracted as texts. This was part of that process.
If this was truly a memory of the general…
‘The ones to invade Seoul were these bastards?’
He was proven right.
[Humans are noisy beings.]
Lee Gun saw a familiar face through his field of vision. It was the Abundance general, who had invaded Lee Gun’s holy ground.
The general had the head of a goat, and it wore the outfit of a magician. Then, it crooked its finger and had countless monsters sneak into the city.
Lee Gun’s field of vision changed at this time. Now, it was the point of view of a different monster. He wondered what was going on, but he soon heard the voice of Guisoon.
[Ahhk! Since this bastard is at the general rank, it is connected to the monarch. Ahhhk! I hate it! The monarch might reverse the connection and invade us! Please let go of my hand, damn god-nim!]
Guisoon sounded like she was crying, but she did as Lee Gun told her to.
[The Secretary is invading the soul of the Time general.]
[The general’s internal information is being stolen.]
[Caution! In the process, you have connected to the ruler’s network, which the general is connected to.]
[Caution! The information of other monsters connected to this network may be mixed in.]
[Caution! There is a risk that you will be discovered by the highest ruler.]
In other words, all monsters were connected to their monarchs, who were their kings. It might be through brain waves or some special signal system. That was a hive network. Moreover, the network was probably structured in a hierarchical structure, going from low to high.
That was why the low-rank monsters were far from the monarch, but a general rank was probably close.
‘We’ll have no problem extracting information from the monarchs.’
Moreover, the general-ranks were probably connected to many monsters, so there was a high probability of memories becoming crossed with other monsters.
‘That’s why my point of view changed.’
Lee Gun had been watching a bird’s point of view, but it was different now. He observed the movement speed, the height, and where the owner of his current vision was landing…
‘It’s a fly.’
This time, he saw the interior of a building. Unlike the bird monster’s vision, this vision was blurry. It was hard to see. However, Lee Gun soon flinched.
“Are you sure about coming here? Department stores are expensive.”
He heard a familiar voice. His vision was blurry, but his hearing was very clear. It might be because it was a monster.
<Who cares? We only do this once a year.>
Lee Gun saw two familiar shadows. One was him talking in sign language. The other was…
“Alright. I want tonkatsu.”
<What? I have enough to buy you a steak. Why do you think I brought you here?
“I like tonkatsu.”
It was a voice that he could no longer hear in this world. It had been a voice more beautiful than any sound in the world.
Lee Gun ground his teeth. The person he was seeing right now was someone he knew very well. This person had been with him for as long as he could remember. They weren’t related by blood, but they had thought of each other as a family at the orphanage they were in. There was that much love between them.
That was why Lee Gun became angry when he checked that person’s face. He had been unaware back then, but he now knew for sure. Monsters were hidden all over the building. That wasn’t all. The employee who gave them the directions was a monster, too.
Therefore, Lee Gun became desperate as he saw the two of them head toward the elevator. They had to get out of there. He wanted to tell them that, that wasn’t the right direction. He tried to extend his hand, but the elevator ruthlessly closed its door.
Boom!
It was beyond despair. Lee Gun saw something he didn’t want to see the most. It was like the nightmare he saw when he fought the helmeted man.
Kwah-roo-roong!
Suddenly, fire erupted within the department store, and monsters invaded the streets of Jongno. He saw helpless people get slaughtered.
Boom boom!
At that moment, the people within the department received word that the Zodiac Saints and the Zodiacs would soon be there. They were letting out sighs of relief as they clustered around each other.
“It will be fine. It will be fine. They said it’ll be more dangerous if we leave this place. They said to wait here no matter what.”
“No, Mom! I’m scared. I want to go outside!”
“Be a bit patient, baby. If we wait in here, they will come to save us. They said so.”
It was as he remembered. The only thing different was that he was seeing this from a monster’s point of view. He was able to see sights he was unable to at that time.
Suddenly, he saw a monster that was on a different level than the monsters that had swept through the place like a fire.
Flash!
This monster had black wings like a crow. It was a hideous monster that had appeared from within the black fog.
Kwah-roo-roong!
It was a monarch
[Ah ah! Our Time monarch…!]
The monsters eating and violating the humans dropped everything they were doing and worshiped this being.
At the same time, something surprising happened.
Flash!
The monarch, who had looked like an enormous monster, turned into a person. He became a young man wearing a suit, and he was as good-looking as Hailey.
[Did you find what I talked to you about?]
[Yes. That’s it. It was as if the dumb Zodiac had squealed. This was especially true of the Aries, who didn’t realize who we were. It chattered away while drunk.]
[Is that so?]
The monarch furrowed its brow.
Seeing its presence, no one would ever think it was a human. The monarch looked like the devil. There was something odd and alien about it, which gave one goosebumps. It was a monster with a very cold gaze.
Lee Gun soon flinched. The reason was the place where the Time monarch was headed. It was where Lee Gun and the other person were unconscious. Lee Gun was unaware of this as it had taken place when he had been unconscious.
Lee Gun had to curse. In a flash, that person’s limbs were ripped away.
Kwah-jeek!
Of course, he couldn’t see what happened next. His point of view shifted to a different monster’s. However, he heard what happened.
[Since you’ve achieved your goal, shall we leave?]
[No. All the humans on this land will become food for us. That’s what I wanted to do from the start.]
Suddenly, the monarch sneered as it told them to have fun. But then, a light exploded forth. It was accompanied by the desperate voice of the Secretary.
[Hey! God-nim! I think we were found out by the monarch! Hurry!]
At the same time, a notification rang out.
[The Record Extraction of the Secretary has ended successfully.]
[Warning! The ruler realized there was an intruder in the network.]
Lee Gun took out the Secretary’s hand.
Kwahng!
The shock of having its body pierced made the Time general vomit blood.
Taken aback, Hugo looked at Lee Gun. “Are you ok, Gun?”
He looked at Lee Gun with a worried expression. Lee Gun held the arm of the Secretary, and he had made their hands pierce through the body. Above all else, it had to do with Lee Gun’s expression.
Their hands had pierced through the body for a mere couple of seconds. However, Hugo knew just from looking at him. He knew Lee Gun’s mood, and he sensed the magical energy starting to emanate from him; it was infused with killing intent.
Moreover, Hugo sensed a rage he had never felt before from Lee Gun, so he was worried. “Gun….”
“…woo.”
“!”
The voice was low, but Hugo was sure he had heard a name.
‘Yeonwoo?’
It didn’t take long for screams to ring out within the trap. Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he squeezed the necks of the generals. “Speak. You guys were the ones to invade Seoul twenty-four years ago? You guys came with your monarch?”
[…!]
The generals flinched at his question, and Hugo was surprised as well.
It was to be expected since the invasion of Seoul was one of the worst calamities in human history. At the time, Hugo had been fighting a war in Australia, so he couldn’t go there. However, that invasion was also famous for Lee Gun’s awakening.
‘I never expected the monarchs to show up themselves.’
This thought lasted only a moment as Lee Gun started twisting the necks of the generals. “Are you deaf? I asked if the one to show up was the Time monarch? Ah. It wasn’t just the Time monarch. I saw your face too.”
Lee Gun’s gaze headed toward the Abundance general. Both the generals were taken aback. It seemed information had been extracted from them when their bodies had been pierced with their hands. Some form of memory extraction skill had been used, but…
‘We are connected to our monarchs, so it shouldn’t have been extracted so easily. How…!’
Lee Gun let out a cold smile.
‘It was the Time monarch. I’m sure of it.’
That monarch was the one that had cut off the undead monarch within the Devil’s Tower. This wasn’t the only interesting part.
‘He looks very similar to the crab bastard.’
Yes, the Time monarch’s face looked similar to that of the Cancer Saint Jean-Louis. There was nothing off about it. Jean-Louis had trapped Lee Gun by stabbing him, and the Devil’s Tower had been the property of the Time monarch.
Jean-Louis wouldn’t have been able to trap Lee Gun within the Devil’s Tower if he didn’t have a connection to the Time monarch. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“You guys seemed to be looking for something twenty-four years ago. What were you looking for?”
[We have no duty to tell you— Kuh-huhk!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed red. “I’ll give you five seconds.”
Lee Gun activated Death Instinct. He had released 100% of his Zodiac’s power. The two generals were having a hard time breathing in front of him.
The invasion of Seoul had taken place after China had been conquered. The monsters had gone in there with the intent of replenishing their food supply. However, all the people who were going to be used as food had come back alive with the awakening of the thirteenth. This was why the invasion had been a big loss, but…
[W-We were looking for the 13th Zodiac, the God of calamity that’ll destroy everything…]
Flash!
When Lee Gun twisted their necks, black lights appeared from the two generals. An unexpected being had contacted him.
[The Abundance monarch is asking for a negotiation.]
[If the precious Knights are released, it pledges to never mess with the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground.]
[It will also help you get rid of the Time monarch.]
The monarch seemed to have purposefully imitated the Zodiac system to contact him. The Abundance monarch was despicable as it imitated the Zodiacs.
[Its underlings didn’t participate in the incident twenty-four years ago.]
[It says the monarchs can become good friends with the God of calamity.]
The snake eyes shone menacingly before he could speak.
Kwahng!!!
The grasping power of his hand made the Abundance general’s head explode!
Kwah-jeek!
As the blood dispersed, Lee Gun smirked savagely. “Fuck off! You will all die.”
The corpse turned into porridge as it fell.

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Ah, That was You? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Ah, That was You? (2)
The general’s head exploded and scattered in front of their eyes. Everyone turned silent. The seemingly unbreakable head of the general had shattered before them.
The monster’s body fell and became a lump of flesh. Then, a shadow appeared from the general’s neck and mutilated the body. The mutilated flesh scattered across the ground.
Koohng!
It no longer had a discernable shape.
Hugo flinched at this sight, but said nothing.
‘I’ve never seen him this mad.’
Lee Gun had no expression. What made it even scarier was that he wasn’t even verbalizing his anger. There was no smile on his face, and his eyes flashed. A boiling murderous intent could be sensed from him.
This surprised the Chun siblings. To them, at the end of the day, Lee Gun was always the kind uncle. However, they couldn’t breathe now. It was as if he were a different person.
Kwah-jeek!
The magical energy Lee Gun instantly emitted and started to distort in shape.
“…!”
Everyone was frightened out of their wits. It was as if an emotion that Lee Gun had been suppressing was leaking out.
The Divine status of Death fluctuated violently.
[Warning! The Divine status of Death is becoming uncontrollable.]
[The second stage of the Divine status of Death is going on a rampage.]
Even Hailey flinched in front of the dark power. This power was too dangerous. In some ways, it was more dangerous than the monarchs. It was a power that could destroy the world in an instant.
The first stage of the Divine Status of Death was dangerous, but it became much more dangerous as it climbed in stages.
The power made even the nearby Zodiacs restless.
[The Sagittarius says it is as expected. This power is too dangerous.]
Hugo flinched at the Zodiac’s agitation. His Zodiac had wanted him to monitor Lee Gun closely. This was the reason.
With his Divine status increasing, Lee Gun’s power would become much more powerful, and controlling it would become harder as well. It would become a frightful, double-edged sword.
[The servants of the Serpent Bearer are afraid of the owner’s power. They are shaking.]
[The Sagittarius says it is a power that no one can control.]
[The Virgo says they must run away.]
The power expanded like a black hole, and it was about to swallow Hailey’s trap.
Boom!
The extremely dangerous power was about to spread into the surrounding area, but the Zodiacs could no longer stand back and watch. They stepped forward.
[The Virgo has used Zodiac Saint Summon.]
Normally, a Zodiac would use this skill when it wanted something from its Zodiac Saint or when it wanted its Zodiac Saint to do something. This was a compulsory summon. The skill cost energy, but the Zodiac had no choice.
[All members of its household will be forcefully moved to its abode.]
[It is trying to summon the disciples of the Serpent Bearer.]
They seemed to have realized they couldn’t stop this power on their own. Instead of stopping Lee Gun, they chose to escape.
The Sagittarius quickly tried to summon Hugo in front of it.
[The Sagittarius is about to use Zodiac Saint Summon—]
However, Hugo’s eyes flashed as if he wanted to say the Sagittarius to fuck off. This shocked the Zodiac.
[The faith toward the Sagittarius has plunged below the threshold.]
[The Zodiac Saint Summon skill has failed.]
[The Sagittarius despairs. It tells you to stop doing this.]
Soon, the magical energy of the Divine status of Death started to melt away Lee Gun’s skin.
[Warning! This power cannot be handled by Super Regeneration.]
It was why this Divine status was dangerous. It threatened the world, but it also ate away its own god.
Therefore, she quickly tried to use the power of Time despite that being dangerous.
Suddenly…
“Gun!”
Hugo grabbed Lee Gun’s shoulder. However, as soon as his hand touched Lee Gun, his face became distorted. The power of Death made Hugo’s hand hard like a rock. Then parts of his hand started to crumble as if his hand was being eroded.
However, Hugo endured it. “Gun!”
When Lee Gun heard the voice that was trying to keep the pain at bay, his brows furrowed. Then something surprising happened.
Koo-goo-goong!
The Divine status of Death had surged forth as if it would destroy everything, yet it started to calm down.
[The unruly Death has been wrangled and pressed down.]
[The unruly Death has been wrangled and pressed down.]
In the process, a black light also went wild, but it didn’t matter.
Kwah-jeek!
[The second stage of the Divine status of Death is now under control.]
[The status of the temple has increased.]
[The Constructs have gained the opportunity to evolve.]
[You have developed a new skill.]
The power of death had almost swept through his holy ground, and it might have swept through his disciples too. However, Death now started to move according to Lee Gun’s will.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief, while the Zodiacs looked shocked. They had no idea an out-of-control Divine status of Death could be controlled like this. Moreover, the most surprised person was the still-alive Time general.
‘Even if he was able to control it, that power…!’
There was a reason its monarch had taken its underlings to Seoul twenty-four years ago to look for this power.
‘When it went out of control, he should have devoured his holy ground and disciples.’
In theory, controlling it through mental strength was possible, but…
‘His mental strength is frightening.’
This was the first time the general had seen the god of calamity’s power with its own eyes. It now understood why the monarchs had put this power under a separate category of Calamity.
‘It makes sense why the undead Monarch coveted this power.’
They had locked up the undead monarch within the Devil’s Tower. However, the undead monarch, who had died at Lee Gun’s hands, wasn’t someone normal.
Old Ones! Amongst the monarchs, some beings were especially powerful. They were ancient special beings that had lived for a very long time.
Anyway, although this being had told Lee Gun to become a monarch, it secretly coveted Lee Gun’s young body and power.
‘I knew he wasn’t normal, but this is…’
Soon, the general’s gaze headed toward Hugo.
‘Someone is capable of anchoring his mind.’
Therefore, the Time general tried to sneak out of the trap. Its monarch would be very happy to learn these facts from it.
‘They can become his weakness.’
Lee Gun’s Zodiac Saints didn’t seem to have truly awakened.
God’s Vessel! They didn’t know how to capture the overflowing power of their Zodiac. They were decadent beings who knew only how to use a copious amount of power.
In truth, all Zodiac Saints were like that. The difference between the Knights and the Zodiac Saints was stark since the Knights knew how to store the power of the Monarch. If one had to make a comparison, all the Zodiac Saints were on level 1.
‘Even if they awaken, I doubt they can become vessels capable of containing that much power.’
Anyway, this was a golden opportunity to attack Lee Gun in his current state.
‘I have to hurry up and tell the monarch about his weakness.’
Of course, the Time general had barely sent half of its body to invade this Zodiac’s holy ground. However, that might be to its advantage now.
‘Only half of me entered this place, so it’ll be easy for me to exit.’
The Time general was one of the thirteen Knights, which were important cards for the monarchs. Unfortunately, another one was killed, but that couldn’t be helped.
‘I’ll return to my master and….’
Suddenly, the Time general felt a chill. It started shaking. It couldn’t move its body. From head to toe, it felt like a skewer had fixed it in place. The general felt like a small larva in front of an enormous being.
Boom!
The red-eyed Lee Gun approached it. “Are you going to run away by yourself?”
[…!]
The Time general looked taken aback as it tried to use its power once again.
[The Serpent Eater attribute is active.]
A green chain appeared from beneath Lee Gun’s feet and squeezed the neck of the blue shadow.
“You didn’t even try to retrieve the corpse of your comrade. It seems you guys have no sense of honor.”
The Time general ground its teeth. In the first place, there was no corpse left to retrieve…!
[Kuhk!]
The Time general screamed. While it had its guard down, the Secretary had stealthily walked up to it, and she had stabbed it in the back. “I found their Commandment!”
[!!]
“Uh. It’s similar to the seal engraved into the blade that stabbed God-nim.”
Yes, a commandment was like a bible for the Monarchs.
The Zodiacs grew in power as they forever transcribed their story. In comparison, the monarchs followed a strict rule of strength to strengthen their powers.
Moreover, the Commandment was engraved like a tattoo on the souls of all its brethren. The Commandment was proof that they had received power from the monarch, and it was the source of their power.
If one were to analyze the Commandment, one would learn the information about its abilities and the power of the monarch. It could also be assigned to a weapon for it to be given power.
This was why the Time general wanted to kill the Secretary, who had stolen its Commandment.
“You did well in bringing what is mine.”
The chaotic black light spread throughout the trap. Death swallowed everything.
* * *
“What? You provoked the Monarchs?!” After a quarter of a day in the Leo Saint’s holy ground, the Leo Saint was shocked by what the person before him said. “You even killed the remaining general?”
Lee Gun sat on the other side, and he laughed when he saw Stevens’s expression. “It doesn’t matter since I plan on eradicating them.”
A serious expression appeared on Stevens’s face.
Yes, for some reason, Lee Gun had come to Stevens’s holy ground, and they were having a conversation.
Stevens learned for the first time how the forces of the unknown civilization were structured, and he also learned that all the generals of a particular Monarch had been killed.
‘One was killed by that brat, Chun Sungjae. The other one was killed by Lee Gun.’
If what Lee Gun said was true, the generals were Saint-ranks. There was no way the Monarchs would stand back and do nothing at this time.
‘Moreover, he ignored its request for a negotiation and killed the general.’
That was like Lee Gun to do such a thing, but….
“Anyway, I’m going to start attacking them in earnest. That’s why I’m here to take some battle-type disciples.”
Stevens became apoplectic when he saw Lee Gun’s smile. “Why does it have to be our kids? You have already acquired the Virgo temple and the Aquarius temple as affiliates!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “Affiliate disciples are completely different from direct disciples.”
The quality of his temple had considerably improved thanks to the affiliate disciples. However, Lee Gun wanted to grow the size of the Serpent Bearer’s temple. He didn’t even have the minimum number of members.
‘I can lay the basic foundation if I have a couple more disciples.’
Currently, his Zodiac Saints were doing all the dirty work. Sungjae and Yooha didn’t have any disciples to guard them. Lee Gun felt a bit bad for it.
‘There is a difference between the EXP brought in by the affiliate disciples and the EXP brought in by the Serpent Bearer disciples.’
“Anyway, I’ll take that Muffin guy. I planned on taking him before. My temple has magicians and close-range fighters, but no tankers.”
“Fuck off! You already have a lot of people gathering at your temple!”
“No! My Zodiac Saint turned them all down.”
Sungjae, who was the interviewer, kept his eyes sharp. He kicked out anyone with an ulterior motive toward Lee Gun.
Stevens was baffled by those words. “Anyway, your temple needs 100 percent faith. You can’t pick them unless they are fanatics—”
Lee Gun suddenly activated his bible.
[Psalm of Sungjae]
Chapter 71
[The Serpent Bearer’s greatness seems to shine with light.]
– Effect: Light Effect (Faith is temporarily increased)]
The light extended outward, and spirited shouts immediately came from outside.
“Lee Gun-nim! Huzzah!”
“Lee Gun-nim! We love you! Die Stevens!”
“…?!” Stevens froze when he heard the sounds.
Lee Gun let out a menacing smile. “I’ll pick amongst them, alright?”
The Leo Saint let out a soundless scream.
‘Bastard!’
As if to make it worse, his Zodiac, the Leo, was still waiting for Lee Gun. It would ask why Lee Gun wasn’t coming to the Divine world and when he would come. Stevens was tired of being asked those questions!
‘Why did he have to come here…!’
His disciples were going to be stolen. Stevens clutched at his face as he said, “Is your business with me done now?”
“No? Of course not.”
“What?”
“Call forth your Zodiac.”
“W-what? Why do you— Koohk!”
With his arms crossed, Lee Gun slammed his legs on top of the table. “If I said to call for it, you call it here.”
There was killing intent in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: Ah, That was You? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Ah, That was You? (3)
“If I said to call for it, you call it here.” Killing intent appeared in Lee Gun’s eyes.
Confronted with that gaze, Stevens had no choice but to flinch.
‘What is it? Something feels different.’
Stevens felt something unfamiliar from Lee Gun. Of course, he had felt different when Lee Gun had returned after twenty years.
When Lee Gun had awakened as the Serpent Bearer, his rejuvenated face and magical energy had changed. He had become a completely different person. It was as if a weak and sickly monster had gotten rejuvenated. Stevens had finally gotten used to it.
‘However, he changed again.’
Lee Gun had become much stronger than the last time they had met.
As a Zodiac Saint, Stevens found it hard to grow in power. Therefore, it terrified him that every time he saw Lee Gun, Lee Gun would be stronger.
Still, this felt a bit different.
‘He is scary.’
Was the sensation coming from the magical energy? Stevens couldn’t put a finger on it, but it was frigid. He felt as if his breath was being constricted.
‘Where did I feel this before?’
Soon, Stevens realized where he had felt this sensation, and he bit his tongue.
‘It was on the battlefield.’
Yes, this was the sensation he had felt when Death touched his skin. In reality, Stevens was feeling the Divine status of Death.
While Lee Gun had both the Life and Death Divine statuses, Death had evolved to the second stage. Therefore, his attribute was tilted toward Death.
The first stage of any Divine status was like a rookie status. Since Lee Gun was a newly born god, it was as if he were in his infancy. However, things were different now.
‘His scent as a human has disappeared further.’
Lee Gun felt closer to the Zodiacs. No, it was a more ominous feeling.
However, Stevens soon shook his head from side to side. The important part wasn’t the change in the atmosphere around Lee Gun.
“O…Our Zodiac is sleeping right now.”
“Is that so? It is sleeping?”
Of course, this was a bald-faced lie.
As soon as Lee Gun had arrived at the Leo Saint’s holy ground, the Leo had gone crazy. Since Lee Gun had placed a blackout screen on the Divine world, the Leo was unable to see Lee Gun.
However, this was the Leo temple. A Zodiac would view everything within its holy ground. As soon as Lee Gun had entered the holy ground, he had stepped into the sensory range of the Leo.
And since the Zodiac could clearly see Lee Gun, the Leo hissed at Stevens and threw a tantrum.
[The Leo is angry. It says to quickly bring Lee Gun to the Divine world.]
[The Leo has been waiting in front of the door, and it is angry that its butt hurts.]
[The Leo says it will kill the Serpent Bearer and take the Chalice. It bares its teeth.]
With his Zodiac going crazy, Stevens felt a headache as he was connected to his Zodiac. He ground his teeth.
A Zodiac could be manifested in two ways, the first being a Zodiac Saint calling for the Zodiac and the other was the Zodiac descending on its own.
Of course, Stevens’s master wouldn’t normally care about the earth’s environment. It would have appeared here, the consequences be damned.
‘That’s why two-thirds of our holy ground were destroyed last time.’
When Red Eye had invaded, the Leo’s holy ground had suffered damage. However, the damage caused by its owner was bigger.
The holy ground couldn’t bear the Leo descending once again. If the holy ground got destroyed, its temple couldn’t acquire the meat that it liked. As if to prove this point, there would be no special meal for the Leo soon.
Therefore, Stevens had been firmly telling its master that it couldn’t come down to earth as it pleased. And so, the Leo kept its foul temper in check as it didn’t leave the Divine world.
‘There is no way the Leo would show up.’
Stevens just had to make the damned disciple thief leave.
‘In the first place, there has to be a reason Lee Gun is looking for our master.’
Stevens said, “Our master is sleeping. You should come next time—”
“Is that so? Maybe I should just take this back.”
“?”
Lee Gun took something out of his pocket and shook it. It was an antique cup, the size of a teacup. This item was the Chalice.
Stevens instantly recognized it, and his face turned pale.
And as if he had expected this reaction, Lee Gun laughed like a sly fox. “I made this Fast Growth Chalice. I believe the Leo’s tooth will grow back with this. But it’s too bad. I’ll sell it to a different Zodiac suffering under similar pain.”
Stevens screamed when he saw the laughing face. And as expected…
Kwahng!!!
[The Leo roars. It says it wants that Chalice.]
[The Leo says it’ll be there as soon as possible. It bares its teeth and says not to sell the Chalice to a different Zodiac.]
[The Leo descends to this land.]
Lee Gun grinned as a golden light appeared in the sky.
Kwah-gwa-gwahng!
It was the descent of a Zodiac! In the end, everything Stevens had expected to happen came to fruition. He clutched his head as the golden light ruthlessly descended toward the Leo Saint’s building.
Koo-goo-goong!
The deluge of the Zodiac’s light instantly destroyed the guest building of the Leo temple. The shock gave rise to enormous winds. The disciples in and out of the building screamed as they were sent flying.
The impact was akin to an atomic bomb falling from the sky! The building collapsed. Stevens, who had been sitting on the sofa, quickly got out of there. At the same time, the incredible winds swept around.
Koo-goo-goong!
How long had passed? When Stevens opened his eyes again, he saw the enormous lion roar after it had destroyed the Leo Saint’s holy ground once again.
[The Leo has revealed itself.]
[The Leo has activated its basic attribute, Intimidation.]
[Intimidation: It breaks the opponent’s spirit. (Decreases stats, defense, and speed)]
The roar of the savage beast could freeze one’s soul. This roar rang throughout heaven and earth.
The Leo disciples were frightened and appalled when their Zodiac appeared once again and destroyed its own holy ground.
“Ahhhk! Why is the Zodiac here again?”
“Saint-nim said he took steps so that it wouldn’t be able to come here…!!”
“We were barely able to restore the buildings of the holy ground!!! Not again!!!”
“Our master consumed the Temple energy once again!”
The Leo didn’t care about that as it looked for Lee Gun.
[Finally, I get to see your face!!]
The Leo roared. It seemed to have been waiting for Lee Gun impatiently. The lion that was bigger than a ten-story building seemed glad to meet Lee Gun. It raised its front paw.
[I have a lot to say, but I want the Chalice first!]
Kwahng!
The front paw infused with power came crashing toward the ground ruthlessly. The building-sized claws roughly scratched the ground.
Of course, Lee Gun jumped between the claws. Softly landing, he laughed. His gaze headed toward the half-grown Leo’s fang. He laughed in satisfaction. “What the hell? I was worried, but it already grew a lot.”
“…!” Stevens felt a chill run up his back when he saw Lee Gun’s bright smile. Could it be? The reason he called for the Zodiac…!
[Serpent Eater special attribute has been activated.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned red, and a chain made out of green light encircled the Leo’s neck and wrists.
Kwah-jeek!
[The Leo is bound.]
[The Leo’s massive power resists the Serpent Bearer’s power.]
“Master!”
All the Leo disciples were shocked. Stevens also looked shocked as he glared at Lee Gun.
“Hey!”
It was different from before. When Lee Gun faced the Leo last time, it had felt like he had been struggling. However, right now, they were on much more equal terms. Then there was the power that had surged forth just now!
Caught in the Serpent Bearer’s chains, the Leo laughed in contentment.
[It seemed you evolved your Divine status, hatchling!]
All gods could evolve using the bible and the power of their disciples.
[You’re only on the second stage! Don’t act so high and mighty! You’re the enemy of my tooth!]
The Leo broke the Serpent Bearer’s chains. When it opened its mouth, however…
Kwah-jeek!!
The Leo’s body shook as if it was paralyzed.
Lee Gun laughed. “It’s finally working.”
[You…!]
A black power had invaded the Leo’s body. This was what Lee Gun had spread in the dimensional crack that existed between the earth and the divine world, the Cancer’s Star of Darkness.
The spiritual body of the Leo had to cross it, so the Star of Darkness had invaded it.
“You were still energetic, so I thought I would have to use my poison too.” Lee Gun finally proceeded to the main issue. He arrived in front of the Leo, who was lying down. “I called you because I have a question for you. It’s regarding what happened twenty-four years ago.”
[!]
The Leo became surprised when Lee Gun mentioned the period. This was to be expected since that period had only one incident where the Leo was involved.
Moreover, the Aries had been hysterical when the Serpent Bearer had been found.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed menacingly. “I read the memories of a monster that invaded Seoul twenty-four years ago. I heard they invaded to find the Serpent Bearer.”
[…!]
“I heard someone amongst the Zodiacs leaked the location of the Serpent Bearer to the monarchs.”
The eyes of the Leo flashed, the eyes that were many times larger than Lee Gun.
[Are you suspicious that it’s me?]
The Leo was baffled. It was about to open its mouth.
Puhk!
[Kyahhhhk!]
However, Lee Gun kicked the enormous eye with his foot. He said as he looked at Stevens, “This dumb cat wasn’t supposed to be in Seoul at the time, yet it was present in the monster’s memories.”
It was the truth. Lee Gun had been unaware at the time, but he had heard it through the monster’s memories. The Leo was the one who had given directions toward the department store that Lee Gun had entered!
“Your size was different, but you were there.” Lee Gun’s eyes let out wicked killing intent. The Divine status of Death leaked out of him.
Stevens felt like his throat was constricting.
“Were you involved in the invasion?”
At that moment, the captured Leo suddenly burst out laughing for some reason.
[Do not presume too much.]
“!”
The serious Leo let out a killing intent that was different from before.
[Warning! The Leo is using Death’s Instinct.]
Something surprising happened.
Koo-goo-goong!!
Accompanying a holy golden light, lightning emanated from the Leo’s body.
Kwah-jee-jeek!
The enormous power destroyed the Star of Darkness, which was eroding its body. The power also destroyed the Serpent Eater’s chains, which had been squeezing the Leo’s neck and arms.
The Leo revealed its fangs as it spoke.
[No matter how much I hate the Serpent Bearer, I would never cooperate with the monsters!]
Lee Gun smiled at the sight, while Stevens sweated.
The Zodiac was trying to be menacing, but its fangs were mismatched. It didn’t look dignified at all.
Lee Gun laughed as if the Leo had confirmed it. “So you never went there?”
[In the first place, Korea was troublesome, so I never went there in the first place…!]
Lee Gun laughed. The Leo was like a cat that didn’t like to move. It would have sent its Zodiac Saint instead. There was no way it would move directly. That meant…
‘It was the Pisces.’
The Pisces was the god of transformation. In the Devil’s Tower, the Pisces had turned Jean-Louis into Kevin, and Jean-Louis had then stabbed Lee Gun.
It was a treacherous being that made one nauseous.
When it seemed Lee Gun was finished with his matter. Stevens quickly spoke up. “Your business is done here, right? Let’s get…!”
He wanted to send his Zodiac back. Stevens quickly tried to use the Zodiac Saint skill.
However, Lee Gun smirked as if to say it was going nowhere.
[Kyahhhhk!!!]
Lee Gun activated Death’s Instinct and broke the Leo’s fang with his foot.
Kwah-jeek!
“Oh, Master!!!”
[Master!!!]
To be precise, he had hit the root. When the tooth started to wobble, Lee Gun kicked it again. He looked to be enjoying himself.
In a flash, a fang was dislodged!
Kwah-jeek!
[Kyahhhhhhhk!]
The last time, Lee Gun had a hard time extracting the tooth because he was under a penalty. Now that he could use 100% of his power, he could use an entirely different method! This was the real reason Lee Gun had come here.
Lee Gun laughed. “Give me more! They are my teeth!!!”
Boohoo-gahk!
[Kyahhhhhk!!]
Aside from the still-growing baby tooth, Lee Gun extracted the three remaining fangs by kicking them.
[You have acquired the Leo’s teeth.]
[You have gained EXP.]
Lee Gun loved the power of Heaven’s Punishment, which had been upgraded using the tooth.
‘If I want to fight a Monarch, I need at least two more EX-rank equipment!’
Moreover, he had found out that the Leo had nothing to do with the incident from 24 years ago. He could use it as good ingredients now! “Since I’m at it, let me clip your nails! Bastard!”
Lee Gun laughed as he raised Heaven’s Punishment.
[Heaven’s Punishment says the Leo is excellent as an ingredient.]
[Heaven’s Punishment says it’ll be a big help to its master.]
The Leo released a savage power, but it didn’t matter.
[Psalm of Sungjae]
Page 50
[The Serpent Bearer’s coolness pierced the sky. He extracted the fang of the Leo.]
– Effect: Ingredient acquisition probability up (Debuff on the Leo. Twice the number of ingredients acquired)
The Leo screamed.
Stevens became angry at the sight. He yelled at his disciples to catch Lee Gun. However…
“Gasp! Lee Gun-nim! You’re so cool!”
“I might fall for you! Just kill that cat!”
“Idiots!!”
The bible’s Faith Increase was in effect. The disciples were cheering on Lee Gun.
It was unknown as to how much time had passed.
[Warning! The bible’s effect is coming to an end.]
[Warning! The Leo is taking damage to use 100% of its power.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
The Leo, who had its nails clipped, violently charged Lee Gun.
[I was going easy because you had the Chalice! But I won’t forgive you now!]
Lee Gun quickly took out his slime and tossed it toward the Leo.
The Leo was about to swallow the slime as if it wanted the slime to buzz off.
Boom!
“Master!!”
The slime changed its form, and it emitted a powder.
The Leo fell. As if that wasn’t enough, it started to roll around on the ground.
Everyone was surprised, wondering what had happened.
Clank!
As for Lee Gun, he smirked as he picked up the enormous scissor.

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Divine Status of Life (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Divine Status of Life (1)
[Kyahhhk!]
A scream spread throughout the Leo Saint’s holy ground. The one screaming was none other than the Leo. There was an edge to its voice.
[Ahhhhk! Master!]
[All of Master’s teeth were pulled out! How can this be!]
[Look! The teeth aren’t the problem right now! Look at it! It became bald!!]
[All of its majestic mane…!]
The Constructs turned deathly pale when everything was ruthlessly taken from the Leo. Its awesome large fangs were the first to be extracted. Then its front teeth were all taken out. Moreover, even its majestic mane, which was sturdier than steel, was entirely shaved off.
However, Lee Gun still seemed unsatisfied.
Bbah-gahk!
[Kuh-huhk!]
He used Death’s Instinct, then stomped on the Leo’s cheek. The Zodiac’s molars started to wobble!
A fight between Zodiacs was like a natural disaster. The Constructs didn’t dare interfere. They could merely clutch at their face.
Despite how it looked, the Leo was a high-rank Zodiac!
[My god! Look at that young god, who has no fear!]
[Just a single fur is coveted by all the gods. It is that great…!]
As if it agreed with those statements, the Leo let out an intense power.
[Bastard! Snake bastard! Stop running around my body like a flea! Just stay still and get eaten by me!]
However, it was useless.
[Clump of Creation Clay has attacked the Leo.]
After turning into a bottle, the slime sprayed the powder once again. The powder was an item that Lee Gun had fed the slime beforehand!
As soon as the powder fell, the murderous Leo fell over once again.
Boom!
As if it were hopped up on drugs, the Leo started to rub its body against the ground.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
Kwah-jeek!
[You have acquired the Leo’s Molar(SSS)]
The Constructs and Stevens had no choice but to scream.
[It says, “At the very least, leave enough teeth so that I can chew meat! Damn bully Zodiac!”]
When he saw the Zodiac act clumsily, a somber Stevens had an expression as if he had seen something he didn’t want to see. “What’s up with that powder?”
The disciples seemed surprised at Stevens’s words.
“Maybe, it’s catnip? Since it’s a feline-type Zodiac, it might be drunk on something like silvervine.”
“Of course, I know that!”
Stevens wasn’t really curious about the powder. “Do you really think we haven’t tried using catnip and silvervine?”
In truth, in the past, Stevens had done many things to soften the Leo’s anger.
The Constructs felt the same way as the Zodiac Saint.
[My god! We gave the Leo the snacks we squirreled away, yet it threw all away in contempt. How can that god…!]
Despite knowing he needed to stop his Zodiac from suffering such indignity, Stevens yelled, “Lee Gun! What did you use? It is catnip, right?”
Lee Gun nonchalantly replied as he watched the Leo rub against the ground, “That isn’t the only ingredient. However, I did my best to concentrate it a hundredfold before I mixed the powder.”
“…!”
Lee Gun had plenty of ingredients he could use to mix drugs. The Aquarius’s Chalice manufacturing room was full of it. Lee Gun always made and used his own drugs, so this was nothing to him.
Those words shocked everyone, but Lee Gun just shrugged it off. He held an enormous shear as he called for Stevens. “Hey, underling cat. It is struggling too much. Cutting its fur is difficult right now. Hold it down for a moment.”
Stevens looked baffled. The Leo’s fur was the softest in the world, yet it was strong enough to repel the blade of a Zodiac.
“You crazy….”
“You don’t like this bastard either. If you help me, I’ll make you an EX-rank weapon, too.”
“…!!” For a moment, Stevens flinched. His reason and emotions being shaken could be seen through his eyes.
His disciples reacted in fright.
“Saint-nim!!”
“Lee Gun-nim! This is a rule violation!”
The disciples grabbed Stevens, who was shaken.
“You just have to ask the Capricorn’s Genius Workshop to create a weapon!”
“That’s right! Despite being sticklers, I think the Genius Workshop will take orders from both Saint-nim and Lee Gun-nim…!”
Stevens snorted at those words. Genius Workshop, my ass! “He probably makes better weapons.”
“What?!”
“In the first place, he’s the one who created Heaven’s Punishment.”
“…!!!”
The Goat Saint Sebastian had kept arguing that his Zodiac had created Heaven’s Punishment. He had secretly spread this lie amongst his disciples.
Suddenly!
[Warning! The bible’s debuff placed on the Leo (Psalm of Sungjae: Page 50) has come to an end.]
[Warning! The Leo’s power will return.]
“Lee Gun-nim!”
The Leo, who had been drunk on catnip, emitted a wild golden light.
[Snake bastard! I’ll kill you!]
[You lack Temple energy. You are unable to open your bible. (You need at least 50% Temple energy)]
[Currency: Serpent Bearer’s Temple energy > 11%]
[Warning! If Temple energy dips below 10%, the temple will cease to function.]
If Lee Gun wanted to fight against the monarchs, he had to test out his bible. So this result satisfied him.
‘Even if I fill the Temple energy to 100%, I can use the bible only ten times before it completely bottoms out.’
Of course, the amount of energy being used was dependent on the temple’s level and which Psalm from the bible was used.
Anyway, Lee Gun could no longer use the bible to eat away the Leo’s power, but that didn’t matter.
Kwah-jeek!
In the end, Lee Gun had left the fur on the face and the top of its feet. He gave the beast a summer cut that would be given to a dog. The rest of the fur was shaved in a refreshing manner.
[You have acquired Highest Quality Fur(SSS).]
[Temple EXP has risen.]
When he acquired the fur, Lee Gun spoke as if his business here was done. “Hey, underling cat. I’m done. Send it back home again.”
“What?!” Stevens was dumbfounded.
However, it seemed Lee Gun did have a shred of conscience as he handed over the Chalice. “Here. If you spray this on it, its fur, teeth, and nails will all grow back.”
Stevens was at a loss for words. “It seems you’re capable of feeling sorry? Are you going to clean up your mess?”
“I’m coming back in two weeks to extract all of it again. Spray on it well.”
“You plan on taking more!”
In the end, Stevens unsummoned the Leo, who was going on a rampage.
Despite being dragged away to the Divine world, the Leo raised its paw toward Lee Gun.
[Nasty baby snake bastard! Come here right now! I’ll eat you in one bite!]
Having acquired all the ingredients, Lee Gun used his Return skill to run away.
The Leo expressed its anger.
[Bastard! Where are you running away? Come to the Divine world right now! I’ll be determined to wait until you come up here!]
Stevens despaired when he saw that his holy ground had been razed to the ground again.
* * *
“Hmph! I see you harvested its mane and nails this time around.”
Lee Gun’s holy ground in Hawaii!
Hugo was dismayed to see the items stacked in front of him. These items that were filling up the workshop were all by-products from the Leo.
‘What sins did Steven’s master commit to deserve this?’
No, it was understandable in some ways. Heaven’s Punishment(EX) was made with the Leo’s fang, and just the sight of the weapon made Lee Gun covet more.
Moreover, the Chalice would make the Zodiac’s fur and teeth grow back sturdier. If one looked at the result, the Leo had benefited too.
On the other hand…
“You kidnapped disciples this time?” Hugo looked at the Leo disciples, who were shaking next to Lee Gun.
One of them Puffin. Lee Gun considered Puffin to have useful skills. So he had tried to bring him from the site where Stevens had lost in three seconds.
Aside from Puffin, this batch had a couple more useful high-rank disciples. They were the ones who wanted to enter Lee Gun’s temple in the past.
“Well, I have no idea if Sungjae will pass them or not. However, we need basic combatants.”
Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement. Lee Gun usually didn’t covet disciples. On the other hand, the ones he brought had the chance of reaching Saint rank. He had personally judged their abilities. It would allow him to grow his temple, and it would benefit Lee Gun greatly.
‘But why so suddenly??’
Moreover, why did he use the Leo as a source of ingredients? Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement.
‘Is it because he saw what happened twenty-four years ago through the general?’
Suddenly, Lee Gun looked at Hugo’s hand. “How’s your hand? Is it ok?”
“Ah! This?” Hugo looked at his bandaged left hand.
When the Divine status of Death had gone on a rampage, Hugo had grabbed Lee Gun’s shoulder. He had brushed against the power of Death. His hand had started to crumble away as the power of Death had tried to eat his left hand. Super Regeneration was used to heal it, but the hand had yet to fully heal.
Hugo just laughed. “Don’t worry about it! I was reckless and got hurt. Also, it won’t impede me from shooting my bow. Unlike you, I’m not left-handed.”
“I’m sorry, and thank you!”
For a moment, Hugo thought he had heard wrong. Did he just hear Lee Gun say sorry? The Archer Saint was shocked.
Lee Gun continued, “Anyway, thanks to you— What the hell are you doing?”
Deeply moved, Hugo leaned against the wall as he massaged his face. “No. Don’t worry about it! It is like Sungjae and Yooha pinning a carnation on me. I feel a similar emotion.”
Lee Gun was baffled. It was to be expected.
[Faith of Hugo Otis has increased.]
[Faith of Hugo Otis has increased.]
Seeing this, Lee Gun said, “Taeksoo.”
“Yes, Gun. Speak more. I’ll listen to whatever you have to say.”
“I want to fix your hand, but it’ll be a bit too difficult right now.”
“!”
Of course, Lee Gun was telling the truth.
‘Super Regeneration was a skill under Life.’
And currently, Lee Gun’s Divine status of Death was higher than that of Life. That was why Hugo’s wound wasn’t fully healed.
Of course, the affiliate Zodiacs were amazed that the hand had healed that much. It was an incredible feat. They thought highly of Super Regeneration, but Lee Gun was unsatisfied.
‘I have to grow the Divine status of Life.’
If the Divine status of Life leveled up, he would be able to access skills categorized under Life. It would allow his skills like Super Regeneration to grow in power. He would be able to evolve them.
In reality, the skills under the category of Death had gotten more powerful when he had reached the second stage of the Divine status of Death.
Above all else, he had developed a new skill, “Reaper Summon.”
“It seems I’ll have to develop my Divine status of Life if I want to heal you fully.”
Having both Divine statuses developed when fighting the monarchs would also be preferable.
“To level up the Divine status of Life, I’ll have to make something of high quality.”
“You have to make something of high quality?”
“Yes. I need to do something related to life if I want to level up Life… Anyway, it reacts to my Manufacturing skill. I’ll probably be able to level up using that.”
“!”
Was this the reason he had briefly visited and returned from the Leo Saint’s holy ground? Good ingredients meant a higher probability of a higher rank item coming out. Moreover, it somewhat made sense why Manufacturing was related to life.
The items Lee Gun manufactured had a sense of self. A new life was born.
‘I can see why it is related to Life.’
Lee Gun continued, “Recently, the special rank that satisfied Life was formed when I made Heaven’s Punishment and the Prosthetic Arm.”
He had confirmed it when he saw his ability log, though he had no idea why these two weapons had influenced the Divine status of Life’s stage.
“Anyway, I plan on upgrading your weapons to the EX rank. I gathered a lot of ingredients that’ll allow me to do so.”
Hugo was moved. If Yooha had said she wanted to marry her dad, Hugo would have felt a similar emotion.
What Lee Gun was talking about was the EX rank!
Hugo had been jealous when he had seen Heaven’s Punishment, yet Lee Gun would make an EX-rank item for him too!
[Faith of Hugo Otis has increased by a massive amount.]
[Faith of Hugo Otis is increasing crazily.]
“That is why I want to ask you this. Do you want me to make you a prosthetic arm?”
The moved Hugo flinched.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he grabbed Hugo’s shoulder. “If it is bothering you, I can change it right now.”
Spark flew from Hugo’s eyes when he realized what Lee Gun meant. “You shouldn’t joke about something like that!”
[Hatred of Hugo Otis has increased.]
[It is affecting Faith.]
Lee Gun laughed as if he was joking. “Anyway, I’ll fix your hand in no time. Don’t worry about it.”
Hugo said it was fine as he expressed his anger.
On the other hand, Lee Gun nodded when he checked Hugo’s faith. It was as he planned.
[Hugo Otis’s Faith: 450%]
‘Good! That’s the sweet spot.’
It wasn’t the sweet spot at all, but Lee Gun had a reason for doing this. High faith was advantageous to him, but at the same time, it also meant the disciple was willing to sacrifice their life for the Zodiac.
The increase in faith was good, but if it went up too much, Lee Gun wondered if the disciple would put the Zodiac over his family.
‘That can’t happen. He has a family.’
A Faith of that magnitude would be fine for his friend.
‘I think my Divine status of Life will increase if I make one more EX-rank.’
At that moment, as if it had heard Lee Gun’s conversation…
[The Sagittarius says it has a very good idea on how to raise the stage of Life.]
[The Sagittarius says wouldn’t Life increase if Lee Gun healed his two problems.]
Lee Gun snorted. Really?
Still, it was worth a try, so he was about to hand over the Chalice to Hugo, but…
Boom!
The ground suddenly started to shake.
[A monarch rank has revealed itself.]
At the same time, Lee Gun heard a notification.
[“Death” is trying to talk to you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Divine Status of Life (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Divine Status of Life (2)
[“Death” is trying to talk to you.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round at the unexpected notification. Death? Was his Divine status trying to talk to him?
As if to prove this, black magical energy emanated from his body as though it wanted to be seen. The magical energy looked like black smoke, with eyes shaped like half-moons. It also had a mouth that looked ripped, like the mask from Scream.
This surprised Lee Gun.
‘Divine status has a sense of self?’
Of course, the items he made possessed a sense of self, so this shouldn’t be too surprising. However, he wondered why this ego had appeared right now.
[It says that when you evolved the Divine status of Death to the second stage, it was able to express its will.]
[Divine status is the Serpent Bearer itself, so it cannot threaten the Serpent Bearer’s life at a fundamental level. But if it is abandoned, it might run amok and go astray. It gives a warning.]
[However, Divine status can grow faster if its advice is followed. You will be able to grasp how to use the power.]
Lee Gun had a rough idea of what was going on. In simple words, the black light that was sloshing inside him had developed a personality.
Sometimes, he had to ponder which power to use. He also had to undergo trial and error to learn how to develop his powers. If he could communicate with the powers, it would be beneficial to him.
On the other hand, the Zodiacs were mystified by this scene.
[The Leo asks if you were finally able to encounter your Divine status. It sneers with no teeth.]
[The Leo says it already brought its Divine status to its knees. It boasts.]
To check if its fur was growing, Lee Gun had removed the screen for Leo. It had appeared with the Virgo.
[The Virgo says the Leo didn’t bring it to its knees. It is an idiot that killed its Divine status. That is why it stopped growing in power. The Virgo laughs mockingly.]
[Moreover, she has never seen a Divine status take such a form, so she finds it interesting.]
[The meeting between the gods and their Divine status is rare and precious. The meeting is supposed to happen only in dreams.]
[When the Virgo’s interest rose, the reputation of your Temple rose.]
It seemed gods fought within themselves when they encountered their power, and the matter resolved itself only when the gods matured.
On the other hand, the appearance of Lee Gun’s power was clearly different. It appeared in reality instead of in dreams or specific spaces. A Zodiac taking interest in it was understandable.
In stark contrast to the others, the Sagittarius looked enraged.
[The Sagittarius angrily asks, “Why is Death suddenly interfering?”]
[The Sagittarius doesn’t care about something like that. It wants to talk to Life.]
[The Sagittarius is desperate, saying the Serpent Bearer has to grow Life.]
This made Death step forward. It felt like Death was trying to block the Chalice from going to the Sagittarius.
[Death whispers the monarch-ranks have shown themselves.]
[Death laughs. “It is impossible to win against the Monarchs with Life.”]
Lee Gun scoffed. It was as Death had said. He could feel the energy of the monarch-ranks, which he had never felt before. Of course, they weren’t close.
Although Lee Gun didn’t know their exact location, he could feel their presence, like he could sense the Zodiacs. It was as if the Monarchs had suddenly appeared on the earth from a different dimension.
Moreover, Death knew very well that Lee Gun gnashed his teeth when anything related to the Zodiacs and Monarchs came up. Death’s eyes slanted upward.
[Death says you should choose it. The Serpent Bearer is an amazing god of calamity that has already claimed hundreds of millions of lives.]
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. Hundreds of millions of lives?
‘Is it talking about what happened within the Devil’s Tower?’
No, it couldn’t be. Even if the tower had kept resetting, Lee Gun didn’t think the number would have reached that high.
Death smirked.
[The incident happened recently, so it wonders how you could forget about that. It says you extinguished very precious lives.]
Lee Gun got even more confused. Precious lives? Recently? “I really don’t know when you put it that way.”
Suddenly, a powerful pillar of fire erupted at the side.
[The Sagittarius is furious. He asks how you could forget what was done to him.]
Ah! Lee Gun did a double-take. When it said hundreds of millions of precious lives, was it referring to that?
It seemed the Sagittarius had been trying to be respectful until now since he was an affiliate. However, his patience had clearly come to an end. The Zodiac warned Lee Gun not to move toward Death.
[The Sagittarius says you must grow Life.]
[He pleads, saying if you want to heal his Zodiac Saint’s hand, Life is the only path forward.]
[He says the only one who can revive his dead babies is Headmaster.]
It was true. Lee Gun couldn’t completely heal Hugo’s hand. Death kept eroding the head, so Hailey had used the power of Time to stop the time of Death. She had to clean up after him. This was also why Lee Gun needed Life.
However, Death just laughed in derision.
[It says you should choose Death. It says your friend’s hand can be saved without growing Life.]
[There is no way Life and Death can co-exist. Death warns it cannot be grown if Life is grown.]
[That is why it says it’ll tell you of a way to fix your friend without growing Life.]
Lee Gun wondered what that method was.
[A mere hand should be cut and killed. He won’t be able to feel any pain forever. It says that will solve everything.]
Lee Gun became angry. He wanted to hit this bastard.
When the light in Lee Gun’s eyes suddenly changed, Death flinched. Did it realize its opponent was formidable or did it not want to be hated by Lee Gun? Death gave a warning.
[Two Divine statuses cannot exist together. If you don’t focus on one, it would be bad for the Serpent Bearer.]
At the same time, the black smoke got bigger. It was Lee Gun’s power, so it was closer to Lee Gun than anyone. It also knew a lot about Lee Gun, so Death started laughing slyly.
[If it is chosen, it will be able to revive the dead.]
[It states you have someone you want to revive.]
The light of Death continued to get bigger as it started to eat away at Lee Gun’s body. Since it had leveled up, controlling it had become harder.
The firewood ax (stage 1) on Lee Gun’s waist felt the ominous power. Heaven’s Punishment flinched.
[Heaven’s Punishment says this power is dangerous, and it calls out to its master.]
[Heaven’s Punishment is anxious when its owner doesn’t reply.]
[Heaven’s Punishment reveals hostility toward Death.]
[Heaven’s Punishment was given an attribute.]
[Attribute of Heaven’s Punishment: Life]
Heaven’s Punishment wasn’t the only one to respond.
[The Sagittarius says he knew this power would be dangerous. He’ll seal it before it can grow further. The Sagittarius emits his energy.]
Suddenly, a red light surged forth from Hugo’s body. It was the descent of a Zodiac! Hugo’s eyes turned golden.
Heaven’s Punishment was about to change its form when…
Boom!
Lee Gun extended his hand and grabbed the black smoke as if he wanted to pop it.
Kwahng!!
The face, which looked like the Scream mask, was in Lee Gun’s hands.
[Death is surprised.]
[If it is chosen, it can…]
“Looks like I have to mentally train you. I’ll show you who is the master.”
Pahng!
Death exploded in Lee Gun’s hand.
[The morale of Death has died.]
[Death says it’ll submit for now.]
[But, it asks that you awaken the Zodiac Saint of Death instead of the Zodiac Saint of Life.]
[Slaughter is needed if Death is to be elevated.]
[Since Death and Life cannot coexist, it warns that raising both abilities at the same time will be very hard.]
[It must…]
Since the Divine status was speaking too much, Lee Gun melted the Scream face into a black goop.
The process was easy. Life was the opposite of Death. The magical energy of life could dampen the energy of death.
The skill that represented Life for Lee Gun was manufacturing (creation), and he used that skill
[Creation Workshop]
When the warm green magical energy touched it, the Scream face despaired.
[The manufacturing skill has been used to change the shape of the subject.]
The Manufacture skill was used to change the Scream face into a dog chew! And the dog chew now floated around Lee Gun.
Hugo… No, the Sagittarius looked relieved when he saw this. By the looks of it, Lee Gun seemed to plan on developing Life?
Splash!
Lee Gun poured the content of the healing Chalice on top of Hugo’s head.
‘!’
The water of the Chalice started to show its efficacy!
[Super Regeneration was added to make this water.]
[When combined with the tonic of the Chalice, it has shown surprising efficacy.]
[The Chalice has regenerated several things.]
[The Sagittarius’s two dead places have regained their function and become sturdier.]
The Sagittarius was moved. Things had worked to his design since he had borrowed Hugo’s body. When the water was sprayed on Hugo’s body, the Sagittarius also felt the benefit of the water alongside his Zodiac Saint.
[The Sagittarius is ecstatic.]
[As expected of Headmaster! He says you’re a much better healing Zodiac than the Aquarius.]
[An achievement has been added to the bible.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s reputation has increased.]
[Temple EXP has increased.]
[It won’t be long before the stage of Life increases.]
Lee Gun was satisfied. Although he had half doubted it, the Sagittarius’s idea seemed correct. However, that wasn’t enough.
Lee Gun put forth a ring as he wagged a finger. The ring was the control ring that allowed him to hold back the power of a Zodiac!
[Black Ring that eats divine magical energy (SSS)]
– Divine magical energy is consumed and stored until the stomach is full.
– Using it as a temporary control system is possible.
Lee Gun had made another ring. It was similar to the ring that acted as a limiter for his power.
He said, “Since you’re inside Taeksoo, the water of the Chalice isn’t as effective. I want to pour it directly on you. Wear this and descend here.”
[!]
“Don’t be moved too much. I’m healing you because you whine so much. Moreover, I don’t like half-measures. It isn’t in my personality”
The Sagittarius was at a loss for words. This was already enough, yet Lee Gun decided to do more. Moreover, with the ring, the Zodiac could descend without destroying the environment. Knowing this, the Sagittarius took the ring. He left Hugo’s body.
[The Sagittarius has descended to the earth.]
Accompanying a light, a shadow appeared.
Koo-goo-goong!
The face couldn’t be seen clearly, but at a glance, this figure possessed a tall and stocky body. If one had to guess, the shadow was probably a handsome Zodiac.
[The power of the Chalice has been used.]
[Your affinity is tilting toward Life.]
[Death is sad.]
Was it because he was the god of the sun? The halo effect made it hard to see the Sagittarius’s face. The Zodiac spoke.
[Yes. The power of Death isn’t good for several reasons. Growing it in conjunction is hard. You should abandon it early on—]
Suddenly…
Boom!!
[You have used the Divine status of Death.]
[?!!]
As if to mock the Sagittarius, the black power surged forth! Finally, the power of Death hit the Zodiac in the worst places.
Kwahng!
The shocked Zodiac retreated. It wouldn’t hinder him in fights, but the parts important to his pride were affected again!
[The Sagittarius asks what you are doing!]
“What do you think I’m doing? I’ll revive and kill. I’ll be able to grow both Divine statuses this way.” Lee Gun smirked. There was no way he would throw away the Divine status of Death. He seemed to have planned on doing this from the start.
As if to reassure the Sagittarius, Lee Gun immediately activated his Super Regeneration skill. The light changed into flames, and it flew toward the Zodiac. “Don’t worry about it. I’ll heal it all in three seconds.”
At that moment…
“!”
Lee Gun flinched as he turned his head.
Hugo sighed as he furrowed his brows. He wanted Lee Gun to hurry up and heal the Sagittarius. “Gun? What’s going on?”
However, Lee Gun didn’t even answer as he disappeared in an instant. Hugo was truly surprised. “Gun?!”
The Sagittarius reacted in fright when he didn’t receive his treatment.
* * *
Downtown Seoul…
Goat sweated as he watched three people emanate sharp magical energy.
“So Noona wrote this.” Chun Sungjae looked at Carly as he held up a paper.
It was a rare sight, but Carly was surprised. It was because of the paper. This paper was the one that she had received from the Secretary for the interview. She didn’t know how Chun Sungjae got his hands on it, but the problem was the content of that paper.
[Q. What do you think about Lee Gun-nim?]
[I’ll marry dad. I’ll marry dad. I’ll marry dad. I’ll marry dad. I’ll marry dad. I’ll marry dad. I’ll marry dad.]
