Carly’s eyebrows twitched. She wondered why her answer was written that way.
The Chun siblings had already found out the truth about this questionnaire through the Scorpio Saint. Their eyes flashed. They knew the power of Lee Gun’s fountain pen better than anyone.
In strict terms, Carly wasn’t human, and her upbringing was unique. However, they couldn’t overlook this as fans of their uncle.
In the beginning, they had started with a respectful conversation. However, they had all fought each other to become Lee Gun’s Zodiac Saint for a reason. In the end, they spoke about things that shouldn’t be mentioned to each other. Their hairs became abristle.
“Do you really think you guys are fit to be the Zodiac Saints of Lee Gun-nim? If I’m being blunt, you guys are weaker than me!”
“Who are you calling weak?”
“You might be a clone Uncle accepted, but I disagree! You should maintain a safe distance from him!”
“A brat like you should stay out of this! Also, you’re a male!”
“Damn it! Then I… I will…!” Chun Sungjae hated losing. This was why he was about to rent a certain spell from the Gemini temple.
However, Goat quickly got a hold of him. “Sungjae! Not that magic! Your father will really faint!” He was sure it was the sex change spell.
In the end, Goat separated the trio, who were about to go to war with each other. Nevertheless, these three knew not to mix business with pleasure. So Goat wasn’t too worried, but…
‘Can these three become friends?’
Clank!
They were here to buy items Lee Gun had requested, and they were about to head out of the store.
Boom!
They flinched when they felt the sudden earthquake.
Doo-doo-doo!
It wasn’t a normal energy. At the same time, they heard a familiar voice.
[Use Teleport!]
It was their uncle’s voice.
At the same time, the light of the Serpent Bearer started spreading across Seoul. However, it seemed he was a bit too late.
“We are trapped!”
A suspicious barrier made it impossible for the group to leave.
Kwahng!
“Goat!”
Suddenly, Goat, an SS-rank disciple, was sent flying. Shocked, the other three looked at the one responsible for that.
“You guys were here.”
It was a monarch.

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Divine Status of Life (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Divine Status of Life (3)
Boom!
The ground shook. Then, Hugo, who was still at Lee Gun’s workshop, felt as if he were suffocated. He felt as if something had grabbed his hands and feet and was dragging him to the center of the earth in an instant. It was an enormous power.
This surprised him.
‘This feeling…’
It was the same feeling he had sensed when the unknown civilization had invaded once again. This powerful sensation was felt when the helmeted man had invaded and declared war on humanity.
Of course, it wasn’t the energy of the helmeted general. The helmeted general had been absurdly powerful, but Hugo had felt a presence that had been monitoring the helmeted general from the background. That presence had felt very far away, and it had never revealed itself.
However, their Zodiacs and Hailey spoke about these beings. Monarchs were the heads of the enemy forces.
Like they had temples on this side, the other side had something called the Hordes. They were an existence that could dominate the Zodiacs.
And Hugo could sense the monarch-rank energy right now. Moreover, it wasn’t a simple presence like before.
‘It came to this land.’
This was a creepy feeling where one felt like one’s soul and innards were being sucked out through a straw. This was why Hugo felt fear.
He could sense that the energy wasn’t coming from a nearby place. It was far away on a continent across the ocean. And just looking in that direction elicited disgust. It was a bizarre feeling.
Hugo suddenly had an understanding. “That is why Gun went away!”
Lee Gun had disappeared toward the location of this power. When it came to monsters, he was quick like a shark that smelled blood in the water.
[The Sagittarius despairs.]
[One second would have been enough. He should have healed him before leaving. The Sagittarius is in pain.]
Hugo got angry when he saw his master despair and drop to the ground. “Damn it! You damn god! Please!”
Why were all the Zodiacs, Lee Gun included, like this?
‘If the disciples find out what the gods are like, the faith will plunge.’
Did they not realize how much work the disciples had to put in to keep them deified?
It didn’t matter in the end.
Hugo looked at the Sagittarius, who was surrounded by flames, and angrily said, “I’ll tell Gun to make you a wig! Please don’t do this!”
[The Sagittarius says it’s useless. He is sad.]
[The Serpent Bearer is the god of calamity that ruthlessly killed hundreds of millions of its children.]
“Damn it! Really?” Hugo was about to say something else.
Flash!
“!”
However, a red light suddenly flashed in front of his eyes.
[Your attack has increased.]
[Your defense has increased.]
[Your speed has increased.]
[You have received 14 buffs.]
Hugo was surprised.
‘This cheapskate god gave so many buffs?’
Moreover, the Zodiac normally gave Hugo useless skills like Sing Well. And these were all pure battle skills.
Seeing his Zodiac Saint’s surprised gaze, the Sagittarius tried to look cool. It stood up.
[He doesn’t want you to go, but he knows you will go where Lee Gun went.]
[The Sagittarius does not want you to die, so it has given you various things.]
[He warns in a dashing manner, saying the decomposing left hand shouldn’t be used.]
A troubled expression appeared on Hugo’s face as he looked at his Zodiac, who was trying to act cool.
‘As expected, he needs a wig.’
He was the god of the sun, and the sunlight was being reflected on his bald head. Hugo had a hard time looking at the Zodiac with his eyes open. Unaware of this, the Sagittarius continued to act dashing as he warned Hugo.
[He says a monarch lives next to the divine world.]
[The monarchs are the kings of the hordes, and even the Zodiacs have a tough time handling them.]
[He says this is why you shouldn’t go…]
Hugo told the Sagittarius to put on a wig as he turned around. He was about to move when he received a call from his subordinate.
Hugo immediately answered the call. “Hey, Jaewon. Did you locate the exact source?”
Lee Jaewon was capable of reading the flow of magical energy from the monsters. He could read even human emotions from the flow, so it was easy for him to find where the boss was.
Hugo used to drag Lee Jaewon around twenty years ago for a reason. He had done it despite Lee Jaewon basically being a civilian at the time.
– Yes. I have sent it to you, Saint-nim. I’m heading there right now. However, Goat is already there.
“Goat? That’s great. Gun will be going to him soon.”
Lee Gun was the type of person to boldly charge through the front door. He tried to bait the enemies to attack only him. It was how he minimized casualties.
“Tell him to support Gun instead of me…”
– I had the same thought, but I couldn’t contact him. I’m pretty sure he is with Sungjae and Yooha—
“!”
Lee Jaewon was about to finish his words when…
Kwahng!
The sound of the phone falling rang alongside the loud noise.
“Jaewon!” Hugo hadn’t even heard a scream. Only a dreadful silence passed through the phone. Then, a sound came from his badge.
[Lee Jaewon’s sign of life has disappeared.]
“…!” Hugo’s steps became desperate.
* * *
Chun Sungjae and Chun Yooha turned their heads in shock.
“Goat!”
Goat had crashed into a building and fallen to the ground. That wasn’t the only surprising part.
“Goat!”
A copious amount of blood leaked out of Goat’s limp body.
In a rarity, even Carly was taken aback.
‘His organs are damaged…!’
Goat was an SS-rank disciple like them. He was one of the ten stars. An attack by a red-rank monster could merely scratch his body. Moreover, his body’s stats were high. Amongst the Ten Stars, his Defense stat was considered to be SS+. He was considered to be at the top.
Therefore, his bleeding so profusely meant that this was out of the ordinary.
At a glance, they could see his wounds weren’t the ordinary kind. They could see what looked like innards falling out of his stomach.
“Sungjae!” Intending to be the bait, Yooha summoned her spear.
Chun Sungjae was about to use Teleport to bring Goat to him.
Boom!
“…!”
However, both the siblings froze when they felt the killing intent. They felt as if the killing intent was pressing down on their bodies, and they couldn’t use their skills.
Realizing the reason for this, the Chun siblings were shocked.
“Oh my! I sent the wrong one flying.”
The one who had sent Goat flying was standing behind them. In fact, they hadn’t noticed its movement at all.
“You’re so small that I hit an entirely different target.”
“…!”
They turned their heads at the same time. The sight left them shocked. The one they saw was Chun Jiwoo, their mother. They wondered what was going on, but they soon felt the menacing murderous intent.
‘…!!!’
That’s right. She wasn’t Chun Jiwoo.
‘It used its transformation ability to trick the dome. That is how it got in.’
A transformation ability of this caliber could be carried out only through the power of the Pisces.
Of course, that wasn’t odd at all. Just a while ago, the unknown civilization’s generals had used it to deceive and enter the barrier of the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground.
‘That means it must be on the side of Abundance…!’
And the situation was as they expected.
The being said, “I borrowed a body to grow my new generals. It seems I made the right choice in coming to the earth myself.”
Its eyes menacingly narrowed. They were the eyes of a beast. “The four of you will become nutrients for my generals.”
They became certain. It had come here aiming for them.
‘The one Uncle killed was the general.’
That meant…
‘Could it be a monarch?’
Taken aback, Sungjae monitored the barrier around him. “Teleport” and “Return” didn’t work within the barrier.
They were trapped within the barrier made by the monarch. As if to confirm this, a voice rang out.
[It is a world completely isolated from the outside. Not even a god cannot enter from outside.]
[One would have to destroy the barrier.]
They had guessed right. Even Lee Gun would be unable to enter this place.
‘!’
Chun Sungjae flinched. Killing intent!
“You will be dead like him. Just wait.”
Chun Jiwoo was about to raise her hand as she laughed when…
Kwahng!
“!”
An arrow planted itself at Chun Jiwoo’s feet.
When the being looked around in surprise, an angry voice rang not too far away.
“You didn’t kill me…!”
“Goat!”
The bloody Goat was clutching at his stomach as he got up. Moreover, a green light was circulating his body.
[You have received the blessing of the Serpent Bearer.]
[Super Regeneration(S) has been activated for the affiliate disciple.]
The Chun siblings let out sighs of relief.
On the other hand, Goat looked furious as the wound in his stomach healed slowly. “It dares to put on the face of Madam…!”
Was that the reason he had been defenseless as he was sent flying?
“…!!!”
Boom!
The three of them felt as if their heads were being pressed into the cement.
“Huhk…!”
They could barely lift their eyes to look at the monarch, and they felt as if their hearts were shriveling.
“The Super Regeneration ability always bothers me when I see it.”
The monarch’s face was devoid of emotion. There was neither any expression nor any warmth, only arrogance, contempt, and disgust.
The group faced the monarch’s power. Chun Sungjae had genius-level perception, so he could feel the power difference. Chun Yooha possessed the natural instinct of a wild animal, and she could feel it as well. Carly possessed Lee Gun’s DNA, so her senses were better than everyone.
They all realized it at the same time.
‘We’re going to die.’
That wasn’t all.
[You guys are mere food, yet you’re being very offensive.]
As the monarch laughed, heaven and earth started to shake.
[Abundance that harvests Life.]
Suddenly, screams erupted from their surroundings.
“Ahhk!”
“Kuh-huhk!”
It was a power that could extract souls.
[If I can’t kill you by injuring you, I just have to extract life itself.]
Souls appeared out of the mouths of everyone in the long strands.
When the monarch extended its hand, an enormous black scythe appeared in its hand!
The Abundance general had also used this technique, but the power was on a different level in a monarch’s hands. The range of the skill covered the entire city!
Kwah-jeek!
Souls instantly surged into the air.
The Abundance monarch was about to eat all of them, but…
[Serpent Eater (SS)]
[!]
A green light captured the souls heading toward the monarch. The one to grab the souls using the green light was Chun Sungjae.
“Koohk…!”
The other members of the Ten Stars had their souls extracted, but Sungjae was able to delay it with the help of the Fairy Monarch with him. Then there was the Serpent Eater skill.
Originally, this skill was a special attribute that couldn’t be changed into a skill even with the consent of a Zodiac. However, Chun Sungjae monitored Lee Gun 24/7. His obsession, combined with the Genius attribute, had made it possible.
Sungjae had joined his power with the Fairy King, and he was barely able to stop the souls from going to the monarch.
[The souls have been returned to where they came from.]
[Chun Sungjae has grabbed countless souls heading toward death.]
[The Divine status of Life has reacted to Chun Sungjae.]
Goat, Carly, and Chun Yooha coughed as they turned and raised their gazes at the same time.
This made the monarch laugh in contempt.
[You are mere food.]
When the monarch made a slight movement with its hand, Chun Sungjae was instantly caught in its hands.
“Huhk…!”
“Sungjae! Koohk!”
The monarch’s eyes flashed as it grabbed Sungjae’s head.
Just touching the human allowed the monarch to read his personal attributes. It assessed Chun Sungjae’s abilities in a flash.
[You possess a trash attribute. However, the ability will cause much harm to our side if left alone.]
The monarch was talking about Chun Sungjae’s Genius attribute, and its eyes flashed in contempt.
[I’ll have to kill you first.]
A black light surged, and Chun Sungjae’s soul got swallowed into the monarch’s mouth. Life instantly disappeared from Chun Sungjae’s eyes. His body slumped in death.
The monarch laughed.
[A Zodiac Saint’s soul is quite tasty.]
At that moment…
[The Serpent Bearer is approaching.]
Killing intent appeared in Chun Yooha’s eyes.
Koo-goo-goong!
Suddenly, a black light encircled her.
[You will awaken as the Zodiac Saint of Death.]

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Awakening (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Awakening (1)
[You will awaken as the Zodiac Saint of Death.]
The notification rang out in Lee Gun’s voice. It was a voice that only the Serpent Bearer’s disciples could hear.
Normally, a designated Construct in charge of managing the disciples spoke through the badges. However, the temple of the Serpent Bearer was unique in that Lee Gun’s voice rang out directly into the disciples’ heads. It was like a divine message.
Was it because of the voice? Carly, who was suffering from the shock of having her soul pulled out, flinched.
Since the Sagittarius temple was an affiliate of the Serpent Bearer’s temple, Goat could hear the voice, too. He looked at his surroundings in surprise. “What the hell? Is that Lee Gun-nim’s voice?”
Although it was Lee Gun’s voice, the voice was kind and warm. This was the reason for their surprise.
Boom!
The green light emanating from Chun Yooha’s body mixed with the black light and raged. The winds lashed out because of the lights, and breathing became harder.
Carly and Goat were surprised by the familiar energy.
‘That is…!’
It was the power of Death, the power of the god of calamity, which the Zodiacs avoided.
Lee Gun’s power had manifested by borrowing Yooha’s body. The Zodiac Saints possessed bodies capable of doing this.
Because of that, Goat couldn’t close his mouth. Although he hadn’t said it, if he were being honest, he didn’t think there was too much of a difference between the Serpent Bearer’s Zodiac Saints and the Ten Stars(SS) like him. At a basic level, the two Zodiac Saints’ bodies seemed greatly fortified. However…
‘They don’t feel like Zodiac Saints.’
That was why the other Zodiac Saints and the other intermediate-rank awakened beings treated the siblings like novices. A big part also had to do with Sungjae’s appearance. It was why they looked down on them, but it seemed they had it all wrong.
[Death is showing a reaction.]
The thing they had sensed was the absence of the color. It was because the siblings hadn’t awakened yet!
Kwahng!
Goat and Carly almost screamed as the black light surged into the air. It was as if Yooha’s body had been fortified for this moment.
[You have become a vessel that supports the great Serpent Bearer’s “Death.”]
[You have received the power of Death from the Serpent Bearer, and you have awakened.]
[Your magical energy and skills will change into the color of Death.]
[You will develop skills befitting the properties of the Divine status of Death.]
[You have developed attributes.]
[Death is elated that its side awakened its Zodiac Saint.]
[Death says that Life cannot satisfy the Serpent Bearer. Only it can satisfy the Serpent Bearer.]
Unlike the other Zodiacs, the Serpent Bearer was a god that possessed two Divine statuses. It was different from the other Zodiacs, where their Zodiac Saints immediately displayed their color.
When Chun Yooha chose her path, her appearance suddenly changed. Like how Lee Gun’s eyes would turn red when he used his power, Chun Yooha’s eyes changed too. Her black hair fluttered as her red eyes glared at the monarch. She was like a reaper.
This amused the monarch.
[That is quite the useful power.]
Abundance smirked.
The Serpent Bearer was a Zodiac that the Time Monarch was obsessed with. However, for Abundance, the Serpent Bearer was merely a newly born baby snake. This was why it didn’t think the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer would be this powerful.
[I planned on giving this brat’s body as a reward to eat, but I’ve changed my mind.]
Abundance tightened its grip around the soulless Chun Sungjae’s neck.
Crunch!
“Sungjae!”
The sound of the young man’s neck bone being broken rang out.
Goat was shocked. He wanted to retrieve Sungjae’s body, but the monarch wasn’t an easy opponent.
Boom!
“Koo-oohk!!”
Its menacing power descended.
They felt as if they were being crushed to death. From head to toe, they felt as if their internal organs were being pressed down. This wasn’t a skill. It was pure overwhelming power! The horrifying part was the sensation touching their skin.
Coldness! It was fear. They felt as if the cold hands of corpses were touching all over their body.
Goat, Carly, and Yooha couldn’t move their bodies in front of this power.
The monarch’s face changed as if it had finally decided to come out.
Kwah-jeek!
The kind eyes of Chun Jiwoo changed into the eyes of a monster. Then, the monarch’s appearance changed from Chun Jiwoo to Chun Sungjae. It seemed capable of changing its face according to the souls it ate.
[If you’re Death, this brat is Life?]
Abundance opened its wicked mouth. In truth, the monarch wasn’t interested in Chun Yooha’s power of Death. This was to be expected since Abundance was in charge of producing monsters. It was the monarch that increased the number of monsters and developed their abilities.
In many ways, Abundance was a monarch that had a plan. There was no way it would look kindly at the attribute of Death, which was the entire opposite of what it grew. In fact, it was more interested in Life!
[This Zodiac Saint’s body is infused with the power of Life. It’ll allow me to get stronger.]
Abundance had lost all its generals. It planned on using the body of the Zodiac Saint to make new generals.
The normal disciples were low rank, but the power of their Zodiacs was embedded all over their bodies. On the other hand, the meat of a Zodiac Saint could be considered top-shelf. It would be enough to create a general.
The monarch grabbed Chun Sungjae like a piece of meat for convenience. It was about to take a bite out of the flesh when…
Kwah-jeek!
A black light surged forth.
Flash!
As if it didn’t want to be bothered, the monarch jumped on top of the four-story building with Chun Sungjae.
Chun Yooha’s eyes flashed as she jumped as well.
Kwahng!
When they saw this, Carly and Goat had a realization.
‘She can’t do it alone.’
Her opponent was a monarch. They hadn’t known it before, but when it started to emit its power, they had realized their opponent was on a different level.
‘Zodiac rank!’
They were sure of it when they saw the power difference. A newly awakened Zodiac Saint’s attack wouldn’t work against it.
A streak of light landed in front of the monarch.
Kwahk!
The red-eyed reaper appeared in front of it again. Her demeanor said that she wanted to kill it even if it touched her brother with its fingertip. She swung her spear.
Flash!
The spear moved at a terrifying speed that fit the name lightning! That wasn’t all. As if it had sensed its owner’s anger, Crimson Earth’s Judgment, which Lee Gun had made especially for her, let out a fierce roar.
[Crimson Earth’s Judgment has changed its appearance through the Divine status of Death.]
[Crimson Earth’s Judgment has evolved into its second stage.]
The black light surrounded the spear blade, and the weapon suddenly folded in a different direction. Then it elongated to look like a scythe.
As he had done to Heaven’s Punishment, Lee Gun had made sure the spear had the property of transformation.
[Crimson Earth’s Judgment exhibits the Serpent Bearer’s “Death.”]
The transformed spear came crashing toward the monarch.
Kwah-jeek!
Killing intent oozed from the black semicircle. Speed, destructive power, and location! Everything was perfect as the black semicircle collided with the monarch’s body.
Kwahng!
The monarch in the form of Chun Sungjae got surrounded by the black light. The monarch lost grip on Sungjae, and Sungjae’s body fell from the sky.
Since the height was significant, the body could get damaged. Therefore, Goat quickly whistled, despite not being able to use his body.
Hweek!
Fire exploded next to him!
Puhng!
A black figure appeared in the exploding flame.
Shweek!
It was a crow. The enormous crow of the Sagittarius temple flew into the sky and intercepted Chun Sungjae.
The monarch didn’t want to lose the body of a Zodiac Saint, so it unleashed its black power. However, that was useless.
Pahng!
Carly used her ability and offset the black power.
The Golden Rule was a technique that could return an attack’s power to its sender. Of course, the ability wasn’t something she could use freely. The price she had to pay was dependent on how strong her opponent was.
‘Hahh!’
Carly pressed down on her shoulder. However, it seemed her efforts were enough.
The crow dodged the monarch’s attack and dropped the body toward Goat.
Plop!
“Sungjae!”
The SS-rank Archer disciple quickly received and held Chun Sungjae in his arms. Goat flinched as his body trembled. Chun Sungjae was limp like a doll, his heart still.
However, Super Regeneration had fully healed his broken neck bone. The only thing the body lacked was his soul.
‘If Lee Gun-nim were here, he could do something about this.’
There was no way Lee Gun would have let his Zodiac Saint die.
[That was surprising. Not bad.]
“!”
Goat trembled as he watched the monarch walk toward them.
“Koo-oohk…!”
Chun Yooha was caught in the monarch’s hand.
[Weakness grown by Abundance!]
The debuff skill didn’t work directly against the unconstrained Abundance.
Despite being held by her neck, Chun Yooha gnashed her teeth as she used the power of Death.
Koo-goo-goong!
This made the monarch furrow its brows, and it threw Chun Yooha.
Kwahng!!
“Miss Yooha!”
As if it was really annoyed, the monarch sent Chun Yooha and Carly to its pocket dimension.
Kwah-jeek!
In the end, the only one left in front of it was Goat.
Goat’s body shook when he met eyes with the monster. He remembered the incident with Chun Jiwoo. If he could somehow get the soul, Lee Gun could solve this problem.
Last time, Lee Gun had bisected the stomach of the toad monster to extract the souls. Goat wondered if Lee Gun could do something similar this time. However…
‘Damn it! How do I take back the soul?’
After taking a stab from Yooha’s scythe, the monarch was emanating a more menacing energy. Moreover, its body had returned to its original state even after being sliced by Death. Of course, this wasn’t regeneration.
[Abundance has produced its body once again.]
Abundance was the monarch that produced the monster army. It could also endlessly proliferate its own body. Missing parts could be replaced by producing more parts.
If its heart was gone, the monarch just had to add and connect another heart. If its leg was gone, another leg could be made and attached once again.
Of course, the monarch’s outer appearance looked more monstrous. However, that wasn’t important now.
‘I can’t even run away.’
The monarch wanted the body of the Zodiac Saint. Even if Goat somehow escaped, it would continue to track them down.
That was why Goat was in a bind. He wanted to find another method, but the barrier was a problem.
‘Shit! The Zodiacs won’t be able to enter this place unless the barrier can be broken.’
The Zodiac Saints as well as the Zodiacs couldn’t approach this particular area. Although Goat’s perception wasn’t as good as Lee Gun’s, he was an SS-rank disciple of the Sagittarius temple. He could sense it if anyone was nearby.
‘I do not feel Lee Gun-nim’s energy….’
Of course, there was no way Lee Gun would have missed a monster invasion of this size. He wasn’t one to remain a spectator.
The fact that Goat couldn’t feel Lee Gun’s energy made it likely that Lee Gun was hiding his power as he approached them. However, Lee Gun hadn’t shown up in front of them. That meant…
‘He isn’t able to enter this place because of the barrier.’
So, Goat couldn’t expect help. The monarch wanted Sungjae’s body, so it would keep coming after them. That was also the reason it had put up this barrier. No one could enter or leave this place.
‘We’ll die here today.’
If he had known this would happen, he would have confessed his love. Goat’s hands were shaking, but he took a firm grip on Sungjae. There was no way he would let Sungjae go.
[Alright. If you hand him over, I’ll spare all of you.]
“…?!” The surprised Goat looked at the monarch.
[I’ll give you the head. Leave the rest. The head is the tastiest part, but I’ll allow you to have it for the funeral.]
“…!”
The monarch’s eyes curved in mirth when it saw Goat’s expression.
[What? I think it’s an incredible offer. He’s a corpse now. If you give me the body, I’ll let you live. A scaredy-cat should act like a scaredy-cat. Get your ass over here!]
Goat’s eyes became bloodshot. “How dare you!”
He was about to charge forward as he emitted the magical energy of the Sagittarius. However…
Koo-goo-goong!
“!”
As if to shut everyone up, Chun Yooha appeared, having sliced through the space with her scythe.
The monarch was taken aback. It wondered how she was able to break through its pocket dimension.
‘This feeling…!’
Although this feeling was masked by the smell of death, the smell of the Space-time monarch was there.
The monarch was proven right.
[Regardless of the place and the time, Death swallows space.]
[Everything is equal in front of Death.]
[Death can dominate and pass through places that it perceives as space.]
[The Zodiac Saint of Death is indiscriminate when it comes to space. She can cross through any space.]
In other words, Yooha just needed the power of Space, which belonged to Death. She was like a reaper where even her physical body could pass through space.
The monarch laughed in contempt.
[Do I have to rip away your legs to stop you from coming at me like a flea?]
The monarch was about to split Chun Yooha into two as she charged toward it, but…
Flash!
Suddenly, a light exploded forth from the monarch’s body.
[…!]
It was none other than the power of Life!
[Life is surging forth.]
A light welled up inside the monarch’s mouth. The light was a warm green light with some golden light infused in it!
The monarch felt tormented as the light surged up inside it. This light agonized the monarch.
Chun Yooha, who had been emanating killing intent, flinched at the sight of this light.
‘Uncle?’
She was sure of it. She could feel her uncle from the power.
Finally, the surging light ripped apart the monarch’s body. Then, someone appeared while ripping apart the body. It was a familiar face.
Chun Yooha was surprised.
“Uncle?”
Kwah-jee-jeek!
Then, something surprising happened.
[You will awaken as the Zodiac Saint of Life.]

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Awakening (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Awakening (2)
“Ahhk! Where the hell is this?”
Chun Sungjae was surprised. After the monarch had swallowed him, he was in a dark, damp, and unknown space.
When he saw the chunks of flesh underneath him, he bit his lips.
‘This is the monarch’s stomach.’
He was sure of it. His soul had been extracted and swallowed by the monarch. And he soon heard the confirmation of his assumption.
[You cannot exit the body of the Abundance Monarch.]
[Warning! After 10 minutes, “Chun Sungjae” will die. Abundance will have completely absorbed your soul.]
[If you’re not quick, you will become one with the Abundance’s body.]
Chun Sungjae reacted in fright. “Ahhk! Don’t declare my death with Uncle’s voice!”
It was the worst. He would become one with a mere monster instead of his uncle.
‘I have to get out of here.’
Was it because he had been swallowed right now or that Lee Gun’s blessing was working on him? Although his body looked half-translucent, nothing had happened to it yet.
However, he was in danger. The only silver lining was the fact that he could use his skills.
A Zodiac Saint had a soul contract with their Zodiac. That was why Sungjae could still receive and use the magical energy of his Zodiac.
And so, the young man immediately activated his attack magic.
Kwah-jeek!
A fire pillar capable of instantly melting steel surged from the ground.
Kwahng!
“…!”
However, the magic didn’t work at all. This flustered Sungjae, and he tried to use his spell again.
[It is useless.]
“!”
An unfamiliar voice surprised the young man. This place was the monster’s stomach. Aside from him, no one should be alive in here.
When Chun Sungjae turned his head, his eyes turned round.
[Magic doesn’t work inside this place.]
“Pisces Saint?”
Yes, a person was sitting atop the flesh full of corpses. It was none other than the Pisces Saint, the Zodiac Saint for the Pisces temple.
The Pisces temple and the Gemini temple were considered to be a pair, the two great magic temples.
This woman didn’t look too older than Sungjae. She was half translucent, so it was obvious that she was a soul like him.
“Why are you —”
[What do you mean, why? I was eaten twenty years ago.]
“?!”
Chun Sungjae’s expression was a sight to behold.
‘Twenty years ago? What do you mean? The Pisces Saint sent Constructs to Uncle’s holy ground not too long ago.’
Chun Sungjae looked like he was about to have a mental breakdown, but the Pisces Saint spoke up.
[You’re amazing. You can maintain your shape even after the monarch swallowed you. Is that because of the power of the Zodiac surrounding your body?]
“…!”
[Well, it doesn’t matter. You won’t be able to kill the monarch. You won’t be able to leave this place. Give up and accept your fate….]
Kwahng!
A powerful green light descended above Chun Sungjae’s head.
Chun Sungjae’s face immediately brightened when he sensed the familiar power. “Uncle! It is you, right?”
– Yes.
The contract between a Zodiac and a Zodiac Saint was a soul contract.
Even though Sungjae did not have his body, he was connected to his Zodiac; they could converse.
Lee Gun let out a deep sigh of relief when he heard his nephew’s voice.
It was great that his Zodiac Saints had come to the location where the monarch had appeared. However, he had received a notification that said the signal to one of his Zodiac Saints had been severed. Of course, the soul contract was still up, so he immediately knew it wasn’t true death.
After checking up on his nephew’s well-being, he continued.
– I am nearby, but I can’t enter this place.
“!”
Currently, Lee Gun was at the center of the barrier. The barrier erected by the monarch was large, but that didn’t matter to him.
[You have used the power of space.]
He had control over space, so breaking in was easy. However, the problem came afterward.
– That bastard put up two barriers. I was able to break through the outer barrier. However, I can’t break through the central barrier, where you guys are located.
The reason for that was simple. The barrier on Chun Sungjae’s side wasn’t being registered as space by Lee Gun’s skill.
Chun Sungjae furrowed his brows. “That means Uncle has no way of coming here…”
– No. Why don’t you use Zodiac descent? Not the possession type. Let me descend using my main body.
“What? If I use it, Uncle will be summoned within the monster’s stomach… Ah!” Chun Sungjae was smart, so he immediately recognized Lee Gun’s plan.
– The fact that the monarch is there means it probably possessed someone’s body. The probability is high. Even if it tried to hide its power, it shouldn’t be able to avoid detection from the dome. The power of a monarch stinks too much.
“You’re right. It did smell human. Maybe, it possessed an S-rank who went missing on the last raid…”
Lee Gun laughed when it turned out as he had expected.
– Then killing it is possible.
The Pisces Saint furrowed her brows when she heard their conversation.
[I know what you’re thinking, but it’s a monarch. If you call a Zodiac here, the Zodiac will get digested in this place.]
There was a problem even before one reached that point.
[This place continuously steals magical energy. If you want to use a high-rank skill like Zodiac summon, an average amount of magical energy won’t be enough. A brat like you can’t—]
The Pisces Saint flinched.
Chun Sungjae was looking at her with a smirk on his face. It was the smile of a child. “I just have to top off the magical energy I lack, right?”
“!”
As soon as he spoke, the Pisces Saint did a double-take. The reason was the magic Chun Sungjae used.
[Magical Energy Connection(SS)]
Chun Sungjae had studied the Zodiac Saint Contract and had developed this special skill. Its function was simple.
<Make a Moving Lee Gun Figurine>
Like a Zodiac, Sungjae could provide a doll with magical energy and make it move. He could use this puppetry by providing magical energy!
He had developed this skill for impure(?) motives, and it didn’t look that useful at face value. However, it was a worthwhile skill.
[You have made a connection with the servant of the Pisces.]
[You can provide her with magical energy.]
[You have changed the rule. The circuitry of the spell has been reversed.]
[The one who gives magical energy will now receive magical energy from the recipient.]
When a connection was made through force, the Pisces Saint was shocked.
‘This bastard is using puppetry magic in reverse to steal my magical energy!’
The direction of the magical energy’s flow had changed direction. Sungjae had used the skill as a straw to extract magical energy. That was why the Pisces Saint quickly tried to escape this space.
[Koohk!]
However, she couldn’t move her body after the connection was made.
This was how Chun Sungjae ate the magical energy of the Zodiac Saint, but he still seemed unsatisfied.
“Give me your Zodiac’s magical energy!”
[!!]
As his voice rang out, something surprising happened.
[Chun Sungjae is extracting the Pisces’s magical energy through the Zodiac Saint.]
An incredible light surged forth.
In simple words, Chun Sungjae was dragging out the magical energy of the Pisces since the Pisces Saint was connected to it.
Normally, there would be a barrier magic placed over the Zodiac Saint to block such infiltration attempts.
‘However, it’s easy if the opponent is a soul.’
The Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints were connected through the soul. When a Zodiac used magic, the structure of the spell would get engraved into the Zodiac Saint’s soul.
And a magician could see the structure of a spell; it was like being able to see the coding script. Just messing up one line would be a victory.
On the other hand, it would be dangerous for Sungjae if he touched something wrong by mistake. He had to be prudent.
‘Thankfully, I learned the basic magic language from the Fairy Monarch.’
[Koohk!]
Through the technique, the magical energy of the Pisces flowed into Chun Sungjae!
[Zodiac Descent]
Finally, he was able to use one of the highest-ranked summon techniques. At that moment…
[You did well.]
Kwahng!
Accompanying the light, Lee Gun was summoned within the stomach of the monarch. However, his appearance was different from normal.
‘That appearance …!’
He was sure of it. It was the Lee Gun that Chun Sungjae and Chun Yooha had seen when they had received their baptism. In the baptism space, they had seen the Serpent Bearer’s true divine form.
An endlessly long, enormous serpent was summoned beside Sungjae.
Even if the Monarch’s stomach was large, right now, it was the size of a human’s stomach! There was no way it could contain such a large snake.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!!
[Huh-huhk!]
Unable to win against the size of the serpent, the monarch’s stomach exploded, and its body was ripped apart!
Kwahng!
Chun Yooha, Goat, and Carly, who had been outside all this time, were surprised.
“Uncle!!”
It was as if the monarch had vomited light. Something had ripped apart the monarch’s stomach and came out. It was a serpent.
Since the serpent was made out of light, making out the exact figure was hard.
However, they were sure who it was.
“Uncle!”
* * *
Boom!
Having its stomach as well as its entire upper body blown apart, the Abundance monarch fell.
Goat and Carly were unable to shut their mouths.
The serpent made out of light, which had come out of the monarch’s body, changed into a familiar figure.
Tahk!
“M-My god! Lee Gun-nim!!”
“Ah… Lee Gun-nim!”
“How…!”
Lee Gun had been wiping away the blood, but he laughed when he felt their gazes. “Why are you so surprised? If I can’t break through from the outside, I just have to break through from the inside.”
“…!!!”
Goat was unable to shut his mouth.
Even if it was a barrier that couldn’t be broken from outside, how could he use such a wild method…!
“Have you lost your mind?! There is no way a monster’s stomach would be normal…!”
This monarch was a monster that could melt and eat a Zodiac. Its stomach should be potent.
In reality, Lee Gun’s skin was melting after he had returned to his original form. Of course, this wasn’t a problem for him.
“Whatever! I have Super Regeneration.” When Super Regeneration activated, Lee Gun’s body started healing.
‘I also gained some resistance when I destroyed the gate. I acquired the monarch’s data.’
[Fragment of Abundance]
– Increased resistance against the unknown civilization’s attacks (Poison, body, etc.)
Since he had acquired this particular monarch’s power, the power was more effective. That was also the reason Lee Gun had decided to go ahead with something as dangerous as appearing inside the monster’s stomach.
‘Thankfully, the one to be swallowed was Sungjae.’
Abundance had a connection to the power of Life. Whenever Abundance used the power of Life, which it stole, Sungjae’s power of Life also became stronger. That was why Sungjae was fine.
However, Goat just stared at Lee Gun in horror. “How can you do something that the Zodiacs are afraid to do…!”
The monarch also seemed to have not expected this. It glared at Lee Gun.
[You are crazy! Something is wrong with your head.]
Then there was Chun Sungjae. He had a very troublesome attribute. The monarch should have killed him on sight instead of swallowing him.
Was it because the monarch was damaged? The barrier around Seoul suddenly started to shake.
‘The barrier is being released…!’
However, Goat soon glanced at Chun Sungjae’s limp body. “Lee Gun-nim! Sungjae!”
As if to assuage Goat’s worry, Lee Gun showed something to him. Despite what was going on, Lee Gun had remembered to grab Sungjae’s soul. It might be different from others, but Chun Sungjae was a Zodiac Saint who had made a direct contract with him.
Unless Sungjae’s body had died, a temporary extraction of his soul wouldn’t kill him.
‘It would have been dangerous if thirty minutes had passed.’
“Don’t worry. I’ll put it in right…”
Boom!
“!”
A golden-green light started swirling around the fallen body of Chun Sungjae, and something surprising happened.
[The Zodiac Saint of Life has used a skill of Life.]
[Self Revive]
Chun Sungjae gasped as he opened his eyes.
“Kuhk! Kek kek….!”
Lee Gun seemed intrigued by this, while Goat and Yooha looked at Sungjae with great relief.
Soon, Lee Gun took hold of Heaven’s Punishment. “Let’s cut open this bastard’s stomach.”
They looked at the broken body of the monarch, who still looked like Chun Sungjae, when all of a sudden…
“Sungjaeeeee!”
Everyone’s eyes turned round at the familiar voice.
“Sungjae!”
When the barrier had shaken, Hugo had pushed through a crack. After landing in front of the group, he looked at Sungjae… No, he looked at the monarch in fright. “Gun! What did you do!”
Baffled, Lee Gun scolded Hugo. “Your son is over there. This one is a fake.”
“What?!”
As if he had fulfilled his obligation, Lee Gun once again raised his ax.
The flustered monarch tried changing its face into the faces of Chun Yooha and Chun Jiwoo, but Lee Gun snorted.
The monarch seemed capable of reading the memories of its opponent to change into a person that could affect its opponent the most.
As if to prove this point, it didn’t change into Hugo.
This was why Lee Gun found it contemptible. “You must be trying to stop me from attacking. It is useless with those faces…”
At that moment, the monarch’s face once again changed to that of a different person.
“!”
Everyone’s eyes turned round at the never-before-seen face, but it was different for Lee Gun. Killing intent instantly appeared in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Awakening (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Awakening (3)
The look in Lee Gun’s eyes instantly changed.
The monarch beneath him had changed its face into the face of a younger person. This person was similar in age to the Lee Gun from twenty-five years ago or even younger.
She had an intelligent face framed by brown, short bobbed hair. Her eyes were bright brown and striking. It was as if she could see through a person’s soul.
When Lee Gun met her eyes, the hand holding Heaven’s Punishment halted for a moment. This surprised the weapon.
[Heaven’s Punishment looks at its owner in shock.]
The monarch laughed at the reaction. In a rarity, the slime, which had been sitting on top of Lee Gun’s shoulder, also looked surprised.
[Clump of Creation Clay says you shouldn’t fall for it.]
[Clump of Creation Clay says this is very dangerous.]
This satisfied the fallen monarch.
‘As expected, it is effective.’
The monarch had chosen this face because Lee Gun had feelings of affection toward the owner of this face, and he also felt apologetic.
The only ones that satisfied such emotions were the Chun siblings and Chun Jiwoo
Although Lee Gun had a deep affection for Hugo, he didn’t feel sorry(?) toward Hugo. Instead, Hugo held Lee Gun’s trust. That emotion was stronger than anyone.
Anyway, the monarch had decided this person was someone Lee Gun couldn’t attack. It knew this face would have a devastating effect.
That face would also be unexpected. The woman with this face was someone who the powerful Time monarch said they must kill. That was why this was a bit unexpected.
Abundance spoke with the face that was Lee Gun’s weakness. “Don’t kill me, Gun. I don’t want to die—”
Kwah-jeek!!!
“Kuhk!”
The monarch vomited. It couldn’t speak any further. The ax’s blade had come crashing down on the monarch’s neck ruthlessly.
Abundance looked at Lee Gun as if the latter had lost his mind.
Lee Gun let out a frightening laugh. “What? You think I wouldn’t be able to stab you if you had that face?”
“…!”
The slime jumped in joy as it watched the distorted face of the monarch.
[Clump of Creation Clay jeers at the monarch.]
[It laughs as it says it warned you not to fall for this.]
[The slime quivers. It is proud of giving the warning of this being very dangerous.]
The warning of danger wasn’t directed at the slime’s owner; it was directed at the monarch.
Boom!
“…!”
As a fierce wind blew, a black power erupted from Lee Gun’s body. Then, the ring on his hand went flying.
Kwahng!
Lee Gun’s fierce magical energy had sent the magical energy control system flying. It screamed.
[“Black Ring that eats divine magical energy(SSS)” says to please give it a signal before you do that. It lets out a sob.]
[The penalty has been lifted.]
[You are in your Zodiac Descent state.]
[The 50% of your power that was being sealed by the ring has been released.]
Hugo shook when he felt the power of Death rage around Lee Gun.
‘Is he trying to evolve to the 3rd stage?’
It was probably too early for that.
Lee Gun seemed more powerful, but it had to do with the removal of the ring, which had been sealing his normal power.
A Zodiac’s powerful strength normally influenced its surroundings. That was why Lee Gun had put on the ring that ate magical energy. The ring allowed him to maintain 50% of his power.
Therefore, although he might feel stronger than usual…
Kwah-jeek!
Hugo flinched when the monarch screamed.
The ax blade was still embedded in the monarch’s neck, and Lee Gun pressed it in deeper. He was trying to open a bigger wound since the monarch was trying to run away.
Laughing, he brought his foot down harder on the blade. “I planned on taking you alive and imprisoning you inside the Devil’s Tower. I planned on using you as fodder for EXP for me and my kids. However, I changed my mind.”
“…!”
An ugly light flashed in his eyes, and he put more strength into his foot.
Ggah-doo-doohk!
The weighted blade sliced through the monarch’s shoulder muscles and crushed its slim shoulder bones.
The monarch gritted its teeth at the horrible pain.
When Lee Gun saw its expression, flames flashed in his eyes. “You still aren’t changing your face?”
As if he was daring the monarch to do that further, Lee Gun relaxed his foot.
Kwahng!
Then, he pressed down again to widen the wound.
Crunch!
The monarch ground its teeth as it looked at Lee Gun.
Normally, a wound created by an edged weapon was nothing to a monarch. The difference here was the weapon.
[This weapon has the Leo’s tooth as an ingredient, and it is very effective.]
[Heaven’s Punishment is reacting to its owner’s emotions. It pours out its magical energy.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s critical damage attribute is active.]
Was it because the ax was a weapon made using the Leo’s tooth? The power of the battle-type Zodiac hit the monarch, and it felt excruciating pain.
‘Damn it! As expected, there is a limit to what I can do in a human’s body.’
To avoid the dome, the monarch had used a human body, and this decision was working against it. The monarch shouted, “Are you of sound mind? How can you do this when you see this— Right!”
The monarch’s eyes flashed as if it had come up with an idea. “If you put this away, I’ll let you have this body.”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned stormy. “What?”
“This human died twenty-four years ago. Ah, ah! Yes… I’m pretty sure Time killed her, and Oblivion ate her.”
Abundance recalled it now. To find the thirteenth Zodiac, Time had taken its army to Seoul. Moreover, it had gone there to eliminate some woman who Abundance had never heard about.
Abundance tilted its head in puzzlement as it looked at Lee Gun.
‘Now that I think about it, this snake bastard was a normal human…’
How did he awaken as a god after being killed by Time? However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Yes. I’ll give you this body. I just have to make another body.”
At that moment, Hugo unconsciously clenched his eyes shut.
Kwah-jeek!
Lee Gun ruthlessly brought down his ax on the monarch’s face.
Hugo was scared to look at Lee Gun’s face, and he realized something at the same time.
‘I know who that is.’
Although his children merely thought that the owner of this face was someone pretty, Hugo now knew.
‘That person is Yeonwoo.’
Before Hugo had met Lee Gun, this woman was the one who lived with Lee Gun. This was only a guess, but she was the one who had affected Lee Gun’s awakening. Their relationship must be…
‘Is she his girlfriend?’
Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement, but he soon shook his head from side to side. He’d ask the next time, after the monarch was taken care of. This matter wasn’t important right now.
‘He might really go to the third stage of Death.’
It would be dangerous. Of course, this didn’t mean Lee Gun should stop evolving Death. From what Hugo had observed, it was a power that would work against the monarchs. The problem was that this power was too powerful.
‘Gun said the reason he’s fine despite having two Divine statuses is that both powers are equal.’
If one side became stronger, that side would purposely try to become larger. This was especially true for Death, which would swallow up the owner in Lee Gun.
‘This is dangerous.’
Therefore, Lee Gun had to grow Life at the same time.
On the other hand, someone was overjoyed at this development.
[Death shudders since 100% of its power has been manifested.]
[As expected, its owner should become the god of calamity. It is so delighted that it is beside itself.]
[Death says that Life is of zero help to its owner! It says to hurry up and kill the monarch as a sacrifice—]
Suddenly, Death screamed.
[Death says the monarch can be killed, but cannot be eaten as a sacrifice.]
[Death says it was wrong. It says to ignore its words.]
Lee Gun grabbed the dog chew that was making a fuss within the black smoke and threw it far away. Then, he tried to look inside the pulped body of the monarch, but…
Flash!
“Uncle!”
Everyone flinched in surprise when a skill was activated.
[Warning! When Abundance feels the threat of death, it spreads the Seeds of Life.]
Abundance was a being capable of bringing monsters to life as its force.
Kwah-jeek!
Like a mushroom spreading its pollen, Abundance had spread its seeds when it had entered this place. If it gave the signal, the seeds would grow by consuming nutrients. It had created these new lives at a request from another monarch.
However, the seeds bloomed when Abundance’s life came under threat. Abundance was the master of those lives. When it was threatened, its instinct was to reproduce.
Therefore, monsters started to appear out of the ground from all directions. This was a bizarre sight, which looked like mold spores appearing everywhere.
[Become the monarch’s nutrient!]
[How dare you do this to their parent’s body!]
They were children. However, they immediately grew up when they received the power of Abundance.
Hugo and Goat quickly raised their bows. They could hear shouts come from nearby. Troops from the other temples were here as well.
“Defend to the last man!”
“How dare monsters invade human territory by pretending to be humans!”
“Kill them all and present them as tributes to our Zodiacs!”
Seeing this, Goat said, “We’ll be in charge of getting rid of them. That is why Lee Gun-nim should—”
“You can’t kill them in normal ways.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun tossed the notebook given to him by the Secretary.
“This is…!”
“Commandment.”
“!”
It was the unknown civilization’s version of the bible, which Lee Gun had stolen from the Abundance general and the Time general.
“I’m not too sure about it, but their souls have to do something that is prohibited by the rules. Many rules are engraved into their souls.”
This was the commandment. It was like a set of commands that made directing the troops easy.
Unlike the disciples, who moved through faith, the monsters were a military group that moved only on command. Of course, the identity of the Commandment wasn’t important.
“The important part is that their weaknesses are written in there.”
In other words, this was a manual on how to defeat them.
“I’ll give this to you. I want you to find the source, and I want you to sweep them clean.”
The Commandment… No, the guide would allow them to attack the unknown civilization, which not even the twelve Zodiacs were able to conquer.
Goat seemed to have realized what Lee Gun meant. He nodded, then disappeared. Hugo was about to follow after Goat, but…
“Ahhk! Sungjaeeeeee!” Hugo’s face turned pale from fright as he wailed.
Chun Sungjae had been attacking the monsters, and he had fallen over when his body was sliced open. Of course, he wasn’t truly hurt or dead.
[Ahhk! What the hell? Why did it suddenly pop out again!]
He had made a mistake while he was killing the monsters, and his body was cut in half. Sungjae had thought he was going to die. However, his soul had separated from his body as soon as his body was damaged.
This was the power of the Zodiac of Life. In his soul state, he would never truly die and would be able to attack his enemies.
Chun Sungjae’s body was quickly mended through the power of Super Regeneration.
However, his father had seen it live, and he couldn’t talk coherently because of shock.
“Sungjae… Sungjae is…” Hugo’s shock lasted only a moment. He then screamed.
“Dad! It’s fine! I’m here!”
The monster Lee Gun from twenty years ago landed in front of Hugo. Soon, the monster Lee Gun started using Chun Sungjae’s spell.
Hugo wondered what was going on.
“What the hell? This is Uncle’s body!”
Yes, Chun Sungjae had entered the slime.
As per Lee Gun’s order, the slime had transformed into the Lee Gun who had high reflex, and Chun Sungjae had temporarily entered it. He would be there only until his body was healed.
Hugo shouted at Chun Sungjae, who was shouting in happiness. “Sungjae! If you move too far away from your body, how are you going to return to it?”
“What! I want to live in this body!”
“What the hell did you say?!”
At that moment…
“Wait a moment. Move to the side.”
“Gun?”
Lee Gun seemed to have business with Chun Sungjae’s body, which was in Hugo’s care. He went on to rip something away in contempt. It seemed to be a flea on Chun Sungjae’s neck.
[Huh-uhk!]
“It really covets our Life.”
This flea was none other than the Abundance monarch, who had disappeared. The monarch had used its underlings to distract them and tried to carry out its previous plan. It was trying to steal the body of the Zodiac Saint of Life.
It planned on eating the body of a Zodiac Saint, then the power would be mixed with its own to recover itself. In truth, Lee Gun’s power of regeneration went well with Abundance.
[Koohk…!]
“I’m curious since Abundance wanted it that bad.”
The undead monarch’s space power had been assimilated under the power of Death. What about Abundance?
“Let me test it out.”
“G…Gun?”
Lee Gun threw the bug and used his ability.
[Gluttony(SSS)]
An incredible light surged forth, and the notifications rang out.
[You have gained EXP.]
[You have acquired a new ability.]
[“Abundance”]
[Life has leveled up.]
[Life is trying to talk to you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Life and Death (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Life and Death (1)
[“Life” has leveled up.]
[“Life” is trying to talk to you.]
This situation differed from that with Death. A warm light appeared this time.
Death screamed at this sight. It wanted to grow Lee Gun as the god of calamity.
[“Death” says hurry up and use its power.]
[“Death” says to ignore Abundance. “Let’s hurry up and go home. You can wash up and go to sleep.”]
Despite Death’s efforts, another face resembling the Scream mask appeared in the golden-green magical energy. Of course, it looked quite different from Death’s face.
Death’s face looked like that of the devil. It had wicked, half-moon-shaped eyes, and the corner of its mouth was ripped like a red mask. If one were being charitable, one could say the face looked mischievous.
On the other hand, Life felt very mature in comparison. Its face had no smile. It instead had a stern expression as if it was shunning evil.
This was the second stage of Life, which made Death apoplectic.
[“Death” despairs.]
[Why did the Serpent Bearer have to swallow Abundance? It screams, “That damned Life opened its eyes.”]
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed at the notification. Is that the reason this bastard kept saying Abundance shouldn’t be used as an offering?
‘Well, I had a rough idea what was going on.’
Of course, Death’s reaction was understandable.
‘Death and Life have a hard time coexisting with each other.’
As expected…
[“Life” hates “Death.”]
[“Life” presses down on the runaway power of “Death.”]
[The energy of Abundance is further developing the power of Life.]
[“Life” has become much stronger.]
[“Life” has become much stronger.]
[“Life” has become much stronger.]
[Any abilities or attributes related to Life will grow alongside Life.]
After being influenced by the energy, Lee Gun couldn’t hear Chun Sungjae’s cheer.
“Amazing! I’m overflowing with power! Uncle is the best!”
Abundance’s power had a connection to life energy. That was why the monarch had become an enormous source of power for Life. This inevitably influenced Chun Sungjae, the Zodiac Saint of Life. The effect was quite staggering.
[The power of Super Regeneration(S) has increased.]
[The power of Creation Workshop has increased.]
[The power of Get Hit Instead of Me has increased.]
[The basic stamina of the Constructs affiliated with the Serpent Bearer has increased.]
[Their mobility has increased. The Constructs will not easily tire out now.]
[The basic defense of the Constructs affiliated with the Serpent Bearer has increased.]
[The total amount of magical energy the Serpent Bearer possesses has increased by a little.]
When Life grew in power, all the stats related to life preservation skyrocketed. The main stats related to survival were defense, stamina, and magical energy.
When Death had grown in power, most of the stats related to damage and curses had increased.
‘Death is the spear, and Life is the zombie… No, it is the shield.’
That wasn’t all. When Death reached the second stage, a new skill had appeared. It was the same for Life.
[Revive]
Anyway, “Life” had fixed a common problem for Lee Gun. His magical energy had increased in quantity by a bit. If he could continue to raise Life like this, his lack of magical energy could be eliminated. However, there was a problem.
Life seemed dissatisfied with Lee Gun.
[“Life” is disappointed in its owner.]
“…!”
Since it was a different reaction than Death’s reaction, Lee Gun flinched. Of course, he had an idea of what the divine status was referring to.
Recently, he had used the power of Death a lot and had killed numerous beings. He had even wiped out hundreds of millions of lives in one move. That was probably why Life was disappointed.
It was as expected. The solemn Life’s expression was a sight to behold.
[“Life” says living beings shouldn’t be killed with a single blow like that.]
[They won’t be able to feel pain if they are cut down in a single blow.]
[Living beings realize they are alive when they feel pain.]
[It says this is why living beings shouldn’t be killed at once. Life grumbles.]
“?!” Lee Gun’s eyes turned round. Did he just hear wrong? It seemed he didn’t.
Death despaired.
[“Death” says that this is why it asked you to choose itself. It states Life has a bankrupt character, and that won’t go well with Master.]
[“Life” is offended. Feelings and sensations are felt when one is alive. They are something precious. It is angry, saying that Death is the devil that kills everything. It does not want to keep company with such a being.]
[“Death” feels aggrieved and asks who is the real devil in this case.]
[“Death” says they should get rid of everything, including Life!]
In the end, the two divine statuses started bickering over who would be more helpful to the Serpent Bearer.
Lee Gun was baffled. Whether it was Life or Death didn’t matter. Both were nutjobs.
Suddenly, a voice spoke to Lee Gun as if this was to be expected.
[The Virgo says, “Divine Status is part of a god. Of course, they would resemble their master in personality.”]
[The toothless Leo laughs in derision. It says your Divine statuses are just like you.]
[The Sagittarius says the Serpent Bearer personality was put on display. He claws at the ground, saying the Serpent Bearer should come here fast.]
Lee Gun got angry, and his eyebrows twitched. However, it didn’t matter. He didn’t care what the gods said. He just had to evolve his Divine status this way. When he reached the final stages, he’d have the strongest attack and strongest defense.
[Only one of the two Divine statuses can reach the final domain.]
[The disposition to reach the end first will go through the final awakening.]
These words intrigued Lee Gun.
‘In the end, I have to choose one.’
This was why the two Divine statuses insisted he pick one of them.
At that moment…
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose when an unknown substance twitched under him. It was so small that he couldn’t see it well, but that was the Abundance monarch!
After suffering under the Gluttony skill, the monarch was desperately crawling across the floor. It was trying to run away under Lee Gun’s eyes.
The monarch ground its teeth. The unbearable pain was a secondary problem.
‘My power was stolen. This is serious.’
After all, the Abundance monarch was in charge of creating monsters for the unknown civilization. It possessed crazy proliferative power akin to that of a cockroach. That was why the twelve Zodiacs had given up trying to conquer the unknown civilization.
Abundance was the king of life. It grew babies into adults and the adults into the ancient-ranks. It was the one that instilled their will to fight.
And what would happen if the power of birth couldn’t be used anymore?
‘The twelve Zodiacs and the humans will dare think about raiding us.’
The humans focused on defense for a reason. They stayed within their domes because of the number of troops they had to confront.
Abundance’s power could endlessly increase the number of troops on its side. But what would happen if there was a limit to the number of monsters?
‘It won’t be good.’
An endless war and a war with an endpoint were two very different things.
Like the birds in birdcages, the humans had been trapped within the domes. Now they would choose to open the domes and come out of them. Mere humans would try to challenge them! This was why the monarch had to get out of there.
Kwah-jeek!
[Kuhk!]
Lee Gun laughed as he stepped on the flea. “Where are you running away, bastard? This might be perfect timing.”
When the two Divine statuses realized the monarch was still alive, their powers shrugged into the sky.
[The two Divine statuses are overjoyed.]
[“Life” is ecstatic that it will be able to make the monarch feel living pain.]
[“Death” is excited by the prospect of killing the monarch again.]
The monarch gritted its teeth when the two powers raged.
[Do not look down on the power of Abundance!]
As soon as it spoke, the barrier around Seoul started to emit light.
“It is the barrier!”
Although Abundance’s barrier was shaking, it was still intact. The monarch laughed as if things were going to plan.
[Look! The light! This barrier was made by my clone. The subordinate you sent will get eaten, and he will be brought to me as nutrients! As expected, an SS-rank human is different!]
Hugo’s complexion suddenly changed. The only SS-rank that Lee Gun had sent out was Goat. Hugo was about to contact Goat when…
Kwah-jeek!
A strange light started to appear from the barrier, and Lee Gun grinned.
* * *
Around that time…
Kwahng! Kwahng!
To catch Abundance and gather tributes for their Zodiacs, several hundred disciples had arrived in Seoul, and they couldn’t hide their shock.
“A-Aren’t they the Archer disciples?”
“Uh! Yeah.”
Their gazes were planted on the large plaza. The plaza was filled with monster corpses, and the Archer disciples were fighting there.
Of course, those several hundred disciples weren’t surprised to see the scarce Archer disciples, who were famous for being beautiful.
“What the hell? They aren’t supposed to be that strong!”
“They are melting the monsters!”
There were Goat, Lee Jaewon, and the youngest disciples who Lee Gun favored, a total of five disciples. And these five disciples were slaughtering monsters that needed several hundred disciples needed to fight.
[You have gained a massive amount of EXP.]
[You have gained a massive amount of EXP.]
[Part of the EXP has been transferred to the Serpent Bearer.]
Their skills were frightening. Even if Goat was an SS-rank and Lee Jaewon was an S-rank, it wasn’t supposed to be like this.
“What is that destructive power?”
“They are way too different from their normal selves!”
Their destructive capabilities didn’t make sense even if their Zodiac had grown in power.
Joseph, the member of the Ten Stars from the Taurus temple, had come here leading the battle-type disciples. He furrowed his brows.
‘Even if their Zodiac’s blessing got stronger, there is no way they should have gotten this strong so abruptly.’
Of course, the Sagittarius temple did possess skilled disciples compared to their limited numbers, but…
“What happened? They weren’t like this a week ago…”
The other disciples soon realized the secret.
“Weapons!”
Those disciples were shocked by the weapons in the hands of the Archer disciples.
“Crazy! Those are SS-rank weapons!”
Yes, Goat and Lee Jaewon were holding new bows, both SS-rank.
“I’m sure of it! They are coming up as SS-ranks!”
A man wearing a glass-shaped appraisal holy item spoke out in shock.
Aside from the royal holy items, the world had only ten SS-rank holy items. They were the best available items.
This was why those disciples were shocked.
“No way! Aren’t SS-rank items supposed to be patented items that only the Capricorn’s Genius Workshop can make?!”
SS-rank items were so expensive and hard to make that the Capricorn’s master craftsmen were very territorial about them. Even the Zodiac Saints had to pamper the master craftsmen to get weapons for themselves.
So how did the last rank temple have those? That wasn’t all.
“What the hell? The others are holding S-rank weapons…?”
“What? Are you playing with me? They don’t have enough money to buy B-rank equipment! Do you realize how expensive S-rank items are?”
“Ah… I do remember hearing that Lee Gun-nim was going to make weapons for the Sagittarius temple…”
“What?! Lee Gun-nim made those?”
Those words gave them a mental breakdown. Recently, a rumor was going around that Lee Gun was going to make the Archer disciples weapons, but everyone had just laughed it off.
“It was said that they are so poor that they asked someone other than the Capricorn temple to make their equipment…”
What was this destructive power?
“Hey! If we’re being honest, aren’t these weapons more powerful than the ones made by the Genius Workshop?”
“Are you kidding me? We are talking about the Genius Workshop here!”
The Genius Workshop and the Capricorn temple were in charge of making the weapons for humanity.
“The Capricorn checks the work of the Genius Workshop. Holy crap! He blocked the teeth of a monster with the bow! How durable is that weapon!”
Lee Gun had given Goat the unknown civilization’s version of the bible. Goat could find the weakness of their enemies through the Commandment. He furrowed his brows.
‘Isn’t this a bible? They are similar to us?’
Of course, the power and the abilities were completely different.
That was why he found it amazing, but this didn’t change the fact that he had a golden opportunity at his hands.
‘We’ll kill all of them’
Kwah-jeek!
Goat’s arrow broke apart Abundance’s barrier.
* * *
The monarch was shocked when it realized its barrier had been broken.
[This is…!]
Lee Gun laughed. “It seems your ace in the hole is gone.”
[…!!!]
The monarch was taken aback.
Suddenly, Chun Sungjae yelled out as if he remembered something, “Oh yeah, Uncle! The Pisces Saint’s soul is inside its body!”
“What?!”
Hugo was surprised, but Lee Gun seemed to have expected this.
“I did feel a familiar energy. That is why I was going to tear open its innards”
“Are you sure you didn’t just want to make a bag with it?”
The monarch trembled when it heard that it would be made into a bag.
‘Shit! I underestimated them too much.’
The problem was that the time had yet to come, so Abundance had infiltrated the human territory quietly. It had planned to spread the seeds of nourishment inside the human territory. And this meant it had to possess the body of a human.
‘I thought the human body would be enough.’
To completely fool the dome, Abundance had trapped itself within a human body. This created a grave situation where it couldn’t run away.
‘This can’t happen. If something happens to me, the invasion plan will run into problems.’
Therefore, Abundance yelled something to create an opening.
[Yes! That woman is your girlfriend, right?]
“!”
It laughed.
[The one to kill that woman was Time! I’ll call it out for you! So you should let me— Koohk!!]
Lee Gun grabbed it by the neck, surprising Abundance.
[W…Wait a moment…!]
[“Death” has activated. The function of the possession magic has been killed, so it can’t exit the human’s body.]
[The trapped soul will be obliterated]
[Wait a moment! Nothing good will come out of this for you! Wait— Kuhk!]
Lee Gun let his fist fly before the monarch could end its words.
Kwah-jeek!
Abundance was turned into a pulp, the first splendid achievement toward gaining victory for humanity.

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Life and Death (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Life and Death (2)
Abundance fell to the power of Lee Gun’s power of Death.
Lee Gun’s opponent held the highest position of leading its side’s forces. Its strength, body, and power were top-notch. Its power had made the Zodiacs raise their guards and insist on fighting a defensive battle.
Such a monarch had fallen to its knees against the power of the god of calamity.
[You have devoured Abundance.]
[You have gained a massive amount of EXP.]
[You have leveled up by five levels.]
[Lv. 29]
[Your physical stats have been upgraded.]
[Speed increased. Visual acuity increased. Senses heightened.]
[You have acquired points (20).]
[Total Points Possessed: 40]
– Upgradeable Skills
[Super Regeneration(S)] [13th Sense(D)] [Act Forbidden by the Gods(F)] [Revival(F)] [Reaper Summon(F)]
[“Death” and “Life” are happy.]
[Both are excited, saying their skills should be increased.]
People cheered.
A monarch had fallen, so the monsters all over Seoul started to hesitate.
[The energy of our king has disappeared.]
[It is gone from this world!]
The monsters were connected to all the monarchs. They received commandments and power from the monarchs to crush the Zodiacs. That was how they could overrun the humans.
So when they lost their connection to the power of a monarch, the monsters immediately knew what had happened.
‘A monarch has gone extinct!’
This was a dangerous situation. Realizing the loss of their master, the invaders under the Abundance monarch quickly started to step backward.
[Retreat!]
[We have no chance of winning!]
[If we stay here, that Serpent Zodiac will eat all of us!]
They were going to temporarily return to their encampment. Then, they would borrow power from the owner of a different encampment.
Boom!
[!]
As if to ask where they were running away, Chun Sungjae, who had the face of Lee Gun, raised his hand high. “It’s too late.”
Flames erupted around him, and his eyes turned golden. “Do you really think you can leave this place at will?”
The angry Chun Sungjae punched the ground, which made green pillars of fire surge up in various locations.
Kwahng! Kwahng! Kwahng!
As if life was boiling up, the ground started to move with the lava. The fire pillars that had surged from the lava changed into a fierce serpent and blocked the path of the monsters.
Boom!!
The monsters screamed.
“Kee-ehhhhhhk!”
[Shit!]
Immediately after their retreat was cut off, the monsters heard a roar. This roar was coming from the disciples, who had been losing up to this point.
“Don’t lose them!”
“Kill every last one of them!”
The resonant roar shook the hearts of the monsters. It was as if the disciples’ shouts had boiled up from the earth. It was as if the roar could shake the ground. This was the rage of humans!
“Wahhhhhhhhh!”
When the disciples rushed forward, the monsters looked flustered. This situation was very different for them. The monarch that had been supporting them was gone. For the first time in their lives, these monsters felt intimidated.
They viewed humans as food, but now they found themselves losing courage. However, something else was even more frightening.
Kwah-jeek!
[…!!!]
Lee Gun moved faster than the roar of the disciples. It wasn’t an exaggeration. He moved faster than the roar that pierced the monsters’ ears.
By the time the monsters registered Lee Gun appearing from the west, he was already gone from there. And when the monsters heard screams of their comrades from the north, they saw their comrades’ heads fly into the air in the south.
Within this chaos, Lee Gun was letting out a cold smile.
When the monsters barely caught up to him, their comrades had been decapitated! They tried to surround him, but it was useless.
The ax was closer to a blunt weapon, yet it effortlessly cut and crushed their comrades. Lee Gun sent the severed heads flying as if they were baseballs. It showed the monsters that they were mere pieces of meat.
Kwahng!!
It was like watching a cannon at work. The monsters froze when they witnessed the power. Then, they started to run away in a direction out of Lee Gun’s line of sight.
However, someone had anticipated this.
“Welcome.” With his bow pulled back, the Archer Saint laughed.
Hugo had placed himself on the exact opposite end of Lee Gun, and he had been waiting for his prey.
As soon as the monsters entered his range, he shot his arrow.
Pahk!!!
This arrow contained the concentrated power of the Serpent Bearer, and it exploded like a nuclear bomb.
Kwah-gwagwahg!
A luminescent light covered the city, and all the monsters swept up in the energy died. Not even traces of them were left.
Normally, Hugo never even thought about receiving power from Lee Gun. However, he had no choice right now.
[The Sagittarius is sad.]
Since his Zodiac Saint was borrowing the Serpent Bearer’s power, the Sagittarius wouldn’t get the EXP and the tributes; they would all head toward Lee Gun. But that wasn’t the problem.
‘This is all of your own doing. Who told you to dig yourself into a hole?’
Since the monarch had spread these seeds itself, the monsters, including the baby ones, had given the disciples a significant amount of EXP.
[All Contribution is headed toward the Serpent Bearer.]
[All the EXP is headed toward the Serpent Bearer.]
[The Constructs of the Serpent Bearer are happy as they take the tributes.]
[The Sagittarius is appalled.]
Hugo wasn’t the only one taking an active role. The Chun siblings, who had awakened as the Zodiac Saint of Life and the Zodiac Saint of Death, showcased their abilities as well.
Yooha held Crimson Earth’s Judgment, which had now turned into a scythe. She lightly landed in front of the monsters trying to run away.
[!]
“Death” seemed to have killed her presence and sound. Chun Yooha appeared emanating black smoke and activated her skill. It was the skill of the Zodiac Saint of Death, which had appeared alongside her awakening!
Kwah-jeek!
The scythe moved in a circle as Yooha swept through the enemies. She had been surrounded, her path blocked. However, that posed no impediment to her.
[All’s fair in Death (SS)]
Surrounded by the black power, Chun Yooha moved through the bodies of monsters. She was like a ghost. It was all thanks to the power of space control, which was under the domain of Death.
This skill allowed her to enter anywhere. She could even pass through living humans. It didn’t matter where her opponent was hiding, and it didn’t matter if she was trapped or not. Yooha could move freely without constraint.
This was the power of Death, which treated everything as equal. It was one of the basic attributes of the divine status of Death.
Moreover, Chun Yooha was already adept at hiding her presence. It probably wasn’t a coincidence that she gravitated toward Death.
“Kee-ehhhhhhhk!”
The disciples were shocked to see the attacks of the newly awakened Zodiac Saint.
Carly, who had been swinging her blade, was also surprised.
‘Chun Yooha became stronger.’
Carly could recognize at once that Chun Yooha had grown in power.
Normally, Carly said Yooha was weak; she discreetly tried to get on Yooha’s nerves. It had been a form of provocation.
Carly always knew Chun Yooha was capable of using more power, but Chun Yooha was never able to break open that egg. That was why Carly kept provoking her.
However, she had never thought Chun Yooha was stronger than her. Carly was that confident in her skills.
‘I’m not so sure now.’
Carly unconsciously gulped. She felt as if Chun Yooha had slightly cracked open her egg. She also felt envious since she was greedy when it came to growing her power.
‘I wanted to become a Zodiac Saint.’
What surprised the disciples once again was that the Serpent Bearer had more than one Zodiac Saint.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
The disciples were already in an uproar, thanks to the weapons in the hands of the disciples from the Sagittarius temple. The rumor of their incredibly strong weapons had spread already.
“What? The last-place temple’s abilities are extraordinary now?”
“Their basic specs were already high, but this feels different! Their weapons are extraordinary!”
“When they use 100% of their power, additional functions appear from… You have to see it for yourself. I’ve never seen this before! It is amazing!”
“!”
Equipment like holy items was like the lifeblood of humanity. They were necessities, so everyone was naturally interested in such items.
At first, the other disciples had thought it was a joke, but a ruckus had broken out when they confirmed the power of those weapons.
“What the hell? Are those manufactured products from the Genius Workshop?”
“Why would you even ask such a question? Who else could make such weapons other than the Genius Workshop?”
The Genius Workshop was a workshop under the direct supervision of the Capricorn. It was the elite workshop where humanity’s greatest craftsmen gathered to create weapons. They were the highest authority in charge of making all equipment for humanity.
However, those craftsmen were known to be the most arrogant in the world. Even governments and the Ten Stars walked on eggshells around them. This was also why people didn’t bother dealing with them.
“Wow! That’s crazy! I’ll have to ask them to make me one too!”
“Hey! Goat! How were you able to commission the Genius Workshop? Introduce us to— Ahhhhk!”
Goat sent an arrow flying toward the generals. He became angry as if they were speaking nonsense. These idiots really thought the Genius Workshop made those weapons. “These were all manufactured by the great Lee Gun-nim.”
“What?!”
This was the appearance of weapons superior to the ones made by the Capricorn Temple. Such surprising news started spreading across the world. It probably reached the Genius Workshop, too.
Soon, all the forces of Abundance were killed, and in turn, Lee Gun gained something new.
[The region occupied by Abundance (the Black zone and the Red zone) can be recovered.]
[You will be able to bring back the authority possessed by Abundance.]
Humanity’s counterattack had started.
* * *
It was one o’clock.
The defense of Seoul had ended in a success, and the disciples were cleaning up after themselves.
“Hey! Sungjae!” Hugo had to get into a quarrel with his son. “What the hell are you doing? Hurry up and get out of there!”
“Noooooooo!! I’ll never leave it!”
“What?! Have you lost your mind?”
