Yes, Hugo was arguing with Sungjae, who was refusing to leave Lee Gun’s body. In actuality, that body was the slime.
Chun Sungjae was a fanboy, and he was in the body of the slime, which looked like Lee Gun. He was in heaven. This was on a completely different level than collecting figurines or cosplaying. He looked like the great hero from twenty years ago, who he saw in those videos.
Chun Sungjae was shedding tears as he wailed in happiness. “This is so cool! I just want to live in this body like this!” He tried to run away.
In the end, Hugo grabbed the back of his son’s neck. “Jeez! Why the hell does it have to be Gun’s body from twenty years ago? You were born and raised handsome!”
“I don’t need any of that! Uncle is the best!”
At this moment, Chun Yooha raised her scythe as if she could no longer stand it. Since she had become the Zodiac Saint of Death, she could probably extract a soul if she wanted to. She could probably do it easily.
“Get out of there now.”
Suh-guhk!
“Ahhhhk! Noooooo!”
In the end, Chun Sungjae was dragged out of the slime’s body, and he had no choice but to go back into his own body.
Watching this from a distance, Hugo looked pleased.
‘As expected, my daughter is grea—’
“I’m going in now. Get out of the way.”
“What the hell did you just say?!!”
The bystanders seemed to be the only normal ones. The disciples of the other temples and Guisoon, the Secretary, were speechless. They just clicked their tongues.
Lee Gun was indeed cool in certain ways, but none of them could understand the mental state of these fanatics.
However, something was even more incomprehensible.
“Isn’t it a complete miss that he was chosen as the Zodiac Saint of Life…? From the looks of it, both of them are more suited to be the Zodiac Saints of Death.”
It was definitely a call for celebration that they were able to become the Zodiac Saints of Life & Death, respectively.
Both Life and Death were satisfied with their Zodiac Saints.
[“Life” loves Chun Sungjae’s “sadism.”]
[“Death” loves Chun Yooha’s “Rage.”]
[Each Zodiac Saint will be a big help in growing the Serpent Bearer’s Divine statuses.]
[Warning! You are Lv. 29. You are gaining attention from the Zodiacs of the same level.]
[When you reach Lv. 30, your body will experience an unexpected change.]
[If you aren’t ready for it, please control your EXP so that you don’t reach Lv. 30.]
Lee Gun wondered what this unexpected change was, but he didn’t think too much about it. He still had a lot of time before he reached level thirty.
‘I can feel my body’s stats increasing now that I’m getting close to level thirty.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Gun. Let’s talk for a moment.”
“!”
Hugo, who had been busy with his children causing quite the trouble for him, led Lee Gun to a place with no people.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “What is it again? I was eating—”
Hugo grabbed Lee Gun, who was earnestly drinking from a juice box, and asked, “I wanted to respect your privacy, so I planned on not asking.”
“?”
“Who is Yeonwoo?”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he heard the name.

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Life and Death (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Life and Death (3)
“Who is Yeonwoo?”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round, and the light inside them changed a bit.
Seeing the look in his friend’s eyes, Hugo realized his mistake.
“Did I ever talk to you about her?”
“Uh? Uh? That is…!” Taken aback at the unexpected question, Hugo furtively moved his eyes.
‘Shit! I didn’t give any warning signals before I asked the question.’
Since this topic was related to the mighty Lee Gun, Hugo had been curious. It was bothering him, so he had asked the question. However, he now wondered if he had touched something he shouldn’t have and incurred Lee Gun’s wrath.
‘It was the same with Abundance.’
Scared, Hugo was about to apologize. “Ah! It was when we were stealing the bible from the generals.”
“…!” Lee Gun immediately had a suspicion even if Hugo didn’t say anything.
Only one incident in recent days was connected to “her,” the incident where he had viewed the events from twenty-four years ago through the general’s body.
Hugo found Lee Gun’s cool response unexpected.
‘Doesn’t he mind me asking?’
The look in his friend’s eyes did change, but it wasn’t anger. It was more an expression of curiosity.
This was why Hugo knew this was his chance. “Who is Miss Yeonwoo? There is no way she’s your friend.”
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. “Why couldn’t she be a friend? I might have a friend that you don’t know about.”
“Let’s be real. You don’t have friends, Gun. Only someone like me would put up with someone like— Kuhk!”
Hugo took a hit.
“What? I’m just telling the truth! Anyway, who is Miss Yeonwoo? I’m pretty sure it was the beautiful woman Abundance transformed into, right? As expected, she was your girlfriend!”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round, and that made Hugo almost certain. There was no way Lee Gun would get that angry at seeing her face if she wasn’t his girlfriend.
“Ah. I see. She was your girlfriend—” Hugo’s expression changed as he was speaking; the reason was his friend’s expression.
Hugo was about to burst out laughing when Lee Gun kicked him in the shin, leaving the Archer Saint feeling aggrieved. “What? I didn’t say anything yet!”
“Shut up! I can read your face. I know what you were thinking. You‘re thinking that there is no way I had a girlfriend, right?”
Hugo looked shocked.
“She really was your girlfriend?!”
It wouldn’t have been strange considering his age, but…
Hugo looked a bit disappointed. “I feel a bit hurt. How can you not tell me something so important…”
“She isn’t my girlfriend.”
“What? She’s not? Really?”
“It isn’t a simple relationship like the one you’re thinking of.”
Lee Gun felt complicated emotions when the memories popped up.
‘Gun!’
Yeonwoo was someone Lee Gun had grown up with in an orphanage.
“She was born deaf, so her parents had thrown her away.”
“Deaf?”
“Yes. Our relationship was strong because we shared the memories of being abused by the orphanage teacher.”
“Abuse?” Was this why he developed such a masochistic character?
“Ah! Of course, I took care of that bastard.”
Hugo became much more afraid when he saw the look in Lee Gun’s eyes. His friend seemed to have been like this from an early age.
“Anyway, I lived with them before I met you. It was the three of us.”
“Three?? N…No way!!!”
This was more shocking than the idea that Lee Gun had a girlfriend. Hugo looked at Lee Gun with contempt.
“What the hell are you thinking right now? I lived with Yeonwoo and her brother.”
“Ah!”
“But her brother died at the hands of a monster. In the end, I lived with Yeonwoo. It was the two of us. However…” Lee Gun suddenly glared at Hugo. “Hey, what the hell are you doing?”
Hugo clenched his fists as if he was happy; he was cheering. The Archer Saint seemed to have stopped listening at some point. He was moved.
‘I won against Gun in one aspect.’
Gun never had a girlfriend before! On the other hand, Hugo had dated before! He even had children now.
‘I’m the winner….’
Lee Gun immediately kicked Hugo.
“Kuhk!!”
“We weren’t related by blood, but she was my only family.”
“Is that so? Family? That was all she was to you?”
Lee Gun became silent at that question. She had been more precious than a friend. However, she was dead, so nothing was to be gained in talking more about that subject. If that fateful day hadn’t happened, he had no idea how his future would have changed.
“On the day I awakened, Yeonwoo died at the hands of a monster instead of me.”
“…!” Hugo was shocked. This was why his friend hated talking about his awakening.
Others described that day as a day when a hero was born. But from Lee Gun’s perspective, it was the day he had lost a loved one.
‘It was a hot topic at the time. Everyone congratulated him, yet he never had a happy expression on his face.’
Lee Gun said with a complicated expression, “She was my best friend in the world. She was also a family member I loved the most.”
On the day of his awakening, his power had surged forth to revive everyone. The only one left dead on that day was Yeonwoo. This was why her name hadn’t even made it in the newspaper.
On that day, the only news anyone cared about was the awakening of the thirteenth. Yeonwoo’s name had been erased from this world because of his name. It was to be expected since there had been no corpse left.
“Gun!”
“No. You guys couldn’t have killed them even if you came.”
The Zodiac Saints would have been wiped out if they had gone there.
Just a while ago, Lee Gun and the others had learned through the Abundance general that most of the monsters in that incident were red-zone rank and black zone rank and were led by the monarchs.
“At the time, I was able to kill them by luck through the power of my awakening.”
That was why everyone called his awakening a blessing, but Lee Gun would rather have her alive than himself.
“That is all there is to it.” After saying all that, Lee Gun started munching on the chicken leg.
Hugo felt a complicated emotion. This topic seemed to be something he shouldn’t have brought up.
At the same time, he had an understanding. He now understood why Lee Gun hated the Zodiac Saints. He also learned why Lee Gun went crazy when he caught sight of the monsters, why he killed the monsters down to the last man, and why he always got involved when people were dying.
‘It might have to do with the guilt stemming from that incident.’
Lee Gun had overwhelming power, yet he had been unable to save a loved one in front of his eyes.
‘Well, this is merely my guess.’
Anyway, it seemed Lee Gun would not stop until he killed all the monsters.
Seeing Hugo’s face, Lee Gun cackled. “What’s with that expression? My best friend in the world now is you.”
“…!” Hugo was moved.
“You are also my most precious minion.”
Asshole!!! Why did he have to say such a thing when he started so well?
Hugo soon came to another understanding.
‘I wondered why Gun was so good with sign language. This was the reason.’
Lee Gun had lived with a family member with bad hearing.
Things were different now with the dome. Inside the dome, it didn’t matter if one spoke a different language or whether one’s hearing or vision was bad. Communicating with each other through telepathy was possible.
‘The fact that Miss Yeonwoo was unable to hear sound was unexpected…’
Hugo’s eyes turned round when he saw Lee Gun move away from him.
As if to promote the Serpent Bearer’s temple, the slime had changed into a serpent while moving around.
At that moment…
“Now that I think about it, snakes can’t hear sound, right?”
* * *
Around the same time, in Northern Seoul, the red zone past the area of the Devil’s tower!
After failing to invade Seoul, two monsters were running somewhere.
[Shit! Our monarch’s territory fell into the hands of that snake Zodiac!]
[Our monarch lost its authority over that land!]
[It is still fine. Our monarch’s power isn’t completely gone. He cannot take our monarch’s territory yet.]
[Please come to your senses!]
[Oh, monarch of Abundance!]
These monsters were yelling toward a piece of hide. This piece of hide that looked like regular leather at a glance was actually the hide from the body of the Abundance monarch.
Of course, there were no abilities left within it. Lee Gun had stolen all of them. Therefore, the hide was useless as an ingredient. The only thing left in it was a small piece of Abundance’s soul.
[Hurry.… Hurry and go to Time.]
The Time monarch might be able to revive Abundance using its Time Regression ability. Of course, Abundance had never suffered this badly, so it had no idea what the result would be. Everything could return to normal, or only its body might return to normal. There was also the chance that it could die. That ability was extremely random.
Moreover, Time was quite difficult to negotiate with, so it might not easily agree to Abundance’s request. However, there was no downside to trying.
If its body could be fixed, the monarch would never leave its encampment. Abundance never wanted to meet Lee Gun again. There was only one problem with that.
‘Lee Gun will mess up all our plans like before.’
Yes, the re-invasion from not too long ago was an attempt to expand its territory. That was also an attempt to make the humans feel helpless.
Humanity had become arrogant under the Domes. Even if it was impossible for them to recover their territories, humans felt at ease since they couldn’t be taken as food.
That was why the unknown civilization wanted to break that impregnable defense. They planned to crush the hope of the humans.
‘That bastard, Lee Gun.’
He had demolished their invasion plans and put Abundance in this state.
‘I’m sure of it. He is someone who will destroy both the monarchs and the gods.’
Anyway, Abundance was in a bind.
‘If I get exterminated, Lee Gun would get all my territory and possessions. The barrier will disappear too.’
Its authority would be completely transferred to Lee Gun. That would create a lot of problems. In its territory, Abundance had hidden many things from the other monarchs.
‘If Lee Gun finds them, they’ll cause a lot of trouble.’
Therefore, Abundance was on the move even as it barely maintained its mind.
‘It’ll be fine. All will be solved if I reach Time.’
Time could use “Time Regression” to return Abundance to its original state. Moreover, Abundance planned on telling Time something.
‘Lee Gun has a weakness. There is a full-proof way of defeating him.’
Abundance had a realization as Lee Gun had defeated it. And if the one fighting him were Time, Time could carry out this tactic. Moreover, Time was the one that wanted to kill the Serpent Bearer twenty-four years ago.
[Anyway, we have to hurry up and go to Time…!]
[Yes! We are here! We just need to ride that gate!]
Abundance laughed at its underling’s words.
‘Just wait, Lee Gun. I’ll use your weakness to conquer you.’
Suddenly, Abundance, which was in the form of leather, flinched. The reason was the thick fog in its surroundings.
‘Could it be?’
Abundance was sure. This feeling belonged to that bastard. Abundance quickly yelled out when it felt an ominous feeling.
[Stop! Not here! We have to quickly take a different path!]
Abundance and the monster holding Abundance both suddenly disappeared.
At the same time, the other monster that had been running with them while acting as a lookout came to a stop.
[Uh? Why am I here?]
The monster stood there with a blank look, as if it had forgotten about its master.
Meanwhile, Abundance screamed as its hide was swallowed up by the fog.
[Damn it! What are you doing? This isn’t the way to Time’s encampment! Where are you going?]
[What? We are going to the Serpent Bearer.]
[Serpent… What?! Hey! Why would we go there?]
[Please wait! We’ll quickly head toward that arrogant Serpent Bearer, and I’ll make sure that you will become the Serpent Bearer’s wallet.]
[What are you talking about? Hey!!]
Abundance soon came to a realization. The reason was the attitude of his underlings.
Abundance knew which monarch had this power. This was a power that could make its subordinate forget about its loyalty.
Therefore, Abundance trembled.
‘It is that bastard.’
And as expected, Abundance felt a frighteningly chilling wave of energy behind it. Its body had been ripped apart by Lee Gun, so it wasn’t supposed to be able to feel the temperature. Yet, the sensation was vivid, as if the energy would eat its soul.
Abundance felt the presence of the being that had made its subordinate forget its loyalty, the being that was also the culprit that precipitated all of this—Oblivion.
Oblivion’s mouth was open as it tried to eat Abundance.
Knowing Oblivion’s power, Abundance screamed.
[Ahhk! There is no point in eating me. My power, territory, and authority were stolen by the Serpent Bearer! I’m telling the truth— Kuhk!]
Abundance was instantly eaten.
Kwah-jeek!
When its eyes went extinct, the ground shook.
The Red Zone and the Black Zone ruled by Abundance changed into a clean Green Zone. Abundance and its underlings vanished from the wasteland.
Inside the fog, Oblivion roared.
[I still need more food.]
The tastiest food it had was some woman who had been with the Serpent Bearer twenty-four years ago.
Now that Oblivion thought about that, the one to eat everything belonging to the Abundance was… Wasn’t he called the Serpent Bearer?
Oblivion started to move.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Our Uncle is the Best (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Our Uncle is the Best (1)
[Lee Gun took care of the monsters invading Seoul.]
[A monster assumed to be a Monarch has been killed.]
[The Red Zone in Europe has transformed into an empty land.]
[The Red Zone has changed into a Green Zone.]
[Humanity holds a big festival. “Humanity recovered its land in 20 years.”]
[“The problem stemming from the lack of land is solved?” Lee Gun’s popularity has increased in various locations. He is being called the “Hope of Humanity”!]
[Will the Serpent Bearer take the newly vacated land?]
The world was in an uproar.
With the elimination of Abundance, the lands that were Red Zones had turned into Green Zones. The reason was that the barrier ruled by the power of Abundance had disappeared.
Thanks to Lee Gun, humanity was able to recapture its territory, but there was one more step to execute.
That Green Zone land was in the middle of the Black Zone. The monsters under the other monarchs were drooling as they approached the fertile land. Humanity had to plant its flag before those monsters reached that place.
Also aware of this truth, Lee Gun was making equipment suitable for the job.
* * *
Back to the present…
“Uncle huzzah! Huzzah!!!” The moved Chun Sungjae was shedding tears. For some reason, he had his fists clenched as he wailed in joy.
Chun Yooha and Guisoon overlooked it. As for the baffled Leo Saint Stevens, he just looked at Chun Sungjae.
Their group was on the flying castle, Drachma. Drachma was the suspended castle where Lee Gun had kicked off Stevens toward the territory of the unknown civilization.
The reason for this group’s visit to the flying castle was to conduct a Physical Examination. The Physical Examination wasn’t that big of a deal. It happened once every fall.
Humanity hosted huge events at Drachma. One of them was the Battle of the Zodiac Temples, where the Zodiacs and their temples pitted their strengths against each other. Another event was the Physical Examination.
In simple words, Physical Examination was an event where one’s abilities were checked. The evaluation determined what kind of equipment and weapons one would receive as an upgrade.
The Battle of the Zodiac Temples was more than a battle between temples. Captured monsters from the unknown civilization were hunted down. It was a place to compare superiority between temples and for one to showcase one’s skills to the world.
At this event, numerous disciples transferred between temples; they were scouted here. It was also an event that was held in preparation for a raid to the unknown civilization.
Anyway, the Physical Examination occurred on the eve of the Battle of the Zodiac Temples.
Chun Sungjae was wailing in joy after coming back from the site of the physical examination. “I grew! My height! I tried everything, yet my height never grew before! But I grew taller this time!”
Dumbfounded, Guisoon looked at the wailing young man.
The Battle of the Zodiac Temples happened only once a year, and it was the only time when all the twelve Zodiacs and Zodiac Saints gathered in one place. It was humanity’s biggest festival day.
Moreover, the problem with Abundance’s land needed to be taken care of, so Chun Sungjae had come as a Zodiac Saint. He would participate in the Conference, and since he was already here, he had taken the physical examination.
“Uncle huzzah!! This is the best record in my life!”
Guisoon scoffed at him. “You grew only three centimeters.”
“What? As a man like me, you know the sorrow of being short!”
The Secretary flinched.
“It’s a full three centimeters! The front digit changed! I’m 160 cm tall now! As expected, Uncle is great!”
Lee Gun had given Chun Sungjae a Chalice that allowed the young man to grow in height. This was why Sungjae was sobbing in joy.
He had bowed toward the Chalice and reverentially drank from it every day for a week! And in that period, he had grown by three centimeters! It was enough of a reason to sing praises.
[Faith toward the Serpent Bearer has increased by a lot.]
[Life is satisfied by its Zodiac Saint’s happiness.]
[Faith toward the Serpent Bearer has increased by a lot.]
Guisoon, who had been standing next to Sungjae, opened her notebook in surprise.
[The Bible’s Psalm of Sungjae has grown by 100 pages.]
Guisoon despaired when useless pages appeared in droves.
Chun Sungjae didn’t care for her reaction. He cheered in joy. “I want to grow as tall as Uncle! I want to grow in another place like Uncle, too!”
At that moment, someone spoke in derision. “You’ll be the size of a child even if you do grow.”
“!!”
It was one of Sungjae’s old comrades. His old comrades were passing by this place after finishing their physical examination. They were the generals of the Gemini temple from the Korean branch, Japanese branch, and Chinese branch.
These magicians under the Gemini temple were displeased with Chun Sungjae. When he was in their temple, Chun Sungjae had been a mere A-rank. Naturally, his becoming a Zodiac Saint displeased them.
“A shorty like you became a Zodiac Saint. I bet you became one because you sucked up to Lee Gun-nim.”
The guard in front of them reacted in fright.
“Eiji-nim!”
This guard was Chun Sungjae’s old guard, Hwang Young. Lee Gun had met him when they had gone to meet the Appraiser.
“He’s a Zodiac Saint now! You can’t treat him with such disrespect!”
The magicians of the Gemini temple just snorted.
“This little shrimp is a Zodiac Saint?! Also, how can he be the Zodiac Saint of Life? Do you remember his bizarre skill record? All of his attack skills were S+ rank, but all the healing skills came up as F rank!”
“That is true, but….”
“You should be the Zodiac Saint of Death! It’s a joke that you’re under Life! The Zodiac Saint of Life is a title befitting someone like our Saintess!”
Chun Sungjae got angry. Saintess, my ass! She was the one to steal his uncle’s data, which resulted in a strange daughter! That Saintess was a thief!
When Chun Sungjae remembered Carly, sparks flew in his eyes. The damn Saintess was the main culprit! She was probably here today!
The young man said, “If she is the Saintess, I’m the Paragon!”
“Huh? Paragon? Can you even use a healing skill?”
Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed. “Of course. I can even revive someone.”
Along with the other disciples, Chun Yooha and Guisoon were hearing about this for the first time. Their eyes turned round. It was to be expected.
The Aquarius was known as the only healing Zodiac, yet it couldn’t pull off a miracle like a revival. That was why even Stevens was shocked.
‘The Serpent Bearer can do something even Sophie can’t?’
Did Lee Gun reach such heights already?
“It was said that the Serpent Bearer is on a higher level than the Saintess of the Aquarius temple. That seems to be true.”
At this moment, a notification rang.
[The Serpent Bearer’s reputation has increased.]
The magicians of the Gemini temple were taken aback when they realized they had suddenly increased the reputation of the Serpent Bearer. They stuttered.
“Revival? You’re a rookie compared to Heiji-nim, yet you can revive someone? Even Heiji-nim can’t do something like that—”
Tuhk!
Laughing, Chun Sungjae grabbed the magician’s arm. “Did you get hurt anywhere in recent days?”
“What? Why do you want to know that?”
“Why?” At that moment, Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed.
[“Wound” Revival]
“Ahhhhhk!” The magician foamed at the mouth as he fell over.
His pain was being revived. The magician clutched at his body. He felt like he was dying. Of course, someone loved this.
[“Life” is elated.]
[“Life’s” EXP has increased.]
[As Life grows, any related Personal Attributes will get upgraded.]
[It will be applied to the Zodiac and the disciples.]
The magician looked at Chun Sungjae, as if he had lost his mind. “Y… You bastard… When you meant revive— Ahhhk!”
Chun Sungjae grabbed the magician’s arm and said in a sympathetic voice, “The wound that you suffered not too long ago must be acting up. I’ll fix it right now for you.”
[Pain Revival (Stage 1)]
“Ahhhhhhhhk! Hey, Chun Sungjae!”
It couldn’t be seen, but a sharp pain was spreading throughout his body. The magician screamed as if he were about to die.
Soon, Chun Sungjae used Super Regeneration. Then, something surprising happened.
[The faulty healing has healed properly.]
[The strange wound has completely healed.]
[“Life” is overjoyed, saying this is a great understanding of Life.]
[It says the Serpent Bearer has a great Zodiac Saint.]
[“Life’s” EXP has increased.]
From the beginning, Chun Sungjae had sensed something was off through the Eyes of Discernment.
‘It doesn’t look as if the Aquarius Saint healed the wound. What is it?’
Then, using Eyes of Discernment, he saw where the wounds were. It seemed the wounds hadn’t been healed properly. It seemed as if skin had been put over the wound to make the wound look like it was healed.
‘Did he go to some quack healer?’
[You can sense the energy of the unknown civilization.]
It didn’t matter in the end.
“I healed you. I want thirty million won. You can deposit it to the Serpent Bearer’s temple.”
“Your temple is charging highway robbery.”
In the end, the magician fainted from the pain.
Chun Sungjae merely brushed his hands off. Of course, everyone else didn’t know how the pain came to be. They just watched the man’s wound flare up once again and Chun Sungjae heal him.
‘I didn’t need to revive the pain, but he was being an asshole.’
Chun Yooha raised her thumb in approval. Guisoon looked sick and tired of the two siblings.
However, the siblings’ actions were understandable. Why?
‘The Serpent Bearer’s temple is new, so they are poor(?).’
Yes, after becoming Zodiac Saints, the siblings had been stunned to find that their temple was poor.
The Leo temple and the Gemini temple were rich. But the newly established temple of the Serpent Bearer was different.
[Serpent Bearer’s Talent: 10]
[Sagittarius’s Talent: 3,789,900]
[Virgo’s Talent: 198,944,840,000]
Talent(Currency, Chance) was the money used by the gods. The tributes and the donations given by the normal disciples were converted to the currency used by the gods. All tributes given by humans held certain values.
Talent in the form of Points could be given to the disciples as salaries. Constructs used Talent to keep up their respectability. It was used as a development fund for the temple and also for trade between temples. It was used in all facets.
This also meant there was a divide between rich temples and poor temples. The siblings had heard Lee Gun mention all this when he was raising his new skills.
‘Talent? Oh! You need Talent for intermediate skills?’
The Chun siblings were in charge of running the Serpent Bearer’s temple. So, aside from EXP, they coveted wealth.
The Gemini temple was flush with cash thanks to selling the Teleport spell. The siblings’ father was an honest person and worked as a mercenary.
In many ways, the disciples had to diligently work for the Zodiac.
‘Uncle is making something important right now.’
Lee Gun had said that to fulfill the requirements needed to grow Life, an aspirational figure was needed for humanity. Therefore, he was making something related to the hope of humanity; it was a necessity to recover the stolen human territories.
Anyway, the two siblings’ actions seemed to bear fruit.
“Wow! The Serpent Bearer’s temple is good. As expected, it’s a healing-type temple!”
“Will the Serpent Bearer’s Zodiac Saints fight other Zodiac Saints in the Battle of the Temples?”
“Are you sure they are doing it this year? The invasion made it so that the Zodiac Saints will have a meeting beforehand. It’s about the raid, and it looks like they will be exiting the dome in earnest.”
“You’re right, but the Battle of the Temples has to be held for the special land of the gods to be summoned. There is no way the Zodiacs will give up on that. It is their opportunity to grow.”
“Uh! Does that mean the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer will take the field?”
“I hope Lee Gun-nim comes out as a special guest.”
“Kyaa! If Lee Gun comes out, the whole world will be abuzz!”
[Serpent Bearer’s reputation has increased.]
[Serpent Bearer’s reputation has increased.]
The Chun siblings were satisfied.
“Let’s use this opportunity to look for disciples.”
“Absolutely”
However, they still seemed worried about the person Abundance had changed into.
‘We still have a lot that we don’t know about Uncle.’
Despite not knowing the full story, the siblings knew their uncle had enemies he was aiming for.
‘We have to work harder for Uncle.’
They wanted to be of help to Lee Gun.
At another place, someone was just scratching his cheek while the people around him were abuzz.
‘He is amazing.’
It was Chun Sungjae’s roommate and long-time best friend, Hahn Jimin.
‘The gap already felt large between the C rank and the A rank.’
Now that Chun Sungjae had become a Zodiac Saint, it felt as if he were on a different planet. Of course, Hahn Jimin knew his friend wasn’t someone to distance himself from him.
– The Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer is odd. There are levels to it. I can’t believe a Zodiac Saint is hanging out with a low-rank awakened being.
However, the people around them didn’t think the same. But that wasn’t important right now.
“Will it be ok, Sungjae? I heard the Genius Workshop is in an uproar because of Lee Gun-nim.”
“What? Because of Uncle? Why??”
“It has to do with the weapons he made?”
“Weapons??”
* * *
Around that time.
[“Lee Gun’s weapons are a million times better than the weapons of the Genius Workshop?” It is blowing up amongst the battle-type temple community.]
[The rumor is widespread. The Genius Workshop is directly under the supervision of the Capricorn. The craftsmen there are angry.]
[“Lee Gun is an excellent fighter, but he’s an amateur as a manufacturer. He cannot be compared to the master craftsmen of the Capricorn temple,” said an elite master craftsman of the Capricorn temple.]
[“Capricorn made Heaven’s Punishment for him.”]
[It is like a brand name. There is no substance. Their worth is inflated.]
[If there is an opportunity, we would like to invite Lee Gun to do a demonstration. We will compare the weapons.]
Hugo clicked his tongue as the articles started popping up again. “Jeez! I was wondering why the disciples were in an uproar the last time, when Seoul was invaded.”
The commotion was rooted in the weapons made for the disciples of the Sagittarius temple. Some were asking if Lee Gun really knew how to manufacture. They wondered if he was trying to deceive others. It was a total mess.
Anyway, the rumors circulating recently said that Lee Gun’s weapons were better than the weapons from the Genius Workshop. Since those within the Genius Workshop were a prideful bunch, this had caused an uproar.
‘That is what you get for flaunting your arrogance.’
Hugo’s temple had been completely ignored by the workshop since it didn’t have money. Even a Zodiac Saint like him was turned away.
But their current reactions were understandable.
‘Yes. Who the hell would think Gun is a manufacturer when seeing his fighting ability?’
As the head of a battle-type temple, Hugo became angry.
‘The Serpent Bearer’s temple is being called a battle-type temple right now.’
They knew Lee Gun’s profession was manufacturing, but just saying it out loud made them feel a deep sense of shame.
‘Well, I was hoping the Scorpio temple would do well in the Battle of the Temple, yet this mess happened.’
Even if Lee Gun did have excellent manufacturing skills, no one thought he would be better than the Capricorn, who was known as the Maker Zodiac.
In the end, people had to see it for themselves.
“Gun, give me a couple of the weapons that you made. The Genius Workshop is doing a demonstration. I just have to toss them a couple of your weapons.”
Lee Gun nodded in an easygoing manner and told Hugo to take a couple of them.
“Gun?”
However, Lee Gun didn’t care about that. He looked at the body of the Abundance monarch that he had scraped together. “It really is there.”
“What is?”
Lee Gun used his skill.
[Reaper Summon!]
Suddenly, someone appeared in the room.
Hugo reared back in shock when he saw this person.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Our Uncle is the Best (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Our Uncle is the Best (2)
[Reaper Summon]
Hugo reared back in shock when he saw this person. This shadow that was in the shape of a person was the Pisces Saint.
Hugo hadn’t been sure at first. However, he recognized her when she saw the features hidden between her gloomy hairstyle. “Liv!”
The name of the person before them was Liv Rich, and she was the Zodiac Saint of the Pisces temple.
Amongst the twelve Zodiac temples, two were great magic temples, the Pisces temple being one of them. If the Gemini temple was known for its magic engineering, the Pisces temple was known for its members being like druids. Their styles also differed.
Despite both temples being magical organizations, the Zodiac Saints of both temples were different. Heiji was tall and also strong like a leopard, but Liv was short in stature. If one had to make a comparison, the Pisces Saint was like a philosopher that didn’t leave her alcove.
‘It felt like one was a social butterfly and the other was a loner.’
When Liv was put next to Heiji, the difference was stark.
Hugo remembered that the Pisces Saint was a girl who didn’t laugh a lot.
‘She seemed to hate Gun, but…’
Was she someone that would like him in the first place? Anyway, why did she come out of there? Moreover, she looked like jelly. Clearly, she wasn’t in her normal state. But it didn’t matter.
[She is a contractor who has received a blessing from a hostile god.]
[Warning! She has received a blessing from a god that threatens the Serpent Bearer.]
[Warning! The affiliate Zodiac Saints must terminate the enemy of the master.]
As the voice rang out, Hugo’s body reacted automatically.
‘!’
The magical energy of the Serpent Bearer surged forth. It must have happened since this woman was the Zodiac Saint of a Zodiac that was hostile to Lee Gun.
Seeing this, Liv quickly tried to run away.
‘It’ll be troublesome if Lee Gun catches me.’
When Liv tried to run away, Hugo acted as if he would have none of it. He shot his arrow.
Shoong!
“!”
However, the arrow just passed through her, surprising Hugo.
‘Physical attacks don’t work on her.’
That meant!
Realizing this fortuitous development, Liv tried to disappear through the wall. There was no way their powers could catch her. She was about to pass through the wall…
[Kuhk!]
However, she was unable to. Lee Gun had caught her by her hair.
Clench!
The flustered Liv tried to turn her head, but Lee Gun yanked her hair. Hugo also tried to help Lee Gun detain her.
Shoong!
“!”
As expected, Hugo’s hand passed right through her.
Lee Gun looked at the flustered Hugo, as if the Archer Saint were pathetic. Lee Gun then said, “Why would you be able to catch her, idiot? She’s a soul.”
“What?”
“Do you realize which skill I used?”
“!”
Hugo realized his mistake. His friend had used a skill he had gained after reaching the second stage of the Divine Status of Death, Reaper Summon.
In simple words, it was a skill that summoned the dead. That meant…!
“W-Wait a moment. Are you saying she’s dead?!”
“Since she reacted to this skill, I guess so?”
Hugo’s mouth fell open from shock. It couldn’t be. Liv had contacted him just a month ago to protect her holy ground. Moreover, when Giselle had invaded his holy ground with the Taurus Saint, Liv had been there with them.
‘Does it mean that she was killed within the past couple of weeks?’
Lee Gun didn’t care about any of that. He let out a cold smile. “This is good since I have business with the Pisces.”
The Pisces had been the one to change Jean-Louis into Kevin at the Devil’s Tower.
Lee Gun was going to crush any Zodiacs who had been involved in his affairs. He would put all of their temples under him.
‘After I killed Abundance, the others are starting to move.’
The ones aiming for the empty lands that used to be under Abundance were on the move. They were the ones who had brought monsters to the earth and the ones responsible for killing “her” twenty-four years ago.
Moreover, the Pisces Saint would be helpful in getting rid of the monarchs that had invaded Seoul twenty-four years ago. She’d also be a big help in taking care of the remaining Zodiacs.
It was as if Liv was looking down on Lee Gun’s murderous intent and plans. She looked like an invalid with her long hair up until that point, but her eyes suddenly flashed. Soon, a strange symbol appeared in her large eyes.
Flash!
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when an odd flash of light appeared before him. A severe burn appeared on his hand.
Kwah-jeek!
[The power of Pisces has dealt a big blow to the deity.]
That wasn’t all.
[The servant of the Pisces has hidden.]
“!”
Lee Gun looked at his hand. Liv wasn’t there anymore. As expected of the transformation Zodiac Saint, she had transformed into something else, then disappeared. Her presence couldn’t be felt.
The transformation ability used by a Saint rank wasn’t poor at all. Moreover, Liv was the Zodiac Saint of the second great magic temple.
The problem was her personality; she was a hikikomori who didn’t like to do troublesome things. Her abilities were fantastic. Her laziness meant that she hid whenever she didn’t want to do something!
“She probably changed into an item.”
“It is obvious!”
Liv found going out to battle too troublesome, so she usually changed herself into a lamp, sofa, book, or wallpaper. She had slept through it all.
Since Hugo knew this, he used his ability to see through things. He first looked at the furniture.
“Tsk! I don’t think she got out.”
If she had, the barrier of the holy ground would have shown a reaction.
While Hugo and Lee Gun were looking at their surroundings, a microscopic organism was trying to exit through the crack in the door.
‘They won’t notice me.’
Yes, it was what Liv had transformed into!
Even if those two were amazing, they wouldn’t notice a microscopic organism.
Liv inwardly laughed in a mocking manner. She was about to leisurely exit the place. However…
Kwahng!
“Lee Gun!! Is it true that you had a girlfriend?”
“?!”
Suddenly, Kevin fell from the sky.
Hugo and Lee Gun were surprised by Kevin’s unexpected appearance. Moreover, the most shocked one was neither of them.
[Poo-huh-huhk…!]
When Kevin had suddenly shown up, Liv had gotten squashed under his foot. His timing had been poor.
Liv had been about to exit through the crack in the door when the Virgo Saint had appeared from the air! Then, he had stepped on her! There was more. Kevin had always been an ice-type awakened being!
Doo-doo-doohk!
[The servant of the Pisces froze from the Virgo’s ice.]
“!”
Since Kevin was emitting his magical energy, the ground froze. And when the ground froze, Liv’s movements slowed down.
Unaware of all this, Kevin asked, “Hey, I’m asking you a question! Did you really have a girlfriend before?”
Hugo was dumbfounded. Why the hell did he show up to ask such a question?
“Gun is a loner. Of course, he never had a lov— Kuhk!!”
Lee Gun kicked Hugo.
As if he was satisfied with the answer, Kevin relaxed. “What the hell? It is a false rumor?”
He had thought he would get to hear a juicy story. Kevin clicked his tongue as if he was disappointed. “It is fine if you didn’t have one. I heard in my territory that Lee Gun had a child. I knew that was a lie. When I heard Lee Gun had a girlfriend, I thought it might be true. That was why I was surprised. I’ll head back now.”
Kevin was about to move. Liv became happy when her upper body became free.
‘Yes. Move your feet all the way. That is all I need.’
She and the Virgo Saint were like oil and water. When the temperature dropped, fish couldn’t move freely.
After Kevin left, Liv would be able to detonate her Zodiac’s power. She would be able to destroy this place. However, it didn’t happen as she wished.
Hugo stopped Kevin. “What the hell? Did you use Teleport just to ask that question?”
When Kevin turned his head, his weight shifted to his feet.
[Poo-huhk!]
Liv was about to use her magic when she was crushed once again.
The angry Hugo continued, “Do you realize how much one teleportation costs! You could have just called! If it’s from Europe, it should be at least four hundred thousand dollars…!”
“What about it? I don’t usually look at the price since that’s annoying. Isn’t that cheap?”
Hugo let out tears of blood. These rich Zodiac Saint bastards! Four hundred thousand dollars! His temple could use that amount as living expenses for ten years! And Kevin said that was cheap!
Lee Gun clicked his tongue when he saw Hugo shed tears of blood. “I’ll eat the Gemini soon, so you can use their teleport facility. Anyway, we have someone to find.”
Liv scoffed at Lee Gun’s words.
‘He wants to eat the Gemini? There is no way it’ll let him do that.’
Liv knew better since she was a magician Zodiac Saint. Heiji had gotten caught up in something that was her doing. She had been caught by Lee Gun in a ridiculous manner. However, her Zodiac was on a different level.
To stop an apex magician god, Lee Gun would need the wisdom of someone like the Pisces, who was also in charge of a magic temple.
‘Well, it has nothing to do with me.’
The conversation seemed to be over, and Kevin was about to move. It made Liv happy. The foot seemed to be lifting since the power that was pressing down on her body started dissipating.
‘Good! Hurry!’
At that moment…
Kwahng!
Kevin suddenly put strength into his feet once again.
“!”
Then, he suddenly emanated cold energy!
[Northern Wind of January]
Liv screamed when the skill was suddenly activated.
[The servant of the Pisces cannot move since she is surrounded by ice.]
[You cannot maintain your transformation.]
At the same time, light exploded beneath Kevin’s foot, and Liv returned to her original form!
“Oh!”
Lee Gun laughed when he realized where Liv had been.
Liv couldn’t move thanks to the Virgo Saint’s energy.
Hugo was taken aback, but Kevin’s eyes flashed.
“Did you really think I wouldn’t know?”
[…!]
As soon as his foot had crushed Liv, Kevin had felt her energy. Taking out his royal holy item, he said, “I was wondering why I couldn’t find you even after I used a trace skill. You were hiding next to Lee Gun.”
Kevin seemed to have some business with Liv. “On the day we went to the Devil’s Tower, you stole my data after you knocked me out. Then, you transformed Jean-Louis, right?”
Kevin took out his royal holy item, the ice blade Winter Frost.
His blue eyes could be seen between his golden hair, and murderous intent raged inside them. “Since Lee Gun wants a piece of Giselle, I won’t lay a hand on her. However, you’re different. You shouldn’t have wronged me like that.”
Amongst all the Zodiac Saints, Kevin had been the only one who hadn’t gone into the Devil’s Tower. He felt humiliated by that. Moreover, he felt used by her.
“I’ll cut off your head myself.” Kevin was about to imbue Winter Frost with magical energy when…
Kwahng!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
A kick from Lee Gun sent her flying.
Kevin looked aggrieved. “What the hell are you doing?”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “Don’t touch her.”
“Why! You can let me have her since she’s my mortal enemy!”
Kevin became angry, saying Lee Gun was sparing her because she was a female Zodiac Saint.
However, Lee Gun just snorted as he looked at Liv. Liv was a soul. Kevin couldn’t cut her throat. The one doing had to be either Yooha or him since they possessed the attribute of death.
“She probably isn’t your mortal enemy.”
“What?”
“She was dead more than twenty years ago. That’s before the Devil’s Tower.”
The two alive Zodiac Saints became surprised. What? She was dead before Lee Gun was trapped?
“Then who is the Pisces Saint that we’ve seen until now?”
“Is it the Zodiac that was contracted to Liv?”
“No.”
“What? Who is it!”
Lee Gun laughed when he heard those words.
* * *
Around that time…
“Wahhhhhhhhh!”
The disciples had gathered at Drachma, and the place was full. The castle was brimming with cheers. It was to be expected since this place was full of people who the disciple didn’t usually get to see.
“It’s the Capricorn temple’s Ten Star!”
“There’s the master craftsmen of the Genius Workshop!”
The Genius Workshop was in charge of making all the weapons for humanity. Because of the numerous rumors about Lee Gun’s weapons circulating recently, they had come here to hold demonstrations.
They were awakened beings walking the single path of being master craftsmen. Therefore, weapons made haphazardly on the side being compared to their masterfully crafted weapons was an insult in itself. It made them angry. That wasn’t all.
‘The other countries said they would purchase our items for a high price.’
They planned on selling a bundle this time around. So their skills being compared to that of an amateur bothered them greatly.
‘This is the chance to undercut the faith toward the Serpent Bearer. It is a chance to raise the faith toward the Capricorn.’
That was the reason for their actions.
“Here. I brought the weapon Lee Gun created.”
“!”
The Archer disciples were behind them, looking baffled.
For some reason, these craftsmen had asked them for a weapon made by Lee Gun. Since Hugo had sent the Archer disciples several blades, the Archer disciple handed over all of them.
“This is useless.”
“What are they going to use to compare and test …”
The craftsmen held up the bow made by Lee Gun.
“Please listen to us closely! If you trust false information, it’ll endanger your lives. That is why we quickly hosted this event.”
“!”
Their eyes flashed seriously.
“I’ll say this again. An SS-rank holy item can be made only by the Genius Workshop. We are under the direct supervision of the Capricorn. No other Zodiac can make such items.”
“It is said that Lee Gun-nim made an SS-rank item. That is an irresponsible statement that could get disciples killed.”
“That’s right. What would happen if you bought a low-rank weapon when it was claimed to be an SS-rank? Do you realize what kind of damage you can suffer on the battlefield?”
“!”
The eyes of the Archer disciples turned round. Is that what these bastards were going to do?
“Please do not worry! We’ll confirm it for you.”
The master craftsmen held up a blade they had made at the same time as they held up the bow Lee Gun had made.
“If the item made by Lee Gun-nim is truly an SS-rank item, it should have the basic option of being as hard as diamond, right?”
The crowd stirred.
“This is an SS-rank blade we made. We’ll try to destroy the bow with the blade. If the bow is really an SS-rank item, it should withstand this attack.”
“If it isn’t…”
The result would be obvious.
They confidently raised the blade. The next second, the sword fell toward Lee Gun’s bow.

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Our Uncle is the Best (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Our Uncle is the Best (3)
Humanity had many large and small workshops. However, most of humanity and their governments chose to commission their items from the “Four Great Workshops.”
The Four Great Workshops were considered to be top tier. However, an elite and highly unique workshop leapfrogged even these four workshops. It was the Genius Workshop; they were known as the best.
The Genius Workshop was under the direct supervision of the Capricorn, the Zodiac of the Manufacturing temple. Moreover, it was the only workshop capable of manufacturing SS-rank holy items. This was why they held great power.
At one time, the Goat Saint had also been a part of the Genius Workshop. However, he had gone missing for some unknown reason.
Anyway, the news that Lee Gun could make SS-rank items too had sent the world in an uproar.
– Amazing! If Lee Gun can make SS-rank items, we don’t need to use the Genius Workshop, right?
– Wow! This is crazy! Lee Gun is a cheat.
– How do the disciples of the Capricorn temple create it when they aren’t SS-rank? Does one have to make a deal with the Capricorn?
– Have you ever seen the Capricorn do anything beneficial for someone other than its disciples?
– Does that mean they make SS-rank items on their own??
– In the first place, Lee Gun being a Maker is shocking.
– Normal Makers can’t raise their battle skills, right?
– Isn’t it a lie? Are you sure you don’t have to see the result of the “Physical Examination” to say such a thing?
– He’ll 100% be a battle-type. Such crazy fighting abilities can’t show up without that. I’ll eat my shorts if that’s untrue.
Making SS-rank items was a part of the Genius Workshop’s unique identity, and this was why its craftsmen were taken aback. Them stepping forward this time made sense.
‘There is no way a fighter like him could have made an SS-rank item.’
‘It may look like an SS-rank item, but it’ll be destroyed in front of a real SS-rank item.’
That wasn’t all.
‘It’s a great opportunity to sell our weapons since humanity is going to attempt to gain back its territories.’
Abundance was gone, and there were signs that expeditions would be conducted, something which humanity hadn’t done for the past twenty years.
This meant a massive quantity of equipment would be sold for the large-scale expeditions, making it a chance to increase the reputation of the Capricorn temple.
As proof, donations were flowing toward them from various countries.
‘The problem is Lee Gun.’
What if the rumor that Lee Gun’s weapons were amazing persisted? It would deal a critical blow to the Capricorn temple.
‘We have to stop him at all costs.’
If they couldn’t solve this disgrace, the orders for the manufacturing of the weapons would instead be transferred to Lee Gun.
‘He’s merely an amateur.’
All of that had led to this moment.
The master craftsmen wanted to show the truth. They wanted to regain the prestige of the Genius Workshop.
And this was why the sword was swung.
Shweek!
The sword clashed against the bow!
Clank!
The sound of metal breaking rang out.
Hearing the disastrous sound, the disciples clenched their eyes shut.
“Ah! The SS-rank bow was broken…!! Bows are rare…”
“Even if it wasn’t SS rank, it was probably an S-rank weapon…!”
“As expected of the weapon made by the Genius Workshop…”
However, when they opened their eyes, they almost screamed.
“W-What the hell!”
The item that had broken was the Genius Workshop’s longsword, not the bow made by Lee Gun.
They wondered if they were seeing something wrong. They looked at it once more, yet the result was the same.
When the blade of the longsword had struck the belly of the bow, the blade had ruthlessly shattered, and the broken end of the sword had impaled itself on the ground.
A deafening roar instantly broke out.
“The Genius Workshop’s sword broke!”
“What the hell? Is this for real?”
The crowd was abuzz.
Moreover, the ones most in disbelief were the ones who had brought down the sword.
‘T…This is crazy!’
Why did it break? Their faces were pale from shock as they looked at the broken sword.
At that dizzying moment, a voice rang out!
“The one that hit the bow broke! The Genius Workshop’s item broke!”
The flustered master craftsmen quickly hid the sword. Then, they desperately yelled.
“E-Everyone, this is a mistake!”
“!”
The raucous hall quietened down.
The master craftsmen continued.
“The weapon was swapped. This is a weapon with its durability almost at an end. They all look alike. Ha ha.”
Suddenly, turmoil erupted in the hall.
“They said it was a weapon with no durability.”
“Wasn’t it really shiny?”
“It was an item made by the Genius Workshop. Things that look good may not be necessarily better. Also, how many SS-rank items do you think they’ve made? It is understandable that they got it mixed up.”
“I guess.”
“Hey! Check the rank again! Since it looks the same, did you bring a C-rank item by mistake? How can a sword be unable to destroy a bow? Ha ha ha!”
The master craftsmen started sweating. In the end, they quickly gestured to their apprentices.
“Hey, hurry up and bring the other one. Bring Number three.”
“W-What?”
“Number three is…”
“Hurry up and bring it!”
The flustered apprentices ran as fast as they could. When they brought the item, the hall was abuzz once again.
The Archer disciples were dumbfounded, and their mouths fell open. This time, the opposite side had brought out a greatsword that was so long and big enough that only the strong Leo disciples could lift it.
The Archer disciples grabbed Goat in fright.
“T-They plan on hitting it like a hammer!”
“Hey, you guys are bullies! You plan on using a greatsword against a bow! That is a bit much!”
“Ahhk! No! They plan on breaking it…!”
“Goat, Lee Gun-nim made it for us! It’ll be broken in half! Go and get it back!”
Taken aback, Goat was about to step forward.
“He said they could do whatever to the bow to test it! However, they are purposefully trying to break it! That is a step too far!”
Unlike his normal self, Goat had called Lee Gun the great Lee Gun-nim. That was how much the bow had moved him. He had poured his affection toward the bow.
Of course, he was desperate. At this point, it wasn’t a test. It was torture for him.
However, the greatsword fell down on the bow before Goat could take the stage.
Kwahng!!!
It was entirely different from before. Then, a scream reverberated in the hall.
Chaeng-gahng!
It was a clear sound, but it was the sound of something breaking. At the same time, a piece of metal flew into the sky.
Goat screamed as he was about to cry. “Ahhhk! That is the weapon that Lee Gun-nim made for me!”
“Ahhhhh! They finally caused an accident—”
The Archer disciples were about to rush forward, but their eyes turned round. Then shouts exploded within the hall.
“Ahhhhhk! What the hell is that?”
“Amazing! It is unharmed! What is that?”
“The greatsword was completely shattered!”
“This is awesome!!!!”
Yes, the broken item was once again the Genius Workshop’s weapon!
One of the master craftsmen held the sword that only had its hilt intact. He shook as he looked at the undamaged bow.
‘This is crazy…!’
A red light was circulating the sleek bow, and the bow didn’t have a scratch on it.
The master craftsmen were having a mental breakdown.
‘This doesn’t make sense. That greatsword was made by our Zodiac Saint.’
‘Moreover, he took a full swing at it!’
‘He also hit the joint where the bow should be the weakest!’
In the end, unable to accept the result, they kept hitting the bow with the handle.
[Goat’s Bow has received no damage.]
[Goat’s Bow has no idea why they are doing this, but it says this feels good. It says to scratch its back now.]
[The power of the massage(?) has made Goat’s Bow fall asleep.]
“What the hell? Why is a bow this hard?”
At those words, screams and cheers filled the hall.
Deeply moved, the Archer disciples covered their mouths.
“Holy shit! We received something excellent…!”
“I never expected it to be that durable!”
That greatsword was famous for being made by the Goat Saint! It was a first-class weapon!
They were used to having the cheapest equipment, so they felt honored. And that wasn’t all.
“Did you really think a sword could break our weapons? Aren’t you looking down on us too much? Do you realize how sturdy the base of the weapon has to be to withstand our strong grip?”
“That’s right! The bow made by Lee Gun-nim is strong enough to use as a blunt weapon!”
“It is incredibly light despite that…!”
“That’s right…! It is nuts! The bow we bought from the Capricorn temple was so heavy….”
“When we asked them to make it light for us, they blamed our strength!”
The Archer disciples sobbed in joy when they thought about the weapons that they had received.
‘Lee Gun-nim huzzah!’
Every one of them had used Lee Gun’s weapon, and they would continue to use it.
The master craftsmen were having a meltdown. They were trying to destroy the bow, yet it seemed to be getting shinier instead of getting battered.
‘This makes no sense.’
A Zodiac Saint had made that greatsword using a blueprint given by the Zodiac. There was no way… However, they soon realized the reason.
[Capricorn says anyone can make a bow.]
[Capricorn says Lee Gun and the Archer Saint are thick as thieves.]
[It states the Sagittarius gave Lee Gun the blueprint to their royal holy item.]
[It states you guys won’t have much problem making such a weapon with the blueprint.]
[That is why comparing weapons is unnecessary. It says to return immediately…]
The eyes of the master craftsmen flashed when they heard the revelation from their Zodiac.
“It just has to be something other than a bow!”
[?!]
It seemed they could finally accept what had happened.
“Yes. The Archer Saint is his friend. Of course, he has the blueprint of the royal holy item!”
“I… If we have it, we could make something similar!”
They quickly brought out Lee Gun’s blade, which the Archer disciples had handed over to them earlier.
“A sword should be compared to a sword instead of a bow.”
When they brought out the blade, the Archer disciples flinched. It was one of the Lee Gun-made items that Hugo had sent to them.
“Hey, hey. Are you sure that blade will be fine?”
“Uh. That is… It’s a common item made by Lee Gun-nim. He said he uses it for cutting beef jerky…”
“What?! That isn’t a blade made for fighting! Ahhk!”
“If they destroy it, they’ll say they won!”
Why the hell did their Saint-nim send such an item? They were about to react in fright when…
Clank!
“!?”
Cheers filled the hall.
“Waaaaaa! The sword broke!”
“It’s three straight losses for the Genius Workshop!”
“Hurry up and spread the word! Instead of the Genius Workshop, we have to ask the Serpent Bearer to make our weapons!”
The master craftsmen of the Genius Workshop turned pale when they saw the crowd’s movements. The problem wasn’t that their weapons were destroyed.
‘It’ll be troublesome if this gets leaked outside.’
“Really…!”
The master craftsman tried to use their disassembly skill without realizing it. They thought the weapons must have some strange mechanism to them.
“Hurry up and disassemble it!”
Kwah-jeek!!
The disassembly skill’s power was shocking like lightning, but when the power touched the weapons…
Kwahng!!!
The sleeping weapons made by Lee Gun suddenly woke up.
[Goat’s Bow is angry. It asks why the massage is intense.]
[The Sharp Jerky Knife is angry. It says the service is terrible.]
Goat’s bow and Lee Gun’s blade floated in the air, then they emanated magical energy and attacked the master craftsmen!
The crowd got more excited when they saw this scene. “What the hell? They are moving by themselves!”
“Are they possessed by a spirit?”
At that moment…
“Spirit! You wanna die!”
“!”
A familiar voice rang within the hall. It belonged to none other than Sungjae, and he was angry.
“All weapons made by Lee Gun-nim have a sense of self. They can grow on their own!”
His words caused a commotion within the hall. As if the durability wasn’t enough, the weapons responded by themselves!
“Are they for real?”
“Hey! Get out of the way. I want Lee Gun-nim to make my weapon!”
“Instead of the Genius Workshop, I want Lee Gun-nim!”
That wasn’t all. Chun Sungjae didn’t want to waste this moment. He kicked Goat with his foot.
Realizing what he had to do, Goat extended his hand. The action was unnecessary, but he called its name. The bow, which wanted to receive a massage, suddenly appeared in Goat’s hand.
Flash!
The disciples were surprised.
“What the hell? Teleportation?”
“That is the Serpent Bearer’s special engraving service. Anyone who wants it has to pay a hundred thousand per use.”
Goat’s mouth fell open when Sungjae started to run a business. The disciples didn’t care. They cheered as they gathered around Chun Sungjae.
“Will Lee Gun-nim take orders to make weapons?”
“Please! Make us some weapons!”
“Ah! I don’t know about that. For each engraving, I’ll have to talk to Unc— I’ll speak to Lee Gun-nim.”
“We’ll buy that service right now!”
“No, we are first!”
“Ahhhh! I’m sorry! The engraving service ran out for today. However, I will be sure to talk to Lee Gun-nim if you buy a Lee Gun-nim figurine with a number attached to it. However, the final decision will be up to Lee Gun-nim. If you’re fine with that, I’ll start the price at five thousand. There will be ten in line.”
“I’ll buy it! Six thousand!”
“Me! Seven thousand!”
“No! Me! Eight thousand!”
“Nine thousand! Please put in a good word to Lee Gun-nim!”
Chun Sungjae laughed like a little devil when he saw the people rush toward him.
However, the Archer disciples started to sweat.
“Those figurines are C-rank junk that Sungjae made, right? Isn’t he swindling them by selling it at that price?”
“Shhh!”
“Wow! Sungjae is selling them and checking their SNS to authenticate their purchases.”
“This is basically a missionary… Huh! The Serpent Bearer’s faith must be rising a lot…”
“Two billion won!!”
“Wow! Our Saint-nim should have made money that way…”
The Archer disciples started shedding tears.
On the other hand, the master craftsmen shook.
“The reputation of the Genius Workshop is…!”
They glared as they grabbed the shoulders of the Archer disciples.
“That bow! How long did it take him to make that?”
“What? I’m sure it was four— Ahhhk!”
The Archer disciples were pushed aside by the crowd. The master craftsman had heard only the number, but they laughed.
‘Four weeks!’
It took him four weeks to make a battle weapon!
‘We can make it in three weeks.’
Their eyes flashed.
“We didn’t plan on doing this, but…
“We would like to send a direct invitation to the place where our Zodiac-nim is dedicated.”
* * *
Around that time…
“What? Three weeks? It takes them three weeks to make one weapon?” The dumbfounded Lee Gun looked at Hugo.
The money and the contribution suddenly being sent to the Serpent Bearer were secondary.
“Hmph! I can slack off and make it in three days. What ingredients do they use?”
“Yes. They have to work 24/7 to… What?! Three days? It took you longer than that when you made weapons for us!”
“Why would I go full power to make equipment for you guys? That should be enough. You guys won’t be able to use it even if I give it to you.”
“#$*&#*!”
“That is a joke.”
Lee Gun then looked above the boiling melting pot. The Pisces Saint was hanging there.

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Spicy Fish Stew
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Spicy Fish Stew
Lee Gun’s Creation Workshop had a blast furnace that was the size of a building. It was his first workshop, where he had designed a large vase where he could melt down raw materials.
[Creation Workshop]
– Lv. 7 (Can make equipment for fighters)
– Current Size: 200 ㎡ (Big enough to make some stuff)
– Blast Furnace Status: Good. Manager: Torch.
– Workbench 1 Status: Good
– Workbench 2 Status: Dirty
– Warehouse Ingredient Status: 80% Full (33 m2)
Normally, the molten steel was extracted through a pipe. The ceiling of the blast furnace was where the materials were broken down, so it wasn’t usually open. However, it was different right now.
“G…Gun.”
“What?”
“Are you really planning on putting her in that?”
“Do you have a problem with it?”
“Of course, I have a problem with it!!”
Hugo looked at Liv, who was chained to the ceiling and was hanging over the opened blast furnace. Liv was like a food ingredient that was about to go next into a boiling pot.
The Pisces Saint was tied up and suspended using Lee Gun’s magical energy of Death. Normally, magical energy couldn’t act as a rope, as it was in this situation. However, Death had reached the second stage, and it could take a physical form. And there was more.
[“Death” says Disassembly will help in raising Death’s EXP.]
[Disassembly is more effective if it uses good quality material.]
[“Death” grumbles, asking how long it has to hold her.]
“Good. If I disassemble that, Death will grow by a lot.”
Hugo was baffled. “Hey! I can’t believe you‘re thinking about putting a soul into the blast furnace!! It’s too cruel!” He didn’t want to hear her scream.
At that moment, as if she was reacting to Hugo’s words, a voice came from the blast furnace.
[It’s fine. This is all so annoying. Just hurry up. Kill me by boiling me.]
“Hey! You’re supposed to ask him to spare your life!”
Hugo became angry, but it seemed Liv really felt that way. She knew Lee Gun had his eyes on her, so she was well aware of the fact that she won’t be able to escape.
‘Lee Gun was like that in the past.’
Liv would be sleeping, and Lee Gun would show up. He would grab her by the collar and toss her onto the battlefield. Whenever she hid, he found her using his supernatural senses.
This was why it was annoying to run away or put up resistance; hence, Liv asked Lee Gun to hurry up and kill her.
Hugo clicked his tongue. “Jeez! I should’ve expected this from you! You made a contract with your Zodiac so that you can sleep!”
Of course, Kevin had a role in Liv giving up the prospect of escaping. The nature of their powers clashed. Liv couldn’t do anything thanks to the ice around her.
Lee Gun said as he pushed Liv toward the boiling blast furnace, “If I use frozen fish as an ingredient, it isn’t going to be as fresh. Well, it doesn’t matter. I’m going to make Taeksoo’s weapon with her.”
“Yes, my weapon— What?! You are going to use her as an ingredient?!”
“Yeah. I need water-type data. Also, you don’t have a decent bow right now. Your royal holy item is only SS rank. You don’t want an EX-rank weapon?”
“No! Wait a moment!!”
He didn’t want to use a weapon containing the corpse of a Zodiac Saint.
As if it didn’t care about that, Life appeared above Lee Gun’s shoulder with a solemn expression on its face.
[“Life” is excited at the prospect of eating spicy fish stew.]
[“Life” says you should put in some red meat too.]
[The Leo likes that idea.]
The excited slime changed into a kitchen knife and got ready to put in more ingredients.
Hugo was shocked by this pandemonium.
Boom!
Lee Gun had pushed Liv into the blast furnace, but he suddenly stopped her. Liv was just one centimeter away from falling into the liquid inside the blast furnace.
Cheeeeek!
Her long hair fell into the molten steel and started to melt. Liv trembled. She seemed scared of dying.
[Ingredients have entered the Creation Workshop’s blast furnace, and 0.000001% has been disassembled.]
[You’ve acquired Disassembly EXP.]
[You have acquired the Pisces Saint’s data (Ocean Walking).]
[The power of the water is starting to melt into the blast furnace.]
[You can now make equipment related to the ocean.]
He knew it was possible, but this showed the blast furnace was good enough to melt a soul.
‘Even the Capricorn was unable to create such a workshop. What the hell did he use to make it?’
Moreover, one could also see body parts of the Cancer within the blast furnace.
Lee Gun laughed after stopping Liv. In truth, he had another reason for capturing Liv.
‘In the invasion of Seoul twenty-four years ago, the Leo had been there.’
However, the Leo had stated that it hadn’t been there. This meant it was someone from the Pisces temple, who were the masters of transformation. However, it was very difficult for a Saint rank to transform into a Zodiac. The probability of the culprit being the Pisces was high.
The Pisces Saint was the bait being used to draw out her Zodiac.
‘I need high-quality bait to catch the big fish.’
Therefore, Lee Gun let out murderous intent as he sent a signal to the slime.
The excited slime had the spicy fish stew in mind as it spat out something large.
Flash!
[Warning! The imprisoned Construct of the Pisces has been brought out.]
[The Construct of the Pisces is trying to escape the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground.]
The Pisces Construct captured at the hot spring turned into gas and tried to run away.
Naturally, Lee Gun wouldn’t just stand by. He quickly took a silver crystal out of a bottle and crushed it.
Pah-jeek!
[Virgo’s Frost Data] x37
– Northern Wind of January (SS)
– A blizzard containing the extreme cold energy is summoned
– The power and the range of the skill differ in proportion depending on the restriction one places on it.
This was the data he had collected whenever he kicked Kevin. Of course, Lee Gun was the head Zodiac, so there was no rental fee for him. He just had to take the skill. However, this skill wasn’t up for rental, so he had to beat up Kevin to take it.
[The lowest restriction: Cuss out Hugo Otis for 10 minutes.]
[The smallest blizzard has been summoned.]
[Diameter: 2 m]
Koo-goo-goong!
[The overpowering ice has frozen the Construct (Low-rank).]
The Construct that had been trying to run away in its gaseous form fell to the ground in its frozen state.
At that moment, Lee Gun extended his hand. Despite him not calling its name, Heaven’s Punishment appeared in his hand!
Lee Gun was about to break apart the frozen Construct.
‘!’
But for some reason, he didn’t. He instead said, “Open the gate to the holy ground.”
“!!”
Hugo reacted in fright when he heard the unexpected shout. “Hey!”
The “Open the Gate” command completely removed the barrier around the holy ground.
[According to the Serpent Bearer’s will, the barrier around the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground has been removed.]
The flustered Hugo became angry. “Have you lost your mind?! The Zodiacs and the monarchs are all aiming for you!”
A Zodiac’s energy was very powerful. The holy ground being open meant the barrier no longer hid Lee Gun’s location. His enemies could sense where he was. He had basically opened the front door to his house.
Many enemies were looking for Lee Gun, and there was no way they would sit still now. And as expected…
Paht!
When the holy ground’s barrier disappeared, a large star flashed in the sky. The dome around the holy ground dissipated like sand as a shooting star fell.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!!!
“Koo-oohk!”
The incredible power split the ground and swept away the objects within the Creation Workshop.
Koo-goong!
It was like a calm wave meeting a storm. The energy surged several meters into the air. This menacing energy was surely the power of a god!
‘Zodiac Descent!’
A Zodiac had invaded. As proof, an incredible wave of magical energy flashed above the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground. If one saw the color, it would become clear who one was dealing with.
The Gemini’s color was a deep blue. This blue was much lighter. It was sky blue!
‘Pisces!’
Surprised, Kevin and Hugo quickly got ready for battle.
With a flame, a sword appeared in Hugo’s hand. As for Kevin, silver particles appeared around him. Then, silver armor with a blue cape appeared above his clothes. The two of them were ready for war!
On the other hand, Lee Gun was calm in this tense situation. “I knew the head would come if I tried to kill your Constructs with my door wide open.”
His red eyes flashed below his black hair. Then he smirked.
[Close the Gate!]
It was as if he had been waiting for this moment. The barrier was activated once again.
The eyes of the trespasser flashed when it saw the barrier.
[You are very underhanded, snake god!]
At a glance, the floating Pisces looked like a woman. However, she was different from the Sagittarius and the Virgo. She looked more like a fairy. In truth, her body looked closer to liquid.
The Pisces was about to fly toward Lee Gun to kill him, but…
“It’s best if you don’t move.”
[What nonsense are you—]
“You’ll do it unless you want to see your Zodiac Saint melted.”
The Zodiac followed Lee Gun’s finger, and she screamed.
[Ahhhk! Zodiac Saint-nim!]
Her solemn expression instantly changed. She had discovered Liv, who was about to get melted by the blast furnace.
When the Zodiac discovered her Zodiac Saint, her voice got higher as she cried.
[Zodiac Saint-nim! Why are you in such a state?]
Liv sighed when she heard the voice.
[If you aren’t going to be of any help, why did you show up?]
The Zodiac screamed as she tried flying toward the blast furnace.
[I was wondering why I couldn’t contact you… What happened… No! Wait a moment! I’ll save you right now!]
However…
[Serpent Eater]
Boom!
The serpent chain extended into the sky.
Desperate, the Zodiac changed into a fish made out of water. She tried to absorb herself into the ground, but it was useless.
[Sun’s Tracking (S)] x 10538
– The tracking skill of the Sagittarius temple was taken by kicking Hugo Otis.
– The same skill can be rented from the Sagittarius temple.
The god was instantly caught when the tracking skill was used.
[Huh-uhk!]
When its location was discerned, Lee Gun’s Serpent Eater technique bore into the ground. The tracking skill allowed him to locate the Pisces even in the dark underground.
Kwah-jeek!
Lee Gun pulled back with his arms as if he was dragging a net, and the Pisces was dragged out.
[Ahhhk!]
The fish-shaped Zodiac screamed in desperation.
[Why are you doing this, Serpent Bearer? Isn’t she your old comrade? This is a bit…!]
Lee Gun’s eyes menacingly flashed. “Comrade?”
[I… I mean… You already know she isn’t the one who killed you… She had already been killed before you were trapped inside the tower…!]
A frightening power surged next to them.
Boom!
Then a cold voice rang out.
[Was it you?]
It was Kevin.
[Did you render me unconscious? Did you steal my data to transform Jean-Louis, who stabbed Lee Gun, into me?]
It was as if his emotions were going to explode. He was about to unconsciously activate his Demigod state. Of course, the Virgo tried to play a trick by changing Kevin’s appearance.
Seeing this, Hugo slapped the back of Kevin’s head. “Hey, you said you don’t like turning into a woman. Get a grip.”
“Kuh-huhk!! Damn it! Anyway, Liv Rich was dead twenty years ago. That means the one I’m referring to is the Pisces!”
As if Kevin couldn’t let it pass, the wicked ice was about to surge forward.
Bbah-gahk!
However, a kick sent him flying.
“Kuhk!”
It was Lee Gun.
Kevin felt aggrieved as he yelled, “What the hell are you doing?”
“You want to die? Quality will suffer if you freeze it.”
“?!!”
At this moment, the Pisces spoke as if it was aggrieved.
[Do not get it twisted, servant of the Virgo. I wasn’t the one to render you unconscious. Another Zodiac conspired with Giselle to trap the Serpent Bearer in the tower.]
“What?”
[The Pisces temple has two Zodiacs.]
“!”
[He’s the culprit. Like Giselle, he tried to eat Zodiac Saint-nim, but he failed. This was why he sold Zodiac Saint-nim’s soul as food to a monarch.]
That was why the Pisces Saint’s soul was within the stomach of Abundance.
[Zodiac Saint-nim was taken hostage, so my hands were tied. I conspired against the Zodiacs and the monarchs— Huhk!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if he had enough. “You disguised as her to call me, right? You said your holy ground was in danger.”
[…!]
While her voice sounded like Liv’s, the Zodiac’s way of speaking had been different. This was why Lee Gun had completely ignored the request from the Pisces temple.
‘On the day I killed Cancer, four suspects were left. They were the Gemini, the Taurus, the Capricorn, and the Pisces.’
Of course, the energy of the Pisces had appeared back then, but it wasn’t this one. It was the other fish. He was the one who had called the monarchs into Seoul twenty-four years ago. That wasn’t all.
Jean-Louis did say it when he was dying.
“The true culprits who trapped you within the Devil’s Tower were the Zodiacs.”
This was why Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “Why are the Zodiacs trying to kill me?”
[T… That has to do with a truth that the twelve Zodiacs don’t want to get out…]
“Is that so?” Lee Gun grinned. “Anyway, I know now. You’re not the culprit. I now know that it was a misunderstanding.”
[Then…!]
Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “I’ll use both of you as ingredients.”
[Thank y— What?!!]
[!]
Kwahng!
When Lee Gun gave the signal, the Pisces Saint fell into the blast furnace.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Eve of the Festival (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Eve of the Festival (1)
Kwahng!
When Lee Gun gave the signal, the Pisces Saint fell into the blast furnace.
Hugo screamed, “Gun!! What are you…!”
He opened and closed his mouth as if he wanted to ask what Lee Gun was thinking.
Lee Gun whispered to him, “Don’t overreact. She won’t die from this. She’s already dead.”
“!”
Lee Gun knew Liv had nothing to do with his death. However…
‘The Zodiac knew about the real culprit, right?’
The Zodiac knew the culprit, yet she hid the truth from Kevin. Moreover, she was shameless enough to call Lee Gun for help in defending her holy ground.
The Zodiac might have had good reasons for doing so, but there was no way Lee Gun would look kindly on such actions. Also, the Zodiac was close to Liv, so Liv might have known about that incident.
‘Despite being in her soul state, she can still use magic. She had plenty of ways to send a message to Taeksoo.’
Well, Lee Gun could see the writing on the wall.
It had probably been too troublesome, so Liv had decided to sleep within the body of the Abundance Monarch. In reality, that was the truth.
Liv fell toward the blast furnace, and frightened by the sight, she screamed.
[Kyaaaaa! Zodiac Saint-nimmmmm!]
Splash!
The sound of Liv falling into the molten steel within the blast furnace rang out clearly!
The flustered Zodiac emitted her power.
Kwah-jeek!
In front of this power, Hugo and Kevin flinched. This power was so strong that it made the Zodiac Saints shake in fear.
[The Zodiac of the Pisces Temple is the ruler of the sea creatures. Her abilities have increased.]
[The Pisces has activated the Sea God’s Instinct.]
Her eyes flashed as her frightening divine status exploded forth. The Serpent Eater skill had trapped the Zodiac, yet she escaped in an instant.
[Warning! The Pisces’s energy is threatening the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground.]
Kwahng!
Flustered, Kevin quickly raised his sword. The Virgo Constructs, who had been secretly hiding within Kevin’s shadow as they thirsted after Lee Gun, ground their teeth as they popped out.
[Baby snake-nim has yet to fully recover his power!]
[How dare you do this inside Baby snake-nim’s territory!]
They weren’t Constructs of a battle-type temple without reason.
Kevin was surprised to see the goddesses appear. “What the hell? When did they hide there… Koohk!”
In a flash, five battle goddesses showed up and raised their blades.
[Kevin! What are you doing? Hurry up and activate Master’s Winter Frost!]
[She’s Baby snake-nim’s precious ingredient— No, I meant to say that you’re about to lose the enemy!]
“I told you guys not to follow after me— Ahhhk!”
A light arrow almost grazed past the side of Kevin’s face.
Hugo was the one who had shot it. The sun’s arrow shot forth like a laser and headed toward the Zodiac, who was moving toward the blast furnace.
The Zodiac’s eyes flashed.
[Illusion Alteration (SSS)]
– Changes all attacks.
The Zodiac’s technique turned the Archer Saint’s arrow into flower petals, which dispersed into the air.
“…!”
[Saint-nim!]
The Zodiac disappeared through the flower petals and landed on the blast furnace.
Boom!
[Saint-nim! Where are you?]
The Zodiac desperately looked for Liv, but Liv seemed to have already fallen into the blast furnace.
The sight of the back of Liv’s head as she floated in the molten steel proved this to the Zodiac. The freaked-out Zodiac was about to scream when…
“What are you doing? Hurry up. You go in too.”
[Kyaaaaa?!]
As if he were waiting for this moment. Lee Gun jumped and kicked the Zodiac.
Bbah-gahk!
The flying kick felt like it was faster than light as the foot slammed into the Zodiac’s back.
[Kyahhhhk!]
The Pisces followed Liv into the blast furnace.
Splash!
[The ingredients that have entered the Blast Furnace will be disassembled.]
[Ahhk. No… Kyahhk!]
Kevin and his Constructs had a realization.
Lee Gun had purposefully let the Pisces escape the Serpent Eater skill.
