Hugo grabbed the back of his neck. If a human soul had fallen into the blast furnace, it wouldn’t do much. Lee Gun had tossed Liv into the blast furnace to lure the Zodiac. That was why Hugo found Lee Gun’s move problematic.
“Damn it! It seems he won’t really use it as an ingredient to make my weapon.”
On the other hand, the Virgo Constructs started entering Kevin’s shadow after they had accepted the situation.
[Go help Baby snake-nim make his weapon, Kevin.]
[Ah! You should go wash yourself with Baby snake-nim!]
[Since you are guys, you can wash each other’s backs. Why don’t you get closer to him? Hhmm!]
It seemed they planned to stay hidden and peep on Lee Gun.
Kevin’s eyes flashed at their hidden agenda.
[Poo-hahk!]
Suddenly, the Pisces was tossed out of the blast furnace.
“!!”
Everyone was surprised by the sight.
[You are alive?!]
However, Lee Gun seemed to have been aiming for this. “It’ll be troublesome if they die already.”
Yes, he was the one to fish out the Pisces from the blast furnace. Of course, it wasn’t just the Zodiac.
[H-Huh-uhk! Saint-nim!]
Liv was still tied up by death as she was dragged out of the blast furnace.
However, the appearances of the Zodiac and her Zodiac Saint differed had changed a little. The Zodiac’s divine status was disassembled, and half of her arm was gone. Liv’s hair had vanished too.
However, Liv was afraid of something more than being tossed into the blast furnace.
[Wow! The blast furnace has piranhas like Lee Gun within it.]
[Saint-nim! You aren’t supposed to be afraid of them!]
It was understandable.
When Liv had entered the blast furnace, she had realized it was full of steel fish that melted down the ingredients. And these fish were letting out grotesque smiles. They were the tools that would break down the ingredients brought inside the furnace.
The Zodiac looked relieved when Lee Gun had fished them out. Liv was merely a soul, so she couldn’t feel pain. There would be no big setback. However, the shock to her mental state would be a problem.
The Pisces was fine since she had innate magic, but she didn’t like the blast furnace at all.
‘It broke down my divine status…!’
Half of her arm was gone, and mysterious sky-colored rocks were floating on the top of the molten steel.
The Zodiac reared back in fright.
‘Did my arm turn into ingredients?!’
Even she would die if he used this method!
While the Zodiac was in a state of panic…
Flash!
Lee Gun unexpectedly used Super Regeneration on Pisces and Liv. He regenerated them.
The blast furnace grumbled at this sight.
[Blast Furnace is sullen]
[Blast Furnace is sad that the ingredients for the spicy fish stew are gone.]
This overjoyed the Zodiac She seemed to have a realization.
[Saint-nim! Rejoice! Fortunately, the Serpent Bearer will show us generosity…!]
In truth, the Pisces temple was the only one that could stop the Zodiac of the Gemini temple as it was a magic temple. The Gemini temple was one of the top three temples that Lee Gun was wary of.
‘If I go head-on against a god of magic, there is no way my body will survive the encounter.’
Lee Gun was an intelligent person, so he naturally knew this.
‘Basically, he’ll be the most inconvenienced one if he kills us.’
So the Pisces smiled as she lowered her head.
[I won’t forget this favor— Kyahhhhk!!!]
The Pisces once again fell into the blast furnace like a stone.
Splash!
The flustered Zodiac floundered about as she yelled at Lee Gun.
[Why are you doing this? Why do this after you healed me?]
Lee Gun stood atop the blast furnace. He laughed when he heard those words. Why? “It’ll be a loss if I boil you only once, right?”
[?!!]
“If the ingredient is good, steeping it as much as one can is the best course of action.”
[What?!]
“Why have one when you can get another? Also, you won’t die easily since you are a Zodiac.”
When the Zodiac was put in the blast furnace, a random body part of the god turned into an ingredient.
Lee Gun wasn’t going to miss this opportunity.
Taken aback, the Zodiac shouted.
[What about Saint-nim?]
“I’ll treat your Zodiac Saint well instead of you. You don’t have to pay attention to her.”
Liv got more frightened by those words. She yelled.
[Just put me in the blast furnace and kill me!]
However, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if to tell them off. “Both of you knew, right? You knew about what happened on the day of my awakening.”
[!]
Since the other half of the Pisces had committed the act, there was no way these two were unaware of it.
“At the very least, you should have spoken up about it when we met in the old days.”
[!]
“You have a choice. Either you go in, or your Zodiac Saint goes in.”
[!]
Liv did feel sorry when she heard those words, and she would rather go to her final resting place than get involved with Lee Gun. So, she opened her mouth.
[I will—]
However, the Zodiac reared back in fright. She then put on a resolute expression.
[Saint-nim! Even if it is annoying to live, you shouldn’t give up on life! I’ll go instead of you!]
“Great.” Lee Gun immediately tossed both of them into the blast furnace once again.
[Kyahhhk!]
[Kyahhhk! Serpent Bearer-nim!! If you planned on doing this, you should have just— Pffft!!]
He continued to put them in and take them out as he regenerated them. It was quite the mess.
The blast furnace was happy since the spicy fish stew had turned into a Shabu-shabu.
[You have acquired data.]
[You have acquired data.]
[Death has grown.]
Hugo let out a sigh.
‘I have to restrain myself for a bit. I’ll unleash myself when I receive a hundred pieces of equipment.’
On the other hand, it seemed all the enemies would eventually enter and exit that place.
‘I’ll make a body for Liv as slave 2… No, I’ll bring her in as a subordinate.’
Hugo couldn’t watch anymore.
However, when Hugo approached him, Lee Gun spoke proudly.
“Thank you hyung. These are all the ingredients for your weapons. I’ll put all the extracts into your weapon.”
“I’m so thankful.”
“What? You’re a fire type, so you suck at aquatic battles. I’m trying to fortify your weakness.”
According to Hailey, one of the monarchs ruled over the deep sea.
‘The oceans are that bastard’s territories.’
Lee Gun had another reason he was using this pair of Zodiac and Zodiac Saint like this. He wanted to draw out the other sibling Zodiac.
“Gun?” Hugo was about to say something when…
Something flew toward Lee Gun.
* * *
Around that time, deep within the ocean near the lands of humanity.
Someone’s eyes flashed within the darkness of the deep ocean.
[Abundance fell?]
[Yes. He fell to a camp belonging to humanity’s side.]
The being lagged when it heard its underling’s words.
[That idiot finally got into an accident.]
Laughter rang out, and the ocean depths shook along with it. At the same time, a menacing magical energy emerged from the ground. It gave a mass death to the fishes that were intermittently swimming around.
The being didn’t care as it continued to let out the joyful laugh.
[I knew this would happen when that bastard trusted its proliferative power too much.]
The monarch of the Deep Ocean wasn’t sad about the death of another monarch.
[This is inconvenient. This means we won’t be able to increase the number of our soldiers.]
Of course, they could increase the number through normal means, but that would take time.
[The humans didn’t venture out of their domes because of Abundance.]
No matter how much the humans had killed, the monsters had continued to increase in number. That was why humanity had lost the will to fight.
[Yes. In fact, the territories occupied by Abundance have returned to the humans. They are starting to crawl out from their domes.]
Humans were food, yet they didn’t know their place. That was why the underling furrowed its brows. Of course, there was no way they would give empty land to food.
[This must be a predicament for you…]
Deep Ocean laughed.
[Predicament? Did you just say a predicament?]
[!]
The monarch burst out laughing and completely revealed itself from the ocean’s depth. It was an enormous beast.
Chaotic magical energy flowed out from the depths of the ocean. Sensing the magical energy, the monsters causing trouble in the ocean ran away in fright.
It was the Deep Ocean monarch. Normally, it didn’t swim within humanity’s oceans. It swam through an ocean called space, where it caught and ate the gods from the divine world.
[The humans are coming out of the dome on their own. I welcome it.]
[!]
Since humans didn’t venture out of their domes, Deep Ocean had been getting bored within the ocean.
[This is great. I was getting bored of eating the gods of the pantheon.]
Deep Ocean’s eyes flashed.
[I heard snake meat is popular these days. I’ll have to find him.]
The Serpent! The Time monarch had put in a lot of work, yet had failed to capture the serpent.
‘Time never does something that would cause him a loss.’
Time wouldn’t move unless there was a significant upside to its move. Deep Ocean wasn’t interested in such a crafty bastard. However, it was interested in the prey.
When Deep Ocean laughed, the underling also laughed as it lowered its head.
[We’ve already infiltrated them.]
Humanity had run away into the sky, which the Deep Ocean was afraid of. It was the flying castle called Drachma, the sky castle where all of humanity would gather.
[Finally, humanity will gather all the divine treasures in one place. Moreover, the energy of the twelve Zodiacs is accumulated within Drachma. It will be of great help to Monarch-nim.]
* * *
Drachma’s small stadium!
Cheers filled the stadium. The reason was simple.
“It’s the Zodiac Saints!”
“What the hell? What about Lee Gun? Where is Lee Gun?”
“Wow! Chun Yooha and Carly are so pretty!”
“Sign this for me!!!”
“The Chun siblings are damn pretty!”
The Zodiac Saints had gathered there for the Temple Conference. The Serpent Bearer, the Leo, the Aquarius, and the Scorpio had sent their Zodiac Saints. The rest of the Zodiac, except Gemini, Taurus, and Pisces, had sent their Ten Stars as stand-ins for their Zodiac Saints.
Normally, these figures wouldn’t gather in one place. There was only one reason they had today.
The talk about the preparations for the Raid was done. However…
“That Sacred Place is ours.”
When the land ruled by Abundance had become empty land, a great change had occurred in the sky.
Nameless Land! With Abundance’s death, Abundance’s “rights” had been canceled. Then, a hidden land possessed by Abundance had appeared. Not much about the land was known, but an incredible life energy was flowing through this land.
“The observatory says an incredible amount of energy is appearing from it.”
“If a country uses this, they would have an endless energy source. If a temple uses it, it could be the source of a power-up.”
It was a land of such stature.
‘Any temple possessing that land would become the number one temple.’
Even the bottom temple would acquire enough power to dominate the other temples.
“Anyway, the Capricorn Temple found it, so we’ll be entering it.”
“What are you saying? The Aries temple observed it first! We will be able to retake territories from the unknown civilization with it!”
This made Chun Sungjae pound the table. “What? Lee Gun-nim got rid of Abundance. Of course, that land belongs to the Serpent Bearer!”
“What?”
Naturally, it had been decided that the Abundance’s territory would be taken by the Serpent Bearer. The problem was the Nameless Land. Of all the places it could appear, the land had appeared in a common area shared by the twelve Zodiac temples. It was a land that Lee Gun couldn’t claim ownership of.
However, Chun Sungjae wanted that land for a reason.
With this land, he could gather EXP for Life. It would also be helpful to Lee Gun in various ways. Above all else…
[Egg of the Serpent Bearer’s Construct (SSS)]
– Reward given to Lee Gun for passing the Trials of Strength, Wisdom, and Reputation
‘With that land, we’ll be able to hatch that egg.’
Yes, the egg was a reward given to Lee Gun for going through his awakening trials. He had given this item to “Disinfectant” Iaso, who was now the Zodiac(?) of the Aquarius temple. It was left in the care of the goddess of healing.
Since she was a medicine-type goddess, Lee Gun had thought having her hatch the egg would be safer. However, the egg had refused to hatch no matter what, so Lee Gun had given up on it. That was why he had aimed for the Libra’s Constructs.
However, Iaso had unexpectedly grabbed Chun Sungjae’s hand and said.
[Oh, holy man of the Serpent Bearer. My power is a bit lacking. If you gain powerful Life energy, you might be able to hatch it.]
She thought Chun Sungjae could hatch it after awakening as the Zodiac Saint of Life. Of course, she wasn’t wrong.
The egg had twitched.
[The egg is showing a reaction.]
[Warning! Its abilities will change according to its prenatal care.]
Since the notification had said prenatal care was important, Sungjae had read his uncle’s hero stories for eight hours. He had even sung hymns of his uncles. He had tried all kinds of things.
However, the level of his Divine status of Life was too low. His power fell short.
[Hatch Status: 23%]
It had increased by 20% in his care. However, the progress had stalled there.
‘With that special land, I can hatch it in no time.’
Even without that reason, the location would be helpful to his uncle. That was why Sungjae had come here with his sister instead of his uncle.
‘I just have to acquire it. That is all there is to it.’
At that moment…
“That land is ours.”
“!!”
When a third party appeared aiming for the land, everyone was thrown for a loop.
Chun Sungjae, Carly, and Chun Yooha were surprised. It was to be expected.
“That’s the Gemini Saint!”
“The Taurus Saint is there too!”
There was no way these two Zodiac Saints should be here, so Chun Yooha glanced at her brother.
The Gemini Saint was a Lee Gun figurine now. The Taurus Saint was the highest-quality cow leather chew toy for the Red Eye, and he was being chewed like gum.
Chun Sungjae’s eyes turned round from surprise when he used his Eyes of Discernment.
‘Zodiacs?’

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Eve of the Festival (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Eve of the Festival (2)
‘Zodiac?’
Naturally, Chun Sungjae was surprised. This place was a conference hall for the Zodiac Saints. Why would a Zodiac appear here like this?
The Zodiac pretending to be a Zodiac Saint spoke up. “We won’t give that land to anyone.”
Chun Sungjae started to sweat when he heard those words.
‘How desperately do they want the Nameless Land?’
Of course, they were aiming for the same land, but why would a Zodiac step forward like this?
It also seemed the Gemini Saint wasn’t a Zodiac Saint. Sungjae wondered if it was Raeriqueen within that body, but the aura was completely different.
‘The magical energy doesn’t feel the same.’
The magical energy from this person couldn’t be compared to that of Raeriqueen. This magical energy was wicked.
Above all else, there was the Taurus Saint! The magical energy coming from him was so brutal that it felt like one’s throat was being constricted. There was no way he was human.
When Sungjae checked, he confirmed that it wasn’t the Taurus Saint.
[Yong Yong (Status: chewing Taurus Saint, taking a brief break).]
Chun Yooha and Carly instinctively sweated.
‘A Zodiac appeared directly.’
Carly was especially vigilant toward the Taurus Saint. She ground her teeth. This was the Zodiac of a battle-type temple! In terms of fighting power, even Lee Gun would have a hard time fighting this god.
‘Damn it! Lee Gun-nim has to acquire the Nameless Land.’
Yes, Carly was deceiving everyone. She had attended the meeting as a substitute for the Libra Saint. The real substitute for the Libra Saint was stuffed in the restroom, and she had boldly appeared as the representative of the Libra.
She did it because that would increase the chances of the Serpent Bearer taking the Nameless Land.
‘There is no way the other Zodiacs would give up on such a prize.’
Of course, Lee Gun planned on crushing the twelve Zodiacs and consolidating their temples. So he had told his disciples that they wouldn’t have to do anything dangerous.
‘However, a Zodiac needs faith, reputation, and power to consolidate its temple.’
That wasn’t going to be easy. Therefore, they had decided to go the easier route.
‘I can’t believe a Zodiac would appear directly…!’
This had never happened before.
[Ridiculous! You became a disciple of the Serpent Bearer, yet you’re pretending to be a part of the Libra temple.]
“!”
Carly flinched when she heard the Taurus Saint’s hateful voice.
Was it telepathy? It wasn’t a sound made through the mouth. However, it was as if the voice was ringing through her ears!
[It is great that you’ve become Lee Gun’s disciple. You’ll be worth killing now.]
Carly trembled.
Unaware of this exchange, the people at Drachma just cheered at the appearance of the Zodiac Saints.
“Ivan! Ivan!”
“Heiji! Heiji!”
Most of them were people from their camps.
However, many people still heckled them.
“What the hell? I heard they died in the last invasion while running away.”
“That’s right. Lee Gun killed all the monsters.”
The Taurus let out a twisted smile when it heard all that.
‘I’ll kill them all.’
If not for its missing Zodiac Saint, why would it have to appear in front of the humans?
However, when Carly started shaking in fits and starts, the “Taurus Saint” let out an unexpected laugh.
[Oh! Can you hear my thoughts?]
Carly unconsciously backed away.
The Taurus contemptuously looked at Carly as it approached her.
[I heard you possess the DNA of a Zodiac. Is that why you can hear me? You are a creature created through design.]
It was oozing killing intent as if it wanted to kill her right now.
[Warning! You feel a powerful killing intent.]
The Chun siblings detected the killing intent at the same time. They flinched. They quickly tried to go to Carly, but the Taurus was faster.
[Warning! It is the Zodiac of the Taurus temple. The master of herculean strength is trying to crush and kill the servant of the Serpent Bearer.]
[Warning! The Taurus is trying to go against the authority of the Serpent Bearer.]
Carly flinched at the pressure being put on her. Just the magical energy of the Taurus was about to squeeze her neck.
Flash!
Suddenly, a light exploded forth from Carly’s pocket.
[“Rock that protects the child” is offended by the Taurus’s threat.]
It was unmistakable. This was the energy of the Serpent Bearer!
The Taurus furrowed its brows, and Carly became surprised. The holy item Lee Gun had made for her was letting out a light. Moreover, it wasn’t something amazing.
Unlike what the Chun siblings had gotten, this item wasn’t a weapon. However, Carly was a disciple of the Serpent Bearer, so Lee Gun had tossed it to her.
[“Rock that protects the child” is offended that the unruly monster cow doesn’t know its place.]
[It is furious, saying it’ll tell what happened to its owner.]
It was a mere rock, yet it was very spirited. This made the Taurus furrow its brows.
[That dirty god of calamity….]
The Taurus hated the mere sight of Lee Gun’s power. It was about to destroy the holy item in contempt.
Hweek!
But the Zodiac suddenly stopped. The reason was “Death,” which was aimed at its neck. Yooha had made her move.
[Crimson Earth’s Judgment roars that this Zodiac is its owner’s enemy.]
[Death threatens the monster cow called the master of herculean strength.]
[Serpent Bearer’s attribute is active.]
[Serpent’s Five Senses]
– The senses of the body will become more sensitive.
Chun Sungjae also activated the ring he was wearing. It was the royal holy item that Lee Gun had made for him!
[Retribution by the Mighty Ocean (SS)]
The ring split in half, then further split into several rings to form an orb.
[Retribution by the Mighty Ocean has activated.]
[All of your attributes will explosively increase for the next ten minutes.]
[You need to fill up enough Life (Stamina) in proportion to the damage you inflict on your opponent.]
Chun Sungjae used his protection magic.
‘I’ll have to bring Uncle here.’
Since Lee Gun was making important items, the group had come here on their own. However, the situation had changed. They had to go up against a Zodiac instead of a Zodiac Saint.
‘All the temples here might be destroyed.’
Kwahng!
Chun Sungjae was about to use Teleport to bring Lee Gun here, but…
Kwahng!
Brutal magical energy exploded, shaking the stadium. People screamed.
“Kyahhhhk!”
“What is going on?”
At the same time, Chun Sungjae was sent flying away.
Boom!
“Sungjae!”
It was a strike aimed at Chun Sungjae.
The Taurus glared at Chun Sungjae as it approached him.
“Weren’t we talking about the rights to the land left behind by Abundance? All Zodiac Saints should be present here.”
This made Stevens unsheathe his sword. “You should act in moderation when dealing with a Zodiac Saint.”
As expected, Stevens had realized the “Taurus Saint’s” identity.
‘It is here to get revenge for its Zodiac Saint?’
That wasn’t all. The Zodiac had undoubtedly come here to steal the land left behind by Abundance.
According to the observation, that land was determined to be a powerful land of Life. It was capable of upgrading the Zodiac, Constructs, and disciples.
This was why the Zodiacs not friendly to Lee Gun ground their teeth. If they could steal this land, they would be able to acquire enough power to kill Lee Gun.
‘Unless the twelve Zodiac temples merge, there will be conflict.’
However, none of the Zodiacs even considered the merger a possibility.
Anyway, it seemed the Taurus didn’t find its disciples to be reliable and had come here to kill Lee Gun’s Zodiac Saints in person.
‘He didn’t descend into a Zodiac Saint. He descended into a disciple.’
Anyone other than the Zodiac Saint was unable to withstand the descent of a Zodiac. They would die. Of course, the Zodiac knew this.
Therefore, Stevens and Carly furrowed their brows as they looked at the Taurus in contempt.
‘It treats its disciples like parts that can be replaced.’
Their gazes then landed on the disciple’s neck, which had the Saint Seal.
‘It must be a disciple with very high faith if he received the Saint Seal.’
Was the Zodiac that covetous of the land left behind by Abundance?
[A power hidden by the Abundance lies there. Our secret is buried there, too.]
Carly flinched when she heard the voice again. This time, the Taurus wasn’t speaking to her. She was able to hear the Zodiac’s inner thoughts.
[The secret of the twelve Zodiacs is buried in the territory Abundance left behind.]
Carly was taken aback.
‘Secret?’
The thoughts continued.
[If Lee Gun or the world finds out about that, the twelve Zodiacs are done for.]
Carly was in a state of confusion.
On the other hand, the Taurus emitted killing intent as if it had business with Lee Gun’s disciples. “I’ll say this again. Give back what your Zodiac stole.”
“!”
The Chun siblings flinched at the Taurus’s words. They were certain. The Zodiac wanted its Zodiac Saint, who had turned into Red Eye’s chew toy.
As a Zodiac, the Taurus couldn’t use the full extent of its power without its Zodiac Saint. And since it had decided to take the land of the Abundance, getting its Zodiac Saint back was imperative.
‘Choosing a new Zodiac Saint isn’t easy.’
And as expected…
“I said give me back what Lee Gun stole.”
At the same time, a commotion broke out in the stadium.
“Lee Gun??”
“Lee Gun is a Zodiac?”
“Rumors were floating around about that….”
At that moment…
“If you don’t want to give him back, I’ll make you want to give him back.” The Taurus approached the Chun siblings. It had come here planning on eliminating Lee Gun’s Zodiac Saints. This was revenge.
Flash!
Suddenly, a familiar face appeared in front of them, surprising everyone. It caused a commotion within the stadium.
“Lee Gun! Lee Gun!”
“Uncle!”
Chun Sungjae looked surprised. Just the mere appearance of Lee Gun had led to the whole stadium erupting in cheers.
“Lee Gun! Lee Gun!”
It was an incredible reception.
Previously, Giselle had tried to undercut Lee Gun’s exploits, so without her efforts, their reactions were much more intense. People had shivered in excitement when Lee Gun’s real skill was revealed, which had led to Lee Gun’s popularity skyrocketing.
When Lee Gun appeared in person, Chun Sungjae said, “I’m sorry, Uncle.”
“No. It’s my fault for not anticipating this situation.”
“Yes. Also, do not worry. I didn’t lose the Taurus Saint to—”
“No. That was my fault.”
“What?”
Lee Gun unexpectedly said to the Taurus, “Yes. I will give back what I stole.”
“!”
“You’re returning the Taurus Saint?!”
“Yes.”
Everyone was surprised, but Lee Gun let out a sharp laugh. “In exchange, you cannot touch my kids.”
The Taurus satisfactorily laughed. “Alright.”
Soon, Lee Gun said, “Sungjae. Give back what I stole.”
Chun Sungjae was surprised. Did the plan change? Or did Uncle have a different design?
Lee Gun approached the group, and Chun Sungjae had to ask the question again. “You really want me to return him?”
“Yeah. Give him back.”
Chun Sungjae immediately nodded when he saw the look in Lee Gun’s eyes. “Ah. Yes. I’ll go get him right now…”
However, when Lee Gun walked past them, the Chun siblings and Carly furrowed their brows. Something felt off.
‘Can it be? That person—’
Bbah-gahk!
Suddenly, Hailey ruthlessly kicked Lee Gun.
Screams erupted among the audience.
“Hailey-nim?!”
“Hey, have you lost your mind?”
Also surprised, Stevens tried to grab Hailey. However, Hailey ignored him as she approached Lee Gun. “I’ll ask you one question.”
“!”
With her arms crossed in contempt, she looked at Lee Gun. “Yesterday, Lee Gun and Hugo had a big fight. They almost ended their relationship. What was the fight about?”
The person that looked like Lee Gun started to sweat.
* * *
Around that time…
[The goods in question are being transferred to the Auction House.]
[The goods in question are being transferred to the Auction House.]
Hugo was using the delivery skill to send the items made by Lee Gun to the auction house. The battle-type temples and the four great master craftsmen from the workshop wanted to see Lee Gun’s items. They had asked Lee Gun to put a couple of items up for auction.
Lee Gun didn’t plan on selling them, yet he had sent a couple of items.
“Hey, where the hell is that damn god-nim?” The Secretary screamed as she barged into the workshop.
Hugo’s eyes turned round. He wondered what the Secretary had seen to come rushing here like this.
“Where is god-nim?”
“What’s wrong?”
“Something crazy is going on at Drachma!”
Hugo flinched when he heard the word Drachma. It was the place where Lee Gun said he wanted to visit. The reason was simple.
– I’ll have to change how I make my defensive gear.
Although he hadn’t shown it, Lee Gun had been shocked when Goat and Sungjae had received damage from Abundance. It was to be expected since Lee Gun had made the defensive gear for those two.
Goat’s equipment had broken immediately, and Sungjae’s defensive gear was close to breaking. Lee Gun could guess the reason. The Serpent Bearer specialized in attack abilities, but his defensive abilities sucked.
The fact that his temple didn’t have even the most common defensive skills was a weakness. When he made offensive items, his blessing stuck. But when he made defensive items, his blessing was non-existent.
That was why the defensive gear he made wouldn’t hold up against anyone above the general rank.
Therefore, Lee Gun had said to his friend, “What about the Battle of the Temples, which is being held at Drachma? The hosts are the Leo and the Taurus, right? In the matches where the monsters will be released, the Taurus is the host as the defensive-type Zodiac, right?”
“Uh. It is. What about it?”
“Is there any chance of the Taurus showing up there?”
“Well… The Taurus always attended through Ivan. But thanks to someone, Ivan is being chewed up by Red Eye. The Taurus won’t attend this year unless its Ten Star Joseph shows up…”
“That means it will show up, right?”
“I think so. If the Taurus doesn’t show itself, it would advertise that something is wrong with the Taurus temple… Why are you making that face? Do you plan on going to Drachma? Are you trying to acquire the power of a defensive Zodiac?”
“Have you lost your mind? Who do you think I am? I’m a busy man. You know that even I can’t break through the steel wall of the defensive-type Zodiac.”
Hugo had an ominous feeling when he recalled Lee Gun’s words. However, he shook his head from side to side.
‘There is no way he would go there after saying that.’
At this point, Lee Gun had realized the machination hatched by the Zodiacs. Since they were of no help to earth, Lee Gun had said he’d take care of them.
However, Drachma was a place that the twelve Zodiacs had cooperated to make. It was like a safe house for them.
‘It is an environment that will be disadvantageous to Gun.’
That was why Hugo had advised Lee Gun to never go there.
At that moment, the Secretary said something shocking, “Drachma is falling right now!”
“What?! Falling! Why!”
“I… I have no idea. I thought it might be God-nim’s doing. That was why I checked the bible’s record to locate him. It says he is there.”
“!!!”
The flustered Hugo quickly headed toward the living room. There was no way Gun would do such a thing, yet the record showed he was there.
“Why is he there? He should be in his room watching TV…!”
The two of them were surprised when they entered the room.
[Don’t worry~ chu chu! ♪]
[He said to call him oppa oppa oppa ♪]
Lee Gun was watching TV and dancing along with the idols.
Hugo immediately realized who this was, and his face turned pale. “Gun! You bastard! Did you really…!”

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Eve of the Festival (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Eve of the Festival (3)
“Yesterday, Lee Gun and Hugo had a big fight. They almost ended their relationship. What was the fight about?”
The person that looked like Lee Gun started to sweat.
Hailey’s brows furrowed. “What? You can’t answer it?”
At that moment, Lee Gun looked furious, and his eyes flashed. “The content of that conversation shouldn’t be discussed in this place. Also, there was no reason for you to kick me.”
Suddenly, he emitted a wave of menacing magical energy. This power was unmistakably the power of the god of Calamity!
Goat screamed when he saw Lee Gun’s patented power. “Sungjae Saint-nim! Please stop Lee Gun-nim! We have to stop their fight—.”
However…
“Son of a bitch!”
Boohoo-gahk!!!
Chun Sungjae’s dropkick landed on Lee Gun’s face. The young man had teleported above Lee Gun’s head before executing the kick.
Lee Gun fell over backward.
Boom!
Goat screamed at this sight. “Saint-nim!”
However, it didn’t end with Chun Sungjae; the young man was just the start. Chun Yooha and Carly also attacked Lee Gun.
Puhk! Puhk!
Lee Gun glared at them. “What are you guys doing— Kuhk!”
However, he could not complete his sentence.
“How dare you speak with Uncle’s voice, imposter! Stop it!”
“!!”
Those words caused a commotion within the stadium.
“Imposter? What does that mean?”
At that moment, Hailey raised her elegant hand and flicked her finger. “Poison of Return!”
As the skill worked, a chaotic aura appeared around Lee Gun’s body. At the same time, Lee Gun screamed as he grabbed his face.
“Silvia!”
The face melted away to reveal a woman. This woman was none other than the SS-rank from the Pisces temple!
Goat’s mouth fell open when he recognized a fellow Ten Star. “You…!”
Soon, a flood of complaints erupted in the stands.
“How dare you change into Lee Gun!”
“Damn Pisces temple!”
“Give us the real Lee Gun-nim!”
Silvia screamed when items were thrown at her from the stands.
“Did you really need Lee Gun’s reputation this badly?”
On the other hand, Goat realized the reason Silvia transformed into Lee Gun. “You are pretending to be Lee Gun-nim to take back the Taurus Saint, right?”
“!”
This surprised him. He had never imagined anyone could recreate Lee Gun’s magical energy, even if it was Silvia.
‘I’m sure I felt Lee Gun-nim’s power.’
However, he soon realized how this happened.
[The power of the Zodiac of the Pisces temple, the master of the sea creatures, can be felt.]
[The Pisces Zodiac glares at the servant of the Scorpio.]
Yes, this entire thing was the plot of the Pisces. This was why Silvia ground her teeth.
‘This was a good opportunity for us to take away the Taurus Saint.’
They had confirmed that Lee Gun remained closeted inside his holy ground. Moreover, they had assumed Lee Gun’s Zodiac Saints would know where the Taurus Saint was.
The change in the situation aggrieved Silvia. “My transformation was perfect. How did you know?”
The Chun siblings looked dumbfounded at the question. They became angry.
“You smell different!”
“The tone of your voice is completely different!”
“Your eyelashes curl in the wrong way!”
“Above all else, Uncle doesn’t speak as if he cares about others’ feelings!”
“?!”
Stevens and Goat started to sweat when they heard their words. They had noticed the smell and the voice?
“Did you notice it?”
“No. Not at all.”
They didn’t get what those people were talking about when they referred to the smell. This was more true about the voice.
As an SS-rank, Silvia had sounded completely like Lee Gun. The prickly personality she portrayed was that of Lee Gun.
Chun Sungjae became angry as if they were slandering Lee Gun with their words. “Uncle’s eyes aren’t like fish eyes!”
“Whatever! You fell for it halfway.”
The young man’s eyes flashed at his sister’s scolding. “Damn it! Anyway, the smell was different!”
His old roommate Hahn Jimin had commented about it in the past. He had said Lee Gun-nim always smelled good.
Sungjae had surmised it was a smell that only gods emanated. As a god’s divinity became more virtuous, their scent also became better. And if the divinity became corrupt, the smell turned foul. He had thought that was the basic principle. Well, he had become capable of smelling it just recently.
‘Noona doesn’t know about it again.’
Well, it didn’t matter.
Hailey approached Silvia. “You used such an unseemly method.”
Hearing the menacing voice, Silvia unconsciously stepped backward. Was Hailey angry because she had changed into Lee Gun? That wasn’t all.
Silvia unconsciously felt something in Hailey’s aura that she recognized.
‘Monarch.’
Hailey’s power felt especially similar to that of the monarch of Time. However, this wasn’t important right now.
‘!’
Silvia became surprised when an unfamiliar creature, a bird, landed on her shoulder. Her face turned pale when she realized the identity of the bird.
‘Can it be?’
Silvia desperately looked at the sky. And as she had expected…
The one to send down that bird landed on the roof of the stadium. “What the hell? It has already started?”
‘Lee Gun?!’
Silvia shook in terror.
The real Lee Gun was laughing from a distance. However, no one in the audience realized he was there, and neither did his Zodiac Saints. No one took notice of Lee Gun…
When Lee Gun’s eyes met hers, Silvia trembled.
‘No. It isn’t as if others haven’t noticed him.’
He made sure everyone didn’t notice.
He had hidden his presence so much that a crowd of this size and even his Zodiac Saints failed to notice him.
Since she was the only one to notice him, Silvia felt chills run down her back. Lee Gun had purposefully sent the bird to notify her of his presence.
‘Even the Zodiacs didn’t notice him.’
It surprised her.
‘This is odd. Lee Gun should be outside of Drachma…’
As if he had read her thoughts, Lee Gun let out a cheeky smile as he maintained eye contact. “Well, I’m sure the slime is doing a good job of not being found out over there.”
Lee Gun had jammed the data of the Pisces into the slime, and the slime was able to change its energy. It could fool Zodiacs and observatories now.
Lee Gun had used that to secretly come here.
‘I really need the power of a defensive-type Zodiac.’
The Serpent Bearer didn’t have even one defensive skill. However, Lee Gun had Super Regeneration, so the lack of defensive skills wouldn’t be a detriment in his fights. But his disciples were a different matter.
‘I enjoy the pain, so it doesn’t matter.’
The others weren’t like him. Lee Gun didn’t want his nephew, his niece, and his friend to suffer. That wasn’t all.
‘Super Regeneration needs part of the body to survive.’
At the very least, there had to be 50% of the body left for the skill to activate, whereas anyone above the general rank could turn the disciples’ bodies into ashes. This was especially true for the monarch ranks.
This was why Lee Gun gave importance to this problem. Super Regeneration would be meaningful only if one could block the attack at least once.
However, a Zodiac possessed indomitable defense. It was the Taurus, the only defensive-type Zodiac.
‘That means I’ll have to get rid of the Taurus to acquire the defensive power.’
This move would allow him to patch the weakness of the Serpent Bearer. He’d also be able to make the strongest defensive gears.
Of course, creating the strongest defensive gear just by pounding in the Taurus’s data wasn’t supposed to be possible. However, Lee Gun was confident in his abilities. It had a bit to do with his pride.
The Taurus was his prey, but breaking through its defense wouldn’t be easy. This had nothing to do with the difference in their powers.
‘For some odd reason, I don’t match up well with the Taurus.’
Lee Gun had no idea why. It was as if someone had cursed him.
Anyway, the Taurus had shown up to the event in Drachma. When Lee Gun had learned that the Taurus had descended into a human body to appear there, he knew this was an opportunity. That was why he had come here.
“What the hell are they doing?” However, Lee Gun started to sweat when he saw his niece, his nephew, and Carly.
Despite knowing Silvia was the fake Lee Gun, they immediately rushed toward her. The reason was simple.
“Change into Uncle wearing a tuxedo!!”
“No! Change into a loveable Lee Gun-nim!”
“No! Change into a kind uncle, and pet my head!!”
“No. I want an enticing uncle!!”
“I would love a sexy pose too!!”
“What about a woman? If so, I can marry Uncle!”
What the hell were they doing?
Frightened, Silvia looked at Lee Gun. “Let go! This isn’t the time to do this! Can’t you see him over there? Lee Gun is— Kuhk!”
“It seems you didn’t learn your lesson until the end.” When Hailey approached her, Silvia’s body shook.
Hailey was gorgeous, but also scary. She unsheathed her Tachi, her royal holy item.
Boom!
“Wait a moment. We are having an interesting conversation.”
“!!”
Lee Gun’s voice rang behind Hailey.
The familiar voice that she heard a handspan above her head froze her.
“Uh… Uh…”
Lee Gun held Hailey’s hand, which was holding her sword; the Scorpio Saint was losing her mind.
Lee Gun nonchalantly stopped Hailey, but his eyes flashed. A signal was sent to the bird that made Silvia afraid!
Then, a large explosion occurred.
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhhhk!”
The item sent on top of Silvia’s shoulder seemed to be an explosive-type holy item.
Silvia became as black as charcoal. She screamed as she was sent flying.
[“Direct Grill Torch (SS)” was successfully activated.]
[Fifty percent of her god’s blessing has been eliminated.]
[You have acquired Disassemble EXP.]
At the same time, shouts filled the stadium.
“It is Lee Gun! It is the real Lee Gun!”
“Lee Gun! He’s the one who acquired territory by killing the boss of the enemies!”
“Hey. He has yet to acquire the land. It is in the middle of their territory, so he has to plant his flag over there.”
“Anyway, he’s the hope of humanity! Do you know this? The Church of Lee Gun has appeared.”
“Did they say he was a Zodiac…? Is that for real?”
The Taurus seemed to find the attention Lee Gun received contemptible.
“It seems you took your time to get here. Well, it’s less work for me since I don’t have to go looking for you.”
The Taurus approached Lee Gun from the front, looking like it wanted to kill Lee Gun. “Hurry up and return what you stole, Serpent Bearer.”
“Stole? Are you talking about Yong Yong’s chew toy?”
“What? Chew toy?”
“Yes. Since your Zodiac Saint’s body is so tough, I gave him to Yong Yong as a chew toy.”
“?!”
“Why are you making such an expression? He’s suitable for it. Chew toys are made out of cowhide.”
In response to the rude words, brown lightning surged forth.
Screams erupted.
Kwahng!!!
“Lee Gun!!!”
The pissed-off Taurus struck out first, its fist capable of blowing apart a mountain.
However, Heaven’s Punishment blocked that fist.
The Taurus wanted to crush Lee Gun. It let out a savage laugh. “You were lucky to acquire divinity twenty-four years ago.”
The Zodiac did not have a weapon, but its entire body could be considered one. It was a Zodiac of unarmed fighting. “I’m not like the idiots that drool over your weapons.”
The Zodiac was making fun of battle-type temples, which included the temples of Stevens and Hugo.
As if it wanted to kill Lee Gun, it released its divine status.
[Warning! The Taurus’s intimidation is getting closer.]
Unlike the battle-type Zodiacs, the Taurus could bring people to their knees just from its divine status touching them.
Kwahng!!
Heaven’s Punishment bared its teeth since the Taurus had dared to mess with its owner.
[Heaven’s Punishment has used its entire body to block the Zodiac’s strike.]
[It roars, saying it won’t let its owner get hurt.]
On the other hand, faced with the loyalty of Heaven’s Punishment, Lee Gun furrowed his brows. For some reason, he pulled the weapon back.
“U-Uncle!”
“Lee Gun! Have you lost your mind?!”
Stevens was surprised, but Lee Gun put away Heaven’s Punishment as he maintained distance.
‘As expected, we are incompatible.’
Was it because his level had risen? Unlike before, he would be able to damage the Taurus, but his offensive capabilities were too woeful in front of it, as if he was under a debuff.
Of course, he felt as if he could break through if he attacked with more power, but…
[Warning! The Taurus is wearing the “Item that kills Serpents.”]
[The Serpent Bearer’s power is weakening.]
[All disciples and holy items that have received the blessing of the Serpent Bearer will suffer a penalty in front of the Taurus.]
This made Lee Gun furrow his brows. Was the “Item that kills Serpents” the reason they were incompatible?
‘They did say the thirteenth Zodiac was murdered by the twelve Zodiacs.’
It was probably killed using this item.
Therefore, Lee Gun looked at Heaven’s Punishment.
[At the soul-rending pain, Heaven’s Punishment is starting to get distressed.]
[Heaven’s Punishment is firm as it endures the pain.]
‘Since it is an EX-rank weapon, there is no way its body will break.’
Its body wouldn’t break, but it had a sense of self; it would be in extreme pain. That was why Lee Gun just needed one second.
‘Is there anyone who can break through its defense for me?’
If the barrier was brought down for an instant, he could strike the Zodiac with Heaven’s Punishment or the Serpent Eater skill. However, he gave up.
‘Breaking through a Zodiac’s defense would be impossible unless the being is a monarch rank.’
On the other hand, the Zodiac was inside a human’s body right now. It was a golden opportunity for Lee Gun.
‘There is no way an arrogant monarch would show up right on cue…’
Suddenly…
Koo-goo-goong!
The ground they were standing on started to shake.
“Kyahhhhk!”
They were above the middle of the Pacific Ocean. The Drachma had been passing over the ocean when it violently tilted all of a sudden. It started to fall.
Then, the Deep Ocean monarch appeared above the ocean.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Eve of the Festival (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Eve of the Festival (4)
The floating castle Drachma had appeared twenty years ago, when humanity had given up on recovering their territories. It was formed when they had decided to self-contain themselves.
[“All the overland routes are blocked.”]
[“The water routes are more disheartening.”]
[“The only place left is the sky.”]
The ground had been occupied by the unknown civilization, so they were stuck. Then there were the oceans. Innumerable monsters lay inside them, and one didn’t dare float a boat on the ocean.
Humanity’s safety was guaranteed inside the dome, but humans wanted to venture out of the dome. So they chose the sky.
Monsters did fly around in the sky, but they rarely ventured into the stratosphere, where the airplanes flew. It might have something to do with the Zodiacs.
Therefore, humanity created something there. This was Drachma, the floating castle. It was an enormous castle that traveled the airway as it moved between the troposphere and the stratosphere.
Drachma was a neutral zone where humanity gathered as a way to promote harmony. Moreover, it was made through the power of the twelve Zodiac, and in its history of twenty years, it had never fallen.
Boom!!!
It had never been rocked, yet the ship of the sky started to tilt over.
Screams started ringing out.
“Ahhhk!”
When the castle tilted at a forty-degree angle, people lost their balance and got swept to one side.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Help!”
Half of the crowd was swept toward the wall. The other half either fell or slipped into their seats. People grabbed seats and railings to prevent themselves from falling to the other side. It was a mess.
“What the hell is going on?”
“Did something happen to the Zodiacs?”
“No. This castle isn’t made to be like that!”
“There should be enough energy in reserve!”
“That’s right. It should be ok for the next thirty years…”
Suddenly…
Ooh-doo-doohk!
The castle tilted, and the chandelier hanging on the ceiling started to violently sway!
“Ahhk! Run away!”
“It is falling!”
“It is too late!”
[Bite]
[Serpent Eater]
At that moment, a golden chain and a green chain grabbed the chandelier.
Kwahng!
The ones making the move were the Leo Saint Stevens and Chun Yooha.
Then, Hailey used a stealing skill to make the suspended chandelier disappear.
[Steal the Shadow]
The people who had been about to die let out a sigh of relief.
“We are alive—”
Boom!!
“Ahhhhk!”
The castle was rocked once again, and more chandeliers, sculptures, and electronic displays fell all at once.
“Ahhhk!!”
“No! We can’t catch all of them!”
The Ten Stars quickly looked for the Taurus.
“Please hurry and put up the defensive barrier!”
However, the Taurus was nowhere to be found.
“Damn it!”
The people below those objects clutched at the pillars as they clenched their eyes shut. They were going to die. It was the day when a catastrophe was going to happen.
Kwahng!!
However, a beam of black and green light extended in front of their eyes. In a flash, Death swallowed all the falling items and turned them into ashes.
[You have acquired Disassemble EXP.]
[“Death” grumbles that it is being used for such a trivial matter.]
People cheered.
“It is Lee Gun!”
The eyes of the Zodiac Saints and the Ten Stars turned round when the items instantly turned to ashes.
“Uncle!”
“As expected of Lee Gun..!”
On the other hand, Lee Gun urgently yelled, “Left!”
“!!!”
As soon as he spoke, octopus legs surged up from various locations on the floor.
“It is a monster!!”
The octopus legs attacked the people. Moreover, the legs didn’t number just one or two. They were in the dozens.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he raised Heaven’s Punishment high. “Everyone, get down!”
“!!!”
The Zodiac Saints were surprised by the shout, but they quickly lowered their heads. Sungjae also followed suit. For some reason, he knew he had to.
At that moment, Heaven’s Punishment drew a circle in the air.
Hoohng!!
A semicircle of green light appeared in the air. Then, the disciples prone on the ground heard a horrible sound.
“Kee-ehhhhhk!”
“Keehk!”
“Kee-ehhhhhhhhk!!”
As soon as the scream stopped, they raised their heads. Their mouths fell open when they saw the scene in front of them. The legs that had appeared by piercing through various locations had been severed; they had been taken care of in no time.
Chun Sungjae wailed. Chun Yooha’s and Carly’s eyes sparkled.
On the other hand, Stevens ranted in anger. “Lee Gun! What the hell? I thought you didn’t have an Area of Effect skill!”
“Yeah. I don’t. It is pure magical energy.”
“Magical energy?!”
Doing something like that had been impossible for Lee Gun in the past, but he had leveled up now. He merely made his aura blade as large as the stadium.
Stevens glared at Lee Gun. “P-Pure magical energy… Y-You used only that to generate this much power…”
The disciples cheered.
“This is nuts!”
“Lee Gun!”
Lee Gun ignored them as he quickly exited through the hole in the wall. The inside wasn’t important right now. He had to get outside.
And as he had expected, a big commotion occurred when people looked outside the windows.
“We are falling!”
“What?!”
The power of the suspension was still holding on, but the castle was slowly falling. Moreover, the direction of their crash was a problem.
“Ocean! We are falling toward the ocean!”
“What?! Ocean?!”
People got frightened. Falling on land was bad, but falling into the ocean was frightening for an entirely different reason.
‘The ocean is a field of monsters.’
Humanity had stopped sailing the oceans for a reason. It was so bad that even the Chun siblings had never entered the ocean. As soon as someone entered the waters, monsters would rip them apart. It was all thanks to the monarch that ruled over the ocean.
Therefore, the inside of the castle descended into pandemonium.
“The octopus legs are clinging to the castle!”
“It is dragging Drachma toward the ocean!”
People screamed.
“Hurry up and get rid of the monster clinging to the castle! Do it before the castle crashes!”
On the other hand, Lee Gun stood amongst the panicked people, and he was laughing. It was to be expected.
‘I can feel the power of a monarch-rank outside.’
He was sure of it. If he defended the castle, he would have a way to get rid of the Taurus.
‘I’ll defend the castle first, then I’ll use the monarch to get rid of the Taurus.’
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
‘Also, I’m curious about the secret that the twelve Zodiacs are hiding.’
The Aquarius and the Pisces had spoken about it before. They didn’t want to reveal why the twelve Zodiacs had tried to kill him. That had something to do with a truth they didn’t want to reveal at all costs.
‘I tried to find out by forcing them to speak, but they made a contract of silence.’
Lee Gun had told Sungjae to dissolve it, but he instead learned that the contract that could release the Zodiacs from their agreement existed within the Taurus Saint’s holy ground.
‘Since I can’t break through the Taurus’s defensive wall, that is the ideal place to hide the contract.’
However…
‘Shields exist to be pierced’
“Eeny.”
[Yes. You called?]
“Find the missing Taurus.”
[I will do as you order.]
Then, an enormous octopus leg entered through the broken window!
Kwah-jeek!!
Lee Gun held his ax and rotated like a tornado. Then, Heaven’s Punishment sliced apart the enormous octopus leg.
“L-Lee Gun-nim!”
Using another leg as a platform, Lee Gun immediately moved toward the head of the octopus. Then, he took out his slime. A scissor appeared in his hand!
Goat’s face turned pale from fright when he saw the familiar scissor from a distance. And it happened as he had expected!
Kwah-doo-doo-doohk!
The scissor windmill turned the octopus into mush, covering the entirety of Drachma. As the innards spread into the surrounding, everyone covered their mouth and dry heaved.
“Ooh…Ooh-ehhk!”
However, the move was effective.
“The castle stopped falling!”
Stevens and Goat, who had quickly followed Lee Gun, spoke as they covered their mouths.
“Hey, you still haven’t fixed your bad hunting habit!”
“I…I never expected to see this again, but as expected, Lee Gun is amazing— Oohp!”
Goat had spoken those words to Lee Gun, but he soon realized his mistake. He once again brainwashed himself into thinking his Zodiac Saint was more amazing than Lee Gun.
“Anyway, we won’t crash thanks to you, Lee Gun-nim. It is quite fortunate…”
“No. I don’t think so.”
“What?!”
As if to prove this, the castle started accelerating toward the ocean. Everyone wondered what was going on, but they soon realized the reason.
“Saint-nim! This is bad! The castle’s floating mechanism is completely broken!”
“What?!”
“What about Teleport!”
“It isn’t working! The castle’s central system is broken. The teleport region has stopped working! We can’t escape!”
“What?!” Stevens was shocked.
But Lee Gun just clicked his tongue. “Tsk! I guess we are all going skydiving. Ah. This is your second time, right? How is it?”
Stevens became angry; he had fallen from Drachma once before because of Lee Gun. “This isn’t the time to joke around. Shit! Someone broke the central system!”
Lee Gun immediately guessed who it was.
[Abyss is ecstatic.]
[The army of Abyss is gathering where the Drachma will fall.]
“Ah. It’s a monarch, the monarch of the ocean.”
“What?!”
“Monarch?!”
“Yeah. I merely thought about it, yet it came here. Aren’t you glad to see it?”
Glad to see it, my ass! Goat had already lost to a monarch before, so his face turned pale. When Abundance had attacked him, the defensive gear Lee Gun had made from him had suffered damage.
This was why Lee Gun had said to Goat, “Hey. I’ll acquire the power of the Taurus, and I’ll upgrade the gear for you. Don’t take the field until I do so.”
However, a monarch had suddenly appeared just a short while later!
“Ahhhk! If it’s the monarch of the ocean, we have no way of defeating it! At least, Abundance had a weakness since we had its Commandment…!”
“Defeating it won’t be easy even if we had that.”
“What?!”
“This monarch is keeping its power hidden, but it isn’t inside a human’s body as Abundance had done.”
“It came in its main body?!”
“Yes.”
At that moment, a truly sly voice rang out.
[I planned on eating only the disciples, but it seems there are two quality pieces of food here.]
The quality pieces of food referred to Lee Gun and the Taurus.
Kwahng!
“Ivan-nim!!”
Soon, a scream rang nearby.
Lee Gun had sent Eeny, and the Construct had lured the Taurus in his direction.
[I’ll eat you guys first, then give the humans to my subordinates as nourishment!]
“!”
The octopus leg was raised once again. For some reason, the monarchs coveted the Zodiacs.
‘Didn’t they say the body of a Zodiac becomes their nourishment?’
The Taurus knew this would be troublesome, so it was about to cancel the Zodiac Descent.
[Do you think I’ll let you run away?]
Unfortunately, they were above the ocean, a space where the Ocean monarch Abyss’s power could reach them.
[You are above the ocean. No one can escape this place without the permission of Abyss.]
“Damn bastard!”
The Taurus couldn’t escape to the Divine world by canceling its Zodiac Descent. Teleportation wouldn’t work either. The floating skill was dead. And, the Return skill was also dead.
It was true that this was a good opportunity for Lee Gun, but at the same time, it was the worst situation for him.
‘We’ll become fish food before I can use the monarch to defeat the Taurus.’
Moreover, the monarch had swum into the ocean depths of a different dimension, so it seemed to be unaware of Lee Gun’s presence.
So Abyss went crazy when it smelled Lee Gun.
[It is a much better smell compared to the other Zodiacs. It can’t be compared. I’ll drop you immediately and eat you.]
As soon as it spoke those words, screams rang all over the castle.
“Ahhhhhhhk!!!”
“Ahk!”
Monsters had been sent as spies inside of Drachma. The monsters appeared from various parts of the castle. Then there were the monsters captured by the disciples for the Battle of the Temples.
[The monsters in the fish tank have returned to their original forms.]
[The captured monsters have revealed their true forms.]
The inside of the castle turned into pandemonium. The hidden monsters started attacking the tens of thousands of disciples within the castle.
“Ahhhhhk!”
“Help!”
“Help us, Saintess!”
Many people had gathered at Drachma for Physical Examination, so the damage was enormous.
Stevens sensed the increased casualties of the helpless victims. He ground his teeth. “Shit… The healing temple won’t be able to handle this many people!”
Moreover, the castle was hopelessly falling straight toward the ocean.
[The floating castle of the sky is falling.]
[The floating castle of the sky is falling.]
They could do nothing and become fish food. No, they would become food for the monsters. Of course, the skill of the Pisces temple would normally allow them to walk and fight on top of the ocean. However, this was a different situation.
Instead of putting up a fight, helpless victims were increasing in number.
‘It is already tough to fight in the ocean.’
Aware of this point, Abyss laughed.
[Hurry up and fall!]
In one fell swoop, it could acquire tens of thousands of prey.
The monsters of the ocean went crazy with joy, while the humans fell into a state of panic.
“Shit. We are done for…!”
At that moment, Lee Gun chanted something, and a light exploded forth.
Flash!
[Holy Ground Designation]
– In a permanent fashion, this place can become the Serpent Bearer’s official territory (holy ground).
– Unlike the temporary holy ground, you need to maintain magical energy. You need to supervise it.
– As the Zodiac’s level rises by one, the scope of the holy ground expands.
– Current Lv. 29 / Possible Range: 1k㎡
When Stevens recognized the skill, he started foaming at the mouth. “Hey! Have you lost your mind?! This is Drachma! It is a joint territory of the twelve Zodiacs! Why are you using the Holy Ground Designation skill?”
“Then you save everyone.”
“?!”
Lee Gun laughed. With his current level, it was as the description said. He could designate only a range of 1k㎡ as his holy ground.
[The power of Space is being applied to the power of the Serpent Bearer.]
[Qualified region Drachma is being perceived as one space. The entire place can be designated as a holy ground.]
Thanks to the Space-time monarch, Lee Gun could use the power of Space. He could use it to designate this place as his holy ground
Finally, the light of the Serpent Bearer spread throughout the neutral region of the twelve Zodiacs. The light covered the entirety of Drachma.
[The Drachma (Area 3k㎡, Height 50m) Space has been successfully perceived.]
[Drachma has been designated as a holy ground of the Serpent Bearer.]
[The basic attribute of the holy ground, Super Regeneration, has been activated.]
[Super Regeneration (S) has leveled up.]
[Super Regeneration(SS) has been activated.]
An incredible light swallowed the floating castle. Then, something surprising happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Eve of the Festival (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Eve of the Festival (5)
“Save us, Saintess!”
“Hey! Breathe!”
“Anyone there!”
“Saintess!”
The second zone inside Drachma.
Sophie, who was inside the stadium, was flustered. The stadium was tilted and full of people moaning. The smell of blood and oil was everywhere. And then there was the pungent smell of burning smell. It was a site of pandemonium.
Sophie trembled. Her reaction was understandable. As the castle tilted, the injured people crowded toward one side, and there were too many of them.
“Help me! Saintess!”
The injured numbered in the hundreds— No, it was in the thousands.
Looking at them was like watching pigs being gathered in one location to be buried alive. Bloodied people were getting tangled up as they cried out. It was a horrific sight.
Inside this pandemonium, the Ten Stars and the generals quickly moved into action.
“What are you doing? Hurry up and drag him out!”
“Take out the potion!”
“Bring out the healing-type Construct!”
The disciples moved quickly.
[The Aquarius temple’s First Chalice skill has been borrowed.]
[First Chalice (S)]
– Self-healing is activated to the max.
[One highest-rank potion has been used.]
[Five high-rank potions have been used.]
[The price has been paid to the Zodiac. The Construct has been summoned.]
The voice coming from the badges rang all around the stadium. However, the skill wasn’t working that well, so plaintive wails of pain could still be heard everywhere.
When their attempts at healing failed, they looked for only one hero.
“Saintess!”
“Please heal us!”
However, Sophie shook when she heard their yells.
‘It is impossible!’
Too many people were injured, and their wounds were too deep. However, the disciples desperately clung to Sophie.
“Please! We’ll give you money for healing us!”
“No… That is…”
The healing fee wasn’t the problem. As the Zodiac Saint of the healing type temple, Sophie couldn’t feel their life energy. She could tell by sensing the energy circulating them. They were close to death; they were barely clinging to life. Healing would be useless for most of them.
At that moment…
“Uh! Someone is healing over there!”
“It is Chun Sungjae!”
“!”
Chun Sungjae flew to various locations as he used his skill.
[See Uncle’s Miracle (F)]
– Your stamina is consumed as Super Regeneration is working on a single subject.
This was a healing skill that he had developed when he had awakened as the Zodiac Saint of Life.
Normally, Super Regeneration acted as a self-healing skill. The only reason Sungjae was able to heal others was the evolution of this skill.
People cheered when they saw his regeneration skill.
“My god! My wounds are disappearing…!”
“The Serpent Bearer’s temple is amazing!”
A light appeared from the necrotic finger as new cells and tissues instantly appeared.
This scene left Sophie trembling.
‘Is that Lee Gun’s Super Regeneration…!’
It was a powerful healing ability that could threaten her power as the Saintess. This was enough for her to raise her guard.
‘I heard he became the Zodiac Saint of Life…’
The crowd became abuzz when they saw Super Regeneration for themselves.
“Isn’t this amazing? Isn’t it better than what the Aquarius Saint does?”
Sophie flinched.
The people were surprised, but Chun Sungjae just clicked his tongue. The skill was powerful, but when compared to his uncle, he would be found wanting.
Well, it also had to do with the fact that his healing skills were lower in level compared to his attack skills.
‘As expected, there are too many people to heal one by one.’
Doing that wasn’t impossible, but it would take too long. The casualties would mount. Moreover, it wasn’t as if he could move these people to the hospital.
‘Aside from the teleport zone, exiting Drachma is impossible.’
This meant the injured couldn’t be moved from this place. Therefore, the young Zodiac Saint tried to think hard about a solution.
Sophie was about to tell him that it was useless.
‘Even the Aquarius cannot save this many people.’
Flash!
“!!”
However, a light surged up from the ground at that moment, surprising everyone.
“What the hell is this light?”
It was an incredible light; it looked like an aurora had emanated from the floor!
Chun Sungjae smiled when he saw the familiar light.
‘It is uncle!’
It was as he expected. An engraving of two serpents appeared on the enormous floor of the Drachma!
Kwahng!
A powerful energy covered the entirety of the flying castle.
Kwah-jee-jeek!
The Constructs that were summoned by this power almost fainted.
[Wait a moment. This feels like holy ground designation!]
[What? This place is the communal area for the 12 Zodiacs!]
[The Zodiacs won’t forgive him!]
However, something even more surprising happened.
“Wow! My wounds!”
“Ahhk! What the hell? My bones knit themselves back together!”
“Wait a moment! Ahhhhk! My leg is growing back! Ahhhk! What the hell!!!”
Pandemonium descended within Drachma again, but for an entirely different reason.
It wasn’t just one or two people, but thousands. The body of everyone within Drachma was regenerating.
This was different from Sophie’s healing, and it also differed from what Chun Sungjae had done.
The stadium, which had been filled with moans and wails of pain, suddenly became full of cheers.
“I’m healed!”
“I’m saved!”
The grief-stricken cries changed into joy-filled cries.
“Whose power was it?”
“Do you need to ask?”
They immediately looked at Sophie.
“It must be the Saintess!”
“Saintess!”
Sophie flinched at their gazes. She shook. Suddenly, she had a sense of déjà vu. The situation made her wonder when something like that had happened, but she soon realized it.
It had been when the Zodiac Saints had exited the Devil’s tower. At that time, the reporters had acted the same way. They had attributed Lee Gun’s achievements to them, the twelve Zodiac Saints. At the time, the Zodiac Saints hadn’t made a fuss, as they had gone along with it.
“Saintess! Thank you very much!”
The frightened Sophie knew this couldn’t happen, so she yelled, “N-No! It wasn’t me!!!”
At Sophie’s strong denial, everyone laughed.
“No way…”
“You are being too modest.”
“No. it really wasn’t me!”
“Saintess huzza…!”
[How impudent!]
“!!”
A powerful light descended above Sophie’s head. The crowd quickly realized who this light belonged to.
‘The Aquarius!’
To be precise, it wasn’t the Aquarius, who Lee Gun had killed. It was Iaso, who Lee Gun had made the new Zodiac.
At the same time, she was the one who ordered around Sophie under Lee Gun’s orders.
The crowd immediately got on their knees when a holy god made her appearance. Zodiacs were great beings they didn’t dare look at.
“God, thank you very—”
[How dare you speak such irresponsible words! This great power belongs to the Serpent Bearer! It belongs to Lee Gun!]
This revelation shocked the crowd.
“Serpent Bearer? Lee Gun?”
“Is that really true?”
Sophie nodded, looking like she wanted to cry.
The sounds of dumbfounded exclamations reverberated in the surroundings.
“See! I told you guys! If it’s a green light, it’s Lee Gun!”
“I know, but I never expected him to be better than the healing-type temple…!”
“Uh? Does that mean the Saintess lied again?”
Sophie almost screamed. “No. I said it wasn’t me this time…!”
“Wow! The fact that you stole credit for Red Eye wasn’t enough? You tried to steal Lee Gun-nim’s achievement again…!”
Labeled as the boy who cried wolf, Sophie felt aggrieved.
‘I said it wasn’t me this time!’
Of course, she could say nothing since she had wronged Lee Gun in the past.
At the same time, the Ten Stars who followed their respective Zodiac Saints were shocked. The Aquarius disciples felt their pride hurt.
However, another surprising thing happened then.
“The central control room contacted us!”
“The damaged suspension mechanism of the castle has regenerated!”
“!!”
* * *
[Holy ground’s special attribute has been activated.]
[Super Regeneration (S) has leveled up to Super Regeneration (SS).]
[Super Regeneration (S)]
– For 180 seconds, magical energy is consumed, and all damaged bodies will be super regenerated to a healthy state.
– Regenerate one Living Being or Inanimate Object
– Caution. It is not usable if Divine Status dips below 30%
▶
[Super Regeneration (SS)]
– There is no Time Restriction as Magical energy and Contribution is consumed. All damaged bodies will be super regenerated to a healthy state.
– Regenerate Living Beings, Inorganic Objects, and Space within the appointed domain.
– Caution. It is not usable if Divine Status dips below 30.
[Super Regeneration (SS) has been activated.]
[The flying castle has recovered.]
[The suspension mechanism has recovered.]
[An unknown high-rank god from the pantheon has become interested in the Serpent Bearer’s ability.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round at the notification.
‘Unknown high-rank god?’
He didn’t think it was a Zodiac.
At that moment, the plummeting flying castle suddenly decreased its speed. Then, it started to right itself.
Doo-oong!
The people became surprised after the castle was no longer tilted.
“We stopped…!”
Stevens looked at Lee Gun as if he was seeing a monster.
However, Lee Gun didn’t pay attention to him, all because of the notifications.
[Drachma has been designated as the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground.]
[If you designate it with a name, it will fully become the holy ground of the Serpent Bearer.]
[What name would you like to designate it?]
“Floaty….”
Lee Gun was about to completely designate it as his holy ground when…
Boom!!
An enormous sound rang out, as if the sky was falling. This made everyone, including Lee Gun, sway on their feet.
“Koohk…!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw the light falling from the sky.
[The Zodiacs are angry.]
Drachma was a communal area, so it was easier for the Zodiacs to view this place. Moreover, this place was a neutral location jointly created by the Zodiacs. It was a strict place where even the Zodiacs weren’t allowed to use their powers.
[The declaration to make the communal area your own is a provocation and an act of war.]
[They say the Serpent Bearer has ignored the pact of the Zodiacs.]
[The Virgo says it isn’t just the twelve 12 Zodiacs. Drachma is involved in an important pact for the divine world.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows at those words. He didn’t know the exact details, but this castle was the land of the gods. It was related to the pantheon. However…
“If you don’t like it, why don’t you rescue the people in here?”
The Zodiacs flinched at those words.
[The Zodiacs understand the Serpent Bearer’s intentions.]
[They will help from now on. Since the humans within the castle are alive now, they ask you to retract the holy ground designation.]
Lee Gun’s expression said that they were talking nonsense. “I don’t want to. This is neutral land. I’m the thirteenth, and I never made that pack. It’s first come, first served.”
Those words caused the Drachma to shake violently. It was a castle where the twelve Zodiacs had made a joint pact. Their power surged forth from within.
[Warning! The power of the Zodiacs is threatening the Serpent Bearer.]
[The Capricorn is angry. It says it didn’t build this castle to hand it over to you.]
Lee Gun smirked when he saw the Zodiacs’ attacks coming from the sky. Attacks like this didn’t matter. His affiliate Zodiacs would block it. But…
[The Sagittarius sends an attack toward the Serpent Bearer.]
“!!”
One of the attacks flying toward him was a fire pillar.
[The Sagittarius says the Serpent Bearer is in the wrong this time.]
[Despite being an affiliate, he says this cannot happen.]
Lee Gun got angry. “Hey, you better shut up, or I’m not going to fix what is dead.”
The fire pillar, which had been flying toward him, stopped.
[The Sagittarius praises the great Serpent Bearer, saying the Drachma is yours.]
The fire pillar started attacking the other Zodiacs.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
Pandemonium broke out around Drachma. Fire pillars, water pillars, ice pillars, and other pillars flew in the sky. The power of the gods violently clashed against each other.
The Virgo neither helped Lee Gun nor attacked the other Zodiacs.
[The Zodiacs are angry. They ask if the Sagittarius has lost its mind.]
[The Sagittarius says, “You guys are the crazy ones.”]
[The Sagittarius is angry, saying how dare they touch the personal vehicle of the Serpent Bearer.]
[The pissed-off Zodiacs have also declared war on the Sagittarius temple.]
[The Pisces threatens the Sagittarius, saying it will destroy everything the Sagittarius is in charge of.]
[The Sagittarius reacts in anger]
[The Sagittarius dares it to do so. He says the only ones fighting are his Zodiac Saint and the Zodiac Saint’s children.]
Lee Gun wondered if Hugo had been asked about the decision, but the declaration of war had been made.
[Drachma has been designated as the holy ground of the Serpent Bearer. The process is complete.]
[Floaty!]
Drachma’s designation as a holy ground succeeded thanks to the Sagittarius.
Lee Gun laughed as if he didn’t like the design of the Drachma, which the Capricorn had created. “I’ll completely break this castle down and remake it.”
Lee Gun had snatched away Drachma by designating it as his holy ground. The Zodiacs were about to express their great anger when…
Koo-goo-goong!
“!”
The floating castle suddenly started to plummet. The disciples screamed from the shock.
“Ahhhk!”
Lee Gun quickly looked below the castle. A black strand was pulling the island-shaped Drachma toward the ocean.
At this point, it seemed the monarch would physically make them into fish food.
The floating castle plummeted at a crazy speed.
Koo-goo-goong!
In a flash, they went past the clouds of the troposphere, and the black ocean came into view.
[Warning! Abyss is aiming for its prey.]
[The servants of Abyss are gathering.]
Lee Gun laughed as he lifted Heaven’s Punishment. It seemed the matter would be over quickest if he got rid of the main instigator.
‘I prefer this.’
It was as if the two Divine statuses reacted to his thoughts.
[“Death” is excited, saying it should be used for such work.]
[“Death” says it wants to make them into sashimi.]
[“Life” says that’ll be too annoying. It suggests boiling the ocean itself.]
[“Life” says being boiled alive is the best type of pain]
They were around four thousand meters from the ocean!
Stevens emitted a golden light as he summoned his golden armor. “Shit! We are falling into the ocean! Get ready!”
“Yes. We will immediately rent the Pisces’s skill— What the hell!”
“What’s wrong?”
Goat looked at his badge, which was shaped like a wristwatch, and his face turned pale. “The Pisces declined to rent the Ocean Walk skill!”
“What!”
“Aside from those belonging to certain temples, it doesn’t care if we fall into the ocean!”
Lee Gun laughed in derision. It seemed this was how they were going to do this. So, he activated his skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Tasty Meat (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Tasty Meat (1)
Lee Gun activated his skill. The next moment, a wave of cold energy emanated from Heaven’s Punishment. It was the winds from the freezing depths of hell. People felt as if it could freeze everything.
Lee Gun swung the ax toward the ocean.
Shweek!
His hand swung so fast that the move wasn’t even visible.
[December Hibernation (SS)] x 4
– The extreme freezing depth of hell puts everything to sleep.
At the same time, a luminescent ball of ice shot out of Heaven’s Punishment, as if the weapon had fired a shell. The ice ball flew toward the ocean.
Pahng!
When the luminescent ball fell into the ocean, it manifested energy. Then, something incredible happened.
Zzuh-guhk!
With the sound of ice freezing, the ocean froze in an instant.
Zzuhng!!
[The cold energy of the freezing depth of hell will put everything to sleep.]
[Everything is going under hibernation.]
The small seed of ice froze the violent ocean, a frightening display of power. The range of the attack was the size of a small island!
The frosty energy went against the currents and quickly froze the creatures at the bottom of the ocean.
Doo-doo-doohk!
The rough ocean currents also froze!
They were in the middle of the ocean, where land and islands could not be seen in any direction, yet an enormous land of ice formed there.
This sight shocked Stevens. It was to be expected since this technique was the Virgo Saint Kevin’s specialty skill, Revolution of the Moon.
Amongst the twelve battle techniques, this was the one with ice properties. It was a winter skill. But how was Lee Gun using it?
“That isn’t a rental skill, so how…!”
How else?
Lee Gun had acquired it by kicking Kevin whenever they saw each other.
“Well, I do have about ten of your skills stored, too.”
“What?!”
However, that wasn’t important right now.
Stevens reared back in fright when he saw where they were falling. “Hey! You made the place where we are falling into ice!”
“What about it? With this, we don’t need Ocean Walk, right? We have land now.”
Stevens was dumbfounded. “Do you realize what’ll happen if we crash into the ice? Drachma might not be able to survive the crash!”
“Would you like to become food for the monsters instead?”
It didn’t matter whether they fell on top of the ocean or ice. They would suffer shock and damage either way.
Falling onto ice would be better than the option of falling into the ocean and having the monsters eat everyone before they could swim to the surface.
Moreover, Drachma wasn’t that large.
‘We’ll be sitting ducks in the other case.’
Lee Gun had to acquire a space where they could fight on the ocean. “Anyway, I’ll use this skill a couple more times, and we’ll be able to fight even without the Ocean Walk skill.”
That wasn’t all. Kevin’s frost skill was perfect for this situation. The powerful cold energy froze anything that got close to it.
While it wouldn’t completely freeze them, it would affect the monsters. It would keep them in check.
[The Pisces, who is the owner of the Deep Sea, laughs in derision.]
[It says that ice of that thickness wouldn’t be able to handle Drachma’s weight.]
[It laughs mockingly. It says the island itself will fall into the ocean, and everyone will become food for the monsters.]
The Pisces mocked them after refusing to lend out the Ocean Walk skill. The Zodiac’s comments were understandable. The reason was Drachma’s weight.
Even if the land of ice was used as a landing mat, it wouldn’t change the reality that they would still fall into the ocean. This was what the Zodiac was trying to convey.
“I never planned on using the land of ice as a landing mat.”
“!”
The Pisces’s confusion lasted only a moment as Lee Gun activated a skill he had prepared beforehand.
Stevens and Goat flinched when they felt the energy.
[Float(SSS)] x 25
It was a magic skill that was completely unrelated to the Serpent Bearer.
While using the skill, Lee Gun placed his hand on the floor of Drachma. And as if a wind blew…
Boo-oong!
An energy wave that felt like the sea breeze encircled the entirety of the castle. This was the magic of the Pisces!
The skill coated the entire castle and started to flash.
[Float has been used.]
At that moment…
“Ahhhk! Help!”
Screams erupted all over Drachma since the people in the castle were unaware of what was going on. They were only five hundred meters away from crashing.
“Ahhk! We’ll fall into the ocean!”
“No! We’ll hit the ice!”
“An ice of that magnitude won’t be able to support this castle! Ahhk!”
Now, only four hundred meters were left.
Three hundred…
One hundred…
The people became desperate as the surface got closer.
“Shit! Let’s borrow a defense skill from the Taurus temple!”
“Let’s do something with magic!”
It was a mess inside Drachma., and the magicians within it quickly tried to use their wind magic. They wanted to slow down the castle’s fall even by a bit.
“No! We won’t be able to stop it!”
“We’ll become monster food!”
Within the pandemonium, Drachma finally fell on top of the land of ice.
Koo-goo-goong!
The impact sent violent waves surging upward!
Drachma’s base had smashed into the land of ice, and the island part had broken away violently.
However, the castle itself had the blessing of a Zodiac, so it was intact. On the other hand, the ice platform couldn’t win against the weight of the castle. It broke apart, and Drachma fell into the ocean.
Koo-goong!
This made the monsters within the ocean rush forward in glee. The fish-type monsters aimed for the humans, who would fall into the ocean soon.
[It’ll be easy to kill humans drowning in water.]
However…
[!]
The monsters that had been anticipating the castle sinking to the ocean floor flinched.
[The humans aren’t sinking!]
Yes, the castle that was supposed to sink into the ocean was floating on top of it. The reason was simple.
[The divine-rank floating skill has been successfully applied.]
[Floaty can now float on top of the ocean.]
[Nothing will be able to easily sink Floaty.]
Lee Gun, who was outside the castle, laughed when he heard the notification. It was the moment when Drachma had turned into a ship.
The people inside the castle cheered when they realized what was going on.
“We are alive!”
Goat and Stevens had thought they would be swept into the ocean, so they were shocked as well, as they looked at Lee Gun. It was to be expected.
“This skill is…!”
“It belongs to the Pisces!”
They were sure of it. This was an innate skill of the Pisces.
‘Float.’
The name explained what the skill did in simple terms. However, something was strange about it. The Pisces Saint had refused to lend out the Ocean Walk skill, so there was no way it would lend out its buoyancy skill.
