In the first place, a skill capable of floating an island of this size wasn’t a rental skill (F-SS). It was an SSS-rank (Divine-rank) skill!
This was why they were having a harder time accepting the situation.
‘It is a skill that only the Pisces can use. What is going on?’
Moreover, the Pisces looked as much taken aback as they were. Why was Lee Gun able to use its skill?
[The Pisces glares at the Serpent Bearer.]
[The owner of the Deep Sea asks where you got the skill.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned cold. “You shouldn’t deny reality. When you saw the skill, you realized it, right?”
[!]
“Your other half is in my hands. I also have your Zodiac Saint, which you put inside the stomach of the Abundance monarch.”
The words surprised Stevens. “Zodiac Saint? You mean Liv? What do you mean by the stomach of the Abundance monarch? She is supposed to be on TV today—”
“Ah! I got the real one out. She’s already dead, so I’m using her right now as a weapon ingredient.”
“I see… Weapons ingredient— What?! What are you saying?”
At the same time, a cold murderous intent spread in the sky.
[The Pisces is displeased.]
[The Pisces says it will consider the Serpent Bearer as an enemy.]
Murderous intent appeared in Lee Gun’s eyes. What? Enemy?
He was dumbfounded. “What the hell are you saying? You already considered me an enemy, and you messed with me from the background.”
The Pisces reacted to his murderous intent.
[You are a snake that crawls on the floor. Let’s see how you survive in the ocean without my help.]
Lee Gun was about to tell it to cut the crap.
Hwee-reek!
However, a black stalk aimed for his back.
“Lee Gun-nim!”
Lee Gun bent his body on reflex and cut the black stalk. He moved at incredible speed.
At the same time, creepy tentacles surged out from the ocean. The tentacles started to grab people.
[The servant of the Deep Ocean is trying to offer prey to the monarch.]
All the disciples within Drachma made the sign of their deity when they saw this. If they had a place to stand, it was doable.
“Everyone! Charge!!”
The disciples landed on the ice platform and rushed into battle.
Stevens and Goat struck down the monsters that surged toward them.
[Contribution EXP is being received from the affiliate disciples. It is rising.]
[Contribution EXP is being received from the affiliate disciples. It is rising.]
[Temple energy is starting to fill up.]
Chun Sungjae appeared in front of Lee Gun. “Uncle!”
“What about your Noona?”
“She and the others are protecting the central system within the castle. They said the floating mechanism can’t be attacked.”
“Good. Even though I didn’t order it, they know what is important.”
As expected, they were quick to make the right decisions.
Lee Gun immediately raised Heaven’s Punishment. He just had to get rid of the culprit that was pulling the castle into the ocean. It would bring this to a close. Afterward, he could float the castle back into the air. His side would win then.
Lee Gun was about to head toward the ocean when…
Kwah-jeek!
‘!’
The black stalk suddenly grabbed him.
“Koohk!!”
It was like the tentacle of a jellyfish. The black stalk wrapped itself around Lee Gun’s neck as it dragged him away.
This development surprised Goat and Chun Sungjae.
“Lee Gun-nim!!!”
“Uncle!” Chun Sungjae quickly tried to attack the stalk, but someone got in his way.
Kwahng!
“!”
The one to appear in front of Chun Sungjae was none other than the Gemini Saint, Heiji.
“I’m sorry, but I need the Serpent Bearer to be eaten by the monarch.”
“!”
It wasn’t the Heiji Chun Sungjae knew. This person’s energy was different. Therefore, he wondered if it was the Zodiac.
“Fairy Monarch, what are you doing? Hurry up and shove him in the ocean!”
“!”
A familiar voice rang nearby. The owner of the voice was the Taurus Saint. No, it was the Zodiac.
The Zodiac had been caught by the same stalk that had dragged Lee Gun away, and it was in an awkward situation. The reason was simple.
[Warning! It is an item that steals the ability of a Zodiac.]
[In front of this relevant item, a Zodiac cannot use its abilities.]
As the notification rang, the black stalk continued to choke him.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘This power…’
He was sure of it. It was the same phenomenon that had occurred when he had fought the helmeted man. It was stealing the power of a Zodiac. That wasn’t all.
“W…What is that!”
Screams could be heard.
Amphibian monsters were starting to approach them from the ocean. They seemed to have planned on dragging everyone into the ocean.
The disciples shuddered when they saw the monsters.
“Shit! There are so many…”
At that moment, they heard a voice.
[Your petty tricks won’t work.]
The sound seemed to reverberate from the ocean.
‘It is coming from the ocean floor.’
Abyss relaxed after sending its underlings. It spoke.
[Zodiacs are what the monarchs want the most. There are two noble preys. I can evolve even if I just eat one of you.]
Abyss had no plans of letting them go.
[Choose. Which one will be eaten by me?]
The disciples would become food for its underlings, and it was going to eat one of the two Zodiacs for itself. Then there was the Fairy Monarch.
The Gemini had newly summoned this monarch, and there was a reason why it had appeared.
“If a monarch eats a Zodiac, it will be satiated. It’ll go to sleep.”
To save the Taurus, this Fairy Monarch would allow Lee Gun to get tossed into the ocean. This was why she had interfered with Chun Sungjae, who was trying to save Lee Gun.
Chun Sungjae flew up in an instant and grabbed the neck of the Gemini Saint. “How dare you!”
His Sadism attribute made it so that he didn’t know any healing skills, but the level of his attack skills was extremely high.
He tried to activate his skill. However…
“You are too late.”
“!”
The Gemini Saint laughed as Lee Gun got dragged toward the ocean.
[First, it is the snake.]
“Uncle!”
The Taurus laughed.
However, when he was about to get dragged inside the ocean, Lee Gun suddenly laughed. “Hey, hurry up and boil the water. All the ingredients I’ve gathered will spoil.”
As soon as he spoke, the ocean started bubbling, as if it was boiling.
While everyone was taken aback, a powerful beam of sunlight surged up from within the ocean.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Tasty Meat (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Tasty Meat (2)
The flashing light exploded forth from the ocean. It was neither a normal light nor a magic spell. This light couldn’t be compared to such laughable lighting or magic. It was the light of the sun.
The surroundings became so bright that it looked like daylight within the ocean. The people above the ice were naturally surprised.
“The ocean…!!”
“What the hell is that light?”
However, something was even more shocking than that light.
Gurgle!
A sound akin to the sound of soup or broth being boiled rang out. It was the sound one heard when the water went past the boiling point and started to gurgle!
Everyone was having a hard time believing what they were seeing. They tried to deny it, but it was unmistakable.
“It is boiling!”
“What?”
“The ocean is boiling!!!”
“What?! Have you lost your mind?”
The people on the ice murmured amongst themselves. However, the ocean water started to boil more. At the same time, they started feeling heat everywhere!
“Ahh! The ice! It is melting! Melting!”
“Get back into the castle!”
Those who were holding their swords on top of the ice platform hurriedly turned back toward Drachma.
The monsters were flustered by this situation, so they were about to move quickly. But…
“Do you think you guys can run away from the sun?” Lee Gun laughed as he remained bound. Accompanying his laughter, a powerful light appeared below his feet!
[The great sun ascends from the vast waters.]
Koo-goo-goong!!
After finally reaching the surface, the sunlight covered the vast Atlantic ocean.
“Ahhhk!”
Realizing the danger, the monsters screamed and tried to run away.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!]
[Jee-ehhhk!]
The water’s temperature had gone up so much that it was boiling, and the monsters within the ocean started to vomit blood.
[The heat of the sun is cooking those monsters.]
[“Life” is overjoyed because of the pain of the monsters.]
[“Life” says it would be great if you can boil them a bit slower.]
[“Death” hates it.]
The scales capable of withstanding cold subzero water temperature were tattered. The muscles within the thick shells became rigid from the heat. Their blood congealed and hardened before it could reach their heart.
[The 7,894 ingredients have been cooked very well.]
[You have gained EXP.]
[You have gained EXP.]
[The monsters cannot stand the boiling water.]
[“Death” is very sad.]
[“Death” doesn’t like things boiled alive.]
[“Death” likes them fried.]
The monsters turned bright red as they floated to the surface of the ocean. It looked as if a piece of land had appeared on top of the Atlantic ocean, which was made out of the bodies of monsters. They did suffer death en masse.
The black stalk-like creature holding Lee Gun seemed to have taken damage too.
[The servant of Abyss is in pain.]
[It twists its body in pain.]
Lee Gun grinned. The being holding him was a high-rank monster sent by a monarch. It was probably a black zone-rank monster. And even a powerful monster had not expected a situation of this magnitude.
‘It is a power of someone I’ve acknowledged.’
Accompanying Lee Gun’s laughter, rough waves erupted. Then, a scream rang out.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!!]
Splash!
The power holding Lee Gun started losing strength. At the same time, Lee Gun fell toward the ocean.
“Uncle!”
However, Lee Gun spun to regain his balance.
Tuhk!
The floating corpses of monsters acted as a good platform.
Lee Gun recalled Heaven’s Punishment, which had fallen into the ocean, and his eyes flashed. “There should be some that haven’t been cooked yet.” His gaze headed toward the depths of the ocean.
The remaining monsters were trying to quickly return to the bottom of the ocean, where the water was cold. However, it was useless.
[Your effort is in vain.]
“!!”
People were surprised by the voice ringing in the sky.
Then, a figure of light appeared above the ocean.
“C-Can it be!”
“It is the god of the sun!”
The Sagittarius glanced at Lee Gun to ask if he had done well.
On the other hand, the people were abuzz at the appearance of a great god. He was far away, so it was hard to see his face. However, they were certain.
“That robe! It is the Zodiac of the Archer temple!”
“Really? I want to see it! I heard the Sagittarius is handsome!”
“What? Really?”
Descent was a great opportunity for a Zodiac to raise people’s faith toward it.
Goat shook when he saw his Zodiac.
‘His head…!’
He had heard that the Sagittarius had lost all his hair thanks to Lee Gun. It would be fine if the Zodiac was just bald, but he had done something weird…
‘No! Faith toward the Sagittarius will plummet if his appearance is revealed!’
They had to quickly send the Zodiac back.
“Hey.”
“!”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile as he called for the Zodiac. “Come here for a moment.”
The Sagittarius immediately agreed.
[I should go since the Serpent Bearer is calling for me.]
The Sagittarius seemed to consider this development a good turn of events. He planned on showing its appearance as a god to increase the members of the Sagittarius temple. It was a great opportunity to do some missionary work when so many people were gathered in one place.
However, Goat quickly moved when the Zodiac got closer.
“Ahhhk! No!” He was already sad that they were ranked last. Goat couldn’t give up on his Zodiac’s dignity.
However, the people were able to locate the Zodiac much faster.
“Uh? Is that…”
“Uh? His head…”
Goat knew it was too late, and he was about to despair.
[Zodiac Forced Summon!]
“!”
The bright figure floating in the sky suddenly disappeared.
“Uh? Uh? What the hell was that?”
“The Zodiac went away!”
The one who had made the Zodiac possess his body huffed in anger.
“That bastard, Gun! Our god almost became advertised as the bald Zodiac!”
It was Hugo. He was a couple hundred meters away from Lee Gun, crouched atop the ocean. A transparent blue bow was strapped to his back.
[Bow made out of Fish(EX rank). Multiple attributes (Hope Seeker of Deep Sea)]
– Water bow made through melting the Pisces
– Basic skills: Ocean Breathing, Ocean Walk, and 5 other fish-type skills
– 3 special skills (SS, EX)
This bow was the first EX rank weapon made for someone else, and Lee Gun had wanted to give it to Hugo first.
Hugo had gone back on his word of not liking it. He had taken the weapon made out of a Zodiac and come here according to Lee Gun’s orders.
It was for no other reason. Drachma had been falling, and he had realized that the one dancing like an idol in his room was the slime.
And after he had realized Lee Gun was gone, he had heard Lee Gun’s voice all of a sudden.
[Hey. Hurry up and find my location.]
‘!’
Since Hugo was an affiliate Zodiac Saint, he could hear the Zodiac’s voice. Until now, he had heard only the clear voice of a woman. So hearing Lee Gun’s voice oddly annoyed him. However, it didn’t matter right now.
[I don’t have time to explain. Get ready to boil a hot pot soup.]
‘Hot pot soup??’
At first, he had thought Lee Gun was speaking nonsense, but Hugo did a double take when he tracked down Lee Gun’s location.
‘He is above the ocean?’
The Secretary had shown up and said something was wrong with Drachma.
Hugo had an idea something was wrong when Drachma had repeatedly dropped and stopped in the air.
‘I don’t know who is behind this, but Drachma will fall into the ocean.’
Of course, he knew what that meant.
‘The ocean is a territory ruled by the monsters.’
If they fell into the middle of the ocean, they would become food for the monsters. That was why Hugo had realized the meaning behind the “hot pot soup” at once and got out of his seat.
The Secretary warned him it would be dangerous when she saw the location, but he didn’t pay attention to her. His one and only idol was there with his children.
[You have rented Teleport.]
[Warning! You are trying to teleport to a dangerous region (Mid-Black Zone). Do you really want to use it?]
It was already a dangerous region, but it was also in the middle of the ocean, where there was no land. However, it didn’t matter to him.
[Ocean Walk has been automatically activated.]
It wasn’t a finished product, but he had the bow that had been manufactured by grinding down the Pisces. He would have no problem above the Ocean. As soon Hugo arrived there, he saw it.
[Warning! The Serpent Bearer, the head Zodiac, has lost his power.]
“!”
Three hundred meters ahead of him, Drachma had crashed into the ocean, and Lee Gun had been captured by a monster’s tentacle.
When he confirmed this, Hugo had immediately carried out the plan.
[All the Temple energy of the Sagittarius has been used.]
[The bible skill has been activated.]
[Sun Summon (SSS)]
In some aspects, it was a skill that summoned the Zodiac itself. However, this was different from the Zodiac descent, where the Zodiac’s soul was summoned. In this skill, the Zodiac was summoned through projection.
When the sun was summoned beneath Lee Gun’s feet, the ocean had started boiling in an instant.
Hugo wondered if a storm would be created if he raised the temperature of the ocean, but it was better than Lee Gun dying.
‘It seems Gun partly allowed himself to be caught.’
It would be troublesome if the prey ran away while the water was boiling. Moreover, Gun was a Zodiac. He just had to stay put, and the strongest monster would try to catch him.
He had kept the powerful monster occupied while its location could be discerned. It was a good plan where he was the bait.
‘Still, this is incredible.’
Normally, Hugo was lacking in power, so he had never attempted this. He could only imagine it. However, after he had become an affiliate under the Serpent Bearer, his options had grown.
Of course, he controlled the power. It would be a shame if the broth was gone… No, no.
He meant to say it would be a shame if the people in Drachma got hurt.
‘That bastard, Gun.’
Hugo had done as asked, yet Lee Gun had planned on showing the Sagittarius to everyone?
On the other hand, the summoned Sagittarius was disgruntled.
[The Sagittarius grumbles. It planned on showing its great presence. It was an opportunity to convert more disciples. It asks why you stopped him.]
[He is angry, asking if you have any plans on reviving the temple.]
Hugo became angry. Who was the one trying to tank the faith? “Do you have any plans for reviving the temple? Do you realize what kind of articles will be written if you appear with that head?”
[The Sagittarius says he rubbed hair growth solution onto its head. He is proud that his hair has already grown.]
“It is a fuzz! How can you show that? If you act this way, I really will go to Gun!”
[The Sagittarius is aggrieved. It says it fed you, grew you, and protected you. He says the guilty one is criticizing the innocent.]
“I’m the innocent, and you’re the guilty one! Also, you acted as you pleased by declaring a war against another temple— Koohk!”
Hugo quickly brought up his bow. The reason was the Constructs of the Taurus running toward him. The Taurus disciples were there too!
[Warning! The monster cow has given an SS-rank temple mission.]
[The Taurus is at a war with the temples of the Serpent Bearer and the Sagittarius. Rewards will be given if they are pushed into the ocean.]
It was a special mission that the Zodiac and Zodiac Saint could give to the temple. When this mission was completed, the Zodiac personally rewarded them. Or the divine seat occupied by the Zodiac gave a random reward.
Therefore, all those disciples and Constructs were charging forward after they received the mission. Moreover, there was a good enough reason to trigger it.
[The monster cow has declared the Battle of the Temples.]
[Like the Serpent Bearer, it plans on consuming the Sagittarius temple. It will make the Sagittarius an affiliate.]
[The Taurus is confident that the Sagittarius temple will be a good servant for them.]
[The merge will help them fight the unknown civilization. It will be very helpful in bringing back the scattered sense of unity.]
Instead of asking for cooperation or agreement, it planned on merging through force.
This made Hugo glare at his Zodiac. “Look! This is your fault for declaring war!”
[The Sagittarius seems a bit apologetic. He tries to hand you some equipment.]
“I don’t need it! Gun’s items are much better! If you plan on giving something, just hand over some money!”
Well, it didn’t matter. The Sagittarius temple did join with others before. On the other hand, Lee Gun was also in a messy situation.
“Uncle!” Chun Sungjae, who was being held by the Gemini Saint, yelled in desperation.
The Taurus temple was ranked third for a reason.
[Warning! It is the power of an indomitable steel wall.]
[The strength of the powerful monster cow exceeds the strength of the Serpent Bearer.]
The Taurus had grabbed Lee Gun from behind. “Honestly, I was surprised.”
“!”
“I never expected you to use the Sagittarius temple to take care of the beasts of the ocean.”
Thanks to the hot pot soup plan, like Lee Gun, the Taurus had also escaped the grasp of the monster.
The Zodiac’s eyes flashed. In terms of physical strength, the Taurus was the strongest Zodiac. Lee Gun, who the Taurus had grabbed with both arms, couldn’t break free.
‘It doesn’t budge at all.’
Breaking free using strength would be impossible. Moreover, blood was dripping down from the body part that the Taurus had wounded in its ambush. The more Lee Gun tried to get out of its grasp, the more blood flowed out.
The Taurus was well aware of its strength. It arrogantly laughed. “Looks like you cannot use Super Regeneration because of my power. First, I would like to thank you for getting rid of the monarch’s servant. I’m alive thanks to you.”
The monarchs had aimed for the Zodiacs, and the Zodiacs were vulnerable to the monarchs; the Zodiacs’ powers could be stolen. On top of that, they were above the ocean in the Black zone.
They would remain in danger until they reached land. The angered Abyss might come to the surface at any moment.
Therefore, the Taurus was truly thankful to Lee Gun. However…
“I’ll make you regret gathering all your affiliate temples in one place.”
It looked toward the ocean. A black shadow appeared from beneath the ocean.
The Taurus flinched when it saw the shadow. It wondered why Abyss had come out so quickly, but it soon realized the reason.
‘It came because it smelled this bastard’s blood.’
The Taurus had never expected the inability of Lee Gun to use Super Regeneration to work out like this.
As expected, the master of the ocean had revealed itself.
[How dare you do this to my underlings!]
But this could also be an opportunity.
The Taurus looked at Lee Gun as it laughed. “Unless you want to get tossed to the monarch as food, you should give me your affiliate temples to me.”
At that moment, Lee Gun took action. Lee Gun had purposefully not used Super Regeneration. It was as if he had been waiting for this moment. He hugged the Taurus and jumped down, taking both of them into the open maw of the monarch.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Tasty Meat (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Tasty Meat (3)
It happened in an instant.
Lee Gun had jumped down while holding onto the Taurus. There was no hesitation. He was instead worried that the Taurus would let go of him. Therefore, he had clutched the Taurus’s arms!
Splash!
Everyone inside Drachma was shocked and frightened at this scene.
“Ahhk! Lee Gun fell into the ocean with Ivan!”
“That’s crazy. They’ll boil if they fall into that soup!”
“Monsters are still alive in there!”
The Fairy Monarch being held in place by Chun Sungjae was also surprised. It had originally planned on helping the Taurus toss Lee Gun into the ocean, but it never expected Lee Gun to voluntarily jump in.
Chun Sungjae and Hugo, who had been watching it in real-time, reacted in fright.
“Gun!!”
“Uncle!”
At a glance, it looked as if the Taurus was hanging onto Lee Gun, but that wasn’t the case at all!
“Crazy bastard!!”
It wasn’t as if he was Nongae, who had plunged into the water with the Japanese general![1]
It was clear. Lee Gun had purposefully fallen into the water with the Taurus. The Taurus represented the impregnable defense. It was the best shield of the twelve Zodiacs and a being of great strength. Therefore, even Lee Gun shouldn’t be able to break the Taurus’s strength! But that was beside the point!
Jumping into the ocean right now would be suicide!’
The electric magical energy flowing through the ocean told the story.
‘Something above the black zone rank is approaching.’
Lee Gun knew little about the monarchs, but this being felt similar to Abundance. Of course, Abundance had been inside the body of a human at the time; it had done so to infiltrate the dome, which allowed the passage of only humans and gods.
Therefore, its abilities had been reduced by a bit. If one was being precise, the amount of power didn’t feel the same. It was only the energy.
Anyway, the ocean contained a monster much stronger than Abundance!
‘He has a death wish!’
There was no mistaking it. They would get eaten by the monster that ruled over the ocean.
As if he had read this thought, the Sagittarius spoke.
[The Sagittarius pouts]
[The Serpent Bearer is not a monster. The Sagittarius wonders why you don’t think he would die in the boiling ocean. He sulks.]
It seemed the Sagittarius wanted to show off its power, yet Hugo ignored him.
‘Just putting him in boiling water doesn’t make it a snake soup.’
Lee Gun would have long become cooked if the sun could cook him. Therefore, Hugo quickly dismissed the Ocean Walk technique, and he was about to jump into the ocean.
Lee Gun was still being held by the Taurus; the fact that he was the weaker one remained true.
Pahng!
“!”
However, the Taurus’s Constructs and disciples got in Hugo’s way. They also stopped Chun Sungjae and Goat, who tried to enter the ocean.
“Stop Lee Gun’s subordinates!”
“Lee Gun was purposefully sent into the ocean by the lord!”
[Complete our mission!]
[Master will take care of Lee Gun!]
Hugo ground his teeth.
‘The ocean is already dangerous as it is.’
Their enemies then rushed toward them at the same time. They had rented a good number of the Pisces’s skills. And, as expected, they proudly activated their skills.
[The Sagittarius temple has no chance of winning near the water!]
[Get rid of them!]
“We’ll turn the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer into an affiliate!”
“Be thankful that the great Taurus wants to make the Sagittarius temple its subordinate!”
The angry Hugo took out the Bow made out of Fish (EX). “Do we look like fools to you?”
Hugo was still worried about Lee Gun as his eyes flashed.
‘Wait a little, Gun.’
He would save his Zodiac in no time. The Archer Saint pulled back on his new bow.
* * *
While everyone was predicting the Taurus’s victory, the Zodiac itself was perplexed.
‘This bastard….’
Lee Gun was like a snake that had caught its prey. He wouldn’t let go of the Taurus. This was beyond not letting go. He was like a serpent trying to constrict its prey. He clung tighter to the Taurus.
This flustered the Taurus.
‘Did this crazy bastard jump in knowing what’s going on in the ocean?’
Naturally, the Taurus wasn’t worried about the boiling water. Its temple was called the impregnable temple for a reason.
‘I can withstand this.’
Its divine body allowed it to hold its breath longer than a human. However, that wasn’t what the Zodiac was afraid of.
Koo-goo-goong!
‘It is here.’
The oppressive energy was just around the corner. In the past, this monarch had lived in the ocean of the divine world. It ate any gods it caught outside. It was the predator of the deep ocean that could invade even the imaginary world of the gods, and it had even eaten high-rank gods!
Therefore, the Taurus quickly tried to get out of the water. This was the ocean dominated by a monarch. The Return skill didn’t work, so the Zodiac had no choice.
[Kuh-huhk!]
However, Lee Gun clung to the Taurus’s neck as if he didn’t want it to leave. When the Zodiac turned its head, it saw Lee Gun’s flashing red eyes.
The Taurus shouted as he was strangulated.
[You crazy bastard! Let me go!]
Divine words were being used to speak directly into his head. That was why they could converse with each other despite being underwater.
[Fuck off! Who said to grab me like that? Once you grabbed me, you should have planned on sticking it out until the end! You aren’t running away!]
This bastard had lost its mind! As Abyss’s energy got closer, the Taurus quickly yelled.
[Don’t you feel this energy? We’ll both get eaten at this rate!]
The divine words were slightly different from before.
[Divine words contain “Persuasion.”]
Divine words could be imbued with power. This was why gods could overwhelm their opponents with just their words.
In other words, a god’s voice could be filled with the will of persuasion. This allowed the god to persuade its enemy. If one imbued the words with love, one could make someone fall for one. That was how the skill was supposed to work, but it was useless right now.
[Kuh-huhk!!]
Lee Gun didn’t want to hear more of its nonsense. He clung harder, like a sea snake.
The Taurus was flustered as his neck continued to get constricted.
‘The divine words do not work at all…!’
This meant Lee Gun’s divine status (level of a god) couldn’t be looked down on now.
The Taurus’s eyes flashed.
‘I have no choice.’
It would have to consume a large amount of temple energy, but the situation couldn’t be helped.
[Be gone!]
This time, the Taurus put “Submission” into its divine words!
A twinge appeared in his senses as Lee Gun felt his mind get attacked.
The Taurus laughed when the strength drained away from Lee Gun’s hands.
[That’s enough— Kuh-huhk!!!]
[There is no way I’m stopping!]
Lee Gun reacted in contempt. He made use of his legs to cling to the Taurus, looking like a koala! Or maybe he was a water ghost in his past life. Lee Gun remained tenacious as he sank the Taurus toward the bottom of the ocean.
The Taurus was losing patience, so it was about to get into a battle of strength with Lee Gun when…
‘…!!!’
The Taurus’s face froze as it turned pale.
A large shadow had appeared beneath the two Zodiacs. It was shaped like a whale that roamed the ocean. However, it was completely different from a normal whale. Its size was on a different level.
One could catch a glimpse of the being’s head, and the head was as big as an island. Moreover, the being looked long enough to cover the length of the deep ocean.
Its tail looked like the appendage of an octopus. Its mouth looked like the mouth of a shark, and it was full of teeth. The fin on its body looked sharp, as if it was made out of a steel mane.
This was the Abyss monarch!
Lee Gun smirked as if he had been waiting for it to show up.
[I’m glad I didn’t heal myself so that my blood could spread its scent.]
The Taurus’s face hardened. This bastard had purposefully not used Super Regeneration!
At that moment, the monarch continued its incredible assault.
Kwa-gwa-gwa-gwahng!
Discovering their prey, the monarch and its underlings rushed forward in a frenzy.
[Become our food!]
The frightened Taurus quickly emitted its magical energy, which made brown lightning flash within the ocean! The move basically gave away their location to the monarch, but the Taurus didn’t care at that moment.
‘I have to run away using Lee Gun as bait!’
The Taurus activated its skill!
[Charge (SSS)]
Kwah-gwahng!!
An enormous boom rang out within the ocean. At the same time, Lee Gun felt a shock hitting his body, as if a mountain had slammed into him.
[Warning! The incredible strength of the Taurus is destroying the body of the Serpent Bearer.]
Just the shockwave had made the ocean shake and changed the ocean currents. A human would have been broken into pieces by this power.
‘The snake is pretty good for being a newborn.’
When it confirmed Lee Gun was falling toward the monarch, the Taurus desperately swam to the surface.
‘Getting out of this place is my priority right now.’
At that moment, however…
“…!!!”
The Taurus felt a chill run up its spine. It felt a frightening sensation, as if an unseen hand was trying to grab its leg. The Taurus didn’t even dare to turn its head to confirm. Just the thought of turning its head gave it chills.
And as expected…
[Kuh-huhk!]
Ooh-dooh-doohk!!!
An enormous appendage encircled the Taurus.
[Koo-oohk! You bastard—]
The Taurus couldn’t finish its sentence as it was dragged underneath once again.
[Kuh-huhk!]
Something was moving at an incredible speed. The Taurus was about to use its power once again when it almost stopped breathing.
‘That is…’
The eyes of a serpent were flashing within the deep waters. Because of the dark ocean, the Taurus could see only the silhouette. However, something was clear; an enormous serpent was moving around!
‘God of calamity!’
This was the true appearance of the god. The Taurus felt a chill. The serpent they had found and killed twenty-four years ago was here.
‘The snake that had reincarnated was found and killed by a monarch.’
In truth, the gods had been hunting the thirteenth since long ago. They feared its power. Moreover, they did it to hide a certain truth. That was why they had found and killed it once again twenty-four years ago.
Of course, its power was anathema to the other gods. Therefore, they had let a monarch take care of the matter despite monarchs being natural enemies of the gods.
Until now, the Taurus had held out hope since it had seen Lee Gun’s power. It had held out hope that Lee Gun was exposed to the god of calamity’s power and held only a portion of its power. The Taurus wanted it to be something similar, not the same.
The Taurus had also agreed to kill Lee Gun in the Devil’s Tower because Lee Gun was annoying. Of course, the Sagittarius had sworn that Lee Gun wasn’t the god of calamity. He had complained that there was no need to kill Lee Gun.
‘I was right! He is the god of calamity!’
The Taurus ground its teeth. At that moment, it wondered whether the Sagittarius had even placed curses on that bastard within the Devil’s Tower or not.
‘We are the same. He’s an accomplice in killing the snake god.’
Maybe, the Sagittarius was terrified, so it went under the Serpent Bearer as an affiliate. Such a being was detestable. But this naturally gave rise to a question inside the Taurus’s mind.
‘Then who was the woman who we killed at that time?’
That didn’t matter right now.
[Serpent Eater]
[Kuh-huhk!!]
The Taurus vomited blood. The body of the snake, which had been encircling its body, turned into chains. The enormous body of the snake returned to being Lee Gun.
[Ha ha ha! Let’s become food for the monsters together!]
Lee Gun pulled the Taurus with the Serpent Eater skill. Right now, he was emanating a power that couldn’t be compared to before.
The Taurus wondered what was going on.
[Masochist (Lv. 2) attribute has been activated.]
[Fighting ability increases as you feel more pain.]
[Pleasure increases.]
[You have acquired a stimulating effect.]
[Your endorphins have risen.]
[With the effect of the second stage of Life, the related attribute of Masochism has evolved (Masochism Lv. 2)]
[Pain is the proof of life. You have acquired more vitality and energy.]
[Masochism Lv. 1]
– Physical ability, vitality, stimulant effect, and senses increase as you feel more pain
▶
[Masochism Lv. 2]
– Physical ability, vitality, stimulant effect, and senses increase as you feel more pain
– As the number of your wounds and your pain increases, your vitality and fighting ability double.
– Energy increases in proportion to pain.
The Taurus got a chill when it felt the energy burning up inside Lee Gun. The reason was there. It saw Lee Gun’s expression as his red eyes flashed. Lee Gun was letting out a terrifying smile! He looked like a spirit!
The Taurus felt fear without realizing it.
‘He’s nuts…!’
Lee Gun hadn’t used Super Regeneration as bait for this very moment.
[Two precious Zodiacs are gathered here!]
The happy Abyss charged toward the two. It opened its mouth wide.
Lee Gun dragged the Taurus along with him as he charged into the mouth of the monarch! They were swimming at incredible speed. This shocked the Taurus.
What kind of crazy bastard would charge toward the mouth of the monster that wanted to eat them! The Taurus desperately used his defense skill as he yelled.
[It is useless! Did you forget I am a defense-type Zodiac! I won’t die so easy—]
[Yes. Between your defense and my regeneration, let’s see who wins!]
Finally, Abyss loomed in front of them. Then, Lee Gun tossed the Taurus into Abyss’s mouth.
1. Nongae was a courtesan in Jinju, Korea. She later became a mistress of Jinju Commander-in-chief Choe Gyeong-hoe. As per popular legend, she killed the Japanese general Keyamura Rokusuke by luring him to a rock on the water, clasping her fingers with rings that locked her around him, and plunging into the water with him tightly in her arms. It is said that she sacrificed herself not only in revenge for Choi’s murder but also out of love for her country. ☜

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Tasty Meat (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Tasty Meat (4)
It happened in a flash.
Lee Gun had tossed the Taurus, and the Taurus had instantly fallen into Abyss’s mouth.
[Kuh-huhk!]
The defensive-type Zodiac couldn’t even put up a fight. Pushed by Lee Gun’s power, the Taurus got swept along the strong current into Abyss’s mouth.
‘Shit!’
The Taurus had no chance of running away in the middle, and the situation had left it dumbfounded.
‘That crazy bastard! There is no benefit for him to do this!’
The Abyss monarch was huge. This meant Lee Gun would get eaten alongside the Taurus. Therefore, the best move for Lee Gun should have been to negotiate with the Taurus so that both of them could get out of this!
The Taurus quickly tried to exit the mouth, but Lee Gun clung to its leg.
[Do you hate me that much? Why do you keep running away from me?]
Fuck! Really! Was Lee Gun saying he would rather die than cooperate with an enemy to live?
At that moment, Abyss closed its mouth.
Kwah-jeek!
The Taurus tried to run away until the end. However, it got swept into the current as Abyss closed its mouth. The Taurus couldn’t even right itself.
[Koo-uhk!]
At the same time, sharp teeth fell on it.
[Huh-uhk!]
The Taurus retreated in fright. Of course, Abyss’s size was indeed a problem, but its teeth could be avoided if the mouth was big enough. However, this was the leader of the monsters. Its mouth was built differently.
[Shit!]
The Taurus had assumed the monarch would have one row of teeth. However, it saw a second row, a third row, and more.
The monarch had teeth akin to sharks. The densely packed teeth had a total of twenty layers! The inside of its mouth of already a chamber of torture. To make matters worse, the monarch’s tongue had bumps that looked as sharp as knives. This was hell made out of sharp blades!
And that wasn’t the end. Since the monarch was huge like a whale, it should have swallowed its food whole; that would have been great. However…
[Zodiacs taste the best when they are chewed.]
Abyss laughed in derision as it brought down the roof of its mouth.
Boom!
The sharp blade-like teeth made the Taurus groan.
[Koohk!]
If the roof of the monarch’s mouth was completely shut, they would die. So the desperate Taurus extended its hands and put its hands on the palate. The activation of its indomitable defensive skill was a must.
However, the monarch wouldn’t fall for such a tactic.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!
As if it wanted to savor the taste, Abyss swept its bumpy tongue toward Lee Gun and the Taurus.
[Kuh-huhk!]
This was on a different level compared to a lick from the feline-type monster. The blade-like bumps ruthlessly cut into Lee Gun and the Taurus, who was holding up the roof of the monster’s mouth.
[Warning! Your body at its current level can’t withstand this attack.]
[Your defense skill cannot block the attack.]
[Your divine body has taken damage.]
[Damage Rate: 60%]
[Damage Rate: 70%]
The ruthless attack destroyed the bodies of Lee Gun and the Taurus.
Kwah-jeek!
Was it because of the tooth lodged in his shoulder? Lee Gun’s right arm was instantly severed. His body had taken extreme damage, which he had never suffered before. Therefore, Lee Gun’s Super Regeneration quickly activated.
[“Life” flinched, sensing a huge danger to its owner.]
[To preserve the body of its owner, Life has raised the power of Super Regeneration to the extreme.]
[Magical energy and Temple energy have been consumed.]
[“Life” has temporarily decreased the energy heading toward the disciples.]
[“Life” has activated Super Regeneration with it revolving around the vital spots. The regeneration of its owner’s body is the highest priority.]
[“Death” is angered by the injuries inflicted on its owner.]
[“Death” vows to kill the monarch.]
The advanced “Life” and “Death” were like the heads of an operation. They were top commanders when it came to the skills under their domain.
Moreover, their Zodiac’s safety was above all else for them, so they controlled the skills on their own whenever something happened to their master. They were a bit(?) crazy, but they were the most reliable commanders for Lee Gun alongside his Zodiac Saints!
In other words, the skills were automatic. Therefore, Lee Gun could concentrate solely on the fight now. And so, a smirk appeared on his lips.
Bbah-gahk!
[Kuh-huhk!]
After leaving the safety of his body in Life’s care, he kicked the Taurus. Due to the kick, the Taurus slipped, and the roof of the mouth came down. The Taurus suffered under Abyss’s teeth.
Kwah-jeek!
The defensive-type Zodiac vomited blood when the teeth pierced through its body.
[Kuh-huhk…!]
[Abyss’s power has partially broken through the Taurus’s substantial defensive skill.]
In truth, Lee Gun was the only one to possess divine statuses personified to this degree.
For instance, the Taurus was having a hard time holding up as it had to modulate its power.
[Kooh-oohk…!]
Did this happen because of the teeth digging into its back? The Taurus’s back looked more bent than before as it tried to prop up the roof of the mouth. With an aggrieved expression, it glared at Lee Gun.
[You cheap snake bastard…!]
Lee Gun was the one who had said they should see which one was stronger between regeneration and the Taurus’s defense!
Lee Gun didn’t care as he tackled the Taurus’ legs.
[Whatever! Just get chewed up, you bastard!]
[Kuh-huhk!]
The Taurus fell and got impaled by the teeth.
[The Taurus’ barrier has been broken.]
The teeth were powerful enough to pierce the body of the strongest defensive Zodiac! The Taurus screamed from the excruciating pain it felt.
[Ninety percent of the Taurus’s barrier has been damaged.]
Abyss was overjoyed.
[The Zodiac’s blood is coming in!]
The Taurus ground its teeth when it heard the monarch’s shout. It was in a very bad spot. As if to make things worse, Lee Gun had kidnapped its Zodiac Saint, so its power had been reduced.
‘That was why I was trying to recover my Zodiac Saint.’
Of course, the Taurus had thought it could find a way to survive if it was swallowed. However, Abyss wanted to chew and savor the two of them. It showed no signs of swallowing them.
As if to prove this, Abyss would chew the Taurus, then move the Zodiac around with its bumpy tongue for a bit. Then, it would chew the Taurus once again with its teeth, as if it were eating candy.
[I like that you aren’t breaking apart easily.]
It wouldn’t have been strange for Abyss to immediately swallow the Taurus and absorb the Zodiac’s power. However, the Taurus’s defense was too strong.
[If I don’t chew you well, I’ll probably have indigestion.]
‘That’s enough. Just swallow me!’
When the Taurus’s eyes turned bloodshot…
Kwah-jeek!
[The Taurus’s defense has been completely broken.]
[Damage Rate: 100%]
The Taurus’s defense was finally broken, and its power started gushing out of its body. When a Zodiac’s body was damaged, divine energy would leak out.
Abyss was excited because of the incredible power.
[The content is pretty full! As expected, the quality of a high-rank Zodiac is on another level.]
The hard outer shell was broken. The only thing left was the tastiest and splendid parts: the flesh, soul, and the core of the Zodiac. The core was the source of a Zodiac’s power.
[Let’s start absorbing its power…]
As if he had been waiting for this moment, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
[Serpent Eater]
A green chain encircled the Taurus, then Lee Gun activated his holy item!
[Shoes that face no problem in water (SS)]
Manufacturer: Lee Gun
– Shoes made by grinding down a part of the Pisces Saint (Walker)
– Part of the Zodiac Saint has been ground down, so the basic skills of the Zodiac Saint are equipped in this item.
– [Ocean Walk], [Reverse Ocean], [Summon Water Spirits], and five other ocean-type skills.
The next moment, an enormous explosion occurred within Abyss’s mouth.
Kwahng!
It was as if a mine had detonated within the ocean. An incredible amount of bubbles and jets of water exploded within the monarch’s mouth. The shock even opened the mouth slightly.
Koo-goo-goo!
And something instantly exited through that small crack.
[Reverse Ocean]
It looked as if a torpedo had been shot. This was Lee Gun. He had escaped from the monarch’s mouth. However, Lee Gun wasn’t the only one that had exited.
[The Taurus’s body has been destroyed.]
[Its Core has been damaged.]
The chained Taurus exited with Lee Gun.
Having lost its prey, Abyss raged.
[How dare you! I went through the trouble of chewing it!]
The monarch had broken the troublesome outer shell, yet someone took away the content within!
From Abyss’s perspective, the situation was like peeling open the shell of a shrimp and the shrimp meat running away.
The Taurus was dumbfounded as Lee Gun dragged it along with him. Lee Gun had acted resolutely as if he wanted to face off using divine abilities.
[You bastard. From the beginning, you planned on breaking my barrier using the monarch’s teeth…]
The destruction of the barrier wasn’t the only thing Lee Gun wanted to do.
[Hahaha! Did you think I would let it have you as prey? You’re my prey!]
He seemed to have planned this out from the beginning. Moreover, the two of them weren’t easily caught. Lee Gun started swimming at ridiculous speed. He was headed toward the surface!
[Catch them! Master’s prey is running away!]
[The armless bastard dares to do this in our territory!]
The underlings of the monarch chased after Lee Gun, but it was useless.
[“Shoes that face no problem in water” have activated their abilities.]
[The direction of the current has changed.]
[A new ocean route has opened up.]
In the rough ocean, Lee Gun’s current swimming speed rivaled the monsters, all thanks to his shoes.
This was his first test item made by melting down a Zodiac Saint. That was why the Pisces Saint’s Shoes had great abilities.
Of course, the item was lacking in durability and defense, but Lee Gun might be able to use the Taurus to strengthen it. The defensive-type Zodiac might be helpful.
[Try taking it away from me if you can, you fish head!]
Lee Gun dragged the Taurus toward the surface. He looked like a fisherman who was moving with the bait already on the hook.
This sight made Abyss furious.
[Damn snake!]
It was angry because Lee Gun had dangled food in front of it before snatching the food away.
The ocean depths shook violently, confusing the disciples above the ocean.
“What the hell? What is going on below?”
“Isn’t that Saint-nim and Lee Gun?!”
It was as if an earthquake had erupted in the ocean. Everyone inside Drachma screamed. Even Hugo and Chun Sungjae, who had been fighting the enemies, were surprised. Hailey, who had been within Drachma to kill the intruders sent by Abyss, flinched.
‘This feeling… Can it be?’
Something was ascending from the ocean. It was a very familiar feeling. And as she had expected…
Koo-goo-goong!
Kwahng!
As if a bomb had detonated, incredible spouts of water surged into the sky. An enormous beast appeared alongside a wave large enough to cover the entirety of Drachma!
“Ahhk! It’s a monster!”
Like a whale breaching, the enormous beast appeared on the surface. Its size was beyond imagination for the people inside Drachma.
Everyone including Hugo, who was a distance away, was frightened. They were sure of it. That shape and that feeling…!
‘Monarch…!’
Every person froze when an ocean monster that transcended common sense appeared before them. They felt like their hearts had stopped from fear. The more shocking part was that the beast was chasing after something.
“Hey! L-Look over there! What is that?”
Hugo looked in the direction the others had pointed out, and the scene left him surprised. They were pointing toward the sky, and Hugo could see a tiny dot.
Others might not know what it was, but Hugo had good eyes. His face turned pale from fright.
[Give back my food, you bastard!]
“Ha ha ha. Fuck off!”
Yes, it looked as if Lee Gun was trying to do deep sea fishing. He had dragged out the monarch using the Taurus as bait. Moreover, he had done it with one of his arms cut off.
At the same time, Heaven’s Punishment found its owner. The ax seemed happy as it twirled. It flew toward Lee Gun.
When the weapon reached him, Lee Gun grabbed Heaven’s Punishment with one hand and unleashed his power.
[The power of Death has been used.]
Lee Gun threw Heaven’s Punishment toward Abyss.
Kwahng!
However, he failed to hit it. The monarch was quick. It dived into the ocean when it sensed danger.
Kwahng!!!
After breaching the surface once more, Abyss released its powerful magical energy.
Koo-goo-goong!
The already-rough sea pitched and rolled violently because of the magical energy. The disciples got swept up by the waves, falling into the ocean.
[Ha ha! This is great! I’ll just eat all of you since it turned out like this!]
Abyss was crafty as it hid and appeared out of the ocean. It kept repeating the process with its mouth open. The situation above the ocean turned into pandemonium! This was to be expected.
“Shit! Our skills don’t work against it!”
It wasn’t just the skills.
“Our SS-rank weapons don’t work against it either!”
“What?!”
Even the SS-rank spear made by the Capricorn didn’t work against the monarch. This surprised the Ten Stars.
‘It is too powerful.’
This was almost beyond imagination. The monarch was so fast that locking onto it was almost impossible. When they tried to attack, it instantly hid within the ocean. They had to seal its movement first.
“Who can do that to something of that size?”
“It is too fast!”
There was no way to deal with the rampage of the predator, so everyone looked on in fear.
“What are you doing, idiot?”
“!”
Hugo flinched when he heard Lee Gun’s voice.
Then, as if he had received some kind of order from Lee Gun, Hugo quickly made a net out of green light.
Lee Gun shouted when he confirmed it. “Aim for its temple! I went through the trouble of making something excellent for you!”
Hugo aimed the Bow made out of Fish (EX) at the monarch.
Abyss reacted in contempt as it continued to pursue Lee Gun and the Taurus.
[Do you think an attack by humans will work on me? You guys are mere prey!]
The disciples froze at its murderous intent. At that moment, however…
“Do not underestimate humans!” Hugo let out a sharp cry.
Pahng!!
The powerful light pierced through the monarch’s temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Tasty Meat (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Tasty Meat (5)
The light was like a laser beam. The clean light pierced through Abyss’s head in one stroke.
At the same time, the monarch’s violent roar shook heaven and earth.
[Kuh-huh-uhk!]
It screamed as blood erupted.
Shocked by the cry, the disciples covered their ears. It was such a pained cry that they had to wonder if they would ever hear such a sound again.
As for the monsters, they cried out when they heard the scream that was full of pain.
[Oh, my liege!]
After having its head pierced by the Archer Saint, Abyss thrashed around as it fell into the ocean. Everything had happened in an instant. Abyss had been in the air for less than one second.
“What the hell happened?”
“Arrow! An arrow pierced through its head!”
“It was the temple!”
Those possessing good eyes or sensing abilities were shocked as they yelled. Soon, everyone was shocked as they realized where Hugo had aimed for.
“Do you mean that small crack at the temple?”
Abyss was surrounded by armor. The armor was hard enough to destroy weapons made by the Genius Workshop. However, all monsters had a weakness, and Abyss was no exception.
Its body had a few locations that weren’t protected by the armor: the joints of the armor.
Lee Gun and the other disciples had realized that this was the monster’s weakness. However, every crack was about the length of a finger joint. It was tiny. One could compare it to threading a needle.
The size was a problem, and then there was the speed at which the monarch was moving.
Hugo had elevated hearing, so he could hear Lee Gun’s voice. In truth, several hundred meters of distance separated Hugo and the Abyss. He shouldn’t have been able to hit the monarch at that distance.
[Master!]
[Kuh-huhk! These bastards…!]
Hugo had been accurate. He had hit the target without even a 1-mm mistake.
In the end, Abyss ground its teeth as it submerged back into the ocean.
Therefore, cheers erupted from the area.
“Wahhhhhhhhh!”
“He hit it!”
“Archer Saint!!!”
Goat clutched his face when he saw Hugo’s exploit.
Even if one could see the target, whether one could hit the target at that distance or not was a different story. Even Goat might fail to hit such a target, but Hugo had hit it in one go!
‘As expected of Saint-nim…!’
In recent days, Hugo had been pushed aside because of Lee Gun-nim’s exploits, but Hugo was also on another level.
Goat inwardly wept in joy.
‘Saint-nim! For a moment, I was drunk on Lee Gun-nim’s bow. I am sorry for praising Lee Gun-nim.’
On the other hand, Chun Sungjae pouted. “Why are you surprised by such a thing? When he is eating, he can catch small fruit flies with a toothpick.”
Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
After he shot the EX-rank bow, Hugo’s eyes shook with surprise. It was to be expected.
‘What the hell? Did I just pierce a monarch’s body with this?’
In truth, he had located his target and shot his bow because Lee Gun had said to shoot. Hugo didn’t really think he would be able to pierce through the monarch. Of course, he had aimed for the location that the mighty Lee Gun had said to aim for, where the attack would work, but this was still unexpected!
‘Its sturdiness can’t be compared to that of other monsters…!!’
Abundance had wanted to infiltrate the dome, so it had entered a human’s body. In terms of sturdiness, it had been on the weak side. This monarch was different! Even the monsters that had accompanied Abyss were in disbelief.
[What is that weapon?]
[How dare he use such a lowly weapon against his majesty!]
Lee Gun grinned.
‘Grinding up and using the Zodiacs was worth it.’
Although it seemed as if the monarchs and Zodiacs were in each other’s food chain, this didn’t change the fact that the Zodiacs were strong. And Lee Gun had ground down those bastards whole to make offensive weapons. There was no way the weapons would be weak.
‘I filled it with the extract of the Pisces.’
“Hey, Taeksoo. That’s not the reason you should be surprised.”
“!”
Hugo wondered what nonsense Lee Gun was saying when…
[The affiliate Zodiac Saint has received a massive amount of EXP.]
[A portion of the affiliate Zodiac Saint’s EXP has been offered to the Serpent Bearer.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s EXP has piled up a lot.]
[Hugo Otis has leveled up a lot.]
[Lv. 5]
[When level 20 is reached, the rank will rise. Hero ▶ Construct(low rank)]
“Ahhhk! What the hell is this?”
Lee Gun smirked when he heard the scream. When he had seen the ranks, he had realized a Zodiac Saint had a chance of advancing to become a Construct.
Anyway, finding the monarch’s weak point wasn’t difficult.
‘I have the Commandments I took from Abundance.’
The Commandments were the bibles of the unknown civilization. Written within them were their rules and sources of power. Therefore, seeing information about the monarchs was possible in the commandments.
That was why Lee Gun called it the Strategy Book. The commandments did contain one line written within Abundance’s note about the Abyss.
Since Abundance was in charge of the Proliferation of the other camps, the book had many stories about them.
For example, it said: “The region around the eyes, shoulders, and chin of the ocean beast shouldn’t be approached.”
When Lee Gun had killed Abundance, he had used the Commandments as a reference. Therefore, he was sure they would be effective once again.
Well, that wasn’t important right now.
“Sungjae!”
Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed when his name was called. He threw the net created using the Serpent Eater skill into the ocean.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
The chains made out of green light passed through the water surface.
Koo-roo-roong!
The chains split as an enormous net appeared within the ocean. The net instantly covered Abyss.
Then, he tried to bring up the enormous net encircling the monarch.
[You impudent bastard!]
In the end, he imbued the net with his ability.
[Pain Revival]
Kwah-jee-jeek!!
The Abyss felt an excruciating pain at its temple.
[How dare a human…!!]
Of course, the pain wasn’t bad enough that it couldn’t be endured.
‘Impudent bastard.’
But the pain was unpleasant. Moreover, the monarch knew this power belonged to the Serpent Bearer, the thirteenth Zodiac.
This was why Abyss grated its teeth.
‘Since Time spent so much effort on the thirteenth, I took an interest in him.’
Yes, Abyss knew Time never did things at a loss. Time was a crafty bastard that moved only according to profit. Therefore, since Time had spent so much effort on this Zodiac, Abyss planned on stealing and eating the prey in-between.
That was why it had come here, but Abyss had never expected this.
‘This snake bastard is outrageous!’
Abyss was finally angry. Its eyes flashed.
[Abyss renews its own life.]
[Its parts that are scattered around the world are being called in.]
[Its gathered power has recovered a part of its strength.]
Aside from the physical ocean, Abyss traveled through the dimensional ocean, the ocean of other worlds, the ocean of the heart, etc. It lived in various ocean depths in many forms.
The Abyss that roamed around the earth’s ocean was one of them. While the various forms of Abyss roamed through various oceans, they stored their power and sent it to each other when needed.
That was why Abyss could temporarily top up on its power.
[Abyss has consumed energy to use the power of the Pool.]
A pitch black strait slowly appeared in the ocean! The dark water spread like black ink, and it was about to sweep over the humans.
At that moment…
Splash!
[!]
Accompanying the sound of water, Hugo entered the ocean. The other disciples quickly followed suit.
Was it thanks to the Bow made out of Fish (EX), which was made by grinding down a Zodiac?
[Reverse Ocean]
Because of the basic skills built into the bow, Hugo was able to easily move through the waters.
The humans held bows and spears that resembled harpoons, looking like they were here for whaling.
Abyss and the monsters laughed as if this had angered them.
[These humans know no fear!]
Abyss immediately twisted its body. The net made with Serpent Eater jerked violently.
“Koo-oohk!”
Chun Sungjae’s veins stood out. He stood above Drachma, holding onto the net. Thanks to the Constructs’ training, he had increased his physical stats, but his strength was still lacking when it came to dealing with this enormous beast.
‘Shit! I have to raise the level of Life!’
It was as the word implied. Life was living energy. As the level of Life rose, the stamina, energy, and strength would also increase. This was applied to the Zodiac, disciples, and Constructs.
Sungjae was barely able to maintain the net, and it lasted only a moment.
Koo-goo-goong!
The angered Abyss created a powerful ocean current. The net broke, and the current swept away the disciples who had entered the waters. This included Hugo too.
When the current swept away the disciples as if they were paper dolls, Abyss let out a sharp laugh.
[How dare you…]
Kwahng! Kwahng! Kwahng!
[Koo-ahhhk!!]
Suddenly, a laser beam flashed within the ocean as it flew toward Abyss.
Kwahng!!
It was Hugo.
Hugo had looked like he was about to get swept away by the current, but he had soon read the direction of the current and sent an attack toward Abyss.
Tahng!!!
There was more. His arrows couldn’t be seen with the naked eye as they ruthlessly attacked Abyss’s weak points.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
The monarch’s flustered underlings tried to converge on Hugo.
[The Serpent Bearer’s maximum strength is being drawn.]
[Bow made out of Fish (EX) is being changed to the maximum output.]
[“Death” readily lends out its attribute.]
[Disassembly!]
[Abundance is a power Life likes. Since Abyss is a power that can grow Death, Death has lent out its power for this particular instance.]
[It says the Serpent Bearer will advent as the god of Death.]
[The power of Death and the Bow made out of Fish resonate with each other.]
The arrows emitted a light, whose intensity couldn’t be compared to before. The light was large enough to swallow the ocean whole! Finally, it crossed the critical point and went shooting into the ocean.
Kwahng!!!
The sound of heaven and earth shaking rang out.
The enormous energy beam Hugo had shot instantly killed all the monsters in the ocean, going on to hit the monarch. Then something surprising happened.
[Abyss’s body is being disassembled.]
[Abyss’s shell has been obliterated.]
Abyss screamed when its body was being disassembled. This was a terrifying power. Of course, the power of the Zodiac wasn’t the only reason this was happening.
A monarch’s body wasn’t that simple. Its sturdiness was on a different level than that of a Zodiac’s body. Not only could a monarch’s body repel outside attacks, but it also allowed the monarch to contain the power it emanated. The monarchs possessed the perfect body.
However, the magical energy of the Zodiacs wasn’t the reason Abyss’s body was cracking….
‘It is the weapon…!’
The problem was the weapon that had been created by grinding down a Zodiac.
‘His weapon is dangerous.’
The power of a Zodiac had been upgraded to make a weapon that was on a different level. And this weapon worked against both Zodiacs and monarchs. It was a weapon that could kill all divine existence.
‘He isn’t a simple Maker.’
It wasn’t just the weapons. Every item Lee Gun made changed the order of the world. No, it changed the order of the universe.
At that moment, an amazing light surged forth from the ocean.
[You have successfully gotten rid of a portion of Abyss.]
[You have acquired a part of Abyss’s ability.]
[Abyss’s Pool]
[It is a power that can grow Death]
[“Death” has leveled up.]
[Lv. 3]
[“Death” lets out a shout of joy.]
[“Death” says Disassembly will now count as Death’s EXP.]
[“Death” says this bastard should also be put in the blast furnace. It says you should advent as the god of Death.]
Abyss was about to sink to the floor of the ocean when a hand appeared from the black water the monarch had released earlier. The hand quickly tried to take Abyss. It planned on taking back the monarch’s body. However…
Tuhng!!!
The loud sound made the hand flinch.
Had Lee Gun expected this? Was that why he had let Hugo take care of Abyss?
[How dare you try to cheat me out of my prey!]
Lee Gun was inside the ocean, and he kicked Abyss. His holy item shoes and buoyancy skill sent the corpse to the surface in an instant.
Kwahng!
The disciples screamed when the enormous body surged into the air.
“Ahhhk!! It is falling!”
Boom!!!
After sending its prey above the water, Lee Gun quickly looked to where the hand had come out from, but the hand was already gone.
After confirming this, Lee Gun placed the Taurus over his shoulder and climbed to the surface.
“Uncle!”
“Yes.”
Lee Gun then looked at the trembling disciples of the Taurus temple. The disciples’ gazes headed toward the Taurus, who was draped over Lee Gun’s shoulder.
“Ah!”
Lee Gun smirked. “Now that I think about it, you guys don’t have a leader anymore, right?”
“!!”
“If the temples merge into one, there is no reason for us to fight. That’s why I plan to merge all the temples.”
“…!”
The words sent the Taurus disciples into turmoil. What? Merge? Merge the twelve temples?
They were shocked since they had never thought about such a thing happening.
When they became agitated, Lee Gun continued, “It is fine. Just give me an answer.”
“!‘
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he spoke. “Do you like the cow, or do you like the snake?”

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Merger (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Merger (1)
“Do you like the cow, or do you like the snake?”
The question stirred up the disciples above the water. They wondered why he was suddenly asking such a question.
“Cow and the snake…”
Although the disciples were surprised, one of them let out a bright laugh. “Really? Why are you asking such a thing? Of course, I like the cow— Kuh-huhk!”
The slow-on-the-uptake disciple was sent flying before he could finish.
Kwahng!
“Ahhhk! Michael!”
The disciple fell unconscious as he got sent flying into the ocean.
His comrades quickly tried to fish him out when Lee Gun approached them.
“What’s wrong?”
“!”
“Since I like meat, I recognize that you guys might like beef.”
Lee Gun held up Heaven’s Punishment in acknowledgment.
The Taurus disciples became frightened. They knew about Heaven’s Punishment; the Capricorn had made it for Lee Gun.
“Why…! Why did that weapon go from the second stage to the third stage…!”
“Why? You guys tried to kill my disciples and affiliates under the orders of your Zodiac.”
“What? Ahhhk! I’m sorry! However, it was an order from our Zodiac, so—”
Lee Gun didn’t care about that in the first place. His eyes flashed. “Whatever. You, do you like the snake, or do you like the cow?”
“W-What? I mean… At the end of the day, I cannot betray my master— Poo-hahk!”
Another disciple flew away. This time, the others caught sight of blood.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he held up Heaven’s Punishment. “Now then, do you like the cow, or do you like the snake?”
“Snake!!! We like the snake!!!!”
“Snake, all the way!”
“Hey! Really, guys!” Goat clutched at his face when he saw this. “It has started again… Lee Gun-nim’s forced conversion.”
“Hey, that isn’t a missionary. That is a threat.”
Yes, Stevens, who was also a victim of the missionary process, ground his teeth. Since the Leo disciples were useful for fighting, Lee Gun had pilfered and dragged away numerous disciples from the Leo temple. Of course, most of them failed to clear the faith requirement, so they were sent back.
Lee Gun planned on doing this again?
“They aren’t going to pass the faith requirement, anyway!”
Goat started to sweat when he heard Stevens. “No… The faith rises if he physically attacks them… He just needs to use his bible to raise the faith.”
“It doesn’t mean much after the bible’s buff comes to an end!”
That was true. The Secretaries’ abilities were unrelated to the Zodiacs. This was why their faith being low didn’t matter.
“When it comes to fighters, nothing good will come from their abilities being debuffed.”
At that moment…
“Did you not hear him, idiot? He is going to merge the twelve temples.”
“!”
Stevens flinched when he heard the prickly voice. This voice belonged to Hugo, who had shouted those words as he rose to the surface of the water.
After pushing back his wet hair, the Archer Saint exited the water. “If he’s going to merge them, faith isn’t needed. He just has to make the Zodiacs submit, and he could bring the temples in entirely.”
“Merge? Will it be like the Aquarius temple?”
They had already heard about what had happened to the Aquarius temple. The Aquarius Saint had been ground down, and someone under Lee Gun had occupied the Aquarius’s seat. That meant the Taurus would….
Hugo smirked at Stevens’s expression. “You’re so naive. He went easy on the Aquarius temple”
“What? He went easy? He could have done something more to them?”
Instead of answering, Hugo snorted.
‘The best outcome was to spare the Zodiac. The temple would become an affiliate, and they would be treated as underlings.’
The worse option would be the Zodiac getting taken out. Lee Gun’s subordinate would be placed in the seat of the Zodiac as a slave.
In both scenarios, their treatment would be different, but the temple would survive.
“Wouldn’t he have the option of annihilating the temple?”
In other words, it was a merger.
Stevens’s face turned pale. “He’ll get rid of the Taurus temple?!”
“The Taurus temple specializes in defense. Does he need the temple if he can steal their abilities?”
“Stop playing with me! Even if its powers are taken, a temple has its own techniques and traditions! It would be like getting rid of the pulse of a temple!”
“I don’t know. I have no interest in the other battle-type temples. In fact, the Sagittarius temple will become one of the three great battle-type temples if the Taurus temple goes away. That might be for the better.”
“Hey! That is your goal!”
“While he is at it, I might suggest to him that he should merge the Leo temple, too. We’ll be the two great battle-type temples. It has a nice ring to it.”
“Hey!”
Stevens wanted to reply to Hugo’s snort, but before he could do that….
“Kuh-huhk!”
Stevens was suddenly dragged toward Lee Gun. The one causing trouble was his prosthetic arm.
[Black Arm (Left) wails as it looks at its parent’s missing right arm.]
[Black Arm (Left) roars as it asks which bastard dares take the arm of its parent.]
[Black Arm (Left) says it will replace the missing arm.]
The prosthetic arm had seen Lee Gun, who had his arm cut off by Abyss. The prosthetic arm wailed as it tried to head toward Lee Gun.
Stevens desperately tried to stop the arm from leaving him. “Hey, where are you going? You already took four hundred thousand dollars for the usage fee!”
[Black Arm (Left) doesn’t care. Its parent is in critical condition.]
“Critical condition, my ass! Someone supposed to be in critical condition is threatening others!”
[It says he is going easy because he is in a critical condition.]
“What the hell? In the first place, you’re my left arm. You aren’t a right arm, so you’ll be useless— Kuh-huhk!”
[Black Arm (Left) is hurt by the verbal abuse. It is angry. It says you should pay compensation to its parent.]
“What the hell did you just say?”
In the end, Stevens was nickel-and-dimed to death as the prosthetic arm slapped him on the cheek.
Hugo looked at his surroundings and laughed in derision. “Anyway, you should be careful. Gun will try to merge the Leo temple too.”
“What?!”
“Why are you making such a face? Did you think he would forgive what you guys did just because you confessed?”
“…!!”
Hugo snorted when he saw Stevens’s trembling expression.
‘Of course, I’m lying.’
There was no way Lee Gun would get rid of the Leo.
Lee Gun kept cackling as he planned to extract the teeth and nails of the Leo. The beast provided good ingredients. In fact, Lee Gun had manufactured SSS-rank pliers so that he would have an easier time extracting its teeth.
‘He made SSS-rank pliers. That perverted bastard!’
Anyway, the ones at the biggest risk of being merged with the Serpent Bearer were the Taurus and the Pisces.
Thirteen temples might become eleven.
Kwahng!
“Ahhhhhk!”
At that moment, a scream rang out near Lee Gun’s side.
“My lord!”
Lee Gun had tossed the Taurus, who had been draped across his shoulder. The Taurus had been rolled up using its outer garment, and the disciples foamed at the mouth when they confirmed its face.
However, Lee Gun didn’t care about that. “I want to merge with the Taurus temple. Give me the seal to the Taurus temple. This guy doesn’t have it. That means one of you must.”
Hugo massaged his forehead as if he was fed up.
‘His actions aren’t that of a Zodiac. He acts like an evil god.’
On the other hand, awkward expressions appeared on the disciples’ faces.
“We do not have the seal. Our Ten Star…”
“Ten Star?”
As a member of the Ten Stars, Goat did a double take. The Ten Star of the Taurus temple was here until not too long ago. However, Joseph was missing now.
“Uh? He was here not too long ago.”
Lee Gun laughed in contempt.
“It seems you told him to run away.”
He looked at the tattered Taurus. The defensive-type Zodiac had a faint smile on its lips.
‘Go hide in our safe house.’
The Taurus temple was called the defense-type temple for a reason. If its disciples hid within the temple’s impregnable fortress, not even the attacks from the god of calamity would work against them.
Goat was about to move.
“Do not worry about him. I have the data of the Ten Stars, so I’ll be able to find him in no time.”
“No! Just shoot the tracking arrow. You don’t have to do anything other than that.”
“What?”
In the end, Goat did as Lee Gun ordered him to. He tilted his head in puzzlement as he readied the tracking arrow. Their opponent was part of the defense-type temple. An arrow would bounce off him. That meant…
“Do you plan on using Serpent Eater? That skill is…”
Serpent Eater was the only binding skill that Lee Gun had developed as a Zodiac. The skill was versatile, and he could even bind a soul. The only downside was the fact that the range was around only fifty meters.
That wasn’t all.
‘Lee Gun-nim’s arm is…’
Since it had been ripped away by a monarch, his right arm hadn’t regenerated yet. Serpent Eater was a capture skill; its effectiveness decreased if the Zodiac’s body was damaged.
‘Serpent Eater’s effectiveness decreases after a certain distance.’
The Taurus knew this, so it laughed. In the first place, the Taurus knew it wouldn’t be a problem.
[It is too late to track him down.]
Its disciple was already within the ocean. Joseph had received the Pisces’s blessing, so he should already be close to reaching Africa, the place where the Taurus’s holy ground was located.
At that moment…
Boom!!
A dark shadow appeared beneath Lee Gun’s feet.
[Death has been activated.]
After evolving to its third stage, Death had changed form again. Unlike the second stage where it only had its face, it now had arms and legs.
[Death has evolved to the third stage.]
[Its attack power, hunting technique, and sense have increased.]
[A new Death skill has been developed.]
Death roared into the sky, frightening everyone nearby.
[It will use the new power acquired from Abyss.]
[Pool!]
At the same time, the disciples screamed. Like the red tide, black water started to disperse into the ocean.
“Ahhhk! Everyone get out of there!”
“What the hell is that?”
Soon after the skill was activated…
“I caught him.” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
* * *
Around that time…
“Huhk. Huhk. We killed them all.”
“Huhk.”
The inside of Drachma was filled with the scent of blood, the reason being the monsters that Abyss had ordered to infiltrate Drachma.
These monsters had pretended to be caught as captives, and they had attacked the power room to take the Core of Drachma. It was a worthy target since it was where the energy of the twelve Zodiacs was stored.
This place contained the power cord that sustained the castle; it was the final line that should never be breached.
‘The castle will fall if its motive power is stolen.’
The castle falling into the ocean was secondary. This was the holy ground that Lee Gun had gone through the trouble of capturing. They wouldn’t let it be destroyed.
Therefore, Carly and Chun Yooha had sent only Chun Sungjae to Lee Gun’s side and took it upon themselves to defend this place.
When they had killed all the monsters, Drachma was filled with cheer.
“Lee Gun killed the ocean monster!”
“Really? I don’t think it was a normal rank.”
“Will this be like the green zone that appeared in Europe? Will humanity regain more land?”
“Moreover, he used his healing ability. The Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple is amazing…”
“Didn’t the Taurus refer to Lee Gun as a Zodiac?”
Carly was moved by this sight.
‘It means merging the twelve temples isn’t completely impossible for him.’
One needed a certain amount of reputation and faith to pull it off. Yet it didn’t look impossible. ‘It would have been perfect if he had a lot of Talent (currency of the gods).’
However, someone was watching this all with a troubled look in its eyes.
‘I never expected Abyss to be killed.’
This being was an observer for the Time monarch and had infiltrated this place by disguising itself as a disciple. It had hidden in this place to observe the Serpent Bearer.
‘Abundance’s loss already caused us a lot of headache, and now we have lost Abyss.’
Of course, numerous variants of Abyss were swimming around various oceans, and only one of them was killed, yet this was a troublesome development.
‘Since Abyss is gone, we have basically lost the Warp ability.’
Warp was a movement technique similar to teleportation. Since Abyss was gone, this was an opportunity to steal the monarch’s territory.
In truth, numerous factions were already moving to take the empty fertile lands before the humans could plant their flags.
‘However, Abyss’s death will be very troublesome.’
The power of Warp was an ability the observer’s lord frequently used. That meant…
‘We have to revive Abyss.’
As it had this thought, the observer took out a pocket watch from its pocket. It was an item that contained the power of the Time monarch.
[Pocket Watch that reverts time]
– Moves the clock 5 seconds back
This would allow it to return to a time before the Abyss was killed.
The observer just had to change the past slightly so that Lee Gun and Abyss never met. Of course, it didn’t have the power or an item to pull this off, but this place was Drachma.
‘The powers of the twelve Zodiacs are gathered here.’
An enormous amount of energy was contained within the power core of Drachma. The core could boost the power of its item. It could probably turn back time to an hour.
‘It’ll be enough to return the Abyss.’
That was why the observer laughed as it headed toward the power core. Capricorn disciples were walking around the observer, and it had worn the same clothes as them. These disciples were the repairmen, and they were busy trying to fix Drachma’s mechanism.
Since the observer had transformed into one of the repairmen, no one paid attention to it. In the first place, everyone was focused on the fact that Lee Gun had killed Abyss.
‘Good!’
The pocket watch was overflowing with power just from moving closer to the core. The observer was about to activate its ability when…
[Koo-hoohk!!!]
The observer groaned. Someone had stabbed it from the back.
“I caught you.”
The observer of Time became frightened when it turned its head.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Merger (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Merger (2)
The observer of Time became frightened when it turned its head.
The one to show up was none other than Chun Yooha, which shocked the observer.
‘This woman was just outside…!!’
It had checked her location and used the monsters to draw her out of here. The observer wasn’t an idiot. It didn’t want to steal the core with a Saint rank on high alert.
The distance between them had been several hundred meters, and the observer had seen Chun Yooha killing the monsters through the window. Moreover, it had hidden its power, so the chance of someone noticing it was close to zero. So how!
The observer then did a double take. The reason was the shadow emanating beneath Chun Yooha’s feet.
‘This power…’
It was a familiar power.
[Death has evolved after eating Abyss.]
[You can now use Abyss’s “Warp.”]
[Pool Walk (Warp)]
When Death advanced from the second stage to the third stage, it had developed a new skill, Pool Walk. Warp, which was Abyss’s ability, had combined with the coordinate system set up by Teleport. One moved through a tunnel that connected space-time.
Abyss moved through locations with dark and negative energy. This was why monsters that used Warp sometimes appeared within the domes. Abyss liked to move through space where humans felt afraid and negative.
However, after coming under Death, Warp had evolved and Death had grown.
As the Zodiac Saint of Death, Chun Yooha was also influenced. She could use the new skill. Of course, the Serpent Bearer’s Warp worked a bit differently.
[You have sensed the shadow of a being that holds ill intent.]
[Target’s Ill Intent (Stage 3: Murderous Intent)]
[The ill intent directed toward the Serpent Bearer.]
[You can travel to the being with the ill intent using its shadow.]
The ability sensed the ill intent toward Serpent Bearer and allowed the user to warp toward the source of the ill intent.
Abyss used corruption and fear as a medium to move, while Chun Yooha used ill intent for that.
Moreover, Death had also absorbed the ability of Space beforehand. Now, the ability wasn’t simply sensing the ill intent in the surroundings; the ill intent could be perceived through space.
Therefore, Yooha could sense the entirety of Drachma!
[You have sensed a being with ill intent toward Drachma.]
[The ill intent as stage 3.]
Ill intent had a total of five stages. Of course, most topped out at stage 1 (mild jealousy or envy). It wasn’t a big deal. However, starting from stage 3 (murderous intent), it was a different story.
‘Dispel!’
Chun Yooha appeared out of the observer’s shadow! She had appeared right on time as the observer had attempted to steal the core.
Yooha was considered the brain that had led the Leo temple for a reason.
‘!’
No explanation was needed. She realized what was going on, so she stabbed the observer’s back with Crimson Earth’s Judgment.
Poo-ahk!
[Ahhk!!]
The observer’s defense was low. The first stage of the spear was enough for it.
