After being stabbed in the back, the observer vomited blood. To make matters worse, it lost grip on the pocket watch of Time. The observer turned its head with bloodshot eyes.
[You …!]
At the same time, the human skin it had worn broke down, revealing half of its face. The observer looked humanoid. However, it had fangs, and the sclera of its eyes was dyed black. It was a monster.
With its identity exposed, the observer tried to use its ability.
[Double-speed Control!]
[Your speed is doubled.]
[Your opponent’s speed is halved.]
As a monster belonging to the Time faction, the observer had abilities related to time. However, something happened before the ability could be activated on Chun Yooha and the observer!
Kwah-jeek!
[Kuh-huhk!]
Carly showed up and stabbed the monster’s shoulder. The observer’s ability fell apart.
“How dare you!”
Chun Yooha’s eyes turned round when she saw Carly. She said, “I thought you were going ahead of me. Why did you get here so late?”
The words made Carly angry. “You were the one who came too quickly!”
“I thought you were the number one disciple.”
“Ahhhk! That is why— Kyaaa!”
Carly screamed when an attack suddenly flew toward her. It was the power of Death unleashed by Yooha. This power hit the observer and also flew toward Carly.
Of course, Yooha wasn’t aiming for Carly; the observer had been trying to use a skill on Carly in secret, and Chun Yooha had foiled it.
[Death has killed the Double-speed Control (Half Reduction).]
Chun Yooha had saved Carly, but at the same time, the power of Death had also swept along Carly.
Carly bared her teeth like a baby kitten. “Chun Yooha, why are you so boorish in sending your attack? I almost died thanks to you!”
Chun Yooha’s black eyes sparkled as she cheekily replied, “I’m sorry! I thought the number one disciple, who is considered to be the best in the world, would be able to dodge it.”
“Ahhhk! You’re trying to deceive me right now! Now that you acquired some good abilities as a Zodiac Saint, you’re trying to get revenge on me! Am I right?”
“If you come under me, I’ll let you borrow my abilities.”
“Ahhhk!”
Carly raged, saying Yooha was deluding herself. Of course, it wasn’t as if she didn’t understand this. They had been enemies in the past and had almost killed each other numerous times. Moreover, she was largely at fault for tormenting Yooha in the past.
Anyway, Carly was now jealous of Chun Yooha, who could use Lee Gun’s abilities. “It’s fine! I’m ok even if I don’t receive abilities from you!”
“I see.”
However, when the two of them tried to take back the core from the observer’s body.
[The ability of Time is resonating with the core of Drachma.]
“!!”
The observer’s pocket watch, which Chun Yooha had taken, emitted a light. It seemed to have sensed the danger to its owner. As it resonated with the power of the twelve Zodiacs stored within Drachma, the ability imbued within the watch started to activate.
[You will be returned to the day before.]
A voice came from the pocket watch, and the two surprised women realized what was going on.
‘Time Travel!’
They quickly swung their weapons. One decapitated the head, and the other stabbed the heart to extract the core. If its body was destroyed, it wouldn’t be able to travel through either time or space.
[Ha ha. That’s useless!]
“!”
The decapitated observer started laughing.
[This power doesn’t access my body. It transmits my memories to the past.]
“…!”
[Even if my body is destroyed, my memories will be transferred to my past self. My past self will change the future.]
First, it had to bring back Abyss.
The observer had suffered unexpectedly, but it knew Chun Yooha’s Warp was dangerous. Her ability was different from that of the monsters that traveled through the fear and darkness of the humans. That woman traveled through ill intent.
‘That means our entire species will be subject to that power.’
All the monsters held ill intent toward humans, especially toward the Serpent Bearer, who had dared lay his hands on the monarchs. It was a frightening prospect.
That wasn’t all. Their location of the headquarters will be revealed in no time as it was a place full of ill intent toward the Serpent Bearer.
‘I must stop it.’
Even if it had to sacrifice its life, the observer had to stop the Warp from being handed over to the Serpent Bearer.
When its ability finished activating, the observer laughed.
[You won’t be able to stop the movement of my consciousness!]
Chun Yooha and Carly were flustered, but suddenly…
[Ahhhhhk!]
The observer screamed.
[Reverse Time]
At the same time, something surprising happened. The body of the laughing observer started to twist around as it let out light. Something odd was happening as its body was distorted.
An odd phenomenon occurred around the observer as if there was an afterimage. Its decapitated head reattached itself, and the stab wounds created by Chun Yooha and Carly were gone. However, the observer looked to be in pain as if it were having motion sickness.
At the same time, the observer glared in another direction, looking furious.
[You bitch…!! How dare you!]
“!”
The observer was looking behind Carly and Chun Yooha. Standing there was the Scorpio Saint Hailey.
Hailey’s eyes flashed as if they weren’t going to put up with its nonsense. “How dare you try to steal Lee Gun’s power?”
The observer was surprised.
[How can you use the monarch’s power— Kuh-huhk!]
The observer was in pain as it bled. The power attacking it was that rough. It felt as if its body had been put in a spinning blender.
The power Hailey used was a power that turned back the time of her opponent’s body. As proof, the observer’s body started to shrink. It was getting younger. This shocked the monster.
[Who are you? How are you able to use monarch-nim’s power…!]
The observer did a double take when it stared at Hailey. This woman was so beautiful that thinking of her as a human was hard. At the same time, her devilish appearance reminded the observer of the monarchs.
Finally recognizing her, the observer became angry.
[C-Can’t you tell that we are comrades?]
As soon as it spoke, a blade pierced through its eye.
[Ahhhk!]
It was Hailey’s sword. “I’ve never thought of you guys as my comrades.”
[Huh-uhk— It seems you forgot your duty while you rubbed elbows with the humans. No. is it the Serpent Bearer?]
“!”
[I heard it from our monarch-nim. I heard an idiot kept entering the Devil’s Tower twenty years ago, trying to turn back time. That was you, right? You tried to save the Serpent Bearer.]
Hailey’s fine forehead furrowed as she doubled the speed of time, making the observer scream.
[Do you think the Serpent Bearer will spare you if you do this? Do you think he’ll consider a monster as a comrade— Ooh-ahhhhk!]
A slightly sad expression appeared in Hailey’s eyes. It meant she knew where she stood.
Finally, the observer became the size of a fist, then it turned into a salamander as long as a pinky. The time had been rewound to the point of its birth.
Then, Hailey glanced at Chun Yooha and Carly. “Now.”
“!”
Chun Yooha brought down Crimson Earth’s Judgment on the salamander.
Kwah-jeek!
[You have acquired EXP.]
[The EXP of the Serpent Bearer is being amassed.]
[It isn’t long before the Zodiac becomes level 30.]
The observer, who had tried to go back to the past to save Abyss, had been obliterated.
Carly and Chun Yooha looked at Hailey in surprise. It lasted a moment.
Then, Hailey picked up the small corpse of the salamander. She had killed it to stop its plan, but it was an observer for Time. Its rank was low, but according to the seal engraved on its body, it was an observer close to Time.
Basically, Time was Lee Gun’s nemesis, and its Commandment could now be extracted.
In the past, Time’s commandment couldn’t be extracted from its general, who had invaded Lee Gun’s holy ground.
‘That bastard is meticulous and cunning. It didn’t trust its generals, so there was no useful information left.’
On the other hand…
“This might be useful if it is regenerated. Let’s take it to the Zodiac Saint of Life…”
At that moment…
“We don’t have to bring Sungjae into this.”
“!!”
The one to show up was none other than Lee Gun.
Everyone was surprised by the familiar voice, and Hailey froze in place. She couldn’t even turn her head. Lee Gun didn’t pay attention to her as he took the small salamander from her hands.
“Thank you!” As he took the salamander, he gave her a handshake as basic courtesy.
He then turned to look at his disciples. “You guys did well without me. Also, Hailey— What the hell? Where did she go?”
Hailey had already disappeared outside. She stood behind a pillar a hundred meters away, shouting, “L-Lee Gun! W-W… When did you get here? I’m pretty sure you went to look for the Taurus temple’s Ten Star…”
“Ah! I already caught him.”
“!”
Lee Gun laughed as he activated his ability.
[Pool]
The floor roiled with black water. Within the black waters were the Zodiac and the Ten Star of the Taurus temple. They struggled with their mouths shut.
Lee Gun laughed in contempt when he saw them. “Shall we start the merger?”

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Merger (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Merger (3)
A while ago, the Ten Star of the Taurus temple, Joseph, had run away into the ocean.
Joseph used to yearn to be the disciple of a battle-type temple, so before he had moved onto the Taurus temple, he had been with the Leo temple as a Ten Star.
In the Leo temple, he had heard stories about Lee Gun ad nauseam, such as how Stevens had defeated Lee Gun.
However, that temple was full of perverts who only knew about fighting, so Joseph had moved to the Taurus temple. And when the Taurus Saint had heard those stories, he had laughed in derision at Stevens.
[Hmmph! You’re too old to boast about winning fights against a repairman who used to fix our equipment.]
However, not too long ago in a stadium, Stevens had been sent flying with a single punch.
At that moment, the Taurus Saint had clicked his tongue. He had said the Leo Saint was a muscle-bound idiot who focused on only attack, and that was why he lost. The Taurus Saint said the Taurus temple was on a different level since their defense was the strongest.
However, Joseph instinctively felt a danger to himself when he encountered Lee Gun.
‘I might die.’
He really felt that way. It wasn’t just that.
‘Our entire temple might disappear.’
It was common for a temple to attack a different temple. By extension, a temple wanted to swallow up another temple. Basically, they wanted a merger.
The ability one could possess differed depending on the temple. For example, a healing-type temple could acquire healing skills. However, they could never acquire fighting skills.
At a basic level, it was impossible to develop skills that diverged from the temple’s nature, even if the Zodiac raised the temple’s level.
Therefore, many dreamed about a merger of temples instead of cooperation. However, no one even thought about doing a merger. Why?
No one wanted to break the framework of the twelve Zodiacs. They didn’t have the courage to deal with the consequence of messing with the way of the universe. Moreover, no one had the courage and ability to turn all the gods into enemies.
‘The look in his eyes is different.’
Lee Gun really looked like he wanted to kill the Zodiacs at the roots.
It was partly at the order from his Zodiac, but Joseph had run away into the ocean when he sensed the danger. He traveled several hundred kilometers in an instant, receiving help from the Pisces, who was on the same side. The situation was all good up to that point!
Koo-roo-roong!
[…!]
Joseph had used the Pisces’s skill to submerge in the water when he suddenly felt a chill. Something was approaching him. As he felt that unpleasant feeling, he momentarily dropped the skill to survey his surroundings.
[…?!!]
Joseph was scared out of one’s wits.
‘What the hell is that?’
A frightening darkness was rushing toward him from behind. It was a strange darkness where one couldn’t see any light. The darkness looked like it was spreading through the waters and approaching him.
Joseph became desperate.
‘I have to run away.’
At that moment…
‘Huhk!’
The strange darkness acted as if it was alive. It attacked Joseph as if it were a snake. It was like a Vantablack; its shape couldn’t be seen, but its mouth dragged Joseph away.
This was the Serpent Bearer’s “Pool” skill.
[Pool(SSS)] (Death Divine Status)
– Area of Effect Capture skill
– After Abyss was absorbed, a new private skill was born for the owner of the Serpent Bearer’s temple.
– Anyone harboring malice will be imprisoned within the deep pool (pit) of the serpent.
– Those who fall within the pool may be put into the first stage of the abyss (influenced by the power of space).
– First stage world of abyss: Space of fear where happiness is dead.
– As Death evolves, the depth and size of the pool expand.
If Serpent Eater was a capture skill, Pool was like an imprisonment skill.
As soon as Joseph was caught, the black pool disappeared from the ocean. The only things left there were the sea creatures that roamed around the ocean.
This was how Joseph, who possessed the seal of the Taurus temple, was kidnapped.
***
Back to the present…
“Shall we start the merger?”
Joseph was dragged in front of Lee Gun, and Lee Gun grinned. When sunlight entered the pool, Joseph became surprised.
“Saint-nim! You guys…!”
The Taurus and about a hundred disciples lay collapsed near Joseph. All of them had been imprisoned in the pool.
Joseph turned pale from fright. However, it lasted only a moment.
‘Yes. We’ll be able to reverse this situation if we have our Zodiac Saint.’
In fact, this was an opportunity where they could win!
Joseph’s eyes flashed victoriously. “Saint-nim! Please hurry and use the Zodiac descent! Please summon our master!”
“!”
Hugo and Stevens, who had followed Lee Gun, flinched. Zodiac descent?
‘That is the Zodiac.’
Hugo looked at Joseph as if the Ten Star were pathetic. Joseph had yet to realize it. However, Hugo soon had a look of understanding.
‘The Zodiac purposefully hid its identity.’
The Zodiac had appeared before Joseph looking like the Zodiac Saint Ivan. Moreover, it had avoided using the exact phrasing of “Zodiac Saint” when it threatened Sungjae and Yooha to return its Zodiac Saint.
Basically, the Taurus didn’t want it known that its Zodiac Saint had lost to Lee Gun.
‘It’ll cause a problem for its faith.’
Still, the situation shouldn’t be like this.
“He is a Ten Star. If he focuses on it, he should be able to see the divine magical energy…”
At Hugo’s mumbled words, Stevens flinched.
‘He can see that?’
Stevens had realized that the Taurus Saint was a Zodiac in reality, but he hadn’t realized it through sensing its energy.
‘Is it a coincidence?’
Goat, who stood next to them, clicked his tongue. “I agree. There is no way he could be a human when you look at the shape of its magical energy.”
What? This bastard can see it too? Stevens started to sweat.
In truth, the transformation skill of the Pisces was perfect. A technique of this level couldn’t be seen through by Joseph or the other disciples. Even the Zodiacs would get fooled.
‘Perceiving it is possible?’
Stevens was having a mental breakdown.
‘Is it because they leveled up after becoming Lee Gun’s affiliate?’
Moreover, Hugo’s energy had changed oddly.
‘Construct?’
It didn’t matter right now. Joseph had no idea that his Zodiac was in front of him. He yelled, “Saint-nim! You said you have no need to use Zodiac descent here, but this isn’t the time to be holding back! I will help! Please bring out the Zodiac!”
The other Taurus disciples yelled out when they heard Joseph’s desperate words. At this rate, a thousand of the elite fighters and about a million disciples would be absorbed by Lee Gun.
Basically, only one way was left where they could prevent being dragged away by Lee Gun—a battle between the Zodiacs!
The Taurus disciples yelled desperately.
“Saint-nim! Hurry up and summon the Zodiac!”
“That is right! The only one that we can trust right now is the Zodiac!”
The Taurus felt like it wanted to die. Their words were driving it nuts.
‘I’m the Zodiac, idiots.’
Moreover, the battle between the Zodiacs had already ended! And it had already descended, so what more could it do?
The Taurus disciples looked at their “Zodiac Saint” with inquiring gazes when they saw his expression.
“Saint-nim! What are you doing?”
“Hurry up and call the Zodiac….”
At that moment, as if he could hear it no longer, Lee Gun burst out laughing. Everyone confusedly looked at him.
However, Lee Gun immediately changed his expression. It was as if he had never laughed before. “That’s not your Zodiac Saint.”
“What?”
“That’s your Zodiac.”
As soon as he spoke, the Taurus disciples screamed.
“Are you playing with us?! There is no way—”
“It is as I’ve said.” Lee Gun made a fist.
[Serpent Eater]
As soon as the skill was activated, the Taurus’s head was revealed!
It was just the head, but there was no denying it. This was the sacred beast from the legends, a being that shouldn’t be messed with. It was Apis, who had become the god of absolute defense, the holy bull of Egypt.
Everyone was surprised by this sight.
“Zodiac?!”
With its identity revealed, the Taurus looked at Lee Gun as if it wanted to kill him. In truth, it had wanted to appear in its true form, but Abyss had chewed up its soul and given it a grievous wound.
The disciples let out forced laughs as if they didn’t want to believe what they had just seen.
“Ha ha ha. No. I…It is fine. This can be explained. I’m sure our Zodiac became like that after fighting the monster…!”
As if he was responding to those words, Lee Gun kicked the Taurus’s face.
Bbah-gahk!
“Oh, Zodiac-nim!”
[Huh-uhk…!]
“Don’t get it twisted. I’m the one who killed that whale. This bastard is in this state because I beat him up.”
“…!!”
Of course, the last statement was a bald-faced lie. However, his words were enough to cause a reaction.
[The Taurus disciples’ Faith toward the Taurus has fallen.]
[The faith toward the Serpent Bearer has increased by a bit.]
Lee Gun laughed at their reactions.
‘I’ll be able to steal their defense ability. I’ll be able to steal the contract that was hidden in their holy ground.’
He wanted to know what truths the twelve Zodiacs were hiding. He wanted to know why they had tried to kill him. The contract kept each other from speaking.
The Zodiacs had thought Lee Gun could never break through the Taurus’s defense, so they had hidden the contract within the Taurus Saint’s holy ground. However, that was at an end.
Moreover, the defense ability would fall under the domain of Life. And by gaining the defensive ability, Life would be able to make up for some of his shortcomings.
When Lee Gun started approaching the Taurus, the defensive-type Zodiac could no longer take it. The Taurus shouted.
[What are you doing, Fairy Monarch? Did you forget about your contract?]
The rough voice called out to the attendant of the Gemini. However, there were no responses. The Fairy Monarch had seemed to realize the Taurus would lose and had hidden itself. The Fairy Monarch didn’t want to cause harm to the great Zodiac of magic.
The Taurus became angry when it realized it had been betrayed.
[You unhelpful piece of…!!]
At that moment…
[Your Temple energy has increased.]
[Divine status has reached 70%.]
[You can use your new skill.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if he had been waiting for this moment. The notification was referring to the new skill that had developed when Life had evolved.
[Winter Hibernation- Accumulate Food (EX)]
– You can swallow and absorb your opponent.
– Anything you eat can be accumulated (abilities, magical energy, divine energy, divine status, EXP, etc.).
– There is a penalty according to how much you eat (physical ability reduced by 50%, sleepiness, laziness, slowness)
– Penalty Duration: Until you digest everything
In simple words, it was like a nourishment storage system.
This skill was different from the Gluttony skill. Gluttony was a skill that ate an attack and spat it out. There was barely anything left after the skill was used. On the other hand, this was an accumulation skill.
‘There is a risk, but this allows me to take all the abilities of the Zodiac.’
Lee Gun laughed when he had this thought. He activated his new skill.
Flash!
An incredible golden-green light appeared around Drachma. It was as if one was looking at intense Life energy.
Kwahng!!!
[You have swallowed the Zodiac.]
[The Taurus has entered your stomach.]
[Everything that constitutes the Taurus is being amassed by the Serpent Bearer.]
It was unknown as to how much time had passed.
When the light dissipated, no one could believe their eyes.
“T-The Zodiac is gone!”
Yes, the defensive-type Zodiac that had been present here until a moment ago was gone.
At that moment, a sound rang out, breaking the shocked silence that had come over Drachma.
Burp!
Lee Gun looked embarrassed as he placed a hand over his mouth.
Hugo screamed, “Y-You crazy bastard! You really put a god in your stomach…?!”
Joseph shook at this sight.
‘The energy of the Zodiac is completely gone.’
His Zodiac was really gone. However, he didn’t give up.
‘Yes. I just have to go to the Pisces since we are cooperating…!’
Joseph was about to try a different maneuver when he trembled.
“!”
The reason was Lee Gun.
‘What is going on? The energy surrounding him got stronger…!’
He hadn’t known it before, but it felt as if a very powerful carapace had appeared around him. It was like watching a monster that was about to molt.
‘I’ll be eaten.’
At that moment, a calm notification voice rang out.
[Your divine status has increased according to the cow you ate.]
[Your temple has gained EXP equivalent to a month’s worth of EXP amassed by the Taurus temple.]
[One of the great thirteen stars is gone.]
[A second empty seat has formed within the twelve Zodiacs.]
[Would you like to fill the seat with a Construct?]
The notification was asking if a Construct of Lee Gun’s would be chosen as a Zodiac, like what he had done with the Aquarius.
Lee Gun laughed.
‘That isn’t a bad idea, but…’
The downside to an affiliate was that he couldn’t use certain powers for himself.
‘Since I have regeneration, I didn’t need healing. That’s why I left it alone. On the other hand, both my disciples and I can use the power of defense.’
According to the Virgo and Sagittarius, Lee Gun would have to use merger instead of affiliation, if he wanted to use the defense skill for himself.
That wasn’t all. A merger was as it implied. The temple itself would be consumed, and the Serpent Bearer would newly develop its own defensive power.
This was why Lee Gun said, “I want a merger instead of an affiliation.”
An unexpected voice rang out in response.
[To do a merger, you need the Seat of Power.]
“Seat of Power?”
He was wondering what it was when an incredible light appeared. Then something surprising started to happen.
A comet-like light fell from the dark sky.
“There is light coming from the sky!”
At the same time, ripples formed in the water in front of Lee Gun. Something emerged from the ripple, emitting a significant amount of murderous intent. Lee Gun raised his guard.
‘Is this some kind of risk for using this?’
[The Seat of Power has appeared.]

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Merger (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Merger (4)
A chair appeared in front of Lee Gun. At a glance, it looked like a throne with the head of a bull embedded on it. Of course, it wasn’t a normal chair.
Lee Gun had raised his guard, and above all else, the Zodiac Saints were taken aback. Their reactions were normal.
“That’s crazy! It’s the Seat of Power!”
Yes, the chair in front of them was a symbol of the twelve Zodiacs, a god’s throne. Each temple had one, and only the owner of a temple could sit on it.
‘As soon as you sit on the Seat of Power, you claim and command the temple. You possess absolute power.’
Hugo and Stevens were well aware of the Seat of Power. Since the Zodiac Saints didn’t want their Zodiacs to lose face, they never spoke about it.
However, the Sagittarius sat on its Seat of Power as he applied the hair growth solution. The Leo flopped on top of the Seat of Power to sleep.
It was unknown who had made these Seats of Power, but the Zodiacs treasured them more than their lives. It was a precious item that outside gods coveted.
‘What is that in front of Lee Gun?’
‘Is the Seat of Power trying to choose its new owner?’
A Seat of Power was a holy item with a sense of self; it was the temple itself. It was loyal to the Zodiac. Dealing with it wouldn’t be easy.
‘If a Zodiac tries to harm the temple or their purpose doesn’t align, the Seat of Power tries to kill the Zodiac.’
‘We have no idea what it will do now that its owner is gone.’
While the two Zodiac Saints had their guards up, the Seat of Power emitted a light.
[The Taurus’s Seat of Power shows interest in the baby Zodiac.]
[The Taurus’s Seat of Power likes the baby Zodiac.]
[It thinks you will fit very well in its seat.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round at the unexpected notification.
‘In other words, it wants me to become the Zodiac of the Taurus temple.’
The Seat of Power had the duty to pick the Zodiac of the temple. Its actions were understandable.
Of course, this phenomenon hadn’t happened in the cases of the Cancer and the Aquarius temples.
‘I didn’t try a merger with them.’
The situation was different for the Taurus’s Seat of Power.
[You have everything, including courage and strength.]
[It says the star of impregnable defense will be helpful in achieving your goals.]
[Do not do something foolish such as a merger. Just become the owner of the Taurus temple.]
[It says you should throw away the perverted seat of the Serpent Bearer.]
It had undoubtedly taken a shine to Lee Gun. However, it didn’t matter.
“Fuck off! Why would I sit on a seat that smells like cow dung? I just have to do a merger.”
In the first place, Lee Gun liked the seat of the Serpent Bearer, though he didn’t know why.
The Taurus’s Seat of Power seemed dissatisfied at the reply
Boom!
Brown light erupted from the throne.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as if his body was in pain. “Bastard.”
As soon as the seat had used its power, his body started to hurt.
[If you do not choose it, it will make the part of the power of the Taurus that you absorbed go out of control.]
[If you want to use that power safely, you must sit on the Seat of Power.]
[To get your revenge, you need the power of absolute defense.]
It seemed both the Zodiac and the Zodiac Saint were crafty.
[If you do not agree to it…]
“Really? You’re only a chair, so why are you talking so much?” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. The one to react to his reaction was “Death!”
Was it because it had developed arms and legs? Death had been walking around in joy when it was summoned above Lee Gun’s head.
It then emitted a violent power, and its expression changed into that of an evil spirit. Death had instantly realized Lee Gun’s intent.
[Death says you shouldn’t worry.]
[It has evolved to the third stage, and it can take care of this without any problem.]
Everyone within Drachma screamed.
Koo-goo-goohng!
Death had swept past them. When they opened their eyes, they saw the decayed Seat of Power.
[The Seat of Power has temporarily lost its power.]
[Life says it is better to burn it instead of decaying it since it’ll feel the pain for a longer period. Life is disappointed]
[It isn’t too late to—]
“Fuck off! I don’t want to hear screams.”
The Taurus disciples couldn’t close their mouths when they witnessed this.
“T-That chair! I’m pretty sure it’s something even the gods of the divine world couldn’t destroy since it’s considered to have ultra-high strength.”
“He did it in just a single moment…!!!”
“What kind of power is that?”
The power of the thirteenth could destroy the items of the gods. It wasn’t an ordinary power.
On the other hand, Stevens screamed for a different reason. “Hey! Do you not realize what that is? I don’t know why, but the gods treasure that item more than their lives!”
“Fuck off! I just have to repair it. Did you forget about my occupation?”
“…!”
There was a reason he was a Maker.
“It’ll be fun. I don’t know who made it, but that chair has a sense of self.”
“Who cares? You can make it too.”
“I might try to make something similar later. It won’t be a bad idea to remodel it.”
“You aren’t even listening to me.”
That wasn’t all. Lee Gun smirked since he had seen through the Zodiacs to a certain extent.
‘The system allows only gods to sit in the Seats of Power.’
If he remade the Seats of Powers to his liking, would he need to put a god in the seat of a ruler? Wouldn’t he be able to put a human on it instead?
‘It might mean we don’t need gods.’
In the first place, Lee Gun was skeptical of the Zodiacs; he was skeptical of the gods.
‘Did the Zodiacs really appear to protect the humans? It feels like they made an appearance to gather more disciples.’
Despite being able to appear at an earlier date, the Zodiacs had appeared when humanity was close to extinction.
Lee Gun wondered if the existence called the gods would be helpful to humanity even if he got rid of the unknown civilization from this land.
The gods had conspired with each other to kill him, so he felt nothing but contempt toward the Zodiacs.
The true culprits that trapped and killed you were the Zodiacs.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
‘Their existence has no meaning if no one believes in them.’
At the same time, Lee Gun had a good idea about the identity behind the voice that he had heard as a notification.
‘I wonder if the notification voice that I can hear is the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of Power.’
Of course, Hugo had also heard the voice of a woman, but he said the voice sounded similar to the voice of Yeonwoo, whom the Abundance had changed into.
‘There is no way!’
Hugo let out a sigh of relief when the threat disappeared.
“I’ll have to take Ivan from Yong Yong. I’ll be able to extract enough defensive skill data from him. Defensive gears will be no problem…”
When Hailey heard that, an odd expression appeared on her face. She spoke up. “If you planned on doing that, shouldn’t you have done it much earlier?”
“What?”
“His Zodiac is gone. Ivan no longer has his blessings. If he’s chewed on by Red Eye in such a state…”
Hugo screamed as if he had been hit in the back of his head. “Ahhhk! That’s right! He wasn’t ripped into pieces only because he had the blessing of his Zodiac!”
Up until now, Ivan had been left with Yong Yong, because the monster liked Ivan so much. However, Lee Gun needed his body if he wanted to make equipment!
“We’ll have to go to Yong Yong as soon as possible!”
Boom!!
Suddenly, Drachma shook.
“Ahhhk! The castle is falling!”
“!”
Cracks appeared in the castle as its ceiling and walls fell. This surprised the disciples.
“What the hell? All the monsters are gone! Why is the castle suddenly acting this way?”
“What do you mean, why? The Taurus is gone!”
“!”
Drachma was a castle being maintained through the power of the twelve Zodiacs. Now, one of the powers propping up the castle was gone. It meant the castle had to fall.
When the ceiling started to collapse in its entirety, Hugo desperately yelled, “Gun! Use your regeneration ability!”
Lee Gun picked at his ear when he heard those words. “I am regenerating it, but it’s getting destroyed faster than it’s being regenerated. Life’s level is too low.”
“What?!”
“It’s fine.”
They just had to exit this place.
“The castle’s design was terrible, so I was thinking about re-making it. Anyway, let’s evacuate everyone…”
At that moment…
“It’ll be impossible to evacuate them.”
“!”
The triumphant opportunists made an appearance. They were the magicians who had appeared alongside the Fairy Monarch.
Lee Gun had thought they had disappeared after betraying the Taurus. For some reason, they were smirking as they looked at him.
“We went to look. The teleport zone hasn’t regenerated at all.”
“!”
Of course, they were telling the truth.
[Zone 1 (Teleport Zone) has been completely lost. It is unrecoverable!]
[Zone 2 (Shopping District) has suffered a 30% loss. It is recovering.]
…
[Zone 9 (Sparring Stadium) has suffered an 80% loss. It is unrecoverable!]
When Drachma became the holy ground for the Serpent Bearer, the status of every item inside the castle was transmitted to Lee Gun.
The magicians knew they were in danger, yet for some odd reason, they were laughing in derision.
“If Lee Gun-nim runs away, you’ll be the reason fifty thousand people will be buried alive here. There is no way you’ll be irresponsible enough to run away, right?”
Hugo furrowed his brows.
‘Why are they trying to provoke Lee Gun?’
There had to be a reason, and it didn’t take long for them to find out the reason.
The magicians continued.
“The only one on your side capable of using Teleport is Chun Sungjae.”
“Yes. Do you think you’ll be able to move tens of thousands of people by yourself?”
“…!”
Chun Sungjae furrowed his brows.
These magicians were capable of using teleportation. Of course, they knew the downside to it.
The smart Chun Sungjae quickly realized what they were thinking. It was as he had expected.
“If you try to move this many people at once, you’ll probably die.”
“That’s right. If you move anything over 100 kg, it’ll cause stress to your body. You’ll throw up.”
“You can divide and move them. However, the castle will fall before you can finish the teleportation.”
Someone yelled when they heard the words of the magicians.
“The Gemini magicians just need to help out!”
The magicians laughed as if they had been waiting for those words.
“Ah! We apologize! However, we cannot use such a spell since Lee Gun-nim designated Drachma as his holy ground!”
“That’s why Lee Gun-nim has to release this place as a holy ground. Hand over Drachma to the Gemini temple.”
This caused a commotion.
Hugo furrowed his brows as if he had an understanding.
‘That is what they are aiming for.’
They could escape this place by themselves, yet they also knew this was a golden opportunity. The magicians were like merchants. Their eyes flashed shamelessly.
“We won’t ask for something that is out of your means. We would like the rights to the ‘Nameless Land.’ We would like the rights to the Green Zone that appeared after you got rid of Abundance. It’s a fixed cost for your lives. If you hand them over to the Gemini temple, we’ll immediately help everyone escape from this place.”
The words angered Hugo and Stevens. As expected of a temple known for being nasty, they were acting this way in front of Zodiac Saints. The crowd also felt similarly. Baffled, the other disciples became angry.
“You guys number only a hundred! Do you think you can move fifty thousand people in time?”
“We can move more than that little brat.”
“What?!”
“That was a joke. We have a hundred Gemini magicians here, and we are capable of moving a large number of people. We can move a thousand people in one go.”
“!”
“However, there is a limit to our stamina, so we’ll be able to use it only ten times at most. We can try to do more, but we won’t be able to guarantee anything.”
“That means you won’t be able to escape from this place if you delay any further.”
This caused a ruckus.
“Hey! If you plan on doing this, why don’t you just make a teleport zone instead? With it, everyone can be teleported…”
The magicians suddenly blanched.
“Only a Zodiac can make a teleport zone.”
“!”
“Do not worry! The only difference is the scale. Our large-scale teleport spell doesn’t differ too much in principle from the teleport zone. It is safe.”
“Anyway, we’ll move you guys in order. The disciples should prepare payment that’ll be given to us, and Lee Gun-nim should…”
For some reason, Lee Gun was smirking. Seeing this, Hugo flinched.
“Ah! Is that so? That’s the principle behind the teleport zone? That’s it?”
“!”
Chun Sungjae contemptuously laughed.
In truth, Abundance had been wary of Chun Sungjae as a magician alongside Chun Yooha.
“Really? Whenever I asked in the past, you guys said it was a trade secret. The recipe wasn’t shown to anyone below the general rank. But it’s just an application of a large-scale teleportation spell? Then I have a good idea of what to do, since I was a Gemini disciple before.”
Chun Sungjae’s words left the magicians dumbfounded.
“Chun Sungjae! It’s an application in words only. Figuring it out with the human mind is impossible…”
Chun Sungjae pushed them aside as if he wanted them to be gone. Moreover, he was delighted that his uncle was looking at him with anticipation in his eyes.
“Get out of the way. I’ll make it in no time.”
“?!”
The magicians wondered what nonsense he was talking about when…
Flash!
Flames erupted wherever Chun Sungjae made a hand gesture and created a magic circle. At the same time, a whirlwind of light appeared before them!
The Gemini disciples froze when they felt the familiar energy.
Lee Gun let out a lighthearted laugh. “I see. The Gemini temple is not that big of a deal. There is no need to make a deal with them.”
[A fledgling teleport zone of the Serpent Bearer has been created.]
[Total Capacity: 100,000]

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Merger (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Merger (5)
[A fledgling teleport zone of the Serpent Bearer has been created.]
[Total Capacity: 100,000]
It was a feast of light. The scene looked as if the lights were swirling in the sky.
Then, a hole made of light appeared in front of them. It was clearly the light of teleportation, the light of the teleport zone. This surprised everyone.
‘That is something only the Zodiacs can make!’
Of course, humans could make it in theory. However, that required processing a massive amount of information, so no one even attempted it.
If one had to make a comparison, it was something only a high-end computer could accomplish. The coordinate value had to be compared and calculated to teleport people. The setup was very complicated.
‘This was why all the teleport zones around the world were made by the Zodiacs.’
Of course, the Gemini Saint Heiji could make it, but the teleport zone would be unstable. This was why she didn’t make one herself. It was that lofty of a territory.
‘He made it in one go?!’
‘He just needed one measly hint??’
Every magician gathered here was an elite magician of the Gemini temple. Therefore, they could appreciate how great an item Chun Sungjae had made. They could tell at a glance.
‘I-I’m sure of it. With that much power, he can move ten thousand by himself.’
No, ten thousand was the minimum! He could probably move everyone within the castle by himself.
This was why the magicians had a mental breakdown.
‘Is the teleport zone supposed to be created like this on the first try?’
‘Are you playing with me? There is no way that’s true! Did you forget about everyone failing?’
‘That’s right! The only success was a ten-man evacuation teleport zone!’
The magicians suddenly had a realization.
‘The Korean general did tell us to never give any magic recipe over S rank to Chun Sungjae.’
‘This is why he didn’t want us to show it to Chun Sungjae!’
At the time, Sungjae’s faith had been low, thanks to his fanboyism of Lee Gun. So the magicians had assumed he couldn’t be told because he would leak it to outside sources!
Everyone was abuzz.
However, Chun Sungjae scoffed. “I wondered what kind of amazing technique was used on this. You guys charged that much for a single use?”
Goat’s mouth fell. “It… It is simple? I heard the twelfth dimension has to be calculated. I heard a rumor that a thousand people have to be used if—”
“No way! Thousand is too much. Anyway, something is off. Why can’t they do something so easy?”
Goat was silent. When he thought about it, Sungjae resembled his mother, who was a researcher. When he had been five, he could solve high-school math problems.
That was why he could learn magic by studying on his own when he was with the Gemini temple. It was as if his brain had developed so much that his height had suffered. Anyway, that wasn’t important right now.
“Let’s hurry up and move to the teleport zone!”
“Yes! How much will the Serpent Bearer charge for it?”
“Uh? The fee will be…”
When Chun Sungjae looked at him, Lee Gun laughed. “It’s fine. I’ll be considered a bully if I receive anything for the first ride.”
If everyone was being honest, the bullies were the Gemini magicians, who were trying to barter in this current situation. Of course, it wasn’t as if Lee Gun was receiving zilch in return for this.
[Faith toward the Serpent Bearer has risen.]
However, the people cheering had other ideas.
“Lee Gun! Take what you deserve! You even killed the monsters in the ocean!”
“That’s right! By designating Drachma as your holy ground, you regenerated everyone!”
The culprit behind Drachma’s fall was Abyss, and Lee Gun had killed it. So from the perspective of the people within the castle, he was their savior.
“Let us compensate you!”
Of course, the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer wasn’t someone to turn down free offerings. Quick on the uptake, Sungjae used flame magic to write Lee Gun’s bank account number in the air. He also didn’t forget to throw the business cards he had made beforehand into the air.
[Great Lee Gun-nim’s Donation Account]
[XXXX-XXX-XXXX ㅇㅇBank]
“Oh! Put it away for now! Let’s go!”
Goat glanced at Hugo when he saw all of this.
Hugo’s brows were furrowed. “What? Why are you looking at me like that?”
“Nothing. I was wondering if subordinates of a Zodiac like that eat well…”
“What did you just say?!”
At that moment, the people within Drachma cheered as they moved toward the teleportation hole.
This frustrated the Gemini magicians to no end. If the Serpent Bearer succeeded in running a teleport zone, it would put them in a difficult situation.
“P-Please do not fall for it! It is a teleport made by a temple other than the Gemini temple!”
The magician’s shout annoyed everyone.
“What about it? It looks to be functioning properly.”
“Don’t say that! You’re about to do a trial run with your lives on the line! Even we would be too afraid to get on it!”
“!”
They exchanged glances.
“We’ll call for more teleporters. That’ll solve a multitude of problems. We’ll be able to move everyone. That is why—”
The magicians who were already trying to go and get more teleporters from outside froze in place.
[Teleportation Failed]
“…!”
In truth, they had told a lie, saying they couldn’t use teleportation. It all had to do with Lee Gun. They had done it to screw over Lee Gun. In reality, they could freely use teleportation. So what was going on now?
‘The Teleport skill isn’t activating!’
They soon figured out the reason.
“I’m not sure about this, but I think the reason is the portal made by Chun Sungjae!”
“It seems their side is using the coordinates in advance, so we can’t use it! Our skill unravels before it can form…!”
The exact reason behind it should be analyzed at a later time. Something else was more important right now.
‘Shit! We won’t be able to exit this place without Chun Sungjae’s Teleport!!’
That was right. They also had to rely on the Serpent Bearer.
“W-What should we do?”
“What else! We should—”
It was as if he had overheard their conversation.
“Oh. Is that so? You guys can’t escape from this place?”
“!!”
Lee Gun laughed. “What? Do you guys want to use this teleport zone, too?”
“N…No. That is…”
In the end, several of the Gemini magicians laughed.
“I think we will have to use it….”
“No way we will use it!”
Chun Sungjae and Lee Gun laughed when they heard the commotion.
“Don’t worry. We don’t plan on letting you guys die.”
The magicians let out sighs of relief.
“That means…”
“However…”
“!”
“We won’t do it for free. Earlier, you guys wanted a fee and recompense for our lives in exchange for teleportation.”
“…!!!”
Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed as the calculator in his head worked. “How much are you willing to spend?”
* * *
An indeterminate time had passed.
[Lee Gun rescued 50 thousand people within Drachma.]
[The teleport zone was a monopolized product of the Gemini temple, but the Serpent Bearer can use it now.]
[The power of the Taurus was sent toward the Serpent Bearer.]
[Ten Star Joseph of the Taurus temple is preparing an official statement.]
[Thirteen Zodiac temples ▶ 12 Zodiac temples? Did the temple merger actually happen?]
[Drachma became the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground. “Is this ok?”]
The world was past being in an uproar. It was stunned.
On the other hand, Hugo sighed as he looked somewhere. He didn’t care what was going on in the world.
“Is your stomach ok? You ate meat after you ate the Taurus. Doesn’t your stomach hurt?”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “Don’t look down on my ability to digest things. My stomach became sturdier when I leveled up.”
“Ah. Is that so?”
If his body was fine, that was all there was to it.
Moreover, Hugo could clearly feel it after Lee Gun had absorbed the entirety of the Taurus temple’s power.
‘He might be able to rule over the Taurus disciples with what he got.’
Of course, they could receive only Lee Gun’s abilities if they developed faith toward the Serpent Bearer. However, that shouldn’t matter.
‘Even I’m using Gun’s power.’
If they could reach 80% faith like him, wouldn’t they all be able to use it? That shouldn’t be too difficult of a bar to pass.
Then there was Ivan, who Yong Yong had chewed up. Thankfully, Yooha had brought him. However…
[Yong Yong has completely damaged its chew toy.]
[Yong Yong is depressed that the texture of its chew toy has changed.]
Hugo gripped his face when he remembered the Taurus Saint, who had turned into a piece of meat. If he was being honest, he had a grudge against Ivan, so he didn’t care if Ivan died or not.
“Shit! Gun won’t be able to extract data from Ivan if he is in this state.!”
Thanks to the incident at Drachma, Lee Gun had obtained the rights to the Nameless Land that Abundance had possessed.
“You won’t be able to make your defensive gear! I’ve been looking forward to the defensive gear!”
His reaction was understandable since the Taurus Saint had turned into mush. Red Eye had chewed him up so much that Super Regeneration could only put him back into something with the consistency of a pudding. That was the limit.
Lee Gun cackled at Hugo’s words. “I remember you saying that you would never use an item with a Zodiac and Zodiac Saint as ingredients.”
“No!! I don’t want to use it, but— Ahk!”
It was like someone who knew the taste of meat. Hugo had gotten a taste of the EX rank through his bow. He despaired.
‘The real culprits that tried to kill Gun within the Devil’s Tower were Zodiacs.’
The monarchs were aiming for Lee Gun too.
‘Regular equipment won’t cut it.’
Moreover, the dream of completely driving out the unknown civilization wouldn’t be out of reach if they had equipment of that rank.
“On the other hand….”
Lee Gun laughed when he saw this. “Don’t worry. I can make EX-rank defensive gear without him.”
“What? Really?”
“Yes. I acquired the power of the Taurus. Well, I have to transfer it to the Serpent Bearer’s temple. Anyway, I’ll be able to imbue defensive skills now.”
Moreover, the Revive skill would be able to bring back the Taurus Saint. Although Ivan might not look like a human, he could be regenerated to an extent.
‘I’ll have to recover this bastard somewhat, so I can upgrade him as Yong Yong’s chew toy.’
That would perk up the depressed Red Eye.
“Anyway, I never knew you were so covetous about equipment. You nagged me a lot when it came to the Pisces. Are you worried about me?”
Hugo flinched at those words. He scoffed. “Thanks to the magical energy of the monarchs, there are fewer and fewer lands available for humanity to live on. We have to take back the land of humanity. Then there is the thing that the unknown civilization has been looking for since the old days…”
Hugo realized his mistake as he looked at Lee Gun.
“What is the unknown civilization looking for?”
“That’s….”
At that moment…
Koo-goo-goong!
Hugo screamed when he heard the sound of an explosion coming from his living room. “Ahhk! My house!”
Hugo knew the culprit very well.
[Death grumbles. It says it wants to reach the fourth stage first.]
[Death will be the first one to become human-like. It will pounce on its master.]
[At that point, you will have no choice but to throw away Life. You will awaken as the god of Death.]
The one to destroy Hugo’s living room was Death, who had developed arms and legs.
Hugo looked at his destroyed living room and despaired.
‘Mortgage… I still haven’t paid off the mortgage…’
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “What grievance does it have? Why is it protesting like that?”
At those words, Death skipped toward Lee Gun and rubbed its face on Lee Gun’s foot.
[Death says it wants a name.]
“I already gave you one. It is Blackie.”
[Death doesn’t like the name of a pet!]
It really demanded a lot of things.
“What about Jun?”
As soon as he spoke, Death’s face brightened.
[Death is ecstatic. It says it has received special treatment with this. It boasts Master will choose it.]
[Life snorts. It says that name is the name of an actor. The name is from a movie that Master watched yesterday.]
[Death despairs.]
While it might like its owner, Death was a nefarious bomb. Hugo didn’t like it. It could become a threat to his friend’s life. And although he didn’t show it outwardly, Lee Gun seemed to have read his expression.
Lee Gun laughed. “Don’t worry! When I ate the Taurus, Life leveled up too. Since it’s the ‘Defense’ temple, it reacted to Life.”
Hugo looked relieved as he gazed at Lee Gun. “Does that mean Life will rise in level if you eat another Zodiac related to Life?”
“Hmm. Are you referring to a Zodiac like that bastard?”
“That bastard…?.”
Hugo became surprised when he saw the TV, which Lee Gun had pointed at. An unexpected piece of news was being shown on the TV.
– Please listen closely. A nefarious rumor is going around in recent days, and it’s harming the prestige of the Capricorn temple.
– The Capricorn and the Genius Workshop have a deep history as a workshop. We have made royal holy items for numerous Zodiac Saints, including Lee Gun’s Heaven’s Punishment. It is a storied temple created by our Zodiac.
– There are more and more instances of people asking Lee Gun to make their weapons. This hurts the prestige of the Genius Workshop. From our investigation, it takes at least four weeks for Lee Gun to make an SS-rank weapon.
– There is no way he can mass produce it. He’s an amateur.
– The Capricorn has worked hard for humanity, and its feelings are greatly hurt. From this moment on, we will transition to a membership system. Only members may put an order in with the Genius Workshop.
– Any temple that puts in an order with Lee Gun will never be able to use the Genius Workshop. That is how we will run it.
The words left Hugo dumbfounded. He looked for his phone. “I’ll have to tell everyone that the bow I used at Drachma was made by you.”
However, Lee Gun stopped him. “It is fine. It’ll be quicker to show them how I make it. At that point, they won’t be able to say anything.”
“What? You’ll show them? What is going on?”
Lee Gun acted as if the answer was obvious as he looked sideways at Hugo.
“The ingredients for S-rank, SS-rank, and EX-rank weapons are very expensive. Also, the shape of the items that I can make with the ingredients I possess is limited. If I go to their workshop, it should be full of expensive ingredients, right?”
“?!”
Did he plan on stealing all the ingredients while saying it was a demonstration?
“What happened to all the money that Stevens gave you?”
“I already used it all.”
“What? Where!”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun laughed as he held up his hammer. Aside from those ingredients, the Capricorn was someone Lee Gun needed since he had business with the Time monarch.
Why?
‘I need a certain item that the Capricorn possesses.’
Also, didn’t Life evolve when he ate the Taurus? What would happen if he ate the Capricorn?
“I’ll just merge it since it’s useless to me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 238: What? Is that all you can do? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: What? Is that all you can do? (1)
[The Taurus Temple ceases to exist!]
[Will they get merged into the Serpent Bearer?]
Around this time, Joseph, the Ten Star of the Taurus temple, was having a mental breakdown. His Zodiac had been eliminated, and his Zodiac Saint was missing. As if that wasn’t enough, the Taurus Saint’s holy ground had ceased to exist.
Everything had disappeared like ashes. The Taurus temple, a battle-type temple with a deep history that ruled the southern hemisphere along with the Libra temple, had disappeared.
“What? The Zodiac’s palace is gone too?”
“This includes the items we gathered over time?”
The location was Egypt, the main palace of the Taurus temple. This was to be expected since the Taurus was the holy beast Apis of Egypt. It had established itself in this place for a reason.
Moreover, Egypt wasn’t the only part of the Taurus Saint’s holy ground. The holy ground spanned West Asia and the Middle East, including India.
Any arid region where the ancient civilizations blossomed was under the territory of the Taurus temple. Since the cultures of these countries revered bovines, the Taurus temple had been able to spread its roots faster.
Moreover, the Taurus temple was ranked third amongst the temples. The Virgo temple (second) was the overlord of Europe, and the Leo temple (fourth) was the ruler of the US. Both were battle-type temples that had made contributions to the world. They were outstanding and distinguished temples…
“The palaces are really gone without a trace.”
Outstanding temples…
“It was consumed by Lee Gun’s temple, including the Zodiac and Zodiac Saint?”
It was supposed to be an outstanding temple…
In the end, Joseph clutched at his face as he looked at the Taurus Saint’s holy ground, which was now a barren lot. He had a crying expression on his face.
The great holy ground of the Taurus was supposed to be filled with the energy of earth and sand. Yet…
The reason was simple.
“The buildings are all gone. The only thing left is the sand.”
“I think they were flown somewhere else. The disciples confirmed it last night.”
“That’s right. The dormitories for the disciples turned into sand. It caused a big commotion during the night.”
“I heard the buildings were seen heading toward Korea.”
“What? Isn’t Korea part of Lee Gun’s holy ground?”
“Isn’t it the Sagittarius temple’s holy ground?”
“What? The Sagittarius temple still exists?”
Joseph despaired when he heard the commotion around him. It was said that the snake had swallowed the cow. That really seemed to be true.
‘Shit! It would have been better if we were an affiliate!’
A while ago, the last-place and the second-rank temples had become Lee Gun’s affiliate. Joseph had derided them for being unmanly. He had thought they had no pride.
‘However, they didn’t lose everything they possessed.’
The Taurus disciples had lost their living places and possessions. Technically, they had lost everything related to the Taurus temple.
[All the holy items given to the disciples have turned into sand.]
[Everything belonging to the Taurus has been absorbed into the Serpent Bearer.]
It seemed a merger meant that the temple and everything related to it would be taken away. That was why all the different structures had disassembled, then headed toward the Serpent Bearer.
They had been transferred over as data.
It was up to Lee Gun’s will to take the items as they were or make them anew.
‘This is more like a pillaging, instead of a merger.’
At the very least, Lee Gun should have left the original items of the Taurus.
Even the sculpture of the black bull had disappeared into ashes, giving Joseph a mental breakdown.
As if to make matters worse, the great energy of the Taurus no longer circulated through his body. An energy akin to a poisonous snake had appeared there. The reason was simple.
[You can temporarily possess the energy of the serpent.]
[You can temporarily receive the serpent’s magical energy to use skills.]
[Provisional Contract Duration: 2400hrs 0 min 0 sec.]
[If you do not achieve 100% faith in this time frame, all the skills and physical abilities you have developed will cease to exist. You will be returned to being a normal human.]
[If you do not like it, please raise your faith.]
Was it because he had changed Zodiacs? Joseph suddenly heard a threatening voice.
The voice spoke in encouragement(?) toward all the elite disciples of the Taurus temple.
[Hang in there. If you do well, your holy items might be returned in order.]
Joseph’s mind felt like it was collapsing when he heard the devilish voice of Lee Gun. However, he wasn’t the only one.
“Why me….”
Puffin had the same reaction after being suddenly sent to Egypt.
Puffin was the Serpent Bearer’s fifth disciple. He was part of the attack force of the Leo temple. However, he had unfortunately been present in the stadium where Lee Gun had defeated him and his fellow disciples in three seconds. Puffin had been one of the fighters who Lee Gun had then taken notice of.
At the time, he had felt like he would be killed if he didn’t join the Serpent Bearer temple. Moreover, his abilities were approved by Lee Gun, so he had entered the temple. Everything was fine up to that point.
– Alright. Your faith toward the Serpent Bearer used to be 50%, but now it is 100%, right? You should head toward the Taurus temple and train the disciples there. Give them some advice, too.
Puffins despaired. He had reached 100% faith toward the Serpent Bearer. He had been dragged away by Sungjae and trapped for three days to watch documentaries about Lee Gun. Instead of reading the newspaper, Puffin had to read Lee Gun’s bible. He had to hear Lee Gun hymns as a lullaby.
He had been brainwashed by Sungjae and his Constructs to print a 100% faith. That seemed to be why he was sent to raise the faith of the Taurus disciples.
‘How am I supposed to do those things in good conscience?’
Moreover, it was unknown whether their faith would go up if the same thing was done to them.
At that moment, someone patted Puffin on the back.
“Don’t worry too much about it. We’ll throw them away if it doesn’t work.”
It was none other than Hugo. The Archer Saint had crossed Kevin’s holy ground to reach this place. Why?
“Please eat your food and watch your movies without me.”
Yes, something had happened before Hugo had come here. With the incident in Drachma, Lee Gun had received numerous presents. One of them was an invitation to dinner at a seven-star hotel.
Normally, Lee Gun would have given away the present to someone else, but the menu made using monster meat seemed to have intrigued him. Moreover, he didn’t want to go by himself.
Since it was an invitation for 2 people, Lee Gun had tried to go with Hugo, and Hugo had told him to go with Hailey before heading out.
Back to the present.
‘Anyway, the disciples of a battle-type temple will be helpful.’
If the Taurus disciples could be safely transformed into the disciples of the Serpent Bearer, it would be a boon to Lee Gun.
‘Gun’s target is the monarch of Time.’
Among the monarchs, six had taken earth’s territory. Two of them had been killed, leaving only four. Time was one of them.
Like the other monarchs, Time was an existence that traveled through different worlds. It couldn’t be found on the earth. To find it, Lee Gun needed the power of other monarchs and Zodiacs.
According to Hailey, the remaining monarchs were extraordinary. They could change the scale of time. If Lee Gun were unlucky, he could be dropped into a strange world.
‘Anyway, Gun’s divine status and disciples need to increase. We’ll grow in power too.’
Since Hugo was an affiliate under the Serpent Bearer, Gun’s growth meant his growth. Of course, it wasn’t as if the situation was without problems.
“Faith? Who the hell would like someone with a trash personality like him? How can the faith toward him rise?”
Lee Jaewon, who had tagged along as Hugo’s guard, burst out laughing when he heard Hugo’s words. “Shall I go buy some alcohol for Saint-nim?”
“Alcohol?”
“When you’re drunk, your faith goes up quickly.”
Hugo looked at Lee Jaewon as if he were offended.
When Hugo had received the notification that he had reached level 5, he had become able to see a function.
[Lee Jaewon (S rank)]
[Sagittarius Faith: 91%]
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 120%]
It was an ability that allowed him to see the faith of other people. This was the reason he became angry.
“Hey! I’m close to Gun, but I’m nowhere close to you! Do you realize Gun looked out for you when you were his porter….”
“Yes, yes. When Lee Gun-nim passed away, I was a student about to take an examination. I had to listen to your drunken words about you missing Lee Gun-nim. You did it every day.”
“W-What?”
“When you met Madam, you kept saying you don’t deserve this type of happiness since you were unable to save Lee Gun-nim. You were the one who made it impossible for me to study for my tests.”
“I never did that!!!”
“I did get into a good university, but it was very hard. Anyway, I’ll go buy some alcohol. Do you think ten boxes will be enough?”
“Hey, Lee Jaewon!!!”
Lee Jaewon was about to order alcohol through his phone when his eyes turned round. “Saint-nim! Look at this!”
“!”
* * *
The Great Sandy Desert, Australia.
World Workshop was the tower where all of humanity’s equipment and holy items were made, and this place was abuzz right now. The reason was the declaration sent out by the Capricorn temple.
“Are they being serious?”
“What? You’re talking about the membership?”
“Aside from the membership, they are saying anyone who puts an order in with the Serpent Bearer will be blacklisted. They won’t even take on orders for repairs.”
The disciples who came to leave their items here became agitated when they heard the speech of the Capricorn temple’s disciples. They were acting high-handedly.
Yet, the Capricorn disciples acted as if their actions were justified.
“Reputation is very important to a temple. This is especially true for a manufacturer temple that has a deep connection with our reputation. Since we have suffered massive damage, we believe the proper measures were taken.”
“We are saying how can we trust those who are actively trying to hurt our temple.”
This caused a commotion.
On the other hand, it was also a desperate situation for the Capricorn disciples.
‘Thanks to Lee Gun, a big order that we were supposed to receive large support from is on the verge of being canceled!’
Yes, it was occurring in Europe where the Abundance had been disposed of. After a Green Zone had appeared in the middle of the Black zone, humanity had become hopeful that they would be able to retake its lands.
Therefore, an expedition was being discussed.
‘A variety of equipment is needed in an expedition.’
And so, governments all around the world, including different classes of countries, had asked for support from the Genius workshop and the Capricorn temple. They had made an agreement, yet the appearance of Lee Gun caused…!
‘Our funding will be cut in half.’
Words they couldn’t believe were spoken to them.
– Wouldn’t it be better if both sides produce the items?
– It would be best to work together for the sake of humanity.
These words had hurt the pride of the Capricorn disciples.
‘Have they lost their minds?’
‘There is no reason to build up an amateur to this extent.’
‘Do they think the path of fighting and manufacturing overlap?’
‘Thanks to him, the Capricorn temple’s reputation has been damaged.’
This was the reason all the workshops affiliated with the Capricorn temple were of one opinion.
“Anyone who wants the Serpent Bearer to manufacture their items should stick to that side.”
“Even if you went to get a quote, you’re barred from entering any of our affiliate workshops.”
“What?! That’s bullshit!”
Their decision caused a commotion among the other disciples.
“What should we do?”
“Will we be ok?”
“That’s right. I heard Lee Gun can quickly make items that are below S-rank.”
“I guess… However, we can’t even enter the Genius Workshop if we order from Lee Gun.”
“That’s right. The royal holy items and Heaven’s Punishment were said to be made by the Capricorn… They are overpowering…”
The Capricorn disciples laughed when they heard those words. It was working as they had planned.
“However, the monster from Drachma was defeated by the Archer Saint’s bow. Didn’t Lee Gun make that?”
“Really?”
The eyes of the Capricorn disciples suddenly flashed.
“Bow? If we have the blueprint, we can make it too!”
“That’s right! Tell him to make the blueprint public!”
Hearing this, someone who had come here to monitor the situation spoke up. “Blueprint? God-nim doesn’t use such a thing…”
“!”
It was the Secretary. “When Lee Gun manufactures items, he doesn’t make a blueprint. He plans it all out in his head.”
The master craftsmen were dumbfounded.
“This isn’t some art project! Do you realize how complex it is to make equipment?”
“Aren’t you a disciple of the Serpent Bearer? That’s why you’re taking his side.”
“It really is true…”
“Anyway, it takes Lee Gun four weeks to make an S-rank weapon. If we expedite it, we can make it in two weeks. If you order it with Lee Gun, you will have to wait a long time. Please think carefully.”
At that moment…
“Two weeks?”
Everyone was stirred when they heard the familiar laugh.
“It is Lee Gun!”
“Lee Gun??”
The master craftsmen were surprised when the man in question showed up before them.
“You guys speak so highly of your weapons, so I came to see them.”
“!!”
Lee Gun soon picked up a sword from the display, an A-rank weapon.
“How long did it take you to make this?”
“That? Three days will be enough for us. Isn’t that fast?”
Lee Gun scoffed, looking dumbfounded. “Three days? This? I can make it in thirty minutes.”
“?!”
The words caused a stir amongst the master craftsmen.
“Are you trying to insult us?”
“There are words you should and shouldn’t say…!”
Kwahng!
As if the master craftsmen had been waiting for Lee Gun, they rushed forward with their blueprints.
“We’ve just received our funding.”
“Oh?”
“The ones who sent it said that we should split it with the temple of the Serpent Bearer. Our Zodiac has been impatiently waiting for this funding and items in particular. Our Zodiac does not want to share it.”
“Is that so?”
“That’s why we should use the same blueprint to see who can make it better. We’ll compare in a fair manner. It’s a blueprint for an S-rank weapon.”
Lee Gun laughed at those words. He had come here thinking he could steal ingredients. And here he was, now confronted with the blueprint and the funding that the Capricorn had been eagerly waiting for.
“Alright. Call forth the one who is best at making weapons.”
The craftsmen immediately moved to call for the Ten Star and the Zodiac of their temple.
“You can use the ingredients over there.”
The Secretary followed Lee Gun toward the storage room, and her eyes turned round.
“Those bastards! How dare they give such ingredients!”
At a glance, the ingredients within the storage room looked fine. There was enough. However, their quality was too low.
What one did with them wouldn’t matter; only a B rank item could be made from these ingredients.
The Secretary had sharp eyes, so she was about to protest. “I’ll go talk to them right now….”
However, Lee Gun grabbed her. “It’s fine. This is enough.”
“What?”

chapters.title: Chapter 239: What? Is that all you can do? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: What? Is that all you can do? (2)
The Secretary’s real name was Yoojin Christian. However, she had received a new name from Lee Gun and became “Guisoon” instead.
Anyway, Guisoon had come looking for the World Workshop for a reason.
“Go to the workshop to buy some paper and writing utensils that you need. If there is a toy that you want, you can buy it too.”
She was on an errand. Although it was an errand, in reality, she was permitted to go enjoy herself. In particular, she was given the temple’s credit card.
This probably had to do with Sungjae, Carly, and Yooha. Because of them, Lee Gun’s bible had grown in thickness; it had become as tall as a person.
At that point, Lee Gun had acknowledged the amount of labor that she was putting in.
The fandom of those three people had crossed the line of them being fanatics. Having high faith was quite useful, but by the same token, the bible was full of content that could be dangerous(?) to Lee Gun if Guisoon left it as it was.
[Huff. I cannot stop looking away from Uncle even for one second. Lee Gun-nim stands out everywhere he goes. Lee Gun-nim makes it so that no one can look away from him. Huff.]
Effect: It doesn’t matter if one is a man or a woman. The Serpent Bearer captivates everyone.
– No one can escape his mojo.
While Guisoon had been knocked out, a new bible effect had appeared. Consequently, Lee Gun had been chased by thousands of men and women who sought his love.
It was so bad that Lee Gun’s chastity had been in danger, and his life was saved when Guisoon had woken up. She had edited the bible.
[One cannot look away from Lee Gun-nim’s greatness. Lee Gun-nim displays his brilliance everywhere he goes. Huzzah for the great light that makes the lowly beings look at him once again.]
Effect: Provoke monsters that have dispersed. Gather all the monsters within a hundred-meter radius.
Of course, Guisoon could fuck over Lee Gun by not fixing the bible’s content, but Guisoon had not done that. It wasn’t for Lee Gun. She just couldn’t stand the passages being so garbage.
‘Yes. He’ll be defeated, but I’ll be the one to defeat him.’
There was no way she would receive help from someone else.
Normally, she was unable to leave the holy ground, but Lee Gun had already upgraded the fountain pen.
[A Wooden Fountain Pen that cannot write lies (EX)]
The fountain pen wasn’t a weapon. It could only write words. Therefore, Guisoon wondered why Lee Gun had upgraded a miscellaneous item to the EX rank.
‘He ground up and used divine ingredients for this fountain pen.’
Although Lee Gun had a perverted taste, his actions had allowed her to leave the holy ground without being monitored.
After evolving into an EX-rank item, the fountain pen could follow Guisoon and go whenever and wherever it wanted.
Anyway, Guisoon was at the World Workshop. She was at the weapons district since she wanted to buy a small weapon for self-defense.
She had naturally taken Lee Gun’s side when he was disparaged. However, she wasn’t doing it because she wanted to help him.
It was understandable since she didn’t look kindly at Lee Gun. She was just annoyed that they judged his skills without seeing him at work. Moreover, she really didn’t like the Capricorn disciples.
‘At the very least, God-nim is serious when he makes his items.’
Lee Gun was so serious about it that the sound of him hammering would come from his room at four in the morning. It had made Hugo chase him out of the house.
Lee Gun didn’t even think about his actions when he pounded the hammer at four in the morning. He would just grumble all night to the Secretary about his friend chasing him out in his underwear while taking her to the pub to eat chicken. The problem was that he ate all the chicken legs and wings for himself.
The Serpent Bearer was a Zodiac that Guisoon couldn’t get herself to like.
Back to the present…
‘What? They want him to make it with these ingredients?’
These ingredients had been brought forth since they were about to face off, yet they were all low-quality ingredients.
At best, one would be able to make a B- or C-rank item with it. So those craftsmen giving him just low-quality ingredients to make an S-rank weapon was mind-boggling.
“I checked the ingredients, so let’s start. Let me use one of the workbenches.”
The Secretary was about to lose her mind as she watched Lee Gun nonchalantly take the ingredients.
She trembled as she grabbed Lee Gun. “L-Look here. Have you lost your mind, God-nim?”
“Why?”
“What do you mean, why? I know God-nim has a good eye! While they don’t look like it, these are all rank five ingredients.”
Lee Gun was thrown off. “What the hell? Are you able to differentiate such things?”
“I do! I learned it when I was under Hailey-nim… That’s not important right now!”
Normally, the ingredients used in the workshop were ranked from one to nine. Moreover, rank five was the minimum rank needed to barely make a weapon.
Basically, these cheap ingredients could produce C-rank items, and such items would break after cutting down a couple of monsters.
S-rank weapons could be made with only rank one ingredients.
‘At the very least, he needs rank 2 ingredients if he wants to make an A-rank weapon!’
In truth, the ingredients that Lee Gun had joyfully picked up were at least one rank higher than that!
It was unclear if his eyes or senses were almost supernatural. Others checked the ranks using machines, yet Lee Gun identified them by eyeballing them.
“They are clearly trying to screw you over, so why aren’t you saying anything…” She soon stopped speaking. Guisoon screamed as if she had a realization. “Ahhk! This is nuts. I knew you were an M. Do you perhaps enjoy this too?!”
Guisoon received a hit. However, she didn’t care as she continued to cling to Lee Gun. “Damn it! I’ll cuss you out instead of them! Just don’t do something that’ll embarrass yourself in front of people!”
Lee Gun uproariously laughed. “What’s going on? Normally, you would wish me to fail.”
Guisoon flinched. She ground her teeth.
‘I’ve witnessed it.’
Anyway, she didn’t like people mocking Lee Gun without knowing his skill level. Moreover, she hated seeing the Capricorn temple preen after they had cheated. “I guess it is to my benefit if you get disparaged.”
“Alright. I’ll head toward the workbench.”
“Ahhhk! This is wrong! A match has to be done under the same conditions!” Guisoon desperately clung to Lee Gun. “I don’t want others to call you an idiot! That means I was caught by an idiot! I’d rather you give me a massive amount of work so that I can die from being overworked!”
“What the hell are you talking about?” Lee Gun ignored Guisoon, who dangled off him, and headed toward the workbench.
The master craftsmen were guiding him toward a location with a fire. They did so because Lee Gun hadn’t brought up the part that worried them.
The master craftsman asked slyly.
“Will you be fine without the tools that you usually use?”
“Are you lacking any ingredients?”
“It’s fine. We’re working under the same conditions. The ingredients are decent enough. I’ll just make an S-rank weapon with them.”
The master craftsmen inwardly laughed as they guided Lee Gun.
‘He didn’t notice the ingredients!’
‘Of course! Who do you think prepared them?’
The master craftsmen of the Capricorn temple were considered great for a reason.
‘I’m confident in my ability to make the ingredients look decent.’
The Capricorn temple’s workshop sold weapons as well as ingredients. The master craftsmen and Constructs affiliated with other temples came to buy them.
The normal ingredients were usually received from the Zodiac. Some were excavated from where the monsters appeared. The uncorrupted parts of the monsters were removed and taken back.
However, selling good ingredients was a waste, so these craftsmen processed cheap ingredients to make them look like a different rank of ingredients before selling them.
It was an act of fraud, but the craftsmen were the type of people to buff out dented items and sell them at retail value. They even charged labor costs.
‘As expected, he’s an amateur. He didn’t notice it.’
‘He is a fake.’
Hugo had praised Lee Gun, and Kevin had shown interest in him. That was why the master craftsmen had been a bit worried.
‘This is our victory.’
‘There is no way he can make an S-rank item with that.’
Of course, Lee Gun could notice it later on, but he probably wouldn’t be able to say something out of embarrassment. Him not being able to detect it would make him a laughingstock.
Therefore, the craftsmen quickly whispered to their comrades.
“Since it turned out like this, let’s gather all the disciples within the tower.”
“It’ll be better if we call for the reporters.”
“As more people watch this scene, our reputation and faith will rise.”
The craftsmen decided to head toward the workbench used for lectures. It was a great place for a crowd to gather.
The names of Lee Gun and the Genius Workshop caused waves beyond imagination.
“Wow! It’s Lee Gun!”
“What the hell? They really are going to have a manufacturing match?”
“They are going to make S-rank items?”
The large workspace that was usually employed by the Genius Workshop for lectures was filled with people. They ranged from the master craftsmen of the tower to the people who had teleported here after hearing the rumor.
“Is Lee Gun planning on taking the Capricorn now that he took the Taurus?”
“Look at that! Isn’t that the Ten Star Taylor?”
“The generals are here too!”
“I can see why they are here. They bought the enmity of the Genius Workshop by asking for a quote from Lee Gun. I bet they are nervous.”
“The Virgo Saint came too?”
“Of course… Huh?! Why is he here?! He isn’t someone who would come to this old workshop.”
Despite his appearance, Kevin had the second-most disciples in the world, and he was considered the second strongest.
Kevin ground his teeth. He was causing more of a stir than the Ten Star by his appearance. “Why do I have to get a room for that woman?”
On the top side of the World Workshop was a seven-star hotel. Within this hotel were a casino, a sparring ring, and a hospital facility. It was a facility where the manufactured weapons could be tested.
When Lee Gun had called him to the hotel, Kevin had assumed Lee Gun wanted to test out a weapon he had made by sparring with him. That was why he had come here as soon as possible.
However…
“She fainted before we had the chance to eat. I need a place where she can rest. Give me your hotel room. I heard the Virgo temple rented out the best floor.”
Why did he have to pay for the room that’ll house the unconscious Hailey? Also, why were the two of them at a hotel? Why was she unconscious?
Lee Gun had calmly replied, “Since the continental breakfast is good, I thought it would be a waste to just eat dinner here. I told her we should spend the night here, and she fainted.”
She had a good reason to faint. It seemed Lee Gun had planned on sleeping in the next room, but… Hailey had fainted before she could hear that.
Anyway, Kevin became angry after Lee Gun took his best room from him. He didn’t mind Hailey. It was a request from Lee Gun, so he would do it even if he didn’t like it. However, that wasn’t the problem.
“Lee Gun is having a manufacturing battle? Did the Capricorn disciples lose their minds?” Kevin spoke as he propped his chin on his hand.
The disciples near him agreed with him.
“I guess so. They are enraged, and they plan on making Lee Gun-nim into a laughingstock.”
“Anyway, Lee Gun-nim may be amazing, but how could he make an S-rank weapon on the spot like this? There are also a lot of onlookers.”
“Those Capricorn bastards are probably used to this situation…”
“Then there is the blueprint. Isn’t it from the hit series that the Capricorn temple makes every month? Of course, they will be able to make their own item.”
“Ah. I feel bad for Lee Gun-nim… Why did he agree to a match that’s advantageous for the Capricorn temple…”
Kevin scoffed at those words. They feel bad for him?
‘Which side deserves the pity? I wonder.’
At that moment…
“Wow! He’s here! That’s the Ten Star of the Capricorn temple!”
Lee Gun had been touching the workbench when he heard the shouts from people.
He laughed in derision.
“Oh. I know him. Isn’t he a Ten Star? Was his name Taylor? Isn’t he famous?”
Guisoon, who was dragged along as a helper, looked dumbfounded. “You’re more famous…?”
At the same time, familiar faces appeared on the workbench next to Lee Gun. One of them was the current head of the Genius Workshop, the Ten Star of the Capricorn temple. He had become the head when the Goat Saint had gone missing.
