Five helpers were standing next to him. They were the most famous master craftsmen in the world, and they had made their appearance.
“Taylor!”
Their entrance lasted only a moment. The Ten Star looked at Lee Gun, who was by himself, and his face hardened. “Didn’t I say we’ll lend you master craftsmen to aid you?”
“That’s right. We will be making a great sword. It’s a large class weapon for the Constructs. A siege weapon will be made too. It’ll be hard to do everything by yourself.”
Lee Gun laughed in derision. “I don’t need any of that.”
“!”
“Whatever. Let’s hurry up and start this.” Lee Gun took a glance at the blueprint.
The items they would have to make would be a ballista-type weapon used in sieges, a large class weapon, and daggers. Manufacturing such a large quantity of weapons by oneself would be impossible.
The star master craftsmen spoke. “Excuse me, Lee Gun-nim. It’ll be hard to manufacture all of them by yourself in two weeks. It isn’t too late to…”
“I don’t need it.”
At that moment, the master craftsmen almost screamed.
It was to be expected since Lee Gun had thrown the blueprint he had been reading into the furnace.
The master craftsmen reacted in fright.
“What are you doing?”
“Hmm? What? I saw it, so I don’t need it anymore. That’s why I burned it.”
“What…!”
“Don’t tell me you have to keep looking at it to make the weapon?”
The master craftsmen ground their teeth when they saw Lee Gun’s spirited response.
‘He’s bluffing!’
“Understood. The deadline is two weeks. It’s until the flame on the Capricorn sculpture goes out.”
“Deal.”
At that moment, the flame was lit on the Capricorn sculpture.
The audience cheered. At the same time, the Capricorn master craftsmen got busy.
“You guys make the set of daggers since we have to make the largest quantity!”
“Yes!”
“The thing that’ll take the longest will be putting the data and power into the siege weapon. It’ll take us three days just to shape it. Hurry!”
“Yes!”
Suddenly…
“Wow! What the hell is that!!!”
“That’s crazy?!”
The audience members suddenly screamed because of Lee Gun.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: What? Is that all you can do? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: What? Is that all you can do? (3)
The Capricorn temple had the star master craftsmen, the peers of the Goat Saint Sebastian. One made weapons, one made defensive gears, and the other made buff-type holy items. They were all famous around the world in their fields.
Of course, other temples had their famous master craftsmen. However, the master craftsmen of the Genius Workshop dominated the scene.
[Oliver, the Ten Star of the Leo temple, made several attempts and failed. The Leo temple failed to place a manufacturing order with the Genius Workshop.]
[His waiting order is 12,000.]
[The Archer Saint Hugo Otis was also denied when he put in an order for a repair.]
[The Sagittarius temple probably can’t handle the repair fee.]
The master craftsmen, who had pissed off even Hugo, stood in front of Lee Gun with supreme confidence. Of course, they had a reason for being confident. First, they had heard that Lee Gun had taken around four weeks to create an offensive-type weapon.
‘Even the low-rank master craftsmen can do that in three weeks.’
As for them, they could do it in a week.
The second reason was that Lee Gun had yet to realize what was wrong with the ingredients they had given him.
‘He said the ingredients were good? He said he could make an S-rank weapon with those ingredients?’
‘Hmmph! One of the basic requirements for being a manufacturer is having a good eye.’
Despite their derision of Lee Gun, it wasn’t as if they hated him. Lee Gun was famous, and the whole world paid attention to him. What if they defeated a famous person like him?
‘Our reputation and the temple’s reputation will rise.’
While EXP grew the size of a temple, the reputation grew the quality of the temple.
Basically, it would allow them to evolve various parts of their temple, including skills. That was why the disciples were trying their hardest to attain achievements. Lee Gun was the ideal prey to accomplish that.
This was what they had assumed. However…
“What the hell is that?”
People screamed when they saw Lee Gun.
“Kyaaa! That’s crazy!”
“I… Is that supposed to be possible?”
The master craftsmen were surprised by the screaming.
People were staring at the kiln. Yes, in front of Lee Gun was a fire kiln that looked like a hybrid of a stove and a chimney. The kiln was burning fiercely. Normally, it was supposed to burn like a wood fire, but it was on a different level right now.
“Ahhhk! The kiln is melting!”
An incredible flame emanated from the kiln. The flame was so fierce that the nearby people ran away. It seemed as if the heat had changed the workshop into a volcanic region.
This shocked the master craftsmen.
‘That kiln is for training purposes…!’
That kiln was incapable of producing such heat.
‘So how…!’
However, something even more shocking was going on.
“Lee Gun-nim!! Your hand is melting!”
“He is doing it barehanded! Will he be ok?”
Yes, Lee Gun had placed his arm in the kiln.
Guisoon, who was next to Lee Gun, also reacted in fright. “Hey! God-nim! Have you lost your mind? Hurry up and take it out! What the hell are you doing? It hasn’t been that long since your arm was regenerated!!”
Was it because his arm had been severed by Abyss? The monarch’s magical energy was insidious. His right arm had barely returned with Super Regeneration, and it had taken several days. Another probable reason for this was that the level of Life was still low.
Anyway, him having Super Regeneration didn’t mean that he was unable to feel pain!
Guisoon clung to Lee Gun’s arm as Lee Gun casually put his hand into the fire.
“God-nim! All the flames used within the kilns of the Capricorn temple are Constructs! It won’t end with a burn wound!”
The low-rank Capricorn master craftsmen ran toward Lee Gun in fright.
“You will die at this rate! The fire is too strong!”
Lee Gun smirked as he kept his hand in the fire. “This is strong? This isn’t enough. Not by a long shot.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun immediately put strength into his arm. Then, a scream came from the kiln!
[Goo-ehhhhhhhhk!]
Guisoon and the master craftsmen were surprised by the scream.
Lee Gun didn’t care as his eyes flashed. “What are you doing, idiot? Do you want to die? Hurry up and raise the temperature.”
At those words, a familiar face appeared within the flame. It was the fire spirit that resembled a lizard.
‘Salamander!’
Since the Capricorn was the Zodiac of the blacksmiths, all kinds of gods related to fire had been made into Constructs.
Sometimes when the Zodiac was making an item, the fire Construct Agni would go into the kiln.
Anyway, Lee Gun was choking the neck of a Construct. The Construct was able to use firepower differently because of this threat.
The salamander shouted when it felt like it was being choked to death.
[Let me go! You snake bastar— Kuh-huhk! Poo-uhk!]
“Tsk! That bastard Torch listens to my instructions very well in my house. You guys look the same, so why are you like this?”
The words left Guisoon dumbfounded.
Lee Gun was referring to Torch, the fire monster that Lee Gun had stuffed into the kiln. He was talking about the calamity that had attacked Cheongwadae and razed the north of Seoul into the ground.
Lee Gun had already trained(?) it, so he just had to step on its tail to get it to crazily spit out high heat. It was unclear as to whether he knew this or not.
“You’re a god, yet your flame is weaker than a monster. I can make neither a weapon nor candy with this, bitch!”
The Construct was dumbfounded.
[Hey, you idiot! If I raise it further, you’ll get hurt— Kuh-huhk!!!]
“Do you really think I’ll get hurt by fire that can merely heat the floor?”
When Lee Gun choked its neck once again, the Construct furiously spat out a flame. The flame was so hot that it could almost melt the kiln!
Lee Gun was satisfied only when a flame looked like the sun itself was summoned. “Good! It is still a bit lukewarm, but this should do.”
The low-rank master craftsmen retreated from beside him. They didn’t want to be burned to death.
“He’s showing off because he has high resistance to fire!”
“Our master craftsmen have as much resistance to fire!”
“We are blacksmiths who know how to control fire! Don’t look down on us!”
Despite the words they shouted, the star master craftsmen on the next workbench were sweating. In truth, they were afraid of putting their hands into a flame of that magnitude, and this made them grind their teeth.
“We told that crazy bastard to make a weapon, yet it seems he’s trying to melt the kiln.”
“Does an S-rank item come out by doing that?”
The master craftsmen looked surprised.
On the other hand, Lee Gun picked up his hammer as if it wasn’t a big deal.
“It’s a worthless performance. He has nothing else to show except for that.”
“That’s right. In the first place, rank five ingredients will melt away in that heat…”
At that moment…
“Wow! That’s crazy! What is that?”
“Look at his speed!”
A commotion happened amongst the crowd as the sound of hammering reverberated in the air. It was the sound of Lee Gun using his hammer.
This shocked the star master craftsmen.
When making a holy item, the first step was to put all the ingredients into the fire of a furnace or a kiln. The ores handed down by the gods had to be mixed with the other acquired ingredients. Then the metal had to be formed into an ingot. That ingot was used to create the shape of an item.
They hadn’t seen him put the ingredients into the fire, yet he had started pounding on the steel.
‘He still hasn’t mixed in the ingredients.’
However, Lee Gun really was pounding his hammer atop his workbench.
Ggahng ggahng!
His left hand held a hammer, and his right hand a long piece of metal. The metal piece in his right hand reminded one of a skewered burning marshmallow.
Ggahng ggahng!
Lee Gun pounded the red-hot lumpy piece of metal. Clearly, the ingredients they had provided him with had been melted and mixed into the metal.
This took them aback.
‘How?’
They soon found out how he did it.
“Ah. This won’t be enough.” Lee Gun picked up the ores and ingredients that had been provided to him. Then, he grabbed the salamander in the kiln by the neck as he dragged it out!
“Here. This is your food. Quickly put it in your stomach and mix it.”
“!?!”
Lee Gun stuffed the ingredients into the salamander’s mouth.
The Construct looked like it wanted to die.
[K-Kuh-huhk! You bastar— I can no longer fit more— Oohk oohk!]
“Stop being a crybaby!” Lee Gun kept the salamander’s mouth shut and shook the Construct as if he were making a protein shake.
Everything was occurring within the flame, and several seconds passed.
[Ggoo-ehhhhk!]
Lee Gun opened the Salamander’s mouth again and shook it. Surprisingly, the mixed ingredients came out.
The master craftsmen from the other temples, who had been in the audience seats, yelled out as if they had an understanding.
“I see. He increased the temperature of the fire to shorten the process!”
“…!”
“Also, the inside of that Construct’s body is the best blast furnace. The mixing process won’t take long.”
“That man is going to kill that Construct! It is a god!”
“Still, he found a way to shorten the process, right? If it is possible, I want to try it out too.”
“Really! How can you say something so profane regarding a god? You should only think about raising the temperature!”
The star master craftsmen were stunned. Of course, doing this was easy in theory. However, how could a person be unharmed in front of that fire? But that was an entirely different problem.
‘A flame that hot would burn away all the data within the rank five ingredients. They’ll just combust.’
Why is it fine then? The question was soon answered.
“Damn it, lizard! Turn down the heat. The data is being destroyed”
[Kuhk— You told me to raise it— Kuhk!]
The master craftsmen did a double take when they heard those words.
‘Is he perhaps managing the heat to the ideal temperature for the ingredients?’
‘That’s crazy! He is doing this without a thermometer?’
‘In the first place, he can’t use a thermometer. It’ll melt!’
‘Is he doing it through touch…!’
That was right. Lee Gun’s skin felt the heat, so he knew when the ingredients would get damaged. It allowed him to modulate the temperature to the exact degree.
Because of this, the workshop descended into pandemonium. However, the star master craftsmen just shook their heads.
“It’s fine. Don’t worry about his method.”
“That’s right. At the end of the day, it all comes down to the ingredients. He can make only trash with trash.”
There was no way an S-rank item would come out.
But that wasn’t all.
‘The speed at which he can work by himself….’
At that moment, they almost fainted from shock.
Ggahng ggahng ggahng ggahng ggahng!
The sound of the hammer rang out as if he was putting on an inspired performance!
Lee Gun was like a madman as he pounded the metal and folded it. He repeatedly hit it and folded it. It looked as if he was pounding mochi in a mortar. Lee Gun kept pounding the ingredients as if it was dough.
[The impurities are disappearing.]
[The impurities are disappearing.]
[Its tensile strength is rising.]
The low-rank Capricorn master craftsmen wondered what was going on.
Kevin, who had been a spectator until now, laughed as he spoke up. “He’s raising the rank of the ingredients.”
Hearing those words, one of the Capricorn master craftsmen quickly put on a glass. It was a holy item that allowed him to see the rank of an ingredient. And when he looked at Lee Gun, the scene left him shocked.
‘The ingredients are really rising in rank!’
It was like watching a scene with an infrared camera.
The minerals Lee Gun was pounding at were rank five, symbolized by their muddy brown color.
When Lee Gun pounded them with his power, the muddy brown color cleared as he kneaded and folded them. One could see the materials change color from red, orange, yellow, and green.
Then, the color finally reached that
‘Blue!’
The master craftsman, who had been viewing this through the glasses, fell to the ground.
“That’s nuts. How can it become rank 1— oohp!”
The master craftsman quickly shut his mouth, but the star master craftsmen heard it clearly. They trembled.
‘The rank of the ingredients rose?’
Of course, it wasn’t as if Lee Gun had used the wrong method. A paper’s tensile strength would rise the more one folded it.
Lee Gun was pounding and folding the ingredients. He was increasing its tensile strength by compressing it. It was a method that could be used if the quality of the ingredient was terrible. But one needed power to pull this off.
However, it was too early to be surprised.
Ggahng!
The master craftsmen flinched and shook when they heard the sound of metal hitting metal. An incredible power was being used on the metal. It seemed the preparation for the ingredients had ended.
Lee Gun kept turning the metal with his tongs as he pounded it with his hammer. In a flash, a blade started taking shape.
Ggahng gahng!
This scene surprised everyone.
“What the hell? It is already taking shape?”
It wasn’t as if Lee Gun had pounded the item dozens of times. He just had to hit each region once: the shape of the sword, the connecting pieces, and even the through-holes.
Ggahng!
People reared back in shock as they listened to the sound of metal being worked on.
“He already made a sword!”
“It didn’t even take five minutes.”
When the master craftsmen froze in place, the people in the audience seat started jeering at them.
“Capricorn temple! What are you doing? Lee Gun already made a sword!”
“Did you guys play around while you worked?”
The star master craftsmen shook at their protestation.
“T…that isn’t it—”
“Hurry up and make it!”
The star master craftsmen quickly put the ingredients into the fire. However, the mixing procedure took too long.
They had no choice. They took out an ingot that they had prepared beforehand. One person grabbed the metal, and two people were about to hit it with their hammers when…
“Wow! That’s crazy! He already made three!”
“??!!”
The star master craftsmen froze. They didn’t get to swing their hammers even once!
Lee Gun didn’t care as he finished the outer appearance of the swords. Then, he dusted his hands off. “Ha. It’s too bad. If I had good ingredients, I could have just made a mold. I would have been able to make it quicker.”
Everyone reared back in shock. He was plenty fast right now.
“Well, it’s fine. Pounding it myself is fun.”
Lee Gun was like a madman as he repeated the previous procedure. He raised the rank of the crappy ingredients, then moved his hands several times to create the shape.
Ggahng ggahng ggahng ggahng!
In a flash, he created eight blades for a short sword, which took him around thirty minutes.
“This isn’t too bad.”
Everyone was astonished.
“It isn’t as if he’s making muffins.”
“He is like a machine…!”
The eight blades looked the same. It looked like he didn’t put much effort into making them, but the blades looked sturdy and beautiful. There wasn’t even a millimeter of a discrepancy between them.
However, something was even more shocking.
While Lee Gun made eight blades, the star master craftsmen…
“N-No way. They couldn’t even make one?”
The master craftsmen froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: What? Is that all you can do? (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: What? Is that all you can do? (4)
Ggahng ggahng ggahng!
“Wow! This is crazy!”
“He made them without looking at the blueprint, right?”
The sound of the hammer pounding on the metal rang out through the workshop. This sound belonged to none other than Lee Gun.
The hammer was raised into the sky, then brought down.
Everyone’s gaze followed Lee Gun’s hands. Their eyes looked spellbound. Lee Gun had mesmerized them, and it was understandable.
They just needed to see him for a short period before he quickly made something.
The people in the building were engrossed in the movements of his hands, which looked to be moving absentmindedly.
The items designed by the Capricorn were complex. Therefore, the Capricorn disciples had a hard time making them without the blueprint despite having made those items over and over again.
Yet, Lee Gun was making such items without blueprints! Of course, there was another reason for his current popularity.
“Kyaa! Lee Gun-nim is amazing!”
“I didn’t know when I saw him from the outside!”
“Lee Gun-nim! Please look here!”
At the sight of Lee Gun wearing a black sleeveless shirt, the contingent of disciples who liked how he looked grew.
Lee Gun had worn this as he had planned on eating dinner with Hailey; so he had donned on a pretty dashing outfit. That restaurant wasn’t a very formal place where he needed a suit, but the dress code was pretty upscale.
Normally, he would have found it annoying. However, Sungjae had an uncanny sense when it came to fashion. Therefore, Lee Gun had worn the t-shirt and pants that Sungjae had bought for him.
However, Hugo had reared back in shock when he had seen him.
“Have you lost your mind, Gun?! You’re going on a date, and you plan on wearing a hooded t-shirt!”
It wasn’t a date, but…
“What is wrong with a hooded t-shirt…”
“Damn it. You really are going to be forever alone!”
In the end, Hugo had slapped Lee Gun’s back and modified Lee Gun’s style before Lee Gun arrived here.
Of course, Hailey had moved five hundred meters away from him when she saw him and started to hyperventilate. However, that wasn’t important right now.
Lee Gun was sweating as he worked, and as his shirt had been getting in the way, he had worn a sleeveless shirt.
The number of disciples who liked this look increased exponentially. Of course, the Virgo Constructs wouldn’t miss such an opportunity, either.
[Get out of the way. I can’t see Baby snake-nim.]
[You’re the one that should move! It’s too crowded here!]
[Kevin! Hurry up and get out of the way!]
[Don’t try to look at the good stuff by yourself— Kyaa!]
“Do not forget you guys are Constructs that are supposed to stay incognito…”
Kevin pressed down on the heads of the Constructs that were trying to come out of his shadow.
At that moment, the Virgo tried to descend since she thought it would be fun to watch this scene.
However, Kevin’s eyes flashed. “You should keep the Sagittarius in check! You guys are sibling gods, yet he keeps coming to us looking for odd things!”
Anyway, two hours had passed since the start of the manufacturing battle. Yet, no one had left their seat. On the contrary, the crowd was getting larger.
A pile of weapons lay in front of Lee Gun.
Guisoon looked at Lee Gun with an overwhelmed expression.
‘How many did he make in two hours? He made daggers, great swords, and even a complex siege weapon…!’
He was in a different class.
Guisoon discreetly glanced at the star master craftsmen. Naturally, they were busy hammering away.
When they saw Lee Gun, they acted like madmen as they sped up their work. Moreover, one could see several blades that had taken the shape of daggers. However, the craftsmen were in too much of a rush.
Ggahng!
“Huhk…!”
When the hammer hit the workpiece, the hilt broke and bounced toward the face of a master craftsman. The hammer had been swung at a wrong angle.
Suddenly, their surroundings became full of jeers.
“How can you make such a basic mistake?”
“Lee Gun is carrying himself much better than you guys!”
“Wow! The master craftsmen of the Genius Workshop look like rookies compared to him.”
“They are complete slowpokes.”
The master craftsmen who were pounding the metal bars felt aggrieved.
‘What the hell are they saying?’
‘Of course, Lee Gun is half-assing it since he spent so little time making those weapons! It’s obvious’
They were too far away to see closely, but with the speed they were made at, there was no way those weapons would be of high quality.
“Amateurs should shut their mouths!”
“Do you think this is a speed battle?”
At those words, a different set of audience members snarled at the craftsmen.
“Why not? Speed should be taken into account. You guys looked down on Lee Gun. You said a weapon that you could make in a week would take four weeks for Lee Gun.”
“You guys are the ones who said that speed is proof of one’s skill…”
The master craftsmen became angry.
“We are putting in effort for quality….”
At that moment, a big commotion occurred on the grounds. The reason was simple.
“I finished one set.”
“!!”
It was the set of eight daggers that Lee Gun had started making first. The set was finished now.
People cheered as they moved closer toward the holy items.
“Hey! Appraise it! Try appraising it! Check if they are really S-rank items!”
“It took him around three hours to make all of that?”
“My goddd! It would have taken a week for the Genius Workshop to make the same item…”
“One item… One week…”
In the end, the star master craftsmen became angry at the murmurings.
“Appraise it! There is no way he can satisfy the requirement since he rushed it!”
“That’s right! We didn’t request speed! We wanted quality! There is no way any of those is an S-rank item.”
“At the very least, they are B rank!”
However…
“S rank! They are S rank!”
“?!”
The star master craftsmen almost dropped their hammers. W… What did he just say?
The appraiser who had been gathered as a judge cheered.
“They are all S-rank items! All eight of them!”
The SS-rank Appraiser Jinmyung had been called in. It had been a while since he had seen Lee Gun, so Jinmyung wailed.
These items were much better in quality than the ones Lee Gun made twenty years ago.
The star master craftsmen were about to lose their minds.
“T… They really are S rank items?”
“H… How can it be S rank if it was made like that…?”
“The ingredients were only rank 5— Oohp!”
“Shhh!”
The master craftsmen quickly shut their mouths. However, Jinmyung’s eyes flashed.
“Hey, you aren’t supposed to do it like that.”
“!”
The voice frightened the master craftsmen.
Lee Gun had appeared behind them. He clicked his tongue as he looked at their workbench. “If you do it like that, the balance will be off. There is no way an S-rank item will come out.”
He had plenty of time left, so he had come out of boredom.
Lee Gun’s words angered the star master craftsmen.
“Hmph! S rank? Don’t joke with us! He probably swapped it out with real S-rank items!”
“That’s right. If not, how can you make an S-rank item so fast using those ingredients…!”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue at those words. He snatched their hammers away. “Idiots.”
“Wait a mom— Huhk!”
He made adjustments to their item.
Ggahng! Gghang! Ghang!
The faces of the star master craftsmen stiffened when they witnessed Lee Gun bring down the hammer.
Five times. It just took him five swings of the hammer to shape the item.
Taylor, the Capricorn temple’s Ten Star, finally dropped his hammer. Before, the star master craftsmen hadn’t witnessed Lee Gun at work with their own eyes. This was why their reactions were understandable.
They were discouraged by the crowd’s reactions and had assumed Lee Gun was just putting up a performance.
Therefore, they had thought they just had to do their best, and people would recognize their work.
Ggahng!
The master craftsmen were mesmerized by the sight before them. It wasn’t just any item. It was the item they had been working on. Lee Gun’s demonstration clearly showed the gap in their skills.
“We have lost.”
Taylor was the first to speak.
Then, the mouths of all the low-rank master craftsmen fell open.
“W-Wait a moment, Taylor-nim! Why throw in the towel? We still have plenty of time…”
“It’s meaningless. The result will be the same even if we pursue this further.”
“…!”
The master craftsmen of different specialties, who had stepped up to help Taylor, acknowledged it.
“It is our defeat…”
“If I’m being honest, you are better at manufacturing than our Zodiac and Zodiac Saint…”
At that moment…
Kwahng!!
It could no longer watch this situation.
[Imbeciles!]
“!!”
A light descended next to them. The building went abuzz when the people there saw a face emerge from the light.
“They are the foreman of the Capricorn!”
Yes, the ones to appear were Constructs, but not normal Constructs.
[Dwarves of Nidavellir]
The angry faces of the dwarves were quite imposing. They were gods with specialized manufacturing power. They were one of the various types of manufacturing gods scouted by the Capricorn temple.
The Constructs let out their boiling anger as they moved toward the star master craftsmen.
[How dare you guys dirty the name of our Zodiac!]
[You didn’t give it your all, yet you admitted defeat. As if that wasn’t enough, you sully the name of the Capricorn?]
[Do you guys plan on pushing the entire temple into a bottomless pit with your irresponsible words?]
The master craftsmen trembled when confronted by the menacing gazes of the dwarves. The dwarven Constructs then glared at Lee Gun.
[There is still time left. We’ll take over.]
Lee Gun was intrigued by their appearances. It was to be expected since they were considered the top master craftsmen who had created weapons for the Zodiacs. Of course, he was intrigued by their skills.
“Go for it. I’ll wait around two weeks for you guys.”
There was anticipation in his words. The dwarves laughed as if those words had left them dumbfounded.
[You’re a cocky baby god. It might be impossible for humans, but those in the divine rank like us can keep up with your speed.]
They immediately grabbed the item. Then, something surprising happened.
Ggahng! Ggahng
[The servants of the Capricorn are making weapons.]
As expected, there was a difference between gods and humans. The dwarven Constructs created weapons at surprising speed.
Ggahng! Ggahng!
Their speed was on par with Lee Gun’s.
“My god! As expected of divine rank…!”
Like Lee Gun, the Constructs created daggers in short order. They produced the same number of items and that too of the same rank.
“These are clearly S-rank items!”
The Constructs laughed in derision when they heard the appraiser’s words.
[Look. We made the S-rank items in the same amount of time as you did.]
[Do not look down at the Capricorn temple. You’re a baby god who has no deep history. Our history as master craftsmen spans several thousands of years. Do not insult us.]
The Capricorn master craftsmen cheered at their words. Soon, the dwarves glared at the master craftsmen, who had accepted defeat.
[You guys are worse than the dirt between my toes…]
At that moment…
“Assholes.”
“!!”
Screams rang out as Lee Gun cussed.
Ggahng!!!
Lee Gun had been looking at the weapons made by the Constructs when he suddenly broke those weapons.
This shocked the audience members and the master craftsmen.
“I-It broke! That was an S-rank weapon…!”
Lee Gun held a hammer in his hand.
The Constructs shook when they saw this. It wasn’t a weapon that should be broken so easily.
Moreover, a hammer was a tool used to make a weapon. It shouldn’t be able to destroy the weapon.
The shocked Constructs looked at Lee Gun.
“Do you want to die? Don’t even think about competing with me with such weapons.”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed in anger. “Of all the things you can do, you created an empty vessel to push abilities into it. You did it to fix the rank?”
“…!”
The Constructs had not created real S-rank items. Since they were using the ability of gods, they were able to hoodwink the appraiser.
At a glance, the items looked decent. However, there was little substance to them. They were weak. What would happen if someone took such weapons out into battle?
‘The user will die in the middle of the battlefield when the weapon breaks.’
This had made Lee Gun furious. He had never made weapons half-heartedly.
“Weapons are like the lives of warriors. It is the job of the manufacturer to create weapons that’ll last until their wielders can return from the battlefield at the very least.”
“!”
“Are you trying to fuck over the disciples that entrust their lives in your hands?”
When a commotion happened around them, the flustered Constructs aimed for Lee Gun’s weapon.
[W-What are you saying, you sly snake? You used the same method to make your S-rank items!]
Window-dressing was all they could do in such a short amount of time.
Therefore, they summoned their divine axes and struck Lee Gun’s weapons.
“The items are undamaged…!”
The commotion inside the building turned bigger.
The Constructs shook. At the same time, they realized the Faith toward the Capricorn was plummeting.
[W-Wait a moment! Today was just a bad day for us. However, it’ll be different for our Zodiac. The Capricorn made the royal holy item for the other gods. It created this bastard’s Heaven’s Punishment….]
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. “Ah! That’s right. I forgot about that. You guys committed fraud by claiming you guys created my baby. I came here to correct that, yet I completely forgot about it.”
Lee Gun’s words set the place on fire. It was to be expected.
This rumor had been going around in secret, but the rumor was never legitimized since people were threatened with being blacklisted.
“What? Heaven’s Punishment wasn’t made by the Capricorn?”
At the same time, Lee Gun extended his hand. Heaven’s Punishment was summoned into Lee Gun’s hand!
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he pushed Heaven’s Punishment toward the Constructs. “Call for your Zodiac.”
[…!!!]
“If you guys really made this, you guys can make the same weapon. I’ll lend you this. Of course, you know all the ingredients that went into making it, right?”
[…!!!]
“Even if the ingredients are different, you can still copy them. If you can make a copy, I’ll acknowledge your claims.”
[Them…!]
Lee Gun grinned. “If you can’t make the same thing, I’ll break all your shit”

chapters.title: Chapter 242: What? Is that all you can do? (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: What? Is that all you can do? (5)
When Lee Gun spoke, a commotion broke out within the 200-pyeong workshop used for lectures. There was only one reason for this.
Before throwing down the gauntlet, what did Lee Gun say?
“Wait a moment! Heaven’s Punishment was made by Lee Gun?”
“You guys said the Capricorn made it!?”
Everyone stood up from their seats.
Before, the master craftsmen from other temples had been enjoying the battle, but they stood up in anger now.
“Hey, Capricorn temple! Is he telling the truth?”
The Capricorn disciples were shocked by the angry shouts.
“What are you saying? O-Of course, he’s lying!”
“What? He’s lying? Someone of Lee Gun’s stature wouldn’t tell such a bold lie. It isn’t as if he’s unaware of what will happen.”
“No way…!”
Originally, the other master craftsmen had come here for entertainment. However, they could no longer be spectators watching a fire burn across the river.
What was the reason they had held back while the Capricorn temple had acted high and mighty?!
‘They were supposed to be the ones who had created the greatest holy items of humanity!’
Yes, the reason the Capricorn temple was upheld so highly was the fact that they had made Heaven’s Punishment.
Heaven’s Punishment was one of the most famous treasures in the world. It was one of Lee Gun’s eight great weapons, which everyone coveted.
Even if Lee Gun were called lousy, there was a reason his items were famous enough to appear on the black market.
‘The premium wasn’t added, because he was simply the comrade of the Zodiac Saints.’
Lee Gun’s raid videos were still among the highest viewed videos on YouTube. Then there was the video of the raid in Russia, which was still being passed around in secret.
Seeing the video, everyone had wondered how a B-rank could accomplish such feats.
When posed this question, Giselle had explained that this was all thanks to the buffs loaned out by the Zodiacs and the equipment made by the Capricorn. She had said that without them, Lee Gun would be like a regular B rank.
Several Zodiac Saints had denied this assertion, but Giselle had put out well-crafted fake evidence. That had boosted the credibility of her assertion.
With the transformation ability of the Pisces, creating fake witnesses and evidence was easy.
Anyway, Giselle had labeled Lee Gun a B-rank awakened being, and in turn, his items were given astronomical value. Why?
‘My god. These are items that can make even a B-rank into a Saint rank!’
‘What would happen if someone of the general rank used those items?’
That was why the generals desperately tried to win bids for Lee Gun’s items. It was also why disciples rushed to obtain trivial items belonging to Lee Gun. They believed in the effect of those items.
Of course, a separate group, made of those like Sungjae, was purely in it because Lee Gun’s personality(?) had won them over.
Anyway, that was the lay of the land.
In all of Lee Gun’s raid videos, Heaven’s Punishment was always present, and it was the highest rank item he possessed!
In truth, Heaven’s Punishment had been put up for auction in Beijing eighteen years ago. Those who had checked its abilities were shocked.
Of course, the ownerless Heaven’s Punishment had violently resisted, so they couldn’t measure it properly. However…
“At the time, it was said the data was equivalent to an SS-rank weapon, right?”
“That’s right. There was also that incident….”
In truth, Heaven’s Punishment had become famous for another reason, too. It was when Heaven’s Punishment came out in the auction.
A surprise attack by an unknown group had tried to interfere with the auction. The mysterious group had attempted to steal the weapon for some reason.
Moreover, several hundred monsters, which had never been seen before, had shown up! They weren’t the monsters of the unknown civilization that people saw daily.
Although this wasn’t confirmed, the lowest rank monster had been at least red zone rank! Therefore, the auction house had instantly turned into hell.
Kevin and Stevens had also come to the auction house to bid for the weapon, but their powers had been ineffective on the monsters, leaving them flustered.
At that time, the restrained Heaven’s Punishment had broken the chains and killed all the enemies by itself, as if it was getting its revenge. Moreover, the weapon roared because it had failed to protect its master inside the tower.
‘Because of that incident, Heaven’s Punishment was completely drained of its power. Moving the weapon had become possible afterward.’
The appraisers who remembered that incident gulped.
At the time, it was said that Heaven’s Punishment had used all of Lee Gun’s magical energy, which was imbued within it.
Anyway, the weapon’s stock exploded because of that incident. The Virgo temple and the Leo temple had lost two rankings for not being able to do anything against the monster.
At the time, Kevin had been gunning for the number one spot, yet he had been pushed to fourth place. Stevens, who had been in third place, had been pushed down to fifth.
As for the Capricorn temple that had made Heaven’s Punishment…
[Capricorn temple’s ranking increased (11 ▶ 3)]
Although the temple was later pushed down by the battle-type temples, it had benefited from the reputation for eighteen years.
Moreover, Heaven’s Punishment’s stock had continued to rise as the false stories about Lee Gun were slowly unraveled.
Then, Lee Gun had stopped the attack by the monsters by himself, and the weapon that he treasured had made him that much stronger.
That was why the assessment of the Capricorn temple was rising rapidly in recent days.
And so…
“What? Lee Gun made that too?!”
“That means Lee Gun already made an SS-rank weapon back in the day!”
“They are frauds?!”
Lee Gun picked at his ears. According to his standards, the weapon had been at the S rank instead of the SS rank.
‘It seems they were generous in their appraisal.’
In truth, Heaven’s Punishment was the first holy item he had made. So he found it lacking in many facets compared to his other items.
However, it couldn’t be destroyed because of the ingredients he had used.
‘Moreover, it isn’t an S-rank weapon now. It’s an EX-rank weapon.’
While pandemonium erupted inside the workshop, one being reacted in anger.
[Heaven’s Punishment keeps protesting that Lee Gun is its master and that he had created it.]
[Heaven’s Punishment feels aggrieved.]
When Heaven’s Punishment wailed, Lee Gun patted it.
“It’s fine. They all know who created you now.”
The Capricorn Constructs glared at him.
[That is enough slander!]
[That’s right. You evil bastard! He’s slandering us! He is trying to steal our reputation to grow his temple!]
The words made Lee Gun laugh. “Slander? Why don’t you call your Zodiac?”
[Stop making ludicrous statements, you bastard—]
“If you guys succeed in making a copy, I’ll go under the Capricorn temple.”
“!!!”
The commotion within the premises got louder than before.
“Did you hear that? The Serpent Bearer temple will go under the Capricorn temple.”
“At this point, it really seems like Lee Gun is the one who created Heaven’s Punishment.”
The shocked Constructs laughed.
‘You are digging your own grave.’
It seemed that the bastard didn’t know what he was putting on the line.
‘If the Serpent Bearer comes under us, we can absorb his affiliate temples too.’
The Capricorn temple had always been ranked middle to low. This move would allow the Capricorn temple to rise to the high ranks!
‘This is an amazing opportunity.’
Ranking wasn’t a measure of absolute strength, but having a high rank had its benefits.
‘We must seize this opportunity.’
Of course, the Constructs knew the truth.
They knew Lee Gun had made the weapon. However, this changed nothing.
‘There is no way our god is unable to make an item made by a human.’
Their Zodiac could see the structure of a holy item just by looking at it. It could copy items just from touching them. So what was this? Lee Gun only wanted a copy!
‘As expected, he doesn’t know anything since he used to be a stupid human.’
Moreover, he had offered to lend them the item.
‘He’s handing us all the information.’
‘Idiot.’
At this point, they considered their victory assured. Therefore, the Constructs immediately yelled out.
[Alright. We were the ones to make Heaven’s Punishment. Of course, we can make one more.]
[The Zodiac wants this.]
They grabbed each other’s hands as they made a circle. Then, they called for their master.
[Oh, master of creation, who creates all creation!]
The Constructs used the Zodiac Summon skill, which called forth their master!
[Please show him your skill! Rip open the mouth of that foolish bastard!]
[Please appear in this place for the sullied honor of the Capricorn temple!]
A pillar of purple light surged up. It was an incredible amount of energy.
This display caused a commotion amongst the disciples.
Kevin raised his guard.
‘The Capricorn is coming.’
Why would the Zodiac not come!
‘It merely has to copy an item! There is no way it’ll bypass this golden opportunity!’
If it didn’t show up, it would be staining the reputation of the Capricorn temple! This was a grave matter where the reputation of the Capricorn temple was on the line! There was no way the Capricorn would refuse to come!
And as expected, a powerful light surged forth. When the light dissipated, the Capricorn—
“?”
Master….
“????”
Their master should have shown up.
[Master?!]
The Capricorn hadn’t shown up. There was no one there. The only thing everyone could see there were the buzzing flies.
The flustered Constructs opened their eyes wide.
[It seems our voices weren’t heard. Let’s call for our Zodiac again.]
[Yes!]
They attempted it again using the same method.
[Master! Please make an appearance here! Please recapture the reputation of the Capricorn temple!]
[They insult the god of the manufacturing workshop, whom all the gods of the Divine world seek out!]
It didn’t matter that they had raised their voices.
[The Capricorn feels awkward. It has refused the call.]
[Master?!!]
Lee Gun smirked. “Your Zodiac refused your summon? That means it has a guilty conscience, right?”
Those words caused a ruckus within the grounds.
“This is nuts! The people of the Capricorn temple really are frauds.”
“That’s right. They have deceived us. Why wouldn’t the Zodiac show up unless it has a guilty conscience?”
“Wow! Out of all of them, I thought the manufacturers would be clean!”
The dwarves were shocked.
‘Oh, Master! Why!’
This opportunity was practically a layup, so why was the Capricorn rejecting it?
‘Our master should be able to copy that bastard’s weapon just by touching it!’
In the end, they poured out their contribution to summon their Zodiac.
‘We’ll surely be able to summon Master with this!’
[Master! You just have to create the same thing!]
[Please show— Ahhhk!!!]
They were about to chant the summoning spell when they screamed. Instead of the Zodiac being summoned, a purple lightning bolt fell from the sky.
[Ahhhk! Why are you attacking us!]
The Zodiac seems furious.
[The Capricorn asks why they keep looking for it.]
[The Capricorn is angry that you guys let this incident grow out of hand.]
[The Capricorn says it’ll get rid of all its stupid underlings.]
[?!!]
[Master!?!!]
Lee Gun couldn’t stand it anymore. He laughed as he clutched at his stomach. “What the hell? I never expected it not to show up.”
[!]
Lee Gun had an idea about what was going on. This was inevitable.
‘The Zodiac knows what Heaven’s Punishment is made out of.’
Unless the Capricorn had lost its mind, there was no way it would pluck the whiskers of the Leo. That wasn’t all.
‘A long time ago Sebastian was successful in stealing Heaven’s Punishment.’
He had been trying to copy it. Despite getting this opportunity, the Capricorn Saint had failed. He had failed despite a highly motivated Capricorn making an appearance.
This was why Lee Gun was certain. “You guys can’t copy this.”
The Constructs ground their teeth when they saw his confident smile.
‘He only learned how to manufacture by stealing our blueprints, yet he is acting arrogant!’
In truth, Lee Gun had learned how to manufacture holy items by studying their blueprints.
It had happened around the time when Lee Gun had just awakened. At the time, Lee Gun had only his body.
‘The Zodiacs put in manufacturing orders with us for their Zodiac Saints.’
On the other hand, Lee Gun didn’t have a Zodiac to even give him an overcoat. Therefore, he made weapons for himself. It had been child’s play for him.
‘Of course, the method to make holy items differed from that of making human weapons.’
Therefore, those of the Capricorn Constructs had laughed as they watched Lee Gun get beaten to a pulp by the monsters.
‘Someone like that…!’
‘He was able to make such a weapon…!’
The more galling part was that he had stolen a blueprint for something basic, the blueprint for a blunt weapon (C rank).
He had made Heaven’s Punishment using that blueprint.
‘It was probably luck that the weapon developed a sense of self. That’s why the weapon turned out to be that powerful.’
[Alright! We’ll try copying the weapon…!]
[It was made using a basic C-rank blueprint. From a big picture point of view, this should be easy!]
The Constructs placed their hands on Heaven’s Punishment as they used their skill. This was a summoning skill that summoned the ingredients the weapon was made of!
[Come out, the ingredients making up Heaven’s Punishment!]
The ingredients were summoned on the ground.
[Good. Let’s grind down the ingredients…!]
Suddenly…
[How dare you summon me, you impudent bastards!]
[?!]
The blacksmith Constructs screamed when they heard the familiar voice.
[W-wait a moment! Isn’t that the Leo?]
[It is… Ahhhk! Why is it here?!]
[Look here, human! Which ingredients did you use?]
Lee Gun picked at his ear. “What else? I used the Leo’s tooth.”
[What?!!!]
[You crazy bastard! How dare you use the item of such a being!!]
[Y-You dare use such an item as an ingredient. We can’t copy it!]
[Do you have a death wish for using this as an ingredient!!!]
[Ahhhk! Hurry up and cancel the summon— Ahhhk!]
[I’ll eat all of you!!]
The Leo was finally about to emerge from the light when…
Kwahng!!!
An incredible light flashed in the air as if it was trying to sort out the summon of the Leo. This light was shaped like a goat.
[The Capricorn has appeared.]
The light was so bright that even seeing it was hard. However, it had the head of a goat and the body of a human.
The Constructs roared as if they had expected the appearance of their master.
[You’re finally here, Master!]
[Please hurry up and make that wretched bastard—]
[Ahhhk!!!]
The goat let out lightning bolts. The Constructs screamed as they fell over.
[The Capricorn says its underlings did this on their own.]
[The Capricorn will take back its useless servants.]
This angered the Leo, who was about to be summoned.
[Hurry up and come here, you goat bastard?!]
The Leo tried to swallow the Capricorn, but it disappeared when the summon was canceled.
The Capricorn let out a sigh of relief.
[I’ll take back my useless servants]
It seemed this matter would end without a big fight. Kevin and the Virgo disciples relaxed as they put away their swords.
The Capricorn was true to its words as it tried to take back its Constructs. However…
Kwah-jeek!!!
[Kuh-huhk!!]
Accompanying the sound of an ax hitting something, blood flew into the air.
“You’re going nowhere. You have to pay what you owe.”

chapters.title: Chapter 243: What? Is that all you can do? (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: What? Is that all you can do? (6)
“You are going nowhere. You have to pay what you owe.”
Accompanying those words, a scream rang out.
Lee Gun had swung his blade, and the ones to scream because of this were the Constructs.
[Kuhk! Master!]
Their shoulders and arms had been stabbed. It was a total mess. The ten dwarves glared at Lee Gun after their blood was shed.
[You are a baby god that has no manners…!!!]
[How dare you do this to us…!]
They were Constructs of a temple with a deep history. They had too much pride. Moreover, their temple possessed a very high reputation amongst the twelve Zodiac temples. They were used to being treated like nobility.
Therefore, being stabbed by Lee Gun was humiliating for them. In truth, their pride had been hurt ever since they started the manufacturing battle. They had felt as if their status was being challenged and that too by a mutant and newly born god!
[You were born as a mere human— Kuh-huhk!]
The Capricorn, who had come to retrieve its Constructs, was surprised by this.
[Isn’t this too much considering we are all manufacturers?]
A commotion broke among the master craftsmen when they heard the deep voice that rang out throughout the grounds.
‘Zodiac!’
The Capricorn seemed furious.
[They might be foolish, but they are the best manufacturers. Their hands are treasures to humanity.]
Lee Gun jeered when he heard the Capricorn’s voice. “Best manufacturers? Yet they tried to fake the rank of the items because they wanted to win a mere match?”
[!]
Lee Gun didn’t care about all the other stuff. He just couldn’t forgive them for making faulty items and calling them S-rank items.
Therefore, he said, “Goldie and Blackie, get rid of them.”
When Lee Gun called for them, lights appeared and the Constructs screamed.
[Life and Death have stolen the magical energy of the Constructs.]
[The powers of the Constructs have weakened.]
[Life may use its power to have the captured Constructs undergo rebirth.]
[Life says they should be reborn as items according to master’s blueprints.]
[At the very least, SSS-rank items will come out.]
[Death says improving the skills would be better for Master’s health. It speaks out in anger.]
[The two Divine statuses try to use their abilities for their own benefits.]
The eyes of the Divine statuses flashed as their chains caught the Constructs.
The frightened Dwarves looked for their owner.
[Master! Save us!]
Their words angered the Capricorn. Who the hell told them to make such a mess without saying anything?
‘Idiots.’
The Capricorn has already been wary because of Lee Gun’s strange manufacturing abilities.
‘There is no way a normal human can create a weapon with a sense of self!’
Despite what had happened, the Capricorn felt uncomfortable, as its divinity had soared. Well, it was at fault for hiding the truth from its subordinates. It should have told its subordinates that it couldn’t copy Heaven’s Punishment.
[Let them go, Serpent Bearer.]
Lee Gun lifted Heaven’s Punishment. “Why would I? You guys lost. I’m only taking what is due.”
[What’s due?]
“It was a bet. I said that if I lost, I’ll go under your temple. Since I won, it should be in reverse, right?”
This made the Capricorn glare at him. Its subordinates had recklessly set the terms of the bet, so why did it have to suffer the consequences?
Soon, the Capricorn nodded in agreement.
[Alright. I don’t care what you do with my useless servants. Do as you please.]
[Master??!!!]
[I am willing to make the concession. It also means I have nothing to do with this incident. Just take them, and fuck off—]
Kwah-jeek!!!
Heaven’s Punishment flew toward the Capricorn, and the flustered goat looked at Lee Gun.
“Where are you running away?”
[!]
“You have no sense of responsibility.” Lee Gun immediately aimed for the Capricorn’s head.
In the first place, Lee Gun had come here because he had something to squeeze out from the Capricorn.
The eyes of the Capricorn, who looked like a goat, flashed.
[Bastard! I planned on letting you off the hook. You’re merely a halfling, and you have the gall to attack me in my holy ground?!]
A Zodiac could use its power within the holy ground. Unleashing its true power within a holy ground did not put many penalties on a Zodiac.
[Do not forget this tower is my holy ground!]
Kwah-jee-jee-jeek!
When the goat extended its hand, something was summoned in the sky.
[Weapon Summon: Gramr]
It was a sword.
The Divine status of the Capricorn was called Volundr. The Capricorn was the king of the Dwarves, the most talented blacksmith. It was the being that had created all kinds of magical swords!
In the divine world, the Capricorn was famous for being one of the top blacksmiths that created weapons for the gods. It had created many Divine weapons.
As proof, a variety of weapons started appearing in the sky!
Doo-doo-doohk!
Kevin did a double take when he saw this terrifying sight. The red sword in the middle was a problem.
‘That weapon is a priceless treasure in the divine world…!’
The divine world had many holy items that were treasured like cultural assets. This weapon in particular was capable of ripping apart Divine statuses!
‘Moreover, Lee Gun was born not too long ago, so even a scratch from it will be a critical wound.’
That wasn’t all.
‘Heaven’s Punishment may be EX rank, but it has yet to undergo a proper durability test.’
It was certain death for Lee Gun. Therefore, Kevin planned on keeping the Capricorn in check with his ice.
However…
‘!’
Kevin couldn’t move his hand. The Virgo had stopped him from taking action. The reason for it was absurd.
[Let it be. If the Serpent Bearer dies from that weapon, that’s his fate.]
“…!!”
Did his Zodiac lose her mind?
‘Normally, she would be all over him!’
The angered Kevin was about to break away from his Zodiac when…
Kwahng!!!
A thundering noise rang out throughout the ground. Flashing lights accompanied it.
“Koohk!”
It was unclear how much time had passed when they saw something amazing.
“G-God-nim!”
Guisoon, who had been next to Lee Gun, almost unhinged her jaws as her mouth fell open. The reason was the sword swung by the Capricorn.
After clashing against Heaven’s Punishment, Gramr had developed a crack.
“T-The treasure of the Divine world…!”
Lee Gun grinned.
Shocked, the Capricorn created some distance between it and Lee Gun.
‘Gramr can reach past a weapon to slice the Divine status.’
However, Lee Gun’s Divine statuses were fine. The attack had failed. No. This was beyond the attack failing…!
“!!!”
The Capricorn felt a chill run up its spine as it met eyes with Lee Gun.
Lee Gun was letting out an ominous laugh! Then, he moved at a speed not visible to the naked eye as he charged the Zodiac.
Clank!!!
The violently swung ax ruthlessly crushed Gramr, a treasure considered the cultural asset of the divine world!
The Constructs were shocked by this sight.
[N-No way! Master’s weapon is something that can never be broken!]
[That bastard’s weapon broke Master’s…!!!]
If this became known in the divine world, it would cause a commotion.
At this moment, the Virgo laughed. She had been watching the battle through Kevin. As expected, Lee Gun had a connection to them.
‘If the divine world discovers the existence of a manufacturer like him, a ruckus would occur.’
She had already known Gramr wouldn’t work against Lee Gun. The Virgo thought about the thirteenth Zodiac. She had helped the serpent escape.
‘There is a reason the snake chose him.’
The serpent had been betrayed and murdered by the gods. The Virgo had secretly helped it in reincarnating. However, this life had been no different for the serpent than the one before.
After reincarnating, the serpent had been in danger of being discovered, so the Virgo had taken action so that it could safely flee.
‘I never expected it to meet Lee Gun as a result.’
Its fate completely changed thanks to the encounter.
“Well, let’s do this.”
[!]
After destroying the weapon, Lee Gun let out a cold laugh. The power of the Serpent Bearer surged forth!
[Death Instinct]
[You have released 100% of your power under control.]
[The Ring that controls the Power screams, saying you didn’t give a warning again.]
When the controlled power was released, a powerful earthquake occurred within the building.
Koo-goo-goohng!
At the same time, the enormous light attacked the Capricorn. The light split through the goat’s body and horns.
[Ahhhk!]
Lee Gun laughed. The Zodiac’s horns weren’t just normal decorations.
[You have acquired the Design Book of the Capricorn.]
They were what Lee Gun had been aiming for in the first place.
‘I’ll be able to learn about the divine rank weapons from the divine world.’
In other words, this was top secret information for the gods. Moreover, Lee Gun would be able to freely make SSS-rank (Divine rank) weapons that only the gods used.
‘The knowledge I possess is limited.’
Was it because the Capricorn had its secret blueprints stolen? The Zodiac was flustered.
The Capricorn had been about to take out more weapons when Kevin tried to move against it, angering it.
[If this is how you’re going to do things, the Capricorn temple won’t make any equipment for humanity!!]
“!”
It was a threat. That wasn’t all.
[Who do you think designed the domes that humanity trusts and relies on?]
The Capricorn laughed. Humanity wouldn’t be able to reject the temple of the manufacturers. It needed the temple.
“We won’t entrust our weapons with you guys anymore!!”
“How can we trust someone that changed the origin of Heaven’s Punishment?”
[!!]
The people that the Zodiac assumed it could sway were grinding their teeth. It wasn’t just them.
“We refuse to follow the Capricorn.”
[…!]
The master craftsmen of the Genius Workshop, who had fought against Lee Gun, threw a revolt. Taylor, the temple’s Ten Star and these craftsmen’s leader, led the charge.
The Capricorn was shocked. These were the core disciples who made up the Capricorn temple.
In truth, its power had started waning. The reason was simple.
‘Their faith toward the Capricorn is falling…!’
This was all thanks to Lee Gun. It meant the downfall of the Capricorn temple.
Lee Gun laughed as he held the severed horns. “I’ll use the Capricorn’s ingredients very well.”
Accompanying his laughter, a black circle appeared below the goat. It was the Pool skill that had finished its cooldown time.
The Zodiac’s scream rang out.
* * *
Around that time, Hugo, who was inside the Archer Saint’s holy ground, screamed as he looked at his phone. “No. This isn’t it. This really isn’t it!”
It looked as if he had seen something wretched, and there was a reason for that.
[Massive Change to the Temple Ranking]
Rank 1: Serpent Bearer Temple (Taurus Temple)
Rank 2: Virgo temple
Rank 3: Aquarius temple
Rank 4: Pisces temple
Rank 5: Gemini temple
Rank 6: Scorpio temple
Rank 7: Libra temple
Rank 8: Leo temple
Rank 9: Aries temple
Rank 10: Sagittarius temple
Rank 11: Capricorn temple
Rank 12: Cancer temple
“No!!! This can’t be! There is no way Gun is ranked number one!” Hugo was about to spit fire from his mouth.
Moments ago, his subordinates had come to him shouting with joy.
“Saint-nim! We finally did it!”
“We finally cracked the top ten of the temple rankings!”
“I’ll never forget this!’”
Delighted, Hugo had checked the ranking. This ranking wasn’t a ranking of power, yet he was interested in it. Moreover, his heart was full from entering the top ten for the first time.
However, this feeling lasted only a moment.
“What the hell? Why is Gun ranked number one!!!”
His son pouted. “What do you mean, why? Of course, our uncle is number one.”
“This isn’t it!”
Puffin let out a bright smile as if he immediately recognized the problem that was the source of Hugo’s anger.
“Ah. Don’t worry about it! This is the ranking that came out when the incident within the World Workshop occurred last night. It is when he peaked. The reputation of the Serpent Bearer rose because of the Capricorn disciples. However, the ranking takes in various factors, so it should change soon. Don’t worry about…”
Chun Sungjae kicked Puffin, while Hugo became angry.
‘I thought it wasn’t a farfetched dream to reach the eighth place if the runaway Aries could be found.’
However, the eighth place wasn’t a problem. Hugo ground his teeth when he imagined Lee Gun’s expression when he would make fun of him.
‘At this rate, it is a matter of time before Gun cements himself as number one.’
It was said the Capricorn temple was going to merge with the Serpent Bearer soon, like the Taurus temple.
‘I guess it doesn’t matter.’
Unlike the Taurus temple, the master craftsmen of the Capricorn temple were very prideful.
‘There is no way he’ll easily merge with….’
At that moment, however…
“Please take us in as disciples, Lee Gun-nim!”
“Lee Gun-nim! I’ll do whatever!”
“?!”
Hugo was shocked to hear the voices coming from outside the Sagittarius temple. An enormous crowd of master craftsmen had gathered outside the Archer Saint’s holy ground. They numbered in the hundreds.
Hugo’s mouth fell open when he looked outside the window. “What the hell is up with them?”
“Lee Gun-nim! We fell for you when we saw you manufacture those items!”
“?!”
Hugo reared back in shock when he saw the handsome man standing in front of the group
‘My god! That star master craftsman wants to go under Gun??’
Taylor, the head of the Genius Workshop, and those considered the best in their field were gathered there.
Even the Zodiac Saints looked at them as if they were celebrities. They were all famous top stars.
People like them were on their knees as they asked Lee Gun to take them in as disciples!
‘There is no way Gun will accept them. His personality won’t allow it.’
In the past, Lee Gun had beaten people half to death when they wanted to come under him as his students.
Since Hugo needed to inform Lee Gun about this development, he called Lee Gun, who should be with Hailey right now.
“Ah!”
Hugo became surprised by the notification.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: Why did you run away? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Why did you run away? (1)
Hugo was surprised by the sudden notification.
[A god of the Pantheon in the Divine world is aiming for the empty seat among the twelve Zodiacs.]
[It is aiming for the Taurus’s Seat of power]
…
[It is aiming for the Cancer’s Seat of power.]
[It is aiming for the Capricorn’s Seat of power.]
‘What the hell is this?’
Hugo was taken aback.
When he turned his head, Chun Sungjae and Puffin looked surprised as well. They seemed to have heard the notification, too.
Of course, their reaction to it was completely different.
“Uncle is the best. Uncle is the best. Uncle is the best. Uncle is the best. Uncle is the best. Uncle is the best. Please let me record Uncle’s voice. Please let me record Uncle’s voice! I like Uncle so much!”
“Ah… It’s Lee Gun-nim’s voice again.”
Unlike Hugo, these two had heard the voice of Lee Gun.
“I still can’t get used to the kind tone of his voice…”
“I don’t care. Just let me be able to record that voice. Let me be able to record it. Let me be able to record it. Let me be able to record it. Let me be able to record it. Let me be able to record it!!”
Chun Sungjae wailed as he turned on the recording function of his phone. However, it was useless.
Puffin sounded a bit sullen as he said, “Is it possible to mute this voice? This never happened when I was in the Leo temple— Kuh-huhk!!”
He immediately got a kick from Chun Sungjae.
“Mute? How can you say such a ludicrous statement as a disciple of the Serpent Bearer?” Chun Sungjae claimed that Puffin’s faith had fallen again and quickly replayed the music file. “Hurry up and raise your faith, Muffin!! Hurry!”
“Ahhhk! I have had enough of Lee Gun-nim’s hymn! Even if the heavenly Yooha-nim sang it, I’ve had enough!”
Faith wasn’t a permanent thing. It was like a relationship, which deteriorated without any interaction. Faith could fall, and this could lead to a revolt. Furthermore, a disciple might develop a skill that could be harmful to their Zodiac.
While disciples gave great power to the Zodiacs, they could also become poison if mismanaged. They were a double-edged sword. Therefore, the management of faith was a must!
“Here! Listen to it!!! If you don’t like my sister’s version, you can hear mine!”
“Ahhhk! Help me!”
Hugo looked appalled by the strong management style of his son. It was also related to him being able to see the faith of his son and Puffin with his eyes.
[Chun Sungjae’s Serpent Bearer Faith: 330%]
[Puffin’s Serpent Bearer Faith: 90%]
Puffin’s faith had been forced to go up to 100% when he had entered the Serpent Bearer temple. And thanks to Sungjae’s persistent management of his disciples, Puffin’s faith normally hovered around 90%.
On the other hand…
‘I have no words when it comes to my son. His faith is 300%.’
Hugo was worried because a faith of that magnitude meant Sungjae might give his life for Lee Gun. Besides that, Hugo was also covetous of the song sung by his daughter. So he wanted his son’s phone.
[You have rented the “Steal Information” skill from the Scorpio temple.]
[It’s a VIP rank. You can steal the target’s (Chun Sungjae’s phone) data (Photos: 647,898. Videos: 1 TB. Audio Files: 240GB) whenever you want.]
Hugo flinched at the incredible amount of data. He tried to narrow it down to the data related to Lee Gun.
[Lee Gun-related data (Photos: 647,897. Videos: 1TB. Audio Files: 240GB)]
“….”
Everything except one picture was related to Gun??? Moreover, what was this other photo? Well, it wasn’t important right now.
“Doesn’t the Pantheon refer to the Divine world, Saint-nim?”
“!”
Hugo became sober at Lee Jaewon’s words.
As the name implied, Pantheon was a temple where tens of thousands of gods lived. The divine world was a place where the twelve Zodiacs and other varieties of gods existed.
Anyway, the divine world was connected to various dimensions and also to the earth.
When humanity had made connections with the twelve Zodiacs, it enjoyed the benefit of receiving protection from the Zodiacs.
‘According to Gun, one can’t reach that place unless one reaches divinity.’
Within humanity, his friend was the only one able to go there right now.
What were the nameless gods from that place aiming for?
“Aren’t the Seats of power referring to the thrones of the twelve Zodiacs?”
Hugo nodded at Puffin’s question. “Yes. Above all else, Gun needs it if he wants a merger. It’ll allow him to bring the power of the other temples into the temple of the Serpent Bearer.”
“!”
Lee Gun already possessed the Seats of power for the Taurus temple and the Aquarius temple. He had yet to acquire the Seats of power for the Cancer temple and the Capricorn temple.
Without finding their Seats of power, Lee Gun couldn’t use the data he had acquired. The reason was simple.
[The destruction of the Zodiacs has created vacant seats. Skills from these temples are currently “unavailable.”]
[You have to find the Seats of power for a merger, or you can bring them in as affiliates. Only then will the skills be reusable.]
There were several reasons the remaining Seats of power had to be recovered for, but…
“The Ten Star of the Cancer temple ran away with it, so my sister went looking for it. I have no idea what is going on with the Capricorn temple.”
Hugo nodded.
“Normally, the Zodiacs have it, but the Capricorn is gone now. I have no idea how to find the Seat of power…”
“Ah! That’s in our holy ground.”
“?!”
Hugo almost screamed when he heard the voice next to him. The one next to him was the head of the Capricorn temple, Taylor, who had arrived here in an attempt to become Lee Gun’s student.
Hugo shouted, “When did you guys come in?”
“Ah! The door was open. Anyway, this is a serious situation. We planned on giving the Capricorn’s Seat of power to Lee Gun-nim.”
“What? Why?!”
“What do you mean, why? If we give it to Lee Gun-nim, he might accept us as his students.”
“…?!”
This bastard knew Lee Gun’s personality, so it seemed he had prepared a bribe…! While Hugo thought Taylor was quite meticulous, he also looked worried.
‘This is going to be troublesome.’
It had to do with the future that Hugo had seen not too long ago.
[Delphi Oracle (SS)]
He had seen Lee Gun surrounded by beings wearing strange masks, and Lee Gun’s appearance started to change in odd ways. Lee Gun’s appearance had taken a serious turn as his skin came off… He looked abnormal.
‘Something is going to happen to Gun. I’m sure of it.’
He had no choice but to be worried. Then there were the words spoken by the Sagittarius.
– There is no way the other gods will stand by and watch when there are vacancies in the temples.
Basically, powerful beings that wanted to become Zodiacs would gather like mad. Even now, the gods were gathering.
Since his friend possessed numerous Seats of power, he would be in danger. However, something was odd about this.
‘It’s too early.’
The Sagittarius said it’d take several years at the very least. So what had happened?
The Sagittarius seemed to be thinking along the same line, and he spoke.
[The Sagittarius complains. This has to do with the Serpent Bearer. He’s asking why you aren’t moving quickly.]
[The Sagittarius says the Serpent Bearer is busy making his wig. Since strength is your only virtue, he says his servant should move quickly. He jeers.]
[The Sagittarius says he raised your salary by ten thousand won. He’s angry that you are too slow…]
In the end, Hugo took out a tiny dagger.
His son, Puffin, and Lee Jaewon became surprised when Hugo tried to unsheathe the dagger. It was the Serpent Bearer’s badge, which Hugo had received last time.
“S-Saint-nim? You will be transferred to the Serpent Bearer temple if you unsheathe it…”
“D-Dad?”
“Pass this message along to Gun, Sungjae. My Zodiac said he wants to merge the Sagittarius temple, too.”
“What?!”
“My Zodiac also wants to be dismantled, so he could be made into my bow. Deliver that.”
[?!!]
Hugo moved as he left behind his despairing Zodiac.
* * *
Around that time, she was inside the hotel located on the forty-fifth floor of the World Workshop.
“Sigh! I showed an unsightly part of me for the past two days.” Hailey despaired as she returned to her room.
For the past two days, she had alternated between being on cloud nine and living in the depths of despair.
She had finally gotten an invitation for dinner from Lee Gun, yet she hadn’t been able to eat. She had shown an unseemly side of her.
She showed something unsightly at the restaurant for the first time. Then, she showed something unsightly for the second time in the hotel room. The second incident had happened around dawn.
‘It’s quite unsettled out there.’
‘It’s to be expected. Lee Gun-nim won against the Capricorn temple’s Genius Workshop.’
Hailey had woken up from her unconsciousness soon. After getting up, she had gone to look for her subordinates. She moved to finish her other unfinished businesses.
She had to track down the Time monarch, whom Lee Gun was looking for. Her subordinates kept saying it would be dangerous for her if she moved closer to the unknown civilization. However, she was confident she could find that bastard if she did so.
‘I have the same blood flowing within me, so I can smell it.’
She wanted the downfall of the unknown civilization.
Anyway, Hailey had been delighted to hear about Lee Gun’s exploits that had taken place while she had been unconscious.
‘The power of the Capricorn temple would be of great help to him.’
She had returned to the room at dawn. She had taken a bath, and she had been about to go to sleep when she noticed it.
‘Why is Lee Gun here?’
Lee Gun was sleeping in her bed, wearing only his underwear!
Did he sense her presence, or did he notice his blanket was gone? When Lee Gun had opened his eyes, she had met his gaze and fainted once again.
Of course, it didn’t take her long to figure out why Lee Gun was sleeping in her room.
* * *
Back to the present.
Hailey glanced at the main instigator behind that event.
The man was grinding his teeth in front of her. “Why are you being like this? I gave him the wrong key, so I admit my fault. However, why do I have to wear this as a result?”
It was Kevin. His eyes twitched as a picture of Lee Gun was placed on the back of his head.
Hailey, who walked behind Kevin, cleared her throat as her face turned red.
“I-It is nothing. I just want you to stay like this for a moment.”
She seemed to be training little by little. At this rate, she would be able to enter a building Lee Gun had visited before.
It’d allow her to not become flustered, no matter what happened. Of course, there was a reason she wanted to get along with Lee Gun.
‘Since I am from the other side, I’ll have to disappear with them.’
However, she was thinking about the immediate future where she would have to fight with Lee Gun. When that happened, she couldn’t become a burden.
This was why her monster subordinates, who lacked common sense, told her that they were willing to mimic Lee Gun. However, she had cut them down.
“Anyway, you and Hugo are the only ones amongst the twelve Zodiac Saints who are similar in size to Lee Gun, and Hugo is busy right now.”
“Are you saying I’m not busy?”
“You have a debt to pay…”
Kwahng!
One of the nearby front windows broke.
Crash!
They immediately put up their guards as they brought out their weapons.
“This isn’t natural. We are under attack!”
Kevin furrowed his brows when he heard Hailey’s words.
“The dome around the tower was broken. Is it a black zone rank monster?”
“No, it isn’t a monster. It’s a god.”
“God? Is it a Construct?”
At that moment, Lee Gun appeared behind them. “No, it isn’t a Construct. It’s a Divine-rank being.”
“!!”
Lee Gun, who had a large bundle slung over his shoulder, laughed. The bundle held all the defensive holy items that he had made.
Since this place had expensive ingredients, he had been busy making holy items by stealing the ingredients.
[Since you made numerous holy items, the EXP of Life has risen.]
[Currently, Life is at stage 3.]
[You can use a new Life skill: Creation]
[Warning! The outer gods are trying to acquire the empty seats of the twelve Zodiacs possessed by the Serpent Bearer.]
At the same time, Lee Gun laughed as he looked at the stars that could be seen through the window. They were the culprits who had attacked this place.
Hailey and Kevin were taken aback when they realized who had staged the attack.
‘The outer gods!’
“Shit! They are here to take the Seat of power inside the holy ground!”
“They plan on stealing the Seat of power to become the new Zodiac!”
“The twelve Zodiacs are high-rank divinities that all gods covet…!”
The fact that the Serpent Bearer was trying to consume all of them was monstrous.
However, Lee Gun laughed in derision. “No. They are here with me in mind.”
Kevin was puzzled. “What? They aren’t the twelve Zodiacs, so how did they locate you?”
The outer gods were located in a region that was far from the divine world. There was no way they would know what was going on here. They had no reason to target Lee Gun.
Lee Gun laughed as if it wasn’t a big deal. “I know why this is happening.”
“What?”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. It was far away from here, but Lee Gun could feel it.
‘The one that went away first came back.’
Yes, there was a Zodiac that couldn’t be found even when he tried to track it down. It was the Aries, whose presence couldn’t even be felt.
This Zodiac had hidden so well that not a hint of its presence could be found. That was also the reason the Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints made fun of it.
It was also why Yang Wei had become Lee Gun’s first victim.
‘When the Cancer was killed, all the others appeared except one.’
However, Lee Gun could faintly feel its energy. It was one of the culprits that had allied itself with Giselle to push him into the tower twenty-four years ago.
It was the presence of the bastard who had sold the information about the Serpent Bearer to the unknown civilization!
‘I was wondering where it went after abandoning its Zodiac Saint.’
There was no mistaking it. As soon as it recognized Lee Gun, it had run away and returned, leading the outer gods here.
Since Lee Gun’s enemies were being eliminated one by one, the Aries knew it was a target, and it was scared.
Therefore, it had brought allies.
‘Moreover, it’s said that one’s divinity and reputation rise just from sitting in the seat of the twelve Zodiacs.’
Some gods had power, yet no reputation. Others were trying to build their army. The outer gods were like mad hyenas as their eyes flashed.
An empty Temple was good bait.
[The enemies are aiming for the Serpent Bearer.]
[The Aries is aiming for the Serpent Bearer.]
But Lee Gun didn’t care since he had been looking for Aries. He had questions he wanted to ask.
‘This is good.’
Soon, he blew a whistle, surprising Kevin and Hailey.
Lee Gun had summoned something. Then, he jumped down from the tower of the World Workshop.
“Lee Gun?!”
“It’s fine. Just get me some Coca-cola.”
“What?!”
“Coke goes best with lamb kebab.”
Kevin spoke out in protest. “What the hell are you talking about? Beer goes best with lamb kebab, idiot!”

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Why did you run away? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Why did you run away? (2)
Kwahng! Kwahng!
The vast desert in Australia!
The Great Sandy Desert, where the Capricorn’s holy ground was located!
The holy land of tens of thousands of master craftsmen!
The World Workshop was in an uproar.
“Koo-oohk! What’s going on?”
“It’s an emergency!”
A bombardment was raining down on them from somewhere in the sky. The beam of light was like a laser. The bombardment continued as it flew through the night sky, as if it planned on destroying the World Workshop.
Boom! Boom!
The master craftsmen were basically the building’s residents, so they were frightened of their wits!
“It’s an attack!”
“The dome is broken!”
They continued to hold on to the shaking buildings. When they looked up into the sky, they saw a shining light.
The master craftsmen ground their teeth.
“Is it a flying-type monster?”
“No! It isn’t a monster!”
“What?! What is it then?”
“Its power is similar to the power of the gods…!”
“What? It’s a god?!”
Chris, one of the top master craftsmen of the Capricorn temple, furrowed his brows when he received the report from his subordinate.
Chris was the third in line within Capricorn temple, serving the Capricorn Saint Sergeyevich and the Ten Star Taylor. He was a master craftsman who specialized in accessory-type holy items, and he was one of the star master craftsmen who had participated in the manufacturing battle against Lee Gun. He had done so alongside the defensive-gear specialist Taylor.
Chris had been tasked with defending the holy ground instead of Taylor, who had gone to ask Lee Gun to accept them as students.
Chris furrowed his brows.
‘Shit! These aren’t monsters. Gods are attacking humanity’s workshop?’
His reaction was understandable since the twelve Zodiacs had made several absolute agreements. One of these agreements was a nonaggression pact.
It was a pact that said they’d never attack locations that would cause a profound effect on the survivability of humanity.
While each of the twelve Zodiacs had different interests, they had a basic understanding that they existed to protect humanity.
‘The World Workshop is where all the weapons and equipment that’ll help humanity survive are made!’
The World Workshop going down meant the destruction of humanity. So who was attacking this place?
“What are you guys doing? Raise your weapons!”
“That’s right! We can’t let them destroy the location where we’ll host Lee Gun-nim!”
Yes, half of the master craftsmen had fallen for Lee Gun at first sight. They had started making a Lee Gun Workshop. They were clamoring to bring in Lee Gun instead of the missing Capricorn.
“Ooh-ohhhhhh! Lee Gun is the great manufacturer god! How can a magician or a warrior become the Zodiac of manufacturing?”
“That’s right! We have to bring Lee Gun-nim as our Zodiac!”
Chris also yelled as enemies entered the tower. “Protect the holy ground that’ll host Lee Gun-nim!!”
Hearing Chris, the conservative master craftsmen cursed.
“Hey, Chris! As a master craftsman of the Genius workshop, don’t be an instigator for strange ideas!”
“Our Zodiac Saint is gone. The Ten Star who’s supposed to be in charge of the temple has fallen for Lee Gun. You shouldn’t act this way as the third in line!”
“That’s right! We heard Lee Gun-nim was excellent, but he probably has only the know-how to make a couple of weapons!”
“The Capricorn made Drachma and this tower! How dare you compare it to a human!”
Chris unsheathed his drill. “Shut up! Just protect it for now! We are still connected to our Zodiac’s power!”
“That’s right! Don’t look down on us because we aren’t fighters!”
There was a reason these craftsmen could fight monsters.
The enemies were sent flying out of the tower, one by one.
Kwahng!!
Clank!
