“Kuh-huhk!”
But then, the weapons that they held were ruthlessly destroyed. At the same time, ghosts started sticking their heads through the broken windows.
“Kuh-huhk!”
The smell of blood instantly permeated throughout the tower as the tower descended into hell.
“Ahhhk! What are they?”
“Are they Constructs?”
“No! They are different from the Constructs! Ahhhk!”
The interior of the tower turned into a scene of carnage, and the number of enemies increased.
When enemies started dragging out the master craftsmen, Chirs ground his teeth. The other master craftsmen shook in fear.
“Shit! This is the end for all of us!”
“That’s right! Why should we serve Lee Gun as our Zodiac? What can he do?”
“It was all nonsense from the beginning…!”
At that moment…
Doo-doo-doohk!
“!!”
It sounded as if heaven and earth were ringing. All the master craftsmen shook.
“W-What the hell is that sound?”
At the same time, those who had looked out the window started to foam at their mouths. The intruder gods were surprised as well.
It was like watching the land of an immortal descend as it parted the clouds. Moreover, the object coming down from among the clouds looked familiar.
“C-Can it be!”
They saw something resembling a ship’s anchor hanging from chains. Then there were the long pillars.
[Floaty (previously Drachma) (EX)]
“Ahhk! That’s nuts! That’s Drachma, which Lee Gun took!”
Yes, Lee Gun had summoned Drachma.
“I… Its appearance has changed?”
“W… What the hell is that?”
Drachma had been created by the Capricorn, and the master craftsmen had applied the finishing touches. Although the flying castle’s appearance had changed, they naturally recognized it.
“D-Didn’t Lee Gun take it, saying he’ll be remodeling it?”
“Yes…!”
The jaws of the master craftsmen almost became unhinged when their mouths fell open. The castle’s appearance wasn’t the only thing that had changed.
“No way! Why is it so big?!”
Yes, the new Drachma descending from the sky looked like an enormous battleship with no end in sight!
Koo-goo-goo!
It was so large that it could almost cover the entirety of the vast desert. Of course, the previous Drachma under the management of the twelve Zodiacs wasn’t small either. But it was about as large as an amusement park and shaped like a circle with buildings embedded in it.
Now, it was a different story.
Koo-goo-goo!
The new Drachma had an elongated shape. It looked like a sky ship that would travel through heaven and earth! That wasn’t all.
“T-That’s crazy. While he was remodeling it, he changed the material Drachma is made with?”
Since these master craftsmen were in charge of repairing Drachma, they knew its structure. That was why they reared back in shock.
“What the hell! In the past, it used to be made out of earth! Did he line it with steel?”
“Steel? There is no way that’s steel! Can’t you tell just by looking at it?”
“What is it? Where did he get such an amazing mineral?”
The master craftsmen started to foam at their mouths when they checked the flying castle.
“Ahhhk!! That’s the Cancer!”
“That crazy bastard! Lee Gun used the Cancer as an ingredient!”
“W-What?!”
“That’s crazy! Lee Gun made a new Drachma!”
The master craftsmen who had disparaged Lee Gun before couldn’t shut their mouths.
Chris laughed at this. “So who has a limited ability to make weapons?”
“That’s not—”
“In the first place, he’s someone who made a weapon using the Leo’s tooth. It’s easy for him to make such a thing.”
“What?! Leo?!”
“Wow! From the looks of it, Drachma’s offensive capabilities are no joke.”
“What? It’s a floating castle. Why would it have offensive capabilities? Stop talking nonsense—”
Before the master craftsman could finish, a light erupted from Drachma. Then, a boom rang out!
Kwahng!!!
It sounded like a missile being launched.
The master craftsmen looked at Drachma at the same time, and the sight left them shocked.
“What the hell! I thought it looked like a battleship. He really equipped Drachma with weapons?!”
Drachma was newly equipped with cannons. It seemed Lee Gun had used all the ingredients that he had gathered until now.
Drachma once again fired its laser cannon!
Kwahng!
The energy of the Zodiacs stored within the castle was mixed with Lee Gun’s magical energy, and it exploded on the enemies
Kwah-kwah-gwahng!
[“Made from Crab Shell” is overjoyed.]
[“Made from Crab Shell” is eating other weapons to grow.]
Black tentacles appeared from the cannons set up on the edges of Drachma. The tentacles entered the castle through the broken windows and ate all the broken weapons of the Capricorn disciples.
One could see the small cannons grow a bit before they fired once again!
Kwahng!
[Serpent Bearer EXP has increased.]
[Serpent Bearer’s reputation has increased.]
[It won’t be long before you reach Level 30.]
The attacks swept away the unknown pawns that had gathered inside the tower.
The Capricorn disciple could only open and close their mouths.
“Aren’t those our weapons…!”
“Were they always able to generate such power?”
“The way Drachma is used… Didn’t it change too much?”
However, it was too early to be in awe.
“Kyaahhhk! Lee Gun-nim jumped off the tower!”
“He jumped down onto Drachma!”
“!”
Was this the reason he had summoned it?
Drachma had been steadily moving toward the ground when it stopped, and Lee Gun jumped down on top of it.
The master craftsmen took up their weapons.
“I see! Lee Gun-nim plans to defeat the enemies by using Drachma!”
“We have to help him!”
“Uh? Wait a moment!”
“!”
“T-The item slung over Lee Gun-nim’s shoulder! Can it be…”
“Isn’t that the Capricorn’s throne that is supposed to be within the tower?!”
“What?!”
* * *
He was on top of Drachma.
The dumbfounded Kevin looked at Lee Gun. Aside from Drachma being turned into a fortress, his reaction had to do with the item Lee Gun was holding.
“You… When did you get that item…”
There was no mistaking it. The item sticking out from Lee Gun’s sack was the throne of the Capricorn temple.
Of course, the legs of the chair, as well as its back, were gone. Only the seat was left. It was an odd sight, but that wasn’t important right now.
“How were you able to bring that….”
“How else? I brought it here after I took my hammer to it.”
“Is that the reason it has no legs?
“How were you able to destroy and take that throne with you? Only the Capricorn is supposed to be allowed to approach it…”
How else?
Lee Gun laughed as he took out something. “I acquired these things from the Capricorn.”
“!”
What he took out was the red goat’s horn and a roll of paper (blueprints).
“Since I have these, it mistook me for the Capricorn.”
“!”
The Seat of power had made a mistake since both Lee Gun and the Capricorn were manufacturers.
“That’s why it tried to go back to sleep, so I took my hammer to its body.”
That had caused the broken throne to try to activate its protection ability, but…
‘I stole it using a skill.’
Lee Gun turned to Hailey. “I borrowed the Scorpio temple’s Steal skill. It was a VVIP skill. Thank you!”
“…!!”
When Lee Gun laughed, Hailey turned her head away as her face turned red.
Her prep work seemed to have been effective. She hadn’t fallen unconscious this time.
“Anyway, the gods will no longer attack that place, since they are aiming for this throne.”
Kevin’s eyes turned round. He had been wondering why Lee Gun had stolen something, which wasn’t his style.
“You are trying to lure the enemies.” That wasn’t all. “Did you call in Drachma because you didn’t want normal land to be affected?” Kevin’s mouth fell open.
Lee Gun grinned. “That’s part of the reason, but I also have yet to acquire the Capricorn’s core.”
“!”
“It ran away before I could acquire its core.”
“We should track it down…!”
“I tried to, but it seems the Aries took the Capricorn.”
“What?!”
“Yang Wei, who was also a captive in our holy ground, ran away too.”
“What?! How was Yang Wei able to pull that off?”
Lee Gun laughed in contempt. “How else? Since his Zodiac had appeared, he ran away by putting his life on the line. His Contract with his Zodiac was broken, but he probably wants to make the contract again.”
Kevin and Hailey looked at Lee Gun as if to ask how he could let Yang Wei get away. However, they had a realization when they saw Lee Gun’s expression.
‘This bastard let him get away on purpose. He acted like he didn’t see Yang Wei.’
It seemed their assumption was correct.
Lee Gun let out a savage laugh.
[Warning! The nameless gods from the outside are aiming for the seat of the Serpent Bearer.]
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed when he heard the notification. He then tapped the ground of Drachma. “Chase it. It’s somewhere you know very well.”
As if answering to his words, the enormous flying castle started to move.
* * *
Around that time, the Aries was taking deep breaths. It had been the first one to realize the return of the Serpent Bearer, and it had run away realizing the dangers.
‘If Lee Gun is alive, we are all dead.’
This had a deep connection to the secret they were trying to hide. Therefore, the Aries had kept the main gods in the dark, as it called for the outer gods.
The Aries gnashed its teeth. The fault lay with the monarchs, who failed to do their jobs properly.
‘If they had killed that snake bastard at that time, this would have never happened!’
Because of them, the thirteenth awakened being had appeared for nothing. Someone like Lee Gun had been created!
However, that wasn’t what Aries truly feared; it didn’t fear the power of the snake that Lee Gun had acquired.
The Aries wouldn’t be running away like a madman if that was true. It had run away for only one reason.
‘The Serpent Bearer.’
There was no denying it.
‘That bastard Lee Gun….’
Boom!
Suddenly, someone appeared behind Aries.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Why did you run away? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Why did you run away? (3)
[This is crazy!]
The day when the Devil’s Tower was destroyed!
The Aries ground its teeth as it cussed.
The Zodiac Saints were shocked by the destruction of the Devil’s Tower. However, the shock they felt couldn’t be compared to what the Zodiacs felt. It was to be expected.
[Doesn’t this mean the halfling’s plan failed, Giselle?!]
The tower was where they had assassinated Lee Gun. It was a small phenomenon, but the guilty conscience needs no accuser. What if Lee Gun had come back out alive? Of course, the tower had been quiet for the past twenty years.
The Constructs had tried to soothe the nervous Aries.
[If he were still alive, he would have come out earlier. Why would he come out now, twenty years later? That’s so random.]
[Yes. That place is the tower of a monarch. If there is a possibility, the monarch might have experimented inside.]
[However, the Cancer gave you information on the framework of the tower several times, and you confirmed it for yourself.]
All the Zodiacs had put out the contract for the murder. Moreover, the ones to set up the details of Lee Gun’s assassination were Giselle and Jean-Louis.
The Aries had many misgivings, so it had borrowed Yang Wei’s body several times to meet Jean-Louis, who would carry out the deed. It had received the tower’s map from him.
At the time, Jean-Louis had laughed in derision as he handed over the map.
– You borrowed your Zodiac Saint’s body to come here. It seems you’re anxious about this. I already went over ten times on how I’ll be killing Lee Gun.
[Shut up, you lowly halfling monster.]
Jean-Louis had glared at the Aries with the eyes of a monster. However, the Aries didn’t care.
[This is true for you and Giselle. There is no way I’ll trust you dirty bastards to plan something that’ll affect civilization.]
– Then why don’t you guys take care of him yourselves? Oh, fake gods.
[!]
The angered Aries glared at him.
[Did that monarch maggot Giselle go so far as to tell someone like you?]
Jean-Louis clutched at his stomach as he laughed.
– I took a stab in the dark since I had a hunch. Is it really true?
[…!]
– That’s a relief. Now I know why you’re all silent when Giselle crosses the line. There is no way the twelve Zodiacs are afraid of Giselle. That means you’re afraid of what she might say.
[You should know your place before you speak.]
When the angered Aries let out its divine status, Jean-Louis let out a shrewd laugh.
– Do not worry. I have ill feelings toward Lee Gun too, so I won’t fail.
[Can I trust you?]
– I am well aware of the fact that you guys are afraid of Lee Gun.
[You are going to act like this until the end.]
– Of course, I have no idea why you are that much more afraid of Lee Gun in comparison to the other Zodiacs.
From several aspects, there had been a lot of loose ends, but the Aries had decided to ignore them afterward. Therefore, it hadn’t stopped its Zodiac Saint when he said he was going to Korea.
That was what had happened before the destruction of the Devil’s Tower, and when the tower crumbled…
“Where do you think you’re going? I’ll feel disappointed if you run away already. I have a lot of questions to ask you.”
Lee Gun had appeared! Moreover, his face and magical energy were completely different!
‘Those maggots failed at assassinating him!’
They had arrogantly made sarcastic remarks! Moreover, there was now an odd divine status around Lee Gun as if he had awakened as a low-rank god!
‘As expected, they were more bark than bite!’
Of course, the plan had been perfect. The variable was Lee Gun, who had broken that plan. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘I’ll have to kill him myself.’
Fortunately, Lee Gun was still a low-rank god. The Aries didn’t think it would be difficult to kill a newly born being. However…
“The weakness of the temple of wealth is obvious.”
As soon as Lee Gun had used the 13th Sense skill, the Aries had frozen at once.
Although it had happened for a moment, Aries was certain. The Zodiac had caught a glimpse of the energy when Lee Gun used his skill!
‘Serpent Bearer!’
That was the energy of the thirteenth Zodiac, the true owner of the Serpent Bearer (Ophiuchus).
This had shocked the Aries. It felt as if it was looking at an ancient being that should have been long gone from this world.
‘It shouldn’t exist in this world anymore.’
The current twelve Zodiacs had done the act with their own hands. It was a different being from the snake that they had killed by hiring the monarchs.
Like the serpent that they had killed, it was the owner of the thirteenth Zodiac. It meant there were thirteen Zodiacs.
On the other hand, Lee Gun was…
‘C-Could it be the former owner of the throne?’
Realizing this truth, the Aries had run away. This was such a grave matter that the Aries didn’t even think about its Zodiac Saint.
‘It’s a threat that’ll annihilate the existence of the twelve Zodiacs.’
This was a problem that the Aries couldn’t handle any longer. There was a high probability that it was mistaken. However, if it was right, the price it would have to pay would be too high.
This was why Aries had hidden while throwing away its Zodiac Saint. It didn’t have the time to notify the other Zodiacs. It didn’t have close comrades.
Moreover, if it told her, Giselle would probably cook up some funny business. She was like a snake in that regard.
That woman had come to their side as a spy. And when she was found out, she had eaten the Libra and the Libra Saint. She was a treacherous being.
Although she was a card thrown away by the monarchs, she was still a monarch-rank being. She wasn’t an opponent to take lightly.
Therefore, the Aries had left earth to a place where the Serpent Bearer’s power couldn’t reach it. Then it came up with a plan to solve this problem.
Of course, it had never expected so many of its fellow Zodiacs to fall in such a short period.
‘As expected, I made the right move to run as soon as I saw him.’
***
Back to the present…
[Are you sure I can take the empty seat of a Zodiac?]
Suspicious shadows appeared around the Aries. These shadows were shaped like beasts, humans, and other beings. They were the gods without a temple.
The Aries had lured them with the empty temples and its power of Wealth. While these gods didn’t have temples, they were powerful beings.
They resided in a different region, but some amongst them could even kill a Zodiac in short order. Therefore, the shadows were grinning.
[We were told we shouldn’t dare approach high-rank temples since we don’t have any basis to do so. This really is out of the ordinary.]
[I never expected one of the prideful twelve Zodiacs to get the outer gods involved.]
Aries was about to snort. It didn’t need them to talk about such trivial things when…
[Yes. I never expected you to do this.]
[!!]
Aries turned around when it heard a familiar voice. It saw familiar figures. One was the furious Capricorn, and the other one was…
[Sagittarius!]
However, the Sagittarius’s appearance was a bit odd. For some reason, he had worn a horse mask. However, that didn’t matter right now.
The Aries immediately had an expression as if it wanted to throttle the Sagittarius by the neck.
[You bastard! Did you oppose our decision at the time to kill Lee Gun because you knew of his identity?]
The Sagittarius didn’t say anything since that wasn’t a false statement. However, that wasn’t important right now.
[Of all the bastards you could bring, you brought them.]
These outer gods were lawless bottom feeders that the Zodiacs avoided.
‘They don’t care about the safety of humans.’
The Sagittarius jeered.
[Were you that afraid of the serpent god’s power?]
Aries was dumbfounded by the ridicule, and it got angry.
[Do you not remember what that serpent tried to do to us? It tried to erase our existence!]
[We were the ones to wield our blades first. The serpent tried to use the power of Cycle.]
[It’s the same thing! If it had activated the power of Cycle, we would have died!]
[That’s why we killed it by making the serpent into the god of calamity.]
[It’s the god of calamity! A calamity that would bring the end to the gods!]
As these two Zodiacs acted as if it were invisible, the Capricorn became angry.
[Stop talking about old stories! How dare you put up my seat as bait! Also, it isn’t as if I completely lost my seat!]
[Who told you to lose to that bastard? It amounts to you suffering under the hands of Lee Gun.]
[My core is still intact, so I’ll be able to regain my power! And when I recover my power, I’ll gather disciples again…]
[The ship has sailed on that plan. You can’t do it with your disciples.]
When the Sagittarius kept picking at its words, the Capricorn glared at him.
[Are you looking down on the Capricorn temple since you’re a battle-type temple?]
[I’m being serious. Your disciples are all Lee Gun’s students now.]
[?!!]
[In fact, they are the ones who want to put Lee Gun in the seat of the Capricorn.]
The angered Capricorn extended its hands toward the Sagittarius and the Aries.
[I’ll kill both of you. I’ll take out both your cores and make it my power.]
At that moment, the outer gods, who had come here for the empty temples, laughed in derision.
[It isn’t time for the Zodiacs to fight amongst themselves.]
[!]
[Someone has come. Look out there.]
As those words rang out, the ground started to shake. Though, it wasn’t an earthquake. The reason was the land that they were standing on.
‘This place is the Nameless land.’
The Aries had taken refuge in the land left behind by Abundance, the land under no rule that all the Zodiacs coveted, the land of the firmament, and the land where Sungjae wanted to hatch Lee Gun’s Construct egg.
After the outer gods would have gotten rid of Lee Gun, the Aries would make this land its territory. It had come here trying to cut the line.
[Isn’t that Drachma?]
At that moment, they saw Drachma, which was supposed to be common land for the twelve Zodiacs! However, its shape and size had changed as it moved in their direction.
The Capricorn froze when it realized Lee Gun had remade the flying castle. It was able to discern Drachma’s structure at once.
The Aries froze for a different reason.
‘Lee Gun is getting closer.’
This meant he was on Drachma, which surprised the Aries.
‘This place still smells like the Abundance monarch. Moreover, the enormous power of life means that the presence of a Zodiac remains buried under it.’
The Aries had chosen to hide here for a reason.
There was no way Lee Gun would be able to pinpoint its location. They were at the center of the enormous energy where it felt like they would be swallowed.
The power was strong enough that the land didn’t take damage even as Zodiacs descended here.
‘How did Lee Gun know I’m here?’
It soon found out why.
[You’re here! I was barely able to find you!]
[?!]
The Aries reared back in shock when it heard the unexpected voice.
A monster was approaching it in the distance. This monster had worn the helmet and armor of the unknown civilization. Since the powerful sinister energy was covering the monster, Aries hadn’t noticed him until he got close.
[That bastard!]
Yes, the one to show up right now was Yang Wei!
Yang Wei was overjoyed when he discovered his Zodiac.
[Oh, god! I’m sure what happened last time was an accident. I understand! That’s why please make a contract with me again!]
The Aries ground its teeth. It could feel the Serpent Bearer’s power from Yang Wei. At the same time, it realized how Lee Gun had gotten close to it.
‘Lee Gun followed him!’
Yang Wei had been with the Aries for more than twenty years. That was why he could pinpoint its energy. He was able to find the Aries without much difficulty.
Yang Wei laughed as he spoke.
[Please do not worry! I, Yang Wei, have read your worries! I have brought information about Lee Gun—]
Kwah-jeek!
Yang Wei’s body was destroyed before he could finish speaking.
[Kuh-huhk! God?!]
The Aries’s eyes flashed as it ripped apart its Zodiac Saint.
[You useless bastard! You brought Lee Gun here!]
The Zodiac quickly turned around. It still had the power of the Aries temple and the outer gods. Also, it had a hidden power that it had stolen from the previous owner of the thrones.
Therefore, the Aries’s eyes flashed as it stabbed the Capricorn, who the outer gods were targeting.
[Kuh-huhk…!]
The Capricorn’s core was ripped out.
The Aries had considerable heavenly power. Then, it immediately looked at the Sagittarius. Was it because Lee Gun’s energy was right at its doorsteps?
‘If I go to the middle world, I’ll suffer the fate of the Aquarius. I can’t go to the divine world since I’ll be charged with treason.’
Therefore, it had to make preparations here.
[Help me, Sagittarius. It isn’t as if I’m here without making preparations. I’ll be able to get rid of Lee Gun with this.]
The Sagittarius unexpectedly became interested in the old cube the Aries brought out. With this treasure, they could harm Lee Gun.
[Oh. You’ll be able to bring the Serpent Bearer to his knees with that.]
Despite going under Lee Gun as an affiliate, the Sagittarius had a lot of complaints. The complaints had to do with the horse mask that the Sagittarius was wearing right now.
Did it read the Sagittarius’s energy? The Aries laughed as it handed over the cube.
[I’ll give you this. Let’s do this together—]
[Ahhk! It’s time for me to apply my medicine. I’m sorry! Goodbye!]
[!?]
After receiving the weapon, the Sagittarius immediately disappeared. There was no hesitation.
It seemed the Sagittarius didn’t want even a chance that he would be lumped in with the other side.
He wrote “Mutton is here” in the sky using fire letters before running away.
The flustered Aries tried to catch him.
[!]
However, the only thing he caught with his hand was the horse mask. The precious hair that fluttered in the air was a throw-in.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Why do you think I ran away? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Why do you think I ran away? (1)
At this moment, all hell broke loose on continents all around the world.
“Ahhhhk! Help!”
“What are those things?”
The reason was the mysterious shadows that had appeared from all quarters.
“They are attacking the holy ground!”
“Block them!”
South America, the location where the holy ground of the Cancer temple existed.
“Shit! They’re endless! What level monsters are these?”
“No! They aren’t monsters! They are gods!”
“What? What do you mean gods— Kuhk!”
The Cancer temple was known as the temple of crime. In line with their nature, their holy grounds were well hidden in various locations.
The underground bunker of the Cancer temple was used to train assassins under Jean-Louis’s order. It was very covert and not an easy place to enter.
However, things had changed, thanks to the Cancer temple’s collapse at the hands of Lee Gun.
[Find it.]
[Find it.]
[Find the throne.]
It was like watching a psychic phenomenon, as shadows crawled all over the walls and floors. The place was like a field of shadows.
The Cancer disciples shook in rage. It was for no other reason.
“They messed with that item!”
“It’s the weapon that we were going to use to take revenge on Lee Gun!”
“What?!”
After their Zodiac had been killed and their Zodiac Saint kidnapped, the Cancer disciples wanted revenge against Lee Gun.
They had finished making the preparations for their revenge and made something that would deal a critical blow to the Serpent Bearer. It would utilize the power of Cancer that had been stored in this holy ground.
So what was going on?
“They seem to be aiming for the Seat of power, Commander-in-chief!”
“What?”
The Ten Star (SS) of the Cancer temple, Luka, received the report from his underling. Luka furrowed his brows.
‘We had a hard time since Lee Gun kept aiming for our Seat of power!’
Lee Gun’s goals were clear.
‘He plans on taking this and stealing the power of our temple.’
Even ragtag beings were aiming for it, following Lee Gun!
‘The Seat of power belongs to Jean-Louis-nim.’
Jean-Louis’s whereabouts were still unknown.
In the Cancer temple, the Zodiac Cancer rarely sat on its Seat of power. Jean-Louis sat on it instead, as if he were the Zodiac.
What Luka sensed was that while all the other Zodiac Saints acted like servants of their Zodiacs. Jean-Louis was completely different. It felt as if he was using the Zodiac.
‘He has inhuman beauty, brains, and abilities. He has a charisma that rises above the gods.’
That was why the Cancer disciples had a feeling of reverence toward Jean-Louis. To them, he was their religious leader, their great Zodiac.
And what did these intruders want to steal?
Luka ground his teeth. “We have to quickly hide the Seat of power—”
At that moment, Luka felt something.
“!” He turned his head around.
“Commander-in-chief! Just a moment ago…!”
“Yes. I felt it too!”
They had felt Jean-Louis’s presence in the distance. To their surprise, the presence was near this place!
The disciples cheered as the energy of Jean-Louis got closer.
“Saint-nim escaped! He escaped from that dirty Lee Gun!”
Luka immediately ordered, “Bring out the Seat of power. We’ll go and greet our Saint-nim!”
They quickly took out the Cancer’s Seat of power, which they had hidden deep. If they gave it to Jean-Louis, the Cancer temple would rise once again!
Therefore, they exited the well-hidden underground bunker.
“Oh! They are coming out.”
Someone was looking down on them from a tall building.
“Haha. They are like ants filing out. I knew this would be effective.”
Holding a binocular, Carly cheerfully laughed.
Chun Yooha’s eyes flashed as she looked at the Cancer disciples. She raised her spear.
* * *
Around the same time, the Archer Saint’s holy ground was also in a precarious situation.
[Hand over Taurus’s Seat of power.]
The outer gods who Aries had called forth to kill Lee Gun had rushed toward the basement. The reason was Taurus’s Seat of power stored there.
At one time, Yang Wei’s corpse had been hidden in this basement too. It was a place that boasted iron-clad defense.
However, the intruders were formidable. The outer gods had quickly located the throne and mounted an attack.
Hugo, who had raised his level, used his abilities without hesitation. However, when he couldn’t see the end to his enemies, he became angry. “Really! Why the hell did Gun have to store something he stole in my place? He’s only living in my place because he’s renting a room! This is a nuisance for me!”
However, the Archer disciples just laughed.
“No way! He left his item in his holy ground! Why is he at fault?”
“That’s right. If we had to split the tower out of 10, Lee Gun-nim owns 7 and we own 3. In fact, we feel a bit sorry because it feels like we are the renters….”
When the Archer disciples let out bright smiles, Hugo kicked them in the butt. “If you like Gun so much, you should go serve him right now! You’ll come to your senses when Gun really treats you like his subordinates!”
“What? Really? Do you think he’ll take us in as subordinates?”
“Hell yeah! We are free from Hugo-nim!”
“If it’s Lee Gun-nim and Sungjae, we’ll be fed until we have a full stomach!”
“Thank you for everything until now!”
“Hey!”
When Hugo became angry, his son clicked his tongue.
Sungjae had been using his spells next to him. As a fellow Zodiac Saint, he seemed to understand why his father was miserable. “That’s why you should have let me give you a consultation on your finances when I offered it. At the very least, you wouldn’t be known as the poverty temple.”
Really!
“Why would I have entrusted it with you? I bet you would have used our expense budget to fanboy over Gun! Do you think I’m a fool?”
“I wouldn’t have done that! Do you think I’m that young? Even I wouldn’t have used the money of the Sagittarius temple to geek out!”
Chun Sungjae huffed as if he were being insulted.
Hahn Jimin, who stood next to him, clicked his tongue.
‘Of course, you would have geeked out.’
All the famous and foreign universities had sent Sungjae invitations for admission, including Harvard, MIT, Stanford, etc. However, the young Zodiac Saint had turned them all down for Lee Gun.
‘If I’m not in Korea, I can’t buy goods for Uncle in an expedited manner. I don’t want to get fired for that reason.’
If he were in charge of the Sagittarius temple, the money would have been embezzled and used in some way to help Lee Gun-nim’s business.
“The Sagittarius temple’s budget is chump change. I can’t even put up a billboard in Times Square using it?! Why the hell would I use the Sagittarius temple’s money to geek out?”
“What did you just say?! Really!”
Ah! It seemed Sungjae wasn’t interested in that aspect. Anyway, it didn’t matter.
Hahn Jimin had also become a disciple of the Serpent Bearer not too long ago. He quickly took out a healing potion. Of course, he hadn’t entered the temple using his own feet.
[The Taurus temple is being forcefully transferred. All the disciples will be automatically transferred.]
Hahn Jimin was Chun Sungjae’s roommate and the person who brought Lee Gun home from the tower. However, he had been a member of the Taurus temple.
Of course, he wasn’t under the directly managed temple. He was part of a small group of C-rank awakened beings who had to pay royalties to use the power of the Taurus temple. It was a nameless organization that had a total of five members.
He had never expected this to happen when the Taurus temple disappeared.
[Would you like to make a temporary contract with the Serpent Bearer?]
[You will be able to temporarily use your existing skills with the power of the Serpent Bearer.]
[It is possible to leave if you want. The only catch is that all of your skills will disappear. Please be careful in making the decision.]
He was merely a C-rank awakened being, so there weren’t any skills that he would miss. However, it was nerve-racking to become the disciple of Lee Gun.
‘I didn’t even dare to say I wanted to join.’
His best friend was a Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer, yet Hahn Jimin had been unable to speak up. He knew his place in this world.
‘The lowest-ranked disciple within the Serpent Bearer temple is of the A rank…!’
He had no idea what was going on with this temple since it had three SS-ranks. Moreover, it also had subordinates brought in as affiliates in the Zodiac Saints Hugo and Kevin.
‘The Secretary is also an S-rank…’
And even the lowest-ranked disciple, the A-rank Puffin, wasn’t what it seemed. Puffin was famous for being in the first string of the Leo temple.
‘Lee Gun-nim is giving me a chance…!’
At that moment…
“Saint-nim! The enemies are turning back!”
“It seems they gave up on the Seat of power located here!”
Hugo snorted as he brought down his bow. “They should, since they’re going up against me.”
“Dad, I chased away most of those who entered this place.”
Hugo glared at his son. It seemed his son’s abilities were better than his now.
On the other hand, the Archer disciples became leery when the enemies left.
“Still, it’s odd. According to Lee Gun-nim, they’ll be tenacious in trying to get this item.”
“Did they perhaps have their eyes set on a different Seat of Power….?”
Hugo and Chun Sungjae did a double-take.
“Is it the Aquarius temple?!”
Yes. Lee Gun had gone to take care of Aries, who had called in the outer gods.
Since Aries was calling for the outer gods, Lee Gun knew their numbers would continue to grow unless Aries was taken down.
All the other locations were being defended, except one.
“Are they aiming for the Aquarius temple?”
“The probability is high. The current Aquarius is Lee Gun-nim’s construct. If she’s eliminated, Lee Gun-nim’s power will weaken.”
“Since the Aquarius temple isn’t a battle-type temple, it would be easy to kill their Zodiac.”
“That’s odd. There is no way they’ll be able to get rid of Gun’s Construct—” Hugo gulped. He thought about Lee Gun’s future, which he had seen not too long ago. It worried him.
“Is the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power fine?”
“!” Hugo’s eyes turned round when he heard Hahn Jimin’s words.
It was to be expected since he had never seen the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power.
‘That’s odd. Gun’s temple should have one.’
Normally, a Zodiac put that item in their territory.
When Hugo looked at him, Sungjae screamed. “Ah! Uncle did take out a chair that I’ve never seen before.”
It was when Taurus’s Seat of power had appeared. Lee Gun had touched a chair that Sungjae had never seen before.
“I never saw it afterward. Uncle did say he hid it in the most secure location.”
Hugo accepted it.
‘That’s the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power.’
A Zodiac’s chair symbolized the temple and the head of the temple. Nothing good came from putting it in a highly visible place.
“With an item of that caliber, he probably put it somewhere safe. It must be at the workshop in Hawaii or…”
Hahn Jimin’s eyes turned round as if they were speaking nonsense. “Uh? Isn’t the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power located in the Archer Saint-nim’s kitchen? It’s the dining table chair.”
“What?!”
“Uh. That’s odd. I’m pretty sure that’s the one…”
The Archer disciples were stirred up.
“Wait a moment. The dining table chair…”
Hugo’s face turned slightly pale.
“Hugo-nim got rid of it, saying it looked old. He threw it away…”
“I didn’t throw it away!!! I just put it out in the dumpster in front of the building!”
“That’s what you call throwing it away….”
Hugo turned to look at Hahn Jimin. “D-Did Gun really say that? He said it’s the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power?”
“N-No. However, he always sat in the same chair whenever I visited the Archer Saint’s holy ground. That’s why I asked the question. He said it was his designated seat… Since it’s the designated seat of a Zodiac, I thought it was a Zodiac’s throne…”
Hugo let out a bright smile in relief. “He sits there because he can see the TV from there. It isn’t his throne.”
The Archer Saint let out a sigh of relief as he decided to send Taurus’s Seat of power to Lee Gun. He told everyone that they should go to the Aquarius temple when…
Brrrrrrrr!
Hugo received a call. He had a bad feeling about this. And when he checked who was calling, he saw it was his friend. So he picked up the phone.
– Hey, Taeksoo. Did you throw away my dining table chair?
“…!!!”
– It seems as if someone keeps attacking it, and the defensive barrier has been activated. I was wondering if it was sent outside.
Hugo started to sweat as he immediately ended the call. “Hurry up and go upstairs!!! Quickly pick up the dining chair table from the dumpster!!!”
* * *
Ddoo- Ddoo- Ddoo.
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement when he heard the sound coming from the phone. “What the hell? I didn’t finish speaking, so why did he hang up?”
He was on top of Drachma. Lee Gun expressed his anger when the phone call abruptly ended.
On the other hand, Kevin was sweating after hearing the conversation.
‘Does he really not know why Hugo ended it?’
Kevin was quick on the uptake, so he had a rough idea of what had happened through the conversation that he had overheard.
It seemed Kevin wasn’t the only one.
“He threw away the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of Power….” With a serious expression on her face, Hailey mumbled to herself.
Lee Gun had said it was a dining table chair, but there was no way he would place a barrier over a normal dining table chair.
‘I’m sure of it. It’s the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of Power.’
Moreover, the chair was being attacked probably by the outer gods who had picked up the scent.
With the skill Hugo had, his defense of the throne was top-notch. This was why the outer gods had probably moved onto the other Seats of power, which would be easier targets.
It must have something to do with the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power, which had been thrown away.
“Are you sure you should be here, Lee Gun? The Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power is in danger…”
“What? What nonsense are you talking about?”
“I’m just saying the Archer Saint threw it away.”
“That’s just my armchair.”
“?!!”
So why were the outer gods after it?
“Will it be fine? It is just an armchair, but I can’t have it destroyed.”
What??
“Well, it should be fine, since I put a lot of traps over it.”
“??!”
If it was just an armchair, why did he place traps over it?
“Anyway, any human that gets close to it may suffer, but it will be beneficial.”
“???”
What did he mean by beneficial?
Lee Gun shrugged it off as he focused his eyes on the Nameless Land, which was starting to come into view.
This land was something left behind by Abundance. It was a mysterious land, yet the flog island was letting out a surprisingly bright light. A powerful light of Life was emanating from the center of the island.
[Life is overjoyed, since it feels the possibility of its growth.]
[Death is depressed.]
[Life can sense something from there.]
Lee Gun had come to this floating island for only one reason:
Mutton is here
It was the bright sign that Sagittarius had placed in the sky.
Lee Gun laughed. “That asshat hid in an adorable place.”
Well, this was for the beast. Lee Gun planned on designating the Nameless Land as his holy ground.
Koo-goo-goong!
Suddenly, an attack came at him from the direction of the Nameless Land. At the same time, unfamiliar faces rushed toward him.
[Give us the seat of the Serpent Bearer!]
They were the outer gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Why do you think I ran away? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Why do you think I ran away? (2)
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw them. They gave off an unpleasant feeling, like ghosts. Most of them looked like human shadows, but all their faces looked odd. It was to be expected.
‘Masks.’
They were all wearing odd-looking masks. One of the masks had fur on it. Another one had a piece of fabric that made it look like a habit that a nun wore.
Most of these outer gods had worn white masks, but each mask had a different expression on it. Some had solemn expressions, while some looked like they were screaming. These were expressions that could be seen in Munch’s “The Scream.” Bestial and demonic expressions could be seen too.
There really were a thousand looks! The outer gods’ faces were covered by masks, so their expressions couldn’t be read. However, there was one certainty.
‘Greedy bastards.’
Lee Gun could feel their ambition through his skin.
[Is that the serpent?]
[I heard it was newly born this time around.]
They acted as if they were noble and aloof. However, they were filled with greed and desire.
All of them unleashed divine magical energy at the same time.
Kwahng! Kwahng! Kwahng!
They surged into the sky, accompanied by the magical energy.
[Warning! After one minute, the tracking power will impact.]
It was a dense attack that didn’t allow him to run away. The power even started circling in the sky as if it was making sure it wouldn’t miss.
At a glance, one could tell the attack had significant offensive power. If it weren’t blocked, everyone would die.
‘It hasn’t been long since I made Drachma a holy ground. There isn’t enough magical energy gathered to use the holy ground defense skill.’
Therefore, Lee Gun planned to test out Taurus’s defensive power. However…
[You still cannot use the power of Taurus that you swallowed.]
[To make it usable, the relevant power has to go through a Transfer process so that it can become the Serpent Bearer’s skill.]
[Power Transfer is an act that changes the laws of the universe. You need a power greater than Temple energy. You need the Primordial Power.]
[You require a price (Talent) to use Primordial Power.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
It was something the Virgo had told him about. Primordial Power was a power that exceeded the Zodiacs. It was like the magical energy of the universe.
In other words, the Constructs borrowed power from the Zodiacs, and the Zodiacs borrowed the Primordial Power. It was how the system was structured. However, that wasn’t important right now.
[You are short on the Talent needed for Transfer.]
[Current Talent of the Serpent Bearer’s Temple: 100]
[Required Talent: 10,000]
Lee Gun had no idea what the ten thousand Talent entailed. This meant that he couldn’t use Taurus’s defense ability, which Red Eye loved.
‘I have no choice.’
Lee Gun immediately took off his uncomfortable gray jacket.
However, when he tried to immediately activate his Super Regeneration, Kevin screamed at him. “You perverted bastard! Even you shouldn’t take that head-on! Super Regeneration is only possible if there are any parts left!”
“What do you want me to do? I don’t have defensive skills.”
The Serpent Bearer temple was the only one amongst the thirteen Zodiac temples with zero defensive skills.
Was it because he enjoyed the pain? No matter how many skills he unlocked, not a single pure defensive skill had come out. In other words, his temple was like a “be hit and get revived like a zombie” temple.
He had swallowed a defense-type temple in the Taurus temple because he simply wanted his cute niece and nephew to be safe.
“Ah, whatever. It’s annoying to think about it. I’ll just charge from the front.”
“Really!!!” Kevin clutched at his head as he screamed. He wondered how Hugo was able to raid with someone as haphazard as Lee Gun.
“Koohk!”
“Look out!”
When lights resembling comets fell from the sky, Hailey extended her fists. Her fists moved as if to switch locations!
[Item Switch (SS)]
– The location of the object you have and the object you want switches.
The Scorpio temple was the temple of thieves. Switching attacks for her was effortless. If the conditions were right, she could switch even human souls!
With her skill, the meteor falling from the sky was swapped out with what looked to be shiny metals.
This surprised Kevin, and he reflexively sent his sword energy flying!
Splash! Splash!
“Ahhk! What the hell is this?”
Black liquid was falling from the sky.
“This is all coke!”
These were the items that Hailey had prepared for Lee Gun, ten thousand Coca-Cola cans! It was like watching rain made out of coke.
Hailey had put these items in the Scorpio temple’s dimensional pocket. Since she had swapped them with her skill, the attack sent by the gods would have exploded within the dimensional pocket.
Of course, it would cause significant damage to the assets of the Scorpio temple, but she didn’t care if Lee Gun was unhurt.
In the end, Lee Gun jumped down from Drachma.
Kevin, who was drenched in coke, yelled at Hailey, “If you planned on doing this, you should have said something earlier!”
Hailey clicked her tongue as she looked at the Virgo Saint. “I never expected him to block the outer gods’ attacks in such a brutish manner. Listen to me, Kevin. The way you use your power will cause damage to Lee Gun—”
At that moment, a section of Drachma exploded.
Kwahng!
It was the lower section. The swapped attacks of the gods destroyed Drachma. Hailey wondered what was going on, and her eyes turned round.
[Princess! Please do not worry! We had moved all the coke!]
The monster Constructs of the Scorpio temple were within Hailey’s shadows. Their eyes twinkled.
[We had heard a rumor that you will be eating lamb kebab with Lee Gun-nim!]
[We wanted the two of you to eat it in comfort. That’s why we moved it to Lee Gun-nim’s room within Drachma!]
[Things turned out like this, but our storage room is safe thanks to what we did!]
Kevin smirked when he heard the voices that wanted Hailey to compliment them. “You’re the same as me! You damaged Lee Gun’s holy ground!”
Hailey despaired. She was ashamed to face Lee Gun.
[Princess! Hurry up and give us compliments!!]
Hailey’s eyes flashed as she unsheathed her sword. “I’ll kill you guys, then I’ll kill myself.”
[What?!!!]
However, the owner of the holy ground just smirked. “I’ll get to drink coke for a while.”
Lee Gun laughed as if the coke cans had come out at the right time. He imbued the cans with the power of Death and kicked them toward the gods.
Kwahng!!! Kwahng!!
It was very effective.
[Koo-oohk!]
Flying like missiles, the cans destroyed the mysterious lights emitted by the enemies.
This stunned the gods.
[That bastard is getting rid of the Divine Line.]
[A rookie like him knows how to do that?]
Lee Gun laughed.
Yes. Divine Line was an automated attack field. According to Sagittarius, it was a defensive technique that gods deployed.
– It’s an ability of the high-rank gods. It’s akin to an aura surrounding the body. If one approaches a certain distance, the line will automatically attack.
– !
The shapes were diverse: ellipse, cuboid, beast-shaped, lines, etc. Since this was the defense technique of the gods, no one could get close to them.
‘It is unknown what kind of power is imbued within it.’
If one was unlucky, the line would contain a power that turned the enemies into slaves.
Therefore, Sagittarius and Virgo had warned Lee Gun.
– As the Serpent Bearer, you should never fight the gods.
– Aside from the level difference, you cannot see the Divine Line. It is quite troublesome.
– You specialize as a close-range fighter. Unless they get close to you, you have no answer to their defensive technique.
Back to the present.
Kwahng!
When Lee Gun imbued the cans with Death and sent them flying, the gods were a bit taken aback. Of course, it wasn’t because of Lee Gun’s attack.
[Wait a moment. Can that bastard see the Divine Line?]
[Yes. He’s precise. He attacks by dodging them.]
[What? That makes no sense!]
Lee Gun smirked as he surged into the sky.
<13th Sense>
Yes, Lee Gun’s eyes could see the automated attack field placed by the gods. The lines were either shaped like a red fan or a red circle.
Lee Gun dodged them. However, as he was about to attack, the masked gods grinned.
[At the end of the day, it’s merely a baby serpent.]
As those words rang out, Lee Gun felt his body become hot.
‘!’
He felt like someone had lit a fire inside his stomach. Lee Gun immediately dodged into the air.
[Your abilities are surprising, but that’s all there is to them.]
“!”
At the same time, a concealed magic circle appeared on the ground.
Lee Gun vomited blood.
“Kuhk!”
Then, he heard a warning notification.
[Warning! With the current level of your body (29), you’re unable to resist the Divine Line.]
[Super Regeneration isn’t effective because of the level of your body.]
[The destruction of your body is faster than Super Regeneration.]
[You have to go through another molt to raise the rank of your body.]
Lee Gun’s body was being destroyed.
The gods approached Lee Gun as they watched it happen. It was as Sagittarius said. These gods avoided close-range fights, so they had kept their distance until now.
[We’ll take your core. You should just die as your divine status is destroyed.]
[The seat of the Serpent Bearer is ours!]
They got close to take out the heart from Lee Gun’s tattered body. However, Lee Gun grinned at that moment as if everything was going to plan. “I was wondering when you guys would get close, bastards.”
[!]
Their eyes looked haunted like the first time they found a monster.
[!]
The light in Lee Gun’s eyes surprised the gods. His eyes turned red as a golden-green light exploded forth. It wasn’t the power of Death that he normally used. It was the power of Life!
[Pain Revival]
Lee Gun had unexpectedly used Pain Revival on himself.
[!!!]
This surprised the gods.
[Stand back! We’ll get swept up in it!]
[No. He isn’t using it on us!]
Lee Gun had purposefully unleashed all the damage to his body, leaving the gods flabbergasted.
[What is that crazy bastard doing?]
[Instead of giving pain to his enemies, he unleashed it on himself!]
[Won’t his divine status collapse at this point? Has he lost his mind?]
Lee Gun groaned as pain washed over his body.
It had started from when he had first killed a monster, and it had crossed the time when he went through tens of thousands of resets with the Devil’s Tower. It even included Abyss’s recent bite. It was all the pain that his body had suffered. Of course, he had released only 1% of it.
The gods knew what was going on just by looking at Lee Gun’s body, and they thought he had lost his mind. However, they soon flinched.
[Masochist Lv.3 attribute has been activated.]
[As you feel more pain, your fighting ability increases.]
[Your pleasure has increased.]
[Your fighting range has expanded.]
[You have acquired the awakening effect.]
[That’s…!]
Pain Revival was something only Lee Gun could use. It was a form of a stimulant drug.
Of course, this could mess him up if something even small went wrong. However, it was a self-buff that Lee Gun had used for 20 years! It was the reason he had been able to use his power without the blessing of a Zodiac.
After the buff activated, a black light surged forth.
[Death Instinct]
Boom!!!
It was completely different from when he had faced off against Abyss. After the buff was applied, the attack power of Death had become much stronger.
Everything Lee Gun had done before this was to set this up. It had all happened in an instant, and the gods realized their mistake. They tried to back off.
Kwahng!!!!
However, the next moment, the outer gods surrounding Lee Gun fell over.
The black power had been imbued within Heaven’s Punishment. It spun 360 degrees as it decapitated the nearby gods.
[The Frost Giant has fallen.]
[The Earth God has fallen.]
[The God that makes houses and fire has fallen.]
[The God of Tea has fallen.]
[You have gained EXP.]
At that moment, Lee Gun ruthlessly stabbed the gods with Heaven’s Punishment.
Kwah-jeek!
[Ahhhk!]
[Kuhk!]
[SSS rank / Ingredient Rank 2 / Legendary rank]
[SS rank / Ingredient Rank 2 / Rare rank]
[S rank / Ingredient Rank 3 / Hero rank]
[SSS rank / Ingredient Rank 2 / Legendary rank]
However, Lee Gun looked unsatisfied with the ingredients he had acquired. Since these were gods without temples, both strong and weak gods had gathered here.
‘Tsk! I was hopeful, but it really is a crapshoot.’
Lee Gun had furrowed his brows when…
[SSS rank / Ingredient rank 1 / Great Spirit Rank]
“!”
Lee Gun smirked when he saw the highest-ranked ingredient. Then, he turned to look at the gods in the back row.
The gods in the back row flinched when they saw the look in his eyes. They weren’t reacting in such a way because they had seen their fellow gods fall. Of course, that was surprising, but their current reactions had to do with the look in Lee Gun’s eyes and the feeling he was giving off!
His smile showed ecstasy, as if he enjoyed the pain!
[Crazy! Is he some kind of masochist…!]
[What are you talking about? That’s a sadist!]
However, that wasn’t important right now. That sensation…!
[It’s the original owner of the twelve Zodiac temples….!]
[That’s right. They are the mutant creation tribe that created everything!]
A shout caused a commotion amongst most of them, shocking them.
[Wait a moment! They are the original owners of the twelve Zodiac temples? Aren’t they the tribe that the gods treasured? I’m pretty sure all of them went missing…!]
[When they disappeared, the Capricorn and the other smiths took their place…]
[Is that a survivor?!]
The gods who had been standing at the back row laughed derisively.
[That’s nonsense. That isn’t possible.]
[The whole universe would have been in an uproar if there were a survivor!]
As if they didn’t want to speak such nonsense, the gods rushed forward.
Lee Gun quickly tried to defend himself.
Pah-jeek!
“!”
Hearing an ominous sound, he looked down at his hands. His plan had been successful, but his body’s level couldn’t keep up.
“…!”
The body, which had been attacked, started to shake.
Hailey and Kevin did a double-take as they watched him from Drachma. They were keeping the gods in check as they protected Capricorn’s Seat of power, which had been entrusted to them.
[Warning! Your body is breaking down.]
[Super Regeneration cannot keep up.]
In the end, Lee Gun’s body crumbled like that of a sculpture. His legs disappeared. His body crumbled. And in the end, his head fell.
“Lee Gun!!”
The two Zodiac Saints were about to head toward Lee Gun.
The sound of Aries laughing from somewhere rang out at this moment. This was the death of a god’s body.
[This is it! Hurry up and extract that bastard’s core.]
[With this, the Serpent Bearer is ours!!]
The outer gods laughed as they got closer.
Flash!
[An affiliate disciple with 500% faith has sent a massive amount of EXP.]
[You have reached Level 30.]
[You are undergoing your second molt.]

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Why do you think I ran away? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Why do you think I ran away? (3)
A while ago, Hugo and Lee Gun had gotten into a big fight. It had been around the time when the Sagittarius temple had moved under the Serpent Bearer temple as an affiliate.
Hugo hadn’t known why, but thanks to his damn bald Zodiac, he had become an affiliate under the Serpent Bearer.
Hugo was pouting. Of course, becoming a gofer for his friend didn’t feel good. Hugo was a prideful man. His pouting was an understandable response, but it was odd that he was being so curt with Lee Gun.
The situation turned so bad that Lee Gun had to ask while raising his eyebrow,
“Hey. What’s your problem?”
“What do you mean, Zodiac-nim?”
“I’m sorry for duping you. No. If I’m being honest, you’re at fault for falling for it. Anyway, change the channel.”
“Yes, yes. I’ll change the channel, Zodiac-nim.”
“Why are you so dissatisfied? Despite you being an affiliate, I don’t make you do errands. Ah, Taeksoo. I don’t want that channel. Put on the movie channel. Also, I want some juice. Of course, it has to be 100% juice.”
Did he not count this as doing errands? Well, it was understandable.
Hugo had been Lee Gun’s student 20 years ago and had done worse for him. For example, Lee Gun wanted to make an ice-type weapon once, so Hugo had to go to the Antarctic to catch a monster.
However, any leftover travel expense was used by Lee Gun to pay for the food expenses. It was all used in a single day. This was why Hugo had to go out and make some money.
When compared to those days, changing the channel and bringing beverages was nothing.
Moreover, Hugo had received things in excess compared to what he brought to Lee Gun. It was also tens of thousands of times better than being in pain all the time.
Despite these changes, Hugo seemed dissatisfied.
“Zodiac-nim. Why don’t you hand your seat as a Zodiac to a Construct? Let’s just be humans.”
Hugo spoke as he handed over the 100% apple juice.
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round.
“What the hell? You aren’t discontent that you became an affiliate. You’re discontent that I became a Zodiac?”
“Hmph. What’s so good about being a god that cannot die? You’ll have to live forever.”
Yes, Hugo hated that Lee Gun had become a god.
It was understandable since gods did not age like humans. At a fundamental level, Lee Gun had become an immortal being.
While he had disciples who would remember his existence, Lee Gun had become a being that would never die. How would that play out?
“If you become a god, you won’t age.
However, you won’t die while everyone around you does. Will you be fine being the only one left? Do you realize how horrifying that is?”
Hugo knew it too well. He had lost his family to monsters. When he finally found someone like a brother in Lee Gun, Lee Gun had died as well. This was why Hugo knew how painful it was to be alone in this world.
In the case of Lee Gun, it would be that much worse. It would be like a mere moment from Lee Gun’s perspective, but people around him would age and die. He’d feel as if everything was in vain.
‘Even Zodiac Saints have a finite life span.’
Hugo’s aging process was slow, but in the end, he would die.
‘In the current environment, I’ll probably die on the battlefield rather than die from old age.’
Anyway, Hugo really didn’t want Lee Gun to feel the loneliness that the gods experienced. In truth, Hugo felt a sense of loneliness from Sagittarius too.
Despite being pissed off, Hugo did his best to alleviate that loneliness. It was why he agreed to do his Zodiac’s demands.
“I planned on retiring with you when we become old. We’d play Korean chess, and I’d die a day before you. However, you became a Zodiac.”
Lee Gun cackled.
“Why would we play Korean chess? By that time, we’ll be playing virtual reality games.”
“Whatever. You can live for tens of thousands of years. You can play games until you‘re sick of it. I’m passing on while I hold Jiwoo’s hand.”
Although Hugo spoke that way, the thought of Lee Gun being left alone by himself someday didn’t sit right with Hugo.
That wasn’t all.
‘I saw the future again.’
The Archer Saint skill Delphi Oracle had activated once again, and Hugo had seen two futures. The first one was an extended version of the future he had seen before about Lee Gun.
‘Gun’s appearance changed.’
It was as if he had molted. Human skin was littered around him, and his appearance had slightly changed. Of course, it wasn’t to say that he looked bad. He just looked different. In fact, he had become more handsome.
Well, Lee Gun looked handsome right now, but it was in the realm of humans. Things would change once he molted.
– Shut up and answer my questions.
After molting, Lee Gun looked at someone with furious eyes. Up to this point, this was the future that Hugo had seen last time. The problem was the next part.
Hugo saw the future that was tied to this scene. From Lee Gun’s appearance, it would take place after he had molted. It was unclear as to how much time had passed, but Lee Gun was mourning as he held a dead woman.
Hugo couldn’t see the face thanks to Lee Gun’s back, but he was sure it was a woman. Moreover, that wasn’t all that worried Hugo.
Aside from Lee Gun’s future, he had seen a different future.
– Run away!
It was the scene of a destroyed city. From the lay of the land and the buildings, the city looked like Seoul.
Hugo saw it clearly. He saw Yooha and Sungjae. He saw his children die. Then he saw the Sagittarius temple get wiped out and his holy ground razed to the ground. Corpses of disciples he knew littered the ground.
The cause was probably an invasion, an invasion on an entirely different level compared to the last invasions by the unknown civilization. The city was a scene of absolute chaos.
The Sagittarius temple was gone, and his children were dead. It was probably done by the monarchs.
Hugo didn’t know who the remaining figures were, but he had heard a young man speak.
– The plan was a success.
Anyway, Hugo had seen these futures. They weren’t delusions. They were the futures he had seen through the Delphi Oracle. This was why his heart was pounding. He was very worried.
‘From the scenery, it did look like the distant future.’
* * *
Back in the present, Hugo shook his head from side to side as he protected Taurus’ Seat of power.
It had to do with how Sungjae had looked in the future.
‘Sungjae’s appearance was different from now.’
Compared to the current him, the future Sungjae was very tall and built. Right now, Sungjae was a skinny 160-cm-tall kid. In the future, he was over 180 cm tall, and his stature was on par with his uncle.
‘At the very least, it won’t be happening real soon.’
From what he saw of Sungjae, that was the distant future. Of course, they would have to make preparations for it, but the important part was that it hadn’t happened yet!
In fact, the task in front of him was more important!
“Ahhhk! Gun’s Seat of power!” Hugo screamed as he ran up the stairs.
As soon as he exited the basement of the Sagittarius temple, he immediately ran toward the dumpster next to the building!
Hugo screamed when he looked at the dumpster. “Ahhhk! No!”
It was a dumpster with recycling bins installed on it. Hugo saw plastic garbage bags and the old kitchen table and chairs that Hugo had ordered his subordinates to throw away.
As expected, a great number of outer gods were gathered there in their shadowy forms. The dreary ghosts floated around something as if they coveted it. The item was none other than Lee Gun’s private dining table chair!
Moreover, the dining table chair possessed its defensive abilities.
“Ahhk! You crazy bastards! You can’t take that!” Hugo immediately summoned the “Bow made out of Fish.”
He did a mad dash as he shot his bow. “Get away from that, bastards!”
The outer gods who had been aiming for the dining table chair glanced at Hugo. They wondered what kind of maggot was interfering with them.
Unperturbed, Hugo swung his bow like a blunt weapon. “Gun will kill me!”
This EX-rank weapon was much better than expected.
Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jeek!
[You have gained EXP.]
[You have gained EXP.]
Aries had called forth a variety of gods. Some were strong, some were weak, and some had their Constructs aim for the temple. The strong and the weak were mixed as they attacked Hugo.
Thankfully, Hugo could hold his own against the outer gods that had come here. Or maybe it was all thanks to the power of his weapon.
The bow pummeled the outer gods out of nowhere, leaving them flustered. They were merely being clubbed by the bow, yet the attack was quite powerful.
[What kind of human is this?]
[I have no idea. It’s faint, but he has divine status.]
In the end, it didn’t matter what he was. Humans were mere bugs to them.
[Hurry up and kill him. Afterward, we’ll take the chair.]
They extended their hands toward Hugo, who was getting in their way.
“Don’t touch it! It’ll be certain death!”
However, the ones dying wouldn’t be them. Hugo would die at the hands of Lee Gun.
In the end, Hugo shot the arrow that he had used against Abyss.
When an enormous explosion erupted from the massive light, Hugo quickly took the chair as the light blinded everyone else and ran away with it.
Since he didn’t want the chair to break, he held the chair as if it was precious. Then, he checked its status. “Good. It’s unharmed.”
With this, no harm would come to the Serpent Bearer’s temple.
“Dad!”
At that moment, Hugo heard his son’s voice, who had followed after him.
Hugo yelled, “You, go to the Aquarius temple! A healing-type temple will have a hard time lasting against the attacks by the outer gods!”
Among the outer gods that had come to the earth, some were powerful beings. They were at the Great Spirit rank.
“Hurry!”
“Understood. However, I’ve never been to the holy ground of the Aquarius temple, so I don’t know the lay of the land.”
Hahn Jimin gasped for breath as he climbed the stairs. He yelled, “I’ve been there, Sungjae! Take me with you!”
Chun Sungjae was taken aback by his friend’s appearance, and he immediately lashed out. “You’re a low-rank awakened being! How can you think about following me into danger? You will never be of help to me, so don’t get any funny ideas. Never leave my dad’s side!”
Chun Sungjae immediately disappeared using Teleport. He had spoken out in worry since he knew how dangerous it was for a C-rank to confront the Divine rank.
Still, Hahn Jimin became sullen. It didn’t matter in the end. “Ahjussi! Behind you!”
“!”
The outer gods rushed toward Hugo, who had run away with the chair. They planned on taking it back.
[That’s the seat of power. I’m sure that’s the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of Power.]
When Hugo desperately protected the chair, the outer gods became sure that the chair was the Seat of power.
[“Armchair that’s good for the back (A)” says it isn’t the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power.]
[“Armchair that’s good for the back (A)” says its back feels tight. It tells you to massage it.]
Hahn Jimin’s eyes turned round when he heard the notification.
[How many times do I have to tell you, Archer? My master doesn’t have a Seat of power. Are you listening to me? Since you’ve become deaf, why don’t you go get me some water?]
The chair seemed to be speaking. This surprised Hahn Jimin. “Do you not hear what the chair is saying, Ahjussi?”
“What are you talking about?”
“Uh… It says that it isn’t the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power.”
“No. This is it! That is why I called Gun!”
At Hugo’s insistence, more and more outer gods converged toward him.
[As expected, that is the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power.]
[He’s an affiliate, and he’s trying very hard to protect it. There is no mistaking it.]
When the outer gods disturbed the chair…
Flash!
[The trap placed over the “Armchair that’s good for the back (A)” has been activated.]
Accompanying the notification, a black hole appeared above the chair.
The outer gods screamed as the black hole sucked them in.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief. “That’s the trap Gun placed over it.”
Gun was someone capable of doing such a thing and more since this was the Seat of power for the Serpent Bearer’s temple.
“Thank god—”
“Ahjussi!”
“!!”
The outer gods weren’t the only ones to be sucked into the trap. It swallowed up Hugo as well.
Hugo screamed, “Ahhhk! Gun, you son of a bitch!”
“A… Ahjussi!”
The trap, which had appeared like a black hole, disappeared.
[Hugo Otis has disappeared from the earth.]
[Hugo Otis has inflicted damage to the outer gods. He has acquired a massive amount of EXP. He has leveled up.]
[A portion of the acquired EXP will be given to the Zodiac.]
[Your faith is 500%. You will send 5 times the EXP and Temple energy.]
[It’s the exact amount of EXP needed for your Zodiac to grow..]
[The Zodiac’s level has reached 30. The requirement needed for molting has been fulfilled.]
[The molting has started.]
* * *
The Nameless Land!
Something incredible was happening in the land of Life. Lee Gun’s legs, body, and head had fallen like a stone sculpture. The accumulated pain and the attacks by the gods had destroyed his body. The damage was so intensive that even Super Regeneration couldn’t keep up.
In the end, the body, which still smelled a bit like a human, died. However, when his head hit the ground, his body emanated a light.
[That’s…!]
It was as if he was shedding his skin.
Lee Gun’s body, which was spread across the ground, transformed like a beautiful ceramic. From the cracks, a form that was emitting light stood up.
This made the flustered Aries yell.
[Why are you just watching, idiots?]
When Aries approached Lee Gun…
Flash!
[Koohk!]
Light surged into the air.
[You have completely shed your human form.]
[You have learned the existence of the Snake Handler.]
[You have acquired the power of a god.]
[You have completely awakened as a god.]

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Why do you think I ran away? (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Why do you think I ran away? (4)
[You have completely awakened as a god.]
A shape made out of light stood up as an enormous amount of light emanated from him.
At this sight, Aries’s eyes went wide.
[This isn’t normal magical energy.]
[What is this alien magical energy?]
The magical energy Lee Gun was emitting seemed like a problem.
Lee Gun already had Divine status, but after molting, he showed magical energy that surprised even the gods.
‘In terms of scope, it’s like the energy of the Great Spirit-rank beings, who’re much stronger.’
The Great Spirits were gods that exceeded the twelve Zodiacs and led a large army of gods. If one had to make a comparison, the twelve Zodiacs led the solar system, while the Great Spirits led the universe; they were a large force.
However, the outer gods also felt a special magical energy that they couldn’t sense from beings like the Great Spirits.
‘He’s strong.’
[That bastard isn’t a normal god.]
[It’s a devilish power! He’s a mutant!]
Then, a symbol appeared around Lee Gun’s left eye, giving rise to a commotion.
[That symbol…!]
When Lee Gun reappeared, his appearance and presence were quite different. He still had his black hair and flashing red eyes. However, he no longer smelled like a human, and the divine power made his body much stronger and sturdier. He also looked much more handsome than before.
The shadowy outer gods were perturbed by his appearance.
[That scent… He smells like the Creation tribe!]
[Creation tribe?]
[They are the original owners of the authority of the thirteen Zodiacs, and they made the Seats of power!]
[That can’t be! They are the beings that the Zodiacs treasure the most! There would have already been a ruckus if they were still alive!]
[You know what kind of existence they were!]
[They went missing overnight.]
[Yeah. It was said that the tribe disappeared after being cursed.]
[The twelve Zodiacs said that.]
The outer gods murmuring amongst themselves angered Aries. This was a troubling topic that should have never surfaced.
Aries glared at Lee Gun.
[Your awakening will change nothing.]
Aries grated its teeth, then extended its hands. Accompanying a light, an enormous door appeared behind Aries!
Koo-goo-goong!
The door was as tall as a 100-story building.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. This was the power of Aries. It was the highest-ranked version of the crate skill that Lee Gun had stolen from Yang Wei in the past!
[Heavenly God’s Storehouse (SSS)]
The storehouse had multiple floors. Each floor allowed the user to take out different abilities.
From what Lee Gun knew, the first floor was the Multiply Storeroom! This was the prototype of the crate that Lee Gun had stolen from Yang Wei. If one put in a weapon here, the place produced the same weapon. If one put a Construct within, the same Construct came out.
It was a power that suited the Zodiac of wealth
[Heavenly God’s Storehouse, 1st floor]
The enormous door opened, and a great many Constructs emerged from it. Moreover, they weren’t normal Constructs.
“They are…!”
Kevin and Hailey flinched. It was to be expected since the Constructs of the Virgo temple were amongst these Constructs. It also included the Constructs of the Sagittarius temple and the Leo temple.
[Battle type Constructs, which have been multiplied within the Storehouse, are rushing out.]
When the Constructs appeared, Kevin got angry, realizing they all looked the same. “You’re a pig of a Zodiac! I was wondering why the envoy I sent never came back. You captured the envoy there, and you’ve been multiplying it!”
It made sense. The Aries temple always coveted the forces of the battle-type temples. That was why Yang Wei diverted Constructs for his Zodiac and had them imprisoned in the storeroom.
The problem was that these Zodiac Saints’ Constructs weren’t the only ones.
[Miny (Berserk) was multiplied by a hundred.]
“!” Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw familiar faces in the sky. Why was it there, and why did it multiply like cockroaches?
‘Miny and Piggy Bank did go missing.’
He had sent them after the general of the unknown civilization, and they had gone missing. This was why he had sent Red Eye after them, yet even Yong Yong had failed to find them. It had brooded.
‘I guess they were over there.’
Lee Gun remembered the sullen Yong Yong, who had come back with pieces of clothes belonging to his Constructs.
‘Looks like Aries’s Constructs were the culprits.’
It didn’t matter in the end.
[Master!]
A voice cried out within the Storeroom. There was no mistaking it. The voice belonged to Miny.
[Now that I heard your voice, I know you’re fine! Piggy Bank suddenly ran away, and I ended up like this chasing after it… I’m deeply ashamed!]
Lee Gun laughed at those words. Well, Piggy Bank (Pixiu) was originally affiliated with the Aries temple. They knew what it liked and drawing it out with bait was probably easy. However, that didn’t matter at all.
“Is Piggy Bank next to you?”
For some reason, Miny flinched.
[That is…!]
“?”
At that moment.
[The Miny clones are attacking!]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he held up Heaven’s Punishment. Miny was a high-rank Construct, so it was very strong. However, it was his Construct in the end.
‘I know their weakness.’
His eyes flashed, but unexpectedly, the hundred Miny clones didn’t even look at Lee Gun. They rushed past him.
“!”
They were headed toward Kevin and Hailey!
Lee Gun flinched.
Kwah-jeek!
“!”
A chain fell from the sky to encircle his body. It was a green chain. Then, the chain encircled Heaven’s Punishment.
[Heaven’s Punishment is in pain.]
Lee Gun tried to rip it off with his power, but the chain didn’t budge at all.
[Serpent Eater]
He had been caught by his own skill. Lee Gun wondered what was going on, so he looked up. The chain had appeared from the storeroom.
[The Storeroom has copied the skill of Piggy Bank (Pixiu).]
[Aries can use Serpent Eater.]
Lee Gun laughed in contempt.
‘I have several under me that can use Serpent Eater.’
One of them had been Piggy Pank, and he was sure the skill had been copied. Moreover, Aries was known as the Heavenly Emperor. It could read the information of all creatures.
It was a god that could sway destiny. Extracting and copying only the skill was easy for it.
Moreover, Pixiu used to be affiliated with Aries, so the Construct was much easier to read.
[How does it feel being caught by your own skill?]
Lee Gun laughed at these words. “It’s awesome. I didn’t realize my ability is this great.”
Aries’s eyebrows twitched when Lee Gun made the sarcastic remark.
Lee Gun put strength into his arms.
‘Pixiu’s level is still low, so its skills are not that powerful.’
Serpent Eater was a skill that could catch souls. This made it maddeningly painful, but he would be able to get out of this with no problem…
“!”
However, Lee Gun flinched again.
As if it had read the look in his eyes, Aries laughed.
[Did you really think I prepared only that?]
Aries then held out something, a cube.
[You probably can’t move at all.]
Because of the power of the cube, Lee Gun felt his power drain out.
‘Of course, it doesn’t mean I’ve become incapable of moving.’
However, when he looked at the cube, his eyes turned violent. It was a look never seen before.
Lee Gun knew that item very well. However, it was unclear whether Aries knew this or not.
[With this, the conditions are met.]
‘!’
[Merit & Demerit – Soul Judgment]
As if it was waiting for this moment, Aries used its power.
Boom!!
[Shit! That technique is…!]
[Master!]
It was an innate power of the Aries, the power of the temple of wealth. The skill allowed Aries to judge the soul of a living being. If one did many good deeds, wealth would be given to them. If evil deeds outweighed the good ones, the technique would unleash divine punishment!
Soul Judgement judged one’s worth. Neither god nor humans could avoid it.
“!”
The symbol of Aries appeared beneath Lee Gun’s feet, and the red light of Aries surged upward! Aries’s red light was different from the red light of Sagittarius. It was like the color of wine, dark red.
At the same time, figures started to appear; this was something only Aries could see. The number was a conversion that represented the worth of its opponent.
‘If a number comes up, I can turn my opponent according to wealth.’
It was one of the special abilities of Aries as the Zodiac of wealth.
For example, Hugo’s worth might be ten Talents. If Aries provided ten Talents, it could bring in Hugo as a slave. Basically, it could buy its opponent’s soul. Lee Gun was no exception.
Flash!
The outer gods were impressed by the light.
[I never expected to see that technique.]
[I remember a time when Aries took many gods as prisoners using that.]
In truth, some great Zodiac-rank gods other than the twelve Zodiacs had become the slave of Aries. The Aries temple had enough wealth to make such a thing possible. Seizing the target was hard, but once the skill was activated, it couldn’t be dodged.
[Even if he’s my opponent, we’re equals. I’ll pay the price with money and buy his soul.]
Its temple was overflowing with Talents that could be deposited. Aries was considered the most wealthy god in the divine world for a reason.
Finally, the worth of Lee Gun’s body came up, and light surged into the air. The outer gods and Constructs cheered.
[?!]
However, when Aries checked the worth of Lee Gun, its expression turned a bit odd.
* * *
Around that time…
“Ahhhk! This is nuts! Where am I?” Hugo was being chased. The space he was running through wasn’t the earth. And that was the least of his problems.
[You have been sent to Tartarus through the Serpent Bearer’s trap.]
“Hey, Lee Gun! You crazy bastard! What kind of trap did you place on the chair?”
Wasn’t Tartarus supposed to be hell? Moreover, it was one of the hells where beings were tortured!
Of course, Lee Gun didn’t know where the trap would be sending the attackers. The only thing he was sure of was that it would be a version of the divine world.
In fact, Hugo could feel Zodiac-rank energy from all directions, and that wasn’t all.
[Catch him!]
[Catch that bastard!]
“Ahhh! Stop chasing me!”
An army of beings with bizarre faces was chasing after him. At a glance, they numbered in the hundreds! Moreover, all these beings were of the divine rank.
“Shit! Stop coming at me!! Gun! You son of a bitch!”
The only thing Hugo was sure of was that he would die at this rate. Moreover, and if he died here, he would be fucked.
– Be careful, Taeksoo.
– What?
– Don’t die by chance. I possess the power of Life, but I can’t revive anything close to a human.
– What?!
– Since I developed the Revive ability, I tested it out. At most, I can revive an amoeba.
– What?! A single cell organism?!
– Anyway, it’s the end of the road if you die. I can’t save you. That’s why you have to make sure to never die.
That bastard sent him to hell after warning him not to die! Hugo was about to lose his mind. Moreover, the words spoken by the beings chasing him made it worse.
[You’re the disciple of that snake god that everyone is talking about, right?]
[Your faith toward the snake god is very high.]
He wasn’t a disciple of the snake god! “What are you talking about? I’m part of the Sagittarius temple?!”
[Sagittarius temple? Do not lie to us. How can that be when your faith in the snake god is like that?]
[We have to kill the liar.]
[I won’t be satisfied even if I beat the snake god to death. Since you have that much faith toward it, you must be the Zodiac Saint of the snake god. I’ll have to get my revenge by killing you.]
[No. I’ll make him my disciple.]
[No. Let’s just eat him. Let’s turn him into an eternal slave in this place.]
“I really am! I’m the Archer Saint!” Hugo was frustrated.
‘Shit! The others have more faith than me!’
Hugo had seen it clearly with the new ability he had developed. Although he couldn’t see his own faith, he could see others’.
His son’s faith was 330%, and Kevin’s was 200%. Since Hailey wasn’t a human, he couldn’t see her faith, but it was probably high.
‘Yooha’s faith was so high.’
Hugo got angry. Anyway, Hugo had made fun of the Virgo Saint the previous day, saying how could he be the Virgo Saint at this point.
