[This place is so deep that a Zodiac cannot come here. We have to ascend to a place where the power of a Zodiac can reach us.]
Hearing that, Hugo quickly placed his hands on the Seat of power. The throne let out a light and transformed into a small cube. It moved into his pocket.
Taken aback, Hugo looked at Yeonwoo. “Let’s go up together. Gun probably found a way for us to escape this place.”
However…
[It’s a Seat of power!]
[My god! It’s a Seat of Power!]
“!!!”
Koo-goo-goong!
Did they smell the scent of the throne? The entirety of Tartarus—the black sky, the black land, and the black river—shook. Accompanying the incredible earthquake, a loud sound rang out.
[Hand over the Seat of Power!]
[It’s an empty Seat of Power!!!]
[With it, we can bring forth the power of a Zodiac!!!]
“!!”
It couldn’t be compared to before when the slave gods had appeared. The enemies before them right now were on a different level.
‘Shit!’
It wasn’t just slave gods from the floor of torture. The gods from the other floors had smelled the Seat of power, and the sound of them rushing toward Hugo reverberated everywhere.
Kwah-jeek!
A hand suddenly appeared below Hugo.
“Shit!”
Yeonwoo quickly gestured with her hand. As an incredible light flashed, the hand screamed. To protect the Seat of power, Yeonwoo had received Primordial Power.
[The condition of protecting the Seat of power has come to an end.]
[The condition has been satisfied. The contract has been finalized.]
[The power given to you on a contract basis will be recovered.]
[It will disappear in around one minute.]
Hugo was surprised by the voice coming from the sky.
Yeonwoo laughed as she had expected this. From the beginning, she had planned on sending only Hugo and the Seat of power from here.
She knew she couldn’t leave this place, and she knew the gods wouldn’t stand back and let her send the throne into the outside world.
Therefore, Yeonwoo slapped Hugo’s arm, and Hugo’s body became airborne. She planned on sending him to the upper floors where Lee Gun’s power could reach him.
Then, Yeonwoo used the last of her powers to hold back the enemies.
This surprised Hugo. “W-Wait a moment!”
There was no way he could leave behind Yeonwoo. He extended his hand. “No! We have to go together.!!”
“!”
Hugo managed to grab Yeonwoo’s arm, but he soon lost his grip.
‘No.’
However, when Hugo was about to be sent flying into the sky, an incredible light fell from the sky. The light surrounded two people. No, it surrounded three people.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: You were here (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: You were here (1)
Twenty-four years ago!
[No, you shouldn’t. Do you realize how important this period is? There is no way you should meet up with him.]
Yeonwoo was a couple of days away from awakening.
She was the Serpent Bearer, the thirteenth Zodiac who had been betrayed by the other twelve Zodiacs.
The reason she had been killed was simple. She had tried to turn everything back to the way it was using the power of Cycle. Yeonwoo had tried to revive the original owners of the Seats of power.
That was why she had been falsely labeled as the god of calamity and killed by her fellow Zodiacs.
Her Divine status had broken down, and she had almost faced extinction. She was barely able to reincarnate with the help of Virgo.
Her reincarnation took various forms. Sometimes, she reincarnated as Constructs, beasts, inanimate objects, beings of various races from other dimensions, and other forms. She had even reincarnated as an agent of the Divine world once.
However, her reincarnation didn’t matter. The twelve Zodiacs and her pursuers found her each time, killing her.
Yet, Yeonwoo continued to sharpen the sword of revenge.
While she was gone, those bastards had usurped the seats from the original owners and occupied the seats of the Zodiacs.
She had considered them to be comrades, yet they had lied. As if that wasn’t enough, they falsely accused her of being the god of calamity and put out a death penalty on her.
Then, she had been killed over and over again for a long time.
Yeonwoo suffered endless death as she continued to plan. She never gave up. She tenaciously kept reincarnating again and again to bring the destruction of the twelve Zodiacs. She had reincarnated several hundred times like that.
Then, Yeonwoo reincarnated as a human for the first time and met Lee Gun.
[Are you listening to what I’m saying, thirteenth? You must not meet that human man ever again, especially during this pivotal time!]
An agent of the Divine world had attached itself to the reincarnated Yeonwoo. The agent was a god that Yeonwoo had been friends with during her days as the thirteenth Zodiac. Therefore, it had secretly helped Yeonwoo sharpen her sword of revenge.
Anyway, the agent of the Divine world had a problem with Lee Gun.
[You will awaken as the thirteenth Zodiac in a couple of days. I doubt anything big will happen, but it’s a period where you should be the most cautious…!]
Yeonwoo was a couple of days away from her awakening. Therefore, she had said she was going to help Lee Gun, whom she was living with, with the orphanage they had grown up in.
Since she was about to awaken, she wanted to reduce the variables. She had determined it would be best if she were alone.
However, that day was different.
– Tomorrow is your birthday. I haven’t seen your face in about two weeks. We should have dinner tomorrow. I’m asking for time off tomorrow. I should be able to meet you in the afternoon.
The agent of the Divine world responded strictly when it saw the text from Lee Gun. Yeonwoo heard the voice in her head through telepathy.
[Once you awaken, you’ll have to leave this place. Don’t dwell on someone you will never see again. You should save your power and focus on your awakening.]
However, Yeonwoo became silent. She knew she would never see Lee Gun again, and it had made her hesitate. That was the reason she had gone to meet Lee Gun. It would be her last goodbye.
Yeonwoo had thought nothing would happen in an hour or two. She also wanted even more memories of Lee Gun to cherish even a little.
However, the Zodiacs and the Monarchs had found her on that day. It was the day when Yeonwoo had to make an important choice as she watched Lee Gun die in front of her.
“I’ll pay the price! Transfer my Divine status to this person!”
[What?! Have you lost your mind?]
The agent of the Divine world reared back in shock and objected.
[Do you realize what it means to hand over your Divine status?! You will die as a god. You will never be able to reincarnate!]
“I know.”
[If you’re aware of it, how could you suggest such a thing? After reincarnating several hundred times, you finally have enough power to carry out your revenge. With this awakening, you’ll be able to carry out your revenge!]
“Hurry. Transfer my Divine status to him.”
[Until now, you were short of power by just a bit. This time, it’ll really be possible! Will you throw away everything to save a human, who has a lifespan of a hundred years? You have suffered humiliation for several thousand years. Will you throw away the sword of revenge that you’ve been sharpening all this time?]
“Please…! He is going to die!”
Her hatred toward the Zodiacs knew no bounds. Yeonwoo had thought about taking revenge for her and her master, yet there was no way she could let Lee Gun die. Even she couldn’t revive a dead human.
‘It’s easier to revive a god.’
A powerful god didn’t perish even if they were swept up in a vast flow of power called the Cycle. A weak, small organism like a human would find its existence ripped apart the Cycle would sweep it up. That was why a human’s death was final.
A revival skill existed, but Yeonwoo hadn’t awakened yet. She couldn’t use it, and the skill had a time limit.
[Has to be within 24 hours of death]
She couldn’t awaken in that period, and no one could help them either. This left only one method.
“Please transfer my Divine status to him.”
Yeonwoo had chosen the life of a human over her revenge, which had spanned a very long time. She didn’t have any other reason. She just wanted Lee Gun to live.
Then, she had paid the price and fallen to Tartarus. It was as if she were being punished for choosing the life of a human instead of taking revenge for her temple.
Back to the present…
Koo-googoong!
An incredible light came down from the sky. The light engulfed three people. It was unknown to whom this power belonged.
Anyway, the aftereffect of the light instantly swept away the beings that coveted the Seat of power.
[Ahhk!]
[Kuh-huhk!]
It was an incredible power. At the same time, Hugo’s body was sent flying into the sky. It was the doing of the light engulfing them.
“Koohk!”
His group pierced through the clouds as they ascended endlessly. When they moved past the clouds, they went through a pitch-black space. As they moved past the space of darkness, they flew past the prison floor. In a flash, unknown worlds flashed by them.
They pierced through each floor as they were relentlessly pulled upwards.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
It felt like they were hitting and breaking a glass wall every time they crossed a floor. The collision happened several thousand times.
[It’s a Seat of power!]
[It is the thirteenth Seat of power!]
It felt like more and more enemies were chasing after them as they moved past each floor. Of course, this couldn’t be helped since they had to move past the other floors to escape this place.
‘Shit! What kind of aggro effect is this?’
It really drove home the incredible value of the thirteenth Seat of power.
‘I don’t know who made it, but this is incredible.’
It was like the One Ring, which everyone coveted. If its original owner still existed, it was an item worth killing the owner.
[This is the last floor.]
[The power of the Serpent Bearer can be felt nearby.]
“!”
Hearing the notification, Hugo realized they were finally about to arrive at a place where Lee Gun’s power could reach them.
“Koohk!?”
However, when they were about to pierce through the sky floor, a nameless god grabbed them. It was an enormous giant with no eyes, and its power was incredible.
[It’s the gatekeeper that defends the entrance to the world of torture.]
[It says how dare slaves try to enter the divine world.]
“?!”
If they could cross this place, they would be able to exit the world of torture and reach the Divine world.
Since it was the last barrier, its gatekeeper was the strongest. It was there to prevent slaves and prisoners from escaping Tartarus.
[It’s the gatekeeper that defends the entrance to the world of torture. The gatekeeper has grabbed a slave that is trying to escape.]
Hugo felt aggrieved after being caught by the enormous hand.
‘Shit! I’m not a slave…!’
There was a reason even the gods didn’t want to fall into this world. Their attacks didn’t work.
[It’s a high-rank god. The level difference is too high to fight it.]
Hugo was about to be dragged back into the depths of the world of torture.
Flash!
However, the thirteenth Seat of power, which was in its cube form, emitted a light within Hugo’s pocket. Then, as if it had sensed that there wasn’t enough power, the Seat of power exited the pocket and let out a power that was bigger than before.
Kwahng!!!
[Ahhhk! Hot!]
[Shit! He escaped! The slave is running away!]
Hugo was like a ball as he flew into the sky once again. How long did he fly in such a frantic manner?
“Huh-huhk…!”
It finally stopped. This time, Hugo was in a place that was like an endless space. However, a white floor existed here.
“Kuhk!”
As if the magic was dispelled, the floating Hugo was tossed toward the ground.
“Jeez! Let me down a bit more gently! I’m at an age where you’ll mess up my back!” Hugo’s body was too young to be able to complain about age-related maladies.
[You have escaped the world of torture using the power of the thirteenth Seat of power. You have reached a space that exists between the floors.]
[Currently, you are located between the lowest floor of the Divine world and the world of torture.]
Hugo wasn’t sure what it all meant, but in short, he had escaped from being a slave. That wasn’t all.
“I was wondering whose light it was. It was the chair.”
The Serpent Bearer’s majestic Seat of power lay before him. The throne’s power had engulfed all of them and dragged them here from the lowest floor of the world of torture, while Yeonwoo had seemed to be trying to send only Hugo up here.
‘I guess I can’t complain too much about Yang Wei. Thankfully, Ms. Yeonwoo was brought along with us. I really wanted to bring her along with me.’
Hugo let out a sigh of relief as he looked at the disoriented Yeonwoo get up in the distance.
“Please wait here. I’ll once again call Gun from here…”
When Hugo grabbed the chair to get up, he saw an unfamiliar sight. It seemed the chair was showing him its memories.
– Since our masters are from the Creation tribe, they were able to make the Seats of power.
– Yes. Also, we will be able to become gods if we have the Seats of power of our masters.
– Let’s kill our masters. We’ll steal those seats.
– That’s a good idea.
Hugo was confused by the vision that he was shown when…
“Jeez! Where the hell were you sent to?”
“!”
He heard a familiar voice. “Think about the person that’s looking for you. At the very least, you should’ve gone to a place where I can bring you back.”
“Gun!”
Lee Gun was walking toward them from the distance. “When I tried to go directly to you, I learned it is a place that a Zodiac can’t enter. Why I outta…”
This was the lowest floor that a Zodiac could travel to.
“Anyway, I’m here to take you back. Let’s go.”
Yang Wei’s eyes turned round when he saw Lee Gun
[W-Who is this handsome bro? Do you know him?]
Yang Wei was near Lee Gun, blinking nonstop. It was as if Yang Wei were assessing a rare item. He looked at Lee Gun’s feet, back, and even his rear.
Surprised, Lee Gun looked back at Yang Wei. However, Yang Wei continued to stick close to Lee Gun, looking mesmerized.
[For some reason, I think he’ll be worth a lot of money! Let’s go sell him right now!!]
Yang Wei received a kick.
The angry Lee Gun looked at Hugo. “What happened to him?”
“Ah… There is a bit of a story behind it.”
“Understood. Anyway, I want you to drag him along. We’ll head out of here.”
When Lee Gun was about to turn around, Hugo quickly grabbed him. “Wait a moment! There is one more person that we have to take!”
“What? Who did you seduce while I was gone—”
When Lee Gun turned his head, his eyes turned round. It was a rare reaction. His gaze had landed on Yeonwoo, who was trying to disappear somewhere.
After discovering her, Lee Gun took quick steps toward Yeonwoo.
Yeonwoo flinched as she felt his presence. She didn’t even look at Lee Gun before she tried to disappear. However, Lee Gun was faster than her.
“Yeonwoo.” Lee Gun grabbed her arm and turned her around. “You‘re Yeonwoo, right!”
When she heard Lee Gun’s voice, Yeonwoo looked a bit like she wanted to cry. She tried to turn her head but…
Chwa-roo-roohk!
“!”
Yeonwoo seemed to have known this was going to happen. That was why she had tried to disappear.
Black chains shot up from the white floor.
[How dare a slave run away!]
[Catch her.]
The chains had followed her from the world of torture. They ruthlessly caught Yeonwoo. One could feel their will: they would never let her go.
“Yeonwoo!”
Yeonwoo laughed when she saw Lee Gun. He was completely different from his old self, who was all bones. It seemed she was satisfied with seeing just that.
She respectfully lowered her head. “Oh, master of the Serpent Bearer. I’m merely an imprint that protected the Seat of power. The real me has been gone for a long time.”
“!”
“I’m thankful that I was able to return the Seat of power to its original owner.”
Now that she was a slave, she knew it wouldn’t be good to get involved with a Zodiac. If she couldn’t get involved with him, she’d rather act like a different person. It would sever any lingering attachment to him.
Kwahng!
The rough chains completely encircled Yeonwoo. She laughed as she was dragged away. “Blessings to the new Serpent Bearer—”
Kwah-jeek!
Lee Gun violently grabbed the chains.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: You were here (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: You were here (2)
“I have something I want to tell you today, Yeonwoo.”
“Really? What a coincidence! I have something I want to say to you too.”
Yeonwoo still regretted what had happened on that day twenty-four years ago.
The Zodiacs and the Monarchs had trailed after her. On the other hand, Lee Gun had probably thought she had died because he had asked her to come out.
Thankfully, the only one to die on that day was Yeonwoo. But she had dragged Lee Gun into all of this.
“What do you want to say to me, Gun?”
“Uh…? Uh… That is….”
“Should I try guessing? I think I know what it is.”
“Uh? Uhhhh??? I mean…! Ahhhk! Wait a moment!”
“We are way behind on our rent, right? I heard from Ajumma. That’s why I brought this. Tada! You don’t have to worry anymore!”
“…”
“Uh? What’s wrong? Wasn’t it about this? Ajumma said it was urgent…”
“We’re indeed behind on rent, but is that something I would speak about in a restaurant like this?”
“No?”
“It isn’t. Also, I paid off all the rent before I left the house. It’s fine.”
“Uh? I…I’m sorry. Did I upset you? Where are you going?”
“Don’t worry! I’m just going to the restroom. I’ll tell you after I get back.”
In the end, Yeonwoo never got to hear what Lee Gun had to say. That had been the last time they had seen each other.
While Lee Gun had gone to the restroom, her enemies had launched an attack. Yeonwoo had tried to leave Seoul, as she pretended as if she were there by herself. However…
[This man is here with you, right?]
This was why Yeonwoo had regrets. She shouldn’t have been selfish even if she wanted to say goodbye to him for the last time. She should have disappeared without saying anything on that day. It wouldn’t have caused any harm to Lee Gun.
That was why she had planned on silently handing over the Seat of power this time. She planned on disappearing into the world of torture in silence.
Yet, this had happened.
Kwah-jeek!
Back in the present, Lee Gun violently grabbed the chains.
‘!’
The thick chains, which had been trying to return to hell, came to a stop.
This surprised everyone, even the chains. It was to be expected since no god would stop the world of torture from bringing someone in.
Lee Gun’s eyes angrily flashed. “Who do you think you are touching in front of me?”
Yeonwoo trembled when she heard his voice.
Hugo’s mouth fell open in shock as if to say he couldn’t believe Lee Gun was capable of saying such a thing.
On the other hand, the chains showed fury.
[What are you doing, unknown god?]
There was murderous intent in his voice.
[How dare a petty Zodiac stop the enforcement of the Divine world’s law?]
Yeonwoo, who was being dragged away, bit her tongue as she tried to stop Lee Gun. A Zodiac couldn’t mess with the doings of the world of torture. They couldn’t get involved in the doings of the netherworlds.
Each world had its rulers and beings in charge. They had signed a pact of non-aggression, where they couldn’t interfere in each other’s territories.
Moreover, the slaves of Tartarus were under the jurisdiction of the world of torture. Not even the highest-ranked gods could get involved in Tartarus’s matters.
That was the rule, and those who broke the rule of the Divine world were disciplined strictly. This was why Yeonwoo became desperate.
[Oh, Serpent Bearer! You shouldn’t!]
When she showed some signs of exercising her will, a collar appeared around her neck for the first time.
Despite losing her Divine status, it seemed she was considered a high-rank god. The collar decided to be wary of her sooner rather than later. It also didn’t like that a slave had dared speak.
It became hard for Yeonwoo to move her hands and feet, yet she yelled out.
[Oh, Serpent Bearer! The chains are considered the body of the Divine world. If you push any further, the Serpent Bearer will become a slave for high treason…!]
Lee Gun ignored that. “Let go right now.”
Clank!!
He put more strength into the hands holding the thick chains. The chains screamed. They felt as if they would break under Lee Gun’s incredible strength.
[You cocky bastard! How dare a Zodiac bastard get involved in the doings of the netherworld! If you do this, we’ll demote you—]
“Fuck off!”
As his cold words rang out, the sound of the ground splitting open reverberated in the air.
Zzhung!
When he roughly twisted the chains, an enormous fissure appeared on the ground.
Kwah-jeek!
[Ahhk! Stop!]
Lee Gun was angry, so he didn’t stop there. “I said let go!”
When his magical energy entered the chains, the chains were smashed apart.
Kwah-jeek!
The chains screamed, and the bound Yeonwoo fell.
“Ah…!”
Tuhk!
However, Lee Gun appeared beneath her and caught the falling Yeonwoo.
Was the scream heard?
Koo-goo-goong!
A strange symbol appeared on the white floor, and unfamiliar beings showed up at the scene. Their heads were that of beasts. These beings were half-humanoid and half-beast. They looked like Constructs, but they weren’t.
[Caution! They are the Constructs under the Divine world. They are the agents of the Divine world. You should avoid crossing them.]
[The agents of the Divine world have the authority to execute even a Zodiac if the Zodiac breaks the rule.]
These beings were the warders of the world of torture. When they made an appearance, Lee Gun put down Yeonwoo and took out Heaven’s Punishment.
Surprised by this sight, the agents tried to take out the tools for execution. However, they hesitated.
This was to be expected since Lee Gun was a member of the Divine world. He had officially awakened as a god. Moreover, he had a high-rank temple, like the twelve Zodiacs.
At a fundamental level, they couldn’t treat Lee Gun with a callous hand. Therefore, they politely spoke to him.
[Oh, thirteenth Zodiac. You’re making things difficult for us.]
[If you interfere further with the Divine world’s enforcement of the law and damage the property of the netherworld, the Serpent Bearer will be put in a tough spot too.]
Of course, they weren’t truly trying to stop Lee Gun. It was understandable since these chains were considered upper management creatures within the world of torture. They were considered high-rank divinities in the world of torture.
‘They are caretakers that have jurisdiction over the slaves of Tartarus.’
‘They are like land owners of a slave farm.’
A Zodiac couldn’t destroy them.
‘Moreover, great difficulty will follow the Zodiac if he messes with the custodians.’
That was why these agents nudged Lee Gun to let go of the chains.
[We will talk to the higher-ups about that slave. However, we cannot release the collar around her throat. We can negotiate on your behalf so that her working conditions are good…]
Despite those words, the eyes of the chains flashed as if these agents were talking nonsense.
[There will be no negotiations! The farm slaves aren’t worth it!]
As soon as it spoke, the ground started shaking. Then, another chain appeared behind Lee Gun.
Did the chains he had destroyed return in their true form? They were much thicker than the ones from before. Moreover, there were many more of them. It seemed they planned on capturing Lee Gun too.
[We will take that bastard and his party to the world of torture! We will torture them!]
However, the thick chains couldn’t speak any further.
Kwahng!!!
As an incredibly loud sound rang out, the chains bounced off Lee Gun before they could reach him. It was as if an invisible barrier had appeared in front of him.
Then, a strange symbol appeared within Lee Gun’s left eye, and magical energy emanated from him.
Zzuhng!
The small chains, which had been pushing toward him, turned into ashes. This shocked the agents.
Lee Gun being able to generate this much power wasn’t the surprising part.
[Wait a moment! Doesn’t this feel like their magical energy?]
[That’s correct! This is the energy of the original owners, who created the Seats of power!]
The revelation caused a stir amongst the agents.
[The original owners of the Seats of Power… Aren’t they extraordinary heroes?]
[However, they lost their minds and were executed by their Constructs. Are you talking about the doomed Creation tribe?]
[That’s correct! The most outstanding one amongst them sat on the thirteenth Seat of power…!]
[What? The thirteenth ruled over the serpent?]
[If it hadn’t lost its mind, it would have been considered the best. That’s the legendary seat…]
The agents looked at Yeonwoo in shock. They were referring to the original owner of the thirteenth Seat of power, who had been Yeonwoo’s owner.
[Did the slave perhaps revive her original owner?]
Yeonwoo was also shocked. After he had awakened as a god, Lee Gun’s power was very similar to her owner’s power. Of course, he wasn’t her owner.
‘However, he’s similar to my master..’
The original owner of the thirteenth Seat of power had picked up Yeonwoo when she was merely a lowly baby snake. It had raised her until she became the god of Cycle.
Moreover, she had been absent when her comrades usurped the original owners of the Seats of power. She had been out acquiring medicine for the original owners.
That had been the reason she had raised herself into the Seat of power to learn the truth of what had happened to her murdered owner.
She had found out that the original owners hadn’t lost their minds. They were betrayed by her colleagues.
Yeonwoo wondered what had happened as she looked at Lee Gun. However, it lasted only a moment.
‘!’
She was surprised when a black gate opened behind Lee Gun.
‘That’s the execution skill of the world of torture…!’
Lee Gun, who was in front of her, was more important that the numerous questions that had appeared in her mind.
‘I can’t let him get involved once again.’
In the end, she used her remaining life energy to squeeze out her magical energy. She was about to block the skill of the world of torture when…
“Kuhk!”
“Miss Yeonwoo!”
Lee Gun was surprised when the collar around Yeonwoo’s neck constricted. It was the doing of the thick chains, which wanted to drag her to the world of torture.
It seemed the pride of the chains was greatly hurt when Lee Gun’s power destroyed them. Of course, they could recover by returning to the Divine world, but they couldn’t recover from the embarrassment suffered at the hands of the slave.
[How dare you interfere after reviving that thing!]
Yeonwoo was in excruciating pain as the collar choked her. Normally, the collar remained invisible, but it clearly signified her rank as a slave.
She was under the control of the collar, and it wouldn’t allow her to escape the world of torture.
Soon, the chains shouted.
[I will destroy you, insolent… Ahhhk!]
Lee Gun’s eyes menacingly flashed as he violently grabbed a piece of the chains. “You guys are the ones that’ll be destroyed.”
As if it was reacting to him, the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power emanated a light.
Kwahng!!
The magical energy infused in his hands let out a light, and the Divine status within the chains was eradicated.
Lee Gun had killed the gods of the world of torture.
[Your Divine status has increased.]
[You have gained a massive amount of EXP.]
The agents reared back in shock.
[A Zodiac finally broke the rule…!]
This was unacceptable to them. They had no choice.
[Oh, Serpent Bearer. You must’ve noticed it. That slave is not long for this world!]
[She will cease to exist after the contract ends. There is no need to make enemies of the world of torture for someone like her…!]
Lee Gun didn’t respond at all to those words. He just spat out, “It’s fine. Just fuck off right now.”
The agents of the Divine world flinched as they could see his anger.
The chains might be gods affiliated with Tartarus, but these agents were public officials. Nothing good would come out if they messed with a Zodiac affiliated with the Divine world. It also had to do with his power.
[We judge that this slave was collected by the Serpent Bearer. We will not send anyone after the slave for running away.]
[Oh, slave. When you do die, thank the Serpent Bearer. You will not die as a slave.]
They were polite as they disappeared.
The collar around Yeonwoo’s neck shattered as well. Was it because the chains, which were her custodians, had ceased to exist?
“Ah!”
She was able to leave the world of torture with no strings attached. This meant the power restricting her movements disappeared. The power that had kept her body suppressed for dozens of years disappeared.
The dumbfounded Yeonwoo was moving her fingers when she felt a presence behind her. It was Lee Gun. She turned her head in surprise.
‘!’
Yeonwoo, Hugo, and Yang Wei were all surprised.
Lee Gun fiercely hugged Yeonwoo as he placed a hand behind her head. It was as if he was holding something precious.
He had missed Yeonwoo’s presence greatly. He buried his face as if he wanted to feel the temperature of her body.
“Yeonwoo.”
Hugo was shocked by this sight. He had never thought Lee Gun would be capable of doing such a thing.
Lee Gun didn’t care as he placed strength into his hands. It was as if he never wanted to let her go.
“I’m sorry! I let you stay in such a place by yourself.”
“…!”
“Let’s go back together.”
Yeonwoo’s hands shook when she heard his hoarse voice. It looked like she wanted to cry. Without realizing it, she reached out to hug Lee Gun closer to her. However, her hands froze as they hovered behind Lee Gun’s back.
‘My contract with the Divine world hasn’t come to an end.’
Her collar was gone, but that was temporary.
Lee Gun would be in danger if he stayed next to her. Even if that wasn’t the case, her presence wouldn’t allow Lee Gun to forge his path forward. She didn’t want that.
‘Once I handed over the Seat of Power, I was destined to disappear soon.’
That was the contract she had made. She had acquired a power that allowed her to protect the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power. In return, she would become a part of the Primordial Power when the contract ended.
Therefore, she laughed as she said, “Thank you for releasing my collar, Great Serpent Bearer! However, I’m merely an imprint. Only the will of my original owner remains. My outer appearance may be the same, but I don’t have her memories. I’m not the one you’re looking for. That’s why—”
Lee Gun sighed. “Do you really think I won’t be able to recognize you?”
“…!”
Yeonwoo became angry. “No… That is… I am…”
Lee Gun stroked her head as if he was soothing Yeonwoo.
As soon as Lee Gun had seen Yeonwoo, he had realized she would be disappearing soon.
As the power of Life and Death grew, he had become capable of sometimes seeing the shape and life span of spirits.
Moreover, it wasn’t as if he had rescued her without knowing that. He had messed with the world of torture with this knowledge in hand. He also wanted to try something, but the notification window spoke to him.
[You changed a slave’s status into a free spirit.]
[However, you cannot bring her in as a Construct.]
[You cannot imbue Divine status to an imprint.]
[It has to be the original soul.]
Her being able to protect the Seat of power as an imprint was already impressive. Of course, the Primordial Power had made it possible, and as a price, she had become a slave of Tartarus.
Moreover, Lee Gun could guess where her original soul was. It was with either Oblivion, who had eaten Yeonwoo, or Time, who had coveted her power.
Therefore, he said, “I’ll come for you soon. Wait for me.”
“…!”
Flash!
Yeonwoo, who had been crying in Lee Gun’s arms, did her best to smile as she started disappearing from the head. It was as if she was made out of the sand. She dispersed like smoke.
Lee Gun didn’t raise his head. And right after Yeonwoo disappeared…
“!”
He realized there was something in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: You were here (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: You were here (3)
Lee Gun realized there was something within his hand. When he opened his hand, his eyes widened.
He saw a small doll. It was a very plain doll, yet Hugo was surprised when he approached Lee Gun. Lee Gun’s face held a complicated expression as he looked at the doll. Hugo had never seen this expression from him.
Lee Gun wasn’t shedding tears, but his eyes looked incredibly sad.
Hugo couldn’t approach him. For some reason, he felt like he shouldn’t say anything to Lee Gun. And so, he kept silent, acting as if he hadn’t seen anything. He was about to turn his head when…
[Wow! Jackpot! This is an amazing item!]
“??!!!”
The genial Yang Wei approached Lee Gun. Then he kept hovering around Lee Gun as if he couldn’t read the room.
[Amazing. This is a treasure of the Divine world! If you sell this to the Divine world, you might be able to buy a floor in the Divine world. Hyung! Hyung! Where did you get this?]
“Ahhhk!” Hugo screamed. That insensitive sheep pig!
He quickly ran forward to grab Yang Wei. “He’s talking nonsense. Don’t pay attention to him, Gun. Put your heart to rest— Huhk!”
Mesmerized, Yang Wei continued gazing at the doll.
[As expected, it is similar to the treasure of the Divine world that I saw!]
“!”
Hugo was surprised. He wondered how Yang Wei knew this when he had lost his memories.
Still, Hugo flinched when he heard that the doll was a treasure of the Divine world. It was to be expected since the small doll was clearly made by Lee Gun.
Hugo naturally recognized the shape and the method used to make such an item. It all pointed toward Lee Gun.
‘By the looks of it, it’s a voodoo doll.’
The doll looked completely unrelated to the Divine world.
“Anyway, that ugly voodoo doll is—”
“I made it a long time ago. It was made in the image of Yeonwoo.”
“Poo-hahk!!”
Hugo almost choked. Flustered, he tried to walk on eggshells around Lee Gun. “Y-Yes! When we were young, making ugly things was popular! Yes! That’s right! You made it really well! I bet Miss Yeonwoo was happy!”
“…”
Hugo was sweating buckets.
On the other hand, Lee Gun merely looked at the doll in a sentimental way. It was unimaginably ugly and bizarre that it made one doubt Lee Gun had made it.
[Wow! If a slave was able to keep it, it must be something that she treasured.]
“!” Hugo’s eyes turned round.
‘Yes. Miss Yeonwoo was a slave.’
It didn’t make sense that a slave would be able to keep something. That wouldn’t be allowed. So, her being able to keep it in her possession meant that it had been dear to her, something that she didn’t want to lose no matter what.
It was like how war heroes kept things like medals, favorite horses, or weapons. The doll was an item of that magnitude.
‘That meant she treasured it.’
It also made Lee Gun more melancholic. This was the first and last thing that he had done for Yeonwoo.
“At the time, I had been so busy that I wasn’t able to do anything for her.”
“Gun.”
“If I knew she would like it, I would have made it better.”
“Gun…”
In the end, Lee Gun put away the doll in his pocket and indicated that he was ok. “Don’t worry about it! This is nothing.”
Hugo was silent.
‘There’s no way he is fine.’
It was to be expected.
‘Lee Gun already knows. He knows he can’t revive Miss Yeonwoo.’
She had been eaten by Oblivion. Oblivion was an existence that could erase even gods.
‘No god can revive a soul that was annihilated. It’s impossible!’
This was what Sagittarius had told Hugo. If only the body had died, some avenues might have been available to pursue. However, nothing could be done if the soul died alongside the body. That was why Hugo had received a warning that he had to be cautious around monsters that could kill the soul.
That wasn’t all.
‘Locating the whereabouts of Time and Oblivion isn’t easy.’
Oblivion could remove any memory about itself from the minds of bystanders and even the space that it occupied. Time was a vagabond that wandered around the past and future.
Even Hailey would have a hard time finding them. This was why a part of Lee Gun already knew it.
‘If the soul is gone, Miss Yeonwoo can’t be revived.’
Flash!
“!!”
At that moment, the item that was thought to be a simple keepsake emitted a light.
[The power of the new owner has made the item undergo molting.]
The ugly doll’s exterior shed away, and a clean glass doll made an appearance. Moreover, it emanated a significant power now.
[The power of the Serpent Handler, the original owner of the Serpent Bearer’s temple, has been applied.]
Yang Wei screamed as if he had expected this.
[Look! I’m sure of it! It’s a treasure of the Divine world!]
Hugo kicked Yang Wei for being noisy. The problem wasn’t that the doll’s appearance had changed.
“It’s letting out a light!”
It was like dowsing rods. Whenever the doll was moved, it emitted light in a particular direction.
[It reacts to the souls of the Constructs contracted to the original owner of the Serpent Bearer’s temple.]
‘Original owner?’
[It is currently reacting to the soul of the being who had kept this item for a long time.]
Yang Wei spoke.
[It seems to be pointing to the location of the imprint’s soul.]
Hugo was surprised. “What? That thing is tracking down Miss Yeonwoo?”
That wasn’t all.
‘It giving reaction means Miss Yeonwoo’s soul is still safe!’
Lee Gun’s Constructs, who had been hiding within his shadow, spoke up.
[Since she was the previous thirteenth Zodiac, she might not perish so easily like a human.]
“What? Miss Yeonwoo? She was the thirteenth Zodiac?”
[I didn’t know that the thirteenth Zodiac was a woman, but she was famous for being the god of calamity]
“It means she’s alive, right?”
Lee Gun had also picked up on this. The light in his eyes was completely different from before. Although his eyes weren’t showing signs of giving up before, there was a huge difference between knowing something for sure or not.
Lee Gun laughed as he held the doll. “I’ll get rid of those bastards.”
Hugo’s eyes turned round when he saw the look in Lee Gun’s eyes. Ever since he had become acquainted with Lee Gun, he had never seen such life in Lee Gun’s eyes.
Koo-roo-roong!
Suddenly, the ground started to shake.
“What the hell! What’s going on?” Hugo was surprised.
The floor they were standing on started to collapse like sand.
Yang Wei screamed.
[Ahhk! If the floor collapses, we’ll fall below again!]
“What?!”
They had gone through a lot to climb out of the world of torture, yet they were about to fall into it again. All of them were wondering what was going on when a sound came from the sky.
[Warning! The sojourn given to the Serpent Bearer has come to an end.]
[The notification will be repeated once again. The sojourn given to the Serpent Bearer has come to an end.]
[You are currently located in between the Divine world and the boundary layer of the Divine world. You will be expelled.]
Hugo was surprised by the solemn notification. “Sojourn? What is it talking about?”
“What? It has already come to an end?”
“What sojourn?”
“Ah. It’s nothing. To find you, I bought a Divine world pass using Talents.”
“What?!”
“The cheapest one led to this place instead of the Divine world.… It can’t be helped since I used all my money to reach this place.”
Yang Wei looked flabbergasted.
[Divine World Pass? Have you lost your mind? That’s incredibly precious! It should be very expensive!]
Although Yang Wei had lost all his memories, any information regarding money had been ingrained in his body.
Hugo looked apologetic. “I’m sorry! You had to use Divine money for me. I know it’s really hard to gather Talents.…”
“It’s fine, since saving you was more important.”
“…!” The moved Hugo almost shed a tear.
It seemed Lee Gun had become kinder after meeting Yeonwoo.
‘His eyes always were venomous, yet they have softened…!’
“Thank you very much! It was my mistake for falling into the trap. You spent your entire fortune to save me!”
Lee Gun smirked as if Hugo was talking nonsense. “My entire fortune? Of course, I spent the entire fortune of the Sagittarius temple.”
“??!!!”
“Why would I spend my money when I’m saving you?”
“…” He went back on the idea that Lee Gun had become kinder.
“Return!” Lee Gun then placed a hand on his Seat of power as he lifted a black stone. It emitted a flash of light.
[You have used the Return Stone]
[Return Stone (SS)]
– It’s the holy item of the Scorpio temple. It transfers one toward the location of the Scorpio Saint.
“!!”
At that moment, Hugo saw another vision within the light. It seemed the Seat of power was showing him something once again.
– Did the creations execute the mad Creation tribe?
– No. The owner of the thirteenth Seat of power is still left!
It looked to be a very important scene. The scene depicted a man sitting on the thirteenth Seat of power.
Hugo flinched when he saw the man.
‘He looks like Gun.’
Of course, the man didn’t look identical to Lee Gun. Their outer appearances didn’t look the same at all.
‘Their magical energies feel very similar. It’s as if they are related.’
The vision lasted only a moment.
[We have to get out of here]
“!”
Was it thanks to moving between dimensions? Hugo lost consciousness as he appeared in the Nameless Land once again.
Kwang!
A powerful beam of light hit the Nameless Land, surprising Hailey and Kevin.
“Lee Gun!”
“Archer!”
When Hailey approached him, Lee Gun laughed. He had gone to the floor between the world of torture and the Divine world. Since it couldn’t technically be called the Divine world, it was much more dangerous for Lee Gun.
“Hailey. Thanks to the skill placed on me, I arrived here without being harassed by the riffraffs. I also used the Return Stone.”
Hailey’s face turned red when he smiled. She quickly moved away from him. “A-anyway, I’m glad you are back unharmed. You should designate this place as the holy ground of the Serpent Bearer, then…”
At that moment…
“Ahhk! Why is he acting like this!” Kevin screamed because Yang Wei was clinging to him.
[Wow! You’re a crazy rich person! Your necktie, socks, and even your underwear are designer products! If I sell everything you have, I can become rich!]
“Hey! Archer! Why’s he like this? Get him away from me!”
Hugo looked sad. He spoke with self-pity as he looked at Kevin. “Ah… You should be a bit more understanding. He’s a little sick.”
“Sick?!”
“Yes. His mind is…”
“What?! What are you talking about? Ahhk! Let go! Stop trying to take off my clothes!”
Yang Wei acted out on his unhealthy appetite for money.
In the end, Kevin huffed in anger as he put back on the clothes that had been stripped from him. As he did so, he asked Hugo, “Whatever! Also, what’s up with the miserable expression on your face? ”
“What do you mean, why? The thought of doing mercenary work again…”
“Mercenary??”
“Gun said he spent all the Talents of the Sagittarius temple to buy the pass. That’s why Sagittarius is depressed, too. It’s obvious his entire wealth was used…”
Hailey tilted her head in puzzlement. “I don’t think he’s depressed for that reason. The cost was put in debt under the Aries.”
“?!”
Hugo glared at Lee Gun for tricking him. However, something was more important than that. “Wait a moment. Why is my Zodiac depressed then?”
Lee Gun burst out laughing. “Of course, he’s depressed since he had his Zodiac Saint stolen.”
“His Zodiac Saint was stolen… What? What nonsense are you talking about?”
Kevin looked dumbfounded at his reaction. “What the hell? You still haven’t noticed, Archer?”
“W-what?”
Lee Gun smirked as he butted in. “Hey! What skill did you think I used to drag you out of Tartarus?”
“What? I have no idea. What is it?”
“It’s the Zodiac exclusive skill, Zodiac Saint Summon.”
Hugo was surprised. This skill allowed his Zodiac to summon him wherever he was located, and Hugo would appear in front of Sagittarius.
“Hmph! What happened to my stingy Zodiac? He normally doesn’t use it since he doesn’t like it, as it expends too much Temple energy.”
“Well, it wasn’t as if he didn’t use it. He couldn’t.”
“What?”
“Why would I go there if your Zodiac was going to use the skill?”
Hugo was silent. It was as if his foreboding feeling had become reality.
“Congratulations on becoming a part of the Serpent Bearer temple!”
“…???!!”
The frozen Hugo started screaming. “What are you talking about?”
“What do you mean? The only skill that could save you from there was Zodiac Saint Summon. However, your faith toward Sagittarius was 50%.”
“!!”
“The minimum standard for a Zodiac has to be 90%, so Sagittarius couldn’t activate the skill. That’s why he requested me. He said it was ok to transfer you to the Serpent Bearer temple. He asked me to bring you out using my Zodiac Saint Summon skill. He said the only one that satisfied the faith requirement was the Serpent Bearer.”
The expression on Hugo’s face was a sight to behold.
“Your faith toward me was overflowing, so I didn’t even need to designate you as a Zodiac Saint. Anyway, you’re part of the Serpent Bearer temple. You’re officially my underling.”
“Wow! He has 90% faith?”
“Hey! Are you playing with me? There is no way—” Hugo’s face froze when he remembered something. “Hey! Stop joking! I’m a Zodiac Saint of a different temple. There’s no way I would be transferred so easily—”
At that moment, Hugo received a call. It was Goat.
– Saint-nim!! You finally picked up! It says I was automatically designated as the Zodiac Saint right now! What is it talking about?! Did something happen to you?!
“??!!”
Hugo desperately tried to activate the badge of the Sagittarius temple, but he couldn’t use it.
[A disciple of the Serpent Bearer temple cannot use the badge of the Sagittarius temple.]
“Ahhhk!!”
Lee Gun burst out laughing at Hugo, who was having a mental breakdown. “Don’t worry. I’m not that evil.”
“Then…!”
“I’ll return everything to normal when your faith toward Sagittarius exceeds your faith toward the Serpent Bearer.”
Hugo roared like a monster.
When Hugo turned around to leave, Kevin asked, “What are you doing, Archer? Lee Gun has something to say right now. Where are you going?”
“I’m toppling the Serpent Bearer temple! I’m going to lower my faith!”

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - Talk to me straight (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 260 - Talk to me straight (1)
Benjamin Goat.
Twenty-seven years old and 190 cm tall, he was one of the Ten Stars (SS-rank), who were considered the strongest amongst humanity.
During his middle school years, Goat had taken an aptitude test. The test revealed that he had S-rank aptitudes toward both the Taurus temple and the Leo temple.
For some odd reason, the young man had fallen for the Sagittarius temple, for which he had an aptitude of D rank. He had ignored the love calls from the Taurus and Leo and joined the last rank temple.
When Goat joined the Sagittarius temple, he had been the luggage guy that did odd jobs. He was a fanboy of Hugo. He still remembered Hugo and Lee Jaewon having questioning looks in their eyes, wondering what he was doing there.
Anyway, Goat was considered Hugo’s right arm. Learning his archery techniques directly under Lee Jaewon, Goat had risen to the SS rank. He had joined the ranks of those considered world-class.
Moreover, he continued to receive numerous love calls, yet he was happy spending time with Hugo, whom he respected. Recently, he was happy being reunited with Lee Jaewon.
Every day was happy for the young man, yet one incident almost gave him a mental breakdown.
[Congratulations, Benjamin Goat (SS)! You have automatically been designated as the Zodiac Saint of the Sagittarius temple.]
“Ahhhk!! Saint-nim!!” Goat suddenly had a meltdown. He wondered if he had heard wrong when the voice coming from his badge gave the notification.
He grabbed the crow Construct, who was in charge of giving out the notification, and asked it to repeat those words.
[Congratulations! You have been designated as the new Zodiac Saint of the Sagittarius temple!!]
“No. This can’t be!”
In the end, he kept calling Hugo, yet Hugo didn’t pick up. It worsened his meltdown. He had tried to contact Hugo several hundred times when the call finally got through.
- Ahhk! What!? I’m the replacement Zodiac Saint?
Usually, a Zodiac Saint was replaced for one reason.
However, Hugo had thankfully picked up his phone, indicating that he was unharmed. Nevertheless, he also seemed to be having a severe mental breakdown.
Goat kept the line open to hear a more detailed story. He kept asking for Hugo, but…
“S-Saint-nim? Can you hear me? Ah, ah? Hello? I don’t think he hung up on me.”
It seemed the phone had been passed on to someone else.
Goat heard a familiar voice.
- Hello?
He flinched. “Lee Gun-nim!!”
- Well, it turned out like this. You’re in charge of the Sagittarius temple for now.
“Lee Gun-nim??! What do you mean, that’s how it turned out? Please give me an explanation….!”
- It doesn’t change the fact that the Sagittarius temple is still an affiliate under me. That’s why you should take good care of it. You guys are very useful to me. If you bring down the temple, you’re dead.
“Lee Gun-nim?!”
- I’ll give you a mission. Taeksoo was firm in keeping the temple small. But he’s no longer the Zodiac Saint of that place, so you can tell him to piss off. I need you to add at least a thousand disciples. I need them.
“What?!”
- Mmm! I want you to roughly have 900 S-ranks and 100 A-ranks.
Goat almost fainted. “That isn’t possible, Lee Gun-nim. Please return our Saint-nim…!”
- A thousand. I said it.
Click!
Goat despaired when the call was ruthlessly ended.
“Ben.”
Goat shook when he heard a cold voice from behind him.
“According to how you reacted, Saint-nim seems to be unharmed. What happened?”
Goat was in the holy ground of the Sagittarius temple. When he heard Lee Jaewon’s question, he started sweating.
Jaewon’s voice sounded gentle, but it wasn’t the case. His eyes were scary, as if to say how dare you become the Zodiac Saint of the Sagittarius temple.
Goat felt like someone who had been promoted instead of his superior. “I-It seems Saint-nim was in trouble. In the process of getting saved, he was temporarily transferred, and I got automatically designated as the Zodiac Saint—”
“Oh! Congratulations! So I should now call you Saint-nim?”
Goat found himself more frightened. “No! This seat should be occupied by Hyung-nim!”
“No, no! You are a Ten Star for a reason. Your abilities are better than mine.”
“What? No! Not at all!!!” Goat was mainly a power user. In terms of offensive power, he was the best in the Sagittarius temple. However, Hugo and Lee Jaewon were overwhelmingly better than him when it came to accuracy.
In particular, Lee Jaewon was the best in terms of dodging and infiltration. He was Hugo’s right-hand man and advisor.
“I’m not suited to be in the front. It isn’t an easy seat to fill.”
Goat let out a sigh, as if he had the same opinion.
In truth, occupying the seat of the Zodiac Saint wasn’t easy.
Goat would have to go out into the world as the face of his temple. His personal life would be on display. Then, he would have to fight territorial wars to maintain the power balance between the temples.
He would have to manage the disciples and Constructs of the temple and take commissions. At the same time, he would have to please his precocious Zodiac as a servant. He would have so many things to do that twenty-four hours wouldn’t be enough.
Moreover, the Sagittarius temple had a low number of disciples, so Hugo used to do 90% of all the work.
‘We can never do what he does.’
If framed that way, wasn’t this good for Hugo?
‘It’s like going from a job that requires pulling all-nighters to a job that is cushy.’
“Anyway, it wouldn’t matter if Hugo-nim likes it there. Since I know his personality, he would hate being under Lee Gun-nim….”
“Ah! Do not worry about that! Lee Gun-nim said he’ll return Hugo-nim,” Goat clarified.
“What? Really?”
“Yes! Lee Gun-nim said that when Hugo-nim’s faith toward the Sagittarius temple exceeds that toward the Serpent Bearer temple, he’ll return everything to normal… Hyung-nim? Why are you making that face?”
In a rarity, Lee Jaewon had a detached expression. “We’ll have to give up on that idea.”
“W-What?”
“Hahh! He won’t be able to achieve it in this lifetime. I’ll have to prepare myself to move to the Serpent Bearer too.”
“Hyung-nim?!”
“I’m joking.”
The look in Lee Jaewon’s eyes changed. “It’s odd that Lee Gun-nim took Saint-nim. Moreover, our Zodiac let Saint-nim go without making a big deal about it.”
“He’s fickle.”
The look in Lee Jaewon’s eyes turned serious. “I don’t think this is about him being fickle.”
“What?”
“You saw it too, right? That vision…”
“Ah! Yes. I don’t know what that vision is about… I’m sure…!”
“There is something to it.”
* * *
Around that time, in the Nameless Land.
“Good! It’s going down! It’s going down!”
Hugo cheered as he looked into a hand mirror. He held the mirror in one hand and his phone in the other.
The phone’s display showed an article and a picture. It was after Lee Gun had returned. The picture showed Lee Gun kicking him. To be precise, it was when Yooha had said she would marry her uncle. Back then, Hugo had charged Lee Gun in anger and received a beating.
Naturally, when Hugo thought about that incident, bad memories surfaced in his mind. Since he didn’t want to take the chance of remembering good memories, he had decided to use visual aids.
Moreover, the picture wasn’t the only thing that he had prepared.
“That is…”
Yes, Hugo had gathered everything related to Lee Gun causing havoc in the past. Those tools seemed to have some effect.
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 480%]
“Good! It fell by 20%! I’ll have it down in no time! Next, I’ll read the abusive texts that I received from Gun twenty years ago!”
This left Kevin dumbfounded. However, the reason for that reaction wasn’t Hugo’s desire to lower the faith. “Why do you still have text messages from twenty years ago?”
“Good! It fell again! I’ll look at the scrapbook that I made a long time ago! These are all articles about Gun causing trouble!!”
Again, why did he have those items? That wasn’t all.
‘In the first place, can he even drop his faith with things like that?’
On the other hand, the tenacious Hugo summoned a bag.
[Gemini temple’s rental skill “Select item summon” has been used.]
“That damn bastard. Yes, this is the ticket. I remember it. He didn’t even give me travel money. He let me traverse Europe with just this ticket and told me to acquire ingredients for him.”
Hugo took out the items in the bag, one by one.
It seemed he was dead set on disparaging Lee Gun despite the embarrassment to himself. “Yes, I remember this. He left a can of ham with me, so the monsters chased after me.
“Ah! I remember this sculpture! When I asked him for a monthly salary, he told me to be satisfied with this! When I said I’m going on a date, he gave me a smelly scarf that made my date run away!”
Kevin was speechless. It was for no other reason. “That nerd… He collected a lot of things.”
Normally, one threw away items that elicited ill feelings.
Now, it made sense why Yang Wei had raided Hugo’s house first when making the Lee Gun Museum.
Anyway, disparaging Lee Gun seemed to be proving effective.
[Serpent Bearer Faith 400%]
“Good!! It went down a lot! I can do this!”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue as he watched all of this. “Taeksoo.”
“What! Don’t talk to me! I’m busy! Do you really think I’ll enter a temple where my children are my superiors?”
“Don’t overdo it too much. It’s hard for me to watch you struggle so much.”
“You’re so fake. Don’t do it. Do you really think I’ll fall for it? It is useless….”
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 500%]
“Fuck $*($*!!”
Kevin feigned a laugh. He had no idea what they were trying to do.
Well, it didn’t matter, since something more preposterous than Hugo was in front of his eyes. It was the sight of two people sticking to Lee Gun like koalas.
“Uncle!”
When Lee Gun called for them, the Chun siblings had come at once.
Thanks to Sagittarius, Lee Gun had learned the Zodiac Saint Summon skill, so calling them had become easy for him.
On the other hand, the siblings were seeing Lee Gun for the first time after he had become a god.
“Kuh-huhk. I can’t look at his face.”
“What the hell! What is this amazing smell?”
The Chun siblings swooned as soon as they saw Lee Gun.
Lee Gun had become more handsome after awakening, and the fanboy and the fangirl naturally noticed this. Then there were the desperate texts that Goat had sent them.
However, the sibling Zodiac Saints were too busy smelling their uncle.
Unable to watch this anymore, Kevin said, “Since your Zodiac Saints are here, you should talk. You said you have something to say.”
“!”
“It must have something to do with the vision we saw earlier, right?”
“!”
The eyes of Hugo, who had been trying to place a curse on Lee Gun, widened when he heard Kevin’s words.
The eyes of the Chun siblings, who were sniffing Lee Gun as they stuck to him, also changed.
“What? The Virgo Saint saw it too?”
“Yes, I saw it.”
Chun Sungjae glared at him. “Wow! You should pay up! How dare you steal a glance into such personal history?!”
“I didn’t steal a glance at it!! Anyway, you showed it to me, right? Are you playing a prank on me, Lee Gun?”
Lee Gun snorted as if Kevin was speaking nonsense. “It isn't a joke. The chair showed the vision to me.”
“!”
“Then, it showed that to my affiliates.”
The content of the visions was simple.
“One showed Uncle from 20 years ago….”
“The other one….”
Hailey ground her teeth when she thought about the other vision.
“I now understand why the Zodiacs had annihilated the Secretaries.”
“That’s right. It probably is related to why the Zodiacs tried to kill Uncle….”
Yes, they had seen the past of not only Lee Gun but also the Zodiacs.
- Did you hear about it? The owner of the thirteenth Seat of power lost his mind!
- What? Really?
- It’s a certainty since the Constructs spoke about it.
The vision seemed to show the Divine world. The Divine world was burning, and several familiar faces had made an appearance. They were the current twelve Zodiacs.
The vision had shown them murdering the man that Hugo thought was similar to Lee Gun. Of course, the man looked completely different from Lee Gun and was probably the original owner of the thirteenth Seat of power.
Before dying, however, the thirteenth had mumbled something to the woman who had come to kill him.
The woman had flinched at the words. However, the reaction lasted only a moment.
Kwah-jeek!!
The last remaining thirteenth had died at that woman’s hands. That woman was one of the twelve Zodiacs that they knew about.
Lee Gun and his affiliate disciples had all seen that face.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Talk to me straight (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Talk to me straight (2)
Ssuh-guhk!
The scene unfolding in front of them was that of a murder. One of the twelve Zodiacs was killing the thirteenth.
This surprised the Chun siblings, who were seeing this for the first time.
‘Uncle.’
They were sure of it since they were the disciples of the Serpent Bearer temple. The woman had brought down the sword on a man. That man was the Serpent Bearer.
‘He is our Zodiac.’
Moreover, his magical energy was almost identical to Lee Gun’s.
If Constructs saw that man and Lee Gun, they would think the two men were identical figures, since Constructs identified others by their souls.
The woman who had killed the thirteenth had short brown hair.
‘I’ve never seen that Zodiac before. She might be the original Libra, who got eaten by Giselle.’
After the original owner of the thirteenth Seat of power died, a cheer rang in the distance.
[We succeeded in dethroning them! We really defeated them! We succeeded!]
The one to shout was none other than Aries. Unlike its present self, the Aries of the past was slim and had worn the clothes of a slave. However, there was no mistaking that it was Aries.
Afterward, more familiar faces appeared. They were in awe as they looked at the Zodiac that had killed the thirteenth.
[He’s supposed to be the strongest amongst our masters. He was our toughest opponent, yet I knew you would be able to succeed.]
The one that spoke while laughing was Aquarius. In contrast to how it had been in the present times, this Aquarius gave off the feeling of being a small sprite.
Next to it was a half-humanoid baby calf, a set of twin sisters, and a set of twin brothers.
The twin brothers spoke.
[Borrowing the power of the monarchs was a big help to us. I was skeptical as to whether we could really make our owners lose their minds.]
[I was right. For some odd reason, our masters couldn’t use their powers against the monarchs. I knew the monarchs were their weakness.]
They all looked young, but there was no mistaking them. They were Taurus, Aquarius, and Gemini.
[Did you take out all the cores of our masters?]
[Of course.]
[Good. Lets… What the hell? I don’t see Sagittarius. Did he fail?]
[No. I heard he succeeded.]
[Why isn’t he showing himself?]
[That particular owner put up a huge fight, so Sagittarius suffered significant injuries. He isn’t dead, but whatever the reason, he won’t move yet. ]
[He did well for a coward.]
They spoke as if it didn’t really matter.
[Did everyone take care of the corpse of their owner?]
[Aside from the thirteenth, everything went smoothly. We used that method to get rid of all of them.]
Then, everyone burst out laughing as if they had waited for this moment.
[Good. We acquired the powers of our masters and their Seats of power!]
[We just need to gather disciples through the Seats of power, and it’ll allow us to become Zodiacs! Our days of being slaves have come to an end!]
Aries cheered, but someone pushed back.
[It’s too early to celebrate.]
She was one of the female twins, who would later become one part of the Pisces. She had a venomous look on her face.
[Our thirteen masters are celebrated as the best heroes of the Divine world. They are also part of the Creation tribe. We might buy suspicion from the other gods.]
[!]
[We have to tie the loose ends.]
They smirked.
The next scene showed Aries and several familiar Zodiacs. They were crying as they spoke out against a group.
[All of this is the fault of the monarchs. They made our masters sick and go mad. However, our great owners were able to regain sanity at their last moment.]
[Our masters lamented about their responsibilities. Then, they sacrificed themselves to block the dangers to the Divine world.]
[Afterward, they passed on their Seats of power to us. This proves our story.]
[We also received the will of our masters, and we promise to rebuild the Divine world.]
[Ohhhhhhh!]
This scene left the Chun siblings disenchanted. It was a sight that they had seen somewhere before.
‘We will never forget Lee Gun’s noble death! He sacrificed himself for all of us.’
‘We will carry on Lee Gun’s dying wishes! We will take back all the lands of humanity!’
That had been the declaration the twelve Zodiac Saints had given when they announced Lee Gun’s death within the Devil’s Tower. It seemed they had learned how to do these terrible things from their Zodiacs.
However, the group soon saw another more serious vision.
“Uncle. Didn’t you say you had two family members who died before your awakening?”
Lee Gun’s eyes instantly turned cold. His Seat of power had simply shown the memories of the twelve Zodiacs through visions.
In the process, the group also got to see memories related to Lee Gun.
[What the hell? He’s still alive!]
[Hurry up and kill him. Our sins won’t be revealed if we do so.]
The ones speaking were probably the Zodiacs of the Pisces temple and the Gemini temple. They were the ones that had killed the reincarnations of Yeonwoo again and again. In the end, they had also killed a young man.
[This will put an end to it.]
The young man was Yeonwoo’s younger brother and someone Lee Gun thought of as his blood brother. He was a part of Lee Gun’s family and a kid who was very attached to Lee Gun.
[Oh, past comrade, if you want to blame someone, blame the actions of the one that tried to reveal our sins.]
[No. Don’t kill him too quickly. Do you realize how much effort we had to go through to find him this time around? He should suffer for making us work.]
[Is that so?]
Lee Gun’s family member had been killed brutally by the Zodiacs.
At the same time, the younger brother didn’t want his sister and Lee Gun to become tangled in this. He had resisted until he died.
Then, the vision again shifted. The final scene it showed was that of the moments before the Zodiac Saints were about to enter the Devil’s tower.
It was after Kevin had been swapped out. Kevin fell to Liv, Jean-Louis, and another female Zodiac.
‘Liv is Pisces. The man and the woman must be the Gemini Zodiacs.’
Pisces and Gemini, who led the two magic-type temples, spoke.
[Lee Gun is a problem.]
[That’s right. The thirteenth Zodiac was killed by our magic-type temples, so why did someone like Lee Gun have to show up? It’s unfortunate.]
[As the great magic-type Zodiacs who established the Temple system, we must kill Lee Gun.]
[That’s right. If we let Lee Gun live, he might kill all the monsters of the unknown civilization. That bastard isn’t helpful at all.]
[Lee Gun is that big of a monster.]
[Tsk! Humans’ faith exists because the monsters are here.]
It seemed the Chun siblings, Kevin, and the Archer disciples had been shown these visions since they were affiliate disciples.
Therefore, they knew they weren’t shown something normal.
On the other hand, Hugo was surprised to hear them discuss it. “What the hell? You guys were shown such things? I only saw the person who was similar to Gun. I saw nothing after that.”
Lee Gun mockingly said behind him, “Idiot. That happened because you fell unconscious. I saw it all.”
Hugo felt a surge of anger.
[Serpent Bearer Faith 450% (-100%)]
Kevin ignored them as he furrowed his brows. “If what we were shown is true, it’ll cause a big mess. If you had shown these scenes to us, there was no way I would’ve doubted their veracity. However, it is a different story since the Seat of power was the one doing it.”
Lee Gun agreed with him. “It might have been instructed to record it, but on the other hand, it could be trying to sow chaos.”
Taurus’s Seat of power had tried to get cute with him.
“Eeny. Meeny. Miny.”
When Lee Gun called out their names, eyes flashed within his shadows.
[You called for us.]
“You guys are fairly high-rank gods, right? Do you guys know about the story of the previous thirteen Zodiacs?”
[What?]
“You guys must have seen the visions. Is it all true?”
The Constructs looked shocked when they saw Lee Gun’s menacing eyes. It was to be expected since they were Constructs that had originally followed the Gemini temple.
[That is…]
“You followed them despite knowing the truth?”
He sounded like he wanted to cut open their necks with a knife. The battle-type Constructs cried out.
[Huhk! That isn’t the case!]
[We just found out about it too!!!]
“You better not be lying to me.”
[We promise! We have no intention of lying to our master!]
[It was something not even the Constructs knew about…!]
“Did you know about the original owners of the Seats of Power?”
The Constructs were surprised for an entirely different reason. It was as if they had never expected to hear such names once again.
“Are you deaf? Do you know them or not?”
[Ah! I’m sorry!!! That is their official title. However, they were famous beings known as the Creation tribe.]
They were legendary beings.
[It’s very hush-hush now, but they were known as a manufacturing tribe, who could create anything. They were peerless. All members of that tribe possessed a special power that could change the laws of the universe. They were considered treasures of the Divine world…]
[However, they suddenly went mad one day. They started to slaughter gods and humans alike…]
[Anyway, they were gods with fame and achievements. That is why the current twelve Zodiacs, who followed after them, were also considered highly….]
“It must be quite a sight to have seen that the original owners hadn’t been truly mad, right?”
Faced with Lee Gun’s cold gaze, the Constructs flinched.
“They are gods that killed their masters through conspiracy. There’s no way such beings would come to earth with good intentions in mind, right?”
[…!!]
That wasn’t all.
“You heard what they said in the vision. If they gathered disciples, they could become gods. Moreover, humans’ faith exists only because monsters exist.”
“!”
“That means several Zodiacs might have joined hands with the unknown civilization to gather humans as disciples.”
Kevin nodded at Yooha’s words. “It’s a good plan. Fear is the easiest way to raise faith and religion.”
His words left the Chun siblings dumbfounded. They glanced sideways at Kevin.
Kevin might look like a simpleton. However, he was someone who had kept his temple in second place for the past twenty years. He was the leader of a massive temple with a billion disciples.
The Chun siblings accusingly looked at Kevin as if he had used such a method to expand his temple.
Feeling aggrieved, Kevin angrily said, “Hey! I didn’t grow my temple that way! The one to use fear was Giselle!”
“Ah. It’s fine. If what the vision showed is correct, I can see where the Zodiac Saints learned all their bad habits.”
“?!”
The siblings’ words took Kevin aback. He was about to say something, but Lee Gun just laughed in derision.
“Don’t be too hard on him. He never entered the Devil’s tower. He’s lousy. He slept outside while we did all the hard work.”
Kevin was about to say something, but he despaired. Everyone else had entered the Devil’s tower except him. So him being unconscious during that time was humiliating for him.
However, the Chun siblings pouted as if they were still displeased with Kevin.
“Still, he was in on it. He didn’t push back on any of the rumors spread about Uncle.”
At those words, Kevin and Hailey despaired, as they labeled themselves as transgressors.
“We…”
“We have no leg to stand on…”
Lee Gun laughed when he saw this. According to what Carly had told him, Giselle had threatened Hailey that she would kill Hugo if Hailey did anything.
‘She probably wanted to protect my friend.’
Hailey had also lent out a place where Chun Jiwoo could be hidden. What about Kevin and Stevens?
‘The two of them were influenced by Giselle.’
Giselle was a monarch called Neglect, who had been hiding as the Libra Zodiac. She had used her power to join hands with the Zodiacs. As for those that didn’t listen to her, she made them into her accomplices.
Moreover, there was also a pact that kept their mouths shut.
‘Of course, they were useful enough to take advantage of them.’
It didn’t matter in the end.
Lee Gun had found a clue on how to find Yeonwoo.
‘I’ll get rid of Pisces and Gemini. Both will suffer the same fate.’
The magic-type Zodiacs were the ones that had built the Temple System on the earth. At the same time, they had weakened the power of the Serpent Bearer. They were the main instigators that kept the other Zodiacs in line for being complicit in the crime.
Above all else, Lee Gun had seen them slaughter his younger brother. His eyes turned violent.
“Uh, Uncle? Where are you going?”
“I’m going to designate the Nameless Land as a holy ground.”
That wasn’t all.
[Someone is calling for the Serpent Bearer.]
Curious, Lee Gun headed toward the center of the land.
“Ah. Uncle! Let’s go together!”
Lee Gun and his other party members headed in the direction where the light was emanating.
At that moment, Virgo asked the despairing Kevin a question.
[Are you chasing after them?]
“…”
[Kevin?]
“Goddess. You must know this, but I owe my life to Lee Gun. You know how I plan on settling that debt, right?”
[I do.]
“Originally, I hated you, Goddess.”
[I know. You tried to kill me in the beginning. You even found out how to kill a god.]
“Despite all that, I accepted you because I knew you didn’t hold any ill will toward me. I also did it because I knew you would never lie to me if I made a contract with a Zodiac.”
The Virgo temple was the temple of rules. One earned power by placing strict restrictions and rules.
If one told a lie, it would show that one had lied. Moreover, there was a top secret that others didn’t know. One of the provisions said that one’s head would be decapitated if one lied on purpose. There were other rules, but these strict provisions also applied to the Zodiac.
Kevin had the condition needed to activate this provision right now. “That’s why you won’t be able to get out of this.”
[What do you plan to say? Why do you keep trying to bait me?]
“Let’s talk about something a bit different.” Kevin’s eyes flashed as he looked toward Lee Gun. “You’re the one who killed the thirteenth, right?”
[!]
Virgo was taken aback.
“Why are you acting dumb? It was you. You’re the one who killed the thirteenth.”
[…!]
“Others don’t know your face, so they overlooked you. However, I’m the Zodiac Saint of the Virgo temple. While your face may be a bit different now, did you really think I wouldn’t recognize you?”
Virgo seemed shocked.
It made Kevin coldly laugh. “However, I don’t think you’re stupid enough to become an affiliate under the temple of someone that you killed.”
[…!]
“Also, I don’t feel any evil intent toward Lee Gun from you, so I refrained from speaking for a bit.”
[Kevin.]
“That’s why you better have a good answer. Why are you monitoring Lee Gun?”
[!]
Kevin pointed his sword at her. “Depending on what your intention is, I plan on wiping out the Virgo temple. I’ll merge it with the Serpent Bearer temple.”

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - Talk to me straight (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 262 - Talk to me straight (3)
Virgo seemed shocked. First, she had never expected Kevin to recognize her old self. Second, she never expected him to show killing intent toward her. It wasn’t an idle threat.
‘He really has intentions of killing me.’
There were two ways of killing a god. One way was to rip out their core, as Lee Gun had done, a brutish method. A weak human couldn’t use this method.
However, the second way allowed even a weak human to kill a Zodiac. It was to destroy the Bible, which contained the genesis of a god.
Kevin laughed. “After you guys eradicated the Secretaries, you put the Bibles in the care of the Zodiac Saints. You know this, right?”
“…!”
Virgo flinched and shook.
Gods were beings that could exist only if they had beings that revered and served them. If there was no memory of an event, gods couldn’t exert their influence.
The prime examples were beings like Buddha and Jesus. They continued to be remembered. If the memories about them weren’t passed to future generations, they would eventually be forgotten.
And when gods get forgotten, they lose their power.
This was why the Zodiacs kept Bibles, which recorded their genesis and achievements. These Zodiacs made sure memories about them would be left behind through written words even if they ceased to exist.
In the past, some wretched low-rank gods had disappeared without even a rumor. They didn’t even have Constructs to worship them.
This system was made by some unknown beings for those gods. And when this system left the hands of those that had made it, it kept evolving and evolving. It reached its current form.
So what would happen if Kevin destroyed the Bible?
“The Virgo temple will cease to exist. Furthermore, the achievements, honor, and Constructs that you gathered will all be gone.”
When Kevin made the deadly threat, a goddess holding a blade shot out from his shadow.
[Kevin! How dare you say something so sacrilegious…!]
“Don’t move. I’ll really destroy it.”
[!]
“Get back in there if you understand me. You guys didn’t see it, but the human affiliates of the Serpent Bearer saw it clearly.”
[…!!]
“Those of the unknown civilization snatched away the lives of humanity and Lee Gun’s family. You guys did all of this to grow yourselves after collaborating with the unknown civilization to usurp the seats of your masters. You should be thankful that my faith didn’t bottom out after seeing such a thing.”
[…?!]
The Constructs were shocked. They looked in the direction where they could feel the power of the Virgo. It was as if they were asking whether what he was saying was true.
“Speak. You were the one to kill the thirteenth, right?”
[Kevin! There is no way our master would…!]
[No. It’s fine.]
[Master!]
Virgo sighed. She had never expected her disciple to take these steps.
[You guys must be confused.]
[No. We are…!]
[You don’t need to deceive me. Your faith has already fallen. All the affiliates saw the vision.]
[…!!!]
The gods hidden inside the shadow gulped as they trembled. Virgo soon continued.
[He’s right. We are the ones that killed the original owners.]
[Master!!]
[However, I swear that we never dragged the Monarchs to the earth.]
“Really?”
[At the very least, I didn’t.]
“You didn’t?”
[The ones to arrive in this land first were the Zodiacs of the two magic-type temples.]
“!”
She was talking about Pisces and Gemini.
[I had the intention of gathering disciples here, but I also had to check up on someone.]
“You wanted to check up on someone?”
[It was the thirteenth Zodiac, called the God of Calamity. I’m the one who reincarnated Lee Gun’s beloved.]
[What?!]
“What!?!” Kevin and the goddesses were shocked.
[Master was the one who hid her?!]
“That’s crazy! Lee Gun really had a girlfriend?!”
They were surprised for different reasons, but it didn’t matter.
[Why would you do something so dangerous…!]
“Lee Gun… You traitor… I thought he was an eternal bachelor like me…!”
[If the Zodiacs of the magic find out about this, they won’t let you be!]
“He had one, yet he acted like he didn’t have one. I won’t let him be.”
[Kevin!!]
The Constructs knew what this meant. The Zodiacs of magic were the most difficult beings amongst the twelve Zodiacs. Moreover, they were twin gods. Each of those two temples had two Zodiacs, and they were the ones to build the Temple system. They were the ones to change the earth.
They had also stolen the magic of the Divine world so that they could use forbidden techniques. It was why none of the other Zodiacs challenged them.
[They are the ones who stole the power of the thirteenth Zodiac. They were the ones who drove the thirteenth to his death, right?]
[There was no guarantee Master would have been safe…!]
However, the Constructs were unable to continue their words. They came to an understanding.
‘If Master is a usurper, did she kill the thirteenth Zodiac to keep its mouth shut…’
‘Then why would she reincarnate…?’
As if he could read their curiosity, Kevin asked, “You were the one to kill the thirteenth Zodiac, right? The one before Lee Gun?”
Virgo became lost in her thoughts.
Yeonwoo, who had been the thirteenth Zodiac, had been attacked while Virgo, Sagittarius, and several other Zodiacs were away. The reason behind it was unknown.
Except…
[The god of Cycle was trying to destroy the Divine world!]
[That bitch revived and spread the virus that made the past original owners sick!]
Virgo couldn’t forget the madness in Pisces’s face as it had shouted those words. When she had realized the seriousness of the situation, she had gone to visit Yeonwoo, but Yeonwoo had already been executed at that point.
Thanks to the power of Life, Yeonwoo had been barely clinging to life. Therefore, Virgo had made a request to Leo and Sagittarius, whom she was friendly with. She asked them to draw the attention of the other Zodiacs, and then, she reincarnated Yeonwoo.
Kevin furrowed his brows.
In the end, Virgo’s action toward the thirteenth Zodiac had allowed Lee Gun to become an awakened being.
“Did you revive the snake god because you felt guilty toward the original owner of the thirteenth seat?”
Virgo laughed at Kevin’s cold voice. She would be lying if she said she didn’t feel any guilt. She had always been close to Yeonwoo, but her true reasons for doing it were separate from that.
When she and her fellow Zodiacs had usurped the original owner of the Seats of Power, Virgo had volunteered herself to head toward the thirteenth original owner.
After seeing the original owner, she had immediately said.
