[Oh, Ruler of the snake. Please make a clone of yourself. I’ll pretend to execute you, and I’ll help you hide in a different Divine world.]
However, the thirteenth had just laughed.
[It’s fine. Hurry up and kill me. This body is at its end.]
[!]
The power of Pisces was killing his body. The involvement of the Monarchs was a certainty.
Pisces and the others had made odd moves, such as trying to find the recent whereabouts of the monarchs.
The original owner soon mumbled something. The words surprised Virgo. However, her surprise lasted only a moment when she heard the original owner’s next words.
[… That is why I have no regrets except one. I worry about my baby snake. I wish she would be able to meet her brother and live a happy life.]
These words had bothered Virgo, yet she had decided to follow his last wishes. She had secretly taken and hidden Yeonwoo.
Kevin furrowed his brows. “What’s Lee Gun’s relationship to the thirteenth”
He had accurately guessed that their magical energy felt the same. Virgo knew this, so she spoke.
[I’m not sure either. They might be related by blood. I’m also trying to find that out.]
“Mmm. Alright. I accept all you have to say.”
[Then…!]
Kevin turned around in a cool manner. “Lee Gun! Let’s merge the Virgo temple too! Put me under the Serpent Bearer temple!”
[Kevin!!!]
Virgo became desperate.
Hugo was dumbfounded by Kevin’s shout, which he could hear from far away. “Why does that bastard want to join Gun’s crappy temple? What’s so good about it?”
“Well, he’s better than a certain someone…”
Hugo felt a surge of anger as he went through his phone. He played the video of a YouTube channel, which he had subscribed to earlier.
If fans existed, haters were bound to exist too.
Since Lee Gun’s personality wasn’t that great, several thousand incendiary videos that disparage him existed on the internet.
Of course, the Chun siblings and Carly wouldn’t let such videos stay up, but they couldn’t keep up with the speed at which those videos were uploaded. Moreover, they couldn’t catch the live broadcasts that circulated underground.
Hugo was pleased to see these incendiary videos. “Yes. I should have done this from the start. Human beings are creatures that can be brainwashed. My faith will be no problem with this.”
Hugo’s children looked at him with dumbfounded expressions. Did he really hate being under them?
“Dad. You should get ready to receive baptism as a disciple. Don’t do anything unnecessary.”
“What? Chun Sungjae! Did you just say this is unnecessary? Look! This young friend is speaking the absolute truth!”
- Everyone. Lee Gun is a violent man. Even if he’s the hero of humanity, you shouldn’t forget his true nature.
“Yes! He’s a violent man!! We shouldn’t forget his true nature!!”
- Moreover, Lee Gun frequently puts his purchases on the tab. There are many instances where he ran away without paying for his food. We’ve gathered witnesses.
“Yes!! Gun eats food without paying the bill! He’s rotten!”
- He even stole money from children.
“Yes! He’s shameful for taking from children— Uh? Gun never did that."
- Do you understand? Lee Gun is a scoundrel who steals money. While the other Zodiac Saints protected the world heritage site, he stole money from them!
“Hey, you bastards are instigators! Gun did everything! Hey, Sungjae! Get me a lawyer! I’ll have to sue these guys for defamation!”
“…”
His children looked at him, speechless.
“Wow! These guys are crooks. Why are the comments like this? I’ll have to flag these as malicious comments. Gun took advantage of every woman that approached him? They all ran away when they saw his face and personality!”
[Hugo Otis]
[Serpent Bearer Faith 580%]
Lee Gun just shook his head when he saw this. At the same time, he came to a stop. The place he had stopped was at the heart of the Nameless Land.
Lee Gun laughed as he watched the light of Life surge up from the center.
[Someone is calling for the Serpent Bearer.]
The Nameless Land was previously ruled by Abundance. It was a mysterious magical territory. No one knew where it came from and why the Zodiacs wanted it.
“God-nim. I believe something is hidden in the Nameless Land... It’s something God-nim can’t afford to lose.”
“Is that so? Something I can’t afford to lose?”
“Yes. That’s why Taurus wanted this land and showed up at Drachma. Of course, it suffered defeat on that day at the hands of God-nim…”
The Secretary had been having fun as she went through the Bible of the Taurus temple, which had merged with the Serpent Bearer temple. She had successfully decoded the records of the Taurus temple, and in turn, Lee Gun had received good information.
‘They were slaughtered by the Zodiacs because they possess such abilities.’
All the Secretaries had been killed in the past for one reason.
‘The Zodiacs didn’t want their secrets to be revealed.’
Secretaries could read the past, and they must have learned the truth about the usurpation. Moreover, they must have learned why the Zodiacs had killed Lee Gun.
As if to prove this, a vision brushed through Lee Gun’s mind.
[Lee Gun taking an active role is fine, but it’ll be a problem if he kills all the monsters.]
[Lee Gun is too good. If left alone, he might eradicate the unknown civilization.]
[We have to stick to our initial goal. We have to raise people’s faith toward us through fear.]
Lee Gun became angry at the unbidden memories that the Seat of power had brought up. It also felt like there was a ringleader amongst the Zodiacs.
“Those wretched bastards!”
Hugo’s body shook when he heard Lee Gun’s words.
‘I’ve never heard such a voice from him.’
The killing intent contained within Lee Gun’s voice was on a completely different level. Hugo had thought Gun had turned a bit more mild-mannered after meeting Yeonwoo, but that thought was dispelled in an instant.
‘For some reason, his personality got much worse.’
Was he mistaken? Hugo shook from fear.
Lee Gun ignored him as he immediately activated his skill.
[Holy ground designation!]
[The Nameless Land has been designated as the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground.]
[You feel an incredible amount of Life energy.]
[Life has gained a massive amount of EXP.]
[The Nameless Land greets its new owner.]
Boom!!!
As the ground shook, something started surging up from it.
[The hidden item is being revealed.]
‘It came out..’
The Zodiacs had interfered with him acquiring this land because they didn’t want him to have this item. Lee Gun let out a sharp laugh as he headed toward the items that had emerged from the ground.
Pah-jee-jeek!
“Uh!”
At that moment, Sungjae cheered.
Accompanying the enormous power of life, the egg he possessed started to crack.
[Serpent Bearer’s Construct (SSS) is reacting.]
Lee Gun flinched. It somehow felt familiar.
* * *
Around that time, Pisces’s holy ground.
“Is that so? Aries became Lee Gun’s slave?”
A Zodiac that had taken on the form of the Pisces Saint started to laugh. She had learned what had happened through an agent of the Divine world.
“It seems Aries bought that cube from Time. Why did it fail in killing Lee Gun?”
[Ah! I believe Sagittarius stole it.]
“Sagittarius?”
[Yes. However, it doesn’t make sense. Sagittarius is our accomplice.]
Pisces let out an odd smirk.
“It’s understandable. He can’t kill his nephew.”
[What? What did you just say?]
“It’s nothing. Anyway, you should get ready. The only Zodiacs left are the Zodiacs of magic.”
[!]
“I know Lee Gun’s weakness.”
[Then…!]
“I’ll bring Time.”
Kwahng!!
Suddenly, Pisces’s holy ground shook. They felt a powerful impact as if they were being bombarded.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Talk to me straight (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Talk to me straight (4)
Twenty-five years ago, three people lived together. They were Lee Gun, Yeonwoo, and her younger brother.
“Gun hyung! Hyung is here?”
“Hey, Hyung is tired. Go away.”
“Really? Should I go and buy some chicken? You want to eat with Noona?”
The young man liked to follow Lee Gun as if Lee Gun were his biological brother. He really liked Lee Gun.
It was also true that the younger brother sometimes acted a bit odd. The look in his eyes at times felt inhuman. Lee Gun had wondered how a child could have such scary eyes.
Despite being a child, he had been familiar with death. At the time, Lee Gun had thought the kid was a courageous yet laid-back person.
However, Lee Gun still couldn’t forget about the day when the monsters had invaded. For the first time, he had felt killing intent from a family member he had been living with.
‘They came here.’
His younger brother always had an idiotic smile on his face, but for the first time, Lee Gun had seen him grind his teeth.
“Did they call them here?”
At the time, Lee Gun hadn’t understood his younger brother’s words. However, this didn’t change that, that kid was the kind little brother who tried to look after Lee Gun and his older sister.
Lee Gun had continued to spend happy days with them for another year. However, that happiness came to an end when the siblings were murdered by the monsters.
On the day he was murdered, the child had let out a sigh of relief for some reason when seeing Lee Gun.
“Ah! What a relief! They didn’t go toward you.” He had then grabbed Yeonwoo. “Be careful of the twins, Noona. They are looking for us.”
After speaking those puzzling words, the child had passed away.
Both Yeonwoo and Lee Gun had been in grief.
At that point, the only family member Lee Gun had left was Yeonwoo, and even she had departed after a couple of months. His only family had disappeared from the world.
***
[The hidden item has revealed itself.]
[Serpent Bearer’s Construct (SSS) is reacting to the item.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he sensed a nostalgic feeling.
Koo-goo-goong!
[The Nameless Land has regained its original owner.]
[It has transformed into the holy ground of the Ruler of Serpents.]
“!!”
The change surprised everyone. They wondered what would show up.
As the ground shook, buildings started to emerge from the ground.
“That’s…!”
“That’s the palace of a Zodiac!”
Yes, these buildings were part of a holy palace; they could be called the heart of a temple.
Each Zodiac possessed a main palace. Normally, it was located in the Divine world. The Zodiac Saints could see it only when the Zodiacs granted them an audience.
The palaces could be seen on earth only if they were replicas or the Zodiac had purposefully called it here.
“That symbol…!!”
“Serpent Bearer?”
“What the hell? Why would the palace of the Serpent Bearer be in a land that was owned by a monarch?”
While everyone was confused…
“Ahhk! It’s coming out!” Chun Sungjae, who held the egg, didn’t know what to do. He was flustered. “Hot! Hot! Hot!!!!!!”
“Hey! Don’t drop it!”
Yooha and Hugo quickly grabbed Sungjae’s arms when light erupted from the egg.
[The new Construct has accepted the power of the Serpent Bearer and is opening its eyes.]
“Koohk!”
Finally, blinding light surged forth. Even Lee Gun had to close one eye.
This egg was a reward that Lee Gun had received for going through the trials for his first awakening. For some odd reason, it wouldn’t hatch, so he had entrusted it to Iaso (Disinfectant).
[Kyahhhk! It hatched!]
[My god!!]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when the egg broke. A small black snake hatched from the egg. It was a tiny baby snake.
“Wow! Look at its size…!”
“Is this really a snake?”
Its body was as long as a finger and its head the size of a fingernail. It was a baby snake, but it was unmistakably a Construct!
[My god! Baby snake-nim had a baby!]
The Virgo constructs swooned, while Hailey and her Constructs looked surprised.
[It’s an infant, yet it’s a very high-rank god.]
[That’s Lee Gun-nim’s Construct…!]
Hugo, who had been watching this scene, became surprised.
‘The power I can feel from it is different.’
If it were the magical energy that could be felt from this land, hatching the egg would have been hard.
“Ahhk!! Uncle!!!”
“!!”
At that moment, Chun Sungjae trembled. It looked like he was about to cry. “U-Uncle! It isn’t moving…! It isn’t breathing!”
“What?!”
Everyone was surprised.
While the ground shook, the snake gasped as it was having a hard time breathing.
The notification told Lee Gun how serious things were.
[The newly born Construct’s life energy is quickly weakening.]
[It needs emergency healing.]
Everyone approached the snake in surprise.
“It really isn’t breathing. Is it sick?”
“Is it innately weak because the egg was handled roughly?”
Chun Sungjae turned deathly pale at those words. “U-Uncle!!”
“What the hell? It’s just hungry.”
Hugo became angry at Lee Gun’s nonchalant attitude. “Hey! Do you think that’s you? It’s convulsing because it’s having a hard time breathing. How can you say it is hungry—”
Koo-goo-goong! Koo-goo-goong!!
The earthquake rang out once again!
Hugo was taken aback since the fierce earthquake made it hard for him to center himself.
“Hey! Are you sure it’s making this noise because it’s hungry?”
“There might be a chance that its body is unwell. I’ll bring the Aquarius…!”
At that moment…
“Ahhhk!” Kevin, who had been approaching them, screamed.
The baby snake, which had been gasping in pain, had jumped at him. To be precise, it attacked a small box located within his jacket.
“That box is…!”
“It’s my snack box. It contains emergency food.”
Hugo replied, “As expected of a rich asshole Zodiac Saint! You put diamonds on your snack box?”
“Who cares? I’m swimming in gems donated to me.”
“Ahkk!!!”
The snake started chewing on the box even though it didn’t have any teeth.
Kevin understood what was going on, so he took out a biscuit. “I’ve never seen a snake that likes cookies—”
However…
“Ahhhk!! That’s not food!”
Yes, the baby snake’s target was something entirely different. It didn’t even look at the biscuit. It started eating the holy item that had stored the biscuit.
This made Lee Gun laugh as if he was amused, while the others screamed.
“What the hell! It’s eating a holy item?!”
“No. It seems to eat whatever is expensive.”
“What? What are you—” Kevin started screaming again. “Ahhk! Don’t eat my phone!!!”
That wasn’t all.
“Hey! My royal holy item is off-limits! Don’t eat it!!” Hugo desperately tried to hide the bag attached to his belt.
The snake had smelled the royal holy item of the Sagittarius temple within the bag.
“This guy is aiming for only high-rank holy items!”
When Hugo desperately tried to protect the Archer Saint’s bow, Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “You’re part of the Serpent Bearer temple. You can’t use it anymore. Just let my kid eat it.”
“Have you lost your mind? I’m going back to the Sagittarius temple! This is off-limits! Don’t eat it!”
Hugo snatched away Lee Gun’s Heaven’s Punishment. The weapon was in a newly made stage 0 form. It looked like a necklace.
“If you want to eat something high-rank, eat this! This is an EX-rank item!”
The move made Lee Gun glare at Hugo, but the snake decided to bite Hugo’s finger.
“Ahhhk!”
To its credit, the snake seemed to recognize its owner’s item.
[(Nameless) says how dare you touch the noble item. It expresses its anger.]
[It angrily says Master’s items aren’t food.]
Since it was like a worm without teeth, it didn’t cause serious damage. However, it was still a high-rank Construct!
Hugo’s finger swelled up.
[(Nameless) has been designated as the Serpent Bearer’s Construct.]
[Will you name it?]
“Name?”
Hugo furrowed his brows when he heard the murmur.
‘He is probably talking about the name of the Construct.’
Lee Gun’s naming sense was terrible.
“I’m sure he’ll name it as Worm.”
“No way, Dad. If it’s uncle, he’ll name it as King Crawler.”
“What are you saying? He’ll call it Alcohol Ingredient.”
“What about Black Poop?”
“Black Rope.”
When Hailey joined in, the Virgo Constructs reacted in anger.
[How dare you look down on Baby snake-nim!]
[That’s right! It’ll definitely be named Aphrodisiac!]
“Joonwoo.”
[See! It’s Joonwoo—]
“?!!!”
Everyone was shocked. It was as if something that could never happen had happened.
“I can’t believe Gun gave a normal name to the baby Construct…!”
“W-What’s wrong with him?”
“Did we do something wrong, Noona?”
“Did it find out that we secretly ate chicken without Uncle?”
They looked at Lee Gun with serious expressions.
On the other hand, Lee Gun nonchalantly stroked the baby snake’s chin with his index finger.
[(Nameless) has received the name “Joonwoo.”]
[Divine Status (True Name) can be checked.]
Lee Gun smirked when he realized the identity of the newly born god. “Anyway, I’ll let you guys feed it. It won’t eat anything I made, so I have no choice.”
“What? You want us to feed it? Doesn’t it eat only holy items?! How would we acquire those…”
“It isn’t my problem. You come up with what to do.”
“Hey!!”
“Anyway, its adult body is supposed to be huge. It’ll eat an ignorant amount.”
“What? What is its identity?”
“I’m not sure, but at the very least, I know it’ll grow as big as the earth.”
“What?!”
At that moment…
Koo-goo-goong!
“!”
The newly emerged palace emitted light, and something surprising happened.
“That’s…!”
Beings that looked like ghosts started to head toward Lee Gun.
[The servants of <Ruler of Serpents> feel the presence of their owner. They are approaching.]
[The servants cannot believe their eyes when they feel the presence of their master. They are approaching.]
Virgo Constructs became surprised by their presence.
[M…My god!]
[They are the old Constructs of the Serpent Bearer…!]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose at their words.
“What? They are the old Construct of the Serpent Bearer temple?”
[Yes! They are the Constructs that existed during the time of the 13th original owner!]
“!”
Everyone was surprised.
The Constructs of the Virgo temple couldn’t close their mouths. Even Aries was appalled.
It was to be expected.
[My god. They were taken by the other Zodiacs when the 13th was killed.…!]
“What? The other Zodiacs took them?”
[Yes…! The 13th original owner was famous in the Divine world for ruling over the strongest Constructs!]
Unlike the surprised Virgo Constructs, Aries was sweating.
‘Shit. They should be trapped within the prisons of the other Zodiacs…!’
Despite Aries being a slave now, it still coveted those Constructs. They were special even in the Divine world.
‘If he is able to recover them, the Serpent Bearer can’t be messed with.’
There were those that were powerful, and there were those that were weak in power. There were also ones that possessed special abilities.
They were very diverse.
Virgo Constructs spoke.
[Amongst the Constructs ruled over by the 13th, there are a lot of legendary beings.]
“That means they are…”
[Yes. They aren’t all of them, but when the Serpent Bearer’s temple was revitalized, they were summoned through his will.]
The Constructs looked like smoke, and they looked longingly at Lee Gun.
Of course, they couldn’t properly see his appearance, but they were sure of it.
[The true owner of the <Seat of Power…!]
[Owner of the Serpent Bearer temple…!]
When they saw this, the Chun siblings had a realization.
“Ah…! Is this why the Zodiacs didn’t want to lose this land to Uncle? This place held the main palace of the old <Serpent Bearer>?”
At Chun Yooha’s words, Virgo Constructs nodded their heads.
The current 12 Zodiacs were excellent, but the era of the original owners was like the height of their power.
[I believe that temple is the old main palace that existed during the time of the 13th original owner.]
Lee Gun smirked.
“You are talking about the one that used to be in the Divine world?”
Hugo and Kevin were taken aback.
“This land is the old territory of the Serpent Bearer??!”
“Why would a monarch occupy such a land?”
It happened when the astral bodies tried to approach Lee Gun.
Boom!!!
“!”
The ground shook greatly.
“W…What is it?”
Everyone was surprised by the alarming earthquake.
Flash!
“!”
Light erupted from the doll that Yeonwoo left behind.
* * *
It was around when Lee Gun was meeting his new Construct.
At the heart of the Sagittarius temple’s holy ground, Sagittarius immediately realized that the Serpent Bearer had occupied a new holy ground.
Since it had to do with the lead temple, he inevitably knew about it.
[It seems Lee Gun recovered the old holy ground of the Serpent Bearer.]
The land had been given to a monarch by the < Zodiacs of Magic>.
Of course, <Abundance> had hidden it from its peers, and it had used the land for its own power.
[From what I hear, you interfered with Aries]
[!]
Sagittarius became surprised when a Zodiac of Magic stood behind him.
It was one of the two remaining Zodiacs of Magic.
It was the Gemini that Lee Gun held a grudge against.
[You didn’t want to kill Lee Gun in the Devil’s Tower. Your love for your nephew is amazing.]
[…!]
[Of course, you have no memory of him, so it isn’t as if you protected him knowingly.]
The Zodiac smirked.
[Well, we were surprised. We never expected that bastard to eat the original owner so quickly. It produced a hybrid like you.]
The Zodiac spoke.
[Well, it doesn’t matter. You will make the right choice again. You will choose whether you stand with them or us.]
However, the Zodiac soon shook its head from side to side.
[No. You chose the other side once you decided to interfere with our work.]
An enormous magic circle appeared, and the magic attacked the Sagittarius.
It caused an enormous earthquake to manifest around the world.
[<Oblivion> revealed itself]

chapters.title: Chapter 264: What is this (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: What is this (1)
Flash!
Light erupted from the doll Yeonwoo had left behind.
This light surprised the mysterious astral bodies that were approaching Lee Gun. Their voices were indistinct, but what they were saying was clear.
[That’s…!]
[That’s the baby snake that followed Master…!]
Since they used to follow the same master, they recognized Yeonwoo. They were about to say something when…
Jee-jeek!
“!”
The ghost-like Constructs started to fade away.
The Virgo Constructs immediately realized what was happening.
[Since the holy ground was revived, they were temporarily summoned. It seems they have been dismissed once again!]
Their words seemed correct. Every one of the indistinct Constructs took a knee in front of Lee Gun.
[We were able to see our exalted master, but it was so brief…!]
[We were given contracts against our will, and we were spread across the other Zodiacs. However, this doesn’t change our loyalty toward the Serpent Bearer!]
[I’m sure the best Constructs among us, who can’t be here, feel the same way…!]
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “I’m sorry, but I’m not the person you used to know.”
[We already know this. This doesn’t change that you are our master.]
“!”
[Being able to be present in your audience is a miracle. We are satisfied with seeing the Serpent Bearer’s countenance even if we will never see you again…]
Lee Gun let out a good-natured laugh. “Why won’t you be able to see me? I just have to go find you guys.”
Moved by those words, the Constructs trembled. They were holding their tears back as they deeply lowered their heads.
[We will look forward to the day we get to meet you again. Until then, please be healthy…!]
They wanted to see Lee Gun a bit more until the end, but they had something more important to do. They spoke.
[Evil conspirators are aiming for the Serpent Bearer! Please be careful of them!]
[You cannot be like those who are buried in this land…]
[We hope this will be of help to you…!]
At last, the Constructs of the old Serpent Bearer disappeared. Then, a light appeared from Lee Gun’s body.
[The Divine status of the Ruler of Serpents has awakened.]
[The pledge has raised the level of the Divine status.]
[You have leveled up.]
[The servants of the Ruler of Serpents have left behind special items and abilities.]
Lee Gun laughed when he felt something from his body. It was the item that they had left behind.
In contrast to his earlier magnanimous laughter, he started laughing in a wicked manner.
‘At a glance, I can tell that they are powerful. The matter regarding their original owner no longer matters. They will be very useful to me.’
Them being under the delusion that he was their owner was beneficial to him.
On the other hand, Hugo seemed worried by the words those Constructs had left behind. “Those who are buried in this land…?”
As if it was reacting to his words, the ground shook.
[The Serpent Bearer’s old land reacts to its owner’s will. It reveals all the items hidden within the island.]
As if it wanted to show Lee Gun something important, the ground split apart.
Zzuh-uhng!
The enormous wild land split apart. It was light watching the miracle of Moses! The object seen beneath the earth surprised everyone.
“That’s…!”
Lee Gun laughed in interest. “Aren’t those corpses?”
The hole clearly contained tangled monster corpses.
Chun Sungjae jumped in, only to be surprised. “At a glance, they look like monsters…! What is this? I can feel Divine status from them! Was magic used on them?”
“If it’s magic, the one behind this must be either Pisces or Gemini, right?”
“Why would the Zodiacs hide this?”
Why else? Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. “These are probably the original owners that they killed.”
“?!”
“After killing something, the hardest task is getting rid of the corpse. It’ll be troublesome if someone investigates. That’s why the original owners were buried here before this land was handed over to a monarch. This was a spotless way of getting rid of the evidence, a win-win situation”
“…!!”
Hearing that, Kevin called forth Virgo, but she also seemed surprised. She seemed to be unaware of this.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “From the energy left behind here, this is the doings of the Zodiacs of Magic. Another thing that bothers me is that these corpses aren’t whole.”
Lee Gun immediately took out his phone.
“Uncle?”
“I got the right man for an investigation like this.”
That person would be able to investigate the Constructs who had shown up here.
After he had made the call, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if the important part would start now. “A Monarch is nearby.”
“What?!”
As if to prove this, the doll Yeonwoo had left behind started flashing.
Hugo’s expression completely changed. “The doll flashing means Miss Yeonwoo is nearby, right?”
“Yes. To be precise, the bastard that’s keeping Yeonwoo is nearby.”
Hailey and the Chun siblings tilted their heads in puzzlement.
“Who is Miss Yeonwoo?”
The answer came from Kevin. “She’s Lee Gun’s lover.”
“?!!”
Hailey’s and the Chun siblings’ expressions were a sight to behold.
“She isn’t my lover.” Lee Gun clarified.
“That’s right. Uncle is single for life!”
Chun Sungjae still couldn’t forget it. After Lee Gun had returned, a large corporation had approached them, saying they wanted to use Lee Gun in a commercial.
“This project makes no sense, Assistant Manager Chang. Who the hell is perpetually single at an age over forty in this day and age?”
“You’re right! I’m sorry! I guess forty was a bit too much. Should I make it around twenty-five years old?”
“Yes. Unless the person has lost their mind, there is no way for them to be single until the age of forty…”
“I’m sorry for still being single over forty.”
“?”
The employees were puzzled since they saw Lee Gun’s youthful appearance. Soon, they screamed and realized their situation. They monitored Lee Gun, trembling.
Of course, Sungjae’s uncle had kept it cool, but the deathly pale employees had groveled for his uncle’s forgiveness. It was a sight to behold.
“W-We have committed a grave sin!! Yes, that’s right! It’s the trend these days to be single until a hundred years old!! Yes! Of course!!!’
“That’s right!!! Who the hell told you to bring such a plan!! Get rid of it right now! Burn it!!! Melt it!!!”
“Yes!!!”
The employees didn’t know what to do with themselves as they shook from fear.
As penance for their sins, Lee Gun received assurance for presents for the next five years. This included the latest consumer electronics, home appliances, and chicken. He also received all kinds of gift sets on top of it.
The eyes of Kevin, Yooha, and Hailey flashed when they heard those words. On the other hand, Hugo didn’t care about that.
He glanced at Lee Gun. “Is Time nearby? It’s the one that went after you at the Devil’s Tower.”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “No. It’s Oblivion.”
“What?!”
“Really?”
Hugo was surprised by Lee Gun’s answer.
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. “I recognize it now that it’s closer. It’s familiar to me.”
“!”
The incident had occurred twenty-four years ago. Lee Gun still couldn’t fully remember what had happened, but a single memory had been left behind.
“On that day, I remember being swallowed by something like a fog.” He wondered if that was Oblivion.
These words shocked Hailey and her Constructs.
[What? Did you just say you were swallowed up by Oblivion?]
[That can’t be…!! There’s no way you’re still alive if it had swallowed you!]
[Even the other Monarchs are afraid of Oblivion!]
Oblivion was an unknown being that didn’t possess many emotions and rational thought. It moved freely throughout the world. If one was swallowed by it, one would be erased from the world.
‘Just brushing it can erase memories and faith…!’
[Also, if it had swallowed you, why can people remember you?]
“Ah. I might have been forgotten. Anyone I had met before my awakening couldn’t remember me. Aside from the items on my person, most of the data about me had disappeared.”
[??!!]
This surprised Hugo and Kevin.
“No wonder nothing came up when I tried looking into your past!”
After Lee Gun had first shown up on the scene, every country in the world had tried to look up his background. They wanted to find anyone related to him to rope him toward their country.
Of course, some Zodiac Saints tried to find Lee Gun’s parents to take them as hostages. However, all of them had failed.
It was why a lot of people were still curious about Lee Gun’s past. Yet, no one remembered him.
“Is it all because you were eaten by Oblivion before? Is that the reason?”
“Maybe?”
Lee Gun nonchalantly replied, but the Chun siblings looked shocked. They looked at him with sadness. How could he be so nonchalant about it? Not being remembered by anyone was a terrible thing.
“That’s why not even your schoolmates came looking for you when your face was revealed….!”
Some swindlers had shown up, but that wasn’t important right now.
‘Since no one can remember Abundance’s face, Oblivion must have swallowed it a while ago.’
Of course, humans and monsters still remembered the existence named Abundance. Digesting a mighty Monarch probably took a lot of time.
“That’s odd. There is no way Oblivion would show itself so readily.” Hailey was worried.
‘Did someone call for it to target Lee Gun?’
Zzuh-uhng!
Hugo became unsteady on his feet as if his head had been hit.
“Taeksoo?”
“Dad!”
Hugo massaged his temple. He knew what this sensation was; he was sure of it.
‘Future prediction.’
It seemed his skill had been transferred to the Serpent Bearer temple. This wasn’t a simple transfer. The skill had evolved to fit the nature of the Serpent Bearer. However, since it was still in development, Hugo couldn’t check what kind of future it was.
[Warning: Serpent Bearer, Juice, Lose something important, Zodiac chance, crunchy, oh yeah!]
Hugo didn’t know what most of these words referred to. However, what else could they mean?
‘Something will happen to Gun.’
Did it have to do with the Zodiacs of Magic?
Lee Gun smirked when he received a notification.
[The Zodiac of Magic has summoned the Monarch of falsehood.]
“I wondered why this was emitting light. It seems one of the Pisces twins called forth Oblivion.”
“What? Are you referring to the Zodiacs of Magic?!”
They wondered how those Zodiacs could call forth a Monarch, but it was a plausible scenario.
‘It might be possible if it is the Zodiacs of Magic.’
“Anyway, I’m going toward those bastards. You guys don’t have to follow me.” Lee Gun placed the newly born baby snake on his head as he turned around.
The Virgo Constructs quickly tried to hold him back.
[Baby snake-nim! It’s too dangerous!]
“!”
[Did you not hear the warning that those Constructs gave earlier…!!]
[That’s right! You might have guessed this already, but the Zodiacs of Magic killed the previous Serpent Bearer!]
[These Zodiacs have a power that can weaken the Serpent Bearer!]
[That’s right. It’s the reason Lee Gun-nim had a hard time getting through Taurus’s defensive wall!]
[If that happens, Lee Gun-nim will suffer the same fate as the previous Serpent Bearer…!]
Lee Gun smirked. “Hey.”
“!”
“Why do you think I went after Taurus?”
“You’re a masochist, so it doesn’t matter. However, your disciples aren’t, so you wanted defensive abilities for them, right?”
Hugo took another beating.
“A-Anyway, you did it because your defensive gears were shredded by a Monarch?”
The Serpent Bearer temple didn’t even have a single defensive skill. It instead had incredible amounts of blessings related to offensive abilities. In terms of defensive blessings, the situation was akin to having nothing on at all.
That wasn’t all.
‘A body part has to survive for Super Regeneration to work.’
And beings like Monarchs and the Zodiacs of Magic could destroy the entire body with one attack.
“You have to block at least one attack, even if your regeneration ability is strong. That’s why you got the defensive abilities…”
“That is one reason. However…” Lee Gun let out a menacing laugh. “You know this. Taurus’s defensive ability also has an innate resistance to magic.”
“!”
Lee Gun always hated the Zodiacs of Magic and their Zodiac Saints. If it were up to him, he would’ve chopped them up with an ax since the various magic spells they possessed were annoying to deal with.
There was a reason the Leo temple’s relationship with the Gemini temple was like oil and water. Leo was a Zodiac similar in type to the Serpent Bearer.
However, those Zodiacs wouldn’t be a problem if Lee Gun had a defensive ability. That wasn’t all.
‘As the level of Life rises, my defense gets stronger.’
That would mean he could block the Monarchs’ attacks.
After hearing those words, the Virgo Constructs looked at Lee Gun with reverence.
[My god! The dream of getting rid of the difficult Zodiacs of Magic isn’t a dream anymore!]
[As expected of Baby snake-nim…!!]
“No. I can’t get rid of them.”
[What?!!]
“Taurus’s abilities haven’t been transferred to the Serpent Bearer yet.”
[!]
As if it were reacting to those words, Lee Gun heard a notification.
[To transfer all of the merged Taurus’s abilities to the Serpent Bearer, you need the Primordial Power.]
[Transfer (Random) needs Talents.]
[Each Transfer needs 10,000,000 Talents.]
[VAT: 1,000,000 additional Talents]
[The total number of Taurus’s abilities that can be transferred is 287.]
Even if he put aside the VAT, Lee Gun needed a total of 2.8 billion Talents.
‘It’s quite expensive for being random.’
Lee Gun glanced at Aries, who had a choker on it.
Aries was frightened when it felt a familiar gaze. It was being picked on again.
[This particular slave has too much debt. It can no longer take on more debt.]
“Tsk!”
Unless the Divine world was stupid, it wouldn’t let Lee Gun continue to slide like this.
“Ten million Talents are needed to transfer just one ability.”
“T-Ten million?!”
The surprised Hugo looked at the rich Kevin.
“I can’t give away Talents for nothing. I need to receive something equivalent…”
“Ah! It’s fine. I have a way of making all those Talents for free. I can get them all at once.”
“What? No way! Even you can’t get 2.8 billion Talents at once…”
Lee Gun glanced at the sky. “Hey, Miny!”
[Yes! Master!]
Aries’s store room housed several hundred Berserk clones.
The Berserk clones got happy as they approached Lee Gun.
[For what reason have you called us…!]
“If you guys are to be sold, which master would you like to be sold to?”
[What?]

chapters.title: Chapter 265: What is this (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: What is this (2)
‘There are only two Zodiacs left.’
The Zodiacs of Magic were the most fantastical beings even amongst the twelve Zodiacs.
[BJ:[1] Which Zodiac temples do you think are the strongest? (Lee Gun Battle Live Broadcast – Viewers: 8,473,858)]
– mack: Of course, it’s the battle-type Zodiac temples. Aren’t Leo, Virgo, and Taurus the ones to kill the monsters?
– hugo: Wait a moment. Why are you leaving out Sagittarius? The Sagittarius temple is a legit battle-type temple that kills monsters.
– WG: They still exist?ㅋㅋㅋ
– hugo: Hey! We took care of what the Leo temple couldn’t do last time. We took care of the Virgo temple’s failure too!
– ri: Yes, yes. I’m glad to hear from the PR team of the Sagittarius temple. ㅋ Next PR team should speak up now
– UnclePetMe: ??? They don’t have a PR team. They don’t have the money to set one up.
– ri: Oh? ㅈ?
… So pitiful ㅠㅠㅠㅠ
– hugo: Hey! Chun Sungjae! Come home right now!!!
– UnclePetMe: Damn it! How did he know?
(UnclePetMe has left the room.)
Well, it didn’t matter.
┕ Of course, the strongest are the magic-type temples.
┕ 2222. Battle-type temples are degenerates that only know about fighting.
┕ Their attack capabilities are the same as that of the battle-type temples. Also, the magic-type temples are the ones that set up the Temple system on the earth. They are the founders.
┕ ㅇㅇ The skill rental system, the disciple system, and the badge system are all their creations.
┕ They were also the ones to re-establish the means of transportation and communication, which the unknown civilization had disrupted.
┕ Zodiacs aren’t interested in temple rankings. It’s all lip service.
┕ 222 Do you realize how troublesome the magic-type temples are
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ Even the Zodiac Saints hate going against the magic-type temples.
Those words were true.
Stevens and Kevin blanched at the thought of fighting those from the magic-type temples, and they were supposed to be battle fanatics who could never get enough of fighting.
“Shit! Those bastards developed another strange spell again!”
“That’s crazy! It’s a Gender Swap spell! Cat! Be carefu— Ahhk! Don’t look toward me, bastard! I’ll see this in my dreams!!!”
Of course, Lee Gun also hated the magic-type temples. There was a reason he and the Gemini Saint butted heads until blood flew.
“Hey! You want to die? What kind of spell did you place on me?”
“What do you think? It’s a spell that prevents your hair from growing.”
“What?!”
“You’re already losing your hair. There is no chance it’ll grow back. I’m sure it’s annoying for you to take care of your hair every day. So I made sure you can’t even grow downy hair. It won’t even grow roots. You should thank me.”
“Hey!!! If you have the time to create something like that, you should develop a way to grow hair!”
“What? What are you talking about? If that were possible, I would be a Zodiac. No, I’m sure hair loss can’t be fixed by the gods either.”
“Hey!!!”
Lee Gun had suffered at their hands in many ways, and this was only a fraction of what they could do.
“Kuhk! Saint-nim! My feet move when I try to move my hands!”
“They all died from old age!”
“Our disciples and holy items turned to ashes from just a flick of a finger!”
It started with a spell that made one ugly. Then came the spell that could make zombies. Another one could swap souls. One of them even made people paraplegic. All kinds of debuffs could be cast by the disciples of these two temples. These debuffs rose in power when the Zodiacs descended.
Moreover, each of those temples possessed two Seats of power and had two Zodiacs each. This was why there were talks that said if the magic-type temples revealed their power, the world would be razed to the ground.
Of course, they chose not to do that because they had a particular weakness. This weakness allowed the balance to exist between the twelve Zodiacs.
‘Anyway, magic resistance is a must if I want to fight them.’
Of course, Lee Gun also knew why the Zodiacs had yet to show themselves.
‘I purposefully locked up their Zodiac Saints in the figurines.’
If a Zodiac didn’t have its Zodiac Saint, it couldn’t manifest its true power on the earth.
For this reason, Lee Gun had meticulously hidden the figurines. There was a possibility of the Zodiacs finding and killing the Zodiac Saints. This way, they would be able to end the contract with their existing Zodiac Saints and find new ones.
On the other hand, it was a temporary measure.
‘They aren’t idiots. If they get angry, they’ll try to attack the Seat of power.’
That was the reason Lee Gun had merged with Taurus.
‘It was why they had a close relationship with Taurus.’
Defense was the weakness of magicians. While the two magic-type temples were on bad terms with the Leo temple and the Virgo temple, they were close to the Taurus temple. That relationship was like the one between crocodiles and crocodile birds.
That was why Lee Gun had refused to bring in the Taurus temple as an affiliate. Instead, he had decided on a merger. It would prevent the Zodiacs of Magic from pulling their tricks on him.
[Congratulations! Number 117 Miny has been safely sold.]
[It was auctioned for 200 million Talents.]
[Ahhhhk!! Masterrrrrrrr!]
The sold Berserk clone wailed in the direction of Lee Gun. Lee Gun had sold it in the Divine world auction he was hosting.
As for how he opened an auction, it was simple.
[Entrance to Market of Goblins (Owner’s skill)]
– Entrance to the Divine world’s marketplace
[Wealth Conversion (Owner’s skill)]
– All kinds of wealth gathered within the temple can be converted into Talents.
– Cash, non-cash items, offerings, donations, etc. The worth of these items will be assessed, and they will be converted into Talents.
These skills had appeared when he had reached level 11. He had acquired them after going through his first trial.
The “Entrance to Market of Goblins” skill probably referred to the marketplace of the Divine world.
When Lee Gun had activated the skill, an agent of the Divine world had appeared and hosted the auction.
[The agent spread the news that Constructs were going to be sold at the Market of Goblins.]
It seemed Lee Gun’s level was too low to enter the auction himself, but it didn’t matter.
[The gods who are participating in the auction are cheering madly.]
[A god with its face hidden looks satisfied. It asks where Constructs of such good quality were obtained.]
[They cheer that the Constructs are high-rank battle-type gods.]
[An enormous number of participants have gathered at the personal auction.]
[Waiting List: 1,403]
[Number 118 Miny has been auctioned once again.]
Lee cackled. Of course, the sold Miny clone despaired as it looked for its owner.
[Ahhk! Master! I like master… Kuhk!]
Number 118 sniffed back its tears as it disappeared in a flash of light.
This sight left Hugo and Kevin dumbfounded.
“A-Are you sure you should sell them?”
Lee Gun snorted. “They are copies. They’ll disappear in the end.”
“Really?!”
“Are you idiots? Of course. If they didn’t, Aries would have been the strongest.”
“That means.…!”
Lee Gun grinned. Aries was one of the twelve Zodiacs for a reason.
Despite being clones, these Constructs’ abilities were good. This was why the gods cheered.
‘Moreover, it replicated the loyalty too.’
“Alright. The sold ones will immediately check the storeroom of your masters. Check if there are any useful Constructs.”
[Masterrrrrrrr!]
[Number 119 Miny has been sold again.]
“Hell yeah! This time, it sold for 400 million.”
Lee Gun had acquired the Auction ability from Aries. If the condition was right, the gods that he wanted could be stolen…
No. Instead of the bids, it was more important to know the internal situation of the other gods.
‘The Minies will bring back information to me.’
Normally, the gods took what they wanted through contests. Therefore, this was a decent option to get what he wanted. That wasn’t all.
It would eventually be found out that Lee Gun could create clones that could deceive even the gods. After that, wouldn’t he be able to make a bigger fortune?
Hugo looked at the evil expression on Lee Gun’s face with disgust. “How can he be a god? I have no idea who would believe in such a god.”
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 590%]
Lee Gun soon gathered around the right amount of Talents.
[Taurus’s abilities will be transferred.]
[You have paid the price.]
[The abilities will be transferred at random.]
[Strong Faith (B)] [Weak Rush (S)]
Lee Gun didn’t like what he got, so he continued to sell the clones.
[The abilities will be transferred at random.]
[Look at my body with awe (C)]
“Damn it! Just sell them all.”
[Yes. Understood.]
At that moment.
[Miny (Original) has been sold.]
[You have acquired 5 billion Talents.]
[Ahhhk!! Master!!!!]
“Whoops! That was a mistake.”
Lee Gun had pulled the trigger by mistake. He quickly slapped the balloon-shaped agent. “Hey, hey. Take it back. Take it back.”
[Y-You want to take it back?]
“Yes. Hurry up. Bring it back.” Lee Gun canceled the auction before the sale was finalized.
[The gods participating in the auction despair.]
[They say the original’s ability is much better. They are losing their minds at the lost opportunity.]
[They say it is such a rare Construct. The gods are clamoring at you to sell it.]
Berserk, who had almost been sold, cried out. It was a high-rank Construct that would be treated very well wherever it went, yet…!
However, Lee Gun didn’t pay attention to it. He continued to transfer abilities as soon as the Talents came in.
[The gods say they’ll pay 10 billion for the original.]
[They are howling. They are begging you to sell it.]
“What? Ten billion? Should I sell?”
[Masterrrrr!!! I will be that much better for you! Please!]
“I’m joking. I won’t sell you.”
[Waaaaa!]
Still, it seemed selling the clones in an industrious manner had been effective.
[Taurus’s abilities (SSS) have been transferred to Serpent Bearer.]
[Unshakeable Suspicion (Innate magic resistance type) (SSS)]
[Steel Wall of the Fortress (Physical Defense type) (SSS)]
[Whole Body is a Weapon (Body Defense Type) (SSS)]
Finally, the skills that he had wanted appeared before him.
“!”
At that moment, Lee Gun’s expression crumpled for some reason.
Hugo became nervous when he read Lee Gun’s expression. “Gun? What’s wrong? Did something happen?”
“That bastard is being attacked!”
“That bastard?”
“I’m talking about the bald bastard. He’s about to die.”
“Bald?”
Kevin and Hailey tilted their heads in puzzlement, but Hugo’s face turned deathly pale.
* * *
Around that time, the Sagittarius temple’s holy ground…
Boom!!
Sagittarius had descended in his incarnated form. He was grinding his teeth. The one before him was Gemini.
Of course, its true body wasn’t here. It had taken on the form of a human woman, who seemed to be a general-rank disciple.
Since the woman wasn’t a Zodiac Saint, her life was at risk, yet the Zodiac had possessed her. It really drove home the fact that the Gemini were terrible beings. They didn’t care what happened to the human they possessed.
Boom!!!
Gemini let out a fierce attack.
[How pathetic! When did you start caring about human territories? Are you holding back your power?]
Sagittarius, who had worn the horse mask, reacted in anger.
[Are you playing with me? This place is my holy ground before it’s the land of the humans!]
As soon as he spoke, flames erupted from the ground. However, the Zodiac of Magic easily brushed aside the flames.
[!]
After extinguishing the flames by brushing them aside, Gemini smirked.
[Your holy ground? What nonsense! In your holy ground, you can dodge my attacks at will. It’s obvious that you don’t want this country to be destroyed.]
[!]
The words were accompanied by an incredible flash of life. At the same time, spears of light fell from the sky.
Kwah-kwah-kwahng!
Projectiles made out of light fell like rain, and Sagittarius fell. The falling spears pierced his body.
Kwah-jeek!!
The spears ruthlessly pierced the chest, stomach, and legs.
[Koo-oohk…!]
Gemini smirked as it finally summoned a treasure that could kill even the gods.
[You look like a pinned butterfly. It’s an amazing sight, but…]
Gemini approached Sagittarius.
[It would be better if I could see your handsome face.]
Gemini was about to take off Sagittarius’s horse mask.
Tuhk!
However, even as he bled, Sagittarius desperately kept the horse mask on.
Gemini furrowed its brows.
[What are you doing? Move your hands so that I remove it.]
[Hmmph! As expected of the lecherous magic god. How dare you!]
[It isn’t like that. You’re wearing something you usually don’t wear, and it’s bothering me. Hurry up and take it off.]
[You’re wicked. Stop being curious about someone else’s face. Be gone— Kuhk!]
Gemini stepped on a sensitive spot, which wasn’t great for Sagittarius.
The angered Gemini gathered its magical energy.
[Since you have a death wish, I’ll grant it. You’re a usurper too, yet you act as if you’re the only kind one.]
[Koohk…!]
[You also turned down my feelings.]
Gemini, whom the other gods feared, was about to take out Sagittarius’ Core when…
Shweek!!!
[!]
An attack containing enormous destructive power brushed by the Zodiac’s face.
The menacing power made blood flow down Gemini’s cheek. The Zodiac turned its head as its eyes menacingly flashed.
It saw familiar faces.
[Those bastards….]
The magic god’s eyes flashed viciously.
Sagittarius looked in the same direction, and he seemed shocked.
[Why is he here?]
As soon as he spoke, a green flame fell from the sky. Gemini dodged the attack and summoned a rock golem. It tried to extract Sagittarius’s core, which was his life.
However, Sagittarius’s rescuer rushed toward the Golem.
“Nooooooo!”
[!]
In a flash, the rescuer kicked the Golem, which was aiming for Sagittarius.
Bbah-gahk!
This new one to kick the golem was unexpectedly Hugo! And Sungjae was the one to send the green fire.
Hugo used the “Bow Made Out of Fish” to ward off the enemies and ran to the Sagittarius’ side. With a face pale from worry, he looked at Sagittarius. “Hey. Don’t die! You cannot die! You are my one and only Zodiac!”
The words surprised Sagittarius.
[I thought you left because you were sick of me. Why are you…]
“If you die, I’ll have no choice but to be Gun’s underling!! Live! Please live!”
[…]
That was the issue!
1. BJ = Broadcast Jockey, a Korean term for streamers. ☜

chapters.title: Chapter 266: What is this (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: What is this (3)
Sagittarius was dumbfounded. When he had been in danger, Hugo had come to save him. This had moved Sagittarius.
Despite Hugo’s faith toward Lee Gun being an insurmountable wall compared to that toward Sagittarius, it seemed Hugo was more attached to Sagittarius, if one considered the time that they had spent together. Sagittarius believed this was the reason Hugo had chosen him instead of Lee Gun.
[Hug—]
“Please never die! I cannot become Gun’s subordinate! I will return to the Sagittarius temple!”
[…]
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 590%]
[Sagittarius Faith: 49%]
“Do you understand? Don’t die since I have to return to the Sagittarius temple! Wait for me here!”
Shouldn’t he be saying this after fixing his faith?
On the other hand, Hugo also seemed to be aware of this, so he quickly took something out of his bag. It was a golden wing.
“Here! I made a request from Gun! I brought something good he made! It’s an SS-rank wig!”
[….]
“This is a robe I received from Gun! This is a helmet! This is a weapon!” Hugo quickly took off the horse mask and placed the golden hair wig on Sagittarius’s head.
One by one, he placed golden items on the Zodiac. It looked stylish.
[Sagittarius Faith: 49.991%]
[Sagittarius Faith: 49.992%]
…
[Sagittarius Faith: 49.995% (+0.005%)]
After taking out everything he had brought, Hugo looked satisfied. “Good! Instead of looking like a goblin, you now give off the gravitas of the sun god! This will raise my faith toward you!”
[…]
Was that how Hugo normally viewed him?
After equipping Sagittarius with all kinds of items, Hugo looked at the Zodiac with a triumphant air. “Good! I’ll be able to return to being the Archer Saint with this!”
[Sagittarius Faith: 49.996% (+0.001%)]
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 592% (+2%)]
At this rate, wouldn’t it be faster for him to become the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple?
Sagittarius despaired. Of course, it wasn’t as if he was unaware of the reason Hugo hated being in the Serpent Bearer temple. Why?
“Dad!”
“!!”
Hugo realized his mistake as the golem suddenly swung its arm. So, he unsheathed a blade from his waist and tried to deflect the attack.
Kwahng!
“!!?”
As soon as he put strength into the hilt of the blade, it broke into pieces. Hugo scrambled. “Ahk! This is nuts! It has S-rank durability, so why did it break?”
The reason he broke the item was the strength increase buff he had received on becoming a disciple of the Serpent Bearer temple.
At that moment, an enormous hand fell toward the head of the defenseless Hugo.
“Ahhk!”
“Ahhk! You’re so dumb, dad!!!” The surprised Chun Sungjae used Teleport and kicked the giant.
Boom!
At the same time, enormous green flames erupted from him.
After melting away his enemy, Chun Sungjae clutched his chest in surprise. “That’s dangerous! How can you not get rid of a hunk of rock like that? Also, you destroyed a holy item!”
“Damn it! What can I do? I suddenly became stronger!”
“Whatever, Dad! You will be under the teachings of the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer from now on! You will go under the Serpent Bearer temple’s magical energy special training!”
“Ahhk!”
Yes, Hugo didn’t want to be bossed around by his children.
He immediately ran forward as he raised his Bow made out of Fish. “I’m a disciple of the Sagittarius temple! Huzzah for Sagittarius! Huzzah! Huzzah!”
Of course, their opponent, a Zodiac of Magic was powerful, but it was currently possessing the body of a human!
‘There is a chance that we can win.’
As if it could read his thoughts, Gemini laughed in contempt.
[You’re quite simple in how you think.]
“!”
Its eyes flashed, and the nearby buildings instantly turned into ashes.
Kwah-jeek!
The Zodiac of Magic then smirked.
[Sagittarius is no longer our comrade.]
As soon as it spoke, the destroyed parts of the buildings coalesced to make enormous giants. There were dozens of them!
[Like the Serpent Bearer merged with the Taurus temple, we’ll merge the Sagittarius temple. It won’t be much since you guys are a temple that does not possess much.]
Those words angered Sagittarius.
However, something happened when he tried to use his magical energy.
“How dare you look down on our temple!”
[!]
Hugo quickly ran forward at an unimaginable speed. Several dozen giants attacked him, but dodging them was child’s play for him.
“You will touch the Zodiac of the Sagittarius temple over my dead body! Sagittarius is the best!”
If Lee Gun were present here, he would’ve shaken his head.
On the other hand, Sagittarius became surprised since Hugo’s movements differed from normal.
‘!’
Of course, Hugo was never considered slow, but this was another level.
“Amazing.”
Hugo was considered to be a compliment to Lee Gun. The duo was called the great heroes for a reason.
Hugo dodged the giants’ attacks as he climbed their arms. He was like the wind as he made fools of his enemies.
“Wow! He looks cooler than the elves I’ve seen in the movies.” It was a rare reaction from Chun Sungjae. His eyes twinkled when he saw a side of his father that he had never seen before.
Of course, such movements were possible for only one reason.
[The attribute of the Serpent Bearer temple has been applied.]
[Super Regeneration, Critical Hit, M, Tenacity]
[The effect of Super Regeneration recovers the damaged muscles to the reference value.]
[The aged cells will be newly regenerated to the reference value.]
The Serpent Bearer temple was the temple of regeneration. It didn’t show its effect on Sungjae, who was still growing, but Hugo was a veteran warrior who had been on the field for the past twenty years.
He had built twenty years of know-how, but the experience came with cumulative injuries and the aging of his body. Those effects couldn’t be ignored. Moreover, the aging process had slowed, but he couldn’t be compared to his prime.
[Your body has been regenerated to the point where it was the most full of life.]
[Your body has been rejuvenated.]
After he had become the disciple of the Serpent Bearer temple, Hugo’s body had already rewound itself to his form from twenty years ago! In fact, his skin was firm, and he looked a bit younger.
“I will protect Sagittarius!!!” The frantic Hugo sent arrows flying fiercely. He had sent ten of them.
Although he was now a disciple of the Serpent Bearer temple and couldn’t use the Absolute Accuracy skill, an attribute of the Sagittarius temple, his skill with the bow hadn’t disappeared.
Shweeek!!
Pahng! Pahng! Pahng!
All of his arrows found their marks!
In fact, the only time Hugo had relied on the Absolute Accuracy buff was during his rookie days, when he had met Lee Gun.
Hugo was seasoned now. He didn’t need Absolute Accuracy with the experience he had amassed. If he had it, it would just be used akin to an auto hunting skill!
Moreover, Hugo’s body was back to its prime, so the arrows he shot kept the Zodiac of Magic in place.
[Serpent Eater]
Kwahng!!!
Now that he was part of the Serpent Bearer temple, his attack and physical ability were much better. “Good! I’m sure my faith toward Sagittarius rose! At the very least, it should have reached 90%…!”
[Sagittarius Faith 49.997% (+0.001%)]
“Ahhk! Why did it go up so little? Is this all you are? What kind of god are you? Try enticing your disciple!”
[…]
Gemini, who had fallen to the ground, started to laugh. The next moment, an enormous magic circle appeared on the ground.
Koo-goo-goong!
When Chun Sungjae saw the shape of the magic circle, he realized what it was. He did a double take.
“Aging magic!”
As soon as he spoke, an enormous mouth appeared from the magic circle. At the same time, a dreary voice rang out.
[From this point forth, age will change depending on the faith toward the Gemini]
[If your faith toward Gemini is below 50%, you will age at least 50 years.]
[Each -1% will be equivalent to an additional 10 years.]
“…!”
Hugo was taken aback. Their faith toward Gemini wasn’t that high.
[Gemini Faith (Chun Sungjae): 90%]
[Gemini Faith (Hugo Otis): –120%]
That was why they were flustered.
‘Shit! It’ll take only a moment before we both die from old age.’
He knew it was dangerous, but Chun Sungjae quickly tried to rush toward the mouth to cancel the spell.
[How dare you do this in my holy ground!]
Sagittarius’s eyes flashed as he spoke in a cold voice. Then, flames fell from the sky. The eyes that appeared on the ground disappeared as they shed blood.
Kwahng!!
The magic was completely broken.
Chun Sungjae’s and Hugo’s mouths fell open when they saw this. Sagittarius looked overjoyed by their reactions.
[Yes, my servant. Let’s see if their faith toward me rose…!]
[Sagittarius Faith: 45% (-5%)]
[…]
Sagittarius despaired. It seemed Hugo wanted Sagittarius to act earlier.
Hugo suddenly realized his mistake. “N-No!! Our Zodiac is the best! Amazing! He’s amazing! I might actually fall for him! I’m alive thanks to—”
“Dad. Super Regeneration is a basic buff of our temple. That’s why the aging magic won’t do much. We’ll regain our youth again thanks to Uncle’s power.”
“Uh? Now that I think about it, you’re right.”
[Hugo Otis]
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 600% (+8%)]
That was the knockout blow for Sagittarius.
“Honey! This is bad!”
“!”
Chun Jiwoo, who had been inside the Archer Saint’s holy ground, ran out when she located her husband.
Hugo was surprised to see his wife uncharacteristically pale with fright. “What’s wrong? Did something happen to the kids?”
“No. It’s about Lee Gun-nim…!”
“Gun? What about Gun?”
“All the Archer disciples forgot about Lee Gun-nim!”
“What? What are you talking about?”
“I don’t know. A fog suddenly appeared and… instead of Lee Gun-nim, they—”
At that moment, a thick fog appeared around them. They were taken aback as the fog thickened.
When Chun Jiwoo suddenly stopped speaking, Hugo grabbed her in surprise. “What’s wrong? Are you ok? Why did you suddenly stop speaking?”
“Speaking?”
“Yes. You were talking about Gun.”
“Gun?”
“?”
“Who is Gun?”
“!”
Hugo did a double take. He looked at his surroundings in surprise.
‘Can this fog be what I think it is?’
He was sure of it.
‘Oblivion!’
It was the power that Hailey had spoken about. However, Hugo could catch a glimpse of a different power within the fog.
‘Is this the doing of the Zodiac of Magic?’
In the end, Hugo quickly stood up. Gemini had ripped apart the Serpent Eater skill as if it was nothing and disappeared, but that didn’t matter right now.
‘It left behind a precious holy item.’
When Hugo picked up the spoils of war, the new Serpent Bearer skill was activated.
[Blue Snake Eyes (SS)]
A luminescent mark permeated through the ground as it rose. This was the Sagittarius temple’s vision skill, which had changed into the skill of the Serpent Bearer temple. It was a new skill.
Hugo let out a sharp laugh as he looked in the direction where the Zodiac had disappeared. “Let’s go, Sungjae! Gun is in danger!”
“What? Who’s Gun?”
Hugo reacted in fright. “Who? He’s your uncle! He’s the thirteenth! I’m talking about the Serpent Bearer!”
“What are you talking about, Dad? You’re the Serpent Bearer.”
“?!”
“You’re the Serpent Bearer who our family respects and loves the most!”
What the hell did he say?!
* * *
“Shit!”
It was unclear as to how much time had passed, but Hugo was desperately looking for Lee Gun.
‘Shit! Everyone forgot about Gun.’
Of course, people hadn’t entirely forgotten about his existence.
– What? That’s odd. I’m pretty sure there was a hero who caught Red Eye.
– Was there a thirteenth? I’m pretty sure he was the strongest.
– He was a dashing person…!
People were aware of Lee Gun’s existence. This was why the probability of this forgetfulness being temporary was high. Moreover, the range seemed to still be limited to Korea.
The problem was the memory regarding the Serpent Bearer.
– The Serpent Bearer is very friendly with the twelve Zodiacs
– He’s a loyal servant of the Zodiacs of Magic.
– No. He’s the Zodiac of Magic’s slave and lover.
Distortion! Along with the forgetfulness, distortion magic was being used en masse. This made Hugo certain of one thing.
‘The Zodiacs of Magic are using the power of Oblivion.’
They were contemptible. However, nothing was strange about it. Those Zodiacs were beings that always developed troublesome magic.
‘If there is no disciple left to believe and leave behind records, the god gets forgotten. The god ceases to exist.’
They were using an underhanded tactic again since they didn’t want to face Lee Gun directly. Hugo looked at Sagittarius to check if his train of thought was correct.
[Sagittarius is ecstatic.]
[If this turns out well, his Zodiac Saint will be able to come back to the Sagittarius temple. He is happy…]
Hugo glared at Sagittarius with a cold look on his face. Sagittarius flinched.
[Sagittarius says this is a tragedy. He scratches at the wall, saying they have to hurry up and find the Serpent Bearer.]
[Sagittarius Faith 30% (-15%)]
Hugo’s eyes flashed as he turned around.
‘I have to hurry up and find Gemini. I have to break this trap.’
Thankfully, he remembered Lee Gun.
‘A god won’t cease to exist if at least one person deifies the god.’
That wouldn’t be a problem.
‘Even the mighty Sungjae was put in such a state. There must be a catch to the forgetfulness.’
Moreover, a monarch had appeared, so it was questionable as to whether the memories would come back easily.
This was why he was worried.
‘Also, I still can’t contact Gun.’
Did he already fall to a Zodiac of Magic?
Therefore, Hugo came to the location where he was supposed to meet up with Lee Gun. “Gun! Are you here?”
He arrived on the road leading to the holy ground of the Zodiac of Magic. However, he couldn’t see too far ahead because of the thick fog. Moreover, there seemed to be a barrier ahead. He couldn’t exit toward the neighboring city.
“Gun… Kuhk!”
At that moment, Hugo was surprised when he bumped into someone. “Gun!”
Hugo let out a sigh of relief when he saw Lee Gun and Heaven’s Punishment, which was delighted to see its owner. “Gun! Thank god! You’re safe!”
“Of course, I am. I’m just hungry.”
“Phew! Do you have money?”
“I didn’t bring any. You should buy some for me. I want to fill up my stomach before I beat those bastards.”
Lee Gun was asking him to buy some chicken from the convenience store; Hugo let out a sigh of relief.
After returning with the chicken he had purchased, Hugo said, “Here. Hurry up and eat it. Everyone within the fog forgot about you. Don’t worry! At the very least, I remember you. Ah. I also found the location of the Zodiac of Magic. Did you transfer all of Taurus’s abilities?”
“Yes. I did all that.”
Lee Gun was eating the chicken Hugo had bought, but for some odd reason, he kept furrowing his brows. He had been doing it for a while, as if something was wrong.
“Do you know me?”
Hugo couldn’t believe his ears. “What?”
“I asked if you know me, you dweeb.”
“?!!”
When he realized what was going on, Hugo’s face turned into that of a demon. It was unforgivable that Lee Gun had forgotten about him!

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Oblivion (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Oblivion (1)
Oblivion was a monarch that not even the highest-ranked gods in the Divine world wanted to approach.
Multiple monarchs had meddled in the affairs of the earth. However, to enter the domes, they needed to possess a human’s body. This had backfired in Abundance’s case, who had died when it tried to attempt this move.
Then there was Abyss, who had sent one of its entities to eat a Zodiac. That had resulted in helping Lee Gun merge with Taurus.
Time was considered the supreme commander in charge of the invasion of the earth, and it had been leeching off Space as a nutrient.
Giselle, the monarch named Neglect, had entered the human territory as a spy.
The remaining monarch was hiding somewhere unknown.
Anyway, several monarchs were connected to the twelve Zodiacs, but above all else, the ability of Oblivion threatened the gods the most.
Even Lee Gun couldn’t escape from the threat Oblivion posed. It was also why the magic Zodiacs had used the power of Oblivion in this fashion.
‘The existence of gods is threatened if people can’t remember them!’
If no one remembered Lee Gun, it would be a critical blow to him in maintaining his Bible. Even if that didn’t happen, the Zodiacs will be at an advantage with memories of Lee Gun being stolen from the people.
Still, this was too much!
“Hey! How can you forget about me?” Hugo felt aggrieved and angry. He grabbed Lee Gun by the collar. “Damn it! I was steadfast in remembering you! How can you do this to your best friend??”
Hugo yelled, but it lasted only a moment.
“Kuh-huhk!”
A kick sent him flying.
“That hurts…! What the hell are you doing?”
Lee Gun, who had been eating his chicken, rubbed his ear when he heard Hugo scream. “Ah! I’m sorry! You might not know this because we are meeting for the first time. However, I do not like someone grabbing me like this. My personality won’t allow it.”
“#$*&$*#!” Hugo seemed pissed off. “Hey! How can you do this to a friend?”
“Friend?”
“Yes! Friend! You and I are friends! We’re brothers in arms, who went through life and death together!”
Lee Gun flinched. Did he realize who Hugo was?
Lee Gun looked over at Hugo. “No way! Why would I be friends with someone old like you? That’s offensive.”
When Lee Gun continued to eat the chicken, flames erupted from Hugo’s mouth. “Then why the hell are you eating the chicken I bought!!!”
That meant Lee Gun had boldly ordered someone he didn’t know to go buy him some chicken?
Hugo’s blood pressure was through the roof. He was about to faint. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘Even Gun lost his memories?’
Hugo seemed shocked by this truth. To confirm it, he asked, “Do you know who I am, Gun? Do you know who these kids are?”
Hugo quickly took out his phone and showed Lee Gun the wallpaper on his screen. It was a new family photo that he had taken after Chun Jiwoo had returned.
Of course, the photo studio offered dolls of the twelve Zodiacs as props. So everyone except Hugo held a Lee Gun doll in the picture. Hugo was the only one who firmly held his own doll.
However, Hugo couldn’t believe his eyes. The Lee Gun figurines were no longer there in the picture. His wife had been holding two dolls, one of Hugo and one of Lee Gun, but the Lee Gun doll was gone.
However, that wasn’t important right now. Hugo showed the picture to Lee Gun. “Do you know who they are?”
The words seemed to have made Lee Gun angry. He looked at Hugo. “Are you playing with me? Of course, I know them. That’s Miss Jiwoo, Yooha, and Sungjae.”
“What about me?!”
“I don’t know you.”
“So why can’t you remember me?!!”
“Who cares? You must have a forgetful face.”
Hugo despaired. He was angered by the situation, but from the energy this man gave off, he was definitely Lee Gun. Moreover, Heaven’s Punishment would never stay next to someone who wasn’t its owner.
It might be the influence of Oblivion or a spell concocted by the Zodiacs of Magic, but Lee Gun had indeed forgotten him.
Lee Gun didn’t care if Hugo was lamenting or not. He just picked at his ear. “Ah! I’m thirsty after eating chicken. You said you’re my friend, right? You should go buy some drinks and ice cream for me. I want 100% fruit juice for my beverages and 100% milk-based ice cream.”
Hugo let out a violent roar. “Hey! Tell me the truth! You remember me, right? You’re doing this on purpose.”
“I have no idea who you are, but I have a feeling that I should take advantage of you.”
“Hey!!!”
Well, it didn’t matter. The situation was annoying, but Hugo realized this might be to his advantage. “Yes! My faith probably fell off the cliff with this!”
He used the black reflective display of the phone to check his own faith. “Wow! Crazy! This will be big. I can feel it. At the very least, it’ll be -500% faith. It really is -500—”
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 600%]
“Why didn’t it change?” Hugo threw his phone. As if throwing it wasn’t enough, he stomped on it.
After taking deep breaths, he then asked Lee Gun, “Do you remember anything about yourself? What about your name?”
“I don’t know.”
“Good. Listen to me well. Your name is Lee Gun, and you’re my friend… At the same time, you’re my underling.”
Lee Gun looked like he had bitten into a lemon. “I don’t think so.”
“You don’t think so? You said you couldn’t remember anything.”
“Yes. I just know that’s not true.”
“I… I guess calling you an underling was taking it too far. In truth, I’m your teacher. I’m the one who developed you”
“Yeah. That’s not true either. I clearly remember things related to me.”
“Is that so? If you’re so sure about remembering such things, you must remember borrowing a million Won from me a month ago. Do you remember that?”
“Ah… Sorry! It doesn’t ring any bells.”
Lee Gun had really borrowed money from him, so Hugo let out killing intent. “Bastard! You’re selectively forgetting stuff!”
After filling up his stomach, Lee Gun picked up Heaven’s Punishment. It seemed he had somewhere else to be. “Anyway, I’m going. I have to kill some bastards.”
Soon, he started walking deeper into the fog.
This surprised Hugo. “Hey! You don’t know your name! Do you know who your enemies are?”
“Nope. I don’t.”
“You don’t, yet you want to kill them?!”
“Yeah. Do you have a problem with that?”
He had a lot of problems with it!! In the end, Hugo was about to return to his wife in anger, but…
“Hey! Wait a moment! Your teacher will show you the way!” Hugo quickly ran after Lee Gun.
* * *
Each of the twelve Zodiac temples possessed its own territory.
The Virgo temple was the emperor that ruled over Western Europe. The Aquarius temple ruled over land that stretched from Western Europe to Eastern Europe.
The Taurus temple ruled over the sand, which included Egypt, the Middle East, and West Asia.
The US had the Leo temple, and the Scorpio temple ruled over the cold regions, such as Canada, Russia, and Finland.
The south, including South America, Africa, and Australia, was represented by the Cancer, Capricorn, and Libra temples.
Then there was the Pisces temple. Any region touching the Mediterranean sea was their territory.
Since the Mediterranean sea existed in Southern Europe, it competed with the Aquarius temple.
Therefore, this place was supposed to be a region of conflict, yet it was unusually quiet. The reason was that it was a country of magic, closed off from outsiders.
In fact, Italy received protection from the Zodiacs of Magic, and it contained one of the cities of magic. Apartments, roads, and other facilities combined to make a fortress of magic.
One of these cities was Venice, and the city of water was a bit restless at that moment.
“Hey! Did you hear what I said?”
The subject was Lee Gun.
“My god! A fog is covering the entirety of East Asia.”
“East Asia? Aren’t the territories of the Serpent Bearer, Gemini, Aries, and Sagittarius temples located there? There is a fog there?”
“Yes. It’s big enough to cover the entire territory. Moreover, something strange is happening there. I’m calling over there, and no one seems to remember Lee Gun-nim.”
“What? Really?!”
“Is Lee Gun-nim fine?”
“It’s the power of a monarch. They are sure of it. That’s why the armed Pisces magicians will be heading toward that region.”
“What? Is that a good idea? Lee Gun-nim designated East Asia as a place where armed disciples are forbidden from entering. All the presidents forbid their armed disciples from entering that place.”
“There is no choice, since we have to subjugate the monsters.”
“It should be fine since they are trying to save Lee Gun-nim.”
They looked toward the lake where the magic city had been built, at the highest point of the city, where the headquarters of the Pisces temple was located.
In this temple made out of the water, a familiar face appeared.
[Are you listening to me? You went too far in bringing in Oblivion!]
It was one of the Pisces twins, who looked appalled. She was the one who had appeared at Lee Gun’s holy ground to save her Zodiac Saint. She was the Zodiac who had fallen into the blast furnace. She had come here to warn her older twin sister.
[Answer me! I can’t believe you sealed the memories about the Serpent Bearer using Oblivion! You went too far!]
Someone sat atop Pisces’s Seat of power. She furrowed her brows when she heard her young sister’s words.
[Are you listening to me?!]
It seemed her little sister’s words had gotten on her nerves. The eyes of the young woman on the throne flashed.
[Kyahhhk!]
The younger sister, who had been floating on top of the water, screamed when lightning flew toward her. She sank into the water.
It didn’t take long for the young woman on the throne to fish out her young sister using her power. She then furrowed her brows as she propped up her chin with her hands.
[You went to Lee Gun by yourself. You’re the idiot who became a holy item. Don’t you dare talk about this!]
[…!!]
Yes, the young woman on the throne was none other than the Pisces Saint Liv Rich. Although she looked like the Zodiac Saint from the outside, the one inside her was the older Pisces twin.
She was the culprit who had brought the monarchs to Seoul twenty-four years ago. She had also knocked out Kevin at the Devil’s Tower and changed the appearance of Jean-Louis, who had assassinated Lee Gun.
The older sister looked at her pathetic younger sister, who had become Lee Gun’s holy item. No, she had become Hugo’s bow.
[At least, your sense of self seems safe since you’re a Zodiac of Magic. Still, how could you allow yourself to become the bow of an enemy?]
[…!]
[Well, it doesn’t matter. I’ll get you back after I kill your owner.]
The younger sister’s sense of self was the only thing left now, so she had become a phantom-like figure. She ground her teeth.
[That isn’t important right now! What were you thinking about bringing in Oblivion?]
The older sister’s eyes flashed.
[Kyaaaa!]
Angry, she walked toward her younger sister and stepped on her head.
[If you hadn’t lost the real Serpent Bearer twenty-four years ago, this wouldn’t be necessary!]
The older sister trembled in irritation.
After stealing the Seats of Power in the distant past, the twins had placed a spell on the thirteenth. They had framed him before killing him as the God of calamity.
Of course, they hunted down the thirteenth over and over again when they learned of the reincarnation. However, things had been different this time around.
For some reason, they had a very hard time finding the reincarnated body in the current cycle. After looking hard for it, they were able to kill the Serpent Bearer twenty-four years ago. This time, it had been a male.
This was why the situation had been unexpected.
– I never expected it to reincarnate as a boy.
Since they had a hard time finding him, they had decided to have some fun. They had burned and drowned the boy. His arms and legs were crushed and then severed. The twins had tortured him and played with him until he died.
Since he was the reincarnation of a Zodiac, he didn’t die easily. This was why he was an ideal candidate to have fun with.
Of course, the news of them killing the boy couldn’t spread, so they had transformed themselves into monsters. This was why there was no news about their involvement.
On the other hand, the twins always had a question about that incident.
– He isn’t putting up much of a fight compared to normal. It’s odd that he’s accepting his death.
It was long after that they had found out that the boy had been trying to hide the existence of his older sister and Lee Gun.
‘Yes. I never expected it to reincarnate as two this time around.’
That was why they had a very hard time finding the Serpent Bearer.
And so, they had been pissed off when they found out about the existence of Yeonwoo. Because of that, they had brought in a monarch to finish the job in no uncertain terms.
For some odd reason, however, Time had taken a great interest in the Serpent Bearer. If one looked back on it, it seemed the younger brother had wanted to protect Lee Gun.
‘Did he know that Lee Gun was his owner?’
It might have been a coincidence, but their powers had returned to Lee Gun.
‘The power of Life and Death is the power of the thirteenth original owner, so it isn’t out of place.’
The thirteenth original owner had received the Divine status of Aesculapius since its seat was empty.
When he recognized the potential of the snakes he had picked up, he had added his power to them. He was able to grow Ouroboros, who represented the cycle.
‘That isn’t important right now.’
The older Pisces gnashed her teeth as she propped her chin up.
[Those contemptible bastards are mere humans, yet they want to dig into the past of the twelve Zodiacs?]
She seemed to have realized the tactic Lee Gun’s side was going to use. In the past, the insolent Secretaries had looked into the Zodiacs’ past instead of creating the Bibles. They used their past as a threat to make the twelve Zodiacs leave earth.
[Lee Gun and anyone who follows him will be crushed like the cockroach Secretaries.]
They had planned on using a ridiculous plan, yet the older Pisces twin just had to erase Lee Gun’s existence using Oblivion to solve the problem.
As proof of this, the older twin smirked.
[The magic has already been activated, and the fog will keep expanding until it’ll cover the entire world.]
[However, the risk of using a monarch’s power is high. If the condition fails— Koohk!]
[Shut up! I put 500% faith as a condition.]
[!]
[I’ve never seen a faith that high even amongst the most devoted Constructs. No one will remember Lee Gun.]
Some disciples did have 100% faith toward the Serpent Bearer, and the highest faith amongst the Serpent Bearer’s Zodiac Saints was 400%.
Although Giselle had warned her about Hugo, when the older Pisces had checked his faith recently, it had been 450%.
If it did go up, it would probably max out at 500%, which was within her prediction range.
[Unless a human has lost their mind, there’s no way a higher figure of faith would come out.]
[!]
