[That’s why this plan cannot fail.]
The Zodiac of Magic laughed coquettishly.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Oblivion (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Oblivion (2)
Right before the fog of Oblivion covered East Asia, Carly was visiting the holy ground of the Capricorn temple in Australia. She furrowed her brows within the World Workshop.
“What did you just say?”
“Hand over Lee Gun-nim to us.”
“What?” Carly scoffed.
After receiving an order from Lee Gun to seize the Cancer’s Seat of Power, she had come here, looking for the master craftsmen to repair her weapon.
Of course, she could ask Lee Gun to repair it, but she didn’t want to be a burden to him. This was why she was unable to speak up.
While Lee Gun had taken her in, there was no way Lee Gun would be happy with her existence. She didn’t want to bother him with something trivial.
That was why she had visited a master craftsman she was normally close to.
“The Serpent Bearer! Hand over Lee Gun-nim! Lee Gun-nim has the Midas touch. The master craftsmen will serve him!”
“That’s right! There is no way we’ll let lowly battle fiends take care of Lee Gun-nim!”
These little bastards…! It was fine that she had come here to fix her item, but humanity’s greatest master craftsmen had brought up some unexpected words.
“Do you know this? Lee Gun-nim is the Zodiac of manufacturing. That is his profession! If he stays in a temple that isn’t suited to him, his abilities will erode!”
“That’s right! He should come here and become the Zodiac of the Capricorn temple! He’ll acquire abilities related to manufacturing!”
“Yes. The lowly battle-type disciples should leave! Don’t let Lee Gun-nim’s abilities waste away!”
Unable to take the harassment from the master craftsmen, Carly became angry. “Hey, Taylor! You should keep your guys in line!”
Carly raised her voice toward someone who stood in front of the cauldron. The star master craftsman Taylor stood there. He was the one who had lost and fallen for Lee Gun in the manufacturing battle.
At the same time, he was the colleague of Carly, Yooha, and Goat, one of humanity’s strongest and a Ten Star (SS rank).
Angry, Carly looked at Taylor, who was repairing her sword. “Hey. Are you listening to me? Your guys are talking nonsense!”
“It isn’t nonsense, right?”
“What?!”
“It’s the same for the Zodiacs. Depending on which temple they join, the skills that they develop differ too. It’s the same for Lee Gun-nim.”
“…!” Carly flinched.
It was as he said. The twelve Zodiacs grew through their disciples, and they developed skills that fit the disposition of the Seat of power they occupied.
For example, the Aquarius temple was known as the healing temple. However, Aquarius only released healing-type skills. It was incapable of releasing skills related to fighting.
“Lee Gun-nim doesn’t have any special manufacturing power, yet he’s that skilled. If he joins the Capricorn temple, he’ll gain abilities related to manufacturing.”
“!”
“He’ll be beyond imagination at that point. How can we let a treasure like him stay in a battle-type temple? It’s like burying talent under mud.”
It didn’t matter in the end.
“Anyway, I will become the Zodiac who’ll serve Lee Gun-nim”
“Hey! That’s your goal! I will become the Zodiac Saint, idiot!”
At that moment, a suspicious fog encircled the over-100-story-tall World Workshop tower. Then, unrest rose amongst the disciples.
“Hey, what were we talking about right now?”
“What else… It’s about the person we serve…”
“Who?”
“Who were we talking about?”
* * *
‘Texts from Sungjae and Yooha are missing. Gun’s name is completely gone from the SNS.’
Hugo was seriously looking at his phone.
‘It means the fog covered the entire world.’
Hugo had tried to contact people far away from this place.
[Gun’s Stalker: Lee Gun? Who is that?]
[Cat Butler: Serpent Bearer temple? No one is there. I heard you acquired a really good weapon.]
[False Saintess: Ahhhhk! I’m sorry! I don’t know who I wronged, but I’m sorry.]
[Just Marry Gun: (No Response)]
“…!”
Hugo became serious. He was sure of it.
‘The fog has spread all across the world.’
Even those in the US and Europe had forgotten about Lee Gun now. This was the doing of the Zodiacs of Magic.
‘They plan on getting rid of Gun for good.’
That wasn’t all. They were trying to erase the past of the twelve Zodiacs! Of course, Hugo understood why they were taking such steps. His side had planned on casting doubt on them through the media.
[The twelve Zodiacs tried to kill humanity’s hero Lee Gun.]
[The twelve Zodiacs used the unknown civilization to usurp the original owners. That is how they became gods.]
[They used the method at the time to get acclimated to the earth. They tried to fulfill their own self-interest and desire.]
[It means a segment of the twelve Zodiacs might already be cooperating with the unknown civilization.]
[The invasion itself might be the plan of the Zodiacs.]
[That is why they tried to kill Lee Gun, who had a connection to the truth.]
This was why all the Secretaries had been murdered in the past. Like the time with the Secretaries, the Zodiacs that knew the truth about them had taken action.
‘However, Gun isn’t easy to deal with.’
They wanted to get rid of Lee Gun’s existence, and they chose a method that was deadly even to the Zodiacs. It was also a way where they didn’t need to get their hands dirty. They had chosen Oblivion.
It was a different form of death where one’s existence was erased.
‘On the other hand, nothing has happened to Gun yet.’
A god needed to be worshiped by someone else. One became stronger by maintaining this connection. Moreover, a minor god that people would forget soon and a major god that had established itself as a state religion were two different stories.
When the subject disappeared through Oblivion, belief itself couldn’t be established. In the end, the power of the god vanished since a god lived off the worship of others.
‘That is why I have to break this spell, so the memories about Gun come back.’
Despite knowing this, Hugo almost had second thoughts about doing it. Why?
“Dad is the best! You’re too cool!”
“Marry me, Dad…!”
Yes. His daughter, who didn’t display any affection, had hugged him. She started love bombing him.
The reason behind it was unknown, but the cause had to do with Lee Gun’s existence being forgotten. Maybe, the faith heading toward Lee Gun was being directed toward him.
“Dad, you really are the best in the world.”
“I love you, Dad.”
It was something that would never happen if things were normal.
“Yes. Why should I recover memories about Gun? Things are fine as is— Kuhk!!” Hugo became angry when he was hit twice by Lee Gun. “Why did you hit me!!! I said we are friends!”
“I can’t stand you grinning like that.”
“You do remember me, right?!”
Lee Gun picked at his ear.
Brrrrr!
Hugo was surprised when the phone started ringing. It was a familiar number. He picked it up as if he had been waiting for the call. “Hailey!”
– Is Lee Gun there?
Hugo became relieved when he heard the familiar name. “I knew you would remember Gun!”
– Yes. I was registered as Time, who’s Oblivion’s peer. It might be the reason I was able to avoid it.
“Time?”
Hailey became silent.
– It’s nothing. Also, I cannot enter the fog since I was recognized as a monarch.
“What? Why?”
– That fog is made using the Monarch by the Zodiacs of Magic. Scorpio and I are forbidden from interfering.
Hugo flinched when Scorpio was mentioned. Unlike the other Zodiacs, nothing was really known about Scorpio.
Normally, Hailey was always front and center, so no one knew the identity of her Zodiac.
‘The fact that it designated someone from the unknown civilization as a Zodiac Saint means it isn’t a normal god.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
– Lee Gun will be in danger if people’s memories of him disappear. However, I have an idea about how the power of Oblivion was used since I’m from the same side. I’ll tell you how to resolve this.
“How to resolve it?”
– The fog is a part of Oblivion’s body. There must be magicians drawing in the fog. There is a high probability that the fairies of the Pisces temple are doing this.
The light in Hugo’s eyes changed. That wouldn’t be too hard.
– As their divinity grows stronger, the Zodiacs also receive a good deal of influence from those who deify the gods. If those who remember Lee Gun disappear, the power of the Serpent Bearer will weaken, and Lee Gun will eventually be unable to use that power. This is why Zodiac Saints are a must for temples; they have the highest faith. They are like the religious leaders who will gather people to deify the Zodiacs.
“Wait a moment. Why the hell did they register me as the Serpent Bearer? Do you know why?”
– This is only a guess.
“?”
– It’s difficult to erase the existence of the thirteenth Zodiac. It would be easier to erase the memories of Lee Gun.
Erasing the existence of a god was hard, but Lee Gun had been a human who had operated as a hero.
– The thirteenth Zodiac will be swapped out for an insignificant human as their standards. Then they’ll try to get rid of Lee Gun, who won’t be able to use his power.
“Hailey… Did you just say I’m an insignificant human?”
It didn’t matter.
“It seems Gun also forgot about me. Do you know why?”
[A god doesn’t have faith in oneself. This is why the faith should be 0%, and you were registered as the Serpent Bearer…]
“That’s why he forgot about me? The mighty Lee Gun fell for such a tactic?”
Hugo looked at Lee Gun as if this made no sense. Lee Gun was in the distance, yawning as he took out a beverage from a vending machine.
‘Still, this is the great Lee Gun we’re talking about.’
Hugo looked at Lee Gun as if something was off.
On the other hand, Hailey became serious. It seemed she had an idea of what was going on.
– Lee Gun was eaten by Oblivion once before, right?
“!!”
– Since he was eaten before, Oblivion’s power must work on him.
“No way…!”
– Anyway, you should be quick about this. All the records about Lee Gun are disappearing around the world. If the Zodiacs of magic can kill Lee Gun, you will be the next, since you were designated as the thirteenth Zodiac…
Boom!
Hugo furrowed his brows when he suddenly heard a sound through the phone.
“Hailey?”
– Why is Time here—
The call abruptly ended.
“Hailey? Hailey!” Hugo couldn’t reach Hailey again. Moreover, the holy item of the Scorpio temple Hailey had lent him disappeared.
Hugo flinched.
‘Did something happen on her side?’
At the same time, Hugo became surprised as he looked over an article on his phone.
‘All the articles related to Gun are gone.’
This confirmed that the fog had covered the entire world.
Hugo looked into the distance at Lee Gun and was surprised.
‘The power of the Serpent Bearer is gone.’
The divinity he could feel from Lee Gun had become faint.
Lee Gun had been deified twenty years ago through the memories of the people who remembered him as a hero. This was why his divine status had taken a big hit.
‘Shit! This is dangerous.’
As if they had timed it so that they could attack a weakening Lee Gun…
[Oh! We found you.]
“!”
Being resembling fairies appeared in the distance. Hugo became desperate when he saw them.
‘They are here to kill Gun since his divinity weakened.’
They spoke.
[If we toss him to Oblivion, we’ll tie all the loose ends.]
Hugo quickly took out his bow. Since Gun was weakened right now, he had to quickly kill the enemies.
[Let’s hurry up and get rid of him.]
[Ah! Wait a moment. Let’s call Master before we…]
Suddenly….
[Uh?]
The eyes of one of the fairies turned round, the reason being Lee Gun, who had appeared above their heads.
[?!]
The fairies were surprised and frightened at the same time.
Lee Gun had been several hundred meters away a moment ago! They didn’t even get to scream. “I was wondering when you guys would show up. I was about to die from boredom.”
[?!!]
Lee Gun, who had appeared in the air, punched the fairies in their faces before they could scream.
Kwahng!!!!
The fairies crashed into the overpass, and the overpass collapsed.
[H-Huh-uhk!]
[What the hell! He didn’t lose his memories? Master was sure Oblivion ate his memories and that he won’t be able to use his power!]
However, they didn’t even have time to be flustered. Lee Gun cracked his knuckles as he approached the fairies. His expression was vicious.
The fairies were gripped by fear. They frightfully asked.
[Do you know us?!]
“Not at all.”
[You don’t know us, yet you’re doing this to us?!]
“Yes. I have no idea who you guys are, but somehow, it feels like I should hit you guys.”
[What— Kyahhhk!!]
The fairies were immediately sent flying. They had come here without much worry, but they realized the seriousness of their situation. They tried to use their summoning magic.
[Attack him!]
[What? Are you sure? Master said he lost his memories, so we should put him into Oblivion alive…!]
[He might have lost his memories, but he’s still a psycho!]
[No human in this world remembers Lee Gun. The loss of his divinity means his power should have fallen at least by half!]
[He can probably use only brute force]
As if to ridicule those words, an earthquake erupted from the ground.
Boom!!!
As if he had been waiting for them to crawl out, Lee Gun emitted a deadly magical energy!
[Kyahhhk!]
It was clearly the power of the Serpent Bearer. Shocked, the fairies almost fell to the ground in fright, as they saw this intimidating sight.
[What the hell?! Why is his power still the same?]
[Since his divinity fell, there is no way he should be able to use the power of the Serpent Bearer!]
[D-Does he perhaps have a disciple left?!]
[What are you saying? The condition was set as a faith of 500%— Oohp!]
Lee Gun’s hands grabbed the fairies’ faces. Letting out a harsh laugh, he held the head of the fairies. “I have one. His name is Taeksoo, and he’s a disciple with a faith of 600%.”
Poo-hahk!!!
He ruthlessly crushed their heads.
At the same time, Hugo’s face looked like that of an oni. “Hey! I thought you lost your memories?!”
Lee Gun let out a cheeky smile. “Yes. I don’t remember anything.”

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Oblivion (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Oblivion (3)
Oblivion had stolen the existence of Lee Gun from the people of the world. It had even stolen his memories, including everything about himself, his friends, and even his enemies.
This had happened because Lee Gun had been swallowed by Oblivion before.
Oblivion had probably stolen numerous memories from Lee Gun’s head using the data from before as a foothold.
The monarch made sure anyone it swallowed would be forgotten, but it also stole the memories from the one it swallowed.
Therefore, even Lee Gun would have lost his memories. That was why Hugo had been trying to do everything to protect his friend.
If Lee Gun had lost his memories, that meant he had forgotten about his powers too! It would be like twenty years ago, when Lee Gun had lost all sensation.
So, whenever they encountered even a bit of danger, Hugo had been the first one to step forward.
“Gun! The ground on that road is dangerous! Koohk!”
Hugo had bought Lee Gun food that he normally liked in the hopes that Lee Gun would remember something about himself.
“Gun. This is the hamburger that you like. You might remember something about yourself!”
When the disciples of the criminal temple had come for revenge against Lee Gun, Hugo had guarded Lee Gun with his life!
“Gun! Look out!”
“Do you not need this, Gun? This is the brand of hat that you like!”
Anyway, Hugo had put his best foot forward. It had even caused his children to make a fuss about Lee Gun.
“Dad! Why are you taking care of only that hyung?”
“Look after us too.”
While they had been coming to this place, Hugo had gone through all kinds of efforts to bring back his friend’s memories! He had done all that!
That was why…
“Hey! I thought you lost your memories!”
When Lee Gun viciously crushed the heads of his enemies, Hugo became angry. He had thought Lee Gun had lost his power, yet Lee Gun used it so nonchalantly. He attacked, knowing where the weakness of the fairies was. Moreover, Lee Gun had said Taeksoo.
“You remember me, right!? You‘re purposefully taking everything I’m giving you, right?”
Lee Gun picked at his ear. “I have no idea what you’re talking about. I don’t remember anything.”
“Wow! You should have told me if you regained your memories…” Hugo flinched. “Is this about the million Won I lent you?”
“I have no idea. I don’t remember. Who are you?”
Hugo’s eyebrows twitched in anger. “Yes. If you can’t remember it, I don’t have to give you the repair fee of a hundred thousand won, which I put on the tab, right?”
“A hundred thousand? It was 119,819 won?”
“Hey! Why do you remember the precise figure???”
In the end, Hugo grabbed Lee Gun by the collar. “Pay up! Pay me my million won! In fact, it’ll be three million won if I add everything up!”
“Why are you being like this, ahjussi? Do you know me?”
“Ahhkk!!”
At that moment, a group was freaking out, as Lee Gun had complacently killed the fairies that approached him.
[What is going on?]
[Why is he able to use his abilities?]
Yes, other fairies had accompanied the fairies that Lee Gun had killed. They were also the ones that had directed Oblivion to this place. The voices continued to speak in the air.
[That’s clearly the power of the Serpent Bearer.]
[Why is he able to activate his power?]
[All the disciples of the Serpent Bearer temple should have forgotten about him.]
Hugo and the Chun siblings flinched when they heard the voices.
The ones from before were taken care of by Lee Gun before they could do anything. These fairies were different.
‘They feel completely different from the ones from before.’
In fact, the presence of a Fairy Monarch could be felt. Therefore, they raised their guards, but they weren’t the subject of these fairies’ interest.
[I’m sure of it. Since he’s able to use his power, there must be a disciple who remembers him.]
[What? Even the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer fell for it. What crazy bastard has more faith than the Zodiac Saints?]
Lee Gun was having a hard time holding back his laughter.
Hugo glared back at him.
[This is bad! I checked it, and one disciple has managed to avoid the condition!]
[Someone avoided the condition of Oblivion? Are you saying someone with faith over 500% exists?]
[Yes, one human is left! He has 600% faith!]
[What? Six hundred percent? Which crazy bastard is it?!]
[That’s more than a fanatic. He is a sucker entrapped by the god!]
Hugo couldn’t raise his head. Lee Gun shook with laughter. He couldn’t lift his head either.
[I found him. The 600% disciple is nearby!]
[Hurry up and kill him! The Serpent Bearer can use his power since that human remembers him!]
“!”
Hugo had a realization. He had become their target. Of course, the Chun siblings realized this too.
“Noona!”
Each of the Chun siblings activated their skills.
“How dare you talk that way about our dad!”
“You won’t be able to lay a finger on the great Serpent Bearer!”
When the Chun siblings rushed forward, Lee Gun laughed as if he was pleased. “Hey kids? Are you sure you don’t need my help?”
“It’s fine! Since you’re weaker than dad, you should hide in a safe place!”
“Dad is tens of millions of times stronger than you, Hyung! He’ll protect you!”
Lee Gun kept laughing as he told Hugo that this was great. Hugo clutched at his face.
They’d create a really big stink once they regain their memories later.
Chun Sungjae warped toward his opponents, who possessed malice. He could use this skill since he used to be with the Gemini temple.
Kwah-gwang!!!
The Chun siblings knocked down suspicious objects. What they had attacked were the telephone pole and the traffic signs.
[Koohk!]
The fairies that had transformed into objects regained their original forms. At a glance, these fairies looked like elementals. They had been using the Teleport skill to bring Oblivion to this place.
The fairies, who were acting as intermediaries, ground their teeth.
[How dare they….]
The power of the Zodiac Saints should have weakened in tandem with the weakening of the Serpent Bearer’s power. However, there was almost no change to their powers because of the crazy disciple with 600% faith.
The fairies glared at Hugo.
[It’s all his fault.]
When their killing intent was directed toward Hugo, the Chun siblings attacked, but it was useless.
“!”
All of their attacks vanished in front of the fairies. Chun Sungjae glared at them since he knew the reason behind it.
‘Each fairy is equivalent to a Saint-rank magician.’
It depended on their rank, but these fairies were akin to sages. They possessed disciples, who they taught how to use their magical energy.
For fairies, sending their attacks to a different location was easy.
‘Moreover, they are directly under the Fairy Monarchs.’
Suddenly…
‘!’
The fairies started mumbling something.
Chun Sungjae did a double-take when he saw the magic circle that appeared beneath them. He used to be a magician of the Gemini temple. So he knew which spell they were using.
Therefore, Sungjae immediately teleported behind Hugo. He touched Hugo’s back, about to send Hugo somewhere else.
“Don’t use that skill!”
“!”
Chun Sungjae flinched when Lee Gun shouted at him. If he let things be, his father would be killed, but Chun Sungjae couldn’t use his skill.
For some reason, he couldn’t go against the words of the hyung in front of him.
At the same time, soldiers were summoned thirty meters in front of Hugo. They were all direct subordinates of the Fairy Monarch!
“!”
Hugo immediately jumped to dodge the attacks from his enemies.
They possessed Saint-rank attack capabilities if one looked only at their power. Of course, they were close, but Hugo knew they were nothing to him.
“Ahhk?!”
However, Hugo couldn’t lift his feet. He almost cursed as he looked down at his legs. Others couldn’t see it, but he saw that the Serpent Eater skill was encircling his legs! From the energy that could be felt from it, it wasn’t used by a mere disciple.
“Hey! Gun! Really!! Ooh-oohp!”
The Serpent Eater skill started squeezing Hugo’s body, and it even covered his mouth.
“Ooh-oop!!”
The soldiers moved toward the immobile Hugo. They were right in front of him!
[If we kill him, Oblivion’s plan will be a success—]
At that moment, Heaven’s Punishment got in between Hugo and the soldiers.
Kwahng!
[!?]
It was as if he had put up a police line. Lee Gun used Heaven’s Punishment to get in the way of the soldiers. He then grinned at the fish caught in his net.
Kwah-jeek!!!
[Kuh-huhk!]
The chains of the Serpent Eater skill erupted from the ground to encircle those who had tried to attack Hugo from the front.
Of course, the soldiers had attacked from not only the front but also the back, and the ones at the back were surprised.
“Hey! Gun! You!”
Their blades that were headed toward Hugo’s back shattered into pieces.
Hugo was shocked.
‘Defensive ability.’
He was sure of it. This was the defensive ability of the Taurus temple.
‘I know he merged with Taurus, but he already transferred all the abilities!’
As proof of this, a green light had encircled Hugo. It was like a thin barrier. The shocking part was that the light spread in the shape of snake scales.
This was why everyone was taken aback.
‘As expected, the defensive abilities changed into the Serpent Bearer’s skills.’
The Taurus temple was the only temple with defensive abilities. Even if Lee Gun was able to transfer the abilities of the Taurus temple, it would take time for those skills to be converted into Serpent Bearer skills!
That wasn’t all. Those who had their hands on Hugo’s back started to sweat.
‘The attack spell should have worked.’
However, it seemed as if Hugo didn’t feel any pain.
‘Did it defend against the pain?’
‘Pain defense?’
This was a new attribute that hadn’t been present amongst Taurus’s defensive abilities. However, the soldiers didn’t have the time to make such hasty assessments. They screamed once again as the Serpent Eater skill surged up from the floor.
[Kuh-huhk!]
The chains didn’t kill the soldiers, tightly encircling the fairies instead.
All of it had happened in an instant.
Hugo looked angry. “Gun! You kept me in place because you wanted to catch them!!”
“Of course. They are like flies. They are too fast to catch using normal means.”
“Hey!!”
“Who cares? I placed the defensive ability over you.”
“Didn’t you do it because you wanted to test out your new ability? You acquired it because of the magic-type temples.”
“Ah! I have no memory of it.”
Hugo really wanted to kill him, but it didn’t take him long to become puzzled. “Gun? Why didn’t you use Death to kill them? Why did you let them live?”
This wasn’t like Gun, but the reason behind it was soon revealed.
“I want to negotiate a bit.”
“Negotiate?”
“If I want to completely get rid of the fog, I need to kill the magician considered to be the core. It is probably a Fairy Monarch. Of course, I can kill these guys and get the fog partially dispelled. However, it’ll only end if I catch the Fairy Monarch. However, I can’t feel its presence. It has to come out for me to bring it to its knees.”
The fairies caught by the Serpent Eater skill were dumbfounded by his words.
[You’ll bring it to its knees if it comes out? You dare insult the Fairy Monarch!]
[That’s right! The previous Fairy Monarch Raeriqueen was a coward. That’s why she surrendered to you. However, you have no right to call forth our monarch!]
Chun Sungjae tried to call forth the first Fairy Monarch, which he possessed. “Uh? It isn’t responding.”
This was probably a side effect of it not being able to remember Lee Gun. The captured fairies knew this, so they laughed.
[We are the direct subordinates under the newly chosen Fairy Monarch. There is no way we’ll submit to Mimir.]
[Also, elementals were born within the fairy garden, and they possess as much life energy as the Serpent Bearer…]
At that moment, the front row of fairies became lost for words, as they saw Lee Gun’s expression.
This puzzled the fairies in the back line.
“Yes. Fairies are beings of life, so they do possess an incredible amount of life energy. Fairies of a certain rank cannot be killed. That is why I had a hard time making the Fairy Monarch called Raeriqueen submit.”
There was an odd joy in his laughter. It made the fairies tremble.
Hugo also shook from fear when he saw Lee Gun’s expression. “Gun….”
“However, that Fairy Monarch crawled and submitted on its own when its limbs were ripped away. Moreover, the life energy of its underlings was so great that I put them in an extractor. I extracted their life energy. The Fairy Monarch immediately surrendered after that.”
[?!!]
Hugo was shocked. Is that the reason Raeriqueen always fainted when it saw Lee Gun…!
“It really is too bad. Since Oblivion was called, I thought you guys would have called the Calamities here.”
[?!]
Lee Gun was referring to the siblings of the Red Eye. “I’m sure those Calamities will be able to torture even the Zodiacs of Magic.”
[Wait a…!]
“There is no way you can’t call for the Calamities when you guys were able to call for Oblivion, right?”
The fairies shook when they saw the harsh look in his eyes.
“Ah! I’m sure the Fairy Monarch can call them forth. Is it hiding nearby and watching us? Ah! Will I be able to drag out the Zodiac if I capture the Fairy Monarch?”
[!]
Lee Gun had found out this was the case through Hailey. He had contacted her earlier through Hugo’s phone.
This was why he stepped on the fairies who were entangled by the Serpent Eater skill.
“Oh yeah! I apologize. I lost my memories because of Oblivion. That is why I forgot how to go easy on you guys.”
[?!]
“I’m sorry, but I’ll work my way up one by one until your leader comes out.” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 270: Oblivion (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Oblivion (4)
The fairies thought that their previous monarch, Raeriqueen, was a worthless monarch, who they didn’t want to associate with. This was to be expected since she had capitulated to a mere human.
That human was Lee Gun. Moreover, Raeriqueen still fainted whenever she saw Lee Gun. That wasn’t all. She was afraid of Lee Gun to such an extent that she had thrown away her Zodiac and Zodiac Saint and pledged loyalty to Lee Gun.
That was why the fairies felt a great sense of betrayal.
‘That coward.’
‘Of all the opponents to be afraid of, she capitulated to a mere human.’
She was thought of as a disgrace to the prideful fairy tribe. However…
[Ahhhhhhhhhk! Stoppppppp!]
[Ahhhk! Please! Lee Gun-nim! Forgive us! Please!]
[Spare us!!! We give up! Please stop!]
The fairies were crying out.
“Ha ha ha ha. More varieties of you guys have popped up compared to the past! Extracting them is worth the effort!”
Poo-hahk!
[Ahhhk!]
Yes. Lee Gun was butchering the fairies he had caught. He had initially captured twenty fairies. However, it didn’t end there.
More fairies had come halfway to save their comrades, so the number catapulted to 50!
Lee Gun grabbed the heads of the elemental-looking fairies that floated through the air and laughed. “Ha ha ha! These pieces of trash are crawling out by themselves!”
These were magical beings born through the skill of the Zodiac of Magic, called Fairy Garden (Alfheim).
They were ingredients that would be reborn again even if he killed them. Still, they were living beings. A single death could last at least several hundred years. At most, it took them a couple of thousand years to be reborn.
However, Lee Gun didn’t care about that. “Yes. These extracts from the green ones were good for my upset stomach.”
[W-Wait a moment— Ahhhk!]
Poo-hahk!
“This one had great skin.”
Bboh-gahk!
[Ahhhhhk!]
“This one was great for headaches and hangovers!”
Poo-hahk!
The fairies were ruthlessly sliced and squeezed. They had their bones extracted. There was no mercy.
The fairies cried out in pain.
[You deserve punishment from the heavens! You won’t get away— Ahhhk!]
“Your voices are too low. If you want to cry, cry louder. Make your owner home out!”
[Ahhhhhk! Bastard!]
“Ha ha ha! The blue ones are rare. You guys make great ingredients as dyes!”
Blood flew in the air as the fairies were diced.
Hugo couldn’t keep his head up when he saw this.
“Ooh-oohk…!” He leaned against the telephone pole and put his hand over his mouth. “That cruel basta— Oohp!”
The slaughter of the toads in the past was like child’s play.
Hugo was used to Lee Gun’s odd actions, yet this was different. He felt as if a new trauma was developing. As he put a hand over his mouth, he had a realization.
‘I can see why Raeriqueen was traumatized!’
She had watched her precious subordinates get diced and extracted. No monarch in the world would be fine after seeing such a thing.
Moreover, the fairies were newly born in the Fairy Garden. This was why they didn’t eat meat. They were beings that ate only plants and morning dew.
‘They are beings that’ll throw up just from seeing animals slaughtered…’
[Ahhhhhk!]
[Please stop extracting us!]
[Please stop slicing up our comrades!]
[We’d rather be buried!]
Hugo turned his head slightly, and he almost barfed. Of course, he had no sympathy for the beings that tried to kill him. “Please… Can’t you kill them in a normal fashion— Oohk!”
Hugo felt like he wouldn’t be able to drink smoothies or fruit juices in the near future.
The powerful first fairy monarch couldn’t take the sight either. Chun Sungjae, who possessed this fairy monarch, dry heaved from being influenced by the monarch.
An indeterminate time had passed, and a reaction seemed to occur to the cries of these fairy subordinates.
An enormous beam of light fell in front of them.
Koo-goo-goong!
Hugo did a double take when he saw the beam of light, Lee Gun smirked, and the Chun siblings were surprised.
“That light…!”
The descending blue light clearly held the energy of the fairy kin! It was the fairy monarch that had hidden nearby to carry out the Zodiac’s mission.
[Warning! A being with powerful magical energy has appeared.]
[It is infused with the energy of Oblivion.]
[It is a being with an energy similar to a Zodiac.]
When the light finally dissipated, a queen appeared with both her arms spread to the side. She was supposed to carry out her mission, so she wasn’t meant to intervene in anything outside her mission.
However, she could no longer stand back.
[I can no longer stand back and hear my subordinates scream.]
Zzuh-uhng!
Seeing this immense power, Chun Sungjae immediately became guarded.
‘She is the new fairy monarch chosen by the Gemini.’
Light emanated from her eyes. Immense power rolled off the fairy monarch as she looked for Lee Gun.
[Weren’t you looking for me, Serpent Bearer?]
The fairy monarch seemed furious.
[I have appeared in front of you as you wanted. Stop torturing my fellow—]
“Ah! You should have come out a bit faster. I already sliced up every one of them.”
[??!!]
The fairy monarch froze when she saw the tragic scene in front of her. Things that looked like her subordinates were strewn across the ground.
Lee Gun was mottled with blood of various colors, including blue and green. He laughed as he looked toward his feet and saw the fairies crawl slowly toward the fairy monarch.
[O… Oh, Fairy Monarch! You shouldn’t have come here! You have to run away…!]
[That’s right! This crazy bastard isn’t a god. He is the devil…!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed menacingly as he smiled. “What the hell? I guess a couple of them are still alive.”
The fairies crawling across the ground felt chills run up their spines when they heard his voice.
Lee Gun immediately raised Heaven’s Punishment.
Poo-hahk!!!!
Heaven’s Punishment had transformed into its stage 3 form. He stabbed it toward the fairies as if he was squeezing out lemon juice.
Kwah-jeek!
The weapon had a large spike, and at stage 3, it was taller than a human.
Green liquid flowed down the broad ax blade, and the fairy monarch froze.
Lee Gun ignored her as he lifted Heaven’s Punishment (Stage 3) with one hand. It weighed much more than a car.
Hugo once again placed his hand over his mouth when he witnessed Lee Gun do something deliberately. He heard an ASMR sound of juice being squeezed.
After some time, Lee Gun handed over two glass bottles to the fairy monarch.
“Here. Take this. These are presents for you.”
[Jam made out of fairies (SS)]
– Recovers 50% magical energy
[Marmalade made out of fairies (SS)]
– Recovers 50% magical energy
At a glance, one bottle looked like it held orange jam, and the other one looked like it contained carrot juice.
The fairy monarch lost her mind.
[Ahhhh! My subordinates!]
It was as if the mental attack was the optimal form of attack. The magical energy surrounding the fairy monarch shook.
Lee Gun laughed as if he had been waiting for this. “Sungjae, Yooha, get rid of her.”
The Chun siblings became angry.
“You aren’t our dad, so why are you ordering us?”
“That’s right! Only one person in the world can give orders to us! We only serve our dad…!”
Lee Gun tried to hold back his laughter.
Hugo gripped his face as if he wanted to die. “Children! It’s fine! Hurry up and get rid of her!”
As soon as Hugo spoke, the Chun siblings dashed forward.
“Dad told us to do it!!!”
“Let’s hurry up and get rid of her!!”
They rushed toward the fairy monarch. However, the fairy monarch wasn’t going to take this lying down. She extended her hand.
Kwah-jeek!
[Ahhhhk!]
[Oh, king— Kuh-huhk!]
Lee Gun found the survivors, and he wouldn’t let them attack. He once again used the extraction process on the fairies.
Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jeek!
This time, the fairies were juiced right in front of her, and the fairy monarch’s mind was completely destroyed.
Lee Gun’s ASMR attack seemed very effective. The Chun siblings’ attacks effectively hit the fairy monarch.
[Kuh-huhk!]
Kwah-jeek!!!
Chun Yooha’s scythe was in its stage 2 form, and it split apart the fairy monarch’s body.
[Rage Revival buff has increased the attack of Death.]
Death was influenced by rage. Therefore, Chun Sungjae was sure how his buff would affect his older sister.
Kwahng!!
[Ahhhk!]
Light erupted from the split body of the fairy monarch. The fairy was exterminated.
[The user of Oblivion has fallen.]
The fairy monarch had received the order from her Zodiac, and she was the user attracting the power of Oblivion to this place. To be precise, she was the medium.
That was why after her death, the power of Oblivion started to go awry.
“The fog is disappearing…!”
The fog had been as thick as though it was smog.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief when the fog started to slowly dissipate. That wasn’t all. The faces of the Chun siblings brightened when a core appeared from the fairy monarch’s body.
“Dad! We did it!”
“Praise us!”
“Really? You want him to compliment you?”
“Stay out of this, Hyung! I didn’t say I wanted a compliment from you, Hyung.”
“That’s right. You’re weaker than dad, so why do you keep saying dumb stuff—”
At that moment, the angry Chun siblings suddenly turned their heads, an odd expression appearing on their faces.
“I said something dumb?”
“…”
Their faces stiffened when they saw Lee Gun.
Lee Gun grinned. “Understood. I’m weaker than your dad, so I’ll just rest.”
As soon as he spoke those words, a wail rang out.
“Ahhhhhhk!!!!”
It was a wail that made it seem as if the sky was falling.
Hugo was thankful that his eardrums remained intact.
Finally, the Chun siblings screamed, about to slam their heads on the ground.
“W-We have sinned gravely!!”
They had realized what they had done up until now.
“Ahhhk! We fail as Zodiac Saints!!”
“I’ll immediately end this useless life!!!”
The Chun siblings cried out as if they really were trying to kill themselves. They started looking for a place where they could throw their body off from.
Lee Gun calmed them down as he approached the fairy monarch. “It’s fine. It happened all because of Oblivion. To be honest, your dad is the weird one. Thanks to him, I was able to end this without losing my power.”
“!”
Both siblings whipped their heads toward Hugo.
“Dad….”
“Why? Why were you fine??”
“Why was he fine? The condition for Oblivion was a faith of 500%, and he had a faith of 600%. You guys have 300% and 400% faith.”
“?!”
The Chun siblings were shocked. Of course, 300% and 400% were almost impossible figures too. However, that wasn’t important to them.
“H-How is 600% possible—”
Suddenly, both of them stopped speaking. As if they had an important realization at the same time, they seriously grabbed Lee Gun.
“Hit us!!!!!”
“Uncle!! Swear at us!!!!”
“No. Ignore us!!!”
“??!!” Hugo’s eyes turned round.
The two fanatics didn’t care as they looked for a convenience store.
“Alcohol! We need alcohol!”
“That’s right! We need liquor with high alcohol content! Noona! Let’s go buy some vodka!!!”
“Hey!! Chun Sungjae! You‘re underaged!!!”
In response to his dad’s angry shout, Chun Sungjae angrily replied, “Who cares if I’m underaged? I’ll be able to buy it if I buy a fake ID!!!”
“Hey! That’s not the problem!?”
Chun Sungjae became quiet only when Lee Gun said firmly that he shouldn’t get a counterfeit ID.
The siblings soon grabbed their father’s arms.
“Dad. I really respect you…!”
“Dad. You’re awesome. I really respect you…!”
Hugo despaired when he saw a look that he had never seen before from his children. It was the words he always wanted to hear, but the reason they respected him for…
‘Should I laugh or should I cry?’
Well, it didn’t matter.
Sssssk!
“The fog…!”
The dissipating fog finally disappeared for good.
When they checked articles on their phones, they were surprised.
“Uncle’s name is back!”
However, Lee Gun’s existence had returned to only East Asia.
“There must be another user calling in Oblivion. Unless I kill that person, I won’t be able to completely escape the fog of Oblivion.”
“They must have summoned multiple fairy monarchs.”
The Chun siblings had told Lee Gun that they would take care of them.
“Wait.”
“!”
“I was able to break the mind of the fairy monarch here, so you were able to defeat it easily. The same method might not work on the others”
“Then….”
Lee Gun took out something from the fairy monarch’s body. “It has a Bible. I’ll call Guisoon. She’ll help you…”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he took out a tablet from the fairy monarch’s body.
Hugo was surprised when he felt the oddness of it.
“Wait a moment. It looks similar, but it isn’t a bible.”
“It isn’t a bible?”
“Yes. That’s a Commandment.”
“!!”
The Chun siblings were surprised.
“The Commandment looks like the Bible, but it’s an item of the unknown civilization. Why does someone from a Zodiac’s side have it?”
“Of course, it isn’t the Zodiac’s item. It’s from the side of the monarch that they are cooperating with.”
“Isn’t this proof that they are tied up with each other?”
However, Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “I’m not sure. I don’t think it’s from the unknown civilization.”
“What?”
“I’ll just have to test it out.”
“Test?”
Lee Gun took out a fountain pen.
[Young Secretary’s Sadness (S)]
– Maker: Lee Gun
It was a fountain pen he made by hammering Guisoon’s data into it. He had made it in case he needed to fix something in his Bible. Of course, it didn’t function as well as a Secretary.
The pen could be used, for instance, when strange words appeared in his bible while Guisoon was passed out from exhaustion.
“If this really is the bible of the Zodiac of Magic, this will work.”
In fact, it might allow him to…
“I might be able to kill the Zodiac from here. I don’t have to search it out.”
Lee Gun fixed something within the bible. The bizarre phrases he wrote headed toward the Zodiac of Magic.

chapters.title: Chapter 271: Ah, is that so? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Ah, is that so? (1)
Several weeks ago…
“What? I have to defend the Bible at all costs?”
Lee Gun had been making the horse head mask when he furrowed his brow. The reason for his reaction was Sagittarius.
“Are you saying I’ll die if my Bible gets damaged?”
[Yes. For gods with Bibles, Genesis is very important.]
“Why?”
[All souls of gods are born from their Genesis.]
“!”
[For example, let’s say a god named Artemis died as Virgo. The god in question would die, but a new soul would be born through the god’s origin. The name would be carried on.]
In simple terms, the name could carry the line.
[Of course, a suitable god may receive the name if a suitable soul isn’t born.]
This was the case with Asclepius, which was taken by the thirteenth original owner.
[Anyway, engineering immortality is possible if a God’s Genesis still exists. It is possible to transfer memories too. The powerful gods can become immortals.]
Lee Gun smirked when he heard this. “On the flip side, a god can be killed if their Genesis disappears. Ah! Give me your head. I have to measure your size.”
[Wouldn’t it be better to heal me…! Anyway, Genesis is basically the god itself. If it gets distorted, it can influence the god. That is why Bibles with Genesis engraved on them are important.]
It was the life of a Zodiac.
[Well, you’re a special case, where you might not die even if your bible is destroyed.]
“Special case?”
[The ones who made the temples and Bibles… You might be the Creation…]
“Creation… What?”
[Nothing. Anyway, you should defend your Bible well. If it gets damaged or distorted, you won’t be able to avoid critical damage. You have to protect the first page at all costs. It informs you of your origins. It is your life.]
“It’s in the good hands of my tsundere Secretary. I’ll know if something happens.”
Well, it didn’t matter. The important part was that he knew the bible was like the life of a Zodiac. A Zodiac could be exterminated using it.
‘The only problem is that finding a bible is hard. That is why that method isn’t used.’
Each bible was shaped differently and hidden in unknown locations. However, it was different right now.
[You have acquired a fragment of the bible from the Fairy Monarch.]
In the case of Virgo, the bible was placed within the Zodiac Saint’s soul. Sagittarius kept his bible in a building within his holy ground. And it seemed Gemini had planted the bible within the fairy monarchs.
From a Zodiac’s point of view, the fairy monarchs were much more trustworthy and safer.
‘Was that the reason they tried so hard to recover Sungjae when he ran away with one of the fairy monarchs?’
Lee Gun had assumed it was because the fairy monarchs’ abilities were powerful.
Anyway, although this one looked like a Commandment, he just had to test it out to see if it was a bible.
Finally, Lee Gun used the “Young Secretary’s Sadness” fountain pen on the tablet. Then, something surprising happened.
Flash!
[It has entered the revision mode.]
The Secretary’s ability changed the tablet into a notebook
Lee Gun grinned as he revised the phrases that came up. He didn’t put much effort in as he crossed out phrases and wrote something else underneath them.
Flash!
The notebook emitted light, surprising the Chun siblings and Hugo.
“What the hell happened?”
“What else? I activated Bible distortion.”
“?!”
Hugo was surprised.
‘This bastard can use the ability of a Secretary?’
That wasn’t important right now.
“Wait a moment! What did you fix?”
The nearby people freaked out when they saw the revision Lee Gun had made.
[When my magic lets out light, the world becomes bright. The light is great enough to light up the world. (Increase ability to create magic)]
▶
[When my magic lets out light, <<my head>> becomes bright. The light is great enough to light up the world. (Luminous effect)]
Hugo was dumbfounded. “What the hell… If you plan on fixing it, you should write something good! Why would you write this?”
“Why not? It’ll allow me to locate her.”
“What? Locate her? Her head is just going to shine, so how…”
At that moment…
Flash!
Light surged up into the sky from somewhere.
The eyes of Hugo and the Chun siblings turned round.
“That is….”
“What the hell? She’s over there.”
“?!”
It was the Zodiac of Magic, who had disappeared after facing off against Sagittarius.
“I wondered where she went.…!”
Since she had wanted to kill Sagittarius, Lee Gun didn’t think she would have gone far.
“Wow! Amazing! He found her actual location.”
The Chun siblings were impressed, and Hugo was dumbfounded.
“W-Wait a moment! If that really is the Zodiac, that really is the Bible…!”
Lee Gun let out an evil laugh. “It’ll be more useful than I thought.”
Of course, this fountain pen was limited compared to the ability of a Secretary. Anything related to the subject’s life couldn’t be written directly. The only thing Lee Gun could change was a word.
Therefore, he had no choice but to fix it so crudely.
‘This will do it.’
Lee Gun started to fix the passages once again.
Flash!
Since this was only a part of the bible, it contained only ten sentences. Nothing that could mess with the origin of Gemini was written there, but it was enough.
[She is the world’s most beautiful and lovely goddess. Her boundless heart continues to grow so much that she cannot sleep at night. (Mind Control magic effect)]
▶
[She is the world’s most beautiful and lovely goddess. Her boundless <<fur>> continues to grow so much that she cannot sleep at night. (Hair growth effect)]
The ground suddenly shook.
[One of the twin siblings expresses its rage.]
[One of the twin siblings reveals hostile intent toward the Serpent Bearer.]
Gemini had let the power of Oblivion take care of Lee Gun. In the meantime, they had been working on a magic spell for a different scheme.
They had been planning on getting rid of nuisances like Sagittarius; Virgo; or Iaso, the new Aquarius. The others would be killed using the same method that had killed the original owners and the thirteenth Zodiac.
However, Lee Gun had started to mess with Gemini’s Bible.
[Warning! The Zodiac of Magic is approaching. She is aiming for the Serpent Bearer.]
She seemed enraged. As proof, the ground started to shake.
Boom! Boom!
From the sound, it seemed as if a giant was approaching.
Boom!
Each earthquake split the ground, severing the lines of the telephone poles.
Boom!
“U-Uncle!”
Even staying on one’s feet in front of that overwhelming power was hard.
Then…
Kwahng!!!
Enormous blue flames fell before them.
Koo-goo-goong!
The flames were big enough to swallow up the city. These blue flames encircle the city in a whirl.
However, Lee Gun smirked. Despite the flames surrounding the Zodiac, Lee Gun could see her through the 13th Sense.
She had a shiny head, and her body was surrounded by hideous fur. The fur encasing her body made her look like a werewolf or a yeti.
“Oh? What an unsightly appearance for the goddess of love and beauty.”
The Zodiac seemed furious at Lee Gun’s mocking.
[Zodiac Descent]
The angry Zodiac decided not to use possession. She used Zodiac Descent.
Boom!!!
The asphalt and the buildings in their vicinity were blown away into pieces, as if a nuclear weapon had detonated.
“Koo-oohk!”
The incredible amount of energy destroyed the city. The act of merely standing in place became arduous.
When the debris flew toward him, Lee Gun laughed as he released his Divine status.
[Divine Status Release 100%]
The ring on Lee Gun’s finger screamed as it was sent flying.
Kwahng!
Black light and green light encircled Lee Gun as he used his ability.
[Serpent’s Nest (SSS)]
This was a defense-type skill that had been transformed from a skill of the Taurus temple. It was a dome skill.
With him at the center, an enormous hemispheric dome covered the entire city. The destructive divine energy that Gemini’s descent had generated was trapped within the dome.
“Don’t destroy everything like a brute. The earth is having an adverse reaction. It’s telling you to fuck off.”
[Damn serpent god.]
The goddess of beauty was in her divine form. She fully revealed herself. This angry Zodiac of Magic watched her surroundings repair themselves through the power of the Serpent Bearer. It was the power of Life.
After consuming Taurus, Lee Gun had gained enough power to recover a city. Of course, that wasn’t important to her right now.
[I planned on putting you inside Oblivion, but I have decided to kill you myself.]
“!”
Lee Gun immediately threw the notebook toward Sungjae, surprising Hugo and his family.
“Uncle?!”
Chun Sungjae was shocked. It was to be expected since the Zodiacs of Magic had played the biggest part in killing the original owners and the previous Serpent Bearer.
This Zodiac was someone who knew how to neutralize the Serpent Bearer. Therefore, a direct fight would be dangerous. The Serpent Bearer might lose if the bible wasn’t used!
“Hey Sungjae. Send that to Guisoon.”
“!”
Chun Sungjae immediately realized what Lee Gun planned to do.
Until now, Lee Gun had made revisions to provoke the Zodiac, and he was successful in drawing her out. However, his tricks would no longer work now.
‘The powers of the Secretary will be able to make revisions worse than Uncle’s.’
Depending on what was revised, a Zodiac’s life could be taken away.
Of course, the use of such abilities came with great risk, but Guisoon was a disciple of the Serpent Bearer temple. The risk was her body being damaged, but she was a part of the temple of regeneration. There would be zero risk to her!
The Zodiac of Magic also seemed to have realized this, so she tried attacking Sungjae.
“Oh no, you don’t!” Having released 100% of his Divine status, Lee Gun ran forward as his eyes flashed.
Humans and buildings were swept away in the collision between the two enormous waves of magical energy.
Boom!
Chun Sungjae, who had a small stature, was almost sent flying from the shock. However, he quickly wrote down instructions before he teleported the bible to Guisoon.
Yet, he felt awkward doing it. “I sent it! Are you sure it’s fine? The Secretary is still inside the fog! He won’t be able to remember Uncle! He won’t follow Uncle’s orders…!”
“It’s fine. He might not remember me, but his fountain pen will.”
“???”
Chun Sungjae tilted his head in puzzlement, but he soon realized what Lee Gun meant. He gave a prayer and finished it by saying Gun-nim. It was in memory of the Secretary.
[Secretary (Disciple 2) has received a wound from the fountain pen.]
[Fountain Pen says Master gave her an order. It is angry. It tells her to hurry up and get to work.]
[Fountain Pen says the both of them can die if she doesn’t listen to Master’s words!]
[The Secretary (Disciple 2), who has lost her memories, cries out. She is a bloody mess.]
[Despite not knowing what it was about, she has made the revisions to the bible.]
Lee Gun’s holy items never forgot him.
The effects of the revision were good.
[Kuh-huhk!!!]
Guisoon was being harassed by the fountain pen as she diligently made the revisions.
[Gemini’s body is being split apart.]
[Gemini’s hair has been pulled out.]
[Gemini’s magical energy has been as sealed.]
What the Secretary was doing was a very high-level distortion.
The Zodiac vomited blood, and she was in extreme pain.
Lee Gun knew this was a golden opportunity, and he was about to head toward the Zodiac.
[Do you believe you’ll succeed by doing just this?]
She was a god greedy enough to bring down the original owners. She was powerful enough to find and carry out a method that would bring them down.
That was why Gemini’s face was filled with madness. She vomited blood as she tried to grab Lee Gun’s arm.
[Do you understand now? You took the most useless part of my Bible!]
Lee Gun flinched when he felt the unknown power emanating from her hand.
‘That magic is…’
He could feel the strange power erasing the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer.
‘It’ll be dangerous if I get caught.’
Suddenly, a bombardment came toward them from the sky. It was an attack from Hugo and his family.
Boom!! Boom!
Because of the attacks, Gemini failed in attacking Lee Gun. Her eyes flashed.
[Elysion! What are you doing?]
“!”
The magic Zodiac called for Mimir, who was possessed by Chun Sungjae.
[You gave me the knowledge of how to kill the original owners!]
“?!”
[Stop acting like you can’t come out! Hurry up and use your wisdom to kill the Serpent Bearer!]
The first fairy monarch, who was inside Chun Sungjae, was flustered.
The Zodiac of Magic didn’t care. She expressed anger and contempt.
[Who revived you again with the Fairy Garden skill! You’re an ingrate!]
Mimir was originally the greatest god of wisdom. It was a library that knew everything, and of course, it knew how to kill the original owners.
[You realized Lee Gun had the energy of the original owner, and that’s why you stuck close to him! Do you think I do not know that, you traitor?]
Chun Sungjae’s eyes turned round.
Lee Gun laughed. “Really? Is that so?”
Chun Sungjae flinched at Lee Gun’s words. To be precise, the first fairy monarch within Chun Sungjae had flinched.
“I always wondered why you betrayed the Gemini temple so easily and stuck to the Serpent Bearer temple.”
Of course, part of the reason also was Sungjae having enough ability to summon it.
The Zodiac of Magic didn’t care about any of that as she desperately yelled.
[I know you’re looking for an opportunity to hand over that to the Serpent Bearer! You better come here if you don’t want to be exterminated!]
Lee Gun laughed at her reaction. He didn’t plan on doing this, but he became sure of it when he saw Gemini’s reaction. “Take out your fairy, Sungjae.”
“!”
Chun Sungjae immediately called out the first fairy monarch.
Having been dragged out, the fairy monarch looked flustered. However, Lee Gun immediately used the power of Death.
Kwah-jeek!
[Kuhk!]
Lee Gun’s hand pierced through the fairy monarch’s body and took something out. It was none other than the Bible of the Gemini temple. Moreover, these weren’t normal pages.
[Gemini Bible]
– First Genesis Page
Yes. In a Bible, it was the most important page, which was related to a god’s origin. For example, the very first page was related to the birth of a god.
Since Elysion was the first fairy monarch, that might be why it carried the first page. This was the other reason Gemini especially wanted the first fairy monarch returned, other than it being a fairy monarch.
When the most important page appeared, the light in Gemini’s eyes changed. Her eyes shone like those of a monster.
[Give it to me right now!]
Gemini attacked.
“Gun!”
However, Lee Gun didn’t even think about blocking the attack. He merely laughed as he held up the Bible, shocking Gemini.
[Uh?]
Then…
Kwahng!!!
Gemini’s attack struck the Bible.
The Zodiac of Magic froze. What her attack hit was the most important Genesis page. The page that could be called the life of a god had been destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Ah, is that so? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Ah, is that so? (2)
A moment ago…
[Princess! Please hurry!]
[At this rate, you’ll get dragged away to the other side!]
The Libra temple’s holy ground in Australia was prospering, as expected of a region belonging to the number one temple. Yet, it was also a place where the Libra temple had run a tight ship.
At the same time, it was where Neglect Giselle had taken root and a place where items from the unknown civilization were stored.
They were the precious items that Giselle had stolen when she made dealings with the monarchs.
This was the reason Hailey had come here.
‘If we want to face off against the remaining monarchs, including Time, we need those items.’
Six monarchs were responsible for sending forces to the earth.
Libra, who was also Neglect, had come here as a spy instead of someone with troops. Abundance was in charge of breeding the unknown civilization’s troops, and Abyss was in charge of transportation. Both of them no longer held influence over the earth.
However, the remaining monarchs were the problem. Though, Oblivion was like a natural phenomenon; it merely wandered around as it wished. It wouldn’t be a problem unless one ran into it.
The most dangerous monarchs were the remaining ones, Time and Chaos! They were the two great bosses who had carried out the invasion of the earth, and they couldn’t be defeated using normal means.
‘Chaos is the parent that raised Red Eye and its siblings.’
In terms of the power of the troop they possessed, they were on a different level than the other monarchs.
This was especially true of Time, who was considered the strongest in terms of troops and magic. Just matching eyes with Time could bring one death. The monarch was that powerful.
Of course, Lee Gun had consumed the Seats of power and the abilities of other Zodiacs, so he had grown his power enough to rival the monarchs. It was something done out of necessity.
‘There is no way the individual powers of the twelve Zodiacs can contend with that of the monarchs.’
Lee Gun might be fated to merge the twelve Zodiacs out of necessity.
On the other hand, Hailey knew that Lee Gun would still fall slightly short of going up against the monarchs even then. That meant…
‘I need to bring him items that’ll create a chink in their armor.’
That was why Hailey had sought items that could be considered a weakness to the monarchs. Hailey held those items right now. She had gone through great difficulties to find them.
However, she seemed to have entered too deeply inside the monarch’s territory.
[Princess!]
A massive green light erupted behind Hailey.
“!”
It was the power of the monarch that had chased after her.
Hailey quickly tried to use her magic in response.
[Return]
Of course, the skill was about to be canceled again by the power of Time.
“Koo-oohk!”
However, Hailey used a similar power, as her eyes burned. If her opponent was rewinding time, she just had to forward to counteract it.
Although her powers were weaker than her opponent’s, she couldn’t allow herself to get caught here. She couldn’t lose these items.
‘Lee Gun and Hugo will fall to them if they don’t have these items.’
Flash!
Hailey was barely able to move north, where the holy ground of the Scorpio temple was located. She had arrived in Russia.
Her subordinates let out sighs of relief when Hailey arrived at the barren, snow-covered fields.
[He won’t be able to come here, now that you’ve reached this place.]
[The blessing of the Scorpio is present here. Princess’s presence won’t be felt here.]
“Yes. I have to hurry and get these items to Lee Gun.”
When Lee Gun had consumed Taurus, his defensive abilities had gone up. He had become capable of defending against the monarchs’ powers to a certain extent. If he were to consume the magic temples, he would become much more perfect.
“If he consumes the magic temples, he’ll be able to do what the magic Zodiac did by using Oblivion. He could reverse it and use it against the monarchs.”
The defensive abilities would be given to the battle-type temples, and the magic abilities would be given to the healing temples and magicians.
‘He’ll be able to exterminate the unknown civilization from the earth.’
Boom!!!
Suddenly, green light erupted from the snowy fields.
Hailey’s face hardened when she saw the man who came out of the light. Her subordinates looked frightened.
[T-Time—]
Her subordinate was immediately destroyed before it could say anything else.
[…!!]
It was the power of the Time monarch. A high-rank Construct had been instantly destroyed. The more horrifying part was that this wasn’t the true power of this man. He was using a twentieth part of his original power.
Finally, a young man showed up as the black and green fog roiled. The man wore a black suit and had dressed like a gentleman.
He approached Hailey.
[It seems I gave you too much freedom.]
There wasn’t a hint of laughter. He was a cold man. Hailey was frozen in place.
[Come here, Daughter. Let’s head back.]
Hailey’s eyes flashed. She found those words contemptible. She had been shunned because she looked too much like a human; she didn’t look like a monster at all. And this man was the one who had stolen everything she had considered precious. Moreover, he had sacrificed her mother as a means to summon a Zodiac, all for his own greed.
As if that wasn’t enough, he considered her a throwaway, tossing her into human territory.
In truth, Time had tossed Hailey into human territory as a suicide bomber for the unknown civilization. It was done to recover a land that the monarchs had to defend.
However, Lee Gun had saved her life, and it was the impetus that made her awaken as a Zodiac Saint.
Of course, Lee Gun didn’t remember anything related to her.
Hailey replied to Time, “I am the guardian of humanity. I am the Scorpio Saint.”
[!]
“You guys are barbarians who would sacrifice your own flesh and blood. There is no way I would side with the bane of humanity.”
Time furrowed his brows when he saw the look in her eyes. He found her actions against her father impertinent.
[It seems you remember something that should have been left buried.]
That wasn’t all.
[Also, you developed something I consider the most useless.]
As soon as he spoke, a black power covering the whole land surged forth. It was as if menacing wings had sprouted from the man’s back.
Hailey shook in fear, and lightning erupted from the ground.
“!!”
Kwah-jeek!
This was Time’s magic spell. It could extinguish the magical energy of a god! It could even block their existence!
This spell could freely control the time and space of Time’s opponent according to his will!
Koo-goo-goong!
In a flash, a black circle appeared beneath Hailey’s feet. The voice rang afterward.
[Lament.]
“…!”
Hailey trembled when she heard the cold laughter. It was to be expected. After all, the energy that she felt below her was a quagmire she could never come back from!
Time’s eyes emitted a cold light.
[Forget it all. Forget your existence. Forget that you are alive.]
Hailey fell into the ocean of Oblivion.
* * *
Around that time, Gemini stood frozen as she witnessed the scene taking place before her.
‘What the hell.’
Kwah-jeek!
At a glance, the object looked like an old tablet. However, it was a bible that was synonymous with a god’s life, and it had been completely destroyed.
Moreover, it was the Genesis page, which swayed the life of a god!
The broken bible finally fell to the ground, and a scream rang out.
[No!!]
Light erupted from Gemini’s body. The destruction of her Genesis influenced her body.
This surprised Hugo and the Chun siblings.
‘The original text from the bible was destroyed?!’
Gemini had a good reason to attack so brutishly. A bible had a connection to the life of a Zodiac. It was standard to have the protection magic of the Zodiac placed over it.
The magicians had to go through dispel magic to be saved from its danger.
“No protection magic was placed on this original text!”
Everyone was surprised by Chun Sungjae’s words.
‘The Bible is the life of a god. How could there be no protection magic on it?’
At the very least, a powerful barrier capable of blocking an attack from a Zodiac should be present there.
However, the bible in Lee Gun’s hands had been completely defenseless. Lee Gun had been the first to notice this, when he had placed his hand on the original text. That was why he had let go of his power before swinging the object in front of him like a shield.
Lee Gun mocked Gemini. “This is why you shouldn’t have brainlessly sent a spell toward me, idiot. Both the Zodiac and Zodiac Saint are the same. You guys are hot-headed.”
Gemini realized who was the culprit behind this. She became angry.
[Mimir!!!]
The first fairy king who had her stomach pierced by Lee Gun avoided Gemini’s gaze in her bloodied state.
[You used to be a Construct, yet you dare rebel against a Zodiac— Kuh-huhk!!]
Lee Gun mashed the broken pieces of the bible with his foot. “You speak too much. You did it to yourself.”
[Damn Serpent Bearer…!!!]
Freya, one of the two Gemini twins, gnashed her teeth. She was the goddess who had descended previously, when Lee Gun had put the Gemini Saint Heiji into a figurine. At that moment, she had wanted to kill Lee Gun.
Of course, she had to retreat at the time when the power of Cancer had interfered.
‘At the time, I should’ve done everything in my means to kill him!’
The goddess vomited blood. She glared at Lee Gun as if she wanted to kill him.
[My sibling won’t let you get away with this.]
“!”
[You have no idea how we killed the original Serpent Bearer.]
The look in Lee Gun’s eyes changed.
Freya smirked.
[That snake. He was our comrade, who died a very painful death alongside the original owner. Now that you are the owner of that seat, you won’t be able to dodge the curse.]
She knew the future Lee Gun would face.
[Now that you’ve placed yourself on the thirteenth Seat of Power, you will die the same painful death. A curse befalls the owners of that seat. You will lose your power and die— Kuhk!]
“Fuck off! You did this to yourself.”
He grabbed the goddess by the head and yanked her backward. Lee Gun was fearless as his eyes flashed. “You should summon your Seat of power before you die.”
[K…Kuh-uhuk!]
“I don’t want to go through the trouble of going to Japan to retrieve it. Hurry up and summon it before I do a merger.”
If he hit her with his fists, he could acquire one or two random pieces of data with each hit. However, a merger would allow him to bring all the abilities of the corresponding temple.
He could grow the temple if he had the Seat of power. He could make new abilities and place a new owner on it.
Freya ground her teeth as she vomited blood.
[My sibling is protecting the Seat of power. It isn’t something you can take easily—]
Flash!
Accompanying a light, a chair was summoned in front of Lee Gun. It was a Seat of Power.
Gemini’s face turned pale.
[Why is that here?]
Lee Gun smirked.
[Fountain Pen is madly stabbing Secretary (Disciple 2)]
[Secretary (Disciple 2) is crying as she makes revisions to the bible.]
[She is retrieving Gemini’s Seat of power.]
“I better buy some chicken leg for Guisoon.” That was the highest praise Lee Gun could give.
An ugly light appeared within Lee Gun’s eyes as he picked up the broken pieces of the bible. Only half of it was left, but these were half of the passages. They were also the most important part of the bible.
[Page 0]
– It is the birth of a beautiful goddess whom all the gods will love.
Freya’s face turned pale. That passage was her lifeline.
[No!]
Lee Gun’s red snake eyes turned sharp as he laughed.
Kwah-jeek!!!!
Freya’s life, which was within the hand of the God of Calamity, was crushed.
This was on a different level compared to destroying the core. The god’s existence would be extinguished! The god called Freya would never be born again.
[Your divine status has increased.]
[You have gained EXP.]
[You have leveled up.]
[Lv. 32]
[Will you proceed with the merger through the Seat of power?]
“Merge.”
[You have acquired the abilities of the magic temple.]
Flash!!!
Boom!!
Was it because a Zodiac’s existence had been destroyed? Something odd happened to Oblivion, which was covering the entire world.
“The fog is…!!!”
The fog that had covered the entire world started gathering in the sky above Lee Gun. It was as if the fog was forming an enormous monster in the sky.
What had happened was clear.
“When the Zodiac disappeared, the reins on Oblivion were released.”
The Gemini siblings had done something very dangerous in dragging Oblivion’s body to the earth.
With one of the siblings having been exterminated, the spell was broken, and the magic had gone amok.
Gohhhhhhhh!
[Warning! The asleep Oblivion is revealing itself.]
[Warning. Oblivion is angry.]
The Zodiacs seemed to have dragged in a part of Oblivion without its consent. The true body of Oblivion appeared through a gate.
Koo-goo-goong!
Oblivion appeared like an enormous typhoon in the sky, and its power was beyond imagination.
[Warning! The fog from the true body of Oblivion is trying to encase the entire world.]
[The existence of humanity will disappear if the fog manages to make contact.]
The flustered Hugo immediately tried to contact Hailey. Hailey might not know how to kill it, but she might know how to send it back.
However…
“Uh?”
“What’s wrong?”
“Gun, who was I trying to call right now?”
The people of the world forgot the existence of Hailey.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw Hugo’s reaction. He glared up at Oblivion in the sky.
“Hailey.”
“What? What did you just say, Gun?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brow as he lifted Heaven’s Punishment. He realized Hailey was within Oblivion.
In the end, the angry Oblivion tried to come outside of the typhoon in the sky.
“Gun!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed in assurance. “The spell of the Zodiacs of magic is still active. I’ll be back soon.”
As if a proof of this was being provided, a dark black hole was sucking Oblivion into itself before the monarch could reveal itself.
This was probably a safety feature left behind by the Zodiacs of Magic. Or maybe it was Pisces, the other Zodiacs of Magic, trying to clean up this mess.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief. “We just have to endure it until that thing is sent back—”
Suddenly, Lee Gun ran toward somewhere.
“G-Gun?!!”
It was as if he knew this was the only opportunity he would get to save the person inside.
“Uncle!!”
Hugo and the Chun siblings didn’t even have the time to stop him.
Lee Gun charged toward Oblivion.
[Prisoner Summon]
He immediately took out Red Eye. Red Eye appeared as it let out a terrifying roar. Riding atop Red Eye’s head, Lee Gun reached Oblivion’s fog in no time.
Kwah-jeek!
He used Red Eye’s head as a launch pad and jumped.
Red Eye let out a squawk, falling toward the ground.
Hugo and the Chun siblings screamed as the impact caused the ground to explode.
“Gun!!! No!”
“Uncle!!”
Everyone reared back in fright, but Lee Gun didn’t hesitate as he jumped onto Oblivion’s body.
Kwahng!!!
With the activation of the spell of the Zodiacs of Magic, barriers had started to appear around Oblivion.
Clearly, the spell was trying to send Oblivion somewhere else.
Unable to watch this any longer, Hugo also got on Red Eye, about to head toward Oblivion.
“Uh?”
Yet, Hugo flinched. “Who was here right now?”
Even Hugo Otis, the person with the highest faith toward Lee Gun, had forgotten the Serpent Bearer.

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Who was it? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Who was it? (1)
Hugo was taken aback.
‘What was it?’
He urgently looked at his surroundings.
“Dad?”
Something was wrong. He felt as if he had forgotten someone important, someone he should never forget. Moreover, he got an ominous feeling that, that person would never come back if he forgot them.
So, he asked, “Yooha. Sungjae. Who was here right now… No. Who were we serving right now?”
“Serve? Of course, Dad serves Sagittarius. We serve Leo and Gemini.”
“Ah! I’m not talking about that baldie! This person couldn’t care less about others, and he dipped into my pocket at will! He’s a hikikomori and an ungrateful idiot. He’s also a psychopath!”
The mouths of the Chun siblings fell open.
“Dad. You lent him money?”
Why was he serving someone like that? Wouldn’t it be appropriate to cut off such a person?
Hugo desperately looked at his phone. He went through his messages, photo albums, and even voice messages. “What the hell? Why isn’t it here? I stored it in permanent storage.”
“What’s missing?”
“I don’t know!”
“What???”
“I don’t know what it is, but it should be here…! It was something very recent.”
He felt as if the voicemails he had saved were especially important. It was as though he had been despairing over something he had lost for a very long time before he found it again.
Moreover, he hadn’t changed his number for the past twenty years because of this person.
“When the Devil’s Tower fell, someone came out…”
“Dad?”
Hugo suddenly screamed. “Devil’s Tower!! Who destroyed it?”
“Who else? Of course, it was destroyed by the monsters within it!”
“That’s right. There is no way a human could destroy the tower considered to be the worst.”
“…!” Hugo was confused.
Of course, his children were right. The Devil’s Tower was a sealed place because the twelve Zodiac Saints could do anything about it. However, the more he thought about it, the more he felt something was off.
‘It is a place we gave up on. So who defeated the boss, Red Eye?’
At that moment, Hugo had a realization. He asked, “What about the person who came out of there?!”
“What?”
“A person came out of there! That person is….”
“Ah…!”
This time, the Chun siblings showed a reaction.
“I remember a big commotion on the news…”
[It was a corpse.]
“!”
An unfamiliar man suddenly appeared in front of them.
Everyone was surprised at his appearance.
“Oh, great Zodiac of the Gemini temple!”
Chun Sungjae, a disciple of the Gemini temple, was especially surprised. “Why has the Zodiac appeared in front of us lowly beings?”
The one before them was one of the Gemini twins. Named Frey, he was the twin brother of Freya, the goddess of love who had had been killed using the bible earlier.
Frey was also the owner of the fairies. And since he was the twin of the goddess of beauty, he was a handsome Zodiac.
Gemini smirked as he appeared before the humans. It was as if he was trying to make sure Hugo and his party would be unable to remember anything related to Lee Gun.
[A human didn’t exit the Devil’s Tower. It was a corpse.]
“…!”
[Foolish and ignorant humans. The media did talk about it. It was about the curious humans who went into the Devil’s Tower but were unable to make it back out alive. It was about their corpses.]
In truth, a commotion had happened when a corpse similar to Lee Gun in height and size had appeared. However, none of them could remember the existence of Lee Gun right now.
“Uh… You’re right, but didn’t they say the corpse looked similar to someone?”
[The corpse looked similar to a Zodiac Saint.]
“!”
[It was big news because someone who revered the Zodiac Saints went in cosplaying as a Zodiac Saint.]
“Ah… That’s right. I believe that happened.”
Frey laughed at their reaction.
‘This is the end of the road for the thirteenth!’
He had been as angry as he could be since his twin sister had died at Lee Gun’s hands. That was why he had purposefully let his skill run amok to get rid of Lee Gun’s existence. He got on the nerves of Oblivion to bring out its true body, and he planned on shoving Lee Gun into it.
Of course, Lee Gun was a battle-type god. Frey had thought it would be tough to put Lee Gun into Oblivion. So he had brought the strongest Constructs, who were imprisoned in the basement of the Gemini temple.
However, then something unexpected had happened!
‘I never expected that idiot to enter it on his own!’
Lee Gun had caused so much headache, yet he turned out to be an idiot! Frey held back his laughter.
‘He probably thinks he can get rid of Oblivion like how he did with Abyss and Abundance. He jumped in, thinking he could acquire its power.’
However, that would be impossible. Oblivion was a powerful being that could make itself forget its own existence! It was a monster that monarchs and Zodiacs would never approach!
Yet Lee Gun had jumped into such a place without much thought?
‘The thirteenth will cease to exist.’
Since no disciples were left to worship Lee Gun as a god, he would lose his Divine status. He would cease to exist.
Gods like Frey could remember the existence of the thirteenth for now, but…
‘Soon, he’ll be erased from our memories too. That bastard won’t be able to use the power of the Serpent Bearer.’
Even the Zodiacs had a hard time erasing the existence of a god, so this was a great development.
“Uh! Dad! Your bow is…!”
“!”
Hugo was surprised. For some reason, he had been clutching at his bow as if it was something precious.
The “Bow made out of Fish” started to melt away. Hugo tried to gather the bow in surprise, but the bow disappeared without a trace from his hands.
Unlike his normal self, Hugo seemed shocked and in despair. The Chun siblings were surprised to see this.
“What’s wrong? Was it something expensive?”
“No… It was free, but…”
“Everything is fine then.” Frey smirked.
This proved that Lee Gun had ceased to exist.
‘It is done! The thirteenth will cease to exist. It’s what we had wanted.’
He wouldn’t mind if that scum of a Zodiac never existed in the first place. So Frey spoke up.
[Do not worry. I’ll make you another bow—]
“Who destroyed the tower?”
[!]
Hugo glared at Frey. “Let’s say that a corpse came out of the tower. Who destroyed the Devil’s Tower then?”
[I said the monsters within it destroyed it.]
“If the monsters within the tower destroyed it, who killed the monsters?”
“!”
“The monsters were sealed because the Zodiac Saints couldn’t get rid of them. If they had come out, it would have caused a big commotion. I don’t remember any news saying they were killed.”
[Withdraw your suspicions. The Zodiacs were the ones to destroy the Devil’s Tower. The mighty gods destroyed all the monsters within it for humanity.]
“That doesn’t sound right.”
[!]
Hugo glared at Frey. “Something feels off about the information that the Zodiacs destroyed the Devil’s Tower and Red Eye. If you were capable of doing such a thing, why couldn’t you get rid of the unknown civilization for the past twenty years?”
The Chun siblings’ eyes turned round.
Frey furrowed his brow. That damn bastard! He was always the dark horse. Without Hugo, it would have been game over as soon as Oblivion’s magic had been used!
‘He is the reason why my sister…!’
Frey could kill Hugo right now, yet it wouldn’t be satisfying. Moreover, the situation had changed.
‘Yes. It’ll be a shame to kill him.’
It was rare to find disciples with more than 100% faith. Someone like Hugo would throw away his life for his Zodiac. He would also help in growing EXP and refill the Zodiac’s Divine status. Hugo was someone who couldn’t be acquired even if one wanted someone like him. Moreover, his faith was 600%.
‘I cannot kill someone like that.’
Up until now, calling forth Oblivion’s true form had been too dangerous. Yet, Frey had called it forth, and that had been worthwhile.
‘Now that the thirteenth is gone, I can switch out the thirteenth for Gemini.’
He would be able to cause a distortion of that magnitude. This was how he would get his revenge for his sister against Lee Gun.
[What are you doing? He dares show contempt and doubt toward a god.]
