Chun Sungjae flinched when Frey shouted. The Zodiac was calling for his disciples. Sungjae’s body reacted as a Gemini disciple, yet something was wrong. “Uh. What the hell? I can’t even use first-degree magic. It seems I’m not a Gemini disciple?”
[…!]
They glared at Frey.
Frey became mad as his eyes flashed.
[How dare humans look at a Zodiac with disdain!]
Suddenly, a luminescent circle appeared below Hugo’s feet.
[Eternal Cycle]
It was a gate heading toward the Fairy Garden. This magic skill extracted and broke down a soul by force. The skill revived the being as a fairy. It would create a being like Mimir, but Frey didn’t care.
Hugo became vigilant when he felt Frey’s greed. He took out another bow.
[Forced Missionary]
The risk was high, but this skill could bind a soul.
“?!”
At that moment, Frey suddenly looked at Oblivion.
* * *
Gohhhhhhhhh.
Hailey was drowning in the ocean of Oblivion. It looked like the endless ocean of Abyss, yet Hailey knew it for what it was.
‘Oblivion.’
It was a being that dragged around the fog. The fog coalesced to create Oblivion’s body, and from inside, it looked like an endless ocean.
Once someone fell within it, they would never be able to surface again. From their recent memories to their most precious memories, they would lose it all. In the end, they would forget even their own existence.
As if to show proof of this, familiar sights appeared within the ocean of Oblivion.
[You aren’t human?]
[Saint-nim! This is bad! The Devil’s Tower has fallen!]
It was as if memories were being pulled out of Hailey’s head. Her memories disappeared in ones and twos.
Her most recent memories were comparatively less important to her.
[What is this woman talking about? You were the one to put poison in his food, so I took it out. I replaced it with herbal medicine!]
[You are the one who put poison in it.]
Then there were the memories she didn’t want to lose.
[What are you doing so far away?]
[Do you want to eat this?]
They were the memories of her occasionally meeting Lee Gun during raids.
As the memories disappeared one by one, Hailey felt her heart break. All her memories disappeared one by one, until it was the time for her most treasured memory.
It was when she had met Lee Gun for the first time, when she had been young.
[She smells like a human. She is dirty.]
[Why hasn’t the monarch killed her yet?]
[She can’t even eat humans or gods. We have to bring her lowly foods. It’s annoying as hell.]
[It’s fine. This time, he’s going to send her to the other side. She’ll be a useful piece.]
[Is that so?]
It was the year 2000, before the unknown civilization had invaded the earth.
Hailey had been scorned, victimized, insulted, and abused. She had been called the dirty sewer rat princess and was sent to the earth as a tool to self-destruct.
When the invasion started in earnest, she would have to eliminate the leaders of humanity, who would get in the unknown civilization’s way the most.
Since she looked the most human, she would have an easy time approaching the humans. Moreover, her excellent looks would engender goodwill from humans.
However, after she had successfully completed her mission, Hailey had been close to dying.
But she traveled through time and space. In doing so, she met Lee Gun when he was a high school student.
Hailey had been able to activate the ability because she was the daughter of the Time monarch.
It had been a rainy day. Her body and face had been ruined, and she had been slowly dying in the streets when Lee Gun had rescued her.
[Are you awake?]
This was how the six-year-old Hailey was able to meet future Lee Gun. Moreover, she was able to spend time with him for a mere month.
When she returned to the past once again, her relationship with him had come to an end. However, it was enough.
At the time, she had given up on everything, yet Lee Gun was the only one who gave her the strength to keep on living. He was the one who allowed her to have goodwill toward humans.
When the unknown civilization had invaded, he had been the only one Hailey had wished would survive.
This was why she had become a Zodiac Saint; she had decided to protect the normal Lee Gun from a distance.
Of course, she had never expected to meet him as the thirteenth awakened being. When she met him again, his face and heart had been ruined. His heart held only hatred for monsters and Zodiac Saints.
Moreover, Lee Gun didn’t remember her at all, but it didn’t matter.
[Kitty. Let’s hurry up and go play with Oppa.]
It was the only memory that allowed her not to give up on life. However…
Sss-rook!
Oblivion finally started stealing her most precious memory, the memory of her time travel when she was young, the memory of meeting him.
Unlike his current self, Lee Gun had laughed with kindness. It was the last memory of Lee Gun’s face, which she didn’t want to lose.
Hailey felt like crying. However, she had only one worry at that moment, as her most precious memory was being stolen.
‘Ah! The item… I have to deliver it to him.’
She couldn’t remember his name. She wasn’t able to see his existence in her thoughts. Yet, the only thought that remained in her mind was that she had to deliver the item to him.
‘No….’
At that moment…
“!”
Someone grabbed her hand. Someone had grabbed her hand within the quagmire of Oblivion, the deepest part of the ocean of Oblivion.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Who was it? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Who was it? (2)
Minutes ago…
‘Damn it!’
Lee Gun, who had bravely jumped into Oblivion’s mouth, was cursing under his breath. The monarch’s insides were like a dust storm. He couldn’t see much. That wasn’t all.
[Warning! Oblivion is stealing the existence of your abilities.]
As the notification rang, magical energy exited Lee Gun’s body.
“Koohk”
The storm made out of magical energy ruthlessly snatched Lee Gun’s magical energy. Of course, not all of his magical energy was stolen.
[The transferred defensive abilities are being activated.]
He had used Abyss to beat up Taurus for a reason, and this was the result of diligently selling two hundred wailing Miny clones.
[Guaranteed Effect (SSS)]
– Magic defense skill, including abnormal status, magic attack, etc.
– Transformed from “Unshakeable Doubt (Taurus)”
– Magic defense effect, including all abnormal status (100% absolute defense).
– Its effect is perfect, but it also embraces pain (accompanied by horrible headache, stomachache, fainting, muscle pain, etc.) as a risk.
A green light surged forth when the new magic defense skill of the Serpent Bearer was activated. Lee Gun’s magical energy, which was being sucked out by Oblivion’s power as if it were vapor, was blocked by a green barrier. As if it were a shield, it stopped his magical energy from being stolen. There was more.
[Fragment of Abundance]
This was the data he had acquired when the unknown civilization had invaded. He had developed some immunity toward the unknown civilization. It allowed him to last a certain period within Oblivion’s body. Of course, the period wasn’t long.
[Warning! It’ll be dangerous if you stay here long.]
[You can stay here for three hours at most.]
‘Three hours should be enough.’
Of course, if that time ran out, he would immediately cease to exist. This was why he urgently looked at his surroundings.
‘I can still feel her energy.’
Lee Gun had jumped into Oblivion when he felt Hailey’s presence. He didn’t know what had happened. However, he had a realization when the memories of Hailey had disappeared, and he had sensed her energy within the monarch.
‘She was swallowed up. I’m sure of it.’
She would never jump inside the monarch herself, so someone else must have pushed her. It didn’t matter in the end.
‘I’ll have to take her out of here.’
Otherwise, Hailey would disappear from this world, like Yeonwoo. It would be death.
Lee Gun felt her energy slowly weaken. At the very least, he couldn’t watch someone near him get eaten by this monster again.
Therefore, Lee Gun intended to head toward Hailey’s direction when…
Koo-goo-goong!
“!”
Eyes flashed within the typhoon. He didn’t even need to ask who this was.
[Oblivion is puzzled.]
[Oblivion is puzzled as to why you weren’t digested.]
Why else?
‘I have Divine status.’
Oblivion seemed to be unaware that Lee Gun was a Zodiac.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he picked up Heaven’s Punishment.
‘Three hours will be enough.’
Koo-goo-goong!
“Uh?” Lee Gun flinched in surprise.
The reason was a change that occurred within his body.
[Humans and disciples have forgotten the existence of the Serpent Bearer.]
[No disciple in the world remembers the Serpent Bearer.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s power will disappear.]
“?!”
Along with the notification, the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer disappeared from Lee Gun’s body.
Lee Gun, who had been like a telephone pole that stood tall in a storm a moment ago, was sent flying like a plastic bag swept up in that same storm.
“Ahhhk!”
It was a rare occurrence. Lee Gun cursed as he was sent flying like a mere fly. “Oh Taeksoo! You dumb bitch!!!”
Of course, he had prepared for this possibility once he jumped into Oblivion. Still…
“How dare you forget me with 600% faith!”
When he would get back, Hugo would pay for this!
In the end, Lee Gun was sucked into the fog. However, that wasn’t the serious part.
[Warning! The maximum period you can spend here has decreased to thirty minutes.]
[You are starting to lose memories.]
The amount of time he could stay here had decreased, and he started losing his memories, like Hailey.
‘Please marry me!’
‘Uncle! Please marry me!’
‘That’s surprising. You’re still alive.’
‘M-My name is Hugo! Teacher! I fell for you! Please take me as your student!’
It was as if his memories were melting away. They disappeared one by one.
On the other hand, his loss of memories seemed to help him.
‘!’
Lee Gun had fallen into the same location as Hailey, and he saw something.
“…!”
It was a golden light.
Lee Gun laughed when he checked what was inside the light.
‘I found her.’
It was Hailey, who was about to disappear.
Lee Gun tried to head toward her.
Koo-goo-goong!
“!”
However, strange beasts came out of the fog. They seemed to be the other spirits Oblivion had swallowed.
At that moment, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed, as if to say that they should piss off. Then, an odd symbol appeared in one of his eyes.
Pahng!!
The monsters that had been running toward Lee Gun ran away in fear.
Lee Gun then headed toward Hailey, who was sinking. And then, he saw it. He saw a curious sight flashing around Hailey.
The light contained the memories extracted from Hailey, and most of them were related to him. Or, they were the memories of her being abused by the monarch.
[You shouldn’t do anything, Princess!]
[Shut up!]
Hailey looked younger than her current self; she looked to be in her late teens. It was right before the monsters had invaded the earth.
These memories surprised Lee Gun.
[Another accident must have occurred nearby, Director.]
[Oh my! Is that so?]
[Are Yeonwoo and Junwoo here?]
This memory was from a time before the monsters had appeared in public.
Hailey had protected Lee Gun when he was in high school. This was also true after the monsters had appeared.
Hailey stayed hidden as she kept an eye on Lee Gun, killing the monsters for him. Of course, she didn’t do it indefinitely. She did it until she became a Zodiac Saint.
This puzzled Lee Gun.
‘Does she know me from before?’
It was odd since he had seen Hailey for the first time only after he had awakened.
‘If you don’t want to die, fuck off!’
He was puzzled as he thought about that moment, but it didn’t matter right now.
Lee Gun tried to grab Hailey’s hand as she was about to disappear. However, what happened next surprised him.
Ss-rrk!
Her body changed into a gelatinous form, and her hand melted away.
Lee Gun quickly pulled Hailey’s body toward him.
Ss-rrk!
However, her body lost shape as it started to disappear.
‘Shit! I was too late.’
However, right before Hailey was about to disappear without a trace…
Flash!
[The Creation ability has been activated.]
* * *
“Hailey…!”
Hailey opened her eyes when she heard a familiar voice. It was a familiar voice that she seemed to have heard before.
‘This voice is….’
Hailey was sure of it. She was sure this kind voice was…
“Lee Gun…!” Her eyes flashed open, and Hailey almost screamed.
The man before was so close to her that their lips were about to touch. Moreover, this man was Lee Gun.
Hailey’s face turned bright red when she realized this. She screamed. “Kyahhhhhk!!”
“Ah! I guess you don’t need CPR.”
CPR?! Hailey regretted the missed opportunity so much that she was about to faint again.
On the other hand, Lee Gun was satisfied to see that Hailey had gotten up. He then looked at his hands in puzzlement.
‘That wasn’t the power of the Serpent Bearer.’
Her being revived was amazing, but at the same time, she looked at Lee Gun with an odd look in her eyes. “Why didn’t you disappear….!”
The more that she thought about it, the more something seemed off.
Lee Gun did possess Divine status, but Hailey couldn’t accept that he could remain unaffected to this degree based on only that.
Soon, Hailey bit her tongue.
‘Is it Time?’
Time was oddly obsessed with Lee Gun, as Lee Gun was the Serpent Bearer. However, if that weren’t the case, his obsession would be connected to the reason Lee Gun had survived being swallowed up by Oblivion twenty-four years ago.
Lee Gun grabbed Hailey. Getting out of this place was more important right now. “Let’s go. I can’t last too long here. It’ll be best if we get out of here within five minutes.”
Of course, Oblivion wasn’t someone that would let them leave so easily.
Koo-goo-goong!!
The monarch felt the anomaly that had occurred within its body. It let its power run amok, to exterminate Lee Gun and Hailey.
Thick thorny vines appeared around Lee Gun and Hailey in all directions!
“Koohk!”
“Hailey!”
They seemed to be made out of the substance that made up Oblivion.
‘It’s Oblivion’s real body!’
The vines were a part of Oblivion’s body. As if to prove this, the vines grabbed Hailey and Lee Gun. The situation was on a completely different level than before.
Kwah-jeek!
“Kuhk!”
The vines fiercely wrapped around Hailey’s neck and Lee Gun’s body.
[You have lost a memory]
[You have lost a memory]
[You have lost…]
Was it because his Divine status was completely gone? Lee Gun could no longer hear the voice. And since they couldn’t use Divine power, they couldn’t even use their skills. It was the worst-case scenario.
‘Shit! This is why Time treasures this monster.’
Was it because Oblivion was powerful or did it have to do with a different special reason? Whatever the reason was, Time treasured Oblivion.
Hailey’s hands shook as she was about to take out an item from her pocket. It was the item considered to be the weakness of the monarchs.
‘I have to give this to Lee Gun….’
However, Oblivion also knew this. It snatched the item from Hailey’s hand.
Finally, the vines were about to wrap around their heads! However…
Flash!
Light exploded forth at that moment.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!!]
The vines encircling Lee Gun were brutally ripped apart. The twitching vines looked taken aback as they slowly backed off.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed in contempt. “Just the mere act of touching me is painful?”
The vines flinched.
Lee Gun let out a savage laugh as he wiped away the sticky liquid. “That’s good. I have something to ask you.”
[…!]
“Is the one you ate twenty-four years ago still here?”
Oblivion suddenly became very restless.
At the same time, Hailey’s eyes turned round. The reason was the odd power emanating from Lee Gun.
[The power of the original owner has awakened.]
* * *
At that moment…
Koo-goong!
Frey looked at the sky in surprise.
“!”
His gaze landed on Oblivion.
‘What was that right now?’
Frey had sensed an extremely strong power. It was an ominous power that made even the gods anxious!
Frey’s face turned pale.
‘No way! It can’t be that bastard, right?’
He was referring to Lee Gun. Of course, there was almost zero chance that it was Lee Gun. That power was different from Lee Gun’s power.
Although Frey had felt it for only an instant, he didn’t think Lee Gun could generate that much power. On the other hand, Lee Gun had caused trouble for them numerous times.
‘There is no way he’ll escape from there, right?’
Koo-goong!
As if Oblivion had recognized the fight being put up, its power became much stronger.
Kwah-jeek!!!
Red eyes flashed inside the fog that seemed to be Oblivion.
Then, the power Frey had felt disappeared completely. Frey inwardly let out a sigh of relief.
‘That surprised me.’
He seemed to have been mistaken. No, he hadn’t been mistaken. Lee Gun had probably failed after putting up a fight.
Kwah-jeek!
[!]
Suddenly, Frey furrowed his brows. Arrows were flying toward him.
It was Hugo.
Frey’s eyes flashed with clear killing intent.
‘Is it Sagittarius?’
After the Serpent Bearer had disappeared, did Sagittarius lend his power to Hugo?
However, Sagittarius had his hopes up high by a bit.
[With this, Sagittarius expects his old Zodiac Saint’s faith to rise.]
But…
[It is useless.]
Frey activated his skill. This skill would extract the souls of Hugo and his family members.
[I’ll make you guys slave fairies.]
In the end, they were plunged into the Fairy Garden.
[They’ll be reborn as fairies.]
Kwah-jeek!!!
Suddenly, the ground shook. Something flew toward Hugo and his family, trying to tear into them. To be precise, this included Frey too!
Frey became surprised when his skill failed.
“Kee-ehhhhhk!”
The one trying to eat them was Red Eye, who Lee Gun had left behind after using it as a launching pad!
Until now, the monster had been unconscious. As soon as it woke up, it attacked Hugo’s party since it was hungry.
“Kee-ehhhhhk!!”
It had completely forgotten about Lee Gun’s existence. And so, it was afraid of nothing. It started to destroy the earth with glee.
The Chun siblings shook at the monster’s appearance.
“Shit! That’s humanity’s worst monster…!”
Frey looked surprised too.
On the other hand, Hugo furrowed his brows. “That’s Red Eye! Didn’t you defeat it?”
[…!]
“I’m pretty sure you said you defeated all the monsters within the Devil’s Tower. You should be able to defeat it easily, right?”
That bastard…
Frey became angry, but Hugo continued to bait him. “Please be honest. You cannot defeat it, right? There is no way the domes would be breached in such a lousy manner if you were able to defeat Red Eye, right?”
[Impudent bastard…!!]
Frey tried to kill Hugo when…
“Yes. I don’t know his name, but someone else defeated Red Eye!!”
[!]
Suddenly, a green light appeared before them. It was none other than the power of the Serpent Bearer!
Kwahng!!!
At that moment, Oblivion screamed in the sky. Then, something shot out of the barrier.

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Who was it? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Who was it? (3)
Something fell out of the barrier containing Oblivion.
Hwee-ohhhhhh!
The item that fell from the sky surprised everyone.
“W-What the hell is that?”
It was a weird clump that possessed chaotic magical energy.
“Where did that fall from?”
The one with the most wooden face among everyone here was none other than Frey.
‘That’s nuts! Why would that fall here?’
Frey’s face distorted as if he had seen something he shouldn’t have. It was to be expected since this item was the body part of a monarch.
‘That’s Oblivion’s flesh!’
The thing twitching on the ground was a chunk of meat, a piece that looked like beef intestines. However, it seemed a bit different from the flesh of a normal monster.
‘Golden light.’
Unlike the carcass of a normal monster, this chunk of meat was different in color.
Frey gulped.
‘What the hell is happening inside there?’
Oblivion was completely different from Abundance and Abyss. It was a monster treasured by Time, the monarch in charge of the invasion by the unknown civilization.
To make the invasion easier, Time had enticed Abundance (Proliferation) and Abyss (Travel) to come along. However, they had a hostile relationship with Time.
They were all monarchs, yet the difference in their military power was stark. That was why Time didn’t seem to care that the two of them had lost at the hands of humans.
However, Oblivion was different.
‘He damaged the body of the monster treasured by Time?’
Hugo didn’t care about Frey’s reaction. After seeing the same thing, he raised his hands to cheer. “Yes!! I knew it! He exists!”
“Dad?!”
Hugo cheered as if he had seen a hero. “I told you that the really cool guy exists! Uh… He’s an asshole, but anyway, the really cool hero is inside the fog! He’s incredibly strong!”
“????”
The siblings looked puzzled, but as if they were reacting to Hugo’s words, a green light flashed around their bodies. The power of the Serpent Bearer was trying to return.
Frey’s eyes flashed.
‘I went through all that to get rid of the thirteenth Zodiac, yet…!’
It was all because of that bastard! Frey became desperate as he emanated murderous intent.
‘When a disciple remembers the existence of a Zodiac, the god regains his power.’
Belief and the stories passed down were the things that gave birth to a god. Therefore, the existence of a worshiper in Hugo meant Lee Gun would regain his power inside Oblivion.
Frey had to quickly nip this in the bud.
[Wait! I understand the human nature of needing someone to lean on. However, it isn’t good to idol worship someone who doesn’t exist. If you deify someone who is fundamentally unknown, it’ll interfere with the power of the Zodiacs—]
“No, he exists… Someone much better than the Zodiacs exists!”
[Damn it! No one is like that!!!]
“There is! I don’t know who it is, but he’s humanity’s strongest!”
Frey glared at Hugo.
‘That fanatic bastard!’
Hugo was such a fanatic that he could probably create a god who didn’t even exist!
Frey’s eyes flashed when he felt the danger.
[The male twin has a loyal servant who follows his words.]
It was his Bible. The bible activated, summoning a blue shadow. The shadow resolved into Frey’s servant.
[Gemini’s Plunder skill has been activated.]
[Warning! Bright One (Skírnir) is threateningly approaching them.]
[It can steal whatever it wants.]
Skírnir was the spirit that had been tasked to bring the bride of Frey when the Gemini twin had chosen his wife.
At Frey’s request, Skirnir had successfully brought the most beautiful woman to be Frey’s bride. However, the spirit had to use magic to threaten her. It had forcefully taken the bride to present her to its master.
That was why Skírnir had manifested as Frey’s power.
[You will utilize 100% of your Talents.]
[Will you use it?]
Plunder was as powerful of an ability as Aries’ Auction ability. As soon as Frey paid the price…
Flash!
The spirit targeted Hugo and his family.
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 0%]
[Gemini Faith: 600%]
[Gemini Faith: 300%]
[Gemini Faith: 400%]
[Forced transfer of temple is occurring.]
When the magic hit the humans, Frey laughed in satisfaction. This risk associated with Plunder was large, but that was also why the skill couldn’t be dodged.
Frey laughed when the look within the eyes of Hugo and his family changed.
[You will follow the words of your Zodiac from now on. Get rid of the badge that is evidence of idolatry—]
“Dad always spoke about him since we were little! He said there was an awesome hero!”
[?!]
After destroying their badges, they were about to pledge their loyalty to Frey. However, the two siblings’ eyes turned round.
“That’s right!”
“Our uncle…!”
The green light surrounding them became larger than before.
At the same time, Hugo found his badge inside his pocket. He let out a hollow smile. “That’s right. I’m his disciple too.”
Frey screamed bloody murder since the skill had consumed all his Talents and Temple energy.
[That maggot!]
Regardless of Frey’s reaction, green light exploded forth from the three humans.
[Faith is being returned.]
A familiar green magic circle appeared on the floor. It was the mark of the Serpent, which had disappeared from the world.
* * *
Around that time, Hailey was surprised by the sight before her.
“The body of Oblivion…”
It was as if an unobstructed tunnel had been opened. A hole had appeared in the sky that had been full of fog. The reason was special.
[The original owner’s power has awakened.]
Along with the voice, a golden light had emanated from Lee Gun’s body and pierced through Oblivion.
This was why Oblivion was shocked.
Gohhhhhhh!
Its cry was filled with rage and pain.
Hailey’s eyes inevitably turned round as she watched Lee Gun.
‘No way! That power is…’
Yes. What Lee Gun had used wasn’t the power of the Serpent Bearer. However, Hailey had an idea of what this power was.
‘That’s the power Time was keeping an eye on.’
She hadn’t known at the time, but she was sure of it now, after having gone through this series of events.
‘This is the power of the original owner.’
Those who were called the members of the Creation tribe were the original owners of the Seats of power.
Hailey naturally wondered why she could feel their energy from Lee Gun.
‘Now that I think about it, Lee Gun always had it. It was an ability that held little connection to the Serpent Bearer’s temple.’
[Man Who Pounds on All Creations]
It was an ability that extracted data, allowing him to create everything within this world. Of course, Hailey had overlooked it at the time. She had thought it was merely his awakened name.
‘Lee Gun was always a manufacturer.’
She wondered if that was the original power of the Creation tribe.
‘It was only a portion of their power.’
At the same time, she wondered why this power would appear right now. However, she soon had a realization.
‘Is it because the Serpent Bearer’s power disappeared because of Oblivion?’
The probability was high. The power of the Serpent Bearer acted as if it was protecting its owner in Lee Gun. And that power had disappeared.
With the power protecting him having disappeared, Lee Gun’s original power had awakened. This power was related to the reason Oblivion had swallowed him and spat him back out twenty-four years ago.
However, that thought lasted only a moment.
Gohhhhhh!!
“!!”
The tormented Oblivion roared. Then, a large typhoon erupted within the enormous fog.
When Hailey was about to be swept away, Lee Gun grabbed her with his arm. When he took a firmer grip around her, Hailey almost died from her heart pounding like a drum.
However, the bigger priority was Oblivion.
“Lee Gun! Use this!”
Hailey took out an item from her possession. It was one of the items that Hailey had stolen from Giselle’s territory. They were considered to be the monarchs’ weaknesses.
The item was a bone.
“It’s Oblivion’s weakness!”
“Thank you!”
Lee Gun activated his skill after receiving the item.
[Creation Workshop]
Finally, Creation Workshop’s magic circle appeared beneath Lee Gun’s feet.
[Disassemble]
[You have acquired data.]
[Bone of the Murdered One (Original Owner)]
After acquiring the data through the Disassemble skill, Lee Gun pounded the data into Heaven’s Punishment.
Flash!
When Heaven’s Punishment roared, Oblivion suffered.
[Heaven’s Punishment roars.]
[Heaven’s Punishment is sad, since the bone belonged to someone similar to its master.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘Someone similar to me?’
It didn’t matter in the end. An unusual symbol appeared in his eyes. Then, golden light erupted into the sky.
Gohhhhhhhhh!
Oblivion tried sending its thorn vines at them, but that was useless. Lee Gun’s golden light collided with the withered thorn vines!
Kwahng!!
Leaves started growing on the vines, and the vines gathered to create a tree. Then, an enormous world tree appeared! Something amazing then appeared on top of the tree.
Flash!
Accompanying a light, a nameless fruit grew atop the tree. For some reason, when the fruit appeared, heaven and earth shook.
[The dispersed gods feel the power of the treasure.]
[Primordial power is showing a reaction.]
[The light in the eyes of the gods has changed.]
Flash!
The golden light stretched out as it hit Oblivion’s body, and the effect was violent.
Kwahng!!
Gohhhhhhhhhh!
Oblivion was in excruciating pain.
As if he wanted to strike the final blow, Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment.
“Koohk!”
However, Lee Gun suddenly became unsteady and dropped his weapon.
Hailey picked up Heaven’s Punishment in his place, surprised. “Lee Gun! Your body!”
The hidden power seemed to be so vast that it had threatened his life. Lee Gun was having a hard time breathing. That wasn’t all.
‘Your skin…!’
The power of the original owner was so strong that his body was incapable of handling it. Lee Gun’s skin was melting away.
It seemed the power couldn’t be used with a normal body.
Koo-goong!
Oblivion attacked the swaying Lee Gun from above.
‘!’
Taken aback, Hailey quickly stood in front of Lee Gun. She planned on being his shield.
Seeing this, Lee Gun desperately got up.
‘She’s in danger.’
Hailey had also been swallowed up by Oblivion, so she had no blessing from her Zodiac. Her body was bare. Just a brush from the attack would kill her. However, it seemed Lee Gun would be a bit too late.
“…!”
Just when Oblivion’s attack was about to pierce through Hailey…
Flash!
A familiar green light appeared around Lee Gun’s body.
[The disciple with 600% faith has remembered the Serpent Bearer’s existence.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s power is returning through the high faith.]
A familiar power encircled Lee Gun, healing all of his injuries. That wasn’t all.
[The high faith has recovered your Divine status.]
[You can use a part of the original owner’s power.]
Lee Gun let out a frightening smile as he activated Death’s Instinct.
[Divine Status 100% Release]
The bright light spread throughout Oblivion.
* * *
“Hey! Stop it!” The angry Hugo shouted.
He was trying to make the unruly Red Eye, who had forgotten the existence of Lee Gun, yield.
Although the Serpent Bearer’s power had returned, Red Eye was a monster. Its memories had yet to return.
Hugo shouted to stop the rampaging monster. “Hey! I am your master’s disciple! That’s why you should follow my orders—”
Red Eye’s tail slammed into him, sending him flying.
“Kuh-huhk!”
“Dad!”
Hugo’s eyes flashed with anger as he got up. “Hey! You’re doing this because you don’t know how scary your master is! Your master is a terrifying pers— Ahhhhk!!”
“Kee-ehhhhhhhk!!!”
“Damn it!” Hugo had almost been eaten by Red Eye.
Moreover, Frey was also angry since Red Eye was threatening him too.
‘The Serpent Bearer has been revived.’
He had tried to bring in the Serpent Bearer disciples by consuming his Temple energy and Talents. However, everything had been ruined.
[It’s fine. I’ll have to give up on the 600% faith disciple.]
The enraged Frey was about to shove Hugo and his family into Oblivion when…
Kwahng!!!
[!!]
Two familiar shadows rushed out of Oblivion.
The sight of those two figures frightened Oblivion.
‘N-No way!’
Frey froze.
On the other hand, Hugo’s face brightened. He was sure of it.
‘That energy and shape…!’
It was clearly their Zodiac. Hugo couldn’t remember the Zodiac’s name, but he remembered his face. That hero had looked like a monster, but his power had been unimaginable.
“Taeksoo!”
“!”
Lee Gun landed on the ground, carrying Hailey like a princess. Hailey had her head down, and she shook as she was in his arms. She might also have been bleeding from the nose.
“Hey, Taeksoo. I got out of there because of you. Thank you!”
“…?”
“Taeksoo?”
With a serious look on his face, Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement. “Who are you?”
“What?”
“That’s odd. Our Zodiac isn’t this handsome.”
“?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Who was it? (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Who was it? (4)
Lee Gun got angry. He had been gone for a short time, so what was Hugo talking about?
Hailey’s eyes turned round.
Oblivious to it, Hugo looked at Lee Gun. He continued to tilt his head in confusion. “Excuse me, but who are you? You’re letting out the energy of the Serpent Bearer, so you must belong to the Serpent Bearer temple…”
Really?
“Do you know where our Zodiac is right now?”
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. He was about to say something when Hugo suddenly screamed.
“Ah!!”
“!”
It seemed his memories had returned. Hugo looked at Lee Gun with an apologetic expression. He couldn’t raise his head. “Ah! I’m so embarrassed. I think Oblivion messed with my head. How can I not recognize you?”
Lee Gun, who had been about to raise his fists, just snorted. It was understandable. Oblivion was capable of erasing the existence of monarchs and gods.
“Yes. I guess it can happen. It’s fine now that you remember—”
“My god! You’re a Construct! Yes! There is no way our Zodiac is this handsome!”
What the hell did he just say?
Hugo seemed unaware of his friend’s reactions. “That’s right. A temple needs a handsome frontman. I’m glad you’re with us. If I’m being honest, our Zodiac isn’t the best example of that. His temper is terrible, and he even kicks out those who try to become disciples— Kuh-huhk!!!”
A fist landed on Hugo’s chin
“Dad!!”
The ruthless uppercut sent Hugo flying and then crashing to the ground.
Lee Gun cracked his knuckles. “Have you lost your mind? This is beyond losing your mind. Did your mind exit to Andromeda?”
“K-Kuh-huhk! Construct-nim?! Why are you suddenly— Ahhhk!!”
“Who the hell are you calling a Construct, bastard!!” Lee Gun flew into the air as his eyes flashed. Then, he landed a drop-kick on Hugo’s head!
Hugo’s screams that rang afterward were the cherry on top.
“Kyaa-hoo-ahhk! Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun punched like a bee as his fists landed on Hugo. Of course, this wasn’t just a regular beating.
[Pain Revival]
“Kuh-huh-huhk!!”
[Super Regeneration]
“Ahhhhhk!!”
[Serpent’s Spite (Increase durability)]
“Poo-hahhk!!”
[You have acquired Hugo Otis’s data.]
[Hugo Otis has gained EXP (Endured attacks from a divine rank monster).]
[Your durability has increased by a little.]
“Now that I think about it, it pisses me off. I remember you, yet you don’t remember me?”
“Kuh-huhk! Kuh-hoo-huhk!”
“I’m allowed to forget about you, but you aren’t allowed to forget me!”
“What?! Hey!”
“Also, you borrowed 10 million Won from me!”
“N-No way! I would have never— Poo-ha-ahhk!!!”
Hugo felt aggrieved after being beaten up. Of course, his EXP oddly went up whenever Lee Gun hit him, but that was of secondary importance.
‘Gun! That bastard!’
Yes. Hugo had indeed been unable to remember Lee Gun, but when he was beaten, half of his memories had returned.
The reason was either the aftereffect of being beaten or the power of the Serpent Bearer being recovered over time. Whatever it was, his memories had returned midway, and what did he hear?
Lee Gun could forget him, but he couldn’t forget Lee Gun? Moreover, Lee Gun had made up the fact that Hugo owed him 10 million Won.
‘Is this how he treats his friend?’
Lee Gun had messed with him earlier by acting as if he couldn’t remember him!
Harboring a grudge, Hugo ground his teeth. Now, he’d make Lee Gun realize how valuable he was by being absent from Lee Gun’s life!
“Who are you to do this to me? Who are your parents? If I’m being honest, I still don’t know who you are…!”
The words angered Lee Gun. “Is that so?”
“Kee-ehhhhhhk!!!”
“!”
The angered Red Eye roared toward the former Archer Saint. Still unable to recognize its owner, the monster was lashing out at Hugo.
Lee Gun let out a satisfied laugh at this. “Yes. You’re a good boy, unlike him. Come here.”
“Kee-ehhhhhhhk!!!”
“?!”
Red Eye attacked Lee Gun, as if it were saying a lowly human shouldn’t touch its prey.
When Red Eye savagely bared its teeth as it rushed Lee Gun, Lee Gun became angry. “Really! Bastards!!”
The enraged Lee Gun held up Heaven’s Punishment.
Bbah-gahk!!!!
He ruthlessly broke open Red Eye’s head.
“Kee-ehhhhhhk!!”
Red Eye mercilessly was knocked down as it vomited blood!
Koo-goong!!
With its head broken open, it looked like a vegetable pickled with blood. The monster seized up and started trembling.
“Kee… Kee-ehhhk.”
Human weapons couldn’t wound it at all, yet Lee Gun’s arm strength was able to turn its skull into dust.
“You want to die? You can’t even remember your owner?”
“Kee… Kee-ehhk.”
Red Eye shed tears. It had 24,788 more deaths to look forward to.
After Lee Gun shook off the blood, his eyes flashed as he looked at Hugo. “Did you also say you didn’t remember me?”
Hugo’s face turned pale from fright. “N-No!! I remember! I remember you!!!”
Light erupted from Lee Gun’s eyes. “No. I can tell that you don’t remember by looking at you. I’ll fix it.”
“??!!!”
The flustered Hugo stumbled backward as he tried to run away.
“Don’t worry! I might look like this, but I’m good at fixing things. I’m a master craftsman.”
“Ahhk! No! I remember you! I was wrong!”
“It is too late.” It had seemed as if Lee Gun was going to put away Heaven’s Punishment when he suddenly brought it back out.
“Ahhhk! Gun!!!”
Lee Gun laughed like an evil spirit as Hugo screamed.
Kwahng!
Then, a loud sound rang out. The screaming Hugo fainted.
Lee Gun snorted. “I wasn’t going to do anything, yet he fainted.”
Heaven’s Punishment let out a light before changing into his slime. Lime looked at the unconscious Hugo and wiggled at its accomplishment.
Lee Gun put the happy slime on his head.
“Let’s do this.” He glared at the sky.
Oblivion, which Lee Gun had bored out of, violently writhed.
Gohhhhhhh!
It was trying to break out of the barrier set by the Zodiacs of Magic. The barrier was getting in its way and trying to bind it.
Lee Gun raised his guard.
‘I can’t believe it survived after taking that attack.’
It was unclear what material made up this monster’s body. But one thing bothered Lee Gun.
[Part of Oblivion’s body]
He had taken a large sample of the monster’s body, thinking he could use it as an ingredient. The problem was the description that had come up when he analyzed it.
[The energy of an original owner can be felt.]
[It is the body of a past Zodiac.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. Why could he feel the energy of a Zodiac from Oblivion’s body? Moreover, it was the energy of an original owner.
‘If it eats gods, do they accumulate in its stomach?’
Or maybe…
‘Can it be? Oblivion is…’
At that moment…
‘!’
Oblivion finally escaped and broke the barrier.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
Kwahng!!!!
When Lee Gun swung Heaven’s Punishment, a Death ray pierced Oblivion.
Gohhhhh!
It inflicted an incredible amount of damage.
[You have acquired EXP.]
[A part of Oblivion’s body has been destroyed.]
[The data for Oblivion’s ability has been acquired.]
For some reason, Oblivion flinched when it was hit with the power of Death. It had been violently roaring and suddenly seemed to have a realization. It disappeared as if it had given up.
Lee Gun lowered Heaven’s Punishment, as he had already checked that Yeonwoo wasn’t present inside Oblivion’s body.
‘She hasn’t ceased to exist, so Time must have taken her.’
Time was the only one who seemed obsessed with the abilities of the thirteen Zodiacs.
Anyway, the main culprits were the Zodiacs of Magic. Thanks to them, he had met Oblivion, whom he wanted to meet. He even acquired its data, but that didn’t change the contempt he felt toward it.
‘The one that appeared here ran away.’
However, it didn’t matter. Lee Gun smirked as he looked in a certain direction.
* * *
Around that time…
‘Shit!’
Having transformed into a hawk, Frey was quickly flying through the fog. He had never imagined Lee Gun would be able to come out alive from within Oblivion.
‘I have no choice but to team up with Pisces.’
The only Zodiacs left were Frey, Pisces, and Scorpio.
Scorpio was a coward that didn’t reveal itself and let its Zodiac Saint do everything.
On the other hand, Pisces was very strong.
‘She was the one who made the original owners sick.’
After hearing the secret way they could kill the original owners from Mimir, Pisces had been the one to carry out that plan.
At the same time, she was the one who kept killing the thirteenth Zodiac Yeonwoo over and over again. She had cruelly killed Yeonwoo’s younger brother too.
On top of that, she was the one who had called in the monarchs. She was responsible for Lee Gun’s death before his awakening, when he was in Yeonwoo’s party.
She was the most vicious one amongst the twelve Zodiacs.
‘Anyway, I have to head toward the Pisces’ holy ground.’
If the two of them joined hands, they could still stop Lee Gun. Frey was about to use his specialty skill. Before he could teleport, however…
[Koohk!]
Lightning flashed, and Teleport failed. Frey cursed.
[I can’t do it here!]
As soon as Lee Gun had exited Oblivion, Frey had planned on teleporting to Pisces. However, the teleportation kept failing.
Frey had a guess on what was going on, and he was soon proven right.
“It’s useless.”
“You won’t be able to escape this place, idiot!!”
Frey cursed when he heard the voices.
[Kuh-huhk!]
Then, a large fire pillar fell from the sky, hitting Frey.
Koo-goo-goong!!
The frightening fire pillar changed into a snake, and the snake wrapped around Frey.
Then, something around Frey started to burn as it flashed.
[Koohk! That’s my younger sibling’s holy item!]
That item was the royal holy item of Gemini, his sibling’s celestial robe. When the item burned, the hawk Frey returned to his original form.
[Bastards!]
Frey’s eyes flashed as he looked behind. However, it didn’t take him long to scream.
[Koo-oohk!]
The Chun siblings had chased after Frey, looking as angry as they could be. They attacked Frey.
“You are going to pay for this.”
[…!!]
Frey became surprised when he saw their faces. Their faces were different from normal.
“Because of you… We did…. To our uncle…!”
“That bastard made us make numerous embarrassing memories!!!”
Even a Zodiac had to flinch at the amount of murderous intent emanating from these two. Just the thought of what they did had made their faces turn red.
They gnashed their teeth.
“Both magic temples have two Seats of power, right?”
A familiar magical energy emanated from Chun Sungjae’s body.
“The goddess was the Zodiac of Magic. You’re in charge of the fairies, right?”
Frey ground his teeth when he saw the magical energy
‘That’s my sister’s…!’
He was sure of it. Lee Gun had taken his sister’s Seat of power and merged half of their temple. So, the members of the Serpent Bearer temple could now use magical abilities.
[How dare a lowly human use my sister’s power!]
Frey’s eyes flashed. He could guess why his teleportation had failed.
‘The Secretary made a modification to our bible.’
The Genesis page of the Bible had been destroyed, so Frey’s sister had died. However, Lee Gun still possessed the other parts of their bible.
The bible was keeping Frey rooted to this land, and his assumption was proven true.
[The God of Fertility didn’t return to the Divine world. He remained to enrich the lands of his servants. The servants wept in admiration toward the god.]
▶
[The God of Fertility didn’t return to the Divine world. He remained for 30 days… Fuck… Damn it… I don’t know. That bastard can’t run away!!! Please stop stabbing me!!! Someone save me.]
The Secretary made modifications to the bible as the very loyal fountain pen kept stabbing her.
This was why Frey was unable to use Return. He couldn’t return to the Divine world. This made Frey angrier.
[How dare you treat a Zodiac like an idiot.]
If he couldn’t leave this land, he just had to destroy the land itself! The bird eyes of Frey flashed as powerful light surged forth.
‘A Zodiac can destroy this land if they set their mind to it!’
They didn’t do it since disciples were the source of their power.
However, Frey could destroy this small piece of land!
The next moment, the Zodiac’s magic was about to detonate like a nuclear bomb!
Flash!
Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed as if he had been waiting for this moment. “Noona!!”
The young man activated Serpent’s Nest (Dome formation), and his sister planted Crimson Earth’s Judgment on the ground.
Lightning flashed!
[Crimson Light]
Writhing like a dragon, the lightning connected itself to make a circle on the ground.
Frey bit his tongue when he saw the lines that were drawn on the ground.
‘That magic circle is…!’
It was clearly a Magic Reflect spell!
Frey’s eyes became bloodshot as he tried to destroy the magic circle, but Chun Sungjae was a step faster.
[Brisingamen]
A familiar holy item was tossed above Frey’s head. It was his sister’s necklace-type holy item.
[…!]
As soon as Frey had his gaze stolen, Chun Sungjae placed a spell on the necklace.
[Size Increase]
The golden necklace instantly became larger than Frey. The enlarged necklace surrounded Frey’s body like a hula hoop!
[Restrict]
[Increase Weight]
The necklace then turned smaller as it restricted Frey.
[Kuh-huhk!]
Since it was a holy item of a god, even a Zodiac couldn’t easily destroy it. Moreover, Frey couldn’t even move because of its weight.
In the end, his body was squeezed to a point where he felt his innards would burst out.
Frey’s eyes were angry.
[You dare use my sister’s magic!]
After Lee Gun had taken Freya’s magical abilities, Chun Sungjae’s magic had become much stronger.
Moreover, Frey was in a precarious situation since his other half was gone and he had used up all his Temple energy.
The Chun siblings showed no signs of going easy on Frey.
“I won’t let you die a clean death.”
[Wait…!]
[Magic Reflect]
The spell was activated. The power that was going to destroy the land was sent back to its sender.
An incredible amount of magical energy struck the Zodiac.
Frey screamed when he felt enough pain to make him lose his mind.
[Kuh-huhk…!!! Wait…!]
“Sungjae.”
Golden light erupted from Chun Sungjae’s body. “I will make sure you pay the price for messing with the Serpent Bearer.”
[…!!!]
Frey felt as if he were looking into Lee Gun’s eyes; he froze.
[Super Regeneration]
[Pain Revival]
[Wound Revival]
[Super Regeneration]
[Pain Revival]
[Wound Revival]
[Super Regeneration]
[Pain Revival]
[Wound Revival]
[Ahhhk!!!]
The sound of Frey’s Core being crushed rang out.

chapters.title: Chapter 277
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: You want to do this? (1)
It was crazy! Frey cursed. The noble blood of a Zodiac was flowing in front of his eyes. Moreover, it wasn’t just one or two drops.
Poo-hahk!!!
The amount of blood gushing out could create a lake.
Frey ground his teeth as he looked at the Chun siblings.
‘How dare mere humans do this to a Zodiac…!!’
When they had installed the Temple System, the thing that the Zodiacs had prioritized was themselves.
– All humans must revere the gods. Humans may not hurt the gods.
Since humans received blessings from them, the Zodiacs had considered this basic decorum that the humans had to maintain.
That was why all the disciples were trained to put the Zodiacs as a priority, which applied even if it was a Zodiac that the disciples didn’t serve.
[Pain Revival]
[Wound Revival]
[Death]
[Super Regeneration]
[Ahhhhhhk!!]
Frey vomited blood as the attacks from the members of the Serpent Bearer temple continued to hit him.
His body was surrounded by a blue light, and he kept shedding flesh and losing blood.
Feeling humiliated, Frey glared at the Chun siblings with a murderous look.
[Do you have no respect for a god? Aren’t you afraid of divine punishment?]
“Whatever.”
Frey screamed when Wound Revival was used once again.
[Ooh-hahhhk!]
When faced with that power, Frey glared at the Chun siblings with a venomous look in his eyes.
‘They have gotten stronger.’
The siblings now had enough power to threaten even a Zodiac, and Frey soon figured out why.
‘Shit. It’s because they acquired the Nameless Land.’
The Nameless Land was the holy ground of the old Serpent Bearer temple, and it was a land that the Zodiacs of Magic had sold to the monarchs.
‘This is why the overall power of the Serpent Bearer temple has increased.’
Lee Gun had awakened the power of the original owner and recovered the holy ground.
However, this wasn’t the reason Frey was having a hard time against the Chun siblings. Frey was a god. He just needed to extract and destroy the souls of mere humans.
‘While Lee Gun might be almighty, there is no way he’ll be able to revive souls that have been destroyed.’
[Gemini cannot use the Soul Extraction ability.]
[You have forgotten how to use that ability.]
‘Shit! Damn Pisces!’
Yes. They were the ones to summon Oblivion. Calling in a monarch to a specific coordinate was difficult but doable.
To handle the enormous amount of energy, however, they had to use Primordial Power.
Of course, this would have been impossible if it was a normal monarch, but Oblivion was a monster that didn’t think in logical terms.
While they successfully summoned Oblivion, this didn’t change the fact that it was a monarch.
‘Of course, there are risks.’
Oblivion was a calamity that not even gods and monarchs wanted to approach. Just being near it would make a god forget about their own existence.
If the summoners were unlucky, they could get influenced by its power. And that exact scenario had happened with Frey.
‘Damn it! I forgot how it feels to use my power…!’
Frey was a magician. He was capable of using all kinds of spells, but he seemed to have received a punishment for using Oblivion. He had forgotten how to use his abilities.
If he had to make an easy comparison, it was like forgetting how to walk or use his hands.
It was unclear as to whether Chun Sungjae had realized what was going on or if he had heard something about Frey. He laughed as he kept his distance from the Zodiac. “You haven’t used your abilities for some time, Zodiac-nim. I wonder why?”
“…!!!”
“Did you perhaps forget how to use your magic like an idiot, thanks to Oblivion?”
Frey gritted his teeth.
[Insolent fools. There is no way that would happen!]
“Is that so?” Chun Sungjae laughed as he flicked his finger. Then, symbols made out of brown light appeared in the air. “This is a spell you guys like to use frequently. There is no way you’ll fail to recognize this, right?”
The flustered Frey started to sweat.
‘Damn it!’
It seemed to be a simple word, just by seeing the length of it. However, Frey had really forgotten the content.
What would happen if others found out that a Zodiac couldn’t use his power?
But Frey then laughed. He had forgotten the content, but at the very least, he still had his knowledge.
‘Since they are brown letters, it must be a curse-type spell! Something of that length and arranged in that fashion must be…’
[Hmmph. That is a curse magic spell that corrodes the bone. It’s an SS-rank—]
Chun Sungjae burst out laughing. “You can come here now, Noona. This asshole can’t use his spells. He probably forgot it because of Oblivion.”
[?!]
“SS-rank curse spell? How funny! I just changed the arrangement of Uncle’s signature, yet you called it a curse spell?”
[…!!!]
Frey had to curse.
‘Damn Pisces!!’
In truth, the Zodiac did expect such risks when they had decided to use Oblivion. Pisces was supposed to use her Talents to get rid of that risk.
‘I’m sure of it. She got rid of only her risk.’
It seemed Pisces wanted to get rid of Gemini here. Moreover, she chose a humiliating way to kill him! He would get killed by human hands!
‘I can guess why she’s trying to get rid of me.’
Damn bitch!
However, Frey soon started laughing as if he had given up. Although he was pissed off at Pisces, who had backed out, he should have known this would happen once he messed with Oblivion. Oblivion was a being that one should never mess with.
Therefore, Frey laughed in a self-mocking manner as he closed his eyes.
‘Yes. My sister is dead. What is the point of continuing to live by myself?’
Frey let go of his murderous intent as he tried to give himself up.
[Kuh-huhk!]
Suddenly, Frey vomited blood. When he opened his eyes, he saw Chun Yooha stabbing him with Crimson Earth’s Judgment.
“Look here. You can’t do as you like and play out your last scene.”
[??!!]
“That’s right. You can’t disappear. Your sister disappeared without leaving anything behind. It means Uncle was unable to obtain any ingredients. Letting you go would be crazy.”
[??!!]
The Chun siblings gnashed their teeth. They already hated the Zodiacs. The reason was what the Cancer Saint Jean-Louis had said to their uncle.
The real culprits who tried to lock you up and kill you in the Devil’s Tower were the Zodiacs.
“As if trying to kill Uncle wasn’t enough, you tried to erase his existence.”
Lee Gun was their benefactor and practically family to them.
Seeing the siblings approach him, Frey ground his teeth.
‘Nothing good will come from being caught by them.’
Their eyes were devoid of sanity.
This was why Frey decided to run away no matter what. But…
“Oh! This is great. I never expected Oblivion to be helpful in this way.”
[…!!]
Frey was surprised by the voice he heard above his head. When he raised his head, he saw the gaze of someone even more insane than the Chun siblings.
“Uncle!”
The crazy bastard smirked as his red eyes flashed. “I’ve always wanted to dissect a body made out of magic. The fairies turned into jam whenever I messed with them. Thank you for letting me have your precious body!”
He brought down Heaven’s Punishment.
* * *
[Breaking news! Following the Cancer, Taurus, and Capricorn temples, the Gemini temple has fallen.]
[All the temples have been absorbed by Lee Gun, and it has caused a shockwave around the world.]
[In reality, it was a merger. Are people talking about him?]
[Yes. Lee Gun was the one who killed Red Eye, and he has saved the world before. Most people say he has the right to do so.]
[Some wonder if merging all the temples into one would be disadvantageous to fighting the unknown civilization.]
[That’s not all. Various sources say Lee Gun really possesses the power of a Zodiac. It means he either needs a suitable shrine or temple. It’ll allow the belief in the Zodiac to strengthen.]
[Uh? Shrine? That’s odd. Doesn’t Mr. Lee Gun already have a shrine in Korea?]
[Ah… Mr. Lee Gun burned that one to the ground.]
[What?! He burned it?!!]
[Yes… He said it was embarrassing. He said to build a special needs school or an orphanage instead…]
[N-Now that you mention it, Mr. Lee Gun received a massive amount of compensation from the Leo temple, and he diverted all that fund for disaster recovery.]
The news about Lee Gun’s temple merger spread quickly. A large-scale war had broken out, but Lee Gun had killed the heads of the temples. Then, he took their Seats of power. It was a merger in reality.
Moreover, Lee Gun was diligently taking the abilities of other gods through their Seats of power
Of course, an enormous number of Talents was needed for this, so he continued to replicate and sell his Constructs.
Moreover, the public reaction to the merger was quite good.
<If it is Lee Gun, we can trust him.>
<If it is Lee Gun, he’ll be able to take back all the lands of humanity>
Of course, one faction poured cold water over the positive reaction.
[Do not be fooled. Lee Gun is merging the temples for his own selfish reasons.]
It was the Pisces temple.
This surprised people.
[Selfish reasons?]
[Yes. Lee Gun brutally killed the Zodiacs who protected humanity. He could have taken them under him as affiliates, yet he chose to kill them. Do you know why he would do that?]
[Why?]
[He doesn’t know how to coexist with others, and he covets the abilities of the other temples. Battle-type temples cannot possess recovery skills. If he could take the skills of other temples, he would be peerless.]
[!]
[There is a reason the Zodiacs kept a balance. That man has broken it.]
[Also, we already warned Lee Gun. If he proceeds with the merger, the balance of the universe would be broken. In turn, it would threaten humanity. More monsters might invade. Listen to his answer about this subject.]
– Monsters? It’ll be great if more monsters invade the earth. In fact, the fear that would cause will make the faith go up.
[Did you listen to that voice? It is what Lee Gun said as he killed Gemini. One of the poor slaughtered fairies left it behind.]
[Anyway, the Pisces temple created the temple system, and we have been protecting the earth until now. We’ll use everything available to us to stop Lee Gun’s plans.]
[To do this, Pisces has descended to the earth.]
Lee Gun, who had been eating chicken, scoffed when he heard the voices coming from the pub’s TV.
“Hey! What the hell are they talking about?”
“What else? They’re saying that you are the demon king and that they are the virtuous heroes.”
“What’s your opinion about it?”
“Wow! They are correct. I completely agree with them.”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows twitched. “What did you just say?”
“They are correct. From my point of view, you are the villain— Kuh-huhk!!!”
He kicked Hugo. Lee Gun was angry for no other reason. “Those bastards used my voice without permission?”
The Pisces temple was the temple of transformation. It would be child’s play for someone from that temple to transform into Lee Gun and record that message.
“I won’t let them die a clean death.”
Stevens, who sat next to Lee Gun, shook when he saw murderous intent appear in Lee Gun’s eyes.
Stevens didn’t know why, but Lee Gun had called him here. The only thing that had been mentioned until now was that Lee Gun wanted to rescue someone using all the powers he had gathered.
“Are you sure about leaving them alone?”
“A couple of our kids became angry when they saw it. Several of them wanted to go there, but I told them to let it be. It’ll all end when I get rid of Pisces.”
“What?!”
Stevens was truly surprised. On the other hand, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
From Lee Gun’s point of view, Pisces was the most hated Zodiac. Pisces had falsely accused Yeonwoo of being the God of Calamity and fastidiously tracked her down to kill her. She was also the being that had called in Time and the other monarchs twenty-four years ago.
Of course, Lee Gun could go catch Pisces and reveal what the Zodiacs had done. However, he didn’t care about that too much.
‘Before I could take them out, she took all the Constructs from Gemini’s holy ground.’
That was why Gemini had been killed. However, taking them under Lee Gun’s eyes was impossible, so a transfer contract must have been made beforehand.
That wasn’t all.
‘She has her.’
Lee Gun could feel it through the TV. Pisces had something in her possession that emitted Yeonwoo’s light.
Therefore, Lee Gun looked at the Zodiac in contempt.
‘This bastard wants a direct conflict.’
Her coming out on TV, talking nonsense, was a simple last-ditch effort. She was showing Yeonwoo’s light to provoke Lee Gun.
‘Her goal is to lure me in.’
Pisces was a powerful Zodiac that had introduced the Temple system to the earth. She was a hikikomori, yet the most meticulous amongst the Zodiacs. She was also the one to kill the original owners using her abilities.
So her coming out in the open like this meant that she was planning something.
That was why Lee Gun had told his kids to not chase too deeply when they tried to charge out.
‘I’ll make her regret provoking me.’
Stevens discreetly tried to leave when he read Lee Gun’s expression. Lee Gun seemed to have called for him because he needed a battle-type temple to fight a magic-type temple. However, Stevens felt he would suffer some mishap if he got involved.
Therefore, he tried to leave without anyone noticing, yet Lee Gun grabbed him.
“Where are you going? I called you because I wanted to give you some chicken. Eat up.”
Stevens couldn’t believe what he had just heard. What did Lee Gun want to give him right now? Lee Gun wanted to give him something to eat. Moreover, it was meat. Lee Gun wanted to give him chicken?
Stevens froze.
‘Today is the day I die.’
Seeing Stevens’ expression, Hugo clicked his tongue. “I understand you want to feed him because you have plans for him.”
Stevens felt like he had heard his death sentence. “What? What do you plan on doing to me that you are giving me your chicken?”
Hugo ignored him. “Anyway, I don’t care what you eat, but are you sure about buying more? This is your ninetieth chicken. The owner of the restaurant is happy, but did you bring your card? I didn’t see you bring your wallet.”
For the sake of living, Stevens quickly looked for his wallet.
“It’s fine. I brought your card.”
“Ah! Is that so? That’s good… My card…. What? Have you lost your mind?!” Hugo screamed as he snatched away the card that Lee Gun had boastfully brought out.
“You really have lost your mind! Be honest with me! What did you buy with this?”
“Ten kilograms of pork belly.”
“Hey!”
“Who cares? You’re a huge fan of mine. You really like me, right? Your faith is 600%.”
“What?! 600%?!”
“Hey! What nonsense are you—”
“Am I wrong? Isn’t it 600%?”
“…” Hugo was at a loss for words as he looked into the mirror. Veins popped out on his neck from anger. He shouted. “Do you not realize fans create detractors? Do you not realize how scary that is!!!”
In the end, the angry Hugo was about to take away Lee Gun’s phone when…
“Are you Lee Gun-nim?”
“!”
A delivery man came looking for him with something in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 278
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: You want to do this? (2)
Inside a bar in Italy, Chun Yooha’s eyes flashed. “What did you just say?”
She had snuck into the holy ground of Pisces temple, and her gaze landed on a man and a woman who were drinking beer.
With a cold expression on her face, Yooha asked the man and woman, “Say it again. What did you just say right now?”
Both of them had trailed her, and they boldly replied to her.
“You must be going deaf, Chun Yooha. Lee Gun-nim’s Zodiac Saint will be me, the Maker Temple’s Ten Star Taylor.”
“Ahhk! Idiot! I’m going to be Lee Gun-nim’s Zodiac Saint!”
An angry expression appeared on Yooha’s face.
Chun Yooha had infiltrated this area near the Pisces temple’s holy ground with her brother. Since they didn’t want to be found out, they had transformed themselves before entering this place. They couldn’t let the Pisces temple get away with speaking such nonsense.
However, two people were speaking more nonsense than the Pisces temple.
After bringing more beer, Chun Sungjae kicked out with his foot. “How dare you guys covet Uncle like this!”
“Koo-oohk!”
Chun Sungjae became angry at Carly and Taylor. “What’s up with you, Carly noona? Where the hell did you pick up this weirdo?”
Chun Sungjae had come here through teleportation, and his outer appearance was different.
Chun Yooha was a black-haired beauty, but she had transformed herself into a blonde beauty.
But Chun Sungjae also looked like a blonde beauty. He looked like a mature woman with curves in all the right places. Moreover, he looked older.
After receiving a kick from Chun Sungjae, the dumbfounded Carly got angry. “What’s up with your getup!”
“What else? Transformation is a must for infiltration, right?”
Having acquired magic ability from the Gemini temple, Chun Sungjae looked elated. With his magic abilities, he had changed his sister’s face and also his own.
“What are you trying to accomplish?”
“What do you think? I’m much prettier than Noona, right? I’ll use this to seduce Uncle.”
“…??!”
Carly was dumbfounded. Like sister, like brother.
Since Sungjae was working with a good foundation, he looked like an absolute beauty. He rivaled Yooha.
“Hmph! This is absurd. Also, what’s up with your chest? It looks like they are about to pop out.”
“What do you mean? Don’t you guys not know Uncle’s preferences? Men traditionally love a curvy body! Uncle is the same. Of course— Ooh-ahhhk! You’re going to rip them off! Don’t grab them!”
Goat, who had followed Chun Sungjae, massaged his face. Finally, the thing that he had worried about had happened.
Carly was unaffected as she scoffed. “What nonsense! There is no way Lee Gun-nim will fall for—”
“Are you jealous because mine is bigger than yours?”
“W-What?!”
Chun Sungjae always had a bad relationship with Carly. He ground his teeth. “What? You’re smaller than my sister. In many ways, you have to work harder.”
“What!!! What did you just say?” Carly’s face turned red as her hackles rose. “In what way am I smaller than Chun Yooha…!!”
She let out a silent scream as she looked at Chun Yooha. “I’ll kill you!!”
“Anyway, I’ll use this on Uncle— Ehhhk!”
Boom!
Chun Yooha ruthlessly kicked her younger brother. With a cold expression, she said to Carly and Taylor, “You guys want to become Zodiac Saints? You dare say that when you forgot Uncle because of Oblivion?”
Taylor and Carly flinched.
“That isn’t…”
“I’ll act as if I didn’t hear anything.”
“That’s right. They aren’t worth engaging…”
Carly, who had been sweating profusely, suddenly bared her teeth. “I heard you guys were being clingy toward the Archer Saint!!!”
“?!!”
This time, the Chun siblings froze.
Carly laughed. “Did you think we wouldn’t find out? You guys forgot about Lee Gun-nim and made a big deal, declaring your love for the Archer Saint!”
The siblings despaired.
“Of course, we love our dad. We love him, but…”
“Ah! That really is an embarrassing past…”
In the end, no one had anything to say, so they decided to end it on a truce.
“If we want to solidify our faith, we have to get rid of the Pisces temple.”
“Ah! Isn’t the Virgo temple’s holy ground nearby? I heard Kevin-nim took Lee Gun-nim’s body that underwent molting.”
“We have to infiltrate as Pisces disciples— What?!”
The light in everyone’s eyes changed. However, they all pretended to not have heard it.
‘I’ll keep quiet and go steal it later.’
‘Damn Virgo Saint! When the hell did he have the time to take that?’
When they were about to go over their plan once again…
“What business does the Serpent Bearer temple have here?”
“!”
A familiar face appeared in front of them.
* * *
Around that time…
“Are you Lee Gun-nim?”
A quick delivery agent had come looking for Lee Gun, having tracked Lee Gun’s location. A sound came from his watch.
[Recipient Lee Gun’s location tracking is complete.]
[Thank you very much for using the Sagittarius temple’s rental skill!]
“You have a delivery, Lee Gun-nim. Please sign here for confirmation.”
“Alright.”
Hugo raised his guard when he saw the quick delivery agent. The delivery agent had used the Sagittarius temple’s Location Tracking skill, a skill that the Sagittarius temple was proud of. It was a very useful skill used in raids and locating a person.
However, this skill was restricted for normal use. It could be used if one was wealthy, but Hugo had put a lot of strict stipulations, since the skill could be used for stalking.
This meant an SS-rank skill had to be used at the minimum to find Lee Gun’s location. Several billion won had to be paid if one wanted to use this tracking skill. There’s no way a normal civilian would pay such a price to send a fan letter. It meant…
‘An enemy sent it!’
Hugo urgently glared at the package in the delivery agent’s hands. He stood up from his seat and snatched the package before Lee Gun could take it. “Gun! You’re in danger! It’s a bomb!”
“…!”
After taking the package, Hugo bent the delivery agent’s arm in a takedown. “Since you have magical energy, you must have been sent by the Pisces temple. You cannot fool my eyes— Kuh-huhk!!!”
Lee Gun kicked his friend. “That’s my personal delivery agent. Get out of the way.”
“Personal delivery agent? Isn’t that person a disciple of the Pisces temple??”
Taken aback, Hugo looked at the delivery agent, but the helmeted delivery agent seemed ecstatic. “Shit! I was taken down by Hugo. It would have been better if Lee Gun had taken me down! No… It’s ok since Lee Gun-nim saw it!”
“…?!!”
Someone mumbled inside the helmet. The expressions of Hugo and Stevens changed when they realized the voice sounded familiar.
“Wait a moment. That voice…!!!”
Hugo approached the delivery agent with an incredulous expression on his face. When he tried to yank the helmet off, the delivery agent became angry and grabbed the helmet. “Let me go. How dare someone like Hugo do this to me! Ahhk!”
In the end, Stevens joined in to help. When the helmet came off, everyone was surprised by the sight.
“Heiji!!”
It was Heiji, the woman known as the blue witch. She was none other than the Zodiac Saint of the Gemini temple.
She and Lee Gun were like cats and dogs. They fought at the drop of a hat, which ended in blood being shed.
A while ago, she had been betrayed by Sungjae and gotten trapped within a figurine.
Yet, she seemed ecstatic at seeing Lee Gun right now. “It hasn’t been long, but Lee Gun-nim has become more dashing.”
The two men’s faces froze. This woman and Lee Gun were sworn enemies. She was someone who would try to stab Lee Gun on sight…!!
In the end, they had only one thing to ask.
“What the hell did you do to her, Gun?”
Lee Gun snorted as he opened the package. “I acquired several things that I had to test out.”
“What did you acquire?”
“Oblivion and Distortion.”
“…?!!”
Stevens and Hugo immediately realized what had happened.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed like the devil. “You reap what you sow. Their leaders also used Oblivion and Distortion on me.”
Stevens and Hugo looked horror-struck.
“In the end, it didn’t work against you…”
“He’s the biggest villain….”
“Anyway, I learned something useful. Of course, I wanted to test it out.”
“Still, that’s a bit….”
“As expected, he’s a villain….”
“Oh yeah. I’m looking for the next test subject. This time, I want a male test subject.”
“Wow!!! You’re absolutely the righteous hero!”
“She deserves what she got, considering what she did to you! In fact, this is too little!”
Suddenly, Hugo asked, “Uh? Wait a moment. Why can I sense the energy of the Pisces temple…!”
“I was thinking about sending her as a spy to the Pisces.”
“!”
“Since Gemini has ceased to exist, Heiji isn’t supposed to be able to use magic. That’s why I told her to try borrowing magic from the Pisces. If she uses their magic at a high level, wouldn’t Pisces want her?”
“Then…!!”
Lee Gun grinned. Amongst the Zodiacs, the biggest rival to Pisces were the magicians. Moreover, Pisces knew Heiji and Lee Gun were on terrible terms.
Heiji used to be the leader of the other magic temple that opposed Lee Gun alongside Pisces. She was capable, and she probably knew the weakness of the Pisces temple better than anyone.
This was why Lee Gun had decided to test out his newly acquired powers on her. “Still. I never imagined she would turn out like this.”
“What? Didn’t you make her like this?!”
“No way!”
He had used Oblivion to erase her bad memories of him, then Distortion to make it so that they were on good terms.
Lee Gun laughed in derision. “It was my first attempt, so I might have gone overboard. However, it doesn’t matter. Both Oblivion and Distortion are very useful.”
The two men shook.
‘At this rate, won’t he be the strongest?’
‘He can use it to raise faith. That’s the end game!’
As if he could read their thoughts, Lee Gun snorted. “I cannot do anything when it comes to faith. Faith falls under the matters of the heart. Moreover, that state doesn’t last indefinitely.”
“!”
Wouldn’t it be a problem if it was unlimited?
“How long does it last?”
“Thousand years?”
“That’s practically endless!!!”
“Well, it’ll be released if something happens to me, so it isn’t endless.”
“…!”
“Anyway…”
Lee Gun checked the package Heiji had brought. Most of them were fan letters, but an unexpected item was in there too.
“What the hell is this? An invitation?”
It was a golden letter.
Hugo and Stevens were surprised when they saw the symbol engraved on the letter.
“No way! They sent you an invitation?”
“What? Who are they?”
Stevens answered, “World Capital Alliance.”
“!”
“You worked without taking any support funds, so you probably don’t know about them. However, they are the ones who became the line of capital for the Zodiac Saints in the past.”
“In other words, they are sponsors?”
“Yes. They still move the market of awakened beings. They are also the ones who called us Zodiac Saints in the beginning.”
In other words, they were an organization that provided funds for their own benefit.
“They are entangled with a lot of Zodiac Saints. They provided support in various ways to control the Zodiac Saints from behind the curtains. Of course, their influence diminished as the twelve Zodiac temples grew larger….”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed when he saw the odd look in their eyes. “Since I absorbed and eliminated the temples, are they making a move?”
“It seems as if you’re trying to merge all the temples into one. I believe they are trying to get on your good side.”
Hugo didn’t seem to have too bad of an opinion of them. “While Libra and Cancer tried to slander Gun’s honor, they rated Lee Gun highly for his achievements. I thought they were ok.”
Stevens laughed in derision. “Do you really think so?”
“!”
“Why do you think the Sagittarius temple never received any support money?”
“!?”
“They probably embezzled it from the middle. Moreover, how do you think the criminal Zodiac Saint Jean-Louis had such a long reach?”
“……!”
“I don’t like people interfering in my affairs, so I severed myself from them. They were probably the ones who provided the manpower and money to cover up the incident with your wife. Also, why do you think all the hospitals turned you down when you tried to hospitalize your wife? In the end, a new hospital had to be built within the Scorpio Saint’s holy ground.”
“!”
“Why do you think all the hospitals around the world declined to take her in?”
“Ahhhk!”
The enraged Hugo was about to run out, but someone stopped him.
“That’s not important right now, honey.”
“!”
The one to calm him down was Chun Jiwoo. She seemed to have found some information as a Secretary. She had come here to fetch her husband, and in turn, sought Lee Gun.
It looked like she had heard their conversation. Chun Jiwoo laughed. “Anyway, the organization that sent the invitation— Oohp!”
Did the smell of the chicken make her nauseous, or was she not feeling well? It looked like Chun Jiwoo was about to throw up.
Surprised, Hugo quickly grabbed his wife. “Are you ok? Are you feeling unwell? Hey! Go do something!”
Stevens was surprised, and he went to get a cup of water. Hugo looked at his wife with worry.
On the other hand, Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he looked at Chun Jiwoo. He smirked as if he had seen something. “I’ll have to prepare a present.”
“What???”
“It’s nothing.”
Chun Jiwoo spoke after drinking the water. “I believe the organization that sent the invitation has a deep connection to the Time monarch.”
“!!”
This meant the invitation might have been sent by Time.

chapters.title: Chapter 279
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: You want to do this? (3)
“Isn’t this too much?”
The Secretary cried her eyes out. Guisoon’s hands were covered in bandages, and countless papers lay stacked in front of her. These weren’t normal documents. They were all original texts taken out from Lee Gun’s bible.
“Ahhhk! My workload grew when that damn snake bastard started merging the temples! Damn it!”
She was in the Nameless Land, the old holy ground of the Serpent Bearer, which the Zodiacs had sold to the monarchs.
The situation was hectic as Guisoon edited the bible. The reason was the increase in the number of Serpent Bearer disciples through the mergers.
“Why is this bastard’s bible acting like a chat window? A line appears every second! This is crazy!”
Normally, only the outstanding disciples could leave behind a record in the bible. However, it seemed everyone could leave a record in the bible if their faith was over 100%.
Of course, higher faith meant the disciples could receive abilities directly from the Zodiac, and these abilities were outstanding. The requirements fit the bill. However, that wasn’t important right now.
[Psalm of Taylor has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
[Psalm of Chris has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
……
[Psalm of Izaya has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
[Psalm of Chun Jiwoo has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
After merging with the Taurus temple, Lee Gun had spoken to the Taurus disciples.
[If you cannot raise your Serpent Bearer faith to 100%, all the abilities that you’ve developed will disappear♡.]
To keep their abilities, the Taurus disciples had raised their faith to 100% as if they were mad. Moreover, those who were capable of doing that were A rank and above. They were a lot of excellent disciples. That was why…
[Psalm of Taylor (Poetry Inclination) has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
[Psalm of Chris (Recipe Inclination) has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
[Psalm of Daniel (Diary Inclination) has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
[Psalm of Chun Jiwoo (Novel Inclination) has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
…
[Psalm of Joel (Cartoon Inclination) has been added to the Serpent Bearer’s Bible.]
“Ahhk!! How the hell do I fix the form of the cartoon?”
Each of the disciples had a different inclination. When it came to the Chun siblings, they simply wrote praises. The others wrote poems, diaries, recipes, cartoons, etc. It was diverse.
However, whatever the form was, all of these inclinations praised Lee Gun, since these disciples possessed 100% faith.
Of course, some of them were fanatics, so a lot of twisted affections were there as well. Naturally, Guisoon couldn’t be at peace when she saw such records.
[Boo-ohhhhhh!!!]
The fountain pen stabbed her hand.
[The fountain pen asks what are you doing. It wants you to hurry up and get back to work!]
[It says the twisted fandom of the disciples may be directed toward its parent. It says to hurry up!]
“Ahhhk!! I’ll kill you! Serpent Bearer!”
Someone laughed at this sight. It was Lee Jaewon. “Lee Gun-nim knows you’re working hard. That’s why he made you that mansion. He gave you a reward.”
“Reward, my ass! He’s making sure I work without going out!”
When Lee Jaewon mockingly laughed, Guisoon looked at him with a haunted look in her eyes. “Why are you acting like this? You’re one of the perpetrators too.”
“What? Why me??”
Guisoon screamed when Lee Jaewon looked aggrieved. “You are part of the Sagittarius temple, yet a bible of yours formed with the Serpent Bearer! Lee Jaewon Bible. Moreover, it’s in comment form!”
“C-Comment?”
“Yes! What you create gets posted on the internet! Yours is more troublesome, since I can edit only when I erase the comments! Do you realize how many calls I have to make daily to erase them?”
“Uh… Still, you don’t have to fix much when it comes to me, right? There is no way I write fanatical texts like Yooha and Sungjae…”
“… What did you just say?”
Lee Jaewon cleared his throat when he saw the murderous look in the Secretary’s eyes. He started to sweat.
Guisoon raged. Of course, the most troublesome one was Hugo’s bible.
“It’s nuts with Hugo Otis. I get a new one every second! It has been produced at a record speed ever since he joined the Serpent Bearer temple! Take him back to the Sagittarius temple!!”
“I’m not sure Lee Gun-nim will allow it.”
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Did you finish investigating the weird corpses we found here?”
Guisoon furrowed her brows. Lee Gun had ordered them to investigate the mysterious corpses found in this place.
However, Chun Jiwoo had immediately identified them.
A couple of hours ago, Chun Jiwoo had brought her tools to this land, and she became very surprised when Guisoon showed her the corpses.
“My god! Only small amounts are left, but they are Zodiacs!”
“What?!”
“Moreover, the dead bodies of the Zodiacs changed into monsters.”
“What?! You were able to discern all of that at once?”
“Oh my! Before I was eaten by the toad, I was a scientist studying monsters and gods.”
“Ah… You were a research engineer at MIT. You were the one to make the missile that could take out the monsters.”
It was clear where Chun Sungjae had gotten his smarts.
When Lee Gun had disappeared, Chun Jiwoo and the scientists of humanity had wondered if there was any way that humanity could resist the monsters. That had led to Chun Jiwoo receiving data about the Zodiacs from Hugo, and she researched monsters.
When she had looked over the corpses, Chun Jiwoo said something unexpected, “That’s odd. One of the corpses contains data similar to the data of Sagittarius.”
“!”
“These really might be the corpses of the original owners…”
