Thinking about that conversation, Guisoon said to Lee Jaewon, “God-nim said he found the data of an original owner inside Oblivion.”
“!”
“I don’t know who it was amongst the thirteen of them, but Time used the body of a Zodiac to create Oblivion. He created a monster using it.”
“That means….”
“It’s said that getting rid of the corpses is the most difficult part. Even the usurpers would have had a hard time getting rid of the original owners’ corpses. They buried the corpses in this land and sold the land to the monarchs.”
Quick on the uptake, Jaewon bit his tongue. “You said these are only parts of the corpses, right?”
“What about it?”
“What if the other original owners were made into monsters like Oblivion? What if they exist somewhere around the world?”
“…!!”
Guisoon’s face turned pale. Oblivion was that powerful. What if other monsters of that caliber appeared…
“Earth will get razed to the ground.”
Guisoon bit her tongue when she heard Lee Jaewon’s words.
“Since these are only partial corpses, what if Time was the one to take them?”
“!”
“Anyway, I’m sure Time can turn gods into monsters.”
It meant Lee Gun might be turned into a monster if he got unlucky against Time. That might have been what the corpse-like monarch of Space-Time had talked about when Lee Gun had met it within the Devil’s Tower. It had told Lee Gun to come over to their side, which meant he should become a slave like Oblivion.
Moreover, Guisoon was able to check this through the records within the bible. “It would be great if God-nim never meets Time.”
Lee Jaewon laughed when he saw the Secretary’s anxious expression. “What’s going on? I thought you hated Lee Gun-nim. Do you like him already?”
The Secretary was surprised. Her face turned red as she lashed out. “Who would like a psychopath like him? Don’t get it twisted! I’m just trying to get close to him so that I can stab him in the back!”
“Ah! Is that so?”
“Also, I hate Time because he looks similar to the Cancer Saint!”
Guisoon clearly remembered who had tried to kill all the Secretaries. There was no way the Cancer Saint, the one in charge of the criminal temple, stayed away from the massacre. Guisoon still gnashed her teeth over it.
Lee Jaewon furrowed his brows. He remembered something Lee Gun had said.
“Right. I want you to keep it a secret that the Zodiacs slaughtered the Secretaries to bury their secret.”
“What? Why?”
“Nothing good would come out of her finding out why her family was slaughtered.”
“!”
Lee Gun had said he would be the one to take revenge for her.
Lee Jaewon laughed in a pleased manner.
‘He doesn’t act like it, but he is a kind person.’
“Oh yeah. What about Madam?”
“Miss Jiwoo? Ah! She went to tell God-nim about what we discovered here.”
Surprised, Lee Jaewon urgently moved. “My god! She’s eating for two, so why would she go alone?”
“What? What did you just say? Eating for two?”
“Yes. Hugo-nim will welcome the youngest member of his family. He doesn’t know about it yet.”
Guisoon screamed. “What? Youngest member? His kids are almost grown up?!”
“They always act like newlyweds.”
“Wow! He really is capable. Well, the kid’s siblings are all grown up, so they’ll help raise—” Guisoon screamed when she suddenly had a thought. “Prenatal care!!! I’ll do the prenatal care!!! Please tell them I’ll do it!!”
* * *
Around the same time, in Spain…
This place wasn’t that far from where his niece and nephew were. It was near the Virgo temple’s holy ground.
Lee Gun had immediately come here after receiving the invitation.
Since Spain was the holy ground of the Pisces temple, the entire city was a magic fortress. Buildings like skyscrapers pierced through the sky, and vehicles made out of magic traversed through the city.
It was like another world, and Lee Gun was invited to the palace of Madrid within the magic fortress.
“Welcome, Lee Gun-nim!”
“It’s Lee Gun!”
“Take a photo!”
“The Leo Saint and the Archer Saint are with him”
“No… Hugo-nim is with the Serpent Bearer temple now, right?”
The reporters were outside. It was as if they had been waiting for him.
The inside of the palace was full of people wearing suits. Most of them were familiar faces. They were from royal families from various countries and presidents of various companies.
They were people that Lee Gun had connections with from well before twenty years ago.
Soon, Lee Gun snorted.
‘It seems she’s the one who called me here.’
He could distinguish her amongst the crowd, the Pisces Saint Liv Rich. No, she was the Pisces.
So, he contemptuously asked, “Are you the one who sent me the invitation?”
The last remaining Zodiac laughed at the question. “No. I only lent this place out. This place is my holy ground. Also…” Pisces took out something. It was a necklace with a small glass embedded within it.
Hugo became flustered when he saw it. He flinched. He had felt the same energy inside the world of torture.
‘Is that Ms. Yeonwoo?’
Pisces laughed. “Weren’t you looking for this, Lee Gun?”
Lee Gun snorted. It was clearly Yeonwoo’s soul.
‘When I saw it on TV, I assumed it was a fake.’
As if to prove that this was real, something within Lee Gun’s pocket emitted light. It was the item left behind when Yeonwoo disappeared. It reacted to Yeonwoo and notified Lee Gun of her location.
Hugo glared at Pisces. “I thought Time had it. Why does a god have it?”
It didn’t matter who possessed it. The enraged Hugo tried to step forward, but Lee Gun stopped him with his foot.
“I want you to only support me. Let Leo take care of anything dangerous.”
“W-What?? This isn’t like you. What’s going on?”
Lee Gun was about to say something in response when he spotted someone.
‘…!!’
Amongst the people gathered here was a person who looked very similar to the Cancer Saint Jean-Louis. However, he was clearly a different person.
It was the Time monarch.

chapters.title: Chapter 280
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: You want to do this? (4)
Murderous intent appeared in Lee Gun’s eyes.
‘Time.’
The man opposite him looked to be in his twenties. If Jean-Louis was a dirty blonde, this one had light blonde hair.
On the outside, he looked like a normal human. In fact, he looked like a butler serving the rich people gathered here. However, Lee Gun was sure of it.
‘I felt it within the Devil’s Tower.’
In the basement of the broken tower, he had felt the energy of Time, when he had killed the monarch of Space-Time. Time was the owner of the tower. That wasn’t all.
‘He’s the one who tortured me in that tower.’
Of course, the actual torture and experimentation were carried out by a general of Time, but Lee Gun knew who was pulling the strings. This was why he could recognize Time no matter what appearance the latter had on.
As to prove this, his 13th Sense automatically activated, and he clearly saw it.
‘Monster.’
The color of light emanating from that man was clearly red. Moreover, there was a reason it was called a monarch. The wicked red light was shaped like an enormous monster.
Lee Gun gazed at the crowd with a menacing look in his eyes. The crowd, including Hugo and Stevens, was taken aback by his killing intent.
“What is wrong, Lee Gun-nim?”
“Gun?”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “Why is that bastard here?”
When Lee Gun accurately pointed out Time, Pisces smirked. The crowd looked to be in an awkward spot.
“Ah. I get why you’re angry, but please don’t get angry at him”
“Don’t get angry at him?”
They had a monarch in their midst. What nonsense was this?
“They look similar, but he’s Jean-Louis’s younger brother.”
“…??!”
Hugo and Steven were surprised.
“Jean-Louis’s younger brother?!”
It was something that they had never heard before, but they were surprised when they checked the man’s face. The man looked eerily similar to Jean-Louis. Their hair color and age differed, but they almost looked like the same person.
The crowd laughed in response.
“Ah. They are twin brothers. He has been a member of this society from the start, and he has been a patron to the temples.”
“He had no choice but to support even the criminal temple, but…”
“When he learned what his older brother did to Lee Gun-nim, he immediately cut the connection with him.”
“To pay for his older brother’s sins, he says he’ll actively support the Serpent Bearer temple…”
“What fucking nonsense!” Lee Gun immediately brought out Heaven’s Punishment.
“L-Lee Gun-nim?!”
“How dare a monster invade human territory?” Lee Gun disappeared and reappeared in front of Time.
Heaven’s Punishment ruthlessly sent Time’s head flying. Red blood erupted from the man’s neck, and the inside of the palace turned into a scene of chaos.
“Ahhhhhhk!”
“Valen-nim!”
As if she had been waiting for this moment, Pisces stood up. “Look! Lee Gun is the type of person to kill someone innocent!”
“!”
“Lee Gun doesn’t care about the safety of humans. I bet he’ll try to kill the last remaining Zodiac. When he gets rid of me, he’ll monopolize the Temple system!”
This caused a disturbance amongst the reporters.
“Send this news out!”
“Everyone stop!!”
Stevens’s shout almost burst their eardrums. The reporters clasped their ears. It was the Leo temple’s Roar skill.
“The one who doesn’t care about the safety of humans is— Kuhk!”
Stevens’s head was suddenly sent flying. A water monster had surged up from the floor and bitten his head off.
“Stevens!” The surprised Hugo quickly took out his bow.
Kwah-jeek!!!
“Huhk…!”
The water snake that had surged up from the floor pierced through Hugo’s heart.
Hugo vomited blood as he fell over. Angry at this sight, Lee Gun used Area of Effect Super Regeneration as he appeared in front of Pisces. “Son of a bitch!”
However…
“…!!!”
As soon as he met eyes with Pisces, he lost his power and fell over.
[Warning. The power of the original owner is being stolen.]
Lee Gun ground his teeth. He was barely able to prop himself up when he became surprised.
‘Super Regeneration is…’
The magical energy of the serpent wasn’t working against Hugo and Stevens. Stevens still had his head cut off, and Hugo’s body had lost enough blood to create a pool on the floor.
The smell of death brushed against him. Deathly pale, Lee Gun called out for Hugo. “Taeksoo!”
However, the fallen Hugo couldn’t answer back. At that moment, someone stepped on Lee Gun’s head.
Kwah-jeek!
It was Pisces. “You and your predecessor and the predecessors before that all died at my hands.”
“…!!” Lee Gun’s eyes shook.
At that moment…
Woosh!
“!!”
He was suddenly sent flying. At the same time, the blood spurting from Stevens’s neck went back into place, and his head was reattached. The fallen Hugo got back up again. It was as if time was flowing backward.
“Weren’t you looking for this, Lee Gun?”
“I thought Time had it. Why does a god have it?”
Lee Gun was surprised to hear the words of Hugo, who was next to him. When Lee Gun looked at his surroundings, he realized what had happened.
‘The time was rewound to the past.’
He had returned to the time when they had just entered the palace.
“Gun? What’s wrong?”
“!”
Lee Gun quickly turned his gaze at Hugo’s question. His gaze landed on the Time monarch, whom he had discovered earlier.
When he met eyes with him, Time laughed. At the same time, Lee Gun heard a voice.
[Did you see it?]
“…!”
[Do you still wish to decapitate me?]
Lee Gun was surprised, but Hugo looked at him as if something was off. “Gun? Why are you zoning out like that?”
“You can’t hear his voice?”
“Whose voice?”
“….”
It seemed only he could hear that voice. Time continued.
[What you saw right now is the future that’ll happen. You might have come here with high spirits, but all futures lead to the death of the Serpent Bearer. It doesn’t matter how much you struggle.]
“…!!”
[You cannot win against Pisces. You will die unless you can weaken the power of this Zodiac.]
Lee Gun laughed in contempt. It seemed Time had shown him one of the possible futures.
[Let’s make a deal. Do you want to die at Pisces’s hand, or would you like to join hands with me?]
Lee Gun snorted.
[Well? What will you do?]
Lee Gun grinned at those words.
* * *
While Lee Gun was meeting Time…
“We’ll aim for the bladder of Pisces.”
The Chun siblings were making plans to hit the Pisces temple. They arrived at the Alps, which was in northern Italy.
They didn’t know how long they could last against a Zodiac, but they knew Pisces had killed the previous Serpent Bearer.
‘Of course, she’ll be a danger to Uncle too.’
The original owners had died without being able to do anything. There was nothing that said Lee Gun couldn’t suffer the same fate. This was why they tried to come at this from a different angle.
It allowed them to come up with Operation Get Rid of Pisces’s bladder.
It was why they had come to the Alps; it contained a facility that was important to the Pisces temple.
‘Pisces’s greatest trap spell is placed here.’
‘If I had to make a comparison, this mountain is an enormous maze that traps intruders.’
Why was it placed in the Alps? It was right on the border of France, the territory of the Virgo temple. This was a place where the Pisces temple and the Virgo temple fought their contentious battles.
This was why Pisces had used the spirit of the mountain range to create an enormous trap spell.
Pisces drained the life energy of anyone trapped within the mountain. That had become a source of power for the Pisces temple. It was a terrifying prison.
‘If we don’t get caught by the trap, it’s a field full of food.’
The enormous maze was full of prisoners captured by the Pisces temple. These prisoners weren’t killed, just thrown in here on purpose. They were used as nourishment for Pisces. If this place were destroyed, it would deal a big blow to the Pisces temple.
That wasn’t all.
‘Since we acquired Oblivion and the Gemini temple’s Distortion ability, we can turn enemies into allies.’
They had come to this for multiple reasons.
“What business does the Serpent Bearer temple have here?”
That’s right. Someone from the Pisces temple had appeared in front of them. Moreover, she wasn’t a normal person.
‘Silvia.’
Silvia was Pisces’s right arm and also one of the Ten Stars, like Carly. She was an SS-rank magician. In recent times, she had been robbed by Lee Gun and also by Chun Yooha. She had been robbed in many ways. This was why she had raised her guard toward the Chun siblings.
“I’m speechless. Are you looking down on the Pisces temple so much that you brought these brats?”
“…!”
The Archer disciples were captured behind Silvia. They were the youngest disciples, and they were also fans of Lee Gun. The disciples were trapped in square water prisons, and it seemed they were in pain since they couldn’t breathe.
Chun Sungjae ground his teeth.
‘The reconnaissance team was caught.’
‘It seems the reconnaissance team was discovered first.’
The Chun siblings furrowed their brows as they looked at the captured Archer disciples.
‘To not get found out, we carried out a covert operation with the Virgo temple..’
Since they would be hitting the East of France, they had asked the Virgo temple to attack from the South of France toward Spain.
Since that place was a part of Pisces’s holy ground, they had expected all the troops to gather in that direction. Moreover, they had confirmed the location of their enemies using the skill of the Sagittarius temple.
‘What happened?’
Silvia laughed when Chun Sungjae glared at her. “It seems you guys are underestimating Pisces.”
“!”
“We already realized what you guys were up to. We were well prepared.”
“Who cares? It’s just Silvia.”
“!”
Carly’s eyes flashed as she unsheathed her sword. Her eyes looked like that of a savage tiger. The Chun siblings and Goat flinched when they felt the terrifying magical energy emanate from Carly.
“Don’t get cute with me, Silvia. Have you forgotten who’s the strongest amongst the Ten Stars?”
There was confidence in her voice. She was confident in her skills and her fighting spirit.
‘If we take care of the Alps, Lee Gun-nim will be able to fight against Pisces.’
Moreover, everyone here except Chun Sungjae and the captured disciples was one of the Ten Stars. The Ten Stars were the ten strongest humans, and they were aides of the Zodiac Saints.
Carly was ranked number one amongst them! She held a one-handed double-edged tsurugi, which emitted light.
It seemed she hadn’t received Lee Gun’s body data for nothing. In a flash, the blade headed toward Silvia.
Goat and Taylor, who were watching from the side, had to admit it. Silvia was ranked in the bottom half of the Ten Stars.
‘There is no way Silvia can win against Carly.’
‘It’s game over now that Carly revealed herself…’
However…
“Hmmph.”
Blood splashed into the air as Silvia laughed.
“Carly!”
The one to bleed was Carly. It was her cheek. Moreover, her own blade had caused the wound on her cheek.
Carly looked taken aback as she looked at her broken blade.
“Now that I’ve destroyed your weapon, your head is next!” Silvia’s eyes flashed as she activated her spell. Her eyes changed into demon eyes as they let out an unimaginable beam of light.
“Koo-oohk!”
Carly quickly dodged, but it seemed she was still flustered by her blade being broken.
This time, Taylor expressed his surprise.
“Carly’s sword is a royal holy item! It isn’t something Silvia should be able to break— Koo-oohk!”
The blue beam of light ruthlessly flew toward them. At the same time, they had a realization.
“That’s the power of a monarch!”
They were sure of it. The power of the monarch could be felt within the magical energy of Silvia.
‘How can this be?’
While everyone was shocked, Silvia laughed. She had the eyes of a monster.
“You guys always act high and mighty. You guys always treat me like an idiot. However, you guys and the Serpent Bearer temple will come to an end. Our Zodiac will activate that spell to get rid of the Serpent Bearer!”
“That spell?”
“Yes. It’s the spell that killed the Serpent Bearer in the past! It’s the spell that killed the original owners!”
“!”
Chun Yooha immediately called out to her brother. “Sungjae!”
This meant he should quickly use the Return skill to reach Lee Gun.
“I guess it’s proper decorum toward a god to get rid of the Zodiac Saints before the Zodiac, right?”
Silvia emanated black magical energy, and a terrifying beam of light flew toward them.
“…!”
Chun Sungjae quickly used his defensive ability. Chun Yooha and Carly used the speed of light skill to stab Silvia.
The two of them had the absolute defense ability around them. They would be able to ignore the attack to charge forward.
‘The ability of the Taurus was acquired to defend against the magical powers.’
A magical attack could be blocked using the defensive ability that their uncle had evolved! The eyes of the two fighting demons flashed as they charged Silvia.
[Time flows backward.]
“…?!!!”
As Silvia laughed, the skill that they had used disappeared. The power of Time had reverted them to the point where they were about to activate their abilities.
Chun Sungjae, who had used the defensive ability, turned deathly pale.
‘No!’
He and the two women were truly defenseless at that moment!
“Shit…!”
The magic attack arrived right in front of them. They were about to clench their eyes shut when…
[Time Restoration]
“!!!”
A magic circle appeared on the floor, and something odd happened. The defensive ability that had disappeared returned, and the beam of light was unable to pierce through Chun Yooha and Carly. They were deflected.
It happened in a split second, and Chun Sungjae let out a sigh of relief. They immediately realized who had saved them.
“Hailey-nim…!”
Silvia looked back in surprise. It was as Chun Sungjae said. A black-haired beauty wearing black clothes was standing there.
Silvia flinched when she felt the cold killing intent from the woman.
Hailey’s terrifying monster eyes met Silvia’s eyes. “Kneel.”
Boom!
Hearing the voice, Silvia fell to her knees without realizing it.

chapters.title: Chapter 281
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: You want to do this? (5)
“Kneel.”
Boom!
Hearing the voice, Silvia fell to her knees without realizing it.
Cold sweat appeared on her back. She didn’t plan on getting on her knees. However, the look in Hailey’s eyes and the sound of her voice were overwhelming. There was no way Silvia could stay standing upright.
It was also why she was flustered more than ever before.
‘There is no way I should feel fear no matter who it is…!’
Gnashing her teeth, she tried to get to her feet.
“Your ability to learn is completely lacking.”
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Hailey’s presence and spirit were overwhelming, and it made Silvia unconsciously lower her head. She felt as if a giant was pressing down on her from above, making her tremble.
‘This is crazy!’
Of course, Hailey hadn’t done anything. It was simply the spirit of the magical energy, but it wasn’t normal magical energy.
‘Monarch rank…!’
Silvia was barely able to raise her head to check.
Hailey was emanating menacing magical energy. Of course, other humans’ eyes couldn’t pick it up, but Silvia had borrowed a small amount of power from the monsters. It was different for her.
After acquiring the power, Silvia considered herself to be in the Saint rank.
‘What the hell…! That woman….’
Monsters felt overwhelming fear when faced with beings above their rank. They were much more sensitive than wild animals. Therefore, Silvia borrowing the power of the monsters had turned against her.
Silvia could feel Hailey’s power more vividly, and it made her body shake. Her head dipped lower.
On the other hand, Hailey looked pissed off. “How can you use that power?”
“!”
Silvia had just used the power of Time. This pointed to only one thing.
‘Time is directly involved now.’
Until now, Time was a wanderer who merely roamed around. So why now?
Moreover, he was oddly obsessed with the Serpent Bearer, the thirteenth seat. Of course, it was only recently that Hailey had learned Time was obsessed with the Serpent Bearer from a long time ago.
‘I found out about it when Lee Gun asked me to investigate the regenerated Devil’s Tower.’
She had realized it when she looked at the records left by the Tower’s admin. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘Lee Gun is in danger.’
Hailey’s eyes turned fierce as she asked, “Speak. Who gave you that power?”
The tormented Silvia grinned. “Really? You’re the leader of the temple of thieves. It seems you used your trifling abilities to steal and use the power of the unknown civilization.”
“!”
“Of course, I have a countermeasure to deal with you.”
Then…
Flash!
As a light flashed, Silvia’s magical energy suddenly underwent a violent amplification.
Kwahng!
“Hailey-nim!”
The Ten Stars were taken aback by this power. Silvia’s power was on a different level than before!
“What the hell is that power? Koohk!”
“Her magical energy has amplified!”
At this point, Silvia’s power had reached the Saint rank! They were having a hard time accepting it.
‘How does she have so much power? It isn’t as if her Zodiac has descended!’
They didn’t even have the time to be surprised. Enormous fishes surged up from the ground.
“Huhk!”
A transparent fish swallowed Hailey, and something surprising happened.
“Hailey-nim!”
After the transparent fish swallowed her, Hailey returned to being her younger self.
[A Frog cannot remember when it was a tadpole!]
It was a skill that turned back the time of its target’s body. Hailey’s age had been reverted to a time before she had made a contract with Scorpio. She couldn’t use any of her skills.
“Ha ha ha! One is out with this!”
The transparent fishes then attacked the other Ten Stars, and they were rapid.
“Noona! Goat!”
In a flash, everyone turned into children. One was five years old, and the other was eight. Chun Sungjae activated his magic, but the power of Time was tricky. Sungjae had turned into a three-year-old child.
“Ahhhk!”
They had returned to an age before Sungjae had become a disciple of the Serpent Bearer. They had become normal humans.
As if to make things worse, Chun Sungjae turned even younger. He turned into a baby.
“Ssung-jjae!”
“Ah-boo!!”
The now six-year-old Chun Yooha quickly hugged her baby brother in her arms.
“You!”
Silvia laughed as if they deserved it. The almighty Ten Stars and Zodiac Saints had turned into babies, and they were crying. She loved it.
“You guys always show off, yet you can’t use your abilities now, right? Don’t worry! I’ll put you guys in the Alps. You’ll cry out for your mother and father. You will ask for food as you starve to death.”
Suddenly…
“Kyahhhhhk!!!”
Black flames surged upward from Silvia’s body. Those trapped by the flames moved under the table.
Silvia’s screams rang everywhere!
“Ahhhhhhk!”
The fierce flames sloughed off her skin. After the skin was taken off, the fan started to melt. The shocked Silvia shouted, “Who did it?”
It wasn’t the arrow of the Sagittarius temple. The only ones capable of using a fire of this caliber were Taylor, who was a master craftsman, and Chun Sungjae. However, both of them were powerless right now. Moreover, Hailey, the biggest dark horse, was incapable of using her power too.
‘So what had happened…!’
“Foolish! Of all the time you could pick, you rewound it to this point.”
“…!”
Silvia became frightened when she turned her head. The one letting out the blackish-red fire was none other than Hailey.
That wasn’t all. When Hailey made a hand gesture, her three-year-old self turned into her eight-year-old self.
Silvia was gripped with fear.
‘What the hell? I thought she would have no power once she lost the power of Scorpio?!’
Hailey had signed a contract with her Zodiac in her late teens. She shouldn’t be able to use the power of her Zodiac during her early childhood!
‘How is she using that power?’
The eyes of the young Hailey flashed as if she was mocking Silvia. “I never told you this before.”
“…!”
“During my childhood, I was the thirteenth knight of the monarchs. I was the general for the Red Monarch.”
“?!!”
Yes. The blackish-red flames surrounding Hailey were her original power. She had been skilled enough to become the general of a monarch at a young age. Of course, she had been ostracized despite that and called the gutter rat princess during her childhood.
Hailey had gone to battlefields without even knowing why she was doing so. This was why she didn’t have many memories that she remembered from that time. Of course, this had nothing to do with the invasion by the unknown civilization.
Hailey’s flame powers had been sealed when Time had killed her mother, the Red Monarch. Time had sealed her power and said.
– That’ll only get in my way. Use my power.
No one had been able to release that seal because of the commandment of Time. Even Hailey couldn’t.
When Giselle recognized Hailey, she had mockingly laughed.
– Oh my! Your power is so weak that I didn’t realize you were the bloody princess.
And of all the time to send her back to, Silvia had sent her back to a time before her power was sealed.
“You merely acquired a single speck in the dust of time, yet you’re acting like a god.”
As soon as Hailey spoke, Silvia screamed.
The blackish-red flame burned Silvia’s eyes. “Ahhhk!! My eyes!!!”
“Still, you were quite handy in using that power against Lee Gun’s disciples.”
“Ahhhk!”
The flame encircled Silvia. Everyone screamed when they saw the flame.
Accompanying the screams, Silvia vomited blood as she fell to the ground. “Ahhk, ahhhk! Help me! Super Regeneration! Use Super Regeneration on me!”
Silvia’s hands floundered as she desperately reached out to the Chun siblings.
However, the baby Chun Sungjae threw a shot glass as if to tell her to buzz off. “Ah-booboo! Boo-boo-boo!! (Hurry up and return me to normal!) Ah-baba-boo-boo! (I cannot even be a fanboy of Uncle like this!)”
In the first place, he couldn’t accept something.
‘How is her life force so tenacious?’
Did it have to do with her magical energy being amplified to the Saint rank?
‘What is the principle behind it?’
However, that question was soon answered. The phone in Sungjae’s pocket started ringing. Sungjae used his sausage-like fingers to check who it was. He immediately answered it.
– Ahhhk! Sungjae! This is bad!
“Ahh-boob-boo (Jimin)??”
It was Hahn Jimin, Sungjae’s roommate. He had been sent on reconnaissance with the Archer disciples. Despite being a C-rank awakened being, Jimin had shown signs of growth. Moreover, he was highly skilled in reading magical energy.
He was the first one to realize the unique smell of a god from Sungjae’s uncle. This was why he had been sent along on the mission. Sungjae had thought Jimin would be of help to them.
“Ah-ooh-boo-boo-boo-bboo-ah?! (What’s wrong? What’s going on?)”
– Sungjae? Is anyone there? I was able to enter the Alps maze! Something is here! It might be a monarch—
– I’ll tear you apart, Lee Gun!
– Ahhhk!
“Ah-booo(Jimin)!!!”
Chun Yooha furrowed her brows.
“I don’t know who it is, but a monarch was trapped within the Alps. The Pisces is draining its power.”
“If we don’t take care of that, Uncle will…”
“!”
At that moment, the royal holy items in Chun Sungjae’s and Chun Yooha’s possessions whined as they lost power, surprising the Chun siblings.
“Ah-boo-boob-boo-boo!!! (Something happened to Uncle!)”
Chun Sungjae wailed as he hit the floor with his hands.
When Goat checked his phone, an article shocked him.
“It’s the Pisces! Lee Gun-nim is already meeting Pisces in Spain.”
It seemed they had to hurry up and cut off the bladder of the Pisces.
“Ah-boo-boo! Ooh-boo-boo-boo-boo!!! (What should we do? Teleportation isn’t working. Also, it is too late to go to the Alps!)”
Silvia, who had been burned into ashes, read their confusion. She trembled as she spoke. “L-Lee Gun is destined to die at the hands of our Zodiac. Our Zodiac… If Pisces can steal and return with Lee Gun’s Super Regeneration ability… I… Kuhk!!”
Hailey pierced Silvia’s body. She then said to Sungjae, “It will be fine. You acquired the Possession ability from the Gemini.”
“!”
The Gemini temple was capable of handling souls.
All the magic-related abilities that Lee Gun had acquired by endlessly beating up Frey had been given to Sungjae. It was for temporary use until Lee Gun could grind up Gemini to make a holy item.
Anyway, one of the abilities that he had received at that time was Possession. Of course, the Gemini Saint had used it to possess a figurine, and she had suffered for doing so.
“If you possess your friend, you can deal with the monarch within the Alps.”
It would allow them to cut off the power of Pisces, who was using Neglect’s (Giselle) power. That wasn’t all.
“If it’s you, you can redirect the magical flow from Pisces to Lee Gun.”
“!”
Hailey then took out small gem crystals from her body.
[Crystals holding the power of Time!]
“Take one each. It’s the power lent out to the Ten Star by Pisces. It’ll be pivotal when facing off against Time.”
The power of the crystal returned everyone to their original form. This impressed everyone.
“Wow! This is very effective!”
“With this, we can make Uncle’s old items back into new!”
Chun Yooha slapped her brother. “When are you going to grow up? By the look of how much power is left within it, it can be used only a couple dozen times. It won’t last long. Just use it for defense.”
At that moment, staring at the holy item, Taylor spoke up. “Won’t we be able to see Lee Gun-nim in his childhood with this?”
Everyone became silent at once.
Then, Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed as he used the Possession magic. The look in the others’ eyes had also changed as they quickly headed toward the Alps.
* * *
Around that time…
[Let’s make a deal. Do you want to die at Pisces’s hands, or would you like to join hands with me?]
Lee Gun snorted at the Time’s words.
[Well? What will you do?]
Lee Gun grinned at those words. “Fuck off!”
[!]
The eyes of Stevens and Hugo turned round when Lee Gun spoke beside them. They thought he was talking to himself.
On the other hand, Time laughed at the unexpected answer.
[You are turning me down?]
Lee Gun let out a mocking laugh in contempt. Then he glared at Time. “I said fuck off. In the first place, how can I trust your words?”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
‘That was the future? There is no way what you showed me is the true future. It isn’t set in stone.’
To coax Lee Gun, Time might have shown him a fake future. This made Time laugh.
[Yes. Your future has only death. I wish you luck in escaping it.]
Lee Gun could no longer hear Time’s voice.
“Do you not hear what I’m saying?”
“!”
Pisces laughed as she shook the necklace that seemed to contain Yeonwoo’s soul. “I’ll say this. This isn’t a fake.”
Time had handed her the item. Pisces inwardly laughed.
‘Hurry up and attack me.’
Amongst the thirteen, Lee Gun had the worst temper. It wouldn’t be strange to see Lee Gun immediately charge at her. With his personality, Lee Gun would try to decapitate her.
At that point, Pisces would bring false charges on Lee Gun, and she would kill them all. She let out a triumphant laugh as she had that thought.
“?!”
However, Pisces couldn’t believe her eyes when she saw Lee Gun.

chapters.title: Chapter 282
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: You want to do this? (6)
Nicknamed the master of the Deep Sea, Pisces was well aware of what kind of person Lee Gun was. Moreover, she knew how bad and eccentric Lee Gun’s personality was. That was why Lee Gun had become the main target of her interest.
‘He has no patience. He’s like a beast that follows his instincts.’
If something pissed him off or if something of his got damaged, Lee Gun didn’t think about the consequences. He would go on a rampage. The man was so self-willed that he had caused a lot of trouble in the past.
‘On the other hand, that makes him easier to anticipate.’
That was why Pisces had been sure the same thing would happen this time.
‘If I provoke him, he will definitely cross that line.’
Lee Gun was someone who didn’t care about anything unrelated to him. It was almost terrifying. However, when it came to something he treasured or his mood being soured, Lee Gun never compromised.
Therefore, Pisces started with the media and used Yeonwoo’s soul. She went low by slandering Lee Gun. The Zodiac had used everything that would get on Lee Gun’s nerves.
The reasons behind the provocation were simple. First, Pisces wanted to shake the faith of those around Lee Gun.
‘The more the gods are worshiped, the more they get stronger.’
Lee Gun was still a baby god, so he wasn’t much of a threat even if he was worshiped. Still, there was no reason to let the situation be. So Pisces had undercut Lee Gun’s image.
Second, for Pisces’s plan to succeed, a necessary condition had to be fulfilled. This was why she had used the media for the low blow. It would make Lee Gun gnash his teeth.
On top of that, she had shown Lee Gun Yeonwoo’s soul, which would make him lose his mind. His foul temper would make him run amok with Heaven’s Punishment in hand.
Yes, he was supposed to run wild.
“?!”
However, Pisces couldn’t believe her eyes.
“G-Gun?!!”
Lee Gun got on his knee and let out an innocent laugh. In fact, he didn’t even take out Heaven’s Punishment. Holding his arms wide open, he said, “Beloved Zodiac-nim! I finally came here to become an affiliate under Pisces!”
“…??!!”
Hugo and Stevens froze. Stevens quickly whispered to Hugo, “Hey, what the hell is this? This was the plan?”
“I… I have no idea!”
As for Pisces, she glared at Lee Gun. “What’s your motive for doing this?”
Pisces was flustered, but she didn’t know any outward signs. She just raised her guard. Obviously, this was a ploy concocted by Lee Gun.
‘He’s trying to lull me into letting down my guard before attacking me! Do you think I don’t know that?’
Heaven’s Punishment still being with him was proof of this.
Boom!
As if he had read her thoughts, Lee Gun threw away Heaven’s Punishment into the distance.
“That’s a disappointment. You really have no thoughts of fighting?”
“?!”
The most surprised person was Stevens.
“Hey! Have you lost your mind? We are inside the territory of a Zodiac of Magic!”
Pisces was one of the Zodiacs of Magic. Since the Zodiacs of Magic moved in a calculated manner, there was no way this place was ordinary.
So Lee Gun throwing away his weapon meant he was defenseless, and there was no way Lee Gun was unaware of this.
Lee Gun seemed unperturbed as he let out a bright laugh. “If you have a hard time trusting me, you should take it. I’ll stay put here.”
“???!”
Stevens was taken aback. He quickly tried to retrieve Heaven’s Punishment, since he knew what kind of weapon it was!
‘It’s a unique treasure!’
However, Lee Gun stopped him. He held back the appalled Stevens.
“Have you lost your mind?”
Above all else, there was no fail-safe installed on Heaven’s Punishment.
“Do you realize what kind of Zodiac Pisces is? She’ll take it immediately—” Stevens’s eyes suddenly turned round as he looked at Pisces.
‘!’
The reaction was normal, since Pisces hadn’t moved at all.
‘Why is she acting like this???’
Pisces was confused at this moment.
‘This makes no sense. There is no way he would act this way, considering his temper.’
Pisces knew Lee Gun treasured Yeonwoo. Moreover, she knew about Lee Gun’s anger toward Jean-Louis.
It was why she had called in Time, who looked exactly like Jean-Louis. Pisces had planned on making Lee Gun flip his lid. So him not attacking her with Heaven’s Punishment was odd.
Nevertheless, Pisces laughed.
‘Yes. This is part of his plan.’
There was no way Lee Gun would hand over his weapon. That meant…
‘Heaven’s Punishment has a trap placed on it.’
It was obvious. This was the reason for her laugh. Still, Pisces was in an awkward position.
‘This is a problem. I can’t use the skill I prepared if he acts this way.’
Pisces had provoked Lee Gun in various manners, all to push Lee Gun into a trap. However, the main catalyst was Lee Gun’s anger, which was the precondition to her plan. Why?
‘Anger is the precondition needed to activate the skill that killed the original owners.’
Of course, Pisces could use this skill even in this situation, but the skill was most effective when the target was enraged. This put her in a bind for several reasons.
Pisces laughed. “You don’t need to act. It’s useless. Do you think I’m unaware of your dirty plan?”
“!”
Pisces knew Lee Gun very well.
‘You won’t be able to keep this nonsense up for long.’
Lee Gun was very loyal to his feelings.
‘He doesn’t have much patience.’
Therefore, Pisces spoke about something that would piss off Lee Gun the most. “Was it Junwoo?”
“!”
“He was your brother, right?”
Lee Gun was silent, but the mood around him suddenly changed.
Pisces laughed. Seeing Lee Gun’s reaction, she knew she had succeeded.
The words also caused a disturbance amongst the reporters.
“Brother? Did she just say Lee Gun’s brother?”
No one in the world knew about Lee Gun’s familial relationships. Since the person in question was Lee Gun, everyone was interested in his past. However, Lee Gun had never spoken about his past before his awakening.
The reporters became excited since this was a special scoop everyone wanted to know about.
Pisces continued, “His death was quite brutal. His limbs were cut away, and he lost one of his eyes. It truly was an unfortunate death.”
Lee Gun was silent. That incident had happened at a time when there were no domes. Several hundred humans were rounded up and killed each day.
The articles around that time didn’t even contain Junwoo’s name, let alone the state in which he was found. Yet Pisces knew the intricate details. Lee Gun knew what this meant.
<I killed your little brother.>
Pisces revealed the truth. It seemed Lee Gun’s mood had changed as his head remained lowered.
Pisces smirked at this sight.
‘Rage! Come! Try and kill me!’
“Uh, uh???”
Suddenly, a commotion broke out when the reporters looked at Lee Gun. Confused by these reactions, Hugo and Stevens turned to look at Lee Gun. When they saw him, they were so surprised that they almost fainted.
“G-Gun?!”
“That’s right. My little brother died.” Lee Gun was crying. He shed large drops of tears, looking very sad. “My little brother was murdered by the monsters. I know what it’s like to lose a family member. I didn’t want people to suffer the same fate as my little brother. This is why I did my best to kill the monsters, and I even took down Red Eye.”
“…!”
“In return, I was betrayed by my comrades. My honor was stolen. Now, I’m falsely accused of killing the Zodiacs…!”
The palace erupted in a ruckus when people heard Lee Gun’s tear-filled voice. It was to be expected.
“L…Lee Gun is…!”
“The Lee Gun that laughs in joy when he rips apart the flesh of monsters… That Lee Gun is…!”
Moreover, Lee Gun looked like a young man in high school. Of course, people felt more pity when a child was in pain.
On the other hand, Pisces was having a mental breakdown.
‘Tears? That bastard is crying??? He’s someone who doesn’t shed even one drop of blood even if he gets stabbed, yet he’s crying??’
Of course, Pisces wasn’t the only one.
“Doctor!!!!! N-No! Get me some tissues!” Hugo was also having a mental breakdown from seeing something he had never seen before.
Stevens had turned deathly pale too.
‘No way!’
They were Zodiac Saints. Their senses were developed to the extreme. They could tell if someone was acting or not. So they immediately knew Lee Gun wasn’t fake crying. So what were they witnessing…!
‘What the hell? At the end of the day, Lee Gun is human?’
Despite that thought, Stevens soon shook his head from side to side.
‘No. It’s the mighty Lee Gun. This is a trick…’
As if he were putting on the final touch, Lee Gun leaned against Hugo while crying.
In the end, the 600%-faith disciple showed a killing intent he had never emanated before. “You want to die! How dare you make him cry!! He’s the hero who took down Red Eye for humanity, so how can you treat him as if he is leftover rice?”
Hugo raged as if he had witnessed his son crying. It caused a commotion amongst the reporters.
“What the hell is going on?”
“Pisces said Lee Gun misbehaved, but…”
If one thought about Lee Gun’s normal image, Pisces’s assertion seemed plausible. Whenever Lee Gun saw monsters, he charged them with glee. This was why people expressed worry about him.
In truth, a lot of awakened beings took the wrong road and misbehaved.
“A person like that is trying to endanger humanity?”
“Wow! Lee Gun is human after all.”
“N-No way. Isn’t he acting like he’s crying?”
“Hey! If that’s acting, Lee Gun should change his profession!”
Even the people gathered within the palace were confused and shocked. In fact, Pisces had gathered all of them here because she was sure Lee Gun would attack her.
Even the reporters recording the scene in hiding looked at Pisces. This made Pisces urgently look at Time.
‘You never told me about this future!’
“What the hell? Are they bullying Lee Gun-nim right now?”
In contrast to the large commotion within the palace, one person was laughing.
‘Thankfully, the holy item made with Gemini was useful.’
Lee Gun was inwardly laughing. Although he hadn’t expected what Pisces had planned, he had realized that the Zodiac was purposefully trying to provoke him.
‘She does know about my crazy personality.’
So Lee Gun had brought an item as a contingency.
[Emotion Dial (S)]
– Manufacturer: Lee Gun
– Gemini’s magic data (Emotion Change Magic) has been imbued to make this item
– Depending on the dial button, you can control the emotions of your target.
Lee Gun had originally created this item to use it on the nagging Hugo. He had never expected to use it on himself.
‘I didn’t know I was capable of crying.’
No matter how sad he was or how much he was beaten up, Lee Gun was incapable of shedding tears.
‘I don’t know if Time showed me a true future, but I can’t let Pisces do as she likes.’
Lee Gun continued as he cried, “Anyway, I did my best to make sure no one would suffer the same fate as my little brother.”
“Yes, yes. Our Gun did his best.”
“Moreover, Pisces was the one who told me I’ll be able to defeat the unknown civilization if I possess the Seats of power of the other Zodiacs. You are the god of the Niles, right?”
“…!”
At that moment, Stevens and Pisces flinched.
‘That bastard…’
Lee Gun looked aggrieved, as if he had been betrayed. He looked at Pisces. “You said that it will allow me to get rid of the monarchs, right?”
“Wait a—”
“So why are you being like this to me? Are you killing the dog after the hunt? Are you going to ruthlessly throw me away like you killed the other Pisces Zodiac and Pisces Saint?”
These words caused an uproar around him.
“She killed a Zodiac and a Zodiac Saint?”
“What’s he talking about?”
Pisces ground her teeth.
‘Faith is falling.’
It couldn’t be helped. At this rate, her plan would be ruined too.
‘Although I can’t satisfy the precondition, I can still use the skill.’
Pisces was thinking about the skill that had killed the original owners. She immediately activated the skill.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if he had been waiting for this.

chapters.title: Chapter 283
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Let’s Do This (1)
A very long time ago…
[What did you say, you shameless bastard?]
[Get out of our sight right now!]
[You’re just a lowly slave with no divine status! Is this what your masters taught you?]
The current twelve Zodiacs were nameless servants at that point, serving the Creation tribe.
However, the being who later became the current Pisces had been ambitious. Its ambition was its desire to possess the Seats of power. She longed for the thrones possessed by their masters.
‘If we have that, we’ll be able to possess Divine status.’
Their masters, the Creation tribe, were the elites of the Divine world. Possessing a high reputation for being heroes, they were gods with abilities to back that reputation.
But Pisces thought differently.
‘Abilities? No, the Seats of power are the ones imbuing our masters with powerful abilities.’
If they, the servants, received the same powers, they would be able to enjoy the same reputation.
In truth, Pisces had learned magic from the original owners, and her skills were said to be excellent. In fact, some even thought that she was better than her master.
So, she came up with the plot for usurpation. The plan was simple.
[You know how to kill the gods, right?]
At the time, Mimir was a Construct for some god. Mimir later became Gemini’s fairy, but it had always been known for its wisdom. It had used the research notes left by its owner as a foundation and mixed the power of the monarchs to create a variety of spells.
One of the fourteen spells it had created made the twelve original owners sick. The last spell was the Thirteenth Killer.
‘The thirteenth Zodiac was the strongest and most special amongst the thirteen original owners.’
Its abilities and talent were the most striking. Unlike Lee Gun, it wasn’t a fighter. However, it had been the strongest amongst the original owners.
‘It was powerful enough for the other twelve original owners to be guarded against the thirteenth.’
The only god to have stood up for the thirteenth was its older brother, Sagittarius.
‘Since the original thirteenth had a screw loose, it didn’t seem to have a good relationship with its older brother.’
Anyway, the Thirteenth Killer spell was used to kill the thirteenth original owner, who they considered the most troublesome. Of course, the one to directly kill the thirteenth was Virgo.
‘We used that skill to steal their abilities beforehand. It was why we were able to end their lives.’
Since the thirteenth had been so strong, the servants had assumed the plan would fail. However, they became sure of it when the plan was successful.
‘As expected, they weren’t great at all!’
What about Yeonwoo and Junwoo, who had succeeded the thirteenth original owner?
All the thirteenth Zodiacs helplessly died under Pisces’s feet when she used Thirteenth Killer. It served them right.
‘That skill is the strongest skill.’
This was the reason for Pisces’s confidence.
‘Lee Gun. Your awakening as the thirteenth Zodiac will be your downfall.’
On top of having that skill, Pisces was the goddess of magic. She had stolen the power of her master, who even possessed the power of Ra. There was no way a rookie like Lee Gun could use his power against Pisces’s divine status, which had cemented its accomplishments.
In the present…
“My god! Lee Gun-nim also possessed the same pain as us.”
“We never knew….”
“Poor guy…”
Even the high-rank disciples gathered in this place were falling for him.
It made Pisces angry, and she activated her magic toward Lee Gun. Of course, Lee Gun being the son of the thirteenth original owner was shocking, but it didn’t matter at that moment.
“You are the same as the previous generations, who were called the Gods of Calamity!”
Pisces extended her hand, instantly summoning something inside it. The object looked like a small urn.
[First Canopic Urn]
It looked like an urn with an animal head as a cover. It was like an urn that one placed innards inside at an Egyptian funeral ritual.
This urn indeed had organs inside it, but no one knew whose innards they were, not even Pisces’s Constructs.
In the end, the urn flashed as blue light surged forward. The marble floors of the palace undulated as enormous fishes surged upward.
“Ahhk!”
“Pisces made the first move!”
“Does that mean Pisces framed Lee Gun?”
Pisces shouted in contempt when she heard the reporters’ shouts. “Do not be fooled!”
“!”
“His crying is all an act! Do not be fooled by such a cheap trick!”
Finally, the water shaped like fish flew toward Lee Gun.
“Gun!”
It wasn’t a normal spell. This was one of the fourteen special spells, called Against God’s Will (Disobey Will of Heaven), which was created by Pisces.
[First Canopic Urn]
<Destroy All Equipment>
‘I have to get rid of all his skills and holy items first.’
Lee Gun wasn’t someone capable of crying through acting in the first place. While he could dupe civilians, he couldn’t dupe awakened beings. This led to only one answer.
‘He’s most definitely using Gemini’s power!’
Pisces had to strip him of the abominable magic.
When the First Canopic Urn flashed, Lee Gun flinched. Then…
Kwah-jeek!!
Bbah-gahk!
Kwah-jee-jeek!
Screams started coming from various locations.
“Ahhk! My protection skills!”
“My holy item!”
All the protection skills and holy items within the palace were destroyed.
“My scapular and royal holy item!” Stevens screamed.
Their items weren’t the only things destroyed.
Kwah-jeek!
“…!”
It seemed the magic had been potent. Lee Gun’s Emotion Dial (S) was destroyed within his pocket.
As soon as the holy item’s power was severed, Lee Gun’s tears dried up.
‘Oh no.’
That wasn’t all. Rage instantly started to boil up within Lee Gun.
When Lee Gun glared at her, Pisces laughed. “Yes. I know it was fake tears. You were acting.”
Those words caused a commotion amongst the crowd, and people tried to check Lee Gun to see if it was true.
In the end, the pissed-off Lee Gun was about to reflexively raise his hand to call Heaven’s Punishment.
Pisces thought the enraged Lee Gun would charge her.
[Thirteenth Canopic Urn]
She summoned a different urn, and Lee Gun flinched when it started emitting light.
“!!”
It was to be expected.
[Thirteenth Canopic Urn]
<Thirteenth Killer>
“…!”
Lee Gun didn’t know what the skill was, but he instinctively realized he shouldn’t approach Pisces.
‘I’ll die if I get close.’
Suddenly, the future Time showed him brushed through his mind. He had felt the same energy at that time.
When the Sadness magic was released, Lee Gun had unconsciously put on a villainous expression on his face.
“H-Huhkk! L-Lee Gun-nim! Were you really acting?”
“W…Was the Pisces right…!”
“?!”
Lee Gun flinched. As a temporary solution, he hugged Hugo. It looked like he was weeping as he buried his head against his friend, lamenting. “Hey, Taeksoo. It seems no one believes me, no matter what I say…!”
The weeping(?) caused murderous intent to appear in the eyes of the 600%-faith disciple.
“Really!!! Bastards!!!”
For the first time in his life, Hugo had witnessed Lee Gun be sad, which had shocked him. Moreover, the rage of the 600%-faith disciple was unexpectedly very effective.
[Because his Zodiac has been insulted, Disciple Hugo Otis feels an unbridled rage]
[The Rage buff has been placed on the disciple.]
[The Rage buff increases according to the value of the faith (600%).]
[Attack has increased as much as the faith (600%).]
[Berserk skill has been created within the Serpent Bearer temple.]
With the incredible buff boosting him, Hugo summoned the Bow made out of Fish (EX).
This surprised Stevens. “Why is his bow intact!?”
It seemed being EX-rank had allowed the weapon to survive the equipment-destruction magic.
Despite this development, Pisces laughed.
‘He won’t be able to use his skill.’
A normal attack with no skills backing it couldn’t deal critical damage to her.
“Who told you to torment Gun?”
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“?!”
Hugo’s arrows razed the palace to the ground. Moreover, the attacks were powerful enough to threaten the Zodiac.
“Ahhhk! W-Wait a moment! Ahk!”
Was it because of the rage buff increasing his attack power? Despite the attack being a normal one, it had the destructive power of a skill!
Pisces was taken aback by the incredible destructive power, and Lee Gun looked very satisfied.
‘What the hell? It’s more useful than I thought.’
Because of Pisces’s magic, even Lee Gun had been unable to activate his skill.
Lee Gun thought this might be a golden opportunity for him. He glared at the urn in Pisces’s hands.
‘I’ll have to deal with that first.’
That had been why Lee Gun buried his face again as he pretended to weep. “It’s all because of that urn…!”
Since he wasn’t using his emotion magic, his acting sucked, yet it was very effective on a certain disciple.
“Bastards! Gun is sad because of that urn!!!”
There was a reason Zodiacs wanted to bring in disciples with high faith.
Containing an enormous power, Hugo’s arrow headed toward Pisces.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
The flustered Pisces called out her Constructs.
[Ahhk!!]
[Master!]
The arrow’s attack power had gone up by 600%, so the Constructs of the Pisces temple were put into critical condition.
Stevens looked dumbfounded. “That fanatic really is…”
The Leo Saint looked sick and tired of what he saw, so he was about to turn around.
‘I was dragged along, but I can’t even use my skills right now. If I stay here longer, I might be killed.’
Kwah-jeek!
“!!”
At that moment, Lee Gun grabbed Stevens’s arm. He couldn’t approach Pisces, and he knew it would be too much for Taeksoo to handle the matter by himself.
‘I have to get rid of that strange urn.’
So, he said to Stevens, “Hurry up and join in. Attack the Zodiac.”
“What?! Can’t you see that I’m without any weapons? It will be an act of suicide!” Stevens didn’t want to be put on the same level as the fanatic. He was about to leave. “I said I’ll help, but I never said I’ll attack a Zodiac…”
“I’ll make you a weapon. It’ll be EX-rank as Taeksoo’s.”
The light in Stevens’ eyes instantly changed. “You dog shit Pisces! Who told you to make our Zodiac cry?”
Stevens charged forward as if he had lost his mind, and his involvement seemed to have an effect.
Kwah-jeek!!!
“?!”
The urn in Pisces’s hands developed a small crack when Hugo’s arrow hit it. The wound was tiny, yet Pisces glared at Hugo. “You dare!”
Lee Gun just laughed. “It seems that urn is your secret weapon.”
“!”
“I’ll destroy it in no time.”
Pisces tried to activate Thirteenth Urn in contempt when…
“How dare you!”
Kwah-jeek!
Hugo’s arrow destroyed the urn. That wasn’t all.
A hand pierced through to its heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 284
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Let’s Do This (2)
A hand pierced through to her heart.
Poo-hahk!!
Pisces vomited blood. She had been attacked from the back!
“Kuh-huhk!”
The black arm had flown in from behind her, piercing through her chest. A hole appeared in the region where her heart should be.
Pisces looked down at the hand that had appeared out of her chest. It was a black arm with fingernails sharp like the claws of a wild beast.
‘This is…!’
The arm itself weighed as much as a weapon.
[Black Prosthetic Arm (Left)]
Manufacturer: Lee Gun.
Pisces immediately realized who the culprit was. “Leo!!! You crazy bastard!!!”
A hysterical shout rang within the palace.
Stevens laughed. “I can acquire an EX-rank weapon if I kill you, Liv. Ah! I guess you’re the Zodiac?”
Pisces gritted her teeth when she saw the mad eyes of a beast. In truth, she had occupied this body a year before Lee Gun had gone into the Devil’s Tower. Basically, she had lived like the Zodiac Saint for the past twenty years.
This was why she knew about Stevens’s obsession with weapons. Moreover, Stevens had been obsessed with Lee Gun’s keepsake not long after Lee Gun had died. Even Pisces didn’t know the reason behind his obsession.
At the very least, she did know how his attitude would change when Lee Gun said he would make Stevens a weapon as payment. Still, this was too much!
“Do you want me to wipe out all the members of the Leo temple!!”
Stevens was simple, but he wasn’t dumb. He knew what would happen if she tried to antagonize them! In reality, he had tried to back off earlier when he had to fight against a Zodiac.
Stevens let out a menacing smile.
“As expected of a Zodiac, you have a lively mouth despite having your heart pierced.” He immediately ripped out her heart.
Poo-hahk!!
“Ahhhk!!”
An enormous amount of blood sprayed into the air. The reporters froze when they saw the ruthless scene.
They came to their senses only when Stevens crushed the extracted heart.
“Stevens-nim!!”
The reporters looked at Stevens in chastisement.
Stevens glared at them. “What? The real Liv died a long time ago. The content within the body is the Zodiac, so what about it?.”
“Mmm! Since her soul still exists, it would have been possible to revive her. However, that option ended with what you did.”
“?!”
Stevens became deathly pale when he heard Lee Gun’s words.
On the other hand, Lee Gun just grinned as he looked at Pisces.
‘As expected, that set her back.’
He had no idea what had caused a Zodiac to go through the trouble of living as a Zodiac Saint for the past twenty years. However, this meant that the body was human.
‘The Zodiac Saints of battle-type temples shouldn’t be looked down upon.’
As if to show proof, Pisces’s body shook after her heart was ripped out. The Zodiac Saints and the Zodiacs of battle-type temples were indeed no joke.
‘Of course, my baby did all the hard work for him.’
The Black Prosthetic arm (Left) seemed proud of itself as it kept slapping Stevens’s cheek. Lee Gun cackled when he saw this.
The left prosthetic arm became excited when its parent looked at it. It increased the frequency of its slaps.
Slap, slap, slap, slap, slap!
[Black arm (Left) is overjoyed by its parent’s warm gaze.]
[Black arm (Left) is excited, saying it’ll extract more rental fee.]
Amongst the recent items that Lee Gun had made, this arm possessed a special rank.
‘It can be used as a weapon substitute.’
However, Steven’s right arm seemed to have been made by the Capricorn temple. It caused Lee Gun’s eyes to flash.
‘I should have made the right arm too. That way, I could extract more money from him.’
However, that thought lasted only a moment.
‘!’
Lee Gun smirked when a green light started circulating his hands.
Flash!
He could use his skill since Hugo had destroyed the first urn.
[Pisces’s first magic, Equipment Disarmament, has been canceled.]
[Skills of the Serpent Bearer temple may be used normally.]
When the skill restriction was released, Lee Gun kept his distance from Pisces as he tried to use a long-range skill.
Seeing the skill that Lee Gun was about to use, Pisces grinned.
‘As expected, he’s too scared to approach me.’
While the 1st skill Equipment Disarmament had been canceled, the thirteenth “Thirteenth Killer” was still active.
‘You’re dead as soon as you get close.’
It was a distance of two meters. The direction didn’t matter.
Lee Gun just had to enter within the distance, and he would lose all functions in his body and fall. The Thirteenth Killer skill changed the current state of one’s bodily functions into a state right before death.
It wasn’t an effective skill since it only worked on the Serpent Bearer. However, the restriction set on it made it that much more powerful!
Lee was quick on the uptake, so there was no way he would easily approach her.
‘That also means Lee Gun is limited in the skills he can use.’
Unlike the healing-type Zodiac Saint Sophie, Lee Gun wasn’t one to use support skills. Among his skills, Gluttony was the closest to being a long-range skill. Or he could use a capture-type skill, such as Serpent Eater or Pool!
Well, it didn’t matter which one he used.
‘I’ll use an attack skill counter!’
If Lee Gun used a powerful skill, she just had to send it back! If he used a capture-type skill, it would allow her to capture Lee Gun! She would be thankful then!
When Pisces was about to activate the counter skill, however…
Lee Gun suddenly grinned. “It’s a feint, idiot.”
“!!”
[Creation Workshop (Manufacturer Workshop)]
An enormous serpent magic circle appeared underneath Lee Gun’s feet. When the magic circle activated, a simple workbench appeared. This skill was useless unless Lee Gun was making an item, yet he had used it unexpectedly.
[Domain attribute “Quickness” of the Manufacturer Space has been activated.]
[Increase speed by 10%]
The speed of the two people within the domain of the Creation Workshop changed.
Stevens and Hugo were at least SS-rank, and they were awakened beings who had high specs when it came to fighting. This was why 10% was a big difference!
The speeds of Stevens and Hugo increased, and they reached Pisces in an instant.
“…!”
Pisces quickly tried to use her attack magic, but it was useless.
[“Bow made out of Fish” neutralized its sister’s attack]
“…!”
Clank!!!
Finally, the thirteenth urn was destroyed. Hugo had swung the Bow made out of Fish to destroy it, and it didn’t end there.
“Taeksoo!”
“You don’t have to say anything! I know what to do!” Hugo grabbed the content of the urn and looked for Sagittarius. “Bald— Oh, Zodiac!”
With his shout, a crack formed in the air, and the head of a crow appeared from it. The crow immediately took the piece of meat in its beak and disappeared into the crack.
Pisces gnashed her teeth when she recognized the crow.
‘Sagittarius!!!’
Sagittarius had taken her item. If the item were taken to the Divine world, Sagittarius knew she couldn’t use the Thirteenth Killer skill for a while.
She wouldn’t be able to retrieve it easily even if she used the power of Time. Sagittarius had shown up at the right time, and his timing was impeccable. This angered her that much more.
‘There should be a limit to how much you love your nephew! Do you think your sins will be washed away if you do this?’
It felt as if the Sagittarius had been waiting for an opportunity to steal the thirteenth urn, as if he had timed it for the moment she took it out.
Pisces ground her teeth as she tried to activate her magic. However, it seemed she wouldn’t be given time to use her magic.
“Hello.”
“…!!!”
Lee Gun appeared in front of her.
The reason he couldn’t approach her was gone. He no longer had to hold back. He moved at an unimaginable speed. This was why Pisces tried to summon a different urn.
“Oh no, you won’t.” Lee Gun grabbed Pisces by the neck and slammed her to the ground.
Kwahng!!
“Koohk…!”
At the same time, the Serpent Eater skill was activated, and the chains penetrated the Pisces’ body.
Then, the Zodiac’s soul was pulled out of Liv’s body. She seemed to be resisting. She didn’t want to get dragged out.
“Lee Gun…!!”
Screams erupted within the palace.
“Lee Gun-nim!”
“This is…!”
Lee Gun laughed.
“Ah. This bastard gave me instructions. She said she’ll get rid of the unknown civilization if I kill the other Zodiacs and bring the other temples’ Seats of power.”
“What?!”
“Also, they are the ones who called the monarchs to earth!”
The surprise felt by the reporters didn’t last long before Lee Gun took hold of Heaven’s Punishment.
“Koo-oohk!”
After the Zodiac’s soul was dragged out, she seemed to want to shout something. However, Lee Gun’s axe was much faster.
Puh-guhk!
The blade of Heaven’s Punishment cut off the soul’s mouth.
“Kuh-huhk!”
Isis, the goddess of magic, glared when her soul’s face was damaged.
“It seems you feel aggrieved, but it doesn’t matter. I have your sister goddess and Zodiac Saint. I’ll make them testify.”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he spoke. At the same time, powerful darkness emanated from him. It was Death.
The black light emitted a monstrous roar as it impacted Pisces.
Koo-goo-goong!
The incredible pressure greatly shook the palace. It was so powerful that one could feel the Divine status cease to exist!
After attacking a Zodiac, the overjoyed Death ripped out Pisces’s Core.
[Death is overjoyed.]
[It is delightful to be of help to its owner.]
However, for some reason, after ripping out the Core, Death flinched.
[It really is too bad.]
As the voice rang, the time around them stopped.
The speaker was Time.
[It seems you prepared for me, but it was a bit lacking.]
“…!”
At that moment, Lee Gun fell over as he vomited blood. Then Lee Gun watched Pisces come back to life through the power of Time.
Time was being rewound. Pisces, who was using the power of Time, laughed. “I’m facing someone who inherited the power of the thirteenth. Did you really think I wouldn’t make a contract with a monarch to face you?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when the Zodiac’s eyes changed into the eyes of a monster. Of course, it wasn’t as if Lee Gun hadn’t made plans for Time.
Hailey had given him instructions on how to deal with Time. “You’ll find that the Scorpio Saint isn’t enough. Of course, I did take a lot of losses for being able to use the power of Time.”
Zzuhng!
The time within the palace froze for everyone, and Lee Gun bled. He couldn’t use his power, and the reason was simple.
‘That is…!’
Pisces took out a familiar item from Lee Gun’s pocket. It was none other than the bone used against Oblivion, the bone of the original owner, which should have been stored within his workshop.
[The power of Time has been activated.]
The bone came out from Lee Gun’s pocket. The time was rewound to the point where Lee Gun had placed the bone in his pocket. It was the reason the bone had made an appearance. However, that wasn’t important right now.
<Thirteenth Against God’s Will magic>
[Thirteenth Killer]
It was the Thirteenth Killer spell that he had neutralized earlier. It had been activated again.
Lee Gun wondered what had happened, but Pisces just laughed.
“The item within the destroyed thirteenth urn came from the same place as this.”
“…!”
Yes, the Thirteenth Killer spell was a spell that needed a special medium.
“Thirteenth Killer can be used only if I have the corpse of the thirteenth original owner.”
She had used the power of Time to fulfill the requirement.
Lee Gun was in pain as he vomited blood.
Pisces laughed and stepped on him. “Now you know. The thirteenth Zodiac cannot win against me. With this, you will die—”
At that moment…
“Uh?”
Pisces, who had been laughing mockingly, suddenly became unsteady on her feet, as if she had lost her power.
Boom!!!
The palace that was considered the holy ground of Pisces fell. That wasn’t all.
“Gun!!”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
The people who had been frozen in time were returned to normal.
The power of Time that Pisces had used was canceled. At the same time, Pisces fell to the ground as she vomited blood.
“W-Wait a moment…! How can this be?”
Lee Gun got up. He grinned as he stepped on Pisces’s head.
[Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple have destroyed the Pisces’s holy ground (Alps).]

chapters.title: Chapter 285
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Let’s Do This (3)
Twenty minutes before the Alps were destroyed…
“Ahhk! That’s crazy! What the hell is that?” Chun Sungjae was screaming in the Alpine range.
Pisces had imprisoned awakened beings in this place. She was sucking out their magical energy with something akin to a straw. It was like a power station.
In other words, this place was one of Pisces’s bases of operations. It had an unimaginable defense but was too large. Dead zones where less power reached also existed here.
This was why the Chun siblings made teams to attack through these dead zones.
‘It won’t be too difficult to find a way to enter that place!’
The Serpent Bearer temple already had the power of Space!
‘We’ll be able to enter in secret if we use it.’
Of course, the Archer disciples had left earlier for the Alps and gotten caught by Silvia. However, in a stroke of luck, Sungjae’s friend had successfully entered the Alps!
Therefore, Chun Sungjae used Possession magic on his friend, who had entered the Alps. To be precise, Sungjae had used a holy item made by his uncle.
[I didn’t give this to you so that you can peep (SS)]
– Manufacturer: Lee Gun.
– Made by putting in Gemini’s data.
– Possess a designated target (both organic and inorganic targets).
– Target has to be something or someone you have touched once before.
– Caution! Your original body will take the same damage if the target of the possession takes damage.
– Standard Duration: 10 Minutes
– Don’t use it in the wrong places.
Anyway, it was well and good that he was able to possess his friend’s body using the Possession holy item. However…!
“Ahhhk! This is crazy! Why is that person here?”
When his friend had called and said that a monarch was here, Sungjae had been worried.
“The monarch was that woman!”
Hahn Jimin… No, the one chasing after Chun Sungjae was none other than Giselle. Of course, she didn’t look like the Libra Saint that he knew.
“You are dead, Lee Gun!!”
“Ahhhk! What the hell did you do to the other half of your face?”
She looked like the terminator. The skin on half of her face had been ripped away, and he could see the muscles. Moreover, half of her body, including her legs and arms, was that of a monster.
While her skin had been ripped away, she didn’t possess red muscles like a human.
This seemed to be the true form of the Negligence[1] monarch.
As chaotic magical energy flashed, black muscles and bones were revealed. Her eyes were red, as if they would shoot beams of light.
“Die, Lee Gun!!”
“I’m not my uncle!!”
The Negligence monarch didn’t care about that; she smirked. She just cared that he was related to Lee Gun.
At the same time, an explosion occurred within the Alps, as if it had been waiting for this moment.
“Ahhhk!!”
[The Alps mountain range has been destroyed.]
It possessed incredible force. Therefore, he urgently blocked the explosion with his defense skill.
[Warning! The influence of Negligence has cut all bonuses by 90%.]
[Effectiveness of the defense ability has fallen by 90%.]
[Your attack ability has become -90%.]
[If you don’t hurry up and get rid of her, our Sungjae might really die]
Chun Sungjae almost cried when he heard the notification spoken through Uncle’s voice. Then, everything fell into place for him.
‘Damn it! I was wondering why Pisces was able to use the power of Time!’
Even if a Zodiac had made a contract with a monarch, it couldn’t directly use the power of the monarch.
‘In other words, different energies are being used.’
Taking the analogy of moving a car (ability), the Zodiacs could move the cars using coal, and the unknown civilization was able to move it using oil.
While his uncle was able to acquire abilities from the monarchs, these abilities had to be converted to the skills of the Serpent Bearer temple. Only then could those skills be used with the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer.
But what about Pisces?
‘Shit! Pisces trapped a monarch here, and she can use the ability of Time by using that woman’s magical energy.’
If he thought about it, Carly and Kevin had gone looking for Giselle before. They had returned, saying Giselle was put in prison by Time and had gone missing.
It seemed Giselle had been transferred to this place after Pisces had made a contract with Time. In the end, it didn’t matter.
“A disciple of Lee Gun voluntarily came to me!”
“!!!”
Flash!
Another explosion occurred. A single attack caused a several-hundred-meter deep sinkhole to appear on the ground.
Chun Sungjae ground his teeth.
‘Shit! Jimin is C rank, so he’ll die just from having that attack graze his body!’
Thanks to Giselle, various locations within the Alps were being destroyed, but that wasn’t enough.
‘I have to quickly deliver the fatal blow here.’
The reason was simple.
[Your Zodiac is in danger. The Serpent Bearer’s power is weakening.]
Chun Sungjae bit his lips as his uncle’s blessing grew smaller. It wasn’t just his uncle’s energy.
‘Even the Retribution of the Mighty Ocean is…!’
The royal holy item made by his uncle had developed a crack. This meant his uncle was in danger.
‘I have to hurry this up.’
Giselle let out a harsh laugh. “It seems you came here to get rid of the last remaining Zodiac. Do you really think I will let you go so easily?”
Chun Sungjae gnashed his teeth and activated his magical energy. He hadn’t been using it because he didn’t want to put too much pressure on the body of his friend, a C-rank awakened being.
“Come out.”
A light surged forth. What Chun Sungjae had called forth was none other than the Fairy Monarch Mimir!
‘It used to be half-dead.’
When his uncle had been getting rid of the Gemini, the bible had been ripped away from Mimir’s body.
‘I’ll spare you since you’re useful.’
Through the influence of the merger, all the fairies had been transferred to the Serpent Bearer temple. Anyway, Mimir’s life had also been spared at the time.
‘Of course, Frey was ruthlessly put into the blast surface.’
Giselle broke out into laughter when she saw Mimir. “My god! You still haven’t killed it! You let it be!”
“!”
As expected of a spy, Giselle knew all the background information about the Zodiacs. “It is the one who told Pisces how to kill the thirteenth and the other original owners! It was one of the main culprits behind the usurpation. So why…”
Chun Sungjae didn’t pay attention to her. He had already checked out the story through his uncle.
‘Mimir didn’t voluntarily reveal the weakness of the original owners.’
Before becoming a fairy, Mimir had been a Construct for a god. Pisces had pierced through the barrier of his holy ground and ripped away the information from Mimir.
‘As expected of Pisces. It’s something I would expect of the Zodiac left standing last.’
Of course, his uncle could tell if Mimir was lying, so it was probably not a lie.
Giselle looked at Mimir and let out a suspicious laugh. “Yes. It might have been inevitable that Lee Gun picked it up.”
“What? What are you talking about?”
“What else?” Giselle said something.
Chun Sungjae became surprised by her next words, but he soon furrowed his brows.
[Three minutes until possession ends.]
He didn’t have much time left, and Giselle seemed to have read his eyes.
She laughed. “Did you think a mere human will be able to run away from me?”
She held a grudge against Lee Gun, and she wouldn’t be satisfied until she ripped apart Sungjae.
However, Chun Sungjae scoffed at her behavior. “Are you an idiot? Who said I’ll run away?”
“!”
“Mimir!”
As the shout rang, the fairy monarch roughly took hold of Giselle. Giselle looked taken back. “Hmmph. Is this something you came up with, Fairy Monarch? You’re merely a Construct-rank servant…!”
Giselle planned on getting rid of Mimir’s power using the power of Negligence.
Flash!
“!”
At that moment, Mimir emanated a powerful golden green light. It was the power of Life!
[Magical energy Revive]
[Ability Revive]
Even if one had received a debuff, it was useless in front of Life’s Revive ability. That wasn’t all.
Koo-goohng!
Negligence, Giselle, was surprised.
Hahn Jimin… No, Chung Sungjae also emanated the golden green light. This was the power of the third stage of Life! It was a power that had evolved when Lee Gun had taken down Taurus!
[Power of Life is being pulled up.]
[A new skill is being called forth.]
Whenever Death or Life evolved toward the next stage, a new skill developed. When Life had reached the second stage, Revive had appeared. And when it reached stage three, Chun Sungjae acquired a skill he had always wanted!
[Creation]
– If the price is paid, anything can be made.
– You may only create something if you understand its underlying structure. You cannot create something with a simple image.
Of course, Sungjae had tried to make his uncle when he had first developed the skill, but all his attempts had failed. However, those efforts weren’t in vain. He was able to perfectly recreate other things.
“!”
Chun Sungjae ran toward Giselle and touched her stomach.
[Creation has been used.]
A light appeared within Giselle’s stomach. Her eyes flashed when she saw this. “What are you doing, you brat?”
Chun Sungjae smirked. “I’ve already eradicated a monarch that went into a human’s body before.”
“Wait—”
The scream was accompanied by the spread of light. The quiet Alps started to violently shake.
Kwahng!!!
It was as if a meteor had hit the range.
* * *
Around that time…
Boom!!!
The expressions of Chun Yooha, Carly, and Hailey brightened when they heard the roar coming from the Alps.
They also saw smoke emanating from the nearby mountain range.
“Sungjae succeeded!”
They looked at Goat, who held Sungjae’s body. Goat appeared relieved. He had heard Hugo’s prophecy a while ago, so he had been very worried.
‘He saw a future where the Sagittarius temple had been eradicated.’
However, with this development, that might no longer be a problem.
“Koo-oohk!”
“Saint-nim!”
They were surprised when blood suddenly flowed out of Sungjae’s mouth. However, it lasted only a moment.
“Huhk…!”
“Sungjae!”
“Are you ok, Saint-nim?!”
“What happened inside there?”
After Possession was dispelled, Chun Sungjae climbed down from Goat’s back and urgently yelled.
“Negligence is inside the Alps!”
“What?! Negligence is Giselle, right?”
Everyone turned deathly pale. Carly’s expression was especially a sight to behold. She reflexively tried to reach for her blade.
“Ah. It’s fine for now. I took care of her. Since I was in my possession state, I couldn’t use 100% of my power. However, she won’t be able to get up for a while.”
“What? You took care of her? How?”
“Like the time with Abundance, I created a clone of Uncle within her stomach.”
“…!”
Of course, he couldn’t clone Lee Gun, so he had passed up on that. Instead, he had created the enormous serpent that he had met in the baptismal space.
‘Tsk! I wanted to get a closer look, but there wasn’t enough time left.’
Anyway, the damage would be significant since it had been pushed out of her stomach. That wasn’t all.
“The power of the monarch was leaking out, so I used it to damage the Alps holy ground.”
Carly’s mouth fell open. “You were successful in using it?”
“I used Mimir.”
Carly furrowed her brow. “But Mimir is….”
Mimir was the being that had provided the knowledge that allowed the thirteenth and the original owners to be killed.
“Why would you let someone so dangerous… What if it betrays Lee Gun-nim?”
“It’ll probably be fine.”
“!”
Chun Sungjae furrowed his brows as he thought about Giselle’s words.
The woman had spoken these words as she looked at Mimir.
– Before becoming a fairy, Mimir was the Construct of the thirteenth original owner.
As Chun Sungjae made a complicated expression, Hailey laughed. “Anyway, you did well.”
When the knockout Hailey let out a beautiful smile, the faces of Goat and Chun Sungjae turned red.
However, Chun Sungjae bit his tongue. “Ah! We do have to go back into the Alps! I placed Jimin in a safe place when the possession was canceled, but we have to go get him… Also, the Negligence isn’t completely dead.”
“Yes. However, the effects of your actions will be great.”
The 14 “Against God’s Will” spells used by Pisces needed a significant amount of magical energy.
That power was being extracted from Giselle, and she had suffered damage now. Thus, Pisces would have suffered a lot too.
Moreover, Hailey’s assessment seemed correct.
Koo-goo-goong!
“Pisces’s holy ground is…!”
The power of Pisces that blanketed Italy was dissipating.
