[The Pisces holy ground has taken a critical blow.]
[Pisces’s power is weakening.]
Hailey said when she confirmed this, “If we destroy the Alps, Pisces won’t be able to use her power. However, you won’t have an easy time destroying that structure, Sungjae—”
Suddenly…
“Leave it to me!”
“!!”
Hailey was surprised by the familiar voice. The Serpent Bearer disciples reared back in shock when they saw who had appeared in front of them.
“G-Gemini Saint?”
“Heiji!”
Heiji was one of the twelve Zodiac Saints, and she was a magician who was called the two great beauties alongside Hailey.
They had no idea why she was here.
“I’ll destroy the Alps’ barrier. Leave it to me.”
“?!”
Everyone was surprised by her words.
At one point, Chun Sungjae had been her student and Hailey her fellow Zodiac Saint. Yet, both of them looked like they couldn’t accept Heiji’s words.
This was especially true for Hailey.
‘What? There is no way Heiji would step forward to help Lee Gun.’
Was it part of some plan? Was she trying to get revenge on him??
Chun Yooha, Hailey, and Carly all immediately raised their guards.
Heiji’s face turned red in a shy manner. “I will be the one to catch Pisces. If I do it, Lee Gun-nim, who I yearn for, will look at me.”
As soon as she spoke, several expressions changed. Goat felt four nightmarish murderous intents emanate within the pub.
1. Term change: “Neglect” to “Negligence” ☜

chapters.title: Chapter 286
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Let’s Do This (4)
[The Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple have destroyed the Pisces’ holy ground (Alps).]
Pisces was being stepped on by Lee Gun, shocked.
‘What the hell…!’
Power was draining out from her body, and she was barely able to make a fist. She found it difficult to imbue her fist with power.
Pisces gnashed her teeth. She realized what was happening to her.
‘Damn it! My holy ground is…!!’
Yes. Among the multiple ways to rob the Zodiacs of their power was one to blow up their base.
The Serpent Bearer disciples not present in this place must have done something. That wasn’t all.
“Gun! Are you ok?!”
“Lee Gun!”
Pisces glared as people approached the bloodied Lee Gun. It seemed the mere sight of a bloodied Lee Gun made Hugo angry. He glared at Pisces.
However, the truly pissed-off one was Pisces.
‘As expected, they messed with Giselle in the Alps.’
The ability of Time was the ability of a monarch. Since it couldn’t be used with the magical energy of the Zodiacs, Pisces had kidnapped Giselle and used her magical energy.
‘I can no longer use the power of Time.’
So Pisces urgently looked for the Time monarch. It didn’t have to be for long. She wanted to ask the monarch to stop Lee Gun’s time since Time seemed to show great interest in Lee Gun.
‘That bastard…!!’
However, Time was already gone. His business seemed to be done here, so he had left.
Pisces ground her teeth.
“Didn’t you say earlier that you knew about my little brother?”
“!”
Pisces became surprised when she lifted her gaze.
“I’ve never mentioned his name, yet you knew my little brother’s name.”
Junwoo and Yeonwoo were his only family, and they had lived together before Lee Gun became an awakened being.
While keeping his foot on her, Lee Gun raised Pisces’s arm. “At the time, there was a lack of manpower, so he had died before he could be taken to the emergency room. We immediately had his funeral. The only ones who know the exact state of his corpse are the family of the deceased and…”
Bbah-gahk!
“Koo-oohk!!!”
“…the culprit.”
When both of Pisces’ arms were broken, she gnashed her teeth.
‘I cannot draw my spells if my arms are broken.’
Lee Gun preemptively blocked the Pisces’ power, then asked, “You guys didn’t want the truth of your deeds revealed, so you killed the previous Serpent Bearers in Junwoo and Yeonwoo, right?”
Pisces screamed again.
Boohoo-gahk!
This time, her legs were broken. It was the same location where Junwoo had suffered damage.
Of course, Junwoo didn’t have his limbs broken. His limbs had been severed, and one of his eyes had been dug out. One would be better off being dead than suffering such a pain.
However, Junwoo had never said it hurt. In fact, the young child had said he was relieved that Lee Gun and Yeonwoo were safe.
That was why Lee Gun’s red eyes turned more violent. “You tortured a child who couldn’t use his power. Did you have that much fun? You kept smiling when you mentioned his name to me.”
Another scream left Pisces’s mouth. Lee Gun had plucked out her eye, and red blood flew into the air.
After having her eye stolen, Pisces glared at Lee Gun as if she wanted it back. It was to be expected since that eye was…!
Lee Gun let out a murderous intent after extracting the eye. “You put an organ of a monster in the body of a Zodiac. How can you say you guys are gods who are here for humanity?”
“Lee Gun!!”
The reporters who had been called to the palace froze when they saw this. “L-Lee Gun-nim! That is…!”
Lee Gun nonchalantly tossed the eye that he had ripped out of Liv.
Seeing the item, the reporters fell back as they screamed.
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “Don’t freak out. It’s an artificial eye.”
“What?!!”
“I’ll have to take it and confirm it. However, it looks like a contract. It is obvious that a contract was made with a monarch.”
“!”
In truth, Lee Gun had activated the 13th Sense as soon as he entered the palace. When he had seen Pisces, he found it odd that he saw the light of the enemy circulate around her eye.
Moreover, he had confirmed that a strange contract had been engraved into the eye. Of course, he had no idea which monarch had made a contract with her.
‘Anyway, the only ones left from those who invaded us are Time and Confusion.’
It was one or the other.
“You made a contract with the unknown civilization, yet you pretended to be saving humanity by creating the Temple system.”
The reporters froze.
“That means…!”
“Gods become stronger if they are worshiped.”
“!”
“It’s the basis of the system that they are talking about. Moreover, fear is the easiest way to gather disciples to worship them.”
“!”
Lee Gun contemptuously stepped on Pisces. “After I disappeared from the world, the Zodiacs were very half-hearted in getting rid of the monsters. Was it really because they were lacking in abilities? Or was it because they would be put in a bind if the monsters were gone?”
“…!”
“Speak if you’re innocent. Why did you kill me inside the Devil’s Tower?”
“…!”
“A part of the reason may have been the possibility of your secrets being revealed, but if we’re being honest, you guys would have been in a bind if I had gotten rid of the unknown civilization. Right?”
Pisces gnashed her teeth as she looked at Lee Gun. In truth, Lee Gun was right.
Gods lost power if they didn’t have worshippers. If they weren’t on everyone’s lips, they would be forgotten. In the end, they would weaken. This was why they had determined the best way to gather human disciples was to use monsters (fear). Humans looked for gods in their darkest times.
Moreover, the Zodiacs hadn’t minded Lee Gun acting as the hero of humanity. The Zodiacs were known to have given divine power to the awakened beings. Their status would rise alongside Lee Gun’s accomplishments.
However, Lee Gun had been too outstanding, causing a problem.
‘He was different from the twelve Zodiac Saints.’
It seemed like if he were left alone, he would get rid of the unknown civilization. Moreover, he was so outstanding that people’s faith might be directed toward him, and that would put the Zodiacs in an awkward position.
‘I would have become deified.’
Lee Gun laughed as if he had wised up to them. “Anyway, I have witnesses to reveal the truth. It’s the real Pisces Saint Liv and the other Pisces, who is this one’s sister.”
The reporters gulped.
“W-Where are they now…”
“Ah! They are inside my blast furnace.”
“What?”
“What?!!!”
The reporters thought they had heard wrong, but Lee Gun merely picked at his ear. “They are floating around in the blast furnace at my home. Both of them are being extracted so that I can make holy items using them.”
The reporters froze. Did they just hear right?
“I-I really think he is the villain…”
“That’s right! Look at his actions and expressions… How can he be the hero… He’s like the boss villain..”
Lee Gun realized his mistake. He grabbed his face once again and enthusiastically (?) started to sob. “I did it for humanity… For humanity…!”
When Lee Gun sobbed (?) as his shoulders shook, sparks flew from Hugo’s eyes. “Hey! You guys want to die? Gun said it isn’t like that!!!”
“That’s right! Our Zodiac-nim said he isn’t a villain! How dare you!”
This time, Stevens became angry.
Hugo glared at Pisces as he throttled a reporter. Normally, he would be the one holding others back since reporters were gathered here. However, things were different right now.
‘Even if we have to use an underhanded method, we have to take down Pisces once and for all.’
The power of all the Zodiacs had to be turned into Lee Gun’s power. It was to be expected since Hugo was worried about the future he had seen.
It was the future where the Sagittarius temple had gone extinct, and his children had died. Moreover, Lee Gun was mourning as he hugged some woman.
‘It must be the work of the monarchs.’
They were the main instigators of the invasion by the unknown civilization. Both Time and Confusion were referred to as the two leaders.
Hugo was uneasy.
‘The future changed not too long ago.’
He felt as if he had been hit on the back of his head. With his many experiences, Hugo immediately realized what that meant.
‘It’s a signal that says the future has changed.’
However, he believed that the future would settle the same way. It was likelier that the events had been pulled forward. As if to pour fuel on his ominous thoughts, Pisces laughed.
‘Witnesses? Idiot.’
Liv might be understandable, but the other being was her sister. She, the older sister, had locked up her younger sister within the Double Fish Palace, the main holy ground of the Pisces temple.
After escaping Lee Gun’s holy ground, her younger sister had done something contemptible when she had tried to stop her.
‘There is no way she’ll be a witness….’
Although they were somehow able to destroy the Alps, the Pisces’s holy ground in Venice wouldn’t fall easily.
‘There is no way he’ll be able to bring….’
Flash!
[Unni!]
[…!!!]
Pisces froze when she heard the unexpected voice. The one to appear in front of them was the other Pisces twin.
The older Pisces twin possessed the Divine status of Isis, the goddess of magic. Unlike her, the younger sister possessed the Divine status of Nefertiti.
When her young sister appeared, Pisces trembled.
‘It’s his doing…!’
Her gaze headed toward Hugo. Hugo held the Bow made out of Fish. As the owner of the bow, he had used the Imprint skill to call forth the younger Pisces twin.
It was understandable since her younger sister was already Hugo’s bow. Her personality hadn’t been completely scrubbed since they planned on using her as a witness.
Since the Imprint skill could summon the weapon, Hugo could also bring the younger twin here.
In the end, the summoned younger sister saw her bloodied older sister and realized what was going on. She spoke.
[Please let’s stop doing this!]
“!!”
The younger sister yelled out in despair.
[I’ll bring Zodiac Saint Liv-nim and reveal everything. That’s why we should stop doing this!]
The older sister ground her teeth.
‘That crazy bitch! What is she saying right now?’
She wondered how her younger sister was able to exit the Riverine temple. However, she soon realized the reason.
[The Pisces temple’s main palace, Riverine temple, has been destroyed.]
[It was destroyed by the enraged Serpent Bearer disciples and the Scorpio Saint.]
Lee Gun laughed in a satisfied manner, while Pisces trembled.
‘My idiot sister will reveal everything to the humans.’
Her younger sister had been so annoying that she had put her Zodiac Saint’s soul inside Abundance as a way to threaten her.
‘Shit! The Divine world won’t go easy on me if they find out the truth…!’
If the news of her having killed the original owners, the heroes of the Divine world, were revealed…!
‘It won’t end well for me.’
The enraged Pisces shouted in anger. “Do you think the monarchs will stand by and do nothing?”
“!”
“They are beasts! Do you not realize that our presence kept them in check— Koohk!”
Lee Gun grabbed her by the hair and pulled back. Unable to move, Pisces trembled.
“Do not look down on Time and Confusion. They are the leaders who had attacked the earth. Only those two may be left now, but there is no way you guys can kill them. They’ll slaughter all the humans.”
“How dare you!”
“Did you really think we were passive in getting rid of the monsters merely for our plan? In the past, they may have been our equal, but they are on a different level now. Someone like you can’t do anything in front of— Kuhk!”
Lee Gun grabbed Pisces by the face and let out a harsh laugh. “That’s not the words of someone who’s going to die soon.”
“…!!!”
At that moment…
Kwahng!
[Divine Status: 100% Release]
Chaotic magical energy surged up from Lee Gun’s body. The power of the God of calamity made the Pisces tremble. It was because she had seen someone in Lee Gun’s face.
‘That person is…’
Pisces soon screamed. The third stage of Death fell on her. After Death swept her up, the sound of her core breaking rang out. It was the death of the last Zodiac.
‘Shit!’
It was as if Pisces had seen the thirteenth original owner in Lee Gun’s smile.
* * *
Around that time, at the Alps mountain range…
Goat was shaking after he returned from his visit to Venice.
“I can’t believe they are so ruthless. They got rid of her as soon as she wasn’t useful”
The person in question was the Gemini Saint Heiji. She had been the teacher of Chun Sungjae and the leader of the magic temple for a reason. She had dispelled the barrier around the Alps mountain range instantly.
In fact, she had also dispelled the barrier around Double Fish palace, which was located at the main holy ground of the Pisces temple!
However, Hailey, Chun Yooha, and Carly had attacked Heiji as soon as the barriers were dispelled. Their teamwork was astounding.
This was how Heiji was instantly buried in the depth of the Alps. Moreover, the burial process wasn’t that difficult.
They used their Saint-rank powers to dig out a manhole. Chun Sungjae used his Creation skill to create a coffin and dirt.
‘They are terrifying.’
In the end, Heiji was buried, and then they came to the Alps to find Giselle and Hah Jimin.
Chun Sungjae scolded Goat, who continued to shake. “Stop shaking, Goat. You’re the Archer Saint. How long are you going to be like that?”
“B-But….”
“That Zodiac Saint deserves it. How dare she aim for Uncle??”
He had been her disciple at one point, so he knew Heiji’s true nature. This was why Chun Sungjae was angry.
“I’m the one who’ll seduce Uncle!”
Goat clutched at his face as if that wasn’t the problem.
‘Lee Gun-nim… He’ll never get to marry in his lifetime.’
Well, it didn’t matter.
“Jimin!!”
“!”
Goat became surprised by Chun Sungjae’s urgent voice. Chun Sungjae discovered his friend fallen underneath a tree and quickly flew toward Jimin.
“Jimin! What’s wrong? You are hurt! What happened?”
The bloodied Hahn Jimin looked like he wanted to throw up. “I…I’m fine, but….”
It seemed Hahn Jimin was watching over the fallen Giselle since he knew his friend would come.
“Over there! A monster suddenly appeared and…”
“!”
Everyone froze as they looked in the direction Jimin had pointed at.
Giselle had turned into a lump of flesh. Her body and soul both had been cruelly ripped apart. She had suffered a true death. Then there were the words written on the floor using her blood.
“T-This is…!”
[I’ll give this to you as a present, Lee Gun]
It was a cruel writing style.
[It’s the payment for helping raise my child. You’re next.]
The one who had done this was the father of Chaos, who had born Red Eye. It was the appearance of Confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 287
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Give it to me, punk (1)
After Lee Gun had taken down Pisces, the world descended into a state of shock. It was a big surprise that came after the press conference where Stevens had revealed Lee Gun had killed Red Eye.
[Gods have betrayed humans.]
[“Human fear was used for faith.”]
[The Zodiacs were the ones that tried to kill humanity’s hero Lee Gun.]
A suspicion was going around that Zodiacs had brought the unknown civilization to the earth. Another said the Zodiacs had tried to get rid of Lee Gun within the Devil’s Tower because they would be put in a bind if Lee Gun spearheaded the eradication of the monsters.
Then there were the stories about the Zodiacs stealing the Seats of power from the original owner. It was the root of everything.
Moreover, there had been a class of awakened beings in the past called the Secretaries. It was said that they were killed because they knew the secrets of the Zodiacs.
Numerous stories came out.
While the people of the world were shocked by the truth, the process in which these stories were revealed shocked them more. It was to be expected.
– What! Say it again! What did you say?
– K-Kuh-huhk! W-We were worried that Lee Gun-nim would drive out the unknown civilization…!
– Your voice is too small! Again!
– T-The Zodiacs conspired to kill Lee Gun-nim using the Cancer Saint… Kyaa! I’m sorry! Please don’t put me in the blast furnace!
Yes. Lee Gun was going out of his way to take the lead in this press conference. The reason he gave was that the humans within the press conference could be taken hostages if he let the Zodiacs conduct it.
This was why Aries and the younger Pisces were brought out on TV as slaves. Lee Gun had seized Aries by the throat and tied Pisces up over the blast furnace. Both of them were giving a confession in that state.
The older Pisces had already been put inside the blast furnace a long time ago.
Zodiacs were beings that could be met only through the bodies of the Zodiac Saints. Since people were seeing the Zodiacs for the first time, everyone was glued to the broadcast.
Of course, the only reason these Zodiacs showed themselves was the collar around their necks.
[Divine Status Controller (EX)]
-Control 100% Divine Status
These were items modeled after his ring, which normally sealed his power.
– Again!
– W-We needed the faith of humans…! H-How many times do I have to repeat this?
– The one from before was broadcasted to Asia. This version will be broadcasted to remote areas of Africa.
– A-Are people able to listen to it there?!
The people of the world became shocked by the bizarre press conference.
Hugo was the same as he watched his TV. “That crazy bastard… He said he’ll clean up the mess, so what the hell is this?”
Hugo looked dumbfounded as he watched the recorded video. If he knew Lee Gun would do this, he would have done it himself.
On the other hand, the one who orchestrated this whole situation looked aggrieved. “Boohoo. People are saying I look more like the villain. Isn’t that too much?”
“….”
Anyone who saw such a sight would have the same thought.
“Thankfully, you have your accomplishments. You should take heart. However, you should keep in mind that you can be viewed as the final boss in a blink of an eye.”
“Boohoo, Taeksoo. I feel so aggrieved.”
“Hey. Stop acting like you’re crying. Who the hell would fall for that terrible acting?”
A dumbfounded Stevens immediately looked at Hugo. Stevens questioningly looked at him, since Hugo was the one who had fallen for it. Hugo had even throttled the reporters by their necks.
Hugo flinched as he yelled, “Damn it! It was the Berserk skill. My body reacted weirdly!”
“Really?”
Hugo ground his teeth as he looked at Lee Gun.
‘I keep developing weird skills because of this bastard.’
Of course, the benefit was that his attack had increased by a vast amount.
It did not take long for the world to react swiftly.
– If that is the truth, wouldn’t we have to rethink the Temple system??
– No. We have to keep that operating system running! We are still fighting against the unknown civilization!
– That’s right. It doesn’t matter what caused this, but the monsters are attacking humans. It doesn’t matter if it is slow or swift. We’ll eventually be conquered.
– Can’t the Zodiac Saints take care of the temples like they’ve been doing?
– What are you talking about? The Zodiac Saints used deception, using Lee Gun-nim!
– We should let Lee Gun take care of—
– Lee Gun? Have you lost your mind?!
– Why would you say that I’ve lost my mind? At the end of the day, Lee Gun is a hero who puts the needs of humanity first! He has never harmed a civilian before!
– He has before, right? He skipped bills in restaurants, and he has damaged properties…
Lee Gun’s eyes turned angry. “Wow. Did you hear what they said? Do they not realize how much I’ve worked for free? Can’t they overlook something so minor?”
“Why would they overlook it? Anyway, I want you to never do a press conference from here on out. Next time, I’ll—”
“It doesn’t matter if it’s you or him. You’ll be fortunate enough if you don’t go overboard because of the Berserk skill.” Stevens interrupted Hugo.
Hugo glared at Stevens. “Whatever. Why are you here?”
It was a fair question, since this place was the main holy ground of the Virgo temple. Lee Gun and Hugo were there because the press conference was being held not too far away.
There was no way Kevin would let the Leo Saint enter this place.
“Do you really have nothing to do as the Leo Saint? Is that all you do? Follow Lee Gun around?”
Stevens angrily replied, “What are you talking about? I’m a customer. Lee Gun said he’ll make me a weapon, so I’m staying here!”
Hugo looked at Stevens in exasperation. He knew Stevens was blind when it came to an EX-rank weapon, but he must know that Lee Gun wouldn’t really make him a weapon.
“Idiot. You’ve suffered enough by his hands, yet you still don’t know Gun…”
At that moment…
“Right. I gathered all the data, so you just have to wait a bit. It’ll take me three days to make it.”
“Really?!” Stevens looked ecstatic.
Hugo looked at Lee Gun as if the latter had lost his mind. “Gun, did you just say you’ll make him a weapon?!”
“Yes. A promise is a promise.”
Hugo’s mouth fell open.
‘Did he eat something toxic?’
What had gotten into Lee Gun? Why was he making Stevens a weapon?
On the other hand, Lee Gun didn’t pay attention to Hugo. He was focused on his own shadow. His Constructs, who he had sent out for reconnaissance, had returned.
[Master, we searched the Pisces’s holy ground, yet we couldn’t find it.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. He emanated an odd sense of killing intent.
Stevens flinched, and Hugo asked, “What’s wrong, Gun?”
“I told the Constructs to search the holy ground. I’m looking for something.”
“What are you looking for?”
“Yeonwoo.”
“!!”
A hand suddenly appeared from the shadow. It was none other than the pendant necklace. Hugo became surprised when he saw the item. It was the item Pisces had used on TV to provoke Lee Gun.
‘It’s the one containing the soul of Ms. Yeonwoo.’
Hugo had wondered why his friend searched Pisces’s body. It seemed he was looking for that item.
The Construct spoke.
[We couldn’t find any more items within the holy ground containing the same energy. We believe that is all there is left.]
“What is it talking about?”
Lee Gun answered Hugo as he looked at the pendant, “It’s nothing. It seems Yeonwoo’s soul was broken up into pieces.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun couldn’t tell from the distance, but he had realized it when he recovered this item from Pisces.
“Only 10% of her soul is in here.”
“What?!”
Their eyes turned round, since they didn’t know such a thing was possible. Of course, Pisces was a cautious Zodiac.
This was why Lee Gun had thought Pisces had used transformation magic to bring a fake when she tried to make a deal with him. He thought the real one would be hidden with her holy ground.
‘It doesn’t exist within the holy ground.’
Ten percent was like a drop in the bucket. Not even her personality would be present in that, yet it was Yeonwoo.
Lee Gun looked at it as if it was something precious.
“The other 90% is probably with Time.”
“!”
Yeonwoo’s soul had originally been in the possession of Time. Pisces had acquired it to provoke Lee Gun. He was sure Time had broken off a piece of the soul to hand over to Pisces. The reason was simple.
‘Time is obsessed with the power of the Serpent Bearer.’
Moreover, Yeonwoo had been the previous Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple. The monarch was probably interested in the power of the Serpent Bearer rather than Yeonwoo.
‘I have no idea why.’
Hugo looked at him as if he was dumbfounded. “Wait a moment. That makes it weirder. The skill that can divide the soul is monopolized by the Cancer temple.”
“However, the Cancer temple no longer has a Zodiac, so that skill can’t be used, right?”
When a Zodiac went away, all the skills under its relevant temple became unsuitable. In fact, there was “Not available” next to the list of rental skills from the Cancer temple.
‘The holy item I made from the data I acquired comes up unusable.’
It was the reason Lee Gun had told Carly and Yooha to go steal the Seat of power from the Cancer temple. He needed the Seat of power for the merger, which would allow him to transfer those skills to the Serpent Bearer temple.
‘However, Gun only transferred skills from the Taurus temple and Gemini temple so far.’
Lee Gun had urgently needed defensive skills, and he had merged the Gemini temple for Sungjae, a magician. The rest hadn’t been transferred yet.
This was especially true for Cancer, who had the attribute capable of killing a god. The skills were very powerful, but caution was needed in transferring them.
“Does that mean Time can use Cancer’s skill?”
How?
It didn’t take long for their question to be answered.
[Hailey-nim said Time is a time traveler that can move between the past and future.]
“!?”
Everyone was shocked by that voice.
“Sungjae?!”
“What the hell? Where are you talking from?” It was rare for Lee Gun to be surprised too.
He hadn’t felt Sungjae’s presence at all.
However, Lee Gun glared when he realized where the voice was coming from. “I told you not to misuse it.”
Lee Gun grabbed the slime on his shoulder. A scream immediately came from the slime. There was no mistaking it. Sungjae had used the Possession holy item to possess the slime. However, that wasn’t the surprising part.
[Idiot! Why did you talk? You were discovered!]
“?!!”
Another voice came from the slime.
“Yooha?!!”
Her dad, Stevens, and Lee Gun became surprised.
Both the Chun siblings had possessed the slime.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows twitched as he mushed the slime’s face. “You little rascals. I told you not to use it to peep on others. Where are you guys right now?”
[Ggoo-ehhhhk!! We are inside the Virgo Saint’s vault!]
“What? Why are you in his vault?”
[We had something we wanted to steal…!]
Hugo massaged his forehead. He had no idea what his children were trying to accomplish.
“So? What do you mean by Time being a time traveler?”
[Ah! Time can move to the past. I was wondering if he used the power of Cancer from the past.]
Lee Gun, Stevens, and Hugo furrowed their brows. Was returning to the past really possible, considering its abilities?
“I can see why they say it’s impossible to kill him.”
Hugo started to let out a cold sweat.
‘In the future, Time had been present in the destruction of Sagittarius and the Sagittarius temple.’
Hugo had to quickly leave the Serpent Bearer temple. He had to return to the Sagittarius temple. He couldn’t let Goat handle this by himself.
“Koohk!”
“Gun?!”
Lee Gun clutched at his heart as if he was in pain.
“Gun! What’s wrong? Are you hurt?”
At that moment, Lee Gun looked to be in great pain.
Koo-goong!!!
Suddenly, a black light surged out of Lee Gun’s body.
[All of your EXP has been applied.]
[The stage of Death has increased.]
[Death is evolving to stage 4.]
[Warning! This is the stage right before the final stage.]
[Your time to choose is not far away.]

chapters.title: Chapter 288
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Give it to me, punk (2)
[All of your EXP has been applied.]
[The stage of Death has increased.]
[Death is evolving to stage 4.]
[Warning! This is the stage right before the final stage.]
[Your time to choose is not far away.]
Chaotic black magical energy surged forth. Just being close to this magical energy generated enough pressure to give one trouble breathing! Even Hugo shook.
‘Death…!’
He was sure of it.
‘The Divine status of Death leveled up when it ate Pisces!’
After reaching the next stage, the Divine status of Death possessed unimaginable power.
Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jee-jeek!
“Koohk!”
“Gun!”
This power was like a black vortex! It had already been extraordinary when it was stage 3, and when it leveled up to the next stage, it started destroying everything in its surroundings.
[Warning! The power of Death is too powerful.]
[Everything in its surroundings is being changed into the status of Death.]
The black vortex turned everything into ashes. This included the sofas everyone was sitting on and the table.
And the black magical energy needed to graze these items just by a bit!
Pah-jeek!
“!”
“My holy item!!”
The black gloves Stevens was wearing ceased to exist. That shocked him.
‘This is nuts! That’s an SS-rank item!’
Of course, he was well aware that an SS-rank holy item was useless in front of Lee Gun’s Divine power (SSS), but the destruction of the item wasn’t the problem. The problem was that a mere graze had destroyed the holy item.
Moreover, not even a trace of it was left, as if the item’s existence itself had been killed. What if the object this power touched were a living being instead of a holy item? Stevens started trembling.
‘I’ve never seen a power like that.’
That wasn’t all.
“My bow!”
Hugo had taken out his Bow made out of Fish to get Lee Gun to check on it, yet almost half of it was destroyed. The personality imbued within the bow was close to being erased. The bow cried out as if it was in pain.
[Bow made out of Fish is in excruciating pain.]
[The power of Death is trying to kill the consciousness of the Bow made out of Fish.]
Stevens was surprised by the sight. To save it, he quickly threw the bow out the window.
“Shit! An EX-rank weapon is going to be ruined!”
On the other hand, Hugo didn’t consider that important. “Gun!!”
He turned deathly pale when he saw Lee Gun. From the outside, it looked as if Lee Gun was swept up by a black power.
Seeing him was hard, yet Hugo was sure of it.
‘Gun’s body is changing!’
In reality, Lee Gun was in pain.
“Koohk!”
The skin on his arm was turning black, and his nails were getting longer and sharper like that of a monster. The power of Death was so strong that he couldn’t control it.
Hugo ground his teeth. He had an unfavorable opinion of Death. Of course, he acknowledged that the Zodiacs and the monarchs had been killed because of Death. It was that powerful.
‘However, that power threatens even its owner.’
In the past, Death had wrecked the body of Lee Gun. It was a dangerous power that endangered its owner the more it leveled up. That was why Hugo wished his friend would become the God of Life instead of the God of Death.
‘In the first place, if he became the God of Death, considering his temper, who would see him as a hero? He’s already a villain.’
Aside from that, Death seemed to eat away at Lee Gun’s lifespan. This was why Hugo hated that power.
Anyway, this power was surely trying to destroy Lee Gun’s body once again! So Hugo quickly tried to approach Lee Gun.
‘!’
However, he was surprised when he got close to Lee Gun.
‘What the hell? His body is fine?’
Of course, it wasn’t really fine, but it wasn’t like last time, when his muscles and bones had been crushed.
As if to show that, Lee Gun was laughing.
‘This is the benefit of going through the trouble of molting.’
In truth, he was bleeding from numerous locations, and his skin had peeled off. However, something of that magnitude was cute to him.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “I get that you want to show off your power, but you should go to sleep for a bit now!”
He used his powerful willpower to press down on the power of Death.
Boom!
He suppressed it until the power didn’t radiate out of his body. And the strategy of using his willpower seemed effective.
Koo-goong!!
[Death is in pain.]
[Death is resisting its owner.]
The stages of the Divine status ended at stage 5. That was why the stage right before it was incredibly strong.
When Lee Gun tried to force all the power into his body, his body protested.
‘Shit! Suppressing it completely is impossible.’
The only choice left was to release the power. At the thought of that, Lee Gun became mad as he glared at the power.
“Get down!”
“!!!”
The shout surprised Stevens and Hugo, and they repositioned themselves.
Kwahng!!!
The black power flew over their heads.
If they had been late by even 0.1 seconds, their brains and other body parts would have ceased to exist. It was a dizzying moment!
At the same time, an enormous explosion erupted.
“Koo-oohk…!!!”
It was a power that wasn’t comparable to a strong gale. This incredible energy had almost sent the Saint-ranks flying. They clenched their eyes shut.
It was unclear as to how much time had passed.
“Hoo-ooh.”
Lee Gun took a deep breath as he opened his eyes. Hugo and Stevens were frozen in place.
“W-What the hell….”
Nothing was left in the place where Lee Gun had released the black power. The room’s walls and the nearby golden palace were all gone. The only evidence of a palace being there previously was the debris and the roof.
Lee Gun seemed to have directed the power toward the building he had known was empty. However…
“You crazy bastard!!”
“You should have said something sooner if you were going to release your power!”
Lee Gun had reduced his power, so it ended with this. However, it didn’t change that they had almost died.
On the other hand, Lee Gun picked at his ears as he healed his body with the power of Life. “I told you to get down. Wasn’t I really kind? I gave you a second to dodge.”
Hugo and Stevens pounded their chest at the mentioned “kind.” Of course, Lee Gun was much kinder than he was in the past, when he would have said nothing. They would have needed to dodge on their own!
Lee Gun was unperturbed as he brushed off his body. “This is a ritual I have to go through whenever the Divine status evolves. Isn’t it great that everything ended with the destruction of a single palace? I wasn’t giving it my 100%, so I thought it would be ok.”
It was a terrifying power even if one considered that.
“I guess it’s fine since no one was hurt. The only thing destroyed was an empty building.”
“Right?” Lee Gun turned around in a carefree manner.
On the other hand, it seemed he was at the doorstep of needing to choose between Life and Death.
“Anyway, let’s go look for the kids. We can go have something to eat…”
“Isn’t this the Virgo Saint’s holy ground?”
“!”
Dumbfounded, Stevens looked at the two men, who looked carefree. “The place you blew up is considered a treasure of the Virgo Saint’s holy ground…”
“….”
Lee Gun and Hugo became silent. They looked at the empty lot where the palace had disappeared without a trace. Since nothing of the original building was left, fixing it was impossible even if Lee Gun wanted to do it.
So Lee Gun said, “Hey. You guys saw nothing.”
Stevens was taken aback when he saw Lee Gun’s bright expression. “What! If it’s you, you can fix it!”
“Ah! I don’t want to. It’s really difficult to fix something without its original frame. It’s annoying and will take too long. Also, why do I have to restore something from the Virgo temple? Let’s just say monsters appeared.”
“Hey!!!”
[Ahhhk! What the hell happened here?!!]
It seemed a Construct shaped like a piece of cloth had witnessed the now-empty lot. It had come back with food that would be served with tea, and it screamed at the sight.
[What the hell happened? Our holy ground’s precious building is…!!!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. He grabbed the Construct with force. “Hmmph. I know you have a lot of complaints in life, but you shouldn’t destroy the holy ground of your master, Construct.”
Suddenly branded as a criminal, the Construct was dumbfounded.
[What are you talking about?]
Lee Gun just smirked. “You hear me? You broke that.”
[What?!!]
“Tell your Zodiac Saint that the repair fee will be one hundred million dollars.”
[Damn you, Serpent god!!!!]
* * *
Around that time…
Kwahng!!!
“Ooh-ook!”
The Chun siblings, who had snuck into the vault of the Virgo Saint’s holy ground, were groaning. They each held onto their heads.
Until a moment ago, they had used the possession holy item to possess the slime.
“Oohk…! The possession was canceled!”
Accompanying a strange shock, their possession was forcefully canceled. At the same time, they had a realization.
“Wasn’t that Death?”
“Yes. Uncle awakened toward the 4th stage.”
As proof, Chun Yooha’s magical energy of Death became stronger. It was also why she felt unsatisfied.
“Sungjae, you idiot. If you hadn’t spoken up, we could have watched Uncle while we possessed the slime.”
Now that their uncle had wised up to it, it would be almost impossible to possess the slime in the future.
When his sister called him an idiot, Chun Sungjae felt a surge of emotion. He pounded the ground with his fist. “Damn it, Noona! I’m sorry! Slime was the ideal candidate to possess!”
They pouted as they looked at the slime clone. It really was terrible.
“Slime even told us the best time to possess it.”
The slime’s official name was “Clump of Creation Clay.” Slime had watched the Chun siblings feel guilty at the prospect of using the possession holy item.
This was why it placated (?) the Chun siblings by saying they could possess its body if they wished to do so. It said Lee Gun wouldn’t notice if they used its body.
This was to be expected since the slime was the second mutant holy item Lee Gun had created after Heaven’s Punishment!
Lee Gun had been falling asleep when he had made it by mistake. Therefore, he had no idea which ingredients he had used to create the slime.
It was the only item whose structure Lee Gun didn’t know, so he had a hard time noticing its presence! It was the ideal candidate to possess! That was why…!
“You idiot! Uncle takes Lime into the bat house! They sleep together too!”
Chun Sungjae wailed when he heard his sister’s words. It was as if he was being charged with high treason. Of course, that wasn’t important right now.
“Shit! I can’t find Uncle’s molt!”
Yes. In truth, they had come to this place to find Lee Gun’s Molt, which Kevin had stolen.
‘How dare he take it without saying anything to Uncle?’
The molt that their uncle had sloughed off possessed incredible power. It was at least an EX-rank ingredient, and its existence was precious in itself.
So the Chun siblings had chased after their uncle’s energy and arrived at the vault. As expected from a rich temple, the vault here was the size of a mansion. It being plated with gold pissed the siblings off, but that wasn’t important at that moment.
‘Uncle’s molt should be here.’
They were in one of the several vaults within the Virgo Saint’s main palace. This one had the most sturdy and comprehensive defense, yet it was rendered completely useless in front of Chun Yooha’s Space skill!
Thanks to the skill, the siblings were able to pass through the walls to enter the vault in question!
“Damn it! This vault is filled with Uncle’s items. I can’t find the molt.”
Their bodies started shaking when they saw the items that filled the safe. These weren’t normal items.
“Wow! This was released ten years ago. It’s a limited edition figurine made with five luxury brands! They collaborated with a master craftsman, so several hundred million won of premium was added to the price!”
“Look at this! Aren’t these the gloves Uncle had worn during the raid in Russia?!”
“Look at that! It’s the original doodle that Uncle drew during that meeting during the 2004 Paris negotiation! It’s inside the picture shown in textbooks!”
“This is the raid map Uncle drew in 2003! It’s the one from Shanghai!”
“This is the earliest version of Uncle’s armor…!”
That’s right. The siblings had entered a vault dedicated to Lee Gun’s items. Everything within this vault was related to Lee Gun. These were premium and extremely rare items that all fans of Lee Gun knew about.
“The only remnants of these fantastical items are pictures within the textbooks! They were all here…!!”
“Shit! If you add everything up inside here, it’s worth tens of billions…!!!”
In the end, they couldn’t even touch the items in fear of contaminating it. While they were making a fuss…
“Noona!”
“!”
Chun Sungjae seemed to have discovered something. Yooha was surprised when she looked in the direction that her brother was pointing.
“What the hell? Why is there a hidden door within a vault?”
It was a vault with a vault, and they knew what this meant.
‘The more important and rarer items are in there, right?’
Their eyes flashed as they put their hands on the safe, but…
Beep beep beep beep!
When they touched the vault, the security system alarm started ringing! As the incredible, loud sound rang within the vault, they could sense the Constructs and Kevin running toward the vault. Of course, those two didn’t care about that.
Clank!
At that moment, the door to the vault opened.

chapters.title: Chapter 289
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Give it to me, punk (3)
Clank!
The door to the vault opened. Then, the enormous vault’s lock opened. It hadn’t been hard to unlock it.
Chun Yooha had used the power of Space to pass her hand through the door and opened the lock from the inside.
Accompanying the sound of metal clanking, the refrigerator-like golden vault opened. Inside it was a drawer that held a luxurious box engraved with gold. The white storage box was a high-end product seemingly worth hundreds of millions! That wasn’t all.
On top of the designer box, a familiar name was engraved in gold.
[Lee Gun]
This shocked them.
‘What on earth is he keeping in here that belongs to Uncle?!!’
In the end, the siblings quickly opened the box, and its contents surprised them.
“What the hell! This is a beverage can!”
Yes, inside the box was a crumpled can of coke. It was the brand of coke Lee Gun liked the most, so it used to appear frequently in old videos of him.
“Isn’t this package design from twenty years ago?”
“That’s right! It really is! Moreover, this is the one that Uncle drank! Look at the doodle he drew! This is a character Uncle frequently liked to draw!”
At the same time, the look in their eyes changed. Of all the things in the world, Kevin had chosen to store this in a vault?
Of course, it wasn’t as if they were unable to understand it. Yang Wei had put a toothpick Lee Gun had used before on display. A can with Lee Gun’s doodle on it was a valuable possession. But even so…
‘Really, Virgo Saint?’
At that moment…
“Catch the intruders!!”
“How dare you try to steal from the main palace of the Virgo Saint! Do you have no fear?”
“Which temple are you from?”
“!!”
In just a short period, the Virgo disciples and Constructs had charged into the vault. Of course, their leader, Kevin, was with them.
As expected, Kevin had his sword unsheathed as he stood amongst the Virgo disciples, who wore pure white uniforms.
“Which bastards dare…”
The eyes of those belonging to the Virgo temple soon turned round.
“S-Serpent Bearer Zodiac Saints?”
“What the hell? Aren’t they the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple??”
When they realized that the ones who had broken into the vault were the Chun siblings, their faces were a sight to behold.
Kevin, who had his blade up, looked surprised too. “What are you guys doing here?”
The Chun siblings didn’t care for the others’ reactions. Their eyes flashed.
“That’s not the problem! What the hell are these?”
“!”
Fire erupted from Sungjae’s mouth as he looked at the vault full of his uncle’s items. “Why does the Virgo temple have these? Damn it! I’m so jealous! I couldn’t buy them even if I wanted to!”
“Did you get permission from Uncle to take these?” They were the thieves, yet Chun Sungjae acted as if they were in the right.
On the other hand, Chun Yooha didn’t care about that. She looked guarded as she scrutinized Kevin. “I misjudged him. He’s also a fanboy of uncle. He is dangerous.”
Kevin became angry at Yooha’s reaction. There was no way he was a fanboy! “Don’t put me on the same level as you guys! I gathered all of this to investigate Lee Gun’s death. They are merely evidence—”
“Hmmph! You put a can Uncle drank from inside a golden box! It’s something he threw away!”
“Can?”
The Chun siblings pushed forward the golden box hidden within the vault.
“Look! It’s a can! I know this one very well. It was sold one month ago for forty million won at the auction! I remember it was sold for a high price because Uncle’s writing was preserved very well! You bought it and stored it here, right?”
Kevin became angry. “What nonsense are you talking about? A different item is supposed to be inside that box!”
“What??”
Kevin urgently yelled at his subordinates. “Go look for it right now! The content inside the box has changed!”
“!!!”
Kevin glared as he picked up the can. “Who the hell put a can inside here? I don’t remember buying this.”
The goddesses of the Virgo temple confessed as their faces turned red.
[Ah… In truth, we….]
[We were told that if we bought it, it would come with a picture that shows the nape of Lee Gun-nim’s neck… Kyaaa!]
“You guys did it!!”
[However, it was Lee Gun-nim from twenty years ago. His face was scary, but his body was…!!!]
[There is a reason he’s popular… Kyaaa!]
When they saw Kevin’s expression, the young apprentice goddesses waved their hands.
[B-But! We didn’t put that inside the box!]
[That’s right! Wasn’t Lee Gun-nim’s precious bone from his body put inside that box? Why would we take such a precious item and swap it out for…]
The Chun siblings were surprised by those words. Uncle’s bone? What was inside the box instead of the can?
“What do you mean by bones? The body he molted didn’t have any bones.”
Kevin furrowed his brows at those words. That’s right. Those items were none other than…
<Breaking news. Lee Gun’s armor was found on the 1st floor of the tower.>
<It’s the legendary armor mentioned inside the textbooks.>
<Remains similar in size to Lee Gun were found next to the armor.>
When Lee Gun had just exited the Devil’s Tower, the public was in a big fuss, as it was said Lee Gun’s armor and remains were found within the tower.
Kevin had bought it all for the crime scene investigators. At the end of his research, he found out that the bones possessed the same DNA as Lee Gun.
However, he was unable to analyze any further than that, but when he recently saw Lee Gun’s molt, he finally found a clue.
‘Lee Gun might have molted within the tower’
Since Lee Gun had awakened before coming out of the tower, the probability was high. Anyway, Kevin had finished his investigation, and he planned on showing it to Lee Gun since the latter was here. However….!
“I checked it thirty minutes ago, and it was here. That means someone broke in during that time.”
The Constructs who had been investigating the vault shouted.
[Kevin! I can feel the energy of a monster within the safe!]
“!!”
The monsters seemed to be the culprit, but it didn’t matter.
‘All the items inside the vault have trackers on them. I’ll find it in no time.’
It seemed the Constructs had read Kevin’s expression. They nodded before disappearing.
Kevin then glared at the Chun siblings. “Alright. Why are you guys here inside the vault—”
Boom!!
“!!!”
An enormous explosion rang out, and it came from the direction of the Virgo Saint’s main palace!
‘Tsk. Is it the monster that stole from the vault?’
Kevin’s eyes flashed as he left the vault. However, his mouth fell open when he stepped outside the vault. The reason was that his main palace had fallen. Moreover, it hadn’t been caused by a monster.
“What the hell! This is the Serpent Bearer’s energy!”
He wondered if it was Lee Gun’s doing, but the main palace was in the opposite direction of the detached palace where Lee Gun was present!
The explosion had come from their living quarters! It caused the flustered Kevin to scold the Chun siblings. “Really! Did you order your disciples to attack while you stole from my vault?”
The Chun siblings looked at him as if he was speaking nonsense.
“What are you talking about? We came here on our own.”
“Then who is that?”
“I have no idea. Who is that?”
The others’ identities were soon revealed.
[Golden Rule (SS)]
[Desert Forge (SS)]
“!!”
These were the innate skills of Carly and the Ten Star Taylor from the Capricorn temple! That wasn’t all.
[Item Swap (SS)]
This was Hailey’s innate skill, which allowed her to swap items!
Kevin screamed at this, “Why is that woman destroying someone else’s house!!!”
After identifying the intruders, Kevin screamed as he quickly ran toward the main palace. He soon caught up to them.
Boom!!
In a flash, Kevin arrived at the main palace, and his eyes flashed when he saw the intruders. They seemed to be looking for something.
Kevin’s eyes flashed when he saw Taylor and Goat looking around the palace. “Even the Sagittarius temple is here? Is your holy ground so small that you plan on taking this place?” Kevin savagely unsheathed his royal holy item.
Goat, who had been suddenly dragged into this, shrank back. “N-No! It isn’t like that! We aren’t trying to take your holy ground!!”
“Then why did you come here armed?”
“That is…!”
Goat couldn’t say that he was here to steal Lee Gun’s molt, so he massaged his forehead.
Kwang!!!
“!!”
They were soon surprised.
[Kuh-huhk!!]
The palace’s wall was destroyed, and a dark figure flew toward them.
“That person is…!”
The dark figure gnashed its teeth as it glared at the people coming out of the building.
[Damn it! I never expected you guys to be here too…!]
“!”
The ones to walk out of the broken building were Carly and Hailey.
Kevin bared his teeth when he saw Hailey. “Hey! You’re the one behind this, right? What the hell is wrong with you? You destroyed everything, even my bedroom! Take responsibility for it!”
“Hmmph! Who cares about your bedroom? Look over there!”
“!”
As Hailey spoke, the black figure resolved into the shape of a person. Kevin and Goat became surprised.
“It’s a monster!”
However, it wasn’t a normal monster. The monster gnashed its teeth. It didn’t care if Kevin was on his guard or not.
[Shit! I never expected so many Saint-ranks to be gathered here. Did you somehow find out about what I was trying to do?]
The monster clenched its fist as if it was trying to hold on to something for dear life.
Kevin wondered what it was gripping when…
“Give it, bastard!”
As a familiar voice rang out, the monster screamed.
Chun Sungjae had appeared using Teleport and kicked the monster. At the same time, the monster lost hold of something.
Clank!
The monster had lost the lid of a small glass doll. Moreover, the glass doll was broken as soon as the power of Death touched it.
Then, a familiar item appeared.
[Serpent Bearer’s Molt (???)]
It was the molt that Lee Gun had shed not too long ago. As soon as the molt made its appearance, all the intruders ran toward it.
The expression on Kevin’s face was a sight to behold. He finally realized the true reason why his holy ground was attacked. “D-Did they all come here looking for that?”
Well…
He could guess the reason. Aside from Goat, everyone here was either a fanboy and or a fangirl of Lee Gun.
On the other hand, the bloodied monster gnashed its teeth when it saw this.
[Yes. I thought humans wouldn’t notice me. It was my mistake for letting down my guard. I should have known others would try to acquire it. It is an item worth having.]
“!”
[Still, I never expected the gutter rat princess to aim for it! As expected of someone of his line, you immediately knew the worth of the Serpent Bearer’s molt.]
For some odd reason, Hailey was sweating at those words, but it didn’t matter.
Hailey was about to attack the enemy. She acted as if she were protecting those guarding the molt.
[Hmmph! It’s useless! That item is our item!]
What the hell was Lee Gun’s molt supposed to be?!
‘Also, which faction is that monster from…!’
In the end, Kevin ground his teeth as he imbued magical energy into his blade. For now, he would have to call in Lee Gun, who was at the detached palace.
At that moment…
Flash!!!
An incredible power surged forth along with a dark power.
The Chun siblings, Hailey, and Carly, who had been fighting over the molt, all became guarded.
‘That power is….!’
The monster seemingly grew its body as if it had been hiding its power.
Soon, they screamed. A chaotic black magical energy appeared on the monster’s back, as if it was trying to summon someone.
It wasn’t just the holy ground of the Virgo temple. It seemed as if the incredible power could send everyone present into the past!
Everyone flinched when faced with this power.
“This is the power of Time…!”

chapters.title: Chapter 290
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Give it to me, punk (4)
It was an incredible amount of power. The power surrounded the monster as if it was creating a vortex.
And when this dark power touched the castle walls, they ceased to exist.
Koo-goohng!!
To be precise, they had returned to a time before the holy ground was made.
Hailey furrowed her fine brow.
‘Someone capable of using such power isn’t someone insignificant.’
If one compared it to the humans, this being was at least a general rank! This meant someone close to Time had come to do its master’s bidding.
Suddenly, the being that looked like a human changed into a monster. A horn sprouted from its head, and its eyes changed into those of a monster.
[Give me the Serpent Bearer’s molt! That is my master’s item!]
In the end, they screamed as the wind pressure sent them flying.
“Koo-oohk!”
“Black zone rank…!?”
Moreover, it seemed the Virgo Constructs had felt something from the power. They urgently yelled.
[Kevin! It’s the energy we detected within the vault!]
Kevin realized who had pilfered his vault. “You swapped out the item in the vault. You went for that item alongside the molt!”
He was sure of it.
‘Time is trying to obtain Lee Gun’s body.’
However, something didn’t make sense.
“Why are they trying to obtain Lee Gun’s corpse?”
Chun Sungjae became angry as he grabbed Lee Gun’s molt. “Of course, they are trying to obtain it because it belongs to Uncle! Also, why would you store it in a way where it can get easily stolen? Ahhk! There are wrinkles around the face?!”
Kevin pretended not to hear him. He could understand why the Chun siblings and the Ten Stars wanted Lee Gun’s body. They were fanboys and fangirls who would like anything belonging to Lee Gun.
‘The skin doesn’t look creepy. At a glance, it looks like a wax figure with its eyes closed…’
It really was a 1:1 large life-action figure. Of course, it was like a large statue broken into large fragments.
‘The skill of the Capricorn temple will be able to fix the broken part like it’s nothing. ’
Anyway, it was a worthy collectible for Lee Gun fans.
“Why would a monster want that?”
At Kevin’s words, the apprentice Virgo goddesses yelled out loud.
[Maybe, they are trying to create a familiar? If it is Baby snake-nim, that’s worth doing!]
“No. It’ll just be an inferior version of Lee Gun! Even if it was well created, it’ll only be able to be used as a moving mascot!”
[!]
They soon found out why Time’s camp wanted Lee Gun’s body.
Flash!
[That’s an ingredient Master will use! Hand over the molt!!]
“!!!”
When the monster gestured with its hand, light emanated from the molt Sungjae was holding. It was a skill of Time!
[Rewind Time (Radius 1 m)]
The time was being rewound as the molt tried to return to the monster’s hands. It was returning to a time when the monster possessed the molt.
[I’ll be taking the molt once again!]
“No, you won’t!” Hailey used the same skill. Her skill clashed against the power trying to turn back time.
Kwahng!
Moreover, she was a formidable foe.
The monster gnashed its teeth as it glared at Hailey.
[You dare betray Master!]
“Shut up!”
An enormous power spike erupted, and everyone within the space groaned. The shock created by the two powers clashing dislodged Lee Gun’s molt from Chun Sungjae’s tight embrace.
“Ah!”
The monster laughed when it saw this. It took advantage of this opportunity and tried to grab the molt that was flying toward it.
“I won’t let you do as you please!” Chun Yooha flew in and hugged Lee Gun’s molt tightly, stealing it.
[Koo-oohk!]
In the end, the monster’s hands grasped only a few strands of hair from Lee Gun’s molt!
Chun Yooha then glared at it. “Do you really think you’ll be able to take this in front of us?”
The monster smirked in contempt. Until now, it had been unable to use a great amount of power because it had been afraid of damaging the molt.
[Yes. It’s an item that I have to present to my master, but Master wouldn’t mind if I use a tiny part of it.]
“…?”
The monster immediately imbued the power of Time into Lee Gun’s hair. At the same time, something surprising happened.
“!?”
After receiving the power of Time, the couple strands of hair started to melt. They became a liquid that had the consistency of slime. The melted substance turned into something they knew.
Ssssrk!
The melted substance became larger and more powerful.
“T…That’s…!”
Everyone became pale when they saw what had appeared.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!!]
“I-It is a monster!”
Yes, the hair that was considered part of Lee Gun’s body had changed into a monster.
It resembled an enormous clay golem. The golem roared toward the sky, and its roar sounded similar to the roar of Oblivion.
Everyone shook at this.
“W-What the hell is that? Is it transformation magic?”
Taylor and Goat had the same thought.
However, Chun Sungjae was quick on the uptake, and he thought differently. He thought about the corpses that had been buried within the Nameless Land.
‘The unknown body parts left there were said to belong to the original owners.’
Pisces, who had possessed the Divine status of Isis, had buried the corpses of the original owner that they had killed. To tie up loose ends, they had passed on that land to the monarchs. That wasn’t all.
‘I’m not sure of it, but it seems Time made Oblivion using the corpses of the original owners.’
It was unclear as to how powerful the original owners were, but at the very least, the monsters born from them were monarch rank.
The implication was clear at that point.
“They said ingredients! Are you trying to make a monster with Uncle’s molt?!”
“!!!”
He was correct. The monster of Time laughed.
[Yes. As you can see from Oblivion, our master likes to use the bodies of Zodiacs as ingredients! Of course, those like Abyss merely treat the bodies as food!]
“…!!”
Hailey bit her tongue.
‘Lee Gun’s molt should be equivalent to the body of a Zodiac.’
Moreover, Time was a magician who had amassed knowledge as he wandered around the past and future. He was skilled enough to lend power to the Pisces, who planned on killing and usurping the original owners.
It was unknown as to how the act was done, but Time could easily create monsters from gods’ corpses! Moreover, Lee Gun’s base abilities were extraordinary.
‘A monster greater than Oblivion might come out…!’
[Kee-ehhhhk!!!]
The clay golem made from the strands of hair let out a violent roar. The sound almost made everyone’s heart stop. It wasn’t just a roar. That wasn’t all.
Koo-oong!!!
An unknown power had cut off their consciousness, and they had fallen to the ground.
“Kuh-huhk!”
They had no idea what had happened. When they became conscious, they found themselves on the ground, bloodied and battered.
“Koo-oohk…!”
If the Virgo temple were not an affiliate under the Serpent Bearer, they would have died instantaneously.
[Injuries to the disciples have been detected.]
[The power of the holy ground has been automatically activated.]
[Super Regeneration!]
They were barely able to stay conscious, and they felt a chill.
‘Black zone….’
‘No, it’s something stronger than that!’
Normal monsters had nothing on this one.
In contrast to them, the monster from Time’s camp laughed.
[My god! As expected, it’s incredible. It is made from the most useless part, yet it is this powerful!]
Moreover, this golem-like monster wasn’t made by Time. The monster from Time’s camp had made it haphazardly, yet the being was this powerful!
[I now know why Master is interested in the thirteenth!]
Kevin ground his teeth as he bled. He glared at the monster. “What is Time’s goal?”
[!]
Kevin had barely fought against Time’s camp, so he didn’t know much about them. However, when he faced the monster from Time’s camp, he became sure of something.
“The power of Time is very similar to Jean-Louis’s power. Moreover, Jean-Louis was the one to trap Lee Gun within the tower.”
“!”
Despite having his heart skewered and losing to Jean-Louis, Kevin had faced off against Jean-Louis using his true power. So, he said, “Time sent Jean-Louis to spy on humanity, right? Also, Time ordered him to trap Lee Gun within the Devil’s Tower.”
The monster from Time’s camp burst out laughing.
[Stupid humans! You still haven’t realized it!]
“!”
[The one you know as Jean-Louis is our great master! It’s Time’s past self!]
“…!!!”
Everyone was shocked.
The monster didn’t care as it let out a lilting laugh.
[Our master is a time traveler. If it’s for his plan, he can use beings from the past. Of course, Jean-Louis was completely unaware of this.]
“…!”
[Master needs the thirteenth’s power of Cycle. He has returned to the past numerous times, yet he was unable to achieve his wishes.]
Time had tried hundreds and thousands of times, but had failed to achieve his goal. The number had reached 18,732.
[This timeline is different. Unlike you guys, Lee Gun is a unique existence that has never appeared in the other timelines.]
“!”
[He’s the only being Master has never met or seen before. His existence is unknown. This is why our master is interested in him.]
In the numerous repeats of the timeline, thirteen awakened beings had never existed. The Zodiac Saints had always numbered twelve.
Of course, the thirteenth Zodiac did exist, but Yeonwoo continued to die in the timelines. Lee Gun didn’t exist in them.
So, Time would naturally be interested in Lee Gun’s existence since he had appeared right now. An unexpected change had occurred. The only existence that Time didn’t know about had appeared!
Of course, Time had wondered if he had been unable to achieve his goal because the existence of Lee Gun had been missing.
The monster laughed since it knew its owner’s intent.
‘He’s the key that’ll allow Master to achieve his goal.’
[Of course, Jean-Louis was unable to consume the Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints, unlike in the previous timelines. However, it doesn’t matter. Master will consume everyone to become the great monarch!]
In the end, there was no way to kill Time, since he was a time traveler.
[That’s why you guys should become Master’s food!]
As that voice rang out, the golem made from Lee Gun’s hair roared.
Everyone shook in fear. However…
Kwahng!!!
Suddenly, a beam of black light came flying in, and the Lee Gun golem screamed.
Boom!!!
The unidentified black beam of light suddenly blew away the golem’s head.
“W-What the hell!!”
It was an incredible power. Moreover, it wasn’t a normal power. Unlike a normal strike that could damage the opponent, this bizarre power destroyed the existence itself!
The faces of the Chun siblings brightened, and Kevin’s eyes turned round.
“W-Wait a moment! Isn’t this Lee Gun’s power of Death?”
[That’s right! It came flying from the detached palace!]
“If it’s from the detached palace— Ahhhk!! What happened to the palace that was over there?” Kevin didn’t even have time to be surprised by the sudden loss of his main palace.
[Shit. That power is…!]
The monster from Time’s camp gnashed its teeth and looked toward the detached palace.
At the same time, it glared at the molt in Yooha’s possession.
‘I’ll have to take that for Master!’
This monster was within the holy ground of the humans, so its power was restricted. It was at a disadvantage in many ways.
As if they had read its thoughts, Hailey and the other Zodiac Saints stepped forward to attack it.
“No way!”
Kwahng!!!
As power clashed against power, the monster from Time’s camp clicked its tongue.
[It seems you will come to your senses only if you’re beaten once again.]
It wanted to pluck out Lee Gun’s hair once again to create another golem.
However, Kevin and the Ten Stars protected the molt.
“Do you think we’ll let you make it again?”
The monster from Time’s camp didn’t pay any attention to them. It laughed as it released its power.
“Koohk!”
As the surface crumpled, Lee Gun’s molt flew into the air.
“Ah!!”
The monster from Time’s camp snatched Lee Gun’s molt and took a handful of his hair.
[Several strands were able to create something so powerful. If I use this much, I’ll be able to create a being that’ll obliterate this continent!]
Its master would cut it some slack for doing this. Finally, the monster was about to rip out the hair it had grasped when…
Bbah-gahk!!!!
“I’ll kill you, bitch!”
An angry kick sent the monster flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 291
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Give it to me, punk (5)
Bbah-gahk!!!!
“I’ll kill you, bitch!”
The angry kick sent the monster flying.
Everyone was surprised by the person who had suddenly appeared at the scene.
“Uncle!!”
“Lee Gun!”
Yes, the one who had sent the monster flying while cursing was none other than Lee Gun. He had calmed down Death when it went berserk due to reaching stage 4 and realized what was going on here.
As proof of this, Lee Gun held a Virgo Construct, which was shaped like a piece of cloth, in his hand. It was the Construct that had brought him tea and food and taken the rap for destroying the detached palace.
“You wanna die, bastard!!”
[Kuh-huhk!!!]
Lee Gun landed on the ground. Killing intent flashed in his eyes, as the monster had been about to pluck out the hair from his molt.
“Of all the things you could have plucked out, that isn’t it!!!” He emanated the chaotic Death.
The monster’s actions seemed to have revived Lee Gun’s memories from twenty years ago. It was a time when his body would deteriorate the more he used his abilities, and his hair had fallen out in droves.
“At the time, I bought and applied everything they said was good! I ate everything they said was good for the hair, yet I failed. In the end, I had to shave my head! #$*#$&*!!”
It wouldn’t have been shocking to see him cry, yet killing intent emanated from Lee Gun’s eyes. “Do you realize what I went through to revive it!! Yet you dare pluck it out?!”
“…You have a rich head of hair now.” The one to answer was Hugo, who was huffing and puffing. He had followed his friend here. “In the first place, that’s just your molt…”
However, Lee Gun felt differently. Even if it was a molt that he had shed, it still looked like him! “I’ll drive those bastards extinct! #$*#$&*!”
It was rare to see him this angry, so the Chun siblings were anxious.
Hugo let out a sigh. He had always been by Lee Gun’s side, so of course, he knew about Lee Gun’s rage.
‘He didn’t show it outwardly, but it was a one-year-long period where the risk to his body was very high.’
That period was the reason Lee Gun had gotten swindled out of his money by the Aquarius temple. He used to feel very sad in front of the mirror.
The risk of using his power was so severe that the hair on top of his head had disappeared, and in the end, he had to shave his head. Lee Gun had been so sad that Hugo couldn’t talk to him for 3 days.
‘In truth, he looked really good when he shaved his head.’
In fact, among Lee Gun’s cosplay fans, there existed something called Lee Gun’s “Five stages of Transition.” The 4th stage was the one that described him during his bald days, and it was a pretty popular look for Lee Gun’s fans. This was why a lot of figurines were created, modeling the 4th stage.
However, it was the period when his temper had been the worst. No, it was when he had been the toughest. This was why it was one of the favorite Lee Gun’s time periods for Hugo and Hugo’s children.
[Kuh-huhk…!! Snake bastard!]
Of course, Lee Gun was unaware of all that.
He immediately summoned Heaven’s Punishment. “I will grind you up, and I’ll make a hair growth solution out of you”
Lee Gun was about to grind up the monster from Time’s camp using Heaven’s Punishment when…
“Wait a moment! You shouldn’t touch it right now!”
“!!”
The one to stop him was Stevens.
The monster, which had launched itself as soon as Stevens shouted, clicked its tongue as if it was too bad.
[You’re quick on the uptake!]
However, the monster’s eyes flashed as if this was enough. At the same time, an incredible light started to spread.
Lee Gun immediately retreated, but the light touched him a bit.
“…!!”
Then, Lee Gun started to become smaller.
The monster from Time’s camp had used something when Lee Gun had sent it flying. It was the ability of Time.
[Rewind Body Time]
The monster seemed to have been aiming for this. It laughed when it saw Lee Gun being swept up by the light.
[I never expected the Serpent Bearer to be here. This is great!]
Once it sent Lee Gun back to a time before his awakening, Lee Gun would become a normal human! Of course, this ability consumed a considerable amount of magical energy, but it didn’t matter.
[You won’t be able to use the power of a Zodiac with this!]
“Uncle!”
The Chun siblings were taken aback by the familiar sight. They immediately realized what had been done to their uncle. So they quickly took out something from their possession. It was an item that returned someone to normal after the person had been attacked by Time.
“Please wait a moment! We’ll change you back to normal—”
However, their eyes turned round. Lee Gun had quickly gotten into his fighting stance when the light dissipated.
“Uncle!”
“Idiot! There’s no way this will work!”
Lee Gun glared at the monster as if he were angry. However, everyone’s expressions changed when they saw him. This included Hugo, Kevin, and even Stevens. It was to be expected.
“Damn it! He’s so cute!!!”
“????”
Lee Gun had returned to being his ten-year-old self.
Hailey, who had been about to attack the enemy, froze for a second.
The one to scream first was Chun Sungjae. He reflexively looked for his camera when he realized his mistake. He realized this wasn’t the time to be doing such a thing.
[Master will be happy if I take you alongside the molt.]
The monster from Time’s camp let out a sly smile. It was about to kidnap Lee Gun when…
“Lee Gun!”
[!]
Stevens grabbed Lee Gun as if the latter were a rice sack.
“!”
A muscular man over 190 cm tall held a ten-year-old boy. It was like looking at a rugby player moving with a rugby ball!
Stevens gritted his teeth as if he had expected this. “Shit! I warned you because my Zodiac almost suffered the same fate not too long ago!”
Hugo, who had been trailing them, became surprised. “What? Leo was attacked?”
“That’s right! That bastard attacked us! The kidnap attempt failed, but we suffered damage. Leo turned into a baby cat!”
“!!”
Hugo was surprised, but Kevin glared at Stevens. “How dare Leo come to our holy ground without permission!! Do you want a war?”
“Whatever! Lee Gun said he’ll make me a weapon! I came here because he called me here!”
“What? Why would Lee Gun make you a weapon?”
“Why else! I did Lee Gun a favor!”
“What?!” Kevin raged. “Are you kidding me?! I did everything Lee Gun asked, yet he never even sparred me once! Why would he do that for you!!!”
Kevin tried to choke Stevens’s neck as if he wanted to kill him. When Stevens also tried to choke Kevin, Hugo became angry. “Both of you should fix your bad habits! Is this really the time to be fighting each other?!!”
Their opponent was an enemy that could threaten even the Zodiac of the Leo temple.
‘It is dangerous.’
In the end, Hugo fished out Lee Gun, who was squirming because he was buried in his oversized clothes.
“Hailey! Kids! Return Gun to—”
“Get out of my way!!!”
“Kuh-huhk!!”
After pulling up his clothes, Lee Gun kicked Stevens and Kevin. The two Zodiac Saints groaned as they fell over. At the same time, they were surprised by Lee Gun’s strength. He was able to send them flying.
“Did he just throw us?”
“Gun!”
Since Lee Gun had returned to an age before he had awakened, he shouldn’t be able to use his power. Moreover, the power of a normal human couldn’t toss a Saint rank. It was impossible. This was especially true of someone with the strength of a ten-year-old!
It meant…
“What the hell? He didn’t lose his power?”
“What is going on?! I heard Gun awakened at the age of twenty-one!”
They weren’t the only ones shocked.
‘No way.’
The monster looked taken aback as well. A chaotic black-green light was emanating from the ten-year-old Lee Gun, and there was no mistaking it.
‘That’s the power of the Serpent Bearer!’
The monster’s mouth fell open.
‘This makes no sense. How can he use that ability as a child?’
The ten-year-old Lee Gun didn’t seem to care as he summoned Heaven’s Punishment. “Come!”
When its owner called for it, the weapon appeared in Lee Gun’s hand. It was weighted to fit his adult body, so the weapon did feel heavy.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows for a brief moment. However, the weapon wasn’t so heavy that he was unable to swing it.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “Die!!!!!!”
Heaven’s Punishment let out a violent roar. The power of Death, which had ascended to stage 4, ruthlessly fell toward the monster.
Kwahng!!!
The terrifying power of the black light swirled around the Virgo Saint’s holy ground. Everyone screamed as they were sent flying.
“Koo-oohk— W-What is this power?”
“As expected of the stage-4 power…!”
After they were sent flying, they opened their eyes. The Virgo Saint’s holy ground was gone. The monster, which had received the attack, had half its body destroyed.
Slime, who sat atop Lee Gun’s head, emitted a light as it jiggled in joy at the sight before it.
The Chun siblings were shocked.
“What the hell? Uncle can use his power despite becoming younger?”
It seemed they had suppressed their desires for nothing. They had agreed to never turn Uncle back to his younger self, since he couldn’t use his power!
“Uncle can use his power despite being younger…”
“He’ll look cuter as a four-year-old….”
Hugo became angry when he saw the crazy look in his children’s eyes. “Stop thinking about useless things! Hurry up and return Gun to his normal self!”
[Koo-oohk…!]
The monster from Time’s camp had only its head left. It vomited blood. Thankfully, it had activated the power of Time, so it didn’t suffer an instantaneous death. However, the power of Death was too strong.
‘What the hell? The power of Death that he’s using is the power of the previous Zodiac. It’s the power of Ouroboros.’
This monster’s name was Square. It was the butler that served the Time monarch, and it was also Time’s left hand. It had served Time for a very long time, so it had even picked out Time’s generals before.
It knew better than anyone about the thirteenth Serpent Bearer, whom its master was trying to obtain. So it knew the limit of the thirteenth’s power.
Moreover, it believed the power of the thirteenth wouldn’t work against it and its master, no matter how strong the power was.
‘It should have the same power as the previous Zodiac. But what is this difference in power…!’
Lee Gun was using the same power, yet the power seemed to differ depending on the user. It was like the difference between the original owner using the power and a Construct using a borrowed power from its owner.
‘He’s not normal.’
This was also why Square had to take Lee Gun to its master.
‘It might be a bit dangerous, but I have to call in the troops…’
At that moment, however…
‘…!!!’
Square was shocked when it saw the slime on top of Chun Sungjae’s head.
‘That’s…! No way!’
For some reason, Square became desperate at the sight of slime.
‘I have to quickly inform Master…!’
When lightning erupted from Square’s body, the Virgo Constructs urgently yelled.
[Baby snake-nim! Please be careful! That bastard’s party isn’t to be underestimated!]
[Jean-Louis is the past version of the Time monarch!]
[There is some connection between them!]
Lee Gun sneered. “Who cares about that?”
The small Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment high. Of course, he wanted to know more about Time. He was curious about Time’s objective. However…
‘That bastard has been a mystery since I’ve been inside the Devil’s Tower.’
Despite trying to find it out, Time was someone that Lee Gun was unable to figure out.
When Lee Gun brought Heaven’s Punishment down on the monster’s head.
Flash!
Death, which had advanced to stage 4, clashed against the power of Time, which the monster received and used.
‘…!’
An unfamiliar sight unfolded in front of Lee Gun’s eyes. It was the sight of corpses filling up a vast ruin.
[I can’t believe this! I’m still falling short with this.]
It was the memory of Time.

chapters.title: Chapter 292
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Give it to me, punk (6)
[I can’t believe this. I’m still falling short with this.]
It was the memory of Time.
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round at the unexpected sight. He saw a familiar young man within the memory.
‘That bastard is…’
He was sure of it. There was no mistaking him. It was Time, whom he had seen in Pisces’s palace.
At a glance, Time looked to be around the same age as him.
‘He really looks like that Crab bastard.’
This made Lee Gun gnash his teeth, but he then looked at his surroundings. It seemed this scene depicted a situation right after a war.
Time stood atop the corpses of countless monsters. The surprising part was the monster he was facing.
‘That’s…!’
It was a monster that Lee Gun was familiar with. Of course, its magical energy and presence differed from the one he knew, but it was unmistakable.
‘That bastard is the monarch of Space-Time, who I saw in the basement of the Devil’s Tower.’
That monarch was the one from whom Lee Gun had extracted EXP through the infinite reset. Sungjae had leveled up thanks to that monster, and Lee Gun had acquired the power of Space.
The monarch of Space-Time spoke to Time.
[You won’t win against the great monarchs, no matter how much you struggle. We are cut from a different cloth.]
It seemed a class system existed amongst the monarchs.
[A cub like you cannot beat us, who have been monarchs from the beginning.]
Time let out a sharp laugh.
[Do not be conceited, old fools. You guys are dim-witted beings that cannot move against time.]
[!]
[You guys are creatures that can live only on a single rail.]
Time disappeared after saying words with unknown meaning.
Lee Gun frowned. Accompanying an enormous flash of light, he watched Time travel across time. While doing so, the monarch conversed with his butler.
[Master! Do you really plan on helping the Constructs of the Divine world usurp the original owners of the Seats of power?]
[Yes. Even if I don’t help them, the usurpation will happen. If I help them in an overt fashion, I’ll be able to acquire some things in exchange.]
[…!]
[It will help in advancing my plan. Moreover, I will be victorious in this timeline.]
As he said those words, the next scene was surprisingly around the time when the current Zodiacs had usurped the original owners.
[I will give you a power that’ll allow you to usurp the original owners of the Seats of power.]
Time grinned as he looked at the Pisces, who was a slave at the time.
[As a price, you have to hand over the corpses of the original owners.]
As the bloody laughter rang out, Lee Gun saw something surprising. It was probably the scene after the current twelve Zodiacs had usurped the original owners of the Seats of power.
After receiving the corpses of the original owners, Time created something. However, it wasn’t like watching the creator make something.
