– In the past, the Serpent Bearer was portrayed as someone who revived the dead. Can it be that the Serpent Bearer Temple is the temple of revival?
– Anyway, this incident has caused the faith that was headed toward the other Zodiacs to be gathered toward Lee Gun!
– This has nothing to do with this incident, but people are lamenting right now.
– They are lamenting?
– Yes! It’s because they thought the young Lee Gun-nim was very cute!
– That is correct! It was an otherworldly level of cuteness! They want to see his younger appearance once again!! No, they want him to live with that appearance forever…!!
– From the rumors, it seemed the power of Time turned him into his younger self. Won’t it be possible to change him once again?
“Ah! What the hell is up with these bastards!!” Lee Gun became angry as he watched the TV. He almost threw the rice soup that he had been eating.
“Do they realize how much I struggled, yet they want me to become small again? Really?”
“P-Please calm down. Everyone is just expressing their thanks toward you, Lee Gun-nim. Of course, you were really cute…”
“What?!”
Lee Gun glared at the government employees next to him.
Yes, he was inside a large rice soup restaurant located within the city. The city was being restored, and not all the monsters had been killed. This was why disciples were given support through meals as they worked on recovery.
Well, Lee Gun avoided doing any of that. “Whatever. Just continue giving me your report.”
“Ah. Yes! The observatories are being restored. The cities around the world were successful in driving the monsters out of the domes. The Zodiac Saints did the heavy lifting there!”
“People from various locations are sending their thanks to Lee Gun-nim…”
“Ah! What the hell? The Zodiac Saints are still alive? They are useless. They should have just died with the monsters.”
“…!”
The government employees realized Lee Gun was still Lee Gun despite being revered. They started to sweat.
“What about the monsters?”
“Ah… Yes! The monsters are still gathered outside the domes. They are still looking for the opportunity to enter the cities.”
“Will we be ok? What if they enter the dome again?”
“We’ll be ok for now. The domes weren’t penetrated through physical force. Yong Yong’s siblings opened it from inside.”
Thanks to people’s faith, the power of the Serpent Bearer temple was rising. The Serpent Bearer temple’s Dome was protecting the world. It was protecting the land of humanity.
‘However, I can’t maintain this for long.’
At most, they would last a month. He would have to exterminate the monsters shortly.
Then there was the last monarch that had invaded earth since he knew his chances were good. Lee Gun had to kill Time and drive out the monsters. That would achieve the eternal victory that humanity was hoping for.
Of course, he would have to prepare for the final battle. He was having this thought when…
[Both your Divine statuses have reached stage 4.]
[Soon, you will no longer be a rookie. You will be a full-fledged Zodiac.]
[Depending on which Divine status you awaken first, you will be able to become either the god of Life or the god of Death. The other one will automatically cease to exist.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘As expected, it wants me to choose one of them.’
However, he believed he would be able to use Life and Death if his expectations panned out.
“I’ll raise their EXP at a similar rate. Maybe I’ll be able to raise both of them to stage 5 at the same time.”
Hearing those words, his affiliate Zodiac spoke up.
[Even the genius thirteenth original owner couldn’t handle the power of Life and Death.]
“What?”
It was Sagittarius.
[The risk of handling both of them was too big. That is why he eventually partitioned and gave them to his Constructs.]
“Really?”
That was the reason Life and Death were given to Yeonwoo and Junwoo, respectively. They were used separately.
[Of course, the power decreased when the Divine statuses were split apart.]
“Their power decreased? How much?”
[Since a stage 5 power was split between two Zodiacs, it was reduced to a power equivalent to stage 3.]
“…!”
This basically meant that the Life and Death used by Yeonwoo and Junwoo weren’t whole.
Lee Gun realized something. Time had acquired the power of the Serpent Bearer through Yeonwoo, yet he was still dissatisfied.
‘That bastard wants a power that is at least stage 5 or above.’
This was why he had failed with Yeonwoo. Well, it didn’t matter.
‘If I want to get rid of Time, I need Death.’
Lee Gun did kill Yong Yong’s siblings using the power of Life stage 3. He used the Creation skill to create all kinds of things to kill them.
‘However, there is no way that’ll work against a monarch.’
Even if Lee Gun created all kinds of growth within Time, Time could immediately reverse them. If Lee Gun were being honest, he didn’t know how he was supposed to kill a time traveler.
‘There must be a way.’
If he was unable to find a way, he would choose to become the god of Death to…
At that moment…
“No!!”
“!”
Lee Gun became surprised when someone suddenly barged through the door. It was Hugo’s voice that he had just heard, and Lee Gun looked surprised to see him.
“Why are you here? Weren’t you supposed to go to the OB/GYN with Miss Jiwoo?”
“What? Jiwoo is hurt somewhere?!”
“No. That isn’t it.”
“What nonsense are you talking about then? Why would we go to the OB/GYN at our age?”
Lee Gun groaned. Hugo seemed to be unaware. Of course, Lee Gun hadn’t been sure himself, so he had told Chun Jiwoo to go to the hospital.
Hugo huffed as he sat down in front of Lee Gun. “Anyway, you shouldn’t choose to become the god of Death!”
“What the hell? Did you read my thoughts?”
“No! It just seems like something you would do!” Hugo fumed as he remained seated in front of Lee Gun.
‘Confusion was aiming for the god of Death.’
Hugo didn’t know why, but there was no way he’d let the monsters get their way. “You have to choose Life at all costs!”
Well, that didn’t matter right now. Hugo let out a bright smile toward Lee Gun, who was grumbling.
“Take this. I picked it up on the way here for you.” Hugo placed something on top of the table. It was Yeonwoo’s soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 305
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Happy Times (1)
Around that time, at Lee Gun’s (the Sagittarius temple) holy ground…
“What?! Mom is pregnant?!”
The Chun siblings were shocked at the unexpected news. It was for no other reason.
“W-We’ll have a younger sibling?”
“Really?”
“Yes. I’m three weeks pregnant.”
Their mouths fell open when they saw Chun Jiwoo act shy like a maiden. The siblings were here at Lee Gun’s (the Sagittarius temple) holy ground to nurse Lee Jaewon and also to listen to reports given by disciples from other temples.
Having a new sibling was something that called for a celebration. They were overjoyed. However…
‘I-I never expected it at this age.’
‘I never expected us to have a younger sibling’
The siblings were twenty years old and sixteen years old, respectively. It would have made more sense that they would welcome a niece or nephew in a couple of years rather than a younger sibling.
“A-Anyway, I’m glad you two are getting along real well…”
“Mom is amazing, but I never expected this from Dad. He’s completely different compared to the old Zodiac.”
Sagittarius, who was a tenant in this holy ground, became sad at Chun Sungjae’s words. He had yet to fix that.
Of course, that had nothing to do with their surprise at the pregnancy news of their parents.
‘I guess it isn’t impossible, but…’
Hugo was a Zodiac Saint, and Chun Jiwoo had always been close to him. This was why she received a lot of divine blessings. In terms of appearance and their body age, both looked to be in their thirties.
They had already looked young, but what happened when they became disciples of the Serpent Bearer temple?
‘Their bodies were rejuvenated. They now look to be in their twenties.’
‘I guess it isn’t odd that they were able to conceive.’
Moreover, it wasn’t just a simple rejuvenation.
‘Dad also received a lot of buffs from Uncle.’
Sagittarius’ junior was dead, but their father was in the opposite situation. His vitality had been boosted.
As if to prove this, Chun Jiwoo squealed in happiness. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Whether it’s a son or a daughter doesn’t matter. The child will become a fanatic of Lee Gun-nim.”
“Yes.”
The Leo disciples, who had come to give a status report to Lee Gun, looked appalled.
Lee Jaewon didn’t pay attention to them as he let out a satisfied smile. Then the Chun siblings ran into a dilemma.
“What will we name it? Did you choose, Mom?”
At Chun Yooha’s question, Chun Jiwoo shook her head in the negative. “I wanted to ask your dad, but I was unable to contact him. It seems he still has unfinished business.”
Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed. “Ah!! I’ll choose the name! The name of the youngest will be Gun-nim! Awesome-Ultra-Super-Duper-Brighter-Than-The-Sun-Lovely-Gun-Nim!”
The Leo disciples choked.
“S-Serpent Bearer Saint-nim. I don’t think that name is possible…”
“That’s right, Young Master. The baby’s name has to be five syllables without the last name.”
“Hey! Lee Jaewon! That’s not the problem?!”
Lee Jaewon didn’t care as he smiled. He was happy because he felt as if an additional member had been added to his family.
In the end, as if the bizarre names weren’t enough, the Chun siblings started bringing names out of this galaxy.
It made the Leo disciples scream.
“Excuse me, Madam? At this rate, your child will be named something weird!”
“Shouldn’t you stop them?”
“Oh my! Aren’t they great names? We do owe a lot to Lee Gun-nim.”
“Really, Madam?”
“Ho ho ho. I’m joking.”
The Leo disciples shook their heads in dismay.
“I’ll just let the father of the household choose the name…”
“That’s good. At the very least, he’ll make a name unrelated to Lee Gun.”
Lee Jaewon laughed in derision. “What are you saying? The risk is the highest with Hugo-nim.”
“What?”
Lee Jaewon sipped his citrus tea as he thought about the past. A resigned look appeared on his face. When Sungjae was born…
“Son! My son was born!”
“Z-Zodiac Saint-nim?”
“Alright! My son’s name will be Gun!!! Chun Lee Gun!”
“Zodiac Saint-nim?!”
Hugo had been happy when Yooha was born, but he had been especially happy when his second was born.
On the next day after Sungjae was born, Hugo had been drinking in an important meeting, but had dashed to the community service center to submit the birth certificate.
“My son’s name is Lee Gun!!”
Of course, Chun Jiwoo agreed with the decision, so Hugo was overjoyed as he submitted the name.
“What? Lee Gun’s name is blocked by law?!”
“Y…Yes…! There is a chance that the name can be misused, so it is temporarily…”
“What about Chun Gun!!!”
“T…That is a bit…”
“Why not!!!”
“P…Please come back tomorrow! You might regret your decision!”
“I won’t regret it!!”
Thanks to the sensible government employee, Sungjae wasn’t thankfully named Gun.
However, the person in question wailed when he heard the story. “Why? Why did they have to block it? Why? My name!! It was the opportunity that would have let me have the same name as Uncle! Whyyyyyy!!!”
“…”
Chun Sungjae pounded the ground as he wailed.
The Leo disciples decided to drop the subject at that point.
At that moment…
“What the hell? It’s quite noisy here.”
“!!”
A familiar face appeared within the Archer Saint’s holy ground.
“Uncle!”
Everyone was surprised by Lee Gun’s appearance. Lee Gun had entered with Goat. Lee Gun had something that looked like some unknown tripe hanging from his shoulder.
“How’s Jaewon doing? Is he ok?”
Lee Jaewon, who was wearing a hospital gown, laughed. “Yes. It’s all thanks to Lee Gun-nim.”
After being healed by Lee Gun, Lee Jaewon had been revived safely. However, some aftereffects were left over from being killed by Confusion.
“Take care of yourself. You won’t be able to use the side that Confusion hit for a while.”
“Yes.”
As expected from the result of a monarch’s attack, Super Regeneration couldn’t heal the aftereffects.
If Lee Gun reached Life stage 5, it was said that there would be no aftereffects.
“Hey, Sungjae. Are you able to make a human?”
Everyone was surprised by Lee Gun’s question.
Chun Sungjae was the most surprised. “Human?”
“What? You are the Zodiac Saint of Life. You acquired the Creation ability. You made my face and various parts to make my clone.”
“??!!”
Chun Sungjae screamed when everyone looked at him. They wanted to know if he had really done such a thing. “I…I’ve never done that…”
“Of course, you did.”
Lee Gun immediately lifted Chun Sungjae and shook him.
“Ahhhk!!”
Numerous goods fell out of Chun Sungjae’s body! They were key chains, looking eerily like Lee Gun.
This included his skin appearance, number of hair, and expression. The key chains also wore the uniforms by each generation that were famous amongst the fans. That wasn’t all.
Something unbelievable fell out of the bag that was made to be used for storage. It was a life-sized Lee Gun figurine, as tall as Lee Gun!
“Ahhhk!!”
No, it wasn’t a figurine.
“Lee Gun-nim?!”
“That’s a human body!!”
Yes, the components making up the figurine were the same as that inside a person. Everyone was shocked.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed when he saw the life-sized body. “Hey, Sungjae. What did you make this with? Did you just imagine it to appear?”
“Uh. That is… If I’m being honest, I plucked out several strands of your hair when you were sleeping, Uncle. I made it from that…!!”
“Hair?”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed at the unexpected word.
Chun Yooha grabbed her brother. “Hey! How can you do such a thing? Of all the things you could do…!”
“Wahhhh, Uncle! I have sinned! I originally planned on making the key chains for missionary work, but when I used the hair, that suddenly came out! I’m sorry. I’ll immediately get rid of—”
“No. You did well.”
“…I did well… What?”
Lee Gun had come here to confirm something. When he touched the life-sized body model, he laughed as if he was satisfied.
“Give me the blueprint that you used to make this, Sungjae. Give it to me even if you don’t have it.”
“What?!!”
“That means you either need DNA or a body part to make a person like this, right?”
Goat immediately realized Lee Gun’s plan. He had heard through Hugo that Lee Gun needed a body for Yeonwoo.
‘Lee Gun-nim is planning on making Yeonwoo-nim’s vessel himself!’
Putting the soul in this vessel than in a paper doll would be much safer and better!
While Chun Sungjae was able to do it through his incredible fandom, Lee Gun was a genius manufacturer. He would sculpt something better than the real thing. He’d make a vessel identical to the actual person. It would be like the Pygmalion effect.
“However, there is nothing of Yeonwoo-nim’s body left…! So how will you do it?”
“No. I have something.”
“!!”
Lee Gun took out Heaven’s Punishment. “Yeonwoo’s bones were used as base material to make Heaven’s Punishment.”
“?!!”
Everyone reared back in shock.
“U-Uncle! You’ll destroy Heaven’s Punishment?!”
“Ah…!!”
“No way!” Lee Gun entered the kitchen and brought back a whetstone. “If Sungjae’s method is correct, I’ll just have to grind it a little.”
“G-Grind it?!”
Lee Gun held the hand ax in its stage 1 form. He started grinding it with his whetstone. Then he used the Creation Workshop’s Dismantle skill! Light exploded forth.
[Heaven’s Punishment feels refreshed when it receives a good scrub.]
[Heaven’s Punishment says it feels very good.]
Lee Gun diligently ground the core too.
[Heaven’s Punishment says that part tickles.]
[Heaven’s Punishment wants you to be a bit gentler.]
Then…
“Alright. I’m done making preparations.”
Lee Gun smirked when he saw the shiny object ground out by the whetstone.
***
“What?! Pregnant?!”
It was 8 o’clock at night. Hugo had an errand to do, so he had come downtown.
His mouth fell open. “D…Did you just say Jiwoo is pregnant? She’s pregnant with our third child?”
– Yes. That’s why you should stop wandering off. Hurry up and come back.
Hugo couldn’t shut his mouth when he received the impatient call from Lee Gun. He didn’t know what to do with himself. He felt as if he had received a gift that was unique to this world.
He couldn’t hide his happiness, and Lee Gun felt it just through Hugo’s voice.
– Are you that happy?
Did it even need to be asked?
“Of course, I’m happy. You saved my subordinates, who are like younger siblings to me. I also got a new lease on life thanks to you.”
Hugo laughed honestly. “If something happens to me, I’ll just have to look for Lee Gun-nim.”
– What? I can’t revive a Divine rank.
“What the hell? Why are you so incompetent?”
– If you don’t want to be beaten up, you should come with a present for Miss Jiwoo. I’m calling you beforehand because you’ll come home empty-handed.
“Yes. I’ll go buy something expensive.”
– Aw! Don’t buy something strange, Dad!
The shouts from the Chun siblings came from the phone.
Lee Gun smirked when Hugo showed signs of going overboard with his purchase.
– Hey. Don’t be so happy. At the end of the day, your third child will be my fan.
“Fuck off! I don’t care if it is a son or daughter. I’ll raise it to follow its father!” Hugo violently ended the call.
Of course, although Hugo spoke that way, he felt truly thankful toward Lee Gun. After Lee Gun died, Hugo had lost a subordinate, who had been like a brother to him. He had also lost his wife, whom he had loved.
He had never thought there would be a reason for him to laugh again.
‘I’ll have to buy Gun a present too.’
Suddenly…
“…kuhk!”
Hugo vomited blood, feeling excruciating pain. An unfamiliar hand pierced through his back to reach his heart.
Shocked, he turned to look backward. The sight left him surprised.
[We meet again.]
Someone who shouldn’t be there had shown up.

chapters.title: Chapter 306
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Happy Times (2)
[We meet again.]
Hugo was shocked by the voice. The being who had appeared behind him to pierce his heart was neither Confusion nor Time.
“H-How…!”
A young man who looked to be in his late twenties stood behind Hugo. He wasn’t human, nor was he a monster.
‘God!’
Yes. The one to appear was none other than a Zodiac! Moreover, he was someone who should never exist in this place!
‘Thirteenth original owner?!’
Hugo was sure of it. It was the man praised as the top genius in the Divine world and also called the genius manufacturer.
Hugo had seen this handsome man wearing the same clothes as he was currently in a vision. Of course, this was unlike the vision where he had watched the thirteenth original owner get murdered. The current one was vivid.
Unlike Lee Gun, he had a gentle face, but cold red eyes flashing between his hair like Lee Gun.
This shocked Hugo.
‘How can someone murdered by the Zodiacs be here…?!’
However, that wasn’t the most shocking part.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
After shoving his hand through someone else’s chest, the thirteenth owner retracted his hand.
Hugo groaned as he expected the pain of his heart being ripped free. He started to fall.
“Uh?”
However, there was no pain at all. That wasn’t all.
“What the hell? Why is my heart unscathed?” Hugo looked confused as he felt his body. There was no trace of it being pierced. It made him wonder if he had a vision of his chest being pierced.
[Alright. That’ll do.]
“…!”
The thirteenth original owner let out a meaningful smile as he leisurely dusted off his hand. Moreover, it was clear that Hugo’s blood was falling from his hand!
Hugo clutched at his chest as he screamed. “What the hell? That bastard did pierce my body!!”
So why was he unharmed? In fact, he was better than ok. He felt an odd power emanate from his body.
The thirteenth original owner let out a bright smile in response.
[Hey, now. Aren’t we acquaintances?]
“Nope. Not at all.”
When Hugo said it with a straight face, the thirteenth original owner looked very sad about it.
[My god! We’ve met each other every day for the past twenty-four years. It is unbelievable that you can’t recognize me.]
“We met every day for the past twenty-four years? What nonsense—”
Hugo’s eyes turned round. The reason was the familiar voice he heard.
[Warning! Let’s put aside the fact that you don’t know we’ve met. Do you still not recognize me?]
[Do you still not know who I am after hearing the notification?]
“…?!” Hugo almost screamed when he heard the familiar voice of a woman. “N-No way. The notification…!”
[Yes. Anyone affiliated with the Serpent Bearer temple hears my voice.]
“?!”
[Of course, the only ones I speak directly to are you and the new Serpent Bearer.]
“…?!” Hugo was confused.
The voice he had heard after entering the Serpent Bearer temple was him? His voice is the one that Lee Gun said he always heard?
No, he had something to clear up before that.
“Why did you use a woman’s voice!?”
[It’s cuter]
“Hey!!!”
When Hugo became angry, the thirteenth original owner clicked his tongue since his joke wasn’t working.
[You might be the exception, but do you think he would follow the orders of an ill-humored male voice?]
Hugo burst out laughing. “What? It isn’t as if Gun would listen more attentively because it’s the voice of a woman.”
That wasn’t in Lee Gun’s nature….
However, Hugo’s mouth fell open when he realized something. “Y-You used Miss Yeonwoo’s voice?”
[I lowered the voice a bit, so Lee Gun didn’t notice it.]
The thirteenth original owner laughed as if he was having fun. On the other hand, Hugo furrowed his brow. That wasn’t important right now.
“Why is someone who is supposed to be dead here?”
[!]
Hugo was unconvinced. It was understandable since the original owners had been murdered by the Zodiacs and their bodies were used for other purposes.
A subtle change occurred to the thirteenth original owner’s expression.
Hugo’s eyes turned cold at this. “Are you still alive?”
In response, the thirteenth original owner immediately sent his fist toward Hugo’s face.
‘!’
Hugo was surprised.
‘This is crazy. He’s as fast as Gun?!’
He didn’t look like a fighter, yet he was an expert! Hugo couldn’t even pick up the hand movement!
Hugo thought he would be sent flying, but he merely blinked.
“…!!”
The thirteenth owner was like a ghost. His fist passed through Hugo’s face. Then, the thirteenth owner smirked in a light-hearted manner.
[I’m already dead. This is merely my afterimage.]
“Then…!”
[Before I died, I secretly put my power into the Divine statuses of the Serpent Bearer. If certain requirements were fulfilled, I would be able to awaken.]
In other words, he wasn’t in his normal state. This took Hugo aback. “Why would you do such a thing? Was it for revenge?”
[No. It was all done since I knew what would happen to Lee Gun.]
“…??”
Lee Gun? Why would Gun’s name suddenly be mentioned here?
Hugo looked suspicious, but the thirteenth ignored him as he spoke.
[Anyway, you’re going to die in your current state. That’s why I came to you.]
“W…What?”
[Wouldn’t it be bad to leave behind your wife and children after suffering an early death?]
Why the hell was this bastard suddenly putting a death sentence on him?
Hugo was baffled, but the other being was the previous Serpent Bearer. So Hugo pushed down his anger and tried to keep his manners. “Understood. I’m in danger of being killed, and that’s why you appeared to help—”
[Nope.]
“What?”
[You have to die.]
“What?!!”
[Ah! My mistake. I meant to say I can’t revive you.]
“…???”
Hugo was dumbfounded.
‘They are the same.’
The thirteenth had a psychotic personality that liked humiliating other people. It was just like Hugo’s friend. Therefore, Hugo asked, “What’s your relationship to Gun?”
The thirteenth was silent for a brief moment. It seemed he was reluctant to reveal the truth. However, the expression on his face indicated that he had decided it was time to reveal his relationship to Lee Gun.
“Hello?”
[I am Lee Gun’s amazing papa.]
“What?”
[Lee Gun’s cool daddy.]
“…what??”
[Father.]
Hugo’s mouth fell open when the thirteenth looked annoyed. He had thought they looked alike, but…!
“Father?!”
The thirteenth no longer pouted as he looked worryingly toward Hugo.
[At this rate, you and Lee Gun will die. No, the entire humanity will die.]
“…what?”
While Hugo wondered what he was talking about, the thirteenth approached Hugo.
[Anyway, I was able to change into this form thanks to you awakening as a Construct. However, I am merely an afterimage.]
Hugo tilted his head in confusion. He was able to change into that form?
Soon, the thirteenth looked at Hugo with a bit of sadness in his eyes.
[I cannot prevent you guys from dying.]
“…!”
The thirteenth furrowed his brow.
[Humanity will be wiped out, and Lee Gun will die at the hands of Confusion and the time traveler.]
Hugo was surprised. When he said time traveler, the thirteenth was referring to the Time monarch. However, the more shocking statement wasn’t that.
[Lee Gun will be gone before he even gets to fight.]
“?!”
[Lee Gun exists in only this timeline. In other words, Lee Gun will disappear once and for all when the time traveler returns in time once again.]
“…!!”
This was Lee Gun’s weakness, and it seemed the thirteenth was very guarded about Time.
[The unwanted guest wants my son’s stage 5 power of Death.]
“!”
[He wants to use the power of Cycle, and he’ll kill Gun as soon as he acquires Death.]
“When you say Cycle…”
[It’s a troublesome power that even I didn’t use. However, using it is possible with Gun’s power. It’s a way that will let everyone survive. I would like your help, but I’m fine if you don’t want to help.]
Hugo was surprised. “I’m not saying I don’t want to…!”
[Is that so?]
The thirteenth laughed. He was about to say something, but he soon sighed. It seemed the time left to him was almost up.
[My child! This will hurt a little, but please endure it.]
“What? What do you mean by it’ll hurt—”
Then…
“Kuh-uhk!”
Hugo could no longer speak. An attack had come flying from his back and pierced through his stomach.
However, the one who attacked him this time wasn’t the thirteenth.
“Ah! I finally found you.”
“…!!!!”
The voice that he heard was none other than Confusion’s! Moreover, the monarch didn’t look like his normal self.
‘Monarch…!’
Half of his body was human, but the rest was that of a monarch.
Hugo vomited blood. The thirteenth’s soul was long gone. The only thing left was his voice.
[Do not be afraid. The blessing of the Serpent Bearer is with you.]
“…!”
[Well, it has been a very long time since I used it. It can’t be helped if it doesn’t work.]
“?!”
The energy of the thirteenth disappeared after speaking those clueless words.
Confusion didn’t pick up on the thirteenth’s presence. He let out a menacing laugh as he looked at Hugo.
Confusion had modified his plans and decided to aim for Hugo. “If I kill you, I’m sure Lee Gun will advance to stage 5, right?”
Hugo glared as he clutched at his stomach.
* * *
It was nine at night…
The restoration of the city was somewhat coming to an end, so everyone was getting ready for a dinner party.
Before the next day’s meeting on what they had to do, they were having a party to celebrate a new life. It was also to celebrate Hugo’s birthday.
“Hugo-nim is a bit late. He said he’ll be here soon.”
Lee Jaewon looked at his watch, worried about Hugo. He had tried contacting Hugo, but had been unable to contact him.
“I wonder if something happened.”
Lee Gun, who had been making a present for the baby, furrowed his brows when he heard those words. If something happened to Hugo, he wouldn’t even need the system. He would immediately know by feeling Hugo’s presence.
However, something was bothering him; something kept interfering with him.
On the other hand, he trusted Hugo’s skills. Although he might nag Hugo, Hugo was his best and most trustworthy partner in terms of fighting ability and the ability to assess a situation.
‘I doubt something would happen to him, but…’
Since he acknowledged Hugo’s skill, him going to look for Hugo could be a nuisance. However, Lee Gun soon got up from his seat.
‘He’s making Miss Jiwoo and his kids wait.’
Ding dong!
“!”
The doorbell rang, and everyone’s expression changed.
“Hugo-nim must be here!”
They quickly headed toward the front door.
“Really, Dad. Why are you so late…”
However, they were surprised when they opened the door.
“It’s a quick delivery!”
“Quick delivery?”
“Yes. It’s an item sent by Hugo Otis-nim.”
Everyone’s eyes turned round when they saw the present sent through the delivery.
“What did Hugo-nim send?”
However, they soon laughed brightly. Then they looked at Chun Jiwoo.
“Hugo-nim said he was going to buy presents. It seems he sent them ahead of him.”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “He must have overdone it. Even the box is high quality.”
Chun Jiwoo laughed as she walked toward him with the box. “I believe this isn’t for me. It’s for Lee Gun-nim.”
“Me?”
Lee Gun, who had been making a present for the baby, furrowed his brows. However, it didn’t take him long to act as if he knew what Hugo was aiming for. “He probably wants me to check it first.”
When Lee Gun laughed, the youngest Archer disciple let out a shout.
“Hurry up and open it, Jiwoo-nim!”
“Hear, hear!”
Everyone laughed at those words as they placed the present on top of the dining table.
“What did Dad send?”
“Hurry up and open it.”
“He didn’t have to send such a thing.” Chun Jiwoo acted shy as she opened the box.
Everyone looked at her with anticipation in their eyes.
“Ah!”
What did she see? When she opened the lid of the box, her complexion changed.
When her hands started to shake, the Chun siblings looked at her with worry in their eyes.
“Mom? What’s wrong?”
“Did Dad send something strange in poor taste?”
Chun Jiwoo couldn’t answer them. She lost grip on the present box.
Koohng!
The Chun siblings and the disciples turned deathly pale when they saw what came out of the box.
“D-Dad!!”
Lee Gun’s face hardened when he saw what rolled out of the present box. It was something sent by a monarch.
– It’s my present for you.
Then, the sound of his rational mind breaking could be heard.
[You have awakened stage 6 of Death.]
[You have satisfied the requirement.]

chapters.title: Chapter 307
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Death Stage 6 (1)
Hugo ground his teeth. Confusion had appeared behind him. However, the power that the monarch gave off was on a different level than before.
‘Did he make some kind of deal with Time?’
Time had taken Confusion back last time, and Time was also the one who had trapped him within a human body.
It was reasonable to assume that Time would be able to release some of that power.
Hugo immediately activated his magical energy. “Koo-oohk…!”
However, as if a hole had been closed, he couldn’t use his magical energy. The reason was simple.
‘That bastard…!’
It was the same as when Confusion had killed Hugo’s subordinates. Confusion had cut off Hugo’s connection to his Zodiac. That wasn’t all.
“You better drop any hope of receiving outside help.”
The monarch’s power surrounded the region. It was the power of confusion acting as a barrier! Of course, it wasn’t a normal barrier.
“Alright. We just have to repair that intersection over there, and we’re done!”
“There will be a meeting tomorrow. We’ll get to see Lee Gun-nim in real life!”
It was in the middle of downtown. The repair job was in full swing, so a lot of disciples were moving about.
The civilians didn’t realize that Hugo was there.
“We are fortunate since Lee Gun-nim took care of the calamities.”
“Isn’t he basically the only Zodiac who we should serve?”
“I’m sure the other temples will move under the Serpent Bearer temple. I’m sure that’s what will happen tomorrow.”
“We just have to get rid of the two monarchs. The idea of us reclaiming our lands is no longer a far-fetched dream!”
It wasn’t just that they didn’t notice Hugo. People walked past him as if he were a hologram or a ghost. They also walked through him.
Hugo gnashed his teeth.
‘Did he erase my existence from the world?’
He soon laughed in derision.
‘Everyone will quickly realize what happened if they can’t contact me.’
Therefore, Hugo took out his bow, but his face soon froze.
“Kyaa! Hugo-nim! Please sign this!”
“…?!!”
A double was not far away from himself. What did that imply?
As expected, Confusion grinned at the deathly pale Hugo. “That’s your dummy. With it, no one will realize you’re in danger.”
“Bastard!”
No one would realize what was happening to Hugo, even if he was killed right now. However, a voice rang at that moment.
[The notification says to trust the Serpent Bearer.]
Why the hell did he expect his trust? Hugo said in his mind, “Fuck off unless you’re talking about Gun! If you have time to do this, contact the others!”
[The notification says that would be impossible.]
[In the first place, Hugo Otis is destined to die this year.]
“What did you just say!?”
[It doesn’t matter if it was the last cycle or the cycle before that. By the year 2025, Time will have eaten all the Zodiac Saints.]
“…!” Hugo bit his tongue.
Lee Gun had told him this after seeing Time’s past. Time kept returning to the past, and it always ended up in Time consuming all Zodiac Saints and Zodiacs. He would become the great monarch en route to destroying humanity.
[Hugo Otis always dies in the most trivial manner.]
[In the 187th cycle, Hugo Otis died when he was walking down the street. He fell through a manhole.]
[In the 197th cycle, he was eating tteokbokki[1] when he choked on it and died.]
[In the 198th cycle, he died while taking a dump.]
[Anyway, Hugo Otis always dies in the most trivial manner/]
“Damn it! You don’t have to tell me such things!!” Hugo became angry.
‘Like father, like son. Both of them are the same in having the ability to upset me!’
“If I think about it, Gun’s cheat-like abilities are all thanks to genetics? He was born in a cradle of gold?”
[The notification feels offended. His son is not like him. His son is nothing compared to him.]
Was this person telling the truth? Moreover, this Zodiac felt oddly similar to Sagittarius. It was as if they were brothers.
‘Are all Zodiacs stubborn like this?’
As though it had read his thoughts, the notification became upset.
[The notification grumbles that his son’s fighting ability is superior compared to his.]
[Moreover, his genetics is set up in a way where his manufacturing ability and fighting ability couldn’t be transferred to Lee Gun.]
Hugo furrowed his brows at those words.
‘Gun being a human means this person had a relationship with a human.’
In the previous timelines, the Serpent Bearer temple had never appeared in front of humanity. This made sense since the Serpent Bearer temple was able to appear in front of humanity only when Yeonwoo passed on her Divine status to Lee Gun.
In the previous timelines, Yeonwoo had been killed by Time before she could do any of that.
‘Only the timeline with Lee Gun present is different.’
Of course, that wasn’t important right now.
“I’m sure even Lee Gun can’t revive a Divine-rank, but I’ll just make sure by ripping apart your soul.”
“!”
Confusion smirked as he approached Hugo. Due to his power, Hugo became unable to hear the thirteenth’s notification.
Boom!!
“!!”
At that moment, the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer surged forth within Hugo’s body, surprising Confusion.
‘Their connection was severed, yet he can still use the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer temple?’
It didn’t matter if one was a human disciple or a Construct. Using one’s abilities was hard once the connection to one’s Zodiac’s power was severed.
Of course, there were the occasional exceptions. Some beings were talented.
‘It isn’t as if he received a Divine status amassed with internal force.’
Hugo Otis possessed a brand new Divine status, so there was no way it could be powerful. So what the hell was this?
Confusion gnashed his teeth as he continued to dodge the attack. He finally understood what was going on.
‘Is that bastard not receiving magical energy from the Serpent Bearer? Is he generating his own?!’
That made no sense. However, Confusion soon realized the reason.
‘Shit! He has 600% faith!!’
As Lee Gun grew the number of disciples under him, Hugo became worried about Lee Gun. A Zodiac had to distribute one’s magical energy to the disciples.
Hugo knew this would cause a great burden to Lee Gun. It was why he didn’t want to enter the Serpent Bearer temple in the first place.
‘Is that the reason he is generating his own magical energy…!’
Confusion had guessed correctly.
[Self-Powered Generator (SSS)]
– A skill born from the desire of not wanting to burden the Zodiac.
– Stamina is consumed to self-generate magical energy.
– The generated magical energy can be given to others.
– Possible to use only when faith is over 500%.
Confusion let out a forced laugh. Normally, disciples and gods developed new skills and abilities according to their disposition. This was also true for Hugo Otis, who received a new Divine status.
The problem was that he possessed a faith that was considered an anomaly even amongst the gods.
‘He’s an anomaly that possesses the most faith in the Divine world.’
The odds of something weird happening increased as faith increased. Moreover, that bastard was someone who had revived a person eaten by Oblivion!
Anything was possible!
“Koo-oohk!”
Confusion ground his teeth as he felt his magical energy drain. “That mutant is really doing this!”
The monarch glared at Hugo, realizing that the man was stealing his magical energy.
It seemed Hugo’s stamina couldn’t be used to self-generate magical energy, so Hugo was stealing magical energy from Confusion. The magical energy was being used for power generation!
In truth, the skill Self-Powered Generator (SSS) possessed another ability.
[Opponent’s magical energy can be taken and changed in your own magical energy.]
The opponent’s magical energy could also be used as a driving force to self-generate power.
This left Confusion dumbfounded.
‘It’s an ability that other Zodiacs would covet!’
Hugo laughed after he was able to steal the magical energy of a monarch. “That’s unexpected. My faith actually helped me!” Then, his eyes flashed as he was about to charge toward Confusion.
However, Confusion suddenly started laughing. “Yes. Let’s see you die from having that high faith.”
“…!”
Hugo immediately vomited blood. It wasn’t without reason.
‘It’s a curse.’
Confusion laughed as he approached Hugo. “Monarchs are the natural enemies of the gods. We eat them. Did you think I would be in a bind because you entered the divine rank?”
“…!”
Moreover, Confusion was a monarch that accompanied Time. He had experienced the past tens of thousands of times.
All kinds of techniques were made through experimentation.
“You’re merely a rookie.”
Hugo felt his head being pressed downward. An unseen power was pressing down on him. However, that wasn’t the problem.
“…!”
He couldn’t breathe and felt as if he were paralyzed from head to toe. This was one of the precious abilities that allowed Confusion to bring the gods to their knees.
“This single ability brought down all kinds of high-rank gods. You should feel honored since you forced me to use it on you.”
Hugo tried to glare at him as if to ask if he had lost his mind. However, he felt like dying from pain.
Confusion laughed sympathetically. “The more faith you possess, the more pain you will feel. The more power will be taken. High-rank Constructs with 90% faith begged for their lives in front of this skill. I can’t imagine what kind of pain you’re feeling with 600% faith.”
Hugo felt like his head and body were about to break from the pain. He screamed. “Ahhk!”
Death was preferable to this pain.
Confusion laughed in satisfaction as he presented something to Hugo. “However, I’ll give you an opportunity.”
“!”
Confusion brought forth a strange gem. “If you use this, your faith will fall to 0%. You will be freed from all the pain.”
“…!”
Hugo ground his teeth. Confusion was acting benevolent, but Hugo knew that wasn’t the case.
‘This bastard is trying to harm the Zodiac.’
If a Construct betrayed the Zodiac, the backlash to the Zodiac was enormous. At 0% faith, it would be like planting a knife in the Zodiac’s back.
Just the mere act of turning a faith of 99% to 0% would put a Zodiac in critical condition. So what would happen to Lee Gun if a faith of 600% went to 0%?
Hugo couldn’t even imagine.
“It will allow you to escape the pain. You will be freed from it.”
“Fuck off! You have no intention of letting me free.”
Confusion laughed coldly. “Oops! You got me.”
Then, Confusion immediately pierced Hugo’s heart.
Poohk!!
As if to make things worse, he stabbed the same place as where the thirteenth had.
“Kuhk…!”
Hugo clenched his fists, feeling excruciating pain. Of course, he wasn’t afraid to die.
The thirteenth original owner had told him to trust the blessing of the Serpent Bearer. This was why Hugo was worried about Lee Gun instead of himself.
‘I’m pretty sure this bastard is trying to make Gun lose his mind after killing me.’
Confusion planned on aggravating Lee Gun’s anger to grow Death. He wanted to turn Lee Gun into the god of Death.
Hugo suddenly recalled something. It had happened around twenty years ago.
– You are an asshole, Lee Gun. I almost died, yet you weren’t even worried about me!!! How could you not even visit me at the hospital? Will you show concern and cry for me when I die?!
– What the hell? I’ll have a barbeque party at your funeral. Of course, I’ll be sure to collect the condolence money.
– Wow! What the hell do you consider your friend to be?
At the time, Hugo considered Lee Gun to be an asshole who didn’t care about his friend. However, Hugo had a wish right now. He wished he didn’t have any special meaning to Lee Gun.The reason was that Death was an ominous power from the beginning, and it was a power sought out by a monarch. There was no way it would be good for Lee Gun.
Poo-hahk!
Confusion pulled back the hand that pierced Hugo’s heart, and Hugo’s vision became blurry. This was beyond a simple death. He felt as if his soul was being ripped away, as though he was going to a place that he wouldn’t be able to return from.
At that moment, Hugo thought he saw the light of the Serpent Bearer while his consciousness faded away.
[You did well. Sleep for a bit.]
That was what he thought he had heard.
* * *
Lee Gun looked at the familiar object that fell out of the present box. He immediately realized this was the doing of a monarch.
With the words written inside the box and the evil energy infused within the body part that had fallen out, he knew it at once.
Chun Jiwoo fainted, and everyone started to scream.
At the same time, Lee Gun felt uncontrollable killing intent.
[You have awakened stage 6 of Death.]
[You have satisfied the requirement.]
[Cycle!]
Accompanying the notification, a never-before-seen chaotic magical energy surged forth.
Kwahng!!!
The black magical energy surged into the sky. The sky started to change as if it was portending a calamity.
Koo-goong!
After sending Chun Jiwoo the present, Confusion was monitoring the situation from nearby. He was happy as he laughed. “Ha ha ha! I was hopeful, but it really did go straight to stage 6! It is stage 6!”
Confusion was ecstatic at the current situation. Time had said Death stage 6 was too troublesome, so he should stick to the awakening stage. Confusion didn’t care about that.
‘It’s a power strong enough to make that bastard say such words.’
This meant it was a power that Time feared.
Confusion felt a thrill as he sensed the vast power stretch into the surroundings. “Ha ha ha!! This is a power superior to that of a great monarch! This will do! I’ll gladly use it! Kill all of humanity, God of calamity!”
Boom!
Confusion flinched when he heard the sound of a large object falling. At that moment, Confusion felt something. He had a feeling that something was wrong.
1. Tteokbokki, or simmered rice cake, is a popular Korean food made from small-sized long, white, and cylinder-shaped rice cakes called tteokmyeon or commonly tteokbokki-tteok. ☜

chapters.title: Chapter 308
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Death Stage 6 (2)
<Divine Status Stage 6>
It was a stage of Divine status that shouldn’t exist. Stages of a Divine status were like levels, and the final stage that the gods could awaken was stage 5.
Normal gods possessed Divine status stage 3, and the highest was stage 4.
Amongst the countless gods, only the ones called high-rank gods reached stage 5. They were candidates to become the Great Zodiacs.
While stage 6 was powerful, it was an unnatural and uncontrollable level. It was commonly designated as the Demonification stage, which was impossible to control.
At this stage, character and control didn’t matter. One moved on instinct like a monster, unable to differentiate between allies and enemies.
Confusion wanted to use this for his own end. Of course, he wasn’t afraid of facing the stage 6 power. Why?
‘I can avoid that power.’
His power was called Confusion for a reason. It could make people’s perception of him fall, allowing him to dodge attacks.
So Confusion laughed.
‘Kill them all. Kill all of humanity and Time!’
Both of their powers would become his! Naturally, Confusion didn’t even need to worry about how to get rid of the out-of-control Lee Gun.
‘Once he entered stage 6, it was game over for him.’
If Lee Gun were left alone, he would lose to his own power. He would self-destruct.
‘At most, he’ll be alive for four days.’
That was the final fate of a berserk god. There was a reason Confusion was so knowledgeable about this.
‘Monarchs and Zodiacs resemble each other.’
The reason behind it was unknown. While monarchs and Zodiacs were mortal enemies, they were unusually similar at a basic level. It was as if they had originated from the same place.
‘Anyway, once, a great monarch moved past stage 5 to reach stage 6. He died.’
No one knew this, but Confusion had witnessed the death by chance. Since he had no rational thoughts, Confusion’s power had worked well on him.
This was why Confusion’s head was full of thoughts of using his power against Lee Gun. That was what was supposed to happen.
‘Shit! What’s going on?’
Confusion stood on top of the bridge located in the Han River Park. He was observing the Lee Gun Tower when he realized something was terribly wrong.
‘Lee Gun’s hostility is directed toward me?’
Lee Gun should have no capacity for rational thought. One of Confusion’s subordinates was beside him, and he also felt the hostile energy. The subordinate furrowed his brows.
[Master, something is off. We might be in danger at this rate…]
“No. We’ll be fine.”
[Are you sure?]
Confusion used his ability more strongly as he smirked. “My power will make sure his power avoids us.”
[Then…!]
“Also, he cannot differentiate between friends and foes in his current state. It’ll be quicker for him to kill the disciples near him rather than to come after us—”
Boom!!
[Kuh-huhk!!]
“…!!!”
The subordinate’s head exploded, and the blood drained out of Confusion’s face.
* * *
Around that time, within Lee Gun’s tower…
Koo-goong!!
The enormous raging power made Chun Sungjae and the Archer disciples tremble. They couldn’t even move their mouths. No, they couldn’t even breathe.
Since the black magical energy surrounded Lee Gun, they couldn’t see him clearly. However, it was clear that his appearance had changed from normal.
‘He doesn’t look human…!’
The disciples, who were in hiding, shook in fear. This was the power of Death!
‘Can it be stage 6?’
Chun Sungjae could feel Lee Gun’s anger. He trembled as he supported his sister. Chun Yooha was the Zodiac Saint of Death, so she was receiving the power of Death from Lee Gun.
“Koo-oohk…!”
The power of Death had become excessively strong, and so, breathing had become hard for her. This was a domain that a human could never endure.
It was at this moment when Lee Gun discovered them.
“…!!!”
Having stepped into stage 6 of Death, Lee Gun approached them.
Chun Sungjae, who was propping up his sister and mother, unconsciously trembled. The person before him was Lee Gun, but he was frightening. Moreover, Sungjae felt it on instinct.
‘We’ll get slaughtered.’
The young man clenched his eyes shut when Lee Gun extended his hand toward them.
“Sungjae.”
“…!”
Lee Gun’s hand unexpectedly stroked Chun Sungjae’s head. “I want you to stay here and take care of Miss Jiwoo.”
“U-Uncle?”
“I’ll be back in no time.” After turning around, Lee Gun flicked his finger.
Lime, who had been stuck to the leg of the dining table, picked up on the cue. It swallowed the object that had fallen out of the present box. That object was none other than a decapitated head.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he walked toward the door.
When Lee Gun exited the holy ground, Confusion shook all over.
‘That bastard Lee Gun…!!’
Lee Gun’s energy was on a different level compared to when he was inside the building. The energy surged into the sky. That wasn’t all.
‘That bastard is coming here!’
The monarch was sure of it. This was supposed to be stage 6, where Lee Gun shouldn’t be able to differentiate between friends and foes! Yet, Lee Gun was coming straight for him.
Confusion quickly got up from his seat.
At the same time, he remembered what Time had said before. It was a conversation from a very long time ago.
– What? The reason you stole the soul of the Serpent Bearer is to use the Cycle ability?
– Yes. It’s an existence that always accompanies life and death. This is why both Life and Death have to be used at the same time to use the Cycle ability.
– What? One of the Serpent Bearer’s two abilities disappears eventually, yet you’re saying both Life and Death have to be used? That’s nonsense…
– Yes. The original owner transferred Life and Death respectively to the Constructs that he raised. Cycle was used through them.
– That means…!
– I have Life.
Time had returned to the past multiple times and acquired Yeonwoo’s soul. Of course, both Yeonwoo and Junwoo were always at either stage 3 or stage 4. It wasn’t to Time’s liking, but what if that soul was compressed tens of thousands of times?
– If I combine all the souls we’ve collected, we’ll be able to generate a power on par with stage 5.
– !
This was why every time they went back in time, they had been tenacious in killing Yeonwoo.
Like the thirteenth original owner, they wanted to use each of the two powers, which had been separated.
The soul of Junwoo, who had been in charge of the Divine status of Death, had also been taken, but it didn’t matter since Lee Gun had shown up. This round was different.
– Lee Gun will be able to grow Death into stage 5.
Time was able to use Cycle with the souls of Yeonwoo and Junwoo, but he had failed to achieve his goal.
So he had changed his plan. Time wanted Lee Gun to reach stage 5. He planned on stealing the Divine status once Lee Gun became the God of Death. Then, he would be able to use the true power of Cycle.
– However, stage 6 must never happen. That’ll be too troublesome.
It was why Confusion had tried to make Lee Gun reach stage 6 despite ignoring the deal he made with Time. He wanted to foil Time’s plan.
‘Shit! How is he able to keep his rational thoughts!!’
Confusion had no choice.
‘I have to get out of here for now.’
Confusion thought about leaving the earth, but…
“Kuh-huhk!!!”
Just as Confusion was about to run away, he fell from the bridge. A black beam of light had traveled from afar and pierced through him. That wasn’t all.
“Ahhhhhk!!!”
The monarch screamed as he fell from the bridge. Black smoke surrounded his leg, and the leg instantly disappeared.
The pain was unimaginable. In the end, Confusion glared forward as he raised his head. Then he shook in fear.
‘That bastard…!’
Lee Gun was coming from the inland. He was walking toward the monarch on top of the river. Moreover, Lee Gun possessed an inhuman chaotic energy!
Desperate, Confusion tried to run away, but it was useless.
“Ahhhk!!”
Every time he tried to run away, the black energy took a body part. It took his remaining leg, fingers, then arms! It ate him away like mad.
“Ahhhk!!”
This was why he slowly moved toward land. He called for his subordinates as he ran away, but that was useless.
Kwah-jeek!!!
When his subordinates were about to appear, the power of Death wiped them out. Death at stage 6 was beyond imagination.
“Give me the rest.”
“…!”
When Confusion reached land, his heart almost stopped. A demonic god was standing above his fallen self. This being’s form couldn’t be seen clearly because of the black energy, but it wasn’t the form of a human.
Lee Gun spoke. “You have it, right? Taeksoo’s body.”
The bloodied Confusion smirked.
‘Now I know why…!!’
He now knew why Lee Gun was able to keep his rational thoughts after reaching stage 6 and how he was preventing himself from going berserk.
‘Yes. He thinks he can bring his friend back to life.’
Lee Gun was using his perseverance to keep himself in control. It was hanging on by a thread.
This impressed Confusion.
‘Scary bastard!’
He was suppressing stage 6 through sheer will.
Confusion laughed.
‘It’s still like a glass house that’s close to being broken. It’s tenuous.’
It seemed all his focus was needed to control Death. Lee Gun wasn’t able to make any large movements. Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “Give it to me.”
“Alright. I’ll return it to you.” When Confusion made a gesture with his hand, a gate appeared in the sky, and a familiar body dropped out of it. It was a headless body of a human. However, the body was wearing Hugo’s clothes.
Lee Gun moved toward where the body had fallen. It seemed Lee Gun was still being patient. He planned on getting rid of Confusion after acquiring Hugo’s body. However, just as Lee Gun was about to take the body…
“Try reviving this, idiot!”
Pahng!!!
“!”
Confusion destroyed Hugo’s body in front of Lee Gun’s eyes.
Lee Gun lost his tenuous hold on his anger.
Kwahng!
The power of Death, which he had been suppressing, spread in all directions. The indiscriminate power that destroyed life tried to cover the entire world.
Confusion burst out laughing. “Yes! I never expected you to be able to control it to this extent. Did you think I’ll die by myself?! You have already reached stage 6 of Death, and Life is gone!”
Lee Gun glared at Confusion. The terrifying power of Death was about to run amok.
“!”
However, Lime suddenly jumped out of Lee Gun’s pocket. It grew its body and swallowed Lee Gun.
Lee Gun groaned after he was swallowed into a strange dimensional pocket. Something hard flew toward his head. It was Hugo’s head, which Lime had swallowed. Then he heard the notification, which he hadn’t been able to hear until now.
[Clump of Creation Clay says to check the object properly.]
Lee Gun flinched when he touched Hugo’s head. When he used the Dismantle skill, something surprising happened.
Kwah-jeek!!
Hugo’s head turned into clay as it dispersed.
“…!”
Someone had made a fake. It was good enough to fool Lee Gun.
Then, something unexpected appeared within the black space inside Lime’s body. It was Hugo’s intact body. Although its heart was pierced, the body was clean. That wasn’t all.
As soon as Lee Gun looked at the real body, information popped up before him.
[Construct: Pushover]
[Location of Soul: Underworld]
[Can be revived with Life stage 5]
Lee Gun relaxed when he saw this, but he soon furrowed his brows. It mentioned Life?
Wasn’t Life gone when Death reached stage 6?
‘It was said the other Divine status disappears once one reaches stage 5…’
[Life has fainted because of Death upgrading to stage 6. It asks you to save it.]
[Life says it feels like it’ll get swallowed up by Death at any moment.]
Lee Gun was surprised. It seemed Life was still around. He was wondering what had happened when he heard the notification.
[Stage 6 is an abnormal berserk state.]
[You haven’t been assigned as a complete god. Your other Divine status hasn’t disappeared.]
It was said that the other Divine status disappeared if one reached stage 5. But nothing was stated on what would happen if the Divine status reached stage 6. That didn’t matter right now.
[Life is about to disappear soon.]
Lee Gun’s eyes dilated.
‘I have to save it.’
At that moment, Confusion shook. He was outside of the slime.
‘What the hell…!’
The slime had suddenly swallowed Lee Gun, so Confusion tried to run away. However, the current situation was moving in an odd direction.
“Death is being held back?!”
No, this felt different from the Divine status being held back. It was as if something new was being born.
A never-seen-before light emanated from within the slime.
Confusion finally realized something was really wrong and tried to leave.
Kwah-jeek!
“!!”
However, Lee Gun’s hand appeared out of the slime’s mouth and grabbed Confusion’s head.
“…!”
Then Lee Gun exited from the slime.
At that moment, Confusion instinctively knew he was dead. Confusion’s consciousness started to fade as the strange power surrounded him. The power felt similar to Time’s, but this power was a stronger power that one couldn’t go against.
[Death stage 6 is starting to fuse with Life stage 4.]
[The power of Cycle is being used.]

chapters.title: Chapter 309
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Death Stage 6 (3)
[Death stage 6 is starting to fuse with Life stage 4.]
[The power of Cycle is being used.]
A strange light explored Confusion’s body. It was a power no one could defy.
However, Confusion immediately recognized that power. It was a power that Time had wanted at all costs!
This left Confusion dumbfounded. “Damn it! He was able to awaken the power of Cycle?!”
Lee Gun was clearly using the power of Cycle! Of course, Time had always used it when he acquired the souls of Yeonwoo and Junwoo.
‘It’s on a different level compared to what Time used.’
Confusion had no idea why Time wanted the power of Cycle so much. The only certainty was that it was a powerful ability capable of destroying great monarchs!
However, Time had never been satisfied even after acquiring so much power. He kept returning to the past over and over again!
As the younger brother of Time, Confusion also enjoyed the endless return to the past, but it was maddening.
‘I always wondered why he wasn’t satisfied with that power.’
Confusion had an understanding when he saw Lee Gun use that power. “Shit! I get why he wasn’t satisfied!!”
Was it the difference in how it was activated? The power of Cycle activated through the souls of Yeonwoo and Junwoo seemed cute in comparison to this one. That wasn’t all.
‘His power of Life should be at only stage 4 right now…!’
Despite this, Lee Gun’s power of Cycle was incredible. However, that wasn’t important right now.
Kwah-jeek!
The activated power of Cycle ravaged Confusion’s body.
[The power of Cycle is breaking down Confusion’s body.]
[The disassembled body will be recreated into something new.]
Cycle was life leading to death and death leading to life. It was an endless cycle. It generated power that created the order of the universe.
In other words, this power pushed all static existence into motion. And that power reached Confusion.
“Ahhhk!!”
Confusion’s body started to distort in odd ways.
[The existence of Confusion has been swept up into the flow of the Cycle.]
[Confusion ▶ Order]
All phenomena had an end. The power of Cycle just artificially accelerated this process!
[The power of Confusion is being dismantled.]
[It is being changed into Order.]
His skin became twisted, and his body became distorted as if it was being folded into itself.
Confusion screamed. It was to be expected since he was a monarch who could use his power only through disorder! “Bastard!!”
In the end, all the magical energy and abilities that Confusion was trying to use started to go out of existence.
Cycle was a loop. Normally, Order would once again be changed into Confusion. It would be the revival of Confusion but…
“Your life ends here.”
“Ahhhhhk!!”
Lee Gun just had to stop the power of Cycle before Order became Confusion again!
Of course, Confusion knew Lee Gun’s intent. He glared as he unleashed his power, planning on resisting.
Kwahng!
When Confusion resisted, the power of Cycle became turbulent, as if it was about to disappear in no time.
“!!”
The only reason this happened was that Life was at only stage 4.
Confusion recognized this at a glance. It seemed levels of the Divine statuses had to add up to at least ten for one to be able to activate the power of Cycle.
‘However, the balance is off right now.’
In terms of power, this Cycle was more impressive than the one used by Confusion’s older brother. However, the difference in the power’s stability was like night and day. Just a small disturbance caused Lee Gun’s power of Cycle to fluctuate. This meant only one thing.
‘It’s an ability that needs Life and Death to be exactly balanced.’
It couldn’t be more or less. The ratio had to be exactly 5:5!
‘I just need to break the balance!’
In this situation, Death had reached stage 6. Lee Gun was in danger of dying just from controlling that power, yet he had to control the power of Cycle too?
‘There is no way that’s possible.’
Confusion’s eyes flashed as he aimed for Lee Gun’s head. “I’ll cut off your head just like I did to your friend!”
He purposely tried to provoke Lee Gun. He thought it would make Lee Gun shift more power to Death.
It was like making the weight shift toward one side when one was barely able to stay balanced. Moreover, Lee Gun’s reflexes were poor right now since he was trying to control his power. This was Confusion’s opportunity!
“It’ll make a great present for your nephew and niece!”
When he heard that, Lee Gun’s eyes immediately flashed. At that moment, Confusion realized that he had made a mistake that he should never have.
Kwah-jeek!!!
“Ahhhhk!!”
After making Lee Gun go berserk into Death stage 6, Confusion realized Lee Gun was beyond formidable.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed, and Death, which was tangled with Confusion’s body, showed a reaction.
“Ahhk! My neck!”
Death ruthlessly surrounded Confusion, then went through Confusion’s throat to decapitate him.
Kwah-jeek!!
Lee Gun ground his teeth as he used the power of Cycle at that moment.
“The one who wanted destruction should return to ashes by following the way of nature.”
Confusion scrambled as he felt as if his body was being ripped apart. At the same time, Confusion felt something.
This power felt similar to what Time used, but at the same time, it was entirely different. Time was unable to go against the flow of nature, but this power…
‘Depending on how this power is used, it can be much higher in rank than Time’s…!’
Flash!
As a light flashed, Confusion’s consciousness faded away. The last thing that the monarch saw was Lee Gun’s face. Confusion let out a forced laugh.
‘Shit! I should have realized in the beginning that he is someone who should never be messed with.’
Confusion’s body undulated in a disordered manner. It disappeared as it turned into ashes.
[You have acquired a massive amount of EXP after getting rid of Confusion.]
[Confusion possesses EXP for Death.]
[However, Confusion was made into Order, so Life’s EXP has gone up.]
Finally, Confusion fell in front of Lee Gun as formless clay. Then there were the human bones that seemed to belong to Hahn Jimin.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he picked up the bones.
[You feel the presence of a human soul.]
[You can use the power of Cycle to revert the body.]
Hahn Jimin was Sungjae’s friend. It seemed the human personality of Hahn Jimin co-existed with the personality of Confusion.
With Sungjae on his mind, Lee Gun tried to pick up the bones. He thought he might be able to return Sungjae’s friend, who wasn’t Confusion. However…
Koo-goong!!
“Koohk!”
At that moment, Death stage 6, which he had forgotten about, started to violently fluctuate. Lee Gun vomited blood as he fell over.
‘It is trying to run amok again!’
With Death reaching stage 6, he was able to satisfy the requirement needed to awaken the power of Cycle. However, the fundamental problem hadn’t gone away.
Koo-goo-goong!!
Death stage 6 was psychotic as it destroyed the body of its owner. It wanted its owner to run amok, so it went berserk.
Despite Lee Gun awakening as a god, this power was able to destroy his body.
“Koohk!”
The problem wasn’t that his body was being destroyed.
[The berserk Death stage 6 is worried for its owner. It says your body won’t be destroyed if you give up resisting.]
[Death goes berserk as it tells you to kill everything.]
Death took away Lee Gun’s rational thoughts and principles. It planned on turning him into the God of Calamity.
Lee Gun tried to forcefully suppress death. However, the extreme pain made blood flow out of his eyes and mouth. The pain was unimaginable. He wondered if this pain was solely caused by Death going berserk.
[It is time to decide your Divine status.]
[If you continue to resist, you will die.]
“!”
The notification said something unexpected.
[Life doesn’t balance out with Death, and they are fighting against each other. Your body cannot withstand it.]
[If you choose to throw away the low-level Life, you will be able to prevent your body from being destroyed by choosing to become the God of Death.]
[The probability of you being able to control Death goes up if you do that.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “Fuck off!”
If he chose to become the God of Death, he would have to give up on Life. It meant he wouldn’t be able to revive Yeonwoo and Hugo. That wasn’t an option.
Lee Gun was finally able to use Death and Life at the same time, so he said, “I just have to maintain the status quo. I just have to raise Life to level 5 or 6.”
[It won’t be easy.]
[Controlling Death stage 6 isn’t an easy task.]
[However, there are no methods that’ll allow you to control it.]
At that moment, Lee Gun grabbed the body of Confusion, whom he had changed into Order.
<Creation Workshop>
He used his manufacturing ability to turn Confusion— No; he changed the body of Order into a ring.
When he put the ring on his forefinger, something surprising happened.
Kwahng!!!
The indiscriminate and uncontrolled power of Death stage 6 started to calm down. It was the power of Order!
Confused, Death stage 6 was forcefully held in place. Even the notification— No, the thirteenth original owner was surprised by that power.
The impressed thirteenth looked at Lee Gun. It was to be expected since he was part of the Creation Tribe, called Creators.
Those possessing the blood of the Creators each had different Creation abilities, for example, nature creation and emotion creation. It was diverse.
The thirteenth was a Creator who possessed the power of Ability Creation. However, Lee Gun was different.
‘Lee Gun specializes in Item Creation.’
Of course, the power of holy items was used for support. The one to truly control the out-of-control Death was Lee Gun.
This was why the thirteenth laughed as if he had expected this.
‘I knew you would be able to do it.’
The thirteenth knew the requirement needed to release the power of Cycle. Death would be raised to 6, so the power could be used at the ratio of 6:4.
Moreover, Life had a stronger vitality than Death. It would allow Life to endure the situation for a short amount of time. During this time, Life had to be raised to level 5. That would cause the out-of-control Death to calm down. Then the final ratio would be 5:5.
‘However, I could never pull off that method.’
The thirteenth thought about a past event. It was when he had given the power of Cycle to his precious baby snakes.
The thirteenth’s older brother, who was the current Sagittarius, had disapproved of his action.
– Why are you separating your power and giving it to your Constructs? The power’s effectiveness will fall if they are used separately.
– You are asking why I’m dividing my power to use them?
– Yes. You know how to awaken the power of Cycle. You raise Death to stage 6, then you raise Life afterwards…
– Hyung, death provokes the rage embedded within the user. If Death reaches stage 6, I’ll become a monster.
– I know that. However, you are talented. Do you really think you will be unable to control your Rage?
– I cannot control Rage. Never.
– Why?
The thirteenth’s eyes were full of murderous intent as he glared at his older brother.
– You should know, right?
– !
– I’m the one who wants you all dead more than anyone.
‘Anyway, I cannot control my Rage.’
Moreover, he couldn’t use his power to get rid of the unwanted guest called Time.
On the other hand, Lee Gun was different. It was the day when Lee Gun had awakened.
When all the monsters had disappeared that day, it was caused by the momentary explosion of Death’s power. At the time, Lee Gun’s Rage had reached the extreme, and he was able to use Life to save all the civilians.
‘He didn’t lose control even after he lost Yeonwoo.’
This was why the thirteenth had determined Lee Gun would be able to control Death stage 6. Of course, he did swap out Hugo’s body for Lee Gun, but…
‘I never expected such a result.’
Flash!!
The power of Death had been about to swallow the world, yet it had completely disappeared, accompanying the light.
[You have successfully controlled Death stage 6.]
[When the power of Death was controlled, a part of its power was transferred to Life.]
[It won’t be long before Life reaches level 5.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 310
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Give me your body (1)
[You have successfully controlled Death stage 6.]
[With the Divine status of Death under control, a part of its power has been transferred to Life.]
[Life will reach level 5 soon.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. At the same time, a light covered the park as if there had been an explosion.
Koo-goo-goong!
The light didn’t last long. The dark power covering the sky disappeared, and the chaotic magical energy that had been damaging Lee Gun’s body disappeared as well.
The only thing that showed Death had gone berserk was the damaged properties.
Battered with blood, Lee Gun huffed as he wiped the blood flowing down his lips. At the same time, his eyes flashed as if to say I told you so. “There is absolutely no way to control stage 6? You wanna die?”
The notification seemed taken aback.
[Normally, controlling it is impossible.]
[You are the strange one for being able to control it.]
Lee Gun ignored that. Although his surroundings were completely destroyed, he knew it was fine.
‘The fact that I didn’t destroy the world is enough.’
As if it had read his thoughts, the notification laughed in derision.
[You really are the god of calamity.]
[It says to never call yourself a hero to others.]
“Who the hell are you? You’re the bald Zodiac, right?”
[It asks why you would make such a comparison. It shows its displeasure.]
[Moreover, it says its hair is healthy…]
Lee Gun completely ignored those notifications. He didn’t know who it was, but it seemed like that worm of a Zodiac, who kept interrupting in the middle. However, that wasn’t important to him right now.
‘It seems I got past the crisis.’
He looked at his ring.
[Confusion Became Nice (EX)]
– Ring created when Confusion became Order
– All phenomena involving confusion can be controlled
– Seal ability. It can be used in a variety of ways.
‘Half of it was thanks to this.’
Of course, the ring that was already in charge of keeping his Divine status in check shouted when a new ring appeared.
[“Black Ring that eats Divine magical energy (SSS)” feels unclean because of its neighbor.]
[It cries that only it should be worn on its master’s precious fingers.]
This baffled Lee Gun. It was to be expected since the Black Ring was the helmeted man, who had made the declaration of war against humanity. It was a ring made by changing the totem that the helmeted man had possessed.
‘In some ways, Confusion is one of their owners…’
In the end, the ring let out a strident cry, but Lee Gun ignored it.
“Kuhk…!”
Suddenly, he vomited blood. While the power of Order allowed him to bring balance to the out-of-control power, it couldn’t last long.
As if his projection were correct, he heard an unfamiliar voice.
[The Divine World says the Serpent Bearer Temple will be in danger at this rate.]
“!”
When Lee Gun felt the familiar energy, his eyes changed into the savage eyes of a snake.
Two golden objects appeared in the sky and flashed. They were the public servants of the Divine world. They approached Lee Gun.
[Lee Gun-nim, you have awakened stage 5 of your Divine status. You are a candidate to become a noble Great Zodiac.]
[You probably do not know this, but you cannot simultaneously possess Divine statuses that oppose each other.]
Murderous intent emanated from Lee Gun. It was to be expected since he was using a form of a loophole to be able to possess Life and Death at the same time. When one reached stage 5, the other had to disappear.
‘It means I broke a rule, and they are here to retrieve Life?’
Thinking that, Lee Gun attacked before they could finish their words.
Kwahng!!!
The public servants became frightened when Lee Gun suddenly sent Heaven’s Punishment toward them like a boomerang.
[Ahhk! W-Why are you suddenly acting like this?]
“Why else? You guys are probably here thinking I used some kind of trickery. That’s why you’re here to retrieve Life, right?”
[What?! Retrieve? No way! You have it wrong!]
[That’s right! We just don’t want to lose a candidate who can become the Great Zodiac!]
[Yes! At this rate, the Serpent Bearer’s body will be damaged…!!]
When it came to the words of others, Lee Gun refused to listen for more than three seconds, yet even he was interested in their words. “Do you have a good solution?”
[Yes…! We will help you awaken completely as the god of Cycle.]
[If you raise Life to stage 5, you will be able to use the power of Cycle! You will be able to revive even gods!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “What’s the method?”
[Yes! You should sell Life to a different Zodiac who specializes in growth. You should let that Zodiac stabilize Death. Life can be given to another too.]
[If you do so, you can take it back after a thousand years!]
[Moreover, the price is cheap! You just have to give up the 600%-faith Construct!]
[Your Divine statuses can be grown by merely giving up a single Construct! It’s an excellent deal…]
“Have you lost your mind, bastards!!!” Lee Gun’s magical energy shot out frighteningly.
“Miss Jiwoo, my nephew, and my niece would be dead in a thousand years. In fact, they could reincarnate ten times in that time, bastards!”
The public servants screamed when they were surrounded by the golden green light. It seemed the power of Cycle was out of the ordinary.
[K-Kuh-huhk! You will never be able to become the god of Cycle without using this method!]
[That is correct! There were cases in the past similar to the Cycle. Some were able to raise their Divine statuses in a 6:4 ratio, but none of them survived!]
[You’re only alive because you were lucky! It is unclear how long you can last with that ring—]
“Fuck off!! Why don’t I just kill you guys to acquire Life EXP?”
[W-What?]
[W-What are you…!]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned violent.
[Life stage 3 used Creation to inflict harmful diseases against the gods.]
[Life has gained EXP.]
[Life has gained EXP.]
[Life has gained EXP.]
The light of torture emanated from Life.
* * *
Around that time, in an emergency room near Lee Gun’s holy ground…
Boom!!
Those inside the hospital became surprised when they heard the loud noise from outside.
“W-What the hell! Is it another monster?”
The city was already a mess because of Confusion. Moreover, the aftereffect of Confusion remained, and a monster could show up from anywhere.
The disciples within the hospital quickly headed outside. Of course, they weren’t the only ones on their guard.
“Lee Gun-nim…!”
It was a single-person hospital room. Those who had been looking over the fallen Chun Jiwoo gulped. This was to be expected since they had no idea what was going on outside. Then there was Hugo’s head, which had been delivered as a present.
‘That was clearly the doing of Confusion.’
It was uncommon for Lee Jaewon to show murderous intent. His eyes were bloodshot. The energy left behind in the box told the story. Even the Chun siblings and the Archer disciples had lost their cool.
If Lee Gun hadn’t stepped forward and Chun Jiwoo hadn’t lost consciousness, everyone would have lost their mind in trying to find Confusion.
After Lee Gun had gone out, they had felt a clash of unimaginable magical energies from the park.
‘I still can’t feel the power of the Serpent Bearer.’
Something had happened to Lee Gun.
Chun Sungjae gritted his teeth as he looked after Chun Jiwoo.
‘Uncle rejected the Return skill.’
It was a warning telling him not to come. To make matters worse, everyone was still in a state of shock from what had happened to Hugo. If something bad happened to Lee Gun too…!
‘I’ll kill Confusion.’
It wouldn’t just be him. Sungjae would kill all the monsters even if he had to go down into a blaze.
“S-Something big happened!”
“!!”
The youngest Archer disciple came running urgently. He had gone to assess the situation at the park.
“Lee Gun-nim…!!”
It was unclear as to what he had seen, but the youngest disciple’s face was frozen.
In the end, Lee Jaewon lost his cool. He couldn’t stand it any longer and grabbed his weapon. His reaction was understandable since Lee Gun hadn’t been well.
“That bastard took down Lee Gun-nim after he killed Hugo-nim—!”
“Lee Gun-nim took care of Confusion!!”
“Yes! As expected, Lee Gun-nim took care of Confusion— What?”
Lee Jaewon and Goat were shocked as they looked at their youngest disciple.
The youngest disciple shouted once again as if he was frustrated by their response. “Lee Gun-nim got rid of Confusion!!”
“What?!!”
At that moment…
“You guys are here.”
“!”
The Chun siblings were surprised by the familiar voice. They raised their heads.
A familiar face stood near the door.
“Uncle!”
It looked like they were about to cry as they hugged their uncle. On the other hand, Lee Jaewon and Goat were surprised.
‘His energy has changed.’
This might be the reason they were unable to feel the energy of the Serpent Bearer. He must have awakened a new Divine status. Well, it didn’t matter.
When the Chun siblings saw the uninjured Lee Gun, they burst out crying. Everything had happened so suddenly, and the trauma inflicted on them was large.
Lee Gun patted them as he asked, “What about Miss Jiwoo? Is she ok?”
“Mom is…! Mom’s fine! She just lost consciousness for a short time…”
“They say the baby is fine too, but Dad is…!”
Lee Gun knew what they wanted to say. “It’s fine. I’ll be able to save your dad.”
“…!”
“Really?”
Lee Gun stroked their heads as he looked at their tear-ridden faces. Reviving Hugo wouldn’t be hard. The only problem was…
[The target is a Divine-rank.]
[He cannot be called back with stage 4 “Return Life.”]
As he suspected, he needed Life stage 5 to revive a Divine-rank. The public servants of the Divine world had also said so earlier. Then what about Life stage 5?
‘In the past, it was said that Time could become EXP for Life.’
That meant Lee Gun had only one goal.
‘I’ll disassemble Time’s body to use it as EXP for Life.’
However, something bothered him.
[Clump of Creation Clay’s eyes are twinkling as it says something was left behind.]
Stuck to Lee Gun’s shoulder, Lime took out something. It seemed the slime had taken something out of Confusion’s body when Lee Gun had killed him with the power of Cycle. Unexpectedly, it was data.
“…?”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round. It was to be expected.
[Heart of the Original Owners of the seats of the twelve Zodiacs.]
“…?”
It seemed this data had come out since he had used the power of Cycle. Like what happened with Oblivion, the data of the original owner had come out. Lee Gun also knew what this meant.
[Clump of Creation Clay thinks something good will come out if this is used as an ingredient.]
[Clump of Creation Clay says it likes Master’s younger form.]
After receiving the item, Lee Gun looked at the slime as if it was suspicious. If he thought about the situation, the slime had swapped out Hugo’s body without him knowing about that.
Moreover, it had swallowed him at the most crucial moment to show that Hugo’s head had been fake.
