Lee Gun’s eyes flashed dangerously as he stretched slime’s cheeks. “Lime.”
Lime grumbled as if it was in pain.
“Be honest with me. Who bribed you?”
Lime started to sweat.
* * *
[Master, events are developing oddly.]
Time’s camp was in a state of emergency right now. No one could have imagined Confusion could be killed. After all, Confusion was Time’s younger brother.
‘He might hate his older brother, but he always gathered EXP for Master throughout the countless returns to the past.’
Since they were brothers, Confusion was affected by Time’s return to the past. The two were always stuck together, and it was why Confusion was that much stronger.
Of course, Confusion was rebellious too, so Time had stuck him inside the body of a human. However, he was still a being akin to a great monarch.
[A person like that was…!]
Time was someone who always laughed, but this time, he couldn’t. If he were being honest, he had never thought his younger brother could die at the hands of Lee Gun.
‘Even if Death is amazing, it can’t kill him.’
Yet he had died. However, it wasn’t through Life or Death! It was through the power of Cycle!
Time had purposefully stirred the pot with his younger brother before unleashing him. He knew Confusion would raise Lee Gun’s Divine status of Death.
The best-case scenario was Lee Gun awakening as the god of Death after reaching stage 5. If things went wrong, Lee Gun would reach stage 6, but Time hadn’t been worried about that.
It would be troublesome, but he knew Lee Gun would self-destruct in the end. He would destroy humanity in his berserk state and wither away. Time just had to recover what he wanted at that point.
[Huh. I never expected him to release the power of Cycle.]
His subordinates looked taken aback.
[Master. That means the plan…!]
Time stood up.
[No. The plan hasn’t been derailed.]
[!]
[I should be thankful since the power has grown to its full form. I don’t have to do anything. I just have to steal his body.]
[Then…!]
[Deliver this message to humanity and all their Zodiac Saints. They have three days.]
[!]
[If they hand over Lee Gun, all of humanity will be spared.]

chapters.title: Chapter 311
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Give me your body (2)
“Please take me on as your student!”
It happened a very long time ago.
Lee Gun had saved Hugo Otis, a person who looked like a dweeb and acted idiotically, from being eaten by a monster. In turn, that person had started stalking Lee Gun.
“I’ll do the laundry! I’ll cook! I’ll do anything! Please!”
Hugo didn’t care where and when. He kept telling Lee Gun that he would like to become Lee Gun’s student.
When Lee Gun was eating…
“Lee Gun-nim! Do you need some soy sauce?!”
When he was killing monsters…
“Lee Gun-nim! Let me take care of these small fries… Ahhhk!”
Even when he went to the restroom…
“Do you need some toilet paper?! I’ve prepared the highest-quality toilet paper with gold flecks!”
When he took a bath…
“Do you want me to scrub your back? I think you’ll like this aromatic oil. I extracted it from a monster and processed it for you!”
When he went to sleep…
“If you want, I’ll sacrifice my body! I’ll be your Dutch wife! Please take me in as a student!”
“Have you lost your mind?”
“Ahhhhk!!”
In the beginning, Hugo had a strong sense of justice, and he was also a psycho who had been out of his mind.
When Lee Gun and Hugo got to know each other for who they really were, they had become enemies. Then, they became friends. Their relationship had been bumpy for various reasons, but in the end, Hugo was Lee Gun’s precious friend.
They had met after Lee Gun had lost Yeonwoo, so Lee Gun had been on edge. Yet, Hugo allowed him to think about his family again. Hugo was his best friend, and Lee Gun was thankful to have him.
Moreover, Hugo hadn’t faltered for the past twenty years. He continued to support Lee Gun, and just this made Lee Gun feel thankful toward him.
‘That’s why I have to bring him back to life at all costs.’
Alongside Yeonwoo, he had to return his friend to his family.
***
Back to the present.
It had been a while since Lee Gun had a dream about the past. He opened his eyes since it was time for him to get up.
‘My magical energy is slowly recovering, so— Kuhk!’
Lee Gun had a hard time breathing. He felt like he was going to die.
‘It’s heavy…!!’
When he tried to get out of bed, he found out that he couldn’t. That wasn’t all.
‘Shit! It’s so hard to move!’
He found it hard to move his hands and feet, as if something heavy was pressing down on him.
‘Shit! Is it an aftereffect from going overboard in controlling Death?’
He had been able to return home safely thanks to the ring that he made using Order. However, Death had tried to go berserk throughout the night, so he had a rough time controlling it.
‘Shit! No matter how much I sleep, my magical energy and vitality recover only by a single degree…!’
In truth, fighting monsters in his current situation would be hard. It might be the aftereffect of reaching Death stage 6.
This was probably why Lee Gun’s magical energy and vitality weren’t recovering. Furthermore, his body seemed to have become paralyzed.
Zzz! Zzz!
“!!”
Lee Gun became angry when he suddenly heard a sound. The reason was the snoring he heard coming from something on top of his stomach.
[Junwoo is full, so he’s in a deep sleep.]
[Junwoo says sleeping on top of Master’s body is the best. He’s in a deep sleep.]
“Hey! You wanna die! You’re too heavy! Get down and sleep!” Lee Gun screamed.
The one sleeping on top of his body was the Construct of the Serpent Bearer temple. He was named Junwoo and designated as a snake god.
Lee Gun was screaming because Junwoo was enormous. “When the hell did you get so big?”
He was sure that the Construct looked much bigger than him. It was understandable since Junwoo would become bigger than a mountain when fully grown, but…!
“What the hell did they feed you? Why are you so big?”
Lee Gun was being crushed under Junwoo. He couldn’t get up.
The black snake didn’t seem to care. Junwoo liked Lee Gun, so he wound his body around Lee Gun.
The face with two cute black bean-like eyes rubbed against his owner’s face.
Of course, Lee Gun was suffocating, so he quickly used his hands to push away Junwoo.
“Stop it—”
At that moment.
“Uh?”
Lee Gun flinched when he tried to get a hold of the snake. It was for no other reason.
‘My hands…!’
The hands grabbing Junwoo were impossibly small. Moreover, they weren’t just small. His fingers resembled those only seen on little children…
‘Sausage fingers?!’
He was sure of it. Junwoo hadn’t grown ignorantly
“Shit! I became smaller!!”
When he saw his size and shape, he realized he looked like a baby!
[By changing your sleeping form, you have developed a new buff skill.]
[Baby Status: Recovery Buff]
Lee Gun became angry. “Hu did dis!!”
It was unclear if he was gurgling or speaking. He screamed.
“Uncle! What’s wrong!”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
The incident with Death and Hugo had already put them on edge, so the Chun siblings and Lee Jaewon quickly entered Lee Gun’s room. However, when they saw Lee Gun struggling on the bed, their eyes turned round.
“U-Uncle?!”
A baby that looked to be less than a year old lay on the bed. A snake was coiled around him, and it looked like the baby was dying(?).
“Hu did dis? Did chu do it?”
“S-So cute!”
While they were still shocked at the loss of Hugo, they became distracted for a short time. However, they soon became flustered.
“L-Lee Gun-nim! Why are you…!”
“Is it Time’s doing?”
Chun Sungjae soon realized what had happened.
“Ah! My stone! The time stone that Hailey-nim gave to me is gone!”
The item that he had turned into a necklace was gone. Moreover, the one responsible for it was nearby.
“Ah…! That bastard!”
Holding Chun Sungjae’s stone, Lime jiggled next to Lee Gun as it placed a headband on his head.
Chun Sungjae bit his tongue. After he had found out Hahn Jimin’s true identity, he had gone to say thanks to the Virgo Construct who had been with him.
This Construct had told him unexpected pieces of information that had allowed him to deduce Hahn Jimin’s true identity.
– That’s odd. The only ones able to smell it before his awakening should be monsters.
– What?
– Do you not remember the fight between Lee Gun-nim and Abyss at Drachma? It was before Lee Gun-nim awakened as a Zodiac rank. Abyss said Lee Gun-nim smelled good like Taurus and wanted to eat him.
– Those are words spoken by monsters, who see gods as food.
Those words had allowed him to realize what Hahn Jimin was, and thankfully, he was able to escape Hahn Jimin’s trap.
This was why he sought out that Construct within the Virgo Saint’s camp, yet the Construct had said something unexpected.
– What? You want to thank me? This is the first time I’ve met Sungjae-nim.
– What? But…
– I’m telling the truth. This is my first time meeting anyone from the Serpent Bearer temple.
– What?! First time?
– Yes. The only point of contact that I had with the Serpent Bearer temple is playing with the slime…
– The slime?
Chun Sungjae looked at the slime wiggling next to Lee Gun with an odd expression.
‘How suspicious!’
Did the slime transform itself to give him a hint about Confusion?
When Lime jumped onto its owner’s face, Lee Gun heard a notification.
[As expected, the ribbon goes well with you.]
[Next time, it wants you to put on a dress.]
Lee Gun became angry. “Hu are yu? You vermin Zodiac!!”
[It feels hurt by the word vermin Zodiac.]
[Looks like it has to return you to a period where you cannot even gurgle your words.]
Lee Gun glared as he grabbed the slime to steal the stone that rewound time.
[This is useless.]
[You are merely a baby. You cannot move in that form.]
Lime nodded.
[It says to stop wandering off and stay in place for a little longer. It says all your magical energy and vitality will be recovered.]
[Recovery Buff: Body Recovery and Magical Energy Recovery]
[A week’s worth of recovery has been shortened to a day’s.]
It seemed someone had created this ability. Lee Gun had a feeling that each age had a different buff.
However, he didn’t care if his body was recovering or not. He was pissed.
[…!]
Lee Gun went blind with anger as he brought down his small fists on the bed.
Kwahng!!!
The slime seemed taken aback. It couldn’t have predicted that the form of a mobility-challenged baby would be more dangerous. In the end, Lee Gun’s power started destroying the building.
Koo-goo-goong!!
“U-Uncle!”
Everyone quickly exited the building.
It was unclear how long had passed.
“Really?”
“Uncle…!”
After becoming an adult again, Lee Gun exited the building. He had folded the whining slime as if it were dough.
When he headed somewhere else, everyone was surprised.
“Where are you going, Uncle?”
“I’m going to go make a weapon!”
“What? I thought you couldn’t move…!”
“I’m all good now!”
Time would be coming after him soon. Lee GUn didn’t know what Time was thinking, but he had to hurry.
Brrrrr!
At that moment, he received a call.
* * *
Around that time, at the World Conference Hall…
“What? Really? You won’t invade if we hand over Lee Gun?”
“That’s correct.”
Tension spread in the air as all the world’s important figures gathered for a meeting. Over a thousand people had participated in this meeting. There were heads of state and politicians representing various counties. Of course, the Zodiac Saints, generals, and the Ten Stars were gathered there as well.
The current war-time confusion was the most chaotic since the incident with Red Eye in the past.
The monsters Confusion had called forth remained outside of the domes, getting ready to invade once again. The problem was the threat delivered to the heads of state of the various governments.
– You just have to hand over Lee Gun. Then we will spare humanity.
This was why the meeting that was supposed to happen at dinner time was quickly pulled forward.
Moreover, the Zodiac Saints seemed to have heard about what had happened from the others. The Zodiac Saints participating in the meeting started bickering amongst each other.
“I’m the boss!”
“Fuck off, Cat! This isn’t a place where you should step forward.”
“Why don’t all the other Zodiac Saints stay out of this? All of you guys got rolled by Lee Gun-nim!”
“What the hell did you say? Hey, Cancer Ten Star!”
“Why isn’t Hugo here yet?”
“Not a single member of the Sagittarius temple and Serpent Bearer temple is in attendance.”
After receiving the threat from Time, they had come up with the Coalition plan. It was the first coalition formed since the Red Eye Raid!
Moreover, this wasn’t an ordinary alliance.
‘All the temples will go under Lee Gun as affiliates.’
This was why the position of commander had to be chosen to lead the affiliate temples, and everyone was fighting for that position.
“Anyway, every Zodiac except the Scorpio was rolled by Lee Gun-nim. That’s why the commander should be Hailey-nim…”
“!!”
At that moment, they felt something. The Zodiac Saints surged to their feet.
“Get down!”
“?!”
Screams rang out alongside Hailey’s words.
Kwahng!!!
An explosion occurred at the conference hall, where several thousand people were gathered. It was unclear as to how long had passed.
“…!”
The conference hall was in a state of pandemonium, and groans rang all around.
“Shit! It’s a raid!”
“Is everyone ok?”
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Shit! Everyone became old!”
The appearance of the heads of state and reporters gathered at the conference hall had changed. That wasn’t all.
“General!”
“…!”
The top disciples gathered in the conference hall had either disappeared or turned into children.
“!”
At that moment, an unfamiliar face appeared above the broken ceiling of the conference hall.
Hailey flinched at the sight of that face.
“That bastard is…!”
“Kyahhhk!! Monster!”
Yes, the one to turn the conference hall into rubble was a monster sent by Time.
[I am here since you still don’t get what is going on.]
They shook when they saw the monster. The more problematic part was the beings that the monsters had brought along.
‘Zodiacs?’
Were they brought here using the power of Time? A gate opened behind the monster, and familiar faces rushed out. Of course, their appearances were completely different, but they were the Zodiacs that these people had served. Moreover, they were showing clear hostility toward their Zodiac Saints.
[If you do not hand over Lee Gun, they will kill you.]
It spoke.
[Well? Have you made your decision? Will you hand over Lee Gun or not?]

chapters.title: Chapter 312
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Give me your body (3)
[Well? Have you made your decision? Will you hand over Lee Gun or not?]
Within the scorched conference hall, several thousand people turned pale from fear. These were all at least B-rank disciples.
“This is crazy.”
As they looked at the sky, their faces were filled with fear. This included the Ten Stars and the Zodiac Saints, who were the representatives of the disciples!
Hailey looked surprised as well.
‘Did Time call them here…!’
From the space that had ripped open in the sky, twelve Zodiacs came out! Although they were Zodiacs, they looked like monsters. However, there was no mistaking them.
‘The ones in the front are Leo and Virgo!’
This made Stevens and Kevin, who still had connections to their Zodiacs, quickly check up on them.
“I’ll give you Churu cat treats!! Hurry up and come out!!”
“I’ll give you a Lee Gun photograph collection!! Come out!!”
Their method of calling out the Zodiacs was questionable, but it was effective.
Koo-goo-goong!
A golden light and a silver light fell from the sky. They were the Zodiacs of the Leo temple and the Virgo temple.
Although they didn’t fully reveal themselves, it was enough. The energy of the two Zodiacs encircled the bodies of the Zodiac Saints.
This relieved Stevens and Kevin. Thankfully, their Zodiacs hadn’t gone over to the other side.
“I guess I don’t have to give her the Lee Gun photographs.”
“I thought he was lured to the other side using catnips.”
Their words caused a surge of anger within the two Zodiacs, but they soon spoke to their Zodiac Saints.
[They aren’t from our timeline.]
[Of all the beings, he brought them! Moreover, they look like that!]
The Zodiacs became angry.
Hailey’s fine brows narrowed. “They were brought here from a different timeline.”
Time was an existence capable of traveling between a variety of timelines. It had probably brought them from a timeline where he had already consumed the Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints.
The only difference between the Zodiacs from this timeline and the ones from where Time had brought them was that the latter group was already going through the monsterification process.
‘The Zodiacs are becoming evil gods.’
As proof of this, every one of those Zodiacs emanated black magical energy. The dark powers coated their skin.
The radiant golden Leo had become the dark Leo, while the beautiful Virgo had become the goddess of death. The holy Taurus looked like a monstrous minotaur. The Gemini and Pisces, the twin Zodiacs who Lee Gun had defeated, were unapproachable evil gods.
Then there was the Libra. She was the previous owner of the Libra seat before Giselle had eaten her!
However, the most shocking part wasn’t them.
“I-Is that perhaps the Serpent Bearer?”
“What?!”
Amongst the Zodiacs was a strange one that looked like an enormous snake. Of course, it hadn’t completely exited the gate, so they could catch only glimpses of its body. However, it was clearly a snake!
The unearthly eyes of the snake that flashed for a brief moment could freeze one’s soul. Every disciple froze.
‘W-What kind of power is that?’
Only one Zodiac possessed the form of a snake.
“I-Is that Lee Gun-nim?”
“That’s what I’m wondering about! If it’s a snake, it should be the Serpent Bearer!”
On the other hand, Hailey ground her teeth.
‘It isn’t Lee Gun.’
Lee Gun was a unique being who existed only in this timeline. That meant…
“It’s the previous thirteenth Zodiac…!”
“What?!”
The Zodiac Saints were surprised. The snake-like Zodiac was probably Yeonwoo or Junwoo, who were called the Ouroboros.
Ouroboros was known as a god that bit its tail. It was a god that represented the beginning and the end. It was the god of life and death. And this Zodiac had yet to reveal itself fully.
However, Hailey knew what would happen if it completely revealed itself to create a circle.
‘All life will be turned into death…!’
So, she immediately said, “Hurry up and contact Lee Gun!”
Hailey’s actions became urgent as she used a skill that was most similar to Time’s. She tried to send the Zodiacs to their original world.
However, one of the magic Zodiacs flicked its finger at that moment, almost making everyone lose consciousness.
Kwahng!!!
Screams rang everywhere as beams of light flashed!
“Ahhhhk!”
The screams were reactions to the bombardment sent toward everyone. They were sent flying.
Since the heads of state of various countries were gathered in this place, a full barrier had been put up. However, the barrier was useless.
Those who were barely able to unleash their power came to their senses.
“…!”
However, they were unable to breathe. The reason was the sight that had unfolded in front of them.
“The conference hall is…!”
The conference hall, which they had occupied, had turned into ashes. That wasn’t all.
Woosh!
“!!”
Everyone became frightened when a large black sun made an appearance. The sun was big enough to cover the sky.
The one to appear above their heads was a golden-haired Zodiac. The sun was behind him, and he looked like he was going to set the entire earth on fire!
“Damn it! It’s Sagittarius!”
Moreover, Sagittarius looked to be a fusion with an original owner.
He was unlike the bald Zodiac and was more powerful than the other Zodiacs.
“Shit! We’ll all burn at this rate!”
“Where is Hugo? What the hell is he doing right now?”
If Hugo or Goat were here, they would be able to summon the Sagittarius of this timeline to offset this other one!
In the end, the sun was about to land on the ground, so Hailey stepped forward.
[Zodiac Descent]
Black light surged forth from Hailey, and her hand changed into an enormous monster hand. Hailey was allowing Scorpio to possess her.
The hand flew toward the location where the sun was about to land! Finally, the power of Scorpio clashed against the power of Sagittarius.
Kwahng!!!
The impact was incredible. The others used their powers, yet for a moment, they lost consciousness.
When those sent flying by the shockwave opened their eyes once again, they saw the monster laughing with its eyes.
[Not bad! You were able to block a strike from a Zodiac.]
On the other hand, the Zodiac Saints shook.
‘That power….!’
As expected of an attack from a Zodiac, no one there could remain standing. Fear struck them.
‘Lee Gun was able to fight on par with those beings?’
Lee Gun being one of those beings sent chills running up their backs, but it lasted only a moment. The monster who had brought the Zodiacs laughed.
[Well? Do you want to hand over Lee Gun now?]
“…!”
Stevens was dumbfounded. “Are you kidding me? Lee Gun is on the same rank as those bastards! How are we supposed to catch him in the first place?”
The monster laughed.
[It won’t be impossible if the Zodiac Saints pool their power together. Isn’t that how you sealed him inside the Devil’s Tower?]
“!”
Although the seal was placed on the outer wall, they were able to seal the Devil’s Tower. The Zodiac Saints were able to do so because they had pooled their powers to use the sealing skill.
If they used it, they might be able to temporarily stop Lee Gun from moving.
[Those who can’t use their power because they don’t have their Zodiacs can use these guys as replacements.]
“…!”
[We killed Hugo Otis, who would have gotten in your way. Do not worry about him. You guys just have to agree amongst yourselves.]
The faces of the Zodiac Saints fell. What? Who had died?
“The Archer Saint?”
Blood drained out of their faces. This included Sophie, Hailey, and Carly. Even Liv, who had regained her body after Pisces had died, was stunned. The shock was greater especially for Kevin and Stevens, who led the same battle-type temples.
Lee Gun would never let such a thing happen, so they might be lying or he might have fallen into a trap without Lee Gun knowing it.
‘He’s very skilled, yet he got killed by them?’
The monster laughed as if it had expected them to freeze up in reaction to the news. Moreover, the people within the conference hall fell into a state of panic.
“Ahhhhk!!”
“We have no hope of winning! Let’s hand over Lee Gun!!”
“One of the powerful Zodiac Saints died! It says Hugo Otis is already dead!!”
“Please just hand over Lee Gun!!”
The monster laughed as if it were enjoying this.
[If you hand over Lee Gun, we’ll restore the missing Zodiacs by bringing them from a different timeline.]
“Did you hear that? They’ll return the other Zodiacs, whom Lee Gun consumed!”
“That’s right! They’ll spare the entire humanity if we hand over Lee Gun!”
“Hey! Be reasonable! Lee Gun-nim is—”
“Who cares! Currently—”
Pahng!!!
“…!!”
The head of the smirking monster exploded like a balloon. Everyone was shocked when they saw the person who had blown up the monster’s head.
“…!”
The other Zodiac Saints had the same reaction. Kevin and Stevens had been about to mobilize to decapitate the monster, so this shocked them.
Even Hailey looked shocked. It was a rare sight for her.
Their reactions were understandable.
“Everyone should be quiet!!”
“…??!!”
The one to blow up the monster’s head was none other than the Saintess Sophie.
“You fell to the nonsense the monster was spouting, and you dare try to sell off Lee Gun! I’ll be the first to throw you guys to the monsters!”
These words baffled the Zodiac Saints.
“You’re the one who would sell Lee Gun at the first opportunity…”
“You’re the one who hates Lee Gun the most among us…”
“You’re the biggest chicken among us…”
Sophie yelled at these reactions from the other Zodiac Saints, “I have a functioning head!! There is no way they’ll spare us because we hand over Lee Gun!”
“Whatever. You’re more afraid of the prospect of catching Lee Gun. Kuhk!!”
Stevens fell when a water cannon hit him.
Sophie served Lee Gun’s Construct Iaso, the new Zodiac for the Aquarius temple. So she wasn’t weak.
“Anyway, humanity won’t yield to you guys!”
The headless monster stood back up as it laughed.
[I see. I’ll consider this a breakdown in negotiation.]
Hailey Seemed to feel its evil killing intent. A green light appeared around her. It was proof that she had gone under the Serpent Bearer temple as an affiliate!
Stevens bit his tongue. “Ah! She’s trying to get ahead of me!” He immediately drew the holy symbol.
Green lights surged into the sky from various locations. It started with the Scorpio temple. Then Stevens from the Leo temple, Liv from the Pisces temple, and the Ten Star Taylor from the Capricorn temple followed.
For the rest of the Zodiac Saints, who were gone, the Ten Stars filled in. Lights surged into the air.
‘Shit! How did this…!’
Koo-goo-goohng!!!
As if they had been waiting for this situation to unfold, the Zodiacs called forth by Time and the monsters revealed themselves.
The monsters covered the sky like swarms of ants, and their numbers shocked everyone.
“Protect the dignity of humans!!”
Stevens moved first as he unleashed his power.
“Protect Lee Gun!”
“I will be the affiliate commander!!”
“Fuck off, cat!! I’m the commander!”
“Why are you obsessed with it? You are a master craftsman. You will get nagged the most by Lee Gun.”
“What?!”
The war with the lives of humanity on the line started.
* * *
Around that time.
[The Scorpio temple hopes to become an official affiliate of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
[The Aries temple hopes to become an official affiliate of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
…
[The Leo temple hopes to become an official affiliate of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
[All the items and skills of the relevant temples will fall under the rule of the Serpent Bearer.]
[The Serpent Bearer can directly control the abilities and missions that could be given to them.]
[All the twelve temples will give fealty to the Serpent Bearer temple. Will you accept them as affiliates?]
Lee Gun was surprised by the unexpected notifications. Since they were going to have a meeting, he had told all of them to come under the Serpent Bearer temple as affiliates, and they had balked at the suggestion.
Lee Gun, who was in his workshop, dismissed the notifications as if they weren’t important. He looked at the being in front of him.
An unexpected figure had shown up before him.
[I’ve been waiting for you.]
It was Time.

chapters.title: Chapter 313
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Give me your body (4)
[I’ve been waiting for you.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned violent.
The man still looked like Jean-Louis as he sat on the sofa inside the workshop. He was just sitting there, holding Hugo’s head.
Lee Gun became angry, and Heaven’s Punishment transformed into its stage 3 form.
“I didn’t place it there so that you can sit on it.”
Lee Gun disappeared in a flash and swung Heaven’s Punishment.
Kwah-jeek!!
The sofa made for the guests was destroyed, and Hugo’s head melted away into the dirt. However, Time was no longer in the seat. He appeared behind Lee Gun, laughing in surprise.
[You don’t go berserk when I use this anymore?]
“!”
This time, the monarch didn’t look like Jean-Louis. He looked like Time. He had purposefully appeared in the form of Jean-Louis to poke at Lee Gun’s temper.
Lee Gun glared at him in contempt. “I may have fallen for it once, but I won’t fall for it twice. Get rid of it before I split your head open and hang it.”
[I went through the trouble of bringing it from the past.]
Time soon reacted in a lighthearted manner.
[Maybe, this will make you react a bit.]
“…!”
When Time made another summon, Lee Gun almost flipped his lid. It was to be expected since what Time had summoned was none other than Yeonwoo.
Moreover, this Yeonwoo wasn’t whole. Time seemed to have brought her from a time immediately after Oblivion had eaten her! It wasn’t a sight one could watch sober!
However, her face was untouched, so Lee Gun could instantly recognize her. It was enough to make Lee Gun’s eyes bloodshot.
Kwah-gwa-gwahng!
Unexpectedly, Lee Gun didn’t go berserk. He sent an attack using Death toward Time.
Time was surprised.
[It seems you can control your rage.]
No, this was beyond controlling his anger. Lee Gun was deliberate in his actions as he tried to take down Time.
At this point, Time should have been annoyed that his plan had failed, yet the monarch smirked as if he welcomed this development.
[I guess I don’t have to worry about it at this point.]
“!”
Time was conducting an experiment, trying to make Lee Gun as angry as possible.
The reason was simple.
[Your body will be mine soon. It’ll be troublesome if Death stage 6 causes your body to go berserk.]
Time looked satisfied as he looked at the ring on Lee Gun’s forefinger.
‘As expected, he has the talent for Item Creation.’
That item had stopped Death stage 6 from going out of control and kept the balance of the Cycle.
Time had been sneaky in creating this situation. He wanted to see if something unexpected would happen, and he had gotten his confirmation.
[I no longer need this.]
‘!’
Time, who had called forth Yeonwoo to strike Lee Gun’s nerve, tried to unsummon her. He was about to send her back to her original timeline.
[Give me your body.]
Kwah-jeek!
Lee Gun grabbed Yeonwoo, who was about to disappear into Time’s warp gate. He immediately activated Super Regeneration and took a full swing while letting out a sharp laugh.
“You’re the one who should be giving me what you got, bastard!”
Kwah-jeek!
Lee Gun brought down Heaven’s Punishment on Time and immediately activated the power of Cycle.
‘If I get rid of Time, I can raise the level of Life.’
If Life became level 5, Lee Gun could bring back Yeonwoo and Hugo, who had become a Construct! That wasn’t all.
“Thank you very much for bringing Yeonwoo’s data from the past!” Lee Gun held Yeonwoo’s body, which was going through Super Regeneration.
He laughed. It was a body that was eaten by Oblivion, so it wasn’t regenerating well. However, it was good enough to acquire the body’s data.
Of course, the Chun siblings were fanatics. This was why they knew Lee Gun’s three sizes as well as the length of his hair and body parts that he didn’t want them to know… While they knew his exact size, it was different for Lee Gun.
‘It’ll be more accurate than relying on my memories to make the body.’
He was only confident that he could make the same face from memory.
‘If I’m lucky, I won’t even have to go through the process of making her body.’
“You should become my EXP!”
Finally, the power of Cycle clashed against Time.
Koo-goo-goong!
The light of Cycle shone brightly as it had done against Confusion. It started to dismantle Time’s body. The reaction was promising.
[The power of Cycle is pulling Time into the enormous flow.]
[Time is being dismantled.]
[EXP of Life…]
However…
[EXP of Life received is 0.]
“!!”
Time, whom Lee Gun had killed, disappeared as he bled. However, it was unlike what had happened with Confusion. Lee Gun didn’t receive any EXP. He soon found out the reason.
[Time is a being that can exist anywhere and anytime.]
“!!”
A voice rang behind Lee Gun. After appearing behind Lee Gun, Time grabbed his head.
[Time Stop]
“…!!!”
Lee Gun’s body froze. He realized which phenomena had caused this.
‘A different version of Time from a different timeline, where he wasn’t dismantled, had jumped over here.’
In other words, it was like passing a baton. No matter how many times Lee Gun killed Time, Time from a different timeline had to cross over to become his true body. This meant…
‘Time wasn’t registered as being killed.’
Lee Gun seemed to have guessed correctly.
Time laughed.
[You exist in only this timeline. I can exist in any of the timelines. You cannot kill me.]
This was the truth. It didn’t matter how many times Lee Gun killed Time. Versions of Time from different timelines would keep coming here.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. A powerful light of Cycle appeared once again, dismantling Time.
In this attempt, Lee Gun tried to eliminate Time before another one could crossover from a different timeline. However…
[Nope. Your level of Cycle is too low to attempt that.]
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Two more versions of Time appeared to grab Lee Gun.
‘Bastard…!’
Time let out a sharp laugh.
[In the first place, speed is not the problem.]
Time put his hand into Lee Gun.
[You can exist in only this timeline. You will cease to exist if you exit this timeline.]
“!”
[On the other hand, I exist beyond this place. I exist everywhere as the Time monarch. No matter how much you struggle, this will repeat forever.]
Lee Gun laughed in contempt at those words. This was expected of Jean-Louis’ true body. However, Time wasn’t dividing himself while sowing seeds.
‘It isn’t just the earth. They are like parallel universes. He’s operating on various timelines.’
Lee Gun was dumbfounded.
‘The only way I can kill him is…’
At that moment…
‘…!’
It was as if Lee Gun had an understanding. He seemed to have thought up a way to kill Time. His expression remained sour since it was a method he couldn’t carry out. However, he didn’t show it on the outside.
“It doesn’t matter. You won’t be able to take the power of Cycle”
This bastard could take his power of Cycle through only one way.
‘He has to extract the cores of my Divine statuses.’
Lee Gun didn’t know which parts would be taken, but it would be similar to how he had acquired the cores from the other Zodiacs. However, Death was at stage 6, and Life was at stage 4.
‘As soon as he extracts it, Death will go berserk.’
This was why Lee Gun laughed. “I’ll tell you this. The ring of Order will follow only me. It will never follow any other master.”
Time smirked at Lee Gun’s expression.
[You probably don’t know why I didn’t approach you until now.]
“!!”
Lee Gun flinched.
[Serpent Eater]
“…?!!”
After putting his hand in Lee Gun’s body, Time activated Lee Gun’s ability at will. Lee Gun was dragged out of his body.
“Kuhk!”
Lee Gun glared at Time. He had no idea why this bastard was able to use the ability of the Serpent Bearer temple.
Lee Gun should have known something was off when Time said he wanted to take and use Cycle, which was someone else’s Divine status…!
“Thanks for the body!”
[!]
Finally, Time entered Lee Gun’s body. For some odd reason, there was no adverse reaction to this.
Lee Gun soon found out how Time was able to do this. It had taken only a moment for him to be dragged out and Time to enter his body. However, Lee Gun had felt it clearly.
‘His energy is similar to mine.’
It was similar to the energy within the bone, which Lee Gun had acquired within Oblivion. Of course, it wasn’t as if they were siblings or the same person.
Lee Gun ground his teeth. A large light surged forth.
[A third party is using the Serpent Bearer’s Cycle.]
[It will lead to Death.]
Time seemed to be planning on dismantling Lee Gun. However, Lee Gun wouldn’t be dismantled without putting up a fight.
‘In fact, this is my only opportunity to kill him.’
This was the method that Lee Gun had thought he wouldn’t be able to carry out! Time was able to use his power. Time having similar energy to him had given him an idea!
‘It’s a gamble, but one worth trying.’
Right before he was going to get dismantled, Lee Gun entered someone else’s body. It was Time’s body.
* * *
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Shit! Lee Gun still hasn’t accepted us as affiliates?”
“Why the hell isn’t he picking up his phone?”
The mass raid by Time started. It was the start of the war with humanity’s existence on the line. Their enemies were not only monsters but also the demonified Zodiacs that Time had brought.
The Zodiac Saints clashed against the demonified Zodiacs, and they felt like dying!
“Shit! I’ll give you the Churu cat treat! Just go back!!”
[Do you think that’ll work on me, idiot?]
Stevens gnashed his teeth. He was in his demi-god beast form, blocking the dark Leo.
“As soon as Lee Gun accepts us as affiliates, our power will increase, and we will be able to use the skills of the Serpent Bearer temple! Endure for a little longer!”
As an affiliate under the Serpent Bearer temple, Kevin boasted exceptional power. He was in his demi-god form as he sent his enemies flying.
“When we receive the blessing of the Serpent Bearer, the affiliate disciples as well as the Zodiacs will become much stronger!”
Of course, unlike Stevens, some felt uneasy about applying to become Lee Gun’s affiliates. The first person was the Ten Star of the Aries temple. He had become a slave when his Zodiac and Zodiac Saint were turned into slaves of Lee Gun.
‘Ha! Why the hell did they have to go after Lee Gun?’
The second person was the Korean general of the Gemini temple, Choi Sunghyuk. He had come here when Heiji had suddenly contacted him.
“Are you sure you won’t regret this, Heiji-nim?”
The third person was the general of the Libra temple. Carly had pushed all authority related to the Libra temple to him.
“Shit! If we become affiliates under the Serpent Bearer temple, Carly-nim will never come back…! She won’t throw away her strange dream of wanting to become the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple…!”
The last group was the Cancer temple. They had been seized by Chun Yooha.
“Whatever happened, this is the only solution available to us.”
They used all their power to fight against the enemies when…
Pah-jeek!!
New forces appeared before them. They were none other than the Chun siblings!
Enormous flames and light clashed with the dark Zodiacs.
Kwahng!!!
The Zodiac Saints were surprised to see the familiar faces.
Goat followed up with a powerful arrow that shot like a cannon. Lee Jaewon also appeared at the scene, using his Area of Effect skill.
When the Chun siblings made their appearances, the Zodiac Saints tried to tiptoe around them. The reason was expected.
“So you guys…” This was unlike Stevens, but Stevens was trying to be careful with his words.
However, the other disciples raised the issue.
“Where is Hugo-nim?”
“Was he really killed by a monster?!”
Stevens and Kevin glared at the disciples. The Chun siblings’ expressions darkened.
“Dad is….”
That was enough of an answer.
Hailey’s expression darkened.
“It’s fine. He died while giving everything he had.”
“!!!”
Everyone was surprised by the familiar voice. The one to appear in front of them was Lee Gun.
“Uncle!”
“Aren’t you supposed to be in your workshop?”
“Ah! I was. However, I thought I should help here first.”
In contrast with everyone else’s reaction, Hailey’s face turned deathly pale. “Everyone get back!”
“Hailey-nim?”
Hailey immediately used her skill.
Lee Gun smirked in response. Then, a large explosion erupted. It was the Serpent Bearer’s power of Death.
Everyone was sent flying as they screamed.
“Ahhk!!”
They had suffered only that much because Hailey had used her Substitution skill to send “Lee Gun’s” attack away.
In the end, Hailey sent a death glare toward her opponent. “Time!”
“As expected, you were able to recognize me, daughter.”
“!!”
The Zodiac Saints and the disciples were surprised by Hailey’s words.
“He’s Time!”
“What about Lee Gun?!”
Hailey sensed the uneasiness. She glared at the monarch as if her looks could kill him. “What did you do to Lee Gun?”
“I killed him. That’s why I’m the Serpent Bearer now. You guys will become my affiliates.”
Everyone froze in place.
Time smirked as he looked at the Chun siblings. “The level of life is still too low. I’m sure I’ll acquire a lot of EXP if I kill the Saint-ranks, right?”
“…!!!”
“Well, don’t worry about it. I’ll accept you all as affiliates under me.”
All of them stiffened when they saw the evil look in his eyes. Lee Gun was already powerful, but this version of Lee Gun had the additional power of a monarch!
When they raised their guards, Time walked forth with an evil laugh. “You can’t attack me. As affiliate disciples, you dare not kill the Zodiac, who is your owner.”
“…!”
The air seemed suffocating, and everyone felt like collapsing to the ground. They had never expected things to turn out like this!
“Hey.”
“!”
Suddenly, someone appeared behind Time. A bow was aimed at the back of Time’s head.
This development surprised Time.
The mouths of the Chun siblings and the Zodiac Saints also fell open when they saw who it was.
“Who the hell are you?”
“!”
“You sound like my teacher, yet why do you smell like a monster?”
Unlike his present self, this version of the person standing there possessed youthful bravado and long blonde hair.
It was a very young Hugo.

chapters.title: Chapter 314
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Let’s See Who Wins (1)
“You sound like my teacher, but why do you smell like a monster?”
The Zodiac Saints were shocked by the appearance of this unfamiliar person. Of course, it was the same for the Ten Stars too.
“H-Hugo-nim?”
They were unable to shut their mouths. There was another reason for their reactions.
“M-My god! That style…! That armor…!”
“I-I’m sure of it! They appeared in Lee Gun-nim’s documentary!”
“It was when he was called by the nickname Terrius!”
The Chun siblings’ expressions changed the most. Having seen their father, they looked like they were about to cry. The image of their father’s head being delivered was still fresh in their mind.
Unlike his current late twenties look, this Hugo looked much younger, as though he had just reached his twenties. Hugo looked to be the same age as Yooha.
Of course, his children recognized their father.
“Damn it! It is annoying because he does look a bit handsome. However, it really is Dad…!”
“Dad!”
The Chun siblings seemed like they were going to cry from joy. Sophie also sobbed. Someone they had thought to have died was here. It was naturally a welcoming sight.
Kevin and Stevens looked to be in disbelief.
‘I’m sure of it. That appearance…’
‘I think that’s him from twenty years ago…!’
Unlike his current self, this Hugo was oddly less worn out and more polite. It was the Hugo from an era when Lee Gun would be irritated at Hugo for him looking like a young master raised on a silver spoon.
At that time, Lee Gun used to treat Hugo with disregard. However, Hugo had been very strong during that period.
Hugo, who had been summoned here, looked surprised. “What the hell? I was under Teacher’s order to buy some hair growth solution when I was told to steal the goods from the Virgo and the Leo temples. I had been carrying that out.”
Kevin and Stevens had been secretly happy to see Hugo, but the light in their eyes changed.
‘Why did it have to be the Archer from that period?’
The two of them became angry.
“You thieving bastard! Do you realize how many losses we suffered because of you?!”
“We did all the hard work, yet we received nothing in return!”
“!”
Hugo tilted his head when he heard the familiar voices. He turned to them. Then, his eyes turned round as if he was shocked. “What the hell? Why did you two get so old?”
“What did you just say?”
“Ah. Whatever. Have you seen Sophie-nim? I am trying to buy Teacher’s hair growth solution from her.”
When Hugo looked for Sophie, the nearby Sophie once again wailed. Hugo exactly resembled his past self, and he was looking for her. After the incident with Lee Gun, Hugo had always looked at Sophie as if she were a bug. His gaze was full of contempt, and this made her sad.
‘He called me Sophie-nim… He said Sophie-nim.’
When Sophie wailed, Hugo looked at her as if something was off. “That’s odd. Why do all of you look old? Was I summoned to some place weird?”
Sophie was on the verge of crying when she heard that. Kevin and Stevens bared their teeth.
“You are going too far with what you’re saying, Archer!”
“Hey! What about you? You returned to having the face of an idiot!”
“Wow! Your face reflects your ill-nature, and your personality sucks in an odd way… Ah! You guys always had terrible personalities.”
“What did you just say?!”
Hugo ignored them as he glared at Time. “So? Who are you? Where is Teacher? Why are you here?”
For the first time, Time furrowed his brow. He was wondering why Hugo was here. Moreover, this wasn’t the normal Hugo.
‘The Hugo Otis of the past came here.’
The only thing that could make this possible was the power of Time.
That was why Hailey was flustered as she looked back and forth between Hugo and Time
‘From Time’s expression, it seems he didn’t call Hugo here.’
In the first place, Hailey had never seen Time look this flustered before.
‘Could it be…!’
Time seemed to have the same thought as Hailey. He furrowed his brow in distaste.
‘It’s Lee Gun’s doing.’
Time had no reason to call Hugo to his place from a different timeline. Of course, Time didn’t think Lee Gun was someone who would get dismantled without putting up a fight, but…
‘Did it happen at that moment?’
When he had seized Lee Gun’s body, he was certain Lee Gun had entered his body. Time had thrown away his body alongside Lee Gun so that they could be dismantled.
Like how Time was able to use the power of the Serpent Bearer, Lee Gun seemed to have been lucky in being able to activate the power of Time.
‘However, Time isn’t something easily handled.’
That power would become poison the more one used it. It was a power that could cause self-destruction.
‘He’ll become lost in time.’
Lee Gun was probably using the power with abandon, but he would get more lost the more he used the power. In other words, it was like an ant nest.
He wouldn’t get lost if he bore through one tunnel. However, once he started creating multiple tunnels, it would be unclear where he came from or where he had to go. He would have no idea about how to get back to the original spot.
‘It means I’ll master the power of Cycle faster than he would master the power of Time.’
As proof of this, Time smirked while activating Death. “This is the future. You shouldn’t be here.”
“!!”
The power of Death headed toward Hugo.
Kwahng!!!
After attacking Hugo, the power would head toward the disciples.
Koo-goo-goong!
Time planned on killing the disciples, then reviving them with Life.
The disciples quickly tried to dodge, but they couldn’t, since they had requested to become affiliates of the Serpent Bearer temple. They had put aside everything to do so.
Boom!
[Kneel]
“Koohk!!”
All the disciples kneeled without realizing it when the Zodiac gave the order. As the mast Zodiac, it was overpowering.
Of course, they weren’t accepted as affiliates yet. However, they had already promised fealty when they made the request. At that point, a collar had been placed around their necks.
‘Shit!’
That wasn’t all. Their high faith had turned into poison for them.
[Everyone, disarm yourselves.]
“Koo-oohk!”
Everyone around the world put down their weapons and released their defensive skills. It was an innate ability of the Zodiacs, called Compulsory Order.
<Everything God Says is Right (SSS)>
– God’s Compulsory Order skill
– Target: Everyone who has faith toward the relevant Zodiac (At least 50%)
– It’s more effective with higher faith. Disciples follow orders without any suspicion.
The trade-off was high to use it. The Zodiacs didn’t like to use it since they had to pay a lot in price. Still, it was a basic power of the Zodiacs.
[You will not use Super Regeneration no matter what. You will willingly receive the punishment given by the god.]
“Ahhk!”
The disciples could merely gnash their teeth.
‘Shit! The faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple is at its highest around the world…!’
This was to be expected since Lee Gun had taken care of the calamities sent by Confusion.
The events were broadcasted live, and everyone around the world was singing praises about Lee Gun.
This was true for them too!
‘Shit! At this rate—’
The power of Death appeared as a spearhead and flew toward the defenseless disciples.
“Kuhk!”
“Kuh-huhk!”
“Ahk!”
However, someone kicked the disciples so that Death’s attack would miss them.
‘!’
He was moving so fast that it looked as if he was teleporting. The disciples became surprised when they realized who it was.
“H-Hugo-nim!”
“Uh. I’m not sure what’s going on, but he’s the bad guy, right?”
The Zodiac Saints laughed when they saw Hugo being able to move freely.
‘Since he’s the only one who isn’t an affiliate, the pressure doesn’t work against him!’
This Hugo was an existence from the past. He was the only person with no connections to the Lee Gun who had become a Zodiac.
Moreover, that era was before Lee Gun became deified. This was why Hugo didn’t have any faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple.
‘Compulsory Order doesn’t work on him!’
Moreover, this was when Hugo had gone all-in on his speed. He had been an evasive archer! At that time, Hugo had been the fastest among them.
The Chun siblings, who Hugo saved, cried as they were held in Hugo’s arms.
“Dad!”
“Daaaaaad!!!”
“What?? Dad?? What the hell are you talking about?”
“Dad!!”
“What the hell? Did I marry??? That can’t be?? I have to serve my teacher. There is no way. I hate the idea of marriage??”
Suddenly, Time extended his hand as if he was angry.
Kevin yelled. “Archer!! Dodge! Lee Gun is trying to kill you!”
“W-What? He really is my teacher?!”
“Who did you think he was?”
“Wow! That’s crazy! Teacher became a Zodiac?”
“Ah!”
For some reason, they got an ominous feeling. Then they bit their tongue.
[Hugo Otis’s Serpent Bearer Faith]
[0 ▶ 600%]
They couldn’t see the figure, but it was obvious what was going on. The Zodiac Saints despaired at the same time.
Kevin was the one who had mentioned Lee Gun by name, and he despaired once he recognized his mistake. “Ha… I forgot he was a Lee Gun fanatic at the time.”
“You idiot! Hugo couldn’t recognize him because Lee Gun became younger!”
Hugo’s mouth fell open when he heard Stevens. “What?! Teacher became younger?”
“Huh? Uh… He came back younger after he revived—”
“What? He revived himself??!!”
[600% ▶ 1000%]
“That’s amazing! Teacher! I’ll be sure to serve you better!”
It seemed Hugo’s blind faith might have started at this point.
The Zodiac Saints massaged their foreheads as they watched Hugo sob in joy.
“Hey. Are you sure this is fine? Aren’t we changing the future by doing this?!”
“I’m sorry… We are done for. It’s my fault.”
As if she were responding to Kevin’s solemn conduct, Sophie became sad.
“Hoo-oohk, Hugo. Please look over here.”
Dumbfounded, Time tried to use Compulsory Order. Hugo wasn’t someone from this era. His faith shouldn’t be able to affect the current reality. It was merely numbers.
It didn’t matter if his faith rose or not. Hugo was able to escape the pressure put on him by the Zodiac. This was why Time wanted to attack Hugo for himself.
“I’m too slow!!”
Hugo had received brutal one-to-one daily battle lessons. He was very sharp. Unlike his self from the current time, the younger Hugo wasn’t deliberate in deciding his action. He was an evasive archer who fought on instinct! His physical specs were completely different.
This meant the person who had sent Hugo took all of this into consideration. Above all else, Time was still getting used to Lee Gun’s body.
“…!!!”
When Time saw Hugo move around at an absurd speed, he was about to use Cycle.
“Is that the source of your power?”
Hugo aimed for the ring of Order, which Time was wearing. He sent a powerful attack, but the ring didn’t break. However, the attack was able to disturb it for a brief moment.
“Koo-oohk…!!”
The balance between Life and Death fluctuated violently. When it lost its balance, Death started going berserk and tormented Time.
Lee Gun had a hard time controlling Death. Now, the Divine status was tormenting Time.
If Time couldn’t control Death, the power of Cycle would no longer be within his reach. Time gritted his teeth as he tried to control Death. However, something happened when Time’s focus shifted to somewhere else.
[Acceptance of the Serpent Bearer affiliates has been completed.]
“!!!”
The disciples flinched when they suddenly heard the voice. Did the missing Lee Gun accept them as affiliates?
The Chun siblings yelled out loud.
“Magical energy! Use it as much as you can!!”
“!!”
“That’s right! The Saint ranks should use so much magical energy that the Zodiac can’t withstand it!”
“He can’t pay attention to us because of Death! Hurry!”
“We have to consume all of the Zodiac’s magical energy!”
“He isn’t Lee Gun-nim, so it doesn’t matter!”
Time had known that such a thing was possible. It was why he hadn’t accepted the affiliates.
“You dare.”
Unfazed by their actions, Time approached them. “I’ll get rid of you all with Death.”
Bbah-gahk!!!
However, Hugo kicked Time. “If you aren’t my teacher, I have no reason to be afraid of you.”
“…!” Time became angry. He tried to use the power of Time, which he planned on not using.
Kahng!!
But the sound of something being severed rang out as Time’s face hardened. The culprit was someone he knew well.

chapters.title: Chapter 315
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Let’s See Who Wins (2)
“Kuhk!”
Lee Gun opened his eyes as he clutched at his distressed heart.
‘Shit!’
He had taken a gamble to enter Time’s body. Before he was going to get dismantled, he had used Time’s ability to get out of there. That had been his first goal!
Of course, he had no idea how to use Time’s ability since that was the ability of a monster.
‘It can’t be that much different from using the ability of a human!’
Thinking that, Lee Gun had used his magical energy at full power. Then, the power of Time had activated as if it was reacting to Lee Gun’s magical energy.
Flash!
Afterward, Lee Gun kept feeling nauseous; he felt like dying. It was as if he were inside a ball with no gravity and being shaken in all directions.
When that feeling came to a stop, Lee Gun opened his eyes to an unfamiliar location. “Shit! I don’t think this is hell.”
A wasteland appeared before his eyes. It seemed he wasn’t dead since he heard the notification sound.
[You have used the ability of Time.]
[You have crossed to a different timeline.]
Of course, Lee Gun had no idea why he was able to hear the notification when he was within Time’s body.
‘I don’t know who the owner of this voice is, but it might be the Seat of power.’
A Seat of power was like a throne for the Zodiac. It seemed as if the Seat of power made a contract with a god’s soul. That was probably why Lee Gun could still hear the voice. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘The important part is that I can use Time’s abilities.’
It was obvious to Lee Gun that Time was going to kill and revive his disciples to level up Life. The monarch would try to master the power of Cycle through that method.
‘It means I have to beat him to the punch. Also, I might not be able to handle the power of Cycle very well, but that bastard has experience on his side. He’ll be able to use it well. I have to hurry.’
Lee Gun quickly surveyed his surroundings. However…
[This is where you ran away?]
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun vomited blood as he heard an unfamiliar voice. The voice came from behind him. He felt as if a sharp spear blade was digging into his chest.
[A mere cub dares to do this.]
“…!”
When Lee Gun turned his head, he couldn’t believe what he saw.
‘That bastard is…!’
The one standing behind him was a pitch-black monster. Moreover, Lee Gun clearly remembered who it was.
‘Space-Time…!’
He was sure of this. It was the undead monarch that had been trapped in the basement of the Devil’s Tower, which was ruled by Time.
Lee Gun had used the infinite reset to take EXP and the Space ability from him.
‘It was the form that I saw from Time’s past, Space-Time in its heyday.’
Space-Time laughed as he took out the hand that had pierced Lee Gun’s chest.
[You’re a cub who was born not too long ago, yet you thought you could win against us.]
Space-Time looked down on Lee Gun.
Lee Gun groaned as he was kicked.
‘Shit! According to this bastard, I’m in the very distant past.’
Of course, Lee Gun had no idea if he was on a timeline where he existed or not. The only sure part was that this was one of the 18732 times that Time had returned to.
This was the distant past, long before the Space-Time monarch was sealed away in the Devil’s Tower as a weak undead being!
Oblivious to everything else, the Space-Time monarch laughed unpleasantly.
[You act presumptuously. You tried to kill the parents who brought you into this world.]
Lee Gun flinched.
‘Parents?’
That question lasted only a moment as Space-Time savagely attacked Lee Gun.
Koo-goo-goong!
Lee Gun deflected his arm on reflex.
Kwahng!
That wasn’t all.
“How dare you act high and mighty, undead bastard!” Lee Gun instantly disappeared, then reappeared above Space-Time’s head, surprising the monarch.
[What the hell?]
Space-Time seemed surprised by “Time’s” movement, which he had never seen before. The eyes of Space-Time turned menacing as if he had realized something.
[Who are you?]
Lee Gun laughed as he appeared above Space-Time’s head. He didn’t have a weapon, but his current body would become a monarch-rank in the future.
‘He probably has useful specs!’
As expected, something surprising happened.
Kwah-jeek!
“!”
His right arm, which had looked like a human’s, changed into that of a monster. Lee Gun smirked when he felt the power, and he aimed for Space-Time’s head. “Die!”
Although he didn’t have a weapon, he was a monster hunter who had survived the Devil’s Tower without a weapon.
‘It’ll be no problem if I have this.’
It was as expected.
Pahng!!!
Lee Gun’s powerful fist pierced through Space-Time’s face…
[You don’t know your place.]
The monarch laughed disparagingly as Lee Gun’s monster arm changed back into a human arm.
“!!”
That wasn’t all.
“Kuhk!”
Lee Gun was unable to use his magical energy in front of Space-Time. He had no idea why.
At that moment, Space-Time immediately decapitated Lee Gun.
“!!”
The sensation of his head being cut off was horrifying. It was clearly the sensation of death. Lee Gun fell to the floor, unable to move.
He didn’t die immediately, but his consciousness started to fade away. At that moment, Lee Gun reflexively tried to use his ability.
[You have used Time Travel.]
It seemed the power of the Serpent Bearer and Time was quite similar. Lee Gun used the power of Time Rewind to put his head back on.
[Shit! That bastard!]
Space-Time gnashed his teeth as he tried to chase after Lee Gun, but Lee Gun disappeared into the light.
When Lee Gun opened his eyes once again, he was much further in the past.
“Koohk…!”
Lee Gun was surprised when he checked his surroundings. It was to be expected since this was a familiar sight.
[The great twelve Zodiacs have lost their minds!]
[It’s fine! Their Constructs have killed their crazy masters!]
[Peace is here once again!]
“…!!”
He had moved to the time when the original owners were murdered by the current twelve Zodiacs. It was the same scene that the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of Power had shown Lee Gun.
‘Is this the Divine world?’
Lee Gun had been dropped within a desolate forest. However, it was a familiar location.
‘It’s the old holy ground of the Serpent Bearer temple.’
It was the Nameless Land, which Lee Gun had designated as his holy ground. It was the land possessed by Abundance and what the Zodiacs didn’t want to lose at all costs.
The Nameless Land was the holy ground of the original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple.
However, this didn’t matter either. The important part was the scene playing out in front of Lee Gun.
[Dig out the buried corpses of the Zodiacs.]
It looked to be the Space-Time monarch and the other monarchs. They were different from the six monarchs who had invaded earth. Moreover, Space-Time was in disguise. His face was the same, but his body was that of a god.
The monarch of Space-Time ordered his subordinate, who had come with him.
[Hurry up and take it out. The Constructs are having a festival for killing the thirteen Zodiacs. We have to finish our work before they get back.]
[Yes!]
The underling started taking a corpse out of the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground. Lee Gun was surprised when he saw the face of the corpse.
‘It’s the original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple!’
He was sure of it. The corpse that the subordinate had taken out of the ground was the original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple. However, the more surprising part was what happened next.
[A great child will be born if I use a Zodiac of this caliber.]
Space-Time turned the Serpent Bearer’s body into a hunk of meat. Then, at his gesture, a bug appeared on the hunk of meat.
The bug ate the entire corpse. After it was finished, the bug kept growing as it let out a fierce roar.
Space-Time laughed.
[Don’t whine too much. I have more food for you.]
Space-Time looked at the subordinate, who had dug the ground. The subordinate flinched.
[M-Master?]
The subordinate didn’t even have time to scream as the bug ate him. The squirming bug soon turned into something that Lee Gun recognized.
‘That is…!’
It was Time. He looked like a young child, but there was no mistaking his face.
Lee Gun suddenly had an understanding of everything.
‘Time was a monarch born using the body of the thirteenth original owner.’
Was this why Time had developed that particular ability? Was this why he was able to use the power of Cycle? Time had been influenced by the Serpent Bearer.
‘Both abilities feel similar.’
The reason Time was able to use Lee Gun’s power of the Serpent Bearer was…
‘Is it because the original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple is his parent?’
Time was a monarch created using the body of the original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple. That might be why Time was able to use the Serpent Bearer’s power. That wasn’t all.
[Next is this one.]
When the monarch of Space-Time made another gesture, a different corpse appeared in the air. It was a Zodiac Lee Gun had never seen before, but he immediately recognized who it was.
[He’s the original owner of the Sagittarius temple.]
For some reason, the notification sounded frosty. However, that wasn’t important right now.
Flash!
Like what had happened with time, the original owner of the Sagittarius temple became a hunk of meat, and another monarch was born. This one was none other than….
‘Confusion.’
This was how those two monarchs were born.
Space-Time had used the usurpation by the current twelve Zodiacs to his advantage. However, Lee Gun soon felt that something was off.
‘Wait a moment?’
If Time and Confusion were born like that, what about the other monarchs?
‘It was the same for Oblivion, Abundance, and Negligence. Weren’t they all monarchs made using the corpses of the original owner?’
If this time period was when Time was born, it would have been impossible for him to make the other monarchs using the corpses of the original owners.
Lee Gun soon felt a chill run up his spine.
‘Did he go back in time?.’
Lee Gun had seen Time’s memories, and he remembered the words exchanged in the fight between Time and Space-Time.
– Do not be conceited, old fools. You guys are dim-witted beings that cannot move against time.
– !
– You guys are creatures that can live on only a single rail.
It seemed Time had gone back in time and manipulated the past to a small degree.
Space-Time had used the usurpation of the original Zodiacs to stealthily create Time and Confusion.
However, Time had boldly approached the current Zodiacs out in the open. He pretended to give information about events that would eventually happen and, in return, asked for the corpses of the original owners.
He helped them pull off the usurpation more cleanly.
‘It wasn’t a coincidence that Time was able to make the other monarchs from the corpses of the Zodiacs.’
He probably knew about his origins.
‘Now, I know everything.’
Lee Gun knew what Time was aiming for. He also knew why he wasn’t able to attack the Space-Time monarch.
‘When Space-Time made Time, he probably placed several restrictions on him.’
Space-Time had probably made it so Time couldn’t attack the parent who had made him. It was why Time was aiming for the power of Cycle.
‘He can turn it back to the time before the great monarchs were born. It also might be possible to kill them by returning them to death.’
However, Time had imprisoned Space-Time within the Devil’s Tower as a living corpse.
‘Or maybe he already used the power of Cycle to create that state?’
Lee Gun’s guess was probably right. Time had returned 18,732 times into the past and gathered the souls of Yeonwoo and Junwoo. While this method was weaker, he was still able to use the power of Cycle.
As a result, the Space-Time monarch had become a living corpse.
‘However, that was the limit, since the power of Cycle was weak.’
This was why Time was unsatisfied and was trying to acquire the perfect power of Cycle through Lee Gun. However, that wasn’t important.
‘I have a rough idea of how to kill Time now.’
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he glared toward somewhere. While Space-Time was distracted, he charged toward the newly born Time.
This shocked Space-Time.
[W-Who the hell are you?]
However, he didn’t even have time to be surprised.
Kwah-jeek!!!
Lee Gun blew apart the head of the newly born Time. He killed Time, shocking Space-Time.
[That bastard!]
Lee Gun let out an evil laugh. “That’s one for now.”
In his attempt to get rid of Time, the ones that interfered the most were the Times from the other timelines. They had appeared in droves. So what should he do then?
“I’ll kill all of them.”
This included the Times from all the timelines.
“I’ll kill all 18,732 of them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 316
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Let’s See Who Wins (3)
Lee Gun let out an evil smirk as he killed a young Time. Of course, he had no idea if killing 18,732 Times was the right strategy.
At the very least, if he killed them all, they wouldn’t piss him off anymore by rushing him with great numbers. Therefore, Lee Gun laughed as if he was having fun.
‘I’ll put this body to excellent use.’
At that moment, was it because he had killed a young Time?
[Who the hell are you!]
Lee Gun snorted when Space-Time raged. “I’m me.”
The words left the monarch dumbfounded. He menacingly approached Lee Gun.
[I don’t care who you are. Die!]
“Hmmph. Catch me if you can, idiot!” Lee Gun immediately used his skill.
[Time Travel]
Since he still remembered the sensation of using it earlier, he didn’t have much trouble activating it. Of course, he wasn’t used to the ability, so he couldn’t set the target…
‘However, I just have to go to the general location where I can feel the other Times are located, right?’
He didn’t know how, but he could feel the countless versions of Time scattered everywhere. This was possible because he was inside Time’s body. Moreover, Lee Gun had the intuition of a hunter, which he had developed through amassing experience.
‘Anyway, I remember the energy of the one I killed before.’
If he killed the young Time, it would be easy to kill Time. Moreover, wouldn’t it erase Time from that timeline?
It was as he had expected.
As soon as Lee Gun crossed to another timeline, he ran somewhere as if he were a madman. This time, he had been dropped in a desolate land!
Lee Gun instantly disappeared and reappeared where the young Time was located! The young Time didn’t even have time to realize Lee Gun’s presence.
‘Two!’
Poo-hahk!!!
Lee Gun ruthlessly decapitated Time. Then, he immediately used Time Travel!
“Three!”
“Four!”
“Ten!”
“Hundred!”
Lee Gun kept picking only the young Times as he kept decapitating them over and over again.
“Ha ha ha! Someone so young fooled around a lot when he was young!”
Time tried to lure and eat a human, but Lee Gun slaughtered the monarch. Occasionally, Lee Gun ran across a bit more mature versions of Time, who tried to kill him. However, it didn’t matter.
Poo-hahk!!!
Lee Gun had felt it clearly.
‘Time’s power gets weaker the more I kill them.’
He knew it for sure now that he was inside Time’s body.
‘The Time that showed up in front of me was his final form.’
That meant the body Lee Gun had entered was Time’s final form. In other words, this was the body that had returned to the past tens of thousands of times, the body with the highest accumulated EXP and stats.
Moreover, it seemed Time was connected to its versions in other timelines. Therefore, the power of Time slowly weakened as Lee Gun killed more of its versions from other timelines.
‘Well, one has to exist in the past to exist in the present.’
The more Lee Gun killed Time’s past existences, the more of its accumulated power disappeared. That was the theory.
However, Time’s power weakening wasn’t harmful to Lee Gun.
Poo-hahk!!!
[You have killed 3,889 Times.]
[You have amassed EXP.]
[The stats of the Serpent Bearer temple have increased.]
Time’s power was weakening, but Life’s EXP was rising at a rapid pace. It was possible because Lee Gun’s soul was that of the Serpent Bearer. Despite Time’s power weakening, he had no trouble killing the other Times.
‘He’s merely a monster!’
Moreover, it wasn’t as if he would be unable to use the ability to cross timelines if he killed them.
Lee Gun laughed as if he was excited. “Ha ha ha ha! It is fun killing him!”
[You have killed 4,000 Times.]
[You have amassed EXP.]
Of course, he didn’t put the EXP toward the Serpent Bearer temple despite amassing it. That was the path to self-destruction.
‘If I send it to the Serpent Bearer temple right now, he will get stronger.’
Time was occupying his body. Therefore, Lee Gun stored all the EXP within Time’s body, which he was possessing right now.
In the beginning, he had wondered if that was possible, but Time’s body was made using the original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple.
The body seemed to be recognized as the Serpent Bearer, so it became possible to store the EXP within it.
‘I’ll take the EXP when I go back to my own body.’
At that moment…
[Zodiac Lee Gun is trying to kill his affiliate Zodiac Saints.]
[Zodiac Lee Gun is showing clear hostility toward the disciples.]
‘!’
Lee Gun’s eyes turned violent when he heard the notification. Time, who possessed his body, was trying to kill his disciples.
‘He’s trying to pull off this nonsense to raise the level of Life.’
Lee Gun had thought killing Time would harm the Time within his body.
‘I guess it isn’t enough?’
Of course, it would be troublesome if Time realized what was going on, so this was preferable for Lee Gun. This was also why he thought about accepting the request from the other temples to become his affiliates.
All the twelve Zodiac temples had sent a request wanting to become affiliates under the Serpent Bearer temple.
‘If twelve Saint ranks put their minds to it, they would be able to deplete the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer temple.’
His niece and nephew were smart, so they would quickly come up with that idea.
[Zodiac Lee Gun is interfering with the Affiliate request]
‘Really?’
Time seemed worried about that scenario too, so he was interfering with the Affiliate request.
[Zodiac Lee Gun is using Compulsory Order to threaten the disciples.]
Time seemed to be capable of using his body without a problem. So Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘Is there anything I can do?’
At that moment…
[Bastard! You are here!]
“!!”
Lee Gun arrived at a different timeline and reared back in shock. It was to be expected since Space-Time had caught sight of him. Space-Time charged toward Lee Gun.
‘Shit. Did I mistakenly come to a timeline that I’ve already visited?’
Lee Gun gnashed his teeth. He was about to jump to a different timeline in a hurry.
Kwahng!!!
“!”
However, a fire arrow surprised him. The fierce arrow blew apart the Space-Time monarch.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he looked at the destroyed Space-Time
‘Clone?’
This was a clone with 1/100th of the power of the monarch’s real body. From the energy he could feel from it, Lee Gun could clearly sense the power of the Cancer temple.
‘Is it a monster made by the Crab bastard?’
At that moment…
A familiar person who had destroyed Space-Time appeared in front of Lee Gun. “Damn it! I’m in a hurry. What the hell is this?”
Lee Gun became surprised when he heard the grumbling voice.
“I have to quickly buy the hair growth solution for Teacher. I have to take it back to him!”
‘Taeksoo!’
That’s right. The one to appear before him was the young. From the looks of it, it was Hugo from twenty years ago!
Hugo was oblivious as he was talking to someone on the phone. “Ah! Yes. Hello? Teacher, I’m sorry. I was on my way to buy a hair loss solution when Jean-Louis interfered… What?! If I can’t steal it, I’ll have to run back to Korea?! You do know that I’m in China, right?!”
By how he acted, this was the period when Hugo was a student under him. That meant…
‘I’m on the timeline where I exist.’
Lee Gun started to sweat. If he moved recklessly, his future might change. It was a dangerous timeline to be on. But then…
“Hey, you! You’re the Cancer Saint, right? Teacher said I have to forage for prey!”
“!”
It was unclear as to what kind of order Lee Gun’s past self had given to Hugo, but Hugo attacked him.
Since Lee Gun was worried about changing the future, he was about to ignore Hugo and turn around.
“Whatever. You’ll become a nutrient for Teacher’s hair!”
Those words pissed off Lee GUn. He ran toward Hugo. “You dare try to make me into a nutritional supplement!!”
Lee Gun sent Hugo flying with a kick. “You wanna die.”
He thought Hugo would shut up after taking a kick, but Hugo unexpectedly grabbed Lee Gun’s foot. “Hey! Who the hell are you? Why do you move the same way as my teacher? Did you do something to my teacher?”
Lee Gun realized his mistake. He had forgotten about it because he had bickered with Hugo over the years. However, this was the era where Hugo had been a fanboy!
Lee Gun was annoyed, so he kicked Hugo. He wanted to make Hugo unconscious.
‘Wait a moment. Taeksoo wasn’t an affiliate under the Serpent Bearer temple during this period.’
That wasn’t all.
‘Taeksoo from this period might be useful for a different reason.’
In this period, Lee Gun had taught Hugo directly, so he knew Hugo’s skills at this period better than anyone. So, he said, “Hey.”
“What!”
“You’ll have to help your teacher for a short time.”
“W-What?”
Lee Gun activated and used the Time Travel skill on Hugo. He didn’t know Time’s location, but that didn’t matter to him.
‘I just have to send him to the strongest Time!’
Time, who had entered Lee Gun’s body, had returned to the past 18,732 times. It was the final form with the most power amassed.
Lee Gun could feel the countless Times, and he sent Hugo to the one with the strongest energy.
An explanation would be a luxury to Hugo. Moreover, Lee Gun had something more important to do! He had to kill Times!
Lee Gun kept crossing timelines as he killed Time again and again.
[You have killed 17,889 Times.]
[You have amassed EXP.]
[You have killed 17,890 Times.]
[You have killed 17,931 Times.]
[You have killed 17,999 Times.]
Poo-oohk!!!
[You have killed 18,000 Times.]
[You have amassed EXP. You can evolve Life now.]
“Ha ha ha. I bet this will start to hurt!”
* * *
Around the same time…
Kahng!!
Time shook as the sound of something being severed rang out. The next instant, the strength drained out of him.
Time’s senses had been dulled after entering Lee Gun’s body, and he finally realized what was going on.
‘That bastard.’
Time had no idea how many of his different selves Lee Gun had eliminated, but Lee Gun had killed enough to affect him, the final form of Time. That wasn’t all.
‘That bastard is sending EXP to Death.’
Lee Gun was purposefully growing Death so that Time couldn’t control that power. This was why Time quickly tried to signal his other selves in the other timelines. He was about to tell the others to stop Lee Gun before they all died.
Poo-hahk!!
At that moment, the sound of blood splattering rang behind him, then the sound of something rolling across the ground echoed.
The thing that rolled next to Time’s feet was none other than another Time’s head.
“That’s 18,732.”
“…!!!!”
All the disciples were surprised to see who had shown up behind them. Time was the same.
Lee Gun stood there, drenched in the blood of 18,732 Times, licking his lips.
“I guess you’re the only one left?” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he pointed the blade at his own throat.

chapters.title: Chapter 317
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Let’s See Who Wins (4)
Monsters! No one could pinpoint their origin. However, it was assumed that their ancestors were the leftovers of the universe, the ones that had fought each other and survived.
Moreover, they possessed a disposition toward Gluttony. They ate all living beings, including gods and humans. They grew up to become a class 1 dangerous species in the universe.
In other words, they were like the devils of consumption.
They were so dangerous that even the great Zodiacs and the evil gods avoided them. They were beings everyone in the universe feared.
Anyway, Time was from the third generation of monsters, and for a very long time, he had tried to kill the monarchs from the previous generation.
[I cannot win against the previous generations no matter which method I use.]
They were beings akin to his parents, who had made him. Of course, he couldn’t kill them using his own technique. However, Time had finally found a way to kill his parents. It was possible because he was capable of traversing time.
[Ah! My god! They are the origin of my parents?]
At the same time, he understood why the twelve original owners had been usurped in such a baffling manner.
[Yes. They are all fakes except for the thirteenth.]
In this process, Time learned about the power of Cycle. While none of his attacks worked against the previous generations, the power of Cycle could turn them into nothing.
‘I can use that power to turn anything back to the state before their birth. I can rewind it to their genesis.’
It was why Time had made his plan.
‘I’ll revert them to the time of their genesis and consume the body that is my parent.’
Therefore, Time had acquired the power of Cycle and grown the power by returning to the past 18,732 times.
At the same time, he had skillfully conspired with the twelve Zodiacs to torment humanity. However, it didn’t matter. In the end, he was met with failure after failure!
No matter how many times he upgraded the power of Cycle by killing Yeonwoo and Junwoo, he was unable to turn his predecessors back to the state before their genesis.
This was why he became a great monarch and imprisoned his parent inside the Devil’s Tower.
At his actions, his parent, Space-Time, had laughed mockingly.
[Oh, great monarch. It doesn’t matter what you do. You cannot get rid of us.]
[What?]
[You act as if your ability to traverse time is something amazing, but you’re merely a nomad who travels through time.]
[!]
[You belong to no world. You’re an irritant and an unwanted guest— Kuh-huhk!!]
That was why Time despaired for his future and decided to switch up the plan.
[After I return to the past this time, I’ll end this plan.]
He finally arrived in the 18,733rd world. After ending 18,732 worlds, Time decided to end everything on this timeline. He planned on getting rid of humanity and going to a different dimension, the divine world.
It was the year 1995, five years before the invasion where he would always take down humanity as his prey. However, when Time tried to acquire the power of Cycle this time, he felt something was off.
[Something is wrong, Master. The Serpent Bearer isn’t in her cage!]
[!]
At this point, Yeonwoo should be in a cage within a zoo. Yeonwoo and Junwoo had always been reborn as snakes belonging to the zoo. However, something strange happened in this timeline.
[What? The Serpent Bearers were born as humans?]
It was a huge change. Until now, Yeonwoo and Junwoo had never reincarnated as humans, not even once in the past 18,732 times!
Then, Lee Gun showed up.
Time felt his heart beat faster.
‘The future is changing.’
He had never seen Lee Gun before.
Time was delighted after Lee Gun received the power of the Serpent Bearer. It was why he ordered Jean-Louis to trap Lee Gun inside the Devil’s Tower.
