Then he kept resetting Lee Gun’s time within the Devil’s Tower and carried out various experiments to grow Lee Gun’s power.
When Lee Gun used his own power to break out of the tower, it had shocked Time, but he was also satisfied.
At the end of the day, that power would be his. That was what was supposed to happen…!
“You’re the only one left.”
“…!”
After killing all the Times from the other timelines, Lee Gun appeared as he eerily laughed.
Lee Gun placed a blade on his neck. “Will you die if I kill this body?”
The Zodiac Saints were shocked to hear those words.
“Wait a moment. That flippant way of speaking…!”
“Are you Lee Gun?!”
This man had the face of Time, yet he spoke in a tyrannical and flippant manner! Those were the hallmarks of Lee Gun!
However, someone got angry at those words. “Hey! Who are you saying is flippant? How dare you say such thoughtless words to my teacher! No, before that, are you sure that’s my teacher?”
Hugo huffed in anger, but in reality, he was stunned at this situation.
Lee Gun ignored them as it looked like he was about to cut his own body’s throat. “Will you give me back my body willingly, or do you want to die like this?”
Time scoffed as he made a gesture with his hand. At the same time, the mark of the Serpent Bearer appeared on Time’s hand, emitting light.
[Zodiac Lee Gun has used the authority of the Serpent Bearer to summon his Constructs]
Accompanying the light, all the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple were summoned.
[M-Master!]
They immediately recognized which one was Lee Gun, but Time possessed Lee Gun’s body. So, laughing, the monarch used Compulsory Order.
“It doesn’t matter what you do to that body, because it would be suicide for you. You cannot return even if you kill that body. You cannot kill me.”
“Is that so?”
“I may be surprised by what you have done, but that is all. You cannot use any other abilities.”
Time could tell just at a glance. Despite entering his body, Lee Gun could use only the Time Travel ability and that too only by instinct.
However, Lee Gun mockingly spoke as if Time was speaking nonsense. “That’s not true? I can do this too?”
“!”
The next moment, a large magic circle appeared beneath Lee Gun’s feet. Time’s face hardened when he saw what was being summoned. And he wasn’t the only one to be surprised.
“That is…!”
Constructs appeared along with enormous lightning bolts flashing in the sky. Moreover, they weren’t normal Constructs.
“Aren’t that…. aren’t they the highest-ranking Constructs?”
“They are the Constructs that the Zodiacs of Magic possessed!”
The ones to yell out loud were the Zodiac Saints.
Sophie shook in surprise when she recognized one of those Constructs. “They are the highest-ranked Constructs that Gemini imprisoned because they wouldn’t take orders…!”
She was sure of it. The beings emitting the white light were the highest-ranked Constructs that the Gemini Saint Heiji was incapable of controlling! It was something Heiji had been sad about!
Eeny, Meeny, and Miny had switched sides from the Gemini temple, so they roared in joy.
[Boss!]
[You are alright!]
When they had ignored the Gemini to give fealty to Lee Gun, they had talked about a Construct who wanted to meet Lee Gun.
[I apologize! You sent us first to the Serpent Bearer to serve him, but…!]
[We should have accompanied Master to look for you. We apologize for being late…!]
[I am glad you’re ok!]
Time looked taken aback as Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
“After I got rid of the magic temples, you secretly took away the Constructs possessed by Pisces, right?”
“…!”
Time had been in league with Pisces, who had basically led the usurpers.
The Pisces temple was also a magic-type temple, the same as the Gemini temple. When the Gemini temple had fallen, Pisces had cut them off as if she were severing a tail. Then she had taken all the Constructs.
When even the Pisces temple was eradicated, Time naturally siphoned away their Constructs.
Lee Gun laughed. “I extensively searched for Constructs within the Pisces temple’s holy ground, yet I couldn’t find a single one. I found that odd.”
“…!”
Time furrowed his brows. He had put away those Constructs to use them as food at a later date, yet Lee Gun was able to take them out.
However, Time just snorted. It didn’t matter since they were mindless gods of destruction. “You might now know this, but they are the ones that broke down the ego of the magic-type Zodiacs. They are destroyers that take orders from no one…”
At that moment…
Boom!!!
A portion of the summoned Constructs kneeled toward Lee Gun.
“…!!”
Time flinched.
Those Constructs then shouted as if they had yearned for him.
[Master.]
[We get to meet the great master once again.]
The Chun siblings were surprised, since this was a familiar sight.
‘In the past, some Constructs had shouted in joy toward Uncle. They had called him Master.’
These Constructs doing the same while looking at Lee Gun meant…
‘They are the Constructs of the old Serpent Bearer?’
It was similar to Iaso, who had been under the Aquarius temple, and Fairy King Mimir, who had been under the Gemini temple. The notification spoke.
[Servants of the Ruler of Snakes wail in joy when they see the Serpent Bearer.]
[They say they are the Constructs of the old Serpent Bearer temple.]
The thirteenth original owner had been famous within the Divine world for ruling over the strongest Constructs.
When he died, numerous Zodiacs had become greedy. They had forcefully stolen away the Constructs. This was true of the Constructs taken by the Zodiacs of Magic.
Time furrowed his brows.
‘They have lost their sense of self, yet they recognize their owner?’
Lee Gun grinned. “You guys, fight them!”
The summoned Constructs flew toward the Zodiacs and monsters threatening the disciples.
Lee Gun, who was stripped to the waist, ran toward Time as his eyes flashed. “Come! Heaven’s Punishment!”
Time became desperate as he quickly extended his hand. Time had the same thought as Lee Gun.
“Come!”
He activated the Imprint skill. The contracted body should be prioritized over Lee Gun’s voice. And as expected, the weapon flew toward Lee Gun’s body.
Kwahng!
“…!!!”
However, Lee Gun arrived before Time at that moment, and Heaven’s Punishment flew into his hand. Then he grinned. “That’s my Heaven’s Punishment.”
After flying toward its real owner, Heaven’s Punishment changed into its stage 3 form as it let out a fierce roar.
At the same time, Lee Gun stabbed Heaven’s Punishment toward his body.
Kwah-jeek!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
He didn’t go easy because it was his body. After piercing the shoulder with precision, he shouted as he lifted Heaven’s Punishment. “Hugo!!”
“!”
“Retrieve it! It’s exactly five centimeters above the belly button!”
“What?!”
“You have to do it exactly after 0.1 seconds!”
They didn’t even have time to be dumbfounded.
Lee Gun changed the direction of Heaven’s Punishment to decapitate his body.
Kwah-jeek!!!
The Chun siblings were shocked by the sight of Lee Gun’s head being decapitated, while Hugo immediately drew back on his bow.
Tahng!!!
There was no way he would miss. His arrow accurately pierced the location pointed out by Lee Gun.
Then, something surprising happened.
“Koohk!”
The decapitated head reattached itself as Lee Gun let out the light of Super Regeneration. Time, who had been hit by the arrow, vomited blood.
“Whew! I’m back.”
“U-Uncle?!”
As if he were showing off a grotesque trick, Lee Gun got up. When the Zodiac Saints looked at him for an answer, he snorted. “My soul gets ejected if I’m decapitated.”
“What?!”
“I experienced that in the Devil’s Tower when I killed the undead monarch…. When a soul is ejected, you inevitably have to go back to your body.”
It was all done to set up the next attack. Lee Gun had ordered Hugo to shoot the location where the monarch’s core was located.
“I have to take back my EXP.”
A flame appeared above Hugo’s hand, and a crow landed on his hand. Earlier, it was the Crow Arrow that he had sent flying.
[Crow Arrow (S)]
– The crow accurately takes an item that it likes.
– Retrieval skill
The crow spat something out on Hugo’s hand.
[Time’s Core]
It looked like a gem.
Hugo wailed in ecstasy when he was able to retrieve the core as ordered. “My god! Teacher didn’t call me a good-for-nothing for the first time! He called me by my name…!!!”
Time clutched at his stomach. His eyes flashed as he got up.
[How did you know the location of my Core…]
Lee Gun laughed in contempt. “I cut you apart 18,732 times. Of course, I’d know.”
[…!]
After taking Time’s core from Hugo, Lee Gun smirked. “Thanks for the EXP.”
Then he crushed the core with his hand.
Kwah-jeek!
[Number 18,733 Time’s EXP is entering you.]
[You have received all the stored Life energy at once.]
[Life has risen to level 6.]

chapters.title: Chapter 318
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Let’s See Who Wins (5)
[Number 18,733 Time’s EXP is entering you.]
[You have received all the stored Life energy at once.]
[Life has risen to level 6.]
Accompanying the notification, a brilliant light appeared from Lee Gun’s body. It was a radiant light never seen before until now. It was a light that signified the evolution of Life.
Of course, it was different from the explosion that happened when Death had leveled up. Death had made it seem as if a calamity had come to the world. The black light had tried to kill everything.
Life was the complete opposite.
[Life stage 6 roars.]
[The deceased are being revived.]
[The extinct plants are blooming.]
[Those who went extinct in the past are coming back to life.]
Boom!!!
The enormous earthquake made the disciples scream. Corpses started coming out of the ground as if they were responding to the light of Life.
“Ahhhhk! Skeletons!”
“Bugs!!”
“Ahhhhk!! What the hell are those prehistoric animals?”
It was as if beings from the netherworld were being called back. That wasn’t all.
[Hair is regrowing]
[All dead things are coming alive.]
“Ahhhk! C-Commissioner! Your Hair….!!”
“M-My god! The dead are coming back alive!”
“Hans!”
The people who had lost their lives came back to life, and the people screaming in pain became healthy.
Of course, stage 6 was a stage where powers went berserk. However, not all things were positive.
[The pain that you want to forget has been revived.]
[The dark history that you wanted to erase has been revived.]
“No!! I don’t want to relive that!”
“Ahhhk! It hurts! That place hurts!”
“Kuh-huhk! The cavity that was fixed last time is…!!”
“My appendix…!!”
“T-The monsters are coming back alive!!”
“Ahhhk! I have to reenlist! I have to start as a private!”
It seemed the memories that people wanted dead had been revived too. Things that didn’t need to be revived came back alive. People howled in pain in all directions.
As the Zodiac Saint of Life, Chun Sungjae looked like he wanted to die. He had fallen over while clutching between his legs.
“Ahhk! Uncle! Stage 6 is a bit— Ahhk! Daddy! My whale wants to live! Love and peace!”
[Life is going berserk]
[Life says everyone will live an eternal life while feeling pain.]
[Life has revived all the life and pain that had disappeared from the world.]
[Life wants to make a beautiful world where the dead, pestilence, and pain are all alive.]
When Death went berserk, it had tried to kill both allies and enemies. Life tried to bring everything back to life, including things that shouldn’t be brought back to life. It was a crazy situation!!
[The lost gods will be revived.]
[The lost treasures will be revived.]
[The Divine world is in an uproar]
This was on par with the god of calamity, which would be able to destroy the order of the universe.
Therefore, Lee Gun bit his tongue as he tried to control the power. Since he had only killed Time in his younger state, he thought there wouldn’t be enough EXP.
‘Shit! I guess I should have expected it from a monarch!’
The situation seemed as if he were suffering from indigestion because he had eaten too much. This was especially true for the final form of Time. It had given a significant amount of EXP.
Lee Gun tried to press down on Life, but Time let out a cold laugh.
[You must be having a hard time since you have so many that you want to protect!]
“!”
[Even you would have a hard time controlling a phenomenon of this magnitude.]
“Koohk!”
At that moment, Time was about to rush Lee Gun.
Kwahng!!
However, Chun Yooha brought her foot down on the ground, and black light started spreading in various directions. It was the power of Death!
She started killing beings that didn’t deserve to be brought back to life by Life. The move was effective since the Zodiac Saint of Death had taken action.
[Kee-ehhhk!!]
[Kee-ehhk!]
“Huh-uhk!!”
The revived monsters and the unknown prehistoric creatures disappeared.
“Huff, huff… What a relief.”
The people howling in pain came back to normal.
“Huh-uhng. I hate you, Dad! I really hate…!” Chun Sungjae, who had been in pain, also quieted down.
All the things that shouldn’t be alive were killed.
Chun Yooha had been looking after her brother when her eyes flashed. “Uncle! I’ll take care of everything else! You don’t have to try to control your berserk power! Just focus on Time!”
“Alright. Thank you.” Lee Gun no longer had to be careful. He sent the full power of Life toward Time.
Koohng!!
[Life has revived all the pain inflicted on Time.]
[All the wounds and pain felt through the 18,733 returns to the past will be revived all at once.]
[Life is sad about Time, who can reset everything if he fails.]
[Life says one’s life has to be full of pain. It says Time should feel the value of pain and endurance through eternity]
Time screamed as the light of Life surrounded him. Just the mere act of reviving pain was torturous.
However, he had been hit with wounds and pain he had suffered in the timeline that he had traveled back into. He almost lost consciousness when they hit him all at the same time.
[Kuh-huhk!!]
Moreover, Lee Gun had stolen his core, so it was hard for him to maintain his body. This was why Time tried to fall unconscious.
[Life is angry, saying how dare you try to forget about the pain.]
[Life has revived Time’s consciousness.]
[It has stopped Time from dying.]
The live torture was continuous. Normally, this pain couldn’t be called back since Lee Gun had killed every version of Time.
However, Life was in the calamitous stage 6, which could destroy the order of the universe!
In the end, Time glared at Lee Gun. However, Lee Gun let out a cold laugh as if to say Time was going nowhere. “Remember this well. You killed Yeonwoo and Junwoo 18,733 times. Your pain is nothing compared to theirs.”
[…!]
“This one is for the pain I endured within the tower!”
Time screamed. He could no longer stay on his feet. He gritted his teeth. The completed power of Cycle was in front of him, yet he could do nothing.
‘I’ll have to give up on this timeline.’
He decided to give up on Lee Gun and return in time.
‘If I’m lucky and there is another Lee Gun, I’ll just kill him when he is young and take over his body.’
Despite not having a core, he had enough power to return in time. That wasn’t all.
‘He looks like he’s fine, but he is barely controlling that power.’
Stage 6 was extremely powerful, but in its berserk state, the power didn’t care about its owner’s body!
Time laughed as he looked at Lee Gun.
‘I can visibly see his life expectancy decrease.’
He believed Lee Gun was barely holding on!
Flash!
Time squeezed out his last remaining power to activate his ability.
[Time has disappeared from this timeline.]
“!”
Time was trying to run away to the past. Lee Gun ground his teeth. If Time moved to the past, Lee Gun couldn’t do anything.
This was why Lee Gun had used the torture attack so that Time couldn’t even think about using his ability!
Time laughed in contempt.
[You’re a novice. The difference in our experiences is stark. Do not take a great monarch lightly.]
Lee Gun quickly headed toward Time, but he was a bit too late.
[Time is disappearing…]
Kahng!!
[!!]
Accompanying an odd sound, Time flinched. His body, which had been disappearing in a haze, snapped back in place.
“…!”
Surprised, he looked down at his hands. He had given up on everything to return to the past, yet he couldn’t run away. This could have only one reason.
“I fixed your time.”
[…!!]
The one to catch Time as he was about to run away was Hailey. Hailey used the same ability as Time and desperately called out to Lee Gun, “Lee Gun! I’ll keep him in place! Hurry!”
Time glared at her.
[You are…!]
“I’ll make sure you will never be able to use that power once again.” As if she had been waiting for this moment, Hailey used all the power of Time that she possessed.
[The power of Time has been sealed.]
[The ability of Time has been sealed.]
[Time can no longer use the power of time.]
Lee Gun laughed. Then the pain of Life bloomed once again!
[Ahhhk!!]
Lee Gun called forth Death. Since both of them were going berserk, it was hard for him to call forth the other Divine status. However, he had no choice.
[The Cycle ability is still on cooldown.]
[You will be able to use it after 1 minute.]
He had no choice but to keep them in check until he could activate the power of Cycle.
[59s]
[58s]
Time, who had been looking at Hailey with betrayal in his eyes, suddenly burst out laughing.
[Yes. You’re capable of that.]
Time let out an odd laugh. It was as if he had expected this moment. Then something shocking happened.
“…!”
“!!”
Hailey started vomiting blood. A long insect burrowed out of her heart. The Scorpio Saint fell to the ground in a bloody mess. The insect then took Hailey’s core from her body and headed toward Time.
Time laughed. The core was synonymous with Hailey’s life. This was why the power of Time was contained within her core.
[I’m glad I hid that just in case.]
“…!!”
[Die.]
Along with a curse, Hailey’s connection to her Zodiac was severed. Then Time used Hailey’s core to use the power of Time.
Boom!
Time disappeared in an instant. He had returned to the past. As soon as he disappeared, changes started occurring to this timeline.
[Warning! The timeline is about to collapse.]
[If this timeline collapses, everything will turn into nothing.]
It was Time’s strategy. The monarch was using his power to destroy the timeline containing Lee Gun. The Constructs gnashed their teeth since they knew this.
[Shit! If we don’t chase Time and stop him…!]
[However, we have no way of chasing after him!]
[How can we catch a time traveler?]
On the other hand, Lee Gun decided that healing Hailey was the priority. He approached her.
[Super Regeneration]
However, Hailey stopped Lee Gun from using Super Regeneration. Her kind couldn’t last long without a core.
“My body was made by Time. Basically, I’m connected to that man. If you heal me, that man will also receive the power.”
“…!”
It was why Time had taken down Hailey in such a cunning manner. She would be more helpful if he left her dying.
However, Hailey laughed as if she had been waiting for this moment. “I knew from the start that he would take my core.”
“What?”
“I will send you to Time.” The bloodied Hailey summoned something.
Lee Gun became surprised when he realized what it was. He naturally knew what it was.
“I was going to let my subordinate give it to you, but…” Hailey struggled to stroke Lee Gun’s face.
A light appeared from Lee Gun’s body. This was the only way someone could chase after a Time Traveler. It was a spell that Hailey had been preparing for a very long time.
“Go. Hurry up and get revenge for the one you love.” Hailey smiled.
* * *
Koo-goo-goong!
Time was breathing hard as he laughed. He had come to his 18,734th world. In place of his own core, he had placed Hailey’s core in his body. Now, he was destroying the timeline containing Lee Gun.
Countless parallel worlds existed, and one could usually interfere in one timeline from another. This was why Time hadn’t planned on getting rid of the timeline.
‘The risk is too high.’
If one destroyed a timeline, all the existences within the timeline would be destroyed. However, this was the only way Time could stop Lee Gun.
‘I’ll get rid of Lee Gun and anything that gets in my way with this. I’ll erase them all.’
He would be able to start a new life in the 18,734th world!
[No one will be able to chase me here and interfere in my—]
At that moment…
“Is that so? You were that confident in your ability to run away?”
[?!!]
Time was shocked by the voice that he heard coming from behind his back. It was to be expected since Lee Gun was standing behind him.
Time looked at Lee Gun as if he had seen a ghost. Flustered, he tried using his power to return in time again. This would be his 18,735th world!
Time wiped his sweat when he made sure he did his return properly.
[Shit… I thought I had returned, yet was I mistaken?]
“Really? Is this all you can do?”
[??!!]
Time almost fainted once again when he heard the voice.
Lee Gun had chased after him as if he were showing off. This bastard wasn’t supposed to have the power of Time!
18,736!
18,737!
18,740!
18,800!
Time kept running away over and over again, yet Lee Gun kept showing up next to him. It flustered him.
Time’s case was understandable since he had stolen Hailey’s ability, but Lee Gun should have no way to follow him.
[How…!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he said, “Confusion.”
[…!]
“Your younger brother was always dragged along with you whenever you returned in time, right?”
[…!!]
C…Could it be?
Lee Gun ignored him. He just smirked as he activated the ability. “Give me the core that you stole!”
Lee Gun’s ability finally landed on the last enemy of humanity.
[The power of Cycle is being used.]
[Time is being dismantled.]

chapters.title: Chapter 319
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Ah. It was you (1)
[The power of Cycle is being used.]
[Time is being dismantled.]
The Divine status of Death was at stage 6, and Life had reached that stage as well. Stage 6 was the stage where the powers went berserk. In other words, it was the greatest strength that the Divine status could reach.
Lee Gun’s two Divine statuses had combined to activate the most powerful Cycle.
Koo-goo-goong!
It was powerful enough to instantly break down the power of a great monarch, who had become the best through returning through time for the 18,733rd time!
[Kuh-huhk!]
Time ground his teeth as the light of Cycle swept him up. This was the power that he had wished for. In his numerous returns to the past, this was the power that he wanted to see! He just never expected to see it in this fashion!
[Shit!!]
Time gnashed his teeth as he glared at Lee Gun. He was sure of it. Hailey was the reason Lee Gun was able to follow after him.
Like how he was able to temporarily use his power after losing his core, Hailey would have been able to do the same thing.
‘I was the one who gave Hailey her time ability and her knowledge about magic.’
Of course, there was no way she could best him with just that. He had naturally sealed her power when he sent her to humanity.
‘That is…!’
Time gritted his teeth when he saw something. Something was shining inside Lee Gun’s pocket. It was Confusion’s core. This was why Time made angry eyes.
‘My brother was always with me when I returned to the past.’
He didn’t know why that happened. The brothers just assumed it was influenced by heredity.
Time and Confusion were made from the thirteenth original owner and the original owner of the Sagittarius temple, respectively. They were siblings.
The younger brother was full of discontentment, but that had been advantageous for Time. His younger brother acquired EXP, and he didn’t have to explain what had happened in the previous returns to the past. Time didn’t need to go over the plan again, so it was convenient for him.
‘How dare that girl use it in this way…!’
Lee Gun couldn’t chase after him just from possessing Confusion’s core. However, it would be possible if Hailey was involved.
Hailey had used magic to place Confusion’s core within Lee Gun’s body and made it register Lee Gun as Confusion. This had only one implication.
“You will never be able to escape me!”
[Damn it!]
Lee Gun let out a menacing smile as he dismantled Time. However, he then dashed toward Time as if there was something more important than dismantling him. Lee Gun was aiming for Hailey’s Core!
‘I can heal Hailey if I have that!’
The core was like the heart of a human.
When Lee Gun extracted Hailey’s Core, something surprising happened.
– What? You found a way to get rid of Time?
– Are you sure, Princess?
“!”
A familiar sight unfolded before his eyes. It was probably one of Hailey’s memories.
This memory was from a time after Lee Gun had died and the world had crowned the Zodiac Saints as the heroes of humanity. Hugo held a grudge against the Zodiac Saints and had waged a battle of life and death against them.
It seemed Hailey had rescued him and was treating his unconscious self.
In Hugo’s fight, the royal holy item of the Archer Saint had been destroyed. Lee Gun had read in an article that an enormous island had wiped off the world from the fight.
Hailey was in bandages since she had been hurt trying to look for the missing Lee Gun within the tower.
– Yes. I wasn’t able to find Lee Gun, but…. I was able to find Confusion’s core.
– What? Confusion’s core…! Isn’t he Time’s younger brother? I heard he’s a human right now…
– Yes. This core was probably a leftover after Confusion was turned into a human. It was being used to run the tower.
Hailey seemed to have seen a part of Confusion’s memories from his core. It was unclear as to which memory she had seen, but she ground her teeth.
– I’m not sure who exactly was the true culprit, but Time is connected to Lee Gun’s death. Time is interested in Lee Gun.
– What? I thought Time wasn’t on the earth?
– With this core, I’ll be able to chase him when he time travels.
– That means…!
– I’ll help Hugo and keep leaking new reports that imply Lee Gun is still alive. If so, Time might show up here.
– !
– Then I’ll use this core to get rid of Time.
– My god! We were worried because you kept avoiding him. You finally plan on fighting your father!
– You suffered so much under him! You probably planned on getting your revenge against him for a very long time. Do you finally want to take over the seat of the great monarch?
Hailey didn’t answer them.
Lee Gun realized something when he saw this.
‘Was Hailey helping me because she wanted to kill Time?’
Hailey originated from the unknown civilization, so it always puzzled him as to why she kept helping him. He had assumed she helped him because she was afraid of him. But this made more sense. Lee Gun nodded as if all his questions had been answered.
Finally, Lee Gun put Hailey’s core in his pocket, and he was about to take out his hand.
– How are you doing, kitty?
“!”
Lee Gun was surprised by the unexpected voice. It was another one of Hailey’s memories. However, that wasn’t the reason for his surprise.
‘This memory…’
It was from Hailey’s point of view. She didn’t seem to be a human yet in this memory.
‘I’m pretty sure this is a four-legged animal.’
A familiar face hugged Hailey as he rubbed ointment on the cat. Lee Gun was surprised to see that face.
‘That kid is me.’
Yes, the young boy that Hailey was looking at was him. The young Lee Gun spoke as he rubbed the ointment on her.
– I hope the burn mark on your face heals.
Lee Gun clearly remembered this memory.
‘It was when I was in high school.’
At that time, while coming home, he had found a severely wounded kitten with a burn on her face.
Lee Gun had doted on that kitten, which had almost died, for a long time. That memory was still vivid in his mind.
However, the kitten had suddenly disappeared one day, so he had been very sad.
‘If I think back on it, it didn’t strictly look like a cat from the earth…’
That wasn’t all. There was another incident, after the monsters had appeared but before he had become an awakened being.
– Yeonwoo! Junwoo! Are you ok? A monster appeared at the house!
– Yes. We’re fine. It was already dead.
– Really? What happened here?
This incident was from before the twelve heroes had appeared. It seemed the cat version of Hailey had stayed nearby and protected them from monsters.
This had continued for several months, until Junwoo was killed. Hailey had protected them until she had gone on to become the Zodiac Saint of the Scorpio temple.
Lee Gun bit his tongue when he saw that memory. He had no idea what had caused Hailey to collapse in front of his house in her cat form, but…
‘It’s you.’
When he had met the twelve Zodiac Saints for the first time, Hailey had a peculiar reaction. He now understood why.
[Let’s negotiate.]
“!”
Time spoke as he was being dismantled. His upper torso was the only thing left. It made him desperate.
[Don’t you want revenge for your family? I’ll turn back time for you. I’ll send you back to the point before humanity was invaded.]
“!”
[I’ll send you back to a time when nothing had happened.]
“…”
[In the end, you plan on turning me into a holy item, like Confusion. However, you won’t be able to use the full extent of the power of Time…]
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. “Shut up! You aren’t worth the trouble to turn into a holy item.”
[!]
“It seems you’re mistaken. I’m not trying to change your personality as I did to Confusion.”
[…!]
“If I make a holy item from someone of your caliber, you’ll continue to reset time and cause me trouble.” Lee Gun let out a harsh laugh. “I’ll return you to a state before you are born. I’ll erase your existence itself. I’ll do what you planned on doing to Space-Time”
Time looked shocked. Dumbfounded, he glared at Lee Gun.
[If I cease to exist, Hailey will cease to exist. Do you not know this?]
“Fuck off! She isn’t your biological child.”
[…!!]
“Moreover, although Cycle will get rid of your existence, it doesn’t mean the past will be changed!”
The next moment, Time screamed. His head was the only body part left.
[Cycle is dismantling the rest of Time.]
[With the power of Cycle, the being that makes up Time will be revived.]
Time shouted as he feigned a smile.
[Do not think it ends here like this.]
“No one worth a salt says such a thing.”
Time laughed as if he couldn’t believe Lee Gun was so oblivious.
[You were able to chase me to this timeline because I am here.]
“!”
[In other words, you won’t be able to return if I disappear.]
After saying those words, Time smirked as if he could read what was going through Lee Gun’s mind.
[Don’t even think that you’ll be able to use my data. I have placed a curse on Time.]
It seemed he was determined not to die alone. Time squeezed out his last remaining power to place a curse on Time.
[If you use my ability, you’ll be broken down like me.]
Time spoke mockingly as he took in the sight of Lee Gun.
[No. That isn’t needed in the first place.]
“…!”
Lee Gun was surprised.
When Time was dismantled, changes started occurring to Lee Gun’s body.
[Warning! Time has aggravated the timeline.]
[Lee Gun is a being that shouldn’t exist on this timeline. He’s considered a foreign substance, and the being will be eliminated.]
Lee Gun’s body started to break down. Time laughed at this.
[You’re a mere bug that can exist only on the 18,733rd timeline. You cannot exist on the other timelines.]
“!”
[To keep the balance of this world, the timeline will have to erase a foreign substance like you.]
Time knew it well since he was a time traveler that jumped timelines. The timelines didn’t like intruders. In other words, only the 18,733rd timeline wouldn’t treat Lee Gun as a foreign substance. That was the only place he could live.
Time laughed.
[Without the power of Time, you won’t be able to return to your world. Do you really think you’ll be able to survive this?]
The gods considered Time troublesome for a reason. Even they had a hard time going against the flow of time.
A timeline was one of the untouchable facets of the order of the universe.
Lee Gun tried using a variety of skills, yet he couldn’t stop his body from being dismantled.
‘Shit!’
Moreover, the speed at which the process was happening was too fast. Lee Gun’s arms and legs had been dismantled. The process soon reached his neck.
[Your Divine status ceases to exist.]
[You cannot use your abilities.]
At this point, Time’s chin and mouth were the only body parts remaining of him. Yet, the monarch laughed.
[You, who share the same root as me, will die together with me!]
Lee Gun groaned. The ruthless power of the enormous universe pressed down on him to get rid of him. It was an irresistible force.
‘This is dangerous.’
A power that he could never escape by himself clutched at his body. It wasn’t a power that Super Regeneration could handle. His feet were ruthlessly broken apart, and his arms turned into dust. Then it was his lower body and upper body!
The ruthless power of disassembly kept climbing until only Lee Gun’s head was left.
‘Shit!’
Lee Gun used the data of time, which he had gathered by killing the numerous Times. However, it was useless.
[It has failed.]
[You cannot return to your original world.]
‘Shit! I have no way of returning…!’
Lee Gun’s mouth soon disappeared, and his eyes were about to disappear. But then…
[You disciples are looking for their god.]
[The disciples wish their god would appear in front of them.]
“!”
As the notification rang out, Lee Gun suddenly stopped disassembling. Then, something surprising happened.
[The faith of those looking for the Serpent Bearer can be felt.]
[Hundreds of millions of beings with strong faith are calling for the Serpent Bearer.]
[Will you answer their call?]

chapters.title: Chapter 320
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Ah. It was you (2)
[The faith of those looking for the Serpent Bearer can be felt.]
[Hundreds of millions of beings with strong faith are calling for the Serpent Bearer.]
[Will you answer their call?]
Lee Gun’s face brightened when he heard the notification, and his body stopped breaking down at once. That wasn’t all.
[A god is born through human faith and need.]
[A god is immortal if disciples believe and remember the god.]
The Zodiacs wanted disciples and faith for a reason. It didn’t matter if thousands of years had passed and the Zodiacs changed their locations. If they had disciples who kept believing in them, they would never disappear.
That was why Secretaries had been made to create Bibles. It was to make sure the gods’ existences wouldn’t disappear even if thousands of years passed.
Was it because the call for him was so strong? A change occurred to Lee Gun’s body, which had been about to disappear.
[The faith of hundreds of millions has revived the existence called Lee Gun.]
[Hundreds of millions of disciples do not want to lose the existence called Lee Gun.]
[Most of the faith on the earth is directed toward Lee Gun.]
[It is enough to embed his presence through all dimensions.]
[Lee Gun has been recognized as an essential being that is needed on the earth’s timeline.]
[The dismantling will be stopped.]
Flash!
Accompanying the light, Lee Gun’s body returned to normal. His dispersed torso, arms, and legs returned to their normal states.
When his body was reconstituted, Lee Gun vividly felt the energy of his disciples.
‘It isn’t just one or two disciples.’
Of course, his disciples boasted a unique presence that stood out, but this was different.
‘This number is almost the entire population of the earth.’
Yes, most on the earth missed Lee Gun and wanted him back. Moreover, regeneration of this magnitude couldn’t be done without true faith.
This was why Lee Gun’s heart was swollen with pride and warm feelings. A lot of things had happened to him, yet this signaled that his work hadn’t been meaningless.
On the other hand, Time was shocked. It was to be expected since the timeline and the power of the dimensions couldn’t be violated by gods and living beings. They were the powers of the universe.
In the past, Time had used this principle to get rid of the great Zodiacs…!
“That’s too bad. Your plan went down the drain.”
[…!!]
Laughter could no longer be found on Time’s face.
Lee Gun savagely laughed when he read the despair on Time’s face. “It’s time to take the spoils of war!”
[!!]
Lee Gun immediately grabbed Time’s head. Then, an incredible light surged forth.
[The dismantling of Time has been completed.]
[The parental figure making up Time has been revived using the power of Cycle.]
The power of Cycle turned in the opposite direction. It reverted to a time before Time was made. In other words, the thirteenth original owner was being revived.
In fact, a humanoid shadow started appearing where Time used to be. It was the first Serpent Bearer, who Yeonwoo and Junwoo had tried to revive in the past.
At that moment, Lee Gun witnessed something odd within the enormous light of Cycle. He saw two things.
First, he saw one of Time’s memories.
– If you use this, you will be able to kill your masters. You will be able to usurp their seats.
In this memory, it seemed Time had brought the corpses of the original owners from a different timeline and was trying to entice the Zodiacs by using them.
However, the next scene was the one that caught more of Lee Gun’s attention.
– What? What did you just say? You have a child?
– Yes, Hyung-nim.
It was a scene where two men were fighting. Both of them had golden hair. One was the thirteenth original owner, and the other was probably the original owner of the Sagittarius temple.
For some reason, the original owner of the Sagittarius temple looked furious.
– You have a child?
– Yes. Why is it so surprising?
The older brother shook when he heard the thirteenth answer coldly. He looked more fearful than angry.
The original owner of the Sagittarius temple grabbed his younger brother’s arm as he spoke.
– Did you have this child so that you can get revenge on us?
The thirteenth looked dumbfounded. Then, he shook off the hand. Until now, the thirteenth’s face had been playful and warm. However, it turned frigidly cold.
– Are you that afraid of that incident?
– Where is it? I have to find that child right now.
– You won’t be able to find the child. Never.
– You…!
The two continued to speak to each other, but Lee Gun couldn’t hear the rest.
[You have accepted the call.]
[You’re flying toward your disciple.]
Lee Gun was being moved before he could see the scene unfold further. It was as if he were bungee jumping. He felt the sensation of falling, and their voices faded away.
The only thing he could hear was the voice of Time, who had seen the same thing. Time spoke in a slightly mocking manner.
[I guess this will lead to a father-son reunion.]
As his consciousness faded away, Lee Gun furrowed his brows. Father-son reunion?
* * *
Kwahng! Kwahng!
The other timeline was destroyed according to Time’s will. This was the only timeline containing the existence of Lee Gun. Humanity was bleeding as they blocked the fallen Zodiacs and the monsters Time had left behind.
“Block them! We have to get rid of them until Lee Gun makes his return!”
“If we retreat, humanity will end here!”
The Zodiac Saints gnashed their teeth as they fought the fallen Zodiacs.
As expected of Zodiacs, the fallen Zodiacs were incredibly strong, yet they didn’t retreat at all.
While their will was strong, the reason was that powerful allies had been summoned.
[The Constructs of the old Serpent Bearer have appeared once again after sensing his presence.]
They were the Constructs of the old Serpent Bearer, which had been held captive by the Gemini temple. It was all thanks to the white god, whom Eeny, Meeny, and Miny called boss.
Moreover, the old Serpent Bearer Constructs, which had been under the service of other Zodiacs, were starting to show up sporadically.
They were pining for the Serpent Bearer as they helped the Chun siblings, the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple.
This gave humanity a chance to win against the monsters and the fallen Zodiacs. Yet, they looked anxious.
“Is Lee Gun not here yet?”
“If we don’t hurry up and call for him, Lee Gun will cease to exist!”
Since they were affiliates under the Serpent Bearer temple, they were able to hear the notification. It allowed them to hear what was happening to Lee Gun.
[Warning! Lee Gun is about to cease to exist in the other timeline.]
[Warning! When the Zodiac ceases to exist, the affiliate contract will be canceled after a minute.]
[Lee Gun has been determined as a useless speck of dust. The dimensional power is trying to get rid of him as a foreign matter.]
It seemed those words made them realize Lee Gun was in danger. Flustered, they had desperately tried to stop the monsters. Then they sent all their EXP to Lee Gun. However, it wasn’t enough to stop a Zodiac from ceasing to exist.
In the end, the Chun siblings desperately used the Zodiac Summon skill.
‘Uncle will be safe if we call him here!’
They kept calling for their uncle with all their heart.
Of course, they had to stop Lee Gun’s demise and summon him across dimensions. The prayer of two Zodiac Saints wasn’t enough.
– Can you hear my voice?
The civilians were confused when they suddenly heard the voice.
– It seems those with a certain amount of faith will be able to hear this…
Originally, only the disciples could hear the notification. Yet, for some reason, everyone around the world could hear it now. The reason was simple.
[Guisoon has edited the Bible.]
[The edit has made it so that those with a certain amount of faith toward the Serpent Bearer can hear the notification.]
Quick on the uptake, Guisoon had realized Lee Gun was in danger, so she had quickly edited the bible.
She thought Lee Gun could be saved if their numbers could be boosted. This was why she edited it so that everyone who had even a bit of faith in Lee Gun could hear the voice.
It was like the voice of a god. When people heard the warning that Lee Gun would cease to exist, they all thought about Lee Gun as if they had made a promise to do so. However, it was too hard to dodge the order of the universe.
“Ah…! I can’t feel Uncle’s power!”
“What?!”
In the end, Lee Gun’s power was severed. The notification’s voice could no longer be heard.
The blessing of the Serpent Bearer temple coming toward them was severed too. That wasn’t the only thing that made them hopeless.
“Huhk…!”
One of the fallen Zodiacs had yet to reveal itself.
Ouroboros, which had been slowly moving within the gate, finally stuck its head out from the gate. The Constructs knew what thighs meant.
[It…It is the Cycle! The preparation has been completed!]
[The Serpent Bearer from the different timeline will revert the earth to a time before it was born!]
“What?!”
The disciples despaired. They had no way of stopping it.
After revealing its face, Ouroboros let out a menacing energy. It was a signal that signified that the earth was about to be destroyed.
The subordinates of the Scorpio temple looked at the unconscious Hailey as they despaired.
[I’m sorry, Princess. It seems we made the wrong choice—]
Flash!
At that moment, an enormous pillar of light fell from the sky. Everyone clenched their eyes shut as the blinding light surrounded the city.
“W-What the hell is this?”
“I can’t see anything!”
In a flash, the light washed over the monsters, and they started to scream.
[Kee-ehhhhhk!]
[Kee-ehhhk!]
What looked to be cancerous masses and tumors popped out from the monsters’ bodies, and they fell over as they screamed in despair.
The expressions on the faces of the Chun siblings brightened when they realized what the light signified.
“C-Can it be!”
A sound akin to lightning rang out.
Kwahng!!!
At the same time, a despairing scream reverberated in the sky. It was a scream coming from Ouroboros and was accompanied by an enormous light falling from the sky.
[Cycle]
The light was like a black hole as it sucked in the fallen Zodiacs, who had been summoned by Time.
The very first one to be sucked in was the fallen Leo, whom Stevens had defeated. Next, the fallen Zodiacs that had been suppressed by the current Zodiac Saints were sucked in. The last one to be sucked into the black hole was Ouroboros.
The Zodiacs screamed as they were sucked in, and their bodies started to change into body parts.
“That is…!”
“It’s an arm?”
“They weren’t Zodiacs?”
They were like Oblivion, whom Time had made using the body parts of the Zodiacs. It meant they were monsters despite having the same powers as the Zodiacs. However, it didn’t matter at that moment.
“Ah…!!”
All of humanity almost cried when they saw who had appeared on top of a building.
“Lee Gun!!!”
“It’s Lee Gun!”
Lee Gun had returned thanks to his disciples’ calling him back. He stood there laughing.
The Constructs, the remaining Zodiacs, and the gods of the Divine world were shocked at his appearance.
[The gods of the Divine world say this shouldn’t be possible. They are shocked.]
[They cannot believe a Zodiac ignored being disassembled by the universe. They ask how his existence could be accepted like this.]
The Chun siblings didn’t care about that as they wailed in joy.
“Uncle!!”
“Unclllllllle!!!”
Relieved, they immediately headed toward Lee Gun.
Kevin and Stevens, who had been riding Constructs to fight in the sky, approached Lee Gun as well.
“Lee Gun! What happened to Time?!”
“You chased after Time, right?”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun bought out Time’s head. Of course, only the chin and nose of the monarch were left, but that was enough.
“Lee Gun killed the leader of our enemies, who threatened humanity!”
“Lee Gun saved humanity!”
Cheers filled the city when they heard the words shouted by Stevens and Kevin.
“Waaaaaaa!”
“The monarch is dead!”
On the other hand, Lee Gun ignored the happy people. He scanned his surroundings.
His reaction was to be expected since Time was deposed. The remaining monsters could be hunted down in a leisurely fashion.
So Lee Gun quickly looked for someone.
“What happened to Hailey?”
“Ah…!”
Their expressions worsened a bit. A city that was missing Lee Gun had been a fierce battlefield.
They were getting rid of the Zodiacs and monsters called forth by Time, so they didn’t have the bandwidth to keep tabs on each other.
Despite this, they were aware of what had happened to Hailey.
“Hailey is….”
Lee Gun discovered Hailey at that moment. He jumped off the building.
Boom!
The subordinates who had been protecting Hailey became surprised.
[Lee Gun-nim!]
“I’m not too late.”
[W-What?! You aren’t too late? She’s already…]
They were going to say that she was dead, but Lee Gun suddenly placed his hand on Hailey’s chest.
“Why do you think I went through the trouble of controlling stage 6 to come here?”
[!!]
The powerful light of Life erupted. For some reason, Lee Gun felt a sense of nostalgia accompanying the light.
– Jeez, you ugly little thing. Stop moving. I have to put medicine on you. You have to endure it even if it hurts!
At the same time, Hailey heard something.
[Come back]
When Hailey opened her eyes, she saw something.
“I can’t call you ugly anymore.”
It was the laughter of the boy that she remembered from a long time ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 321
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Ah. It was you (3)
It was a day when there was heavy rain.
Lee Gun picked up a cat in front of his house.
It was a baby kitten covered in blood.
Its entire body was broken, and there was an especially nasty burn wound on its face.
“My god, kitty… Where did you hurt yourself like this?”
Of course, the kitten had been Hailey, who had lost her power.
There was no way Lee Gun would have known this.
At the time, Lee Gun had left the orphanage, and he was living by himself.
He was still a student, so he didn’t have much money.
Despite this fact, he had taken the kitten to the vet, and he had taken care of it with all his heart.
“I want you to heal quickly. Oppa will take you somewhere nice, and we can go play.”
It had taken quite a long time.
“It is cold. Why are you outside? Come here. You can sleep with oppa.”
Yeonwoo and Junwoo were still living in an orphanage, and they knew about the existence of the cat.
They knew Lee Gun dearly loved his cat. This was why Lee Gun had been very sad when the cat suddenly disappeared. It was why they had been equally sad as Lee Gun.
Of course, a young girl with a burn mark in the same location as the cat had shown up in front of him.
At the time, he had no idea who the girl was. She had merely shown her face at the time.
Back to the present.
Hailey had opened her eyes, and Lee Gun was gently touching her face.
“You are all healed.”
“……!”
Hailey was very happy after she opened her eyes.
It was to be expected since she saw Lee Gun as soon as she opened her eyes!
Moreover, it was a dream where Lee Gun was gently petting her!
It really was the best of dreams…
Dream….
Dream?
“??!!?!”
When Hailey came to her senses, she almost screamed.
It wasn’t a dream.
Lee Gun was stroking her face.
However, she didn’t have the opportunity to scream.
“I looked for you a very long time. I’m glad. You became pretty.”
Lee Gun gently rubbed her face and forehead as if he was petting a cat.
It caused Hailey’s face to turn red.
He was close.
Lee Gun was unnecessarily close, and his lips were that much closer.
She was at her limits.
[P…Princess?!!]
Hailey once again lost consciousness.
The sound of her head hitting the ground was quite loud, so her subordinates cried out in despair.
[Princesssss!!!]
Lee Gun was also surprised.
He was very taken aback, because he had reigned in <Life> in order to save Hailey.
“Shit. Is <Life> making trouble again?”
He criticized <Life> for already causing trouble, and it seemed <Life> felt aggrieved.
It had to do with the fact that he had consumed energy to the extreme when he used the power of <Cycle> on <Time>.
The effects of the power going berserk had temporarily died down, but <Life> once again started to move in a violent manner.
It caused cries to erupt from all directions.
On the other hand, the Zodiac Saints couldn’t close their mouths when they saw Hailey live again. The Chun siblings didn’t care about that. They clung to Lee Gun as they wailed in joy.
“Ah…!!”
At that moment, the nearby disciples were surprised.
Phantom beings were gathering in front of Lee Gun.
“They are…!”
They were none other than the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer, who used to be called the strongest god.
[The Constructs of the older Serpent Bearer temple feels the presence of their owner. They are approaching you]
[When the empty seat of the Serpent Bearer became filled again, the other old servants cried out in joy.]
[The older servants want to meet their master.]
All of them came close to Lee Gun before they took a knee.
Of course, these weren’t their true bodies.
After the death of the 13th original owner, most of them were forcefully taken by the other Zodiacs.
They were here secretly as they avoided surveillance from the Zodiacs.
[We cannot see you with our true forms, yet we are fortunate enough to see your face before we die.]
[We want to become a source of power for the Serpent Bearer like before, but we cannot escape the owners that hold us. We cannot stay here too long.]
They were able to send their clones when they felt the danger to the Serpent Bearer and their original temple.
The Constructs ceaselessly shed tears.
[We can no longer be with you, but we will always help whenever needed.]
[Please keep your exalted body safe until the day we meet again.]
Lee Gun nodded his head as he looked at them.
“Alright. Thank you.”
The Constructs wailed in joy at those words, then they disappeared in a puff of smoke.
The only one left was the leader of Eeny, Meeny, Miny. He was the one that had been imprisoned by the Gemini temple.
It was a giant with a copious amount of white fur. It was a god that looked like a yeti.
[The <White god of Light> is happy to finally meet the Serpent Bearer.]
[It is very sorry for sending subordinates that weren’t of big help to the Serpent Bearer.]
[It promises to pledge loyalty to the new Serpent Bearer.]
Lee Gun nodded his head at the notification.
“Alright. I will allow it.”
Accompanying a massive light, the furry god’s appearance changed.
It turned into the shape of a very beautiful and powerful woman.
[Chief Gatekeeper of the Serpent Bearer temple (Heimdall) (Highest rank)]
[God of Light(Highest rank) has become the Construct of the Serpent Bearer.]
[It has the spec to be put in the seat of the Royal Construct(Directly under Zodiac). Will you place it there?]
“No. I have someone else I have to place there first.”
Was it because of the faith and the fact that the existence of <Time> had been completely disassembled?
[You have satisfied the condition.]
[You have become the only god of <Earth>]
[You have become the Zodiac of district <Earth>]
[<Earth> has been designated as the holy ground of the Serpent Bearer]
[Will you give a name to district <Earth>?]
Lee Gun picked at his ear as if he found the task to be very annoying.
“My land.”
[<Earth> was changed to <My Land>]
[Heroes can be grown into Constructs, and you are able to challenge outside holy grounds.]
[In the same vein, the Zodiacs ruling over other places may show interest towards the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground…]
Lee Gun didn’t find this to be important, so he surveyed his surroundings once again.
He had brought back Hailey. The ones left were Yeonwoo and Hugo.
Before he did that…
“Come here, Hugo.”
Hugo wailed in joy when Lee Gun called for him.
“My ears didn’t deceive me! Teacher called me by my name again!”
The Zodiac Saints, who had been putting things in order, shook their heads from side to side when they saw this.
At some point, Hugo had stopped being a Lee Gun fanboy, so they had forgotten about it.
However, Hugo that they remembered had always been like that.
On the other hand, Virgo fell into her own thoughts when she saw this.
It was to be expected since Lee Gun had united the temples, and he had become the one and only god of earth.
This was why she suddenly had a thought.
‘Maybe, the Serpent Bearer planned all of this.’
She was referring to the 13th original owner.
He was reputed to be one of the strongest gods in the Divine world. He was called one of the cornerstones of the Divine world.
Of course, he had been a magic type Zodiac. He was unlike Lee Gun, who was outstanding in his fighting abilities.
Still, even the great spirits were afraid of him as a god.
Yet he was a kind god, who treasured his Constructs. The Constructs were usually treated like slaves, so the Constructs had willingly followed after the 13th original own.
However, Virgo remembered the day of the usurping.
When Virgo told him to run away, the 13th original owner laughed as he spoke.
‘No. This is enough.’
‘What?’
‘They are the underhanded usurpers. With this, my <Revenge> is done.’
‘……!’
That’s right.
His comrades were murdered by Constructs, and he was dying as well.
Yet he was laughing.
He acted as if the original owners deserved to die.
That smile had bugged her for the longest time, and it was the reason why she had kept an eye on the <Serpent Bearer>.
In the end, she could only come to one conclusion.
‘Could the Serpent Bearer have….’
However, such thoughts lasted only a moment.
“Ahhk!! Teacher!!”
Hugo, who had been ecstatic at his name being called, screamed.
It was time for him to be sent back to his own time by Lee Gun.
[You are using <Time>’s data]
[<Time Travel> (1 turn)]
Lee Gun broke the black gem.
It was one of the countless pieces of data that he had acquired by killing the young <Time>.
Of course, it couldn’t perform amazing abilities since it was the data of young <Time>.
However, it was capable of sending Hugo back to his original time.
“Ahhhk!!”
Hugo was swept up by an enormous light.
At that moment, Lee Gun grabbed Hugo’s forehead.
“T…Teacher?”
“Farewell. Say hi to the version of me that is there. Tell him to hang in there.”
“What?!”
“Ah. I guess it doesn’t matter since you won’t remember this?”
“What?! What are you saying!”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun used the ability of <Oblivion>.
This Hugo was from the 18,733th world. It was where Lee Gun existed.
It meant this was Hugo from Lee Gun’s past.
Basically, the future would change if he remembered what had happened.
This was what Lee Gun had planned to do in the first place.
[<Oblivion> will be used to erase the memories related to this timeline]
Hugo screamed as he disappeared into the gate of Time.
However, Lee Gun suddenly shouted in surprise after Hugo disappeared.
“Ah!”
The Zodiac Saints were shocked since it was rare for Lee Gun to scream.
“What’s wrong! What happened!”
“Shit. I forgot to Oblivion his faith….”
“What?!”
“Since he doesn’t have any memories of this, I guess faith shouldn’t matter too much.”
“Hey! That’s the most important part?!”
It happened at that moment.
“Koohk…!”
“Uncle!”
Lee Gun was about to say something when he fell.
He clutched at his heart.
It seemed just maintaining stage 6, which was the berserk stage, was a problem.
[Warning. The ring of <Order> has reached its limit.]
[Stage 6 Divine statuses are trying to take the life of their owner.]
[<Death> has to be chosen, so <Life> can be killed.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he dismissed those words.
In order to revive ttwo, he had to maintain stage 6 even if it was painful.
Lee Gun quickly gestured with his hand. It caused slime to suddenly appear from an unknown location.
“Hurry… Take out Yeonwoo and Taeksoo!”
It happened at that moment.
“Kuhk!!”
“Lee Gun!”
Lee Gun was tired as he could be. He vomited blood as he fell over.
It was true that he had spent a lot of power getting rid of <Time>, but he also hadn’t slept since his Divine statuses had reached stage 6.
Despite possessing the ring of Order, he couldn’t control stage 6 while asleep.
While he was in such a state, he had to kill <Time> over 18,000 times, and he had used the power of <Cycle>.
There was no way he would have enough stamina left.
[You cannot control your Divine statuses.]
[The Divine statuses stage 6 are destroying the body of the Serpent Bearer.]
Lee Gun lost consciousness.
When the person suppressing them was lost, Life and Death started to go berserk like mad.
“Shit!”
Chun Yooha and Chun Sungjae quickly tried to suppress their respective Divine status when it happened.
Koo-goo-goong!
“!!”
They were surprised.
The stage 6 Divine statuses, which had been about to go berserk, suddenly disappeared.
“Uh? Where’s Lee Gun?”
Lee Gun was also gone.
* * *
“Wow!! Humanity won!”
“Lee Gun brought us victory!”
The news of Lee Gun killing <Time> spread across the world, and the whole world was in the midst of celebrating.
“We just have to get rid of the remaining remnants of the monsters.!”
“We’ll do that in no time!”
“That’s for another time! Where is Lee Gun-nim!”
“We need an interview!”
The happy people diligently looked for Lee Gun.
However, Lee Gun was somewhere else.
He was in a place that wasn’t earth.
[Gun.]
“…fuck off.”
[Gun.]
“…fuck off, Oh Taeksoo.”
[Gun~]
“??!!”
Lee Gun woke up in shock as he felt wind enter his ears.
He was surprised when he saw his surroundings.
His surroundings looked like space.
‘Where is this place?’
THere was something more odd than his surroundings.
“……????”
Lee Gun was struck dumb by the person in front of him.
There was a golden haired handsome man standing in front of him.
‘This guy is the 13th original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple.’
There was a playful expression on his face, but his laughter was oddly arrogant.
Lee Gun bit his tongue.
‘Since <Time> was reverted back to a point before his genesis, this guy must have appeared since <Time> was made from him.’
Lee Gun sighed as he got up.
Since he was the owner of Yeonwoo, he wasn’t an enemy, but…
“I don’t have time to meet you. I have people I have to revive right now….”
[You slept for a long time, my son.]
Lee Gun’s face froze in an instant.
What?
What did this bastard say?

chapters.title: Chapter 322
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Father (1)
What did this bastard say? Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold.
The thirteenth merely grinned at his reaction.
Flustered, Lee Gun glared at the thirteenth. There were things one could say and things one could not. It was their first time meeting each other, so what nonsense was he spouting?
Therefore, Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment on reflex. “Fuck off! Do you know me?”
[Of course, I know you very well. You are Gun. You’re my lovely son.]
When the thirteenth started stroking his head, Lee Gun’s expression turned incredulous. This crazy bastard was the master of Yeonwoo and Junwoo?
The thirteenth seemed oblivious as he let out a bright smile.
[In that sense, would you like to wear this?]
“???!”
The thirteenth let out a bright smile as he brought out a dress for a baby girl.
[Dad made it. It’s a popular style these days. Do you like it?]
As expected of something made by a member of the Creation tribe, the dress was of high quality. The thirteenth’s talent was almost wasted in making it.
However, that wasn’t important to Lee Gun right now. “You worm of a god… What are you…”
[Ah! You’ll have to become young again. My Gun grew too much. Shit! You were cute when you were small.]
“?!”
[Ah! You resemble your pretty mom. Why couldn’t you have been a daughter? I would have really liked that. Anyway, I still think this will go well with Gun— Uh?]
Instead of answering, Lee Gun changed Heaven’s Punishment to stage 3. “Who the hell are you? Who are you to treat me like this??”
The thirteenth, who had a bright smile on his face until now, let out a genuine smile. It almost made one wonder if this being was the same one as the one who had brought out the dress. He was incredibly charismatic.
Letting out a meaningful smile, he spoke with certainty.
[Who else? I am your father.]
Lee Gun put on an expression that he wasn’t having any of it. “Really? Then you should die by your son’s hands.”
Lee Gun looked at him with contempt as he swung Heaven’s Punishment.
Kwahng!!!
The thirteenth screamed.
[Ahhk! You ripped the dress that your father made with care!!!]
“Die!”
[Ah! It’s fine. I made several of them.]
“?!”
The thirteenth started laughing as he summoned dresses of various colors, making Lee Gun’s face turn red from anger.
However, Lee Gun soon faltered on his feet. He had spent too much power suppressing stage 6. Even staying conscious was a chore for him.
The thirteenth let out a bright smile as if he understood what Lee Gun was going through.
[Son, you must be having a hard time, right? That’s why you should turn smaller. If you turn smaller, your magical energy and stamina will recover.]
“What?”
[I gave you an ability through which you can quickly recover your magical energy and stamina if you turn into a baby. Why aren’t you using it?]
Lee Gun gnashed his teeth when he realized what the thirteenth was implying. On the other hand, the thirteenth acted oblivious.
[You have Time’s data, right? You can use it to make yourself younger! You’ll immediately recover your stamina if you do so!]
In the end, Lee Gun became angry. “You were the one who turned me into a baby?!!”
[Ahhhk!]
The thirteenth screamed. The attack hadn’t landed, but Heaven’s Punishment had almost sliced open the thirteenth.
The thirteenth yelled as if he felt aggrieved.
[What’s wrong? I made an ability that helped you even if you were made younger! I gave you the Attribute of a Small God and the Attribute of a Baby! Do you not know this?]
“You’re the one who placed those attributes on me?”
Of course, the buffs that the thirteenth had placed on him using Ability Creation had been very useful.
When Lee Gun became a child, his speed had increased. A buff that activated only during a certain state was more valuable.
But it having proved useful didn’t mean Lee Gun felt good about it.
“Die!”
Faced with his son’s anger, the father looked aggrieved.
[Wait a moment! You shouldn’t act this way toward me! I’m the one who swapped out Hugo’s body! I’m the reason you’ll be able to revive your friend again!]
Lee Gun flinched. “What? Who swapped out whose body?”
When Lee Gun finally grasped the entire situation, flames erupted from his mouth. “You were the one who took Hugo’s body!!”
[Yes. It was a good idea, right? If I had let him be, Confusion would have killed his soul too. That was why I placed a spell on him before he died. I took his soul, and I sent it to the Divine world.]
Lee Gun became angrier. “That means you knew Taeksoo would die, yet you sent him on his way!!”
[In that situation, I couldn’t stop Confusion. Since he was going to die anyway, I made sure he’d be able to be revived at the very least.]
“What? He was going to die anyw—?!”
For a moment, Lee Gun had almost lost his temper. He took a deep breath. It didn’t matter now. The thing that had gotten Hugo killed was his carelessness, and he didn’t want to cry over spilled milk.
On the other hand, if this bastard was telling the truth, he could have told Lee Gun that the Hugo’s head that Confusion had sent them was fake. He wouldn’t have gone berserk to reach stage 6 if he hadn’t seen Hugo’s head!
“Why would you make me believe it was real…!”
[Mmm? I never tried to trick you?]
“What?”
[Ha ha. It is my fault for being too good. I made it so well that the monarch and my son fell for it. That’s awesome— Kuhk!]
Lee Gun grabbed the thirteenth by his throat. “What did you just say??”
[What? It worked out if you look at the result. Anyway, you needed to reach stage 6 of Death if you wanted to release the power of Cycle.]
Lee Gun flinched at his bright smile. His words sounded reasonable, but Lee Gun didn’t buy it. “You purposefully kept your mouth shut to make me go berserk?!”
He was sure of it. The thirteenth knew about the requirements needed to release the power of Cycle.
The thirteenth laughed apologetically.
[You’ll be able to revive him. That’s all that matters, right? I made sure to take the body, so it was unharmed. I also placed his soul in a place that would be safe from Confusion.]
At that moment, Lee Gun truly realized what it felt like to lose his shit. “Die!!”
[Ahhhk! Why? It was the only way I could save you and Hugo! It was the only way to kill Time and Confusion! Even if I were able to keep Hugo alive, he would have been targeted by Time.]
“I don’t care!!! Just die!!!” This bastard hadn’t killed Hugo, but he had basically used Hugo’s death. Of course, it angered Lee Gun.
“Miss Jiwoo saw something she didn’t need to see because of you! She’s pregnant!”
[What? I never expected someone else to see an item sent to you by Confusion! You can erase that memory using Oblivion! Also, the blessing of the Serpent Bearer isn’t that weak! That child will be fine!]
With those words angering him even more, he was about to kick the thirteenth. However, he held himself back. Although he was angry, he didn’t have the time to waste with this bastard.
‘I would rather use this time to revive the others.’
So, he said, “Whatever. Just return me to where I was!! I don’t want to see your face!”
[Wow! You’re so harsh. You got rid of your uncle’s hair because you’re so mean.]
“Hmmph. That baldie deserved— What? Uncle?” For a moment, Lee Gun couldn’t believe what he had just heard. The thirteenth was referring to Sagittarius.
Uncle?
“Unclllllllle??”
[Ah. To be precise, he’s your older uncle.]
The fact that he was the older uncle wasn’t important. “Why is that bald Zodiac my older uncle?”
[Well, he doesn’t deserve to be called your uncle.]
“What….” Lee Gun had no words.
On the other hand, the thirteenth didn’t care if Lee Gun wanted to speak or not. He continued to tell his story.
[Anyway, don’t even think about reviving the original owners using the power of Cycle. You must never do it.]
“What?” Lee Gun flinched.
Like how he had revived the thirteenth, he was pondering about returning the other original owners to their previous states. Since they were the owners of the Seats of power, he wondered if they would be useful to him.
[The ones you call the Original Owners aren’t the owners of the real Seats of power.]
“What do you mean?”
[The original twelve Zodiacs, who were usurped by the Constructs, were called the Original Owners, but they were also Usurpers.]
“!”
The eyes of the thirteenth turned cold when he thought about the original owners.
[The true owners of the twelve Zodiac temples were Creators like me. The Original Owners that you guys know about coveted the powers of the Creator Tribe. They killed the people of the real Creator tribe to steal their power. They are the fake Creator tribe.]
“!”
Lee Gun looked at the thirteenth as if he comprehend what was being said. “Wait a moment. You called Sagittarius your older brother. That means…”
[Sagittarius… He’s mixed, but at the end of the day, he’s 90% my older brother.]
As he mumbled his words, the eyes of the thirteenth flashed in contempt.
[The original owners and my older brother killed our parents and our tribesmen.]
* * *
Creators were special gods that possessed different Creation abilities, such as ability creation, emotion creation, weather creation, and world creation. They were outstanding gods, and their names were famed within the Divine world.
While they didn’t receive any special Divine statuses, their existence itself had been powerful. They weren’t known for their fighting abilities, yet they were known as important figures in the Divine world.
They were the reason the Divine world remained protected in the war against the outer gods.
The Creation tribe had dozens of members. However, only twelve of them had been able to use the real Creation Ability.
[Thank you! Our reputation rose thanks to you guys sticking with us.]
[No. We’re family. We should help each other.]
However, the twelve of them being too talented was a problem.
[What? Seats of Power? They were able to make such a thing?]
[Yes. One can use the Temple System with it.]
[Temple System?]
[Unlike the other gods, it was developed so that one could gather disciples. A Zodiac’s level and skills can be increased using faith.]
[They made it so that we won’t get threatened by outside forces, but…]
[We can become Great Spirits if we possess the Creation Abilities of the Creators.]
In the end, the twelve Creators were killed by their relatives.
[Kuh-huhk!!]
[Ahhhk! W-Why would you…!]
[You guys don’t know how to use your abilities. You used your powers on useless beings.]
[Yes. We’ll make better use of your abilities.]
[…!!]
They even took out the cores of the Creators, which allowed them to steal the Creation Ability. Then they disposed of the corpses as space dust.
The space dust became monsters and, in the distant future, the monarchs. One of these monarchs had been Space-Time.
The thirteenth’s parents were part of those twelve Creators. If one had to make a comparison to human age, the thirteenth had been three years old then.
The thirteenth had seen his parents get murdered, so he was on the way to being deposed too.
[Shit! This kid saw it all!]
[Who would have thought that he was inside the closet?]
[We have to kill him!]
However, the one to spare the young child was the current Sagittarius, the thirteenth’s older brother.
[Let us spare this child.]
[What? Have you lost your mind? It’s the end for us if he remembers what happened today! He saw his parents get murdered by us!]
[He’s still too young! He won’t remember what happened today.]
[…!]
Sagittarius was the thirteenth’s half-brother. Despite sharing the same bloodline, he was a god that didn’t possess the Creation Ability. Moreover, he was also one of the usurpers who had killed the Creators.
[Also, this child can use the Creation Ability. We need at least one capable of using the “real” Creation Ability. It’ll make everyone believe that we are the Creation Tribe.]
[!]
[Anyway, there are thirteen Seats of power. We have one empty seat. He won’t be able to remember anything, so we’ll raise him to become our comrade.]
[Alright. Understood.]
This was why the thirteenth had joined the usurpers, who had killed his parents. They became the Creation Tribe and were called the Original Owners, and he became the thirteenth Zodiac.
Of course, his abilities were so great that he had become famous as the thirteenth Zodiac.
[Shit! His abilities are getting stronger as he grows up…!]
[Hey, are you sure this is fine?]
[….]
At the end of the day, a real Creator was different. As the thirteenth grew, the Original Owners realized the stark difference between their powers, so they became guarded against the thirteenth.
Still, they thought everything would turn out fine since the thirteenth couldn’t remember what they had done.
[What? What did you just say?…]
However, the original owner of the Sagittarius temple was shocked when the adult thirteenth had brought up the subject.
[What’s wrong, Hyung-nim? You guys killed my parents and the real Creators. You guys shamelessly took their seats. Is it strange that I know about that?]
[…!!]
The original owner of the Sagittarius temple froze.
[When did you…]
[I have a good memory. I remembered it from the start.]
[…!!!]
[Don’t worry about it. I do not plan on taking revenge against you. We might have different mothers, but I did really like you, Hyung-nim. That’s why I hate you that much more. It’s enough to kill you, but in the end, I cannot kill you guys.]
[…!!]
[Why do you think I cannot handle Death? It’s thanks to my rage. I turn into a monster the more I hate you guys.]
[Aslan…!]
The thirteenth had planned on living a quiet life, but a certain incident had reignited his desire to get his revenge. It had to do with Lee Gun and Lee Gun’s mother.

chapters.title: Chapter 323
chapters.content:
Chapter 323 - Father (2)
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. The pain from stage 6 going berserk was still troubling him, and on top of that, he had been kidnapped to some strange place.
Beyond all that ridiculous, someone he had seen for the first time was suddenly claiming to be his father. As if that wasn’t enough, the bald Zodiac had been revealed to be his uncle.
Moreover, his uncle and the original owners were the bad guys, so he was told not to revive them.
‘If they have such a sordid past, I have no reason to summon them.’
Lee Gun, who had been listening up to this point, looked for the exit. From the looks of it, he realized this was the Middle World.
It was like the secret hideout that Aquarius had used to hide in the past, a crack between dimensions.
‘Is this the Serpent Bearer’s space?’
Anyway, he couldn’t see the exit. So he tried to use his Space ability, but the thirteenth just let out a bright smile as he grabbed his son’s shoulder.
[My son. From your expression, it seems you’re curious about your mother.]
“Not at all. Also, why do you keep saying that you are my father?”
[Yes, yes. You must be curious. Your mother was the most beautiful woman in the universe…]
“I’m not interested??? Also, I was born a human. How am I the offspring of a god?”
The thirteenth let out a laugh full of complicated emotions. It seemed this was a story that he wanted to tell to Lee Gun at all costs.
[Your mother was a human.]
“!”
The thirteenth stroked Lee Gun’s face with yearning. An expression of longing appeared on his face as if he had seen Lee Gun’s mother in his face. Even though that had happened a long time ago, it was still vivid in his mind.
In those days, the thirteenth would occasionally leave the Divine world and sneak into human society. It was all for only one reason.
“Oh my! You always come when there is no moon.”
Lee Gun’s mother had been a princess. She was a princess of a theocratic state that worshiped a different god.
Of course, the princess was the holy priestess of the theocratic state, which followed another god. It wouldn’t go over well if word got out that the holy priestess had fallen in love with a different god.
This was why their meetings were conducted in secret. They always met on the first day of the lunar month. It was a day when the humans, the sun god, the moon god, and anyone else couldn’t see them.
The thirteenth appeared on the first day of the lunar month, when the moon went into hiding, and they had to depart when the new moon started to appear.
In principle, the holy priestess must look at only the Zodiac that she served, but she had instead fallen in love with the thirteenth.
Them being able to silently look into each other’s eyes had been enough.
Moreover, the thirteenth was willing to give up his revenge for the happiness of this woman. He didn’t even dream about taking his revenge and just resolved to live a quiet life. He even hid the fact that he remembered what happened in the past. However…
[Damn it! This is driving me nuts. Aslan remembers what we did!]
[What?! D-Does he want to get revenge on us?]
[He didn’t say it! However, how can I trust what he says?]
[Shit! Should we have killed him alongside his parents on that day?]
[This is all Sagittarius’ fault! If only he didn’t tell us to spare Aslan so that we could use him!]
[This is bad! Aslan is Sagittarius’s little brother!]
[What? Is that true? How do you know this?]
[They were acting suspiciously, so I followed them! They said they are brothers!]
[Shit! Did Sagittarius spare him because he’s his younger brother?]
[That damn bastard…!]
The original owners shook in fear.
The thirteenth had made it clear that he had no plans of harming them, yet how could they trust him?
They were afraid. Therefore, when they found out about the existence of the princess that the thirteenth had been hiding, they made a plan.
They planned on taking the princess hostage and putting on a leash around his neck. However…
[D-Damn it! What the hell are you going to do about this?]
[Why are you blaming me? I never expected things to turn out like this!]
They had killed the princess by mistake.
[Damn it. She resisted when I tried to use my power on her…!]
[Shit! Why are humans so weak?]
[Ah! Wait a moment! This woman is still alive. She’ll live if we heal her…]
[Forget it! She has already seen our faces! We are dead if she speaks to Aslan about this!]
The thirteenth could never find out that they had meant ill will toward the princess.
[Let’s erase our tracks and keep our mouths shut.]
The original owners informed the royal family and their people of what the princess had been up to.
The princess was supposed to be the holy priestess that served a god of a theocratic state. So her having feelings for a different god was a huge problem. It was big enough to enrage the god that she had served.
Moreover, the original owners had purposefully hit the country with a natural disaster. People blamed the natural disaster on the princess. They blamed her for letting her eyes wander to a different god. Everything that happened afterward was easy.
“The fallen princess caused the famine and drought.”
“The flood swept away everything here!”
“The god of our nation is angry!”
“The god is angry, and he wants the princess to be deposed!”
In the end, labeled as a traitor to her nation, the princess was burned alive at the stake.
At that time, the thirteenth had been away on a mission, and he had quickly returned to save the princess. However, it was too late.
Since she received the curse of her god, he couldn’t revive her using the power of Life. Of course, not everyone had died.
[It seems your mother protected you.]
The princess had been pregnant with the thirteenth’s child. That child was Lee Gun. Lee Gun had been inside her belly, and he had miraculously survived. The thirteenth gritted his teeth.
‘It’ll be dangerous if they find out about the existence of this child.’
He didn’t care about himself, but his child would be endlessly hunted down. This was why the thirteenth used the power of Cycle as soon as he took the child out of the mother’s stomach.
‘It isn’t time for you to be born yet.’
This was how Lee Gun was put into the flow of a god in charge of the life of humanity. Anyway, this had allowed Lee Gun to avoid the detection of the gods and be born into the world someday when it was safe for him.
Of course, he would temporarily wear the shell of his fake parents, but that shell would peel off over time.
‘I want you to remember nothing. Don’t get into any trouble. Live happily as a human.’
