This was how the thirteenth sent Lee Gun on his way.
When the thirteenth had lost all those he had loved at once, he had shed tears of blood.
[I will never forgive them.]
What was so important about power and reputation? He had been willing to bury everything, yet they had done this to him. It had caused the rage and hate that he had been suppressing to surge forward.
[You guys should suffer the same fate. Whatever you guys stole, you guys will have stolen from yourselves in the same fashion.]
Therefore, the thirteenth immediately sought out the Constructs of the original owners, who were being tormented.
While he couldn’t take the Constructs of the other Zodiacs, he knew these Constructs well. He usually took care of them.
This was why he knew what pains they were going through, and he knew about their dissatisfaction. Egging them on was easy.
[Why are you guys treated this way? What do you guys lack?]
[!]
[Am I wrong? From what I see of your abilities, you guys are much better than your masters.]
[!]
This was how he egged on the Constructs, then he called for his Construct Mimir.
[Mimir. You know everything about this world. I’m sure you know my and the twelve Zodiacs’ weaknesses.]
[Master?]
[I want you to spread that information to the Constructs of the other temples, especially to the Constructs of the Pisces.]
[What? That will put you in danger too, Master!]
[It doesn’t matter]
[…!!]
The light in the thirteenth’s eyes had changed. The hate was slowly turning him into an evil god.
If he couldn’t control his anger, he knew he would become a monster. However, he didn’t care.
‘Let us all die. All the thirteen Zodiacs will be annihilated.’
Those original owners had usurped the seats that they coveted, and they would die by being usurped in the same way.
This was how his plan had slowly progressed. The original owners, who had sinned against the thirteenth, had fallen into the trap on their own. They became sick, and their Constructs made plans to usurp their seats.
Of course, the thirteenth never told anyone about this plan. This was especially true of Yeonwoo and Junwoo.
‘I cannot let them change into an evil god like me.’
If they found out what he was planning, they would volunteer to help him. The thirteenth was changing into an evil god, and if he weren’t careful, he would assimilate the other Constructs. He would make them fall.
This was why he didn’t let his Constructs approach him. He made it so that his Constructs could live a free life when everything was done. He made a contract with Divine world to facilitate this. He merely left behind requests and letters.
[I want you to have a happy life with your younger brother.]
The thirteenth stroked the sleeping baby snakes.
[I know I’m asking for the impossible, but if it is possible…]
He wished they would look after his child that would be born someday.
This was how the usurpation happened, and as planned, all the original owners had died. It also allowed the Constructs to take their power, but the thirteenth didn’t care.
The Seats of power and the power of the original owners belonged to the Creators. He considered it a gift to them, and he merely had to leave after that.
The thirteenth had thought his revenge had ended there. However…
[I never expected the monarchs to make Time out of my body.]
Lee Gun snorted when he heard the word of the thirteenth. “So your plan went awry?”
[Yes. Moreover, I couldn’t do anything since I was already dead.]
Space-Time was born from the corpse of the Creators, who had died a long time ago. He then created Time, so his being so powerful was understandable.
Of course, Space-Time had eventually become Lee Gun’s EXP sandbag through the resets…
The matter was wrapped up nicely, but…
[Anyway, you know this because you fought them in my absence. The monarchs are quite troublesome beings. This is especially true of Time. There really was no answer for him.]
“!”
Time was the unwanted guest, and he made events flow in the opposite direction compared to the other monarchs.
[I never expected him to join hands with the twelve Zodiacs to threaten humanity. I never expected him to lay hands on Yeonwoo and Junwoo.]
Time had been a nasty piece of work. He had returned to a time before his birth. The usurpation that would have happened without the power of a monarch was facilitated by Time.
He made it seem like he was helping them and easily secured a partnership with the twelve Zodiacs.
[Well, I never expected the Constructs who took over as the new twelve Zodiacs to fall so far… You did good taking care of that.]
The thirteenth wondered if those seats had changed them. He had believed in those children. This was why he felt a mixture of emotions.
Moreover, Time hadn’t just repeated these events once. He had done it tens of thousands of times, as Yeonwoo and Junwoo were tormented.
Then, there was another problem. Like Confusion, the thirteenth had also been swept up in returning through time. He had returned 18,733 times.
The reason was that Time was made from his body. However, unlike Confusion, the thirteenth was returned to the moment of his death. It gave him a real headache. Basically, it was the moment of Time’s birth.
[I thought I was about to lose my mind. It was really painful. My throat was cut, so I couldn’t talk. I couldn’t do anything. I could merely warm up the Serpent Bearer temple using the last of my power.]
“Is that how you were able to steal away Taeksoo?” Lee Gun had listened up to this point. He feigned laughter. “In other words, I’ve been cleaning the mess of my parent up until now.”
The thirteenth became serious at those words.
[No! That isn’t it at all! This was all done to grow you.]
“You want to die? What nonsense are you talking about?”
The thirteenth’s expression changed.
[Why do you think your mother was found out?]
“!”
[Why do you think the twelve Zodiacs came to kill Yeonwoo and Junwoo?]
It was the genesis of all the tragedies. Lee Gun’s mother had been found out by the gods, and she was killed in the process of being kidnapped.
Yeonwoo and Junwoo had been killed by the Constructs when they tried to take revenge for the thirteenth.
[I revealed the entire truth to Yeonwoo and Junwoo in a letter before I died. I told them that they didn’t need to take revenge for me. I told them to be free and not pay attention to my affairs.]
“…!”
[Had that letter been delivered, Yeonwoo and Junwoo would have never thought about getting revenge for me.]
Lee Gun was surprised.
[Also, I requested my Constructs to be freed after I died. That fell through. As a result, the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple were taken by the other Zodiacs.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned serious. Of course, he knew what those words meant.
[Basically, someone told the original owners about the existence of your mom. Someone took the letter that I had left behind for Yeonwoo and Junwoo.]
“…!”
The thirteenth’s eyes turned sharp.
[Amongst the gods, some want the power of the Creators.]
“!”
[In other words, they’ll come for you.]
Well, he had never imagined Yeonwoo and Junwoo would meet Lee Gun.
[Anyway, you have to be careful. In truth, I never expected Time to use my daughter-in— I mean I never expected him to use Hailey to move to the other timeline. However, you were able to withstand the disassembly by the timeline. You were able to return. It’s something even the gods can’t do anything against. It’s all thanks to your power and the power of your human disciples.]
“What about it?”
[It isn’t a normal power. No one imagined human faith could be that powerful. This is why all the gods of the Divine world and the outer world will be interested in the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground. They’ll be interested in the earth and humans.]
This included the gods who had taken the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple and even the Great-Spirit ranks.
On the other hand, Lee Gun snorted when he realized what those words implied. “That’s fucking stupid. Are you saying the gods will want to take this land? They’ll come to make humanity into their disciples?”
[Yes. That is why—]
“Let’s say that might happen someday, but that isn’t important right now.”
[!]
Lee Gun immediately summoned something.
The eyes of the thirteenth turned round when he saw the familiar figure. That was none other than the body of Yeonwoo.
[I didn’t want to do this in front of others, but it seems you don’t plan on letting me out of here.]
Her body had been easier to procure since Time had called forth Yeonwoo’s body from the past. Of course, Lee Gun had patched up anything lacking.
Lee Gun then placed his hand on top of Yeonwoo’s body.
[Come back.]
Finally, Yeonwoo opened her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 324
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Come Back (1)
“It will be fine. The twelve heroes will come and save us in no time. Let’s be a bit patient.”
These were probably her last words. After that, Lee Gun and Yeonwoo had never seen each other again.
Lee Gun had never thought he would see her again.
[Come back.]
It was short, but the words were spoken with a powerful voice. The voice was like a lighthouse.
Whether one was in the dark and the depths of a deep ocean didn’t matter. It was a voice of light that signaled one should come toward it, a magnetic voice.
When she turned toward the voice, she experienced something peculiar. She felt as if she were floating into the sky, while a light swept her up. She felt that if she opened her eyes, she’d be moved to a different world.
In the end, this was how Yeonwoo returned to her original world. Previously, she had been in a nihilistic world where she could feel no feelings or senses.
Now, she was in the sublime world of the living, where she could feel happiness and sadness. And when she opened her eyes, the first thing she saw was a very familiar face.
“Gun…!”
Lee Gun bit his lips when he heard the familiar voice. It was a voice that he remembered.
“Yeonwoo.”
Years. It had been dozens of years.
If Lee Gun added the time that he had spent within the tower, he couldn’t guess how long it had been, how long it had been since he was able to call out her name like this.
Even being able to call out her name made Lee Gun choke up. This was the same for Yeonwoo.
“Gun…!!”
Yeonwoo hugged Lee Gun. She cried when she saw Lee Gun, who was alive.
Lee Gun patted her back as he hugged her as well. “I’m sorry! I was too late.”
“No. I’m the one who should be sorry…! I dragged you into everything…!”
It seemed that had continued to bother Yeonwoo.
Back then, Lee Gun had been a normal human. He had no connection to the Serpent Bearer temple.
However, Lee Gun just shook his head from side to side. “I was able to live thanks to you.”
Despite the horrible nightmare that had been waiting for him, he didn’t regret becoming an awakened being. Thanks to that, he had been able to meet some people.
The thirteenth laughed as if he was pleased.
‘That’s why he tried to revive Yeonwoo in a place where no one was present.’
Lee Gun pretended as if he wasn’t choked up. He faked a cough.
The thirteenth looked at his son anew.
“Are you ok? Can you hear me well?”
“!”
Yeonwoo was surprised by Lee Gun’s words. “Now that I think about it, my hearing is…”
“I fortified your body so that you can hear again.”
“!”
Yeonwoo was originally unable to hear sounds. To be precise, it wasn’t as if she was unable to hear Lee Gun’s voice.
Although her hearing had been sealed, thanks to the power of the Zodiac, she was able to telepathically hear the voices of Lee Gun and her younger brother.
“Time called your body back from the past, so I made some changes to it. Well, half of your body was damaged, so I had to tinker with it…” Lee Gun scratched his cheek. “Anyway, you should carefully take stock of your body. I’m great at making items, but I’m not so sure about living beings. Is it ok?”
“Yes. It is ok, but….”
“But what?”
An odd expression appeared on Yeonwoo’s face as she felt her body. “For some reason, my chest became larger…”
“Cough!!!”
Lee Gun coughed as if something was stuck in his throat.
Yeonwoo seemed oblivious to it as she tilted her head in puzzlement. “That’s odd. They were never this big….”
“No!! Cough! I didn’t know your exact size…!! Cough!!”
The thirteenth let out a wicked smile as he looked at his son. He had a reason for doing it.
[Maybe, he changed your body to his preference?]
“You want to die!!!!!”
[Yes, yes. I know my son’s preference now. I’ll apply it to you next time.]
“Apply what!!!!”
[I do like having a daughter~]
“Do you really want to die!!!!”
The thirteenth cackled, and Yeonwoo finally realized his presence. Her mouth fell open.
The thirteenth let out a bitter laugh when he saw this.
[I’m sorry, and I’m glad you are ok.]
When Yeonwoo saw the familiar face, she couldn’t close her mouth. It looked like tears were about to roll down her face. However, she lowered her head. It was a habit.
“I never expected to see you again like this… Ahh!” Yeonwoo screamed as she was about to prostrate herself.
However, a hand suddenly flew in to stop her. The hand stopped her forehead.
The culprit was none other than Lee Gun. “It’s fine. You don’t have to bow down to that bastard.”
“!”
The thirteenth laughed.
[Yes. I’m no longer your master. He is.]
The thirteenth looked at Yeonwoo with satisfaction. His reaction was expected since he had picked up Yeonwoo and Junwoo when they were on the verge of death. They were the baby snakes that he had reared.
Naturally, he wanted her to live a happy life with her little brother Junwoo despite his death. If there was an opportunity, he thought it would be great for them to meet Lee Gun, but…
‘I never expected her to pass her power to him.’
The thirteenth had been surprised by the siblings’ chance meeting with Lee Gun, and he never expected them to sacrifice their lives to save his son.
When one considered what had happened, it was as if he had nudged his son to grow up as the Serpent Bearer…
‘If I knew he would become someone who doesn’t even acknowledge his father, maybe I shouldn’t have helped him.’
Lee Gun didn’t care as he grabbed Yeonwoo’s arm. “Anyway, let’s head back.”
It seemed he didn’t want to see the thirteenth’s face. “I don’t know why, but the Divine statuses have stopped going berserk. I’m sure it’ll be fine if we head out.”
[You don’t even entertain the idea that your father stopped them from going berserk?]
Instead of answering him, Lee Gun unfurled his middle finger.
The thirteenth feigned laughter as he flicked his finger. Then something surprising happened.
Flash!
[Dad has imbued the Serpent Bearer with a new ability.]
[Praise Your Father]
– Seals the berserk Divine statuses. It can temporarily lower them to stage 5.
– If you shout I Love You Dad, Limit Cancel status will activate. You will be able to use stage 6.
“!”
Lee Gun looked at the thirteenth when something unexpected happened.
The thirteenth smirked.
[Stage 6 will erode your lifespan and body. If you continue to live with stage 6, you won’t live even a year as a god. You’ll die. If I’m being honest, it really is harmful, so you shouldn’t use it.]
Lee Gun looked like he had bitten into a lemon. The thirteenth grinned at that expression.
[What? Did I say something false? Stage 6 almost caused the downfall of the earth. You almost wiped out humanity through the pain that they felt. Your Zodiac Saints acted beyond their means. You might think that was why everyone was safe, but…]
Lee Gun gestured his hand in anger. “Change the skill title from ‘I Love You Dad’ to ‘Fuck off.’”
[Is that what you were dissatisfied with?!!]
“Of course? Since you’re giving me the skill for free, there is no reason for me to reject it. Ah. I want you to change the skill name from ‘Praise Your Father’ to ‘This Is My Power.’”
[Really! Do you realize how hard it was to create that ability? You should allow that much…!]
The thirteenth became angry, but he soon spoke as if it was enough.
[I want you to give my regards to my daughter-in-law when you get out. Tell her that her father-in-law wants to see her.]
Lee Gun completely ignored his words, but Yeonwoo’s eyes shook violently.
‘D…Daughter-in-law?’
Who was he referring to?
[My baby.]
“!”
Yeonwoo turned her head when the thirteenth called out to her.
[Did you not get a letter that I left you after I died?]
“No. There was nothing like that…! I only received a message full of anguish…!”
[Message?]
“Yes. It was a holographic message of an angry master saying that the other Constructs were going to kill you…”
“Ji Yeonwoo. Don’t refer to that god as your master.”
[Understood. Take good care of Gun.]
Yeonwoo looked both happy and sad as she smiled. “Yes. I will do my best to protect him. Since I’ve lost my Divine status, I don’t know if I’ll be of any help to him…”
The thirteenth laughed at those words.
[No. You guys already had your own Divine statuses.]
“!”
[I temporarily gave Life and Death to you and Junwoo to save you guys. You will be able to awaken your new Divine status like Junwoo. It’ll be done through the new blessing of the Serpent Bearer.]
Yeonwoo was surprised when she realized what those words meant. “My little brother is alive?!”
“Ah! Stop talking with that guy. If you keep responding to him, he’ll try to get closer to us.” Lee Gun opened the door of the Middle World.
Koo-goo-goong!
He exited the Middle World along with Yeonwoo using the power of Space. The thirteenth looked satisfied as he saw the two exit the place.
[I know you’re there. Stop watching us in secret. Come out.]
[!]
Unlike when he looked at his son, the thirteenth’s eyes were now cold.
Then, a familiar face appeared. It was a Zodiac wearing a horse mask. It was Sagittarius.
* * *
Around that time…
“Ha! Are you sure this is fine?”
“Are you really sure this will be ok?”
“I-It will be fine!”
“What are you going to do if it isn’t?”
The Leo Saint, Virgo Saint, Aquarius Saint, Scorpio Saint, Pisces Saint, and the substitute Zodiac Saints were shaking from worry.
The person lying before them was none other than Hugo. It was Hugo’s body, which was summoned early on by slime.
The Zodiac Saints and the Archer disciples made a circle with Hugo at the center. The Zodiac Saints were paying respect to their peers and guarding the body against anything unexpected.
They would do it until Lee Gun returned. However, there was a reason they were shaking from worry.
“Did Lee Gun really send Hugo back to the past without erasing his faith?”
“Yes. I heard it clearly.”
“Damn it! Hugo was already that bad. If his faith gets added to that…!”
“What if the future changes?!”
“Hmmph. If it changes, it changes.”
“!!”
Everyone was surprised by the familiar voice. The one to suddenly show up was none other than Lee Gun.
Then, the eyes of the Zodiac Saints turned round when they saw Yeonwoo’s face for the first time.
“Uh? Who’s this beautiful woman?”
“Ah! Is she the one? Is she your girlfriend?”
Hailey was surprised by Kevin’s words.
At that moment, Yeonwoo checked Hugo’s status. “Gun. You can’t revive a Construct using the method that you used before. The souls of Constructs are under the domain of the gods within the Divine world.”
She seemed to be an expert in this matter since she used to be the god of Life. “He probably got swept up into one of the worlds ruled by the gods of the underworld. According to the rules, you have to go there and receive approval.”
Of course, she immediately realized whom they had to see.
“Since my previous master sent this soul away, he probably sent him to his friend Hades, the master of the Underworld.”
Lee Gun nodded. Making contact with the master of the Underworld wasn’t too hard.
[You’re connected to the “Master of the Underworld.”]
[The request to retrieve the soul of a Construct belonging to the Serpent Bearer Temple has been submitted.]
[The request has been received.]
[A commission will be taken (1 Talent).]
[The soul of Hugo Otis (Construct Name: Pushover) is being called forth.]
Lee Gun activated his skill.
[Come back]
Flash!
The next second, Hugo breathed as if he had been rescued from the waters.
“Kuhk! Cough! Cough!”
Everyone cheered at this sight.
“Dad!!!”
“Hugo!”
“Hugo-nim!!”
The Zodiac Saints and Archer disciples were all happy. The Chun siblings cried as they ran to their father.
“Dad!!”
“Yes. Kuhk. Cough. You guys were safe. I’m glad nothing happened to—”
Boohoo-gahk!!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Hugo was suddenly sent flying by Lee Gun’s kick.
This shocked everyone.
“Hey! What the hell are you doing?”
“How could you?”
Instead of answering them, Lee Gun angrily asked, “Who are you?”
“W-What?”
“I said, who are you, asshole?”

chapters.title: Chapter 325
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Come Back (2)
Around the time when Lee Gun was waking up Hugo, the thirteenth furrowed his brows as Sagittarius made his appearance. It seemed the god of the sun had tried his best not to be discovered by the thirteenth.
[Did you think I wouldn’t find out about you staying hidden near my son?]
Sagittarius was silent when he heard the words full of barb.
In the past, he had been the thirteenth’s older brother. He had been part of the Creator tribe, yet he had never developed the Creation ability. This was why he became covetous of the power of the Creators and killed his tribe members along with his accomplices.
However, Sagittarius had also been murdered in the same fashion when the thirteenth had carried out his revenge.
Unlike the others, Sagittarius had his core absorbed by the Construct that killed him, so his original personality had remained.
Of course, it hadn’t been long since he had remembered the memories from his days as one of the original owners.
‘I recovered all my memories right before Lee Gun went into the Devil’s Tower.’
In the end, Sagittarius spoke to the thirteenth.
[Since you’ve been revived, you should get rid of me. You should complete your revenge.]
[No. I won’t.]
[What?]
[Now that I’ve gotten older, that task has become annoying in many ways.]
[…!!]
The thirteenth glanced at the surprised Sagittarius.
[Of course, it’s probably the fault of the Sagittarius Construct, who ate a core that wasn’t purified. Or maybe, your personality was left behind because the blood of the Creators flows within you. Anyway, you had a curse placed on you.]
[That’s….]
[It’s fine. Since you helped my son, I’m willing to forgive what you did in the past.]
However, the thirteenth then laughed in a nasty manner.
[Of course, I never plan on helping you revive your hair and your problem down there.]
[…!!!!]
Sagittarius’ face crumpled. Was the thirteenth letting him off because he was enjoying this…!!
The thirteenth didn’t care as he furrowed his brows.
[Anyway, I want Hyung-nim to stay by Gun’s side and look after him. Someone out there is aiming for the power of the Creators.]
[!]
[This bastard might have goaded you to kill your parents.]
Of course, this didn’t change that Sagittarius’s actions were unforgivable.
On the other hand, Sagittarius looked taken aback.
[Why are you leaving him to me? Why can’t you stay next to him?]
[I’m someone who should have died on that day. The dead should disappear. Gun is the thirteenth Zodiac, and he’s now the owner of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
[!]
[Still, I want to be a bit selfish. I want to disappear after I see my daughter-in-law and my grandchild.]
The thirteenth smiled as he thought about Lee Gun.
[Anyway, I told Gun that you’re his uncle. Good luck.]
[??!!]
Sagittarius almost screamed. Why the hell did he have to tell Lee Gun about that?
Once Lee Gun found out about the truth, he would go harder against him! Sagittarius was about to say something, but he almost throttled his younger brother when he saw the thirteenth’s expression.
[You told him on purpose, right?!!]
[No way. Why would I do that? Do you have something to hide, Hyung-nim?]
Sagittarius despaired when he saw the thirteenth flash a bright smile, as if nothing was wrong.
‘I should have never left the Divine world.’
If he had stayed in the Divine world, he wouldn’t have come face-to-face with Lee Gun.
Suddenly…
[!]
The thirteenth’s expression changed, surprising Sagittarius.
[What’s wrong?]
[A problem must have occurred on Gun’s side.]
The thirteenth quickly disappeared.
* * *
Bbah-gahk!
The Zodiac Saints and the disciples were shocked by what was happening in front of them. Lee Gun had suddenly kicked the revived Hugo. So they grabbed Lee Gun.
“Hey! Have you lost your mind?”
“I get how you feel, but… this isn’t it!”
Lee Gun ignored them as he looked at Hugo with cold eyes. “How dare you pretend to be Taeksoo? You want to die?”
The Zodiac Saint and the disciples, who had been trying to hold Lee Gun down, were surprised.
“He’s pretending to be Taeksoo…”
“That’s not Hugo?!”
The Chun siblings look at Hugo in surprise. Everyone who saw Hugo’s expression was shocked.
Normally, Hugo would have gotten angry before saying something. However, he had an odd smile on his face right now.
“Hmmph. As expected of the Zodiac of the earth, you noticed. I can see why the Great Spirits are focused on you.”
“!!”
The Chun siblings immediately broke away from Hugo.
“Who are you?” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed in anger. It didn’t matter who this bastard was. “I’ll ask nicely. Bring Taeksoo. Are you trying to cheat me?”
“Even if you say that— Kuh-huhk!!!”
Lee Gun stepped on his head as if to shut him up. “I’ll get rid of a finger each time you talk. Hurry up and bring me Taeksoo!”
In the end, Lee Gun was going to get rid of him with Death. But…
Flash!
A light descended from the sky.
“!”
At the same time, the light changed into a hologram. A holographic man appeared at the scene with a smile.
[Even if you get rid of it, your Construct won’t be returned.]
“!”
Lee Gun looked at him as if he were speaking nonsense. “Are you the culprit? Stop talking nonsense. Hurry up and hand over Taeksoo.”
[I don’t want to.]
“What?”
[You’re a Zodiac from the border with no title, yet you possess an amazing Construct. This is why it’s getting pretty crazy in the Divine world.]
“??!”
[Even a god cannot have a faith of more than 200%, yet he has 600% faith. It is unheard of. That might be why he’s on a different level compared to the other high-rank Constructs. As if having a special ability wasn’t enough, he possesses the power to replace 600 high-quality Constructs. It caused a big fuss within the auction house.]
Lee Gun feigned laughter as if he was dumbfounded. In other words, the Divine world had been turned on its head because the gods coveted Hugo. This was why the god of the underworld had ignored his official request and sent a different soul.
At this point, Lee Gun’s gaze moved to a different location. “Hey! You want to die! You told me I could bring him back! You said you were friends with that god of the underworld!”
It seemed Lee Gun had realized the thirteenth was lurking around in the shadows.
In the end, the thirteenth appeared as if he was reacting to those words. He was sweating profusely.
[I have no idea. There is no way Hades would act so stingy.]
The god inside the hologram laughed when he heard those words.
[It has been a while, and my father is no longer here. I already helped my father retire.]
The thirteenth continued to sweat.
‘There was already a transition of generations.’
His son’s gaze felt very prickly. The thirteenth looked aggrieved as he spoke.
[Why the hell did he have to lose his seat… Kuhk!!]
In the end, Lee Gun choked the thirteenth. “Why the hell did you have to send Taeksoo to the underworld of all places?”
[No! If I hadn’t sent him there, he would have been exterminated by Confusion! His soul itself would have ceased to exist! At that point, no god would have been able to revive him! This is better than losing him forever!]
“#$*&*!” Lee Gun wanted to immediately send the thirteenth flying, but he held himself back. The reason Hugo was sent there wasn’t important right now. “I paid the fee, and I asked him to be returned through the official channel. You will be reprimanded if you deny the request.”
[It doesn’t matter. It won’t be a problem if I just have to send back an item worth equal in value.]
“!”
[That’s why I sent you a substitute. In terms of specs, he’s on par with the “Pushover.” In fact, he’s one of the highest-ranked Constructs that might rank much higher than the other one. He is a special one that used to be owned by a Great Spirit. He’s someone precious that everyone covets. That should be enough, right?]
Was this bastard playing with his words? Lee Gun said, “I don’t care about specs. I need that particular soul.”
[Alright. I’ll return him. Instead, you should give me the Serpent Bearer’s holy ground, the earth.]
“What?”
[I’ll return it after five hundred years.]
In the end, murderous intent appeared in Lee Gun’s eyes. The bastard was getting too smug because Lee Gun wasn’t doing anything. He was talking nonsense.
[Ahhk! Gun! I’m being sold!]
“Dad!”
At that moment, a familiar voice came from the hologram. Hugo sounded like he was being chased by a goddess.
[Ho ho ho. Your face is not bad, and your abilities are quite useful. I’ll let you be my 19,788th husband.]
[Ahhk! I’m a married man! I have two kids!]
Death started to leak out from Lee Gun’s body. “This is my last warning. Give him to me.”
[Ha ha. I’m an exalted great Zodiac. I have more disciples than the people populating the earth. I’m the ruling god of the Pluto Dimension. A rookie like you being able to use the 600%-faith Construct to acquire such a land as a holy ground should be enough.]
The god of the underworld laughed after saying that.
[With him, a god could reach the mysterious stage 6, which no god has accomplished. This is why everyone is excited. You should give up something as good as him to your elder! You’re merely a poor god from the outskirts!]
This was how the hologram ended. Lee Gun’s patience reached its end.
“U…Uncle? Ahhhhk!!!”
Boom!
As if reacting to Lee Gun’s rage, stage 6 of both Life and Death surged forth.
[Those maggots…]
“U…Uncle?” They had never reached stage 6, yet they were acting this way?
[I never planned on going to the Divine world since it was too annoying.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed with menacing light.
* * *
[Lee Gun is the only god of the earth.]
[Lee Gun has saved the earth.]
[Every temple is taking care of the remaining remnants of the monsters.]
[The monsters are on the run after losing all their masters.]
[With the Serpent Bearer at the center, the lands belonging to humanity are being recovered.]
The world was abuzz. The monarchs, which had invaded the earth, were gone. Consequently, the monsters within the Red zone and Black zone had lost morale.
The disciples of the earth, who followed the Serpent Bearer, were cleaning them up. All the Zodiac Saints had stepped onto the battlefield as they joined the extermination.
Of course, they felt like dying because their Zodiac (Lee Gun) chastised them even if they slipped up a little.
Anyway, the Zodiac Saints and their substitutes were cleaning up the monsters, who were running away.
“That’s why I’m not handing over the title of Zodiac Saint for the Serpent Bearer! Noona can take over the Zodiac Saint seat for the Libra temple! In fact, Uncle said to pick out the Zodiac Saints for the other temples!”
“Oh really? You’re trying to pick a fight with me because you grew a bit taller?”
“Yes! Let’s do this! Come at me!”
Stevens shook his head from side to side. He watched Chun Sungjae and Carly fight and growl at each other.
Thanks to Lee Gun’s power, humanity was smoothly recovering its lands. However, the task would take several more months of work, and the idea of traveling with these two sounded dreadful.
‘At this speed, I’ll just have to endure it for half a year.’
“Zodiac Saint-nim! Come here for a bit!”
“We found something strange!”
“!”
The disciples seemed to have discovered something within the crack in the ground.
The Zodiac Saints rushed toward the disciples who had called them. What they saw surprised them.
“This is…!”
“I think we killed it when we were getting rid of the monsters. However, its appearance is odd.”
“What the hell? That isn’t a monster. Isn’t it a god?”
The being looked too odd to be a Construct of the twelve Zodiacs, whom they were familiar with. It had an odd appearance that they had never seen before.
On the other hand, Kevin bit his tongue. “Is it an outer god…?”
It wasn’t a complete match, but this being smelled similar to the outer gods that Aries had brought along with him.
‘Did it come from the same place?’
Of course, that wasn’t important right now.
“The other gods are getting interested in the earth and the human disciples, since we possess a power that they’ve never seen before. Was it on reconnaissance?”
“Lee Gun did say others might invade to steal the human disciples.”
“Then…!”
“There is no downside to being guarded. We do have the blessing of the Serpent Bearer.”
“What about Lee Gun?”
Chun Sungjae stood a bit taller at those words, but he soon bit his tongue. “Ah. Uncle went to the ob/gyn with Mom…!”
* * *
“That’s why you should take care of yourself, Miss Jiwoo. You have to keep this with you at all times. Also, the child can come at any moment, so you should stay at home.”
“Oh my, Lee Gun-nim! You already said that over twenty times. Also, I’m only three months into my pregnancy. How could the child come out?”
“Ah. I guess you’re right.”
They had come to the ob/gyn with Yooha and Yeonwoo. Lee Gun nodded. “Anyway, I’ll bring Taeksoo back before this child is born. If something happens, you should immediately speak to Yeonwoo. Yeonwoo can travel freely between the earth and the Divine world.”
Chun Jiwoo nodded in response.
Lee Gun entrusted Chun Jiwoo to the person he trusted the most. He saw her off to make sure that she was careful, then he said to Yooha, “None of you guys have reached the Divine rank, but some have developed a bit of Divine status, right?”
“Yes. Jaewon Oppa, several Zodiac Saints, and I…”
All of them were over level 10.
“Yooha will come with me. I’ll call for a couple of them when the time is right. That’s why I want you to speak to Sungjae. I want him to make sure they level up and become a Construct rank.
“The monsters will act as nourishment for them, so it won’t be too difficult. I want you guys to send Contributions toward me too… Ah. Should I ask Hailey to come with us?”
“!”
Hailey originated from the unknown civilization, which the gods feared. They would probably faint if they realized a monarch rank had entered the Divine world.
“Yes. I’ll take her with me.”
Yooha and Yeonwoo were surprised by those words. This was especially true of Yeonwoo, who seemed anxious for some reason. She opened and closed her mouth as if she wanted to say something.
Oblivious to this, Lee Gun flicked his finger. It made the slime hop toward him and jump on top of his head.
[Clump of Creation Clay says it wants to go too.]
Lee Gun looked at the slime in suspicion, but he soon ripped the item that he had taken from the Dimensional manager. He had never expected to use it like this.
[You have used the Divine World Pass.]
The voice of the Divine world’s representative rang out.
[Greetings to the Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
[Do you have a destination?]
“I want to go where Hades is.”
[You will be moved to Region A.]
[The Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple (rank unmeasured) is ranked last in the pecking order.]
[The Divine world is full of gods higher up in ranking, so please be careful.]
Finally, a beam of light appeared before him. Lee Gun walked toward the light pillar. He had never planned on going to a place like the Divine world, but…
“I’ll crush all of those bastards.” Lee Gun let out an evil laugh.
Finally, the door to the Divine world opened.
<Part 1 of the Revenge Episode Completed>
NaughtyOtter’s Thoughts
Part 2 will begin right after this. I will be translating it too. There will be no pause.

chapters.title: Chapter 326
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: I Came to Find You? (1)
On that day, he had earned many nicknames.
He was the hero who had returned from the dead. He was the hero who had saved humanity from the monsters. He was a shameless hero who frequently dined and dashed.
He was a crazy hero who had gone to fight an elementary student because a video game had angered him. He was a psychotic hero with a bad temper who had spoken more cuss words than regular words in an interview.
He was a legend. A legend then became a myth. And the myth became a god. The god made new myths to live forever in the hearts of the people. However…
[Lee Gun has left the earth, and he has been put to rest.]
#Hell_Yeah_Freedom
#Lee_Gun_Gone
#Never_See_Him_Again
#Will_Disclosed
The entire world was turned on its head when an announcement was posted on Lee Gun’s official site.
The twelve Zodiac Saints also received the news.
“Lee Gun is gone?!”
The first one to come calling in surprise was Stevens. When Stevens charged into Lee Gun’s house, Chun Sungjae’s eyes turned round. The world was indeed abuzz, but he had never expected this man to be the first one to come here.
“Are you here because you are worried about Uncle…”
“Where are Lee Gun’s holy items? If Lee Gun isn’t here, I’ll take his weapons!”
At that moment, one could see the twinkle in his eyes.
“Have you lost your mind? He wrote a will! You should be worried about Uncle instead of trying to steal his items in such a brazen manner!”
People around the world were already rioting, thinking the Zodiac Saint had again trapped Lee Gun in the tower. They were demanding the Zodiac Saints to return Lee Gun.
In such an environment, there was no way Sungjae would hand over the items to this idiot.
After being kicked by Chun Sungjae, Stevens looked aggrieved. “Lee Gun went to retrieve Hugo! Lee Gun can’t be killed even if he is stabbed to death. Why should I be worried about him!?”
At that moment…
“I’m not sure how it’ll turn out this time for him.”
“!”
A voice came from the front door.
Kevin and the other Zodiac Saint substitutes stood there. Everyone was relieved to hear Lee Gun was fine. However, Kevin looked uneasy.
It was to be expected since the Divine world wasn’t a human world. It was called the world of the beast.
“Isn’t the Archer Saint already a resident of that world? I heard bringing him back will be difficult.”
“Hey. It’s Lee Gun. That won’t be a problem. That is why I’ll use his weapons while he— Kuh-huhk!”
When Chun Sungjae was about to step on Stevens, the Virgo Constructs descended. For some reason, they quickly sought out Chun Sungjae.
[Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer Temple! We heard the news!]
[We heard Baby snake-nim has headed toward the Divine world!]
[If it isn’t too much trouble, do you know which route he took to the Divine world?]
“Route?”
[Yes. Amongst all the routes to the Divine world, there is one considered truly dangerous…]
The worry was evident in their eyes.
While the well-known Zodiacs could instantly teleport, it was a completely different story for the nameless gods.
[H-He might not have the know-how, so we were wondering if he took the most difficult Road of Perseverance….]
“Ah. You don’t have to worry about that. Uncle used this to reach there.” Chun Sungjae waved a ticket that looked like a train ticket. It looked already used since it was ripped in half.
The Virgo Constructs looked relieved to see that.
[Oh! It’s a ticket that sends you directly to the Divine world.]
[In fact, it’s a gold-rank ticket. Baby snake-nim won’t have difficulty reaching the Divine world with an item of this caliber.]
[We’ll be able to meet Baby snake-nim soon…]
However, their faces froze when they actually saw the ticket.
Chun Sungjae tilted his head in puzzlement. “What’s wrong?”
The Virgo Constructs screamed as if there were no tomorrow.
[Kyahhhhk! Baby snake-nim! Why did you have to go there of all places?]
[Why would you go to that region?]
[Nooooooo! Baby snake-nim!]
“What’s wrong?”
The Virgo Constructs were a nervous wreck as they spoke.
[When did Baby snake-nim leave?]
“T-this morning?”
[That means he’s still at the arrivals hall!]
“Why are you acting like this? Is it somewhere dangerous….”
[Kyahhhhk! We have to hurry up!]
“!!”
[H…He should be fine for now! If he hasn’t entered the Divine world yet, we can still look after him…!!]
[Kyahhhhhk! Hurry up and bring a clairvoyant! We have to confirm it!]
“What’s the problem?”
They quickly moved into action.
* * *
Pantheon—it was the land of the gods, where millions of gods fought each other. In this boundless world, the heavens existed outside of the heavens. It was a place where the most greedy citizens gathered. Moreover, it held all kinds of treasures.
Come.
Worship.
Follow.
Take.
That was how one could acquire myths to reach eternal life.
“Let this be known. You don’t have the looks needed to enter the great Divine world. You aren’t qualified at all.”
“What did you just say, you primitive bird-looking bastard?” The angry Lee Gun threw a frame with a hole in it.
The bird-headed god raged. “You bastard! How dare you act this way against an evaluator!”
“Evaluator! What kind of evaluation is this? You want to die!” Lee Gun got up in anger.
He had left the earth to reach the Divine world of the gods to find his kidnapped friend. However, he had yet to enter the Divine world.
[You’re an unregistered god. Your divinity hasn’t been registered.]
[You will be connected to the entry office closest to your destination.]
He wasn’t sure about it, but it seemed all gods had to go through a registration process.
‘Is it like acquiring citizenship?’
It didn’t matter in the end. Lee Gun had been sent to this place as the voice told him that he would be connected to the entry office here.
At a glance, the office looked like a bank teller counter. Of course, the size of the place was unimaginably large. If one looked at the length and breadth of the counter, it was endless. The sky and the ground were white spaces, yet there was only the teller’s window.
When some birds handed out number tickets, Lee Gun went along with it. So what the hell was this?
“You said you’ll evaluate me for entry, yet you suddenly disparage my looks? Are you trying to pick a fight with me?”
“What do you think I’m doing? I am judging if your face is suitable for the Divine world!”
“You’re merely asking me to pick up this shitty frame, so how is this an evaluation?”
“How rude! That is a mold created by the god of Art!” The angry bird-headed god waved his hand as if to shoo him away. “Return to where you came from! Billions of gods come here daily. We are overflowing with gods wanting to enter the Divine world.”
“What does that have to do with my face?”
“It has everything to do with it. The evaluators are in charge of maintaining quality in the Divine world. Your face isn’t right for the Divine world.”
“It isn’t right?”
“That’s right. These are the ideal faces.”
When the other brought out pictures, Lee Gun furrowed his brow as he took them. “This is quality? How handsome are these bastards that they passed—”
Lee Gun’s face froze.
“Humanoid faces have no personality! As you can see, the vintage amphibian and reptilian looks go well with the Divine world!”
Enraged, Lee Gun ripped apart the photos. He then glared at the bird-headed monster. “I don’t care if my face has a personality or not. Just register me. Do you realize how many high-ranking humanoid gods I know….”
“No way!”
“Why do you keep saying no….”
“In the first place, you’re too handsome! The goddesses will go nuts if I let you in! Fuck off!!”
Did this bastard lose his mind? The enraged Lee Gun choked the god’s neck. “Let me through before I boil and season you. Hmm?”
The god made choking noises as it spoke. “Fuck off! You aren’t even a fighting-type god, so do you really think I’ll be afraid of you? Even if you gain entrance, you will merely be a low-rank god that’ll give massages to the goddesses! If you want entry, you can purchase a service from our Zodiac. If you pay 100 Talents, we’ll change your face into that of someone from the popular fish face— Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “If you like it so much, I’ll fix your face right now.”
“What? What do you mean… Poo-hahk! Kuhk! Huh-kuhk!” The enraged Lee Gun let his fist fly toward the bird-headed god.
The teller counters were divided into booths, so no one knew what was going on inside one. This was why no one from the outside came to stop Lee Gun.
After some time had passed, the small space of one pyeong was full of feathers and blood.
The bird-headed god had fallen to the ground, and it raised its trembling hand. “You bastard… You looked delicate, yet you were a fighting-type god… Since you were so skinny, I thought you were a bad apple…”
Instead of giving an answer, Lee Gun picked up a stamp on the desk. He nonchalantly stamped a document.
Kwahng!
Name: None of your business
Divine Name: Don’t know
Affiliation: None
Divine Status: Don’t know. Make stuff well.
Age: 25
<Passed Evaluation>
It seemed he had to register various things, but Lee Gun didn’t care about them at all.
‘They are like maggots.’
It was clear as to where the Zodiacs had acquired their personalities.
‘I guess it doesn’t matter.’
If he used this method, he would enter the Divine world soon.
* * *
It was clearly a mistake to have thought that.
“Ahhhk!”
Lee Gun was falling from the sky after passing through the first entry office. It was for no other reason.
[Master! You should have waited where they told you to wait!]
[I’m pretty sure this happens if you fail the evaluation for entry!]
Three evaluations were needed to enter the Divine world. The first evaluation was Entry Declaration (Resident Registration).
The second evaluation was a physical examination. This included checking personal belongings and qualifications. It was a security screening.
The third evaluation was in-processing, when one submitted documents.
Anyway, Lee Gun had arrived at the second evaluation center. A deer-headed god there had told him to be on standby until it was time for his physical examination and inspection of his belongings.
Ignoring the instructions, Lee Gun had headed toward the bridge leading to the next examiner. This was the result of his choice.
Hweeeeng!
[You’re a visitor who didn’t receive the security screening. You will be expelled.]
“!!”
As the notification rang, the floor disappeared from the bridge, and Lee Gun started free-falling.
Lee Gun’s Constructs suddenly started falling with their master, and they started to scream. They were currently sealed within Lee Gun’s shadow.
[Master! We’ll be in big trouble if things continue like this!]
[If we continue to fall like this, we’ll fall into the sewage treatment plant of the Divine world!]
[If we get swept up in it, we’ll become clumps of waste. We won’t be able to come back out alive!]
Lee Gun didn’t know what was going on, but clearly, even gods would perish if they continued to fall like this.
[Should we have waited back there?!]
[That’s right. It isn’t too late to head back…]
“Are you kidding me? We’ll have to wait for twenty years! I can’t afford to wait that long!”
Lee Gun raged. He had to take back Hugo before his 3rd child was born. Twenty years was a non-starter!
“You guys said the time difference between the earth and this place isn’t that significant!”
[However, Master will be in danger if we continue like this!]
“Can none of you fly?”
[Master, if you cannot use your power, you cannot break the seal and come out with us!]
“!”
Lee Gun immediately used the Construct Summon skill, but his magical energy refused to come out.
“…!”
Lee Gun was taken aback, but he soon found out the reason.
[Master cannot use your power since you haven’t been admitted yet!]
[To stop the illegal entrants, the powers of the gods are sealed here. It doesn’t matter what rank the god is— Ahhk!]
Lee Gun started falling faster. He kept falling through the endless space with clouds.
At the same time, a light exploded forth from a place with dense clouds. It was coming from the direction where Lee Gun was falling toward.
The Constructs screamed when they saw the red light.
[That’s the disposal plant! If we get swept up in that, we won’t be able to come back out alive!]
[Moreover, it’s connected to the septic tank of the Divine world…!]
“!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. Before he could locate Hugo, he was about to be decomposed like manure. He was at a loss for what to do.
As he was about to be swept up into the light…
Kwahng!
Koohng!
“Ahhhk!”
Something stopped him.
“…?”
He hit something that felt like scrap iron. The shocked Lee Gun looked at his surroundings.
‘Is it an airship?’
It was a sailboat flying through the sky. This small flying vessel could seat two people, and it was very poorly made, as if it was made with scrap metal.
“Damn it! Who the hell is it?”
At that moment, a man opened a door and came out from the flying vessel. He looked to be a human in his late twenties. However, the energy that he was giving off made it clear that he was a god.
But this energy was different from that of the Zodiacs that Lee Gun had seen up until now. Moreover, this god also felt different from the public servant gods that manned the first and second entry evaluation centers.
Those servant gods felt similar to Constructs. This one was different. He seemed lower in rank than the Constructs and gave off a novel feeling.
[He is a subtype divine-rank god.]
“Subtype god?”
[He is lower in rank than the civilians, such as the Adjunct-deity or the Quasi-deity rank. He’s from the lower class.]
[They are those Master do not even need to converse with.]
It was unclear, but it seemed even gods had ranks and stations among them. Anyway, the Constructs were relieved that Lee Gun was ok. They whispered from his shadow.
[He doesn’t seem to be an evil god.]
[Since Master has to go through the entry examination, you should ask him to transport you back to the second entry evaluation center.]
Lee Gun angrily dismissed the suggestion. “Have you lost your mind? I’ll have to wait twenty years if I go there. It’s a non-starter.”
There was no way he would act according to their expectations.
[But… the laws of the Divine world are unforgiving. You should comply with the law.]
[There is no way we’ll be able to enter without…!]
“Hey! Why do you keep talking to yourself?”
“!”
The male god approached Lee Gun and looked at his surroundings. “Be quiet…! I’m fucked if I get caught smuggling myself. Stop causing a commotion or we will be….”
The Constructs froze when they heard the word “smuggling.” On the other hand, Lee Gun’s eyes sparkled brightly.
Is that so? He was a smuggler?

chapters.title: Chapter 327
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: I Came to Find You? (2)
Yes. He was a smuggler.
Lee Gun’s smile became brighter than ever before.
‘Why did I think of that?’
He had no reason to wait in the queue. He had no reason to have his face evaluated by others.
‘I just have to force myself in there.’
As if they had read his intent, the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple became scared out of their wits.
[M-Master! You can’t!!!]
[It doesn’t matter what you have in your mind, but you can’t do it! It isn’t something you should do!]
The Constructs were connected to their master. While they couldn’t read his thoughts, they could sense his mood.
When Lee Gun’s sharp feelings suddenly resolved into something bright, the Constructs clenched their butts. It was obvious what their master was thinking!
[Master!!]
[You can’t do that….]
“You’re being noisy. If you guys keep opening your mouths, I’ll kill you guys first.”
The Constructs within the shadow became silent at once. They didn’t want to die at their owner’s hands.
‘Master is scary even if his power is sealed.’
‘As expected of Lee Gun-nim…’
The owner of the flying vessel was oblivious to what was going on. He furrowed his brows. “Why the hell is this bastard mumbling to himself?”
Lee Gun looked at the male god when he spoke up. At a glance, the god looked like a shepherd.
‘He doesn’t look like a fighting-type god.’
Lee Gun continued to glare at the god, but gained no other information.
‘As expected, none of my skills are working.’
Normally, the Gaze of a God would be automatically activated, and he would be able to confirm numerous pieces of information.
To check the status of his skills, he unfurled his hand, but he saw only one thing through the golden hologram.
[LOCK]
It seemed he was unable to use his skills, including Super Regeneration, until he entered the Divine world. Well, it didn’t matter.
“You said you’re a smuggler, right? You should let me ride along with you.”
The male god looked Lee Gun up and down, baffled. “Since you fell from that bridge, you must have failed during the entry evaluation. You’re a reject.”
The male god brought up his forefinger as if he was about to push Lee Gun’s forehead with it. “How dare a lowly bug like you give orders to me? From your looks, you seem like a low-rank god that does odd jobs…”
However, when the forefinger was about to touch Lee Gun’s forehead, Lee Gun grabbed it. Then he broke it.
“Ahhhk!!”
It had happened in an instant.
The flustered male god tried to attack Lee Gun.
Bbah-gahk!
“Ahhhhhk!!”
Lee Gun moved like lightning as he broke the god’s joints. Lee Gun wasn’t using any weapons or magical energy, yet he was like a kid playing with his toy robot. He merely needed one hand and one foot to dismantle a god. The god was put on the ground as if it was nothing.
Ba-gahk! Bah-gahk!
The god felt as if his joints were about to be destroyed. He lay on the ground, shaking. “W-what is your identity? No, what are you?”
“It’s none of your business.”
“I mean… If you’re a fighting-type god, you should have said so in the first place…!!”
“I don’t care. Just drive this thing. Hyung-nim has business in the Divine world.”
The god was dumbfounded. How old was this bastard to give orders to him? Why did he have to call him Hyung-nim?
At that moment, the god saw the document sticking out from Lee Gun’s pocket. He took it without Lee Gun noticing it, and when he unfurled the document, a scream escaped his lips. His reaction was understandable.
Age: 25
“Ahhhk! You’re a novice that isn’t even a hundred years old, so how dare you order me around!!”
“!”
“Hey! I might be young, but I’m 3,200 years old….”
Bbah-gahk!!
“Drive.”
“Yes… Hyung-nim.”
* * *
It didn’t matter whether one wanted to succeed or whether one wanted to show off one’s power. The best from various worlds gathered at the battlefield of the Pantheon.
Lee Gun arrived at the entrance to the Divine world in no time.
At a glance, it looked like an enormous mountain. The flying boat infiltrated the world by hiding itself within the cloud, and they entered an enormous cave.
Then the god immediately hid the airship. They would have to walk from that point on.
Satyr looked at Lee Gun as if the latter were suspicious. “I have a question, Hyung-nim.”
“Keep it short.”
“I don’t want to be presumptuous. This might be rude, but…”
“Don’t ask if it’s rude to ask, idiot.”
“Kuh-huhk!!” Satyr shed tears after being beaten up again.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “Whatever. What’s your name?”
“What? Ah! My name is Satyr…”
“Hey, Gigolo. Do you know about the gods? I’m looking for someone.”
Why the hell did he ask for his name if he was going to act this way? Satyr was going to push back, but he shut his mouth when faced with Lee Gun’s fists.
“Yes! I’m confident about being in the top three when it comes to information about gods!! I can find anyone…!”
“Hades.”
“What?! Of all the gods you can look for, you’re looking for an Olympus Zodiac! Moreover, he’s part of the eight great powers…”
Satyr discreetly looked Lee Gun up and down. He reacted in disgust. “Since you’re looking for a Zodiac, you must be trying to become his Construct… He won’t accept a god that participated in smuggling.”
Lee Gun merely snorted. “Construct, my ass! I’m going there to kill him.”
“Ah! Is that so? I guess it doesn’t matter if you’re going for that purpose—”
The laughing Satyr suddenly screamed. “Ahhhhhk! No way you’re going to kill him!!!”
“?”
Satyr looked scared out of his wits as he grabbed Lee Gun by the collar. “You must be oblivious since you’re a novice! Someone of your caliber cannot go against someone like that! Do you understand what I am saying?!”
Bbah-gahk!!
“Never mind….” Satyr cried after being hit by Lee Gun again. “It seems Hyung-nim is clueless about everything. You must have come from a backward dimension.”
“?”
He started writing something on the floor.
[Ancient God] (Bastards in the Heavens)
[Great Spirit] (Royal bastards)
[Zodiac] (Noble bastards) <- You’re aiming for this
[Construct] (Knights·Retainers) <- Very annoying minions of the Zodiac bastards. ※Caution: Depending on their size, there might be high-rank Zodiacs in this class. You shouldn’t mess with anyone starting from here at all costs.
[Adjunct deity] (Commoner) <- I’m here
[Quasi-deity] (Lowest Class)
[Subtype deity] (Poor slave) <- You’re here!
“Do you now see the problem?”
When Lee Gun glared at him as if he were unimpressed, Satyr screamed while erasing the words he wrote. He wrote anew.
[Transcendent god]
[Highest-rank god]
[High-rank god] <- You’re aiming for this ★
[Middle-rank god]
[Low-rank god]
[Lowest-rank god] <- You’re here!
Satyr opened his eyes wide. “Do you understand now? Do you realize how great the high-rank gods are? They are scary and worthy of worship! How dare you say that!”
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. He had beaten up and turned such exalted beings into weapons?
Satyr’s body shook. “Both the high-rank and the low-rank gods are already in a frenzy because of the 600%-faith Construct that was captured not too long ago…!”
“!”
Lee Gun turned his head when he heard the story about Hugo.
“Anyway, it seems you cannot raise your rank, so you’re trying to kill a god as an achievement to raise your status. Give up on that idea. From the looks of your ranking, you seem to be in the lowest rank. I can tell you’re a subtype deity. A novice like you against a high-rank god is—”
“Fated to be torn apart by us.”
“?!”
The voice of a third person reverberated above their heads. At the same time, the wall of the cave came alive to turn into a beast.
“Ahhk! It’s the customs enforcement officer!”
The beast-like Construct tried to kill Lee Gun and Satyr. “I’ll immediately execute both of you!”
“Ahhk! No! Please spare us! We didn’t mean anything by this!”
The Construct was about to swing its weapon when…
Poo-hahk!!!
Lee Gun did a roundhouse kick, sending the Construct’s head flying.
Streams of blood shot out from its neck.
“K…Kuh-huhk…!!”
In a flash, the Construct’s head fell to the ground.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he landed lightly. “Execution, my ass!”
“…!!”
Satyr almost screamed. “H-He’s dead…!”
“It isn’t dead. Keep your mouth shut.”
“…!”
Lee Gun kicked the head of the Construct, which had turned into stone, as he took the lead.
Satyr shook from fright. The customs enforcement officer was a Construct affiliated with the Divine world. Such Constructs were high rank; they were the elites amongst the elites. Yet he was able to dispatch them in an instant!
‘What the hell! He is a low-rank god!’
The established gods could see it with their eyes. They could somewhat see their opponent’s ranking.
Lee Gun seemed oblivious as he moved inward. If he passed through this place, he would be able to find Hugo. He would be able to decapitate Hades.
Finally, he reached an open space. “If I pass through this place, it’ll be the Divine world, right?”
However, Lee Gun’s face hardened as soon as he entered the space.
‘What the hell is this?’
It was a vast indoor space, like the space one encountered before one exited the airport. It was like the last gate where the passport was checked.
This proved to be true, as an employee in the front was checking documents before sending the gods through.
‘What the hell is this line?’
The line in front of Lee Gun was at least several kilometers long, reminiscent of a line to an amusement park attraction.
Satyr laughed as if to say Lee Gun shouldn’t feel intimidated. “It might look like this, but this place merely issues tickets. Do you see the doors that look like walls? The pillars of light that you can see beyond them are direct gates. We just need to cross that gate over there!”
Lee Gun got angry. The reason for his anger was the conversation taking place among the beings waiting in line. They spoke as they sighed.
“Ah! This is driving me crazy. It’ll take three hundred years this time.”
“What? That’s fast since you’re at the front line. This line will take five hundred years.”
What the hell did they just say?
Lee Gun was angry.
One of the public employee gods was oblivious to his anger. He handed Lee Gun a waiting number ticket.
“Oh my! You’re a handsome male god. You’re lucky. This line is moving quickly, so you’ll be able to enter in 1,300 years. I want to congratulate you!”
“…”
What did this bad say? At that moment, a middle-aged god slyly cut in line in front of Lee Gun.
He cut in line, making the nearby gods raise their eyebrows in anger. However, the culprit seemed close to the public employees. He just snorted when he looked at Lee Gun. “Kids these days don’t know how to yield to their betters. Someone with a low rank should be quick on the uptake.”
Lee Gun looked at the back of the culprit’s head. The culprit didn’t care as he dug out something that looked like a phone. “Yeah. It’s me. I’ll be there soon. You should prepare a lot of drinks— Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun let his fist fly toward the culprit.
Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!
The god who had cut in line became bloodied. The nearby gods cheered, but Lee Gun ignored them. He shook off blood from his fists as he walked forward. He was doing it because something was off.
The line was long, but the evaluation wasn’t something that should take too long. Like checking the passport, this place should be checking their faces and dispensing the tickets.
‘It shouldn’t take hundreds of years.’
In the end, Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he reached the checkpoint in the front.
“Wow! Your name is three letters long? It’ll take me three years to type it. Hey. What do you guys want for lunch?”
“Oh my, old man. Your penmanship isn’t sophisticated enough. Please come back after you write it again. Ah. You have to get back in line.”
The public employees checking the documents were doing other things.
The gods in the line not getting angry at this display was impressive, but this was because these gods’ powers were sealed until they entered the Divine world.
In this place, the public employees were in power. The gods were patient as they did as asked. They remained patient as they followed all the rules.
On the other hand, an angry Lee Gun grabbed a public employee by his collar. “Hey. Why the hell does this take three years?”
“Hmph. If you don’t like it, you can head back. I have a lot to read. Of course, it’ll take a long time.”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose in anger when he saw the document being waved in his face. The document that the employee was reading was a single paper with not a single letter on it.
While this was occurring, the line next to him started shrinking rapidly.
Lee Gun furrowed his eyebrows at this sight. “That line is moving very quickly. They are reading more documents than you guys, so why is that line faster?”
The public employee god spoke mockingly. “Why else? It’s all about money.”
“What?”
“Don’t you know capitalism? If you feel aggrieved, you can take out some money. Well, you look poor by your appearance. I doubt you have any money.”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “Haha! I promised Yeonwoo to not throw a temper tantrum, but…”
“What nonsense are you—”
Bbah-gahk!!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
“Kyahhhk!!!”
The interior of the evaluation center turned into a scene of pandemonium.
The public employee who had his face smashed by Lee Gun fell unconscious. The nearby public employees got to their feet, and they screamed.
“C-Capture him!”
Lee Gun didn’t pay attention to them as he jumped on top of the table. He looked behind where the public employee sat.
Numerous mechanical devices lay back there. He had no idea which button opened the gate, but it didn’t matter.
Beep-Beep- Beep- Beep-
Lee Gun nonchalantly jumped off the table after pressing all the buttons. It was mayhem in the evaluation center.
Beep-Beep- Beep- Beep-
[Gate Opened]
[Danger]
[Danger]
[Danger of Exploding]
The walls blocking all the entrances disappeared, and all the gods waiting in line cheered at this.
“What is going on?!”
“That person opened the door!”
“Wow! Huzzah!!”
With Lee Gun leading the way, all the gods rushed toward the gate leading to the Divine world. Tens of thousands of gods rushed forward all at once!
The corrupt public officials, who had connections to the Great Spirits, turned pale from fright.
“Ahhhk! No! We won’t know who entered if they do that!”
“Catch them!”
“Cut off the transmission equipment!”
Was it caused by Lee Gun pressing the buttons? At that moment, a large explosion occurred within the evaluation center.
Kwahng!!!
[Ahhk! Turn off the transmission equipment!]
[Hurry up and catch them!]
[Catch the one who beat up the public employee first!]
[No! The gate exploded!]
An act of terror had occurred, and the evaluation center was burning.
The Zodiac Saints of the earth were watching all this through the power of clairvoyance possessed by a Construct. They were at a loss for words.
“That crazy bastard….”
“I’m the idiot for thinking he would enter through the normal way…”
A calamity had entered the Divine world.

chapters.title: Chapter 328
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: I Came to Find You? (3)
“What? There are 564,477 entrants?”
“Y-yes!”
The Divine world had been turned on its head. The reason was the massive crowd that had suddenly entered the divine world.
“What are you talking about?”
“Some crazy god blew up the equipment within the evaluation center…”
“What?!”
Which psycho did something worth being punished by the heavens?
“We are currently diverging our entire manpower.”
“At this rate, we will have no idea which gods have entered the Divine world!”
“…!”
These elite Constructs were the public employees of the Divine world. This incident was causing them headaches because a lot of them had made backroom dealings with the Zodiacs.
“We won’t be able to locate him since things turned out like this.”
“Do you mean the god of the Serpent Bearer temple?”
“That’s correct.”
In truth, they had received a heads-up on a god that they should be on the lookout for. This god had been put on the list.
[Serpent God of the twelve Zodiacs]
[Zodiac of the Earth]
[He might come looking for his Constructs. Be on the lookout.]
[It’ll be fine to refuse him entry.]
They had no idea why, but they were told to expel a low-rank serpent god.
‘I also never expected the gods to join up because of a Construct of human origin.’
It didn’t matter in the end.
“What the hell? A serpent god was amongst the twelve Zodiacs?”
“What? You didn’t know about it? I guess it’s to be expected since it is a top-secret matter.”
“Top secret?”
At the end of the day, the twelve Zodiacs were quite famous.
Currently, eight great forces existed within the Pantheon. These forces ruled over tens of billions of stars and dimensions. They were the leaders of those dimensions and the kings of the gods. Living beings of all dimensions treated them as kings of the universe.
The twelve Zodiacs had been one of those forces. One time, they used to be called the ninth great force.
‘Of course, they had deteriorated to the point that they are considered nonexistent. This is why more and more gods are unaware of the twelve Zodiacs.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“The Zodiacs want us to track down that fledgling. What if he’s amongst the illegal entrants? What are we supposed to do?”
“Hey. Losing the serpent bastard isn’t important right now! We have to prioritize restoring the arrivals hall! What are we going to do if an evil god crawls through it?”
“You’re right. The Constructs will quickly take care of a mere serpent god. He is classified as the lowest-rank god.”
That serpent god’s temple was located on the fringes. It was a country bumpkin temple with a lowly minor god. His name wasn’t even known.
“We have to find the terrorist instead of that guy!”
They quickly rushed toward the arrivals hall.
* * *
At this time, the terrorist in question was swearing profusely. “Fuck! This isn’t a smooth ride!”
Lee Gun was passing through an unknown tunnel. As he traveled down a dark endless tunnel, he felt like he was riding a roller coaster, as though he was being sucked toward somewhere.
Suddenly, he realized where he had felt this sensation. “Damn it! This feels the same as traveling down the gullet of a monster!”
He raged at the being who had made this tunnel, but the awful sensation dissipated soon.
Pahng!
“Koohk!”
Accompanying a bright light, Lee Gun exited the cave. When he opened his eyes, he flinched.
‘This place is…’
He was thrown into a space as large as the universe. He couldn’t see the end of it. It was a vast expanse of universe that could instantly swallow up a mere god.
Moreover, Lee Gun saw it clearly. A familiar world was unfolding before his eyes. It was like staring at a black hole.
A black sphere lay there, and with the sphere at its center, a red storm was swirling around it like a typhoon.
Moreover, a red pillar of light was extending out from the black sphere. It headed toward the sky, toward heaven. It was like looking at an elevator connected to the Divine world.
That place was the lowest floor of the Divine world. It was the World of Torture. It was where Yeonwoo’s soul had been located and also where Hugo had been lured into by Confusion.
However, that place wasn’t Lee Gun’s destination.
Pahng!
“Koohk!”
Lee Gun was immediately sent hurtling toward the red pillar. When the red light of the pillar swept him inside it, he felt as if he were riding an elevator. In a flash, he was sent flying upward.
[You are permitted to enter the Pantheon.]
Accompanying a sound that seemed to come from the universe, Lee Gun saw an unfamiliar world. It was an odd world that looked to be made in an icosahedron shape. Here, the dimensions met other dimensions. It was the world of the gods that emanated a massive amount of energy.
Pantheon was an amalgam of ten thousand dimensions.
[The ticket’s information remains in your body.]
[“Where Hades is located”]
[The exact coordinate is unknown. Do you have the general coordinates?]
He didn’t care about going to the general area. “Send me to that bastard’s house.”
[It is on the 5th dimensional floor.]
[Warning! The region in question is high rank (a very expensive region).]
[Will a low-rank god like you be able to handle the toll?]
[You might take on massive amounts of debt.]
[I will give you another opportunity to choose the general area.]
When the voice spoke in a sarcastic manner, Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. “Fuck off! Just send me to the fifth floor.”
A scream rang from Lee Gun’s hand after he spoke. It was Satyr. Lee Gun had kidnapped Satyr to gain more information about Hades and Hugo.
“Ahhhk! That’s crazy! Fifth floor?! You plan on going to a high-rank dimension! Are you sure you can facilitate this?!”
Lee Gun didn’t know the exact details, but the fifth floor seemed to be a very nice place.
[The fifth floor is the private region for the high-rank gods. It is very expensive.]
[You need 100 thousand Talents.]
[However, since this is your first time moving there, you will be charged 1 million Talents. This includes taxes.]
[If the amount is even 1 Talent short, you will be put under forced labor for 1,000 years. A penalty of 10 million Talents will be added on top.]
Shocked at those words, Satyr tried to run away. Unlike him, Lee Gun laughed. “I knew this would happen, so I brought this.”
Lee Gun took out a small cloth bag. When he opened it, Satyr’s eyes rolled backward.
“M-My god! Those are all gold coins! These are all Talents! How much is this in total?”
“They are fakes.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun was able to make anything using his Creation Workshop ability. He had made this item when he saw the currency of the gods. Basically, it was counterfeit money!
“Ha ha ha! Take this, assholes! This is the money for the toll!”
Satyr screamed. Such a thing wouldn’t work in the Divine world.
[You have met the requirement for 10 million Talents.]
[You have successfully deposited the toll fee.]
[Welcome! The Divine world welcomes the wealthy god.]
“Ahhhk! The Divine world was bamboozled by counterfeit money?!”
Lee Gun merely grinned. Those coins weren’t made normally. He had used Life stage 3 and his Creation ability to create those high-quality items.
“Then let’s go to the fifth floor….”
[Fake Currency has been detected.]
[A growling sound can be heard from these Talents.]
[These Talents possess a sense of self.]
[The manufacturer of the Talent despairs since these Talents are too beautiful in how they were made.]
[The originals look much uglier than these.]
[You have been charged for creating counterfeit money. You will be expelled.]
“What the hell!?”
Lee Gun had been caught because he made them too well. He was instantly expelled.
“Ahhhhhk!”
They were thrown toward the icosahedron world and fell as if they were skydiving.
[A low-rank god (rank unmeasured ) dared to create counterfeit money to trick the Divine world.]
[You dare imbue life into the currency of the gods. Did you really think the high-rank gods wouldn’t notice your shameless actions?]
[You will be put under forced labor for 1,000 years and pay a fine of 10 million Talents. This number will be tripled since you have offended us.]
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. “That’s a bunch of bullshit! If their stomachs hadn’t growled, you would have never known they were fake, idiots!”
Moreover, wasn’t currency much more valuable if they possessed a sense of self? Moreover, they hadn’t returned his items either!
[You will be sent to the 20th dimensional floor. You will fall to the lowest floor.]
Satyr turned pale from fright. “Ahhhhk! Not the twentieth floor of all places!”
The Dimensional world was a place where dimensions were stacked and overlapped over each other. It was like the inner core of the earth. The lower one went, the worse the situation got.
It was like the upstream being the cleanest. Everything thrown away from the top flowed to the bottom. That was why the lowest floor of the Divine world was where all the waste gathered. It was akin to a waste disposal plant.
The last and the lowest floor of the Divine world was a dumpster that one should avoid falling into at all costs!
“Even a Great-Spirit rank will lose their Divine status if they get swept up in it! Hurry up and ask for mediation— Ahhhhk!”
Mediation, my ass!
A great power slammed down into Lee Gun. It was a power intended to crush a mere low-rank god into the dust making up the Divine world.
Pahng!!
As if he were being pressed down by powerful gravity, Lee Gun was instantly hurled toward the lowest floor.
Kwah-gwah-gwahng!
“Koo-oohk!”
Then, the dizzying sensation continued one after another. It was as if he were breaking through layers of glass walls between floors as he fell.
He was getting closer to the lowest floor, yet he was still unable to use his power.
Kwahng! Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Ahhk! We really will be sent to the waste disposal plant at this rate!”
The Divine world seemed hellbent on taking away Lee Gun’s Divine status.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
[You have been expelled from the 15th dimensional floor.]
[You have been expelled from the 16th dimensional floor.]
[You have been expelled from the 17th dimensional floor.]
Lee Gun felt as if the fierce power pressing down on him wanted him to know his place. He furrowed his brows.
[This is the 18th dimensional floor.]
[You have been expelled from the 18th—]
Kwahng!!!
“!!!”
Suddenly, Lee Gun embedded his fists into the dimensional wall and extended his arms. It seemed he was trying to slow down the speed.
Ggah-gah-gah-gah-gahk!
“H-Hyung-nim!!” Satyr’s face turned pale from fright. “It’s useless! Do you realize how much power each floor possesses?”
Even the Great Zodiacs paid money to travel between each floor for a reason. No god tried to put up a resistance against the administrators of the Divine world.
Even if some gods were spirited enough to try, they would be ripped apart before they were sent to the lowest floor. They would find their end there.
“Your body will get crippled— Ahhk!”
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhhk!!”
An enormous sound rang out. It was loud enough to rend the dimension.
Unclear how long had passed, but Satyr’s mouth had fallen open, and it remained open as the sound continued.
Lee Gun, who had been about to be expelled, came to a stop. This was accompanied by the sound of the dimensional wall being destroyed.
He had won against the power of the Divine world slamming into him! Yet, he was nonchalant. “Jeez! I thought my shoulders would be dislocated. If I popped a disk at this age, I’d have made the ones responsible pay for it.”
This wasn’t something that should end with a mere herniated disk! Satyr let out a soundless scream.
‘How sturdy is he to endure that!’
He bit his tongue.
‘Is he perhaps a diamond that became deified to become a subtype god?!’
Material god! Yes! The probability of this god being one was high. The Zodiacs probably needed a hard crystal to make their weapon, so he had probably been deified. Otherwise, this situation didn’t make any sense at all.
However, that wasn’t important right now.
Hoo-doo-doohk!
“!”
Satyr almost screamed as he watched the debris fall from the sky.
‘The boundary of this floor was destroyed!’
From the crack created by Lee Gun, the sound of a bizarre roar seeped through. Satyr felt an ominous feeling as he gulped.
‘Did something happen to the top side…?’
However, he didn’t have long to feel worried. “Kuhk! Wait a moment, Hyung-nim! Don’t grab me by the collar— Ahhhk!”
Lee Gun dragged Satyr as he jumped through the crack in the dimension.
* * *
The place Lee Gun had jumped into seemed to be connected to the ocean. It was unclear as to how long the dark ocean swept them away.
“Poo-ha!”
Lee Gun, who had been swimming until now, finally made it above the surface. At the same time, he swept his hair away in annoyance. “I’ve suffered several dozen years’ worth of hardship thanks to that idiot Taeksoo….”
“Kyahhhhk! It’s a handsome male god!”
“!!”
Lee Gun was surprised by the voices he suddenly heard. When he turned his head, he found goddesses wearing nothing but their swimsuits.
“My god! Who is this? Is he a new employee?”
“It has been a long time since we got one in a humanoid form!”
“Didn’t he just break through the dimensional wall?”
“Oh my! Really?! I’m glad I came here to play!”
Lee Gun wondered why he had to fall here of all places, but he soon found out why.
[Congratulations! The entire 18th dimensional floor is a floor of entertainment.]
[Warning! If you aren’t careful, you might spend all your Talents in one day.]
“…?!”
Was it because he had finally entered the Divine world? He heard a voice that he had missed. In reality, it was the voice of the thirteenth, his father. However, Lee Gun knew that it was the Serpent Bearer’s Seat of power speaking.
The female voices continued to speak to Lee Gun, but Lee Gun completely ignored them as he turned away from them.
“Hey. Where the hell is the exit?”
The goddesses seemed disappointed, but Lee Gun told them he was busy. He started looking for Satyr, his guide.
“I’m so happpppppy! I want to live here forever! This is paradise— Kuh-poo-hoop!”
“…”
Satyr was in the arms of a goddess. He was so happy that he looked like he was about to drown.
Lee Gun was about to say something to him when…
‘!’
Was it because he had entered the Divine world? Lee Gun slowly felt his Divine power return. He tried to sense Hugo’s energy, but his brows soon furrowed.
‘As expected, I sense nothing.’
When he was on the earth, he had tried using the Virgo Constructs to track down Hugo, but all their attempts had failed.
‘I thought I would be able to feel his energy once I reached the Divine world.’
