Hades’s divine artifact was the invisibility helmet. It probably had the power of Invisibility.
At this point, there was only one way to find Hugo. Lee Gun had to find the one who had kidnapped Hugo. However, there was a problem in trying to meet that bastard.
‘Will I be able to reach the fifth floor?’
When Lee Gun looked at the sky, he saw something resembling a red barrier. It was probably a wall that separated each floor.
While the thickness of the walls was a problem, his attempt at counterfeiting had been discovered. He would have to suffer a lot of damage if he wanted to reach that floor.
‘I have no choice. I’ll just break everything.’
He grumbled since it would be very annoying. Therefore, Lee Gun was about to turn around when he heard it.
“We are quite lucky today. Hades-nim is visiting us, yet someone that amazing is also visiting us!”
“That’s right. I heard he acquired a very rare Construct. I’ve never seen Hades-nim be so happy!”
“He brought other famous gods along with him!”
Lee Gun, who had been angry until a moment ago, slowly turned his head around. What? Who was here? His evil smirk was merely the cherry on top.

chapters.title: Chapter 329
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: I Came to Find You? (4)
What? Who was here?
It was rare to see Lee Gun’s eyes sparkle like this. In fact, it was beyond sparkling. Those eyes flashed savagely. “Hey. Give me the details. Who’s here?”
The goddesses became overjoyed when Lee Gun approached them.
“Ah! Do you mean Hades-nim?”
They didn’t want Lee Gun to leave for somewhere else, so they tripped over themselves as they tried to tell him various news.
“It’s said that he acquired a rare Construct not too long ago! I think his name was… Pushover? A banquet is being held as a celebration. That’s why he came to the eighteenth floor!”
“This event is considered a blessing to the Divine world. This is why other famous Zodiacs are here too!”
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. Right. That bastard stole someone else’s best friend, yet he was having a party?
Lee Gun was as angry as he could be, but it didn’t matter since this situation would be to his benefit. “So where do I have to go if I want to meet him? I have business with him.”
The goddesses were taken aback for some reason. They looked at him as if to check his mood.
“Ah….”
“What? What’s the problem?”
“It’s nothing. Telling you the location isn’t the problem. We just aren’t sure if you’ll be able to meet him…”
“That’s right. Unless you are an authority of Olympus, they won’t let you in.”
“It is very hard to meet a high-rank god in person…”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. He was about to say something when…
“Ah! That Construct over there will have an easy time getting in.”
“!”
The goddesses unexpectedly pointed at Satyr, who was dying of happiness.
“Aren’t you a Construct of Olympus? You’ll have an easy time getting into the banquet, right?”
“Yes. You should introduce him to Hades-nim. I’m sure he will be happy.”
“!”
Lee Gun looked at Satyr to see if this unexpected piece of information was true.
Satyr got apoplectic. “Ahhk! Fuck off! I was struck out from the divine registry of Olympus. There is no way I can introduce him!”
“Oh my! You weren’t stricken from the divine registry. You might have incurred anger from the gods for being a pervert, yet they are still looking for you.”
“Ahhhk! No! I’ll die if I meet them!”
In the first place, he had learned a piece of information about Olympus that he wasn’t supposed to. That was why he had tried to smuggle himself into the Divine world.
If his entry were to be recorded, they’d try to catch him using stupendous force.
Satyr felt an ominous feeling, so he tried to run away.
“It’s fine. You’re coming with me.”
When Lee Gun’s eyes flashed, Satyr screamed. “Ahhhk! Fuck off! Why me?”
The Satyr who had called Lee Gun Hyung-nim was nowhere to be seen. He yelled in a shrill manner, “If you want to go, you can go by yourself! Since I couldn’t use my Divine status, I pretended to surrender to you. It was a strategic move. I can use my Divine status now that I’m in the Divine world. Yes. You’re probably a subtype god. Your body is sturdy because you’re a crystal that was deified!”
“!”
Satyr jabbed the empty air as if he were daring Lee Gun to attack him. “I might have gotten on the bad side of the gods, but I am Pan. Everyone knows that name. How dare a low-rank god dare—”
Suddenly…
Koo-goo-goo-goong!
“Ahhhhk!”
The magical energy of the Serpent Bearer instantly surged forth. Unlike before, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed red when his power was released. “Do you want to follow me after a beating? Or do you want a beating before you follow me?”
“Understood!! I’ll immediately follow you even if you break my legs!!”
“It’s fine. It’ll inconvenience me if your legs are broken.”
Satyr. No, Pan started to shed tears.
* * *
The eighteenth dimensional floor was considered a lower floor, but it was called the entertainment dimension for a reason. The entire continent was a flashy city of night.
“Over there. I’m pretty sure I saw Hades-nim enter there.”
The goddesses laughed in delight as they pointed at a lake. A large cruise ship was floating on top of it.
Of course, the cruise ship looked much more advanced than the ones seen on the earth.
‘I can sense him.’
Lee Gun could feel a familiar energy within the ship. Of course, the Constructs had put up a screen using their ability to obscure who went into the ship, but Lee Gun was like a bloodhound. They couldn’t fool him.
When Lee Gun started heading toward the entrance to the ship…
“Who are you?”
Some Constructs blocked his way. Their bodies resembled that of human security guards wearing suits. However, their heads were that of a long snake.
[Divine Name: 12 Trials of Hardship]
[Divine Status: Hydra (Construct)]
[Affiliation: Master of the Land of the Dead (Hades)]
[Nemea’s Nine Twin Water Snakes]
When the information came up, Lee Gun laughed, while Pan blanched.
‘Their poison can kill gods, and they don’t die even when they are decapitated. They are Hades’ Constructs…!’
Therefore, Pan tried to run away, but Lee Gun grabbed his rucksack. Lee Gun hadn’t put any force behind it, yet Pan couldn’t move even a millimeter.
At that moment, one of the nine twins gave them a death glare.
“What business does a low-rank god have coming here?”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile as he slapped the back of Pan’s head. Pan put forth his rucksack in fright.
“Ah! This guy wants to become Hades-nim’s Construct! That is why I brought him here!”
“Construct?”
“He’s a fighting-type god! His fighting ability is quite useful, so I brought him. He is quite admirable since he brought some funds too!”
“Funds?”
When Pan opened the rucksack, the water snakes were impressed.
“Oh oh! These are all Talents!”
“He must be wealthy!”
Pan started sweating, while Lee Gun let out a bloody smirk.
‘The idiots of the Divine worlds are crazy about money. That is apparent.’
He would fully use this to his advantage. Lee Gun extended his hand. “Here. This is a tip for you guys.”
Lee Gun gave each of them a Talent. Pan shook in fear as he watched this. It was to be expected since he had seen Lee Gun put a suspicious mechanism inside the Talents.
‘There is no way they’ll fall for this. They are trying to catch him by—’
“Hmmph. You’re quick on the uptake. You will go far. Your prospects look bright.”
“Since Pan-nim brought him, his skill is assured.”
“Follow us. Master will be happy.”
Pan clutched at his hair when there was no pushback in letting them in.
‘Pick up on it! How are you this oblivious? Why?’
The Hydras were oblivious to Lee Gun’s scheme as they headed into the cruise ship. As they moved deeper into the ship, the look in Lee Gun’s eyes changed.
‘He is in there.’
He could feel Hades’ energy from the hall on the other side of the door.
‘!’
Suddenly, he could hear an odd murmur coming from the hall.
When Lee Gun quickly entered the banquet hall, the security at the door stopped him.
“Hey! How dare a low rank— Kuhk!”
“Stop saying he is low rank! He’s a guest!!”
“What?!”
The water snakes who had let Lee Gun in narrowed their eyes as they whispered to the security guards.
“He has a lot of money.”
“!”
They shrewdly aimed for Lee Gun’s pocket.
On the other hand, Lee Gun flinched when he entered the hall. A party was taking place inside, full of gods wearing luxurious dresses and divine clothes.
‘He isn’t here.’
Hades was nowhere to be found no matter how much Lee Gun looked.
Lee Gun coldly asked the twin water snakes, who had brought him inside. “Hey, where is Hades?”
“He should be here—”
“Ah! Hades-nim? Master quickly went to his star palace on the tenth floor. He got caught by his wife.”
“?!”
The water snakes were shocked.
On the other hand, Lee Gun just laughed as if he was amused. “I guess I’ll just have to head that way.”
That was preferable. The conversation would move quicker if the wife was there.
“Guide me toward the tenth floor to the star palace or whatever. You said you’ll arrange it so I can meet him.”
The water snake siblings looked at Lee Gun and spoke with serious expressions.
“We can’t.”
“What?”
“We can’t suddenly go there. It was fine here since he came here to play. However, that place is the palace of an exalted god. We cannot go there without prior consent. We can’t enter that place.”
“Yes. We need consent from Hades-nim to have a face-to-face meeting with him. This is especially true right now since he brought a rare item. It is a Construct with 600% faith. Thieves are constantly trying to steal it. Moreover, the item keeps trying to run away, so the security was heightened.”
“Since it’ll lower the value of the product, Hades-nim can’t even cut off the Construct’s legs.”
“Still, he received a lot of money upfront, so he’s able to party like this.”
“Also, that guy keeps talking about Gun daily as he desperately throws out weird paper planes outside… Who the hell is Gun?”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows twitched when he heard that. These bastards were treating Taeksoo like a product?
“Just wait a bit. Since we appreciate your sincerity, we’ll take you there in no time.”
“How long will it take?”
“It’ll take ten—”
Bbah-gahk!!!
Unable to hold it back any longer, Lee Gun sent his fists flying toward the faces of the water snakes.
Screams erupted within the banquet hall.
Lee Gun ignored that as he let out a bright smile. “You want me to wait ten months? Damn gods! You guys are too much.”
The siblings, who had yet to become bloody messes, spoke in shock.
“Look here. This is a big misunderstanding. It isn’t ten months. It is ten—”
It was about to say ten minutes.
Bbah-gahk!!!!
Lee Gun let his fist fly again as he scoffed. “What? Ten years?!!”
The last standing sibling quickly yelled out.
“N-No!! Ten—”
Bbah-gahk!!
“Ten years!!!!”
“No! It isn’t ten—!!!”
In the end, the last sibling’s face was crushed as it fell over.
“Ha. You have no scruples saying it’s ten years.”
The Hydras couldn’t even move their mouths. They felt aggrieved.
Moreover, Lee Gun didn’t plan on listening to them any further. He found a pass for the tenth floor within the pockets of the water snake siblings.
On the other hand, pandemonium broke out in the banquet hall. The reactions came from the gods who had been enjoying the party until a moment ago.
“What the hell is he?”
“Those are Hades-nim’s security guards!”
Lee Gun smiled when he heard those words. He turned his head. It was for no other reason.
“You guys are eating and drinking using the money acquired from selling my friend?” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
The Serpent Bearer Constructs felt an ominous feeling. They spoke within Lee Gun’s shadow.
[Excuse me, Master. You shouldn’t do this. A lot of important beings are here.]
“I see. They are all Hades’ friends?”
[Master???]
“Haha. I’ll make them into wet food for Yong Yong.”
[Master!!!!]
Screams rang out within the banquet hall.
“Damn it! Who the hell are you?”
“I’m the entertainer brought in by Hades! What about it?”
“What are you— Ahhhk!”
Pan shook outside the door as he heard the bizarre sound coming from the hall. What kind of being had entered the Divine world?
* * *
Around that time…
[Pantheon’s 10th Dimensional Floor]
Hades heard something bizarre after he returned to the star palace. “What? What did you just say right now?”
“Outside right now! Outside!”
“Outside, what?”
“An intruder came! He’s at the front door!”
“!”
Hades furrowed his brows. He was already busy, yet an intruder had come. “Let the outer security handle the intruder. I have no idea why you would bring this issue to me.”
“He isn’t a normal intruder. It’s a bizarre serpent god…!”
“Serpent god…?” Hades tilted his head in puzzlement for a moment. “Ah, ah.”
He finally remembered something that had slipped his mind, then burst out laughing. “I see. He came here to retrieve his Construct.”
“Master?”
“He’s a nameless low-rank ground from the frontier, yet he’s putting in the effort.” Hades laughed if he found the serpent god cute. “What shall we do about the intruder?”
“He isn’t worthy of our attention. Just leave him be.”
“Really?”
“At the end of the day, he’s a lowly god of no consequence. He wouldn’t be able to enter this place even if he wanted to.”
“Then….”
“Instead, I would like you to send a message to the important guests within the ship’s banquet hall. Give them my apology for leaving early. Tell them I had an urgent business I had to take care of. Tell them I was tied up, so I was unable to contact them myself. They can enjoy the party by themselves tonight.”
“I will do as ordered.”
Hades laughed as if he was enjoying himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 330
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: How much was he sold for? (1)
At this time, Lee Gun had swept through the banquet hall of the cruise ship. Various sounds mixed in with groans emanated from the ship.
“Shit! What the hell—”
“What the hell happened—”
It was pandemonium. Blood and expensive food were mixed and scattered across the floor. An unrecognizable but fancy table stuck out from the ceiling. Of course, the rosewood table wasn’t the only thing stuck on the ceiling.
“Koo-ooh…!”
Gods were slumped on the ground, the walls, and the ceiling. The gods, who had barely survived, were in a state of turmoil.
“Did that bastard from before do this?”
“Yes…!”
That god’s identity was unknown. For some strange reason, he didn’t use his Divine Status, a god’s base ability. Basically, he didn’t use his Achievement. It was as if he didn’t know how to use it. However, that wasn’t the problem.
“Elder!!”
“Are you ok, elder?”
When communication went dead, Constructs and fellow Zodiacs came looking for the gods that had suffered from the mishap inside the banquet hall. The newcomers to the scene were shocked at the sight of the bloodied gods.
Moreover, that crazy bastard had put important figures in the Divine world through the wall. These gods looked like old men.
“Ahhh— Elder of the Kunlun!”
“The Lion of Valhalla is…!!”
As if to make matters worse, these were very important figures within the eight great forces in the Divine world.
One was the headmaster of the Great Spirits, the great sifu of the Kunlun faction. The other one was an envoy of Valhalla, a faction where the most violent warriors gathered. Moreover, they were the only moderate faction! Therefore, not even the Great Spirits messed with them.
The identity of that bastard from earlier was unknown, but this wasn’t something trivial.
“There will be a big uproar from above!”
“My god! Who would do such a rude and terrible thing…!”
One of the gods with a bloody nose woke up. He had been flung to the ground.
“Who else…!”
“!”
The bloodied gods from all directions started getting up. They were helped back to their feet.
“He said it with his own mouth! He’s an entertainer called here by Hades!”
“Hades?”
A large commotion erupted among the gods. They realized the implication behind this move.
“This was done by Hades?”
“That’s correct.”
The light within the gods’ eyes instantly changed.
“That shitheel…”
Hades had a wide circle of acquaintances, and he had hosted this event. It was an event where they would hammer out a peace treaty.
As if to make matters worse, this gathering was full of gods who wanted a shot at getting an auction ticket to the rare Construct.
“Yes. This is a trick Hades played on us.”
“It makes sense. The fact that he wanted to sell that Construct made no sense in the first place.”
Hades didn’t need to say anything. His goals were obvious.
“Hades is probably trying to put us down for the Great Zodiac Battle.”
The gods let out evil murderous intents.
There was a reason why everyone was interested in the Construct called Pushover. Currently, the Divine world was on the brink of starting an enormous war called the Great Zodiac Battle.
In short, it was a succession war that would pick the king of the gods, as the throne remained empty.
“That’s why he hosted this party. What a rotten bastard!”
“He sent in an assassin because he wanted a leg up in the Great Zodiac Battle?”
“I’m sure of it. That entertainer received orders from Hades and carried out this scheme!”
In truth, Lee Gun’s actions had no thoughts behind them. However, it didn’t matter as the eyes of the gods flashed with anger.
“Hmmph. While we are in different factions, I would have gladly supported him.”
“He’s an ungrateful bastard.”
“No. Hades isn’t the only problem. The head of the faction that kept Hades in the fold bears responsibility.”
“You’re correct.”
The Zodiacs violently got to their feet. They looked like they were immediately about to go to war.
“Notify all the Zodiacs! We will immediately attack Hades and Olympus!”
* * *
“Oh! This is the star palace.”
A huge palace was in front of Lee Gun’s eyes. Unlike the 18th dimensional floor, the 10th floor had gray skies. It seemed that if one went higher, the sunlight reached the dimensional floors. And it stopped reaching the dimensional floors as one went lower. That was how this place was structured.
Of course, Lee Gun couldn’t exit the grounds of the palace.
[You have used the Temporary Pass to a Zodiac’s Territory.]
[Temporary Pass to a Zodiac’s Territory (Rank 4)]
– It is a pass issued to a Construct for a mission.
– Regardless of rank, it can’t be used. Possible to temporarily enter Master’s territory.
– The only restriction is that one cannot leave the territory in question.
[Available Sojourn Time: 28hrs 34mins 30 sec]
He couldn’t run away either, but he didn’t care about that. “Oh. He must make a lot of money. It’ll feel great shaking him down.”
Lee Gun laughed as he looked at the star palace. However, some beings reacted differently from Lee Gun. They were crying.
[Master!!!]
They were the Constructs hidden within Lee Gun’s shadow.
[Master! You really shouldn’t be doing this!!]
Lee Gun squinted when his subordinates cried out in despair. “What did you just say? Why are you guys complaining?”
Was he really asking because he had no idea? Lee Gun’s Constructs didn’t even want to think about what had happened on the ship earlier.
Of course, some gods were able to run away, but a majority of them had been beaten into a bloody mess. This was why Lee Gun’s Constructs spoke up.
[They were within the ship! I’m sure of it!]
The Divine world had hundreds of thousands of factions. However, the eight great forces stood at the top in terms of size and power.
[Aside from those of Olympus, other members of the eight great forces were there! Kunlun and Valhalla were there!]
[Valhalla is considered the most vicious group. You put their envoy through the ceiling…!]
What were they in comparison? The Serpent Bearer temple had only ten Constructs! The other forces ruled over tens of thousands to tens of millions of Constructs! They were already outclassed in terms of numbers.
Borrowing the power of allies in the twelve Zodiac temples was full of uncertainty. The absorbed temples were full of Constructs that lacked loyalty.
[Anyway, the news of what happened will be sent up the chain!]
[They’ll aim for Master!]
His Constructs despaired, but Lee Gun merely picked at his ear. “Who cares if they come for me or not?”
Those beings held no importance to him.
[Master?]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he grabbed the bloodied water snakes, which he had caught on the ship. He grabbed the Hydras by their necks and threw them somewhere.
Hweek!
The twin siblings were sent flying like a bullet as they flew in a straight line!
Shweek!
They crashed through the main gate of Hades’s palace.
Kwahng!!
This shocked the security guards at the palace’s main gate.
“B-Brothers!!”
A dog-headed guard couldn’t hide its shock.
“Aren’t these your younger brothers?”
“Brothers! What happened? Don’t you dare die on me! Open your eyes! My brothers!”
The water snake desperately shook its younger siblings.
“I see. You are one of the nonuplets.”
“…?!”
The water snake’s body shook when it heard a terrifying voice behind it. A bone-chilling coldness ran up its spine. And when it tried to turn its head…
Kwahng!!!
“C—Cough…!!”
The Hydra vomited blood after Lee Gun grabbed its head.
Lee Gun narrowed his red eyes. “Whatever. Hurry up and guide me.”
The dog-headed Construct let out a violent howl when he saw this from the sides.
[Divine Name: Cerberus (Construct)]
[Affiliation: Master of the Land of the Dead (Hades)]
[Hellhound]
“Bastard! How dare you enter this place! How dare you beg us to do such a thing!”
The hellhound let out a violent aura.
[Divine Achievement Release]
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. This was a power that he had never seen before. Moreover, he had an odd feeling that he shouldn’t let the Construct use this power.
As if to prove him right, his Constructs quickly yelled.
[Master! You shouldn’t fight it head-on!!]
[You can’t let it touch your body…!]
Lee Gun didn’t pay any attention to them. “A mutt should act like a mutt! Lead the way! Bitch!”
[?!]
“Sit!!!” Lee Gun brought his foot down on the hellhound’s head.
Kwahng!!
A large explosion occurred at the gate.
* * *
Some time later, Hades reached the heart of the star palace.
“What? What did you just say?” Hades couldn’t believe what he had just heard.
The steward lowered its head as it shook. “The gate was breached!”
“An unknown low-rank snake god invaded the star palace!”
Hades was dumbfounded. His guards should have been present at the gate. The vassals seemed to have sensed their owner’s discontentment. It meant this was occurring all because of their incompetence.
“Excuse me… Master—”
Slam!
When their master put down the drinking cup, the vassals flinched.
With a cold look in his eyes, Hades spoke in a low voice, “Alright. At the end of the day, that bastard has one goal.”
“!”
Hades feigned laughter as he got up. Lee Gun was aiming for him. “He’ll come my way. That’s why you guys should make preparations. We’ll give him a grand welcome..”
“!”
It didn’t matter if one was a human or a god. In front of death, everyone was equal. Moreover, this novice god couldn’t even fill his Divine status or Achievements. Hades would end that bastard’s life.
The master of the land of the dead opened his arms wide. He prepared to greet his guest.
* * *
“Hey, are you sure this is the inside of the palace?”
“Yes…! It is!”
The hellhound vomited blood as Lee Gun dragged it along with him. He had tasked it to act as a guide.
Lee Gun narrowed his eyes when he looked at his surroundings. The inside of the castle felt antique like a temple, yet it had a modern feeling to it, like something on the earth.
“Excuse me. You didn’t tell me where you want to go.” The hellhound furrowed its brows. In truth, the hellhound knew what would happen soon.
‘There is no way he can win against Master’s power.’
This was why the hellhound perspired as it asked, “I just have to lead you to Hades-nim?”
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. “No? Do you think I’m crazy? Why would I want you to guide me there?”
“What? Then where?”
“Wife!”
It took a moment for the Hellhound to buffer those words. “What?”
“Didn’t you hear me? I’m talking about Hades’s wife.”
The hellhound screamed, “What?! His wife?!”
“Yes. She’s here, right? I heard Hades was dragged here by his wife. I want you to take me to her.”
The red eyes of the snake god flashed as he let out an evil laugh.
* * *
At that moment, silence reigned within the Divine palace.
Tap! Tap!
Hades tapped his fingers against his chair as he waited. He furrowed his brows. “He’s late.”
A decent amount of time had passed since he had received news that Lee Gun had penetrated the gate. Moreover, he was with the hellhound, so there was no way he would get lost.
Hades had even sent out a reconnaissance Construct to monitor Lee Gun, yet nothing special had been reported back.
‘His target is me.’
Lee Gun had chased after him to reach this place. There was no way he would run away in fright.
‘So why isn’t he coming?’
In fact, Hades was letting out his magical energy so that Lee Gun could sense him. He was openly broadcasting his location. Since he had assumed Lee Gun would be coming here, he had covered this place with attack skills.
“Master!”
It seemed there was some news.
One of his vassals rushed toward him, pale in fright. “Something terrible happened! The god sent out on reconnaissance returned right now.! The snake god…!”
“What is it? Did he run away?”
The reconnaissance bird whom the vassal had brought screeched like there was no tomorrow. “That isn’t it. That serpent god went toward Madam!!”
What? It was rare to see Hades flustered.
Hades didn’t have time to feel shocked. He quickly tried to go to his wife.
Kwahng!!!
‘!’
However, the door to the room exploded.
“!!”
It seemed one of the reconnaissance birds had been let loose on purpose when Lee Gun had gotten close to it.
The bloodied reconnaissance bird fell to the ground in the smoke.
“I went through the trouble of coming here. Why would I leave?”
A familiar face walked through the door. Hades had seen this face through transmission before.
The red-eyed young man was laughing. “Is this what you planned on looking for?”
A familiar figure was slung over the man’s shoulder!
“…!!!!”
The man was Lee Gun, and the one slung over his shoulder like a sack of rice was Hades’s companion god.
Hades ground his teeth as he glared at Lee Gun. “Bastard…!”
Lee Gun laughed as if he had caught Hades with his hand in the cookie jar. “Whatever. Just hand over my friend. Or is he already gone because you sold him?”
“What?”
“How much did you sell him for? How much should I sell your wife for? Hmm?”

chapters.title: Chapter 331
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: How much was he sold for? (2)
Hades was truly taken aback when he heard Lee Gun’s menacing laughter. He had never expected Lee Gun to come to the Divine world looking for his friend. On top of that, Hades never imagined he would be faced with this situation.
His cold gaze headed toward the Hellhound, who was standing next to Lee Gun. The being with the Divine name of Cerberus started to whine. The dog-headed guard placed its hands over its face.
This left Hades dumbfounded. Cerberus was supposed to protect the gate, yet it had its tail between its legs. It had even brought the enemy to Hades. That wasn’t all.
Did he really bring my wife?
‘No! There is no way. That’s a fake.’
His wife wasn’t someone a low-rank god could kidnap.
However, Lee Gun let out a menacing laugh when he saw Hades’s expression. “What? Does she look like a fake?”
Hades flinched at first, but then scoffed.
‘He’s bluffing.’
Did he think Hades wouldn’t be able to recognize his wife? The god of the underworld let out a bloody smile. “Yes. If you want to sell it, you are free to do so. There is no way I’ll trade it for a 600%-faith—”
Before Hades could finish, he heard a familiar sharp voice.
“Husband!!”
“?!!”
Hades’s face crumpled. It was to be expected.
‘Shit. She’s the real deal!’
He couldn’t see her face, but the woman slung over Lee Gun’s shoulder was expressing her anger.
Hades started to sweat. The woman’s way of speaking and energy was identical to that of his wife.
It seemed the snake god had indeed pulled off a shenanigan.
Therefore, the dumbfounded Hades glared at Lee Gun. “It seems your small brain came up with the idea of kidnapping her. Did you really think you’ll be able to swap him for my wife?”
Hades was dumbfounded, but he soon nodded in acknowledgment. At the end of the day, a lowly Construct couldn’t be compared to his partner.
[Divine Name: Persephone (High-rank god)]
[Affiliation: Olympus]
He couldn’t lose Persephone’s Achievements and powers. That had to be prevented at all costs. It was why he had caused Persephone’s death so that she could be passed on to him. He had done so to possess her.
Hades’s eyebrows climbed. “Oh, snake god. I understand your resolve now. I will return your friend. That’s why you should give me back my precious wife—”
“What nonsense are you talking about?”
“What?”
“Taeksoo is Taeksoo! Your wife is your wife! These are two separate matters, idiot!!”
“???”
Hades’s eyes turned round. For a moment, he couldn’t understand what Lee Gun was saying. “What did you just say?”
Lee Gun tapped his finger on his head as if to ask whether Hades was lacking understanding. “Of course, you have to hand over my friend. Your wife will be sold at a high price, and I’ll use the money as a deposit! Do you understand now?”
“What?!!”
“I went into debt because I made some counterfeit money! I need a lot of money to repay the debt! Ha ha ha ha!”
Hades was dumbfounded. “You messed up, so why—!!!”
Hades was about to shout something else when he suddenly held his breath. He realized his opponent wasn’t someone who could be reasoned with.
Moreover, Lee Gun had made a mistake from the beginning when he decided to kidnap Hades’s wife. Persephone was a high-rank god. She had an invincible power that would allow her to get out of this situation.
Therefore, Hades was patient as he waited.
‘My wife is looking for an opening.’
When she would use her power, he would use the opportunity to take her back. So Hades kept staring at the goddess slung over Lee Gun’s shoulder.
One second. Two seconds. Ten seconds. One minute.
“…”
Nothing happened.
His wife was still held over Lee Gun’s shoulder like a sack of rice.
Having run out of patience, Hades yelled, “Partner! What are you doing? Hurry up and use that skill!”
However, Persephone didn’t answer him. Hades’s eyebrows rose at the silence.
‘He must have done something to her.’
Hades had no idea which Divine Status Lee Gun possessed, but it was probably a binding type skill. That made sense for a snake god. It was like how he was able to hide his energy.
In the end, Hades shouted, “I’ll lend you my power! Use your escape ability (Advent of Sprint)! If you use that power…!”
Despite those words, the silence continued.
Hades felt something was off, so he asked, “My partner, are you not using your ability on purpose?”
“Kyahhhk. Please kidnap me, Snake god!”
“??!”
Persephone had never planned on going to Hades in the first place.
Hades was flabbergasted. “You bastard! What did you do to my partner?”
“I did a bit of this and a bit of that?”
“?!”
Hades’s expression was a sight to behold.
Lee Gun merely snorted. In truth, he had merely shaken hands with Persephone when he had met her. From the way she spoke, it had become clear to him that she hated Hades. However, he didn’t care about their backstory.
“If I hand over your house dog and water snakes to the auction house, I’ll be able to make a lot of money!! Ha ha ha ha!” Lee Gun was practically daring Hades to attack. He used Persephone as a shield as he rushed toward Hades.
Hades’s eyes flashed. “How dare a psychotic low-rank god do this!”
When he made a hand gesture, water surged forth from the floor.
[Land of the Dead’s Five Bifurcated River]
[River of Wailing (Cocytus) (3rd)]
Water rapidly filled the palace.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!
“Look at your tragic past to shed tears!!”
‘Oh my! This would allow me to clear my eyes.’
Lee Gun was thankful. When he was about to move his hand…
Pah-ahng!
“!”
Lee Gun emanated a mysterious light.
This light surprised Hades. It was a barrier. Hades’s surprise grew even more when he realized who was the culprit. He turned his head.
“Persephone!!”
Pretending to be unconscious, Persephone feigned ignorance.
In the end, Hades summoned a different water.
[Lake of Fire (Phlegethon)]
“I’ll burn even your soul! Die!”
In a flash, the water turned into fire.
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. Fire? Did he need to show off his Super Regeneration here?
Before he could do that, however, another light surged forth at that moment!
Pahng!
“Persephone!!”
Persephone pretended to be unconscious. She acted as if she hadn’t heard anything.
Hades’s eyes turned savage as he gnashed his teeth.
“Ferryman!” When he shouted, a man wearing a hood appeared on the floor.
[Divine Name: Charon (Construct)]
[Affiliation: Master of Land of the Dead (Hades)]
[Ferryman that guides souls through the path of death]
A creepy man turned into fog as he instantly disappeared. At the same time, a green light appeared beneath Lee Gun’s feet.
[Master!]
[Boo-oh!]
They were Lee Gun’s Constructs, who had been unable to come out because they were sealed. Two of them were summoned.
One was the god of battle, Frost Giant Jotunn (Meeny). The other was the fat Pixiu (Piggy Bank).
[Currently, you are limited to summoning to Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
[Your rank is too low.]
[There are restrictions.]
Two were enough. Miny froze the Ferryman, who had turned into fog. Then Pixiu immediately sucked in the frozen Ferryman.
“Ferryman!”
“I’m sorry….”
Having been dismantled in an instant, the Ferryman disappeared. However, it had accomplished something. The Ferryman had carried out its mission before it disappeared.
“!”
[Master!]
Persephone, who had been draped around Lee Gun’s shoulder, was gone. She appeared on the chair that Hades had been sitting in! It was a prison shaped like a chair, and Persephone was unable to break away from the chair.
Hades laughed out loud. “I got my wife back. I don’t need to worry now. I’ll get rid of all of you!” He immediately tried to get rid of Lee Gun.
“Hey, are you sure you really recovered her?”
“!”
Lee Gun mockingly laughed.
Hades flinched. At that moment, his Constructs shouted in fright.
“Master! Mistress is…!”
“She’s gone!”
Persephone was gone. Of course, she hadn’t moved on her own.
When she sat on the chair of the underworld, its restraint ability had been activated.
“Mistress’s energy has vanished from the Divine world!”
“She was kidnapped!”
“?!”
Hades couldn’t sense his wife’s energy. He shook. It was almost as if she had ceased to exist. Hades’s mind was reeling as he glared at Lee Gun. “What did you do to her?”
Lee Gun scoffed. “What nonsense are you talking about? You’re the one who took her.”
Lee Gun smirked. Naturally, he had a guess as to what happened.
“Boo-boo-oh…?!”
For some reason, Pixiu suddenly let out a cold sweat.
Lee Gun suddenly unsummoned Pixiu and Miny!
[An object is struggling with Piggy Bank’s (Pixiu) stomach. Pixiu is in great pain.]
[Its stomach feels like bursting.]
[It has fainted.]
Of course, Pixiu was a low-rank Construct.
Lee Gun wondered how Pixiu was able to secretly kidnap a high-rank god in Persephone. However, that question could be answered later.
“You’re dead.”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as powerful magical energy exploded forth.
Boom!!!
“!!!”
Accompanying his red eyes, the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer surged forward.
Hades reflexively felt fear toward that power.
‘This power is…’
It was the power of a common low-rank god.
Shocked, Hades tried to use his power, but Lee Gun was faster.
Bbah-gahk!!!
Lee Gun’s fist landed on Hades’s face.
“Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun’s offensive ability was significant. Moreover, he possessed overwhelming physical attributes symbolic of fighting-type gods!
When Hades unexpectedly took a beating, his mind felt dizzy. The being in front of him might now be a low-rank god, but something was off. A simple punch shouldn’t possess this much power.
“You bastard! What are you holding in your fists?”
“Ah. This? It is what you guys hate the most.”
Bbah-gahk!!!
Hades clutched at his stomach.
“Kuh-huhk…!”
The blow was followed by an uppercut, and Hades almost lost consciousness when the attack connected. He had no idea what Lee Gun was using, but he would be in danger if this continued.
‘Shit. I never wanted to use this power against him.’
However, he had no choice right now. Hades glared at Lee Gun. “The master of the floor is informing the Divine world.”
The Constructs within the star palace reacted in shock when they heard Hades’s mumbling.
“M-Master?!! You shouldn’t do it!”
“That’ll benefit only that snake god…!”
“Please expel the enemy that threatens this Dimensional floor!”
“Ahhk! Master!”
A strange light appeared underneath Lee Gun’s feet. Lee Gun’s eyes turned round. The next second, Lee Gun disappeared.
The Constructs looked horrified as they looked at their master.
“You used the right given to the owner of the Dimensional floor!”
“Shut up! I had no choice if I wanted to expel him!”
Hades was the owner of the tenth Dimensional floor. He glared as blood ran freely from his face. He had just used an ability of the Divine world, which only the owners of the Dimensional floors could use.
Expulsion! It was a deal made with the Divine world, and the Divine world loved money. Therefore, this ability consumed a massive number of Talents.
Above all else, the god’s achievement was recorded in the Divine Records. When a god etched a special record, the god became stronger.
“You are declaring to everyone that he’s a dangerous foe. He’s dangerous enough for the owner of a Dimensional floor to request his expulsion!”
“A record like that would be beneficial to….”
Hades groaned. “Just follow me if you plan on talking such nonsense. He had a pass, so he might come back here. We have to move.”
“!”
“He isn’t normal. We’ll go to Olympus and ask for help. I can also ask for help from the gods at the party.”
When Lee Gun had come looking for his Construct, Hades had thought Lee Gun had a trick up his sleeve.
‘He has a bizarre tool that can be used against the gods.’
“However, he can’t go against the gods of the eight great forces relying on a tool…”
At that moment…
Pah-jeek!
“…!!!”
The skin of the region that Lee Gun had struck started to disintegrate. It caused Hades to gulp. The god of death felt the fear of death.
‘Is it not the power of a tool…?’
Therefore, he said, “We have to hurry.”
“What?”
He intoned his next words without realizing it. “I have to run away to a place where he can’t chase after me!”
Hades would go to a place where all the gods would be aligned with him if he gave the order! He would go to a place where no one could enter! Fear gripped him as he quickly headed toward Olympus.
* * *
Around that time…
“This is bad! Valhalla sent a declaration of war. They say they’ll destroy Olympus!”
“Kunlun sent the same message!”
Olympus was turned on its head because some factions of gods had suddenly declared war against them.
“No! Hades-nim isn’t someone who would do such a thing!”
“You’re misinformed! Assassination! We would never….”
Suddenly, Olympus had become isolated, and it was totally a mess within.
“Where is Hades? The Great Zodiac is angry!”
“Who is this entertainer?”
Only one being there knew who the entertainer was.
“What’s wrong, Sagittarius?”
“Your complexion has been pale since a while ago. Why are you…”
It was none other than the Zodiac of the Sagittarius temple.
“Ah. It’s nothing.”
Damn it! It couldn’t be. There was no way, right? It couldn’t be him, right??
* * *
[You have been chased out through the Dimensional floor owner’s authority.]
[This is the 18th Dimensional floor.]
[Your opponent has run away to Olympus.]
[Currently, Olympus is under the threat of war.]
[You cannot go to Olympus unless a famous high-rank god allows it.]
[The record of you being a threat to the 10th floor has been recorded.]
[The record in question has manifested a Divine skill.]
Lee Gun laughed in anger when he heard the voice. Of course, he knew such a thing could happen. Still, he was a bit angry when things turned out like this.
‘Taeksoo isn’t on the 10th floor.’
Finding him wouldn’t be too hard since he had Persephone.
[Piggy Bank’s (Pixiu) stomach has burst open. Piggy Bank is unconscious. You cannot summon it.]
[Remaining Time: 17hrs 38 min 21 sec]
There was no way he would wait 17 hours. Moreover, Hades hadn’t run away to somewhere weird like the nether world or the world of torture. It was advantageous for Lee Gun that Hades had run away to Olympus.
Hades had probably run to Olympus since he trusted the gods over there.
‘If it’s Olympus, that bastard should be there too.’
It was unclear as to whether he was dodging Lee Gun. All communication with him had ended after Lee Gun had entered the Divine world, but that didn’t bother Lee Gun.
‘If he refuses to come out, I’ll root him out.’
Lee Gun smirked.

chapters.title: Chapter 332
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: What’s your relationship? (1)
“Ahhhhhk!!!!” Pan let out a horrible shriek, as if he had seen the face of a horrible monster.
“As expected. I knew you would be here.” Lee Gun had appeared in front of Pan.
Lee Gun let out an evil smile. He looked at Pan as though he had seen a good friend.
However, Pan’s reaction was entirely different. “Ahhhk! Why are you here?! I thought you went to the 10th floor to become Hades-nim’s Construct!”
Construct, my ass!
“I was chased out of there through the Dimensional floor master’s power.”
Pan clutched at his head when he saw the bright smile. “What did you do that you were chased out with that power?”
Him being chased out by the Dimensional floor master’s power meant the Expulsion skill has been used.
Each Dimensional floor from one to twenty had an owner. These beings were the masters and rulers that managed each Dimensional floor.
Normally, the most powerful gods took these seats. Moreover, the Divine world transferred the power of the administrators to them. These were seats that came with great advantages and authority.
One of those authorities was the power of Expulsion. It didn’t matter what rank the opponent was. A Dimensional floor owner could expel anyone. However, they didn’t use this power lightly.
‘It leaves behind a record.’
It was a useful power, but it was also proof that one couldn’t subdue one’s opponent with one’s power.
Anyway, that was the situation right now.
Pan had been playing with the goddesses of the eighteenth floor as soon as Lee Gun had left for the 10th floor. He froze.
‘I thought I would never see him again.’
Unlike him, the goddesses let out happy smiles as they ran toward Lee Gun.
“Kyaaaa!! That person came back again!”
“We thought we would never see you again!”
Pan had already been discarded by the goddesses a while back. They looked over Lee Gun’s body with worries.
“Have you heard? The party on the ship that we told you about got wrecked!”
“Some ruffian called himself an entertainer and caused a big mess…!”
“Unfortunately, Valhalla’s envoy and Kunlun’s great sifu were there…!”
“It wasn’t just the two of them. Anyway, we were worried. We thought you unnecessarily got swept up in the mess.”
The goddesses looked relieved, and they started gossiping with serious expressions.
“So, who’s the entertainer?”
“According to first-hand accounts, he is a monster.”
“Oh my! Is it a monster god like the Kraken?”
“Did you perhaps see his face? He seems to be a very dangerous god.”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “I have no idea. It was pandemonium inside. I ran away because I was scared.”
“That’s right. Safety is the best option.”
The goddesses were pleased as they screamed.
On the other hand, Pan, who was being stepped on by the goddesses, became sure of something.
‘He did it!’
All the gods called to the ship were important figures invited by Hades. Not even the Great Spirits dared to mess with these gods. Everyone wondered which psycho had messed with them! And that was why Pan was sure it was Lee Gun.
‘I was fucked the moment I got involved with him!’
When that thought brushed his mind, Pan quickly crawled between the goddesses’ legs to get out. He didn’t want to get involved with that bastard. The best solution was to run away.
Kwah-jeek!
“Hey, Olympus god. Aren’t you going to show me your house?”
Pan cried when he was caught by Lee Gun once again.
* * *
“I just have to contact them here?”
“Yes….”
Pan brought Lee Gun to a highrise building. The building in question was located on a busy street.
[Connector Building]
Each floor of the Divine world was larger than the earth. This was why countless gods were gathered there.
However, maintaining communication across floors was difficult, unless one had special privileges like the Great Spirits.
This was why the Multidimensional Connector Building existed. It was a place where one could leave messages and items to gods they didn’t know the address of. One could contact them.
Pan took Lee Gun into one of the many public phone booths. Before pressing the numbers on the touchpad, he questioned Lee Gun with a stricken face. “Are you really looking for an Olympus Zodiac? Are you sure this person is there?”
“Did you not hear what I said?”
Pan looked like he wanted to die. “Olympus is one of the top floors! It’s where the Great Spirits reside! There is no way they’ll accept a request for an audience…”
“I don’t care. Did you really think I was looking for a high-rank god?”
Pan truly felt relieved to hear that. He grabbed Lee Gun’s shoulder. “Man! Great! That’s good to hear! Who do you want me to contact? Do you have a friend in Olympus? Is it a Construct of a Zodiac—”
“Sagittarius.”
“Ah-ha! I was wondering who it was. Sagi—”
Sagi—
Sagi—
“Saaaaaaagitarius?! Are you talking about the owner of the Sun?”
“Uh! Apollo. He pretends to be handsome, but he is impot—”
“Ahhhhk! He’s one of the high-rank gods!!! Have you lost your mind? If you want to die, you can die on your own!” Pan screamed as he grabbed Lee Gun’s shoulders. “You want to meet such a scary person! You said you won’t be meeting a high-rank god!!! You liar!”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose as if to say he hadn’t told a lie. “How is he a high-rank god?”
Pan screamed once again, “He’s a very high-rank god! Amongst the tens of millions of gods, he’s ranked in the top 150!!! He’s a big deal!!!”
He had power! He had the status!
“While they were destroyed, he was one of the twelve Zodiacs— Kuh-huhk!!”
“I don’t care about that. Just hurry up and contact him.”
After being hit by Lee Gun, Pan cried as he pressed the button on the touchpad. “Olympus, third floor. Please connect me to the palace of the Sun.”
Something surprising happened. A fancy fairy appeared on top of the touchpad as a hologram. It asked for confirmation from Lee Gun and Pan.
[Is this your first meeting with him? What should I say your name is?]
“He’ll know if he sees my face. Tell him that.”
[Understood. I will attempt to request a face-to-face meeting with the owner of the Sun.]
Some time passed.
[The Sun palace has refused your call.]
[Have a nice day.]
“!”
At that moment, Lee Gun’s eyebrows twitched. He wondered if something went wrong, so he attempted to contact Sagittarius again.
[I’m sorry!. The person has refused.]
[He says he doesn’t know you.]
Lee Gun got angry. Is this how it was going to be?
Pan looked at Lee Gun, wondering if he and the high-rank god really knew each other.
Lee Gun smirked. He angrily pressed the button and said, “Hey, you want to die? Come out before I spread your secrets.”
[The sun god says he has no secrets. Your request has been denied—]
“Your hair is a wi—”
[You are connected to him.]
[He allows your entrance into Olympus.]
[There are no conditions.]
[Please come to the sun palace.]
Pan was shocked when a VIP pass was summoned. “This makes no sense!! Why would someone of that caliber do this!!”
Why this guy?! The shocked Pan looked at Lee Gun.
Lee Gun merely snorted. “That maggot. I should get rid of all his hair roots too.”
* * *
Pantheon!
The Divine world was made of twenty floors. The third floor was a space occupied by the highest-rank gods.
Olympus was located in a region that low-rank gods could never climb. This was why it was almost unbelievable that Lee Gun could reach this place. After all, his rank was still unconfirmed. However, that was a moot point.
“Does that bastard really want to die?” Lee Gun was angry. It was to be expected. “He decided the location of the meeting, yet he isn’t here? Huh?”
Yes, Lee Gun was supposed to meet Sagittarius at an appointed location. That location was a cafe run by Olympus.
Sagittarius had summoned a pass in secret, so them meeting inside Olympus would punt him in a bind. This was why they scheduled a meeting outside.
Lee Gun had come to the location where Sagittarius wanted to meet him, yet Sagittarius was nowhere to be found. Lee Gun called for the employee just in case.
[What? Why would a member like that come here?]
[If he comes here, the Constructs would have immediately noticed. That is beside the point. Do you want to work here?]
[You have the looks.]
Bbah-jeek.
Sparks flew in Lee Gun’s eyes when he realized he had been stood up. “In this situation, that baldie sent someone to interview me for a part-time job?!”
It was a misunderstanding, but Lee Gun shot to the employee’s face. “Is this how he wants to do it?”
At least, tens of millions of gods resided on each floor! It was like looking for a Mr. Kim in Seoul,[1] but finding Sagittarius wouldn’t be too hard.
Kwahng!!
“Hurry up and come out, baldie!”
If he couldn’t find Sagittarius, he’d have to make Sagittarius come to him!
Lee Gun went to the plaza and destroyed a statue. Since this place was ruled by the forces of Olympus, the sculptures of the famous gods of Olympus were placed there.
Lee Gun ruthlessly decapitated the sun god statue, making everyone in the plaza scream.
“W-What is that low-rank god doing?”
“He dared to decapitate the great sun god!”
“He deserves divine punishment for such an act!!!”
“Oh, Sagittarius!”
The gods were shocked as they looked for the guards.
Lee Gun had assumed that if he destroyed the sculpture, he would be arrested. Unexpectedly, someone of high stature made an appearance.
Flash!
A door made of light appeared in the sky, and an army poured out of it.
“How dare you do that to a god of Olympus!”
“We are already busy right now…”
“Are you there!”
“?!”
Lee Gun tossed aside the soldiers that appeared from the gate and entered the space where they had exited from.
The tossed-aside soldiers were shocked.
“Ahhhk! You crazy bastard! How dare a ruffian enter Olympus!”
“Get him!!!”
On the other side of the gate lay a beautiful palace.
[Warning! You have entered the territory of Olympus (Highest Risk).]
[It is full of high-rank gods.]
[Currently, the Serpent Bearer is ranked in the lowest group.]
[You will immediately be killed if you are caught. You should quietly hide—]
Lee Gun kicked the Constructs rushing toward him as if he were telling them to fuck off.
Bbah-gahk!! Bbah-gahk!
Now that he was able to enter this place, it didn’t matter.
“Where is that lolicon bastard?”
Lee Gun looked for Hades first. He searched any place that looked suspicious and broke everything in his path.
A voice desperately spoke to Lee Gun.
[Warning!! Gods have karma.]
[When you incur grudges from the gods of the Divine world, they can transfer it to you as karma!!]
[There is a penalty for rampaging too much through the high-rank territory!]
[If you get sued, your karma will mount, and you won’t be able to use your power!]
The voice desperately tried to stop Lee Gun, but Lee Gun surprisingly didn’t receive any karmic debt. There was a reason for it.
“Ahhk! Valhalla has invaded this far!”
“Insolent fools! Oh, Divine world! Consume our Talents! Send a massive karmic debt to Valhalla!”
The gods seemed to think that the invaders had destroyed the buildings instead of Lee Gun.
“You guys are the ones who broke the rules first and attacked us!”
“You guys declared war on us first! You sent that assassin called the entertainer to the banquet hall!”
“Damn it! Where the hell is Hades?”
Pandemonium descended within Olympus.
Of course, Lee Gun almost crossed paths with the enemies several times, but…
“Kuh-huhk!”
Some unknown force took care of the enemies for him. In fact, some enemies were sent to a different location right before Lee Gun crossed paths with them.
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. What the hell was this?
‘Then there is the fact that Persephone was stolen away by someone.’
This was odd. Who was it? In the end, that didn’t matter.
Pah-ba-bahk!
A harpoon pierced the path before Lee Gun.
“You’re the one that the master of the sun spoke about?”
“I heard a snake snuck into the town.”
“!”
To catch Lee Gun, the Constructs surrounded him.
[Warning! They are all Zodiac-rank Constructs.]
[All their Divine status is high.]
Lee Gun even saw a familiar face.
“Oh, Serpent Bearer…”
They were the crows who were the Constructs of the Sagittarius temple. They were the ones who Hugo summoned most often and used.
The Constructs who had come to capture Lee Gun sighed as they approached him.
“Oh, nameless low-rank god. We heard the story from the owner of the sun.”
“You must have gone through a lot.”
Lee Gun sighed as he laughed. “Finally, we are getting somewhere…”
“You caused a revolt because you didn’t receive your salary.”
“Olympus will take care of your debt, so head back— Kuh-huhk!!!”
Bbah-gahk!!!
The enraged Lee Gun let his fist fly toward the gods. “Lost wage, my ass!”
The crow Constructs couldn’t hide their disappointment. They knew things would turn out like this, so why were they told to do this?
“Hey, what are you doing hiding over there?”
“?!”
The Constructs flinched at Lee Gun’s cold words.
Lee Gun instantly disappeared when he discovered someone above the tree of the luscious garden.
Bbah-gahk!!!
He sent his fist flying toward someone watching him from the top of the tree.
A golden-haired man fell from the tree.
The Olympus Constructs were shocked, but Lee Gun ignored them. He grabbed the man by the neck.
The Constructs turned pale from fright. This was a god ranked in the top echelon!
“Sagittarius!”
“Apollo-nim!”
Both the high-rank and the low-rank gods were shocked when they saw Sagittarius taking a beating.
The Constructs quickly summoned their weapons, but the bloodied Sagittarius stopped them. “It’s fine. We know each other.”
The Constructs were taken aback.
“What kind of relationship—”
This was the first time they were meeting in person. Sagittarius rolled his eyes as if he was reading Lee Gun’s mood. “…uh. That is… N-Nephew?”
Lee Gun raised his fist in anger. “You dare place all those unspeakable curses on your nephew?”
“It isn’t like that!”
Lee Gun let his fists fly.
1. “Looking for a Mr. Kim in Seoul” means ‘finding a needle in a haystack’ in English as Kim is one of the most popular family names in Korea. ☜

chapters.title: Chapter 333
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: What’s your relationship? (2)
“I have to do unnecessary things like this because of that lowly god from the boonies.” The displeased Hades headed toward the heart of the tenth Dimensional floor.
Thanks to Lee Gun, he was coming back from the hospital. It didn’t come naturally to him.
‘What kind of power did that bumpkin bring from the earth?’
Hades clutched at his stomach, where Lee Gun had attacked. The god of the underworld had used quick judgment to expel Lee Gun, so the damage was superficial. However, this didn’t change that he felt crappy. Moreover, Hades’s expenses had increased for no reason thanks to him!
‘How much did they charge for a small wound like this?’
He had to get it fixed, so he had gone to a hospital. However, this wound didn’t fall under his medical insurance. Therefore, the hospital requested an absurd amount of money.
‘These bastards from the Divine world only care about money.’
Since his medical insurance hadn’t kicked in, the hospital of the Divine world was unimaginably expensive.
This was the reason Valhalla was in deep debt; they constantly went to war as they gathered warriors. The hospital fees exceeded the money they got from the spoils of war. They were always in the minus.
Olympus made their money through commerce instead of wars for a reason. They conquered all kinds of dimensions and colonized them. It led to these dimensions generating money for them.
Of course, Olympus used to have a legendary healing Divine status called Asclepius, and every god had tried to steal it. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Open the door to Olympus!”
“Huhk. Hades-nim?”
“It’s the master of a Dimensional floor!”
At the heart of each floor was an enormous Divine world elevator that passed from the first to the twentieth floor.
Hades had arrived at the elevator to be transported, and his eyes held anger.
“Hurry up and move. I want to go to the third floor!”
“Yes!”
Hades ground his teeth as he grabbed his sore stomach.
‘I won’t forgive that snake god.’
If the Olympus Zodiacs heard of his plight, they would surely help him. This was also probably true for Kunlun and Valhalla, who had been present on the ship.
‘I spent the deposit to show them enormous goodwill.’
He had such thoughts as he reached the third floor and arrived in Olympus.
‘He’s a snake god with no backing. Killing him won’t be too hard…’
However, Hades’s expression crumpled as soon as the elevator door opened.
“Exterminate Olympus!!”
“Peace treat, my ass!”
“You guys are crooked and dirty!”
“…?????”
Hades’s eyes turned round.
This should be a place where the warm sunlight enveloped the city in a cozy manner. In the beautiful sky, airships of all kinds flew through the sky. The white skyscrapers always looked beautiful and elegant…
Elegant…
Kwa-gwa-gwa-gwahng!!!
“Kill them!! Kill all the Olympus bastards!”
“??????????”
Giants were throwing stones, and Taoist hermits were letting lightning fly. The white skyscrapers had turned into a battlefield.
Hades became more dumbfounded when he learned who had caused all of this.
“Where is Hades? We know you guys are hiding that bastard!”
“What nonsense are you spouting? We’re looking for Hades too!”
“Where the hell did that bastard run away after causing this mess?”
“Just shut up and send us Hades! We’ll decapitate him!”
“…???”
Hades’s expression was a sight to behold. “That’s Kunlun and Valhalla!”
He had given an enormous amount of time and effort to bring them over to his side. So why were they acting this way? However, that wasn’t important right now.
The Zodiacs of Olympus were about to mount an offensive against Kunlun and Valhalla. It made Hades desperate.
“Stop! Who are you guys attacking? They are guests!”
When the voice rang out, the Zodiacs of Olympus and the intruders all came to a sudden stop.
“Why are you guys fighting? Sheathe your swords right now…”
At that moment…
“Motherf—!!”
“What the hell did you say, you @#*%?”
They directed their Divine artifacts toward Hades. A strike from a Divine artifact could destroy a god’s soul, so Hades had no choice but to run away.
“Why are the honored guests suddenly acting this way?”
Hades soon realized the cause of this crazy situation.
“They said they were attacked on the ship by an entertainer hired by Hades-nim!”
“That entertainer said he was carrying out Hades-nim’s request!”
Hades was baffled by his Constructs’ explanation. “Entertainer? I never hired one…”
However, it didn’t take long for Hades to bite his tongue.
“He was tall and possessed commanding red eyes. He’s said to be a fighting-type god!”
“!”
“He was a humanoid low-rank god who smelled a lot like a human… When we inquired about him at the documentation center, only one god fit that description. His name is ‘None of your business’….”
Hades grabbed the back of his neck. It was that bastard!! He had wondered where the snake bastard had wormed himself into the tenth floor from. It was from the ship?!
The warriors of Valhalla didn’t care. They wore their divine armor as they extended their swords.
“You will dearly pay for insulting us!!”
Hades almost cussed. “Idiots! He wasn’t sent by me— Kuh-huhk!”
Just being grazed by the divine spear could kill a god. It let out a sharp roar.
In the end, Hades yelled, “Alright. I’ll take responsibility for everything!!”
“!”
Things had spiraled out of control. He had to get a handle on this at all costs.
‘I just have to make sure the Great Spirits do not hear about this.’
The Great Spirits were the great pillars that supported each force. Of course, Olympus had one too.
‘I just have to catch that snake bastard before he reaches Olympus.’
The snake bastard’s target was him. He was the one who had created this situation. While the party on the ship could be dismissed, the Great Spirit won’t hold back if the snake god crawled into Olympus.
When that thought reached his mind, Hades immediately summoned his strongest Constructs, the dog-headed Constructs.
“I have a lead on that snake.” Hades took out a small glass bottle that he had secretly stolen from Lee Gun. “I’m glad I stole it as a contingency. I want you to track him down and make sure he never dreams about coming to Olympus.”
The Constructs took a sniff of the item.
“Ah!.”
“Did you find him?” Hades smirked as he immediately got ready to send his Constructs away. “Where is he? Is he on the eighteenth floor? Or did he already get booted by the Divine world to the twentieth floor?”
The dog-headed Constructs sweated.
“That is…”
“What is it?”
“O-Olympus….”
“What?”
“It says he’s already in Olympus!”
“…????”
Hades’s expression was a sight to behold.
How did he get here?
* * *
Lee Gun had been able to enter Olympus thanks to a mole(?). His eyebrows rose because of the man before him.
It was a blonde man in his late twenties. He had worn a white sleeveless tunic emblematic of the Olympus faction. This was Sagittarius, the Zodiac of the Sagittarius temple.
Lee Gun was currently in his private residence, and in the distance, servants wearing maid outfits were observing him. They were murmuring quite loudly.
“Who is he?”
“Isn’t he a low-rank god??”
“How can he get a direct meeting with one of the pillars of Olympus?”
On the other hand, Sagittarius looked at Lee Gun with a stiff face. “Mmm… That is… N-Nephew?”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun raised his fist.
When he saw Lee Gun’s savage expression, Sagittarius immediately changed his words. “S…Serpent Bearer.”
“What?”
Sagittarius was afraid of being hit by Lee Gun, but he lifted his finger to point behind Lee Gun. “Can you stop that?”
Pandemonium had broken out behind Lee Gun.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
A slime was going crazy and was vandalizing the surroundings.
Lee Gun had smuggled Clump of Creation Clay by putting it in a glass bottle. Of course, he couldn’t take out his items before he entered the Divine world. After he arrived here, he had received a penalty because of the counterfeit currency penalty. He couldn’t use any of his items.
[You have no reference. You cannot participate in any economic activity.]
[You are banned from fighting.]
[You cannot use any fighting skills and items.]
In other words, he had been deemed a criminal. He was prohibited from using public facilities, his bank account, and personal wealth. That was why Sagittarius had used his authority to release the restriction.
[Sagittarius has requested the Divine world for a temporary vouch for his character.]
[Item use restriction has been released.]
However, as soon as it was released, Lime started to destroy Sagittarius’s private residence.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
It destroyed the walls. The expensive furniture was eaten as if a rat had eaten them. Everything was a mess.
“Serpent Bearer! Stop that slime!”
Lee Gun sat on the sofa, sighing in annoyance. “Lime. You shouldn’t do that.”
“Oh. As expected…! Thank you—”
“It’s too weak. I want you to make it unrecoverable.”
Sagittarius screamed at his words. Lime turned into the Lee Gun of twenty years ago as it destroyed everything.
The Constructs turned pale from fright when they saw this.
‘A psycho appeared.’
Sagittarius was aggrieved as he lost all his belongings. “I kept you hidden until now. Doesn’t that mean…”
Lee Gun let out his murderous intent. He looked at Sagittarius as if to ask whether the Zodiac wanted to die.
“In the first place, why are you here?”
“!”
“Your Zodiac Saint was sold off, so why are you doing nothing here? That lolicon bastard is keeping Taeksoo imprisoned, yet you stood back and watched?” Lee Gun gave him a death glare as he raised his fists again.
Sagittarius started to sweat.
“It seems you’re part of the Olympus faction, like Hades. Are you sulking because Taeksoo is part of the Serpent Bearer temple? Is that why you ignored him?”
“No! I have a good reason for doing this!”
“What is it?”
Sagittarius wasn’t acting dignified at all as the elder uncle. However, he was in an awkward position.
He had naturally thought about retrieving Hugo, but he couldn’t enter Hades’s territory. They were enemies. Moreover, it was said that Hades had paid a fair price to have Hugo transferred to the netherworld.
If Sagittarius stepped forward, it was immediate grounds for war.
‘Also, Hades has the registry for my subordinates.’
If Sagittarius moved, Hades would take the lives away of every Construct under Sagittarius.
“He’s a nasty piece of work. He killed his adoptive father to steal his Divine status. He even acquired Persephone through inheritance.”
“Inheritance?”
“The gods of the Divine world can be grouped into three large categories.”
The first was Inheritance—in other words, reincarnation in conjunction with killing the previous god. The killer god would inherit the Divine status, and the god would be reborn into the seat.
Basically, their personality and memories were completely different. However, their powers and Constructs were seamlessly handed over. This was why the god could use its power after being born. Hence, this was the most commonly used method in battle. It created a pure-blooded god.
The second one was Transfer. In other words, a god died a natural death or voluntarily handed over the Divine status.
When the twelve Zodiacs had stolen the power of the original owners and when Lee Gun had stolen the Zodiac’s powers, both fell into these categories.
The only downside was that it wasn’t one’s original power. This was why digesting it took time. Moreover, one could also fail to acquire the power, depending on one’s talent and inclination.
The third way was a Newborn God. A child was born between two gods, or a spirit, item, or a human was deified. The details didn’t matter. A new god was born. The downside would be that the god had to start from the lowest ranks.
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Hades kidnapping Hugo has to do with the seat of the Great Spirit.”
“Great Spirit?”
Sagittarius extended his finger to draw stars in the air. It was a star with nine points, a nonogram where three triangles overlapped onto each other.
“This is the Divine world. Each point is controlled by the eight great forces. Currently, we are located in the 12 o’clock direction.”
It was where the Olympus faction lived.
Lee Gun had a rough understanding.
‘When I used the pass, it said district A.’
The Divine world was probably made out of nine worlds, and they each possessed floors numbered from 1 to 20.
The center was where all of them were connected. In reality, each district was connected in five-floor increments.
“Anyway, there is a contest for the seat of the Great Spirit. The gods are fighting each other for this important seat.”
“What does that have to do with Taeksoo?”
Lee Gun raised his fist as if to say “don’t speak in a roundabout way.”
Sagittarius whimpered. “It’s a period where everyone is trying to grow their power. Everyone’s limit is stage 5, so everyone is aiming for stage 5. A Construct with 600% would allow a god to grow their power…”
When sparks flew in Lee Gun’s eyes, Sagittarius quickly spoke up. “Anyway, he’s a rare Construct! Even the Great Spirits are interested in him, so my hands are tied— Kuhk!”
In the end, the nephew kicked the uncle.
“Master!!”
“Your excuse is too long. It just means you were just scared.”
“No!” Sagittarius was about to speak again, but he refrained.
Amongst the Great Spirits that wanted Hugo, some had a grudge against the “Creator” tribe. Although he regained his memories late, Sagittarius was part of the Creator tribe. If he got close, he would be hacked to death.
“Anyway, nephew….”
Lee Gun had an expression as if he would kill Sagittarius if the god of the sun called him nephew one more time.
Sagittarius flinched. “Serpent Bearer, give up on Hugo. Go back to where you came from. Look at this.”
He took out one of the paper planes that Hugo had let fly while in captivity. “My subordinates were staking out, and they were able to acquire this.”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he unfurled the paper plane. Inside the paper plane seemed to be words written with Hugo’s penmanship.
[Gun, you don’t have to come looking for me.]
[I love it here.]
[I’ll meet a new family and have a great life here. You should have a happy life too.]
[Don’t interfere with my happiness any longer. Go have a kid with Ms. Yeonwoo and have a nice life.]
[Nothing good happened to me after you returned.]
Sagittarius let out a light sigh. “This is what he wants— Kuhk!”
Sagittarius received a kick from Lee Gun’s running shoes. And he soon started shaking. It was for no other reason.
“Nephew!! Your Divine Status! Divine Status!”
The stage 6 Divine Statuses, which had been sealed with Lee Gun’s body, were starting to leak out. His power subsided before it turned into something ugly.
Lee Gun seemed enraged. “Do you think a family man like him would have written something like this?”
“…!”
“I was going to return after I found Taeksoo. This was why I didn’t cause any trouble until now. I held myself back.”
“Hey, Serpent Bearer, you already turned Olympus into a mess.”
“Since this was my first time coming to this place, it was hard keeping a low profile.”
“You turned Kunlun and Valhalla on their heads!”
Lee Gun ignored him as he asked, “Is Hades here?”
“He is, but….”
“If so…”
“?”
“Which faction is on the worst terms with that bastard?”
“What?”
The god of calamity let out an evil smirk. “He messed with something he shouldn’t have.”

chapters.title: Chapter 334
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: What’s your relationship? (3)
“He messed with something he shouldn’t have.”
Sagittarius felt a chill run up his spine when he saw Lee Gun’s evil smile. That smile gave off an ominous feeling.
Sagittarius started to sweat as he extended his hand. “Nephew, what do you mean he messed with something shouldn’t have? How much more of a mess are you going to make in the Divine world?”
Divine beings lived here!! His uncle desperately yelled out loud, but Lee Gun just glared at him as if he was speaking nonsense. “What are you saying? I’ve been very quiet until now.”
“?!”
Was this bastard really that oblivious?! Did he not realize who had caused all this mess in Olympus? Was this how it was??
The oblivious Lee Gun extended his hand. He was trying to call Heaven’s Punishment. Since the weapon was made with the intent of using it on monsters, Lee Gun didn’t know if it would work well against the gods.
However, he wanted to decapitate Hades with it.
“Tsk. As expected, I can’t take out my weapon.” Lee Gun furrowed his brow as he waved his hand through the empty air.
As soon as he had entered the Divine world, his Constructs and most of his items had entered his shadow. Since he had carved a seal into Heaven’s Punishment, it was supposed to be summoned. However, it was unable to come out.
[Heaven’s Punishment cannot come out of the shadows.]
[Heaven’s Punishment is sad.]
Sagittarius tilted his head in puzzlement. “You can’t summon it? That’s odd. I gave you a personal reference, so the restriction should have been lifted.”
The Divine world hated gods without money. Since it was a world set up like that, it had a lot of betty criminals with minor transgressions.
When one developed a criminal history, one couldn’t use one’s items and abilities. However, high-rank gods could provide gems and a reference to release the restriction.
‘It should have been released earlier.’
Lee Gun grumbled as he opened his hands. “Something odd happened to my skills too.”
Before he entered the Divine world, it said [LOCK] on skills. However, when the lock was released, something even stranger appeared.
– Divine Achievement (0)
– Divine Status –
[Life] Ability (3-star ability and two others)
[Death] Ability (3-star ability and two others)
[???] (3=star ability and one other)
The shape of his skills had changed, and something unknown had appeared. At that moment…
[You aren’t registered as a resident of the Divine world.]
[Please hurry and register yourself as a resident.]
[Since you haven’t received citizenship, you cannot use your weapon. You need permission.]
When Lee Gun heard the voice coming from the thin air, he glanced at Sagittarius. “Hey. It says I wasn’t registered as a resident. What do I have to do?”
Sagittarius looked taken aback. He didn’t register as a resident?
“How did you get in? How were you not registered?”
“Well, they were evaluating my face and items. They also made me wait.”
“Evaluation? Did you enter through the arrivals hall?”
“Ah. That’s right. I think so. Well, it was all very annoying, so I just passed through it. I smashed everything to enter this place.”
Sagittarius’s face was a sight to behold. “You were the one to destroy the point of entry!!!” He screamed.
Currently, the Entry Offices of the Divine world were a mess. It was said that they had suffered a terrorist attack!
“You caused 5.6 million unidentified gods to enter the Divine world, bastard!!”
This was why the civil employees were on high alert and the Great Spirit in charge of the entry offices was aggravated.
This was why the enraged Zodiacs were going crazy, looking for the main instigator who had entered the Divine world illegally!
“How come you can’t do anything in moderation? At the very least, you should have kept it low-key when coming in!”
“Who cares? I don’t care about the gods.”
Sagittarius was crazy and exasperated by his nephew’s attitude.
‘He’s driving me nuts!’
When he thought about it, he was hiding an incredible criminal.
‘I thought he messed with only Olympus!’
Sagittarius had never expected this, yet events had turned out like this…
‘If he gets caught, I’m dead too.’
In the end, Sagittarius grabbed his nephew’s shoulders as if he had lost his mind. “Why didn’t you go through the easier routes? Why did you have to go through the entry office route?”
“What? There are other routes?”
“Of course, there are! Don’t you have Constructs?
“You could have registered residency as a low-rank Zodiac, and you would have been able to come into the Divine world easily!”
Lee Gun’s face crumpled at those words.
‘Did I do all of that in vain?’
Well, it didn’t matter.
“It’s fine. I’ve already entered this place. I want you to introduce me to Hades’s enemies.”
Sagittarius was about to say something when a sound rang out.
Dingdong!
“!”
Accompanying the clear bell sound, a hologram appeared in the corner of the room. It seemed to be a front gate connected to the private residence. The ones who had pressed the doorbell appeared on the hologram. They were a pair of beings.
[We have received a tip.]
[It was said that you’re hiding an illegal entrant here. May we enter?]
Lee Gun smirked, while Sagittarius inwardly screamed.
* * *
Around that time…
“Why the hell is that snake bastard in Olympus?” Hades was angry.
He had to get a handle on this situation before the Great Spirit became aware of it. It would be a toss if he could receive forgiveness from the other gods and was able to accomplish this.
However, Lee Gun already being inside Olympus changed everything!
Hades gritted his teeth. “Who let him into Olympus?”
His reaction was understandable, since this was the mighty Olympus. It wasn’t a place one could enter without permission.
‘Someone let him in, and this person is hiding the snake god.’
The only being capable of doing such a thing was a Zodiac belonging to the Olympus faction! This meant that someone had worked with the snake god to put Olympus in this state.
‘I don’t know who it is, but I’ll kill him alongside the snake god.’
In the end, Hades held Lee Gun’s item, which he wanted his Constructs to get a scent from. Raising his arms, he used his divine power. “As an owner of a Dimensional floor and a main god of Olympus, I command you. Search the register of the Divine world. Find the owner of this item by searching all of Olympus.”
At the same time, a surprising light erupted. Strands of light emerged from the floor and surged into the sky.
[The god who fits the parameters is being tracked.]
The strands went to the first, second, and third floors of Olympus. It then spread into the entire region.
[The exact location of the applicable god cannot be found.]
“What?!”
[The applicable god is not registered as a resident of the Divine world. He is an unregistered god.]
[Since there is no information, the tracking skill of the Divine world doesn’t work on him.]
“What the hell?”
He was an unregistered god. It was something impossible.
[Either he didn’t properly register himself or he smuggled himself through the entry office.]
[Currently, the entry offices are destroyed, so not even the records are left. That is why he cannot be found…]
Hades grabbed the back of his neck. If Lee Gun had smuggled himself into the Divine world, he would be able to completely evade the Divine world’s tracking.
“Why the hell did he enter through that method when he is a Zodiac?”
This meant the other gods wouldn’t be able to find him.
‘If someone is hiding him, I’ll never be able to find him.’
The snake god being secretly let into Olympus meant that this was the deed of a high-rank god.
With this dragging out longer, the Great Spirits would find out about this much quicker.
Therefore, Hades’s Constructs started sweating as they asked the question.
“Excuse me, Master. I’m sorry for bringing this up, but didn’t the snake god come here just to find his Construct?”
“!”
“If we tell him where the 600%-faith Construct is, wouldn’t the snake god go there? If so, wouldn’t it be better to go there and set up an ambush—”
“We can’t do that.” Hades cut off their words as he furrowed his brows.
The reason was the location. Even if the snake god were informed about Hugo’s location, the probability of Lee Gun regaining Hugo was low. However, Hades didn’t want to go asking for trouble. Above all else…
‘The 600%-faith Construct isn’t a normal Construct.’
Hades wasn’t just thinking of Hugo’s faith of 600%. When Hugo’s soul had entered the netherworld, Hades had found out an unexpected truth.
[Oh, Master of the afterlife, this is a very odd soul.]
The three goddesses of fate, who had a deep connection to the netherworld, told Hades about Hugo.
[This soul possesses an unimaginable number of Achievements.]
[Achievements?]
[I don’t know what he did in his past life, but even an evil god would have a hard time amassing this many Achievements.]
It wasn’t a normal soul when even the goddesses of fate gave him a warning.
‘This is a bigger deal than I thought.’
The fact that he had a lot of Achievements meant that he had a lot of internal energy. There was no way Hades would let such a soul go.
“Whatever. He’ll come out if I place a curse on him”
“A curse?”
Instead of answering, Hades took up the glass bottle that he had used to find Lee Gun’s location. If he had someone’s item, he could place the curse of death on him. It was an easy task for the god of death.
Hades smirked as he used his ability on the item dropped by Lee Gun.
[Curse of the Netherworld (5-star)]
This ability has risks associated with it, but this was a fatal curse even to a god. It was much more effective against a Zodiac with defensive abilities.
Finally, the curse directed toward Lee Gun infused itself into the glass bottle.
Flash!
“…!”
