Hades was surprised. Lee Gun’s glass bottle suddenly activated, and something popped out. It was an unknown figure.
“Master!!”
At a glance, she looked to be an absolute beauty.
Hades became guarded when he saw the woman.
“What kind of energy is this…!”
She was neither a god nor a human.
He instinctively felt danger, so he was about to move to a different location. However…
Pah-gahk!!!
The unknown figure hit Hades on the head, and Hades fell to the ground.
* * *
“Over here! He ran away in this direction!”
“We received a tip! An intruder came into Olympus!”
“It’s an illegal entrant!”
Lee Gun and his uncle were being chased by the gods of Olympus. Of course, Sagittarius didn’t need to run away, but everything had to do with Lee Gun.
If Lee Gun hadn’t entered the Divine world illegally, Sagittarius having hidden Lee Gun wouldn’t have been a problem!
“Damn it, nephew! You should just go back home!!!”
“Fuck off, baldie!”
In the end, they exited Sagittarius’s private residence and hid in the enormous garden of Olympus.
Sagittarius clicked his tongue. “They are civil employees of the Divine world. They can use Ability Restriction skills.”
In other words, they had the disarmament skill. Sagittarius had been labeled as an accomplice, so he was also targeted with this skill.
Lee Gun smirked as if he didn’t care. He didn’t mind fighting head-on here, but he would have a hard time moving through Olympus in this environment. It seemed this was related to his Divine status too.
“Won’t we be able to escape this place if we have Persephone? I think she has some kind of escape skill.”
“What? Why are you suddenly bringing up Persephone? Why would she be here in the first place?”
“Why else? I stole her away from the tenth floor.”
Sagittarius screamed when he realized what had happened. “Ah!!! What did you steal this time around?”
Instead of answering him, Lee Gun summoned Piggy Bank (Pixiu). The Construct looked glad to see its owner. It was laboring from being too full.
“B-Boo-oh??”
“Whatever! Let’s cut your stomach open. I don’t know how you were able to eat her, but I need to take out Persephone, the one you ate.”
“Boo-oh?!!!”
Lee Gun held up a knife and approached Pixiu as though he would cut its stomach open.
Pixiu cried out. It wanted to avoid that outcome at all costs.
“Over there! It’s Sagittarius!”
“Tsk!”
Voices rang in the distance.
The uncle and nephew had been hiding behind the tree. They clicked their tongues as they got ready to fight barehanded.
At that moment, the civil employee gods, who had been rushing toward Lee Gun from a distance, suddenly vomited blood. They fell to the ground.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun and Sagittarius tilted their heads in puzzlement.
“…?”
However, it didn’t end there.
“Those bastards…!”
When the civil employee started charging toward them once again from a distance, Lee Gun and Sagittarius brought up their blades.
Poo-hahk! Poo-hahk!!
“……????”
However, the enemies once again fell at a frightening speed.
Lee Gun and Sagittarius were confused about why their enemies were falling over, since the two of them weren’t doing anything.
If their enemies got close, it would be convenient since they could take their weapons. However…
‘What is it?’
The ones behind this weren’t the Constructs of Sagittarius.
An unknown third party seemed to be helping them, and they soon found out who.
“Koo-ahk!! Catch that human girl!”
“What? What is a human doing here?”
“Wait a— Ahhhhk!”
“Catch her! Catch that girl with the spear!”
“What the hell? Why is she so strong? Whose Construct is she?”
Sagittarius and Lee Gun flinched when they heard the sound coming from the distance. It was a very familiar and distinctive sound.
Sagittarius, who had been silent up to this point, started to sweat as he asked, “Serpent Bearer, did you bring your Zodiac Saints here?”
“Have you lost your mind? I left both of them behind so that they could guard their mother. Also, this is a road I’ve never traveled before, so I don’t know how dangerous it would be. Why would I bring my companions here?”
“What about the other Zodiac Saints?”
“I came to the Divine world by myself.”
“!!”
It was the truth. Aside from the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple, Lee Gun had brought no one else, since it was dangerous.
However, Sagittarius continued to sweat as he listened to the screams emanating from the distance. “They said it’s a human girl. It has to be…”
“Hey, how would Yooha enter this place? She would have had to hide somewhere without my knowledge…”
Pixiu flinched violently when it heard those words. It looked guilty.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed at this. “We’ll just have to confirm it. I’ll open your stomach.”
“Boo-oh?!!”
“Ah! You can heal it, baldie. I can’t use Super Regeneration right now.”
“I can only cauterize the wound?”
“That’s fine.”
“Ggooo-ehhhhhhk!!!!”
When it heard that its stomach would be cut open and cauterized, Pixiu sniffled and desperately tried to vomit. It vomited all the items within itself.
“!!!”
Sagittarius was shocked by the items Pixiu desperately vomited. Lee Gun also flinched.
Pixiu had spat out Yooha’s bag and other various belongings, proof that someone had been hiding within its stomach.
Lee Gun felt a bit faint when he heard his enemies scream in the distance.
‘Yooha followed me in secret!’
Kwa-gwa-gwa-gwahng!
This time, a sound came from the opposite side. It came from Hades’s side.
Sagittarius turned pale from fright when he heard the sounds of gods dying. He turned to look at Lee Gun.
“Who else did you bring with you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 335
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: What’s your relationship? (4)
[My word, Baby snake-nim…!!]
The earth!
The Zodiac Saints and the Constructs had gathered within Lee Gun’s house, holding a council of war, the reason for it being obvious.
[What kind of crazy Zodiac enters the Divine world in that fashion?]
[He didn’t go through the Zodiac registration. Him going to the entry center should have made us feel uneasy…!]
[Baby snake-nim will receive penalties if he does that…!]
[Why did he have to go through district A?]
The Virgo Constructs were nervous wrecks, and it seemed the Leo Constructs felt the same. They were having a mental breakdown.
[The penalties of the Divine world are dangerous.]
[Moreover, district A is under the Olympus faction.]
[That place is full of dangerous five-star rank gods…]
However, the Virgo Constructs screamed for an entirely different reason.
[Kyaahhhk! District A has the entertainment dimension!!]
[If he receives the penalty, he’ll get eaten alive by the goddesses!!]
[Baby snake-nim’s chastity is in danger!!]
When the Virgo Constructs despaired, the Leo Constructs became angry
[Hey, Virgo temple!!! Why the hell are you worried about something like that!!!]
[Kyahhhk!!]
However, the Leo Constructs soon groaned. Unlike the other gods, they had watched and experienced Lee Gun’s fierce temperament.
Lee Gun had carried out the terroristic attack on the entry centers, yet they would consider it lucky if that was all he did.
‘Please don’t mess with the Great Spirits!’
If it were up to them, these Constructs wanted to go to the Divine world right now. However, it would probably take them some time to enter the Divine world.
‘The Zodiacs are all there. Only the Constructs crossed dimensions to reach the earth.’
This was why they could merely put their trust in their Zodiacs, who were present in the Divine world!
However, Leo was sleeping. Their Zodiac not answering them back made them uneasy. In the end, they couldn’t do anything about that.
After the incident at the entry evaluation center, they had lost track of Lee Gun. However, the Zodiac Saints didn’t seem too worried about it.
“If something happens to Lee Gun, the Zodiac Saints will immediately be notified.”
“That’s right. We— No, I will notify you, so you guys don’t have to worry about that.”
At that moment…
“Excuse me… Young master?”
“!”
Lee Jaewon visited Lee Gun’s house with a bright smile on his face. Although he had a kind look on his face, something was oddly terrifying about his expression.
“Young master, where is Miss Yooha?”
“!!”
In a rarity, Chun Sungjae flinched.
Stevens, Kevin, and Goat furrowed their brows when they heard Lee Jaewon’s words.
“Uh? I haven’t seen her for the past couple of days.”
“Since we’re here to watch Lee Gun, there is no way she would miss such a meeting.”
Chun Sungjae flinched harder.
With a bright smile on his face, Lee Jaewon looked at Chun Sungjae. “I’m pretty sure Young Master and Young Miss were told to stay with Madam, right? When I asked Madam, she said Young Miss never came there…”
Chun Sungjae avoided his gaze. “N-Noona went to her part-time job. She went to Siberia to pick up some coffee beans.”
Lee Jaewon firmly grabbed Sungjae’s shoulders. “Young master? Coffee can’t be grown in cold places.”
“She is in South America…”
“Young master???”
When Chun Sungjae saw Lee Jaewon’s angry smile, he finally cried out loud. “Waaa! Noona followed Uncle to the Divine world!!!”
The words surprised everyone.
“Wait a moment. What? She went to the Divine world as a human?”
[Does she realize what kind of place that is?]
“Did Lee Gun knowingly take her there?”
“N-No. She went in secret. Uncle doesn’t know…”
This shocked them even more.
“How did she go there without Lee Gun noticing her?”
“Well, it is a secret….”
“Young Master?”
Chung Sungjae kept sweating when he saw Lee Jaewon’s smile. “That is…”
Chun Sungjae thought about what had happened not too long ago.
Right before he had left for the Divine world, Lee Gun had advised them to stop following him. “I’ll bring your dad. It’ll be dangerous, so you guys should stay here. You shouldn’t follow me at all costs. Don’t do it.”
However, Yooha couldn’t accept that, and the one to help out his noona was Chun Sungjae. His bright idea was to use Pixiu.
‘Since he’ll take his Constructs, I thought she could enter Pixiu’s mouth. I thought there was a possibility that Uncle wouldn’t notice her that way.’
Of course, they had lured Piggy Bank (Pixiu) in secret with food, and Sungjae had a hard time forcing his Noona into Pixiu.
The mouths of the Zodiac Saint and the Constructs fell open when they heard the story. They used a Construct in such a manner…!
Suddenly, the Virgo Constructs acted as if they had some kind of epiphany.
[Ah! Is that why Baby snake-nim entered illegally?]
[That’s right! The entry center would have checked his belongings, including his Constructs!]
[Oh! As expected of the Serpent Bearer, he realized midway that she was there. He illegally entered the Divine world because he didn’t want her to get caught!]
On the other hand, Lee Jaewon blanched.
‘There is no way things turned out like that.’
“Now that I think about it, it isn’t just Hugo’s daughter. I wasn’t able to contact the Scorpio Saint…”
Goat laughed at Kevin’s words. “No way! She’s probably in Canada. We’ve been having trouble with strange disciples popping up saying they aren’t part of the thirteenth Zodiac. She’s probably taking care of them.”
“There is no way she would do the same thing as Yooha.”
No, she was someone dangerous too. Lee Jaewon massaged his face. It seemed he would have to inform Sagittarius about this. Lee Jaewon sighed. The austere Sagittarius would be able to keep the two of them in check.
“I should have somewhat expected this, but I never thought she would follow him. Hailey-nim also likes Lee Gun-nim. I heard Miss Yooha asked Lee Gun-nim to marry her at their first meeting…”
“I guess it’s genetic. She gets it from her father.”
“What? Dad?! What are you talking about?”
“I’m talking about Miss Yooha’s fandom…”
“I’m talking about the other thing!”
Chun Sungjae recalled the words his sister had spoken after meeting Lee Gun for the first time.
“Don’t worry! I don’t plan on unnecessarily putting Uncle in an awkward position.”
However, she said she was free to follow him since she was a fangirl. It was why her fandom of Lee Gun had burned brightly.
On the other hand, someone trembled in the kitchen. She had been preparing refreshments when she heard their conversation.
Lee Gun was going to get eaten alive by the goddesses of the Divine world… Hailey was nowhere to be seen… Yooha had chased after Lee Gun… Hailey liked Lee Gun… Yooha had proposed as soon as she saw him…
An anxious look appeared in Yeonwoo’s eyes as she disappeared to another place.
* * *
Kwahng!
The Constructs chasing after Lee Gun were defeated by Yooha.
Yooha let out a sigh. Pixiu had been summoned for the first time at Hades’s star palace. She had exited its mouth there.
Amongst the skills that the Divine status of Death provided her with were Teleportation (Warp) and Stealth. This was why it wasn’t difficult for her to move under the radar from Lee Gun.
After exiting Pixiu, she had kidnapped(?) Persephone and used her stealth skill to secretly follow Lee Gun. She also took care of the Constructs that tried to go after Lee Gun.
“Whew! That’s the end of them.” Yooha took a deep breath after defeating the enemies.
Unlike the monsters, gods were quite difficult to hunt down.
A pigeon-headed civil servant coughed as it lay on the ground. Gnashing its teeth, it extended its hand.
“You human bitch…! Which route did you take to enter this place? What grudge do you have against us to attack—”
“Ah! One was left.” Chun Yooha picked up her spear, which looked like a harpoon.
“Yooha!!”
Chun Yooha flinched at the familiar voice. She got ready to run away.
“You stay there, Yooha! If you run away, I won’t sign your figurine!”
Sagittarius was dumbfounded by the words Lee Gun shouted. He turned to look at his nephew. “Nephew. Do you realize how old she is—”
Before he could finish, Chun Yooha, who had been about to run away, obediently sat on the ground. She waited for Lee Gun. Her eyes twinkled as she extended her hands. She wanted him to hurry up and give her the figurine.
Sagittarius’s mouth fell open at the sight.
Lee Gun glared at her. “Why are you here, Yooha? I told you to not come since it is dangerous here.”
“But Dad is here…. I couldn’t stand back and do nothing…”
Lee Gun was about to express his anger, but he merely sighed when he saw Yooha’s sullen face. “Alright. Don’t wander off. Stay close to Uncle.”
The next moment, the figure of Chun Yooha, who looked like she was about to cry, was nowhere to be seen. She stuck to Lee Gun’s leg like a cicada.
Lee Gun got angry. “Hey. Not like that.”
Chun Yooha pouted.
The dumbfounded Sagittarius ignored her antics as he asked, “Oh, daughter of my Zodiac Saint, what did you just do?”
“!”
“Most of them are low rank, but I don’t get how a human was able to defeat gods.”
Yooha tilted her head in puzzlement, as if to say he was speaking nonsense. “When I swung this, they started running away and falling.”
“What? What nonsense are you— Ahhhhk!!!”
Sagittarius convulsed when Yooha lifted her spear toward him. He hid behind Lee Gun. “What the hell are you holding?”
“It’s a weapon made by Uncle….”
“Ahhhk! Don’t ever bring that thing close to me! Never!”
“…???”
“Serpent Bearer! What did you make that from?”
“What else? It is the corpse of the monarch I killed before. That one is… Ah, was it called Abyss?”
“Ahhhk!! That’s why the gods ran away in fright. You’re holding such an item!!”
The unknown civilization was a race that the gods hated the most. This was especially true of the monarchs, the leaders of the unknown civilization.
‘Even the Great Spirits avoid engaging the monarchs’
It was a predator-prey relationship. The unknown civilization was the worst race to the gods, who ruled over dimensions.
An item infused with their power could weaken a god. It could even make the gods faint. Moreover, this was Abyss, whom Lee Gun had killed before.
Of course, Lee Gun had killed only a part of Abyss, but Abyss had invaded the Divine world before. It had entered through the dimensional cracks to eat gods viciously.
That shocking incident had yet to fade from the gods’ memories, yet Lee Gun had made such a weapon!
Lee Gun didn’t care for Sagittarius’s reaction. He seemed amused. “It seems gods hate monsters more than I thought.”
“Of course, they hate monsters. Moreover, the items of the unknown civilization are illegal. Their hatred for the monsters is unimaginable. The Great Spirits especially hate the monarch rank—”
Sagittarius blanched as he looked at Lee Gun. “You can’t do it, nephew.”
“What?”
“You’re laughing. You plan on making items from all the monster corpses you have gathered. You plan on distributing them. You must never do that. Never. It must not be done. That should be off-limits!!”
“Oh! I didn’t think that far. Thank you for the idea.”
“Ahhhk!!!”
“Anyway, we should go find Taeksoo since you’re here too.”
However, it seemed Hugo had left Hades’s possession, and his location was unknown.
‘I guess I have to go find Hades first.’
“Oh yeah. Take this, Uncle.”
“!”
Yooha handed Lee Gun something. “I picked it up when I took down a couple of enemies within Hades’s star palace…”
It was a letter that Yooha had taken from a defeated civil servant.
Sagittarius flinched when he saw the shape of the letter. “Give it to me.”
“!”
The reason for his reaction was the power enveloping the letter. It was the power of a high-rank Zodiac, who was in charge of Olympus’s Messenger service.
If the seal of a high-rank Zodiac was placed on it, it couldn’t be sent to just anyone.
Sagittarius forcefully broke open the letter. It had a high-rank seal, but Sagittarius was also a high-rank Zodiac of the Divine world.
Kwah-jeek!
A fierce flame burned the envelope as Sagittarius read the content of the letter. He furrowed his brows. “It is addressed to Hades, but…”
The problem was the one supposed to have received the letter. It was a Great Spirit.
Lee Gun smirked when he saw the content. “You did well, Yooha.”
“!”
「Oh Great Spirit. Thank you for your purchase. I will inform you of the location where the Construct “Pushover” will be transferred to you.」
His reaction was to be expected since the letter told the location of Hugo. Lee Gun’s eyes flashed savagely.

chapters.title: Chapter 336
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: What’s your relationship? (5)
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed savagely.
Yooha tilted her head in puzzlement. She couldn’t understand his reaction. “What does it say?”
Yooha couldn’t read the content of the letter in Sagittarius’s hands, as it was written in the language of the gods.
This wasn’t the case with Lee Gun. He had stolen holy item designs from Capricorn and had self-taught himself the basics of how to manufacture holy items. Although it had been a short process, he had learned their language.
So Lee Gun nonchalantly said, “It basically says your dad was sold.”
“D…Dad was sold?” It was rare to see Yooha freeze up.
Lee Gun tousled her hair as if to reassure her. “Uncle will get him back. You don’t have to worry about it.”
Of course, Hugo had left behind a rubbish letter saying “Don’t come looking for me.” and “Nothing good happened to me once you came back.”, but…
‘Who cares about such a letter?’
It didn’t change that Lee Gun would still go and take Hugo back. “I wonder if it’ll be possible.”
“!”
Lee Gun glared at Sagittarius, since the god of the sun was throwing cold water on his plan.
Sagittarius held up another letter. He seemed to have stolen it from the pigeon-headed Zodiac that Yooha had defeated. “The problem is that a civil employee of the Divine World possesses a letter like this one”
“!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. The civil employees had gotten on his bad side because of the incident at the entry evaluation center. “What about them?”
Sagittarius read the content. He wanted Lee Gun to hear it. “Listen, gods. A low-rank snake god from the border area is aiming for the 600%-faith Construct.”
“!”
“The 600%-faith Construct will be a useful shared resource for the Zodiacs of the Divine world. Despite knowing this, the low-rank snake god will come looking for his Construct. According to the contract of the Divine world, you are ordered to banish and interfere with the low-rank Zodiac in question—”
Sagittarius suddenly cringed. It was because Lee Gun had picked up his cudgel. “I’m just reading what is written here! These aren’t my words!”
Sagittarius was aggrieved at the expression on Lee Gun’s face. “It seems the Zodiacs don’t care about their factions. They plan on colluding on this matter. Bunch of maggots—”
“You are a Zodiac like them.”
When Lee Gun lifted his fist, Sagittarius quickly grabbed his arm. “Nephew! Let’s use talk instead! Aren’t you a Zodiac too?!”
“What did you just say?” Lee Gun didn’t want to be put in the same basket as them, so he was about to rip out Sagittarius’s wig.
Sagittarius became serious as he defended his head. “Are you really this oblivious? The civil employees were paid off behind the back. They are all on the same side. This has never happened before!”
Lee Gun snorted. “Who cares about that? I now know the location. I’ll just have to go and get him.”
“That’s all the more reason not to do it.”
Lee Gun raised his eyebrows as if to say what nonsense Sagittarius was speaking.
Sagittarius pointed at the letter in Lee Gun’s hand. “The letter says Duat, right?”
“!”
Lee Gun looked at the letter again.
「The location of the transfer will be Duat. May the blessing of Ennead be with you.」
Sagittarius said, “Duat is the underworld… In other words, the world of the dead. The world of the dead is a special region that not even gods can enter.”
It was a part of the Divine world, yet the divine status of the netherworld had to approve one’s entry. Not even the Great Spirits could enter it without permission.
“The world of the dead is divided into regions. Duat is the most unfriendly region. It’s an isolated region.”
Hades ruled over the underworld of Tartarus. The Pluton dimension was a tourist attraction with hot springs and prostitution. The Samsara underworld was an enormous plantation with agricultural plants. It was also where one received mental training.
On the other hand, Duat was used by the gods of the underworld as a place of torture.
“The Ennead faction rules that place, and they are the cruelest faction amongst the eight great forces. Also, you should watch this before you do anything. This was taken especially for you.”
“!”
Sagittarius took out a little machine from his pocket. When he pressed the button, a hologram appeared.
[It’s the highest in history!!]
[He is a Construct with 600% Faith.]
[Everyone gathered here is a prominent figure. Each of you will have a different way of using this high faith.]
[You can brainwash him. You can kill his personality. You can even change his memories.]
[His face is decent, so you can use him as a body slave. His fighting ability is high, so you can use him in numerous ways.]
[Anyone would be better than his previous owner!]
[Kyaaa! Husband!]
Sagittarius stopped the hologram. “Look. That’s the scene from the auction house. This was when Hugo was sold. I had a very hard time getting this footage— Kuhk! Why are you suddenly being like this? Kuh-huhk!!!”
Sagittarius was stomped on by Lee Gun and Yooha.
“You want to die? If you had the time to take such a video, you had enough time to rescue him?!”
“Useless Sagittarius!!!”
“No! My subordinate took the footage!! Ahhk!” Sagittarius ignored his battered state as he pointed at someone in the footage. “Over there! Look at them! Do you see that group wearing white?”
“Who are they?”
“They are the Kunlun faction! Anyway, Hugo was originally sold to the Great Spirit of Kunlun!!”
“!”
Sagittarius’s white clothes became dyed red. He grabbed Lee Gun’s leg as he said, “That footage from the auction was taken three months ago! However, the letter Hugo’s daughter brought to us was sent to the underworld yesterday, right?”
“!”
“Hades had to change his plan when you came to the Divine world. He made it so that you can’t chase after Hugo!”
That wasn’t all.
“You asked earlier as to who had a bad relationship with Hades, right? They are the ones. In the past, Hades razed Duat to the ground.”
The exact reason was unknown, but the Great Spirit of the Ennead faction hated Hades to death.
“You saw what was written in the letter. The 600%-faith Construct will be used to bury the hatchet. Moreover, Hades is asking them to imprison and torture you in Duat.”
It was unclear why, but Hades was showing zero intention of losing Hugo to Lee Gun.
Lee Gun snorted. “I don’t care. Just tell me how I can go to the underworld.”
Sagittarius started to sweat. As expected, Lee Gun wasn’t going to stay still. “Nephew. Even if you have the Divine status of Death, you need work experience to acquire a license to get there. It also takes a lot of money. Entering the underworld is too difficult.”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. Was this bastard trying to help or not?
For some reason, Sagittarius avoided Lee Gun’s gaze. “Since he’s being sold to the Great Spirit of Ennead, he’ll be transported to the Ennead’s main palace within the underworld. There is no way we can snatch him away from Ennead…”
At that moment…
“Oh my, Master of the sun. There is a much easier way to accomplish that goal!”
“!!?”
A familiar face appeared from the mouth of the summoned Pixiu.
“P-Persephone!”
Lee Gun…. No, she was the Zodiac kidnapped by Yooha.
When Persephone pushed her face out of Pixiu’s mouth, Pixiu whined and gagged as it kept its mouth open.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he looked at her. “There is a simple way?”
When she met Lee Gun’s eyes, Persephone squealed. She became shy. Entering Pixiu once again, she answered, “Yes! Herm—”
“Ahhhk!!!!”
Sagittarius quickly placed a hand over Persephone’s mouth. He started to let out a cold sweat, as if the answer would put him in an awkward situation.
‘No way! The messenger god is off-limits. That’ll get Olympus involved.’
Hermes was very close to the Great Spirit. If they got involved any further with the Olympus faction, the Great Spirit and the Zodiacs would find out that Sagittarius had hidden Lee Gun.
Hiding someone who had illegally entered the Divine world was a sin. Sagittarius would be labeled an accomplice of Lee Gun, who had to be killed!
“Nephew? It is nothing—”
“It’s Hermes!”
“Ahhhk!!!!”
Sagittarius screamed as he looked at Lee Gun’s face. “Nephew. If you get Olympus involved, they’ll kill—”
“I’ll take you out with my hands before that happens.”
“Ahhhk!!”
The power of Death struck Sagittarius.
* * *
“Damn it!” Hades cussed after opening his eyes.
The Olympus Zodiacs and the forces present on the party cruise were in front of his eyes. They had bound Hades, and their divine energy was raging as if they wanted to kill him. Hades bit his lips.
‘Shit! This is all the fault of that strange woman!’
In truth, Hades had planned on catching Lee Gun before the Great Spirit found out about what was going on. However, an unknown woman had appeared from Lee Gun’s item and knocked Hades unconscious…!
However, Hades was sweating for an entirely different reason. He had felt the energy of the unknown civilization from that woman. Moreover, it was the energy of a monarch.
‘It can’t be, right…?’
There was no way it could be true. Lee Gun had already turned the Divine world on its head. It would be apocalyptic if a monarch had entered the Divine world.
‘Just a piece of a monarch’s corpse entering this place would cause a state of emergency.’
However, that wasn’t important right now. That woman had disappeared somewhere.
“Do you really think the Great Spirit will forgive you after it sees what you’ve done?”
“Wait! I didn’t do this. The snake god—”
“You’re the one who dragged him in! You got played by a low-rank Zodiac!”
Hades ground his teeth when several thousand gods moved toward him. “I’ll do my best to repay any damages suffered.”
The next second, Hades screamed.
As if they had been waiting for that moment, the gathered gods took all of Hades’s wealth. They took Talents, the star palace, and all the wealth within it!
Hades was considered a wealthy god, and the amount he had lost just now was almost a fatal blow.
[The Divine world is giving a warning to the owner of the land of the dead. Your debt is too high. You do not have enough funds to pay the taxes.]
[Next week is income tax day. If you cannot pay your taxes, you will fall into the world of torture. Please be warned.]
All the gods had to pay taxes to the Divine world.
If Hades couldn’t pay it, he would become a slave of the Divine world. However, he had lost the money to pay the taxes because of Lee Gun. This was why his face turned pale.
The gods weren’t satisfied with what they took.
“Hey! There isn’t enough money! Give us more!”
“I’ll pay the rest of the balance soon. Just wait!” In the end, Hades had to write a note that put up his body as collateral.
Then, Hades quickly tried to go to the underworld. He had to quickly finalize the transaction of Hugo. He had to receive the rest of the balance for the sale.
“Hey! Where the hell are you going? The Great Spirit is looking for you!”
“Our master is looking for you!”
Hades’s face turned pale from fright at the mention of the Great Spirit. He wasn’t mad enough to go to the Great Spirit! He knew very well what would happen if he let himself get dragged along by them.
“Ah! Over there!! Money!”
“What? Money?”
“Ah! That bastard is running away!!!”
Hades quickly disappeared to the underworld. Because of that damned Lee Gun, he had become penniless, yet it didn’t matter.
‘If I hand over Pushover and receive the remaining balance, this loss will be nothing.’
This all hinged on the premise that the deal and transfer went on without a hitch. The problem was Lee Gun, who unnecessarily kept looking for his Construct. However, the place where the trade would happen was special.
‘There is no way he’ll be able to enter that region.’
The gods of Duat had ordered a ban of all gods from entering the underworld.
‘One cannot illegally enter that place.’
Hades smirked as he quickly headed toward the underworld of Duat.
* * *
Around that time…
“Where the hell did Hades run away to?”
“Hey! Spread the wanted posters!”
At the center of Olympus’s third floor, Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose when his surroundings turned raucous. It was because Hades’ name was mentioned.
‘I wonder why they are looking for him.’
Hades had probably done something wrong.
‘Should I tell them where he went?’
It didn’t matter in the end.
“Uh… You want me to send you to the underworld? You want to go there despite Olympus being in this state?”
“Uh… Yeah. I have business there that I must attend.”
They had come to a passenger transportation company owned by Hermes. Hermes was the messenger god and the only god who could travel to all the worlds.
“If it’s Hermes, he’ll be able to move all of us, right? He transports passengers.”
“He does… However, Hermes-nim isn’t here right now. Also…”
“Also?”
“Currently, all entry into the underworld is forbidden.”
“Let’s put that aside for now. Did you hear about the terrorist? It’s under the jurisdiction of Olympus’s Great Spirit. That’s why those on the top are making a big fuss. They are mobilizing everyone to catch him.”
“Do you know who the culprit is?”
“Not really. He can’t be tracked, and someone is hiding him.”
Sagittarius turned pale as he looked at Lee Gun. “N-Nephew. Since things turned out like this, let’s just give up. Let’s wait this out at a different location…”
On the other hand, Lee Gun smirked as he stared at the poster on the wall. Then he approached the counter. “Do you guys do courier service too?”
“What? Ah!. Yes…! That is correct. We are the largest courier service company in the Divine world!”
“Is the promotion on the poster true? I can send an item to anyone?”
“Of course! Please do not look down on the power of the messenger god!”
“Is it possible to deliver a person through the courier service?”
“What?”
“The recipient is Pushover.” Lee Gun smirked as he pointed at himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 337
chapters.content:
Chapter 337 - Drop Shipment (1)
Lee Gun smirked as he pointed to himself.
Everyone’s eyes turned round when Lee Gun asked if he could be sent as a parcel. This was especially true of Sagittarius, who had brought Lee Gun to this place.
He whispered to Lee Gun, “Are you being serious?”
It didn’t take long for Sagittarius to scream inwardly when he saw Lee Gun’s expression.
‘This guy has no plans on doing an indirect inquiry…!!’
Hermes was the Messenger god, and he was a big player in the entire Divine world when it came to the passenger transport business, considered to be in the top two. Moreover, as per a rumor, they could traverse different dimensions. Aside from traveling in time, Hermes could travel to any place in this world.
Lee Gun had probably planned on finding Hugo through this method after he had heard of this.
‘Still, the delivery idea came out of nowhere!’
Did he think such a thing was possible?
Lee Gun didn’t care as he smirked. “If Pushover can’t be the recipient, I don’t mind if it's Hades.”
“…?!”
The employee behind the counter looked taken aback.
“What? It isn’t possible? You can send a person as a parcel, right?”
“I-I guess we can send you if we label you as livestock…”
The flabbergasted employees looked over Lee Gun and Sagittarius.
“You want to go to the underworld despite the current situation?”
“Excuse me. You said your name is Bamboo Spear-nim? Aren’t you affiliated with Olympus?”
They looked Lee Gun up and down with suspicion. Currently, Lee Gun was wearing Sagittarius’s clothes. He had worn a white jacket. The description of his original black jersey had spread far and wide. Moreover, it smelled greatly of humans.
Also, Sagittarius had changed Lee Gun’s black hair to red as a disguise. This had made Yooha pant in joy as she took a lot of photos.
Of course, Lee Gun’s Divine statues were already sealed, so there was no need to do anything about them.
Anyway, Sagittarius’s efforts had been effective. The gods had mistaken Lee Gun to be under the Olympus faction.
“Olympus is a mess right now because of a god called the entertainer.”
“We received orders to assemble, yet you want to go to the netherworld… Are you running away?”
“Do you have something to do with this situation…”
When distrust entered their eyes, Sagittarius became desperate. “No!! It isn’t like that!! This kid works part-time for my store! A terrible bastard stole money from this kid and ran away to the underworld!!”
The dumbfounded Lee Gun looked at Sagittarius.
Sagittarius stroked Lee Gun’s head as he continued, “As someone who hired him, I can’t stand still. This kid also has to pay taxes to the Divine world soon. Anyway, we are in a hurry! Please do us a favor!”
When Sagittarius started to sweat, the employees tilted their heads in puzzlement. They had never seen this side of Sagittarius.
‘He’s always calm and cold.’
‘He’s known as the noblest god in the Divine world.’
Lee Gun looked at Sagittarius with an unsatisfied reaction. He was asking why Sagittarius was employing such a useless method.
‘If words don’t work, I just have to make them listen.’
‘You're right.’
In the end, Lee Gun and Yooha started raising their weapons as if they were in agreement. However, Sagittarius desperately grabbed and lowered their arms.
‘Ahhhk! Everyone from the Serpent Bearer temple is crazy!!!’
They were all the same!
Sagittarius became very serious since he was the one hiding Lee Gun.
‘If you get me involved, you won’t find any answer to your problem.’
At that moment, the employees looked at Lee Gun and said, “Since we are in the presence of the god of the sun, we’ll make an exception. We’ll send you as livestock through the parcel service.”
“As you probably know, a terrorist attacked the Divine world’s entry center a couple of days ago.”
“!”
“Unfortunately, the one in charge of the entry center was Olympus's Great Spirit. That’s why all the members of Olympus are being aggressively pushed to join the effort to catch the terrorist…”
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. “Entry center? I—”
“Ahhhk!!!!!!”
Sagittarius took Lee Gun into his arms as if he wanted to shut him up.
The employees looked at them in suspicion.
“You did what?”
“I— Oohp.”
“He was there! He was one of the victims!!!”
“Ah-ha! I see. Anyway, this is his general description. You should keep it in mind. He can’t be tracked. Either he’s hiding or someone is hiding him…”
“If someone is hiding him, the Great Spirit said it will kill that being.”
Sagittarius's face turned pale from fright as he continued to sweat.
* * *
“Nephew.”
“You want to die.”
“Serpent Bearer.”
“What?”
“I have a question.”
“What is it?”
Sagittarius seriously asked, “Over there… Why… Why do I have to get into a box?”
Lee Gun had been packing Sagittarius in a box. He savagely glared at the god of the sun. “You aren’t going to go? You have zero desire to save Taeksoo.”
“It isn’t like that!!! I’m just asking why I have to go there! You were the one supposed to go inside the delivery box!”
Sagittarius looked aggrieved as he tried to exit the large box. However, Lee Gun grabbed him by the back of the neck and put him into a sturdy delivery (wooden) box. Yooha held up a sticker that would label Sagittarius as livestock.
Sagittarius desperately tried to exit the box, but his group had asked to use a space that the employees didn’t particularly use. The god of the sun had never expected it to be used against him like this!
“I have things to do in Olympus!”
“Shut up! We’ll go to Taeksoo. You take care of the counterparty.”
“W-What?! Why?”
“Why else? The counterparty of the Taeksoo trade is the Great Spirit of Ennead or whatever. We can’t have him interfering with Taeksoo’s rescue. Just beat him half to death.”
“What!!! Hey! Do you realize what kind of being a Great Spirit is— Oohp! You might be able to do it, but— Oohp!!!”
Lee Gun pretended not to hear as he closed the lid. As soon as Yooha placed the livestock sticker, a light surrounded the box. It was sealed shut.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Hey!!”
Lee Gun placed the box containing Sagittarius onto the conveyor belt. Then, he wrote a message on the box using the marker borrowed from the employee.
[To: Ennead Great Spirit]
“Ahhhhk!!” The container containing Sagittarius fell into the hole at the end of the conveyor belt. It was being delivered to its destination. The marker was an item connected to the Messenger god’s abilities.
[Cross Through Dimensions (4 star)]
- Address for All Creations (5 star): Automatic search. Assigned.
Lee Gun dusted off his hands when he confirmed this, then took out another empty box. “Where do you want to go, Yooha? Do you want to go to your dad? How about Hades?”
Yooha’s eyes twinkled. “I want to go with uncle.”
Before departing the earth, Lee Gun had told Hailey and Yooha that he would take them to the Divine world, yet he had snuck out in secret at dawn.
Lee Gun sighed when he heard Yooha’s words. He looked resigned as he wrote Pushover on the box. Then, he gestured to her to get into the box. “We’ll go immediately to Taeksoo…”
At that moment.
“I’m sorry, but I can’t make that delivery.”
Kwah-jeek!!!
Accompanying an unfamiliar voice, a harpoon made out of powerful magical energy fell on the conveyor.
Kwah-gwa-gwan!
The conveyor belt came to a stop, and an unfamiliar man wearing a suit appeared in the shipping room.
He was a handsome male god, like Sagittarius. The green-haired male god had a meaningful smile on his lips.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw this being.
[Divine Name: Wanderer of Borders]
[Divine Status: Hermes (Zodiac)]
“You can’t go to the address you just registered. Pushover is a Construct that Olympus is aiming for too.”
“Huh?”
Lee Gun looked askance at the male god, but the messenger god merely smiled. “You’re that problematic snake god, right?”
Hermes was a god with significant Divine status. His eyes shone with golden light as he looked at Lee Gun’s outer appearance. It seemed his eyes could see the Divine status leaking out of Lee Gun. Lee Gun’s aura looked like the precious twin snakes.
The messenger god smiled. He was interested since Lee Gun was the original owner of the 600% Construct. However, he also realized something was off.
‘That’s strange. It was said that he’s a Zodiac with stage 5 Divine status.’
The messenger god was friendly with the civil servants, so he had eavesdropped on them. Although he hadn’t heard the exact details, he had heard that Lee Gun was the god of Cycle.
Stages 1 and 2 were considered normal Divine status for a low-rank god. Stages 3 and 4 were for the middle-rank gods. Divine status stage 5 indicated a high-rank god.
However, that wasn’t the case with Lee Gun.
‘He looks to be the lowest-rank god.’
For some odd reason, Lee Gun smelled like a human and his energy seemed like that too. In fact, the auto-detection system of the Divine world had classified him as a low-rank god.
Of course, Lee Gun was a new god, so he hadn’t been properly measured. However, that measurement’s result would more than likely be the same.
In fact, Hermes wondered if the civil servants were in error. It was rare, but Lee Gun did have two Divine Statues. Hermes wondered if Lee Gun was treated as a stage 5 because stage 3 and stage 2 were added together.
‘They said the power of Cycle can be activated only if the two Divine Statuses are combined.’
If so, the civil servants were generous in calling it stage 5.
This made the messenger god laugh.
According to the rules of the Divine world, a god was considered a Zodiac if it possessed a Construct. However, low-rank gods were embarrassed to call themselves Zodiacs since the title of a Zodiac was a title emblematic of the ruling gods. So the low-rank gods had given up on that title.
It was why the gods looked at the snake god with contempt. He wasn’t even a high-rank Zodiac, yet he planned on keeping a 600%-Faith Construct. Moreover, he didn’t give up his title of Zodiac despite being a low-rank god.
The messenger god didn’t show any outward indication of his thought as he approached Lee Gun and Yooha. “I like you guys, especially you.”
The messenger god smiled as he looked at Yooha. “Do you guys want to be my Constructs?”
“?”
Then he grabbed Lee Gun’s shoulder. “Do you want to join Olympus? Our Great Spirit is interested in you.”
Currently, a war is going on in the Divine world, named the Great Spirit selection match.
The Great Spirits put great importance on this war, and they all wanted their factions to win.
‘He’s the owner of that Construct. He must know a special way to make a 600%-Faith Construct.’
On top of everything, a rumor was going around that a monarch of the unknown civilization had been killed in a distant dimension.
It was probably only a rumor, but monarchs were beings that made even high-rank gods convulse.
‘If we find out the secret method, the monarch can be…’
The messenger god’s eyes flashed as he activated his ability.
[Information Backflow (4 star)]
It was an ability that allowed him to forcefully see and steal information about his opponent.
However, when the messenger god explored Lee Gun’s Divine statuses, he flinched hard.
‘W-Wait a moment.’
Seeing him this flustered was rare.
‘This bastard’s Divine Statuses are…!’
They were above the level of a high-rank god. Moreover, Lee Gun didn’t possess just two Divine Statuses.
‘Three? No….’
“!”
While the messenger god was searching him, Lee Gun grinned as he brought out something. It was none other than the spear created with Abyss’s body!
The messenger god caught wind of what kind of power the spear emanated, and his pale face froze on reflex. “Wait a moment. What is that?”
“None of your business.”
The next moment, the monarch spear pierced through the messenger god’s body.
Kwah-jeek!
“Ahhhhk!”
Lee Gun wrapped the messenger god’s body with tape. Then he placed him into a new delivery box. “I’ll send this bastard to a monarch.”
“What? Wait a moment! Hey?!! Oohp!!”
When Lee Gun placed the lid, Yooha once again placed the livestock sticker on the box. Then Lee Gun wrote the name of the recipient on the box.
[To: Abyss (Monarch)]
After that, he used his strength to put the box at the end of the conveyor belt and pushed the box into the black space.
Hweek!
The messenger god screamed because of the violent push. “Ahhhk! No! Hay! Open this—!! Ahhk!!”
However, it was all in vain as he was sent as a parcel.
At the same time, Lee Gun entered the delivery box with Yooha. The box had the name Pushover written on it.
They were delivered in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 338
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Drop Shipment (2)
“Ahhhk!”
The delivery route was very rocky. Lee Gun had chosen this delivery method because he wanted to go to Hugo. However, it wasn’t particularly a good method.
Lee Gun and Yooha felt like dying as they were transferred as a parcel. However, the space they were in being confined wasn’t the problem.
“Damn it! They consider themselves the number one delivery service, yet this is how they make delivery!! The content will get damaged!!”
It was a small box that one person could fit comfortably in, yet two people had entered it. However, this wasn’t the problem; it was motion sickness.
The path was so rough that the box was tossed and thrown around. It flew as it made 360-degree turns. The two people inside it were having a rough time.
“They said they’ll put their pride on the line for being the number one business industry! They said they handle items with care! Bullshit! I bet they all arrive damaged!!!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed within the box as he complained about the false advertisement. Of course, the box itself was sturdy, so it hadn’t been smashed to pieces. However, the situation was precarious.
The box looked like it could give out at any moment, so Lee Gun said, “Grab onto Uncle, Yooha. You might fall if you aren’t careful.”
Yooha’s ears perked up. She was already hugging him, yet she nodded. “Hey! Don’t bury your face against me on the sly!!”
Yooha ignored him.
It was unclear as to how long had passed. The box shook crazily in turbulence before it started to descend downward.
Ggee-eek!
“Koohk!”
As soon as the box tilted downward, it plummeted toward an unknown location.
Koo-goo-goo-goohk!
The duo felt like they were falling down a strong current as their screams got stuck in their throats. Yooha breathed in a strained manner as she clutched at Lee Gun’s waist. Finally, the box collided with something.
Kwahng!!!
The collision was so intense that the box staying intact was almost a miracle. The box stopped shaking after a voice rang out.
[The delivery has been completed. Thank you for using Hermes’s delivery service! If you leave a 5-star review, you will get a 50% discount on your next order!]
Review, my ass! When that voice disappeared, Lee Gun furrowed his brow. He could hear sound coming from outside the box.
“What the hell did we receive?”
“Pushover? Hey, come and take your item! You received a parcel!”
When Lee Gun heard that, he smirked inside the box. They seemed to have arrived at the right place.
At that moment, someone tried to open the lid of the box. Then…
Kwah-jeek!!!
Lee Gun’s arms shot out through the crack of the opened box.
“Huhk!”
The beings who had been opening the box reacted in fright when hands suddenly appeared out of the box.
Lee Gun grabbed them and slammed them against the box.
Kwahng!!
“Ahhhhk!!”
“What the hell…! Ahhhhk!”
Kwahng! Kwahng!!!
After getting rid of the irritants gathered around the box, Lee Gun leisurely exited the box with Yooha in his arms. “Whew! It seems we arrived safely… What the hell is this?”
Lee Gun became angry after he exited the box. “Why is there only one door?”
When he looked at his surroundings, he saw only a desert and a door. Annoyed, he kicked open the door and entered it.
The room he entered had some alligator-headed gods within it, and they looked at Lee Gun in shock.
[Divine Status: Ammut]
“What are you—”
Lee Gun glared at them. “Hey, alligator bastards! I’m a parcel addressed to Pushover. Where is the recipient?”
“W-What? He is over there….”
“Over there?” Lee Gun followed the finger of the alligator-headed gods and got angry. It was expected, since Lee Gun and Yooha should have been delivered to a building, which was very far away.
“Damn it! They dropped off the box in front of the door?!”
However, Lee Gun soon let go of what had happened. He turned to the alligators. “Whatever. So Pushover is over there?”
The alligator-headed gods finally realized what was going on. They scoffed as they unsheathed their weapons.
“You rat!!”
“How dare you enter Duat! Let’s rip his heart out!”
“We’ll use you as food for our compatriots!”
The next second, projectiles shot out of the desert. The projectiles changed into hooks that were used to extract the heart! It was the hunting technique of the Ammut!
“You will be our 1,898,349th heart—”
Punchng! Punchng! Phung-phung-phung!
“!!!”
Lee Gun instantly snatched the small projectiles as if he were catching flies. When he unfurled his hand, the captured projectiles fell to the ground. “What about my heart?”
Taken aback, the Ammuts tried to use their abilities once again.
Kwahng! Kwahng kwahng! Kwahng kwahng kwahng!
“Why do you guys keep shooting? It’s annoying. I can’t use Super Regeneration, so it stings.”
The Ammuts were flustered when they saw Lee Gun walk toward them as if their attacks had been no big deal. They shouted.
“Attack the woman instead— Kuh-huhk!!!”
However, they couldn’t finish their words.
Yooha had already appeared behind them using teleportation and planted her spear into the back of an Ammut.
“Ahhhk!! What the hell is this spear? Help— Kuh-huhk!”
The other Ammuts let out cold sweats when they saw this. Only one possibility could explain this current situation.
“The two of them are gods with the Divine status of Death! They have resistance to the power of Death”
“What? I’ve never seen them amongst the gods of Death!”
Each god had their own attribute, and the gods with similar attributes naturally got to know each other.
The Ammuts could tell just by looking at their energy.
Lee Gun didn’t care for their surprise. He ripped away his ruined clothes in annoyance. “That baldie doesn’t even have a single decent outfit.”
“!”
“Your leathers looked more useful than this.” Lee Gun’s red eyes curved menacingly as he looked at the Ammuts
* * *
Around that time, within the palace pointed out by the Ammuts, where Hugo was!
The Zodiac on guard furrowed his brows. There was a reason for it.
“What? An intruder entered this place?”
“Yes. At a glance, he looks like a snake god… He’s a Death god that I’ve never seen before…!”
“Moreover, he’s looking for Pushover.”
The god who had the body of a human and the head of a canine smirked. “Ah! I wondered who it was.”
They had agreed to do the transaction here with Hades. This was why Pushover was here too.
To settle the balance and inspect the product, the Great Spirit was scheduled to make an appearance here.
“What should we do? The Great Spirit will be here in thirty minutes, and the transaction will start soon….”
Anubis, the Zodiac of Duat, stood up in annoyance. “Don’t worry! I’ll get rid of him before Master arrives.”
“Please be careful. That snake god is psychotic…”
“Hmmph! At the end of the day, he’s a god. How psychotic can he be—”
The black canine-headed god screamed as soon as he exited the door.
“I got alligator leather. One, two, three, four, five…ten.”
“Ahhhk!!!”
The dog-headed god trembled when he saw his compatriots being turned into leather.
Lee Gun was currently skinning Anubis’s compatriots. Lee Gun had already reached the entrance of the palace. His surroundings were full of Ammuts groaning in pain.
The dog-headed god could no longer take it. He shouted at Lee Gun, “What the hell are you doing?”
“What else? I’m gathering ingredients.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun looked at Anubis with anger. “Will you hand over my friend, or do you want to hand over your hide too?”
What did this crazy bastard say??
* * *
“Oh, Great Spirit. It’s almost the appointed time.”
“It’s already that time.”
“Yes. It’s time for you to go to Duat and check the goods.”
If the 12 o’clock direction of the Divine world was under the Olympus faction, the 3 o’clock direction was under the Ennead faction.
The Great Spirit of Ennead, who held up this enormous faction, laughed in amusement.
[What is the status of the product?]
“It’s the highest quality. With him, Master can achieve what you want.”
“If it’s Master, you will be able to fully take the 600%-Faith—”
Shweeek!
“?!”
At that moment, something shining fell from the sky. When the item landed on the ground, the eyes of the gods turned round.
“Delivery???”
Sagittarius felt like dying after he had been suddenly shoved into the delivery box. It was Hermes’ delivery service, so Sagittarius knew the parcel wouldn’t be delivered to the wrong place.
‘Why him…’
Since they shared the same Divine status of the sun, this Great Spirit considered Sagittarius a thorn in his side. Moreover, Sagittarius had a target on his back since he had transgressed against the Great Spirit in the past!
Therefore, Sagittarius was trying to find a way to run away.
“This says it’s livestock.”
“Did someone send meat as a present? Open it.”
“Ahhk! No!!!”
The delivery box was opened.
“…???”
“…”
The gods were surprised, wondering why Sagittarius came out of the box.
“Sagittarius?”
“Livestock?”
“Ha ha ha! How have you been, Master of the Fire Wheel?”
As soon as Sagittarius jumped out, an enormous flame that dwarfed him shimmered.
The Great Spirit’s form couldn’t be seen. He slowly smirked in contempt.
[Why were you delivered here as a parcel?]
“It was a mistake…!!”
“Is that so?”
The Great Spirit’s eyes flashed menacingly as he looked at Sagittarius.
[Are you sure you aren’t here to save your Zodiac Saint? You aren’t here to interfere with me?]
“What?”
The Great Spirit smirked in contempt.
[I heard through the grapevine that Pushover was your old Zodiac Saint. You probably heard Pushover is being sold to me, so you are here to sabotage me.]
Sagittarius flinched. His nephew did ask him to run interference, and he knew such actions would be beneficial to his nephew. However…
‘My opponent is a Great Spirit. It’ll just lead me to my death.’
Sagittarius tried to chase the subject. “There is no way I would do such a thing. I was helping Hermes, and I tripped by mistake—”
[Oh, really? Then what is that next to you?]
“What?” Sagittarius was shocked when he looked at his side. His face turned pale from fright.
A disgruntled slime was next to him, and it was tapping itself against Sagittarius.
‘Damn it, nephew! He put it in here!’
In the end, Sagittarius started to sweat. “This child is my Construct. Isn’t it a holiday soon? We must have fallen into a holiday present box.”
[If that’s true, you wouldn’t mind if I go make the transaction.]
“Yes. I plan on heading back—”
At that moment, Lime let out a bright light.
Sagittarius reared back in fright when he realized this was a bomb that had previously blown up a monarch.
‘No!!! Not that! I’ll be declaring war against him if this happens!’
Lime didn’t care. It sent Lee Gun’s bomb flying, which it had swallowed beforehand.
Kwahng!!!!
An incredible light detonated against Ennead.
Sagittarius had faithfully carried out the mission of stalling the Great Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 339
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Drop Shipment (3)
Duat, the world of the dead, was one of the few places in the Divine world that gods avoided. Once a being fell into Duat and became a citizen, its identity didn’t matter. They had to work for Ennead. This included humans and gods. High-rank gods weren’t an exception either.
The guards who kept them in line were the Ammuts. They extracted and ate the hearts of the sinners who ran away. They were the ones who maintained discipline within the underworld.
This was why the Great Spirit looked kindly on them. They were beloved.
‘What? Ingredients?’
Anubis, the messenger of death, was dumbfounded by what he saw. He looked again and again, but the sight of his compatriots groaning with their hide ripped off was still there!
“Bastard! How dare you do this to the gods of Ennead!”
The Serpent Bearer Constructs within Lee Gun’s shadow felt miserable when faced with Anubis’s rage.
‘Ahhhk! Master!’
Although this was better than the afterlife of rebirth, Duat was known for being dreadful within the Divine world.
‘How can he do that to the gods of Duat…!!’
‘Ahh, Master. They aren’t monsters. You did it to gods…!!’
‘You will receive divine punishment!’
Gods never laid hands on the bodies of other gods. They didn’t dare to. This was why Anubis wondered if this was a new type of torture instead of an attempt to gather ingredients.
However, Yooha and Lee Gun diligently picked up the skinned leather that they had chopped up. That wasn’t all.
“Don’t you like alligator meat, Uncle? I heard it’s good for your stamina.”
They planned on using the Ammuts as a food ingredient!
Anubis’s eyes flashed. “How dare you do something so unspeakable! You dare use violence in the holy garden of kings!!”
Lee Gun brushed off his hands as if he had done nothing wrong. “I asked them to tell me the location of Taeksoo, yet they ignored me.”
“What?”
“Don’t worry! Although I skinned them, I didn’t kill them. Since the quality of the ingredients was great, I was thinking about making them into my Constructs.”
The Zodiac Anubis exploded in anger. “Bastard!”
He spoke words of power with murderous intent infused within them. A powerful Divine power exploded forth.
Koo-goohng!!
Yooha’s eyes turned round when she saw this. It was because the surging power felt similar to Lee Gun’s power.
‘Death.’
It was to be expected. Anubis was a god of death that guided the dead. He was the conductor of souls.
[Divine Name: Judge of the Dead]
[Divine Status: Anubis (Zodiac/Construct)]
[Affiliation: Owner of the Underworld (Osiris)]
The power that fiercely surged forth was similar, yet completely different from Lee Gun’s power. This power was capable of turning a clear sky into a night sky.
[Your enemy has released the Divine status of the “Master of the Dead.”]
[Warning! He’s a high-rank god with high Divine status.]
[You cannot withstand it with a low-rank Divine status.]
The warning didn’t seem to be wrong. It was a powerful energy.
However, Lee Gun smirked. He looked at Anubis with contempt. “So you have no intention of taking me to Taeksoo too?”
Anubis’s eyes turned sharp as he burst out laughing. “He’s excellent food. He’s such excellent nourishment that the Zodiacs drool over him.”
Then, the master of the Dead unfurled his arms.
[Summon Laborers of the Underworld (4 star)]
Accompanying the savage energy, spirits were summoned behind him.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Lee Gun’s eyebrows slightly rose when he saw this.
‘Humans?’
No, they were a mixture of low-rank gods. These beings that looked like ghouls were the residents of the underworld.
They looked like dead fish. Their flesh was pale and white, and they looked like spirits that would be dispersed by the wind. Moreover, they numbered in the tens of thousands!
The master of the underworld savagely bared his teeth.
“This is the underworld where even gods lose their power. I’ll make sure you never return to sunlight.”
The next moment, the residents of the underworld started using a particular skill on Lee Gun.
[They are the residents of the underworld.]
[Warning!. They are under the order of the master of the underworld. They are stealing the life and energy of their opponent.]
“Against their numbers, it doesn’t matter if the opponent is a god. They can instantly turn a low-rank god into a mummy.”
“Uncle!” Yooha quickly looked at Lee Gun.
Until now, physical attacks had worked on their opponents. However, this time, their enemies were deceased spirits. Physical damage didn’t work against ghosts.
Of course, Lee Gun knew this, yet he nonchalantly extended his hand as he checked his skills.
[Currently, you are under the penalty of the Divine world.]
[There is a restriction placed on your freedom of movement. Since you are under debt and obligation to do forced labor, your abilities are restricted.]
[Currently, you can use the following abilities.]
[Life: a 3-star ability and two others]
[Death: a 3-star ability and two others]
[???: a 5-star ability and one other]
Lee Gun smirked when he checked which skills were available for use. They would be enough.
Koo-goo-goong!
Yooha forgot to breathe at that moment. It was as if a storm was trying to swallow up the desert.
Anubis smirked. Lee Gun was the owner of Pushover. The deceased spirits would extract vitality from Lee Gun, and Anubis would share it when he had drinks with the other Zodiacs. It would at least be enough to be a snack.
However…
“Uh?”
Anubis flinched at that moment. It was inevitable since the energy of the murderous deceased spirits behind his back instantly disappeared.
Finding it bizarre, Anubis turned his head, but he found out that he wasn’t mistaken. “Where did all the residents go?”
“Where are you looking, idiot? They are here.”
“!!”
Anubis flinched again when he looked at Lee Gun. “Those bastards?!”
The residents summoned by Anubis were all summoned behind Lee Gun. The eyes of the deceased spirits flashed as they stood behind Lee Gun.
[Summon the Dead(2 star) has been used.]
[Summon the Dead (2 star)] (Death)
– Summons souls
– When more Divine power is used, the range from where the dead could be summoned expands. If you have a clue, you can call forth a specific soul.
Summon the Dead was a skill that had appeared when the Divine status of Death had reached stage 2. However, the skills that Lee Gun had used often had turned into abilities when he arrived in the Divine world.
It was merely a guess, but abilities seemed to be higher in rank than skills.
‘One star is the lowest rank, and 5 star is the highest rank.’
That wasn’t all.
[Warning! Magical Energy is a substitute. It’s the Divine power modified specifically for the earth.]
[Warning! In the Divine world, Divine power is used instead of Magical energy.]
[Divine Power: It is the power of a god. It is Divine energy.]
[When Divine Power reaches 0%, you will perish.]
[Current Divine Power of the Serpent Bearer: 70%]
Magical energy was a power filtered so that Divine energy could manifest on the earth. It meant Divine power was the true power of a god.
While he had seen this before, Lee Gun would have had to come to the Divine world at least once anyhow.
After using the power of a god, Lee Gun cracked his knuckles. On the other hand, Anubis was dumbfounded.
‘He used Summon the Dead!’
That was clearly an ability under necromancy!
‘Hmmph. It seems he does possess the Divine status of Death.’
That was how he and his companion could safely enter Duat when this place smelled like the dead.
Soon, Anubis feigned laughter. In the end, Lee Gun was a god on the side of Death.
‘He basically told me his weakness.’
In the underworld, one could make money by renting out the deceased spirits. Therefore, Anubis was well aware of the weakness of the necromancer-type gods, who used the dead spirits.
‘It’s obvious. He summoned the deceased spirits to turn them into his power.’
Anubis smiled. While Lee Gun may have been able to summon them, he had taken the wrong deceased spirits.
‘They are residents directly under the rule of the Owner of the Underworld.’
They were the souls of humans yoked and ruled directly by the king of Duat. Moreover, according to the rules, they couldn’t become anyone else’s underlings while they were yoked to Duat.
“You lost once you summoned them to your side!” As a proxy for the owner of the underworld, Anubis supervised the deceased spirits. His eyes flashed. “Bite into the neck of the snake god!”
The absolute order of Anubis caused the deceased spirits to charge toward Lee Gun, but…
[Return]
When Lee Gun spoke those words, something frightening happened.
Flashed!
A bright light swept up the tens of thousands of deceased spirits surrounding him.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!
The holy light surged up from the god and cleansed the summoned residents.
[You have used the power of stage 5 of Life.]
[With the power of life, you have forcefully revived the dead spirits into living beings.]
“?!!!”
Wait a moment! What the hell did it say? Anubis screamed. However, it was too early to be surprised.
[New flesh has appeared on the body of the dead.]
[Vitality has appeared within the body of the dead.]
[The dead have received yin and yang energy, and they are moving in an energetic manner.]
[The affiliation of the dead has changed.]
[Since they are living, the rules of the underworld no longer work against them.]
In a flash, the dead spirits turned into normal humans.
“What the hell! My body is…!”
“I’m alive!!!”
Anubis’s expression was a sight to behold.
Lee Gun merely smirked. “The orders from the god of the underworld are useless against living beings, right?”
“What?!”
“What would happen if I turned all the residents of this world into living beings?”
Anubis screamed when he heard this. “No!!”
The population of Duat would decrease by the number of people Lee Gun revived.
‘Shit! At this rate, Master will punish me!!’
The dead were considered the assets of the underworld, and they could be lost now. The true ruler of Duat wouldn’t stand still.
This was why Anubis was taken aback.
‘What’s going on? That bastard isn’t a necromancer-type Death god? Why does he have the Divine status of Life, the antithesis of the underworld? Was my information wrong?’
That couldn’t be true.
‘Could it be? Does he have two Divine Statuses?’
Anubis’s shock lasted only a moment.
Koo-goo-goohng!!!
Lee Gun’s red eyes flashed as the revived diseased spirits started a riot.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“You guys tortured us and used us with no regard for us, bastard!”
“We are no longer shackled by Duat!”
The diseased spirits started to destroy the buildings of Duat. They started stealing the fallen Ammuts to sell them.
The flustered Anubis tried to stop them, but it was useless.
[The revived deceased spirits are affiliated with the Serpent Bearer temple. They are destroying Duat.]
“Ahhk!!”
Lee Gun laughed when he saw this. Although he had revived them using a 5-star ability, they were revived humans. Moreover, there were restrictions on the revival.
[Your Divine status is lacking. There is a limit to how long you can maintain their lives. Duration of Life: 239 days]
[Since you are using your 5-star ability, you are consuming a lot of Divine power. You need to recharge it.]
[Current Divine Power: 20%]
Lee Gun scoffed.
‘I just used it once, yet it consumed over 50% of my Divine power.’
This was to be expected since the Zodiacs on the earth had a hard time filling up their Divine power. Of course, Lee Gun had beings under him with faith over 100%, so his Divine power refilled quickly despite him using a lot of it.
‘Is that why they want Taeksoo?’
Well, it didn’t matter.
“No, Owner of the underworld! I didn’t dispose of the residents— Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun grabbed Anubis’s neck as he was talking to someone.
Kwahk!
Angry, Anubis looked at Lee Gun, who was letting out a menacing laugh. “You bastard— Kuh-huhk!!!”
“Lead me to Taeksoo before I turn you into an accessory.”
“Why the hell would I— Kuh-huhk!!”
Bbah-gahk!! Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!
His fists were faster than his words.
* * *
Lee Gun was dragging the bloodied Anubis somewhere.
Anubis wanted to use his power, but he couldn’t because of Lee Gun’s threat.
‘If you get smart with me, I’ll revive all the residents of Duat.’
If Lee Gun caused the entire population of Duat to disappear, it would be a death sentence for Anubis! This was why Anubis gave up on using his powers.
At that moment, they arrived at the entrance of Duat, where the Great Spirit would be receiving his goods. It was an underground city connected to Osiris’s private residence.
Yooha and Lee Gun clearly saw him there.
“Dad!”
“!”
It was a shocking sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 340
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: I’m here for you (1)
It was a shocking sight. Yooha’s eyes turned round at the sight in front of her. It was rare for Lee Gun to blink his eyes in surprise like this.
Their reactions were expected since before them were banquet wine, women, and music. They could see a pond made out of alcohol and a mountainous amount of various meat types and dishes…
“Ah-ha-ha! I don’t want to go back home. This is heaven!!”
“Oh-ho-ho-ho! My dear! Please take this glass too.”
A man was sitting among the gold, jewels, and women…
“I’ll be treated as Gun’s minion if I go back to the human world! Why would I go back? Ha ha ha! This place is the best!”
That crazy bastard was doing this?? Lee Gun became angry.
Yes, Hugo was drinking alcohol and eating meat in front of them. He was having a good time. He also had goddesses by his side!!
“Oh-ho-ho-ho, my dear! Why aren’t you eating as much? We got a lot of great alcohol here.”
“Oh, Pushover god!”
“You have 600% Faith. How is such a thing possible?”
“Please show us the way!!”
Everyone on the earth was currently worried about Hugo.
[He was suddenly dragged away to an unfamiliar world!]
[What if he gets tortured there because he is a human?!]
[Gods are known to be cruel…!]
However, the idea of him being tortured after being kidnapped was bullshit.
“Pantheon is the best! I’ll live here for the rest of my life!!!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned fierce. “What nonsense is this….”
A violent murderous intent emanated from his body. It was the power of Death, which he had suppressed when he reached the Divine world! “I went through hell to get here, yet he’s having a good time with women?”
Anubis, who had been dragged along by Lee Gun, was surprised to see this. He screamed. “Stop! The palace will be destroyed! This is what I told you!! Pushover doesn’t want to go back home…!”
Anubis had already warned Lee Gun multiple times while being dragged along. He said it would be useless even if Lee Gun went to Hugo!
“He has 600% Faith. There is no way we’ll treat him poorly— Kuhk!!!”
Lee Gun stepped on Anubis, who was flapping his mouth.
When Yooha saw her dad having a good time amongst women, she was about to step forward. Unexpectedly, Lee Gun gestured at her to forget it. He stopped her.
“Uncle?”
“Your father isn’t a degenerate like that. I’m sure Hades did something. He might have lost his memories.”
“!”
Amongst Hades’ abilities was a technique called River of Lethe (Forgetfulness). This was something Lee Gun had guessed might happen.
“There is a chance that he’ll try to run away. There is no way Hades would sell Hugo without erasing his memories.”
“Then…!”
“Let’s wait a bit. At this point, I think it’ll be useless even if we take him by force. Let’s be calm and explain the situation first…”
“Ah! Who was my previous owner? He was called Lee Gun. He was a narcissist who was full of himself. He was a masochist virgin— Kuh-poo-huhk!!!!”
“Kyaaaaa!!”
Lee Gun instantly flew through the air to kick Hugo. The thought that he had suggested Yooha a moment ago was nowhere to be found. Lee Gun went crazy as he stomped on Hugo.
“What the hell did you just say? I’m a narcissist who’s full of myself? I’m a perverted masochist? You called me a bad-tempered bald kid?? You want to die?”
“K-Kuh-huhk! Why are you adding more words to what I said— Kuh-huhk!”
The surprised servants quickly tried to grab Lee Gun, but it was useless.
Kwahk
Lee Gun lifted Hugo by the scruff of his neck. “Whatever. Let’s go home, asshole!”
At that moment…
“What are you doing?”
One of the male gods serving Hugo made a gesture with his hand, and something surprising happened.
Ooh-kong!
“!”
A circle appeared under Lee Gun and Yooha, and a deep hole formed beneath them.
[It’s a tunnel that leads outside of Duat.]
[You are being banished.]
After falling into the hole, Lee Gun and Yooha were about to be sent outside of Duat.
However, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. In a flash, he held Yooha in his arms to jump out of the hole.
The Constructs were surprised by his incredible speed.
Lee Gun angrily looked at Hugo. The look in his eyes hadn’t changed at all despite his daughter and his best friend being in danger just a moment ago.
Hugo coldly said, “I’ll ask them to open a way out of the underworld. Go back. Don’t interfere with what I’m doing.”
Lee Gun’s face hardened. “You really want to live here?”
“It is none of your business. Also, a replacement for me should have been sent to you, right?”
“…!”
“Also, why are you here in the first place?” Hugo laughed as if he was dumbfounded. “I even wrote a letter saying you shouldn’t come here. Did you not understand what I was saying?”
Lee Gun didn’t speak when he heard those words. He scoffed. “Huh.”
His already-limited patience seemed to have come to an end. As proof of this, Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “I see. I have no choice if that’s what you want.”
“Yes. You finally understand what I’m saying. Give my regards to everyone—”
“I’ll head back after I kill you.”
“?!!”
Bbah-gahk!!!!
Lee Gun’s fist landed on Hugo’s face. Then, Lee Gun let out a frightening laugh. “If I can’t take you back, let’s just have your funeral here instead.”
“What— Poo-huhk!! Ahhhhk!!”
Lee Gun struck Hugo as if he were beating up a monster.
Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!
The gods of Duat screamed as though they were watching something unspeakable.
“Kyhhk!”
“Pushover-nim!”
Lee Gun didn’t hold back at all. He was using his power as if he didn’t care if his opponent was a human or a monster.
The only reason Hugo was able to endure the beating was that Lee Gun was controlling his power.
If he killed Hugo instantly, Hugo wouldn’t be able to feel pain. This was why he refrained just enough so that Hugo didn’t immediately fall unconscious. He was beating Hugo to give him maximum pain.
Hugo’s consciousness started to fade, and he became panic-stricken.
‘Damn it! This is completely different from what I was told!’
While this being looked like Hugo, he was an Olympus Construct wearing Hugo’s appearance. He was here under Hades’s orders. He had to pretend to be Hugo and fool all the gods gathered here.
Moreover, he was ordered to tell the snake god to go back home if he came looking for Hugo.
Of course, sending back a god wouldn’t be hard. He just had to wound the snake god’s pride, and the snake god would go back.
“Ok. I understand. You can die here if you don’t want to go. You have no right to see Miss Jiwoo and Sungjae.”
“Koo-huhk! Koo-huh-huhk! Kuhk! Ggoo-ehhk!!”
At this rate, the Olympus Construct would die before the transaction could take place! The Construct vomited blood. He had never expected the snake god to say he’d kill Hugo. The gods who had put Hugo’s appearance on him had placed protective power around his body. This included Hades!
‘Damn it! He is breaking the barrier?’
Something more problematic had to be addressed before that.
‘What kind of psycho beats up his best friend like this!!’
The Construct was sure Lee Gun was letting his rage consume him. There was no reasoning with him.
At this point, Hades’s Construct desperately clutched at Lee Gun. He was supposed to keep his mouth shut, but the Construct realized he might die if things continued. “E-Excuse me!! I have something important to tell you—!”
He was about to say that he was a fake. At the very least, it would let Lee Gun regain his reason!
“Excuse me! I’m a fake!!”
“I know, idiot!!!”
“?!!!”
The shocked Construct screamed as if he felt aggrieved. “Then why are you hitting me?”
“It’s pissing me off that you said those words with that face!!”
What the hell!!!
Lee Gun’s deadly fist, which had sent Red Eye flying before, flew toward the Construct.
Kwahng!!!
Lee Gun’s power was too strong as the protective power around the Construct shattered.
Kwah-jee-jeek!
“K-Kuh-huhk…!”
That wasn’t all.
“Kyahhhk!!! Who the hell is this?”
“Where did Pushover-nim go?”
When Lee Gun beat up the Construct to a pulp, the Construct shed skin shaped like Hugo. It was the Hugo mask that the Construct had been wearing.
With the makeover reversed, the Construct’s true face was revealed.
The Constructs of Duat were shocked at this sight.
“What the hell! He’s a fake?!”
They were the Constructs who had been serving Pushover. Aside from being surprised, they were also angry.
Yooha, who had been in the distance, was also stunned by what she had witnessed.
On the other hand, Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose in anger as he shook off the blood on his fists. “There is no way Hugo will badmouth me when he is drunk.”
The surprised Yooha asked as she approached Lee Gun, “Then the letter written by Dad that Uncle saw…”
She wanted to ask if it was fake.
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. “No. That was Taeksoo’s penmanship.”
Lee Gun recognized Hugo’s penmanship. It was also why he was pissed.
“Everyone fell for it because he’s wearing this.”
“Ahhk!!”
Lee Gun took a familiar wristwatch from the Construct’s wrist.
This surprised Yooha. “It’s the watch that Dad always wore since a long time ago…”
Although it was used as the badge of the Sagittarius temple, this was a precious item that he had received from someone in the past.
Lee Gun put away the watch as he got up.
As he did so, Yooha found an item fallen near his feet. “Something is under you, Uncle…”
Lee Gun immediately destroyed the item using Death.
‘!’
It was the Hugo mask, which had fallen off the Construct’s face.
Lee Gun’s expression became frosty. Although he had only glanced at it, he recognized it. He realized where the mask had originated, and he could tell if it was the real deal or not.
They had created the perfect disguise using the mask and the watch. It was good enough to fool the gods.
“Where is Taeksoo?”
“!”
Lee Gun’s cold voice pierced through the Construct and the gods of Ennead. “I’m pretty sure I heard a sound nearby, but I can’t pinpoint the location.”
Anubis, who had been dragged here by Lee Gun, desperately tried to run away through the door when he heard that.
Kwahng!!
“Koohk!!”
The surging energy of Death pressed down on Anubis. “Where are you going, doggie?”
“…!!”
Anubis gritted his teeth when Death captured him. He had brought Lee Gun to this place for a reason.
‘They were supposed to finish the transaction while I buy time. Is the transaction still ongoing?’
Anubis had immediately alerted his superior when Lee Gun had come knocking. Since Lee Gun’s target was Hugo, Anubis was supposed to keep Lee Gun busy. While he did so, Hugo would quickly be transported to Ennead. Lee Gun would be unable to go there since it was a sealed region!
‘Maybe, the deal hasn’t been finalized yet?’
However, a problem had to be addressed before that.
‘Sound?’
The transaction was supposed to happen on the lowest floor of the palace, the labyrinth. Was it possible that Lee Gun could hear the sound emanating from there? However, Anubis’s surprise lasted only a moment.
“Oh, Messenger of Death. It seems the deal hasn’t even started yet.”
Anubis was dumbfounded when his underling whispered to him. “Why hasn’t the deal gone through yet? The transaction should have started a long time ago!”
“For some reason, the Great Spirit has yet to arrive…!”
Anubis was taken aback. The Great Spirit was always on time. So what happened?
Kwahk!!
“Take me to the place where the transaction is taking place before I dismantle you.”
“There is no way I’ll tell you— Kuhk!!”
When Lee Gun grabbed Anubis’s neck, Anubis’s canine face ceased to exist because of the power of Death. It changed to the face of a human. Moreover, Anubis’s armaments were dismissed by force.
At that moment…
“Gun!”
The gods within Anubis’s shadow sounded flustered when a voice rang somewhere.
[I’m sorry! He suddenly started going berserk at the trading place!]
“What? Stop him right n—”
Lee Gun instantly disappeared.
* * *
While Lee Gun was at the Osiris palace, Hugo was located on the lowest floor.
“Ooh-oop!”
Hugo was at the trading place, being pressed down by the gods. The Constructs were sweating as they were barely able to hold down Hugo.
It was expected since Hugo was a very powerful Construct. Exhausting him was a colossal task.
“Why the hell is he suddenly trying to escape?”
“He was quiet for a while, so why…!!”
“Ooohp!”
