A bandage was wrapped around Hugo’s face to shut him up.
“What’s going on? What happened while I was gone?” Hades returned after going outside for a moment. He furrowed his brow as he looked at Hugo. “Did the product do something?”
“No, it’s nothing. It seems he doesn’t want to be sold. For some unknown reason, he went berserk when he heard a sound coming from above…”
Hades snorted as he sat down. “So, when will the Great Spirit of Ennead be here?”
Hades sat down, seeming to be in a foul mood. It was only normal since he had gone into debt. He had to pay for the damages caused by Lee Gun. He also had to pay taxes to the Divine world soon. His home and body were close to being sold to pay the debt.
This was why the completion of the deal was his highest priority.
“Time is gold. I cannot waste any more time. When will he be here?”
“For some unknown reason, our communication with the Great Spirit has been severed… However, the master of the underworld said he’ll come here as a proxy.”
“Ah. I see!”
It didn’t matter if another god came. So Hades was about to speak up.
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhhk!!”
A scream rang out within the trading place. All the gods within the trading place, including Hades, were surprised.
“Who is it?”
Hugo flinched as he started to tremble. The reason was the familiar voice.
“I’m here for you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 341
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: I’m here for you (2)
“I’m here for you.”
It was a voice he had missed. He had thought he would never hear that voice again. Hugo felt himself relax.
On the other hand, Hades looked dumbfounded.
‘Why is he here again?’
Of course, Hades planned on settling his grudge against Lee Gun. If he didn’t catch and kill Lee Gun, the Great Spirit of Olympus as well as Kunlun and Valhalla would try to kill him. However, things were different right now.
‘I planned on getting rid of him within the territory of Ennead.’
That wasn’t the only shocking part.
‘Eco!’
The problem was the male god, who Lee Gun had caught. To fool the eyes of the other gods, a minion of Hades had been transformed into Hugo. Hades glared when he saw the transformation undone.
‘What the hell? How the hell did he get caught?’
His reaction was understandable since Eco had gone through a special transformation. Hugo’s face had been skinned, and the power of the Olympus gods had been borrowed to perfect the disguise.
So how did Lee Gun find out?
Eco clenched his eyes. He felt aggrieved at being caught.
‘What kind of person praises his friend when he gets drunk!!! That makes no sense!!!’
Wasn’t it normal to disparage the friend? Eco, who had stolen Hugo’s watch in greed, shed tears.
“Gun!”
When Lee Gun heard the voice of the man he had been looking for, he turned his head immediately. “Taek—”
Murderous intent appeared on Lee Gun’s face as soon as he turned his head. Hugo was being pressed down and restrained by three Constructs. However, that wasn’t important right now. The problem was the bandages covering Hugo’s face.
“Those maggots…” Lee Gun’s voice turned fierce.
While he had seen the mask on the upper floor, he hadn’t seen how it was made.
It seemed Hugo hadn’t received decent medical treatment. His bandages were mottled with blood.
When they saw Lee Gun’s spirit, the Constructs wearing the golden armor quickly raised their spears.
“Protect the product!”
“Get rid of the intruder!”
However, the Constructs restraining Hugo couldn’t speak. Lee Gun had instantly disappeared and reappeared in front of them!
“Huhk…!”
Faced with Lee Gun, the Constructs almost stopped breathing.
Death emanated from Lee Gun’s face, and he didn’t look like a human or a god.
‘Monster!’
He looked like a monster that ate gods.
When Lee Gun swung his hand, the Constructs beside Hugo were ripped apart.
[Eliminate]
It was the power of Death, the power that allowed Lee Gun to rip apart monsters with his bare hands at times.
When he swung his hand, the power of Death destroyed the armor and the protective abilities of his enemies.
Poo-hahk!!!
His enemies were instantly ripped apart.
“K…Kuh-huhk!!”
Two of them fell, and the last one fell on his butt.
“N-No way!”
The Construct didn’t even have the presence of mind to swing his spear.
‘There is no way I would be unaware of a god of this caliber.’
The Construct had felt this level of power before, but that had been from high-rank gods. No, it might have been a level of power given off by the Great Spirits.
Ssuh-guhk!!
“Koo-ahhk!!”
Hugo unsheathed the sword on the Construct’s waist and decapitated him.
“Gun! Are you ok?”
When Hugo’s voice got closer, Death, which was wrapped around Lee Gun, retreated a bit.
Lee Gun clicked his tongue when he saw that Hugo had become a mummy. “What the hell happened to your face?”
“Ah…”
“It’s fine. Let’s head back after I fix it.” Lee Gun extended his hand and tried using Super Regeneration.
“There is no way you’ll run away with the product.”
“!”
Boom!!
An enormous power detonated within the trading place.
Koo-goo-goong!
The ground shook as someone stepped on the ground.
“Is it you who rattled Olympus? Are you the problem child who stepped onto Duat with your sullied feet?”
“!!!”
Everyone was surprised by the appearance of the humanoid figure. He was the great Zodiac who ruled over Duat. He was the owner of the underworld, who possessed the Divine status of Osiris.
The great Zodiac was already angry at Lee Gun for stealing the residents of the underworld. He considered the residents his assets. The Zodiac let out his Divine status as if he was about to attack Lee Gun. “What did you do to my residents?”
“That’s not important right now!” Hades glared at the owner of the underworld. “I need you to settle the balance first. You can kill him after we complete our deal!”
“What nonsense are you talking about? In the first place, you were the one to bring him. That’s what caused all the strife. In fact, I should probably ask for damage compensation!”
Hades looked dumbfounded as his eyes flashed. “Alright. Let’s cancel this deal— Koohk!!”
At that moment, an attack shut Hades up.
Kwahng!!
“Koo-oohk!!”
“Kuhk!”
It was Lee Gun. After sending the power of Death toward Hades, Lee Gun checked his skills.
– Currently available abilities:
– Life Ability (3/8)
[Pain Creation (3 star)], [Return (4 star)], [Return 2 (5 star)]
– Death Ability (3/8)
[Eliminate (1 star)], [Reaper Summon (2 star)], [Cycle (5 star) Requirement not satisfied]
– <???> Ability (2/6)
[Gaze of a God (1 star)], [Death Instinct (4 star)]
Lee Gun smirked when he saw this. Was it because Sagittarius had worked hard to appease the Divine world? Or was someone settling his debt for him?
‘The number of abilities I can use has increased from before.’
Despite this, his opponent was a high-rank Zodiac. Fighting him without any weapons would be hard. Lee Gun was at a disadvantage, yet he didn’t care at all.
“Listen to me well. You will be my cudgel.”
“Ooh-ahhk! What are you saying? Let me go!”
Lee Gun lifted Anubis like a cudgel. Anubis looked like a piece of meat tied to a stick used for bbq. He was an excellent blunt weapon. However, it didn’t end there.
With a savage look in his eyes, Lee Gun lifted Eco. “You will be my shield.”
“Ahhhk!! Why am I the shield?”
“Why else? Taeksoo became my shield as a friend. You dare imitate him despite not being able to do that?”
“Hey! What kind of psycho uses his friend as a shield?”
Hugo massaged his forehead when he was hit with reality.
Osiris and Hades merely scoffed.
“He’s merely a buff-type god!”
If he possessed the power of Life, he was merely a healer-type god!
Lee Gun smirked when Osiris and Hades used their powers.
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhhk!!”
Lee Gun used Anubis and Eco to block the gods’ attacks.
Kwahng!! Kwahng!
Anubis and Eco lost consciousness when they received direct hits from their superiors’ attacks.
Osiris and Hades scoffed when they saw Lee Gun charging toward them.
“Do you think such a shallow trick would work—”
At that moment…
“!!”
They flinched in surprise as they watched Lee Gun.
[Death Instinct (4 star)]
– Max-attack ability unleashed. It can be used until Divine power reaches 0%
The gods’ eyes went wide when they saw a bright light starting to encircle Lee Gun.
“Wait a moment. That power…!”
“Isn’t that the power of a fighting type god— Kuhk!!”
Lee Gun instantly disappeared. His speed couldn’t be compared to before, as he sent both gods flying at once.
Kwahng!!!
Osiris ground his teeth when he crashed into a wall. Gods came in many varieties: fighting gods, punishment gods, wealth gods, luck gods, etc.
Amongst all of them, the strongest were the fighting-type gods. Among them was a rare and valuable subset, called the war gods, who were at the pinnacle.
It was a rare position for which one needed skills as well as achievements! This was why Death Instinct was a top-ten skill that proved that one was a war god! A rookie god shouldn’t possess this power.
‘There is one amongst the Great Spirits who is called the war god!’
However, the gods soon smirked. While that ability was powerful enough to be revered, it had a clear downside.
“It’s a double-edged sword, since that skill consumes a massive amount of energy.”
“How will he be able to withstand the massive amount of Divine power being consumed?”
Divine power was the energy that allowed gods to use their abilities. When it reached 0%, it signaled instant death.
As proof of this, the light around Lee Gun’s body was dimming.
[Divine power left: 8%]
“This is the end for you!”
Then…
“Taeksoo! I suffered a lot looking for you! I’ll take you from here even if I have to give up my life!” Lee Gun suddenly shouted out of the blue.
“????”
The gods assumed he was uttering his last words. However, something surprising happened.
[A disciple with high faith has been deeply moved. There has been an explosion of faith.]
[Your divine power has recharged through the prayer of the disciple.]
[Divine power: 80%]
At this sudden surge in Lee Gun’s power, the expressions on the two god’s faces were a sight to behold. They wondered how such a thing was possible.
On the other hand, Lee Gun had experienced what 600% faith could do on the earth. This was why he let out a savage laugh. “You should be worried about yourselves instead of me.”
“…?!”
He immediately disappeared. Then, he violently struck Osiris and Hades.
Kwahng!!
“Kuhk!”
“Koo-ahk!”
The two gods struck and became embedded in the wall.
Lee Gun quickly canceled Death Instinct and rushed toward Hugo. “I have business here. You should head up first. Yooha came here too. She wanted to see her father.”
“Yooha?”
“Hmmph! You think too lowly of the gods of the underworld.”
“!”
The bloodied Hades barely stood back up. “It seems you must have fought a lot when you were a human. You were able to acquire the right to use Death Instinct, but there are things that a war god can and cannot do.”
“!”
When he heard Hades’s words, Lee Gun furrowed his brows. He cracked his knuckles as if to dismiss Hades’ words. However, he soon realized something. “Hey, Taeksoo. Did you eat something while you were here?”
Hades had an ability called “Rule of the Underground world.” It was said to be an unforgiving ability.
In other words, the ability prevented anyone who had eaten the food of the underworld from leaving this place. Persephone had eaten a mere three pomegranate seeds, yet she couldn’t completely return to the living world.
This was why the Virgo Constructs had given Lee Gun a firm warning before he had left the earth.
Lee Gun raised his eyebrows. “Did you eat something because you were hungry?”
“Do you think I’m you? I didn’t even lay my hands on water after I came here!”
“I didn’t think you would do something like that, but…”
Still unsteady on his feet, Hades laughed. “Yes. You didn’t eat anything, but I did plant something in you!”
“!”
As soon as Hades spoke, Hugo vomited blood.
Lee Gun flinched in surprise as he grabbed his friend. Hades’s ability activated at that moment.
[Three Seeds of the Pomegranate (5 star)]
– Anyone who falls within its range will become Hades’s subject. You will not be able to exit the underworld.
– You will become a Construct under Hades
Accompanying an incredible light, a strange magic circle appeared under the entirety of Duat. This time, Anubis and Osiris were shocked. After all, Hades’s ability influenced them too.
“Wait a moment! What are you doing?”
“Hades! That ability traps a living being within the underworld!”
“That ability should have been used only on Pushover and the snake god! So why?”
Hades burst out laughing. “Stupid gods of Ennead! That old-fashioned ability was my father’s ability. That ability was slightly changed when I succeeded him!”
“What?”
“I planned on using it after Pushover went over to your territory, but it doesn’t matter now.”
“!”
“It’s a shame that the Great Spirit didn’t get caught in it, but you guys will be beneficial to me during the Great Spirit war.”
Osiris was a pillar of Ennead. Anubis was a high-rank god. Then there was Lee Gun. Their presence would be excellent for Hades.
“Thank you for showing off your skills, Snake god. You can use your surprising power as a fighting-type god for me!”
Having been stabbed in the back, the gods of Ennead glared at Hades.
“Bastard! You never planned on going through with the deal! You dare cheat Ennead?”
“Haha. Duat is first!”
Flash!
Lee Gun narrowed his eyes at the flashing light.
[Warning! Hades activated his ability.]
[Warning! You are being forced to become Hades’ Construct.]
The powerful ability of the underworld god seized all the gods within Duat.
“Ahhhk!! Master!”
All the gods of Duat were dragged into Hades’s shadow.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
Even Anubis was no exception.
All of them were being forcefully changed into Hades’s Constructs!
To accomplish this, Hades had pretended to make a deal about Hugo. He had used it to his advantage.
Hades would receive money, and when Hugo went over to the other side, Hade would have activated his ability to turn the entire force of Ennead into his Constructs!
Of course, whether he could make a Great Spirit into a Construct was not confirmed, but Hades was a shrewd god.
Anubis having been dragged away meant that he had constructed a new power
Kwah-jeek!
That power had paralyzed Lee Gun’s body, who was caught by Hades’s shadow too.
“Do not be disappointed, snake god. If you stay under me, you will be able to see me reach the unexplored territory called stage 6. You will see me use it as your master”
Lee Gun jeered. What the hell did he say?
“Stage 6?”
At that moment, Lee Gun twitched his hands.
Flash!
Hades flinched at the light emanating from Lee Gun’s body. At the same time, Lee Gun heard a welcoming sound.
[Virgo has paid off a portion of the Serpent Bearer’s debt.]
[A portion of the Divine world’s penalty has been released.]
[You can partially use your sealed skills and abilities.]
Lee Gun smirked when he heard the voice. He had wondered why the Virgo had been silent up to this point. But it didn’t matter in the end.
Lee Gun laughed when he saw one of the skills that had been released.
[This is my power (Name Before Modification: Praise Your Father)]
– Skill made by the thirteenth original owner. Seals the berserk Divine statuses. It can temporarily lower them to stage 5.
– Fuck Off (Name Before Modification: I Love You Dad)
– If you shout I Love You Dad, Limit Cancel status will activate. You will be able to use stage 6
“Fuck Off.”
Lee Gun’s stage 6 Divine statuses were released.

chapters.title: Chapter 342
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Messed with the wrong guy (1)
“Fuck off!”
When Lee Gun spoke the words, the Divine world immediately trembled.
Koohng!
Getting an ominous feeling, Hades instinctively put more strength into the ability he was using. He tried to make Lee Gun his Construct before Lee Gun could do anything. However, Lee Gun was faster.
Koo-goong!
“!!!”
When Lee Gun unleashed his power, the shadow of the underworld tying him up like a rope was instantly obliterated.
Pahng!!
Hades was sent flying by the pressure.
“Koo-oohk!”
Hades raised his gaze and froze. The reason was Lee Gun’s appearance.
Lee Gun walked toward Hades without any weapon in hand, yet he looked completely different. Half of his body had turned into a bizarre shadow, which was burning like a flame. It was a terrifying flame, looking at it was gazing at pure destruction. Then, the burning shadow raged violently as if it would swallow up the castle.
Koo-goo-goohng!
The enormous power shook the palace of Osiris, and Lee Gun continued walking forward in a terrifying manner.
[What about stage 6?]
“Ah… Ah!”
[I will kill you.]
Monstrous eyes flashed within the shadowy half of Lee Gun’s body, almost making Hades scream.
‘What the hell is that?’
Anubis and Osiris shook from fear.
‘Wait a moment. That is…!!’
It was unbelievable, but there was no mistaking it.
Stage 5 was the maximum level of Divine status that the gods were able to evolve to. The Divine status on display was a step above that. It was an uncharted level!
‘Stage 6!’
A level that none of the Zodiacs had reached!
‘This is impossible. Even the Great Spirits can barely manifest that domain!’
Stage 6 was a monstrous domain that could make millions of Zodiacs yield. It was a domain that even the Great Spirits had a hard time handling, so it had been sealed. So how was that bastard able to….!
‘No. That isn’t important right now.’
Hades instinctively felt the danger, so he quickly raised his Divine power.
‘I’ll take Duat, then I can leave this place!’
If he couldn’t turn Lee Gun into his Construct, he would have to be satisfied with the gods of Duat!
Koo-goohng!
Hades accelerated the already active skill of the Three Seeds of the Pomegranate. Osiris and Anubis, who were tied up by the shadows, started to scream.
“Ahhhk!”
“You’re a despicable and underhanded bastard!”
The energy surrounding them instantly changed.
[The Master of the Underworld and the Master of the Underworld Road have become the Construct of Hades.]
[The residents of Duat have become affiliates under Hades.]
Hades laughed after achieving his goal. He was about to move to his territory within the underworld, Tartarus, when…
Kwahng!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
[Where are you running away?]
Lee Gun violently grabbed the head of Hades, who had been trying to run away. He clutched Hades’s head as if he wanted to crush it, then slammed it into the floor!
Kwahng!!
Hades almost lost consciousness. He tried to escape from Lee Gun’s grasp, but Lee Gun had released his stage 6 Divine status and was too strong.
It was Death stage 6. This Divine status had long surpassed Hades’s Land of the Dead Divine status.
Therefore, Hades desperately increased his Divine power to escape Lee Gun’s grasp.
Poo-hahk!!
“Ahhhhk!”
He was about to manifest his ability through his arm, but before he could do that, his arm was ripped away. Blood fountained out of him. Then Lee Gun ripped away Hades’s legs for trying to run away.
Poo-hahk!!
“Koo-oohk-oohk!”
Hades groaned in pain as he glared at Lee Gun.
Lee Gun roughly grabbed Hades by his face.
[So you’re the one who ripped away my friend’s face?]
The powerful grip dug in as if it wanted to rip away the god’s skin.
[I’ll rip away your face just like what you did to him.]
When Lee Gun put power into his hands, a scream rang out. The sounds of muscles being severed rang out as Hades clutched at his face. No, he couldn’t even touch his face.
As soon as his hand touched the peeled skin, an indescribable pain caused shrieks to emanate from his throat.
“You crazy bastard!!!” Hades bared his teeth as he activated his power.
[Master of the Land of the Dead has activated his Divine Achievement.]
[My Father’s Power is Mine (5 star)]
This was a special power. It was a bit different from the abilities used by the other gods. The moment the power was activated, changes started occurring in Lee Gun’s body.
[The power of the achievement that your opponent established is stealing away your Divine power.]
[Your power is being stolen.]
[Divine Power: 50%]
[Divine Power: 10%]
It was a stage 6 power. Just maintaining it drastically cut away at his Divine power. And now, Hades almost caused the stage 6 power to disappear.
Because of that, Lee Gun shouted, “Hey, Taeksoo! In truth, I really think highly of your skills. You know this, right? You’re my only partner!”
[Your disciple with high faith is moved.]
[Divine Power: 60%]
Lee Gun laughed as he continued to rip apart Hades’s body.
Boo-hahk!!!
However, the Divine power didn’t last long.
[Divine Power: 12%]
Lee Gun shouted again, “Hey, Taeksoo! You shoot the bow much better than I do! You are the best!”
[Divine Status: 70%]
“Hey, Taeksoo! You might not know this, but I made a scrapbook containing all your achievements!”
[Divine Power: 80%]
“Hey, Taeksoo!! In terms of personality, kindheartedness, and appearance, I’m like your big brother, right?”
[Divine Power: 79.9%]
“What the hell? Why did it go down?!!”
It didn’t matter in the end.
Boo-hahk!! Boo-hahk!!
Lee Gun’s Divine Power was getting recharged endlessly. He laughed as he ripped apart Hades’s skin.
[Ha ha ha! Die, you son of a bitch!]
Hades felt like he was losing his mind from the frustration.
‘That bastard…!’
Divine Power was the energy of the gods, and it couldn’t be refilled easily. It wasn’t like water.
Even if a god ate and rested for a year, merely 5% of their Divine power could be recharged.
This was why one had to drink Divine world’s exclusive potions or use all kinds of methods by working the Constructs. The gods had to work very hard to raise even 1% of their Divine Power!!
“That damn bastard is like a battery!”
Hades tried to kill Hugo. Hugo was the culprit that was allowing Lee Gun to run amok. Hades didn’t care if Hugo was a product to be sold. He didn’t have the luxury to quibble about such a thing. If Hugo were eliminated, Lee Gun would be unable to run amok like a mad dog!
Although not much was left of Hades’s body, the god still gathered the last amount of his Divine power to kill Hugo. He created a clone.
If he killed Hugo, he would stand a chance. At the very least, it’d create an opportunity. However…
Poo-hahk!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
A spear flew through the air to pierce Hades’s neck. The spear had come flying from the entrance.
It was Yooha, who had come down from upstairs. She glared at Hades with rage-filled eyes.
In the end, the clone disappeared, and Hades could only choke after having the spear pierce his neck.
Lee Gun approached Hades, emanating chaotic energy. He let out a menacing laugh.
Hades’s eyes turned bloodshot as he looked at Lee Gun. He seemed to know what was about to come.
Kwah-jeek!!
Lee Gun’s hand pierced through Hades’s chest. He wanted to take out the core that contained Hades’s Divine status.
Like what he had done with the other 12 Zodiacs, Lee Gun could steal Hades’s Divine status.
Lee Gun’s eyes curved in laughter after he shoved his hand into the chest.
[Ah! I have such bad luck with guessing locations. I guess it wasn’t here.]
“Kuh-huhk…!?”
[Since my skill is locked, I can’t find it in one go.]
It seemed Lee Gun wanted revenge for Hugo. He purposefully stabbed all over Hades’s body.
Poo-oohk!
He violently twisted, swirled, and pulled within Hades’s body.
The pain was enormous even for a god. Hades choked in pain as he tried to grab Lee Gun’s arm. However, an appendage of Lee Gun containing Death was within Hades’s body.
Hades’s abilities were erased whenever he tried to use his power. This was the power of Eliminate.
Some time passed like that.
[Ah! I finally found it.]
“…!!!”
Lee Gun took out Hades’s core, whose location he had known from the start.
Poo-hahk!!
“Huh-huhk…!”
Without his core, Hades couldn’t breathe. He fell to the ground. His body struggled from the pain, and he started crawling away.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he stomped on the god.
Kwahng!!
An incredible light surged upward.
[You have eliminated the Owner of the Land of the Dead.]
[A Divine Achievement has been recorded.]
Osiris and Anubis froze at this scene.
‘What is he? That is…!!’
Hades was a famous figure in Olympus, and Olympus was one of the eight great forces! He ranked in the top hundred in the Divine world, yet Lee Gun had killed him as though Hades were a bug?
However, they soon shook their heads from side to side.
‘This is good for us.’
Hades had used an underhanded method to turn them into his Constructs. They were the rare pillar gods of Ennead. Ennead would suffer damage if they became underlings of Olympus.
‘Since the owner of the Land of the Dead is no more, the power placed on us should disappear…’
It should disappear….
“What the hell? Why isn’t it disappearing?”
The gods of Duat couldn’t use their power. They screamed.
“Hades is dead, so why?”
“What the hell? Why are we still Hades’s Constructs?”
The Serpent Bearer Constructs discreetly poked their heads out of Lee Gun’s shadow when they heard the screams of despair. They whispered to Lee Gun.
[Master, you took Hades’s Divine status… Were they transferred to you?]
[What? That means the Master of the Underworld and the Master of the Underworld Road have become Master’s Constructs?]
When he heard their whispers, Lee Gun laughed evilly. “They are my Constructs now?”
“What did you just say?!!”
Osiris and Anubis turned pale when they finished assessing their situation.
“No! No way! Wait a moment. This isn’t it!”
“Ok. Their names are…”
“Ahhhk!!!”
The gods of Ennead clutched their heads.
* * *
Hades’s Construct Eco and the gods of Duat felt faint. It was for no other reason.
‘A god of Olympus was killed.’
‘Moreover, a low-rank god killed a high-rank god!’
‘The Divine world will be in an uproar if this news gets out!’
The bound owners of Duat felt faint for an entirely different reason.
‘Ahhhk!! We became the Snake god’s Constructs!!’
‘Ahhhk! That’s right! We weren’t released as Hades’s Constructs, and his Divine status was taken by that bastard!!’
‘That means the ownership exchanged hands!!’
‘That is correct!!’
‘Shit! What the hell is this!!’
The low-rank gods didn’t matter, but Osiris and Anubis were the pillar gods of Ennead. They were high-rank gods. This was why they were losing their mind. The core power of Ennead had become Constructs of an unknown, low-rank god!!
‘This makes no sense!’
‘He’s a hatchling!’
On the other hand, Lee Gun ignored them. He was going through Hades’s wealth.
He used the Duat palace’s system to put Hades’s Divine status up on the Auction House.
[Welcome to the Auction House.]
[The information of the item you wish to sell will be analyzed.]
The extracted core of Hades was put on top of the odd machine’s table. It worked on its own as a hologram popped up.
[Material wealth and manpower possessed by Divine status Hades are being pulled up.]
Countless pieces of information appeared through the hologram, and Lee Gun used his Constructs to analyze the data.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed when he saw the content. “This bastard was rich. I thought he was in debt, yet he possessed a lot of things.”
If Lee Gun were to absorb the Divine status, everything, including the debt, would be transferred to the Serpent Bearer temple.
Moreover, Hades could be reborn using the inheritance or he could be turned into a weapon…
“It doesn’t matter. That bastard is no longer important.”
“Ahhhk!! No! This is a very important problem!!”
Osiris and Anubis were about to lose their minds.
“Release us, Snake god!”
“We will reward you— Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun kicked them to shut them up, then headed toward Hugo.
Yooha had finally reunited with her father. She clung to him as she sniffled.
Lee Gun extended his hand toward Hugo. “Let’s fix your face first.”
He immediately tried to use Super Regeneration, but the regeneration ability didn’t activate. “Tsk! It seems I still have some debt left, so not enough of the penalties were removed.”
When Lee Gun furrowed his brows, Hugo merely let out a light sigh. “It’s fine. You don’t have to fix me. I finally understand what you felt twenty years ago. My face isn’t that important—”
“Idiot! There is nothing left if you don’t have your face.”
“W—What did you just say?!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. He could put Hades’s face on Hugo, but Hades was ugly according to his standards.
“Sagittarius… He’s annoying, but useful. I can’t use him.”
“You should give me a mask for now….”
“Fuck off with that, idiot. Miss Jiwoo and your third child will faint if they see your face.”
“That isn’t—”
“Whatever! Come out, Disinfectant.”
Lee Gun immediately summoned Iaso, the goddess of healing. Iaso used her powerful healing ability to grow new flesh on Hugo’s face.
“Oh…!”
The regenerated face still had a lot of scars, but Hugo no longer looked like a model for human anatomy.
“This is all I can do with my power. However, mere scars will be healed when Master’s great power is released.”
“Ok. While you are at it, why don’t you give him a check-up?”
Iaso smiled as she placed a hand on Hugo. “Yes! I’ve been monitoring him since earlier, and I don’t think there is any problem aside from a lack of nutrients— Kyahhhhk!!!”
Everyone flinched at her scream.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he looked at her. “What is it?”
Iaso had turned pale as she shook. Lee Gun crossed his arms as he approached her. She quickly whispered to him, “Master, I… I found a severe flaw with Pushover-nim.”
“What is it?”
“Give me your ear for a moment…”
When Iaso moved closer to him, Lee Gun furrowed his brows in annoyance. However, he soon flinched.
His expression froze when he heard her.
“What?!”
It was rare to see Lee Gun this shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 343
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Messed with the wrong guy (2)
What did she just say?
It was rare to see Lee Gun this shocked. His annoyance was nowhere to be seen as he quickly moved his head closer to Iaso. “Hey, are you sure? Are you sure you aren’t lying?”
The anxious Iaso nodded. “Yes. Everything I said was true.”
“…!”
“It wasn’t just one flaw. It found two…”
At that moment…
“Why are you acting like that? What’s wrong?”
Lee Gun flinched when Yooha got close.
“Uncle?”
“That is… I’m sorry. You will never get to see your fourth sibling.”
“?!!”
Yooha immediately realized what those words meant; she turned pale.
At this point, Hugo had also become very nervous. “Hey! What is it?”
When the person in question asked this, Lee Gun flinched for some reason.
“Gun??”
Instead of answering his friend, Lee Gun rolled his eyes as he discreetly whispered into Iaso’s ear.
Iaso’s eyes turned round when she heard her owner’s question. “What?! Are you asking if you tormented Sagittarius so much that it influenced Hugo-nim?!”
Taken aback, she quickly whispered back, “Do not worry. There is no way that could have happened. Master isn’t at fault.”
Lee Gun finally stopped sweating. He confidently approached Hugo and whispered in Hugo’s ears.
Hugo wondered why Lee Gun was acting this way, but his face turned paler when he heard what Lee Gun had to say. “What?! What the hell did you just say!!?”
At Hugo’s shell-shocked expression, Lee Gun sympathetically patted his friend’s shoulder. “It’s fine. Don’t worry! I’ll fix it somehow.”
Hugo despaired, but then, he unexpectedly looked like he didn’t care about it. “No… It is fine.”
“What? It’s fine?!” Lee Gun said as he looked at the resigned Hugo.
“It’s too bad, but I’m getting old. There is no use for it now.”
Hugo had been rejuvenated thanks to the Serpent Bearer, so he shouldn’t be saying something like this.
However, Hugo laughed as if he had lost his mind. “It’s fine. I’ll just have a platonic relationship. I’m not too greedy—”
“You should be greedy!!!” Lee Gun raged. He had created a plan to reach a faith of 1,000% using Hugo’s children. That wasn’t all.
“I won’t let Miss Jiwoo and the baby see you like this!”
“Jiwoo?”
“That’s right! The relationship is so good with her that there is a third baby…”
“You’re married, Gun?”
“????”
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold.
On the other hand, Hugo furrowed his brow as he looked at Lee Gun. “It kept bothering me from before. Did you marry while I was captured and had a third kid?”
“What nonsense are you talking about?” Baffled, Lee Gun pointed at Yooha. “Do you not know who she is?”
“Is she your girlfriend?”
Yooha was shocked.
In the end, Lee Gun took out his phone and showed some photos to Hugo. “Do you not know who these people are?”
“Oh! That’s a beautiful woman and a fine young man! Are they your disciples?”
“You want to die? That’s your wife and son!!”
“What?! I’m married?!!”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun landed a flying kick on Hugo.
Bbah-gahk!!!
“Dad!!”
“Don’t worry, Yooha. I’ll take responsibility for your dad.”
“…!!”
Lee Gun looked at Iaso with anger on his face. “Hey, Disinfectant. Is this one of the two flaws?”
“No. That is—”
“Ahh. Whatever! Let’s give you a beating first.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun cracked his knuckles. He looked at Hugo with a menacing expression. “You got dragged away by a god, and now you’re treating me like this!”
“Gun??”
“Moreover, you even had your face ripped off. You got kidnapped again by someone else, and you were sold, despite being my Construct!!”
“No!!”
“I finally got you back, yet you lost your memories? I’m sure it’ll come back if I beat you up!!!”
“Ahhhhk!!!” Hugo screamed as a fist flew toward him.
* * *
Some time passed after Hugo received mental therapy.
[You have eliminated a high-rank god within the top 100.]
[The level of your Divine power has gone up.]
[You have entered the rankings of the Divine world.]
[You have accomplished a great achievement worthy of being recorded. You have acquired a Divine Achievement.]
[Divine Achievement (God’s Achievement): 2]
– Content: Chasing out the master of a floor (4 star)
– Content: Killing Hades (5 star)
[Divine Achievement can be used to increase the ability of the body or as a skill. You can also sell it.]
[The details can be checked through the Central Reserve.]
Lee Gun heard a familiar voice. It seemed the elimination of Hades had been a huge achievement.
‘Achievement? Is it similar to the Bible?’
He was confident that he had heard about this from Sagittarius and Virgo.
‘Gods grow stronger through Achievements.’
Gods were rulers of all dimensions and the worlds that existed within them, like the earth. These worlds were used and run like colonies. Of course, the 12 Zodiacs had used the Temple System to evolve. They received EXP from disciples. It was different for the other gods.
‘They become stronger depending on their Constructs and Achievements.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
Lee Gun looked at his friend, who was suffering on the floor. “You still can’t remember me?”
“No….”
When Lee Gun raised his fist, Hugo screamed. “I think I remember! No, I do remember! At the very least, I remember Jiwoo and Yooha!!! I remember the wedding and the moment when Yooha was born!”
Iaso was dumbfounded when she heard Hugo’s desperate shouts. “My god! He was able to make the memories return by doing that…”
It wasn’t as if Hugo were an old-fashioned TV!
Lee Gun dusted his hands off as if he was satisfied. It wasn’t a complete recovery, but this process just had to be repeated for 72 hours. That would solve this problem.
“What is his defect? Is it his memory loss and his erectile dysfunction? I guess I solved the memory loss. The only thing left is to fix…”
Flustered, Iaso shook her head from side to side. “N-No. That isn’t the important part.”
“What? That isn’t important?”
“The important part is… Umm. One of the two defects within him isn’t his memory loss, it’s his lifespan…”
“Lifespan?”
Iaso nodded at Lee Gun’s expression. “Yes. Pushover-nim has only one week left to live.”
“…!!”
Yooha and Hugo were shocked.
“Of course, Master is the exalted god of Life and Death. It shouldn’t be too big of a problem…”
Soon, a menacing voice emanated from Lee Gun’s mouth. “Which bastard did this?”
The gods in his surroundings flinched. They trembled when they heard Lee Gun’s cold voice.
“We know who the culprit is?”
“!”
Lee Gun smirked when he heard Anubis. “You know? Is that so? Then speak.”
Anubis and Osiris stood up as if they had been waiting for this moment.
“Hmmph. Impudent low-rank god! If you want to know, you should release us from being your Construct!”
“That’s right. A price equivalent to the information needs to be paid. If not, we won’t tell you— The goddesses of fate were the ones to do it. I’m sure of it.”
“?!!”
Both Osiris and Anubis froze in shock when Anubis gave away the information.
“Osiris-nim!!”
“Why the hell did you…!”
Lee Gun grinned. “Now that I think about it, Constructs can’t cheat their master in a transaction. They can’t also lie either. Right?”
The Constructs had to tell the full truth when ordered by their master.
When the gods of Ennead realized what had happened, they screamed as they clutched their heads. If they weren’t careful, they’d reveal all the information about Ennead to Lee Gun!
Lee Gun smirked. He stepped on them as he asked, “What about the goddesses of fate?”
“Do you think I’ll tell you— Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun put strength into his foot and said, “Lower your eyes.”
“No….”
They tried to keep their mouths shut, but their mouths opened by themselves.
“I’m sure Olympus is behind it! Amongst the eight great forces, they are the most like traders in their disposition!”
“Speak in honorifics. What does being a trader have anything to do with this?”
“I’m saying that guy got partitioned! There is no way they would sell someone as precious as Pushover. By the looks of it, they planned on selling what they considered bad parts to others at an outrageous price!”
“Bad parts?”
“They are any parts of Pushover’s personality that get in the way of his loyalty! If he had memories of you, the 600% Faith would be directed toward you. If he has memories of his family, he’d always try to run away!”
“That’s why the parts of his soul that were useless to them were chopped away and sold to the other factions!”
“Of course, getting rid of Faith is impossible no matter how much you partition someone. Moreover, that personality was partitioned with a short lifespan. He was supposed to disappear on his own after being sold.”
Lee Gun finally understood the defect that had developed within Hugo. It meant this was the real Hugo. However, it was a hollowed-out version of him.
In other words, his personality, containing the memories and emotions that would interfere with their plans, had been taken out.
In other words, the human parts of Hugo were cut out and sold as products. Moreover, his lifespan was purposely made short so that the human parts would disappear on their own. That meant only the divine part of Hugo’s body had been left behind.
‘Nothing that can be identified as Taeksoo was left behind in the Divine body.’
If he had to guess, Hugo was a doll with only his Faith and abilities left behind.
Anubis looked at Lee Gun at that moment. “Well… In the case of Pushover’s impotence… Oh, Snake god. Aren’t you the god of life?”
“Yes. What about it?”
“That is… Thanks to your ability, he seems to have received some benefits…”
“What about it?”
“Isn’t it obvious? When he was being partitioned, what is considered one of his defects was stolen by the Great Spirit of Olympus.”
“What?!”
Hugo opened and closed his mouth.
On the other hand, Osiris and Anubis spoke as if it all made sense.
“Their faction is desperate to expand the number of children they have.”
“Once, an outstanding healing god was affiliated with Olympus. His name was Asclepius. When the outstanding god of medicine disappeared, the gods of Olympus could no longer have children… Anyway, one of the defects was stolen by the Great Spirit.”
“What the hell?!”
The Great Spirits were the kings of the current gods. However, no supreme ruler existed right now. This was why kings existed in the Divine world, and they were the leaders of the eight great forces.
Anubis continued, “By the looks of it, Pushover’s Divine body is in Olympus.”
“Well… This one probably has a connection to his Divine body, but….”
They glanced at Hugo.
“It seems this Pushover was made by gathering the most useless parts of him.”
“That’s correct. His lifespan being one week means he is trash…”
“What?! Trash?!”
On the other hand, Lee Gun laughed as if he was dumbfounded. What? The most useless parts were used?
“Nonsense.”
This was the part of Hugo that Lee Gun treasured the most. Moreover, they had made a mistake in putting a stipulation that made Hugo’s lifespan into one week.
‘These bastards are underestimating my power.’
It would be to Lee Gun’s benefit if Olympus grew Hugo’s Divine power.
‘Anyway, we can’t go back like this.’
At that moment…
[You’re the one who killed Hades?]
“!!”
A bird sitting by the window suddenly let out a light as it moved its beak.
[We saw Hades disappear from the registry of gods. Did he die here?]
Lee Gun furrowed his brow when he heard the unfamiliar voice. “What the hell is that?”
Anubis started to sweat. “Ah… That is a communication line opened to make a deal with Hades… It seems it was disconnected until now…”
“What? That bastard is from Olympus?”
The being on the other end was taken aback.
[I am from Olympus. Who are you, you impudent bastard?]
“I am the master of these guys.”
[Ah! I see! You’re the Great Spirit of Ennead! I apologize! I was rude!]
Osiris and Anubis screamed. No! That wasn’t it!
Lee Gun hadn’t said anything false, but his words were misleading! However, their despair was ignored.
The one from Olympus spoke up.
[Hades went there to consummate the trade, and it seems that the snake god killed him. Do you know if that’s true?]
“That—”
Before Osiris could say anything, Lee Gun brought his foot down on him.
“That is true.”
[Ah! I’m so sorry! It seems you weren’t able to do the trade because he died. Since Hades is dead, we can’t ask for damages either. It is already a mess here thanks to the entertainer.]
“What business do you have with me?”
[To consummate the trade of Pushover, we will send one of our people once again. Please understand we are taking a loss too. We have to find the snake god, who killed Hades. We have to file for damages, yet we don’t know what he looks like. Since you were there, do you know what the low-rank god looked like? Please cooperate with us so that we can catch him.]
Osiris and Anubis continued to sweat.
“That is… That bast… I meant to say that person… He is very dashing…”
“He… He is beyond handsome… You guys have nothing on him…!”
[What? What did you just say?]
Osiris and Anubis couldn’t badmouth their owner, so they could merely slam their hands against the ground.
On the other hand, Lee Gun listened with a smirk on his lips.
‘These kidnappers are like maggots.’
“The eyewitness information of the snake god will be sent to you in short order.”
[Ah! I would appreciate it if you did that—]
Kwahng!!!
Lee Gun used his power of Death to destroy the glass bird, which acted as a medium for communication.
Hugo shook as he watched Lee Gun laugh. “G-Gun?”
At the same time, something vibrated within Lee Gun’s pocket. It was a phone-like device Sagittarius gave to him for communication purposes. When he picked up the call, he heard a familiar voice.
[N-Nephew… Did you rescue Hugo? I somehow stopped the Great Spirit of Ennead… I might not look it, but I’m one of the pillar gods of Olympus. I did well, right…?]
“You did well. So, where are you right now?”
[I returned to Olympus. Why…?]
“I’ll send you another bomb. I want you to carry it to the Great Spirit of Olympus.”
[What? What are you…!!!]
Click!
When Lee Gun ruthlessly ended the call, Anubis and Osiris looked at Lee Gun in shock.
“Are you trying to antagonize Olympus?”
“They are gathering forces to aim for a place called the earth right now…!”
Lee Gun smirked as if their words had left him dumbfounded. “Idiots! Do you realize the occupation of the god whom I got rid of?”
“!”
Soon, their shocked selves saw Lee Gun bring out Hades’s item.
“That is…!”
It was Hades’ Divine Item.
[Registry of Hades]
It was a registry containing the names of all the souls and gods within the Divine world. This item could determine the life and death of the gods.
Lee Gun laughed as he saw Eco, who was trying to slowly sneak away. “You.”
“Y-Yes?!!”
“Do you know who contacted me earlier?”
“No. I mean…!”
“Tell me their names.”
“What?!”
“I’ll shrink their remaining lifespan into one week.” Lee Gun let out a menacing laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 344
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Messed with the wrong guy (3)
Hades’ Divine item was called <Registry of Hades>.
It was a registry that listed the life expectancy of the gods. It could be used to increase and decrease the lifespan of the gods.
Of course, there were stipulations and restrictions when one wanted to use an item of this caliber.
This was why Lee Gun headed towards the <Ancient Temple> in order to use the registry.
For some reason, his Constructs told him that Registry of Hades could be only used over there.
On the other hand, there was something else that took priority at that moment.
“Hey. Are you sure its not working?”
“…….”
“Really? There is no reaction at all?”
“…Gun.”
“Damn it. It really isn’t rising!”
“Why the hell do you think it’ll work, you idiot!!”
Hugo sent his fist flying towards Lee Gun, who was pushing lewd materials towards him.
That’s right.
Lee Gun was trying to fix Hugo’s defects. In order to check if it was fixed, they were participating in some extracurricular activities.
In order to help his friend, he had brought out various footages, photos, sounds and all kinds of media for Hugo.
Lee Gun grumbled.
“Tsk. I thought I made a strong effort this time, yet it didn’t work?”
“Damn it!!”
Hugo wanted to toss aside Lee Gun, but he knew he couldn’t do it. This was why he clutched at his face.
On the other hand, Lee Gun continued to talk to himself.
“Shit. If I knew this would happen, I would have asked Yooha to borrow a picture of Ms Jiwoo.”
He said he opened lewd contents, but all he could find were fanfictions with the 13 heroes as the topic. Of course, there was no way such contents could be lewd, so he searched several websites for experimentation. However, it was useless.
“Really! Work a little harder! Let’s take this home! Look at another one!”
“Really! You want to die!”
In the end, Lee Gun pouted when his handphone was temporarily confiscated.
It wasn’t as if he had shown R-rated content with no plan in mind.
In case it worked, he had used the Chalice skill of the Aquarius to create healing potions. He poured a lot of it into Hugo.
However, it hadn’t worked, and he had no idea what to do next.
“If the Chalice can solve it, the baldie wouldn’t have suffered so much.”
Moreover, it wasn’t as if Hugo had lost function. The part of him capable of doing it was cut out. One couldn’t revive something that didn’t exist in the first place.
That wasn’t all.
‘Aside from this defect, his life expectancy isn’t growing.’
It seemed all of his life expectancy was extracted when Hugo was partitioned.
Of course, there might be a solution if all his penalties were lifted. Lee Gun would be able to use all of his Life abilities…
‘I can’t always revive someone that’ll die in a week.’
Even he couldn’t revive someone indefinitely.
[Caution. If the revival is too far out of the natural order, the reviver’s soul will be consumed.]
[Penalties will be applied including to your Karma.]
In other words, reviving someone that wasn’t at the end of the road wasn’t as flagrant. However, indefinitely reviving someone that had reached the end of their lifespan would greatly damage the order of the universe. It would make Lee Gun amass Karmic debt.
Lee Gun didn’t mind it for himself, but he worried the Karmic debt would splash towards Hugo and his family.
‘I have to find the other parts that were cut away, and I have to combine them. That’s the most surefire method.’
This included defects that the Great Spirit of Olympus had stolen away.
Hugo’s abilities and life expectancy had been taken away by his kidnappers. It had been done for their benefit.
‘Those bastards are dead.’
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. That thought was driving Lee Gun mad when it happened.
“S.…Snake god. You can use it here now. Hurry up and take it.”
“!”
Lee Gun smirked when he heard a voice from next to him.
It was Anubis.
He was returning Hades’ item to Lee Gun. Since Anubis was also a god of the underworld, he was able to complete this task quickly. However, he looked desperate for some reason.
“If our business is done here, let’s quickly get out of here!!!”
“Why are you in such a hurry? Do you have to go to the restroom?”
“This place has everything to do with it, you asshole!”
Anubis expressed his anger.
Currently, they were at the <Neutral Zone> under the supervision of the Divine world. Since the Pantheon was divided into nine large factions, this place was a shared space for everyone.
Moreover, it was a place where fighting was forbidden and in a way, it was like a civic center. All the divine activities of the gods were administered here.
This included the registration of Zodiacs and Constructs. They also managed Divine items and colonists in various territories.
In order to use the Divine item taken from Hades, one had to go through a procedure in this place. This was why they were here.
“Do you understand what I’m trying to say? This is where all the factions gather! What if I come across a god that I know… Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun kicked Anubis.
“Say the magic word. Master.”
“Fuck!! You are a mere fledgling g…!”
“What the hell? Is it a fight? Who are they?”
“I think they are from Ennead….”
“Ahhhk!”
When Anubis started garnering attention, he quickly lowered himself as he covered his face.
The other gods walked past them as if they didn’t care.
Anubis felt like dying.
‘I don’t have time to be doing this…!’
“Anyways, I secretly transferred its ownership from Olympus to you. You’ll be able to use it… Kuhk! Master!”
Lee Gun looked satisfied as he activated the <Registry of Hades>.
Since the ownership of the registry had changed, it changed from black to gold.
The book hovered in the air, and there were countless names of gods written inside.
“What the hell? Why are they mostly gods under the Olympus faction?”
“Why else? You have to fight other factions and take their names. That is why it is rare… Ahhhk! Why is my name written there!”
Anubis was shocked when he saw Osiris and his name written at the end.
After they became Constructs, they were entered into Lee Gun’s ownership.
Lee Gun didn’t pay attention to him as he turned the page.
Olympus was enough for now.
“I think the Divine status of the one that called earlier was called <Morpheus>….”
Morpheus was the god of dreams. He was the origin of morphine.
After turning several pages, Lee Gun smirked.
“There he is. His Divine name is <Master of Dreams>. His remaining life expectancy is 48,349 years.”
It seemed the life expectancy of gods were determined by ‘Achievements’, ‘level of Divine power’, and the number of ‘followers’.
If one erased the numbers to rewrite it, one would change the fate of the gods.
However, there was one crucial problem.
“Hey. I can’t change the numbers. It says it is locked.”
Anubis grabbed the back of his neck, because Lee Gun was too green.
“That Divine item can harm the order of the universe. It is a 5 star Divine item, so it can’t be used on a whim!”
“That’s so lame. How is this supposed to be used?”
“You have to buy a <Permission Ticket(Absolve Responsibility)>!”
“Permission ticket??”
“Yes. It is like a chip that absolves responsibility!”
Permission Ticket(Absolve Responsibility)> was the most important item in the Divine world.
Even a god couldn’t mess with the order of the universe in an excessive manner.
Amongst the abilities and items owned by gods, they had the means to bring the end to the universe.
This was why restrictions were placed on certain techniques. These techniques needed permission from the Divine world to be used.
If it was used by force, Karmic debt will be amassed. Penalty would be dished out depending on the gravity of the offense.
It wasn’t an unreasonable system.
‘If it is allowed to be used with no restrictions, everyone might die.’
On the other hand, the life expectancy of the low rank Constructs could be freely expanded and contracted.
However, Lee Gun wasn’t aiming for the Constructs.
‘I want the Zodiac ranks’
Lee Gun smirked.
“How do I buy the <Permission Ticket>?”
“What? There is no way someone like you can… Kuh-huhk!”
Anubis was hit again by Lee Gun, yet he pounded his chest in frustration.
It was to be expected since the <Permission Tickets> were sold depending on the god’s credit rating and level.
Moreover, it was hard to buy even one or two of them. This was why the gods didn’t like selling them.
“You are a rookie that probably has no Divine Achievements. How dare you think you’ll be able to buy it! You should consider yourself fortunate if you are able to acquire even one…”
“Ah. What the hell? I can acquire 1,000 of them.”
“?!!”
Lee Gun automatically saw the <Permission Ticket> through the clearing house.
He smirked.
He took out papers from something that looked like a kiosk.
[<Serpent Bearer>]
[Beginning and End Serpent]
[Designer]
-Number of Permission Ticket allowed to be exchanged-
-Sale of Divine Achievement-
[Content: Chasing out the master of a floor(Permanent Defense Increase)] = 10
[Content: Killing Hades(Permanent Attack Increase)] = 50
-Sale of items in possession-
[Strange Spear] = 100
[Strange Currency] = 10 for 1
[Pushover] = 500
[Registry of Hades] = 20
[Weapon of the Sun] = 10
[Leo’s Tooth] = 50
Lee Gun smirked.
He didn’t know for sure, but it seemed he could purchase Permission Tickets using the Achievements and items that he had amassed.
‘The spear and the currency are the ones I made.’
It was probably referring to the spear made from the Abyss monarch, and the counterfeit money that he had made.
In the case of the counterfeit money, he had no idea why it was valued so highly.
‘Was it because I made it with the carcass and excrement of the monsters?’
Did they have some use like the spear made from the monarch?
It didn’t matter in the end.
‘They possess a sense of self. I just need to give an order, and they’ll return to me.’
This was why Lee Gun spoke without hesitation.
“Alright. I’ll sell Leo’s Tooth and the remaining 1,000 currency.”
It happened at that moment.
“Uh!”
When Lee Gun took out the counterfeit money that he had created, a murmur erupted around him.
It had to do with the rumbling noise coming from the Talents.
“Wait a moment!! Look at that!!”
“Isn’t that the item that came out the auction house?”
“That’s right. It is the Talent that possesses a sense of self!”
In a flash, the gods gathered around Lee Gun.
“Oh, nameless god! Do you plan on selling them for the Permission Tickets!”
“Uh. It says 10 of them can be exchanged for one Permission Ticket, so…”
“I’ll give you 1 Permission Ticket for 7 of them!”
“What?”
“I’ll give you 1 Permission Ticket for 5 of them!”
“I’ll give you 1 Permission for each of them!!!”
“????”
Anubis’s eyes turned round when he saw the odd sight.
He had no idea what was going on.
Lee Gun didn’t care if Anubis was shocked or not. He smirked.
“I’ll give you 10 for each of them.”
“Alright! I’ll buy a total of ten thousand!”
“?!”
In a flash, he acquired <Permission Tickets>, which were hard to acquire.
Lee Gun nonchalantly created a large stack.
“What the hell? It is easy to buy Permission Tickets.”
While Anubis was taken aback by what he saw, he laughed in disbelief.
“Y…You won’t be able to affect the pillar gods with ten thousand. Do you realize how many gods are under Olympus?”
Lee Gun didn’t care as he activated his <Creation Workshop> skill.
“I am a manufacturer god. I just have to make more. That is all there is to it.”
“?!!!”
Anubis screamed as he saw stacks of counterfeit money start to stack up.
* * *
It was around that time on the 1st floor of the Divine world.
“What? Why the hell is no one inside the main god’s palace!”
It was a spire that was located between two imposing rock faces.
Enormous city and buildings stretched out below the high skyscraper.
Morpheus was located on the highest floor within Olympus’ territory.
He had just finished his communication with Lee Gun, and he had come here to meet the Great Spirit in regards to the deal involving Hades.
At that moment, he couldn’t hide his shock.
This place was the headquarters where the Great Spirit, pillar gods and their faction’s greatest officers resided.
Unlike the 2nd and 3rd floor containing European style low-rise architecture, the 1st floor was elegant. It was a city of spires that evoked the feeling of a battlefield.
Moreover, this palace was supposed to have countless Constructs that would deliver nectar and food at all times…
“Is anyone here!”
“M…Master of Dreams…!”
“!”
Morpheus scanned the hallway, and he became surprised when he saw the remaining guard of the palace. He was on the ground, and he was having a hard time breathing.
“What is going on!”
“That is… Kuh-huhk!”
Finally, the guard screamed.
At the same time, familiar symbols appeared below and the guard was dragged under the surface.
It was the symbol of Hades’ underworld!
It was the symbol of Tartarus!
“He was dragged away to the underworld?!”
There was no mistaking it.
This was Hades’ power. It was the Registry of Hades!
One’s life expectancy can be manipulated to make others into residents of the underworld.
‘Who!’
After Hades had died, he had come here to report to the Great Spirit. He did it to restart the deal with Ennead.
He had already sent Anubis and Osiris over there to make the transaction.
[I have to frontrun the other gods, so I can take some profit for myself.]
The gods of Olympus weren’t just aiming for Pushover’s Divine body. They were aiming for the money that would come in for selling Pushover.
The money would be used to take over earth where Pushover had come from.
So what the hell happened…!
However, it seemed this phenomenon wasn’t only occurring within the palace.
“Did you hear! All the Constructs of Olympus were dragged to the underworld.”
“What?!”
When change occurred, most of the gods including the pillar gods and high rank gods came rushing in.
They looked shocked.
“I thought Hades was dead, so how….!”
“What are the goddesses of fate doing!”
Flash!
“Ahhhhk!!”
The gods, who had rushed to the palace, screamed.
The screams filled the entirety of the palace’s first floor.
In a flash, the light surrounded the entirety of Olympus. The light engulfed all the gods.
At the same time, they couldn’t believe the number that hovered over their bodies.
“This is….!”
“It is our life expectancy… Ahhhk!!!”
The god screamed.
Normally, the figure ranged between thousands to tens of thousand years.
It suddenly changed into [7 hrs 00 min 0 sec].
Their life expectancy contracted to seven hours.
The gods turned pale, and they froze in place. They never expected such a thing to happen.
[Ah. Ah. The underworld is giving notice to Olympus.]
“……!!!”
It was an unfamiliar voice that rang out through Olympus.
The voice could be heard from the sky.
“That is…!”
There was a bird flying in the sky, and the voice could be heard coming from it. It was very similar to the communication bird that had been sent to Ennead.
[I killed Hades. That means I am now the owner of the underworld. Ah. Most of your Constructs were made into residents of this place. They are still alive and well. You don’t have to worry about them for now.]
“……?!”
“Who the hell is that bastard!!”
[You probably know this already, but all your life expectancies were changed to 7 hours. You can refer to it. I wanted to make it 7 days, but I didn’t realize I had to specify the unit of time. That is why it turned into 7 hours. I apologize for that.]
“??!!”
[Anyways, that is what happened. Don’t struggle unnecessarily against it. If you want your life expectancy back, give me back Pushover.]
The gods of Olympus had a mental panic when they heard the voice.
What did that crazy bastard just say?
“D…Did he really…!”
“The Divine world didn’t intervene in this matter?”
The gods were taken aback.
Of course, this was also true for one of the pillar gods of Olympus, who stood amongst their ranks.
Sagittarius was also taken aback.
It was for no other reason.
‘What the hell, nephew!!’
What was the point of making his life expectancy into 7 hours too!

Chapter 345: Messed with the wrong guy (4)
[Ahhhk! My lifespan suddenly became shorter!]
[Help!]
[Seven hours? This makes no sense?!]
[Who the hell is that crazy bastard?]
Lee Gun smirked when he heard the frantic screams. After the communication bird sent to Ennead had been fixed, Lee Gun had used it for his own. This was why he was able to hear these gods’ voices very well.
“Alright. It seems their life expectancy really dropped.”
He had worried it would fail, but the voices assured him that he had been worried for nothing.
On the other hand, the god of the underworld was dumbfounded by the situation.
“That crazy bastard!!!” The shocked Anubis looked at Lee Gun.
To find Hugo, Lee Gun had entered Duat as a package. After that, he had skinned the leather of the Ammuts.
At that point, Anubis had already realized Lee Gun was a psychopath, but he never expected Lee Gun to threaten the lives of the gods. Moreover, he had witnessed something else.
[Ah! I made a mistake. I was supposed to specify the time.]
[What?!]
[Whatever. The underworld doesn’t have enough residents. They can die quickly for all I care.]
He had seen Lee Gun cackle while saying that.
Hugo also seemed surprised by these events. He was thankful that Lee Gun would go so far for him, but for some odd reason, he felt as if Lee Gun’s goal had changed.
On the other hand, Yooha looked a bit disgruntled. It was for no other reason. “You should have left it as seven minutes.”
“If I had done that, they would have died before they could bring out your father.”
“Ah! You’re right.”
Hugo looked at the two, taken aback.
Then, Lee Gun took something else out of the kiosk. It seemed to be his own data.
[Talent in Possession: – 100 million]
[Ability available for sale] (Unit Price)
Life
1 star [Super Regeneration] [Absolute Defense]: 500 million
2 star [Pain Revival]: 1 billion
3 star [Pain Creation]: 5 billion
4 star [Return]: 10 billion
5 star [Return 2] [Cycle]: 20 billion each
6 star [???]: Price inestimable
Death (same prices as above)
1 star [Eliminate]
2 star [Reaper Summon]
3 star [Pond Walk (Warp)] [Personal Poison]
4 star [Soul Disassemble]
5 star [Destroy All Creation] [Cycle]
6 star [???]
??? (Price inestimable)
1 star [Gaze of a God] [13th Sense] [Creation Workshop]
5 star [Act forbidden by the gods]
[Miscellaneous skills that can be sold] (500 million each)
[Oblivion] [Get Hit Instead of Me] and 10 other skills
[Item available for sale]
[Time’s Data]: 10 billion
[Abyss’ Data]: 10 billion
…
[Aquarius’s Data]: 100 million
[Confusion’s Data]: 10 billion
[Constructs available for sale]: 5
Anubis was shocked when he discreetly glanced at Lee Gun’s sheet.
‘He’s a fledgling, so why is he judged so highly?’
Lee Gun had just taken out the personal data of a god that the Divine world had assessed.
This surprised Anubis. The Divine world was a miser, yet it had given such a high price to Lee Gun’s abilities.
‘That means the Divine status is higher in quality.’
What the hell were the Divine powers that were “Price inestimable”?
‘Does that mean a price can’t be put on them?’
However, something was even more shocking.
[Divine world debt: 30 billion Talents]
[Forced Labor: 1000 years]
Anubis was shocked by the debt Lee Gun had amassed.
‘Crazy bastard!!!’
What the hell did he do? He was a fledgling god who had been here for only a day, yet he had accrued this much debt!
Of course, Lee Gun would be able to quickly pay the debt off, considering the items he possessed. It also made Anubis that much more shocked.
‘He was able to run up such a large amount. It means he’s someone that the Divine world is cautious of…!’
He was a very dangerous person. Of course, Anubis had a good idea as to why.
[Ahhk! Help!]
[I don’t want to die like this!]
[Do you need money? I’ll give you anything!]
“Good! I’ll be able to resolve my debt if I charge them a fee for their lives.”
Anubis started to sweat. This bastard would be a calamity to the Divine world!
* * *
Around that time…
“How does that make any sense?!”
“Where did this crazy bastard come from?”
Suffering from Lee Gun’s attack, Olympus was a maelstrom of confusion. These beings were gods. To them, whether it was seven hours or seventy years didn’t matter; a time of that magnitude felt like a nap to them. Some gods even took seven hundred years to take a bath.
This was why a life expectancy of seven hours was unimaginable. Those who had reached the Zodiac rank didn’t even think about their deaths. So what the hell was this?
Of course, Sagittarius had also received the notification.
‘Nephew! I blocked the Great Spirit of Ennead for you!’
Sagittarius inwardly felt sad. After dealing a blow to the Great Spirit of Ennead, he had a tough time running away.
‘It was really hard to get out of there!’
Sagittarius clutched at his face as if to ask why he was being treated this way by Lee Gun.
‘Aren’t we peers as members of the thirteen Zodiacs…!!’
In the end, he took out his phone-like device.
‘I’ll have to contact my nephew, and I’ll ask him to return my lifespan…’
Bbah-gahk!!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Lime came out of Sagittarius’s pocket and unleashed a beating on him. The slime didn’t want any funny business against its master, so it stepped on the face of the fallen Sagittarius.
Puh-guhk! Puhk, puhk, puhk!
Sagittarius was dumbfounded. This bastard had acted the same way in front of the Great Spirit of Ennead!
“Why are you acting this way toward me?”
Considering its owner, Sagittarius wondered if the slime just hated him.
Lime kicked Sagittarius as if to say he should go look for Hugo.
On the other hand, the gods were shell-shocked after having their lifespan suddenly reduced.
“Damn it! All my subordinates have been dragged to the underworld, so I can’t tell them to conduct a search!”
“He purposely got rid of our Constructs to tie our hands and feet!”
“Why did Hades have to drag him here? Whatever! We should kill Hades first!”
“He’s already dead!”
“Damn it! That’s why I said we shouldn’t mess with someone who already has an owner!”
“It’s fine! We are wasting time by fighting among ourselves!”
They got ready to look for Lee Gun.
“That bastard has the registry of Hades! We just need to use the tracking ability on the Divine item, and we’ll be able to find his location!”
“Ah! That’s the master of the Sun’s…!”
Their gaze landed on Sagittarius, and the god of the sun flinched.
“Oh, great pillar god of Olympus! Give us the ability to be able to track the Registry of Hades!”
“We will be able to find the dirty bastard with it!”
Sagittarius started to sweat under their gazes, and when Lime glared at him, he pretended to faint. “Ah! I’m out of power. I can’t use my ability!”
“Oh, pillar god!”
“I think the snake god did something to me…!”
The gods were shocked at this sight. They held Sagittarius.
“That underhanded bastard used his power against a pillar god!”
At that moment, someone raised his hand.
“I have a detection-related skill!! The Registry of Hades is active in the Ancient temple!”
The eyes of the Olympus gods flashed. The more renowned Zodiacs of the ground especially felt anger at the situation that they found themselves in.
“I’ll kill that impudent god!”
“How dare he blackmail us with the lives of the gods?”
“!”
The high-rank gods savagely let out their Divine power.
Sagittarius, who was pretending to be unconscious, felt his heart sink. Lee Gun would have a hard time if gods of that caliber ganged up against him.
‘No! They are top-100 ranked gods, who boast a long history!’
Sagittarius became desperate, but the other gods moved faster than him.
“Let’s quietly head toward there. If the other factions find out about this situation, we’ll be in big trouble.”
“That’s right.”
They mobilized quickly. However, when they were about to enter the neutral zone, where Lee Gun was…
“Where are you guys going?”
“?!”
Other gods blocking the entrance to the neutral zone made an appearance. The gods of Olympus glared at these other gods.
‘Valhall, Eden, Kunlun…!’
Gods of the other factions approached the gods of Olympus with menacing expressions. Moreover, they had come in significant numbers.
This surprised the gods of Olympus.
“What the hell are you doing? Get out of our way!”
“We don’t have time to deal with you guys….”
“I heard your guys’ lifespan shrank into seven hours.”
“?!”
“Ha ha ha ha! I don’t know what happened, but we just need to stall you guys for seven hours. That’ll lead to your annihilation, right?”
