chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Thank you (1)
The Zodiacs were dumbfounded.
‘What did he just say?’
‘One hour?’
The gods of Olympus were sweating bullets. Their seven-hour lifespan had been reduced in a flash.
Of course, the problem wasn’t just that Lee Gun possessed the Registry of Hades.
“He controls time…!!”
“This is crazy! Does the snake god possess the Divine status of Time?!”
“No way! Since he can use the registry, he must have a Death type Divine Status!”
In the first place, the Divine items of gods couldn’t be used by anyone. At a basic level, they each possessed an owner, and the owners had to possess similar attributes to the items. Only then could the owners use those items.
In the case of the registry, the Divine status of Hades had to be used, or one had to possess a similar type of power as the underworld god.
‘Shit! Who the hell is he? How come his data is missing from the records of the Divine world…!’
“Maybe, the snake god is a god of time. He was able to use the registry because he stole Hades’s Divine status?”
“Are you kidding me? Hades has been dead for only a day! There is no way the snake god could make a Divine status his own in just one day!”
“That’s right. It takes at least a hundred years to absorb a Divine status!”
At that moment…
“Tell me the location of the Registry.”
A menacing voice rang out, surprising everyone.
“Master of the Sea!”
The one to show up was a male god. He was a blue-haired god with a robust physique. With a dumbfounded expression, he said, “Do you think I’ll let this enemy do as he pleases? I’ll go bring his head on a platter.”
“I’ll go too.”
“Oh oh! Two pillar gods are stepping forward. This will be resolved with no problem.”
A male god possessing the Divine status of Poseidon appeared alongside a beautiful goddess of war.
Sagittarius’s face turned pale when he saw them.
‘Why the hell are they here?’
Each faction possessed Pillar Gods, the highest-rank officer gods who held up each faction. They were the closest to being Great Spirits and were extremely strong.
‘That child will have a hard time if he fights a two-on-one battle against them!’
It wasn’t just power. Including the level of their Divine status, these gods amassed internal power and influence. With everything they possessed combined, they were overpowering.
‘Hades stole the Divine status of his father….’
The change of the guard had happened not too long ago, so Hades could be considered a juvenile god.
It was why he had become greedy and made deals with the other gods, stealing Hugo. He had been focused on making a network.
However, this wasn’t the case with these two gods.
‘They inherited their power long ago.’
For gods, time was power. Over time, their power became stabler and stronger.
When it came to the battle among factions, they were competitive in fighting for the top spot.
This was the reason for Sagittarius’s shock.
Of course, the master of the sea was oblivious to this, so he turned around.
“Wait a little. When I find where he’s hiding, I’ll have his head in no time—”
“Ahhhk!!”
“?!”
The master of the sea and the goddess of war jumped in surprise when Sagittarius screamed.
“Louis?”
Sagittarius clutched at his heart as if he was about to die. “Huhk—! I’m dying! My heart!”
When Sagittarius fell to the ground, both of them ran toward him, flustered.
“What’s wrong, Louis? Why are you acting this way?”
“Huhk…! I can’t breathe!”
They considered his complexion to be terrible. The master of the sea quickly called out to the other gods.
“Louis’s condition seems grave! Doctor! Bring a high-rank god here!”
The gods were taken aback when he asked for a high-rank healer god.
“We no longer have Asclepius-nim…!”
“What shall we do?”
Sagittarius was one of the important pillar gods of Olympus. Moreover, his current status couldn’t be shown to just anyone.
The master of the sea had a friendly relationship with Sagittarius, so he got angry.
“Call for that idiot Aquarius of the twelve Zodiacs! I think the snake god caused this, so I’ll quickly get rid of him!”
His words made Sagittarius desperately clutch at the master of the sea. “No! I think I’ll be better if you nurse me back to health!”
“W-What?!”
“It has to be you!”
“????”
Did this bastard lose his mind? The goddess of war clicked her tongue when she saw this. “You can stay here, Master of the sea. I’ll go decapitate the snake god.”
Sagittarius desperately grabbed at her arm this time. “You have to stay too.”
“What?!”
Sagittarius was known as the most handsome god within the Olympus faction. It didn’t matter if the god was male or female. He had the capability of seducing any of them.
At this moment, he tried to seduce the goddess of war. “Please don’t leave me. Protect me from my side.”
The two gods had dumbfounded expressions on their faces, but Sagittarius was desperate.
‘My nephew will kill me if I let these two go after him.’
He would stop them from going to his nephew! He’d sacrifice his body to do so!
However, the goddess of war merely snorted. “Fuck off! You aren’t my type. You can die for all I care.”
“Kuh-huhk!!”
The goddess of war ruthlessly stepped on Sagittarius as she turned around.
“Anyway, we should locate Pushover. Where is he?”
“Do you plan on negotiating with him?!”
“No way!”
“Then…!”
“Think logically. He is using a 5-star Divine item. That means he’s running low on Divine power.”
“Above all else, it comes down to the Permission Tickets.”
“!”
The master of the sea and the goddess of war smirked.
“I don’t know how a fledgling like him was able to purchase enough Permission Tickets to influence all the gods of Olympus, but he should be slowly reaching his limit. He won’t be able to maintain it.”
The Registry of Hades had a lot of constraints because it adversely affected the rules governing the gods. In other words, it was a Divine item that had a lot of maintenance expenses.
“Hades rarely used it since the maintenance expense was so high. He has taken so many gods hostage. There is no way he has any more Permission Tickets left.”
This was why these gods smirked as they sent a request to the Divine world.
“We are acting as a proxy for our Great Spirit. Olympus will pay to have our request granted by the Divine world.”
“For the next hour, the purchase of Permission Tickets is banned throughout the Divine world.”
They had no idea how the snake god had purchased so many Permission Tickets, but they stopped the snake god’s ability to buy any more of them.
The Divine world immediately accepted the request.
[The Divine world received the fund amassed by Olympus.]
[As requested, all official transactions will be restricted for the next hour. This includes ability exchange and Permission Ticket exchange.]
The gods were taken aback by the announcement.
“Even if you blocked the Divine world, there are other factions! They have heard the news about us, and they are ecstatic about it. What if they sell the Permission Tickets to the snake god… It wouldn’t be strange for those gods to give the tickets at no cost!”
“Yes. If the snake god wins, Olympus will be no more…”
The master of the sea laughed as if they were speaking nonsense.
“No, the gods of Olympus will deal with him, and we just have to place a barrier over the other factions.”
“Then…!”
The goddess of war unsheathed her sword and stabbed the ground.
[Territory Declaration (4 star)]
Kwahng!
After activating her ability, Athena raised her voice toward the sea god. “The rest of you should go to the Great Spirit of Ennead! Finish the Pushover deal!”
“!”
“Once we are paid, we can negotiate with the Divine world. We’ll be able to get rid of the snake god.”
At that moment, someone approached them.
It was Morpheus. He had communicated with Lee Gun when the latter was in the underworld of Duat.
“I’ve already sent my subordinates to the Great Spirit of Ennead a while ago. We’ll receive payment soon.”
“The snake god’s Divine power is probably depleted. It’ll be our victory once we make him reveal himself.”
They would make the snake god regret messing with one of the eight great forces. The gods smiled.
* * *
‘What the hell is he?’
Anubis couldn’t hide his shock.
‘That’s the power of a monarch!’
Other gods might not recognize it, but Anubis could see what Lee Gun was doing. The problem was the data of Time used by Lee Gun.
Shaped like an unknown gem fragment, it was clearly related to the unknown civilization, which the gods were frightened of. Moreover, this item contained the power of one of their leaders!
‘This was the case with the spear too. What kind of relationship does he have with a monarch?’
However, that was a problem for another time.
‘That is a 5-star Divine item.’
To take the entirety of Olympus hostage, Lee Gun would need a massive amount of power and mental strength. So why did he look fine?
Flash!
Suddenly, the gods near Lee Gun were surrounded by light, and they started to scream.
Pahng!!
“Kuh-huhk!”
“Kyahhhk!”
All the gods who had been trading Permission Tickets with Lee Gun were repelled by a light. Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘Expulsion skill?’
It was the light emanating from the Registry of Hades. This was a skill used by Athena. The Territory Declaration had been set in this location.
At the same time, anyone not belonging to the Olympus faction was pushed out.
In the end, all of the gods were pushed out of the neutral zone, and an unexpected voice rang out.
[All transactions regarding the Permission Tickets will be halted for an hour.]
[The Registry of Hades has only 1% energy left. It’ll be sealed after five minutes.]
[You can recharge the energy of the Divine item with Permission Tickets.]
[To reactivate the Registry of Hades, you need at least 100 Permission tickets (1% per 100 tickets)]
[Remaining Permission Ticket: 2]
[When the Registry of Hades is sealed, the ownership of the registry will be automatically transferred to the goddesses of fate.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows, and the Constructs hidden in his shadow ground their teeth.
[They stopped the transaction of the Permission ticket so that Master cannot use the registry.]
In other words, Lee Gun had a crappy car that was running out of gas, and the Olympus bastards had temporarily shut down the gas station. Moreover, they prevented other sellers of oil from approaching him and sent them flying.
‘At this rate, the ownership of the registry will be handed over to the goddesses of fate?’
This meant Lee Gun had to earn his keep if he didn’t want the item taken away.
“Well, it doesn’t matter to me, since I just have to kill them all.”
Anubis was shocked by those words. “You shouldn’t do that! Do you really plan on killing them all?”
“Why not? It’s a shame I couldn’t find Taeksoo. However, I can slowly search the empty house if I kill them all.”
“You can’t! You might get away with taking gods hostage, but do you realize how much Karmic debt you’ll amass if you kill that many gods?”
Lee Gun stepped on Anubis as if to say he should lower his eyes. Then, his eyes flashed. “Who cares about Karmic debt? Also, won’t it be advantageous for you if I die? Why are you so hell-bent on stopping me?”
“Why!! If you become a slave through Karmic debt, I’ll also become a slave as your Construct— Ooh!” Anubis shut his mouth as if he had revealed important information.
Lee Gun laughed with his eyes. “Really? It’s that type of system.”
Osiris, who had been listening to this, quickly changed the subject. It would be best to mess up the snake god’s plan and drag him to the gods of Olympus.
“We’ll help you, snake god. You cannot use the registry anymore, so you should give up on the hostage act…”
At that moment…
“Ah! You were here! Are you the Great Spirit of Ennead?”
“!”
Anubis’s eyes turned round. The gods of Olympus were approaching them with a lot of luggage in tow.
“Anubis-nim and Osiris-nim! You must be the Great Spirit since you have Pushover by your side!”
“!!”
While they had covered their faces, Anubis and Osiris were pillar gods of Ennead. They were famous figures in the Pantheon. Moreover, only one being could step on them with immunity, the Great Spirit!
“We couldn’t personally make contact with you. We assumed you were still here for the transaction. It was right of us to come looking for Osiris-nim.”
They were the god of Olympus. They had come here after going to Duat to complete the transaction.
As if to confirm this, information popped up.
[Affiliation: Master of Dreams (Morpheus)]
“When Hades died, we became in charge of completing the transaction. We are here to receive our payment.”
Lee Gun smirked. “I see. Payment?”
“Yes. I’m sorry about what happened with Hades, but you did receive Pushover. Since we caused great inconvenience to Ennead, we brought several items as sweeteners.”
“!”
They pushed forward their packs.
Lee Gun smirked when he saw the packs. They contained items that traded at a premium within the Divine world.
Of course, Lee Gun didn’t know what they were used for, so he overlooked them. But one item did catch his eye.
“We have Permission Tickets here. Anubis-nim requested a bunch. I heard the Divine item of Ennead needs a lot of Permission Tickets to use.”
Anubis hadn’t put much thought into it and had just requested a list of precious items. He screamed inwardly.
‘Damn it! Our plan…!!’
“Excuse me, Great Spirit… Why are you disguised as someone young?”
“What?”
The gods who had come for the transaction looked at him with odd looks in their eyes.
“That is… We know the Great Spirit of Ennead doesn’t like snakes…”
They wondered why the Great Spirit was giving off the scent of a serpent. That wasn’t all. The color red was considered ominous within the Divine world.
“There is no way the Great Spirit would make his eyes red…”
Then, their bodies flinched and shook when they felt the energy Lee Gun emanated.
After he raised his Divine power, Lee Gun’s black eyes started shining red.
This frightened the gods, and they reflexively raised their weapons.
“Who are you?”
“Who are you to act that way to the pillar gods?”
Lee Gun let out a frightening smile. “I’ll gladly use the items you brought me.”
Screams rang out.
* * *
Around that time, in Olympus, the palace where the Great Spirit resided.
“What?! The Registry of Hades is still working?!”
They were secretly here to look for Hugo’s other parts, and they couldn’t believe their ears.
“It hasn’t stopped yet? What happened?”
“Does he have enough Permission Tickets despite the trade being halted?”
“That’s impossible! He entered the Divine world just a while ago! How could he…!”
“Morpheus and his underlings were robbed by the snake god when the Master of dreams went to consummate the deal!”
“What?! They were supposed to go to Ennead! Why did they go there?”
The gods grabbed the back of their necks.
“We have no choice. Hurry up and find Pushover. We can make a clone.”
“If we put the clone out in the open, the snake god will show himself, and his Divine Power should be depleted.”
“Is that so? Taeksoo is here?”
“…!!!”
They heard a cold voice at that moment. The gods froze when they heard the voice emanating from next to them.
The snake god didn’t care about their reactions as his eyes flashed. “Thank you for leading the way!”

chapters.title: Chapter 347
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Thank you (2)
“Thank you for leading the way!”
The faces of the gods froze.
A male god looking to be either in his late teens or early twenties had suddenly shown up before them. He had red eyes, which were considered ominous even in the Divine world.
‘This bastard…’
However, they were shocked for an entirely different reason.
‘We couldn’t sense his presence.’
They were here to find Hugo under the pillar gods’ orders. Although they took orders from the pillar gods, they were still Zodiacs of Olympus.
While Olympus had recently pivoted to commerce and trade, it still had gods considered the kings of the battlefield. These were the gods who had taken numerous heads of Constructs in the battle between factions.
They were confident that they would never let an enemy get behind them. Therefore, they immediately unsheathed their weapons.
“Who are you?”
“Who are you to enter the holy palace of the Great Spirit— Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun didn’t even bother listening to them. He slammed the face of his opponent against the wall.
Kwahng!
“Whatever! Open the door so I can find Pushover, idiots.”
“…?!”
They had never seen his face before, but they recognized the voice. Moreover, he had mentioned Pushover.
The gods glared at him.
“That voice…! Was it you?”
“You’re the one who broadcasted that psychotic announcement!”
There was no mistaking it. He was the damn bastard who had taken the entirety of Olympus hostage! At the same time, they realized a shocking truth.
‘Crazy! Someone immature like him killed Hades?’
‘He smells like a human.’
‘Someone like that…!’
Lee Gun was a god, but he smelled too much like a human. This wasn’t welcoming news to the gods.
On the other hand, Lee Gun merely cracked his knuckles. While his debt wouldn’t allow him to take out Heaven’s Punishment, he didn’t care about that. “Hurry up and open the door. He’s somewhere in there, right?”
“Call the pillar gods here!”
“Die! Do you think we’ll let someone who smells like a human enter the Great Spirit’s palace— Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun’s red eyes flashed as he disappeared. Brushing past the gods, he used his ability of Death.
[Soul Dismantle (4 star)]
A black shadow surged forward, and the gods screamed. When Lee Gun’s hands touched them, a black wind swept them up, and they disappeared without a trace.
The other gods were frightened when the souls of some gods ceased to exist in front of their eyes.
‘Wait a…’
They seemed to have seen something shocking. It was to be expected since gods didn’t die easily. Unless one messed with their life expectancy, a healing god could easily revive them. This was contingent on the soul being intact.
Yet now, they felt as if the souls of the gods had been ground up!
Lee Gun approached the trembling gods. He had raised the Divine statuses of Life and Death from stages 1 to 6.
Of course, he couldn’t claim that he had methodically raised the stages, but each level possessed a unique ability.
In the case of Death stage 1, the ability was “Eliminate.” It was a basic technique of Death that erased everything, including physical matter. It could be used in a variety of ways, including eliminating armor or skills.
The 2nd stage was “Reaper Summon.” It allowed Lee Gun to summon the deceased. Moreover, it could make the dead submit to him.
The 3rd stage was “Pond Walk (Warp).” With this skill, Lee Gun could travel to locations that possessed shadows, evil intent, and death.
The 4th stage was what he had just used. While Stage 1 Eliminate could temporarily destroy and eliminate everything, stage 4 was different.
‘Soul Disassemble!’
Body, soul, mind, personality, and even non-physical things could be ground up using this technique!
The gods were in disbelief as they watched their peers get disassembled. In the end, they had a realization.
‘That bastard…!’
‘Could it be…!’
Someone spoke aloud what the gods were inwardly thinking. “You are a high-rank god?”
Accompanying the harsh voice, an attack came crashing toward Lee Gun.
Kwah-gwa-gwahng!!
A barrage of red light fell from the sky. Lee Gun immediately moved away.
A male god wearing a leather jacket appeared at the spot where the light hit, and the situation was as if a missile had detonated there.
“I never expected the snake god, who attacked the other gods, to be a brat.”
It wasn’t just one pillar god. Several had appeared.
There was the God of war Ares, Master of the sea Poseidon, and…
‘Ahhhk!!! Why is that kid here?’
Sagittarius had followed the other Zodiacs here, and he almost screamed. He had desperately stopped the other gods from going after Lee Gun, but when the gods mentioned they were going to hide the other parts of Hugo, he followed them.
Sagittarius planned on monitoring the situation and stealing away Hugo, but he froze when he saw Lee Gun.
‘Does he realize what I went through to stop them from going after him?’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“I’ll make sure that snake bastard can’t even pass on his power.”
The war god looked like a delinquent as his eyes flashed.
When he tried to take out his Divine item, Sagittarius froze.
‘All the pillar gods are gathering here.’
If Lee Gun got surrounded by them, he would have a tough time putting up a fight against them. This was why Sagittarius quickly contacted Virgo.
[Where are you? Stop watching Lee Gun in secret. Hurry up and come to the palace of the Great Spirit?!]
The reply came fast.
[Nope. If I go, I’ll be found out immediately because of my life expectancy.]
“!!”
Sagittarius was about to accuse Virgo of running away by herself when…
Poseidon’s eyes flashed as he tried to activate his ability. “I’ll decapitate you and mount your head on top of Olympus’s front gate.”
The master of the sea gathered liquid from the air, intending to kill Lee Gun. However…
Shwehhhhk!!!
“??!!”
A frightening light arrow flew toward him from the back. Poseidon flinched. When he realized who had shot the arrow, he glared at the person. “Louis! Where the hell are you shooting at? I told you to aim for the snake god’s head!”
Sagittarius held his light arrow, looking sad. “Ahhh! I’m sorry! I’m getting old. My eyes aren’t what they used to be.”
Sagittarius clicked his tongue as he tried to take out his Divine item.
Shwehhhhk!!
Once again, an arrow flew toward Poseidon, and this time, the master of the sea became angry. “Louis!!!”
“Oh man! My joints are aching! Phew! You should reach my age. Everything is hard to do.”
“I’m older than you by ten years! How dare you!”
Sagittarius clicked his tongue. If he combined his life as part of the Creator tribe, he was much older than Poseidon. It didn’t matter.
‘I’m sure nephew will go easy on me now—’
When Sagittarius glanced at Lee Gun, he froze. With a bright smile on his lips, Lee Gun mouthed something.
‘You!’
‘You brought them here!’
‘You are dead!’
No, he hadn’t!
Kwahng!!
When an explosion occurred within the palace of the Great Spirit, all the gods flinched.
“That direction is…!”
Lee Gun’s red eyes flashed as he laughed. “Yes. It seems they found him.”
“…!!”
Finally, Lee Gun had no reason to stall them anymore. He let out a cold smile.
The god of war raised his eyebrows.
‘Could it be?’
Poseidon seemed to have realized what was going on, so he contacted the goddess of wisdom and war.
The goddess hadn’t come here. She was left in charge of Pushover.
“The snake god’s comrades went that way. Catch them!”
Yes, Lee Gun hadn’t come here alone. While he kept the gods busy, Yooha and Hugo had already been on the move.
Yooha was the Zodiac Saint of Death. She possessed techniques that used the power of Death. If she used “Hide Presence (Stealth)” and “Passage through Space,” she could easily walk around the palace undetected.
Poseidon struck the ground, causing water to appear on the ground. Then, he shouted in a sharp manner, “I call to all the gods.”
[Olympus’s 12 Pillar Summon (5 star)]
Sagittarius flinched when the bomb went off.
‘What? I’m here, yet he used it?’
This skill was used during the battle between the factions.
Nine pillar gods were summoned from the floor. That wasn’t all.
“That’s him!”
All the scattered gods converged upon them.
When all the gods were gathered in one place, Lee Gun smirked. “Too late, idiots.”
He immediately used his power.
[Pond Walk (3 star)]
A black rotating space appeared behind Lee Gun.
The gods scrunched up their faces. They could tell what kind of ability it was by seeing the energy it was emanating. This was clearly a teleportation-type ability! It made the gods scoff.
“Teleportation abilities are useless in front of the Messenger God.”
The Messenger god could track any god he saw. This was why Hermes could summon anyone once he met them. Moreover, he could track any being even to the depths of hell.
However, Lee Gun laughed. “Where is the Messenger god?”
“…!”
Poseidon blanched when he looked at the pillar gods he had summoned. Aside from the gods whose intentions he didn’t know, he had summoned them all. However, Hermes was not among the summoned.
This surprised the master of the sea. Did Hermes refuse the summon? That couldn’t be the case.
‘He was the most involved in the work involving Pushover. There is no way he would fail to show up when we are about to lose Pushover.’
Hermes had cut away the best parts of Pushover so that he could give it to the Great Spirit. Why would he look on and do nothing?
In the end, Poseidon once again used his ability to summon Hermes.
Flash!
“…!!!”
Something did get summoned within the flash of light. However, when the gods saw what it was, they screamed.
“Ahhhk!!!”
“Wait a moment…!!”
It was a bloodied arm! The arm looked like it had been chewed on by a beast. Half of it was bone, and the other half was mangled flesh.
Nevertheless, the gods immediately recognized who the arm belonged to.
“Hermes-nim!”
“The messenger god is…!”
Poseidon’s face hardened.
‘The Messenger god is dead?’
That wasn’t the real problem.
‘Only one being could treat a god like a piece of meat.’
It was as he expected.
“It seems the recipient was really happy”
“!!!”
Lee Gun’s ability of Death stage 3 had developed after he had killed a clone of the Abyss.
[Stage 3 ability of Death has been influenced.]
[The stats of the ability of Death stage 3 have increased.]
Lee Gun laughed like a fox as he put his hand into the rotating space.
[Pond Walk(3 star)]
When he tried to disappear, the gods rushed after him.
Lee Gun smiled when he saw this. “Eat this.”
“?!”
He picked up a bomb that he had sent to the Great Spirit of Ennead and the monarch.
Sagittarius flinched at the sight of the bomb.
‘That is…!’
He knew what had happened to the Great Spirit when that bomb struck him.
‘No!’
Sagittarius desperately tried to stop his nephew, but Lee Gun nonchalantly threw the bomb.
“Ah!!”
Lee Gun put his hand through the Pond Walk (Warp) space and instantly disappeared.
Flash!
Then, a light encircled the palace of the Great Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 348
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Caught you(?) (1)
At the highest floor inside Olympus’s territory—its greatest base, where the Great Spirit resided—an unidentified light exploded from the skyscraper between the cliffs.
Kwah-gwa-gwahng!
An explosion beyond anyone’s imagination swept through the floor.
“Kyahhhk!”
“What the hell!”
Koo-goo-goong!
Millions of gods lived on the first floor.
The gods who had been chasing after the snake god screamed because of the sudden pressure.
“This is nuts!”
The snake god had dragged their servants to the underworld. The only ones left here were the gods, who had their lifespan reduced. They were already shell-shocked from the reduction of their lifespan, and now, the castle of their greatest god had been hit with a terrorist attack!
However, that wasn’t the only shocking thing.
“The palace is…!”
This palace had remained intact without a single crack even when various factions had attacked it in the past. The greatest artisans of the Divine world had come together to create this Divine piece.
Moreover, the master artisans had borrowed the knowledge and blueprint of the Creators to make this palace.
“The palace fell?!”
“What about the pillar gods? Didn’t they all enter that place?”
“Did they survive?”
The bomb Lee Gun threw at the palace created mayhem inside the palace.
“Koo-hoohk…!”
Having been swept up by the explosion, all the pillar gods were bloodied. They were groaning.
At a glance, it was clear that they were all in bad shape, except for one.
‘Damn it! I almost died…!’
It was none other than Sagittarius.
When Lee Gun had tossed the bomb, Sagittarius had quickly used his defensive skill and moved to a safe location. However, the attack was too powerful.
‘I used my defensive skill, yet I took this much damage.’
Sagittarius furrowed his brows as blood ran down his shoulder.
‘It was a bomb originally used against a monarch.’
During the invasion of the unknown civilization, Lee Gun had delivered this bomb using Yang Wei, who had possessed the body of the armored man.
While that bomb was designed perfectly, it had been made using normal ingredients. That was why that bomb had been unable to kill Lee Gun’s opponent at the time. However, this bomb was different.
‘It’s an item made by grinding up monarchs!’
As expected…
“Kuh-huhk…!”
“What the hell…!!!”
The pillar gods, who had taken a direct blow from Lee Gun, vomited blood. Normally, their lives weren’t under threat, no matter what kind of attacks hit them, but things were different right now.
“Koo-oohk…!”
They had suddenly suffered an attack, unable to use their defensive abilities. This was why their skin was ripped apart and turned into a bloody mess.
They glared at Lee Gun.
“That damn snake bastard…!!”
Sagittarius, who was hiding by himself as he watched this sight, poked his head out from behind a pillar.
“Hey! Po! Are you ok? Are you guys alive?”
Poseidon and the other pillar gods got angry when they heard a familiar voice.
“You crazy…!! Do I look fine to you?! Louis! Why are you the only one unharmed?”
“I’m a genius, unlike you guys?”
The pillar gods became angry. That bastard!
They soon vomited blood, as if they were about to die. It seemed this wasn’t a normal bomb.
“Damn it! It seems to have a poison effect. I can’t move!”
Sagittarius clicked his tongue. “That’s why you should’ve developed your appearance and intelligence instead of muscles.”
“Damn it! Really!”
“Hey! If you plan on speaking such nonsense, you can bring us some healing potions!”
“I don’t want to. It’ll infect me if I get too close to you guys. I’ll get poisoned.”
“Hey!! Be honest with me. You dodged because you knew what was coming. Do you have some kind of relationship with the snake god?”
“No way! I also suffered damage, trying to shield my comrades.”
He looked down at the goddess who was under him. She was one of the gods that the Master of the sea had summoned before the bomb had gone off.
She was the Virgo. He had thrown himself on top of her to protect her. She was part of the twelve Zodiacs, and their Divine statuses were that of siblings.
“See? I suffered a lot of damage too. I had to use forty Permission Tickets—”
Sagittarius’s face stiffened when he looked down. The summoned Virgo seemed to be a stuffed doll. Moreover, the face had a middle finger imprinted on it.
Sagittarius despaired. He had used Permission Tickets to save a doll!
On the other hand, Poseidon ground his teeth. While Virgo’s abilities were strong, Poseidon could never tell what she was thinking. If she were here, Virgo and Sagittarius would have tested his patience. She was better off not being here.
But Hermes was a problem.
‘Without him, we’ll be in a terrible spot.’
Checking if Hermes was dead or alive was their priority. The messenger god was the Divine world’s best informant. Hermes possessed information that could influence the war between factions and the Great Temple War.
‘Then there is the information about the extinct Creator tribe.’
They were trying to revive the Creators, who were called Gods of Blessings. A single Creator could support tens of billions of gods. The Creators were outstanding.
Anyway, the gods had received information that one of them was alive somewhere. They had planned on getting in the good graces of the god of blessing and making him a member of Olympus.
If that didn’t work, they planned on stealing his Divine status so that Olympus could inherit that power. If they could make him an ally, it would certainly be to their benefit.
Hermes possessed information about the whereabouts of this important being. There was no way he would go to the monarch through his own will.
‘That snake bastard…!’
Clearly, the snake god had done something, as he had mentioned a recipient. It didn’t matter in the end. Poseidon had already sent pillar gods in that direction.
“Anyway, the palace has guards. The snake god’s allies have probably been caught already.”
However, his subordinate suddenly expressed his dismay. “That is… The guards within the palace were all defeated!”
“What? How?”
“They lost to a human girl…”
What? Human??
“How did they lose to a human?!”
“The spear she’s wielding caused problems…”
“Spear?”
* * *
The heart of the Great Spirit’s palace…
A black rotating space appeared on the ceiling. Lee Gun popped out of the rotating space and landed like a squirrel.
Tuhk!
He smirked as he looked at his surroundings. “I should’ve expected this.”
He thought the inside of the palace would be crawling with guards, but the guards had been ruthlessly slaughtered a while back.
Lee Gun knew who did it because he saw a familiar-shaped wound caused by a spear. Pleased, he asked his Constructs, “Where are those two? Did they find the other pieces of Taeksoo?”
[Yes. They did find him, but someone is in their way.]
Lee Gun laughed when he heard Eeny’s (Jarl) words. “Alright. We just have to get out of this place. You should make preparations for an escape.”
[Yes. Does that mean Master will go with them…]
“Nope! I have something I’m looking for.”
[You are looking for something?]
“Yes. Taek—”
At that moment…
“!!!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he extended his hand.
Chaeng!!
He deflected a blade flying toward him. It wasn’t a normal sword, as Lee Gun’s hand started bleeding.
Poo-hahk!
‘!’
It was a blade that could pass through his ability. He was surrounded by the power of Eliminate (Death), yet the blade had pierced through the protection and his skin.
Then, a beautiful woman in her late twenties walked toward him with a long blade in hand. The woman had black hair, and she wore a white shirt. She was also equipped with a sword.
[Divine Status: Athena (Master of Resourcefulness)]
[Divine Name: Patron of Darkness]
“You’re the one who deceived the pillar gods.”
The pillar gods had chased after him and exited before the bomb went off.
Lee Gun tried to move toward the goddess, but he found that he couldn’t move.
‘!’
The cause was the suspicious words that appeared behind him.
<Keep one’s beauty>
“…!”
That wasn’t all. Another phrase appeared next.
<Create the most beautiful appearance in the world>
When those words emitted light, blood started gushing out from various locations around his body.
Poo-hahk!
“Koohk!”
Soon, he realized who the culprit was.
“My god! The sight of you shedding blood is quite beautiful.”
“!’
The one who had made words appear around Lee Gun was a golden-haired goddess. She looked to be a female warrior accustomed to fighting.
[Divine Status: Aphrodite (Master of Praise)]
[Divine name: Praise the Absolute Beauty]
[Master of Praise has used “Praise of Beauty (5 star)”]
[Praise of Beauty (5 star)]
-The goddess of beauty sends a signal, and her opponent will change into a form that she considers beautiful and ideal.
[Warning! Divine Power: 7% (Cannot use ability)]
[If it falls below 5%, it will cease to function. You will faint.]
[If it reaches 0%, you will die.]
Because of the goddess who carried herself like a queen, Lee Gun couldn’t use his abilities and Divine power.
A voice rang out at that moment.
“Gods are the most beautiful when they are helpless. When I see the most arrogant gods lose their pride, their faces become very beautiful to me”
Lee Gun clenched his fists when confronted by the psycho. The goddess smiled as if to say his efforts were in vain.
Then a long vine-like object encircled him.
“From what I’ve heard, your Divine power keeps refilling if Pushover stays by your side. Is that true?”
“!”
It seemed Eco, who had been in the underworld, had spread the rumor that Hugo was a battery.
“However, we have Pushover in custody. You won’t be able to use your ability.”
Lee Gun smirked at those words. Ability? He just had to destroy this binding skill using brute strength.
He was about to put strength into his arms when Aphrodite ordered her subordinates, “You guys should go alert the auction house.”
“What? Auction house? Why would we…”
“Why else? Can’t you see this guy? At a glance, you can tell he is high quality. Of course, we’ll sell him. I’m sure we’ll be able to sell for a high price to the goddesses.”
Her subordinates flinched.
“You can’t do that! The Great Spirit of Olympus ordered us to bring the snake god to him!”
“Ah! That’s right. He did say that.”
Lee Gun stopped moving when he heard that. His eyebrows rose.
‘Great Spirit?’
His eyes rolled around as if he was conflicted. The important parts of Taeksoo had been taken by the Great Spirit. What if he let them capture him? Wouldn’t he be able to go to the Great Spirit?
Lee Gun smirked at that crazy idea. He was about to purposefully go limp so that he could be dragged away. But…
“Look at his child! He’s like a natural monument that is hard to find in this universe! He’s a virgin!! Do you realize how much money he could be sold for?!”
“?!”
Lee Gun looked at Aphrodite, taken aback.
Aphrodite suddenly expressed her anger at her subordinate. “Do you know this? He’s a virgin who has never held the hand of a woman! Virgin! A product of his quality is very rare! He’s fresh meat! Do you realize how much money the starving goddesses will give me!!!”
A vein popped out on Lee Gun’s forehead.
With a serious expression, the goddess looked Lee Gun up and down. “Huhk! Maybe he’s a virgin because he can’t get it up…”
Crunch!!
“Who cares! It doesn’t matter once I sell him. Oh yeah. Are the stats of this snake god so high because he is a virgin? I might have to research it.”
Crunch!!!!!!
Lee Gun became angry, but the goddess didn’t care as she grabbed him by the face. “Stop resisting and submit to me—”
“You little maggot!!!” Lee Gun immediately headbutted Aphrodite.
Bbah-gahk!!!
Lee Gun’s hard head smashed into the face of the absolute beauty.
“Kuh-huhk…!!”
When Aphrodite started bleeding from the nose, Athena’s eyes turned round. Of course, she knew what such strength meant. Her underlings were shocked.
“S-she’s the famed goddess of Olympus, known for her beauty!!”
“Oh my! I knew your body looked good. It seems you’re a fighting-type god.”
Athena looked interested as she unsheathed her sword.
On the other hand, Lee Gun continued to stomp on Aphrodite. “Bitch! What is it to you that I’m a virgin?”
“Kuhk! No! kuh-huhk!! Kuhk!”
“I feel sick that I was trapped in the tower because of the gods, yet you dare say that! You want to die!”
Lee Gun ripped apart the vine surrounding his body with strength.
Kwah-jeek!!
The gods shook in fear at his surprising strength.
Lee Gun seemed furious. He continued to beat Aphrodite. “Damn it. I planned on acting weak and getting captured! You ruined my plan! That’s why I’m going to hit you more!”
The gods trembled as Lee Gun used a string of harsh curse words. They had never heard such language before. They were unimaginably low-class words that threatened to damage the minds of the gods.
“He’s small like an acorn, yet he’s a fighting-type god!”
“He is beating her up without using any of his abilities?!”
Abilities, my ass!
“Fuck off! Who cares about dog shit abilities!! I just need my fists!!”
In the first place, his abilities were merely buffs! They were the cherry on top!
Aphrodite stood up in the face of Lee Gun’s attacks. “I went easy on you because you are a product—”
Poo-hahk!
“Kyahhhk!!”
Someone had stabbed her. It was none other than Athena.
Aphrodite was shocked when she was stabbed in her thigh. She glared at Athena. “What are you doing? Can you not differentiate between an ally and foe?”
Athena also glared at her as she flicked off the blood. It was as if she found the blood dirty.
“I can. Fuck off! I’ll make him my Construct. He’s my type.”
“What?!”
“I told you to fuck off.”
“Hey!”
When Athena stomped on the ground, the floor disappeared as a light swept it up. Aphrodite fell into the earth.
“Kyahhhk!”
When the person getting in her way was gone, Athena walked toward Lee Gun. “I really find your temper adorable. Become my Construct.”
The subordinates were shocked by these words.
“Goddess! We have to take the snake god to the Great Spirit!”
“Just say he died. I’ll do a better job growing him. In terms of the number of Constructs, I’m in the top ten within the Divine world.”
“You shouldn’t!”
“Be my Con—”
At that moment…
“Construct, my ass!”
“!!”
Someone shoved a monarch weapon into Athena’s back.
Poo-oohk!!
“How dare you aim for him?”
“Kuh-huhk!!!”
Athena vomited blood.
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when an unexpected woman appeared in front of him. She wasn’t supposed to be here.
“Yeonwoo?”
The woman wearing a mask flinched at the mention of that name.
“Yeonwoo? Who is that?”
“What?”
The newcomer shouted as she continued to sweat, “I-I’m Saint Mask!! I’m not Yeonwoo!!”
“???”
Really?
