chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Caught you(?) (2)
Lee Gun looked at the woman, dumbfounded.
‘Saint Mask?’
If she wanted to bamboozle him, she should do it properly. She had worn a golden mask with feathers. Lee Gun wondered if she really thought she could wear a shoddy mask to fool him.
“Kuhk…!”
Athena vomited blood after being stabbed by Yeonwoo. She then glared at her opponent. It was for no other reason.
‘She is…!’
Her gaze remained locked on Yeonwoo. The mask didn’t allow Athena to see Yeonwoo’s face, but the gods could sense each other’s souls. Although it didn’t feel the same as before, Athena felt that this soul was familiar.
‘She smells like one of the twin snakes…’
This newcomer smelled like the twin snakes who had acted as the temporary Zodiac for the Serpent Bearer temple. This surprised Athena.
‘Weren’t those snakes executed after their owner was killed?’
The head of the thirteen Zodiacs had been a Creator named Aslan. He was the Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple.
Aslan and his twelve comrades had lost their minds and were executed by their Constructs. It had been a huge scandal within the Divine world. It was to be expected since one of the nine great factions had been destroyed.
The thirteen gods who had been executed were the Creators, who had been called the gods of blessings.
Anyway, the Creators had been wiped out at that time, and the twin snakes had succeeded Aslan. However, they were also executed when they were accused of using the magic of the evil gods.
So why was Athena smelling the snake, who was executed a long time ago?
No, that wasn’t important right now.
‘The Constructs under the Serpent Bearer are the problem!’
Back then, the Serpent Bearer sat atop the Divine world because of the quality of his Constructs. When the Serpent Bearer temple had fallen, the Great Spirits of the eight great factions had gleefully stolen the Serpent Bearer’s Constructs.
Each faction was still using those Constructs as important slaves. While the twin snakes might have been temporary Zodiacs, they belonged to the Serpent Bearer temple.
‘Those slaves might react to her…!’
The old Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple might get the wrong idea and rebel. They might try to escape. That would be troublesome.
‘The other Creators aren’t the problem.’
The magic god Aslan had been a cheat-like existence. It was different for the other Creators, who were executed alongside him.
‘The fact that they were usurped by their Constructs means that the Creator tribe wasn’t that big of a deal.’
This was why Athena was skeptical of finding the Creators. However, it was a completely different story for the Constructs, which had been stolen from the Serpent Bearer temple.
Oblivious to all of this, Lee Gun looked at Yeonwoo with his brows furrowed. “Hey, Ji Yeonwoo. Why are you here?”
Yeonwoo, who had worn a fancy festival mask with gold trim and feathers, started sweating. “J-Ji Yeonwoo? I’m Saint Mask. I’m not Yeonwoo.”
Lee Gun scoffed. “You really thought I wouldn’t recognize you?”
Shocked, Yeonwoo sweated even more. “I-I’m not her! I came here because Miss Yeonwoo asked me to! I’m Saint Mask!!!”
“What the hell are you doing at your age?”
Yeonwoo wanted to cry.
But Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “Why are you here? What about Miss Jiwoo? No, how were you able to come here?”
“Ah, Miss Jiwoo! I left my clone— No. I meant Miss Yeonwoo is taking good care of her! Anyway, I came here because I needed to deliver something to you!”
“Ah! Is that so?” Lee Gun still looked at her with an incredulous expression.
On the other hand, Yeonwoo surveyed her surroundings. “Excuse me, Serpent Bearer.”
“What.”
Yeonwoo looked around Lee Gun as if she were looking for someone. “Do you… Do you have a party? Are you here with someone? ”
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. “I’m alone.”
“W-What about Yooha? From what I heard, she followed you…”
“Yooha is with her father.”
For a variety of reasons, Yeonwoo felt a sense of relief as she took a deep breath. Then she asked another question as if she had just remembered something else. “Ah! Is there anyone else aside from her…”
“Anyone else?”
“Do you have a party member aside from her?”
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. He had no idea why she was acting this way. “I got my Constructs. Who else would be here? I told everyone to stay on the earth.”
After getting the confirmation, Yeonwoo looked very relieved. “Then take this. I brought it here just in case… Miss Yeonwoo wanted me to give this to you.”
“!”
Yeonwoo brought out the weapons Lee Gun had made. He had made them on the earth by grinding up monarchs.
“I knew you didn’t take the bow.”
When Yeonwoo opened the rifle case she was carrying, Lee Gun was pleased. Inside it was a bow. It was the one he hadn’t assembled yet. He had planned on giving that bow to Taeksoo after bringing him back.
“Oh! Taeksoo will be able to fight if he has this.”
Although his Divine status getting stolen was part of it, Hugo had been acting very weak within the Divine world.
“I won’t let you do as you please.”
“!”
Athena, who had fallen to the ground after vomiting blood, charged toward Lee Gun like a ghost. She was a pillar god and a fighting-type god for a reason.
With a violent look in her eyes, she swung her sword. She was frighteningly fast.
‘He can’t use a bow in a close-ranged fight.’
It meant she just had to get rid of the unknown weapon that had pierced through a pillar god’s defense!
Her fierce sword strike hit the sword Yeonwoo held in her hands.
Chang!
“!”
Yeonwoo flinched.
As if she wanted to extract Lee Gun’s Divine status, Athena let out a violent Divine power.
Kwah-jee-jeek!
At that moment, Aphrodite had depleted Lee Gun’s Divine power, so he wasn’t able to use his abilities.
That wasn’t all.
‘He no longer has that bizarre weapon.’
It was her victory!
[Divine Death Strike (5 star)]
“I’ll make you my body slave.” Athena was about to extend her Divine power, but…
Lee Gun made a fist in annoyance.
Poohk!!
“Kuh-huhk?!”
Athena, who had been charging forward with great force, suddenly fell forward.
Pooh-hahk!!
As if she were hunting down an animal, someone had planted a spear in Athena’s back.
“Body slave? You want to die.”
“?!”
It was Yooha. She was really far.
Flustered, Athena glared at her.
‘From that distance?!’
It seemed the blood of the Archer Saint did flow through her. Yooha had thrown the spear from several hundred meters away and had hit a bullseye.
The eyes of Lee Gun and Yeonwoo turned round. At that distance, Yooha was showing an ability beyond humankind.
Soon, Lee Gun looked at the goddess, who was in pain.
“Kuh-huhk!”
After pulling out the spear, he held her up. Then he threw her into the hole that Aphrodite had fallen through.
“Kyahhk!!”
In the end, Athena also fell from the palace of the Great Spirit. She fell below the clouds, and Lee Gun once again threw a weapon toward the falling goddess!
Kwahng!!!
“Kyahhhhk!!”
[You have acquired data.]
[You have recorded a new Achievement.]
Lee Gun laughed when he hit a bullseye.
Yooha arrived next to him, out of breath. “Uncle. You weren’t sullied— No. Are you ok?”
At that moment…
“Uh?”
Yooha saw Yeonwoo when she got close to Lee Gun, and her eyes turned round in surprise. “Uh… Yeonwoo… Unni…”
“No!!! I’m Saint Mask!! I’m not this person called Yeonwoo!”
“????”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue when he saw Yeonwoo desperately deny the truth. However, he soon tilted his head in puzzlement. “Yooha. What about your dad?”
“?!!”
When he mentioned her father, Yooha’s face turned pale. “Oh my god! I left behind Dad!!!”
“W-What?”
“I heard it through the wiretap. Some women were talking about turning Uncle into a body slave! I couldn’t help myself!”
My word! She was going to make her father cry.
* * *
Around that time…
“Ahhhhk!!”
Left by himself, Hugo was screaming. He was dodging and running away from a man swinging a blade.
“Hey, come here!”
“Ahhk! Don’t come near me!”
“Damn it! You’re like a mouse running away!”
An annoyed, expressionless man was chasing him. It was the war god Ares. He had been dispatched early on to guard Hugo’s Divine status, which Hugo’s party had been looking for.
Before Lee Gun’s bomb had gone off, he had entered the palace with Athena and Aphrodite.
Yooha had come here with her father to recover his Divine status, yet she had suddenly disappeared.
“Ahhk! Although I don’t remember her well, you’re supposed to be my daughter! How could you leave behind your father?”
Hugo was like a mouse as he dodged Ares’s sword. In truth, he didn’t remember much about his family, including Yooha.
Regarding Yooha, he remembered snippets of him holding her when she was a baby. He remembered taking her around when she was young.
He realized she treasured Lee Gun enough to abandon her dad, but he was still in disbelief. They had been hiding and avoiding Ares even when his daughter was present.
However, Yooha had become surprised when she had heard something. She told him to wait and disappeared.
Afterward, he had been discovered by Ares’s area of effect skill.
“If I’m being honest, Olympus became a mess because of Pushover!!”
“!”
Ares raised his sword in annoyance. “If it wasn’t for you, the crazy snake god wouldn’t have come here.”
“Damn it! What the hell are you saying? If we’re going to quibble, you should be mad at Hades, who kidnapped me in the first place…!”
“Whatever! I’m annoyed because they dragged me out of my bed!! Just die!”
Damn it! This god had as foul a temper as his friend.
However, Hugo couldn’t fight even if he wanted to. He didn’t have any weapons, and his Divine status was missing. He was a regular human right now.
‘Damn it! This isn’t the time for me to be doing this.’
Hugo remembered the time when he had been imprisoned inside Hades’s palace.
[What? The Creators are alive?]
[Yes! Even the Great Spirits are looking for them.]
At times, a god named Hermes had visited Hades’s palace to meet the master of the underworld.
Hugo had heard a crucial piece of information there. This was why Hugo had sent the strange letter as a paper airplane from within Hades’s palace.
Anyway, he had good reasons to quickly get out of this place, but…
‘Damn it! I’ll die before I can do that!!!’
Hugo screamed as he dodged Ares’s sword. In the end, he had been corralled into a dead end!
Ares let out a dangerous smirk. “You’re a useless clone. I’ll show mercy as a god. I’ll just cut off your legs. It doesn’t matter since you will only live for a week.”
Finally, Ares raised his blade.
Hugo desperately yelled when he had nowhere to run away. “W-Wait!”
“Hmmph. It’s useless to beg for your life…”
“I’m not the Zodiac Saint of the snake god!! I’m the Zodiac Saint of Sagittarius!! Yes, I’m his Construct! I’m a subordinate directly under Sagittarius!”
“What?”
Ares looked shocked. He retracted his blade a bit. “Ah! I’m sorry! Did you just say you are Louis’s Construct?”
Hugo smiled in relief. “Yes! Sagittarius is your friend, right?”
“Wow! You’re the servant of that asshole!”
“Huh?”
“Haha haha! I’ll just kill you right here!!!”
“Ahhhhhk!!!”
Ares summoned a great sword that couldn’t be compared to the one he had before.
Hugo almost let out a string of curses when Ares attacked more fiercely.
“Die, servant of that asshole Sagittarius!!!”
“Ahhh!! Damn you, Sagittarius! How do you usually act around others!!!”
Hugo swung the blade Lee Gun had given to him for temporary use. However, the war god sent him flying as though he were a piece of paper. Hugo had lost in terms of strength.
Kwahng!!
“Koo-oohk!”
This was a celestial world where Zodiacs had gathered. The Zodiacs were like grains of sand in how numerous they were. The gap between a human and a god was huge.
‘Damn it! Unless I recover my Divine status…!’
Poo-hahk!!
“!!!”
A spear flew through the air like a beam of light and pierced through Ares’s arm.
“Koo-ahhk!!”
When Ares screamed, Hugo’s face brightened as he looked up. “Daughter! You are back—”
Hugo’s expression was a sight to behold when he realized who had attacked Ares. For some odd reason, a long-haired woman wearing a mask was there.
“Are you ok?”
Hugo looked taken aback. “Hailey?”
The woman wearing a mask flinched. “I-I’m not Hailey!! I’m Black Scorpion!! You mistook me for someone else!”
“???”
Excuse me?
She was Hailey, no matter how one looked at it! She wasn’t supposed to be here!

chapters.title: Chapter 350
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Caught you(?) (3)
Hugo was taken aback. His memories weren’t whole, and it felt as if pieces of the puzzle went missing. He had memories he could recall and memories he couldn’t. Despite this, he knew about Hailey’s existence.
So, he asked, “Why are you here, Hailey?”
The masked Hailey flinched. “No! I’m not Hailey! I am Black Scorpion…!”
“Hey, if you plan on hiding your identity, you should change your name. Scorpion? Why are you acting this way?”
“No. That is…” Hailey discreetly surveyed her surroundings.
Hugo’s eyes turned round when he realized something. “Did you come chasing after Gun?”
It was as he had expected. Hailey started to sweat as she fixed her mask. “That is… Lee Gun was adamant when he said I shouldn’t come here. What would happen if he finds out that I’m here? That’s why I’m not Hailey right now. Do you understand?”
She was persistent, but no one in the world looked like her. She could be no one else…
‘No. That’s not important right now.’
“What are you doing in the Divine world? Aren’t you natural enemies with the gods? You’re a monarch!”
“What do you mean I’m a monarch?”
“I heard you were a general in the past! You even acted as a proxy for the monarchs! Do you realize how much praise your underlings spoke about you? They said you were a monarch-rank being!”
Surprised, Hailey looked around at her surroundings. Her subordinates seemed to have said some unnecessary things while she was absent.
It was true that she used to be a general. She had also acted as a proxy for a monarch, but…
“That is the me from a very distant past…”
“It doesn’t change that you’re classified as someone from the unknown civilization. The gods became apoplectic just from hearing your name…”
While he was imprisoned, Hugo had heard and witnessed it several times. The gods ground their teeth whenever the unknown civilization was mentioned.
The unknown civilization liked eating gods. They occupied the role of predators, so the gods’ reactions were understandable.
Anyway, this current situation couldn’t be good for Hailey.
“The gods will try to kill you if they see you…”
“That’s why I have to keep it further under wraps. In truth, I invaded this place in the past…”
Mmm? She invaded this place?
When Hugo looked at her in an inquiring manner, Hailey furrowed her brows. “They probably won’t recognize me, but in the distant past, the monarchs attacked the Divine world. I entered the Divine world and destroyed this place.”
“Destroyed?”
“Well, our actions caused the population of the Divine world to drop by two-thirds. The Divine world was sent into the dark ages for a hundred years… Oh well! I’m here because I was worried about Lee Gun. I won’t do anything this time. Don’t worry too much about it!”
Hugo’s eyes turned round. That wasn’t what he had expected. Since Hailey was the natural enemy of the gods, he had worried they would attack her.
‘If that’s the case, shouldn’t I be aggressively asking for her help?’
Hugo quickly grabbed her. “Hailey! Help me! I have to take back my Divine status from him!”
“What? Divine status?”
Kwahng!!!
“!”
Ares appeared once again, bleeding because of the spear Hailey threw. “Damn it! What’s up with that woman?”
“!”
A violent expression appeared on his face as he approached them.
Hugo, who had been attacked by Ares until this moment, froze.
Hailey furrowed her brows. “Now that I think about it, you lost your Divine status. Did that barbarian do it?”
“No. The goddess of fate stole it, but… Anyway, the extracted Divine status is inside the inner room! This bastard has the key to the room! I’m not sure if we can take it from him—”
“You’re a mere human, yet you talk about Divine status!” Ares cut off Hugo.
“Koo-oohk!”
Powerful lightning fell all around him. Red light sparked like lightning. It was Ares’s Divine power, which paralyzed Hugo.
“How dare a sack of flesh like you even dare get involved in our matters! This place is the tower for the exalted gods. Know your place.”
“…!”
“As a mere human, you merely acquired one Divine status. Did you really think that’ll put you on the same footing as the gods?”
Ares instantly appeared in front of them. He raised his Divine power as if he found them feeble. “A sack of flesh from the colonies should know your place!”
Finally, his greatsword fell toward their heads.
“…!”
Hugo gritted his teeth. It seemed they wouldn’t last long enough for Lee Gun to get there.
Kahng!!!
Suddenly, the falling greatsword stalled in the air.
‘!’
Ares was surprised.
Doo-doo-doohk!
Hailey had blocked the falling sword and that too with only one hand!
Ares tried to push her down with strength, but Hailey merely smirked. “Your attack is light. It’s like being attacked by a baby.”
“?!”
Ares flinched when he saw the eyes behind her mask. The reason was the menacing magical energy his opponent emanated. Her pupils narrowed like a carnivore!
‘This bitch!’
He was sure of it. She was a monster from the unknown civilization! Moreover, she wasn’t an ordinary one.
Ares ground his teeth. Since Pushover knew her, there was a high probability that she was a friend of the snake god. This left him dumbfounded. What did that snake god bring into the Divine world?
Ares quickly tried to take back his blade, but he couldn’t dislodge it.
Hailey’s smile was cold. “From the looks of it, you seem to be a baby god. You inherited your power not too long ago.”
“…!”
“You should either unseal your abilities or get rid of your cheap weapons. If not…”
“!”
“You will become food.”
The next second, Ares’s weapon broke.
Zzuhng!!!!
Are looked at Hailey, flabbergasted. He was sure of it! Pupils like that didn’t exist amongst gods, and her magical energy gave it away!
“This is nuts. Why is a monarch— Kuh-huhk!”
Hailey immediately struck Ares’s solar plexus.
Tuh-uhng!
The incredible power made Ares vomit blood.
However, he was called the god of war for a reason. He retreated as he tried to keep his body out of harm’s way.
‘Damn it! The battle isn’t important right now. I have to tell everyone that someone from the unknown civilization snuck in—!’
But as if she had read Ares’s thoughts, Hailey ruthlessly sent her fist flying.
Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!!!
“Hey, Taeksoo. Are you there?”
“?!”
Suddenly, hearing Lee Gun’s voice, Hailey got scared out of her wits.
Hugo turned to look at Lee Gun as if to greet him.
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement as he looked at the fallen god of war. “What the hell? Who did this?”
“What? Can’t you see? Who else do you think…” Hugo’s eyes turned round when he turned his gaze.
Hailey, who had been here until a moment ago, was gone. “What the hell? Where did she go???”
“What are you doing? Were you having a dream?”
“No. Hailey was…” Hugo was about to say Hailey was here, but he was surprised. The reason was the woman following Lee Gun. “That person is…?”
Did Miss Yeonwoo chase after Lee Gun?
Yeonwoo flinched at the questioning gaze. She shouted, “Ahhk, friend of the snake god, do not be surprised! I’m not Yeonwoo! I’m called the Snake Mask…!!”
“Didn’t you say you were Saint Mask earlier?”
“…?!”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue as he headed toward Ares. The culprit seemed to have purposefully erased her presence, but he had a good idea as to who had done this. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘The gods are gathering here.’
It seemed those damn bastards had felt their presence.
Lee Gun suddenly turned to grab Hugo’s shoulder. “Look at this, Taeksoo. Isn’t it awesome?”
Hugo’s eyes turned round when Lee Gun brought out a bow. “That is…!”
“I made it on the earth. I did it while thinking about my only friend. I hope you like it.”
“!!”
Hugo looked moved.
[Your Divine power has been recharged.]
[Divipower 7% ▶ 80%]
Hugo was so moved that he extended his hand. “Thank you, Gun. I’ll use it well—”
“Die, damn bastard!!!”
“?!”
Poo-hahk!!!!
As soon as his Divine power was recharged, Lee Gun imbued the bow with Divine power and ruthlessly beat up Ares. It seemed he had never planned on giving the bow to Hugo.
“Ha ha ha! You can become my nutrient!!!”
Poo-hahk! Poo-hahk! Poo-hahk!!!
He had learned this from Yooha using her spear. The weapons made from the monarchs reacted especially to the blood of gods. Basically, they grew stronger as they ate more gods.
“Give me your data!!”
Hugo realized he had been used. He was about to express his anger when…
“Snake god!”
“!”
Pillar gods rushed into the castle. They were the ones who had gotten injured by the explosion. However, they seemed to have been healed, as they had been cleaned up quite a bit.
Lee Gun, who was drenched in the blood of gods, crushed Ares’s head with the bow.
Bbah-gahk!!
“!”
“You guys are next.”
“What a psycho!”
Soon, Poseidon’s eyes flashed. Water-shaped horses attacked Lee Gun from all over the palace.
“Gun!!”
Being hit by the attack would flatten him. Lee Gun smirked as he touched Hugo and Yeonwoo.
[Pond Walk (3 star)]
A shadow surged up from the ground and swallowed up Lee Gun, Hugo, and Yeonwoo. It was Warp.
They reappeared in the deepest part of the Great Spirit’s palace!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Yeonwoo landed lightly. Hugo covered his mouth as if he wanted to vomit.
They had arrived inside a holy dome that contained the statue of the Great Spirit. Despite being the palace of a god, this space was filled with malice.
Lee Gun imbued Divine power into the key he had stolen from Ares. Then something surprising happened.
Doo-doo-doo-doohk!!!
The sculpture of the Great Spirit split apart, and a shining core appeared within it.
[Pushover’s Divine Status]
Lee Gun laughed as he extended his hand toward the core.
Kwahng!
However, a powerful laser-like light pierced through the wall and flew toward him.
‘!’
It was Poseidon’s attack. Despite being sent from a long distance, the attack still contained unimaginable power.
“How dare you enter the Great Spirit’s space!”
The voice of a god rang out as if it was going to shake heaven and earth.
Tuhng!
Blood leaked out of Hugo’s ears since he was human.
Poseidon’s attack flew toward them once again.
Kwahng!
“Koohk!”
When the ceiling and the ground collapsed, Yeonwoo clasped her hands as she clenched her eyes shut. Then a green light emanated from her. The falling debris stopped in the air as if there was no gravity.
Stepping on the floating fragments, Lee Gun jumped into the sky. He was trying to regain Hugo’s Divine status, which was floating in the air. However, when Lee Gun extended his hand…
“There is no way I’ll let you take it!” Poseidon smirked. When he flicked his finger, another beam of light flew toward Lee Gun.
Tuh-uhng!
The light split into two like shooting stars. They headed toward Lee Gun and Hugo’s Divine status.
“!”
Lee Gun immediately realized what Poseidon intended to do.
‘He’s saying one of us must die.’
If Lee Gun blocked the attack coming toward him, Hugo’s Divine status would be destroyed. If he grabbed Hugo’s Divine status, he would be hit by the attack.
‘If I take a direct hit, it’ll cause a lot of damage.’
On the other hand, his answer was already chosen. Lee Gun chose Hugo’s Divine status.
Yeonwoo immediately tried to take action, but Lee Gun mumbled something, which made her flinch.
In the end, Poseidon’s attack pierced through Lee Gun’s body.
Kwahng!
When Lee Gun vomited blood, the gods laughed as they approached him from the distance. Hugo’s face turned pale, and he rushed toward Lee Gun.
“Gun!”
Lee Gun smirked as he grabbed Hugo by the back of his neck. “Whatever! Just pay back the debt.”
“What— Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun pierced Hugo’s stomach with the hand holding the Divine status.
Hugo gurgled as he felt a foreign object enter him, but Lee Gun merely laughed. “Even if I die, I have to send you back to your family.”
“Gun…!!”
“Name your third child after me.”
“!”
Lee Gun looked like he was about to die. He laughed as if he was leaving behind a dying wish.
Shocked, Hugo tried to say something, but a black puddle of space appeared beneath Hugo and Yeonwoo.
“I’m sorry I won’t be able to go home with you. Tell Sungjae I’m sorry for not being able to keep my promise.”
Realizing the meaning behind his friend’s words, Hugo desperately tried to grab Lee Gun. “Gun! No…!!”
However, Hugo became speechless when he was swallowed up by the shadow alongside Yeonwoo. They had been teleported to a different location.
After making Hugo cry, Lee Gun let out an evil laugh, as if his near-death state was a lie. The wound that looked like it could kill him healed in an instant.
[The disciple with high faith is full of emotions.]
[Divine Power 60% ▶ 100%]
‘I completed the requirement with this.’
If Lee Gun wanted to release his stage 6 skills, his Divine power had to be over 90%. That was why he had planned out this scenario.
Lee Gun cackled.
‘As expected, this is amazing.’
[You are a very noisy bastard]
“!”
The voice of Olympus’s Great Spirit rang out.
A subtle change occurred in Lee Gun’s eyes when he heard the voice. At that moment, the pillar gods continued to get closer to him.
“Stay still! You’re surrounded!”
“Louis! What are you doing? Get him!”
As per Poseidon’s order, Sagittarius pulled back on his enormous bow made out of light. However, the arrow missed by a large margin.
The eyes of the gods turned round when they saw this.
“Louis!”
“Ah! My hand slipped! I’m sorry! I lost my grip!”
“Hey! Why are you being like this?”
The missed arrow destroyed the ground. Sagittarius smiled when he saw this.
‘He’ll be able to run away easily using that.’
He had purposefully aimed for the floor leading to the underground tunnel.
The other gods summoned a net, but Sagittarius merely laughed.
‘He’ll be able to dodge that with room to spare…’
However, Lee Gun didn’t dodge.
“?!”
Instead of dodging, he let himself get caught in the net.
The gods yelled in delight, but Saggitarius was flustered.
‘What the hell? Why?’
The pillar gods assumed Lee Gun had run out of power, and they approached him. Athena and Aphrodite, whom Lee Gun had sent flying, were there too.
“You really gave us trouble!”
“Whatever! Let’s drag him to the Great Spirit!”
Accompanying their words, the scenery changed.
Flash!
Tied up in chains, Lee Gun was dropped off inside an unfamiliar palace. This palace was on a different level compared to the others he had seen. It was fancy and large.
“!”
An unfamiliar figure appeared in front of him. The powerful light made his appearance indistinct; it had to be the Great Spirit.
All the pillar gods, who had arrived before him, glared at Lee Gun as they spoke.
“Is that the snake god, who turned Olympus into a mess?”
“He wasn’t as inexperienced as I thought.”
However, something else bothered them the most.
“Someone like you shouldn’t have been able to enter Olympus.”
“Who let you into Olympus? Speak! Who is it?”
“!!”
Sagittarius flinched, but then rolled his eyes.
‘That child agreed he wouldn’t talk about me.’
Even if either of them were caught, they decided to act as if they didn’t know each other. That was the plan. It would allow them to create an opportunity to do something. Of course, his nephew would be tortured at this rate, but he could do nothing.
‘I have to live first.’
In the end, Lee Gun was at fault for instigating all of this.
[It’s fine. I’ll ask him.]
“Great Spirit!”
[Who are you?]
Lee Gun smirked as he answered, “Who am I? I’m his nephew.” He pointed at Sagittarius.
Everyone within the palace froze, then the pillar gods became angry.
[Louis]
Sagittarius turned pale from fright.
‘Ahhk! Nephew!!!’
You weren’t supposed to reveal that!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 351
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Nephew! (1)
Sagittarius Louis. Once, he had been a part of the Creator tribe.
It was not too long ago after Lee Gun’s father, Aslan, was born, the time when Sagittarius was called Garan.
“Hyung-nim! Garan hyung-nim!”
“You’ll fall, Aslan. Don’t run.”
Everyone had been envious of Garan at that time. He was a god who had everything, including wealth and power.
However, his mother wasn’t a creator, so he wasn’t officially part of the Creator tribe. That was why he was jealous and afraid of his genius little brother, Aslan, who was outstanding.
Blinded by jealousy, Garan had helped to kill the Creators. He had usurped the positions of the Creators. However, his and the other usurpers’ thrones were later stolen in the same fashion by their underlings.
Garan realized that his throne being usurped was the revenge enacted by his younger brother, and he saw the big picture. He thought of his underlings murdering him as a way to pay off his sins.
Of course, he had never expected the underling who had killed him to fail to fully absorb him and die. Instead of his underling’s personality, Garan’s personality had remained in the body.
Moreover, he never expected his nephew, whom he had suddenly gained, to be so unreasonable. He had also never expected his nephew to stab his uncle in the back like this!!
“Who am I? I’m his nephew.”
‘Ahhk! Nephew!!!’
You weren’t supposed to reveal that!!!
Sagittarius became pale from fright when Lee Gun revealed his identity. Of all the places to reveal it, he had done it in front of the pillar gods and the Great Spirit!
Sagittarius felt murderous intent directed toward him from his surroundings!
“He’s your nephew…”
“Is that how it is? That snake god is your nephew?”
“It isn’t like…that!” The desperate Saggitarius looked at Lee Gun.
However, Lee Gun had the brightest smile on his face. His expression said Sagittarius was being thrown to the wolves. It was up to him to survive this situation.
Boom!
“!!”
The Great Spirit’s castle shook violently.
Sagittarius felt like dying as the Great Spirit’s power raged around him.
‘There is no way he’ll kill a high-rank god.’
The gods used their power as if they were going to make Sagittarius give up his power. Because of Lee Gun, Olympus had been attacked and cheated by the other factions.
“Yes. There had to be a connection for him to be able to enter the holy grounds of Olympus.”
“Louis, you playboy bastard. I was wondering why you couldn’t properly attack the snake god.”
“In the recent fight between the factions, you didn’t even participate. You went off to play. I thought you had lost your touch.”
“No!”
Sagittarius once again looked at Lee Gun as if he were asking for help, but Lee Gun was still laughing as though he were innocent.
Seeing himself surrounded, Sagittarius inevitably became angry. “Hey! How can you believe that? He’s lying!”
“He’s lying?”
“Yes. He’s trying to run away after putting all the blame on me…”
“You’re too much, Uncle!”
“?!”
Lee Gun looked hurt as he gazed at Sagittarius. “Uncle asked me to take care of Hades. You said you hated Hades’s guts.”
What the hell did he just say?
Lee Gun lowered his head, and his shoulders shook as if he was pretending to cry. “I just wanted to be loved by Uncle. I knew it would cause harm to the Divine world, yet I did my best! Now that your nephew is caught, you throw me away as if I’m nothing!”
Ah! He felt like he was losing his mind! Sagittarius grabbed the back of his neck.
However, Lee Gun ignored him as he acted sadly.
“If you don’t believe me, you can do a DNA test!”
That would prove nothing!
‘Humans and gods are different!’
Sagittarius had a headache. He had no idea why his nephew was acting this way, but he was clearly doing this on purpose.
The gods became angry.
“We can’t locate the registry. Where did he put it?”
[The registry doesn’t matter.]
“Lord of Heaven!”
[A low-rank Divine item can be found in no time if I put my mind to it.]
“Oh, Great Spirit. This is a problem that affects the lives of all the gods within Olympus.”
[Shut up!]
The flashing figure looked more interested in Lee Gun than in his dependents.
[Snake god! How did you kill Hades?]
“!”
[Hades was less than a hundred years old, so he might have been immature. However, he wasn’t someone a snake like you would have been able to eat.]
Lee Gun snorted. He had purposefully let himself get caught to find the Great Spirit, who had hidden very well. Now that he had found the Great Spirit, he had no reason to act like he was caught. That was why he had gotten Sagittarius involved.
Lee Gun smirked. “Have you lost your mind? Why would I tell you my trade secret?”
The flashing figure laughed in response to Lee Gun’s laughter.
[Then I’ll change the question.]
“?”
[Do you have any idea about the Creators?]
What?
* * *
“Aahhhk!”
Hugo and Yeonwoo exited the black pond. They had been dropped off on the eighteenth floor, the floor of entertainment, of all places.
Tossed out in the air of the eighteenth floor, both of them fell into different hot springs.
Splash!!
Screams rang out from the hot springs.
“Ahhhk! Who the hell is this?”
The voice of a young man rang out. It was Pan (Satyr), whom Lee Gun had met while illegally entering the Divine world!
Pan, who had taken up a part-time job at the hot springs, was shocked.
‘I was finally able to meet Virgo! Why did the commotion have to start right now?’
At that moment, someone grabbed the back of Pan’s neck. “Are you the idiot called Pan?”
Pan turned pale when he saw Lee Gun’s Constructs, who had followed Hugo. His reaction was expected since Lee Gun’s Constructs were high-rank, fighting-type gods, who were famous within the Divine world.
“Ahhk! What business does a high rank Construct like you have with me?”
“Just shut up and take this. Master sent this. It’s an order to smuggle people out of here.”
“What? Smuggle people out of here… Let’s put that aside for now. You said Master! Who is great enough to order around…!”
Hugo, who was barely able to exit the water, coughed. He looked like he wanted to cry. “Gun…!!”
He remembered the last image of Lee Gun, who had transported him. His friend had sacrificed himself and looked like he was giving his last goodbye.
“What do you plan on doing by yourself…!”
Meeny Jotunn and Miny Berserk started to sweat when they saw Hugo about to wail.
[Do you understand? You guys are dead if you tell Taeksoo.]
To kill the Great Spirit, Lee Gun had purposefully let himself get caught and pretended to be close to death in front of Hugo.
If Hugo was worried about Lee Gun, he would continuously pray for Lee Gun. It would continuously fill up Lee Gun’s Divine power.
‘If we tell the truth, that servant will get angry.’
‘T-That is how I see it.’
Currently, Lee Gun was benefiting from Hugo’s worry.
[Divine power is being filled to the brim.]
[Divine power is being filled to the brim.]
…
[Divine power is being filled to the brim.]
Since they were immediate Constructs who guarded their master, they could check up on Lee Gun’s status in real-time. If they knew when their master was in danger, it allowed them to come up with a plan of action.
In the end, although they felt guilty, they tapped Hugo’s shoulder.
“M-Master might be in danger, but I’m sure he will be fine. He’s powerful!”
“Yes! Also, Master wanted us to give you this!”
“What?”
Hugo was taken aback when he saw the item taken out by Lee Gun’s Constructs. “R-Recorder? He told you to give this to me?”
“That’s correct. He said to listen to it 24/7. It doesn’t matter if you’re awake or asleep. You should keep it on.”
“What??”
‘What the hell is recorded here that I have to listen to it 24/7?’
That wasn’t the only important item given to him.
“This is Hades’s registry and Permission Tickets!”
Surprised, Hugo pointed at the several dozen leftover tickets. “He had this many Permission Tickets left? Why didn’t he end the lives of the gods using this?”
Lee Gun had said that he was unable to manipulate the lifespan of the gods because he was short on Permission Tickets.
At that moment, Meeny relayed Lee Gun’s words. “Ah! Master said, ‘I have to use it to extend Taeksoo’s lifespan.’ This was why he said they were off limits.”
“Gunnnnnnnn!!!” Hugo wailed.
At the same time, the Constructs heard it.
[Serpent Bearer’s Divine power is filling up.]
[Serpent Bearer’s Divine power is filling up.]
[Serpent Bearer’s Divine power is filling up.]
[Divine power 100% ▶150% (Over Capacity)]
The Constructs’ mouths fell open. They were dumbfounded. They had done as their master ordered, and they could now see why the Zodiacs and Great Spirits coveted Hugo.
‘What the hell is he?’
‘Did he do something in the past?’
‘Did he record some bizarre Achievement in the past?’
From what they had observed, Yooha also filled up the Divine power at breakneck speed.
“Anyway, let’s hurry up and smuggle ourselves out of this place. It is the opportune time, as the upper floors are in turmoil.”
However, Hugo went to Yeonwoo, who had fallen into the hot spring next to them, and said, “I can’t go by myself. I have to move Gun far away from the gods.”
“What?”
When Hugo had been imprisoned inside Hades’s palace, he had heard a conversation between Hades and Hermes.
‘They are looking for the last survivor of the Creator tribe.’
Hugo immediately realized who the survivor was.
‘It’s Gun.’
From what he had heard, the Creators were geniuses who could feed the entire universe. It was like a genius being able to feed an entire country.
That part wasn’t the problem. The problem was the conversation that followed after that.
[Creators are servants of the Divine world. We’re the children of the Divine world. We’re qualified to use their power for our benefit.]
[They were immediate slaves under the Divine world. Of course, we have that right.]
[Slaves? They were clearly on higher strata than us. It isn’t easy to reach the servant status of the Divine world. Do you realize how tremendous the Divine world is?]
[Who cares if they are talented? At the end of the day, they are dirty and crude compared to us.]
[I guess it doesn’t matter what happens if we can use that power.]
‘…!’
Hugo had been dumbfounded when he had heard this. He wasn’t sure about anything except one thing.
‘They will use Gun for their benefit.’
It was why Hugo had sent those strange letters from Hades’s palace. He had thought Lee Gun might see it by chance if he did come to the Divine world.
Hugo knew Lee Gun getting more involved with the Divine world meant trouble.
‘Even Gun can’t win against the Great Spirit.’
While he had been imprisoned, he had seen the Great Spirit once. This being was powerful beyond imagination.
‘I have to help Gun escape before he gets used by the gods.’
Boom!!!
The Divine world trembled. It shook so violently that the situation couldn’t be compared to an earthquake.
“Wait a moment! What the hell is that…!”
Lee Gun’s Constructs turned pale from fright when they looked up at the ceiling. An unidentified monster was moving through the split sky. At the same time, voices rang in all directions.
“Hey! Did you hear?”
“The upper floor is in turmoil!”
“The prisoners that were banished to the cracks between the floors have escaped! The monsters have escaped too!”
“What? Is someone trying to destroy the Divine world? Who did it?”
The situation within the Divine world was pretty dire.
“Aren’t they the ones who hold a grudge against the Great Spirits? How…!”
“Which crazy bastard destroyed the cracks between the floors?”
“I never knew destroying them was even possible!”
Hugo knew the only person capable of doing it. He started to sweat.
When Lee Gun had first entered the Divine world, he had bought the wrath of the Divine world by using counterfeit money and was dropped toward the twentieth floor.
However, Hugo had heard Lee Gun had stopped on the eighteenth floor by destroying the floors in between…
Could it be?
* * *
Olympus!
The gods blanched when they heard the Great Spirit’s words.
“Creators? Why do you ask the snake god about their existence?”
The Great Spirit laughed.
[He probably doesn’t know. If he doesn’t know, it doesn’t matter. There is something more important to discuss.]
“!”
A menacing light emanated from the Great Spirit.
[Do you have the Divine status of Asclepius?]
“What?”
[I think you might have it. You’re the snake god who inherited the Serpent Bearer’s seat. Your previous generation stole that precious Divine status.]
“!”
Those words made Lee Gun think about what Aslan had said.
– What? You had the Divine status of Asclepius?
– Yes. The Divine status of Asclepius was something I stole a long time ago.
-You stole it? Why?
– The reason was Cycle. The Divine status of Cycle was something that had been lost a long time ago. I was able to revive it using the Life Divine status.
– !
– Of course, it had merely been a rumor at the time, so I had used it as Healing Support (Stage 3). However, I suddenly developed Death at some point. When I possessed Life and Death, a new Divine status of Cycle appeared.
– Then…
– At the time, the Divine world gave that power the temporary name of Ouroboros.
It was an unknown power that no one had been able to revive before. In the end, when Aslan died, the Serpent Bearer’s throne had stored the Divine status of Asclepius. It was then transferred to Lee Gun.
When Lee Gun recalled the conversation with Aslan, the Great Spirit smirked.
[Are you listening to me?]
Lee Gun snorted. “Who cares about that?”
[Is that so? It’s fine if you don’t know about that.]
“Lord of Heaven!”
[This is my last word to you.]
Sagittarius clenched his eyes shut. The inevitable had come.
[Oh, snake god. Join Olympus.]
All the pillar gods, including Sagittarius, were surprised.
“W-Wait a moment, Great Spirit!”
“That’s preposterous!”
“He’s the one who ruined Olympus….”
At that moment…
“Alright.”
“!”
“However, there is a problem.” As if he had been waiting for this moment, Lee Gun’s eyes emitted a red light. “You’re the one, right? You’re the one who stole the most important part of Taeksoo.”
[!]
Lee Gun emanated a strange scent. The power of Life and Death was activated separately at the same time.
The gods couldn’t believe their eyes.
‘What is that power…?’
Gathering his Divine power had been worthwhile. Lee Gun smirked. “Give it to me, bastard.”
[Cycle]
The Great Spirit’s palace shook violently.

chapters.title: Chapter 352
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Nephew! (2)
An incredible light surrounded the Great Spirit’s palace.
Koo-goo-goong!!
When the palace shook, the gods screamed. The powerful force split the floor, and the walls started to fall. The source of this power was Lee Gun.
[Cycle]
Cycle was a rare, precious power that appeared only if Life and Death coexisted.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed after he called forth the Divine status of both Life and Death at the same time.
Koo-goo-goohng!!!
Boom!
As his energy shook Olympus, the gods were frightened.
‘This is impossible!’
‘He has two Divine statuses at stage 5?’
Stage 5 of a Divine status was the highest level one could reach. At that stage, there was no way to develop any other Divine statuses; the Divine status was already deeply embedded into one’s soul.
Even if one put a lot of effort into it, any other Divine status would reach only stage 3. If one got lucky, it topped out at stage 4 (Middle-rank).
Lee Gun also had to choose between Life and Death. Each god usually had one Divine status. If a god did acquire more Divine status, it was either entrusted to someone else or given as an inheritance.
Lee Gun had two stage 5 Divine statuses! Just this alone made him on par with a god having stage 6 Divine status!
However, something even more frightening had happened.
[Life and Death are being combined.]
[The Divine status of Cycle is opening its eyes.]
“!!”
The gods doubted their senses when they sensed the power.
‘Wait a moment. That power is…!’
Their expressions changed when they realized what it was.
On the other hand, Lee gun smirked. He had played around with the registry for one reason: to gather all the high-rank gods in one place.
‘It is a power that defeated the monarchs with one blow.’
He was sure it would be very effective against the Great Spirit! In the past, his power had been out of control. It had been too hectic to discern what kind of system governed the power. However, the situation was different now.
[Cycle is a Divine status that forms only when Life and Death become complete.]
[When Life and Death are activated at the same time, they can be changed into the Divine status of Cycle.]
In other words, it was a transformed Divine status.
Flash!
Finally, a light different from that of the Divine statuses of Life and Death surged forth.
The Divine status of Cycle allowed Lee Gun to leapfrog the pillar gods. Lee Gun’s hair had been dyed red with Sagittarius’s ability, but the powerful Cycle turned his hair back to its original color.
This made the gods desperate. They had no idea how a baby snake could use a Great Spirit-rank power, but that wasn’t important right now.
“Stop him. We can’t let it run amok here— Ahhhk!”
Before they could speak any further, Lee Gun’s power ruthlessly struck Olympus. Then, something surprising happened.
“Koo-oohk!”
“Ahhhhk!!”
As the power of Cycle swept them up, their faces turned pale from fright.
‘My body is turning stiff!’
It was unclear if their Divine statuses were being sealed or if they had disappeared. The power of the gods vanished. They tried to use their powers, but Lee Gun kept sucking them away. It was as if Lee Gun was using their powers as a source for his power.
The gods felt an uncontrollable rage.
‘He’s a lowly god who used to be a human!’
In the end, they shouted.
“Lord of Heaven!!”
“Send a counterattack!”
The only one capable of fighting against a Divine status of that caliber was the Great Spirit. However, the Great Spirit gave an unexpected answer.
[I cannot use my power in front of that.]
“What? What do you mean by that?”
A Great Spirit couldn’t use his power? That made no sense!
The Great Spirit immediately recognized Lee Gun’s power. It was a troublesome power. It wasn’t as if the Great Spirit was unable to use stage 6 power, but this power was the worst.
‘That’s one of the powers belonging to the king of the gods.’
It was the king that governed the gods.
Soon, his subordinates shouted.
“Great Spirit!”
In the end, the Great Spirit pivoted.
[A high number of Olympus’s gods have emission-type abilities. It doesn’t matter how much power is used. He’ll consume it and use it as a source of power.]
“What?!”
[He’s the worst type of being that we can go up against.]
“…!”
In truth, the Great Spirit had been very interested in Lee Gun. He created a Construct with 600% faith, and he killed Hades.
‘He probably has the power of healing god.’
A power of that magnitude would be a big boon to Olympus.
However, Lee Gun didn’t join Olympus at all. Instead, he brought out a very problematic Divine status.
[Cycle Stage 1]
“Ahhhk!!!”
The power of Cycle, which had been threatening the gods, washed over the entire territory of Olympus.
Tuhhng!!
Something frightening happened.
Olympus’s buildings started to fall. No, falling wasn’t an apt description.
[Olympus’s barrier is being returned to the state of nothingness.]
[All the buildings built within Olympus are being reverted to basic materials. They are being returned to the state before they were built.]
[Creation ▶ Destruction]
The palace of the Great Spirit within Olympus boasted a history that stretched back as far as one could remember. In a flash, it turned back into a state before it was built. That wasn’t all.
Koo-goo-goong!!
Starting with the Great Spirit’s palace, everything within Olympus’s territory started turning into nothing. The pillar gods bit their lips at this sight.
‘I’m sure of it!’
‘That’s the long lost Primordial power!’
In the past, the Primordial God was the highest-ranked god. It occupied the highest seat. Cycle was one of the numerous abilities that the Primordial God had possessed.
Among the numerous Divine statuses within the Divine world, the Primordial Divine statuses were the strongest and the closest to the source.
Of course, the Primordial Divine Statuses had been all recovered after being stolen except the Cycle. It was a power that had gone extinct, disappeared without a trace.
That was why everyone tried very hard to revive this Divine status. This was true from lowly creatures to high-rank gods.
However, the gods that claimed to be the gods of Cycle were all imitators. They only claimed to have revived the power of Cycle.
For example, the wind god called it Cycle of Air. The god of finance called it Cycle of Wealth. Then there was the healer god that was in charge of Cycle of Blood.
‘The twin snakes were able to imitate it, but…!’
The original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple, Aslan, had reared two baby snakes, Yeonwoo and Junwoo. If they wanted to imitate the power of Cycle, both of them had to be present. Moreover, even if they used it, they could change the fate of only a single god.
This was why they were close to being the gods of Life and Death instead of Cycle.
However, this snake god was different. He had the power to disturb the order of the universe!
[Divine Status ▶ Anti-Divine Status]
[Immortal ▶ Mortal]
…
[Beauty ▶ Ugly]
[Ugly ▶ Really Ugly]
[Rich ▶ Poor]
[Male ▶ Female]
[Female ▶ Male]
[God ▶ Human]
“Ahhk!!”
The gods lost their Divine statuses when the light of Cycle hit them. It was death as a god. Some couldn’t overcome their age and died. This was the power of Cycle stage 1, “Reverse (Reversion Cycle).”
In other words, the power could change the source and attribute to its exact opposite. This was the power that had taken care of Time and Oblivion.
The pillar gods’ appearance changed, and their Divine statuses disappeared, giving them /a mental breakdown.
Thanks to Lee Gun, the immortal gods became mortal. They became lowly bags of flesh.
“Bastard!!”
Of all the things they could be turned into, they had been turned into humans, who couldn’t use Divine status!
“You cheap bastard!”
“Fight us fair and square…!”
They glared at him, but Lee Gun merely let out a menacing laugh.
“Kneel.”
“!”
Oppressive Divine power fell on top of the gods’ heads.
Kwahng!!!
The powerful pressure pressed down on them. They were no longer gods. They were no longer immortal beings. Their heads slammed into the ground.
“Koo-oohk—!”
“Bastard— Kuh0huhk!!”
Lee Gun’s red eyes flashed as if to say how dare they raise their heads.
“A bag of flesh like you dare threaten a god?”
“…!”
“From what I recall, someone said a lowly human shouldn’t get any say within the great tower of the gods.”
The pillar gods froze.
Accompanying a menacing smile, Lee Gun brought down the power of Cycle toward the ground.
Kwahng!!!
The powerful light fell once again, destroying all the buildings on the first to the twentieth floor.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!
“Ahhhhk!!!”
Tens of millions of gods within Olympus were swept up in the light of Cycle. It was the destruction of Olympus.
To accomplish this, Lee Gun had purposefully sent away Hugo, Yeonwoo, and Yooha to a different location. He had come here alone because if they were here, he couldn’t cause mayhem to his heart’s content!
The Great Spirit glared at Lee Gun, who was like a calamity in motion.
[Ignorant fool!]
He should be frightened by the power used by Lee Gun, but he didn’t care. The Great Spirit was part of the strata that ruled over the Divine world. This was why he knew about this power better than anyone. He knew how to overcome the power of Cycle. It wasn’t that difficult.
[He just has to use it one more time, and everything will return to normal!]
“!”
The reversion had happened once. It merely had to happen again to return everything to the starting point.
This power could turn everything into nothing, but at the same time, it could turn nothing into something.
This was why the Great Spirit purposefully let Lee Gun waste his power. The vanished Olympus and the attributes of gods could be reverted once again using the power of Cycle! Moreover, he didn’t need to ask Lee Gun to do it.
‘I just have to take his Divine status and use it.’
Of course, all gods had a hard time developing and using more than one Divine status. However, Great Spirits could handle several of them. In fact, they were magnates that could use the Divine statuses of the gods under them!
Extracting and temporarily using the Divine status from that fledgling god wouldn’t be hard.
The Lord of Heaven used lightning bolts several meters in size. They coalesced to form a giant made out of lightning. A man had appeared. It was the Great Spirit of Olympus.
“You’re too young to use that power, baby snake.”
The light around Lee Gun’s power started to contract.
[The power that you have accumulated has almost been depleted.]
[If you want to use the power of Cycle, you need 100% EXP for both Life and Death.]
[EXP has been reset to 0%.]
[You need to recharge your EXP and Divine power.]
[Current Divine Power: 17%]
[Your transformation as the god of Cycle will be undone.]
The symbols of light, which had appeared above Lee Gun’s body, started to fade away.
The Lord of Heaven laughed. As the power of Cycle had also swept him up, his body had gone through a reversion. However, he was a Great Spirit-rank for a reason. The effect was temporary for him.
“You don’t know how to use your power yet. When your power dissipates, I’ll teach you a lesson.”
Lee Gun smirked. “You’re the one who should be taught a lesson.”
“What?”
At that moment, the Great Spirit and the pillar gods froze.
Doo-doo hk, doo-doo-doohk!!!
Lee Gun’s power of Cycle had turned the barrier around Olympus into nothing. As the ceiling split, Olympus’s sky started to split too. That wasn’t all.
Doo-doo-doohk!!
The ground started to split apart. Then, shouts came from the ground.
“The pillar gods are here!”
“That damn Great Spirit of Olympus!!”
The prisoners banished to the cracks between the floors had come to attack Olympus, whose gods had been turned into humans by Lee Gun.
“Kill them!”
“They are our enemies!”
“…!!!”
The pillar gods turned pale. Dumbfounded, they watched the prisoners rush toward them.
“Your problem starts now.”
“?”
“I’ve been spraying pheromone for a while now.”
“Pheromone??”
The gods hadn’t noticed this, but Lee Gun was letting out an odd scent.
“It’s a product that amplifies my scent by a magnitude of ten million. It’s to lure someone I know very well. I made sure the scent would travel a far distance… Ah. I think it’s here.”
“???”
“Why don’t you take a stab? Who do you think I was calling by spreading my scent?”
The gods looked confused, but Lee Gun merely laughed in response. He tossed something toward the Great Spirit. It was Hermes’ arm, which Poseidon had summoned. Hugo had taken it, saying it might be useful as an ingredient. At that moment…
Doo-doohk! Doo-doo-doohk!
“!”
Everyone could feel an ominous energy spread through the crack. The foreboding feeling lasted only a moment before something frightening appeared from the crack in the sky.
Kwahng!!
[Who dared to steal the food that I was eating!]
“!!!”
The gods froze.
The Abyss monarch had descended into the Divine world.

chapters.title: Chapter 353
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Nephew! (3)
Around a year ago, after Abundance had died, a fertile land called the Nameless Land had appeared. The Zodiacs had come to Drachma to take the land for themselves. One of them had been the Zodiac of the Taurus temple.
[Give me what you stole, Serpent Bearer. Right now.]
The twelve Zodiacs had tried to acquire the land so that their past would stay hidden. However, catching the Zodiacs’ scent, a being had appeared from the ocean. It was Abyss.
[There are two Zodiacs here!]
It was a monster that looked like a whale. Abyss was a being that could freely teleport to any place that was full of darkness, including dreams, shadows, fear, and the dark.
It traveled through the oceans of various dimensions to hunt prey and was known as a predator.
The Abyss that Lee Gun had killed on the earth had been a form of an alter ego. It was one of Abyss’s clones.
Since Abyss liked eating, it had sent its clones to various locations. Despite being clones, they were extremely powerful.
Moreover, Lee Gun had made excellent use of the corpse of the Abyss clone. In fact, the spear made from its bone was capable of instilling fear within the Divine world.
Anyway, Lee Gun had been able to get rid of Taurus using Abyss, and he still remembered how its energy signature felt. Abyss also wanted to eat Lee Gun at all costs.
Anyway, Lee Gun had pretended to be caught by the Great Spirit, and when he stood in front of the Great Spirit, he felt it once again.
‘Abyss.’
He felt Abyss coming closer.
Abyss seemed to really like Hermes. It had been licking the bones clean when its food had disappeared. This had made Abyss chase after the scent of its prey, which led it to this location.Lee Gun was sure of that, and this was why he had spread his scent heavily. Back at Drachma, Abyss had gone crazy when it had smelled Lee Gun’s scent.
‘I can use this to my advantage.’
Of course, it had been a pretty big gamble.
Back to the present…
Doo-doo-doohk!!
[Who dared to steal the food that I was eating!]
Kwahng!!
The Abyss monarch descended into the Divine world!
Koo-goo-goohng!
“Ahhhhk!”
Among the monarchs who had invaded the earth, Abyss had been the largest.
The enormous Abyss hit the Divine world like an out-of-control freight train. The whale-like being looked furious at its food having been stolen. It started destroying the Divine world with its enormous body.
[Who was it? It has been a long time since food walked in on its own. I was enjoying the feast!]
This was the world that housed the rulers of dimensions. The Pantheon fell into a state of absolute panic.
“That is…!!”
“It is the Cluders!”
While humans called them the unknown civilization, other places called them the Cluders.
Moreover, this was the Abyss!
“This is nuts! Why is that psychotic predator here…!”
The gods were shocked when they recognized its face. Their reactions were natural since this being had attacked the Divine world a couple thousand years ago and had greatly destabilized the Divine world.
The monarchs that had invaded them included high-ranking beings like Silence. While the other monarchs had been unreasonably strong, the one that had caused the most trouble was Abyss.
That psychotic predator had eaten or harmed over two-thirds of the Divine world’s population. It had eaten life equivalent to what would be born in a thousand years.
‘If only the Divine world hadn’t underestimated them…’
The Divine world had suffered such heavy damage that, that period was called the Hundred Year Darkness.
The worst memory that the gods had was created by the unknown civilization. It was such a humiliating memory that the gods almost hadn’t bounced back from it.
Such a being had been lured here!
“Shit! We can’t use our power right now…!”
It didn’t matter if they had their guard or not. This foe was so mighty that the gods had to wonder if anyone could defeat it.
“Shit! Sound the alarm!”
“We have to chase it out!”
“Shit! We made sure those bastards couldn’t come in!’
Oblivious to its surroundings, Abyss became angry at the Great Spirit.
[You are the one who dared to steal my food!]
The Lord of Heaven was taken aback when he became the target. He glared at Lee Gun, who had tossed Hermes’s arm to him.
Lee Gun snickered. “You guys aren’t a fledgling god like me. You’ll have no problem taking care of it, right? Oh yeah! You guys are humans right now.”
The Lord of Heaven glared at Lee Gun. Even if the Great Spirit were in his optimal state, dealing with monarch ranks was troublesome!
In this unexpected situation, the flustered Great Spirit yelled at Abyss, who was running amok. “Leader of the Cluders, this isn’t a place that you should have come to!”
[What the hell did you just say?]
“Also, I’m not the one who stole your food!” The Great Spirit threw Hermes’s arm toward Lee Gun and looked at Abyss. “It might have been a clone, but I heard it was defeated by the snake god on the earth. That means your target isn’t us. You should direct your attention toward him!”
The gods couldn’t believe what they had just heard. The fact that a monarch had gone to such a distant dimension was surprising, but who had taken care of what?
It was news that wasn’t known to the Divine world. This was why the gods looked at Lee Gun with expressions of shock.
‘Is that the reason the Great Spirit tried to bring him into Olympus? Is it because he knew this?’
The Lord of Heaven’s machination seemed to have worked. Abyss’s menacing gaze landed on Lee Gun. Abyss had finally caught sight of Lee Gun.
[Look who it is. You’re the snake god who ruthlessly killed my precious clone.]
“You shouldn’t have come to the earth. You were asking for death.”
[Hmmph. I heard you killed Time. It seems you have gotten tastier since the last time I saw you. I was wondering whom I was smelling.]
The gods of Olympus flinched. What? Time was dead? That Time was dead?? However, that wasn’t important right now.
The Great Spirit immediately carried out its plan. “That is correct, leader of the Cluders, who swims through the Abyss. We will help you kill that snake god. Let us cooperate—”
[Fuck off! You guys are thieves who touched my dinner!!]
“Ahhhhhk!!’
The gods screamed when the angry Abyss lashed out.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
In a flash, Abyss ate several gods, who had become humans.
[Did you really think I wouldn’t know the energy signature of the bastard who took my dinner? Damn merchants!]
“Wait a— Help!!”
[Since the snake god prepared this feast, I’ll spare him!]
“Ahhhk!”
Abyss was enjoying itself as it chased after the gods to eat them.
The gods who had tried to summon Hermes felt terrible. They were at fault for thinking they could negotiate with the boorish Cluders! Moreover, they couldn’t use their power even if they wanted to. The power of Cycle had turned them into humans.
‘All the power amassed within the land of Olympus is flowing to him.’
Their powers were being used as a power source for Cycle.
This was why the Great Spirit was avoiding using his power. He ground his teeth.
Since he was a Great Spirit, he knew the power of Cycle was temporary. He didn’t plan on fighting until the power of Cycle dissipated. So he planned on buying as much time as possible.
However, the unreasonable beast had attacked, and the Great Spirit was busy dodging the attacks. He yelled at Lee Gun, “Snake god!”
“!’
“I’ll forgive you for making a mess of Olympus. Just use Cycle once more!”
These words left the gods dumbfounded, but Lee Gun merely smirked. “Why should I? It says it won’t attack me.”
“Do you really trust the words of that beast? You’re its next target! I guarantee it!”
“I’m not so sure. What if I hand over someone valuable, like Hermes? I’m sure it’ll like that. What if I give it a Great Spirit?”
“!!”
“Anyway, you guys have fun fighting it instead of me. It’ll catch you guys and chew you up like gum.”
The gods glared at him, dismayed by his words.
“That damn bastard plans to run away by himself while leaving behind that thing!”
“He’s doing this despite using our powers as his power source!”
“Who says I’m running away?”
“!’
Lee Gun unsheathed his sword as if to say they were speaking nonsense. He then attacked the Lord of Heaven, who was already under Abyss’s attack.
Kwahng!!
“Koo-oohk!”
The sudden attack surprised the Lord of Heaven. He turned to look at Lee Gun, but Lee Gun merely smirked.
The power of Cycle that was letting out a silver-white light was gradually contracting. However, another power surged in its place.
[Death Instinct]
The intense power surged up from Lee Gun’s body. It was a power that only fighting gods possessed, so the Lord of Heaven furrowed his brows.
Lee Gun didn’t care as he viciously swung his sword. “Whatever! Just give me back my friend’s ability!”
Lee Gun came from the front, and Abyss was coming from the back! In a flash, the tables were turned against him, so the Great Spirit became angry.
“Cluder! That sword was made using your bones! The one you should be eating is him, not me!”
[Alright, Zeus. I’ll grind down your bones and drink it!]
“No! That’s not— Koohk!”
Zeus, who had lost his Divine status, groaned. The blade made from Abyss was aimed toward the region between his legs. He glared at Lee Gun. “Where the hell are you attacking?”
“What? You took the power away from my friend’s little buddy! Give it back! I want to be a soccer coach for his kids!”
Zeus’s expression was a sight to behold. “What are you talking about? Why would I take that?”
“I already checked up on it! When you broke apart Taeksoo’s soul, you took that away too! Do you think I wouldn’t know about that? You took it!”
Zeus looked dumbfounded. “I didn’t take it!”
Zeus thought it was all nonsense, so he looked at the pillar gods who had been involved in that matter. The pillar gods were sweating as they fought the prisoners.
“Now that I think about it, Hermes said…”
“I think he mentioned doing it when Pushover’s soul was being divided.”
That bastard! After speaking those words, an odd expression came over the faces of the pillar gods.
“Why would Hermes take such a thing?”
“That’s not important right now! Give it back! I’ll be ashamed to see Miss Jiwoo without it!”
Poseidon, who served the Great Spirit, became frustrated. “Even if we wanted to give it back, Hermes is gone! We have no idea where it is! It is your fault for sending Hermes to the monarch— Kuhk!”
“Give me one of yours then!”
“?!”
What the hell did he just say??
The angry Lee Gun threatened Poseidon. The vicious power of a fighting-type god threatened the gods.
Appalled, the male gods ground their teeth. One was a beast that let their words go in one ear and out the other; the other was a psycho!
“Run away!”
“How can there be two of them that act like this?”
However, they didn’t have the opportunity to speak any further.
“Koo-oohk!”
Abyss ate another god.
The pillar gods desperately looked at the monarch.
‘Whatever.’
They had a way of instantly turning the tables.
‘That bastard has Hermes’s core.’
Since Hermes had been eaten, the core containing his Divine status must be with the Abyss. If they recovered the Divine status, the Great Spirit could use it for a short period.
‘The transportation ability can transport the monarch out of the Divine world.’
This applied to Lee Gun too.
Kwahng!!
Abyss’s attack destroyed the territory of Olympus’s Great Spirit.
Koo-goo-goong!
“Ahhhhk!”
The ground split apart. The gods and the prisoners fell through to the lower floor, and Abyss chased after them.
[Food! Where are you going!]
Lee Gun also tried to chase after them but…
Flash!
“!”
His eyes turned round as Lime rolled up next to him with a crystal. Slime handed over a yellow crystal to him.
[Messenger god’s (Hermes) Divine status (core)]
This was the core containing the god’s Divine status. It seemed the core had been stuck between Abyss’s teeth or some part of its body and had fallen to the ground in the fight.
The Constructs were surprised when Lee Gun picked up the core.
[That’s the core of the Messenger god!]
[You can inherit it, give it to someone, or sell it!]
Lee Gun became interested when he heard the word inherit.
When he had a conversation with Persephone, he had learned that the inherited Divine status only transferred power. The previous owner’s personality disappeared.
This was why disobedient gods were purposefully killed so that others could inherit their powers. This way would allow one to grow these gods according to one’s taste.
Therefore, Lee Gun smirked. Hades had kidnapped his friend, but Hades’s abilities overlapped with his own. This was why inheriting his Divine status wasn’t worth the effort for Lee Gun. However, this one might be useful.
In the end, it didn’t matter.
“Snake god! I’ll agree to any deal! Just use the power of Cycle once more!”
A light emanated from the hole that led to the lower floor. It was a hole created by prisoners to enter this place, but Abyss’s attack had widened it.
Lee Gun let out a harsh laugh as he looked at the gods barely hanging on to objects. He pulled out a column from the Olympus palace. “Fuck off, idiots!”
Then he ruthlessly threw the column toward the gods.
Screams started to ring out.
