Anyway, fighting-type gods possessed the Mind’s Eye attribute.
[Eyes that will absolutely allow you to win in battle!]
The eyes of the beast flashed, and he aimed for Lee Gun’s weak point. He had immediately located Lee Gun’s cores, which contained his Divine statuses.
‘As expected, he has two cores.’
If he took out the two cores, Zeus would be able to use Cycle.
After he had located the Divine status cores, Hercules’s hands shot forward at a frightening speed.
Feeling the murderous intent, Lee Gun quickly reacted.
Hercules extended his arms.
Fighting-type god attribute!
[Inborn Predisposition (4 star)]
- Turns the body into a weapon.
The bodies of fighting-type gods were weapons in themselves!
After strengthening his body, Hercules tried to overwhelm Lee Gun. No weapon could pierce through his body.
When Hercules got closer, Lee Gun’s Divine status of Life started to react violently.
[Your opponent possesses an Achievement that’s a natural enemy of you.]
[]
[Life has raised its guard as it is gathering its power]
[It is strengthening and healing the body of the snake god.]
[Life has gained EXP.]
It seemed Hercules had acquired an Achievement by killing numerous snakes. Lee Gun possessed the Divine status of a serpent. This meant they were like oil and water.
The beast-like Hercules’s hand stabbed toward Lee Gun’s body.
Poo-hahk!
At a glance, it looked like he was aiming for the heart. However, Hercules was actually aiming for the stomach. The move toward the heart was a feint.
As he pretended to aim for the heart, his other hand aimed for the stomach, where Lee Gun’s cores were.
Hercules looked at Lee Gun with surprise. “Hmmph! Your reflexes are excellent.”
Lee Gun had read his attack and grabbed both of his arms.
It was clear that his opponent’s power was strong, but the hands dug into Lee Gun’s body. The reason could have been the Achievement that was a natural enemy to him.
“It does hurt since I don’t have Super Regeneration.”
The surprised Hugo and Hailey tried to attack Hercules.
However, Lee Gun signaled them off as he spat out blood. Clearly, he had engineered this situation. “It seems you’re proud of your impenetrable body, but you lost once you touched me.”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he clenched Hercules’s arms.
This made Hercules laugh. As a fighting-type god who had amassed Divine power and Achievements, he was second to none.
‘I have twelve five-star rank Achievements, and one of them is close to being a 6 star.’
In terms of power, fighting-type gods were leaps and bounds above the other gods. Hercules possessed one of the strongest Divine statuses as a war god, which numbered few.
“What do you plan on doing with those weak hands? It is useless—”
Ooh-doo-doohk!!!
“…!”
Hercules's eyebrows rose because of the pain. At the same time, he scrunched up his eyes.
Ooh-doo-doo-doohk!!
Lee Gun’s power had crushed Hercules’s thick bones in his arms.
The other gods were shocked when they heard Hercules’ bones break.
‘He broke Herc’s arms?’
The pillar gods, as well as the gods who had come to capture the pillar gods, were shocked.
Lee Gun laughed. “I’ll turn you into a cudgel.”
Lee Gun was letting out the Divine status of Death as he tried to rip away Hercules’s arms.
[The goddesses of fate have manipulated the snake god’s record.]
As that notification rang out, Lee Gun flinched from the pain.
‘…!’
Strength left his body, and the wounds on his body suddenly worsened.
[The goddesses of fate have changed the fate of the snake god.]
[The snake god has been changed. He has suffered grave wounds, and he cannot move.]
What the hell?
Soon, blood trickled out of Lee Gun’s mouth. As soon as the strength left his body, Hercules pinned him. Hercules seemed to be unaware of the goddesses of fate’s intervention.
He clicked his tongue as if this was inevitable. “Look here. In the end, you couldn’t win with strength. As expected, you’re a stick—”
Kwahng!!!
An arrow flew toward Hercules’s head, but the fighting-type god threw a rock. After stopping Hugo’s arrow in midair, the vigilant Hercules yelled, “If you shoot me again, I’ll break open this bastard’s head.”
Hugo furrowed his brows.
“Let go,” Hailey said in a menacing voice as she kicked Hercules.
Bbah-gahk!
That power sent Hercules away from Lee Gun, and Hailey emanated a black magical energy. It was the power she had sealed since she didn’t want her identity to be known to the Divine world.
The Scorpio Constructs, who had been hiding within her shadow, quickly shouted at her.
[P-Princess! You shouldn’t!]
[You shouldn’t release your abilities! The gods will immediately rush toward you!]
Hercules furrowed his brows at Hailey’s power.
“Herc-nim! This isn’t the time to do that! Hurry up and get rid of the snake god!”
“The goddesses of fate have helped us!”
“Hurry up and kill the snake god while he cannot use his power!”
Hercules’s eyes turned round. “What? They got involved?”
[Ah! You guys are pissing me off.]
“…!!!”
Hercules flinched and shook when he heard the voice from behind. It was a voice that wasn’t from this world. Feeling the murderous intent, the fighting-type god tried to defend himself.
Kwahng!
The frightening power of Death brought Hercules to a halt.
Hercules reflexively felt something from that power.
‘This feeling… He isn’t a human or a god.’
Hercules got an ominous feeling as he tried to get rid of Lee Gun.
Pahk!
Lee Gun disappeared in a flash, then used his ability on Hercules. It was the ability that had been released when Yooha had caught all the gods.
[Personal Poison (4 star)]
The unique poison of the Serpent Bearer struck Hercules. It was a poison that caused pain. The immortal gods would rather die than feel such pain!
Hercules couldn’t take the pain either. He screamed.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
“Herc!”
Hercules groaned as he watched Lee Gun approach him. “Koo-oohk— Finish me!”
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. “No. You’re more helpful alive.”
“…!”
Hercules and the other gods were surprised.
“Is he sparing Hercules because Hercules is a god who protects the Divine world?!”
“It makes sense since there aren’t that many fighting-type gods…!”
“He turns Olympus into a mess, yet he seems to care about the Divine world…?”
Lee Gun smirked.
[While being guarded against the god with the opposite Achievement, Life is drawing up its power.]
[Life has gained EXP.]
[Life has amassed EXP, so it is almost ready to be able to use Cycle.]
Thanks to Hercules, Life was gaining EXP. Raising Death’s EXP was easy since Lee Gun just had to kill. On the other hand, raising Life’s EXP had been hard even on the earth.
Wouldn’t it be beneficial to leave Hercules like this until his EXP was full?
‘I’ll let it stack until I catch the other gods.’
Lee Gun had come to a stop at that moment, and it caused the eyes of the pillar gods to flash.
“This is it. We have to attack when the snake god is injured…!”
At that moment, Hercules sent the pillar gods and the other gods flying.
“Kuh-huhk…!!”
Taken aback, the pillar gods looked at Hercules.
“What are you doing?”
Hercules slammed his head against the ground as he shouted. “I will serve you as a younger brother! Please take me in as your Construct!”
“!”
The gods were shocked, and Lee Gun looked at Hercules as if the latter were speaking nonsense. “If this is a ploy to get me to release you from the poison, dream on.”
Of course, the poison would naturally dissipate after a certain amount of time.
“No! As soon as the goddesses of fate helped me, I lost. Moreover, you were able to overwhelm me with such a handicap. You also spared my life for the good of the Divine world! I will serve you as a younger brother!”
The pillar gods of Olympus were dumbfounded.
“Wait a…!”
Lee Gun thought over it for a moment.
‘A Construct of this caliber would be to my benefit.’
Would it be a boon to raising the EXP of Life?
Lee Gun said, “Alright. I guess there is no downside to doing it.”
“Thank you! I will serve you with sincerity!”
“Ah! The poison….”
Before Lee Gun could say anything else, Hercules looked at Hailey and said, “Ah. If it’s possible, I would like to ask her to be my wife…”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - Eyes Wide Open (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 360 - Eyes Wide Open (3)
“Ah. If it’s possible, I would like to ask her to be my wife…”
Lee Gun’s gaze headed toward Hercules.
The gods also looked at Hercules with dumbfounded expressions. The pillar gods had put the fate of Olympus in Hercules’s hands. Was he betraying Olympus for a woman?!
Hailey, the subject of his interest, was also angry. Who the hell was he to claim her as his wife? “Who gave you the permission to—”
When an angry Hailey tried to take matters into her own hands…
Bbah-ghak!!!
“!?!”
Lee Gun moved first as he kicked Hercules. Surprised, Olympus’s fighting-type god looked at Lee Gun. Lee Gun had his arms crossed as his eyes flashed.
Bbah-gahk!!
He once again kicked the flustered Hercules, this time between the legs.
Kwahng!!!
“…!”
Hercules let out a soundless scream when his important place was battered.
Everyone turned pale at this sight.
“H-Herc!!”
Hugo, who had his bow drawn, winced as he closed his eyes. He didn’t want to think about the pain. No, the pain wasn’t the problem.
‘He 100% lost function.’
This was Lee Gun’s kick. It was powerful enough to kill monsters with a single blow! Moreover, Hugo had seen it. The kick was imbued with the power of Death!
Lee Gun had used Eliminate, which could get rid of defensive skills and other important things in a ruthless manner!
Lee Gun didn’t care. He had an annoyed expression on his face as his eyes flashed. “How dare you say that to my cat?”
“Kuh-huhk—?!”
Hercules had no idea what he had done wrong as he clutched the part between his legs. He felt like dying. Although he had the body of a fighting-type god, an attack of that nature might kill him. Moreover, his defense was down because of Lee Gun’s poison.
Hercules shook as he tried to endure the pain. “H-Hyung-nim, W-What did I do wrong…”
“You don’t know?”
“Yes! I don’t kn— Kuh-huhk!!”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun spoke to Hugo using “Construct Communication.”
“This is great, Taeksoo. I’ll take his junior and give it to you.”
Hugo was unable to speak.
[What? You crazy son of…]
He didn’t need such a dirty thing.
However, Lee Gun ignored Hugo’s opinion and looked at Hercules. “I have a high regard for your loyalty, so I’ll allow you to become my Construct.”
“!”
As soon as he spoke, a light appeared under Lee Gun’s feet. It was the symbol of the Serpent Bearer.
[Divine status “Hercules” became a Construct of the Serpent Bearer.]
[Divine status: Hercules (High-rank Zodiac)]
[Divine Name: Being that Smashes / Heaven’s Slayer / Hero of Gods]
[Abilities in Possession: Lift the Sky (5 star), Strongest Hero (5 star), Blood of Giganto Maxia (5 star), and 6 more]
[Fighting-type god’s attributes: Mind’s Eye, Inborn Predisposition, Weapon Master, Return, Slaughter, and 3 more]
The Symbol of the Serpent Bearer also appeared underneath Hercules.
[What would you like to name the qualified Construct?]
“Club.”
[Hercules has been nicknamed “Club.”]
The gods gathered there looked on in shock. Of course, they knew what that light meant.
“He made Olympus’s fighting-type god his Construct?”
“What?! That makes no sense!”
It didn’t matter if the gods were small or large. They were all involved in the flow of the universe. That was why Zodiacs usually employed Constructs to fight a proxy war. This allowed the Zodiacs to avoid Karmic debt and bloodshed.
This meant Constructs were considered the power of a Zodiac. The gods got stronger as they took in more powerful Constructs.
And fighting-type gods were the highest-rank power. They were so precious that they couldn’t be bought with money!
‘They are monsters that can change the tide of a battle! They can snatch victory from the jaws of defeat!’
In fact, the Olympus faction was able to survive the attack by the monarchs because of Hercules. Furthermore, the monarchs had been bloodied enough by the fighting-type gods. The fighting-type gods’ presence was the reason the monarchs had never invaded again.
Everyone was desperate to have a fighting-type god, but they were beings that couldn’t be brought on board.
‘Also, wasn’t Hercules being discussed as a candidate to become Olympus’s Great Spirit?’
‘A nameless and unknown god took him for a Construct!’
The gods had already forgotten about the bounties placed on the Olympus gods. The events that had unfolded in front of them were that shocking.
On the other hand, the pillar gods of Olympus reacted differently.
‘Herc! That crazy bastard!’
Was he backing out because he was blinded by a woman? Hercules was someone they had barely kept on their side by using debt.
Lee Gun didn’t care as he spoke. “What about your servant, Taeksoo?”
[Sagittarius ran away when he caught wind of what was happening. I’m sorry!]
Lee Gun was nonchalant as he accepted the answer. He had already expected Sagittarius to act that way.
Crossing his arms, Lee Gun walked toward Hercules, who was dying, and extended his hand. “Detox.”
When Lee Gun used the power of stage 5 of Life, the vitality chipped away by the poison was recovered.
[Power of Life stage 5 has been used.]
[The strong power of Life has suppressed the poison of Death.]
[The vitality of the Construct, which was harmed by the poison, will continuously recover (for 1 hour).]
Of course, he hadn’t neutralized the poison, so the pain hadn’t gone away. However, that was none of his business.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he smirked. “This is an order as your Zodiac. Capture all the gods from Olympus.”
“!!”
When Hercules turned his head, he saw the angry pillar gods glaring at him. “Herc! You might be a brute, but this isn’t it.”
“You didn’t become a slave despite your debt because we intervened.”
Lee Gun snorted. “Hey. If you capture them, I’ll pay off all your debt.”
“!”
Hercules looked at Lee Gun as if this was unexpected, while the pillar gods turned pale from fright.
Poseidon’s eyes flashed. For some reason, he had wrapped himself in a cloak. “Herc, I trusted you. It isn’t too late. We’ll take you back if you admit that you made a foolish mistake. It’s something only you can do.”
Hercules furrowed his brows. They said they trusted him, yet they had gotten the goddesses of fate to intervene.
Moreover, he couldn’t attack his Zodiac even though he had yet to be acknowledged as a Construct by the Divine world. It would be an act that could demote him to the status of a slave, yet they were boldly asking him to carry that out.
At this point, the pillar gods realized that things had become too complicated. They started backing away.
Lee Gun’s red eyes flashed. “Ah! That’s right. I don’t have to go through the trouble of paying it off for you. If I get rid of them, your debt will be written off, right?”
“…!”
The next moment, a wind erupted behind Lee Gun.
Tahng!
Hercules instantly disappeared and reappeared behind the pillar gods.
‘!!’
He swung his hand, and the gods gathered in the group screamed.
“Wait… Kuh-huhk!!”
The fierce strike sent the cloak that Poseidon had worn flying, and the sight that emerged surprised the gods.
“P-Poseidon is a woman?!”
“Hmmph. I was wondering why he had on that cloak.”
“The proxy for the Great Spirit of Olympus is…!”
On the other hand, Lee Gun burst out laughing. “I see. He’s the one who suffered the gender swap.”
“!”
When Lee Gun had used Cycle within Olympus, he had confirmed it. Someone’s sex had changed, and someone’s appearance had changed.
Lee Gun seemed pleased. He cheekily laughed. “You look a thousand times better like that. You should continue to go around like that. You should bow down to me and thank me.”
“You bastard…!!”
Poseidon didn’t even have the chance to grind his teeth. The nameless gods who had come for the bounties were sent flying by Hercules’s attack.
“Ahhhk!”
The gods who had come to see what was going on screamed when a building fell.
As the situation took a drastic turn, Poseidon quickly ordered Olympus’s gods, “Shit! Retreat for now!”
The pillar gods, who had become humans, quickly tried to move to a different location.
Kwahng!!
However, Hercules captured them in one fell swoop.
“Koo-ahhhk!”
The eyes of Hugo and Hailey turned round, since they had nothing to do.
“Wow! This is very convenient.” Lee Gun laughed in a buoyant manner.
* * *
“Herc! You won’t get away with this!”
“That damn snake god!”
The pillar gods captured by Lee Gun were dragged away by the civil servants, and
Lee Gun immediately received the bounty.
[Will you use the deposited bounty to pay off your debt?]
“Yes. All of it.”
Of course, he couldn’t pay off all the debt just from catching them. The amount was too large.
However, Yooha had continued to commit evil acts and place the blame on the pillar gods. This was why their bounties had increased.
The amount Lee Gun was lacking was bridged by the numerous miscellaneous gods that Hercules caught.
This was why the debt that was over 50 billion was…
[Serpent of Beginning & End: +100 million]
[No Divine name (Pushover): 0]
Lee Gun’s debt had been reduced in an instant, and he was satisfied. A debt that ran into the tens of millions had been paid off in one sitting.
That wasn’t all.
‘Any shortfall was solved by selling their items.’
These pillar gods possessed weapons and Divine items that were beyond imagination in terms of price.
This was why Lee Gun sold them for expensive, premium prices. Of course, something that bothered him did pop up.
[Soul with no Divine name (Pushover) cannot accumulate wealth because of his soul’s Karmic Debt.]
Soul’s Karmic debt? If it were the soul’s karmic debt, it probably didn’t happen in his current lifetime.
‘Is this why Hades wanted Taeksoo so bad?’
Since Hades was the god of the underworld, he could analyze a soul.
At that moment, as he had resolved his debt, an immediate reaction took place.
[The sealed Divine abilities have been released.]
[You have regained the right to use your weapon.]
“!”
Lee Gun’s abilities were released, and he could use his items now. This was also true for Hugo. That wasn’t all.
[The basic powers of a Zodiac have been released.]
[Offering, Trade, Zodiac Descent, etc]
[You will now be able to receive territory from the Divine world.]
Accompanying those words, a light appeared before Lee Gun, and his Constructs became happy.
[Oh! It is the territory of the Serpent Bearer temple, Master!]
[It comes with the land document. You’ll be able to buy and sell it.]
“Oh. Land document?” Since “land” was mentioned, Lee Gun looked forward to it.
Flash!
However, when he saw the items that appeared while emitting light, his expression was a sight to behold.
[Serpent Bearer’s Territory]
[Lowest-rank territory (Newspaper)]
[Seed and Claypot for the Territory (C rank)]
The items were a clay jar and a newspaper.
[It is the size of the territory allowed to the Serpent Bearer. It is set according to your level.]
[Current Zodiac rank: 204989 (Low rank)]
[You should increase your cumulative rank by acquiring Constructs and Achievements.]
[Please put your name into the Divine world and grow your territory.]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose.
As for Hugo, he held the newspaper and clutched his stomach as he laughed. “Your territory is a newspaper…! Newspaper!”
The Constructs were also taken aback.
[That is…! It is probably because you didn’t officially undergo the measurement!]
[That’s right! I…If you were probably measured, you would have been given a large palace…!]
At that moment…
[A Zodiac that claimed to be your guardian and elder recommended the territory for the Serpent Bearer.]
[Sagittarius recommended the 0-rank territory (Newspaper).]
[Word from the guardian: Nephew! It seems you don’t know much, so I chose something with the most potential!]
The Constructs screamed when they saw Lee Gun’s expression.
[M…Master! It is fine!]
[Yes! A golden object of the same rank could have been gotten. It is too bad, but the newspaper is great in the fact that all kinds of information about gods could be learned from it…]
“Ha ha ha! A dog house would be better than this! Kuhk!” An angry Lee Gun kicked Hugo as he asked, “Where the hell did Sagittarius run away to? You can’t locate him?”
He had no idea why Sagittarius’s bounty was 60 billion, but it didn’t matter.
‘If we want to get out of the Divine world, I have to find the Rule Book.’
Even if Yeonwoo was able to steal the Rule Book, the problem was the “Key.”
‘I need the goddesses of fate. I need their power to use the Rule Book.’
He had to kidnap the goddesses, take the Divine status, or receive the qualification to use it.
[The goddesses of fate will never come out of their hiding. Just dragging them out will be tough.]
[That is correct. They know they are a target, so they only meet others remotely. They never reveal themselves…]
The Constructs seemed troubled, but Lee Gun unexpectedly laughed. The reason was the words Satyr (Pan) had told him in a conversation earlier.
- What? Goddesses of Fate?
- Yes. Do you know what will make those hikikomoris reveal themselves?
- T-The goddesses of fate want to marry Louis-nim!
- What? They want to marry whom?
- Sagittarius-nim! It’s true! Please return my hair now!!
Satyr (Pan) was affiliated with Olympus, so he knew about the relationships between the Olympus gods.
Lee Gun smirked when he thought about that piece of information. “Where is that baldie?”
“He can’t be tracked.”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. If he put his mind to it, he could probably find Sagittarius. However, his opponent wasn’t an easy mark.
“Where is that bastard hiding?” Lee Gun concentrated, yet he couldn’t sense Sagittarius. It meant that the god of the sun was determined to hide.
“It’ll be impossible to catch the goddesses of fate without him…”
At that moment…
“Shall we drag him out into the open?”
“!”
The eyes of Osiris and Anubis shone as they appeared.
Lee Gun smirked, raising his eyes in contempt.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - Would you look at this guy? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 361 - Would you look at this guy? (1)
“Is this the doing of the snake god by chance?”
The civil servants of the Divine world clicked their tongues as they looked at the ranking board before them. The reason for their reactions was the update on the board, specifically Lee Gun’s rank.
< Serpent Bearer >
[Zodiac Ranking: 204989 (Low rank)]
This ranking was the Zodiac ranking, which excluded the Constructs. It basically listed the rulers who managed the colonies.
The ranking combined a variety of factors, including wealth, number of troops (Constructs), and power. The rank of a Zodiac could give a rough estimate of their strength.
“He got rid of Olympus’s gods and made a mess of Olympus. That’s why I was looking forward to seeing it.”
“At the very least, I expected him to be within a five-digit number.”
Other civil servants, on the other hand, were surprised and appalled.
“His ranking is too high! For a newbie, it’s very high.”
“That’s right. A new god usually starts at the lowest-rank group…”
“Wait a moment! What caused Olympus to fall?”
“What else? It was probably Hades’s Divine item. That Divine item is incredible if activated…”
“Then the Great Spirit’s power didn’t cause Olympus to fall?”
“If not, nothing else makes sense…”
At that moment…
“Ah! Wait a moment! That ranking has an error!”
“!”
Another agent quickly came running toward them from far away. He was holding a tablet-like object.
“I’m sorry! The person in charge didn’t put the Divine status assessment into the ranking!”
“What?”
“Does that mean this ranking reflects only his wealth and Constructs?”
“Yes! I re-entered it! The real ranking will show up when it is refreshed. It is coming up right now.”
“You should do your work properly. Still, it shouldn't change the standing too much…”
Despite these words, odd expressions appeared on their faces when they checked the tablet.
“What the hell? Why did the snake god’s name disappear? It was over here.”
“Did it fall further…”
“No! He’s over here!!!”
“What? Where?”
“Here!”
“Where the hell… Kuhk?!”
The gods who had been looking at the ranking board couldn’t believe their eyes.
“What the hell is this?”
They screamed when they saw the unbelievable ranking.
***
Around that time…
“Shall we drag him out into the open?”
“!”
Two familiar gods appeared in front of Lee Gun. It seemed the two of them didn’t want to draw attention to themselves, so they had covered their faces.
Lee Gun merely smirked at their appearance. He glared at them as if to say he knew what they were doing. “You guys were nowhere to be seen when we were catching the pillar gods. Why are you suddenly appearing right now?”
“Of course, we were going around various places to help you.”
Lee Gun looked at the two of them in contempt. “Ah! You guys were trying to help me by leading the Olympus gods to me? Is that why you were with them?”
“!”
Osiris and Anubis flinched when they saw his menacing smile.
Lee Gun looked at them with his red eyes as he squeezed Anubis’s neck. “A Zodiac knows the locations of their Constructs. I already know your faction met up with the Olympus gods. Did you think I wouldn’t find out about it?”
“What are you saying? We— Kuhk! Huhk!!”
“I know where you ate, and I know where you took a dump. I can recite all your actions. Should I recite it to you in the form of a song??”
A normal Zodiac wouldn’t be able to know their Constructs’ actions to that extent. However, Lee Gun was different since he possessed the independent twelve Zodiac system.
“Don’t try any funny business with me. I know you guys don’t harbor any goodwill toward me.”
Suddenly, the stubborn Osiris approached Lee Gun as if the remark had offended him. “Why are you saying this? Of course, we want to help you since you became our new master.”
“Oh, really? Then you wouldn’t mind me revealing to everyone that you guys are my subordinates? Ok.”
“!!”
When Lee Gun headed toward the public bulletin of the neutral zone, the two gods reacted in fright.
“Just having Hercules under me created a big buzz! Do you realize how much they are willing to pay me for an interview on broadcast? They’ll be shocked to find out that the pillar gods of Ennead or whatever are my Constructs.”
It seemed they wanted to avoid this at all costs. Anubis grabbed Lee Gun’s arm as he said, “Why are you being like this? We merely have a big grievance against Sagittarius! That’s all!”
“Grievance?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he turned his gaze. “Yes. That bastard is…!”
At that moment…
[You can’t, Anubis.]
‘!’
Osiris’s strict voice rang inside Anubis’s head. Anubis flinched. They were using telepathy that could only be shared between the gods of Ennead.
[We cannot let him find out about that person’s story.]
Osiris was referring to the Great Spirit of Ennead, one of the top three figures in the Divine world.
‘He placed the bounty on Sagittarius.’
The reason for the crazy 65-billion bounty was the Great Spirit of Ennead. Of course, this amount was minuscule to a Great Spirit, who possessed great wealth. The Great Spirit had snorted at such a figure.
‘He already had a grudge against Sagittarius. The incident with the bomb made him angrier.’
The Great Spirit of Ennead wasn’t like Zeus.
‘He was born alongside the Divine world, and he accompanied the Primordial god. He didn’t inherit his power at all.’
He was the strongest amongst the Great Spirits and was considered one of the three pillars of the Divine world. It was said that if he raged, he was capable of destroying the Divine world.
Although he hadn’t been hurt, Sagittarius had ruined something precious to the Great Spirit. This was the reason for the bounty: to bring Sagittarius in front of the Great Spirit.
[What would happen if the snake god learns that we are trying to catch Sagittarius using the bounty? What do you think will happen?]
The snake god had cheated the gods of Olympus. He was tricky.
[If the snake god gets a hold of Sagittarius, he’ll try to negotiate with us.]
Anubis laughed in a knowing manner.
[Osiris-nim should be the one who should be mindful of not leaking your objective.]
Anubis was aware of it. He knew why a god of Osiris’s stature was trying to stay next to the snake god.
‘He is trying to steal the Divine status of the twelve Zodiacs from the snake god.’
Osiris specifically wanted the seats of Gemini and Pisces from the twelve Zodiacs. Those two possessed Divine statuses of gods that had originated from Ennead.
[Divine status: Isis]
[Divine status: Nefertiti]
Moreover, both Divine statuses had a connection to Osiris. The great magician of the Divine world, Aslan, had stolen those Divine statuses and given them to the twelve Zodiacs.
Originally, those two Divine statuses were noble powers of Ennead. They were Divine statuses that could have deepened Osiris’s internal energy.
‘Why the hell did he bring it with him to the Divine world?’
The snake god had voluntarily crawled into the Divine world with those Divine statuses! Osiris hadn’t said it, but Anubis was sure Osiris was aiming for them.
‘However, we have to escape being his Constructs first.’
This was why they looked at Lee Gun. “As a Zodiac, you can go back to the earth only if you make changes to the Rule Book. Pushover is a Construct, so he can go back to the earth. However, he would have to pay a departure fee.”
“Departure fee?”
“Yes. Kunlun as well as the other forces want Pushover. They’ll make sure he can’t leave. At the very least, you need 10 billion Talents in bribe money for them to turn a blind eye.”
“Ten billion?!”
When Hugo opened and closed his mouth, Anubis laughed to reassure him. “It’s fine. Sagittarius’s bounty has gone up again to 65 billion. We can use him to negotiate with the goddesses of fate, and at the same time, you can hand him over for the bounty. You can use him twofold.”
Lee Gun snorted as if he was trying to tell them to fuck off. “I don’t need your help. You should summon him, Taeksoo.”
Since Sagittarius was Hugo’s Construct, Hugo should be able to summon him.
Flash!
“!”
Hugo summoned Sagittarius, but what appeared was the horse mask!
“!”
When their eyes became round, Anubis moved in close as if to say he had expected this. “Sagittarius is a formidable god. He might not look like it, but he’s capable of killing several thousand gods.”
“!”
Pillar gods were such beings.
“He is a cruel god who killed gods without a single trace of mirth on his face. His nickname is the White Reaper. He is famous in the Divine world for being cold-blooded. He’s an elite.”
“Such a god won’t be summoned through Construct Summons. No way!”
The expressions on the faces of Hugo and Lee Gun were a sight to behold.
White Reaper…?
Cold-blooded…?
‘Who the hell are they talking about?’
It seemed Sagittarius had gone around making a lot of enemies.
Thinking that, Lee Gun grabbed Anubis by the throat. “You call him here. Then I’ll believe you.”
“Release my power. If you do— Ggoo-ahhk!”
“Since you’re a dog, you should act like one. Use your nose to find him. If you don’t, I’ll grind you up and turn you into a real dog.”
“Gun, why don’t you let Hercules train them?”
Osiris snorted. “He’s a worthless fighting-type god who got blinded by a woman. Do not compare him to me.”
“Yes. Trust us. It is advantageous for you to hand over Sagittarius for the bounty.”
“What are you talking about?”
“What else? For gods, colonies are considered their power and strength. That’s why gods must acquire colonies.”
Lee Gun possessed the earth, which was considered a very high-quality land.
“Since doing so is taboo, gods won’t openly try to take it. However, you have little backing, money, and Constructs. Do you really think you’ll be able to maintain your colony? You’ll have it stolen in a fortnight.”
“!”
“Normally, you can donate money to the Divine world to protect your dimension, but can a poor god like you have the funds to— Kuhk!”
“I don’t give a damn about the donation. You can sell Duat and pay it off. This is an order from your Zodiac.”
“…?!”
Osiris was taken aback, but Lee Gun took out something as if he just had an idea. It was a necklace used for communication.
Lee Gun manipulated the necklace, and a familiar figure appeared as a hologram. It was Kevin.
He got up as if he was glad to see Lee Gun.
[Lee G— Why is that woman there?!]
Lee Gun ignored Kevin’s irritated words. He got straight to the point. “I contacted you because I need to confirm something”
[You want to confirm something? Ah! You did cut me off earlier and ended the call…!]
“You said some unknown beings appeared there claiming to be my friend. They are trying to swindle everyone?”
[Yes! They claim to be your Construct and say they will be managing the earth for you! They are asking for all kinds of tribute that they claim will be sent to you!]
Lee Gun smirked. Which gods were using his name to steal tribute from his dimension? That question was answered in no time.
[They said the goddesses of fate had sent them. They claim to be very close with you.]
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. They were carrying out such a plan while he was fighting Hercules?
Hailey immediately realized what was going on. “You’re the Zodiac of the earth, yet you’re absent. They used this opportunity to send their Constructs.”
Osiris realized his plan was going awry, so he clenched his eyes shut. He had planned on somehow making Lee Gun negotiate with the goddesses of fate. It would give Osiris and Anubis the chance to secretly contact the goddesses. They would be able to broker a secret deal.
‘The goddesses of fate can free us from him if they change the rules…!’
After they would be released from being the snake god’s Constructs, they planned on completing their mission.
It was an order from their Great Spirit. When they asked why they had to do such a thing, the Great Spirit had given an unexpected reason.
- We cannot lose that precious Creator.
- What? What do you mean…
The two gods of Ennead gulped as they recalled those words.
Lee Gun laughed while looking at Kevin. “Earth is fine since Sungjae is there. You should work with him. Don’t get too involved.”
Kevin nodded.
* * *
After returning to the earth, Yeonwoo felt a grave energy.
“What? You can’t get in touch with Sungjae?”
To inform her about Hugo, Yeonwoo had visited Chun Jiwoo. But she looked at her surroundings as if something was off.
‘That’s odd. Nothing too strange seemed to have occurred while I visited the Divine world.’
“!”
Yeonwoo had been walking toward the window when she lowered her head. She took a deep breath.
‘This energy is…’
Murderous intent appeared in her eyes. It was to be expected since she had felt this ominous energy when the original owner of the Serpent Bearer temple had died. It was the energy of an ominous god that could be felt from the corpse of her owner.
At the same time, Yeonwoo heard a voice.
[My pretty Creator, where is the new child?]

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - Would you look at this guy? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 362 - Would you look at this guy? (2)
Lee Gun was the Zodiac of the earth. He had to tackle several problems. His first problem was that Hugo had been kidnapped. Of course, he had solved that issue.
The process of saving Hugo had created more problems, but Lee Gun didn’t care about that.
‘He has scars left on his face, but it’s fine since he became manly(?) like me.’
Hugo’s junior could be fixed by taking it from someone else.
‘Anything beyond that isn’t my problem…’
On the other hand, Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement as he listened to Kevin’s story. “Hey, Gun. You said he has to work with Sungjae. Who’s Sungjae— Kuh-huhk!”
“Damn it! I forgot about his memory. Whatever. It'll be fine. I just have to beat him up.”
“What???”
Anyway, Lee Gun had only one problem remaining. He had to find a way to return home. Moreover, he had heard that the goddesses of fate were running a scam on the earth.
‘Earth has Zodiac Saints, so it’ll be fine for now…’
At that moment…
[This is bad, Gun!]
“!”
Lee Gun heard Yeonwoo’s voice through the official Construct-exclusive telepathy.
He furrowed his brows. “Yeonwoo? What’s wrong?”
[Sungjae is missing!]
‘Sungjae was missing?’
In a rarity, Lee Gun furrowed his brow. “I’ll try to contact him.”
It seemed the Constructs had heard the same telepathy. They sounded taken aback as they yelled out loud.
“You cannot contact the Zodiac Saint here, Master. You need a Communication Stone.”
Communication Stone was a tool that allowed a Zodiac to contact their Zodiac Saints. Amongst gods, the distance didn’t matter. They could contact each other using telepathy.
However, this wasn’t the case with humans within one’s colony. The telepathy didn’t work that way. This was why the Constructs were taken aback.
“Shit! Did something bad happen to our baby Zodiac Saint? Should we borrow one?”
“Who will lend them to us? Communication Stones are very expensive, so only rich Zodiacs can dream about using them…!”
[Clump of Creation Clay had stolen a Communication Stone.]
[Would you like to use it?]
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round as he looked at the slime on his shoulder. Lime was waving the stone in front of his face.
Lee Gun had no idea where it had stolen the stone form, but the slime seemed to have predicted its owner would need the stone. However, there was a problem.
[It is a new stone that has never been used before.]
[You need to connect it to the base station.]
[would you like to use their service?]
[The monthly communication fee will be 2 million Talents. One million Talents are needed to set up the first connection.]
It was extremely expensive.
Each of Lee Gun’s Constructs stepped forward, saying they’ll take on the debt.
Lee Gun discreetly glanced at someone next to him. “Club.”
“Yes? You called for me?”
“Go sell him.”
“?!!”
Suddenly put in the spotlight, Anubis reared back in shock. “W-Wait a moment! Sell me?!”
Lee Gun was sure a pawnshop would lend him money by putting an item up as collateral.
“You might not know this, but that place gives out loans according to the item that you give them…!”
“I know. I own him.”
“?!”
“If I put him up for auction, I won’t be able to bring him back. That’s why I’m choosing the pawnshop.”
Hugo, who had been a frequent customer of pawn shops, looked appalled. “If you can’t pay back the pawnshop, it’s the same as selling the item…?”
“Who cares? I’ll be able to pay it all off if I capture Sagittarius. If I can’t pay it off, I’m fine with that.”
“!?”
Lee Gun gestured with his hand as if he held no love for Anubis.
In the end, Anubis screamed as Hercules dragged him away. It was unprecedented for a Zodiac to be sold to a pawnshop!
Anubis tried to run away, but his opponent was a fighting-type god. He couldn’t run away.
Osiris didn’t want to be sold, so he kept silent.
Some time later, Lee Gun received notifications.
[You have received a loan of 200 million Talents from the pawnshop.]
[You have deposited the communication fee.]
[You can contact a Construct located in a different dimension. Please select your target.]
Satisfied by the voice he had heard from the stone, Lee Gun immediately connected to Sungjae.
[You are connected to the Dimension “Earth.”]
[Connection complete.]
Soon, a hologram appeared above the gem, depicting a familiar scenery. It was Hugo’s living room, which was designated as the holy ground of the Serpent Bearer temple. It was also considered Lee Gun’s room.
“Sungjae? Sungjae?”
While Lee Gun was absent, the number of his figurines in the room had increased several folds. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Sungjae!”
When there was no answer, Lee Gun wondered if the connection was garbage.
“!!”
However, the hologram suddenly captured the image of an enormous eye, almost making Lee Gun and Hugo scream.
The black bean-like eye belonged to a snake. It was Lee Gun’s Construct Junwoo.
Since the baby snake was too young to fight in the Divine world, Lee Gun had left him next to Sungjae.
Lee Gun asked, “Hey, Junwoo. Where is Sungjae?”
The snake was overjoyed to see Lee Gun. As if to answer his question, he enthusiastically danced. It looked as if he were copying Sungjae.
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. What did he mean?
‘Is he imitating me? Wings?’
That wasn’t all. The snake was having fun as he gave several signs.
Seeing this, Lee Gun immediately called his Construct. “Decipher what he’s saying.”
“W-What?”
“That’s odd. If Sungjae’s life was in danger, I would have received a signal.”
If a Zodiac Saint died, Lee Gun would know as the Zodiac. The system was set up that way.
Hugo furrowed his brows as he said, “I hope nothing happened to Sungjae.”
Lee Gun looked impressed by those words. He looked at Hugo. “Did you remember something about your family?”
“No. However, you said he’s my son. That means he’s a smaller version of his cute dad, right?”
Lee Gun looked like he had bitten into a lemon. “Mmm. Yes. He loves his dad… I guess?”
“Right! He’s probably a papa’s boy!”
Would it be better if Hugo never regained his memories?
“It’s fine. Let us find Sagittarius first. We can’t go home without him.”
“Where is Sagittarius?”
“It’s a place you know very well.”
Hugo wondered where the place was, but he became surprised by the words Lee Gun whispered in his ears.
“What?! That bastard went there?!”
* * *
Hugo was dismayed as he looked at the building in front of him. “He really is here?”
Lee Gun had the same expression as he looked at the building.
“This is a cat cafe!”
Persephone let out a bright smile when she heard their shouted words. She had led them here.
“Yes. It’s very famous! The cafe has franchise stores all over the place, but this one is the best since you can touch Leo!”
Persephone had come here after liquidating her husband’s assets. Hugo massaged his forehead when he saw her bright smile.
Yes, they had come here since Sagittarius was hiding here. This place was none other than a store owned by Leo.
Animal cafe! Here, the Constructs under the Leo temple moved freely through the cafe and acted cute. It was a place where they were doted on by customers…
“This place is very popular. Where else would one have an opportunity to pet Leo? Of course, you have to pay a massive amount of money to meet Leo, and you need to pay extra if you want to touch him.”
“Huh huh huh. A fighting-type Zodiac runs an animal cafe…”
Although Lee Gun had enjoyed farming ingredients from Leo, Leo was the great fighting-type Zodiac of Mahabharata
Mahabharata was another of the eight great forces. It was a place full of fighting-type gods. The place was described as hell, where lightning and flames raged.
‘It’s tough to get in there…’
This meant Leo was a difficult god to find, yet he was running a cute cafe nearby like this.
“Leo is unexpectedly good at running a business…”
It was an animal cafe, yet it had a high number of fierce beasts. However, that didn’t matter.
“Why did he go to the cat?”
“Gun…”
Of course, it was understandable.
‘They are allies as members of the twelve Zodiacs, and Leo is the only one who doesn’t care what others do….’
Sagittarius had made the right choice. This was a place that Lee Gun would have never thought about coming to. Moreover, all the employees here looked like animals, so hiding one’s face was easy.
Even though Sagittarius was close to Virgo, he would never go to her since she was on Lee Gun’s side. The other factions were filled with gods who wanted the bounty.
“Anyway, it’ll be troublesome if Mahabharata is keeping Sagittarius under wraps. That’s why he purposefully hid here.”
“Who cares?” Lee Gun immediately opened the door to the cafe.
Kwahng!
Everyone’s attention was focused on him, and beast gods wearing waiter uniforms approached him.
“Welcome. Are you looking for a specific subject?”
“I’m here to meet Leo.”
“Ah! You’re a special guest! Hey, Master’s butler! Why don’t you serve these important guests?”
A young waiter quickly approached them.
“Yes, yes. I’ll guide them to Master— Kuhk!”
The god wearing a snake mask suddenly came to a stop.
‘This is nuts! Why are they here?’
This god was none other than Sagittarius, who had come running to Leo. As the price for hiding here, Sagittarius had agreed to work as Leo’s butler. And right now, the god of the sun was sweating.
‘Shit! I have to run away.’
Sagittarius immediately tried to run away through the backdoor, but…
“Hey, where are you running away?”
“?!!”
As if he had been waiting for this moment, Hugo blocked Sagittarius’s path. With his debt having been paid off, Hugo had regained his abilities. This was why he was very fast.
“Get ready to be sold. You just have to help us for a short time.”
“There is no way I’ll believe that!”
Sagittarius quickly used his skill on Lee Gun and Hugo and tried to run away.
[Hair loss]
Hair fell off from the heads of Lee Gun and Hugo.
This made sparks fly from Lee Gun’s eyes. “Bastard.”
Since they were related, he had planned on going easy on the Sagittarius. But that was now out the window.
Lee Gun let out a menacing smile as he cracked his knuckles. “Customer. Do you have some kind of business with our employee?”
“!”
A beast god grabbed Hugo’s shoulder.
“Idiot! Over here! Hurry up and run away!”
All the employees helped Sagittarius run away.
“Master said to let that idiot run away!”
“Hurry!”
Lee Gun smirked as he watched this from the entrance. “What the hell? They are all on the same side?”
Since this was someone else’s store, he had planned on not causing too much trouble.
“Customer. I’m sorry, but you are being a nuisance. Please leave— Kuhk!!!”
Lee Gun kicked the waiter when the beast god brought up his arms in a rough manner.
The customers screamed when they saw this.
The eyes of the beasts, who had been acting cute toward the customers, flashed. They immediately charged Lee Gun.
“Gyahhhng!”
“Gyaoh!”
This was the same for the employees.
“Get him! He’s merely a baby snake who became a Zodiac not too long ago!”
“There is no way savage beasts like us will lose to a baby snake!”
“While you may be one of the twelve Zodiacs, do not make the mistake of thinking you’re our ally!”
“His Achievements will be a great help to Master Leo!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if he preferred this. “Since all the gods of Olympus were humanoid, it did weigh on my conscience to split them apart, so I let them be.”
Lee Gun smirked as he summoned his item. It was a Divine authority that had been released when he had put the gods of Olympus in prison to pay off his debt!
[You are given the authority to use your Divine item.]
“Come out.”
When Lee Gun extended his hand, divine power exploded forth.
Kwahng!!
[Heaven’s Punishment (EX)]
The ax seemed to have been classified as Lee Gun’s Divine item. After it was finally revealed, Heaven’s Punishment let out a violent roar.
Koo-goo-goong!
The gods screamed as a wind swept around the store. The onlookers reacted in fright.
“What rank Divine item is that…!”
“Wait a m—”
The gods were unable to speak.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed, and he charged toward them like a madman.
The employees and the small animals reacted in fright. They started running away.
“Hey! Close the store!”
“Run…!”
Sagittarius was taken aback when everyone left him behind to run away.
“Hey! How can you guys just leave? You guys should protect me! Did you forget about your promise?!”
“Can’t you see that bastard has lost his mind?!”
“If you’re so great, you get rid of him!”
“We are weak pets!”
In the end, Sagittarius cursed as he turned around.
Bbah-gahk!!!
“Kuhk!!”
However, Hugo caught Sagittarius before the latter could run away. Sagittarius tried to break free, but he felt a chill run up his spine when he heard the footsteps coming toward him.
“!!”
When he looked back, he saw the flashing red eyes of Lee Gun. Lee Gun had already skinned the leather of the beasts.
“Where do you think you are going?”
Once Lee Gun took out his Divine item, it was impossible to run away.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - Would you look at this guy? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 363 - Would you look at this guy? (3)
In a flash, the pet cafe turned into a scene of carnage.
Sagittarius had no choice but to scream. The reason was naturally Lee Gun. “No. Wait a moment! Let it go!”
“No way I'm letting go, baldie. You’re going to run away again, right?”
“No! You got the wrong guy!”
Sagittarius tried to break free from Lee Gun’s hand, which was grabbing the back of his neck.
‘Damn it! Why is he so strong?’
It didn’t look like Lee Gun was gripping very hard, yet his hand was like stone. It wouldn’t budge. Desperate, Sagittarius shouted, “Sir! I’m a blameless employee of this place! That’s why— Ahhk!”
Lee Gun pulled off the animal mask on Sagittarius’s face. His face caused a commotion.
“Louis-nim?!”
“My god! Why would someone of that caliber work as a butler here?”
Sagittarius started to sweat. “Haha, Serpent Bearer. I never expected you to like a place such as this! Yes, your taste is important. Which animal are you here to see? I’ll introduce—”
“Hey, do you want your hair ripped out?” Angry, Lee Gun grabbed Sagittarius’s wig.
Sagittarius immediately defended his wig as he cried out, “Pardon me all to hell! Master!!”
The crowd, who had been exiting the store, became surprised by this sight.
“What the hell? Who’s that kid? Why’s the White Reaper bowing down to him??”
“Why is a god of his caliber working a part-time job here?”
Sagittarius started to sweat when he heard those words. There was a simple reason he had come to Leo.
‘He’s the most tight-lipped.’
Sagittarius was close to Virgo. They were close enough to freely go in and out of each other's rooms. However, she enjoyed being led by someone else. This was true for the other gods.
This was embarrassing to admit, but Sagittarius had a lot of enemies in the Divine world. Therefore, he had gone to Leo!
‘Absolute Safety!’
Of course, the negotiation hadn’t been easy. When Sagittarius had met him, Leo had an incredulous look on its face as it scratched with its paw.
[I understand your situation, but why do I have to help you?]
[Why else? Have you forgotten the promise we made a long time ago?]
[I don’t care about that. I’m going to sleep. Fuck off! I want to sleep until the butler brings my food.]
[Damn it!!]
Leo couldn’t be bothered by the conversation, so it had lain on the ground. However, Sagittarius hadn’t given up.
‘The gods might avoid Leo as if it is a psycho, but for me, there is no better place to be than here.’
Leo was once a baby lion fostered by Aslan. However, Leo didn’t care about others, including Aslan. This was why Leo was much more trustworthy for Sagittarius.
Sagittarius had looked after Leo since the lion was young. This was why he spoke up.
[Kargo! It’ll be very advantageous for you if you hide me!]
[There is no way that’s true. In the first place, you’re a god of debauchery. There is nothing advantageous you can offer me…]
[If you hide me, you’ll be able to meet Lee Gun!!]
[!?]
It didn’t matter if one offered offerings, promises, or all kinds of good stuff. Leo rejected them all. Only Lee Gun’s name made its eyes flash.
[If I hide you, I’ll be able to meet Lee Gun?]
[Yes! Didn't you hear? Lee Gun entered the Divine world.]
[What? He did?]
[Yes! He’ll come chasing after me. If I’m not here, he won’t even think about seeing you. If I’m here, wouldn’t he come here?]
[…!]
[If you hide me, I’ll make sure to instigate a fight between you and Lee Gun.]
Sagittarius let out a wicked smile when he saw Leo’s eyes flash.
‘Alright. I convinced him!’
He had said Lee Gun would come looking for him, but he knew the truth.
‘There is no way Lee Gun would come to a pet cafe.’
He just had to shut his mouth and keep out of sight…
‘Damn it! I didn’t expect him to really come here!’
Did someone witness him? Sagittarius let out a cold sweat as Lee Gun flashed a menacing smile.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he dragged Sagittarius away. “Let’s skip the small talk. We can go home if we sell you. You just have to come with us for a short time and help us.”
“Wait a moment. That makes no sense!” Sagittarius struggled as he looked for his allies.
‘Damn it! They all ran away!’
It seemed they were afraid of Lee Gun, who was holding Heaven’s Punishment. The gods who were supposed to help Sagittarius were nowhere to be seen.
Of course, Lee Gun’s first instinct had been to skin the beast gods, so them running away in fright was understandable.
At that moment, a nude eagle god, who had its feathers all plucked out, emitted light from its neck.
It was the same Communication stone necklace that Lee Gun possessed.
[Oh, Construct of Leo. The resources coming from there suddenly stopped. Did something happen?]
“!”
The eyes of Lee Gun and Hugo turned round when they heard a familiar voice. At the same time, a familiar face appeared above the luminescent necklace. It was a hologram made out of light.
“Stevens?!”
The one to appear was none other than the Leo Saint. Hugo was surprised by his appearance, and Stevens was the same.
[What the hell? I see you’re fine, Hugo— Ahhk!! What happened to the Constructs?]
Stevens was shocked as he looked at the birds of the prey-type gods, who had their feathers all plucked out. All the fallen gods had lost their dignity. They looked like boiled chicken. This made Stevens rage.
[Who would do such a cruel act—]
“What did you just say?”
The angry Stevens could speak no longer.
[Lee… Lee Gun!?]
His face turned pale when he saw Lee Gun standing there with a menacing expression on his face.
[What the hell? Why are you there?]
On the other hand, Lee Gun looked offended by Stevens’s face. “Whatever. You’re dead.”
[What?!]
“When we get back to the earth, you’re dead.”
[What? Why?]
“Moreover, you will never get another weapon from me.”
[Why!!!!]
“Lastly, I’ll make sure you won’t be able to have any descendants.”
Why was this happening? Stevens was aggrieved to hear this out of the blue.
He looked at Hugo, but Hugo avoided his gaze. “I-I’m sorry. May you rest in peace.”
[What?!]
This was all happening because Hugo had told Lee Gun a story about Stevens in their conversation about Hailey. It was the story of the early days when the Zodiac Saints had met for the first time and Stevens had hit on Hailey.
However, Hugo took no responsibility as he acted oblivious. He grabbed Lee Gun, who was shooting lasers from his eyes. “Anyway, let’s take him before anyone comes to stop us—”
Kwahng!!!
“Do you really think I’ll let you guys leave?”
“!!”
A savage voice rang out as the second floor of the cafe was destroyed. The cafe building was shaped like a ‘ㅁ’. There was no ceiling, so it had a hole in the middle. Therefore, when the walls of the second floor were destroyed, the debris fell to the first floor.
Kwahn! Kwahng!
“Kyahhhk!”
“M-My word! It’s Leo!”
Leo was a lion god that possessed golden fur. His fur was considered beautiful even in the Divine world.
Of course, Leo’s skin had various bald patches where the fur was missing. It was as if it had alopecia.
The enormous lion that emitted a golden light was over five meters tall, and it revealed its savage teeth.
Lee Gun snorted.“That cat dares do that?”
Leo already had its fur and teeth taken on the earth. Of course, on earth, Leo was unable to use 100% of its power. The synchronization rate with its Zodiac Saint had been low too.
That was why Leo always said it’d rip apart Lee Gun and told him to come to the Divine world.
Leo growled as it let out a fierce Divine power. “I’m glad you’re here, you little rat!”
It seemed determined to destroy its store. Golden lightning struck the surrounding area.
Kwha-jee-jeek!
Hugo groaned when he saw the lightning. This was on a different level compared to when Leo had descended to the earth.
At the time, it had felt like a clone that could use only 10% of its power. Now, it was a completely different story!
[Caution! Leo is one of the fighting gods of Mahabharata.]
Lee Gun snorted at the voice. This was why Leo was able to become a Zodiac of a battle-type temple.
Lee Gun dodged like a mole in a whack-a-mole game. Landing lightly, he said, “Hey. I have no business with you. I came to recover this guy. You know that a bounty was placed on him, right?”
“Of course, I know. The Great Spirit of Ennead placed a massive amount of bounty on him. Louis does have a lot of enemies.”
“If you know…”
“I’m sorry, but that is all the more reason I can’t let you do it!”
“!!”
Kwahng!!
Leo attacked Lee Gun with its enormous front paw. “Do you think I’ll stand by and watch some other god profit!!”
An angry Lee Gun smirked. “Hey, you want to die? I have to go back home.”
The remark made Leo savagely laugh. “I know what you’re thinking about doing, but do you think it’ll solve your problem? Also…”
“?”
“Why the hell do you want to go to the lowly earth? You should live here in comfort and safety!! You can continue to be my sparring partner here!”
As soon as it spoke, it emanated a powerful energy wave. Then, something surprising happened.
[Leo has transformed into a fierce battle-type god.]
Leo still had the head of a lion, but its body turned into that of a human.
Lee Gun laughed as if he was angry. “I was going easy on you because there was a chance that my debt could go up.”
This wasn’t something that made sense since Lee Gun had ruthlessly taken the leather and feathers of the Constructs.
Anyway, Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment. The power that a Divine item could generate in the Divine world was on a different level.
Koo-goo-goohng!
After receiving Lee Gun’s Divine power, Heaven’s Punishment let out a fierce roar. It was about to clash against Leo when…
“…!”
Lee Gun flinched.
[The thief has stolen something precious.]
Lee Gun turned his head when he heard the voice. He furrowed his brows.
Sagittarius was gone. Hailey and Hugo, who had been looking over Sagittarius, were gone too.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
* * *
Around that time…
“Did we lose the snake god?!”
“Yes! The person blocking the snake god is one of the ten Avatara, Leo. Even if the snake god was able to bring down Olympus, there is no way he can easily get past Leo and chase after us!”
“Good! This bastard must never fall into the hands of the snake god!”
“Yes!”
This was the outer edge of the neutral zone.
Sagittarius sighed as he was taken by some kidnappers.
‘I can’t believe these guys are helping me.’
Yes, while Lee Gun was clashing against Leo, Sagittarius had been kidnapped by one of the eight great forces. Moreover, Sagittarius had purposefully let himself be kidnapped.
‘I just have to avoid my nephew and the Great Spirit of Ennead. It doesn’t matter who takes me.’
If he were handed over as a wanted person, he would surely fall into the hands of the Great Spirit of Ennead!
Moreover, Leo was affiliated with Mahabharata, and they hated Ennead. This was why they were trying to pocket him.
‘It wouldn’t be a bad idea to hide within the Mahabharata.’
However…
“Do you think I’ll let you leave?”
“?!”
When fierce arrows flew toward them, the gods were taken aback. They used Sagittarius as a shield.
Kwahng!!
Sagittarius vomited blood after taking the bombardment.
“Kuhk…! Kuh-huhk! Hugo! Do you plan on killing your master? Moreover, I’m human right now! Kuhk!”
Hugo ignored Sagittarius’s words as he pulled back on his bow. The gods, who were surprised by Hugo’s appearance, started to laugh.
“If there is only one, it’ll be fine. Let’s just run—”
“I’m sorry, but there are two of us.”
“!”
Hugo had come out in the open as bait.
The gods flinched when they saw Hailey blocking their path. They tried to take out their Divine items, yet they couldn’t believe their eyes when they saw their opponent.
‘That face… I’ve seen it before.’
There was no way they would forget a beauty of her caliber. They were thinking about it when they did a double-take.
‘Wait a moment! Doesn’t she look like the young girl that the Great Zodiac put a bounty on?’
‘You are right…!’
They were taken aback. One of the gods handed over Sagittarius to the other. This wasn’t the time to act indecisively.
‘I’ll tell the superiors about this woman. You stop them. We have to take advantage of Leo stalling the snake god.’
‘Yes. He knows better than anyone that it’ll be very troublesome if Sagittarius is sold off. At the very least, Leo will block…’
“You bastards!!!”
“?!”
The gods of Mahabharata heard a voice coming from the sky. Their mouths fell open.
“L-Leo?!”
Instead of blocking Lee Gun, their ally had chased after them. They had been barely able to kidnap Sagittarius, so this development left them dumbfounded.
Leo was supposed to interfere with the snake god so that they could prevent another faction from taking benefits!
So what was going on?
“Why did you follow us?”
“I thought you agreed to stop the snake god for Mahabharata?!”
“While you were blocking the snake god, we planned on….”
Leo expressed its anger instead. “Who cares? The snake god also went missing when you guys stole Sagittarius! Give him back!”
The two gods were at their wits’ end when Leo started attacking them.
“Damn it! You’re supposed to be one of the ten great Avatara!”
Like the twelve pillar gods of Olympus, each faction had its officer gods. Leo was also an officer god of Mahabharata.
‘Shit! At this rate…!’
“I was wondering where you guys ran away. You made it only this far?”
“!!”
Lee Gun appeared before them.
The gods tensed as they immediately got into their offensive stance.
“We heard tales about you, snake god.”
“However, we won’t be easily defeated like Olympus…”
“Bastards!!! You want to die! How dare you aim for my prey!”
“Damn it!!!”
Leo attacked them as if to say it didn’t want them to lay a hand on Lee Gun.
The gods of Mahabharata, who were on the same side as Leo, pounded their chests in frustration.
When Leo started causing a scene, Sagittarius was sent flying through the air, and Lee Gun immediately took possession of him.
Due to this, Sagittarius begged for forgiveness as he pleaded for his case, “Please, Nephew. Don’t hand me over. If I’m handed over to the Great Spirit of Ennead, I’m dead.”
Lee Gun laughed. “Don’t worry! I have no plan on selling my only uncle to them.”
“Nephew…! That means…!”
“I’m going to sell you to the goddesses of fate as their husband.”
“Yes! Goddesses of fate… What did you just say?!”
Sagittarius looked more frightened as his face turned pale.
“No! Those women are worse than…!!”
It seemed they had heard Lee Gun’s words at that moment.
Hoohng!
Sagittarius’s body suddenly became blurry.
[The goddesses of fate are happy as they take their prospective husband.]
Leo, the gods of Mahabharata, Hugo, and Hailey were all shocked by the sight.
Lee Gun smirked.
‘It is going as planned.’

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - Goddess of Fate (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 364 - Goddess of Fate (1)
Mahabharata was one of the eight great forces, which stood at the zenith of the tens of billions of gods.
If Olympus had their twelve pillar gods as officer-rank gods, Mahabharata had ten powerful incarnations, called Avatara.
While Leo didn’t have any drive, he was still one of their officer-rank gods.
Currently, those incarnations were focused on Sagittarius, whom Lee Gun was aiming for. The reason was obvious.
‘It’ll be a big problem if the snake god hands over Sagittarius!’
‘The one to put a bounty on Sagittarius was the Great Spirit of Ennead!’
He was the big elder who had taken the lands of the twelve Zodiacs in the past! Moreover, a famous story was spread around the Divine world, in which the Great Spirit of Ennead wanted to shred Sagittarius into pieces.
The reasons were simple. First, Sagittarius had scammed Ennead in the past and screwed him over. Second, he had stolen a precious treasure from the Great Spirit.
There was no way the Great Spirit would let things be when Sagittarius had become a human.
On the other hand, it wasn’t as if Mahabharata was doing this to save Sagittarius.
‘The Great Spirit of Ennead is a sun god, like Sagittarius. His powers will grow if he consumes Sagittarius.’
This meant Mahabharata was trying to stop a Great Spirit of a different faction from getting stronger.
In the process, we’ll recover the item Sagittarius stole from the Great Spirit of Ennead!
That was why the gods of Mahabharata, who had received an important order, screamed at that moment.
“Ahhk!! That bastard sold him to the goddesses of fate!”
“What the hell is he thinking?”
They froze, realizing something.
‘That snake god! He planned on negotiating with the goddesses of fate!’
The goddesses of fate were directly affiliated with the Divine world, and they held a Rule Book, which was considered the book of fate. That book could change the rules of the Divine world.
The Great Spirits had put great importance on this item, and it was something they wanted.
‘To put it bluntly, the Rule Book could wipe out one of the eight great forces.’
‘It can bring a lifetime of bad fortune to any of the great forces.’
Something like that had happened in the past.
‘If one possesses the goddesses of fate, one can stand at the zenith amongst the gods!’
Of course, the goddesses of fate were fickle and picky. They asked for a lot, so not anyone could make use of them.
“Ahhk!! It’s an entirely different story if that playboy is given as an offering! I’m sure the snake god is trying to trade Sagittarius for the Rule Book!!”
“What?! T-There is no way the goddesses will accept such a trade! He’s the one who destroyed their faction…”
“No! They don’t have strong ties to any of the factions!”
In other words, the goddesses of fate could do anything, and it wouldn’t be out of character!
Of course, no one had any idea what the snake god would ask of them.
‘If a Zodiac is looking for them, he must want to make them use their Rule Book!’
‘By sending Sagittarius, he bought an incredible amount of goodwill from them!’
At this point, their task of keeping Ennead in check and informing their Great Spirit wasn’t a priority.
‘We have to stop the snake god first.’
Overwhelmed by this thought, the gods of Mahabharata grabbed Hugo.
“Oh, reasonable-looking god! W-What do you plan on doing with the Rule Book?”
“Are you aiming for the seat of a Great Spirit?”
Great Spirit, my ass! However, Hugo had no obligation to tell them this. Instead, he looked at Lee Gun, dumbfounded. “You planned on doing this from the start?!”
Lee Gun let out a satisfied laugh.
* * *
After instantly disappearing, Sagittarius found himself in an unfamiliar palace. His face turned pale, since he could guess where this was.
‘This place is…!’
He was sure of it.
‘It’s the palace belonging to the goddesses of fate!’
It was a location that no god could locate, a place they all wanted to visit. However, this wasn’t the case with Sagittarius.
‘I have to run away!’
Despite being tied up, he quickly crawled across the ground. He tried to exit the palace.
Tahng!!!
“?!”
A bullet pierced the ground before Sagittarius. Having almost lost an ear, Sagittarius shook in fright as he turned his head.
“Welcome, my beloved Louis-nim! I missed you!”
“…!?!!”
A goddess who looked to be in her forties approached him, looking enraptured. She had a cigarette in her mouth.
[Divine status: The Three Goddesses of Fate / Lachesis (Present)]
She wasn’t like an elegant noblewoman. She looked more like someone who could be found on the battlefield shooting her guns. The goddess even had an eyepatch over one eye.
Sagittarius knew that she had lost that eye when she gambled with it as collateral.
In the end, Sagittarius greeted her with a smile frozen on his lips. “I…It has been a while. Where are your sisters? Why are you alone?”
Lachesis (Present) smiled. “Why are you looking for my sisters? Marriage is something you do one on one. Of course, I’ll be the one doing the good deed with Louis-nim.”
Sagittarius turned pale from fright.
Lachesis (Present) let out a harsh laugh as she continued, “If my sisters see you, they’ll take you away from me. That is why I’ll lay claim to you first by marrying you.”
When Lachesis took out the documents and seal, Sagittarius felt like dying.
The goddess ignored him as she let out a bright smile. “I thought the snake god was bad because he messed with Hercules. I guess he is a good boy. I never expected him to choose us instead of money.”
“#$*&#$*!”
Nephewwwww! Sagittarius felt like he was losing his mind. Why did he have to fall into their hands out of all the beings out there?
The three goddesses of fate were called the three Moirai sisters. Currently, they worked directly under the Divine world, but in the past, Sagittarius had been in the same faction as them. This was why he knew them well.
‘They are psychos!’
A lot of male gods had approached these goddesses and come back out as corpses!
Thankfully, only one out of three was here right now.
‘I can somehow run away if there is only one.’
According to her words, it seemed she wasn’t going to call her sisters. However…
“Hey, you want to die?”
“How dare you try to take Louis-nim for yourself?”
“Ahhhk!”
The other sisters appeared before he could set his mind at ease.
[Divine status: Klotho (Past)]
[Divine status: Atropos (Future)]
Klotho (Past) looked like a young child, while Atropos (Future) looked like an old woman.
Sagittarius tried to run away.
Tahng tahng tahng!
He ducked when the three sisters shot bullets at him and cried. Then, his eyes flashed.
‘Yes. My nephew concocted this plan.’
There was no way the mighty Lee Gun had sent him here without a plan!
‘He’s a psycho who sent a bomb to a monarch and one to a Great Spirit by attaching it to me.’
In truth, he felt some kind of object moving alongside his body.
‘I’m sure he attached a device to me.’
In this situation, Sagittarius could endure getting blown up. He didn’t mind what kind of bomb it was. There was no way his nephew had attached an item that could kill him.
‘No. He’ll save me even if I die!’
This was why Sagittarius said to the three sisters, who were fighting amongst themselves, “Alright. I’ll marry you guys. However, I want you to take my clothes off first.”
“What? You want us to take your clothes off?”
Sagittarius’s best weapon (?) was his face, so he put on his best expression. “The snake god sent an item with me. He said it was a wedding present. I want you guys to check it out.”
The goddesses of fate were suspicious, but soon, lecherous smiles appeared on their faces. They started pawing at his body.
“Do you mean this box? Is this the wedding present?”
Sagittarius had been about to cry when they finally found the device attached to his body. He laughed. “Yes! Open it!”
When the goddesses opened the box, a light exploded forth.
Sagittarius immediately moved out of harm's way. Then, something surprising happened.
Kwahng!!
Sagittarius smiled when he heard the sound accompanying the light. However, the explosion of light was accompanied by flower petals and paper.
「Sagittarius will be given to only the most beautiful and talented goddess..」
The eyes of the goddesses of fate flashed when they saw the message.
Sagittarius screamed.
‘Nephewwwwwww!!’
The goddesses fought each other as they held onto Sagittarius.
“Let go. Louis-nim is mine.”
“You let go.”
“How about we split him into three equal parts? I just need his face.”
“Uh? That’s not a bad idea. I just want his heart.”
“I want his lower body.”
“Alright. Let’s cut him.”
The captured Sagittarius let out a soundless scream. Klotho (Past) wanted his face, Lachesis (Present) wanted his heart, and Atropos (Future) tried to cut away his lower body.
Sagittarius became desperate.
‘Nephew! When are you going to arrive?’
This was being done by the mighty Lee Gun. Why would Lee Gun send him here?
‘He’s going to come here and break everything like usual!’
Sagittarius was sure Lee Gun would come. He was coming here. He had to come. “Why isn’t he coming?”
Sagittarius was close to being chopped up. He was about to scream when…
Kwahng!!
“!!”
The goddesses’ palace fell.
Sagittarius and the goddesses turned their heads in surprise.
“That direction is….”
They were wondering what was going on when…
“Ah! I finally found you.”
“…!!”
They were surprised to hear an unexpected voice.
“Virgo?”
“My younger sister!”
Sagittarius was close to crying when he saw his younger sister.
The silver-haired goddess was a battle-type Zodiac. Blood dripped down from her sword as she let out a cold smile. A pile of corpses was strewn behind her.
“I’m sorry, but I have no plans of having you guys as sisters-in-law.” Virgo smirked menacingly. “This is especially true since you guys betrayed the Serpent Bearer in the past.”
Taken aback, the goddesses of fate scoffed.
“What right do you have to get involved…”
“Ah! I forgot to tell you something. You guys are better off not marrying him.”
“What? What do you mean?”
“He has faulty goods.”
“…?!”
With a bright smile on her face, Virgo pointed between Sagittarius’s legs.
The shocked old-looking goddess quickly put her hand down Sagittarius’s pants.
* * *
Around that time…
“Gun, do you have no plan on going after the baldie?”
“Why would I?”
“Why else? He is your…”
His uncle was desperately looking for him, yet Lee Gun wasn’t going there. Lee Gun was currently searching the rooms occupied by the goddesses of fate.
“I threw him as bait. There is no point in doing that if I go after him.”
“Hey, what if they really marry him… What if they find out that he has a defective product?”
“It’s none of my business. I can say I handed him over without knowing about it.”
“….” Hugo decided to drop the subject and placed a hand on the wall. When he used his ability, something surprising happened.
Koo-goo-goohng!
It was a never-before-seen power, and it destroyed the wall. This power belonged to neither Sagittarius nor Lee Gun.
As the Pushover god of the Serpent Bearer temple, Hugo had acquired Divine status. This was Hugo’s original power.
When he destroyed the wall, a secret research lab was revealed. “What the hell is this…!”
Many lights were on display in the lab. At a glance, they all possessed powerful energy.
Lee Gun looked happy.
Hugo clicked his tongue. “I was wondering what you were looking for. Is this it? What are they?”
“What else? They are the juniors of male gods.”
“Ah. Junio— What?!!”
Lee Gun snorted. To be precise, these lights were the power of life that allowed one to have descendants.
It seemed the goddesses of fate used to have a deep connection with Hades, who was a god of the underworld.
Osiris, who was another god of the underworld, had fed Lee Gun information about the goddesses of fate.
‘Future likes to collect the precious essence of the male gods. Is she planning on making a new god?’
No one knew why the goddesses of fate collected them, but Lee Gun had heard the hushed conversation between Osiris and Anubis.
- As expected, Olympus is planning on reviving the Creators.
- Is that why they are gathering the power of life from male gods? They are trying to create new gods that are Creator rank?
Lee Gun’s eyes had flashed when he had heard the familiar name. However, it didn’t matter right now.
“Ah! I found it. This is yours, Taeksoo.”
“????!”
“I can send you home now.”
It seemed Lee Gun’s goal was to find this from the beginning. He pointed at the green light that was placed at the end of the display.
“That is…!”
“It’s your ability that Zeus took. It’s too dirty for me to touch, so you can go and take it for yourself.”
“Damn it! Really…”
“That’ll also increase your lifespan.”
“!”
Hugo was surprised by the unexpected words. He had been wondering why Lee Gun was obsessing over this! “You were looking for it to increase my lifespan?”
“No. I did it for your fourth child. It’s for my dream of becoming the owner of a team.”
“What does becoming an owner of a team have to do with my children?”
Hugo was taken aback, but he moved. He knew what had to be done.
When Hugo finally headed toward the light, Lee Gun was about to turn around, but…
“Lime?”
The slime jumped off Lee Gun’s shoulder and quickly dragged something toward him.
‘!’
Lee Gun was surprised when he saw it.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - Goddess of Fate (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 365 - Goddess of Fate (2)
Lime had brought a large mass of light. At a glance, the light looked like a regular lump of light, but Lee Gun’s face became visibly contorted. It was for no other reason.
[Creator’s Large and Girthy Thing]
Lee Gun got angry. “Damn it! Don’t bring that dirty thing!!”
“!!”
In this instance, he wished “Gaze of a God” wouldn’t activate. It was also why Lee Gun furrowed his brows even further.
Creators were special gods. They were so powerful that even several monarchs had originated from them.
‘Creator? There is no way this belongs to that person…’
At that moment, Lee Gun thought about the blonde man who had claimed to be his father. Moreover, he knew only one Creator, the thirteenth original owner.
On the other hand, Lime could guess what Lee Gun was thinking. It brought the large and girthy thing and slapped Lee Gun’s leg with the item, as if it were asking a penny for Lee Gun’s thoughts.
[Clump of Creation Clay expresses its anger. It says to put that away in a safe place.]
[It says this might be an important item.]
Lee Gun looked at Hugo with a serious expression. “Holy crap! This is big. You want to swap it out for this one?”
“Swap— Cough! You crazy bastard! What did you just say?”
“What? You are smaller than m—”
“It isn’t small!!!!” Hugo immediately became angry. That bastard, Gun, never used his, yet kept making fun of him. Hugo planned on teaching him a lesson.
“In the first place, whose is it?!”
“I don’t know. However, it seems to be the power of a Creator.”
“C-Creator?”
Hugo froze, thinking about the same person as Lee Gun was.
Angry, Lime butted its head. However, Lee Gun ignored it as he aggressively tried to sell the idea that the item would be beneficial to Hugo. “Look at the size of the light. It’s out of this world. Wouldn’t Miss Jiwoo like it? If you have it, I’ll really be able to become the owner of a team.”
“Damn it!!!”
As if to say he didn’t need it, Hugo kicked the enormous light. “If you like it so much, you take it!”
“No. It’s dirty.”
“It’s dirty for you, yet you want me to take it?”
Well, it didn’t matter. Although he had exaggerated it a bit by saying the lights were the junk of gods, it was more apt to say that they were the Life ability of gods.
“Why are they gathering such things?”
“I’m not sure. The only certain thing is that the owners of these are all famed gods.”
“They are famous gods?”
Hugo bit his tongue. He had heard a rumor that the major male gods avoided the goddesses of fate for some odd reason. That was why he had almost been sold off as the 19,788th husband. Was this related to that?
Lee Gun laughed. “Anyway, the fact that the goddesses of fate took yours means they accepted you as a god worth collecting, right?”
If that was true, wasn’t the one most in danger Lee Gun?
[You can feel the energy of the Rule Book nearby.]
A loud boom rang out, accompanied by the notification.
Tahng tahng tahng!!!
The wall of the room was destroyed. Hugo was surprised by the menacing face that made its appearance.
“You cheating snake god!” An old woman with a furious face had charged into the room.
[Divine status: Atropos (Future)]
When she saw Lee Gun, she pointed her gun at him as if she wanted to kill him. “Snake god! What the hell did you give us?”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he saw the murderous intent on her face. Behind her was Sagittarius, who looked like death warmed over. He was being carried by the middle-aged Lachesis (Current) and the child-like Klotho (Past), letting out deep sobs.
“Wahhhhh! My purity… My innocence…!” Sagittarius clutched the area between his legs, looking like he wanted to die.
Future’s eyes flashed as she ignored him. “How dare you deceive us by handing over a defective product?!”
“Oh wow! You already found out? I thought you wouldn’t find out until the wedding night.”
“Don’t look down on us!”
When she heard the unexpected information from Virgo, the old woman had immediately put her hand down Sagittarius’s pants and used her ability.
Among the three goddesses of fate, Future had the ability to cut fate. She was the one to cut out Hugo’s Divine status, and she had also cut away his lifespan.
