Just by passing her hand through Sagittarius’s body, she was able to read the entirety of his fate. This was why they became aware of the problem.
“You killed it so thoroughly that there is nothing for me to cut out!” Future had planned on cutting out and storing Sagittarius’ ability. She was enraged. “How dare you trick us and send this fake!”
On the other hand, Louis was sobbing. “Wahhh! I didn’t even get married, yet I was sullied…”
He looked as if the world was crumbling down around him. This surprised Hugo and Lee Gun.
‘What the hell did they do to him…’
Well, it didn’t matter.
“Did you come here to give me the Rule Book?”
The goddesses looked dumbfounded.
“Rule Book? We do have it, but do you think we’ll let you have it now that you gave this to us?”
When she saw Lee Gun’s sly laughter, the old woman’s eyes flashed as she grabbed the back of her neck. “There is a limit as to how much you can insult the goddesses who work directly under the Divine world. Take him away…”
Present and Past spoke up at that moment.
“If Big Sis doesn’t want him, the two of us will split him up between us.”
“That’s right. We just want his heart and face. That’s all we need.”
“It’s fine, since everything above his lower half is fine.”
For some reason, Lee Gun chuckled when the goddesses talked about Sagittarius. “Are you sure you checked for all the defects?”
“What?”
As soon as he spoke, Lime flew toward Sagittarius and pulled off the Zodiac’s wig.
Both the goddesses and Sagittarius reacted in shock when the baldness was revealed.
“Kyahhhhk!!”
“Ahhhhk!!”
Having a good time, Lime spun the wig.
The one who was shocked the most was Past, who had claimed that she cared about only the face. She was trembling. “L-Louis-nim is bald. Bald!”
Until a moment ago, she had been happy. Now, she tossed aside Sagittarius, and her eyes flashed in anger like the old woman’s. “You bastard!! How dare you give us a defective product!! I won’t forgive you!”
When Past looked like she wanted a refund, Lachesis’s eyes twinkled. “Then I can have him—”
“You stay put!!”
The goddesses of fate looked at Lee Gun as if they wanted to kill him.
“You wouldn’t have given him as a present unless you were trying to insult us!!”
Being treated so callously, Sagittarius shed tears. The old woman, who had read his fate, was filled with anger as she looked at Lee Gun. This was beyond being insulted.
“You ruined our plan. We tried to acquire him since he’s a Creator.”
“!”
Lee Gun and Hugo couldn’t believe their ears when they heard the unexpected words. They were surprised for different reasons.
“It is because he’s a Creator?”
“Wait a minute! Who’s a Creator?”
This was the first time Hugo was hearing this, so he found it peculiar.
Lee Gun scoffed. “Is it connected to what was inside there?” He pointed at the item of the Creator, which he had found inside.
The old woman contemptuously laughed. “Yes. Creators are called the gods of blessings. They were gods used by the Divine world as weapons. Before the nine great forces emerged, they were considered precious weapons of the Divine world.”
“!”
“However, they went extinct at some point, and we tried to revive them. But it’ll be possible if we find the information about how they procreate.”
Lee Gun laughed as if he were baffled.
The old woman glared at him. “If a Creator can be acquired, one can get hold of the greatest power. However, Creators went extinct a long time ago. Aslan was the last one left, but he died too. When his body and soul went missing, our plan was ruined.”
Then, the old woman looked at Sagittarius as she let out a cold laugh. “Thankfully, we found out that the son of the Creator tribe’s chief had been reborn! We were overjoyed, yet… See what you’ve done?!”
Lee Gun contemptuously looked at Sagittarius as if to say how could a son of the chieftain cause the extinction of a tribe because he was covetous of his own tribe’s power.
Sagittarius, Aslan’s big brother, started to sweat. He had recovered his past life’s memories not too long ago, but he remembered it all clearly. This was why he could make no excuse.
On the other hand, Hugo let out a cold sweat when he heard the conversation. He didn’t care about Sagittarius’s identity.
‘Gun has to be prioritized.’
The sisters seemed to be unaware of it, but Lee Gun was a Creator. Getting out of this place was the right idea.
“He killed Aslan before we could possess him…!”
At that moment…
“Ah. Really? It was you guys?”
“!!”
Everyone was surprised by Virgo’s appearance.
Virgo looked at the goddesses of fate with contempt. “I knew you guys were sad for an entirely different reason when Aslan died.”
“…!”
“It’s true. You guys were the Constructs of the previous Serpent Bearer.”
“…!!”
The goddesses of fate were surprised.
Virgo laughed. “Well, all the other Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple are all slaves, yet you guys are being treated well. That means you guys sold information about your master”
This meant they were never loyal to the Serpent Bearer. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Before Aslan died, he did mention that others were aiming for the Creators. Was he referring to you guys?”
The old woman scoffed. “It seemed you liked Aslan, so you probably have a grudge against us. Unfortunately, Aslan wasn’t referring to us. Another group was already trying to acquire the Creators, so we followed suit.”
The old woman dismissed Virgo as she glared at Lee Gun. “Anyway, you have to revive this bastard’s ability, Snake god! You are capable of reviving that place with the power of Life!”
Lee Gun let out a menacing laugh. “I don't want to. I’m going to let him be like that for the rest of his life.”
The goddesses of fate scoffed. How dare he act so boldly in front of them?
“You didn’t learn your lesson during your fight against Hercules. You know what we can do.”
“Since you destroyed Olympus, we thought you were a big deal. We looked forward to your ranking, yet it was low.”
“It’s proof that you’re unable to properly use your Divine status yet!”
“Your power probably went berserk, and you were lucky enough to direct that power to the pillar gods! Don’t even try to claim you were responsible for doing it!”
At that moment, they summoned a book. It was the Divine item that could manipulate the fate of the gods.
Like the time when they had interfered with Lee Gun’s fight against Hercules, they planned on immobilizing Lee Gun.
Hoohng!
“!!”
As Lee Gun laughed, the eyes of the goddesses turned round.
Hugo instantly appeared above them. With violence in his eyes, he stole the book.
“Koo-oohk!”
“Bastard!!”
His ability was good enough that they weren’t able to sense his approach. This left them flustered.
‘What’s going on? There’s no way the Divine world was wrong in their assessment.’
On the other hand, Hugo furrowed his brows after stealing the book of fate. He looked at the goddesses.
‘Something is off.’
He had met the goddesses of fate when he was inside Hades’ palace. He had seen Giselle during that encounter.
Of course, he had been tortured and had been close to falling unconscious from fatigue. This was why his memory of that time was fuzzy, but he was sure of one thing.
‘They aren’t the ones I met.’
This was why this felt off.
‘Are there more goddesses of fate?’
When Hugo stole the book, the goddesses looked at Hugo in dismay.
“I can’t believe someone with your Achievement is staying next to the snake god.”
“What?”
“That Achievement can kill even the snake god”
The eyes of the goddesses of fate flashed as they approached Hugo.
“If you don’t plan on using it, give it to us!”
“Idiots! Who told you to covet what’s mine?”
The goddesses were taken aback when they felt the surge of power.
“Wait a moment! That power is…!”
“It is different from his ranking…!”
When the goddesses shouted that, a desperate voice came from their shadows.
[There was a problem with that part.]
It was a Construct of the goddesses.
[It hasn’t been published yet, but according to the civil servants, the assessment of his Divine statuses wasn’t included in his ranking…]
“What?!”
[When all the information was reflected in the ranking, even the civil servants were surprised by his rank…]
“The civil servants have to maintain peace at all times, yet they were surprised. How high is his ranking?”
Lee Gun smirked as if he had been waiting for this moment. He flicked his finger.

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - Goddess of Fate (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 366 - Goddess of Fate (3)
The goddesses of fate were a troublesome bunch who the gods of the Divine world didn’t like interacting with. This was to be expected since they were goddesses who observed and foretold the fate of gods and humans. Moreover, their role didn’t end there.
The goddesses of fate had received orders from the Great Spirits, so they were allowed to directly interfere and eliminate the fate of gods. It was like what they had done with the incident with Hercules.
At the time, they had slightly tweaked Lee Gun’s fate. They had made it so that Lee Gun was fated to lose to Hercules. This was the “Fate Correction” ability, the three goddesses’ stronger weapon and power.
None of the gods antagonized the goddesses because of this power. In fact, the gods acted favorably toward them since they wanted the goddesses as assets to their factions.
“Idiots, who told you to covet what is mine?”
Lee Gun didn’t care about any of that. He just wanted to screw them over.
The goddesses ground their teeth when they saw Lee Gun’s expression.
‘We have to change his fate.’
When they started to move, Lee Gun contemptuously flicked his finger. It caused Sagittarius’s eyes to turn round, and a scream rang out.
“Ahhhk!!”
The one to scream was Hugo.
“What the hell is this?”
Accompanying the light, a lightning bolt beyond imagination emanated from Hugo’s body.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!
“If you move even a finger, you guys are dead.”
The goddesses reared back in fright when they heard Lee Gun’s words.
“This is the Great Spirit’s…!”
“Isn’t that the Lord of Heaven’s lightning!!”
This was the lightning of Zeus, the opponent Lee Gun had faced in Olympus.
Hugo, who was in pain, didn’t know what was going on. He was flustered, but Lee Gun yelled at him as if it was no big deal, “Go, Lightning Man! If you shoot your bow right now, you’ll be able to use lightning arrows!”
“Hey!!” Hugo was afraid he would die from electrocution before that! “Where the hell did you get this lightning?”
Hugo felt like he was about to faint. He quickly felt that all over his body. Clearly, this was Lee Gun’s doing.
While Hugo had been absent, Lee Gun had fought the god of lightning and probably used the acquired data to make something strange. Moreover, he had probably stuck the item on Hugo!
“Damn it! Where is it?” Groaning in pain because of the powerful lightning, Hugo groped his back.
With Lee Gun’s power of Life, Hugo would come back to life even if he died to the lightning. However, pain was pain.
Hugo became angry when he found a weird delivery sticker stuck to his back, which was emanating lightning.
[Lightning Sticker for Taeksoo’s Use (SSS)]
- A protective sticker created using the data of the Great Spirit Lord of Heaven. It electrocutes the enemy and the user with lightning.
“Damn it! Get this off me!”
“Why? I was worried you would get kidnapped again. I used precious data to make this for you!”
“Really!! You bast—”
Before Hugo could say anything else, the lightning went berserk in all directions. It attacked the old woman.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!
“Ahhhk!”
“Unni!”
It was the power of the Great Spirit for a reason. When Future took a direct hit from the lightning, she fell. Moreover, it seemed her heart had stopped.
The attack was indiscriminate. Sagittarius was surprised as well, but he soon defended against it.
[Family Shield]
Sagittarius screamed when the lightning struck him and fell to the ground.
This made Hugo angry. “I get that your heart is in the right place!! However, this indiscriminately attacks our allies! Don’t you have something more normal?”
Lee Gun looked resigned as he took out colorful gems. “If you don’t like that equipment, you can choose amongst these. I’ll give you a Divine status that might be of help to you.”
“!”
Lee Gun had taken out the Divine status cores of four gods
[Divine Status: Ares]
[Divine Status: Hermes]
[Divine Status: Hades]
[Divine Status: Aphrodite]
Hades was the first one Lee Gun had killed, he broke open the head of Ares, and Hermes was killed by Abyss.
As for Aphrodite, she was captured by Hercules. Lee Gun had taken her core before she could be handed over to the civil servants.
Aphrodite had tried to seduce Lee Gun to run away. In the process, Yooha had broken her and taken out the Divine status.
Since the Olympus gods were human now, their Divine statuses were carried around within their bodies.
The rest of the gods had frozen when they saw Yooha kill Aphrodite. They had quickly elected to go to prison so that Lee Gun couldn’t acquire their Divine status.
‘On the other hand, their bounties decreased if their Divine statuses were missing.’
One among them had tempted Lee Gun the most, but he had decided to put off taking that god’s Divine status. After all, he planned on raiding the prison later on.
Anyway, this was how he had acquired these precious Divine statuses of high-rank gods.
“Choose one that you want as a power-up. What about Aphrodite?”
“Give me something decent, alright?”
Hugo expressed his anger, but the goddesses of fate were angrier than him.
‘He might have put it in an item, but how could he use the power of a Great Spirit like that?’
They became guarded against Lee Gun since he had stuck an item imbued with the power of Zeus on Hugo. Normally, the power of a god couldn’t be used in a piecemeal like this. It was even more unlikely on a new god that smelled like a human.
‘His ranking was high enough to surprise the civil servants.’
While Lee Gun’s fate had been read, there was a limit to pinpointing his level too. However, the goddesses didn’t betray their feelings since they knew the worth of Lee Gun’s Divine status from the beginning. They had been eyeing it.
It was why they had gotten involved in the incident with Hercules. They just had to create an opening and steal the Divine statuses of the pillar gods.
‘The Divine status is as precious as it could be.’
It could be called the core of a god.
“How dare you talk about letting a mere Construct take the Divine status of a high-rank god! How insolent!”
“He already has a Divine status. Do you think it’s easy to handle two high-rank Divine statuses?”
“Divine statuses aren’t fragments of power that can be upgraded. Only the Great Spirits can handle multiple Divine statuses. There is no way Pushover is capable of doing it.”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed with coldness. “If he can’t do it, he’ll get beaten up.”
“!”
“I can do it, so why can’t he?”
The goddesses were dumbfounded. Of course, they knew what his words meant. The light in their eyes changed as they asked a question.
“Can you really use them? Can you use several Divine statuses instead of fragments?”
“That’s right. Well, it’s annoying if they get stolen, so I was thinking about making return-type equipment.”
When he said equipment, the goddesses scoffed. They thought he was taking the joke too far. However, Hugo froze for an entirely different reason.
‘Does he plan on turning all the gods within the Divine world into equipment?’
The probability of it happening wasn't zero.
‘Unless something dire happens, I doubt he’ll…’
However, the problem right now was with himself.
‘If I can’t handle the Divine status, my bones will be pulverized. I might also be used as an ingredient for making equipment.’
“It doesn’t matter in the end.”
“!”
Lee Gun arrived next to Hugo and handed over a Divine status core. Then he took the Book of Fate, which Hugo had stolen.
The goddesses of fate glared at them.
“How dare you!”
Lee Gun pulled the book as if he planned on ripping it apart. “You guys tormented the gods with this, right? From what I heard, this is the source of your power. Unless you don’t want me to destroy it, you should take out the Rule Book.”
The goddesses of fate were dismayed. The rules of the Divine world were written inside the Rule Book. This book had major and minor laws that made the foundation of the Divine world. It was a book of law with various rules.
Moreover, gods that numbered more than the stars wanted to fix the laws to their advantage. This was why the gods sucked up to the goddesses of fate.
The goddesses of fate were flabbergasted. No one had tried to threaten them in this fashion before. No god had the guts to do it.
“We thought you sent Louis-nim as a tribute because you wanted the Rule Book or you wanted to change your fate.”
“You vulgar and arrogant bastard…!”
“We should have known by your cowardly actions when you turned the gods into humans!”
However, they soon started laughing.
“That’s a Divine item. No god can harm it. Not even the attack power of a fighting-type god—”
Kwah-jeek!
“…!!”
The goddesses’ expressions changed when they heard the sound. The metal cover of the book started to break apart. The goddesses looked at Lee Gun in shock.
Lee Gun merely smirked. “While my attack abilities might not work, this is merely an item.”
“!”
Lee Gun used the Manufacturer skill “Dismantle.” His eyes flashed. It was one of the abilities that were freed after he had paid off his debt. “I don’t care how great this item is. The Dismantle skill works really well against it.”
“…!”
The goddesses of fate couldn’t believe this.
“Isn’t that the skill of a Manufacturer! That bastard is a Manufacturer-type god?”
“That’s odd. When I read his fate, he had the power of only Life, Death, and Cycle…!”
Something was off.
‘Almost everything is revealed through Fate Reading. It doesn’t matter what type of god it is.’
This included Great Spirits. It was out of the ordinary for them to be unable to see all the information at a single glance.
‘We’ll have to dig in further.’
‘Even a Manufacturer god shouldn't be able to…!’
Desperate, they looked at Hugo.
“Hey, servant!”
“!”
“If you return that Divine item, we’ll reduce your Karmic debt!”
“What? Karmic debt?”
“Yes! I can’t believe you can stay next to that snake god with that Karmic debt. It’s odd…”
Hugo scoffed. “Karmic debt? What nonsense are they talking about—”
Boom!!
“…!”
Was it because he had recovered the ability of his important part here? Hugo’s vision suddenly changed.
‘…!’
His surroundings changed. No, his surroundings were the same; he was just seeing a vision. It was similar to his foretelling ability, but a little different. This wasn’t the future. It was…
[Kyahhhk!! Run away!]
[Murderer!]
[He killed them all!]
Hugo saw countless corpses of gods in front of him. There were tens of thousands… No, more than that. It was as if he had killed them all.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!!
The sound of destruction rang out as Hugo’s vision returned to normal.
‘!’
Taken aback, Hugo looked at his hands, which had been covered with blood until a moment ago.
“Kyaahhhk!”
“That bastard!!”
The goddesses of fate raged as they looked at Lee Gun. Lee Gun had destroyed the Book of Fate, and he didn’t have a single ounce of a guilty conscience.
In fact, he looked dumbfounded. “Is this for real? What the hell is up with its durability?”
Lee Gun was able to seal one of the abilities of the goddesses of fate with this. “Ah! Whatever. If you want me to fix this, you have to take out the Rule Book. You have to fix what I want.”
The child-like Past extended her hand with bloodshot eyes.
“You’re facing the goddesses of fate. You’re acting too arrogant!”
At that moment, a saw-toothed wheel appeared as it split the sky.
Koo-goo-gooohk!
The goddesses thought about the order that came from the Great Spirits, which had come right after the destruction of Olympus. It was an order regarding Lee Gun.
- Listen to us, Goddesses. We want you to change the fate of the snake god. We want you to expel his right as a god.
- That means…
- We want you to destroy his existence itself. Let him reincarnate as a microbe.
Of course, the goddesses had ignored the order. Lee Gun was too valuable to do such a thing, but things were different right now.
Their eyes flashed. The saw-toothed wheel kept spinning endlessly as lightning shot out. Then, something surprising happened.
“Koohk!”
“Gun!”
Lee Gun’s vision shifted. When he opened his eyes again, they turned round.
‘This place is…’
He found himself on top of a bed.
‘Earth?’
However, it wasn’t the present.
‘It was when I was living with Yeonwoo and Junwoo.’
This was before he had become the thirteenth awakened being, before Yeonwoo and Junwoo had died.
At that moment, he heard a voice.
[We read your past record. You were able to revive the girl, but you were unable to find the younger brother.]
“!”
[We know you read the record within the underworld to find the soul of your sibling.]
[That was why you entered the Divine world in the first place. You came to find the soul of your sibling, right?]
“!”
It was Past’s voice. This was the ability of Past.
[Crossroads of Fate (5 star)]
- It changes the fate of the past.
[That is the time when your younger brother was still alive. What happens if he is kept alive?]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose.
[From what I’ve heard, you received the Divine status of the snake god because of the power of the two siblings. If the younger brother is kept alive, you will lose the power of the snake god, but won’t you be able to find your sibling?]
The goddess laughed.
[The existence of the hero Lee Gun would disappear, but the other heroes will take care of the world in your stead.]
Lee Gun checked the Divine power within his body. He could still use his power. It meant he could save his younger brother here. The goddess wanted him to change his fate.
‘In the end, she wants me to choose between family and being a hero.’
[You never wanted to become a hero. This is a special opportunity to save your sibling.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. Of course, he had a way to get out of this power.
‘It isn’t like the fight against Time, where we switched timelines. I just have to forward the time until the present.’
He still had the data of Time, which he had kept for emergency use.
‘Using it is a shame since the ability of Time is so useful.’
Lee Gun had killed Time using Cycle, so not even his corpse had been left behind. Only a minuscule amount of the monarch’s data was left.
Lee Gun smirked at that moment.
‘Wait a moment. This is the past. That means Time is here, right?’
Would it be possible to duplicate him?

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - That isn't it! (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 367 - That isn't it! (1)
Time was relatively young amongst the monarchs. Despite him being young, his abilities were excellent.
He could create other monarchs. Moreover, he had eliminated his parents and other monarchs. He was a nasty piece of work. Time seemed infamous in the Divine world too.
Of course, the monarchs had roamed the space and dimensions like pirates. Of all the places they could have gone, they had attacked the earth and met their demise at the hands of Lee Gun.
‘Anyway, the Great Spirits hate the monarchs.’
This was also seen in the incident when the spear made from Abyss had turned the Divine world upside down.
However, the only intact Monarch corpses that Lee Gun had recovered were that of Abundance and Abyss. Oblivion had disappeared into the fog. Negligence and Confusion had possessed human bodies, so they couldn’t be extracted as ingredients.
‘If I have the ability of Time, I can change that.’
He could have the data of Negligence and Confusion. If that wasn’t enough, he could bring back Abyss and Abundance, whom he had fully turned into ingredients.
What would happen if he rewound time using Time’s ability?
‘It will be possible to have an infinite supply of ingredients.’
This was why he had coveted the ability of Time. Unfortunately, the power of Cycle had erased Time’s existence. Therefore, Lee Gun had been unable to acquire anything related to Time, including his abilities.
The only thing he had received was the single-use A-rank abilities that he had acquired by beating up countless versions of Time.
At the time, Lee Gun had been satisfied just from being able to eliminate Time, but at the same time, getting rid of him had been a shame; he was unable to use Time as an ingredient.
However, things were different right now.
‘Time exists here. This is before he was split apart by Cycle.’
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
‘If I acquire his ability, creating the spear of Abyss wouldn’t be a problem. In fact, I can make an infinite number of them.’
This would help him since some idiots still coveted his territory and his friend.
When Lee Gun became obsessed with this thought, he dug through his memories as he picked up his folding phone.
At that moment, he called someone.
- Hello? Hyung?
Lee Gun felt a pang of nostalgia when he heard the familiar voice. He closed his eyes for a moment.
Ji Junwoo! He was Yeonwoo’s younger twin. He had sacrificed himself to save his sister and Lee Gun. That wasn’t all.
Unlike Yeonwoo, Lee Gun was unable to find Junwoo’s soul, no matter how much he looked.
Lee Gun felt the yearning for a moment, then he asked, “Where are you, Junwoo?”
- What? Me? I’m….
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he heard the location. He was sure of it now.
‘This is the day when Junwoo dies.’
To be precise, it was two months before Yeonwoo’s death, the day he had awakened as the thirteenth.
If he thought back on it, he found out that he had a question that he wanted an answer to.
‘Who revealed the location of Junwoo and Yeonwoo?’
The two of them had been Zodiacs for the previous Serpent Bearer temple, and they had successfully remained hidden for over ten years.
‘They weren’t revealed for nothing.’
Time had been obsessed with them, yet even he had been unable to find them easily.
‘So who was it?’
It didn’t matter for now. After he ended the call with Junwoo, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. Unlike before, he could immediately sense the energy of Time.
‘I found you, bastards.’
Was it because he had grown in power? Lee Gun’s radar could immediately pinpoint the evil intent and energy of the monarch.
‘They are quite close.’
It hadn’t been his intention, but his visit to the Divine world had allowed him to advance his skills and power.
Lee Gun unleashed his Divine power. The darkness became turbulent as he used Warp!
[Pond Walk (Death stage 3)]
- You can move by using darkness, evil intent, and shadow as mediums
- The range increases depending on how much Divine power is consumed.
[You have consumed 10% of your Divine power]
After being swallowed up by darkness, Lee Gun appeared in a back alley in Seoul.
His eyes flashed when the location was closer than he had expected.
‘What the hell? That bastard was already in Korea?’
At that moment, Lee Gun witnessed something unexpected.
‘That is…’
Time was conversing with his underling.
[Master, it seems Scorpio is showing interest in Hailey-nim.]
“Is that so? That’s interesting! That Creator is showing interest in that child?”
[Should we quickly search for the princess? Shall we bring her here?]
“No, let her be. I already have someone I sent as a spy— Kuhk!”
As if their conversation wasn’t even worth listening to, Lee Gun activated Death’s Instinct. Then he stabbed Time.
Since he knew how strong Time was, he had taken the limits off his power. He used Death stage 6.
When Time was stabbed, the monarch’s underling was taken aback, but it was soon ripped apart by the violent energy of Death.
[Master!]
Feeling the danger, the surprised subordinates of Time, who were nearby, started showing up.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he shredded them all to pieces.
‘I can’t change fate, so I have to be careful in copying him.’
While his hand pierced Time, he activated Life stage 3. It was the ability of Creation.
[Life Creation (3 star)]
- Divine power is consumed to create Life.
- You can create if you understand the structure. (You must possess the Data of your target.)
- You can create something that already exists.
- Depending on the target that you are trying to create, you need to pay a high price.
If Creation Workshop was a Manufacturer skill, this ability was capable of creating a variety of living substances, including wounds, malignant tumors, and clones.
Of course, it created the same thing as something that already existed. In some ways, it was close to a Life cloning ability.
After his debt had been paid off, Lee Gun had wanted to use this ability as soon as it was returned.
Of course, this move had its risks. If he killed Time, it might change the future. However, Lee Gun shrugged off that worry.
‘He can’t be killed so easily.’
He knew better than anyone how strong Time was. The power of stage 6 hadn’t worked against him, so Lee Gun had to resort to using the power of Cycle.
This meant Lee Gun didn’t have to worry too much. He didn’t have to control his power since Time would survive without any intervention! Even if he used all his power, he would barely be able to make Time half-dead.
‘That’s why I’ll beat him to an inch of his life, then take his ability.’
He just had to erase the memory using Oblivion’s data! However…
[Congratulations! You completely killed Time!]
[You acquired the power of Time.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round at the unexpected voice.
“?”
Wait a moment. What did it say? Killed? What?
“????”
Lee Gun looked back and forth between the ability he had acquired and Time’s corpse. The ability was real, and the corpse was also real…
Realizing what had happened, Lee Gun started to sweat.
‘No! What the hell! You aren’t supposed to die so easily!’
* * *
When Lee Gun disappeared, Hugo’s eyes widened in shock.
As soon as the goddess of fate used her ability, Lee Gun’s figure had blurred before he disappeared.
“I sent him down the path of the past, where he’ll be able to change the past. He won’t be able to interfere with us.”
“There is no way he doesn't choose the fate where he gets to save his younger brother.”
Hugo flinched. He immediately realized what those words meant.
‘She sent Gun to the past’
When she mentioned the younger brother, it must be Junwoo.
‘Since he gets to save his younger brother… He was sent to a time before Junwoo’s death?’
Hugo was sure of it. The goddesses of fate were trying to change the fate of the past. They planned on erasing the Snake God, who was the “Hero god.”
Lee Gun was able to awaken as the snake god through the death of Junwoo and Yeonwoo. He had inherited their powers.
As expected, the goddesses of fate laughed.
“He went to the past with his current ability. There is no way he’ll overlook his younger brother.”
“His younger brother suffered such a brutal death. There is no way he’ll let it happen again.”
Hugo’s eyes turned round. What? He was already overpowered, yet he went to the past with his ability?
Hugo’s shock lasted only a moment. Then, he snorted. It was to be expected.
‘The Monarchs and Zodiacs were all present at that time.’
What would happen if Lee Gun went back to the past with his ability intact?
‘He would be like a fox in a henhouse. There is no way he’ll let such an opportunity pass by.’
In the past, Lee Gun had been inexperienced in using his abilities. This was why even though he was able to acquire many corpses, their data had gone to waste. He had such complaints as he made his equipment.
On the other hand, Lee Gun had been unable to go to the past because he lacked the power.
Hugo’s eyes flashed as he laughed. “Idiots. Do you realize what you’ve done?”
Lee Gun wasn’t the type to cling to his past. The incident with his younger brother was unfortunate, but there was no way Lee Gun would touch the past. He wouldn’t change his fate.
‘He’ll somehow use this opportunity to extract all kinds of data.’
Lee Gun could acquire data by beating someone up.
‘Moreover, the weapons that work against the Great Spirits were made using the monarchs.’
Lee Gun knew this.
“You guys made a mistake. You sent that crazy bastard to the past.”
However, the goddesses seemed to have read Hugo’s expression. They chuckled.
“That all depends if he can return here.”
“!”
Past and Present laughed frighteningly.
“How dare that dirty and lowly bastard underestimate us!”
“We are time travelers. We are rulers of fate.”
“!”
They were different from the Time monarch, who only knew how to travel between time.
“Since he’s capable of destroying Olympus, he’s capable of changing the past. However, that’s all he can do.”
“If he can’t get back to the present, that’s all he can do.”
“…!”
The goddesses snickered.
“I am Past. Klotho can pluck the thread of fate.”
The young goddess extended her hands, and a beautiful thread appeared there. It was Lee Gun’s fate.
Present clutched it as she smirked. “I am Present. Lachesis can take the plucked thread and put it into the wheel of fate. I can spin the future.”
“Of course, the snake god’s fate will come to an end if Future cuts the thread. However, we incur too much Karmic debt if we kill a god.”
“If Present doesn’t spin the wheel, his fate won’t be connected to the future.”
Hugo froze when he saw their knowing eyes. The past, present, and future being manipulated by the goddesses of fate was a bit different from time travel.
‘They can hold the entire fate of a single being.’
In other words, his friend was trapped in the past, unable to return to the present.
Present clenched the middle portion of Lee Gun’s thread. She tangled it as she said, “It doesn’t matter if he saves his younger brother or not. He’ll keep going back to the past from this point on.”
In other words, it was an infinite loop.
“It means the snake god can do whatever he wants in the past. He cannot return to the present or the future.”
“Still, we were lenient on him. If he chooses to save his younger brother, he will be able to live happily ever after in the past.”
“Since he entered our domain, it doesn’t matter if he uses the power of Time. He’ll return to the past.”
Hugo was surprised. It seemed they had been aiming for this from the start!
On the other hand, the goddesses of fate looked at Hugo with dismay, then they laughed.
“I can’t believe this happened to you.”
“You used to think of humans as maggots, yet you became human.”
“…??”
The goddesses clicked their tongues in sympathy, but they soon spoke in acceptance.
“Karmic debt is Karmic debt.”
They had read the memories of Hugo and Lee Gun, and they looked at Hugo as if he was a rarity.
“Thanks to your Karmic debt, you stood out amongst the twelve Zodiac Saints. That’s why you became his servant.”
“While you might be the high-rank amongst them, I cannot believe you mingled with the humans. It’s hilarious that you even had children with a human.”
The goddesses soon moved on.
“We’ll stop making fun of you now.”
“The Divine world is in overload thanks to the long war it went through. If war persists, the Divine world will break apart. That is why we need high-quality land like the earth.”
“If you cooperate with us, we’ll help you shed your human shell. We’ll return to your original state.”
“We will also tell you about your Karmic debt. There is no reason for you to suffer next to the snake god.”
“Once you gain that information, you will look at the snake god and the earth in contempt.”
“What nonsense—”
Hugo was about to call it nonsense when…
“Koohk!”
He suddenly clutched his heart.
The goddesses laughed as if they had expected this.
“It seems you chose not to tell the snake god, but isn’t your body unstable?”
“!”
Instead of answering, Hugo furrowed his brows. He had become more and more certain when he had opened his eyes inside the Divine world.
‘I can feel a power that isn’t my power.’
The only thing he was certain of right now was that this power wasn’t good for him.
The goddesses laughed as if they had read his thoughts.
“It’s proof that your Karmic debt is waking up. If you don’t resist, we'll help you. You won’t last long in that state.”
“Hmmph.”
It didn’t matter what nonsense the goddesses were talking about. That wasn’t important.
‘I just have to get rid of Present, who tied that thread into a knot. It’ll allow Gun to return.’
This was Lee Gun that he was talking about. He’d probably come back from the fate of the past with all kinds of stuff.
Hugo just needed to act as support. As he thought about that, he grasped one of the Divine statuses Lee Gun had given to him, aiming to get rid of Present.
The goddesses laughed at this.
“If you’re thinking about using that Divine status, you’re better off giving up on it.”
“Your body won’t last if you use that.”
Hugo clicked his tongue as he put away the Divine status into his pocket. He knew that already.
That asshole should have handed over something of moderate power. Why the hell did Lee Gun give him something that he couldn’t use?
In the end, Hugo took up the bow instead of the Divine status. But he started to sweat.
‘I see zero openings. What should I do?’
Sagittarius was of no help either. Hugo was thinking about abandoning Sagittarius to team up with Virgo when…
‘…???’
Hugo’s eyes turned round when he saw Lime stealthily move behind the goddesses of fate. His reaction was understandable.
‘Where the hell are you going, Lime? You shouldn’t go in there!’
His shock at the direction in which slime was moving lasted only a moment.
Hugo almost scrambled. Lime seemed to have split itself. It appeared from Hugo’s pocket and shoved something into Hugo’s mouth.
“Kuh-huhk— Oohp!!”
It was the Divine status Lee Gun had given to him.
Thanks to the slime, Hugo instantly absorbed the Divine status.
Hugo and the goddesses screamed when they saw the light that exploded forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - That isn't it! (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 368 - That isn't it! (2)
Light exploded forth from Hugo’s body. Everyone was surprised when the Divine status was absorbed into Hugo’s body. The one shocked the most was the one who had eaten the Divine status.
“Kuhk-oohp—! No!!”
Realizing what he had eaten, Hugo tried to spit it back out. However, Lime jumped above his head and slammed itself down toward Hugo’s head.
Bbah-gahk!
The impact caused the Divine status core in Hugo’s mouth to pass through his throat.
“Kuhk! Oohp!”
A Divine status could be used in two ways.
The first one was just using the Divine status by possessing the core. Of course, this allowed one to temporarily use the Divine status.
However, there was a limit to how much of the Divine status’s power one could use. Moreover, one could not inherit the god’s Constructs. Then there was the danger of having the Divine status stolen.
The second method was to eat the Divine status. It was to take possession of the Divine status as your own. This basically meant that when Hugo ate the core, he had inherited the Divine status.
“Why? Of all the ones it chose to feed me…!!”
Lee Gun had given Hugo three Divine statuses.
[One that incites riots and fighting: God of War Ares.]
[All locations exist under his feet: Messenger god Hermes.]
[One in charge of beauty: Goddess of beauty Aphrodite.]
What Lime had shoved into Hugo’s mouth was the core belonging to the master of beauty!
This was the reason for Hugo’s surprise. Lime usually did a lot of strange things, but it never did things that would cause harm to Lee Gun. If one dug into it, Lime always worked toward helping Lee Gun.
Still, that bastard…!
“How can you feed me Aphrodite— Kuhk!”
Hugo felt pain as the Divine status started to spread throughout his body. As the Divine status was transferred, Hugo was connected to the power and Constructs.
[Divine Status: Aphrodite (Master of Beauty)]
[Divine Name: Praise the Absolute Beauty]
[The power is being transferred.]
[Vision of Beauty(5 star) and 6 others]
The goddesses of fate laughed as they clutched their stomachs. They had read Hugo’s Karmic debt, so they knew very well what he was like in the past. Right now, his past was locked, so they couldn’t view all of his past. However, Hugo had been a Construct who had killed gods like bugs, including the snake god.
Aside from the master he had served, he didn’t care if it was a human or a god. He treated everyone like insects. His power was elite, and it allowed him to act that way.
An incompatible Divine status could naturally be extracted after killing the god possessing it. However, the Master of Beauty was a precious Divine status. Discarding it would be a shame.
“My god! I’ve never seen a male god take possession of that Divine status!”
“What kind of mutant will this produce?”
“He’s not a mutant. Anyway, it’s a powerful Divine status of a pillar god. He probably can’t use that power…”
“In the first place, how is a human withstanding the Divine status of a pillar god? His body should have exploded—”
Pahng!!
“!”
The eyes of the goddesses of fate turned round when a ferocious arrow flew toward them. The power of a pillar god, which they assumed Hugo would be unable to use, flew toward them.
“That bastard…!”
“Shit! Block it!”
The goddesses raised their guards when the arrow of Absolute Accuracy flew toward them.
Puhng!
“…!!”
The arrow violently flew through the air and struck the head of one of the goddesses, then the arrow changed into light, which was shaped like a heart.
Puhng puhng puhng!
Hugo’s eyes turned round when his arrow lost power.
The goddesses laughed when they saw a trick usually performed at parties.
“Shit! You surprised me for nothing!”
“Woo! Shoot one more at us!”
“Hmmph! It doesn’t matter how many you shoot. It is useless—”
The goddesses were about to mess with Hugo’s fate when…
Boom!
They felt chills run up their spines as they felt a terrifying wave of energy.
‘What is this feeling?’
It was a murderous intent strong enough to pressure them.
They flinched as they looked at Hugo.
‘Is it him?’
The flustered goddesses were about to get rid of Hugo when they became surprised for an entirely different reason.
“W-Wait a moment! That’s…!”
The reason was the slime, which was on top of Hugo’s head.
Lime held an enormous substance made out of light. It was the Creator’s large and girthy object, which Lee Gun had brought out earlier.
To revive the Creators, the goddesses of fate had kept this item inside their research lab. It was the power of a Creator.
When Lime tried to give it to Hugo, the goddesses reacted in fright.
“No! Do you realize what we went through to take it from Ennead?”
“Capture it! It doesn’t matter if you kill him!”
The goddesses tried to take down Hugo.
Koohng!
However, they froze when they felt the power leaking out of Hugo’s body. When they saw his face, the goddesses were surprised.
Hugo’s pupils had changed. Now, they were like the pupils of a beast that ate gods.
‘…!’
That wasn’t all.
Kwahng!
When the latent brutal energy surged forward, the goddesses of fate forgot to breathe for a moment.
‘That’s the energy of a predator!’
‘How….’
Lime didn’t care about their reactions. It pushed the Creator’s long and girthy object into Hugo’s head.
This made Hugo scream, but he soon heard an odd auditory hallucination.
[Put down your instinct to kill!]
It was the voice of a master reigning in his underling. At that moment, Hugo’s transformed energy and pupils returned to normal. Then something surprising happened.
[Beauty has undergone taxidermy.]
A very strong power surged forth.
[Your Divine status has leveled up.]
[The Serpent Bearer temple has leveled up.]
The strong power Hugo emitted struck the goddesses.
The powerful light made Lachesis (Present) flinch, but she laughed when she realized nothing had happened to her. “Hmmph! It doesn’t matter what your past life was. You are a mere human now—”
However, she froze when she turned her head. Klotho (Past), who had trapped Lee Gun in the past, had become frozen like a doll.
“Unni!”
Lachesis suddenly had an understanding.
‘That bastard…!’
Master of Beauty could perform taxidermy on whatever they considered beautiful and cool. If the Master of Beauty thought someone bleeding looked beautiful, it could cause one’s opponent to get hurt.
“…!”
The fallen Klotho’s (Past) appearance changed into the appearance of Lee Gun! It was the version of Lee Gun when he had wild long hair!
Hugo became angry when he saw this. Virgo seemed surprised, but Sagittarius had an understanding expression on his face.
“Ah! That’s how Lee Gun looked when he met Hugo for the first time.”
“What?!”
It was what Lee Gun had looked like when he had saved Hugo from being torn and eaten by a monster.
From Hugo’s point of view, Lee Gun had looked the coolest when he had ripped apart the monster. Hugo had been so impressed with that, that he had asked Lee Gun to become his teacher.
“But why does he look like a woman with long hair?”
“Ah! Hugo met Lee Gun for the first time when he was dying. So he mistook Lee Gun for a woman because Lee Gun was wearing a monster’s fur on his head.”
“Ah!”
That wasn’t all.
[Pushover has advanced to become a new high-rank Construct.]
[You have received a new attribute.]
[Every disciple of the Serpent Bearer temple is influenced by this.]
[Faith (Love, fanaticism) has increased.]
[A new affiliate Construct has been formed. As the construct grows, the rank of the Serpent Bearer increases.]
Klotho (Past) changed into Lee Gun when the latter was in his prime. She immediately attacked Lachesis (Present).
Kwah-jeek!!
“U-Unni!!”
“Die!!”
“?!”
Klotho (Past) embodied Hugo’s abstract form of Lee Gun. She registered Lachesis as an enemy and attacked her. Moreover, she was as strong as Lee Gun!
Lachesis ground her teeth.
‘If I attack her, she’ll die.’
The power of the Master of Beauty allowed one to change the form of the enemy into what one considered the most ideal form.
The previous Master of Beauty loved to see her enemies in a bloodied state. In the case of Hugo, his enemy took on the form of the Strongest Ally Doll. That was how his ability manifested.
When Virgo saw this, she had a thought.
‘We really might be able to take the Rule Book.’
Virgo was the one who had told them about the existence of the Rule Book.
Zodiacs tried to flatter the Great Spirits for a reason. There was a reason why they gave their treasures and earned profits to the Great Spirits.
[The Great Spirits have worked on the laws.]
[The goddesses of fate have added the laws to the Rule Book.]
The Zodiacs were afraid of the cozy relationship between the Great Spirits and the goddesses of fate. Therefore, they could do nothing against the two groups.
That was why Virgo thought the only one who could steal the Rule Book was Lee Gun, since the Serpent Bearer didn’t care what others thought.
Virgo furrowed her brows as she looked at Hugo. “Did you know about his past life before picking him, Louis?”
“What’s it to you?”
“!”
Reincarnation of life was under the domain of the Divine world.
“I knew he had some Karmic debt, but the only ones capable of knowing his past are Mahabharata, who run the Reincarnation Hell, and the goddesses of fate.”
“!”
The gods who incurred Karmic debt were sent to the Reincarnation Hell, and they were reborn as different creatures. It allowed them to get rid of the Karmic debt, and they would be reborn as a god again.
“If it’s a human, it’s the lowest rank of the Divine world’s wheel of rebirths. They are the ones that have no hope of becoming gods again.”
While one lived as a beast, one didn’t incur any Karmic debt. This wasn’t true of humans.
Humans were creatures of greed, so they continued to incur Karmic debt throughout their lifetime.
This was why humans returned to being dirt after their deaths. They were the lowest-rank beings who could merely become the structural ingredients of the Divine world.
Therefore, the gods avoided reincarnating as that rank. It was why Sagittarius wasn’t interested in Hugo’s Karmic debt. He picked Hugo as his Zodiac Saint. A god could use and throw away a human without suffering any consequences.
“The power from earlier…” Virgo furrowed her brows as if she had a thought, but it was a passing thought. “That isn’t important right now.”
“What?”
Virgo immediately flicked her finger. “Family Shield (Serpent Bearer Rental Skill)!”
Lifted into the air, Sagittarius became Virgo’s shield.
Louis was struck by the lightning sent forth by Lachesis. He fainted as he foamed at the mouth. “Die!”
Hugo and Virgo rushed forward to get rid of Lachesis (Present), who was the last one left.
* * *
Lee Gun looked at the slumped form of Time in dismay.
‘He died.’
It was rare for Lee Gun to be this flustered. He started slapping Time’s cheek. “Hey, you aren’t supposed to die so easily. Stop pretending to be dead. Hurry up and get up!”
If Time died here, his future would change. In other words, Lee Gun as the thirteenth hero would disappear. Any relationship with that as the basis would change.
Moreover, Time was the leader of the monarchs that came here. There was a chance that without him, the monarchs would all disappear from the earth, but…
‘There is no way the other monarchs would leave the earth because Time is gone.’
In fact, a new monarch might try to invade the earth instead. It meant Lee Gun’s future as the thirteenth hero might still exist.
It had to exist if he wanted to kill Red Eye. He had to kill the monarchs twenty years later and save humanity.
This was why Lee Gun was shocked.
‘Why the hell is he so weak?’
Of course, Time hadn’t become weaker. Lee Gun had become stronger.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘Is it related to the fact that I killed 18,732 versions of Time in all the other dimensions?’
That wasn’t important right now.
“Clone! Clone!”
Since he had taken Time’s ability, the future might have changed. This was why Lee Gun used the Divine status of Life stage 3. He used Creation to replicate Time. It was a complete copy, so his abilities and memories would remain.
“You are—”
Bbah-gahk!!
Lee Gun rendered the clone unconscious and swapped out the dead Time with the clone. He had put in a substitute and erased the clone’s memories using the data of Oblivion.
As if he wasn’t satisfied with this, Lee Gun put the original Time over his shoulder. It was the Time whose face Lee Gun had kicked in.
Since he had acquired Time’s ability, Lee Gun quickly got out of there before the clone could wake up.
‘I can just use the ability of Time to go back to my original time, but…’
Lee Gun suddenly became worried about his family. Today was the day when Junwoo had died for him and Yeonwoo. This was why he headed toward the location where Junwoo would die.
‘Junwoo died in an alley in the opposite direction of the house.’
Lee Gun was lightly jumping across the top of the buildings when his eyes turned round.
‘I found them.’
He lightly landed on top of a telephone pole and discovered Junwoo, who was being chased by the Constructs of the magic-type temple.
It seemed Junwoo was purposefully leading them away so that the existence of Yeonwoo and Lee Gun wouldn’t be revealed.
Lee Gun’s heart felt a pang when he saw this. If he had his way, he would kill all the Constructs. He wanted to save Junwoo, but he had to hold himself back.
‘I’ll find you again. Soon.’
It would be like how he had found Yeonwoo. He’d revive Junwoo, who was the other snake. It was also the reason he was here. He wanted to see where Junwoo’s soul went after he died. He’d be able to find that information now.
“What the hell? You’re a god I’ve never seen before. Which faction do you belong to?”
“…!”
Suddenly, Lee Gun heard a familiar voice as a strange group appeared behind him. When he saw them, his eyes turned round.
They were neither the twelve Zodiacs nor the forces of the unknown civilization.
‘Hermes!’
He saw the gods of the Divine world and recognized a familiar face in Hermes. Then there was…
[Divine status: Valkyrie (Valhalla/Construct)]
[Divine status: Thoth (Ennead/Zodiac)]
[Divine status: Anubis (Ennead/Zodiac)]
Aside from Valkyrie, they all looked like young boys. Clearly, they were using incarnate bodies.
‘They are the Zodiacs of the Divine world.’
Lee Gun’s eyes turned into the menacing eyes of a snake.
‘The ones to leak the location of Junwoo and Yeonwoo were…’
It made sense.
The ones to find and kill Junwoo and Yeonwoo were the Zodiacs of the Gemini and Pisces temples. The magic-type Zodiacs had been affiliated with Valhalla and Ennead. Moreover, why would Zodiacs be here instead of Constructs?
‘The other members of the twelve Zodiacs would have gone crazy if they knew these Zodiacs were here. They would have chased the other gods out.’
It meant Pisces and Gemini had turned a blind eye to these Zodiacs. Furthermore, these gods had gotten involved with what had happened here.
At that moment, Valkyrie asked, “What is your affiliation? Since you smell like a human, you must be a low-rank Construct, who was just passing by.”
“What’s that across your shoulder?”
Lee Gun glared at them when he heard Anubis’s question.
‘Anubis is an underworld god, who guides souls to the underworld.’
Despite him trying to summon Junwoo, the reason why he was unable to find Junwoo’s soul was…
Lee Gun was about to go crazy at the thought when they harshly asked him the questions.
“Oh, low-rank Construct, we asked you, where are you from?”
“How dare you not answer the questions from Zodiacs?”
Lee Gun laughed at those words.
“What?”
“!”
“Are you curious?”
Lee Gun smirked.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - I will find you
chapters.content:
Chapter 369 - I will find you
Lee Gun smirked in a frightening manner. He had always thought something was off.
Yeonwoo and Junwoo were the previous Zodiacs of the Serpent Bearer temple, and they had been raised by the thirteenth original owner. The Serpent Bearer temple used to be considered the leading temple among the twelve Zodiac temples.
The siblings weren’t easy marks who could be discovered by the other twelve Zodiacs. However, it would be an entirely different story if the Divine world conspired against them.
Thoth was the god of knowledge, Hermes possessed absolute tracking, Valkyrie could discern souls, and Anubis was an underworld god who could retrieve the soul.
Divine statuses of such caliber had gathered in one place. Of course, they could find what they wanted.
‘It seems they helped the magic-type temples since they are allied forces.’
Odd expressions appeared on the gods’ faces when they saw murderous intent take over Lee Gun’s face. It was beyond having an odd expression; they felt offended.
“What kind of god are you?”
“Why is a low-rank god showing such hostility toward us?”
This was twenty-five years ago. Naturally, none of the gods recognized Lee Gun.
Moreover, Lee Gun smelled very much like a human. If he didn’t reveal his Divine status, they were bound to mistake him for a human. However, they did sense something was off. They looked toward Thoth and Valkyrie.
“Oh, the differentiator of souls.”
Valkyrie immediately furrowed her brows when she inspected Lee Gun. “You’re a god with three Divine statuses.”
The gods flinched.
Three? Normal gods would have no more than one Divine status. The more outstanding gods had two at most. Three was almost unprecedented.
“It might be possible if he’s a low-rank god with low quality—”
“No. He’s a high-rank god.”
“!”
When Valkyrie gave the short answer, the gods became guarded. A high-rank god possessed three Divine statuses. There could be only one reason for this.
“Is he a ne’er-do-well who goes around hunting for Divine Statuses?”
“No. There is a possibility that he’s an incubator god who grows Divine statuses. It could cause a war between factions if…”
However, the young male god named Thoth laughed at Hermes’s words. “He’s a snake god that only knows how to eat. There is no way he’s an incubator god.”
“!’
Anubis’s eyes flashed. The snake god was the natural enemy of Ennead.
Thoth smirked. “He’s not the snake who wants to overtake our master. However, something is off.”
“What is it?”
Thoth was like Mimir. He was a god of knowledge and possessed the ability to see through the wisdom of all creation.
An odd look appeared in his eyes as if he were breaking Lee Gun down with his eyes. He looked between Lee Gun and Junwoo.
“Why is Ouroboros, which should be over there, with you?”
“…!”
Thoth had a meaningful smile on his lips as if he had figured out Lee Gun’s identity. The gods were surprised by the unexpected information.
“Ouroboros…”
As a Primordial being, Ouroboros had ceased to exist in the past. However, the notorious genius magician Aslan had revived the god.
“He’s the god who accompanies Life and Death.”
“What? Do you mean the Cycle?”
They looked at Lee Gun as if he was an oddity.
“Didn’t Aslan give that power to the twin snakes?”
“We found and tracked down that power right now. Did we find the wrong person?”
“Should I check once again?”
At that moment…
“There is no need for you to check.”
In the blink of an eye, Lee Gun appeared before them. Moreover, he emanated the light of a fighting-type god!
[Death Instinct]
The gods were shocked by the light, but Lee Gun didn’t even give them time to process the information.
“!!”
Infused with Divine power, his fist flew toward the gods.
Kwahng!!!
The gods were surprised by the sudden attack. They scattered.
“Fighting-type god?”
“If he’s a fighting-type god, that’s all the more reason we should know who he is!”
However, they could no longer speak. It was because Lee Gun had released Death stage 4.
The gods tried to use their powers. However, Lee Gun kicked them out of the air, and they slammed into the ground.
Kwahng!!!
The one to crash into the ground first was Anubis. The other three followed him soon.
Kwahng!!!
The gods, who looked like young children, groaned.
“Damn it! We are in our incarnate form, so our power is…!”
“We cannot use all of our power!”
Zodiacs had their power restricted to one-tenths if they were in any location other than the Divine world. This was why they eventually looked at Valkyrie.
While they were restricted, it was a different story for Valkyrie. She was the Construct of the Valhalla Construct. She was one of the goddesses who had trained the Great Spirit’s army.
Unlike them, Valkyrie could and had come here in her true form.
“Get him!”
“You can use all of your power!”
Valkyrie looked dissatisfied as she gazed at the Zodiacs. She didn’t want to do anything outside her mission. In the end, however, she summoned her weapon as if she had no choice.
[Master! You can’t let that weapon touch you!]
“!”
Lee Gun’s loyal Construct appeared from his shadow. Miny (Berserk) violently deflected the spear brought down by Valkyrie.
Kwahng!!!
This made Valkyrie furious.
“You belong to our master’s army, yet you dare follow a different god?!”
Valkyrie summoned the Great Spirit’s weapon. A sharp spear was summoned into the sky.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
[Death stage 5]
Koo-goo-goohng!
Death stage 5 instantly ripped apart Valkyrie’s wings.
The summon was canceled, and the violent maelstrom of Death even swallowed up the nearby incarnates.
“Koo-oohk!”
“We can’t withstand this any longer!”
“Let’s sever the connection for now.”
“You want to sever it?”
Thoth let out a wicked laugh. “We know our opponent’s Divine status. Since we know our opponent is a god, capturing him by changing the rules won’t be hard.”
Thoth spoke like an old fox, and they tried to sever the connection to their incarnate forms. They were about to carry out the severing when…
Flash!
“!!”
Lee Gun used his ability.
[Physical Time Pause]
It was one of Time’s abilities!
While their mental status remained normal, the gods’ bodies came to a stop. It surprised them.
Lee Gun ignored their reactions as his red eyes flashed. “Where do you think you guys are going? I have a lot of questions I want to ask.”
Lee Gun’s eyes were more wicked than that of the god of hell. He grabbed Valkyrie by the neck.
“Kuh-huhk…!”
“You guys are tracking down the Zodiacs of the Serpent Bearer temple. Who ordered it?”
Valkyrie grinned as she used her skill.
[Suicide (Great Death)]
This skill allowed the War gods of Valhalla to end their own lives. At the same time, the gods would return to the palace of the Great Spirit.
Valkyrie laughed as if to say that there was no way she would impart any knowledge to Lee Gun, then her body slumped.
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed at the act.
[All Creation Revival (Life Stage 5)]
Kwah-jeek!!
Accompanying the green light, Valkyrie gasped in pain.
“Huh-uh-uhk!”
When she regained consciousness, she shook in fear.
Lee Gun had a menacing expression on his face. He clutched her neck as if he wanted to wring it. “You dare die without my permission? You can’t die freely in front of me. I’ll revive you again and again.”
Overtaken by fear, Valkyrie froze.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he interrogated her. “If your master ordered it, just say it. Is it ok for me to assume that the Great Spirit of Valhalla ordered it?”
“That is…!”
Thoth had been frozen up to this point, but his eyes turned round when he had a realization.
“Could it be?”
Kwang!!!
Accompanying an explosion, a young man was sent flying toward Lee Gun’s back.
Koohng!
“!”
It was none other than Junwoo. Lee Gun looked at him in surprise. The young man was bloodied and dying. His head had been cracked open, and one of his arms was cut off. It was a miracle that he was still alive.
At the same time, Lee Gun heard the voice of a Construct who had chased down Junwoo.
[I will ask again. Where is the other Serpent Bearer?]
Junwoo said as his voice faded away. “…I told you. There is only one.”
[Nonsense!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed with murderous intent. Then, a black shadow surged up from his feet.
[Pond (Death stage 3)]
- Capture a wide area.
- Those with evil intent will be trapped within the deep pit of the snake.
Lee Gun tossed Valkyrie into the pond, then headed toward Junwoo.
Thoth had realized something, so a conspicuous light flashed in his eyes. He stopped Lee Gun. “You’re the new Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple. If you mess with him, your immediate future will be changed, right?”
Lee Gun didn’t care as he blasted the Construct of the Pisces, who had been tormenting Junwoo. He used Death.
[Soul Dismantle (Death stage 4)]
Kwahng!!!
In a flash, the Construct was ripped apart.
Thoth sympathetically clicked his tongue. “Ah! I warned you! You can no longer rewind your fate— Kuhk!”
Lee Gun grabbed the head of Thoth, who was unable to run away. “Wait a moment, Serpent B—”
Pah-gahk!!!
He ruthlessly ground down Thoth, Anubis, and Hermes using the Divine status of Death, then brushed off his hands.
[You have acquired the data of the gods.]
[Thoth’s Data]
[Valhalla’s Great Spirit’s Data]
[Death has gained EXP.]
[Your Death EXP is full (100%).]
[You need 50% more Life EXP to use Cycle (stage 6).]
[Life (50%) / Death (100%)]
[When both Divine statuses EXP reaches 100%, Cycle may be changed. It will be able to grow.]
In the end, no god remained around him. The only ones left in the alley were Lee Gun and Junwoo, who looked to be around the age of Sungjae.
Junwoo had one of his eyes gouged out, and his vision was damaged. He asked, “Who are you?”
He was asking Lee Gun what kind of god he was.
Despite his younger brother calling out to him, Lee Gun didn’t approach him. He just extended his hand.
[Eliminate (Death stage 1)]
He couldn’t save Junwoo right now. If he did that, something irrevocable would happen. He had to return Junwoo to the state that he remembered.
Therefore, Lee Gun planned on ending Junwoo’s life in the most painless way possible. If he used Eliminate well, he could create a powerful anesthetic effect.
In fact, it seemed Death was taking effect as the pain disappeared from Junwoo’s body.
After confirming this, Lee Gun immediately turned around.
‘If my guess is correct, someone from the Divine world will come to retrieve Junwoo’s soul.’
He had no choice but to confirm this.
At that moment…
“Hyung.”
“!”
When Junwoo called out to him, Lee Gun flinched and came to a stop.
Junwoo wasn’t in a state where he could discern who the man before him was. He could just tell if someone was male or female or human or not through the silhouette. That was all he could discern.
Moreover, there was no way Junwoo would be able to recognize this Lee Gun in the first place. Lee Gun’s height and body size differed from what they had been at this moment in time.
Therefore, Lee Gun surmised that Junwoo was using the general term of hyung to call out to a nameless stranger. Changing his voice, Lee Gun responded, “It’s fine. You'll be able to live. I called for the ambulance. It’ll be here soon—”
“Gun hyung.”
Lee Gun flinched.
Junwoo let out a faint laugh. “…Gun Hyung. I’m glad you’re alive, and you became an amazing Zodiac.”
Miny (Berserk) read Lee Gun’s emotions and glanced at Lee Gun.
[You can’t, Master.]
Lee Gun couldn’t help himself. He approached Junwoo, calling forth the power of Life, which would be able to save Junwoo.
‘!’
However, Junwoo stopped Lee Gun’s hand. Then he said something unexpected, “You don't need to do that. If Hyung became a Zodiac, it means I am alive.”
“…!”
“Of course, Hyung might not recognize me—”
Lee Gun was about to say something when…
Koo-goo-goon!!
“!”
His surroundings started to shake, and his environment started to shift.
Having caught wind of something, Miny (Berserk) quickly yelled,
[Master! Hurry up and use the ability of Time! Looks like the goddesses used the Loop ability!]
It seemed the meeting with Junwoo was a trigger. The goddesses of fate had planned on sending Lee Gun repeatedly to the past.
Lee Gun grabbed Junwoo as he used the ability of Time.
[The ability of Time has failed to activate.]
[This is a fixed past where you cannot move along the timeline.]
The Constructs became flustered.
[Master!]
Finally, Lee Gun was about to get swept up into the Past loop.
[Gun!]
Accompanying a familiar voice, the loop stopped, and a golden rope fell from the sky. Then, Lee Gun saw it.
In the distance, there his past self was, desperately looking for Junwoo. Unlike his present self, that Lee Gun looked mild-mannered and kind. His body was small and skinny.
Lee Gun laughed as he looked at his past self. Then, he grabbed the golden rope.
“I’ll find you soon.” He disappeared as he stroked Junwoo’s head.
* * *
Around that time…
“Gun!!!”
After making the ideal(?) Lee Gun, Hugo shouted toward a book.
Sagittarius grunted as he glanced at Hugo. “How long do I have to do this? My arms are about to fall off!!”
“Stay like that until Gun climbs up, bastard!”
“Damn it!” Sagittarius had put his hands through the book.
This book was none other than the ability of the goddesses of fate. It was the Akashic Records.
[Already recorded Akashic Records (5 star)]
- The fate and past of each god are written in the book of fate.
It seemed Lee Gun had entered the book. Basically, the goddesses of fate hadn’t really sent him to the past. They had just tossed him into a fate recorded in the book.
It was similar to time travel, but different. The difference was that where Lee Gun had gone was an isolated space that couldn’t be influenced by outside forces.
It meant Lee Gun couldn’t return unless he was taken out of the book.
Lee Gun using the ability of Time inside the book was a trap that the goddesses had set for him.
‘It doesn’t matter if he saves Junwoo or kills Time to return to the present. It’s a trap that leads all paths down a loop.’
So, using Time’s power was useless.
Hugo had felt something was off when the goddess had mentioned the loop. That was why he had found out the truth after defeating the remaining goddesses.
‘Gun wasn’t sent to the past. He was sent into the book.’
The book held the record of the past and a connection to it. However, this record of time was preserved for research purposes.
While one could change the past here, this change altered only the memories of the ones that came into contact with the interaction. However, the future didn’t change. The people involved in the change only felt a sense of déjà vu.
Therefore, Hugo had ordered the two goddesses to take out Lee Gun from the book. However, the only one who could take Lee Gun out was Future, who had keeled over from a heart attack.
This left Hugo with no choice but to order Sagittarius to take out Lee Gun. There was only one reason why he did that.
[Lid for the Bald (SS) is heading toward its parent.]
[Lid for the Bald (SS) is happy since it has located its parent.]
Lee Gun had made Sagittarius’s wig, and the wig could freely increase and decrease its length. It was a special item. Moreover, one of Lee Gun’s babies would be able to find Lee Gun no matter where he was.
This was why Sagittarius’s wig had suddenly come off. The god of the sun had to hide his baldness with his clothes as he put his hands into the book.
As if the book was connected to a different world, his hands went through it easily.
This was when Future regained consciousness from her heart attack. When she caught sight of Hugo and Sagittarius, she yelled in shock, “No! If you extract him like that, the fate of the other gods will be affected—!”
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhk!”
Finally, Sagittarius fell backward as Lee Gun exited the book.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief. “Gun!”
Lee Gun had returned to the present. However, the atmosphere around Lee Gun felt different from normal.
“Gun?”
However, this person had to be Lee Gun since he was holding the golden rope. To be precise, he was holding onto the wig as he dusted himself off.
Future flinched at this sight.
As for the man in question, Lee Gun laughed and looked at her with cold eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - Fate that is starting to change (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 370 - Fate that is starting to change (1)
When Atropos (Future) met Lee Gun’s eyes, she shook from fear.
‘That god…’
The process wasn’t instantaneous, but the goddesses of fate could read the information of their opponents. They could do so by looking into the eyes of their opponents.
Klotho (Past) could read the Karmic debt and the road taken by the opponent. Lachesis (Present) could see the fork in the road and the choices that the opponent faced. Atropos (Future) was able to meet the opponent at the end of the road, the final destination.
However, when Atropos met eyes with Lee Gun, she froze.
‘Monster.’
A fear that she had never felt before gripped her.
‘He was said to be a fledgling god with no past life.’
If fledgling gods were described through the language of the gods, it would be expressed like this.
While fledgling gods were a blessing, they were also troublesome foes to deal with.
However, Atropos had seen the end of Lee Gun’s fate and learned something more important than anything she had learned so far. “You are a Creator!”
“!”
Although Lee Gun didn’t have any data about his previous life, Atropos had seen a familiar piece of data at the end of Lee Gun’s fate. It was the data of a Creator!
‘The human smell was so thick that we didn’t notice it.’
It was unclear why a god smelled so much like a human, but that wasn’t important.
“You have yet to awaken, so I didn’t notice it. However, a living Creator changes the story.”
The goddesses of fate coveted Sagittarius because they wanted to revive a Creator. Unfortunately, Sagittarius had his soul mixed up with his Construct. He had been an impure vessel.
But Lee Gun was a pure vessel. Moreover, he couldn’t be compared to Louis in terms of age. Lee Gun was a green and young god!
This thought drove the old woman crazy as her eyes flashed.
‘I have to cut away and take his thing!’
That way, the dream of reviving the Creators wouldn’t be a dream.
The old woman discreetly got up. She let out an elegant smile as if she had caused Lee Gun an inconvenience. Then she lowered her head. “Oh, snake god. You’re the god of blessing who is treasured by even the Divine world. We apologize for any transgression—”
Bbah-gahk!!
“Kuh-huhk—”
Lee Gun had no plan of hearing her out. He kicked Atropos in the face, sending her flying.
When Atropos came to her senses, Lee Gun was stepping on her with a smirk on his lips. “Stop with the nonsense. Hand over the Rule Book.”
Atropos looked dismayed, and she tried to say something. However, Virgo and Hugo pointed their weapons at her.
“…!”
At this point, Atropos yelled in desperation, “We don’t have the Rule Book!”
“Oh. Is that so? That’s the plan you are going with?”
“This isn’t a plan. I’m telling the truth!” Atropos looked aggrieved as she shouted, “The Rule Book is with Norn’s goddess of fate!”
“!”
The eyes of Virgo and Sagittarius turned round at the unexpected name. Only two groups in the Divine world were called the goddesses of fate. The first group was Moirai, which they controlled. The other group was the Norns.
Both groups had goddesses of fate working directly under the Divine world. However, the Norns were originally under Valhalla.
“I see. I was wondering why you guys didn’t use the full power of fate. Did you make a bet with the Norns?” Virgo sounded amused.
This made Hugo furrow his brows.
‘The ones to show up inside Hades’s palace were them?’
He was wondering why they had felt different from the goddesses of Moirai. Giselle wasn’t with these goddesses of Fate. She was probably with the Norns.
Atropos spoke knowingly, “Anyway, we lost a bet with them around a hundred years ago. They took the Rule Book— Ahhk!”
Lee Gun, who had knocked Future to the ground, held up something as he grinned. “Then what is this?”
“!”
The goddess was flabbergasted when she saw the item. It was none other than a notebook. The goddess wondered why Lee Gun had it. Hugo sighed as he looked at someone, and the goddess soon had her answer.
‘That piece of clay…!’
While she had been unconscious, Lee Gun’s slime had entered her clothes and stolen the Divine item.
Lime had handed over the Rule Book as soon as Lee Gun had come out. It danced in joy.
[Clump of Creation Clay says the rules can be edited with this.]
[Clump of Creation Clay laughs, saying there is no way she can dodge its detection.]
The goddess immediately said to Lee Gun, “That isn’t the official Rule Book.”
“Official Rule Book?”
“You want to exit the Divine world, right? If you want to fix that, you need the official Rule Book. We possess the unofficial one! The unofficial Rule Book can fix only the small rules.”
“This is what you are referring to?”
“Yes…!”
“Hmmph. It’s an unofficial one.”
This meant he couldn’t fix the rules as he wanted.
“What is the limit to fixing the rules with this?”
“That is… You will be able to stay attached to the earth.”
Lee Gun immediately had an understanding.
‘While it can’t completely change the rules, it is still quite effective.’
That wasn’t all.
‘That isn’t the only rule I want to change.’
When Lee Gun smirked, Atropos picked up on what he was thinking. She grabbed him. “S-Snake god. You cannot use the Rule Book without us.”
“!”
Atropos looked worried as she gazed into Lee Gun’s future. “As you probably know, there are those gunning for the Creators.”
She was referring to the ones who Aslan had been worried about. They had revealed the location of Lee Gun’s mother to the gods and gotten her killed. Their actions had driven the angered Aslan into madness.
‘They used the ingenious move of bringing Aslan’s older brother to their side and precipitated the downfall of the Creators.’
As for why they did it, the answer was simple. They wanted to collect the Creators. However, they were wicked beings who refused to dirty their own hands.
“Who was it?”
“There are two.”
“Two?”
“One is an evil god. The other one is the Norn’s goddess of fate.”
The evil gods were understandable, but the other group was Valhalla. Valkyrie, whom Lee Gun had met earlier, had belonged to them.
While Olympus’s goddesses of fate also wanted the Creators, their reasoning was different from that of Valhalla.
Atropos’s eyes twinkled. This might be a great opportunity to hit them. “As you stand now, you cannot handle the Great Spirits.”
These goddesses of fate had a deep relationship with the Great Spirits, where they scratched each other’s backs.
Atropos politely lowered her head as she said to Lee Gun, “However, I am the goddess of the future. I might be impertinent in saying this, but I got a small glimpse of your future.”
“You saw Gun’s future?” Was Gun able to marry? Did he have any kids? With those questions in mind, Hugo looked at her.
However, Atropos said something unexpected, “Unfortunately, your thread of fate is very short. Moreover, there is no inheritance, transfer, or rebirth in your future.”
Virgo and Sagittarius flinched. Of course, they realized what those words meant.
‘This is simply the problem of him dying or not.’
Gods rarely died. Even if they did, their powers were inherited or transferred.
‘It is something that happens if one’s existence itself disappears.’
However, Hugo clicked his tongue.
“I wouldn’t bank on that. Any prophecy involving Gun never came true…”
A serious expression appeared on Sagittarius’s face when he felt Hugo’s gaze.
He also possessed prophetic powers, but the goddess was talking about something completely different. She had seen the end of Lee Gun’s fate.
Sagittarius possessed prophetic abilities similar to Lachesis (Present). He could see the crossroads, so the future differed depending on the choices one made. It was completely different from Future, who saw the end.
‘What she said is pretty much a death sentence.’
He also had no idea why such a future would come to pass.
Hugo snorted when he saw the look in Sagittarius’s eyes. “Have any of your prophecies ever come true regarding Gun?”
“A prophecy given by a goddess of fate is different from what I can do!” Sagittarius was about to say something else, but Future interrupted him.
“Do not worry about it. You plan on stealing the Rule Book, right? If you join hands with me, we can steal the Rule Book. Then I can help you escape your horrible fate.”
She inwardly smirked. Her words about helping him escape his fate were a bald-faced lie.
‘A Creator will be eventually caught and killed by the evil gods.’
In the past, the Evil gods had killed the Creators. They were hunters who were still obsessed with the Creators.
‘They are probably the reason he has no future!’
The goddess didn’t want to get involved with the evil gods, so she had a thought.
‘Allying with him pains me, but it’s a different story since he is a Creator. He’s worth allying with. I’ll just get rid of him afterward.’
Hugo and the Zodiacs thought this was a reasonable path.
‘If we use them, we can use the Akashic Records and the book of fate. The unofficial Rule Book can be used too.’
Lee Gun, who had taken the notebook, looked conflicted as well. His eyebrows rose. “I have a question before I do anything.”
“Yes. Please ask.”
“The dimension containing the earth is my territory. My Constructs told me some goddesses were trying to swindle the earth. They were trying to take tributes. Are you those goddesses?”
“N-No way. It is probably the Norns.”
“Ah! Were they also why Hercules got involved?”
Atropos politely clasped her hands and bowed. “Ah! I apologize for that. Hercules is the fighting-type god for Olympus. We couldn’t let him get hurt. We’ll make sure it never happens…”
At that moment, Atropos was watching Lee Gun. Lee Gun was smirking. His expression made it unclear as to whether he was an evil god or not.
‘…!’
Lee Gun took up his enormous ax!!
Shweek!
The ax that the goddess had never seen before fell toward her head.
* * *
‘In the not too distant future, the god called Lee Gun and humans won’t exist.’
Hugo was oddly worried about Future’s words. She might have been telling a lie to get out of her situation, but the information that she saw was the truth. Of course, Lee Gun was the type of person to smash any predetermined fate. So Hugo shouldn’t be worried, but…
“Ahhk! The tax suddenly went up!”
“Ahhk!! Males are forbidden from entering this road!?”
“Ahhk! I have to pay 100 million Talents each time I want to use my weapon??”
“Shit! Who is responsible for this?”
Hugo groaned as he listened to the shouts emanating from all directions. In the end, he yelled at Lee Gun, who was busy writing in the notebook. “Hey! Stop it!”
