Yes, Lee Gun was changing the rules of the Divine world, causing chaos.
Lee Gun grumbled as he worked his carving knife against the notebook. “Damn it! The letters used by the gods are so curly and crooked. Fixing them is hard!”
“Cut it out!”
Lee Gun had never planned on sparing the goddesses of fate. He had instantly turned Future into a corpse, taken her Divine status, and used it on the Rule Book.
Of course, a proper Scribe Pen was needed to edit the book, but Lee Gun didn’t think that fixing the letters would be hard. So he had decided to do it himself.
The simple Rule Book was a thick notebook made out of wooden pages. This was why he used his engraving knife to scratch and edit the engraved letters.
This made Sagittarius dismayed.
‘My god! He can fix it without a Scribe Pen.’
The technique needed to fix the already engraved letters was extraordinary, but the Divine power wouldn’t activate if the penmanship differed from the original engraving. That meant…
‘He can copy the penmanship too? It must be identical.’
Moreover, he was doing it by using a single carving knife.
‘Crazy bastard!’
A rumor had it that the Rule Book had been manufactured by a Creator. That might be why Lee Gun was able to make edits to it.
Since Sagittarius was also a Creator, he had abilities related to Creation. However, his abilities were peerless.
At that moment, Lee Gun was expressing his anger as he turned the pages of the notebook. He was having a hard time deciphering the unique language of the gods. So he was making changes to each rule.
“Damn it! Where is the rule that’ll let me go back home? I’m sure it’s here! This one was a dud!”
“Stop it! If you keep changing the rules of the Divine world, you’ll get on the bad side of the Divine world again! You’ll go into debt!”
“What else can I do? I killed all the goddesses, so I have no one who’ll use it instead of me.”
“Then you should have spared them!”
“No!”
“Stop it. You’re working in vain. Give it to an expert.”
“There are no experts! Only the ones who can activate this can see the letters! You guys already have your own Divine status, so you can’t use the ability of others!”
“Of course, we have them! We just have to leave it to the goddesses of fate!”
“We killed them all! I thought you killed Past and Present!”
Hugo proudly waved his hand. “I didn’t kill them. I just turned them into my subordinates.”
When Hugo gestured with his hand, two goddesses appeared from his shadow.
Lee Gun’s face was a sight to behold when he saw the goddesses. It was to be expected since Lachesis (Present) and Klotho (Past) had taken the appearance of Lee Gun! However, they were women! Moreover, they were beautiful women!
“???” Lee Gun looked puzzled. “What the hell are these hybrids? Why do they look like this? What did you do to them?”
Hugo flinched. Biting his tongue, he turned his gaze away. “Uh… I have no idea. They transformed on their own.”
“They did it on their own?”
At that moment, Lime’s eyes twinkled as it perched on top of Lee Gun’s head.
[Hugo Otis has advanced to Hugo-rodite]
[Hugo-rodite used his power of beauty to change the two goddesses into ally dolls.]
Both Lee Gun and Hugo heard the voice. Hugo screamed since he had been hiding his power.
Lee Gun smirked as he looked at Hugo. “It seems you ate the Divine status. Why the hell would you eat that one instead of the good ones…”
“Damn it! It’s all your fault! Whatever! Just take this Divine status out of me!”
Lime was overjoyed as it looked at the pretty Lee Gun.
[Clump of Creation Clay says it is a very good ability.]
[Clump of Creation Clay says you should let it be.]
Hugo became angry. He grabbed the slime as if he wanted to pop it. “Bastard! You purposefully fed me this one!?”
Lee Gun burst out laughing. He had never expected the Divine status of the god of war Ares would be discarded for this one.
“What can Hugo-rodite do? You’re a god of love who shoots arrows now. Are you the cupid of love?”
“Fuck!!”
“I thought Ares’s Divine status was right for you, but this might be more useful.”
“Take it out!!”
Lee Gun ignored him as he closed the notebook. “Whatever! I have to confirm something before I leave the Divine world.”
“Confirm what?”
“I think Valhalla and Ennead were involved in Junwoo’s death.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. It seemed he was trying to fix anything related to the Rule Book.
[A god of the underworld can view all the underworld’s registry.]
Lee Gun had Hades’s Divine status, so he was trying to find Junwoo’s soul. “While I was looking for you, I was checking if Junwoo’s soul was in this place. The underworld is the place in charge of human souls. I can’t let Yeonwoo be by herself.”
It would be a lie to say Lee Gun didn’t feel guilty whenever he saw Yeonwoo. It was guilt that he had been unable to save Junwoo.
As if he accepted that reasoning, Hugo said, “Is that why you guys aren’t sharing a room?”
“W-What the hell did you just say?”
“It’s fine. Hurry up and wash that guilt away so that you guys can share a room. I just want to see my niece or nephew.”
“Hey!”
At that moment, Osiris had been listening to Lee Gun’s words. He was stuck between a rock and a hard place.
‘I never expected the goddesses of fate to have used the Akashic Records.’
Things had turned very troublesome because of the goddesses.
‘If the snake god realizes what happened that time, it’ll get messy.’
In the end, Osiris quickly exited the place. He had to inform the Great Spirit of this.
‘When is the fighting-type god coming to get rid of that bastard?’
Osiris had been barely able to keep Lee Gun bogged down in the Divine world. Things would get troublesome if Lee Gun managed to go to the earth.
When Osiris came outside, someone appeared in front of him.
“!”
He was a war god who looked like a young human. “Because of the goddesses of fate, the snake god found out something about Ennead? ”
The man looked annoyed, but Osiris was glad to see him. “Oh, great fighting-type god of Ennead, Set! You must have felt the danger we are in. I’m glad you’re here. I was given orders to prevent the snake god from going to the earth. Let’s carry the plan out together.”
Set laughed as he tapped Osiris. “Don’t worry! The Great Spirit already realizes what has transpired.”
“Alright. Then I should—”
Poo-hahk!!
“Kuhk!”
Set stabbed Osiris’s heart.
“Huh-uhk…!!”
Osiris inquiringly looked at Set, but Set merely laughed. “Die, traitor.”
“!”
“Osiris’s power should be taken as an inheritance, and I have to take care of the snake god. Then I have to send him back to the earth. These are the orders given to me by the Great Spirit of Ennead.”
Bastards! Osiris became angry.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - Fate that is starting to change (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 371 - Fate that is starting to change (2)
Osiris gritted his teeth when he met Set’s eyes.
“Bastard.”
Set was like Lee Gun. He was one of the few and precious fighting-type gods and a powerful war god who protected Ennead.
Olympus’s Hercules was known as the hero and shield of the gods and was considered a holy guardian. But Set was different.
[Cleaner]
He was the one who disposed of beings useless to the Divine world. This killer god had cleansed up numerous gods, so his being here meant only one thing.
‘We were going to be discarded from the start.’
It had been decided the moment they became Lee Gun’s Constructs!
The Great Spirit had pretended to be fine despite finding out what had happened to Osiris and Anubis. He had told them it was a good development and that they had to monitor Lee Gun.
Therefore, the loyal Osiris felt aggrieved. “He’s able to dominate the rules of the Divine world! He just has to pull us out from being the snake god’s Constructs!”
“Extracting you guys is as easy as breathing for him. However, he doesn’t like that you guys smell like the snake god.”
“…!!!”
Set let out a sharp laugh. It didn’t matter if Osiris couldn’t comprehend the move. “He hates when his belongings smell even a little like someone else. Moreover, he always hated snakes because of Aslan.”
“…!”
“Don’t worry! Anubis will soon follow after you.”
“!”
As soon as Set spoke, a wave of sand erupted from behind him. The sand encircled Osiris’s neck.
“Koohk!”
Then, something surprising happened.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!
Osiris was lifted into the air, and a sandstorm erupted beneath his feet. The storm was like an enormous sand ocean. It swelled as it swallowed everything in the surroundings.
Osiris quickly said, “Are you curious about the snake god’s weakness and goals?! If left alone, he’ll become a threat to the Great Spirits!”
Olympus had the twelve pillar gods, and Mahabharata had the ten Incarnates. As for Ennead, they had the nine Redeemers.
Killing off an officer-rank god like this was a big mistake.
“If you cause the inheritance right now, the snake god will be able to have me, and my memories will have been wiped out. That is why—”
Set let out a menacing laugh as he threw Osiris into the sand ocean. “Do you really think I’ll let the snake god find you?”
“Kuh-huhk…!”
He planned on making sure that Lee Gun wouldn’t be able to find Osiris’ corpse. Lee Gun was a god of life.
‘If he has a corpse, he’d just revive it.’
Moreover, Lee Gun had the odd ability to use the corpses of gods. If officer-rank gods fell into his hands, it would cause them great harm.
‘We won’t let that snake god take the seat of the Great Spirit.’
The sand started to rip apart Osiris, and his scream rang out.
‘The snake god is next.’
Lee Gun was the same rank as Set, a rare fighting-type god.
Instead of worrying about such a being causing trouble, Set had been ordered to get rid of Lee Gun.
When Osiris disappeared into the sand, Set started to move. However…
“…!”
Set suddenly felt a frightening sensation. It came from beneath his feet! An enormous shadow appeared beneath Osiris, who was being ripped apart.
‘That is…!’
A deep darkness with no end in sight spread across the sand ocean. The shadow was shaped like an enormous whale.
‘It’s that damn predator!’
The newcomer to the scene was Abyss, whom Lee Gun had called into the Divine world. Of course, it had been telling the truth when it said it didn’t want to mess with Lee Gun. It had refused to go after Lee Gun.
The tyrannical monarch appeared within the sandstorm, and its eyes flashed. Its gaze was directed toward Osiris and Set.
[Poor abandoned god. Do you feel rage? Do you want revenge?.]
“…!”
The whale roared with joy.
***
Around that time…
“What? How much?”
“Because of the interest, the amount is a little over ten billion Talents.”
Lee Gun stood in front of the pawnshop located within the Neutral Zone. He had come here to reclaim Anubis, and he was angry. The day before, he had pawned off Anubis to borrow some money. It was to pay for the communication fee. Now, he had returned to reclaim Anubis.
‘I have to ask him about Junwoo.’
If he wanted to return to the earth, he would eventually need Anubis’s power from time to time.
‘I have to use the route through the underworld where no one can track me.’
Anyway, that was why he had come to reclaim his Construct. That was all well and good.
‘It was just a single day, yet they increased the interest by several times.’
The owner of the pawnshop shamelessly laughed. “The original amount is 200 million Talents. If you don’t pay the interest of 9.9 billion, you won’t be able to take back your Construct.”
Lee Gun had planned to hear the story about Junwoo from Anubis. So he looked at the owner of the pawnshop, dumbfounded.
On the other hand, the more baffling part was Anubis’s attitude.
[What the hell? Snake god? Why the hell did he come back?]
“!”
When he had been sold, Anubis had found it humiliating since he had been sold as an officer god. He had caused a big fuss. However, he no longer seemed to be humiliated.
Anubis was reflected on the other side of the interphone screen, and he pretended to ignore Lee Gun. No, it went beyond ignoring him.
[You threw me away. You exchanged me for money. I have no business with you. Fuck off!]
Anubis saved his hand as if he was shooing Lee Gun away.
Lee Gun wondered if Anubis was miffed at being sold despite being an officer-rank god. However, that wasn’t the reason.
[Kyahh! Anubis-nim! Try this dish over here!]
[Kyahh! There are all kinds of treasures and servants here. We are willing to serve Anubis-nim!]
Even though he was Lee Gun’s Construct, Anubis was being treated very well. It was as if he was a Great Spirit.
While Lee Gun wondered what was going on, his Constructs became restless.
[He’s a pillar-god rank, so they don’t want to return him. They hit the jackpot.]
[That is right. No one hands over a Construct to a pawnshop. What kind of crazy— I meant to say only someone special as Master would do such a thing— Kuhk!]
The Construct could no longer speak.
[Ahhk! Master!!]
Then Lee Gun approached the owner of the pawnshop and grabbed him by the head.
Kwahng!
As if he was trying to stub out a cigarette, Lee Gun rubbed the owner’s head against the contract.
Ooh-doo-doohk! Kwahng!
“Kyahhhk!!”
“Whatever! Bring me the one contracted to me. I mean the one who is living the good life. Where is he?”
The employees clicked their tongues.
“Hmmph. You seem to be a war god, but nothing good will come out of trying to use force against us. Moreover, you cannot meet those in charge. Currently, the Divine world is in a state of chaos. There is a scary snake god, who ate up Olympus. You should run away before you suffer—”
“That’s me, bastards!”
Kwahng!!!
Lee Gun destroyed the wall of the pawnshop. It wasn’t as if he was unable to find Anubis by himself. It didn’t matter where the Construct was.
Boom!
[Death (Stage 4)]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as an intense power of death destroyed the pawnshop.
Kwahng!!
He had been holding back because he hadn’t wanted to go into debt for causing trouble. The debt would prevent him from using his abilities again. However, it no longer mattered.
Kwah-gwa-gwa-gwahng!!
“Ahhhhk!!!”
[The power of Death has smashed the barrier placed over the pawnshop.]
[The barrier stopping the ability of a Zodiac has been destroyed.]
As soon as he heard the notification, Lee Gun crossed his arms and menacingly flicked his finger. “Construct Summon. ‘Son of a Bitch.’”
A familiar face appeared in front of him. “Ah-haha! Why don’t you bow down to me, snake god—”
It was Anubis. He had put his trust in the high-rank barrier around the Neutral Zone. So when he saw Lee Gun like this, his expression changed. He didn’t even have the time to scream.
Bbah-gahk!!!
“Ahhk!!”
Lee Gun stepped on Anubis. “Speak if you don’t want to die.”
“W-What! Do you want to know how to smuggle yourself out of here?! I understand! I’ll give you an answer! However, you need to separate the soul and the body. I must have my power back to—”
“I don’t care about that. I know you came to my territory twenty-five years ago.”
“What? Why would I go to earth— What? Twenty-five years ago?” Anubis was about to say Lee Gun was speaking nonsense when he suddenly furrowed his brows.
- Mmm. The snake god might try to kill you.
Yesterday, Thoth had sent a Construct to Anubis, and it had suddenly spoken some nonsense.
‘Was this what he was referring to?’
Thoth hadn’t said much. It was quite brief.
- It doesn’t matter what the snake god asks. You should act innocent. Then do your best to kill the snake god.
That was the nonsense Thoth had spoken.
Lee Gun continued, “You chased a Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple twenty-five years ago, right?”
“!”
Anubis flinched at the unexpected question. Of all the questions the snake god could ask, why did he have to ask that one?
Lee Gun spoke as he pressed down on Anubis’s neck with his foot. “Since you did it, you weren’t working alone. Who was behind you? Also, where did you take the soul of the Death Serpent Bearer you killed at that time?”
Anubis looked conflicted.
‘Wasn’t that the task we carried out with Valhalla?’
However, why would he say anything that would cause harm to his Great Spirit? He was probably working very hard right now to free Osiris and him.
This was why the loyal Anubis let out a smile. “Pisces of the twelve Zodiacs asked a personal favor from me. I was close to Isis— Pooh-huhk!!!”
Anubis was crushed underneath Lee Gun’s foot.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if he was dismayed. “Ah ha! It was a personal favor, yet you took along the Zodiacs of Valhalla and Olympus? I know you guys don’t get along.”
“…!” Taken aback, Anubis tried to change the subject. However, Lee Gun activated his ability.
[Pond (Death 3 star)]
A black shadow shimmered behind Lee Gun.
Anubis flinched when he saw the unconscious figure inside the shadow.
‘Valkyrie…!’
Moreover, this wasn’t a normal Valkyrie. Like how the nymphs under Virgo possessed Divine statuses, numerous Valkyries possessed Divine statuses as well.
That Valkyrie is…!
‘It was the one who accompanied me…’
That Valkyrie was a goddess who had supposedly been killed by the Great Spirit after that incident.
Anubis started to sweat when he realized he had no more lies that he could tell.
‘This bastard is a psycho. He is unpredictable as well.’
It would be a catastrophe if they got caught up in the crossfire. In the end, he had to speak. “I’ll give you an explanation in a calm and orderly way, so wait a little. Valhalla instigated that incident. It has nothing to do with us—”
“I’m going to Ennead right now.”
“Ahhhk!” Anubis screamed.
This bastard really had a short temper! He probably meant it when he said he would invade Ennead.
‘I can’t let what happened in Olympus happen to us!’
[Anubis has used his ability]
The space around them changed. Their surroundings changed into some random world, which was sealed away from the outside. It seemed Anubis didn’t want the story leaking out.
“Alright! I’ll tell you!” Anubis ground his teeth.
It didn’t matter since the fighting-type god of Ennead would be coming soon to kill Lee Gun. That was the instructions Anubis had received.
- I’ll be there soon. Keep the snake god in place.
For some unknown reason, the Great Spirit of Ennead hated Lee Gun. His hatred was strong enough for Ennead to send the fighting-type god.
So Anubis decided to use all kinds of tricks to keep Lee Gun in place. “Yes! We were all under orders! I was under the orders of the Great Spirit of Ennead! The others received orders from the Great Spirit of Valhalla!”
“Finally, you speak what I want to hear.”
“However, the one pulling the strings was Valhalla. Our Great Spirit merely accepted a request from Pisces!”
“Oh! Is that why a high-rank god of the underworld was mobilized? For that trivial reason?”
Lee Gun had brought in an underworld god, and since Anubis was in charge of the cycle of rebirth, he held a high position amongst the gods.
When Lee Gun contemptuously laughed, Anubis continued to sweat. “The Great Spirit of Ennead agreed only since the opponent used to be a Construct under Aslan.”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose when he heard the unexpected name. “Aslan?”
“Yes. He used to be in the Creator tribe… Creators were basically technician gods who worked directly under the Divine world.” Anubis looked at Lee Gun with an odd look in his eyes. “Do you know him?”
“I don’t.”
“Is that so? Anyway, Aslan was one of the few special genius gods. Anyway, our Great Spirit was on terrible terms with Aslan.”
“Oh! Why? What did he steal?”
“What? The one to steal from our territory was Sagittarius… Anyway, we don’t know the reason behind their beef. However, they clashed against each other frequently.”
It was shocking whenever Aslan chose to clash against a Great Spirit. It was said that the Great Spirit was quite lenient, and they were drinking buddies at one time.
‘Aslan was a psycho.’
In other words, the Great Spirit of Ennead and Aslan had been mutual enemies. The reason behind the conflict was unknown.
That was probably why the Great Spirit of Ennead took and destroyed the land of the twelve Zodiacs after Aslan’s death. He had even taken the Constructs and divided them up between the other factions.
“Anyway, Valhalla was covetous of the Death Serpent Bearer. For some odd reason, they need Death.”
“Not Life?”
“Yes. Just Death.”
Lee Gun was intrigued. Without Life, Cycle couldn’t be activated. So why?
“Anyway, we had nothing to do with that incident. We just held a personal grudge, and it’s the past that holds no connection to you.”
“Oh! Is that so?”
“That’s right. Also, the Great Spirit isn't interested in such Divine status. He is interested in a Creator. I think he wants something fixed.”
“Then where is the soul of that snake god?”
“That is….” Anubis whispered Junwoo’s location into Lee Gun’s ears.
It was rare to see Lee Gun this surprised.
‘What? Really?’
At that moment, a god hiding near them was listening in on the conversation. Only Great-Spirit ranks could view and listen in on what was going on with Anubis’ barrier. It was supposed to be an invincible barrier, yet….
“Damn it! That bastard is telling him everything.” An angry expression appeared on Set’s face as he eavesdropped on the conversation.
But then, he laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - Fate that is starting to change (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 372 - Fate that is starting to change (3)
It didn’t matter in the end.
“Since I found the dog, I have no business here.”
Lee Gun had found his target. So he dragged Anubis away by the back of his neck.
This surprised Anubis. “I told you the information! Shouldn’t that be enough?! Where are you taking me?”
“Where else? We’re going home.”
“…!”
Since Lee Gun had the Rule Book now, he could stay on the earth. It wouldn’t be a problem. He just had to exit through the departure gate.
‘A bunch of scrubs came to my land to play.’
However, he had way too many gods who harbored grudges against him to use the departure gate. Then some wanted his Achievements, 600%-faith Construct, etc.
A lot of annoying beings were out there. So Lee Gun wanted to use the underworld path, which was the best route to sneak himself out of the Divine world.
‘Taeksoo was dragged away using this path.’
It was the shortest route where the other gods couldn’t chase after them.
“Let’s go to the underworld. You said you’ll guide me.”
Flustered, Anubis yelled, “I can guide you! However, only souls can traverse that route!”
In other words, one had to separate the body and soul if one wanted to use this route. That was why the other gods wouldn’t be able to chase after them.
“So what?”
“What do you mean? Do you plan on throwing away the body of a fighting-type god? Do you plan on possessing the body of a colonist?” Did he think a fighting-type god was something anyone could become?
‘Among the countless gods, I can count the fighting-type gods with my fingers!’
Despite his words, Lee Gun smirked. “Yup. I don’t really care. I’m a god of Creation. I just have to copy the body and remake it.”
“?!”
The dismayed Anubis was dragged away.
‘Shit! At this rate, he’ll really go back to the earth.’
He had to keep Lee Gun in place until Set arrived, as Set was a fighting-type god, like Lee Gun!
In the end, Anubis shouted in a last-ditch effort, “I won’t go, bastard! Why would I follow a penniless beggar Zodiac like you when I can go to Kunlun?”
“!”
“If you want me, come back to me after you become as big as Kunlun!”
Lee Gun looked at Anubis as if the god was speaking nonsense, but the other Constructs just nodded as though Anubis’s statement wasn’t out of line.
“Kunlun is the richest faction in the Divine world.”
“There is a reason the Zodiac of the Aries temple used to be under Kunlun. Aries was famous as the god of wealth. He was called the Jade Emperor…”
Kunlun was a fantasy paradise that possessed many precious items. However, that had nothing to do with Lee Gun.
When he showed indifference, Anubis quickly whispered to him, “Kunlun’s Lotus Land has the special Heavenly Peach!”
“I’d rather eat chicken than fruit.”
“That’s not it! Heavenly Peach is a fruit that has so much power of Life that it can create a Divine status of Life!”
“!”
“If you can obtain it, you can freely use your ultimate skill! Isn’t the prerequisite needed to activate Cycle really troublesome?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. Anubis wasn’t wrong. Why?
‘The EXP of both Life and Death have to be 100%.’
What was his current status right now?
[Death EXP: 500%]
[Life EXP: 0.00004%]
To raise the Divine status of Death, Lee Gun merely had to destroy everything. It coincided with what he was already doing. However, Life was in the dumpster.
To raise Life, Lee Gun had to be pure in doing good deeds(?) for other people. No, he had to act as a healer.
This was why he tried to repeatedly kill and revive his foes, but it was considered cheating. It had failed to raise the EXP. Maybe, it was because he had bad intentions(?) behind his actions.
The discrepancy in EXP was staggering. It meant that Lee Gun didn’t do many good deeds. However, the Constructs took it in stride.
“Well, the Divine status of Life is something kind and righteous gods develop.”
“Master being able to acquire it is a miracle in the first place.”
“What did you just say??”
Thankfully, he was able to kill a monarch such as Time and raised his Life EXP. However, such an opponent was rare.
As if he could read Lee Gun’s inner thoughts, Anubis whispered to Lee Gun, “At this rate, you won’t be able to use Cycle in a couple hundred years, right? Will you be able to fight off the Zodiacs who covet the earth in the meantime?”
“…” Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
According to Anubis, he would be better off going to Kunlun instead of going straight to the earth.
He had to acquire the peach.
Anubis smirked as he tempted Lee Gun.
‘Of course, I’ll steal the peach from him.’
The peach was a treasure coveted by gods of other factions. If Anubis returned to Ennead with it, he would receive a favorable evaluation.
Masking his true intentions, Anubis continued, “Anyway, you should act as if you’re handing me over to Kunlun. You can use that opportunity to acquire Kunlun’s peach. Wouldn't that be more beneficial for you?”
“You said it’s the treasure of the Great Spirit. Do you really think you are worth that much?”
At that moment…
“Well, we can’t let you view the peach if you’re willing to pay such a price.”
“!”
Lee Gun turned his head when the employees of the store spoke up. His eyes widened.
“!”
The employees who had cute appearances until a moment ago had changed. Their small figures had turned large. Their cute eyes and faces had turned fiendish.
Lee Gun wondered who they were, but he found it out soon.
“Master! This is bad! They are the gods directly under the Great Spirit of Kunlun!”
“They aren’t the low-rank gods supposed to be in charge of the pawnshop!”
“!”
As those words rang out, their surroundings changed.
[You have entered the territory of Kunlun.]
He had thought this was the pawnshop run by civil servants at the Neutral Zone. Yet the sign changed. It turned into a building belonging to the Great Spirit of Kunlun.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw the familiar door plate.
‘They were the first ones to successfully bid for Taeksoo.’
It was as he had expected.
“You stole Pushover, whom our young lady successfully bid for. You also put the Great Spirit’s respected elder in such a state. Don’t tell me you already forgot about that.”
This meant that they had pretended to be employees of the pawnshop and prepared a trap for him. That wasn’t the only problem.
“Master! They are Gluttony spirits, who are capable of eating gods!”
“!”
They weren’t like Cluders, but they were a race of beings that the Divine world considered a subject of nightmares!
Lee Gun immediately tried to use his ability of Death.
[Warning! Your abilities don’t work against them.]
[The Peach Blossom Spring barrier has been placed over the corresponding space.]
[Peach Blossom Spring is peaceful, and there are no conflicts. Its unique barrier ability disarms your abilities.]
[All weapons will be disarmed.]
“!”
Lee Gun couldn’t activate his powers.
Anubis, who was caught, screamed. “Shit! I always wondered why they had the guts to engage in business with other gods!”
While putting Anubis aside, the employees had known Lee Gun was a Zodiac, yet they had asked for interest from Lee Gun. They had been unafraid for some odd reason.
‘Since Kunlun can conduct business with other gods using them, they must be extraordinary!’
The gods of Kunlun, who had been hiding their powers using the power of their Great Spirit, revealed their teeth.
“Master— Kuhk!!”
When a Construct was swallowed first, Anubis clenched his eyes shut. The Gluttony spirits would never let the Construct go once they ate it.
‘That bastard is done—’
Pooh-hahk!!!
“!”
Lee Gun summoned Heaven’s Punishment and split the enemy into two. The swallowed Construct fell out of the stomach.
“Kuhk! Master… I apologize…”
“It’s fine if you’re safe.”
The Gluttony spirits didn’t react to the death of their comrade. They seemed stunned that Lee Gun had summoned Heaven’s Punishment.
“Wait a moment. What is that Divine weapon…!”
The eyes of the Gluttony spirits turned round, and they spoke some unexpected words.
“If you give us that weapon, we’ll give you the interest on top of returning the pillar god of Ennead.”
“In fact, we’ll give you the Constructs that we acquired.”
Their words angered Anubis. It was said that Kunlun had the most discerning eye in the Divine world. If they were reacting like this, that item had to have incredible value. Its worth was beyond imagination, yet…
“My Divine status is worth less than a weapon? Moreover, I’m the addon??!”
“Shut up before we eat you, damn puppy!”
Kunlun’s Gluttony spirits rushed toward Lee Gun, but Lee Gun suddenly unsummoned Heaven’s Punishment. This surprised his Constructs.
“Master! Why!”
The reason he put away Heaven’s Punishment was simple.
[The saliva of the Gluttony spirits has taken off the outer coating of Heaven's Punishment.]
[Their sticky blood has dulled the blade a little.]
[Durability is going down quickly.]
Since they were Gluttony spirits, their abilities were specialized toward neutralizing gods. Lee Gun wouldn’t destroy the blameless Heaven’s Punishment because of them.
‘It hurts my child.’
This was why he called forth a substitute. “Come out, Club! Get rid of them all!”
He called forth the strongest defender amongst his Constructs, the fighting-type god.
[Club (Hercules) is unconscious.]
[He needs to be resuscitated.]
“!”
Hercules had been called forth, but he came out looking like a corpse.
This left Lee Gun dumbfounded. It seemed Hercules had been poisoned. His body had stiffened.
When Lee Gun looked at his Constructs with an inquiring gaze, they seemed embarrassed.
“H-he tried to ask for the Scorpio Saint’s name, so he got beaten up…”
When Lee Gun heard that Hercules had asked for Hailey’s name, he became oddly angry and clicked his tongue. “I guess it can’t be helped.”
“Yes. Master should use your Divine weapon to—”
Bbah-gahk!!!
Lee Gun grabbed Hercules’s leg. He used Hercules like a club as he killed his enemies.
Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!
The power of the Gluttony spirits damaged Hercules’s body, but Lee Gun didn’t even blink an eye.
“His body is sturdier than mine, so he won’t die.”
“?!”
It was to be expected of a god that boasted of having the strongest body.
Lee Gun turned around, and his eyes flashed as if he had a thought.
‘Kunlun’s peach…’
“Become food for our Great Spirit!”
When many Gluttony spirits rushed him at once, Lee Gun got annoyed. He used one of his special skills.
[Get Hit Instead of Me (1 star)]
Suddenly, Sagittarius and Hugo fell in front of Lee Gun.
“What the hell? This ability is…”
“Damn it! Where the hell did he summon me— Ahhhk!!!”
The Gluttony spirits revealed their teeth. Sagittarius and Hugo scrambled when they saw the spirits.
“Wait a moment. Gluttony spirits?! Kunlun?!”
Realizing what was going on, Hugo immediately brought out his bow. He prepared to aim the bow. “Gun! I’m going to get rid of them in one shot, so lure them…”
When he turned his head, however, the sight angered him. Lee Gun was running away. It seemed he was letting Sagittarius and Hugo stop them.
Nevertheless, Hugo shrugged it off as he activated his ability.
[Vision of Beauty (5 star)]
Kwahng!!
“Ahhhk!!”
When the arrows hit them, the Gluttony spirits turned into allied dolls (Lee Gun). Their attacks had stopped, but another problem had cropped up.
Doo doo doo doo doo!
“!”
Although they had their appearance turned into that of the female version of Lee Gun, their instincts as Gluttony spirits seemed to have remained. They were trying to exit the pawnshop to eat the other gods.
Sagittarius blanched. “Hey, servant! Won’t they indiscriminately earth the other gods?”
“Who cares?”
“They are the underlings of Kunlun’s Great Spirit! If we don’t return them to normal, we’ll suffer his wrath!”
Hugo didn’t care as he quickly ran away.
Around that time, a being was observing this maelstrom of confusion from the Peach Blossom Spring, the land of the Kunlun faction.
- Run!
- Ahhhk! Servant! Change them back to normal! Hurry!
The Construct of the Great Spirit furrowed his brow when he saw Lee Gun’s reflection on the pond. “They are a boorish group. Despite being a small Zodiac without Constructs…”
“Should we call up our entire force and chase after that impudent snake god?”
The snake god had messed with an elder treasured by the Great Spirit. He had also interfered in their bid for Pushover.
“Even after getting the successful bid, his younger sister lost Pushover to the snake god. She’s still crying about it.”
“All the Great Spirits of the eight great forces are feeling uncomfortable because of what the snake god did to Olympus.”
“It seems those who do not belong to the eight great forces are chasing after the snake god to acquire his Achievements.”
“Of course, one of the other Great Spirits might get rid of the snake god before that. Maybe, we should…”
On the other hand, the Great Spirit felt different as he watched Lee Gun through the screen. Then, his gaze fell on his subordinates, who had been turned into female versions of Lee Gun.
“Oh. Look at that.”
He suddenly seemed interested.
* * *
“Huhk! Huhk!”
“We barely made it out.”
After exiting the pawnshop, Hugo and Anubis entered a lodging facility within the Neutral zone.
Monsters roamed the nights of the Divine world, so one must be indoors by night. It was why Virgo had rented this place out earlier.
Of course, they had almost been unable to enter this place. The reason was the Lee Gun Gluttony spirits that Hugo had made and released earlier. It was pandemonium out there.
“Ahhhk! Help!”
“Stop— Kuh-hoohk!”
The streets of the Divine world were filled with blood and corpses. That was why the lodging facility was full even before night since a barrier had been placed over it.
Of course, the EXP of the gods being eaten by the Gluttony spirits was funneled toward Hugo and Lee Gun.
This made Anubis beg to be able to follow Lee Gun. He looked at Lee Gun and Hugo in disgust.
‘The Divine world is in a mess thanks to those two.’
As for Sagittarius, he furrowed his brow as he looked at Anubis. “Nephew, are you sure that bringing him despite not paying anything is a good idea? Those bastards at the pawnshop are treasured by the Great Spirit of Kunlun.”
“Who cares? If he causes trouble, I’ll just wreck him.”
“If you continue to act that way…”
Flash!
Suddenly, a golden letter fell in front of Lee Gun.
Sagittarius reared back in shock when he realized the identity of the golden letter. “Look! It’s Kunlun! The Great Spirit has declared war on you!”
Dealing with the other Great Spirits was already a chore. If Kunlun joined in, it would be very troublesome.
‘Kunlun has the most Constructs amongst the factions in the Divine world.’
Their forces were so large that everyone sidestepped them.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “Reading your language is annoying. Read it. What does it say inside?”
“What else could it be? Those misers probably—”
Sagittarius’s face crumpled when he opened the letter.
“What is it?”
“I-It is nothing. He’s better off not seeing this letter…”
When Sagittarius avoided his gaze, Lee Gun snatched back the letter. He could get a gist of what was written, and he couldn’t believe his eyes.
[We are willing to overlook that you took the pillar god of Ennead without paying the interest.]
[We won’t ask you to take responsibility for laying hands on the venerated elder at the boat party.]
[If you want, Kunlun will protect Pushover and the Serpent Bearer from all forces.]
[If you want, I will give you a dowry of 100 billion Talents.]
Those words made one wonder if the gods of Kunlun had lost their minds giving such concessions. Though they were making a proposal that the Serpent Bearer couldn’t refuse. However, the problem was the last sentence.
[Except the Serpent Bearer has to become the 13,888th bride of Kunlun’s Great Spirit]
“?????”
When Lee Gun looked for an explanation from Sagittarius, Sagittarius massaged his forehead. “It seems Kunlun’s Great Spirit really liked the female version of Nephew created by the servant.”
“What the hell??”
“That is… In other words, he’ll pay for you to change your gender using the power of Cycle, and he wants you to marry him…?”
Lee Gun ripped the letter as if it was a crazy suggestion.
Hugo clutched his stomach as he laughed, while Lee Gun’s eyes flashed with murderous intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - Fate that is starting to change (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 373 - Fate that is starting to change (4)
“What?”
Around that time, the Great Spirit of Mahabharata furrowed his brow when he heard an unexpected piece of news.
[You really saw that girl?]
“Yes. Her name is Hailey. There’s an age difference, but she has the rare features that make her a peerless beauty. There is no mistaking her.”
Sighs erupted all over the region ruled over by the Great Spirit of Mahabharata.
“I never expected the Red Blood Princess to appear here once again.”
“Who’s the Red Blood Princess?”
“You don’t know her? It was when the monarchs invaded us a long time ago. She was a famous Cluder. She was the daughter of an enemy monarch...”
“Ah! That kid…!”
The gods of Mahabharata looked toward their Great Spirit, the Supreme Being. The Great Spirit of Mahabharata possessed the Divine status of Vishnu. It maintained order.
At its heart, Mahabharata was structured where they had a tripartite god system. However, one of the Spirits had gone through inheritance, so he was still in his child form. The other had ceased to exist.
A Construct (Storm) had returned from the snake god. It was done under the order of the Great Spirit. The Construct bowed.
“The problem is Hailey. That woman is with the snake god.”
This caused a murmur amongst the Constructs who served the Great Spirit.
“That girl has the highest bounty in the Divine world!”
The reason for the bounty was simple.
‘She’s connected to the incident where Mahabharata’s Great Spirit Shiva was murdered.’
How the Great Spirit had died was unclear, but Hailey was responsible for it. She was that dangerous of an existence. That was why the gods ground at the mention of her name. It was also why the Constructs looked at their master with conflicted expressions.
“If that woman is with the snake god, Mahabharata cannot openly take the side of the snake god…”
“Also, the Zodiac of the Leo temple was seen next to the Serpent Bearer! What is Leo doing?”
“That’s right. It’s said that woman used to be a Zodiac Saint of the twelve Zodiacs. There is no way Leo would have been unaware of that girl!”
The Constructs who had come back from the mission started to sweat.
“… That person never showed interest in others.”
Groans came from the surroundings.
“Ughh. He should be a fighting-type god. However, he ate his Divine status, saying it was too noisy. That is indeed something he would do.”
Leo was a war god who had been raised by Aslan. While he was raising his Divine status, the Divine status had developed a personality. Leo had eaten it because it was annoying.
At that time, Aslan’s expression had been a sight to behold, since he had been trying to develop Leo into a fighting-type god.
On the other hand, Leo was still very strong. It would have been great if he listened to those around him.
Suddenly, the Great Spirit of Mahabharata said something unexpected.
[Alright. I’ll get rid of the Red Blood Princess. ]
“What?! You will personally go?”
The Constructs who had come back after assessing the situation looked surprised.
“That woman seems to be very close to the snake god. If we mess with them, Mahabharata might…”
[How is that problematic?]
“I-It’s nothing. However… there might be a bigger problem than the Blood Red Princess…”
The gods of Mahabharata furrowed their brows.
“What else is there?”
“It has to do with Pushover. He revealed the version of himself from the time he accrued his Karmic debt. It happened where the goddesses of fate presided.”
“!!”
The reactions to Hugo’s story couldn’t be compared to before. It caused a ruckus.
The reactions were expected since Mahabharata was called the Samsara Hell. It was in charge of the punishment and reincarnation system. Taking care of the sinners was their job.
Basically, the ones who had carried out Hugo’s reincarnation were the gods of Mahabharata. Naturally, they knew about Hugo’s Karmic debt.
The gods of other factions were unaware of Hugo’s identity, so they talked about making him into a Construct. They wouldn’t be speaking so peacefully if they knew the truth.
‘If they knew who he was, they wouldn’t have let him into the Divine world.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“His instinct came out when he ate the Divine status. It’s understandable. Is everything ok right now?”
“Yes. Thankfully, he ate the Master of Beauty Divine status, so his evil instincts didn’t awaken.”
When the gods heard that he had eaten the Divine status of Aphrodite, they inwardly let out sighs of relief.
‘It would have been catastrophic if he had swallowed a war god.’
Hugo may be a normal human, but they couldn’t let their guard down if they considered what was inside him.
“Anyway, be careful of Pushover. You might think he’s fine since he’s human, but we must never let his form from his previous life reveal itself.”
That was the absolute truth. In the past, Hugo was someone who had destroyed the Divine world and slaughtered the gods. In truth, he was the reason Brahma had to go through his inheritance.
Then there was Hailey, who had killed Shiva.
‘All the troublesome ones have attached themselves to the snake god..’
“It would be best if we don’t send Pushover back to the earth like we originally planned.”
“If he awakens by mistake, he’ll destroy that dimension.”
“The best thing to do is to put him in the dimension of torture or some isolated dimension….”
The Great Spirit of Mahabharata clicked his tongue.
[That isn’t just. It doesn’t matter what his past life was. He’s a human right now.]
“What if his instincts come out?”
[If they do…]
The Constructs were shocked by the next words.
* * *
As this discussion was going on, Hugo, who had raised the alarms of the gods, was being bullied by Lee Gun.
“Go get some food. I’m going to die from starvation.”
“What? Food?”
“Yes. I used too much of my abilities today. It feels terrible. FYI, I’ll eat only meat.”
The unexpected order left Hugo dumbfounded. Of course, Hugo used to serve Lee Gun three meals a day when the latter was his teacher, but… “Bastard! I bought you snacks! What more do you want?”
“Yes, servant. If you’re heading out, you can get me something too. FYI, I eat only prime meat and the highest-grade fish. If it isn’t the finest ingredients— Kuhk!”
Hugo kicked Sagittarius. Although he was annoyed by Lee Gun’s order, it was understandable.
‘There is a reason that baldie wanted me to send hamburgers as tribute in the past.’
The Divine world’s food was terrible. It had the effect of filling the Divine power.
‘If I had to describe it, it tastes way too healthy.’
It seemed he didn’t want to suffer through that particular misfortune again as a god. How bad was the snack?
[Ah! You have a good eye. That is a special skewer! The meat was marinated for a hundred hours in the excrement of the X god! It costs only ten Talents!]
[…?!]
Even the mighty Lee Gun threw away the chicken. Well, that wasn’t important right now.
“Since we have a guest, you should bring us something to eat.”
“Guest?”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun pointed at Anubis and the outdoors. “I told him to bring the key that’ll allow us to head toward the underworld. To go to the earth, we’ll use the same route that you took.”
“What? What about your body?! Only souls can pass through there!”
“I can make a clone when I reach the earth. I can throw away the original in the Divine world.”
Sagittarius looked at him as if that wasn’t a good idea. “Your body is that of a fighting-type god. Even you will have a difficult time making the clone. The clone’s body will be inferior to your original body”
“It can’t be helped. While I might suffer a loss in spec, I’m in a hurry to get back to the earth.”
Anubis furrowed his brow.
‘Well, there is a route he can take where he won’t have to throw away his body. He won’t be chased by the gods on this route either.’
That was the route used by the janitors. In other words, this was the route traveled by trash cans. The route was so dirty and dangerous that no god traversed through it. However, that tunnel was connected to all worlds.
Moreover, that route could only be opened by the Cleaner “Set,” the fighting-type god of Ennead. However, Anubis had no reason to tell Lee Gun about it. Why?
‘You will be eliminated here by the fighting-type god.’
Knock, knock!
“!”
The god Anubis had called was already outside the door.
“I brought what you asked for, my lord.”
It was an unfamiliar goddess carrying a scroll. It was the transformed Set.
* * *
‘I will forever deprive you of Divine status.’
It would be the same for Anubis and Lee Gun.
Set’s eyes flashed as he came to visit Lee Gun. After receiving the order from the Great Spirit of Ennead, he had put Osiris through the inheritance process. He planned on doing the same for Anubis, then he could clean up Lee Gun.
“What is this?”
Set could only twitch his eyebrows when foul objects were placed in front of him.
“Gun… You….”
“What?”
Hugo looked at the strange food. No, it was more of a sorry-looking monstrosity than food. He massaged his brow.
A dish that couldn’t be called a chicken was before them right now. Lee Gun had made it himself by frying this chicken.
‘What did he fry it with? How could he produce such trash food…’
The reason why Lee Gun had made this chicken simple. While Lee Gun had been conversing with Anubis and the underling that Anubis had called, Hugo had brought boiled chicken for them to eat. It was a bland dish.
That had made Lee Gun furious.
[Damn it! Why the hell did you boil the chicken in the water again…!!]
[You get to eat while doing nothing, so why don’t you just eat it? Oh yeah! I heard that eating it without salt is popular. That’s why I took out the salt— Kuhk!]
[Damn it! This is why I want to go home!]
Set, who had transformed into a goddess, laughed as he spoke.
[There is no way the earth’s food is better than what we have here. Is there something that you like over there?]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. Then he furrowed his brows as he had replied,
[Ah! This won’t do. Wait here. I’ll show you gods the greatness of the earth’s food.]
Lee Gun had immediately turned Lime into an enormous frying pan and used Torch to make chicken with vigor.
Thirty minutes had passed.
Lee Gun said it was chicken, but it looked like trash…
No, it was food.
“N-Nephew. This looks completely different from the chicken that I know.”
“It looks terrible, but it should taste good. Eat it.”
Sagittarius looked amused as he tried to pick up the chicken, but Hugo quickly grabbed his hand in fright. His actions meant Sagittarius shouldn’t eat it at all costs; it’d kill him.
‘You don’t know how bad Gun is at cooking.’
There was a reason Hugo had provided Lee Gun three meals a day when the latter was his teacher. It wasn’t because he had endless respect for Lee Gun, and neither was it because he was a pushover.
‘I did it because I wanted to live!’
For someone great at making items, Lee Gun was horrible at making food. Lee Gun didn’t have any feel for cooking. Moreover, the problem had worsened when he returned.
Items that Lee Gun made contained a sense of self. The food he made was imbued with life, so the sauce moved on its own and the entrees opened and closed their mouths.
‘Thankfully, this dish isn’t moving…’
However, Hugo flinched when he saw a pill bottle in Lee Gun’s hand.
[Pesticide]
It seemed Lee Gun had used it to kill the life of the twitching food. Hugo blanched even more when he saw the energy imbuing Lee Gun’s hand.
[Death]
The pesticide couldn’t kill it, so he used his ability!!
Set didn’t know this, so he dubiously looked at Lee Gun. “A-Are you sure this is edible?”
“Of course. It’s the most popular food in the place where I reside. I guarantee its taste. Right?”
Feeling Lee Gun’s gaze, Hugo and the Constructs started to sweat.
“Uh. Yeah.”
“T-That is correct.”
Amused, Set looked at Lee Gun. While he had come here under orders, he had also been interested in Lee Gun.
‘Normally, humans are slaves not worthy of associating with gods.’
It was natural for a Zodiac to feel shame if one lived in the dimension that the god ruled over. Humans and other colonists were slaves. They could exist only thanks to the Zodiacs.
However, the earth was a place being treasured by someone who possessed a Divine status capable of destroying Olympus.
This was why Set was interested in Lee Gun and the colonists that he ruled over.
‘If the colonist slaves are high quality, I might be able to trade them.’
Moreover, Lee Gun was a fighting-type god. Fighting-type gods were very rare. There was no downside to becoming friends with the snake god.
“Thank you for the hospitality. I will eat it with thanks.” Set smiled as he ate the chicken of unknown origin.
Lee Gun smiled in satisfaction.
As soon as Set swallowed the chicken… “Kuh-huhk. Kuh-hoo-poo-huhk!”
Set wanted to die.
At that moment, Anubis’s face turned pale.
“Wait a…!”
It seemed Set couldn’t maintain his transformation. He transformed from the goddess back to a menacing fighting-type god.
When a familiar male god suddenly appeared there, everyone became guarded.
“Master!”
“My god! He’s the Cleaner for Ennead!”
The Constructs unsheathed their weapons. They seemed to have a great epiphany.
“Master knew this bastard’s identity, so he poisoned him!”
“As expected of Master!”
Lee Gun felt hurt inside when they called it a poisoning attempt. While he had known his opponent was in a transformed state, he wanted his opponent to get a taste of real chicken.
In the end, Set gasped as he looked for an antidote.
[Stimulate (5 star)]
That was one of the unique abilities of a fighting-type god. He tried to activate the healing ability.
[You cannot recover your body with it.]
[The fighting-type god of sand is having a hard time breathing.]
[The fighting-type god of sand is dying.]
Even a 5-star ability couldn’t heal it. Set started vomiting blood.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Only after throwing up all the pieces of food that he had eaten could Set breathe again. He had barely saved himself.
Unsteady on his feet, an angry Set glared at Lee Gun. “I was skeptical, but I should’ve known better. By the food you guys eat, I can tell the history of that race. Humans aren’t worth rehabilitating. I know this well now.”
“Hey, your words hurt.” Lee Gun did try to cook a proper dish.
Well, it didn’t matter. Set seemed to have a generalized bad opinion of humans because of Lee Gun. He immediately used his power. “I thought they could be traded, but I was wrong!”
“!”
“I’ll get rid of them as I originally planned.”
“Master!”
“Do not ever think about stepping into the Divine world again!”
“!”
When Set made a gesture, a red light appeared from the ceiling.
Koo-goo-goong!
The red light sucked in everything, including inanimate objects and all living beings.
[Cracked Door of the Dimension (3rd door)]
Sagittarius and the Constructs flinched.
“That’s the Cleaner’s ability!”
Set was the Cleaner, and he used this ability to get rid of gods.
However, Sagittarius furrowed his brow. “Isn’t that a space connected to a different dimension?”
Hugo had been clutching at a pillar. His eyes widened when the different dimension was mentioned. “Dimension? Then we can go to the earth through that?”
“It’s possible.”
“Then we should exit using that! We won’t have to leave behind our bodies!”
The Constructs desperately yelled.
“No! You can go to the earth through there, but that place is…!”
“Whatever. Just fuck off!”
Set wiped the blood from his lips. His eyes flashed.
This made the Constructs scream. They were in danger of being sucked through that open door.
When the powerful winds tried to pull Lee Gun in, his Constructs quickly yelled at him.
“Damn it! Master! We cannot be dragged into that place at all costs!”
“What is it? If it’s a crack in the dimensions, is it any different from the middle world?”
“It’s a traditional maze of the Divine world, which even the Divine world forgot how to traverse!”
When Lee Gun said he was going to the Divine world, Virgo Constructs had been worried Lee Gun wouldn’t take the straight route. They had been worried he would take a different route. It was the route that Set had connected using a tunnel.
Set laughed. “You said you wanted to sneak out to the earth. I’ll send you that way. While it’s a maze, it still has a departure gate. Since it’s you, you’ll be able to find it quickly. I wonder if it’ll take you ten thousand years to find it.”
“!”
When the Great Spirit of Ennead had said to send them to the earth, he was referring to this method.
“While you deserve to be put to death, we’ll merely banish you. Be thankful to the mercy of the Great Spirit. Don’t step into the Divine world for the next ten thousand years.”
“What the hell is he— Kuhk!”
In the end, all the gods, including Hugo, were sucked into the door. The fighting-type god had opened this door with permission from the Divine world, so not even gods could avoid being sucked in.
Lee Gun was having a hard time withstanding the pull.
“Koohk!”
In the end, he got sucked in too. However, he sent the power of Death flying toward the gate just before that.
Kwahng!!
Set smirked when he felt the shock. “Idiot. It doesn't matter what you send. The door won’t be destroyed—”
Set and Anubis were shocked at once. While the gate wasn’t destroyed, the light coming out of it had changed in color.
‘Black?!’
Anubis realized the implication. He reared back in fright. “Wait a moment…! That’s not the first door!”
“He used his power to change the space where it is connected to…!”
The space was directly connected to the colony. If they went through using that gate…!
“They might be able to go directly to the earth!”
“It doesn’t matter.”
“What?! Didn’t the Great Spirit say they should be thrown into the maze…”
“They are entering somewhere worse than the maze. You do realize what’s in there, right?”
“!”
It was a place gods refused to go to, as even they could die there.
“They’ll die before they can find the door— Kuhk!!” Set groaned as a chain made out of light encircled his neck.
“Kuhk! Wait a moment!”
“You’re going with me, idiot!”
“!!”
The chain was Lee Gun’s “Serpent Eater” skill! Lee Gun smirked as he was sucked through the door. He pulled Set. “You can be my guide!!”
Set was shocked. “No! I can’t leave the Divine world! Wait a moment! Hey! I can’t go there!”
In the end, caught in the snake god’s scheme, Set also disappeared from the Divine world.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - These Punks (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 374 - These Punks (1)
Accompanying an enormous wind, Hugo, Sagittarius, and the Constructs fell somewhere unfamiliar.
Kwahng!
At a glance, it looked to be a dark place in the mountains. Moreover, a strong scent of grass and insects was all around them.
Hugo looked at his surroundings. “Koo-oohk! Where the hell is this?”
Sagittarius gingerly got up as if his back hurt. He furrowed his brows at those words. “This is the crack between dimensions. It’s a tunnel connected to all kinds of colonies.”
“Is it connected to the earth?”
“Yes. Unlike the maze, this tunnel will allow us to reach the earth in a minute. The gods won’t be able to chase after us, either.”
Hugo was happy to hear this. He had been worried since the energy that this place was giving off was out of the ordinary. “We just have to find the exit! We have our bodies, and no one is chasing after us. This is the best route.”
“Yes. It would be awesome if we can exit this place.”
“What? Why? Is it that hard to find the exit?”
“No, we have to solve a problem before that. Ha! That damn nephew!”
“What are you—”
Kwah-jeek!!
“Kooh-oohk?!”
Hugo didn’t have the opportunity to speak further. A black shadow clung to him and choked his neck. He wasn’t the only one.
“Koo-oohk! Bastards!”
The unidentified shadows clung to the Constructs, who had fallen with them. At a glance, these shadows looked like zombies, and they were unbelievably strong! Moreover, they seemed to be aiming for the valuables possessed by Hugo and his party.
However, Hugo immediately had an understanding.
‘They are strong!’
They were strong enough that high-rank gods couldn’t break free from them. Moreover, they could discern which items in his possession were the most valuable. They went straight for his bow, which Lee Gun had made for him.
What were they? Why did they become monsters without a shred of reason?
As if they had read his question, Lee Gun’s Constructs, who were now captured, quickly shouted, “These are sinners who ran up their Karmic debt! We can’t let them drag us away!”
“Karmic debt?! The goddesses of fate said I had Karmic debt. What is it?”
“The power of gods is boundless! However, there are rules.”
“What rules?”
“It doesn’t matter if a god uses a powerful ability. They just can’t mess with the order of the universe. If they do, they start amassing Karmic debt.”
“Order of the universe…”
“This is why one must acquire the Permission ticket (Exoneration) beforehand. Normally, the Permission ticket (Exoneration) is enough for one to get exonerated. However, if you go too far, you amass Karmic Debt. Depending on the Karmic debt, you either are cleaned by the cleaners or get executed!”
“Then these bastards are…!”
“Yes. They are sinners with Karmic debt. They were cleaned up by the Cleaners of the Divine word!”
The words surprised Hugo, who had been kicking the zombies since they were about to pull his hair. “These are the Evil gods?!”
“No. They are good-natured in comparison, since only the cleaners were mobilized to get rid of them.”
“Good-natured?”
“Yes. Evil gods are gods that have fallen the most. It is laughable to talk about their Karmic debt in comparison. They are the ultimate foes.”
“!”
“These guys can be considered cute in comparison to those bastards. In other words, these guys just committed misdemeanors. The ones who commit felonies fall into the Torture world. The ones considered to be more of a danger to the Divine world are sent to the Samsara Hell, which is managed by Mahabharata. They are executed there and are reincarnated as a different form of life.”
Reincarnation. Hugo furrowed his brows. One of the goddesses of fate had said something similar to him.
“Anyway, that’s why there is a high chance that humans who are either geniuses or possess abilities were gods who had sinned in their past lives.”
“That means….” Hugo was going to ask if this was the case with Zodiac Saints, but he soon became angry. “Hey! Get the hell off my head?!”
Sagittarius had climbed his shoulder to get away from the zombies.
“How long are you going to talk from up there? Why don’t you get down and fight?”
“Why would a pillar god like me fight? I’m a genius and an elite. I don’t do dirty work.”
This angered Hugo. “I coddled you so much that you’re trying to walk all over me!”
“Hmmph. Who cares if I walk over you? What are you going to do about it— Ahhhk!!”
Hugo grabbed Sagittarius like a club and started beating his enemies with him.
Pah-gahk! Pah-gahk!!
“Ahhhk!!”
In the end, Sagittarius cried as he complained about his back pain.
“Anyway, no attacks work on them since they’ve lost their bodies. They also steal the power of the gods! As if they are zombies, their powers get stronger!”
“What?!”
“Basically, they will start trying to steal our bodies!”
“Where’s the exit?!”
“This place is like a trash can where sinners are thrown away! If the exit was so easy to find, they would have escaped a long time ago!”
“It’s fine! I’m confident when it comes to finding things!”
“No. The problem comes after we find it! Only the cleaners can open the door to this place! It means we are forever trapped here!”
Hugo ground his teeth when Sagittarius got to the point.
Koo-goo-goong!
“!!”
Suddenly, the ground shook, and familiar faces fell from the sky.
“Shit! Let go!”
“What the hell? Fighting-type god?!”
“Gun?!”
Lee Gun was choking Set around the neck as they fell from the sky.
They didn’t even have time to be shocked.
Hweek!
Lee Gun threw Set on the ground and landed atop the god.
Koohng!!
The ruthless kick made Set want to die.
This scene left Lee Gun’s Constructs dumbfounded.
“He’s the one who put us in this trash bin, yet he’s here…!”
“Damn it!”
Set looked like he was about to lose his mind as he clutched at his face.
Hugo was moved. “Gun! You came to save us!”
“No. I just wanted to screw this bastard over, so I just brought him here.”
“!?”
Sagittarius seemed baffled that Lee Gun had dragged in someone like Set. Then he laughed. “If he’s here, we don’t have to worry about not being able to leave this place.”
“!”
Like being able to open the lid to a trash can, Set would be able to open the tunnel leading to the earth. However, he was someone who shouldn’t be here.
“Hey! I have to get out of here quickly. I can’t be here!”
“What?”
“I’m the gatekeeper who manages all the doors to the Divine world! If I’m here, all the doors will open from the irregularity! It’ll allow the Cluders and the outer gods to be able to invade the Divine world!”
Set desperately tried to go toward the door that was now closing.
[Descent of the Fighting-type god]
However, Lee Gun immediately activated his ability and kicked Set. Because of the chicken laced with pesticides, which he had eaten earlier, Set wasn’t in top form. He groaned.
“You’re also a fighting-type god, who exists to defend the Divine world! You must know! You know how dangerous it’ll be if the monarchs invade! Do you really not care that the Divine world might get attacked?”
Lee Gun tilted his head. “That has nothing to do with me?”
“What?!”
“In fact, I wouldn’t mind if the Divine world became splintered.”
“…!”
Set glared at him.
“The Divine world has your bitc— Your Zodiac Saint is there! That is why…!”
However, Set trailed off because Lee Gun had a menacing smile on his lips. The fighting-type god suddenly had a realization.
‘This bastard already sent his Zodiac Saint to safety.’
In the end, Set feigned laughter, realizing he wouldn’t be able to escape from this place. “Alright. Do as you please. You guys will rot here.”
He knew where he had sent them.
‘This is the place where “they” took residence.’
There was no way “they” would let Zodiacs and Constructs of this caliber go.
“My god! Look who it is.”
“…!”
“I never would have expected to see a snake god in the flesh.”
Unfamiliar gods revealed themselves as they stepped on the zombie gods having Karmic debt.
‘They are high-rank gods.’
When they approached the group with scary looks in their eyes, Set smiled. “They are my collaborators. They are the butchers that take care of the gods I send down here.”
Sagittarius and the Constructs became vigilant.
“Be careful, Master! They can steal power from the gods!”
“Shit! The Karmic debt gods are in the front, and butcher gods are behind us. We can’t use our abilities in this place…”
“What? Why can’t we use our abilities?”
The Constructs ground their teeth when Hugo posed the question.
“This place is a dumping ground, so it’s forbidden for us to use our abilities here! In other words, anyone who uses their abilities here will incur Karmic Debt!”
It was a system that prevented sinners from running away.
“Basically, we’ll become like those zombie gods!”
“!”
It seemed this was why Sagittarius wasn’t using his skill. However, it wasn’t as if there were no recourse.
“Won’t we be fine if we have the Permission ticket (Exoneration)? Do any of you have it?”
“We gave it all to Master…”
“I used it all.”
“What?!”
The more Permission tickets (Exoneration) one had, the more one could use one’s abilities. This was why these tickets were considered precious items in the Divine world.
Sagittarius massaged his forehead. “Shit! We’ll lose without being able to do anything.”
Finally, the enemies discovered Lee Gun, and they glared at him.
“Snake god! You bastard!”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose when he saw the menacing figures.
Set taunted him. “See. This is the end for you guys. Who told you to open the door to this place? You would have been better off going to the maze. Moreover, they are worked up since they haven’t come across a Zodiac in 1,000 years—”
“Damn it! Why haven’t you changed your clothes yet?”
“You have to quickly make preparations if you want to marry the Great Spirit!!”
“???”
“What the hell are you guys doing? The snake god is here! Bring the food! Open up the path!!”
“????!”
Instead of attacking them with their blades, they ushered Lee Gun away.
Set’s expression was a sight to behold. “Wait a moment! What are you guys doing— Kuh-huhk!”
“Fuck off! Bastard!”
“We have no time to pay attention to you!!”
“Why are you suddenly being like this— Kuhk!”
Set was trampled upon by them.
Hugo reined in his laughter as Set’s partners turned on him. Then, he asked, “Are they from Kunlun?”
“T-They are….”
“Ah! I should have known.”
It seemed the letter sent by Kunlun was real. The gods affiliated with Kunlun prostrated themselves in front of Lee Gun.
“The Great Spirit’s bride has arrived!”
“It’s our madam!”
“Madam!”
“Please come this way! We’ll help you get ready for the marriage ceremony!”
Set looked like he was about to lose his mind, while Lee Gun was also angry. “Crazy bastards.”
The sounds of screams ran out between the cracks in the dimensions.
* * *
Around that time…
“What? Giselle?”
“Yes. It’s Giselle.”
In downtown, Kevin had been killing the straggler monsters when he met Yeonwoo. An unexpected expression appeared on his face when he heard what had happened in the Divine world.
It was to be expected since the Libra Saint, whom they had known, was a lie and that the original owner of the body was alive in the Divine world. Moreover, she had tried to help them even after dying.
“Hmm! I don’t know much about the Libra Saint, but…”
He was sure she had been the daughter of a politician, and she was someone who pursued world peace. She had also shown strong interest in Lee Gun and wanted to sponsor him.
However, then she had suddenly changed from the person that they had first met. This was why everyone thought she had been acting before that.
“Anyway, I have to find her. It’ll allow me to acquire the Rule Book. The one in Gun’s possession is a temporary Rule Book…”
“Won’t the temporary one be enough?”
“Gun won’t be able to stay on the earth long with it. At most, it’ll be a couple of weeks…”
That wasn’t all.
‘He needs the official Rule Book if he wants to protect his body from the Great spirits.’
Like the time when he fought Hercules, the official Rule Book might be used to manipulate Lee Gun’s fate.
“You said the gods came here saying they are Gun’s Constructs, right? I have no idea what they are up to.”
“Understood. I sent a message to my underling. We’ll be able to find them quickly. Also, we are over SS rank. That’s equivalent to the Construct rank. We won’t lose to them.”
They had no idea which gods had come to the earth, but they would carry out their mission until Lee Gun arrived.
Yeonwoo’s face brightened at those words, but…
Kwahng!!!
The building located downtown suddenly blew up, and pandemonium descended into the city.
“…!”
Kevin stopped breathing when an enormous monster appeared before him. His reaction was understandable since he knew his opponent’s rank.
‘Red rank?’
These monsters shouldn’t exist any longer on the earth. The ones who had been a danger from time to time were the devil-like outer gods when they attacked the humans. However, they were different from the monsters.
“Ahhk! Run away!”
“Call for the Zodiac Saints!”
The place became the epicenter of confusion. Kevin called for his Zodiac’s power.
“Shit. That bastard—!”
Kevin had unsheathed his sword, and he was about to attack the monster when…
Tahng!!
“!!”
Someone killed the devil, which was larger than a building. They were none other than angels with wings.
“That is…!”
“Eden!”
Yeonwoo glared at the newcomers.
Eden was one of the eight great forces, and their heavenly army was full of angels.
After they instantly killed the devil, humans appeared on top of the building alongside the angels, causing a commotion among the public.
“Are those the Zodiac Saints?”
“What the hell? None of the S-ranks and above look like them.”
“They are a different group!”
The ones that appeared atop the building were awash with the halo emanating from the angels.
“You guys are being deceived.”
“!”
“The existing twelve Zodiac Saints are trash. We are the Zodiac Saints who will now serve the Zodiac of the earth. We will serve Lee Gun-nim.”
Kevin looked dumbfounded as a new set of twelve Zodiac Saints suddenly made their appearance.
Damn it! What the hell was going on?

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - These Punks (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 375 - These Punks (2)
The Dimensional Crack connected the Divine world with multiple dimensions. Normally, it was a place filled with screams of gods with Karmic debts, who had been eliminated by the fighting-type gods.
However, things were different right now.
“Ahhhk!!”
“Stop it, you bastard!”
“Ahhk! You really are going to kill me! Don’t you know how to respect your elders?”
The gods of Kunlun were screaming.
Lee Gun had taken out the Divine weapon of Life, Heaven’s Punishment, and was ruthlessly cutting down the gods of Kunlun.
Poo-hahk! Poo-hahk!
It wasn’t just that. He stalked those who ran away and played Whack-A-mole as he looked for the gods who ran away and hid in their residences. Ruthlessly destroying their homes, he ripped them apart!
The gods of Kunlun were appalled by his rampage, which was close to being a terroristic activity.
“Hey! Do something about that child!”
“Do something? What if something bad happens to Madam?”
“That’s right! If we injure Madam, Master will kill us!”
“Damn it! He’s the Great Spirit’s bride, so we don’t dare touch him!”
Despite Lee Gun going on a rampage, the gods of Kunlun couldn’t even lift a finger against him, and any attempts to resolve this through words failed.
“Die!!!”
“Ahhk!”
In the end, the gods quickly came up with a different strategy. It was a method that they frequently used during wars to take territory from their foes.
“Change him to a non-fighting god!”
“Drain his power!”
The Taoist gods immediately used their power. A powerful light extended a hundred meters toward the front, inevitably exposing Lee Gun to it.
“!”
[Your fighting ability is vanishing because of the power of the Taoist.]
[The Taoist’s power has transformed you into the Shangri La's contented god of poverty (for 1 hour)]
[You have become a secluded god who loves to be lazy.]
[You have become a god who loves to smell the roses. You have developed the personality of wanting to appreciate the fine arts.]
As the notification rang, a change occurred to Lee Gun’s body.
“Gun!”
A blue light that settled the body and soul surrounded Lee Gun. Lee Gun rubbed his eyes as if his mind was in a fog.
When they realized the power had worked against Lee Gun, the gods of Kunlun let out sighs of relief.
“It worked! Hurry! Take him in!”
“Bring the wedding dress!”
“I’ll bring the groom!”
Bbah-gahk!!!
“Kuh-huhk!”
The god who had gone to get the wedding dress was thrown aside.
At that moment, the gods of Kunlun couldn’t believe their eyes.
Lee Gun had been looking spaced out. He had been rubbing his eyes as if he was sleepy. However, he suddenly started killing the nearby gods as he moved like a drunkard.
Puh-huhk!
Poo-hahk!!
“Kuh-huhk!”
“Die!!”
The gods of Kunlun were dumbfounded.
“He’s supposed to be a god of poverty and happiness, so why is he so violent?!”
“Normally, they stay in place and enjoy the arts. They wallow in sensual pleasures like wine and women!”
When the attribute of poverty and happiness took hold, one usually started enjoying sensual pleasures. So why was he behaving in such a way?!
“Is that how he enjoys the arts?”
“That makes no sense unless he is a psycho!”
On the other hand, Hugo looked on in understanding.
‘Gun did hate his space being invaded the most.’
In fact, Sophie had almost gotten cut in half when she had entered the room where Lee Gun had been sleeping.
Basically, Lee Gun wanted to enjoy himself, yet insects were buzzing around him. This was why he became much more violent. However, that wasn’t important right now.
Puh-huhk!!
“Why the hell did he become stronger when he became a non-fighting-type god?”
“You uncouth— Kuhk!”
Lee Gun was more temperamental as he swung his ax. His mood seemed worse than usual.
The gods of Kunlun groaned as they died.
“Koohk… We prepared a wedding dress for him.”
“Design… Does he not like the design?”
It seemed he was ready to decapitate the gods. Lee Gun raised his ax as he trampled on the gods.
Hugo quickly jumped in to stop him. “Stop, Gun! Nothing good will come if you go any further! It’ll be detrimental to you!”
“!”
When one harmed the gods here, one accumulated Karmic debt. Moreover, Lee Gun would just be making more and more enemies.
Hearing that, Lee Gun thought about what had happened in the Divine world. He immediately agreed with Hugo. “I guess you’re right.”
“Right? That is why—”
“My Death EXP doesn’t rise no matter how many I kill.”
“Huh?”
“Ah! I can’t lose EXP like this. I have to torture them while I keep them alive.”
“Wait a moment!!”
The next moment, a fierce green light surged forward from Lee Gun, and screams rang out.
[All Creation Revival (Life stage 5)]
[Pain Revival (Life stage 2)]
[Pain Creation (Life stage 3)]
…
[All Creation Revival (Life stage 5)]
The fierce light of Life continued to flash with the Dimensional Crack.
Cycle could be activated only if the EXP of both Life and Death reached 100%. One also had to hit the growth requirements. This was why working on the EXP was a must.
A long time passed like this.
[Life EXP is 96% filled.]
[When it reaches 100%, you will be able to use Cycle.]
Lee Gun tapped his shoulder as if it was stiff. “Alright. The EXP will no longer go up.”
“D-Damn it. Why does the Great Spirit have such taste… No, why did he change like this?”
The old gods of Kunlun spoke in agony.
“Oh, Great Spirit! Why would you choose such a god? You’ll have your junior cut off before you can spend a night together.”
However, Lee Gun didn’t care as he grabbed the grandfather-looking Taoist god by the back of his neck. It seemed he had spared them on purpose. “Lead the way. How do I get to the earth?”
“Snake god! You should be kind and soft to the Great Spirit, who will become your husband!”
Lee Gun became angry, and he tried to crush the old god.
[What are you guys doing? Why is it taking so long?]
“!!”
An unfamiliar voice could be heard as warm light fell from the sky. At the same time, a goddess wearing fluttering beautiful silk clothes appeared.
The gods of Kunlun quickly lowered their heads at her appearance, while Sagittarius’s mouth fell open.
She was in her incarnate form, but there was no mistaking her.
‘She is the mother god of Kunlun!’
Kunlun was known as the faction with the most members and wealth. Moreover, this goddess was a high-rank god who possessed as much power as the Great Spirit.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose as he looked at her.
[Divine name: Master of the Taoist gods]
[Divine status: Xiwangmu]
The goddess immediately realized what had happened when she saw the scene in front of her. She looked at Lee Gun as she spoke.
[Oh, snake god! What don’t you like that you continue to refuse the sincerity of Kunlun?]
She was asking him what was wrong.
“Do you need a beating to find out?”
However, the goddess merely smiled.
[Over half of the gods of the Divine world follow Kunlun. That endless number of gods will all become your servants. What more do you want?]
“Fuck off or I’ll bring you guys down like Olympus! I have no business with you guys.”
When she realized he was being serious, the goddess let out a sigh.
[If possible, we want a happy marriage. However, we cannot give up on this arrangement.]
“What?”
[You took Pushover, whom we won in the auction.]
“!”
Hugo flinched. Now that he thought about it, Kunlun was the one to bid for him at the auction. They had used sheer amounts of wealth. That wasn’t all.
- Ho ho ho. Your face is decent, and your powers are useful. I’ll make you my 19,788th husband.
Someone from Kunlun had tried to take him away as she said that!
The goddess continued.
[Thanks to you disappearing, the young sister of the Great Spirit is still crying. Do you realize how sad she was? It seemed she really fancied him.]
Lee Gun cackled when he heard this. “What the hell? You were about to be sold to such a distinguished being. You must regret it. Do you want to go back? It isn’t too late.”
“You can get sold, bastard!” Hugo glared at Lee Gun.
The goddess was oblivious to this exchange. She merely clicked her tongue as she spoke.
[Moreover, there was the incident with Taishang Laojun, the elder god of Kunlun.]
“Tai… What?”
[I’m talking about the elder who you beat up like a dog at the boat party. You even hung him up, Snake god.]
“Ah….”
Lee Gun had beaten up so many gods that he had no idea who it was, but he did have a passing memory of beating up someone like that. He didn’t know what that god did for a living, but it seemed he was a personage of a high position. He probably was a sifu.
The goddess let out a beautiful yet cold smile.
[We have our honor to uphold. After losing Pushover, there is no way we will give up even if there are problems with this marriage!]
“What do you expect me to do?”
[Think about it. It’ll be hard for you to save the earth even if you go right now. A Great Spirit will dote on you, so why would you want to go to a colony dimension like that?]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he tilted his head in puzzlement. He had heard gods claiming to be his Constructs had appeared on the earth, yet the goddess’s words got on his nerves for some reason.
The goddess wouldn’t say such words if it was a simple case where imposters had appeared on earth.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he tried to feel her out. “What is going on over there?”
[One of the eight great forces went there.]
Lee Gun laughed as he tried to get more out of her. “If they went to the earth, they are in their incarnate forms. They will be Constructs. My Zodiac Saints can easily take care of them.”
[I’m not so sure. Among the eight great factions, there is one whose gods choose to become Constructs.]
“!”
[Basically, they reject the title of being Zodiacs. Their father, who’s their Great Spirit, is the one and only Zodiac. This is why there is no restriction for them when it comes to moving between dimensions.]
Sagittarius flinched. Did the army of Eden go to the earth? That would be troublesome.
Zodiacs suffered penalties when they headed toward a colony dimension. The penalty stopped them from using their full power. That was the law of the gods engraved within the Rule Book.
