Moreover, Zodiacs could mess up with and destroy the environment of the colony dimension. This was why they weren’t supposed to exit the Divine world.
If Zodiacs ignored the rule and descended to the colony dimension, a formidable rule of the Divine world would go into effect.
‘The god under the penalty will die.’
This was why they had to go in their incarnate forms, which were like their clones.
The rules of the Divine world made a distinction depending on the rank of the ruler. It separated the strong. However, this wasn’t the case with Constructs. They were not Zodiacs.
‘They can head toward the colony dimension with their power intact.’
Zodiacs used Constructs to conduct their wars for a reason. There was great benefit if all Zodiac rank and high-rank gods could go to the colony dimension as Constructs.
Eden was the only faction that could do this because it was structured in a way that it had only one god.
‘If I had to make an extreme comparison, it’s like several thousand monarch-rank beings appearing on the earth.’
In fact, the ones who held the upper hand in the war to take colony dimensions were Eden. In other words, they had rescinded their rights to be Zodiacs to pursue power.
‘Why would Eden go to a place like the earth?’
Those angels were known to be picky and elitist in their taste. Well, it didn’t matter.
“Bastards.”
Hugo flinched when he heard the word spoken under his breath.
It seemed the goddess was offended by Lee Gun’s rejection. The greatest goddess of Kunlun menacingly spoke.
[If you still don’t want to come—]
“Ok. I’ll agree to the marriage.”
[!!]
“?!”
The ones to be surprised the most were Hugo and the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer.
“Gun?!”
“Master!”
Lee Gun smirked.
Taken aback, Hugo looked at Lee Gun. However, a peculiar smile hung on Lee Gun’s lips.
After realizing who had gone to the earth, Lee Gun had developed an objective.
‘I’ll have to bring that from Kunlun.’
Lee Gun laughed as he spoke. “I’ll marry the Great Spirit of Kunlun. In return, I expect you guys to prepare an ample amount of dowry. Do I need to prepare anything?”
At Lee Gun’s nonchalant words, Hugo’s mouth fell open in dismay. On the other hand, the gods of Kunlun started cheering.
“The Great Spirit will be happy!!”
“We did it!!”
The goddess was also happy.
[I’ll send my subordinate to guide you.]
“Alright. I’ll make preparations too.”
The flustered Hugo quickly grabbed Lee Gun as if to ask what Lee Gun was thinking.
On the other hand, Sagittarius was happy. He was even clapping. “Oh, man! I will become an in-law to the wealthiest faction of the Divine world! Congrats, Nephew!”
“Haha! What are you talking about?”
“What?”
Lee Gun grabbed Sagittarius and coldly whispered into his ear. “I’m not the one getting married. You are.”
What the hell did he just say?!

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - These Punks (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 376 - These Punks (3)
“Damn it! Really!” Sagittarius screamed.
Lee Gun had grabbed him from behind.
On the other side, Hugo had his bow drawn. Hugo felt uncomfortable at the idea of shooting Sagittarius, so he glanced at his friend.
Seeing Hugo being indecisive, Lee Gun said as if to ask what he was doing, “It’s alright. He won’t die. Hurry up and shoot him.”
“No!”
Sagittarius was going to be transformed into his nephew through Hugo’s arrow of beauty. The god of the sun looked at Lee Gun to ask him to stop all of this.
He had indeed committed wrongs against his nephew. Moreover, Lee Gun was the head god of the thirteenth Zodiacs. Still, there were things that one didn’t do.
“I can’t believe you’re thinking about selling me off to Kunlun! That’s nonsense!”
Yes, Lee Gun had whispered words that Sagittarius couldn’t comprehend. Then he had dragged Sagittarius away, saying Sagittarius had to prepare himself to go to Kunlun.
Lee Gun told Hugo to use his power of beauty. It was the same concept as that of turning the goddesses of fate into ally dolls.
After changing the god of the sun into a version of himself, Lee Gun probably planned on handing him over as the bride of Kunlun.
Sagittarius might have had a shot at escaping if he were a god right now, but he was in human form. He was lacking in power compared to Lee Gun.
Therefore, Sagittarius grabbed Lee Gun and sincerely said, “I’m sorry for the wrongs I did you, Nephew. Let’s just let the past be bygones.”
Sagittarius had cheated Lee Gun out of a lot of the repair fees. Since Lee Gun didn’t have a Zodiac, Sagittarius had cheated Lee Gun a little(?). He had sold Lee Gun holy items, claiming they would increase his fighting ability.
“I am your uncle, Nephew!”
“I know. That’s why I want you to go have a happy life in Kunlun.” Lee Gun let out a bright smile, and Sagittarius felt like dying.
Lee Gun’s Constructs were sweating.
‘Sagittarius is famous in the Divine world, yet he is…!’
‘He’s known as the White Reaper and is ranked highly amongst the Divine world’s ranking…!’
There was a reason the Great Spirits of various factions ground their teeth when it came to him. He was a god with dignity…
“Nephew, let this one slide just this once!!”
Cold sweats ran down the Constructs when they saw Sagittarius helpless before Lee Gun.
At that moment, Sagittarius became serious. It was like the time with Ennead. He wouldn’t survive if he was sold to Kunlun.
‘There is no way they'll let me be.’
No other god in the Divine world had as many enemies as Sagittarius had.
“Also, do you realize what kind of place Kunlun is? Do you realize why the Great Spirit has 13,887 brides? Do you know why his younger sister has 19,787 husbands?”
“They are degenerates?”
“No! Eighty percent of them die! Most of them die on the first night!”
“!”
Hugo’s eyes turned round as his bow remained drawn.
Desperate, Sagittarius grabbed Lee Gun’s shoulders. “It doesn't matter which faction they come from. They all die for some reason. Of course, I have an idea why.”
“What happens?”
“They have their yin and yang sucked away. Anyway, a marriage to them is a death sentence!”
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. He scoffed. “Why do you want me getting married if it’s certain death?”
“You’re a god of Life. Of course, you will survive!”
“Right. You are the god of the sun, which never extinguishes. You’ll live too.”
“Damn it!”
Of course, 99.9% of the reason Lee Gun was doing this was torturing Sagittarius, but his eyes became serious. “I heard you stole something from the Great Spirit of Ennead.”
“!”
“I want you to steal something from Kunlun, something I want.”
Sagittarius flinched when he heard what it was. Why did Lee Gun want him to bring that of all things?
“Of course, Kunlun is rich, so it’ll be great if you steal their money too.”
Sagittarius was dismayed. “Do you really think that the Great Spirit and Xiwangmu will fall for it?”
They ruled over thousands of Zodiacs for a reason. While their smiling faces looked innocent enough, there was a venomous streak within them. One couldn’t tell how deep it went.
“Moreover, Kunlun is very cruel. If I get caught, they’ll really kill me…”
However, Lee Gun smiled as if he didn’t care. “Fuck off! I have a way that’ll make it so that they won’t find out.”
“What?”
Lee Gun immediately placed a hand on his body and activated his ability.
[Material Creation (Life 3 star)]
A blinding light flashed, and Lee Gun made the same clothes that he was wearing. He had cloned them. Then he activated his next ability.
[Creation Workshop (Creator 1 star)]
A light appeared beneath his feet.
Hugo’s eyes turned round, the reason being the magic circle of the Serpent Bearer temple, which always appeared when the Creation Workshop was activated; the shape of the magic circle had changed.
Normally, in the symbol, three snakes intertwined with each other, and two of them looked like they were guarding the remaining snake. However, it was different now.
‘There are only two snakes.’
Its shape reminded him of Cycle. It seemed like instead of one of the three snakes disappearing, the snakes had evolved.
‘Now that I think about it, Gun did say his abilities re-awakened after he arrived in the Divine world.’
Skill was a form of technique, and ability was something only gods possessed. This was merely a guess, but this shape signified the god of Cycle.
‘Does that mean those snakes will evolve into one?’
[You have passed on data from the Creation Workshop.]
[Personal characteristics (Freak Genius) have been used. It has allowed you to add attributes to the armor.]
[No one will notice (EX)]
- Manufacturer: Lee Gun
- Armor Type (Defense SSS)
- The data of Confusion and Oblivion has been used. It confuses your opponent’s awareness.
- Additional function granted: Makes one look alluring
Finally, Lee Gun handed over the completed clothes to Sagittarius. “That lecher won’t notice if you use these. Mmm. I haven’t tested them, so it’s a maybe.”
“!!”
This bastard was really planning on selling his uncle to Kunlun!
“Ah! Let me give you a warning. You must never take them off. It’ll all be for nothing even if a bit of the clothes come off. That’s why you should protect your chastity.”
“#$*$#&*!” Sagittarius grabbed the back of his neck. If he knew all of this, why the hell did he add a function that made one look alluring?
Lee Gun was a god of technique and a Creator. The special attribute of the Creators was Creation, and in the case of Lee Gun, that power became abundant when used on equipment.
The item was probably 100% effective, but…!
“You should have added an attribute of revulsion instead! It’s a problem if he recognizes me, and it would also be a problem if he doesn’t recognize me!”
“I don’t care what happens to you after you are sold off!”
“?!”
Lee Gun laughed as he grabbed Sagittarius’s hand. “Since I’m sorry, I’ll give you a gift.”
“!”
Sagittarius’s face stiffened when he saw the bottle in his hand.
[Fast Hair growth solution (EX)]
- Hair loss healing elixir made using Super Regeneration and the drug-making ability of Aquarius
- In just three days, your hair will grow plentiful.
“…”
“Have a nice life. When you divorce him, you should take all of his wealth as alimony. However, it is up to you to protect your chastity.”
Sagittarius let out a soundless scream.
* * *
The Peach Blossom Spring, far away from the Dimensional Crack.
Xiwangmu and the Constructs of Kunlun, who had been looking over Lee Gun, inwardly let out sighs of relief.
“Thankfully, the snake god agreed to come over to Kunlun.”
“Are you sure this will be fine?”
They had heard the rumors going around the civil servants.
“From what I heard, the ranking hasn’t been refreshed yet, but the snake god’s ranking isn't what it’s right now. You must know what that means…”
This made Xiwangmu laugh.
“It might be higher than expected. He might still be getting stronger by the time the ranking is renewed.”
“What?! It’ll go up more?!”
They looked at Xiwangmu, having no idea what she was thinking.
Xiwangmu let out a beautiful smile. “There is a chance he’ll get evaluated highly if you consider his Divine status.”
“What do you mean…”
“He possesses the power of the Primordial god.”
“!”
The complexion on the Constructs’ faces immediately changed. The Primordial god was the king of gods. The Divine statues the Primordial god possessed were used to create the Divine world. It was a power that existed since the start of creation and a source of power for the universe.
Xiwangmu let out a meaningful smile. “The Great Spirit of Kunlun is the same. Like the snake god, he possesses one of the powers of the Primordial god. What do you think will come out if our Divine status is combined with his?”
“That’s the reason behind the marriage…”
Xiwangmu laughed.
‘Of course, the Great Spirit does fancy the snake god. It’s probably 90% of the reason. However, it doesn’t matter.’
Though, she was worried about Hugo, whom the snake god kept near him. Hugo was the Construct that Kunlun had won through a successful bid.
While the 600% Faith was tempting, she had found it odd that Valhalla wanted him as well. This was why Kunlun had overwhelmed the auction from the start.
‘His identity bothers me.’
“If the snake dies when he meets the Great Spirit, we’ll just take his Divine status. If he survives, it’ll be important to get a baby god from the union.”
“However, the younger sister of the Great Spirit seems to be greatly interested in the snake god. She said he’s cool…”
Xiwangmu smiled. “It doesn’t matter if the Great Spirit takes the snake god as his bride or his younger sister takes him as a husband. It doesn’t matter.”
“That means….”
“I want you to make preparations to send the snake god as a husband to the younger sister.”
“What should we do with the rest?”
The goddess smiled brightly as she spoke.
* * *
“Ohh!”
The Constructs of Kunlun showed admiration when Lee Gun’s party made their appearance.
“Oh! That’s a great Divine item! I’m sure it’s worth a lot!”
Lee Gun and his constructs had shown up, holding a fancy palanquin.
“Let’s depart.”
Cuss words could be heard coming from the palanquin.
“No. Don’t depart— Koohk!”
Lee Gun kicked the palanquin.
Inside the palanquin was Sagittarius, covered with a thick veil and cloth. The cloth encased him from head to toe. He was unrecognizable and felt like dying.
The reason was what Lee Gun had said.
[I want you to steal the Heavenly Peach from Kunlun. I heard it’s loathed in the Great Spirit’s garden.]
Lee Gun had been aiming for the peach from the start.
[Eden or whatever went to the earth. I’m sure I’ll have to use Cycle. You’re already aware of this. It takes a really long time to raise the EXP of Life.]
He could raise Death through indiscriminate killing.
[Anyway, Kunlun’s Heavenly Peach is a Divine item that can raise the power of Life by a lot.]
It would allow Lee Gun to quickly fill up the requirement needed to use Cycle. Still, this was too much!
‘It’s a precious treasure. There is only one!’
Hugo whispered to Lee Gun. They didn’t care if Sagittarius was suffering or not. “Thankfully, they didn’t notice. If we’re lucky, the Great Spirit won’t notice either.”
Lee Gun laughed. He had made sure to clone Sagittarius’s Divine status. Either he could use it on the earth, or he could give it to Hugo.
Soon, Lee Gun said, “As promised, you’ll give us the location of the exit leading to the earth. We’ll also take the wedding present here.”
“Yes. Here it is. However, we must do something before that.”
The Constructs of Kunlun had been looking at the treasures behind their backs, and peculiar smiles suddenly appeared on their lips.
“Aside from the snake god, we’ll process the others according to the rules.”
The Constructs of Kunlun surrounded Lee Gun’s party.
‘!’
When Lee Gun and his party wondered what they were doing, the Constructs of Kunlun laughed as if it was no big deal.
“Do not worry! Aside from the snake god, all his Constructs will be transferred over to our side.”
“!”
“This is in case the bride changes his mind.”
“That’s right. He might be aiming for the Great Spirit’s wealth. What if he runs away with it?”
An enormous light surged up from the ground. Sagittarius, who was within the palanquin, was surprised to see chains.
‘This is Kunlun’s Construct Transfer!!’
It forcefully bound the soul to change the affiliation of the Constructs! In other words, they would become slaves of Kunlun! It was why a high proportion of the gods were affiliated under Kunlun.
This power encroached upon everyone, including Sagittarius.
‘Shit! This is dangerous!’
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. At that moment…
[The snake god is my prey, insolent fools!!!]
Kwahng!!
The ground exploded, accompanied by a familiar voice. Menacing eyes appeared from the shadows of the Kunlun gods.
The gods were shocked.
“That bastard is…!”
“Abyss!!”
The gods of Kunlun were in a state of turmoil at the sudden appearance of a monarch. This monarch was one of the leaders of the Cluders! It considered gods food!
“Bastard! It was said that you were hiding within the Divine world! You were here!”
[I can be anywhere. I can hide anywhere. I just need evil intent.]
“…!”
Abyss’s eyes flashed within the shadows.
[How dare Kunlun lay hands on my prey! You have guts!!]
Abyss would rather take Lee Gun for itself if he was being sent to Kunlun. The monarch’s shadow encircled the palanquin.
The gods of Kunlun flinched.
“No! He took the bride of the Great Spirit!”
“Hurry up and save the snake god!”
When the palanquin was lifted into the air, the gods of Kunlun yelled out in desperation.
“Snake god! What are you doing? Hurry up and exit the palanquin!”
Sagittarius, who was within the palanquin, felt like dying.
‘Shit! I’ll die if I get to Kunlun. However, nothing will be left of me if I follow the monarch!’
In the end, Sagittarius was going to ask for help from Lee Gun, so he was about to open the door.
“?!”
However, Lee Gun and Hugo were missing from the scene of pandemonium. Moreover, they had taken all the wedding gifts Kunlun gave in exchange for the bride!!
‘Ahhk! They ran away without me!!’
Koo-goo-goong!
Abyss swallowed Lee Gun and the palanquin. No, it swallowed Sagittarius.
“!!”
The gods of Kunlun were shocked and dismayed. Then their eyes flashed with anger.
“That bastard!”
“Call for the Great Spirit and all his troops!”
“Chase it! This is war!!”
* * *
Lee Gun’s party had stolen all the items brought by Kunlun, and they were currently screaming. One of the items that Lee Gun had run away with was the Pathfinder (Teleportation) Box, and he had activated it.
The box suddenly changed into a large toad, and the toad swallowed the entire party. It was unclear as to how much time had passed.
Ptooey!
The toad spat out Lee Gun’s party when it arrived at the destination. Lee Gun’s party fell atop an enormous door.
Koohng!!
The door was like the ground where one couldn’t see the end. It was a steel door with a large symbol engraved on it.
[Door connected to the earth!]
The continent that they were standing on was practically the door. It was overwhelmingly massive.
Hugo tried to open the firmly shut door using his strength. “It isn’t budging at all…!!”
The toad changed back into a small box. Lee Gun put it away and gestured with his hand. He was telling them to move. “Get out of the way.”
“Are you going to break it?!”
“Why would I do that?”
Lee Gun laughed as he took out Set from the toad. “Open the door.”
“Kuh-huhk! Stop! Kuhk!”
Lee Gun choked Set, and the latter had to use his ability. Then, light exploded forth from the door.
After forcing Set to open the door, Lee Gun approached the crack in the door. He grabbed the firmly shut door and pulled on it using his strength. Then something surprising happened.
Doo-doo-doohk!
The door that hadn’t budged at all started to open. The earth could be seen through the opened crack.

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - Master! (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 377 - Master! (1)
“What?! Kunlun decided to take in the snake god as a bride!”
The Divine world was turned on its head.
Many gods had been about to head toward the earth under orders. However, they then heard the news that Kunlun had made ties with the snake god.
“Does that mean we have to cancel our plans to turn the earth into a colony?”
Gods were beings who managed all lands as colonies. Colonies were equivalent to their powers. The earth was a land filled with high-quality disciples. Therefore, the gods would never leave this land alone.
The system was set up in such a way that gods kept stealing colonies from each other. However, the earth was the snake god’s colony.
“If there is a marriage alliance with Kunlun, we’ll be antagonizing Kunlun!”
“The earth will then be possessed by Kunlun.”
“…!!”
Was Kunlun trying to take earth through such a method?!
“With the snake god’s ranking in mind, it would be better for him to be absorbed into Kunlun—”
At that moment…
“Hey! Did you see it?!”
“See what?”
“The Zodiac ranking!”
“What about the Zodiac Ranking?”
Several gods flinched when they heard the conversation about the ranking. They were the ones who had heard about it beforehand from the civil servants. They knew about Lee Gun’s ranking.
‘I have no idea why he was designated as a pillar god rank by the Divine world.’
‘He’s considered to be the top amongst the pillar gods.’
The ranking had been released to the public. This could shock everyone. Rumors could be started that the snake god was a Great Spirit-rank being. It’d be like the past, where the ninth great faction might be formed.
The gods who knew this immediately spoke up.
“He was lucky. He acquired the power of Cycle.”
It meant the snake god had risen above the other pillar gods only because of his Divine status, which had belonged to the King of the Gods.
“Anyway, there is no reason why he should be ranked higher. At best, he’s at the pillar god rank—”
The gods screamed when they saw the newly updated display.
“What the hell?”
They rubbed their eyes when they saw the figure that had moved up.
***
Oohng oohng!
An enormous whirlpool of light swirled underneath the door. The whirlpool was a connection tunnel, which was connected to the earth!
It was like looking into the eye of a storm. Hugo blanched at the sight.
‘I’m glad I left my daughter in Virgo’s care!’
Although Hugo didn’t remember everything about Yooha, she was his precious daughter. He didn’t want her to travel using a tunnel that looked like a meat grinder!
After the door had been opened, he had seen objects get shredded to pieces while they were swept into the whirlpool. Hugo almost cursed.
Lee Gun didn’t seem to mind. Limbering up his body, he said, “What are you doing? Why aren’t you jumping in?”
“Jump… You really want to use this tunnel?! Just touching it might kill us!”
“It’s fine. If you turn into chunks of meat, I’ll piece you back together.”
“#*$&*!” Hugo regretted rejecting Virgo’s offer to sneak him out and not exiting via the safe route, like Yooha.
‘Or maybe I should have gone with Hailey, who went to see Scorpio.’
Lee Gun snorted as if he read Hugo’s thoughts. “If you went to meet the Scorpio, you would’ve been eaten. A hundred percent.”
“What? Why?”
Lee Gun scoffed as if he couldn’t believe Hugo was unaware of it. “You didn’t notice it while you were next to Hailey?”
“What?”
“Scorpio, who protects Hailey, wants you dead.”
“????”
Hugo looked at Lee Gun as if he was spouting nonsense. “You must be mistaken.”
“Are you discounting what I saw?”
Lee Gun had seen it for himself. When he had been on the earth, gods existed far away, so he hadn’t been sure. However, now that he had visited the headquarters of the gods, he had a different opinion.
‘Scorpio looked at Hugo as if he was a mortal enemy.’
Unlike the other Zodiacs, Scorpio never appeared in front of Lee Gun while Hugo was by his side.
It also seemed Scorpio disliked Sagittarius. This was especially evident when Taeksoo had come back from the goddesses of fate.
The only thing that happened to Taeksoo is that he had swallowed a Divine status. This was why Hugo was that much more mystified.
Lee Gun had a passing suspicion that Hugo was hated, but what had he actually done to the Scorpio to deserve the threat of death?
Lee Gun clicked his tongue when he saw Hugo’s expression. “You probably caused an accident while I was gone.”
“I didn’t!”
Scorpio had been like a benefactor to him. Why would he cause trouble for Scorpio? In fact, he should have been nice to Scorpio!
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “Or it might be something obvious.”
“Obvious?”
“While I was gone, you were dumb enough to get bullied by the twelve Zodiac Saints, and if that’s not bad enough, a hospital was rented out for Miss Jiwoo for over ten years. It might have to do with Hailey… What if it doesn’t like you since you were a bother to its Zodiac Saint?”
Hugo wondered if a god was really that petty, but then he was reminded of Sagittarius. There was no rule that prevented a god from being petty.
‘However, putting Scorpio on the same level as Sagittarius is a disservice.’
So what had caused it?
‘Did I commit a faux pas?’
It didn’t matter in the end.
“That’s why you should stop complaining and follow me. You’re the safest by my side.”
“…”
Lee Gun said it while laughing, but Hugo's expression soured. “You might try to act cool, but it’s obvious. You’re telling me to follow you so that you can fill up your Divine power.”
As if he felt a bit guilty, Lee Gun’s eyebrows twitched. However, he soon kicked Hugo. “Whatever. Go in, asshole!”
“Ahhk!”
Receiving a ruthless kick, Hugo fell toward the light that looked like a meat grinder. He screamed like Tarzan as the light swept him up. Lee Gun followed him.
A dizzying wave hit them. The flow was repetitive and constant.
Hugo was in so much pain that he found it hard to breathe. At that moment, he thought about his beautiful daughter. If the daughter he loved so much were here, she would have told off the mean Lee Gun for him.
Some time passed like that.
Boom! Boom!
“Kuh-huhk!”
They were dropped off somewhere. Hugo groaned as he got up. Then they heard a familiar voice.
[You have returned to the earth.]
[While you passed through the Dimensional crack, a time difference has formed.]
Time difference? Hugo looked at his surroundings as he asked, “How much time difference is it, Gun?”
“Who cares? Where the hell did we fall?”
They had come to consciousness within a building, and they could hear the sound of a crowd outside.
“It looks like a museum….”
There was no mistaking that. It was unclear as to which country this was, but they could see exhibits and signs. This was clearly…
“Isn’t this your museum, Gun?”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round. Now that it was mentioned, he saw his pictures and items all over the place. There was even a life-sized wax figure.
Moreover, it wasn’t just the picture before his return, when he looked like an orc. The pictures of him after his return were here too.
He knew the Zodiac Saints had museums in various countries, but from what he remembered, he didn’t have his own museum.
“What the hell? Does that mean it was built while I was gone?”
“You must be loving it? This is almost on the same level as the Louvre museum.”
Lee Gun always talked about wanting a museum. Now that his friend’s wish was granted, Hugo smirked as he said, “It means a couple of years passed at the very least. There is no way a museum of this size could have been constructed in a couple of months.”
While looking at his surroundings, Hugo seemed to have located something. He laughed. “Look here.”
He found a ticket from the merchandise store. As if to confirm admission, the ticket had a stamp. The date was printed there.
[2044]
“Twenty years have passed.”
“What? Twenty years?”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “Tsk. Do I have to use the Time ability?”
“Wait a moment. You might incur Karmic debt if you use the Time ability. Your Construct went to get the Permission Ticket (Exoneration). Just wait a bit.”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows at those words. “Why are you so excited?”
“Isn’t it obvious? I’ll get to see your kids here!”
“What??”
“Why not! If twenty years passed, you’re probably married. You’ll have a wife!”
“…!”
Enough time had passed for this to be possible. The past and the present were connected.
While Lee Gun might have been oblivious and had no interest in a woman, twenty years would be enough for him to have a wife. There was a chance that he had kids!
‘Who became Gun’s wife?’
That was Hugo’s main interest.
Although Hugo was curious about his own family, he was the most interested in Lee Gun’s family.
“Is it Miss Yeonwoo or Hailey?!”
“W-What?”
“Who do you like more?”
“What the hell are you—”
“What? Is there a third candidate?!”
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold.
Dying from curiosity, Hugo turned around. “It’s fine. I’ll find it out myself.”
“Hey!”
Who was Lee Gun’s wife? Did he have a child? Was it a daughter or a son?
“I’m sure of it. His children will be like mine. They’ll praise and follow their Uncle Hugo.” Hugo spoke of his dream scenario as he tried to exit the museum.
Of course, he took a Lee Gun key chain from the merchandise and filled his pocket with other goods.
“From the language used in the museum, this place seems to be Europe… We should head toward Kevin.”
“Are you sure this is a museum? Why are there no people within the museum?”
“It must be because they haven’t opened it yet. Can you hear the voices outside?”
Lee Gun dubiously looked outside, but it did seem like voices could be heard from outside…
‘What is that energy….’
“Let’s go.”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “Hey, we aren’t from this era. Should we do nothing before we head back to our time?”
It was only twenty years. There couldn’t have been too much change. They were gods.
“What if someone recognizes us….”
“Alright. I’ll go right after we see your wife.” Hugo spoke as he picked up an orc-like mask of Lee Gun from the merchandise store.
Lee Gun looked dumbfounded, but Hugo spoke as he opened the door. “I don’t know which country this is, but I bet it’s full of people wanting to see you—”
As soon as they exited through the door, their faces hardened.
“That’s…!”
Everyone was dead outside. That wasn’t all.
“Gun! Look at those vines!”
Unknown vines surrounded the museum.
‘The vines are alive.’
When they cut down the vines, they realized the truth.
“These bastards are the ones making the human voices!”
There was no mistaking it.
‘They are mimicking the voices of the humans that they have eaten.’
The situation outside the museum of Lee Gun was horrifying. It was as if a monster had appeared outside, and people had run away to live. As if this place was the last beacon of their hope, people had gathered here. It was like people heading toward a church or shrine for refuge.
It didn’t matter which monster had invaded, Lee Gun always made everyone feel that they would make it out alive. That was why those people had come here looking for Lee Gun.
In fact, a dead child was clutching a figurine of Lee Gun.
Hugo looked at the dead child with pity.
‘They’ve been dead for more than a couple of days.’
At the very least, the bodies had been left like this for several years. The unknown vines were the only reason they hadn’t become skeletons yet.
Hugo quickly exited the museum. Corpses were strewn everywhere, and a city in ruin could be seen. It almost looked haunted.
‘I don’t sense any life.’
The earth had been wiped out.
It didn’t take them long to figure out the identity of the plant.
‘This is an item of the Divine world.’
What if they were truly in the future? It meant…
‘In just twenty years, humanity was wiped out?’
The unknown plant seemed to be the culprit.
When Hugo realized this, he was about to say something.
Flash!
However, a never-before-seen power emanated from Lee Gun’s body.
“Gun!”
This wasn’t the power of Death or Life.
‘Is it his power as a Creator?’
The power started imbuing new life into the ruined buildings. The grass killed by the gods grew again. The water evaporated by the sun started coming back in an instant.
Surprised, Hugo continued to watch this.
With an angry expression, Lee Gun said, “Hey. I know what the future is like. Let’s head back to our original time.“O-Ok.”
This was the future that would happen if they weren’t present on the earth. It seemed the future had unfolded this way because they were trapped within the Dimensional crack.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed in anger. “I went through so much trying to keep the earth alive.”
The unknown civilization had invaded the earth, and he had protected his planet even as his body was destroyed. As if to make things worse, he had been betrayed by the gods and Zodiac Saints, and he had rotted away inside the tower. When he came back alive, he had eradicated all the monsters at the source.
He had thought he wouldn’t have to deal with the gods once he left the Divine world.
“Those bastards killed what I saved?”
This drove Lee Gun nuts, and he immediately used his power.
Flash!
[You used the power of Time, which you have brought.]
The power of Time could mess with the order of the universe. Unlike the renegades such as the monarchs, gods were rulers. They ruled over the residents of the colonies, so their powers came with responsibility. They couldn’t use powerful abilities at will.
[Master! We scraped together all the Permission Tickets (Exoneration) we stole from Kunlun!]
[You can use that power!]
His Constructs took out the Permission Tickets from the bag containing Kunlun’s wedding presents(?).
When Lee Gun grabbed them, light exploded forth.
[You have used the Permission Tickets stolen from Kunlun. You will go back in time as far as possible.]
The visions of Hugo and Lee Gun shifted.
“Kuhk!”
They fell in the same location, but there were no museums this time. They saw only a large plot of land, where construction was being planned.
At that moment…
“Kyahhk! Lee Gun-nim!”
“!!”
“Lee Gun-nim!!!”
“Wait a moment! That’s Lee Gun!”
The ruckus from a large crowd reached their ears. The people walking down the street were shocked when they recognized Lee Gun. Hearing that Lee Gun was here, a crowd rushed toward him. Of course, the crowd brought out their cameras and phones.
“Are we sure this isn’t a Lee Gun impersonator?”
“Lee Gun-nim!!”
Hugo, who had been next to Lee Gun, was pushed away by the ground. He felt aggrieved. “We seem to have come to the right time, but why do they recognize only you? What about me??”
“Why else? It’s the difference in the faith and the good deeds I did.”
“What?!”
In truth, it was because Hugo was still in his spirit state.
‘My phone works now.’
Lee Gun took out his phone, and he saw that it had a signal. He laughed.
[Roaming (+Paris)]
[11/09/2026, 1:15 PM]
‘I guess around half a year has passed.’
That should be enough.
“He cut it a bit close, but this is fine. We came back before your third child is born.”
“What??”
“Anyway, I don’t have any money right now. Let’s summon the nearest Zodiac Saint, and let’s get going.”
Lee Gun used his phone. He was about to call his subordinates when cheers erupted among the crowd, and a familiar phrase reached Lee Gun’s ears.
“Uh! It’s the Zodiac Saints!”
“They must have come here after hearing the news about Lee Gun-nim”
Lee Gun and Hugo snorted. Only a few Zodiac Saints were left, yet to their credit, they had come knowing Lee Gun had returned.
“What has gotten into you guys? You came promptly—”
However, odd expressions appeared on their faces when the two of them turned their heads.
“Welcome, our Zodiac. Welcome, our master.”
“The Zodiac Saints greet the great master for the first time!”
“!”
The ones who had shown up weren’t Stevens and Kevin. Moreover, these newcomers’ words were unexpected.
“Please do not be surprised. We are the new thirteen Zodiac Saints, who serve the Serpent Bearer.”
“Thirteen Zodiac Saints?”
“Yes! Kevin-nim and Stevens-nim, whom you are looking for, have passed away. When the other remaining Zodiac Saints left, we took their seats.”
“It’s an honor to meet Lee Gun-nim in the flesh!”
“…?”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose when he saw them. What the hell were these guys?

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - Master! (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 378 - Master! (2)
Who the hell were these bastards?
The dumbfounded Lee Gun and Hugo looked at the group in front of them.
The ones to greet them were a group of around three people, with their ages varying greatly.
One of them was a girl who looked to be in middle school, and another was a man who looked to be in his thirties. However, their appearances weren’t what was important right now.
‘Zodiac Saints?’
Hugo had also never seen them before. Dismayed, he whispered to Lee Gun, “Gun, they are humans…right?”
Lee Gun snorted. Hugo was asking that because these newcomers were emitting weird energy. He had immediately sensed this energy since he had felt several of their presence in the Divine world. The scent of the gods was thick around them. No, the entire earth smelled like them.
[Master, I smell Eden from various locations.]
The voice of a Construct came from Lee Gun’s shadow.
Hugo’s eyebrows rose. “They aren’t humans?”
“They are humans, but they possess Divine power.”
“Then…!”
“They are Construct rank. It means they already reached Divine rank, like you.”
“Then the gods of Eden changed into them…!”
“I’m not so sure. The Zodiac Saints look like humans. I can be sure only if I crack them open.”
Crack them open? What did Lee Gun plan to do?
Hugo was about to give Lee Gun a questioning look when the Zodiac Saints came closer.
“Anyway, it’s an honor to meet Lee Gun-nim.”
“We are none other than the—.”
Kwahng!!!!
Lee Gun didn’t let them finish. He let his fist fly. The young man standing in the very front was sent flying. Just the sound itself could make one wonder if the young man had survived the hit.
The crowd, who had gathered around when they saw Lee Gun, screamed.
“Kyahhhhk!!”
“Lee Gun-nim!!!”
Hugo was also shocked. He glanced around to see if any paparazzi or reporters had witnessed this scene. Then, he yelled, “Gun!!! The newspaper company is nearby… Damn it! Let’s hear what they have to say…!”
They could get the lay of the land only if they heard what the so-called Zodiac Saints had to say.
Lee Gun merely cracked his knuckles. “Yes. I listened to them for three seconds.”
Hugo massaged his forehead. Yes, it was better than sending someone flying after one second. When it came to Lee Gun, he had made great strides.
‘Still, we have to find out who they are before we blast them!’
At the very least, they had to find out what was going on in the world.
The ones who had been about to introduce themselves were struck dumb. They looked at Lee Gun.
The government employees had come rushing at once when they heard the rumor about Lee Gun. They were shocked and dismayed as they ran up to Lee Gun.
“Ah. He’s over there!”
“Lee Gun-nim!!!”
Lee Gun had appeared after a six-month absence. Some might wonder if he was a fake Lee Gun, but the oracle given by the observatory was never wrong.
- A massive power is heading toward here.
- That is the power of Lee Gun-nim. There is no mistaking it!
Around half a year ago, Secretary Guisoon had put up an SNS post that hinted at Lee Gun’s death(?). The news had turned the world up on its head, but it had lasted only a moment. The world had soon learned that he had moved to a different dimension.
Moreover, the observatory became aware of Lee Gun’s and Hugo’s return about an hour ago, when Lee Gun had used the ability of Time twenty years in the future.
This was why the government employees had come out to greet him. They looked nervous as they spoke to Lee Gun.
“Lee Gun-nim, please don’t make the mistake of thinking they are your enemies! They are not!”
“They are only here to greet…”
Lee Gun didn’t care. He kept twisting his head as if he was stretching. “Is that so? They came to greet me, yet they didn’t bring out the bells and whistle?”
“What?!”
“You said they are here to greet me. Then they should have brought out the red carpet and a private plane.”
The government employees started to sweat. When Lee Gun had gotten rid of the Pisces, the scene of him shedding tears(?) had been shown on TV. It had fooled the world into thinking he had a soft personality, but that charade didn’t last long.
‘There is no way his temper went anywhere.’
The civilians were taken aback.
‘As expected of Lee Gun….’
‘He hits first and asks questions later….’
This almost made it unlikely that he was a fake.
On the other hand, Lee Gun snorted as he glared at the group who had come to greet him. “Whatever. Why are you guys pretending to be Zodiac Saints?”
“!”
The three people, who had been sticking together, broke out from their shock. They immediately lowered their heads.
“We aren’t pretending to be Zodiac Saints. We are the new Zodiac Saints.”
“What bullshit are you talking about?”
“You might be shocked since this is quite sudden. It’s quite understandable.”
“Since you have come back after six months, you might have not heard about it yet. However, the previous Zodiac Saints lost their rights to be Zodiac Saints.”
“What? They lost it?”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose a bit as if he was annoyed.
This made the new Zodiac Saints respond confidently.
“That’s right. While you vacate your seat, Lee Gun-nim, a new monster… No, a devil made an appearance. The previous Zodiac Saints could do nothing against it. They were helpless like the time they were against the unknown civilization. Humanity was under threat again.”
Lee Gun immediately realized what that meant. “Oh. However, you guys were able to get rid of it?”
“That is correct.”
“!”
The one to answer was the young man, who Lee Gun had sent flying. He had already gotten up, and he was walking toward Lee Gun. Blood was running down his forehead, but he didn’t seem bothered by it.
Hugo flinched.
‘He was hit by Gun, yet he’s fine?’
If one was strict about the definition, the young man wasn’t fine. He was bleeding. However, he was also able to talk nonchalantly.
‘He’s formidable.’
Hugo flinched again when he saw Lee Gun. It was rare for Lee Gun to show interest like this.
‘No. Gun wouldn’t be interested in the fake Zodiac Saints!!’
However, the worried Hugo was right in his presumption.
As if to prove that, Lee Gun’s eyes curved like the eyes of a fox. He had gone easy since he didn’t want the Zodiac Saint to die, yet the young man was able to move?
When Lee Gun looked at the Zodiac Saint in acknowledgment, Hugo became nervous. He was about to say something, but the Zodiac Saints smiled and spoke first.
“The previous Zodiac Saints were your enemies, Lee Gun-nim. After they trapped you in the tower, they lived a life of wealth and luxury. They were trash.”
“Yes. You’re right about that.”
“Gun???!!”
Hugo grabbed Lee Gun, but Lee Gun merely smirked as if he was not bothered by their words. “I left them alive only because of the monsters. I don’t care if anyone disparages them now.”
“!”
“So what did you do with the previous Zodiac Saints? Did you guys steal the thirteen seats?”
“We didn’t just steal them. We did it fair and square. There was a contest of strength in front of the countries and the people. We took those seats.”
“Oh. You guys fought?” Lee Gun let out a bright smile as he looked at the government employees and the civilians. “Really?”
The student’s face turned red as she spoke when Lee Gun looked at her. “Yes, yes! Also, they were…!”
Soon, the Zodiac Saint spoke.
“It’s as the people said. The thirteen Zodiac Saints, who had been swapped out, all lost to us.”
“Ah-ha! That means it is beneficial for all of us?”
“Yes, it is.”
“The snake god is the ruler and guardian of the earth. The new thirteen Zodiac Saints are here to protect the snake god.”
“This might be quite sudden and confusing. You might be suspicious of us, but we will do our very best to help…”
Lee Gun was cool about it. If things had really turned out like that, he didn’t really care.
“Alright. I’ll allow you guys to serve me.”
The Zodiac Saints’ expressions brightened.
“That means…!”
“Since I allowed it…”
“!”
“You guys can all die.”
As fierce Divine power emanated from his body, Lee Gun let out a bright smile.
* * *
[The Zodiac Saints are powerless against the devil! Will we truly be ok?]
[The Zodiac Saints lost to the newly awakened beings, who were detected to have SS-rank abilities!]
[We are the new thirteen Zodiac Saints, who received power from Eden. We are prepared to protect Lee Gun-nm.]
[They are the fake Zodiac Saints. They couldn’t face off against the monsters for twenty years because of their incompetence. They plotted against Lee Gun-nim, and they were unable to kill the fallen Zodiacs.]
[What have they done while Lee Gun-nim was gone?]
[They are trash.]
“Yes. They are good at speaking. They are indeed idiots.”
“Gun.”
At the Charles De Gaul airport in Paris, Lee Gun sat in the middle of downtown, waiting for someone while munching on a baguette.
He snorted as he watched the news, which was chronicled for the past six months. “What? I told these idiots to defend our home, yet they had their seats taken.”
In other words, the previous Zodiac Saints had undergone a change of generation after he had gone to search for Hugo.
Unknown outer gods had appeared on the earth, and they were dubbed as the devils. The power of the previous Zodiac Saints didn’t work against the devils. However, the newly appeared SS-rank Zodiac Saints had easily killed them. The reason was simple.
‘Angels are like a cheat code when dealing with devils.’
However, Lee Gun had no plans of coddling Hugo and the Zodiac Saints.
“All the new Zodiac Saints possess the power of Eden angels. In the first place, our skills were specialized to work against the unknown civilization, yet they want us to defeat the devils? Of course, they would have a hard time against them.”
“They shouldn’t have been pushed around to that extent.”
Before he had gone looking for Hugo, Lee Gun had given orders for the empty seats of the Zodiac Saints to be filled.
- It’s annoying to micromanage all the disciples. Just pick the strongest ones to be the Zodiac Saints since I’m the Zodiac.
Aside from the already established temples, Lee Gun had given orders to find Zodiac Saints for the Aries, Taurus, Cancer, and Libra temples.
This unfortunate event had occurred when this was happening. Moreover, the previous Zodiac Saints were missing.
‘They are either hiding, captured, or dead.’
At such a moment, the earth had received the protection of the angels, and a new twelve Zodiac system had formed.
Hugo sighed. “Eden thought this through. It wasn’t other gods. Naturally, the existence of angels would work well on the people of the earth.”
When the monsters and the twelve Zodiacs had appeared, the existing religions on earth had gotten weaker. However, the existence of Eden would hold great sway over the three great religions of the earth.
If Eden had slandered the hero of humanity in Lee Gun, humanity would have rejected them. Their current approach had struck the right note for humans to accept them.
“Is the Great Spirit of Eden the god from the bible?”
“I don’t think so.”
Of course, Lee Gun had something to check before he did anything. When he turned around, Hugo looked at him with an odd look in his eyes. “Gun. The airport terminal isn’t that way. You aren’t going to ride the plane?”
Lee Gun had caused a ruckus in downtown, and he had taken the car of a government employee for himself. Hugo assumed it was to go ride an airplane.
Lee Gun snorted. “Why would I ride something so slow?”
“What? Why did we come to the airport?”
“Why else?” Lee Gun smirked as he whistled.
Then, a violent earthquake hit the area, and something surprising happened.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!
“Ahhhhk!!!”
“It’s a monster!”
Screams rang out in the surroundings, and a familiar face appeared from the sky. A red being was flying toward them while wagging its tail.
Hugo’s face turned pale at the sight.
* * *
Hugo’s worry became reality. Red Eye had come to greet its owner, and they were riding it.
Hugo suffered from motion sickness as they arrived at a familiar location. It was the building of the Sagittarius temple, which was also considered Lee Gun’s home.
Lee Gun immediately looked for someone. “Miss Jiwoo!”
The sound of a dish being broken along with a familiar voice rang out. Then, a familiar face made an appearance.
“Lee Gun-nim!!” It was a surprised pregnant woman.
Goat and the young Archer disciple stood next to her. They had been helping Chun Jiwoo.
“Lee Gun-nim!!”
“My god! It really is Lee Gun-nim?”
Everyone was surprised since Lee Gun had appeared after six months. They asked why Lee Gun hadn’t picked up on any of their attempts to contact him, but in the end, they all let out sighs of relief.
“Miss Jiwoo, I brought Taeksoo as promised.”
Tears welled up in Chun Jiwoo’s eyes.
“Really? My husband is ok?”
Lee Gun laughed as he pointed next to him.
Hugo was also glad to see Chun Jiwoo. His memories weren’t whole, but of course, he could recognize his wife.
Soon, Hugo opened up his arms as he approached her. Chun Jiwoo quickly ran toward him.
However, they walked past each other.
Chun Jiwoo opened the door. She opened the closet. She opened the toilet cover, as she yelled, “Where are you, husband?”
“I’m not over there! Honey!! I’m here!”
Goat tilted his head in puzzlement at this scene. “Where is Hugo-nim?”
“He’s in front of you.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun laughed when they asked why they couldn’t see Hugo. “He became a god without a body. Humans can’t see him unless they concentrate.”
The married couple waved their arms through the empty air in yearning.
In the end, he looked at his surroundings.
“So where is his body, which was supposed to be stored here?”
“What?”
“I’ll return him to his body, then I’m going to cut down the angels.”

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - Master! (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 379 - Master! (3)
“Oh. Is that so? The snake god is here?”
In Eden, Archangel Michael, the leader of the heavenly army, smiled at the unexpected news. He was the one who had sent the angels to the earth.
Of course, he was merely registered as a Construct since Eden had only one god. It was their quirk.
When the head of Eden learned that Lee Gun had arrived on the earth, he coolly laughed.
“We have already invaded, so it matters not. We don’t have to pay attention to him.”
“However, the twelve Zodiacs… The Zodiacs of the earth have connections to Mahabharata, Olympus, Ennead, and Valhalla. They might try to intervene…”
While they had become independent, the twelve Zodiacs had belonged to the eight great forces.
Michael’s eyes flashed as he laughed. “No, that’s the reason they won’t be able to say anything. Do you realize how many bribes they took from Eden? They won’t dare.”
“…!”
“Of course, Mahabharata won’t do as we wish. However, Zodiacs steal each other’s colonies. That’s the rule.”
“!”
“Regardless, they aren’t ones to move when it comes to a small dimension.”
The Zodiacs of the Divine world were rulers who possessed territories, like feudal lords. They became stronger by possessing more quality territories. If others complained, the other Zodiacs could do the same thing.
“Instead of fighting the snake god in the Divine world, they should have stolen his territory first in a legitimate manner.”
“You’re correct, but I’m not sure the territory of a nameless god would help Eden…”
Michael laughed at his subordinate’s words. “The earth dimension was coveted by the monarchs. This was why the Zodiacs of earth developed the Faith and disciple system. In terms of offerings and faith generated, they are fantastic.”
A place like this was fit for their Great Spirit. They might be able to awaken their father from his deep sleep.
“Thankfully, Ennead trapped the owner of the earth inside the Dimensional Crack.”
He had never expected the rotten and cunning Great Spirit of Ennead to be of help to them.
‘Despite knowing our intentions, Ennead chose to trap the snake god inside the Dimensional Crack.’
Soon, Michael laughed. “It doesn’t matter. Carry on with our plan.”
“Then….”
They weren’t merely trying to steal the territory called the earth.
“The gods always need a battlefield.”
“!”
While the gods in the Divine world pretended to be aloof beings, they continued to slaughter each other until the smell of blood permeated from them.
However, none of them wanted to sully their own lands. They didn’t want to dispose of the corpses. No one was crazy enough to let others destroy their property. This was true for the colonies too.
‘A war shouldn’t be fought on your land. It should be fought on someone else’s land.’
“When the earth becomes connected to the Divine world and the other Dimensions, it’ll become the new battlefield for all the dimensional gods.”
Eden was merely the first one to place a post in this territory. That’s why the snake god should be thankful to them. Eden had made sure this isolated location would be a place of interest for the gods.
* * *
“So… My body was stored here?” Hugo looked into the room, dumbfounded. It was one of the larger rooms in the house, but Hugo became angry when he saw the state of the room. “Damn it! Why the hell was my study turned into a fan cave?”
This room used to belong to Hugo. It was a room where he conducted business as the Archer Saint.
“Ha ha ha. Since you weren’t here, Sungjae took it over…”
“He said his room was no longer enough…”
“When looking at how this house was built, he said this place had the best ambiance…”
This was true in terms of the wallpaper, cabinets, lighting, humidity, temperature, and interior design.
Hugo despaired; the room looked like a museum.
‘Should I be glad that he didn’t throw away my items?’
It seemed new product lines of Lee Gun had come out after Hugo’s death. There was a pile of items that he had never seen before.
Of course, the most problematic part was that not a single Hugo merchandise was there! He was the beloved father! Well, it didn’t matter.
“Why was my casket placed in this fanboy hangout?” Hugo pointed at his casket, which was placed in the corner.
When Lee Gun passed on what Hugo had said, Chun Jiwoo and Goat let out bright smiles. “We thought Lee Gun-nim would be able to protect you if you were placed here.”
“It was better than sticking you in the basement…”
“Young master Sungjae was generous enough to allow it.”
Hugo grabbed the back of his neck. Figurines were arranged on top of his casket as if they were defending it.
“Damn it! Why the hell was my casket placed here?”
“They told you why. This place was the safest.”
They had a point, but…!
“Damn it! Since he bought Gun’s limited edition items, he should have bought them for me too! How can he buy it for only himself!!”
Lee Gun ignored his friends as he headed toward the casket. “I'll return you to your body in no time. Just wait a bit—”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he opened the casket. “What the hell? Where is he?”
Hugo’s body wasn’t inside the casket.
This surprised Goat and Chun Jiwoo.
“I checked while I was cleaning this place in the morning…!”
“I also checked every day…!”
Before he had departed for the Divine world, Lee Gun had used the data of Time to stop the time of Hugo’s body. It had been preserved, yet it was gone right now. They never expected this.
[Master, did Eden perhaps take it…]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows at the Construct’s words. The probability was high.
Although Hugo was worse(?) than him, he was nonetheless a Zodiac Saint of a fighting-type temple. His body would be a fantastic weapon of war!
Lee Gun’s eyebrows were about to twitch when…
“Hey, hey! Hurry! They are already here!”
“I want to, but the holy ground’s security became stronger when Lee Gun returned.”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose when he heard the voices behind the curtain.
Pahk!
“Ahhhk!!”
When he pulled aside the curtain, he saw unexpected faces, and his eyes turned round. The others were also surprised.
Goat became angry when he saw them.
“Those bastards…!!”
“Ahhhk! It’s the Ten Star of the Sagittarius temple!!”
Young male disciples had passed through the wall behind the curtain, in an attempt to get away with the stolen Hugo’s body. If one looked at their age and the clothes that they were wearing, their identity could be narrowed down.
“What the hell? They are the disciples of the eunuch?”
They were none other than the disciples of the Virgo temple. Originally, the holy ground of the Virgo temple only contained women. This had always bothered Kevin. So he had taken in male children, who had yet to go through their puberty as pageboys. These children were orphans from the war, who had nowhere to go.
Why were they here….
“Do you guys want to die? How dare you try to steal Taeksoo’s body!”
When Lee Gun grabbed their heads in a rough manner, the young boys started crying.
“L-Let me go! Who cares if you are a god? We know you’re in league with Eden, and you will get rid of us! You will kill us like how Kevin-nim was killed!”
“What?”
“Kevin-nim’s disciples and Constructs were all transferred to the new Zodiac Saint— Kuh-huhk!”
“You’re being rude, brats.”
The young boys, who took a beating from Lee Gun, continued to speak as they cried.
“That terrible Zodiac Saint won against Kevin-nim using an underhanded method!!”
Lee Gun knew something was off when he heard this. He furrowed his brows. “Virgo saw this and did nothing?”
“How the hell should we know? Maybe she received compensation from Eden or something!”
“You guys should know more since you went to the Divine world— Kuh-huhk!”
In the end, the children took a hellish beating, and Lee Gun dragged Hugo's body like a sack of rice.
When Lee Gun crooked his finger, Hugo approached him.
“What do you want— Koohk!!”
Lee Gun ruthlessly kicked Hugo, shoving him into his body.
Bbah-gahk!!
The incredible pain made Hugo almost want to vomit blood. He cursed, “Bastard! Why don’t you go a bit easy…!”
At the same time, he heard a scream full of unshed tears.
“H-Hugo-nim!”
“Husband!”
“…!”
Hugo became surprised by the sound he heard from his surroundings. It seemed he had returned to his own body.
Tears welled up in Chun Jiwoo’s eyes, and she was the first to hug him.
When Hugo felt the warmth from her body, he felt his eyes turn red. He had returned to the arms of his family. He felt it for sure at that moment.
The married couple called each other by name, about to have a tearful reunion.
Pleased at this sight, Hugo said, “I’m glad that we are spending quality time with each other, but we still have a problem to solve.”
“What?”
“You might not be able to have your fourth child.”
“Excuse me?!!”
“What?! It wasn’t fixed?!”
To be precise, it was because Hugo didn’t have all of his memories.
‘He’s still lacking the part of his soul containing his memories.’
Lee Gun had gathered around 70% of Hugo’s soul. The remaining 30% was missing. Of course, he had tried to meddle with the fate of the goddesses of fate, to extend Hugo’s life span, but it hadn’t worked.
[The fate of the goddesses of fate cannot be changed.]
[Currently, Pushover has a life expectancy of twelve years.]
The remaining 30% of Hugo’s soul contained most of his memories and lifespan. Lee Gun had to find it. It was a must.
‘I’m sure one of the factions that wanted Taeksoo has it.’
This meant he’d come across them at some point. Therefore, although it was an urgent problem, it wasn’t a priority right now.
“What happened to the other Zodiac Saints?”
“!”
Goat’s eyes turned round when he heard Lee Gun’s question.
With a savage look in his eyes, he said, “I don’t see Sungjae, Yooha, and Jaewon.”
“That is…!” Goat had no idea where to start the story. In the end, he just started to talk.
“Miss Yooha chased after you, Lee Gun-nim, and we haven’t seen her since. Sungjae…”
Goat lowered his head. “Not too long after the angels made their appearance, Sungjae disappeared like a whirlwind.”
“What? He’s missing?”
“Yes. Also, Jaewon Hyung-nim was…” Goat spoke with a serious expression on his face. “As Lee Gun-nim probably knows, the new Zodiac Saints had made their appearance, and it spurred Jaewon Hyung-nim to take the seat of the Archer Saint.”
“What? Jaewon did that?”
Goat nodded. “Since they were trying to steal the seats of the Zodiac Saints, he thought I would be in danger as the temporary Zodiac Saint.”
In fact, the other Zodiac Saints had gone missing after suffering defeat at the hands of the new Zodiac Saints. Moreover, Lee Jaewon treasured the Archer disciples as if they were his young siblings.
“The seat of the Zodiac Saint was transferred to Jaewon Hyung-nim, and he fought against the new Zodiac Saints. Everything was going well. In fact, Jaewon Hyung-nim held the upper hand.”
It was a predictable outcome since Jaewon had learned his fighting techniques from Lee Gun and Hugo. He was their student.
However, things had taken an unexpected turn.
“During the fight, it was as if the spigot to his power was shut off. He couldn’t activate his magical energy or his skills…!”
“!!”
Lee Gun flinched as if he felt guilty. Hugo looked at Lee Gun with a doubtful expression.
“The magical energy of the Sagittarius was gone. In a flash, he became powerless. That’s why he lost… Koohk!”
Oh, no! Lee Gun started to sweat. He was sure of it.
‘It happened when I used Cycle to turn baldie into a human.’
A Zodiac provided power to his disciples, yet he had been turned into a human. As a disciple of the Sagittarius temple, Lee Jaewon’s abilities were sealed when Sagittarius underwent that.
Of all the times it could have happened, it had occurred during the fight, and Jaewon was unable to use his power.
‘The timing was….’
Hugo had the same realization, so he gave a side eye to Lee Gun.
Unaware of this, Goat lamented as he hit the ground. “Anyway, Jaewon Hyung-nim lost in such an unfair manner, and he was dragged away into the den of the angels…!”
He couldn’t be contacted. It was unclear as to whether he was alive or not.
Lee Gun felt a bit sorry. He scratched his cheek as he cleared his throat. “What about Yeonwoo? Do you know what happened to her?”
“She’s at the den of the enemies.”
Hugo became surprised when Chun Jiwoo spoke up.
“Was she captured…!!”
“No! She went there on her own.”
“!!”
“It seems she knew who we are fighting, so she went there to thrash them.”
Lee Gun nodded. “It’s fine if that’s what happened.”
Hugo was surprised by his reaction. “Are you sure you don’t have to intervene on behalf of Miss Yeonwoo?!”
“I have no plans of interfering. I’m not worried about her. In some ways, she is stronger than me.”
“What??”
Hugo was about to ask what he meant when Lee Gun spoke up.
“Let’s go find my Zodiac Saints first.”
Chun Jiwoo seemed worried as she whispered, “Excuse me, Lee Gun-nim. Miss Yeonwoo wanted me to tell you that our enemies are the angels, and they are very dangerous…”
His Constructs gulped as they whispered.
[Master, Eden is probably planning on awakening their Great Spirit.]
[They’ll be able to acquire a massive amount of tribute from the earth.]
[Moreover, the humans of the earth are uniquely vulnerable against Eden.]
[From what we’ve heard, they are even planning on laying hands on Pushover’s past life…]
“It doesn’t matter.”
“What?”
Lee Gun laughed instead of giving an answer.
* * *
Around that time, in Asia…
“Hurry up and move! We have to move the goods of the earth to Eden using the Dimensional door!”
The angels of Eden were using their gate to send humans of the earth to colonies belonging to Eden. In other words, they planned on exporting manpower. It was to be expected since the earth was full of outstanding awakened beings.
The angels of Eden planned on sending the existing awakened beings to their colonies as laborers. The angels asked questions.
“Things are going smoothly, but is it ok for us to secretly take the earth first?”
“It’s a bit suspicious. That’s why we have to transport everything before Valhalla comes. This place will turn into a sea of fire.”
“A sea of fire?”
“Yes. The supreme commander is going to use Pushover to turn this place into a sea of fire. It’ll allow Valhalla to bring that plant.”
“Then we’ll have to hurry up and take all the meat on this bone.”
“Yes. I heard the quality of humans here is top-notch. I think they are called disciples.”
These two angels were in charge of exporting manpower. As watchmen, they were moving the selected humans.
Flash!
Suddenly, a light appeared from the Dimensional door, and a woman appeared before them.
The angels laughed, since it was a familiar energy.
“That’s the energy of the goddess of wisdom and war. Aren’t you Athena?”
“What the hell? I thought the gods of Olympus turned into humans and went to lift the curse. Did you already solve that problem and come here?”
“That’s great. We planned on calling for you guys—”
The angels were surprised when they saw the woman step out from the light.
“Y-You are—”
They didn’t even have time to be surprised. The figure surged into the sky, and her eyes flashed. In a blink of an eye, lightning fell from the sky.
Flash!
The head of the two angels burst open.
Poo-hahk!!!
The woman who had instantly killed the angels dusted off her hands.
“You bastards are begging for death.”
It was Yooha, who had eaten the Divine status of Athena.

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - Master (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 380 - Master (4)
‘After twenty years, the earth will cease to exist.’
The culprits had to be the gods of the Pantheon. The first step to that was swapping out the existing Zodiac Saints for the new ones.
‘Well, the others are none of my business.’
Why would he worry about the Zodiac Saints? Nothing was endearing about them. He didn't care if they died or not. It was their problem. But his most treasured niece and nephew were a different story. The cat that he had raised was also off-limits.
Jaewon was also one of the thirteen Zodiac Saints, so that changed the story as well.
The disciples looked at him with worry in their eyes.
“We heard the other Zodiac Saints are dead. Two were purposefully kidnapped. I’m sure they had a purpose for doing so.”
“Their aim doesn’t matter.”
“What?”
‘We must get them back.’
The problem was their location.
‘They aren’t appearing on the disciple management system.’
Goat must have realized this too. He looked at Lee Gun with an awkward expression. “We tried to search for them for the past couple of months… However, we couldn’t find a single clue.”
“We wondered if they were dragged away to a different colony, but we couldn’t track them down.”
The Sagittarius temple’s disciples were wizards of tracking. They were better than the disciples of the Serpent Bearer temple in that aspect, yet they were unable to find a single clue.
It meant the previous Zodiac Saints couldn’t be found using conventional methods.
That was why Goat was trying to get a hint from Lee Gun.
Lee Gun contemptuously looked at him. “Idiot! Do you think I went to the Divine world just for looks?”
“!”
Lee Gun smirked as if to say he shouldn’t be underestimated. “I need an item. It has to be an item precious to that person and irreplaceable.”
“What? Jaewon Hyung-nim doesn’t like to talk about himself. We don’t know what is precious to him.”
“Ah. It’s probably this.” Quick on the uptake, Chun Jiwoo quickly went to grab something.
Lee Gun unexpectedly laughed when he saw the item.
Chun Jiwoo had brought a framed picture of Hugo, Lee Gun, and Lee Jaewon in their youth.
Pleased at this, Lee Gun took the item. “Next is Sungjae.”
Lee Gun was about to enter Sungjae’s room, but Goat quickly got in his way. “Excuse me, Lee Gun-nim. Only we should enter Sungjae’s room…”
“Ah. It’s fine. I already know he’s a big fan of mine.”
On the other hand, Hugo didn’t have any memory of his son, so his heart was pounding. His figurine not being on top of his casket had shocked him a bit.
‘I’m sure he’s embarrassed, so he hid his father’s figurines inside his room.’
Hugo was full of anticipation as the door to Sungjae’s room was opened. His next expression was a sight to behold.
“…???” Hugo was shocked to realize the room had no figurines of him. There was even a figurine of Stevens and Kevin.
However, his shock lasted only a moment. He despaired for a second time when he saw Lee Gun activate his skill and pick up an item. It was a large pillow with Lee Gun printed on it. Lee Gun held an ax, making a cool pose.
Hugo’s expression was comical as he looked at the Lee Gun pillow. “My son… is a pervert?!”
“You want to die? It’s just a normal pillow.”
Hugo didn’t hear him. He continued to search Sungjae’s room as if he was in disbelief. “He has nothing related to his father? I’m sure it’s here!”
Hugo kept searching and searching, yet found nothing related to him. He wailed. “There is no way my son is like this! I’m sure he’s a son who thinks about his father… He’s someone who thinks about…”
Goat looked at the spectacle in disgust. He whispered to Lee Gun, “Why is Hugo-nim acting that way?”
“Ah! He has a bit of a defect right now. You should give him a bit of latitude.”
“What?!”
“For now, let him get used to reality.”
G…Get used to reality? Goat looked at the wailing Hugo in pity, but it lasted only a moment.
Lee Gun spoke in a low voice, putting Divine power into his words. “As the master Zodiac, I command you. Come out from my underling’s shadow.”
The goddesses of fate appeared from Hugo’s shadow.
Goat and the Archer disciples freaked out when Lee Gun mentioned they were the goddesses of fate.
Of course, humans knew about their existence.
‘This is nuts…! He went to the Divine world and came back with the goddesses of fate as his Constructs?’
Divine status of that caliber belonged to the end bosses! Moreover, when they saw the goddesses, their expressions were a sight to behold.
“L-Lee Gun-nim…?!’
The three goddesses had changed into female versions of Lee Gun. Moreover, one was a child, one a high schooler, and the last an elder sister!
“L…Lee Gun-nim! Their appearances… What’s going on?”
“Ah. There was an incident.”
“???”
What the hell had happened in the Divine world??
Lee Gun acted oblivious as he placed a hand on the book taken out by the goddesses of fate.
[The omniscient and omnipotent goddesses have forcefully activated the Akashic records (5 star), which is in their care.]
[Since they are affiliated to the Serpent Bearer temple, there is no problem with you using it.]
[You do not need a permission ticket if you want to browse through it.]
Lee Gun’s vision shifted.
‘!’
The first thing he saw was his own room. It seemed Sungjae had entered it to feed Junwoo. Then he carried out the one-day, ten Lee Gun schedule. Sobbing, he watched the Lee Gun’s exploits recorded on video and ate the tear-soaked bread.
“Damn it! I should have followed Uncle like Noona. I never expected him to be gone for over a month.”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he watched his nephew. In fact, something had puzzled him from the start.
‘If he was kidnapped, I would have noticed, and he isn’t someone who would allow himself to be dragged away.’
What method had they used to take Sungjae? He was trying to discover this information when…
Geeeng-
Lee Gun flinched when he felt an odd energy.
‘!’
Sungjae was currently recording shows from foreign channels, which merely mentioned Lee Gun’s name, when his expression suddenly changed.
When Sungjae headed somewhere, a surprised Mimir jumped out of his body.
[Little master!!]
Mimir was always with Sungjae. It quickly grabbed a hold of the young man.
[Little master. You shouldn’t go there. That is Eden…]
At that moment, a suspicious symbol was reflected in Sungjae’s eyes, and power emanated from his body.
Kwahng!
It was a powerful magical energy that Sungjae usually didn’t show.
‘This power is…!”
The power was strong enough to push back even the fairy monarch.
Kwahng!!
[Koohk!]
In the end, the fairy monarch had been forcefully sealed somewhere, and Chun Sungjae had teleported to an unknown location.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘It looks like he was mesmerized by something.’
Well, it didn’t matter.
Lee Gun picked up the unexpected item, which was used to seal the fairy monarch. When he broke it, the fairy monarch came out.
The fairy monarch immediately had a realization about Lee Gun.
[Big Master! You used the Akashic records. You came using such a dangerous path…!]
“It’s fine. Follow me.”
Mimir was one of the three great treasure houses of knowledge in the Divine world. It was considered to be one of the great sages. So Mimir was ideal as a guide.
After taking Mimir out, Lee Gun read the next record. It was Lee Jaewon’s.
Flash!
The scene that appeared in front of his eyes was a stadium with thousands of spectators. Mimir furrowed its brows when it saw this.
[It’s the incident where Lee Jaewon fought the one trying to claim the seat of the Archer Saint.]
“Oh oh! Is this the passing of the torch for the Archer Saint too?”
Two people were fiercely fighting for the seat of the Zodiac Saint. Of course, Sagittarius had turned into a human, so Lee Jaewon was unable to use his skills and magical energy.
“Oh! You fight well despite losing your power!”
“As long as Lee Gun-nim was here, this seat was occupied by Hugo-nim. Do you think I’ll cede that seat to some unknown woman? Lee Gun-nim wouldn’t want that.”
‘I don’t mind if he hands it over. He should have just given it up.’
[Master?!]
In the first place, most of the ones trying to become the new Zodiac Saints were beautiful women.
‘They are better than the original ones. They should have just let the switch happen.’
[Master!!!]
At that moment, Lee Gun-nim saw an unexpected scene.
“Jaewon Hyung-nim!”
Lee Jaewon, who had been putting up a good fight, suddenly faltered.
[A very powerful ability of Eden has been activated.]
[Call from the Heavens]
[Good people and the people needed by the heavens will be taken.]
[This is especially effective against those with high faith and those treasured by the gods.]
It was said that heaven took the good people first.
It was as if god had called them up.
Eden had used this ability to call up humans from their colonies and turn them into heavenly soldiers.
Similar to Sungjae’s case, Lee Jaewon’s eyes became unfocused and he lost. An angel flew down, and Lee Jaewon was about to be sent to some unknown location.
Mimir spoke when it saw this.
[They were sent to Eden’s colony. They were sent to a very high-rank facility.]
“Of all the pigeon’s dens, they were sent to a good one??”
[That is correct… M…master?!]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
Mimir yelled in surprise when he had a realization.
[Big Master! We are within the Akashic records! While you may browse it, you’ll accrue Karmic debt if you take action! The memories of this place might get tangled, and we might not be able to exit this place!]
Lee Gun didn’t care as he turned into a shadow. Then he appeared in front of an angel.
The angel who had been trying to take Lee Jaewon became surprised. “S-Sagittarius?”
Lee Gun had taken the appearance of another.
The angel tried to call for his allies, yet he didn’t have the time to do so.
Bba-gahk! Bba-gahk! Bba-gahk!
It was unclear as to how much time had passed.
[You have learned the Mimic ability.]
Lee Gun had acquired a new skill as a bloodied angel slumped to the ground. He had gained what he wanted from the angel’s body.
[Eden Colony (Garden of Eden) Express Ticket]
Lee Gun learned his lesson during his incident with Hades, so he smirked as he took away the item.
When he was about to put away the item, the sound of a notification and a different voice could be heard from the sky.
[Who dares steal a glance at Eden’s record?]
“!”
An unfamiliar voice rang out from the sky, and the space started to distort.
Since Mimir was the greatest treasure house of knowledge, it immediately recognized who the voice belonged to.
[Master!]
Soon, Lee Gun disappeared.
* * *
“Kuhk!”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
“Gun!’
Lee Gun had exited the book. Hugo was surprised since Lee Gun had come out faster than expected. He asked in surprise. “What happened?”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun went to his room and picked up a Hugo figurine.
Hugo tilted his head. “What the hell? That’s my figurine— Ahhk!!!”
Lee Gun ruthlessly broke off the head of the Hugo figurine. It was the only Hugo figurine in the house, so Hugo couldn’t believe this. He was about to scream when…
Flash!
[Big Master!]
Mimir, whom Sungjae had sealed within, shared its memories within the Akashic record. It lowered its head.
[You used the Akashic records. What made you use such a dangerous method?]
“Who was the one to chase me out of the Akashic records?”
[The pillar god of Eden… His name is Michael. He’s the archangel and leader of Eden. It seemed they joined hands with Valhalla’s goddess of fate (Norn). I’m pretty sure they kidnapped the Zodiac Saints to awaken the Great Spirit of Eden…]
“What? They are going through all of this nonsense to wake a god from his sleep?”
[Yes. That’s why they swapped out the Zodiac Saints. Since the Zodiac Saints had become affiliates, they possess great power now.]
[They are trying to awaken their Great Spirit, who went into eternal sleep.]
[If we dither too long, even their life force may be drained.]
The disciples turned pale when they heard the Constructs.
“Then we have to quickly find where they are…!”
“I know where they are. They were taken to their colony.”
“Their colony… Can it be? Eden!”
“Yes. It’s outside of the earth, and they are placed deep within their territory. That’s why we couldn’t track them.”
However, it didn’t matter since Lee Gun had taken out the express ticket from the Akashic records. “We can get there quickly with this.”
The Constructs spoke up as if they were worried.
[Master. Eden is one of the eight great forces, and it’s their colony. It’s a dangerous place. If you wreak havoc… If you use your power there, it might start a great war amongst the Zodiacs. You have to focus on taking them out discreetly. You must not destroy…]
They sighed when they realized their words had no effect on Lee Gun. So, they spoke.
[Master. The ticket isn’t enough to reach the colony of Eden.]
“The ticket isn’t enough?”
At that moment, another voice rang out.
“Yes. You need a key instead of a ticket.”
“!”
Everyone was surprised by the unfamiliar voice. They looked outside. Angels stood outside with their wings spread.
They furrowed their brows as they thought about the information that they had received from the Divine world.
‘That bastard pushed down the ranking of our father?’
They were not showing it, but they were about to explode.
‘Damn Divine world.’
Their Great Spirit had been pushed down in ranking, but he had been asleep for a very long time. This meant measuring the power of the Great Spirit of Eden was useless since the measurement couldn’t be taken.
Thus, Lee Gun hadn’t passed their Great Spirit in terms of skill…
‘How dare he pass our Great Spirit to take the eighth spot?’
It had caused shock in the Divine world, and Lee Gun was being seen as the new candidate to become a Great Spirit. Pandemonium had erupted inside the Divine world.
They became angry when they thought about it. However, they soon took deep breaths.
‘It has to do with his Divine status.’
With the power of Cycle, they wouldn’t need to take the lifespan of the high-rank disciples. They’d be able to use it to awaken the Great Spirit of Eden.
So they laughed as they spoke.
“We heard the snake god was back, so we were looking for you. Yet you were having such thoughts about us.”
“We understand why you would take such actions, but your Zodiac Saints are already servants of Eden. Moreover, your power isn’t enough to visit our colony.”
They smiled.
“However, we aren’t the bad guys. Since things have turned out like this, we’ll return your Zodiac Saints.”
“If you wait, we’ll go for them soon.”
Lee Gun snorted. They were speaking nonsense.
Mimir spoke worriedly, since he could discern what the angels and Lee Gun were thinking.
[Big Master. I’m sure you don’t like taking suggestions from others, but instead of signaling a war, we might be better off cooperating with them.]
“As expected, Mimir is knowledgeable. Also, you have no way of reaching our colonies.”
[I resent this, but they are right. That is why we should—]
Flash!
It could be only seen by Lee Gun, but something flashed as it entered his shadow. It was a key!
[Sagittarius has quickly sent the item called Eden’s Key.]
[Sagittarius has quickly sent the Heavenly Peach.]
[Sagittarius says acquiring it was very hard.]
[That’s why he wants to barter with you right now.]
[He really thinks his chastity will be taken by the Great Spirit of Kunlun.]
[He says it’s an emergency!!!]
[He shouts as he asks you to quickly turn him back into a god!!!]
After receiving the items, Lee Gun grinned as if he had been waiting for this.
The angels asked him a question.
“Will you wait here? We’ll quickly go get—”
Lee Gun interrupted them. “Yes. I don’t need idiots like you guys.”
“What?”
“Did you guys really think I wouldn’t figure out your plan? You’ll make me wait a thousand years, right?”
“!”
“This is war, bastards.”
After receiving the key, Lee Gun ignored the angels and Sagittarius. He used the ticket to the colony of Eden.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - You guys can suffer too (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 381 - You guys can suffer too (1)
