“Nephew!! Let’s cut a deal!!”
In the Peach Blossom Spring, Sagittarius was sending an SOS signal to Lee Gun. “Nephew! I'm really in danger! My chastity is about to be taken away!!”
Yes, he had been dragged back to Kunlun. Originally, Abyss had eaten him. However, Kulun had chased after both of them, saying that they had to save their madam(?).
Of course, nothing good could come from facing off against one’s natural enemy, but gods were also formidable foes.
In the end, Abyss felt annoyed because it had to fight hard. However, it refused to let go of Sagittarius no matter what.
[How dare the petty gods try to take my precious food?]
Abyss tried to rip apart all the gods in contempt.
Sagittarius had no choice but to yell since he felt like a shrimp that was going to have its back blown out. He thought he was going to die. “You whale bastard! I’m not the snake god! You’re mistaken!”
Abyss had heard the sound coming from its mouth and laughed in derision.
[Stop speaking nonsense. You smell like the snake god. There is no way…]
It rolled Sagittarius in its mouth, trying to taste and savor its food. But the monarch soon furrowed its brow.
It seemed to have realized something and chewed Sagittarius before spitting him out.
“Kuhk!”
“Madam!”
Sagittarius fell to the ground. Grinding his teeth, he glared at the monarch.
‘When it thought I was Lee Gun, it ate me like candy! It tried to make me last!’
The gods of Kunlun were mystified by this sight. They glared at Sagittarius and Abyss.
“Thankfully, we were able to rescue the snake god, but what the hell happened? Why would that tenacious bastard just give up on Madam?”
“Maybe, this isn’t the snake god?”
“…!”
Sagittarius was still in his human state. So when the gods became suspicious of him, he flinched as he shook.
‘If I’m found out, I’ll be killed instantly.’
When Kunlun tried to investigate him, he quickly yelled, “I stabbed him!”
“What?”
“I possess the Achievement of bringing down Olympus! That whale has got nothing on me!”
Abyss looked at Sagittarius as if the latter was way off base, but it soon turned around. It hid its presence so that others couldn’t sense it.
Sagittarius yelled at this sight, “Look! It lost to me on the earth. That’s why it’s running away with its tail between its legs!”
“Oh. As expected of the bride chosen by the Great Spirit…!”
The dumbfounded Abyss disappeared into the shadow, but it didn’t seem to care what was said.
[At least, Kunlun was unable to drag away your old Zodiac Saint. That’s enough.]
“…!”
It was a voice that could be heard by only Sagittarius. Abyss seemed to have been referring to Hugo.
An odd expression appeared on Sagittarius’s face.
‘Why would it care if my Zodiac Saint got dragged away by Kunlun?’
Why was the monarch suddenly talking about Hugo instead of Lee Gun?
‘Does it think of Hugo as a food item?’
Hugo was always with Lee Gun, and he was Lee Gun’s Construct. So this development was understandable, but Abyss merely laughed as it disappeared.
[At the very least, I should show some respect to someone from the same race.]
“…?”
Sagittarius furrowed his brows further.
‘Same race?’
He had no idea what nonsense the monarch was spouting, but that wasn’t important right now.
“Ahhk! Why is the Great Spirit here? I was told he was away!”
In the end, Sagittarius was taken to the Great Spirit’s palace, and he was currently being chased by the Great Spirit.
‘I was barely able to acquire the peach. I even emptied Kunlun’s storage house and sent it all to Lee Gun!’
His work here was done, and he just had to run away!
‘Why the hell is my nephew not answering me?’
Sagittarius really felt like his chastity was about to be stolen, so he desperately sent out an SOS message.
“Ines! Save me!”
He used his telepathy skill toward Virgo.
- I’m sorry, but the Serpent Bearer said to leave you be. The Serpent Bearer chose not to revert you to your original state. He must have a reason for selling you to Kunlun.
“What? Really?? He sold me on purpose?”
- He said you have a Divine status that you’re hiding. He says you should release it and become a slave to the Serpent Bearer temple.
“…?!”
Was that his goal?
- Anyway, I wish you luck. If he means to refer to the Divine status of a Creator, all kinds of beings might crawl out for you.
Sagittarius flinched. Aside from Lee Gun, few knew about his past. Of course, the relationship would inevitably be revealed since he started referring to Lee Gun as his nephew.
‘Ines. Is he looking for those aiming for the Creators?’
He thought about the recent meeting with Aslan.
- I want Hyung-nim to stay near Gun and look out after him. Someone out there is aiming for the power of the Creators. This bastard might have goaded you to kill your parents.]
As if to make matters worse, this unknown being might have killed Lee Gun’s mother. It was a dark secret.
‘Some want the Creators dead.’
If Lee Gun was revealed as a surviving Creator, they would aim for him. This was why Sagittarius could become bait if he was able to drag out the power of a Creator for himself…
- Isn’t this great? You’re a bachelor. You shouldn’t feel aggrieved since your partner will be a Great Spirit.
“Hey! Why are you acting as if this has nothing to do with you? How can you act this way toward your sibling?”
At that moment…
[You are here.]
In the end, the Great Spirit of Kunlun found Sagittarius. The Great Spirit approached him as he shed his clothes.
Sagittarius desperately yelled, “Hey, you crazy bastard! I’m not the snake god! The real snake god ran away already!”
[I know.]
“What?”
In a flash, the Great Spirit pierced the body of Sagittarius.
Poo-hahk!
“Kuh-huhk…!”
Blood flew into the air. Sagittarius was in pain as he glared at the Great Spirit.
The Great Spirit laughed in an airy manner.
[I took off my clothes because I didn’t want your lowly blood on my robes.]
“…!”
Sagittarius returned to his original appearance when his chest was pierced.
[I planned on killing you with one blow. You have quite the defensive gear. Was it made by the snake god?]
The Great Spirit looked very interested, but Sagittarius couldn’t speak. He just vomited blood.
Thanks to the cloth of Life made by Lee Gun, he had avoided immediate death, but it was a critical wound.
[I never expected you to steal my precious peach from my garden in such a short period. I’ll forgive you since you sent it to the snake god.]
“Bastard….”
[You’re a famous thief in the Divine world, and you have caused a great deal of headaches to the Great Spirits. Moreover, I’ll be able to acquire at the very least a rare 5-star rank Achievement (Divine Achievement) if I kill someone with your Divine status.]
The Great Spirit looked at Sagittarius as if a treasure had fallen into his lap. He was about to slaughter Sagittarius when…
Flash!
“!”
As if they had been waiting for this moment, Sagittarius’s clothes emitted a light.
‘!’
That wasn’t all. The clothes expanded in all directions and roughly encircled the arm piercing Sagittarius’s chest.
Kwah-jeek!!
Sagittarius looked at it in surprise. The Great Spirit raised his eyebrows in contempt.
[Impertinent bastard.]
The gods of Kunlun were shocked by this sight.
“Master!”
Sagittarius heard something unbelievable.
[Serpent Bearer has activated the Creation Workshop skill.]
[Your opponent is being turned into equipment for the Serpent Bearer temple.]
* * *
Around that time…
Flash!
Lee Gun had used the permission ticket, and he was dropped inside an unfamiliar town. Hugo fell along with him, and he looked at his surroundings.
“This place is… Is it a place similar to the earth?”
It wasn’t the Divine world. This place was like the earth. Gods used this dimension as a colony. Like the humans, the residents here sent tributes to the gods. In other words, this was another world.
The difference was that they were inside a machine city.
[You have arrived at Eden Colony 1.]
[You sense a population of one hundred million.]
[They aren’t humans.]
Lee Gun immediately furrowed his brows. “I don’t know what they are, but be on your guard.”
Pah-ba-bahk!
Suddenly, a suspicious object ran toward Lee Gun and Hugo. Hugo immediately drew his bow when he felt the murderous intent.
“Gun!”
Finally, the object revealed itself. It turned out to be a monstrous beast folk.
This being boasted insane speed and savagery. It tried to bite Lee Gun.
Lee Gun summoned Heaven’s Punishment, and Hugo got ready to shoot his arrow!
Bbah-gahk!!!
“!!”
At that moment, figures fell from the sky, instantly killing the monster. The eyes of Hugo and Lee Gun turned round when they saw the familiar figures landing before them.
“Hailey!”
“Yeonwoo??”
They had no idea why these women were here.
On the other hand, Hailey and Yeonwoo finally noticed each other’s presence after killing the monster. Both women became guarded.
However, the most shocked person was Lee Gun. He had no idea why these two were here.
“Hailey was with us in the Divine world. However, she went to Scorpio, because it was calling for her. So why is she here…”
“Ah! I was chasing after the bastards from Eden when I was dropped here…”
Yeonwoo’s head turned. “Y-You were with him in the Divine world?” Her expression was asking what was going on between the two.
Oblivious to this, Lee Gun looked at Yeonwoo. “Yeonwoo, I thought you were in our house when you decided to go to Eden’s main base. So why are you here…”
“Ah! I planned on doing that, but I felt the energy of the Serpent Bearer disciples here…”
This time, Hailey’s head turned. “Our house?”
She was shocked, since it sounded like they were living together.
It was unclear as to whether Lee Gun noticed the two women’s expressions, but he spoke as if he was ready to move on. “I’m glad you guys were here before me. Did you see Sungjae and Jaewon?”
Odd expressions appeared on their faces as they looked in the same direction.
“Yes. I found the den of the enemies, but the inside was a bit weird…”
“Weird?”
They had come here thinking there would be a fight, but had found something odd.
“It must be a colony of Eden, yet I couldn’t even find a single flag of Eden…”
“The civilians who should be transporting the offerings are nowhere to be seen.”
“The only activity that I saw was cattle ruthlessly being dragged toward a strange tower at the heart of the city.”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he headed toward the town. He thought Sungjae or Lee Jaewon was in trouble.
The party ran toward the building in question, and enemies instantly appeared before them. The newcomers showed strong hostility toward Lee Gun, who had broken through the barrier.
“Intruders! Where did you come from?”
The beast folk looked to be a resident of this Eden colony. It approached Lee Gun, wanting to savagely rip him apart.
“Hey! You guys want to die? How dare you attack him! How dare you not listen to the orders of the sect leader!”
“!”
Another person appeared and violently kicked the beast folk.
Everyone flinched at the unfamiliar voice. However, something surprised Lee Gun even more at the next moment.
“Uncllllllllle!”
“!!”
Someone ran up to him and jumped at him. He clung to Lee Gun like a koala.
“Uncle!!!”
There was no mistaking it. His speech pattern and energy made it clear that he was Chun Sungjae.
However, the crying Chun Sungjae looked entirely different from the Chun Sungjae that they knew.
“Wait a moment. Are you really Sungjae? Why are you so big?”
The short kid was gone, and a grown-up Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple stood in front of them. No, he was the religious sect leader of the Eden colony.

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - You guys can suffer too (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 382 - You guys can suffer too (2)
“Uncle!”
Lee Gun was surprised when his nephew hugged him in a welcoming manner.
If one looked at this man’s way of speaking, appearance, and energy, he was clearly Chun Sungjae. However, his height and age were completely different.
In the past, Sungjae used to be 160 cm tall and looked skinny enough to be blown away by the wind. Now, he was over 180 cm tall, almost as tall as Lee Gun.
Therefore, he had to ask again, “Are you really Sungjae?”
“Of course, it’s me! Wehhh!” Chun Sungjae was so glad to see Lee Gun that he couldn’t speak coherently. “Me, me! Do you realize how long I haven’t been able to see you, Uncle!!!”
In the end, Lee Gun tapped his nephew on his rear, who continued to hang onto him. “Hey, if someone saw this, they would assume we’ve been apart for ten years.”
Chun Sungjae took deep sobs. “Two years!!! I wasn’t able to see Uncle for two years!! In two years, I could have rewatched footage for 730 days. I could have spent 17,520 hours buying goods. I could have used 63,072,000 seconds to film Uncle’s vlog!”
“Did you plan on taping me while I went to the restroom?”
He looked dismayed for a moment, but it didn’t take long for his face to harden.
“Wait a moment. What? Two years?”
It looked as if something was off. He had left the earth for six months, yet two years had passed for Sungjae.
‘Is the flow of time different here in Eden’s colony?’
Did this influence Sungjae’s growth? Of course, all of Sungjae’s genetics went toward him being smart. He wasn’t supposed to grow over 170 cm at the end of his growing phase.
‘I guess the Serpent Bearer temple is known as the temple of Life for a reason.’
He could revive dead hair, so why wouldn’t he be able to revitalize the stalled growth period? In other words, Lee Gun’s power had caused Sungjae to grow in height.
Lee Gun laughed as he said, “Hey, Sungjae. Don’t greet only your uncle. You should show some love to your father. He’ll be saddened if you don’t.”
Chun Sungjae turned his head in surprise. He finally saw his father, and he looked very happy.
“Ah…!”
However, Chun Sungjae immediately ignored his father and hugged Lee Gun once again. “I wasn't curious about Dad. I knew Uncle went to save him. Of course, you would bring him back!”
As if his world was crumbling down around him, Hugo was having a significant mental breakdown. “He should be a son who calls out to his dad. He should lovingly greet me. So why…!”
“Who the hell are you talking about?”
“Is he acting this way because I didn’t recognize him?”
“No, your son was always like that.”
“There is no way my son would act this way!” Hugo despaired.
Chun Sungjae felt something was off and was embarrassed. He looked at Hugo. “Uncle… Why is Dad acting that way?”
“Well, there is a defect in your father’s head. He’s unable to remember you guys.”
“What?! He can’t remember us?”
When he saw Chun Sungjae’s expression, Lee Gun knew he made a mistake. He quickly tried to change the subject. “Ah! It must be shocking, but it’ll be fine. Uncle will quickly recover your father’s soul, and his memories will be given back to him.”
Chun Sungjae immediately grabbed Hugo’s hand. “It’s fine, Dad. You probably forgot that you planned on giving me ten million won to further my fandom of Lee Gun-nim. However, I understand what you’re going through.”
“Sungjae?”
“You always supported my fandom of Lee Gun-nim. You were a good father who gave me money so that I could collect figurines. You also gave me your room to use as a Lee Gun-nim fan cave. It seems you’ve forgotten all about that, but I can never forget that you were so understanding. I’ll use it well.”
“….”
Sungjae was so happy that he was trying to swindle his father.
Hugo, who didn’t have his memories, started to sweat as he saw his son looking at him with bright eyes.
Did he really give up his room so that his son could pursue his fandom? Did he really plan on giving him ten million won?
“R-Really? I did that?”
“Yes! That’s why I really like you, Dad! Oh yeah! You told me to put in an order for large posters, figurines, and albums of Lee Gun-nim. They’ll be placed in the living room. Don’t worry, Dad! I ordered the highest quality frames!”
“Uh… Alright.” Hugo felt like a sucker for some reason.
Why would he let his son purchase a Lee Gun poster and hang it up in the living room? Hugo felt leery, but he couldn’t remember it. That was why he had only one train of thought.
‘It seems I was a father who prioritized the needs of my children.’
At the same time, Hugo looked at Chun Sungjae as if something was greatly bothering him.
‘I’ve seen this version of my son.’
He had seen it previously.
‘He looks the same as the one shown in the prophecy of the Delphi Oracle.’
It was around the time when Jean-Louis had invaded the holy ground of the Virgo temple. He had been overwhelmed because of Lee Gun.
- Run!
Hugo had seen it clearly.
Yooha, Sungjae, and the Archer disciples had become corpses, and the city had been decimated.
At the time, Hugo hadn’t paid much attention to that version of the future. Sungjae looked different. Moreover, the ones who could create a similar scenario to that in the prophecy had been Confusion and Time, and they were dead.
‘My son looks exactly like the one I saw in the prophecy.’
Hugo froze. Delphi Oracle didn’t tell him the date when something would happen. He had thought it was a false future, but it turned out to be a future that had been far out in time.
‘Does that mean something will cause death to my family in the near future…’
Hugo was flustered. The monarchs had been all taken care of by Gun.
‘Was it an attack from the gods?’
However, Hugo merely shook his head from side to side. This was a problem for a different time.
“Gun. We have to get out of here quickly.”
Yeonwoo spoke in a pressing manner.
“This place is Eden’s colony. If we don’t hurry, we’ll get brainwashed by Eden, including the Constructs.”
That wasn’t all.
“Moreover, Eden is warlike, like Valhalla. The residents of this colony will be formidable.”
“You’re right.”
Hailey had come to the Divine world before, and Yeonwoo had been a god of the Divine world. Therefore, they were well-informed about Eden.
‘Like Mahabharata, Eden is made up of gods that want “Order.” In fact, they have gone to war in the past to protect the rules.’
However, their definition of Order differed.
The gods of Mahabharata refrained from killing. They considered killing dirty, so the only one with the license to kill in Mahabharata was their fighting-type god. It was all left for him to do.
Basically, the way they punished others was by sending them to the Samsara hell, a place of teaching, enlightenment, patience, and control.
Eden was the opposite. They deluged the humans with punishments. In other words, they kept order through executions.
Moreover, the Constructs and civilians of this place were trained to be warriors. So they were fanatic executioners who believed unconditionally.
‘Words don’t work against them.’
Olympus was known for trade. Ennead stood for purity. Kunlun stood for charity. Mahabharata was known for public order. And Eden was known for executions.
The gods of Eden never listened to others, and in terms of cruelty, they were at the top among the eight great forces.
“If we continue to stay here, the residents will discover us…”
As expected…
“Who’s there?”
“!!”
Everyone flinched when they heard the sharp voice. It seemed the residents had realized intruders had entered this place.
The guards who looked over the Eden colony raised their weapons, glaring at Lee Gun.
“How dare a cunning snake like you crawl into Eden!”
“Disrespectful bastard! Are you here to steal Eden’s disciples?”
Moreover, they numbered in the several dozens. The snake seemed unwelcome in Eden. This had been the case in Ennead too.
‘Well, it’s understandable. Snake is an existence that tempts the gods in Eden.’
Why would Eden like the snake god?
‘Moreover, they were the guards placed over the colony.’
They were loyal to the archangel. There was no way that they’d let Lee Gun and his party leave quietly.
In the end, Lee Gun could read the mood, so he brought out Heaven’s Punishment. The enemies rushed toward him, so he released his Divine power. He was about to swing Heaven’s Punishment, but…
“Wait a moment!! Stop!!!”
“?”
The attacking guards suddenly came to a stop. They shouted as if they had seen something that they weren’t ready to see.
“That weapon…! Isn’t that the great Heaven’s Punishment-nim!!!”
“What?!”
“…?”
They seemed afraid of scratching Heaven’s Punishment. They quickly put away their weapons, and their bodies shook.
In disbelief, they looked Lee Gun up and down. “D…D…Does that mean the one holding Heaven’s Punishment is…! The one with the nasty look in his sharp eyes is…!!”
“…?”
“Him!!!”
“It is him!!!”
“…????”
The guards got on their knees in front of Lee Gun as if they were greeting their god.
“Oh, oh! How could we not recognize your noble face?”
“You look sterner than in your picture!”
“Oh snake god!”
Did they lose their mind? Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold.
Yeonwoo, who had been the previous snake god, knew Eden better than anyone here. Her and Hailey’s expressions were a sight to behold as well.
‘Eden is supposed to hate the snake...’
‘Eden has a system where they have only one god, yet they are worshiping a different one…’
The guards couldn’t even look at Lee Gun’s face as they took a beating from Sungjae.
“Hey! How could you not recognize his face at once? You lack faith!”
“Sect leader!!!” The dumbfounded Lee Gun looked at his nephew. “Sungjae?”
“Ah! Please do not worry. Everyone here is my subordinate.”
“Lee Gun-nim! Please sign this!!!”
The guards remained prostrated as they took off their shirts and handed them over to Lee Gun.
Dismayed, Lee Gun looked at Chun Sungjae.
‘What the hell did he do in his time here?’
These were the guards of Eden, who were supposed to monitor and put down any rebellions in the colony. Yet, they seemed oblivious as they called for their subordinates.
“What are you doing? Lee Gun-nim has come! Hurry up and bring all the tributes that we gathered and give them to Lee Gun-nim!”
“It’s a must if we want to grow the Serpent Bearer temple!”
When the guards yelled, screams came from the buildings.
“What? Who’s here?!”
“Lee Gun-nim?!”
These were the screams that could be heard at a concert. The ground started to shake.
At the same time, large beast folks and civilians prostrated before Lee Gun. They started stacking items that were very useful to gods. They offered Talents, Divine power-recharging snacks, and other tributes.
“Lee Gun-nim! Huhk, huhk!”
“Lee Gun-nim!! Please take this!”
“These are the tributes that the Eden colony gathered!”
These were all the tributes that should be sent to Eden.
Usually, tributes were harvested from each colony and sent to the Zodiacs. The Zodiacs used them to grow their power. As they became stronger, the number of Constructs they could possess rose. It was possible to upgrade their territory, abilities, and Divine body.
Above all else, their lifespan would grow, and they would receive special privileges from the Divine world.
“Sungjae….”
“You don’t have to be on your guard against them. All of them have over 100% faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple.”
“…”
He seemed to be telling the truth.
[Eden Guard’s Serpent Bearer Faith: 200%]
[Eden Guard’s Serpent Bearer Faith: 182%]
…
[Eden Resident’s Eden Serpent Bearer Faith: 287%]
[Other beings with Serpent Bearer Faith over 100%: 120,983,984]
What kind of missionary work did he do that he achieved a number that had been impossible to achieve on the earth?
[The Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple (Chun Sungjae) has reached level 20. He possesses a weak Divine status.]
[You may designate him as a Construct (low-rank) rank. You can grant him a Divine status that you currently possess.]
[Currently, Chun Sungjae possesses the Divine name of Demonic Sect Leader.]
Lee Gun couldn’t believe his eyes.
‘My god! The dad is a pushover, and the son is a Demonic Sect Leader.’
Unlike Divine status, Divine name was like a personal trait. He possessed two Divine names, but…
“Listen to me! Uncle… No, Lee Gun-nim is the only god. He possesses the Divine name of Beginning and End Serpent and Designer!”
“Oh, oh! He has two Divine names?!”
“It is rare for a god to possess two or more Divine names!”
“It’s something only the strongest of the gods can have! He is extraordinary!”
“He is more amazing than the owners of Eden!”
Lee Gun grabbed the back of his neck. That wasn’t all.
[A total of 120,983,984 beings want to follow the Serpent Bearer temple. They want to offer tributes.]
[It is an act that goes against the rule of the Divine world. Will you take them?]
Lee Gun smirked at the unexpected windfall. He didn’t care about the rules. Of course, he would take it. Although he was dumbfounded by this development, this was good for him.
‘I’m just paying them back for trying to steal my land.’
“What are you guys doing?”
Suddenly, an unfamiliar voice came from the sky. It looked to be two angels. They had found it odd that the residents of the colony were gathered in one place.
The angels were especially taken aback by Lee Gun’s presence.
“Guards! Didn’t I tell you to keep surveillance over the Demonic Sect Leader’s safety?”
When the angels got closer to them, Hugo immediately brought out his bow. “Should I get rid of them?”
He planned on blasting them before they arrived. However, Lee Gun smirked. “No. I’ll turn them all into my devotees.”
“What?”
“I’m stealing this territory.”
“What?!!”
“They were the ones who stole first.”
“Still, we are within their Colony! They look to be high-rank gods! Are you sure it is possible?”
When he heard those words, Lee Gun took out the Heavenly Peach, and his eyes flashed. “If they don’t want to serve me, I’ll make them want to serve me.”
The power of the snake god violently surged forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - You guys can suffer too (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 383 - You guys can suffer too (3)
“If they don’t want to serve me, I’ll make them want to serve me.”
The power of the snake god violently surged forward. The enormous power made the nearby residents scream.
Although putting it like this was a bit of an exaggeration, Lee Gun’s power looked strong enough to cover the entire planet. Moreover, he didn’t have this much power when he had gone up against the monarchs!
This shocked Hugo.
‘Does he really plan on taking this place?’
He was doing it despite this place being the home ground of the enemies?
The power of a Zodiac depended on the number of Constructs it had. A chasm existed between the number of Constructs belonging to Lee Gun and the same for Eden.
‘Normally, there is a difference of one level per a hundred Constructs amongst the Zodiacs.’
The difference in stats grew if one possessed Zodiac-rank Constructs, and all the Constructs of Eden used to be Zodiacs. One didn’t need to see Eden’s level to know that it was extremely high.
‘What if we get surrounded…’
However, Lee Gun didn’t plan on being cautious.
Hugo turned his head. “Miss Yeonwoo! Please stop him!”
Yeonwoo was Lee Gun’s family. She was an older sister-like figure and the only one who could hold him back.
“If it’s Miss Yeonwoo, even he will listen…”
However, Hugo almost screamed when he turned his gaze.
“Angel wings are quite warm. It is best to rip them off and use them as blankets.” Yeonwoo had a bright smile on her face as she took out large scissors.
Hugo screamed. “Ahhk! Please don’t act like Lee Gun! Why do you have to take after him of all people?”
“Hey, say it correctly. What do you mean, she’s acting like me? If I’m being honest, she’s the originator.”
“#$&*&!”
What kind of family was this?
Hugo grabbed the back of his neck. He quickly looked for another person who could save him. “Hailey! You should stop….”
“You just need to take the heads off the fowls.” Hailey unsheathed her sword as she flew through the air.
Hugo despaired. In the end, he didn’t want Lee Gun’s ladies to be hurt, so he took out his bow. He looked at Lee Gun with worry in his eyes. “What are you going to do about your Divine power?!”
Lee Gun handed something over to Hugo.
[Hey, Taeksoo. You are better than me.]
[Hey, Taeksoo. You are the best.]
[Hey, Taeksoo. You know I trust you, right?]
[Hey, Taeksoo. While we aren’t related by blood, you are my only brother.]
[Hey, Taeksoo. Do you know that I love you enough to be your guarantor?]
“….”
It was a recorder!
“It goes on for a hundred hours. If you stop it in the middle, you’re dead.”
“Hey. Why would this shitty thing work…!!”
[The Divine power of the Serpent Bearer rose by 50%.]
[The Divine power of the Serpent Bearer rose by 100%.]
Hugo despaired.
At this point, the angels had also realized what was going on. They were flabbergasted.
“That’s the snake god!”
In Eden, snakes were related to death. Snakes symbolized temptation and stood for Satan. And the legless being had crawled secretly into Eden.
The angels contemptuously laughed when they saw Lee Gun become hostile.
“You’re a candidate for banishment just for being a snake. It seems your intentions are impure in invading a colony as a Zodiac.”
“You’re a very young Zodiac who never experienced a fight for influence. Yet you came to steal our territory?”
“I don’t know where you got the guts to come here by yourself, but it doesn’t matter…”
At that moment…
“Protect Lee Gun-nim!”
“Send our contributions to Lee Gun-nim!”
“Lee Gun-nim! Hurry up and take this!”
“?!”
The angels couldn’t believe their ears as they watched the residents’ behaviors. The residents of the Eden colony didn’t pay any attention to the angels.
The beast folk pointed toward a building at the center of the city, an enormous tower! The building was where they collected tributes. The tributes stored inside were supposed to be transported to the Divine world.
“Lee Gun-nim! If you come this way, you won’t encounter the security barrier!”
“You have to come this way if you want to take everything!”
“?!”
The angels couldn't believe what they were witnessing. They merely looked at the residents.
The guards were opening the storerooms with their keys. The residents were offering shortcuts to the snake god and telling him about the important facilities within the city.
“Lee Gun-nim!!”
“Please take our contributions!”
“Please take our EXP!”
“Have they lost their ever-loving mind…!!”
Did they not realize what those tributes represented?! The angels were about to block them.
[Gluttony (Creator 3 star)]
However, a strong power surged forth as an enormous snake made out of light fell from the sky. It almost looked like a dragon. The light ruthlessly swallowed up the building.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!
[All the offerings of the Eden colony have been absorbed.]
[You can convert it all to Talents.]
[The estimated value is 28 billion 3.98 million and 391 Talents.]
Lee Gun laughed. The earnings generated by the colony were quite good. He would be able to purchase Permission Tickets (Exoneration) as well as a bunch of other items.
Of course, he was curious about one thing.
“Give our contribution to Lee Gun-nim!”
‘Contribution.’
This was a concept used only on the earth.
The twelve Zodiacs possessed the thrones and received EXP from the disciples to increase their own levels. That was how the system works.
‘Well, I believe the ones to make that system were the Creators.’
Anyway, why were other factions using the twelve-Zodiac system, which only the Creators had used?
As if it was answering his question, he heard a notification.
[The Bible system was created by the Creators, and the Divine world set up the Divine Achievement (Achievement) system. Creators created the disciple system, and the gods are using the colony system.]
Lee Gun immediately accepted the answer. Creators were the Divine world’s greatest technicians. This meant that the system they created had been misappropriated by the gods. The gods were misusing it.
Well, it didn’t matter.
“We lost several years’ worth of tributes because of those crazy bastards!”
“Get rid of the guards and the heretics!”
When the angels glared at them, the residents flinched and shook in fear.
Chun Sungjae raised his guard and intended to give orders. He used a new skill, which he had developed when he was given the Divine name of Demonic Sect Leader.
“Kuh-huhk!!!”
Chains surged up from the ground to encircle the angles. It was Lee Gun’s “Serpent Eater” skill!
In the beginning, Lee Gun had come here to find his nephew, and he planned on leaving then. However, he had unexpectedly gotten a taste of significant profits.
Lee Gun laughed as he held them in place. “Now that I think about it, this place is called Eden Colony 1, right?”
“What?”
“Then there are Colonies 2 and 3?”
The angels got an ominous feeling.
* * *
The Divine world’s Garden of Eden…
“What did you just say right now?”
The angels who served the sleeping Great Spirit of Eden were surprised by an unexpected situation.
“Offerings aren’t coming from the colonies!”
The high-rank angels let out sighs at the report. They were putting a lot of effort into the earth, so they didn’t want to be bothered by trivial matters.
“Don’t panic. It must be a mistake.”
“It isn’t! A problem must have occurred at the colonies…”
This made the high-rank angels smile. It meant this was a common occurrence.
“It must be the moocher gods, who came to take our resources.”
“Don’t worry! There are over 1,845 Eden colonies. Problems at one or two colonies will resolve themselves quickly…”
“That is… We lost offerings coming from all 1,845 colonies!”
“What?”
The high-rank angels finally realized something serious was going on.
“All the resources coming from the colonies were cut off?”
“What about the managers? Have you been contacted by the colonies’ managers?”
“They keep saying that they are sending us tributes like normal, but they just keep repeating odd phrases…!”
“Did you go there yourself?”
“We kept sending troops, but we lost contact with all of them…!”
“…!”
What was going on over there? The high-rank angels were frozen, and their subordinates shouted.
“At this rate, won’t we be in trouble? If we receive no supply, it’ll be detrimental to our plan of waking up the Great Spirit…”
“No, that’s not the real problem. At this rate, the Great Spirit might lose his life in an hour…”
“That’s sacrilegious! Shut your mouth!”
“!!”
They were the angels serving the Great Spirit of Eden, and their Great Spirit was the only one asleep. Moreover, they were providing nutrients that extended their Great Spirit’s lifespan.
‘How dare someone touch the Great Spirit’s food…’
In the end, the flustered high-rank angels quickly shouted orders.
“We will get rid of the culprit ourselves. You guys notify the commander on what’s going on.”
“Do not worry. It probably is nothing. We’ll visit the colonies ourselves and…”
Beeeeeee-
“!!”
Their faces turned pale when they heard the sound ringing throughout Eden…
“That alarm sound is….!”
It was an alarm that rang when Eden was in danger, but it wasn’t a normal one. It was an alarm sound that should never ring, and this alarm hadn’t rung since the monarchs had invaded the Divine world a long time ago!
* * *
“Ohhhhh!!!”
The colonies of Eden were ruthlessly destroyed by Lee Gun. He had already destroyed 1,845 locations.
Although the main force of Eden was focused on the earth right now, the internal defense of these places was still strong. However, it didn't matter at all.
[The skill of the Demonic Sect Leader is active.]
[It can forcefully raise the faith toward the Serpent Bearer to over 100%.]
In the past two years that Chun Sungjae had been stuck here, he had developed a missionary-related skill.
The young man was able to use his skill to create a free pass that allowed others to enter the temple. Of course, this skill could be maintained for a limited time and came with side effects. However, it didn’t matter.
“Kuh-huhk!! He’s the enemy! What are you guys doing?”
“Lee Gun-nim!! Hahk-hahk!”
“Lee Gun-niiiim!!”
“They’ve really lost their minds!!”
The skill was strong enough to create a schism within Eden, and it turned the colonies into a mess. Moreover, Lee Gun swept in and took away all the offerings that had been stacked within the colonies.
[Gluttony]
Kwahng!!
[You have absorbed all the tributes from 1,845 Eden colonies.]
[You have collected 100 billion 3494 Talents until now. ]
[How would you like to use them?]
“Exchange it all for Permission Tickets (Exoneration)”
This would prevent anything annoying from happening in the future.
Moreover, if Chun Sungjae’s “Forced Corruption” skill didn’t work, Lee Gun ground down angels into ingredients.
“Ahhk!”
“Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun gathered all the data from the angels and seized all the Eden colonies.
The angels, who had their wings ripped off, gnashed their teeth.
“The snake god has declared war on us!”
“He’s a psycho!”
While the Zodiacs tried to steal each other’s territories, they still maintained a line.
“You are breaking the rules!”
“Do you not know about the peace accords?”
“What nonsense is the accord?”
“Only Constructs may be used to conduct a war! It’s forbidden for a Zodiac to directly invade a territory!”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. He had heard about it.
Zodiacs never fought directly against each other.
“It’s illegal for a Zodiac to directly take the resources and land of a colony! You are plundering us!”
“Yet you— Kuhk!”
“Plunder? Hey, fuck off. When did I steal anything of yours?”
“How can you say this isn’t stealing…!”
“Tell me how is it. Did I steal by force or did your residents give presents to me of their own volition? They gave it as tributes. How can you say that when you saw it for yourselves??”
“… No!!”
“Also…”
“!”
Lee Gun stepped on the angels. “You guys invaded my land and stole my disciples, right?”
“That’s…!”
“What?”
Instead of answering, the angels bit their lips. They had no choice.
‘He’s a candidate to become a Great Spirit? He’s supposed to be one of the leaders of the gods?’
‘No way!’
‘Also, Michael-nim wanted us to separate the snake god and Pushover.’
The angels shouted when they recalled their orders.
“You weren’t recognized as an official Zodiac. Your land wasn’t registered with the Divine world!”
“The accord doesn’t apply to lands without an owner!”
“What the hell are these bastards saying?” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he raised Heaven’s Punishment.
There was no need for him to use Cycle, which consumed a lot of power.
[Death (Stage 4)]
Kwah-gwa-gwahng!!
The angels screamed as they resisted Lee Gun’s power until the end. It would have been better for them to have been converted by Chun Sungjae at this point.
“Shit…!! Shock absorption doesn’t work!”
“He’s too strong! The damage was so high that it got past the Shock Absorption— Kuhk!”
At this rate, they would all be consumed by Lee Gun, so they gestured with their hands.
“We have no choice. Call it in.”
“We have no choice but to use it!”
In the end, they used their final option. The light emanating from the angels drew a magic circle in the air.
Accompanying a massive amount of light, something revealed itself inside the summoning circle.
Lee Gun, as well as everyone, was surprised by the face that had appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - You guys can suffer too (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 384 - You guys can suffer too (4)
Lee Gun, as well as everyone, was surprised by the face that had appeared.
“Jaewon!”
Hugo was also surprised by the man who had appeared from the summoning circle. Moreover…
“That person is….”
“Isn’t that Heiji?”
Lee Jaewon wasn’t the only one summoned. He was accompanied by Gemini Saint Heiji.
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. “Why the hell is she over there?”
She was Chun Sungjae’s old boss, a magician who used to be Lee Gun’s sworn enemy.
When Lee Gun had gotten rid of Pisces, he wanted to test the power of Oblivion and Confusion, so he had kept Heiji as a subordinate. Well, that wasn’t important right now.
“She was captured by the angels too?”
“All the existing Zodiac Saints were defeated by the new Zodiac Saints in some form or other.”
They had all gone missing, so their disciples were anxiously searching for them.
On the other hand, Hailey looked oddly guarded when Heiji made an appearance. She furrowed her fine brows. “It’s best if you don’t get close to Heiji.”
“?”
Lee Gun blinked at her unexpected words. He looked at Hailey. “Didn’t you guys bury her inside the Alps?”
“!”
Hailey flinched.
Lee Gun had gone through the trouble of turning Heiji into an ally using the power of Oblivion. Since they had purposefully buried Heiji, Lee Gun’s Constructs had to spend a lot of effort to look for the Gemini Saint.
“You buried her because you said the power of Oblivion didn’t work against her, right?”
Hailey flinched once again. She didn’t have the heart to say it; she had buried Heiji because Heiji dared covet Lee Gun. The Scorpio Saint could only sweat.
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “I had to use Confusion on her too.”
“…!’
He hadn’t thought Hailey would bury Heiji without reason, so he had assumed Oblivion had failed on the Gemini Saint. This was why he had used Confusion’s power on her.
He didn’t care if Heiji attacked him, but it would be a problem if she held ill will toward the people around him.
Hailey sweated even more.
Oblivious to this, Lee Gun vigilantly looked at Heiji. “Well, it seems that the effect of Confusion has already been broken.”
There was a reason Heiji was a Zodiac Saint.
Lee Gun looked at Heiji using the Gaze of a God and saw that the effects of Confusion were gone.
It meant Heiji’s vicious temper, which had made Hailey bury her, had returned! Moreover, such a woman was standing with Jaewon?
“Did she join the side of the angels? Is she keeping Jaewon as a hostage?”
Lee Gun growled as he lifted Heaven’s Punishment.
In contrast, Heiji blanched at the sight of him. “W-Why are you here?”
“Don’t change the damn subject. You stood by the Zodiacs while you betrayed me. Now you’re trying the same thing while you stick to the angels?”
“W-What?!” Dumbfounded, Heiji looked at Lee Gun. With an aggrieved expression, she quickly rushed toward Lee Gun and whispered, “I’m trying to get rid of Eden from the inside! I’m trying to protect you since you are the Zodiac of the earth!”
“You’re trying to trick me again. Why would you protect me? Did you get shot in the head?”
“That is…!”
Heiji was about to say something when Hailey’s eyes flashed. She got between the two. “She’s the enemy. She’s a cheat. She’s wicked. There is no reason to listen to her.”
“?!”
Heiji looked at Hailey, baffled. Hailey narrowed her brows a bit as she looked back at Heiji.
Hailey knew Heiji had an interest in Lee Gun as a woman twenty years ago. She didn’t know what happened later, but the two had become sworn enemies. What about now?
‘I’m sure of it. Oblivion made her forget why they became sworn enemies.’
Hailey had no idea why the two had fought or what event precipitated their bad relationship.
Now that Heiji’s bad memories of Lee Gun were gone, Hailey was sure Heiji’s interest in Lee Gun would resurface!
While both of them were Zodiac Saints, Heiji had always been bold. She was a woman who knew no shame! In fact, that woman had once tried to pounce on Lee Gun!
This was why Hailey felt she had to be like a brick wall in blocking Heiji from doing something very bold!
Yeonwoo’s brows also started to furrow as she sensed something similar to Hailey.
“Well, it’s fine. I just have to take back Jaewon.”
“!”
Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment toward Heiji as if he was telling her to not interfere. “Sungjae. I’ll take care of that woman. You take care of the angels.”
“Yes.”
At that moment…
Shweek!
“!!”
An arrow violently flew toward Sungjae. The one to shoot the arrow was Lee Jaewon!
Lee Gun looked at him in surprise. The magical energy infused into Lee Jaewon’s arrow was Heiji’s.
Sagittarius had become human, so the Archer disciples couldn’t use their magical energy. It seemed this was why he was borrowing power from Heiji, but…
‘Jaewon attacked Sungjae?’
“Did he become brainwashed after being taken by the angels?”
However, Lee Jaewon said something very unexpected. “Lee Gun-nim! You shouldn’t stay next to that person!”
“???”
“If you stay near him, you’ll be in danger!”
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. “Hey, Jaewon. You must not recognize him because he’s all grown. He’s Sungjae.”
“That’s not what I’m trying to say! I’m not the one being controlled! Young Master is the one being controlled!”
What the hell?
“What kind of nonsense are you spouting…”
“The angels planned to let Young Master acquire the Demonic Sect Leader Divine status! It was done to offer Lee Gun-nim as a tribute to the Great Spirit of Eden! The civilians merely acted like they were converted! Lee Gun-nim, you will be in danger if you stay next to him!”
As if he had heard nonsense, Lee Gun turned to look at Chun Sungjae.
On the other hand, Chun Sungjae became angry. “There’s no way that is true! Jaewon Hyung is the one who was brainwashed! It should be obvious since he’s in league with the Gemini Saint! Moreover, Eden summoned you!”
“To regain the souls of Young Master and Hugo-nim, we just pretended to be on their side!”
Lee Gun’s eyes twinkled. “Is that so? Taeksoo’s soul is here?”
“Yes!”
Then, Lee Jaewon attacked the angels who had summoned them.
Pahng!
‘!’
Taken aback, the angels mounted a counterattack.
The two parties clashed against each other, creating enormous pressure and sending the nearby angels and residents flying.
“Koo-oohk!”
It seemed he had planned on using the wind pressure to send Chun Sungjae flying too, but Sungjae ground his teeth as he activated his defensive magic. “Uncle! Something’s wrong with Jaewon Hyung!”
“Lee Gun-nim! Don’t fall for it!“
At this point, Hugo was surprised too.
“Gun? Did you check their faith?”
“Both of them are over 100%, but faith is a useless indicator if they are brainwashed.”
“!”
Faith was something that existed deep within one’s soul. It didn’t matter if an outsider had brainwashed or manipulated the mind of a person. It was rare for one’s faith to change.
‘It doesn’t change unless one defects.’
If the faith was low, the probability of one defecting was high. However, above 100% faith, one was a fanatic. No ordinary brainwashing would work against them.
‘Those with faith of over 100% will lay down their lives if their god orders them to die.’
Basically, it was impossible to tell if mental manipulation and brainwashing had happened by looking at the quantity of faith.
Hugo felt conflicted. “Who’s telling the truth? Is it my son or Jaewon??”
“Uncle! Of course, Jaewon Hyung is brainwashed, so he’s trying to play both sides against us!”
“Lee Gun-nim! Don’t fall for it! Do you really think he could do missionary work within the base of the enemies?!”
Hugo was sweating. “Who is telling the truth?”
It was rare to see both Yeonwoo and Hailey taken aback.
“I can feel Hugo’s energy, but there is a certain logic to Jaewon’s words.”
“But I think Sungjae is capable of converting that many disciples.”
When the two of them seemed confused, Lee Gun gestured with his hand. “Ok. I understand. Both of you come here. I’ll sort this out.”
Chung Sungjae and Lee Jaewon immediately approached him.
“I swear on the heavens. I am not in league with Eden!’
“I swear too!”
“Yes. Don’t worry! I have a method that will sort this out.”
“What method— Kuhk!!!”
Lee Gun grabbed their heads and slammed them against each other.
Kwahng!!
He added his power behind the move, and it sounded as if heaven and earth were splitting.
Finally, Lee Jaewon and Chun Sungjae fell unconscious and hit the ground.
Hugo felt himself sweating. “You said you were going to sort them out? Were both of them brainwashed?”
“I have no idea. Who cares?” Annoyed, Lee Gun brushed off his hands.
Hugo was at a loss for words.
‘Since he can’t tell the difference, he hurt both of them.’
“It’s fine. Hurry up and carry them. Why are you just staring?”
“?!”
The son was unconscious, and the father was being berated by Lee Gun.
Lee Gun turned to look at Heiji.
Heiji flinched when she saw the look in his eyes. She spoke as if to clear her conscience. “I-I did nothing. As proof, I brought Hugo’s soul with me.”
“You brought Taeksoo’s soul?”
When Lee Gun’s face got closer, Heiji’s face became slightly red as she said, “Yes. When I became conscious, I was in the den of the angels. I used this to my advantage to bring his soul. I had known about Hugo being sold at auction. I had overheard that his soul was ripped apart before he was sold.”
“You were kidnapped too?” Lee Gun tilted his head as if he found that odd.
‘The angels kidnapped the ones with high faith.’
Heiji had about 90% faith toward Gemini. She wasn’t someone the angels would covet.
Therefore, Lee Gun checked Heiji’s faith, but the results only increased his confusion.
[Serpent Bearer Faith 245%]
“???”
Her faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple was very high.
Lee Gun could merely blink.
‘What’s going on? I’m pretty sure Confusion’s effect on her was dismissed.’
Was she still under the Confusion skill without him knowing about it?
This made him suspicious.
Lee Gun placed a finger on Hugo’s soul with anxiousness, an emotion he rarely showed.
“Are you sure you didn’t install a bomb on this?”
“Do you think I’m you?”
“I-I see.”
Heiji had brought out a marble letting out a subdued light.
The goddesses of fate had cut up Hugo’s soul, and this was one of the parts sold to the gods.
Hugo’s Divine status had been in Zeus’s palace. The useless human part of the souls was cut up into small pieces and sold. Unlike the Divine status, that part held Hugo’s memories and lifespan, the part that had been useless to Olympus.
‘This is the remaining 30%.’
It was something that Hugo should always have.
Lee Gun did a close assessment of the soul and handed it over to Hugo after confirming that the item was clean.
“Eat it. You will be able to recover your lifespan, memories, and power.”
When Lee Gun shoved it into Hugo’s mouth, Hugo was in pain.
“Oohp!”
Lee Gun and the slime were the same! It was to be expected since the slime was a creation of its master!
Would it kill them to do it in a more normal fashion?!
The fragmented soul passed through Hugo’s throat!
‘!’
Hugo became dazed.
[Pushover’s lifespan has returned to normal.]
[You have regained your lifespan.]
At the same time, Hugo saw something that he had never seen before in his life.
‘!’
They were the memories from his past life, which existed deep within his soul.
- Ahhk! Run!
- What the hell is he?
It was so long ago that it was called the time immemorial, a time when he had taken on a massive amount of Karmic debt.
- He is a monster that eats gods!
- Run!
- Shit! He’s too powerful! Our attacks don’t work against him!
Gods whom he had never seen before were running away. On the other hand, he was having fun killing these gods. He moved leisurely as he hunted them down.
It was unclear how much time had passed.
Poo-hahk!
Hugo had killed an unknown god and was joyously eating another. However, he shook when he saw the face of the god that he was eating. It was to be expected since the face looked very similar to Kevin’s.
‘Why is he here?’
Hugo was shocked, and he froze.
“…soo…! Hey! Oh Taeksoo!”
“!!”
Hugo became conscious when he heard Lee Gun’s voice.
Lee Gun asked, “Are you ok?”
“Uh. Yeah.”
“Do you remember your son?”
When Lee Gun picked up the slumped Chun Sungjae, Hugo screamed. “Ahhhk! Sungjae!!!”
“Also, you promised to give thirty million won to each of us so that Sungjae can continue his fandom of me. Right?”
“Stop spouting nonsense!!!”
Lee Gun nodded. “Good. Your power and memories have returned.”
It was a very odd way to confirm that, but Lee Gun seemed oblivious to it. “Since I’ve found my nephew, let’s head back to the earth.”
“!”
At that moment, Lee Gun turned around. The fallen angels groaned, inwardly letting out sighs of relief.
‘Alright. He’s finally leaving.’
‘Let’s pretend to be unconscious.’
‘As soon as he leaves for the earth, we’ll inform our commander about this.’
If this news got into their commander’s ears, an all-out war would start.
‘Hurry up and go…’
“Hey.”
“!!!’
Lee Gun grabbed the angels by the hair and pulled up their heads. They dared pretend to be unconscious in front of him. “I have some questions for you guys.”
“…!!!”
“Of course, you’ll answer them, right?”
The angels shook when they saw Lee Gun’s glaring eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - You guys can suffer too (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 385 - You guys can suffer too (5)
In a dimension far, far away…
“What? We lost all of our colonies?”
A young man who had been giving orders from a distance furrowed his brows. He was Michael, the supreme commander of Eden.
Micheal was displeased to hear that the colonies were taken from them. He narrowed his eyes. “Who’s the culprit? Is it the snake god?”
The angel giving the report trembled because of the cold voice.
“Yes. We believe the residents were converted, and all the offerings were taken.”
“Should we let the court handle this? We can claim that he committed an illegal act as a Zodiac. He looted us.”
“That is… He didn’t steal from us. The offerings were voluntarily given to the snake god. I do not believe it can be sent to the courts…”
Kwahng!!
The angel couldn’t speak any further.
The commander kicked him in the head and sent him flying. Micheal then let out a sharp laugh as he roughly pulled back the subordinate’s head. “This isn’t an arcade.”
“!”
“This isn’t the time to tell such jokes.”
Faced with the red eyes of the commander, the angel shook. He was sure he was going to be decapitated soon. A blasphemous act had been committed.
‘Since the offerings haven’t arrived, the Great Spirit won’t be able to wake from his sleep. In fact, he’ll lose his power and cease to exist.’
Eden had a system where it had only one god. The Great Spirit was the only Zodiac that existed in this faction. All the angels voluntarily claimed to be either Zodiac-rank beings or Constructs.
It was also why all the angels of Eden were desperate to awaken the Great Spirit, who had been asleep for a very long time.
“Our Great Spirit became like that because of the presumptuous Creators. Yet Eden suffered another humiliation by the snake god?”
The bloodied angel couldn’t raise his head.
“Imbeciles.”
“…!”
“It’s fine. We’ll send the earth’s offerings to Father (Great Spirit) as a substitute.”
This time, the angel couldn’t raise his head. “That is…”
“What’s wrong now?”
“A god is interfering with our work on the earth.”
“God? Who?”
“According to the report, it’s the goddess of wisdom and war…”
“Athena?” Michael scoffed as if he wanted to kill at that moment. “Olympus shouldn’t be in a spot where they can interfere with us.”
“It isn’t the Athena we know. It’s a new god…”
“Doesn’t that mean the power was given as an inheritance?”
“No. It was transferred. Moreover, it was given to the human girl who is the Zodiac Saint of the snake god— Kuhk!”
The subordinate was being choked. He could no longer speak as he vomited blood.
“Idiots, are you tired of living? Do you want me to give your powers to others as an inheritance? Why the hell do you keep making work for me? Do you guys want to die?”
“That isn’t it— Huhk!”
Michael let out a bright yet violent smile as he choked his subordinate. “Is that all you have to say for your will?”
The subordinate shook. In Eden, the supreme commander was the highest-ranked leader, who was a proxy for the Great Spirit. He carried out the Great Spirit’s function. Moreover, his power almost rivaled that of the eight Great Spirits.
In other words, the angel might really die if he spoke the wrong words. Unfortunately, he still had more to say to the supreme commander. It was the most important part.
“When the snake god invaded, the alarm bell started ringing, the alarm bell that should never be rung.”
“Bell?”
“Yes. It rang last when the Great Spirit fell into a deep sleep…!”
That bell rang whenever Eden’s future was in danger. It had rung only once, when Eden was in danger of being destroyed.
It was a bell that should never be rung, a sound one should never wish to hear.
‘In the past, that monster invaded us and committed a great outrage against the Great Spirit. The sound was heard on that day.’
“If it weren’t for those underhanded Creators, the Great Spirit would have never gone to sleep…”
Creators were technician gods, who worked directly under the Divine world. They had been small in number, and they weren’t beings that fought battles. But they were a precious tribe that could never be replaced. They were the only ones who could fix the Divine world.
‘Only they can awaken our Great Spirit.’
“Since the bell was rung, you have to go there quickly…!”
“It’s fine. I know why it was rung.”
“What? You know why it was rung?”
Michael snorted. “It’s the archer who stands with the snake god. He’s the reason the bell rang.”
“The archer…”
“Why do you think Sagittarius picked him as his Zodiac Saint? Is he that big of an idiot? Is he bored of living? Is he choosing a new way to kill himself?”
The angel, who was vomiting blood, shook again. Only one such person had accompanied Lee Gun. It was Pushover, who had been chosen as a Zodiac Saint by Sagittarius.
“The bell really rang because of him?”
“Damn Mahabharata! Why the hell did they let that monster be reborn? I was against it.” Michael narrowed his eyes as if he detested Hugo.
In the past, Hugo had been a monster that had killed and eaten many gods.
“How dare a shameless sinner like him live again pretending to be a human?” Michael clasped his hands behind his back as he said in a low voice, “Come out, Raphael.”
Like the twelve pillar gods of Olympus, Eden had five archangels. This included Michael.
However, only two of them were left. The rest had been eaten by the monster who stood next to Lee Gun.
‘I’m sure their Divine statuses were hidden by that monster. That’s why we couldn’t find them.’
Well, it didn’t matter.
“Let’s go. I’ll take care of him myself.” Michael disappeared toward the gate of Eden.
* * *
At the colony of Eden…
“Huh….”
The muscular men looked almost mesmerized by the scene in front of them. They saw a destroyed land, with mounds of angel corpses stacked there. Then they saw a large population of residents cheer at the sight of the corpses.
The Leo disciples clicked their tongues.
“Let me get this straight. Lee Gun-nim…”
“You forcefully took their land and the almost two billion residents…”
“The land from 1,845 locations…. He turned it all into the colonies of the Serpent Bearer temple…”
“You want us to help you steal?”
These words angered Lee Gun. “Steal? Hey! The land and tributes were all given to me by my disciples!”
“Yes… In the process, you destroyed all of their civilization.”
The Leo disciples had arrived here after Lee Gun had called for them, and Lee Gun’s new land had left them dumbfounded.
Lee Gun had even summoned Red Eye to destroy all the items belonging to Eden and had stolen all their resources.
The Leo disciples were at a loss for words.
‘As expected of Lee Gun-nim….’
‘He’s great at invading too.’
‘At this rate, you can call him a pirate.’
Lee Gun raised his eyebrows when the Leo disciples looked at him as if he were a thief. He had called for them to colonize this place and to move resources. That was all well and good, but…
“I called for the cat bastard. Why are you guys here? What happened to him?”
The Leo disciples flinched. Lee Gun didn’t seem too interested in the Zodiac Saints, yet the Leo disciples gave an answer.
“S-Stevens-nim went missing.”
“What? He’s missing too?” Lee Gun had planned on killing Stevens because he had harassed Hailey in the past.
The disciples were unable to raise their heads.
“He lost to the new Zodiac Saint.”
“He was barely able to stay alive, but his whereabouts are unknown…”
The Leo disciples looked at Lee Gun with hope in their eyes. It was the main reason they had agreed to come here at Lee Gun’s summon.
“Still, we are glad to see Lee Gun-nim.”
“Me? Why?”
“Why else?! Lee Gun-nim is the strongest person on the earth.”
“If it’s Lee Gun-nim, you will be able to save Stevens-nim!”
“That’s right. We’ll be able to save Stevens-nim if we have Lee Gun-nim!”
Lee Gun snorted. “Have you lost your mind? Why would I rescue him?”
“What?”
“Y-You guys used to be comrades. Currently, he is a subordinate Zodiac Saint…!”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “They look more useful in terms of fighting ability. They also seem to have more sense. Above all else, they seem to be my fans.”
“L…Lee Gun-nim!!”
“He lost a fight. Since I planned on filling the empty seats, this might be better for me. It’ll be the changing of the guard.”
“Ahhhk!!!’
The Leo disciples were shocked. They quickly grabbed onto someone.
“Say something to him, Hugo-nim!’
“What?”
“Kevin-nim is also gone!”
“Hugo-nim, weren’t you best friends with Stevens-nim and Kevin-nim?”
Hugo’s actual best friend kicked the Leo disciples. “Moreover, I left them alive for my EXP! You guys should become my EXP too!”
“Ahhk! Hugo-nim!”
The Leo disciples called for help, but Hugo wasn’t listening to them. He looked nauseous as he covered his mouth.
When Kevin was mentioned, Hugo remembered his vision. He felt the sensation of eating someone who looked like a person he knew. Of course, it wasn’t a good feeling. He remembered the being had wings.
At a glance, he looked like a high-rank angel. Did the angel merely look like Kevin? Or were they related by blood?
‘Or are they the same person…?’
That wasn’t all.
‘I thought I saw someone that looked like Jiwoo too.’
Bbah-gahk!
“Kuhk!!”
Lee Gun suddenly hit the back of Hugo’s head since Hugo had been lost in thought.
A strength that could send monsters flying hit Hugo.
Hugo became angry. “What the hell are you doing?”
“Why aren’t you saying anything, asshole?”
“What!!!”
“You should say I’m your best friend! Are you embarrassed about me?”
“???!!”
What the hell???
“I think of you as a brother, yet you can’t even say I‘m your best friend!”
The dumbfounded Hugo vomited blood. Lee Gun’s words and actions didn’t match up!
After beating Hugo half to death, Lee Gun spoke as he brushed off his hands. “It’s fine. I have to find them either way.”
“A…As expected of Lee Gun-nim!”
“You’re going to save the Zodiac Saints….”
“They might be the reason the earth falls in twenty years.”
“What??”
It felt as if their goals differed. However, their puzzlement lasted only a moment.
[You took out an item from the Pond.]
Lee Gun took out an item, which he had stored in his shadow. It was an ark.
[Eden’s Ark (SSS)]
- It manages all the gates to Eden and the related territories.
- Only those chosen by the Great Spirit may use it.
He had found this item when the angels had volunteered(?) their help.
In simple words, this was an overall system that managed the entrances and exits to Eden. Lee Gun would be able to send offerings anywhere he wanted with this. He could also gain control of the gates placed all over Eden and choose the points of entry and exit.
[You can use the attribute of the Designer to analyze and decipher the item’s information.]
[The coordinates of the transportation routes have been changed.]
[You have changed the coordinates.]
[Offerings] Eden Colony ▶ Eden (Before change)
[Offerings] Eden Colony ▶ Earth (After change)
He fixed it so that any accumulated offerings would now head toward the earth.
[All Inbound Travelers] [Eden ▶ Abyss(Monarch)] (After change)
“Oh yeah. Eden also has a gate.” He laid hands on the gate connecting Eden and the earth.
[All Inbound Travelers] [Eden ▶ Earth] (Before change)
[All Inbound Travelers] [Eden ▶ Monarch Populated Area] (After change)
The captured angels turned pale from fright when they saw the change.
‘Wait a moment! The angels of Eden will be sent toward the monarchs….’
They realized what Lee Gun was planning, so they tried to alert their headquarters of this truth.
‘We have to tell our comrades! They must not take the gates!’
At that moment, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he lifted Heaven’s Punishment high. Blood and feathers flew into the air!
Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!
[You have acquired Data.]
[You have acquired Data.]
[You have acquired Data.]
[You have acquired Data.]
Lee Gun started destroying all the evidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - Brainwashed? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 386 - Brainwashed? (1)
“Kuh-huhk…!”
“Help— Kuhk!”
Lee Gun killed all the angels who told him about the ark, silencing them for good. That wasn’t all.
“This will be enough for me to make a new bedroom.”
“Ahhhhk!”
“Stop plucking— Ahhk!!’
Hugo and the Leo disciples turned pale from fright when they witnessed Lee Gun pluck out the angels’ feathers.
Was he trying to make a baby room for Hugo’s third child? Or was he trying to make his own honeymoon (?) room?
After plucking all the feathers from the angels, Lee Gun smiled as if he felt much better. He lifted a large bundle and laughed. “What are you doing? I opened the gate with the ark. Let’s go.”
“A-Are you sure it’ll be ok?”
“Yes. I got enough ingredients with this.”
“I wasn’t referring to that…”
“Ah! I took out the Divine statuses of those who weren’t worth using as ingredients. I delivered them to Abyss.”
“… That isn’t…. Ah. Whatever.”
Hugo felt as if Abyss was being treated as a food waste disposer. However, he didn’t go out of his way to point this out. He had something to do before that.
“Gun. You might be perceived as a threat by the other gods. So you should designate only the largest colonies amongst the 1,845 locations as your colonies…”
“I’m designating all 1,845 locations as Serpent Bearer colonies.”
“Why don’t you listen to others?”
Lee Gun ignored him as green light emanated from the colonies.
[Do you intend to turn all 1,845 locations into Serpent Bearer territory?]
[Will you take in 2,084,783,478 residents?]
[Managing so many residents with so few Constructs might be a tall task.]
“Yes. I already acquired slaves, who will be in charge of the colonies. It doesn’t matter.“
At this point, Hugo was at a loss for words. He merely massaged his forehead. Moreover, it would be easier to go with the flow instead of asking Yeonwoo to stop Lee Gun.
“You already have a tiny number of troops! What if you expand your territory and make enemies of all the gods?!“
“It’ll be great. I’ll be able to make a living room using them.“
“Damn it!!!”
It didn’t matter in the end.
After he had killed all the witnesses, Lee Gun headed toward the gate connected to the earth.
[Eden’s Ark (SSS) is being activated.]
[Eden’s Ark is creating a new place of departure.]
[Eden Colony ▶ Serpent Bearer Holy Ground]
[If you add destinations to the ark, you will be able to travel to a variety of dimensions (148 slots remaining).]
He still hadn’t figured out whether Eden had brainwashed Sungjae or Jaewon, but it didn’t matter.
‘I’ll just beat them up if they get out of line.’
Finally, their surroundings changed.
Lee Gun smiled when he took in the familiar air and buildings. “Alright. I’m back home.”
“Hey! This is my house??” Hugo glared at Lee Gun.
Whenever Hugo was about to have a good time with his wife, Lee Gun would suddenly appear on top of the bed using the Holy Ground Return skill. He told the couple to not pay attention to him and carry on, then disappeared afterward.
“Who cares? You have no problems having kids now. In fact, weren’t you able to have your third child because of my blessing?”
Hugo was deciding whether to kill Lee Gun or keep him alive when…
Kwahng!!
“!!”
An enormous monster appeared in front of the Lee Gun tower. This one looked a bit different from the other monsters.
At a glance, it looked like an armored lifeform wearing items made out of metal.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “Is it the devil-type monster, which appeared the last time?”
Unconcerned, Lee Gun took out Heaven’s Punishment. He tried to blast away the monster.
Koohng!!
“!!”
However, when Lee Gun met eyes with the monster, as if someone had jarred his brain, he faltered.
“…!”
“Gun!”
Lee Gun felt as if the strength was draining away from his body. The monster used this small window of opportunity to attack him.
‘!’
Hailey and Yeonwoo had just exited the gate, and they flinched. This was especially true of Yeonwoo, who realized what was going on.
‘Isn’t that the being made to neutralize Creators…!’
Yeonwoo was quick to realize what was going on. She was about to step forward, but…
Zzuh-uhng!!!
“!”
Enormous ice pillars shot up from the ground and froze the monster. It was Heiji’s area of effect spell.
She approached Lee Gun as if she was worried. “Are you ok, Gun?”
“In terms of reaction time, you were always the best amongst us.” Hugo said as he lowered his bow.
Yeonwoo and Hailey were aggrieved. They were capable of doing the same thing!
Yeonwoo pouted since she used to be a Zodiac in the past. Until now, she had been using the data given to her by Lee Gun. However, she didn’t possess a Divine status. This was why she felt as if she was falling behind.
On the other hand, Lee Gun massaged his forehead as if he couldn’t comprehend this situation. “Why are you helping me? What is your goal?”
“W-What?!”
Heiji looked aggrieved. She was about to say something. However, Yeonwoo cut in to ask a question. It was because although Lee Gun was picking a fight with Heiji, he looked quite close to her.
“Excuse me, Mr. Hugo. Was she close to Gun in the past?”
“What? No… That is…!” The flustered Hugo didn’t know what to say, so he was sweating.
[That woman is terrible. She is aiming for Lee Gun-nim!!]
“!!”
Men with the head of black insects appeared from Hailey’s shadow. They were Cluders, but they were currently Constructs of the Scorpio temple.
[When Lee Gun-nim needed medicine, she was the Zodiac Saint who requested a steamy night with him as recompense!]
[If it weren’t for our Sage Time skill, Lee Gun-nim would have been…!!]
It was a corrupted version of the story, but it was enough for Yeonwoo.
“Steamy night… Steamy night….”
“M…Miss Yeonwoo?” Taken aback, Hugo looked at her.
On the other hand, Yeonwoo looked at Lee Gun as if she had come to a decision.
In the end, Lee Gun ordered Heiji to be monitored. He believed Heiji was helping him as part of a plot.
Then he finally entered the first floor of the Lee Gun tower.
“Lee Gun-nim.”
“Welcome.”
“!”
Goat and the Archer disciples should be greeting him, yet unfamiliar faces stood in front of Lee Gun.
The ones surprised by their appearance were the Constructs of the Scorpio temple, who remained in Hailey’s shadow.
[Those bastards are…!]
“We never expected the Serpent Bearer temple to use the same temple as the Archer temple…”
“As Zodiac Saints, we are now in charge of being caretakers of this place.”
“We are Vince and Anna. We will be serving Lee Gun-nim from now on.”
“…?”
A beautiful man and woman stood in front of them.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
‘That woman is…’
He had seen her in the Akashic Record when he was viewing Lee Jaewon’s past. “You’re the woman who fought Jaewon for the Archer Saint’s seat.”
“What? Does Lee Gun-nim already know about me?”
Anna was in disbelief. She looked at Lee Gun as if she was enraptured. She was beautiful enough for Sagittarius to acknowledge her; she had fulfilled the beauty requirement needed to enter the Sagittarius temple.
On the other hand, Hugo’s mouth had fallen open. “The seat of the Archer Saint really changed hands? It happened without my permission??”
Anna laughed as she said, “I do not wish to be rude, but we heard Hugo-nim isn’t part of the Sagittarius temple. We heard you are the disciple of the Serpent Bearer temple. Hugo-nim already lost the right to have a say in our affairs. Moreover, I fought Lee Jaewon, whom Lee Gun-nim is carrying. I won the seat of the Zodiac Saint.”
Her words were oddly antagonistic. Hugo furrowed his brows. However, it didn’t take long for their eyes to widen.
“The Sagittarius temple is an affiliate under the Serpent Bearer temple. While waiting for Lee Gun-nim’s return, I increased the number of Archer disciples.”
Their mouths fell open when they saw the number of disciples.
[Archer disciples: 83,748]
“There are over 83 thousand disciples?!”
“If the support disciples are counted, there are a total of a hundred million disciples.”
“…one…one hundred million…”
It was a number that Hugo couldn’t even dream about.
Lee Gun said, “Wow! She’s better than you. They are quite skilled. Maybe, I’ll be better off with them as Zodiac Saints.”
“What? Hey! That’s not true at all…!”
“How many Archer disciples did you have around the world when you were the Zodiac Saint??”
“…Fifty-eight….” Hugo despaired.
Anna looked at Lee Jaewon. “Originally, I planned on exercising my right as the Zodiac Saint to end the life of the old Zodiac Saint. However, I chose to banish him since he is under Lee Gun-nim.”
“!”
“If Lee Jaewon agrees to serve me as the Zodiac Saint, I am willing to take him back.”
“Alright. You take care of the Sagittarius temple. Who are you?” Lee Gun looked at the beautiful man standing next to Anna.
The man took a knee as if he was beholden to Lee Gun. “I am someone who aspires to become the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer. Originally, I wanted to fight Chun Yooha or Chun Sungjae. However, I couldn’t do so. That’s why I came here for Lee Gun-nim’s permission. This is a small token of my sincerity.”
“Oh.” Lee Gun looked at the man who had used his excellent ability to scrape together disciples and donations. The list impressed Lee Gun.
“When it comes to faith toward Lee Gun-nim, we won’t be found lacking. Please allow me the chance to fight for the seat of the Zodiac Saint!”
“Mmm. I don’t mind it, but Sungjae and Jaewon are unconscious right now.” Lee Gun looked at Lee Jaewon and Chun Sungjae. His Constructs had them over their shoulders as if they were sacks of rice.
It seemed Lee Gun had put too much power behind his attack. The two of them weren’t able to wake up easily.
“Then the disciples of the Serpent Bearer can be chosen according to Lee Gun-nim…”
Boo-hahk!!
“!!!”
Lee Jaewon, who had been unconscious, opened his eyes and rushed toward the Zodiac Saints.
The new Archer Saint Anna seemed to enjoy this fact. She let out her magical energy. “You dare get in my way! It is fine. As the Archer Saint, I’ll be generous. I’ll allow a rematch—”
“I’m the one who’ll become the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple!!”
“?!”
However, Lee Jaewon didn't charge toward Archer Saint Anna. He unexpectedly rushed toward Vince, the candidate aspiring to become the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple! It seemed Lee Jaewon wanted to become the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple.
Anna was dumbfounded when she was ignored. She looked at Lee Jaewon.
Lee Gun and Hugo seemed surprised too.
“J-Jaewon?”
Was it because he was brainwashed by Eden? As if an instinct buried deep within him had resurfaced, Lee Jaewon attacked Vince. “I’m the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple!!”
As if responding to Lee Jaewon’s voice, Chun Sungjae raised his head. “How dare you aim for my seat!!”
Chun Sungjae was out for blood as he sent a close-range flame attack toward Lee Jaewon. Originally, Sungjae was a long-range magician and was squishy like a paper doll. However, it seemed he had become a close-range magician now. He quickly attacked Lee Jaewon.
The new Zodiac Saints were dumbfounded to see this fight.
“What the hell are we watching?”
Chun Sungjae’s eyes flashed as he fought Lee Jaewon. “It’s fine. Since things turned out like this, I’ll take out the Archer Saint and convert them into Serpent Bearer disciples!”
“??!!”
Instead of attacking Lee Jaewon, Chun Sungjae attacked the new Archer Saint Anna.
Anna was surprised. “Who is that crazy bastard?”
“Who else? It’s Sungjae.”
“What?! That huge guy is Chun Sungjae?”
Chun Sungjae ignored them as he shouted, “I’ll combine both the Sagittarius temple and the Serpent Bearer temple! I’ll turn them all into ashes! I’ll take out Uncle too!!”
Hugo had no idea what was going on, so he grabbed Lee Gun.
Lee Gun finally realized what had happened. “Ah! Both of them were brainwashed. In turning them into their servants, Eden brainwashed them into losing control.”
“What?!” Hugo was dumbfounded.
Both of them were brainwashed, yet they had attacked the angels and converted the Eden colonies?
Well, it didn’t matter.
Lee Gun looked at the two, who stated that they were the new Zodiac Saints, and furrowed his brows.
‘How are they able to use magical energy? Which Zodiacs are giving them power?’
It wasn’t him. It also wasn’t the twelve Zodiacs. Neither did it feel like the power of Eden.
‘It feels similar to the monarchs.’
This feeling was a problem.
‘It feels similar to Hailey.’
Was it connected to Hailey’s parents?
* * *
Around that time….
Flash!
Michael and Raphael, the leaders of Eden, appeared in a location that looked to be a jungle. They had mobilized to attack Lee Gun.
They rode Eden’s gate, which headed toward their colony.
“How many angels did you bring?”
“About ten thousand, enough to overwhelm the snake god.”
“Yes. However, the energy over here is annoying me. How much of a rampage did the snake god go on…”
At that moment…
“Uh?”
Michael pushed aside a large leaf, and his face became distorted. “Wait a moment.”
The location before him was filled with monsters, including four monarchs. Their eyes flashed coldly.
“This isn’t our land!”
The eyes of the angels and the monarchs locked onto each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - Brainwashed? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 387 - Brainwashed? (2)
“This is crazy…!”
The archangels cursed under their breaths as they met eyes with the beasts.
Standing before them were the Cluders!
The angels were surprised. Although this location looked similar in appearance, it wasn’t their colony.
The young man next to Michael noticed where this was and immediately said, “Michael! From the looks of them, we seem to be inside the territory of the monarchs!”
“Even a blind man can see that, idiot!” Michael quickly summoned his sword. “What are you looking at, idiots? Let’s head back right now!!”
They desperately moved toward the gate and caught sight of the ten thousand angels who had followed them.
Poo-hahk!!
“Kahhk!!!”
Poo-hahk!”
“Ahhk!”
“Kuh-huhk!”
As if they were offended that the angels had the audacity to try to head back, the monsters instantly went for the throat of the angels.
Many of these monsters looked like beasts on all fours; some even looked like insects and octopuses.
“M-Michael-nim… Ahhk!!”
The angels were bitten and dragged away by their necks, their arms ripped off and their stomachs ripped open.
The angels had been crowded around the gate, and it instantly turned into a scene of pandemonium.
Michael ground his teeth as he quickly stabbed his sword into the ground and put up a barrier. “Kill the ones inside the barrier!”
Flash!
While the monsters could no longer get close to them, they were small fries. But one being there was important.
[Look who it is. It’s the high and mighty ancient birds and their sparrows.]
“…!”
It was none other than a monarch.
The angels glared at the being when they felt an energy from it that could rival a Great Spirit.
‘They are the damn gluttonous pirates.’
They used their words, appearances, scents, and traps. By any means necessary, they lured and violated the souls and bodies of their prey. They were terrors.
[Did you guys come on your own so that we can eat you?]
“Shut up! You guys are mere insects who only think about eating and playing around, so how dare you…!”
They were stupid and vulgar looters, yet they dared to challenge gods with deep history.
Michael glared at them, but restrained himself. If they fought against the monster, the angels were the only ones who would suffer.
“What are you doing?! Open the gate again!”
“We cannot return, Michael. The gate is closed.”
“What?”
“The ark isn’t responding to us. Someone might have meddled with it.”
Michael expressed his annoyance. “Which psychotic bastard is responsible for this…!”
Michael swore toward the heavens since he realized who the culprit was. “This is why I wanted to burn all the snakes in the Divine world!!”
It had to be the doing of Lee Gun. He must have messed with the address of the teleport to screw over Eden. The archangel was sure of it.
However, this also raised a question. Something was off.
