Lee Gun laughed as he looked at the baby wrapped in a blanket. “It’s a girl. You must be loving it, right?”
“Ah…!” Hugo’s face brightened when he saw the child.
Chun Sungjae had followed in after Hugo. It seemed he was moved since he was shedding tears(?). “Finally, I’ll have a brother and sister relationship for the first time. This is the best.”
“Hey, we are brother and sister.”
“I don’t care about that, since having a little sister is the best. Unlike someone I know, she’s really pretty. She’s the best.”
Chun Sungjae took a hit once again.
His older sister was known for her beauty around the world and was popular. However, she was merely someone he could share information about their fandom. She merely shared the same family registry as him.
On the other hand, the newly born baby was cute and pretty. That wasn’t all.
“Your third child looks just like you, right?”
Hugo cried out. He was deeply moved. Yooha and Sungjae bore strong resemblances to their mother.
However, the third child looked like Hugo. Her eyelashes were long, and she had the same light hair and eyebrow color as her father. Hugo preferred his kids looking like his wife, but for some odd reason, the children resembling their mother liked Lee Gun more than him.
“Thank you, god!!”
“You’re welcome.”
“…”
Chun Jiwoo lifted the child toward him. She wanted to let Hugo hold her. “Please greet her.”
Hugo extended his arms as he looked at the small, twitching child. He felt a storm of emotions as he wailed out loud. “This is why you said I’ll cry!! Jerk!”
Faced with Hugo’s wail, Lee Gun blanched. “That isn’t it.”
“What? What do you mean?”
“Well… You better see for yourself.”
“S…See for myself?”
At that moment, Hugo got an ominous feeling. He almost screamed as he was about to take the child. “Ahhhhk!”
When he was about to receive the baby, his third child flew into the air as if she was dodging his hands. It wasn’t an exaggeration. She truly flew into the air.
“????!?!!”
Hugo’s expression was a sight to behold as the newborn baby floated away from his hands. He screamed as he tried catching the baby on impulse, but the baby was truly flying through the air! “Ah! Huh? What the hell is this?”
Everyone shook their heads because they had the same reaction already.
“As you can see….”
“The child isn’t normal….”
“?????”
However, the important part started right now. The flying baby twitched her arms and legs as she flew toward Lee Gun.
As if she liked Lee Gun, she landed on his shaggy hair. It was as if she considered Lee Gun her father. She laughed with a very satisfied expression on her face.
Lee Gun wore the baby like a hat. He pointed at her as if he was making a point. “It seems she imprinted me as her father.”
“#*$&#*#?!!” Hugo’s words were indecipherable as he quickly took back his child. “She thinks your head is a toy. That is why she flew toward you! Hi! I’m your dad…!”
Hugo hugged the child tight as if he would never let her fly toward Lee Gun again. “See? She loves her father—”
However, Hugo couldn’t speak any further.
Shoong!
Instead of liking him, the baby disappeared from his arms.
“?!!!”
When the baby disappeared, Hugo looked like he was having a mental breakdown. “Where did she go?”
“Over here.”
“?!”
She had disappeared as if she had teleported and appeared in Lee Gun’s arms. It did seem she had imprinted Lee Gun as her dad. She liked Lee Gun.
However, she had teleported to him. Hugo seemed aggrieved. He looked at Chun Sungjae, a magician. “I no longer know you, son!!! How dare you get revenge against me like this!”
Even if he liked his uncle, there was no need for him to screw over his father by using teleportation.
Chun Sungjae pouted as if the insinuation had offended him. “Even I wouldn’t use teleportation on a baby. It’s dangerous.”
“You didn’t teleport her?”
That meant…
Lee Gun returned the baby to Chun Jiwoo and grinned. “It seemed she was awakened before birth, and she imprinted me as her father.”
“#$*$#&*#!!!”
“Dude, talk in human language.”
“#$*&#$#$^!! $&$*$#&*!!!”
Hugo returned to being primitive when he was made fun of.
In the end, Hugo was sad. He wailed as he grabbed onto his wife.
Chun Jiwoo patted his back. “It probably has to do with the fact that Lee Gun-nim used a lot of his power of Life on us.”
“Ahem! For prenatal education, I read Uncle’s biography to her every day.”
“For prenatal education, I turned on Uncle’s documentary series.”
“Ah…! Please do not worry! I told old stories about Hugo-nim! It was mostly about Hugo-nim taking a beating from Lee Gun-nim, but…”
They were of no help!!!
“#$^$&#^ (You are all the same)!!”
“At least, Guisoon tried to brainwash her by saying Uncle is a bad person. I guess it was useless?”
“She said she’ll be overworked to death trying to organize the bible. It was why Guisoon cussed as she went hard on the prenatal education…”
The two siblings pouted as if to say they didn’t think the amount that they had expanded the bible by wasn’t unreasonable.
In the end, Chun Jiwoo patted Hugo’s back. She assured him that his daughter would recognize him as her father soon.
Lee Gun was relieved since nothing too bad had come out of this.
‘Well, the earth is going to be in an uproar for a while.’
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. According to Kevin, the angels had caused strife on the earth, and they had created connections all around the world to the Divine world. The detestable gods were starting to cross over into the earth.
‘How dare they think about making my territory a battlefield for gods?’
He should have known they were up to no good when they had tried to plant that strange tree on the earth.
Then there was another problem. It was Hugo’s soul.
‘Well… He seems fine for now.’
It seemed the information about Hugo’s true identity had been spread across the Divine world. However, that wasn't important right now.
“Husoon!!!!”
“What?”
“My third child’s name will be Husoon!!! It is Husoon since she loves her dad!!!”
Lee Gun chopped down on Hugo’s head.

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - What is that? (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 394 - What is that? (5)
“Husoon!!!” Hugo’s eyes flashed as he picked up the birth certificate.
Everyone looked at him in contempt.
“Are you serious?”
“Yes! Look! The kid loves it!!! Husoon!!”
The sounds of someone crying could be heard when he spoke those words. It was his third child, and it seemed she didn’t like the name.
When the baby cried, everyone narrowed their eyes at Hugo.
“She’s crying….”
“She hates it….”
“She says to get rid of it…”
“How about Huri?”
“What?”
“Hudo? Huji? Huja? Husook?”
“Wehhhhhhhh!!!!”
The youngest kept crying as if she would rather be dead(?) than have those names.
Lee Gun watched this as he picked up and ate a red bean bread. He looked at Hugo as if the man were pathetic. “Look. She hates it so much that she’s crying. She doesn’t want her father’s name to be a part of her name.”
“There is no way that is true!!! It’s a coincidence!!! She’s just hungry right now!”
“I’m being serious. Right, Sungjae?”
“You’re right. Let’s try this.” Chun Sungjae put on a show as he let out a bright smile toward the baby. “Lee Gun!”
“Kyaa!”
“Gunsoon!”
“Kyaaaa!’
“Gunja!”
“Kyaaaaaaa!”
“Gunsook!”
“Kyaaaaaaaaa!”
There were no signs of the youngest being in tears. Instead, she let out a bright toothless smile.
Lee Gun cackled as if he wanted Hugo to see this. “See? She likes everything with my name in it.”
“There is no way…!”
“Just put down my name.”
“Fuck off!!!!” Hugo roared in despair. “There is no way my daughter… No way…”
Hugo despaired as he watched his daughter show favor toward Lee Gun. He cried in front of her, sniffing. “Let’s make a compromise! Hugun! No, Husnake!!!”
“…”
Lee Gun still had the red bean bread in his mouth, and his expression was a sight to behold. It was a look of disdain as if to say he couldn’t believe someone like Hugo was born in this world.
Hugo continued to howl. “Why? I put something similar to your name— Kuhk!!!”
He took a hit again. The hit was accurate this time; Lee Gun had hit the crown of Hugo’s head. Hugo couldn’t speak any further as he fell to the ground.
In the end, Lee Gun lamented as he looked at the youngest. She had just opened her eyes, and it seemed she wanted Lee Gun to hold her. The cute little hands of the baby extended toward him.
“If she were a boy, Gun would have been fine. However, she’s a girl. The name doesn’t go well with her.”
The ones to be surprised by his words were none other than Yooha and Sungjae. This was especially true of Sungjae, who was male. It was as if he had heard the world was coming to an end.
“It was possible…? Is that how it is…?”
Sungjae trembled as if he had received a shock.
Lee Jaewon tilted his head as he looked at the young man. “Young Master? What’s wrong?”
“I want to go back to the past. Would it be ok if I change my name…?”
“Young Master?”
“What if I use Cycle to be reborn again?!”
“Young Master!!!”
“At that point, I can change my chromosome and come back, right!!?”
“Sungjae!!!!” Lee Jaewon screamed as he desperately tried to stop Sungjae.
Chun Sungjae was sad for a moment, but he raised his head when he heard Lee Gun’s words.
“Didn’t you guys already make a list of names to choose from?”
“Ah. Yes. We do have names that we picked out with Mom.”
Since the father wasn’t present, the family had been unable to finalize the name choice. This was why Chun Jiwoo had planned on making Hugo choose from the list after he returned. But…
“Husoon… Husook… Huja….”
The father was acting that way.
In the end, Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “Let’s just pick the one the baby likes the most amongst the backup names.”
“Ah! I would like Lee Gun-nim to choose the name.”
“What? Me?”
“Yes.”
Chun Jiwoo looked at Lee Gun with anticipation. “If it weren’t for Lee Gun-nim, the baby and I would no longer be in this world. You’re the benefactor who saved my child.”
“…!”
“If it isn’t a bother, I would like to ask you to do this… Is it ok?”
“I’m fine with it if you are.”
“Ah. Thank you very much!”
“Please text me the list of names”
“Yes!”
The Chun siblings pounded the ground, dying from envy. Their uncle was choosing her name!! He was handpicking the name!!
Hugo finally came to his senses. He whined as he extended his hands. “Gun is terrible at naming stuff… I want to choose a name too! I want to do it!!!”
“Dad, you should stay out of this! Moreover, you smell funny!”
“I don’t smell!”
Lee Gun had an odd expression. He glared at Hugo as he exited the hospital room. As he checked the lists of names sent by Chun Jiwoo, he furrowed his brows.
‘I merely have to get rid of the gods if they do something funny.’
The problem was…
‘Taeksoo.’
Yes, Hugo was a Cluder who had reincarnated as a human. Lee Gun had heard it from the Red Monarch.
Hugo’s past life seemed to be the problem. Of course, it couldn’t simply be called his past life, since the soul was identical. This was why one couldn’t treat them as different entities. The biggest problem right now was…
‘The gods won’t stand by.’
Hugo had been the mortal enemy of the Divine world. In other words, Hugo had caused mayhem in the Divine world, like Lee Gun.
The gods trying to make Hugo their Constructs had made it clear that they were idiots.
‘It also means Hugo was so harmless that they hadn’t noticed who he was.’
They had been meticulous in stealing his abilities, and he was thrown away to be human. Still, it wasn’t true to call him harmless…
[Evil murderous intent is boiling out of Hugorodite.]
He had already sensed it. He didn’t need the notification to tell him about it. The others might not notice it, but the energy of a monster was starting to leak out of Hugo.
When Lee Gun had seen Hugo after the latter had returned from visiting the goddess of birth, he had felt a chill run up his body.
‘He may be human, but it’s clear that he was a monarch.’
It meant his instinct as a monarch was awakening. Moreover, this was the energy of the type of monster that he hated the most. Lee Gun had faced and killed monarchs, so he knew them better than anyone.
‘I can never become allies with them.’
Hailey was one too, but her case was different. The deciding factor was the piece of information given to him by the Red Monarch regarding Hailey’s origins.
- That child isn’t a Cluder.
Of course, Lee Gun hadn’t been surprised to hear that. He had enough information to have his suspicions about Hailey.
Lee Gun hated the smell of monsters, yet Hailey didn’t smell one at all. Moreover, she wasn’t gluttonous. In fact, she smelled more similar to humans. That might be why she was chosen by a Zodiac in the first place.
‘The gods hate Cluders more than me.’
After he had returned, there was a reason Lee Gun had overlooked Hailey when he had observed her.
On the other hand, monarchs were different. They were predators who could never exist in the same place as him. What would happen if the instinct of a monarch awakened inside Hugo?
At that moment, Lee Gun thought about Chun Jiwoo and the three siblings. He also thought about the future where Hugo would rip them apart and kill them.
His expression hardened. What should he do?
At that moment…
“You noticed it too?”
“!”
Kevin appeared in front of Lee Gun, smelling very much like an angel.
As this was going on…
“Husoon. Why not Husoon… What’s wrong with it?”
After being denied(?) by his wife and children, Hugo sniffled as he returned home. His children had asked him that if he kept acting weird, he should go home and bring items for the baby and the mother.
At the end of the day, Lee Gun would be choosing the name, and it was a very good thing.
‘Blessing is given to anything a god chooses and touches.’
If the baby was lucky, wouldn’t her name be infused with the blessing of a Zodiac? If so, her safety wouldn’t be a problem. Of course, this didn’t mean Hugo would let her grow as a fanatic of Lee Gun.
“I’ll expose her daily to the work that I do. Since she already likes Gun, I’ll start by staying close to Gun. Then I’ll slowly replace Gun.”
Was he trying to aim for the comparison effect? There had been a period when his appearance had been second to none.
Hugo shrewdly placed an old photo album in his bag.
“You look happy.”
“!”
The look in Hugo’s eyes turned violent when he heard the voice. “You!”
The one to appear was Archangel Michael, who had lost an arm. Micheal said, “This is baffling. You’re a trash beast that should be gone from this world, yet you’re grinning like an idiot here.”
What the hell?
* * *
Around that time, the Pantheon of the Divine world was in an absolute mess because of the Great Spirit of Kunlun and Abyss.
“What did you just say? Hermes’s Divine status was turned into a Divine item?!”
The Divine world had been turned on its head. While the berserk Great Spirit of Kunlun was a problem, Abyss was causing another round of shock.
Of course, the Divine world had data on Abyss since they had experience fighting it. They were successful in cornering it, but the problem was the fountain pen.
Its origins were unclear, but the fountain pen allowed Abyss to move freely. It allowed Abyss to ambush the gods.
What was this unknown fountain pen? Was it something the snake god had made using Hermes’s Divine status?
‘This isn’t like imbuing an existing item with an ability.’
“Damn it… There was a report mentioning a spear with the power of a monarch imbued inside it. I thought it was nonsense…!’
“It hadn’t been a lie…!”
It was that ridiculous. If one attached a brain, heart, and other organs to a cup, it didn’t mean the item could move like a living creature.
This was something that was beyond one’s imagination.
‘Even a god has to work within the realm of possibility. Creating something that doesn’t exist is impossible.’
Only one type of being could do such a thing.
‘The Creators.’
‘That bastard is a Creator!’
They were the only ones who had eccentric and out-of-the-box techniques.
At that moment…
“Hmmph. I was wondering why he took the name Designer. He was a Creator?”
“Baldr of Valhalla…!”
“What’s that chicken you are holding— Ahhhk! Thoth-nim!”
The gods were shocked when they realized Thoth’s body and legs had turned into that of a bird.
Thoth had been attacked by the Great Spirit of Kunlun, and he was close to death.
“What happened to him, Baldr…!”
“The Great Spirit of Kunlun went berserk and started emitting a strange power. That turned him like this.”
“What? Is it a new ability?”
“No. It seems he’s also a victim.”
“What?!”
The Great Spirit of Kunlun’s appearance had changed in odd ways, and he had started emitting a suspicious light. Any god touched by that light changed into something bizarre, and all of this had been caused by one person.
‘Snake god.’
While Kunlun’s Great Spirit had morphed into something strange because of Lee Gun, he was a Great Spirit for a reason.
“Thanks to him, 40% of the Divine world’s territory was destroyed.”
“Was the Creator aiming for this from the start?”
Instead of answering that, the high-rank gods narrowed their eyes.
While the Creators had gone extinct, they were incredible beings with no peers.
‘We have craftsmen that are on par with them, but…’
Despite this, the Creators had followed around the Primordial god; they were master technicians who had built and created the Divine world.
They had created the Divine Achievement (Achievement) system as well as the rule books and all the regions in the Divine world. They had created the foundation of the Divine world. Of course, that wasn’t important right now.
“You’re the source of all that has happened!”
“Ahhhk!!!”
Sagittarius, who was placed on the gallows, screamed. He was wrapped up tight and tied to a guillotine. All the gods of the Divine world had gathered here, shouting at him.
“Sinner! Sinner! Sinner!’
Sagittarius looked aggrieved. He struggled. It was great that he had dodged the Great Spirit of Kunlun from robbing him of his chastity. However, Lee Gun’s scheme had made the Great Spirit of Kunlun go berserk.
The source of this problem had been the clothes Lee Gun had made for him. Since Sagittarius was the servant of the snake god, he had been branded as the culprit and sent to the gallows.
This was why Sagittarius was angry.
“This is unfair, bastards! I’m also a victim!”
“Unfair, my ass! Do you think we don’t realize you and the snake god are part of a force that’s trying to overthrow the Divine world?”
“Overthrow!! Why would I do that?”
“You chose a monarch to be your Zodiac Saint. This has all been planned!”
“That’s right! As if that wasn’t enough, you let the snake god enter the Divine world! You did it on purpose…”
“What? What did you just say?”
Baldr of Valhalla looked dumbfounded. He approached Sagittarius. “Are you going to feign innocence? The rumors have spread far and wide. Your Zodiac Saint ruthlessly killed a god using the power of a monarch.”
Sagittarius’s face stiffened. Power of a monarch?
Soon, Baldr laughed. “We already checked with Mahabharata. He is the first-generation Monarch Endless Change, the enemy of the cursed gods. As if eating the gods wasn’t enough, he lured his comrades into the Divine world. He was a cunning bastard who made a fool of the Divine world. What if this was all done purposefully from the beginning to overturn the divine world?”
“…!”
Sagittarius couldn’t speak as if he had a headache. This was why his younger brother had said something strange! He had asked if Sagittarius knew something when picking his Zodiac Saint!
“Just wait a moment. He is…”
“It doesn’t matter since he’ll be executed, too. There’s something more pressing right now.”
“What?”
“The Serpent Bearer has declared war on us.”
Sagittarius got an ominous feeling.
“Since you’re the one who brought him here, we’ll execute you.”
What the fuck??!

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - Follow me to the roof (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 395 - Follow me to the roof (1)
“You noticed it too?”
“!”
Kevin appeared in front of Lee Gun, smelling like an angel.
Lee Gun narrowed his eyes.
‘Angel?’
There was no mistaking it. The one in front of him was Kevin. That was for certain, yet he smelled very much like Eden. Moreover, he didn’t feel like someone normal.
However, that wasn’t important right now. Lee Gun menacingly glared at Kevin. “Noticed what?”
“Why are you acting dumb? Someone like you should have noticed it. I’m talking about Hugo.”
“…”
“He’s a dirty monster. Moreover, he’s a Monarch.”
Looking ill-humored, Lee Gun glared at Kevin. “So what? What do you want me to do?”
Lee Gun was like a demon. He became on edge. It was to be expected, since the look in Kevin’s eyes wasn't normal. It was as if Kevin was treating Hugo… no, all of them as enemies.
Kevin looked at Lee Gun as if the latter had lost his mind. “What are you supposed to do? You know very well who’s in the most danger if he’s a monster, right?”
Lee Gun didn’t bother giving an answer.
‘It’s his family.’
That wasn’t all.
“He went through the trouble of saving humanity, yet that monster will kill all of them. You’re better off killing him right now. Your friend will hurt the people around him, and he’ll be tormented by his actions. You know you don’t want to see that.”
Lee Gun suddenly burst out laughing. “Is that what happened at that moment?”
“!”
“You shouldn’t try to deceive me of all people. You smell like a chicken, yet you act as if you’re working for humanity?”
“….”
“What? You regained your old memories, so you want to help your other chicken comrades?”
“!”
Quick on the uptake, Lee Gun had realized what had happened to Kevin.
When Raphael had been killed, a lot of his feathers had fallen all around them. Clearly, Kevin had recalled the memories from his soul when the feathers had touched him.
Lee Gun had heard about it when he visited the Divine world. Not all humans were like this, but the awakened beings with the more special abilities had a high chance of having a past life.
That made it obvious what was going on.
Kevin was very talented. He was ranked first or second amongst the Zodiac Saints. He was an awakened being who was called the genius swordsman.
Yet, he had never won against Lee Gun.
‘Anyway, it seems he’s an archangel.’
All of a sudden…
[We are here to escort you.]
[Our commander.]
Unfamiliar voices came from Kevin’s shadow.
At these angels’ urgings, Kevin snorted as he turned around. “Yes. It’s as you’ve said. I have no unresolved feelings toward humans now. It’s a relief.”
“Is this how you truly feel?”
“Yes. I will return to the place where I used to belong.”
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. “Where you used to belong? Are you talking about the chicken coop?”
“What if I am?”
Lee Gun laughed when he saw the subtle look in Kevin’s eyes. “I have only one answer.”
Lee Gun took up Heaven’s Punishment.
Kwahng!
[Construct Pushover has awakened to his lost instinct.]
* * *
Around that time…
“You look happy.”
“!”
The look in Hugo’s eyes turned violent when an angel appeared before him. “You!”
The one to appear before him was Archangel Michael, who had lost an arm. “This is baffling. You’re a trash beast that should be gone from this world, yet you’re grinning like an idiot here.”
What the hell?
Hugo immediately brought out his flame. This angel was like Raphael, who had taken Hugo’s wife hostage. “How dare you invade someone else’s house?”
The powerful flame attacked Michael as if it was trying to bind him. However, Michael’s eyes flashed. Then something surprising happened.
Zzuh-uhng!!!
The archangel could also control fire. The flame missed him.
“!”
Michael laughed. “I also rule over fire. Do you think Olympus’s fire will work against me?”
He leisurely got rid of the fire and sat on the sofa. “The proxy for a Great Spirit came to visit you, yet you treat your guest like this? Since a precious guest is here, you should bring out some tea—”
Suddenly, a chain made out of light flew toward Michael and choked him around the neck.
“Koohk!”
It was one of Hugo’s skills. Michael ground his teeth when couldn’t break the chain with Divine power.
‘Is it the snake god’s technique?’
It seemed Hugo was indeed the Serpent Bearer’s Construct.
When Michael glared at him, Hugo snorted. “Gun loves chicken. Do you think chicken can put up a fight against him?”
Michael was dumbfounded. He broke out laughing. “Did you forget that you’re a Cluder? You’re a Cluder, yet you follow the snake god? You mated with a human and had children with her? Is that how you’re living now?”
As if to dismiss him, Hugo choked him more violently. In truth, he remembered the sensation he had felt when he killed Raphael and the goddess of birth. He was in a state of turmoil, but it didn’t matter right now.
“I chose Gun and my wife because I like them. I will continue to protect them from bastards like you. If I’m a Cluder like you guys say, do you think I’ll be capable of feeling such emotions toward them?”
Michael couldn’t hold it back in. He burst out laughing. “Protect? Did you just say they are people you want to protect?”
“That’s right. Do you know what percentage of Faith I have toward the snake god? It is …!!”
Hugo massaged his forehead as if he got hit with a dose of reality. However, he soon said, “Ha… Yes, 60… No, it is 600%!!! There is no way a Cluder would pick a god and a human wife—”
Before Hugo could finish, Michael laughed like a madman. However, his laughter stopped soon. “Hey.”
“?”
“That’s the reason you chose the two of them, idiot.”
“…!”
Hugo furrowed his brow.
Michael said as if that was the crux of his point, “Creators are gods of technique. They possess a crazy offensive ability akin to that of fighting-type gods. Lee Gun must have developed these powers by himself when he faced the Cluders. However, half of his soul is divine. He’s of mixed blood.”
When Hugo still didn’t get the implication, Michael continued, “Cluders like the gods as prey the most. That’s the reason you liked Lee Gun at first glance.”
“…?!” Hugo looked like he had been punched in the gut. He was having a hard time believing those words.
Why did he endure being beaten by Lee Gun to have him as a teacher? Was that the reason? No, the fact that he had developed loyalty toward who he considered prey messed with his mind more.
Hugo looked out of it, but he soon came to an acceptance. It was plausible with Lee Gun. However, it was different with his wife.
“Gun is a god, so I get that I could be drawn to him. But my wife is different. I love her. That is why I chose—”
“It’s the same for your wife, idiot.”
“What?”
“She’s a Secretary, who has a special ability to threaten even the Zodiacs. Did you really think such an ability would appear within a normal human?”
This time Hugo was unable to laugh. He understood the implication behind Michael’s words.
“Secretaries used to be low-rank gods who managed the records of the Divine world and the Achievements of the zodiacs.”
Michael smirked. “It means your wife is a nameless, low-rank god, who was affiliated with the Divine world.”
Hugo froze. Of course, he knew what that implied.
This made Michael gleeful. “You claim to be a noble human who used your free will to choose them. However, you merely chose them using the instinct of a Cluder. The fact that you chose the two of them shows that you have a corrupted instinct….”
Michael laughed as he said all that.
Hugo was in shock. The chains in his hand started to loosen.
Michael inwardly let out a sigh of relief as he waited for the chains to unravel faster.
Chaeng!!
“!!”
Hugo once again tightened the chains, glaring at the angel. “Why are you being like this toward me?”
Michael inwardly cursed from the pain, yet he didn’t let it show as he looked at Hugo. “That’s what you’re curious about?”
“Is it a grudge against me because I ate the gods?”
“If you know that, you should act like it. The perpetrator is living a happy life with his wife and kids? Do you even think about the victims? Moreover, you’re shameful enough to act as the hero of humanity?”
Hugo froze, and the chains binding Michael loosened. It was as if Hugo was having a complete mental breakdown.
Michael gleefully laughed. In truth, Michael didn’t care about the grudges held by the victims. He didn’t care if the monarchs ate the gods or not. The ones who had gotten eaten had been weak. Although Eden had suffered in some ways, it had also profited in others.
Michael just hated Hugo, and he had come here to torment Hugo. In other words, it was revenge.
‘He is the reason our father fell into sleep. We have no idea when he’ll wake up.’
This was why he was pissed off.
‘He’s the crude bastard that got along with the Creators.’
Creators were the gods directly under the Primordial god, called the geniuses of the Divine world. However…
‘They were mere gods of technical skills who tried to teach lessons to the gods.’
At the end of the day, the Creators had meddled with others because of the backing of the Primordial god.
Originally, Michael wanted to end Hugo, but Mahabharata had slithered away with Hugo. As a result, they were able to get rid of all the high and mighty Creators. They were able to get rid of Aslan, who had been a thorn in their side.
‘I’m sure he got along with the Creators because he wanted to eat them.’
Why else would a first-generation monarch ally himself with the Creators? Well, the past didn’t matter right now.
‘He can’t even use his power because of his rebirth.’
Michael gloatingly cackled when he saw Hugo spaced out. Anyway, he had visited this place because he wanted to recharge the power that he had lost when fighting against the monarchs.
‘It was a good choice to use the land belonging to the god of life.’
It was only half, but he had recovered his power to a certain extent. There was no way Hugo would be able to touch him.
[Holy Spirit Transition (Transmission)]
‘It’s time. I’ll go back and assemble the gods on the earth.’
They had to quickly turn the territory of the snake god into their own. That wasn’t all.
‘If we interrogate him, we can find out how we can wake our father. We can find out where he hid the Divine status of the archangels.’
Michael felt refreshed as he was about to unfurl his wings. But…
Kwahk!!!!
“!!?”
Michael turned around when someone violently grabbed his golden hair. He felt as if his hair was about to be torn out. Then he was mercilessly dragged away.
“Wait— Kuhk!”
He wondered what was going on.
When Michael turned his head, he was surprised. The one to grab his hair was Hugo, who was laughing with a menacing look in his eyes.
* * *
Around that time…
“It’s the commander!”
“Can it be? Is it Gabriel-nim?”
A festive atmosphere spread within Eden. It had been several hundred years since Eden was like this.
The reason was Kevin, who the angels had brought here. He was one of the five commanders of Eden, who had gone missing.
“Since we didn’t have our pillar gods, Eden suffered many indignities…!”
Several thousand angels greeted Kevin’s return.
“Do you recognize us now?”
“Yes. It took me a while to recover my memories, so I was late coming back. I’m sorry.”
“It’s fine, since you’re here now.”
“Michael-nim will be happy.”
Kevin had come here after leaving behind Lee Gun. He ground his teeth despite agreeing with them. “I’m embarrassed and deeply ashamed of playing human until now.”
“Yes. However, everyone will be happy.”
“You think so?”
“Yes! Everyone is inside. They have made preparations to greet you—”
Poo-hahk!!
At that moment, the angel guiding Kevin was decapitated, and Kevin leisurely wiped the blood away from his blade.
Screams erupted after several seconds.
“Kyahhhk!!!”
“Oh, archangel! What are you doing in front of Father— Kuh-huhk!!”
Another head fell to the ground. The Garden of Eden instantly turned into a place of pandemonium.
Shocked, everyone looked at Kevin.
“Gabriel-nim! What is this all about?”
Kevin let out a menacing laugh after ruthlessly decapitating another angel. “You want to die?”
“Gabriel-nim???”
“Gabriel, my ass! Fuck off, idiots! You didn’t come looking for a very long time, so why are you making all this fuss? Well, I was able to find the stronghold of the chickens. You guys did well in leading me here”
The angles turned pale when they realized what was going on. Kevin was using the power of an angel.
“Why are you doing this? That power is…!”
“Ah. Yes. Thank you for giving back this power.”
“…!!!!”
“How dare you trick the humans and attack a pregnant woman? Moreover, you sent those bastards as the new Zodiac Saints?”
The angels realized what was going on, so they quickly tried to make a defensive line. However, a light that could split the earth fell toward Eden.
Kwa-gwa-gwa-gwahng!!!
[The stronghold of Eden has been turned into the territory of the Serpent Bearer.]
[EXP is heading toward the Serpent Bearer.]
The encampments of the angels were instantly destroyed. It seemed Kevin had planned on doing this from the start.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - Follow me to the roof (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 396 - Follow me to the roof (2)
“Ahhhk! Help!”
“Don’t do this!”
Kwahng!!
Eden was a utopia without any taint. It was a place made for their father, the most beautiful land with a long history.
The Eden that had been laboriously created for their sleeping father was turning into a field of blood.
Of course, it wasn’t because another force had invaded them. The monarchs hadn’t invaded them either!
“You guys can all die!!!”
“Ahhhhk!!”
The angels’ encampment was being destroyed by an ally. Moreover, this being was one of their commanders!
“Gabriel-nim! Why are you— Ahhhk!”
Kwahng!!
This heavenly land had been filled with fruits, but it was now covered with ice. The water of life turned into a flood, sweeping away the angels.
This was the ability of ice and water, which belonged to Gabriel, one of the five archangels.
Kevin’s white clothes and white-blond hair were mottled with blood. He looked like an asura.
The angels, who had been in tears after seeing the return of their commander, either bled or died.
Kwahng!!!
At this point, the high-rank angels ground their teeth.
“Damn it! He’s lost his mind!”
“He should be using that power to protect our father’s subjects! What are you doing?”
They had already been under great pressure because Lee Gun had changed the coordinates of the ark. Their forces had suffered great losses, yet this bastard was adding more to the figure!
“Stop him from using his power! At the end of the day, his divinity was forfeited!”
“That’s right! He shouldn’t be able to use his most important abilities!”
At that moment, the angels grabbed their throats as they opened and closed their mouths. It was as if they couldn’t breathe. They felt as if their heads were submerged in a fishbowl.
The angels struggled in agony. The moisture in the air had been extracted and placed around the faces of the angels.
[Purification]
It was the power of an archangel, which was supposed to wash away anything impure.
When this power struck the angels, most of them died as their heads exploded within the water.
Kevin clenched his hands as he watched this sight. He almost sighed as he ridiculed them. “All of you’re corrupt. You’re so rotten that you cannot be purified. You cannot be saved.”
“Corrupt?! You’re the one who made Father’s land like this, yet you dare say…!”
Kevin’s eyes flashed as if those words had left him dumbfounded.
“You sucked the blood dry from the colonies to make this land!”
“Kuh-huhk!”
When Kevin chased after them, they knew they were overmatched. They quickly looked for their supreme commander.
“Michael-nim! Where are you, Michael-nim?”
“He said he needed to visit somewhere to recover from his wounds— Kuhk!”
“Michael won’t be able to come here.”
They froze when they looked behind them.
Kevin seemed unconcerned as he laughed. “While his opponent is the idiot Pushover, Michael went directly toward a monarch. Only an idiot would do that.”
The angels gnashed their teeth.
“Are you looking down on Michael-nim, bastard?”
“How dare you say he’ll lose to a monarch who reincarnated as a human?”
Kevin snorted. “He was able to eat me. That immature bastard won’t be able to do anything against the monarch!!”
Once again, the angels’ screams rang out.
“Whatever. I’ll exterminate all of you, including your father!” Kevin let out a cold smile as he raised his sword.
The enraged angels cussed at him.
“You crazy bastard! You’re an archangel!”
“Fuck off! I shed that title a long time ago!!!!”
What the hell did he just say?!
Kevin’s face became stormy when he recalled the soul’s memories. “Archangel?? I kept my chastity for several dozen years in the Virgo temple! That’s enough!!”
“W-What?”
“The archangels have to keep their chastity too!! Both can fuck off!”
“??!”
What the hell was he saying? He wanted them to fuck off for that reason!?
“This is a holy and noble work!”
“If you keep your chastity for ten thousand years, you develop a special ability!!”
“You guys better shut up!!”
The dumbfounded angels looked at Kevin.
On the other hand, murderous intent appeared in Kevin’s eyes. Of course, this wasn’t the only reason for this murderous intent. When he had regained his memories as an angel, he recalled something crucial regarding the Virgo temple.
Gabriel was in charge of records related to fertility. This was why he had encounters with Virgo. He would occasionally receive commissions to find Constructs who had broken their chastity. This was why he knew the secret of the Virgo temple.
Of course, Kevin didn’t mind that Virgo had chosen him as her Zodiac Saint. She hadn’t picked him knowing he was Gabriel, and he was a human now.
The problem was…
- Hey, horny goddess.
- What?
- You told me this before. If the Virgo Saint doesn’t keep their chastity, they will immediately get a heart attack and die, right? That was why I desperately dodged anyone of the opposite sex. For the past twenty-five years, I wasn’t even able to hold the hand of a woman.
- That’s right.
- You want to die?
- What are you talking about?
- I won’t die even if I don’t keep my chastity!!! You want to die!!!
Kevin had lost his mind when he realized the goddess had cheated him.
He remembered the truth and shouted, “It’s fine. You guys can all dieeeeeeee!!!!”
“Ahhhk! The archangel has lost his mind!!!”
“Give me back my 3,325 years!!”
Kevin went on a rampage, and the angels died as they screamed.
* * *
“Let go!”
Hugo grabbed Michael by the hair.
Michael glared at Hugo. How dare a dirty and lowly being lay a hand on him?
“How dare a beast like you do this—”
Michael was about to tell Hugo to let go before cutting off Hugo’s hand. However, he was unable to do so.
“Koohk!”
A fist flew toward his face, and an unimaginable strength hit him.
Puhk!!!
Michael almost lost consciousness. The blow was powerful enough to crush his face. However, Michael couldn’t feel the will to fight behind that power. It was like someone swinging to crack open the hard shell of a fruit. It was an unforgiving power!
Michael had felt this before.
‘Monarchs…!!’
It was chilling as it showed how they felt nothing in front of life, oozing arrogance.
Michael cursed as blood started to splatter everywhere.
‘He awakened as a monarch?!’
However, there was another more pressing matter.
‘This bastard caught me!’
Michael was in his holy spirit state, where he could pass through everything. No one should be able to touch his body. So what was going on?
At that moment, Michael almost lost consciousness.
Bbah-gahk!!!
After sending a fist toward Michael’s face, Hugo kept his grip on Michael’s head. He slammed the head down on the ground as if he were breaking open a coconut.
“Kuh-huhk!!!”
Michael groaned as his head was broken open. Blood spilled on the floor. He trembled as if he had been paralyzed, glaring at Hugo with bloodshot eyes.
‘Bastard…!’
Hugo laughed; his eyes flashed as though to say he expected more.
Michael ground his teeth. It was true that he had come here to purposefully provoke Hugo. He planned on making Hugo lose his humanity by dragging out his true instinct.
The archangel planned on reverting Hugo to days when he indiscriminately hunted down gods and humans. This would mobilize the other gods to hunt this bastard down!
Of course, it didn’t matter if his true instinct didn’t come out. Michael wanted to break Hugo’s mind so that he would kill himself.!
‘This bastard…! He didn’t go berserk or self-destruct!’
As if he was reading the look in Michael’s eyes, Hugo scoffed. “My mental state is not fragile enough to break from that, idiot. Do you think I’m an elementary school student or something?”
“…!”
“In fact, Gun’s mental attacks are worse.”
That was the truth.
He had suffered it when he served Lee Gun as his student.
While his house had fallen, Hugo used to be a young master from a rich family. So he had a fragile mental state.
This was why Lee Gun had used force to break and rip apart Hugo’s mental state. In fact, someone with a normal mental state couldn’t stay close to Lee Gun.
Hugo had a mental breakdown only two times. First was when Lee Gun had ground up monsters to make porridge for himself; at that time, Hugo had been unable to eat for a week. The second was when Lee Gun had died.
Hugo showed the whites of his teeth as he laughed. “You’re an elder god, right? Then you must have never been beaten to an inch of your life, right?”
“Wait—”
Michael screamed.
Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!
While being beaten to a pulp, Michael tried to use his ability.
‘Damn it! Why can’t I use my ability?’
The reason was simple.
‘Damn it! I have recovered enough from the wounds suffered by Wind…!’
That wasn’t all.
‘Could it be…!’
He was sure of it. Hugo was using the power of Endless Change.
Wind, Underground, Flame, and Endless Change—among the first-generation monarchs, Endless Change had secretly entered the Divine world. His ability had allowed him to violate even the Primordial god.
Endless Change was aptly known as a mimic. He could perfectly copy the appearance, movement, and speech of the gods. He never had his own true appearance from the start, like Confusion.
Moreover, he could use the abilities of the gods if he ate certain gods. It was beyond copying at that point.
And only one being could completely neutralize Michael like this…!
‘Father!’
Michael glared at Hugo with bloodshot eyes. “Could it be? The Great Spirit of Eden…!!”
Hugo looked very satisfied when Michael raged. He knew what would humiliate and anger the angels the most. “Why do you think your snobby father hasn’t awakened even now?”
“…!!!”
“Yes. I already ate your father. The tasteless parts were used to make a monarch.”
“What did you just say?!”
“I can’t believe you guys still haven’t recognized your father.”
“What…? What are you….”
“Your Father was turned into a monarch. He invaded the Divine world and ate you guys. You guys still haven’t realized that?”
Michael turned pale as Hugo laughed. As a first-generation monarch, Endless Change was able to dupe even the Primordial god. Michael’s father, the Great Spirit of Eden, had also been trifled with using cheap methods.
Still, Michael had never expected his father to turn into a monarch! It was inconceivable, but Hugo being able to suppress his power gave credence to his words…!
Michael, who had come to shake Hugo’s mental state, had his mental state destroyed by Hugo instead. He was barely able to break himself out of the stupor. “Do… you really think I’ll believe that? Father is in Eden…!”
“Yes. The one you guys are feeding is a fake. It’s a medium connected to the territory of the monarchs. You guys have been providing nutrition to the monarchs, whom you detest.”
“…there is no way…!”
“Let me pose a question. Who among the monarchs is your father?”
Finally, strength drained out of Michael’s body. His pupils shook as if he had let go of his sanity. “I’ll…have to confirm it…”
Hugo’s eyes flashed. He wasn’t going to let Michael run away. He stabbed Michael.
Michael glared as he tried to kill Hugo, but it was useless. “Kuh-huhk! That asshole snake god…!!”
Michael’s mental state was shaken, which caused his defense to drop.
Hugo had been aiming for this.
Kwah-jeek! Bbah-ddoo-doohk!
Michael vomited blood as he fell to the ground.
Hugo also slumped to the ground in exhaustion.
Koohng!
“Oohk!”
The thick smell of blood had permeated the house, and Hugo gritted his teeth. His instinct made him want to eat Michael’s corpse. The thought kept invading his mind.
‘Damn it!’
In the end, Hugo extended his hand. He had a feeling that if he ate this, he’d never be able to come back from this. However, he was having a very hard time holding himself back since it was a high-rank god.
‘Just this once.’
Kwahng!
“!”
Hugo flinched when an item fell to the ground. It was the new family picture that he had taken alongside Lee Gun.
At that moment, he wondered what he had been thinking.
Poo-hahk!
Unexpectedly, Hugo didn’t aim for Michael’s flesh. He extracted only Michael’s Divine status.
[EXP is headed toward the Serpent Bearer temple.]
[Achievements have been offered to the Master.]
Hugo’s hands stopped shaking. “Quickly… I have to clean the house before Jiwoo and the kids get here.”
He let out a sigh. Looking miserable, he squatted to pick up Michael. It seemed he planned on getting rid of Michael, as if nothing had happened here.
Slam!
“!”
Hugo let out murderous intent when he felt an unfamiliar presence. He turned his head. “Who is it?”
However…
“…Jaewon?”
“H-Hugo-nim.”
How long had he been here?
Lee Jaewon had turned pale from shock. It was for no other reason. “He said Hugo-nim is a monarch…. What was that conversation about?”
Hugo bit his tongue. Lee Jaewon seemed to have heard the conversation between him and Michael.
At some point, Lee Jaewon had realized Hugo was fighting Michael, so he intended to barge in. It was then that he had heard their conversation. He had frozen in place.
“Hugo-nim.”
“Ah… That chicken bastard was lying.”
“But….” The light in Lee Jaewon’s eyes didn’t change.
Lee Jaewon was a clever Zodiac Saint, who was quick on the uptake.
In the end, Hugo said as if he had no choice, “Do not speak about this to anyone else. This is especially true for Gun.”
“What…? Lee Gun-nim?”
Hugo wondered if telling Lee Gun everything was the right way, but he became somber. He was sure of it.
Despite their current situation, there was something that couldn’t be denied. He was a monster, and if Lee Gun found out…
‘Gun will kill me!’
He knew better than anyone else that Gun was ruthless toward monsters.
Lee Jaewon finally came to his senses at that moment. He asked, “D-Does that mean… the Great Spirit of Eden was really turned into a monarch…?”
“No. I just made it up on the spot.”
Hugo wasn’t sure of it, but he had a vague memory of what had happened. He had just pieced together half-truths.
“I had to break this bastard’s mind.”
Since he knew everything, Hugo placed a rag in Lee Jaewon’s hand. He was telling Lee Jaewon to help him clean before Gun could see it.
Lee Jaewon slowly started to mop up the floor.
* * *
He was inside a building run by the Leo temple. They had received the Serpent Bearer temple’s permission to do so.
[Are you sure this is ok, Master?]
His Constructs’ voices came from his shadow.
[Are you sure it’s ok to let the Virgo Saint leave like that?]
Just when it had looked like Lee Gun was going to get rid of Kevin, he had surprisingly let the Virgo Saint leave.
This was why the Construct worriedly said,
[He is someone who will betray Master. Moreover, he’s an archangel. I’m sure he’ll bring the Great Spirit of Eden and his troops for revenge…]
However, Lee Gun merely laughed. “Ah. It’ll be fine.”
[What do you mean, it’ll be fine?]
“You guys didn't notice it. He was being monitored by the angels. The angels acted as if they had just come to bring Kevin, but they had been there for a while.”
[!]
Yes, they had detected angels that couldn’t trust Kevin yet.
At the same time, Lee Gun had picked up something from Kevin. This was why he had the latter purposefully leave. Lee Gun had a feeling it would be fine if he let Kevin handle Eden.
That was why Lee Gun left the hospital to carry out a task. Of course, this didn’t mean he was free of all worries.
[Where are you, my precious Creator?]
Lee Gun had heard a gloomy voice. It was for only a moment, but he became leery. This was why he had distanced himself from the hospital.
‘Well, the voice is gone now.’
Anyway, that wasn’t important right now.
“Lee Gun-nim. Why did you call us here….”
The new Zodiacs Saints stood in front of him.
Lee Gun smirked as he looked at them. “Why else would I call you here? I have a task for the new Zodiac Saints of the earth.”
“!”
“Before I get to that, come out.”
“What?”
Lee Gun’s red eyes flashed. “Don’t feign ignorance. You sent the new Zodiac Saints since you wanted to do this in the first place, right?”
“L-Lee Gun-nim?”
“I know one of you is him.”
“!”
“The treacherous Great Spirit of Ennead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - Follow me to the roof (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 397 - Follow me to the roof (3)
The Zodiac Saints and disciples gathered there were shocked.
‘Great Spirit…’
‘I’m pretty sure they are the top dogs amongst the Zodiacs.’
Each dimension had an owner called a Zodiac.
As for the earth, Lee Gun had become its Zodiac, and the angels of Eden had later appeared here.
At this point, the information about the gods had been spread far and wide. Humanity and the Zodiac Saints had become acclimated to the information about their existence.
However, Ennead was an outsider Zodiac, who had nothing to do with the earth.
When everyone was surprised, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he said, “What? I’m right. The new Zodiac Saints were created as a feint.”
“…!”
Still, he was talking about a Great Spirit. A being of that caliber suddenly appearing on the earth would be noticeable. His power would stand out.
This was why the replacement of the Zodiac Saints had been carried out. It was all to evade Lee Gun’s notice, and the Great Spirit had been skillful in sneaking in.
Since the Zodiac Saints were the strongest among humanity, an overly strong energy would be overlooked.
‘Did Eden carry this out for the Great Spirit of Ennead, or did he carry this out in secret…’
“You hid amongst the Zodiac Saints like a vermin. Were you secretly trying to stab me in the back, or are you guys all in on it?”
“What?!”
“You dared bring angels to my territory. You even brought in an outer god. Do you guys plan on dividing the land amongst yourselves?”
The Zodiac Saints were met with a harsh verbal assault. They spoke as if they felt aggrieved.
“Lee Gun-nim, we swear there aren’t any outside gods amongst us!”
“Is that so?”
“Yes! We may have received power from the angels, but we are all loyal to you, Lee Gun-nim! We want to serve you!”
“Is that so?”
“Yes! That’s why…!”
“Then you guys won’t mind if you guys die for me, right?”
“…What?”
They didn’t even have the time to ask what he meant.
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhk!!”
Lee Gun took out Heaven’s Punishment and ruthlessly brought it down on the Zodiac Saints. When the brutal weapon struck the ground, it split apart the building.
Ooh-doo-doohk!!
The Zodiac Saints were barely able to dodge, and they screamed. They weren’t the only ones.
To mediate the meeting between the Zodiac Saints and Lee Gun, subordinate disciples and politicians had come here. They were frightened.
“Lee Gun-nim! We apologize, so please calm down!”
They looked at Lee Gun with surprise.
On the other hand, Lee Gun raised his eyebrows as if he couldn’t comprehend their actions. “Why are you guys running away? I thought you guys had the resolve needed to pledge loyalty to me.”
No! This had nothing to do with that! They were about to say something when Lee Gun’s attack continued.
Flash!
Heaven’s Punishment had become classified as a Divine item. It let out a violent roar as it attacked the Zodiac Saints.
Lee Gun disappeared the next instant, and the blade reached their necks.
The Zodiac Saints tried to block it with great force.
Bbah-gahk!!!!
“Kuh-huhk!!!’
The first man smacked by Heaven’s Punishment was sent flying.
Bbah-gahk!!! Bbah-gahk!!
“Ahhhk!!”
“Ahhk!”
The other Zodiac Saints were sent flying too. There was no mercy.
The long-range Zodiac Saints quickly moved when they saw this.
“Lee Gun-nim is strictly a close-range fighter! He won’t be able to use his power if we don’t approach him!”
“Get out of his range!”
“We’ll use an invisibility spell….!!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he grabbed Heaven’s Punishment.
The Zodiac Saints out of Lee Gun’s range vomited blood as they were sent flying.
“Kuh, kuh-huhk…!”
It had taken only ten seconds.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed in contempt. “Did you think you'd be fine if you got out of range?”
“That is…!”
They had a realization. It was useless to talk about range when it came to Lee Gun. That wasn’t all.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun let out a fierce laugh as he sent all twelve Zodiac Saints flying as though they were boneless.
The Zodiac Saints took damage to their bones and organs. They couldn’t get back up.
“Shit…! I saw him with my eyes!”
“You were able to see him? Really…?”
“Wait a moment! He’s coming again!”
Lee Gun swung Heaven’s Punishment like a fly swatter. Everyone, including the security guards, inside that place was sent flying by the wind. The disciples were swept up in it too. They groaned.
“Shit! That weapon is using a strange skill…!!”
“What kind of skill is this….”
Lee Gun laughed at their ignorance. “Ignore Weaklings.”
“Ignore Weaklings?!”
“It’s a newly made skill that defeats only the weaklings.”
“?!”
“I used all the data I scraped together to give Heaven’s Punishment a shine. I also gave it some upgrades.”
“…!”
Heaven’s Punishment roared as if it wanted everyone to look at it. It seemed to be aware that it had done something naughty(?), but it didn’t care.
In recent days, only Life and Death had been helpful to its master. Despite being upgraded, Heaven’s Punishment had been dissatisfied.
The Zodiac Saints as well as the disciples beaten up by the weapon felt aggrieved. They shouted,
“Normally….! Isn’t it supposed to attack those who aren’t weak?”
“All the Zodiac Saints were beaten up and sent flying. What do you mean…”
However, they soon couldn’t speak. Amongst the twelve Zodiac Saints, one remained standing. It was the Zodiac Saint of the Aries temple, and she was furrowing her brows. She was a gorgeous woman.
The fallen Zodiac Saints couldn’t believe their eyes.
“She’s…! I’m pretty sure she was next to me and was hit by the attack.”
“Why is she ok? What happened….”
Lee Gun smirked as he looked at the woman. “As I’ve said, it’s Ignore Weaklings.”
“!”
It was as if he had finally found what he wanted.
Lee Gun glared at the woman with savage eyes. “You’re playing human here. Are you having fun? Moreover, you’re pretending to be a woman? Is that your preference?”
Humanity suddenly shook.
Boom!
It was an overwhelming sense of pressure. The woman’s expression instantly changed.
[It’s nothing. I’m here to check up on the land that’ll become the battlefield for the gods.]
Battlefield for the gods?
Lee Gun contemptuously looked at the Great Spirit. Eden had brought the angels, and Valhalla wanted to plant some strange tree here. Was the Great Spirit of Ennead here to coach them?
‘I knew they were all on the same side, but…’
In the first place, the Great Spirit of Ennead had used Set so that Lee Gun would vacate the earth. They wanted to take the earth for themselves.
‘They are the reason the earth’s future was a mess.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
[Warning! A Zodiac is directly descending.]
[Warning! Earth is being destroyed by that power.]
[Synchronization Rate: 40%]
…
[Synchronization Rate: 40.2%]
[Earth’s lifespan is decreasing.]
“!”
This damn Zodiac wasn’t going to use an avatar. He was openly and directly coming down to the earth.
‘When a Zodiac leaves the Divine world to descend, it causes harm to the land.’
The colony’s environment would be destroyed. This was why the Zodiacs were unable to leave the Divine world. They used either an avatar or a proxy (Zodiac Saint) when they wanted to visit their colonies. It was an indirect way to descend.
Lee Gun had created a ring that could completely control his power so that he wouldn’t cause harm. It was why he was able to freely step into the colonies. It didn’t matter if he was using his power.
‘I made an edit to the rule within the temporary Rule Book.’
This was why Lee Gun could stay in his colony despite being a Zodiac. However, there was a limit on what he could do with a temporary Rule Book. He had modified the rule to “If a Zodiac doesn’t release over 50% of their power, the Zodiac won’t influence the environment of the colony."
Basically, it would be meaningless if all his power was released. This was why he didn’t release more than half of his power. Of course, the Great Spirit of Ennead knew this too.
Kwahng!
“!”
It seemed he didn’t plan on hiding his power. The Great Spirit laughed as he kept raising his synchronization rate.
[In the first place, I didn’t like you. You took those who used to be my children.]
Lee Gun scoffed at those words. Taurus and Pisces used to be Zodiacs belonging to Ennead. But Lee Gun didn’t care as he crooked his finger. “I’ll fight you. Come outside, bastard.”
[Why would I do that?]
“What?”
[I don’t have to move an inch, and this place will be destroyed.]
The Great Spirit of Ennead let out a cold laugh. The synchronization rate was steadily increasing, so his power was quite overwhelming.
The Great Spirit spoke as if he had been aiming for this.
[Choose, snake god.]
“What?”
[If you give up your rights to the earth, I’ll leave.]
“!”
[If you don’t, I’ll continue to stay here like this.]
The Constructs within Lee Gun’s shadow made a commotion.
[Please do not fall for it! He’s bluffing!]
[That’s correct. Zodiacs are high-rank gods who are given massive power and freedom! However, this means their responsibility is high too!]
[It’s part of the Divine world’s rules. A Zodiac cannot stay in a colony on purpose. It’s a grave sin!]
[Even a Great Spirit…. No, it is because he is a Great Spirit. He would be given a more severe punishment. He’ll take on Karmic Debt!]
All gods were afraid of Karmic Debt. This was more true for the Great Spirits, who had a lot to lose!
[Of course, he’s bluffing! There is no way you should agree to such a trade!]
However, the Great Spirit of Ennead merely smirked.
[Karmic Debt? It doesn’t matter. Such rules have no hold over me.]
[…?!]
Lee Gun wondered what he was talking about. However, it didn’t take him long to find out.
[The power of the goddesses of fate, who is in charge of the rules, is taking effect.]
[The Great Spirit of Ennead does not have Karmic Debt.]
Valhalla’s goddesses of fate, who had taken the original Rule Book, had to be in league with the Great Spirit of Ennead. Since he was one of the most powerful beings, doing so wasn’t out of character for her.
Of course, Lee Gun might be able to go toe to toe with that bastard if he used Cycle, but…
‘I can’t do it here.’
The Great Spirit’s power was getting stronger. If Lee Gun added his power to it, the earth and its environment would be destroyed.
‘I’ll have to move this to a different place.’
This was why he sent his thoughts to his child, who was very far away.
[An order was given to Quick Service made from Hermes (Fountain Pen).]
‘I’ll call Abyss here. I’ll make it swallow him and him back to his land.’
Abyss could move freely through space, so it wouldn’t have a difficult time pulling off such a task. Moreover, didn’t Abyss want to come to him?
‘Give my coordinates to Abyss. If I call for it, it’ll come...’
At that moment…
[Abyss has declined the summon.]
[It won’t come unless it’s allowed to eat the Serpent Bearer.]
Lee Gun became angry. What did this bastard say? Every second was important.
Lee Gun furrowed his brow.
‘Alright! I’ll let it eat me! I’ll agree to it! Tell it to come here right now!’
He’d just give it an arm; he could just regenerate one!
Abyss seemed to have received the message from Lee Gun’s child. It reacted immediately.
[Abyss has spruced itself up as it agreed.]
[Abyss says it likes being on top.]
…?
…???
‘Top?’
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement as he looked at his body. When it said top, it was probably referring to his upper body, right?
Lee Gun had a sour expression on his face.
‘…if my upper body gets eaten, I won’t be able to regenerate…’
He thought it would be ok, but he had to take the safest route. His heart had to remain intact. However, it wasn’t the time to weigh such things right now.
‘Alright! Top! I’ll allow it! Come!’
When he gave the order, it felt as if heaven and earth were shaking.
Koo-goo-goong!
Something enormous appeared in the sky, covering the sun and the sky.
Flash!
People screamed when they saw it, while the Great Spirit of Ennead feigned laughter as if he couldn’t believe it.
[A Monarch basically became his dog?]
The Great Spirit extended his hand when an enormous whale-like figure appeared in the sky.
This place wasn’t the Divine world. The Great Spirit wasn’t under much pressure since he just had to get rid of this colony in its entirety.
However, Abyss had expected this move. It disappeared and reappeared with the Great Spirit’s shadow! Unknown eyes flashed within the shadow of the Great Spirit.
The Great Spirit knew this tactic, so he was about to use his ability.
[You have a habit of taking your prey as you hide in the shadows.]
At that moment, the Great Spirit of Ennead tried to send flames toward it, but his hand came to a stop.
[From the shadow, the owner of Duat is aiming for the Great Spirit of Ennead.]
[The Great Spirit has been summoned to Duat.]
The one hiding within the Great Spirit’s shadow wasn’t Abyss. The one hiding there was none other than Osiris, who had been missing for some time.
Lee Gun also found his presence unexpected as he looked at the shadow. Soon, the eyes of Ennead’s Great Spirit flashed in annoyance.
[Dirty monarch. You couldn't help your dirty habit of stealing. You laid hands on someone else’s child.]
At that moment, the summoning light created by Osiris encircled the Great Spirit.
[Great Spirit Summon]
It was an ability granted to only the pillar gods of Ennead! Since someone from the same side was calling him, the Great Spirit of Ennead was sucked into Duat. It was clear that he had planned on trapping the god of the sun in Duat (underworld).
The underworld was like the halfway house for the Divine world. It was a special region that even the Zodiac ranks had a hard time leaving.
Even the god of the sun would have a hard time coming out if Duat’s gates were closed. It would take him a while.
[At the end of the day, you’re merely buying time…]
It was just annoying to come back to this place once again. The Great Spirit of Ennead smirked. He planned on raising his power to exterminate Osiris.
If Osiris is killed, the summon would stop!
Bbah-gahk!!!
“!!”
At that moment, Lime appeared out of nowhere and kicked the Great Spirit’s head.
The Great Spirit looked around in surprise. In the end, he was pushed and got sucked into the summoning circle.
Kwahng!!!
Lee Gun laughed in satisfaction.
Since the Great Spirit was trapped within Duat, he just had to push the power of Cycle into Duat. When Lee Gun switched to the Divine status of Cycle…
[I carried out your request]
Abyss laughed as it disappeared.
However, Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. It had said it liked the top. Why didn’t it take his arm?

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - I thought so (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 398 - I thought so (1)
It had said it liked the top. Why didn’t it take his arm?
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. He found it odd, since Abyss had no patience. Compared to the other Monarchs, it was more beastly. In truth, it wouldn’t have been odd if Abyss had decided to attack them.
At that moment, he heard a notification.
[Abyss says it will visit you in no time.]
[Abyss says it’ll spruce itself up before visiting at night.]
Lee Gun narrowed his eyes. It was to be expected.
‘It’s coming for a midnight snack.’
Lee Gun glared at the location where Abyss had disappeared. The fact that it had disappeared despite seeing the humans made something clear; it could be reasoned with.
‘If it wants a midnight snack, I’ll just make some ramen for it.’
It seemed his arm(?) could always be used as bait if he wanted to use Abyss.
A loud exploding sound rang out when Abyss went away.
Kwahng!!
The sound came from the light that had swallowed up the Great Spirit.
Koo-goo-goong!
Something surprising happened.
“Lee Gun-nim!”
From the light that had swallowed the Great Spirit, a giant that was burning like the sun emerged. It was a monster letting out golden light, which had the head of a bird. The giant let out a fierce roar as if it was about to snatch away Lee Gun.
[Fire Wheel Lord (Great Spirit of Ennead) has activated its Divine Achievement (Achievement) skill.]
[Divine Name: Sun Incarnate]
[Fire Wheel Lord has sent out its incarnate.]
It wanted to destroy the earth while taking Lee Gun away at all costs.
The giant was letting out fierce flames, and its sharp hand threatened Lee Gun.
Koo-goo-goong!
Lee Gun snorted. He brought out the power of Cycle. He had enough EXP to transition into the power of Cycle.
[Life EXP 100%]
[Death EXP 100%]
[The condition needed to transition into the Divine status of Cycle has been met.]
When he had helped in the birthing process that Chun Jiwoo underwent, he had filled the EXP of Life. For the Divine status of Death, the EXP came in when Kevin razed the Garden of Eden to the ground.
However, just when he was about to activate the enormous power…
[Where are you, my lovely Creator?]
Lee Gun flinched when he heard the voice.
Zzuh-uhng!
“…!”
Strength suddenly drained from his body. He had felt a similar sensation of his brain shaking last time. It had happened when he had returned home from the colony of Eden.
‘Yeonwoo said it was similar to the power that neutralizes the Creators…!’
His ability hadn’t come out, and that split second of hesitation was enough. In a flash, the Great Spirit’s incarnate appeared before him.
‘Bastard.’
Lee Gun ground his teeth. His eyes flashed as he raised Heaven’s Punishment. He couldn’t get rid of his foe without taking damages if he had only Heaven’s Punishment at his disposal.
Ptooey!
“!”
At that moment, Lime spat something out in front of Lee Gun.
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he saw what it was. “Ahhk!!! What the hell? Why are you here?”
What Slime had spat out was Secretary Guisoon!
As soon as Lee Gun had gone to the Divine world, Guisoon had put up a false SNS, saying that he had died.
Afterward, she had gone into hiding somewhere.
Lee Gun smirked when he saw her.
‘I wondered where she had run away.’
Having been suddenly dropped here, Guisoon screamed once again.
“Ahhhk!!! What the hell is that?” She screamed when she saw the fire giant in front of her. “Why is that monster here?”
At that moment, Lime quickly wrapped around Guisoon’s head. Then something surprising happened.
Flash!
It was as if slime was releasing her ability. The ability of a Secretary was forcefully activated.
[Modify Divine Achievement]
When the light exploded forth, the giant of golden flame flinched as it came to a stop, as if it was unable to move while the skill was active.
On the other hand, Guisoon was screaming, “Ahhk! I can’t see! I can’t see! Get off my head! Oohp!!”
Lime ignored her as it carried out its task.
[Delete Achievement]
This destroyed the stalled giant’s body.
Kwa-gwa-gwahng!
It was as if the body had turned into balls of light; they dispersed into the surroundings.
The angry voice of the Great Spirit of Ennead, who had sent the giant, rang out.
[Secretary? Those detestable dogs of the Creators still exist?]
“…?”
Lee Gun was wondering what the Great Spirit meant when one of the dispersing balls of light brushed him. At the same time, he saw something strange. It was probably one of the memories engraved in the giant’s soul.
- Listen, Creators.
- You have made an item that should have never been made.
It was a scene where the Great Spirits and the Zodiacs were lodging a complaint against the Creators.
- Bibles? Why did you make such a thing, and why did you give it to those that aren’t Zodiacs? Why give it to low-rank gods?
- With all due respect, a god has a short lifespan if it doesn’t have those that believe in them. The opposite is true if the god does have a lot of believers. Their power and lifespan may increase indefinitely. Since a lot of disciples follow the Great Spirits and Zodiacs, their lifespan and power are plentiful. This isn’t the case with the low-rank gods.
- What about it?
- They all went through an arduous road to become gods, and it would be a shame if they died in short order. That’s why we created the Bible to extend their lifespan.
- Lifespan?
- Yes. If they achieve something special, it will be recorded in the Bible. That power will grow on its own. It will expand their abilities and lifespan.
- It can expand their abilities and lifespan? Have you guys lost your minds? Only the Zodiacs are allowed to have power and a long lifespan!
- If they don’t want to die an early death, they can do as they’ve always done! They can pledge their loyalty to the Zodiacs as Constructs!
- You want mere servants to be able to stand on their own feet!?
It was the sight of the Creators having a big argument, and the scene came to a stop when the giant was eradicated using Delete Achievement.
The giant created using Divine Achievement (Achievement) disappeared, causing the Great Spirit to push its face out from the summoning circle leading to Duat.
‘!’
He looked enraged.
[Great Spirit of Ennead has increased his synchronization rate.]
[Synchronization Rate: 52%]
[Synchronization Rate: 53%]
The Great Spirit pushed out of the summoning circle, and it looked like he wanted to grab Guisoon.
However, the paralyzed Lee Gun’s abilities returned at that moment. He immediately infused the power of Cycle into his hand.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!
He put almost all the power he possessed into his hand. The power was condensed into a cube, and he threw it toward the Great Spirit.
The power of Cycle wouldn’t detonate on the earth. It would detonate within the summoning circle, mitigating the effects on the environment.
However, the Great Spirit dodged the power of Cycle.
“!”
Lee Gun quickly tried to make another one.
Kwah-jeek!!
Lime caught the power of Cycle like a baseball this time and threw it toward the Great Spirit.
Flash!!!
The power embedded itself inside the Great Spirit’s body, causing a powerful reaction.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!
The Great Spirit of Ennead didn’t want to be swept up by the power, so he tried to grab the compressed power. He didn’t want the compressed power to detonate, so he tried to compress it again.
However, it was too much power. He couldn’t do it while carrying out his attack, so he was sucked back into the summoning circle. However, it seemed he was as angry as he could be.
“!”
A strand of light extended out from the Great Spirit’s body and grabbed the slime. In a flash, Lime disappeared along with the Great Spirit into the summoning circle.
Boom!!
The summoning circle completely disappeared. It had all occurred in a blink of an eye, and the Great Spirit of Ennead was gone from the earth.
Guisoon, who had almost died, had slumped to the ground, alongside the other disciples. They looked at Lee Gun.
“A…Are you ok?”
“T…The slime was dragged away. Will it be fine?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. In strict terms, the slime wasn’t a living being. It was an item. He had fallen asleep while making it, so he had no idea which ingredients he had used, but it was his second creation.
“I don’t think it can be killed even if one tried, but…”
He hadn’t known what it was. This was why he had tried boiling it and cutting it. Slime had slapped back, but it never died no matter what he did. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Hey, doggy. You were watching, right?” Lee Gun called forth his Construct inside his shadow.
Anubis, who had been inside the shadow, flinched.
[W-What are you talking about?]
“What else? Your Great Spirit didn’t mind killing Osiris, right?”
[That…that is…!]
“You will suffer the same fate, right?”
[….]
Lee Gun told the sweating Anubis to let go of his loyalty to his Great Spirit. “Do you know about the power that immobilizes the Creators?”
[!]
“Talk.”
Anubis was very hesitant before he spoke.
[The Creators were gods directly under the Primordial god, and they were outstanding gods. However, there was a group that even they couldn’t do anything against.]
“Who are they?”
[They are called the Evil Gods. They have a connection with the Cluders, and they are called the hunters of gods. At the same time, they hunt the Creators. They are fallen gods, who are enemies of the gods.]
“Then….”
[You probably were unable to move because of them.]
Was the source of the strange voice the Evil Gods? Lee Gun laughed as if he was amused.
* * *
Ennead…
Kwang!!
Lime had escaped from the hands of the Great Spirit and crossed over to Ennead. However, it was being chased.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
Assassins sent by Ennead’s Great Spirit were chasing after it.
The assassins looked like wolves, and the gods were abuzz when they saw them.
“Kyahhk! What the hell?”
“Aren’t they the underlings of the Fire Wheel Lord?”
“What are they chasing? Is it an enemy?”
“I don’t know if it deserves to be called an enemy….”
A clump of slime was groaning as it ran away. It was the Clump of Creation Clay, and despite its escape, it was swallowing various items from all around Ennead.
“Kyahhhk! That thing stole a gem!”
“It took meat from our house!”
After stealing enough items, Lime went to the elevator of the Divine world, which allowed it to move to a different region! It seemed to want to return to the earth.
Lime quickly tried to move toward a tall tower when…
Kwahng!!!!
The tower that the slime was heading toward was destroyed. Screams could be heard as enormous flames erupted.
At the same time, a cold voice rang out.
“You have nowhere to run.”
The gods were surprised.
“Fire Wheel Lord!”
“Oh, Fire Wheel Lord!”
A young god revealed himself. There were all kinds of wounds over his body, but it was clearly Ra, the Great Spirit of Ennead.
He had never inherited his power. He was one of the top gods who had existed since the Divine world was born.
Ra let out a cold smile as he looked at the slime. Of course, Ra was supposed to be trapped within Duat after being hit by the power of Cycle. However, he was able to chase after slime.
He had barely been able to suppress the power of Cycle. It was compressed within his body without being able to activate. Of course, this didn’t mean he hadn’t taken any damage.
‘That reprehensible bastard…’
The gods were shocked by the raggedy appearance of the Great Spirit.
“Why do you look like that, Fire Wheel Lord…!”
“Ah. I had to smash Duat to come out. I had a reason for doing so.”
“You smashed the underworld… Are you saying Duat is no more, and the Fire Wheel Lord is responsible for it?!”
“You destroyed your territory?!”
“Hmmph. I just have to remake it.”
“What?! Did the Creators make that place for you?”
“There is no one capable of remaking it!”
“Of course, there is.”
“What?”
The Great Spirit extended his hand in anger. At the same time, golden vines extended to violently bind the slime.
Kwahng!!
The vines slammed the slime against the wall. The gods screamed.
“Oh, Fire Wheel Lord…!!”
“What is that…!”
When the appearance of the bound slime changed, everyone was shocked.
“That’s…!”
The Great Spirit had an annoyed smile on his face. “You ran away pretty well in that lowly form.”
Lime had changed into a golden-haired man.
“Ah! It seems the old man is still going strong. If you have something good to eat, you should share.”
He was Lee Gun’s father and the previous Serpent Bearer—Aslan.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - I thought so (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 399 - I thought so (2)
The gods were surprised to see this young man.
Lee Gun looked like he would maul anyone who bothered him. Unlike him, this man looked very soft and gentle.
However, Aslan’s expression wasn’t kind at all. This was especially true when he faced the Great Spirit. A rotten smile hung on his lips.
His appearance caused a stir amongst the gods of Ennead.
“My god! It really is Aslan. What’s going on?”
“What?! That’s Aslan?!”
While they might not know what he looked like, everyone knew his name.
During the era of the nine great forces, he had been the leader of the thirteen Zodiacs. He used to be a god with great influence in the Divine world.
‘He was on par with the Great Spirits.’
The Zodiacs were scaled in terms of power according to their abilities, Constructs, and Divine items.
At one point, Aslan had possessed the strongest Constructs.
‘Moreover, he was very strong in his own right. There was no answer for him.’
When the thirteen Zodiacs had been part of the nine great forces, the other eight great forces had been of one mind in being guarded against Aslan for a reason.
His appearance raised questions.
‘Isn’t he supposed to be dead?’
Didn’t his Constructs execute him because he went crazy?
‘Was he revived?’
‘No way! Who has the power to accomplish such a thing?’
‘Did he do it using his abilities?’
It was plausible since Aslan was called the Firmament Magician. He was known as the greatest magician.
The Great Spirit didn’t care as he looked at Aslan and burst out laughing. “You’re supposed to be an elite of the Divine world, yet you’re insignificant now. Why are you in clay form? It doesn’t suit you.”
“I wonder why?”
“Whatever! He’s your son, right?”
“….” Aslan wordlessly glared at the Great Spirit.
The eyes of the Great Spirit of Ennead flashed in contempt. “I did hear the rumors. You went to someone else’s colony and fell in love with a human. However, I never received any information that you had a child from that time.”
The child had descended from the line of the Creators. It had to be brought to the Divine world and used for their benefit.
As expected, the Great Spirit of Ennead cackled. “Did you manufacture a Revive ability so that you could revive yourself?”
“!”
Each of the Creators possessed a different manufacturing ability.
In reality, Creators that possessed Space Creation, Climate Creation, Material Creation, and other similar abilities had created the Divine world.
As for Aslan, he could manufacture and use any skills. This was why many mistook him for a magician.
The Great Spirit snickered as he looked at Aslan, who didn’t look anything like a god. It seemed a revival was impossible since his Divine status had been extracted and his body destroyed….
“Yes. He’s your son. Your son made you into an item.”
“What?!”
“What do you mean by that…!”
Instead of answering, Aslan snorted.
‘To be precise, I went into the item…’
Before dying, Aslan had put his thoughts in the Serpent Bearer temple. At that point, he had realized the existence of Time. He wanted to monitor the situation and, if possible, get rid of Time.
Then his Divine status was transferred from Yeonwoo to his son, and it allowed him to hang around his son.
Of course, he had merely been a thought form, so he could stay only as a small spirit. He wasn’t able to communicate with his son. However…
- Ah. I wonder if I’ll be able to make a drug that can fix my face with this recipe.
His son was falling as he started combining various ingredients. Aslan had been watching this in his thought form when it had happened.
To help his son, he had entered a bowl of medicine, and that precipitated what happened next. His son was half-asleep when he had dropped a strange potion bottle.
Clank!
- Ahk! Wait a moment! Gun! Ahhk! No!
Flash!
The spirit of a monster had appeared from the potion bottle, and Aslan was entangled with it. He was unable to separate himself from it, and to make matters worse, the manufacturing process had caused a reaction.
All kinds of ingredients had mixed, and Aslan’s thought form of Aslan had acquired a body.
‘So…I’m…a slime…’
The Clump of Creation Clay was thus created. To be precise, Aslan had become a manufacturing tool.
