Afterward, he had acquired and brought herbs when his son suffered pain on his own. When his son was about to die from the cold, he brought wood and started a fire for his son.
Since he was a slime, he couldn’t kill monsters. Still, he did his best to protect his son in place of his dead mother. Of course, his fandom of the TV idols was a freebie.
Ra seemed to have realized what was going on through his extensive experience. He laughed in contempt. “I knew you felt somewhat familiar when you came with Sagittarius. I never expected you and your older brother to try to kill me by detonating a bomb.”
Of course, he was talking about the time when Lee Gun had sent Sagittarius to him as a parcel.
“It was your hobby to raise Constructs. Did you raise your son using that same ability?”
Aslan laughed instead of giving an answer. It was the truth.
This was why he had used the Temple system and the notifications. He gave missions to level up Lee Gun. He fixed the process so that Lee Gun could grow as a Zodiac on his own.
When Lee Gun had come out of the tower, he had been a newborn god, though he was a low-rank god.
Of course, this was an all-or-nothing attempt. If it had failed, his son would have been in danger.
Despite this, Lee Gun passed everything to become a complete Zodiac. Moreover, Aslan was able to rank up as Lee Gun grew.
This was why he was barely able to change into his original form!
Flash!
When Aslan’s eyes flashed, the vines of light were exterminated.
Kwahng!!!
“Kyahhhk!!!”
Accompanying the explosion of Divine power, Aslan landed lightly.
The Great Spirit feigned laughter. “You want to fight me?”
“Are you able to last a match with me? You should act your age. You should go take a nap.”
“Don’t get cute with me, brat. I saw you when you were in your diapers.”
“Despite that fact, please do not forget that I’m the one who cut off your arm.”
As soon as Aslan said that, an enormous flame surged into the air. Ennead became a sea of fire. It was as if the dimension was on the verge of ruin.
The gods screamed.
“Fire Wheel Lord! Please stop!”
“The older brother is a thief, and the younger brother always antagonizes me. The son of the younger brother made a mess of the Divine world. All your family members are insane.”
Aslan smirked when the Great Spirit showed signs of wanting to burn everything down.
Soon, the Great Spirit and Aslan clashed with each other. They moved at a speed that couldn’t be seen by the naked eye.
Aslan crooked his finger. The compressed power of Cycle within the Great Spirit appeared in Aslan’s hand.
‘!’
Aslan had used his ability to bring the power of his son, and he immediately threw it.
The gods of Ennead were surprised.
“Wait…!!”
The entirety of Ennead was hit with the power of Cycle.
* * *
Around that time.
[Really? Gods are all gathered within the earth?]
Inside the territory of the monarchs, the first-generation monarch named Wind smirked in amusement. He was already in a great mood because he had eaten the angels of Eden.
When Wind moved at the mention of the earth, the second-generation monarchs looked at him. It was unexpected.
[Are you going to go there yourself?]
[I did plan on going there at some point.]
Amongst the newly born Monarchs, the most talented one had been Time. Earth was where Time had resided and eventually died.
Wind had been furious that Time had died there since he had treasured Time.
On the other hand, the second-generation monarchs looked at him as if that was a wise move.
[In truth, Endless Change was discovered there.]
[!]
[What if Endless Change thinks wrongly that we are invading his territory? What if he attacks Father…]
Wind merely smirked. Endless Change was a first-generation monarch like him. At the same time, he was Wind’s comrade and a brother-like figure. His being alive made Wind elated.
Coincidentally, the Cluders had been expanding their forces and getting ready for an invasion. It was why they had nurtured more monarchs and why the third-generation monarchs, such as Time, had been let loose.
If Eternal Change were really alive, they had to find him and bring him into the army.
[With him, it’ll be possible to completely revive the forces of the Cluders.]
[Are you sure it’ll be fine? He was swept up into the Samsara hell and became a human.]
[Moreover, it’s said that he’s a Construct of the snake god…]
Wind burst out laughing.
[You are saying that because you don’t know my brother.]
[!]
Wind knew Eternal Change better than anyone.
[He is the most devious and cruel bastard amongst us. In the past, he pretended to be a god to sneak into the Divine world. He played around with the gods while keeping himself hidden.]
To eat the gods, Eternal Change had pretended to be their comrade. He had also spent time with the Creators by pretending to be their ally. He had done that because the Creators were closest to the Primordial god.
As soon as he achieved his goal, he had killed the Creators, then called in the Cluders to smash the Divine world.
[Of course, he’s pretending to be with the snake god. He is acting like a pushover.]
* * *
‘I’m dead if he finds out.’
At that moment, Endless Change, no, Hugo was shaking.
He couldn’t fully remember the memories of his past life. However, his instinct was talking to him.
‘Gun will kill me if he finds out my identity…!!!!’
Hugo kept his mouth shut and shook in fear. The mere thought of Lee Gun finding out about the truth made his hands shake.
‘He’ll immediately take up Heaven’s Punishment, right? He’ll immediately cut me down. He’ll turn me into ingredients. He’ll grind me up, saying I’m the earth’s trash, right???’
He had watched Lee Gun until now. It was why he was sure.
‘He’ll decapitate me!!!’
Normally, Lee Gun tried to kill Hugo for eating one more chicken leg. What if he heard Hugo was a monster?!
‘He’ll cut me to pieces!! No. I’ll be fortunate if he stopped there…!’
“Dad!”
“Ahhk!!” When his son called out to him, Hugo screamed as he turned around. “What!!”
“Why are you sweating so much? Do you have to go to the restroom??”
“No! What about your mom and the baby?! What about your sister? Why are you here on your own?”
“Why else? You said you were going to get her clothes. I came looking for you since you weren’t coming back! Anyway, Mom will come later. Grandpa will come too.”
“Uh… Is that so? What about Gun? Is Gun coming home?”
“Uncle?” Chun Sungjae tilted his head in puzzlement. “Uncle said he’ll be gone for a week. He said he has to get rid of some people.”
Hugo let out a huge sigh of relief.
‘It’ll be fine if Gun isn’t coming.’
He would avoid Gun and use that time to come up with a way to avoid detection. However…
“I’m here.”
“Ahhhhhk!!”
Hugo screamed when he heard Lee Gun’s voice right behind him. “Gun! What? I thought you weren’t coming for a week!”
“I’m here because I have some stuff to pack. Also, a guest is supposed to come tonight.”
“G-Guest? Who’s coming?”
“Ah! Abyss.”
“Ah. I see— What?! Abyss?!!”
Why the hell would it come here? Did Gun plan on having a large-scale battle inside his home?
However, Lee Gun’s next words were more ridiculous. “It said it’d spruce itself up and come and eat me. That’s fine. I’ll make it leave after giving it some ramen to eat.”
“????!”
“Maybe I should drag it somewhere else just in case…”
“Wait a moment!!!” Hugo quickly shouted. “D-Do Miss Yeonwoo and Hailey know this?”
“Why would you mention those two?”
“Of course, we should speak about them!!!”
Its goal was abundantly clear!
‘A female wants to spruce herself up and come eat him! What else could it mean?’
Hugo had a lot that he wanted to say, but he soon massaged his forehead.
‘Fuck it.’
Gun wasn’t someone who would get taken advantage of by another, and there was no way he would show interest in a monster.
Hugo was currently afraid for his own hide. There was no room for him to be worried about Gun. In truth, the thing that scared him the most right now was…
“What the hell? Why is the house in such a mess?”
“…!!!”
When Lee Gun spoke as he assessed the house, Hugo felt a chill run up his spine.
At that moment, Lee Jaewon was getting rid of Michael outside, and he was surprised. “L-Lee Gun-nim?”
“Yes. I’m here.”
Lee Jaewon was surprised to see Lee Gun. He discreetly retreated and whispered to Hugo, “Z-Zodiac Saint-nim, are you sure we won’t tell him what happened here?”
“We have to hide it. We must never talk about it! This is especially true for Gun!”
If Lee Gun found out about Michael, he would ask the obvious question. How had Hugo gotten rid of Michael?
‘Damn it! How can I tell him that I killed him using the power of a monarch?’
At the end of the story, Hugo would have to tell Lee Gun about himself.
‘That’s why we’ll act as if nothing happened…’
Suddenly…
“I smell blood…”
“?!!”
Hugo and Lee Jaewon felt their heart sink when they heard Lee Gun’s mumbling.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed menacingly. “Hey, Taeksoo. Did you get rid of a god or someone like that here?”
“N…No?! No one came here. Maybe it’s Raphael?”
Lee Gun looked at Hugo in suspicion. “It’s someone else. Also, the inside of the house oddly smells like a monster.”
Hugo froze when Lee Gun looked at him.
‘I’m dead if he finds out.’
He met eyes with Lee Gun and shook as if he was about to be hunted down.
Lee Gun raised his eyebrows. He was wondering why Hugo was being like this.
‘Did he eat a god while I was gone?’
“Hey.”
“No!! I’m not a monarch!!’
“…?”
Why was he acting so suspiciously?

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - I thought so (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 400 - I thought so (3)
Why was he acting so suspiciously?
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold as he looked at Hugo. Hugo had never acted like this before. For some odd reason, Hugo was trembling as he looked at him.
‘Why the hell is he acting this way?’
In fact, Hugo was unable to meet his eyes. He looked afraid of being in the same place as him.
Naturally, sparks flew from Lee Gun’s eyes. His best friend looked like he had a guilty conscience and was especially afraid of him.
‘Did he eat Michael?’
Hadn’t the Red Monarch said this would happen? She had said Hugo’s instincts and memories would surface. She had also said it would cause great danger to the gods and humanity.
No one needed to tell Lee Gun who had been here.
‘Great Spirit-rank angel.’
Moreover, only two out of the five Archangels were left. And Raphael had been killed, so that left only one!
‘It’s Michael.’
That bastard’s corpse was missing, and Hugo was shaking in front of Le Gun’s presence. It meant…
“Hey, did you…” Lee Gun wanted to ask if Hugo had eaten the angel because his instinct as a monarch surfaced.
However, it was as if Hugo had already made up his mind about what was going to be said.
“No!! I’m not a monarch!!!” he screamed, knowing that Lee Gun thought of him as a monarch.
‘I’m sure of it! He thinks I’m a monster!’
Clank!
“!!”
Lee Gun summoned the menacing Heaven’s Punishment, making Hugo scream. “Whether or not that is true, I just have to test something out.”
Hugo turned pale from fright. He was sure of it. Lee Gun didn’t care if he was a friend or not. Lee Gun wanted to rip him apart and kill him immediately after finding out his identity! There was no mistaking it!
‘Of course, I can understand why he wants to!’
Although the gods had been involved, the monarchs were the reason his family had been ruthlessly killed. Lee Gun had suffered pain and humiliation for twenty years because of the monarchs!
In other words, Lee Gun wouldn’t be satisfied even if he killed all the Cluders! So, he would naturally lose his mind since a Cluder had been by his side!
‘Shit! I should have denied it!’
Lee Jaewon also became pale from fright when he saw the look in Lee Gun’s eyes. He quickly grabbed Lee Gun. “You can’t, L-Lee Gun-nim!”
Lee Gun glared at him. “Whatever! What did you guys do here?”
“What? That’s… Hugo-nim and I are cleaning this place.”
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed. “Clean? You guys killed an angel here. Are you guys erasing the evidence?”
“!!”
Hugo and Lee Jaewon were surprised. They felt their heart sink.
‘We hid the energy so that we wouldn’t be found out…!’
It seemed the mighty Lee Gun couldn’t be fooled.
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. “Why are you hiding it?”
“That is…!”
When Hugo hesitated, Lee Gun clicked his tongue.
Seeing this, Lee Jaewon became desperate. He quickly lowered his head and shouted, “I’m sorry! Lee Gun-nim, we thought that if you found out about Hugo-nim, you would try to kill him!!!”
Still holding Heaven’s Punishment, Lee Gun furrowed his brow as if he was insulted. “I won’t kill him, idiot. Why would I do that?”
“Lee Gun-nim, your words and actions don't match right now! Ahhk!”
Heaven’s Punishment fell in front of Hugo.
Kwah-jeek!
Hugo was barely able to dodge it. His face turned pale as he froze.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he told Hugo to stop dodging like a mouse. “Don’t move, idiot. I’m just testing out if I can keep you by my side or not.”
Hugo soundlessly screamed when the ax blade was lifted high into the air.
See! Lee Gun was really trying to kill him!
* * *
- What? Why is Hailey your cat?
Yeonwoo recalled the incident with Lee Gun. In truth, she had been curious about this part for a while.
She knew Hailey was one of the thirteen Zodiacs and his comrade. However, Lee Gun didn’t look at Hailey as a simple colleague.
Moreover, Yeonwoo had witnessed it at times even in the Divine world. Lee Gun treasured Hailey, and he had referred to her as his cat. This confused Yeonwoo. If she were being honest, it made her feel uneasy!
This was why Yeonwoo decided to be direct. She had asked Lee Gun about Hailey, and he had told her an unexpected story.
- Do you remember when we were students? When I left the orphanage first to live on my own? Do you remember the cat that I had?
- Ah! That… It was a female black cat, right?
Back then, Lee Gun had picked up an injured kitten. Yeonwoo remembered that he had raised the kitten as if she was the apple of his eye.
Could it be? Was it Hailey?
- She was hurt, so she involuntarily was sent back from the future. She arrived in front of our house. Moreover, she was in that form because she had lost her power.
- Then…!
- Afterward, she looked after us. She made sure we weren’t attacked by the monsters.
At this point, Yeonwoo had a realization. She understood why Hailey had become a Zodiac Saint despite being a Cluder.
‘It had to do with Gun.’
At the time, Lee Gun had been a normal human, and Hailey had continuously tried to protect him from the other Cluders. She had done it from a place where others couldn’t see.
However, Time and the monarchs had then attacked the earth in earnest, and Hailey had realized there was a limitation in protecting Lee Gun from the shadows.
In reality, Scorpio had approached Hailey when Hailey had found it harder to stay next to Lee Gun.
Of course, it was unclear if Lee Gun was aware of this, but Yeonwoo knew this to be true.
‘Gun is interested in Hailey.’
It had always been like this. Lee Gun had been a child who would get obsessed and attached to anything that was his.
This was why Yeonwoo felt a bit anxious.
‘Does he like Hailey?’
On the other hand, Yeonwoo had no idea what she was to him. She had been his closest friend and family until she had died, but…
‘He might just think of me as an older sister…’
Yeonwoo despaired. Of course, something else also worried her.
‘On that day, Gun was eaten by Oblivion.’
She was concerned about the day she had died. When Lee Gun had been eaten by Oblivion, all sorts of emotions had been eaten too.
Basically, Lee Gun had lost a couple of emotions, and the effects from that time still affected him. ‘It also might have to do with his desire for revenge…’
While it would break her heart, Yeonwoo didn’t care who he chose. She just wanted Lee Gun to return to the time when he had been full of emotions.
“Hey, Yeonwoo. I might have found Junwoo.”
“What? Really?”
“Yes. I’m pretty sure he is in Valhalla. I’ll get him back in short order.”
Lee Gun had laughed as he stroked her face.
Yeonwoo blushed when she remembered that scene.
‘As expected, I don’t want to lose him to someone else…’
At the end of the day, she wanted to go back to the days when she was able to live with Lee Gun. She would be happy if that happened.
The problem was that some beings were trying to get in the way of that.
‘The ones who want the Creators are closing in.’
In the past they had disappeared when they were unable to find Aslan’s body, but what if they were targeting Lee Gun now?
Yeonwoo’s gentle eyes turned sharp.
At that moment…
“Miss?”
“Miss Yeonwoo!”
“!”
Yeonwoo turned her head in surprise.
It was Chun Jiwoo, who held her third child next to Yeonwoo. “You don’t look so good, Miss Yeonwoo. Are you ok?”
They had exited the hospital and were heading home. The taxi held Jiwoo, Yooha, Yeonwoo, and Jiwoo’s father, and they were about to arrive home.
“Ah. Yes. I’m fine—”
Kwahng!!
“!!”
When the sound of an explosion could be heard from the house, everyone was surprised.
“What is going on…!”
They quickly went into the house and were surprised.
“Dad!”
“L…Lee Gun-nim?”
“Gun!”
They entered the house and looked at Hugo and Lee Gun in surprise.
Hugo and Lee Gun were fighting. To be precise, it was a one-sided fight. Hugo was screaming and being chased by Lee Gun.
It was unclear what had happened, but Lee Gun seemed angry at Hugo. “I said to stand still, asshole! Miss Jiwoo is here because you kept dodging!”
“Shut up! Wouldn’t you dodge too!! I might die!!”
“I’m not trying to kill you!”
“If you have a conscience, you’ll speak after you put away your weapon!”
At this point, Yooha and Chun Jiwoo carefully whispered to Lee Jaewon.
“Umm… What accident did he get into?”
“What did dad do wrong this time…?”
Accident…. It seemed no one was on Hugo’s side.
However, Lee Jaewon couldn’t tell them that Hugo was a Cluder and that Lee Gun was trying to test Hugo’s instinct.
‘If he’s faced with death, we’ll know if his humanity takes hold or the Cluder’s instinct takes hold…’
When Yooha and Chun Jiwoo approached them, Lee Gun unexpectedly stopped swinging Heaven’s Punishment. He glared at Hugo and said something unexpected. “You really have nothing to do with them.”
“I don’t! Trust me! It’s for real! I swear on the heavens!”
“Alright.”
“…!”
As if that was enough, Lee Gun turned around nonchalantly. “Ah! I’m hungry. Let’s go eat.”
It seemed he didn’t want to show the fight to Chun Jiwoo and the others.
When Lee Gun agreed to put an end to it, Hugo finally let out a sigh of relief. He was about to wipe his sweat when…
[Oh, Endless Change. Do you really have to carry out this strange act?]
“!!”
A fierce wind picked up, and an unfamiliar voice rang out.
The light in Lee Gun’s eyes changed when he felt that energy.
‘Monarch.’
It wasn’t a normal one. Something about this monarch was clearly different from the ones that had appeared on the earth until now.
As he thought that, Lee Gun reached out a hand toward a wavering shadow in front of him. He used his skill as soon as he grabbed the being.
[Pond Walk]
Lee Gun instantly moved along with his enemy. They reappeared within the holy ground of the Serpent Bearer temple in Hawaii, which housed Lee Gun’s workshop, where he created weapons.
Lee Gun had grabbed the enemy’s head to bring him here. He threw the enemy toward the ground.
Kwahng!!
The enemy didn’t even have the time to land as this all happened, and he feigned a laugh.
[I never expected you to not let me land at all.]
He had planned on blowing up Lee Gun’s house as soon as he landed. No, he was going to blow away Lee Gun tower.
[You read my intent just from me moving there and brought me here. I’m genuinely surprised. You move at great speed.]
Lee Gun’s eyes menacingly turned red. “Who are you?”
[I am Wind.]
“!”
A powerful wind arose alongside a cloud of dust.
[Are you the one who got rid of Time, whom I put a lot of effort into raising?]
Lee Gun glared at the laughing silver-haired man, with his guard up. This monarch looked like a normal human, but Lee Gun knew it at a glance. He was an overwhelmingly powerful monster.
‘Is he a first-generation monarch?’
In terms of depth, range of ability, and power, he was clearly much stronger than the monarchs who had come to the earth.
Lee Gun activated his Divine status of Cycle as soon as he saw the monarch.
Wind also raised his guard. He clicked his tongue as if he wanted Lee Gun to stop.
[I’m not here to fight. I’m just here to find my brother.]
“Brother??”
[Yes, my brother Eternal—]
Someone attacked Wind before he could finish.
Kwahng!!!!
Wind snorted.
[As expected of my brother, your greeting is as rough as ever.]
The one to attack was Hugo, who had followed them.
Wind laughed, looking elated to see Hugo.
[I'm here to take you back, my brother.]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows twitched. “What? Brother?”
Until a moment ago, Hugo had said that he had no connections to the monsters.
Feeling Lee Gun’s cold gaze, Hugo screamed, “No. It isn’t like that!”
[My brother! Why are you being like this? Have you already forgotten about me? We are brothers and comrades in arms. We’ve shared blood and soul.]
“Ah! You guys are brothers who shared blood and soul?”
Hugo turned pale from fright when Lee Gun took out Heaven’s Punishment. It seemed he planned on killing both of them.
Wind seemed oblivious to this; he merely clicked his tongue.
[What? Did you forget our promise? We promised to eat everything when we were awakened after tens of thousands of years. We’d eat the impudent gods and the humans. All of them.]
Lee Gun’s gaze turned much colder as he looked at the two of them.
When he sensed his own death, Hugo glared at Wind for saying something unnecessary. “Hey! Stop talking nonsense! Get the fuck out of here right now unless you want to die!!!”
[…?]
Wind looked at Hugo as if he didn’t understand why Hugo was acting this way.
[Do you not recognize me? I am your one and only brother. You even said I’m your only family— Oohp!]
“Ah. He’s your only family.”
As soon as the menacing voice spoke, an immense power flew toward Wind and decapitated him.
The one to send the attack was Hugo, and he tried to gauge Lee Gun’s reaction. “Gun! He’s talking nonsense!! I’m not his brother! I’m not a monster! I’m really not a monarch!”
Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment. “I see. He’s your only brother? No, he said that you guys are family? I’ll be sure to get rid of both of you. Don’t worry about your wife and kids. I’ll take good care of them.”
“?!!”
W…What the hell did he just say?

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - That's not what I meant (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 401 - That's not what I meant (1)
Eternal Change was the most destructive one among the first-generation monarchs. No one had seen his true form, and no one had survived a fight with him.
The only emotions he felt were madness, hunger, and mind-numbingly tedious boredom.
Although no one knew what he looked like, he was very famous. Everyone shook in fear when they heard his name. Moreover, he had made a fool of the entire Divine world, so many around the universe gnashed their teeth at his name.
It showed how powerful he was. If someone said that all life was exterminated wherever he appeared, everyone would accept it as fact.
This was why everyone had been afraid on the day when Eternal Change was executed. His evil soul had been thrown into the Samsara hell. It was an attempt to destroy the soul itself, but a soul of that caliber wouldn’t be destroyed so easily.
Everyone had thought he would be revived once again. They assumed he would be revived as an evil monarch. That was what was supposed to happen.
“Hey!! Are you boldly declaring right now that you’re going to take my wife and children?!”
“Yes, I did.”
The evil monarch… No, Pushover had flames coming out of his mouth when he heard Lee Gun’s words.
Hugo knew Lee Gun was crazy, but he never expected Lee Gun to boldly state he would steal someone else’s wife! “Hey! Have you lost your mind? That won't happen until dirt covers my eyes! Insanity!”
In the end, Hugo tried to grab Lee Gun by his collar. “What, asshole?”
“!”
Hugo was unable to do that. He froze when he saw Lee Gun’s menacing eyes.
Lee Gun said, “You made a promise with him. You guys were so close that you made a pinky promise with him. The promise was to eat all the gods and humanity. So what are you saying? Wife? Children?”
“N-no way… He didn’t say we made a pinky promise...”
“What?” Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose menacingly.
Hugo tucked his tail behind his legs, struck dumb by fear. He felt like if he didn’t shut up, he would die from Lee Gun decapitating him.
Wind, who had been sent flying when he was hit by Hugo, looked dumbfounded.
[That bastard is taking it too far.]
The power that sent him flying was no joke. Wind seemed to have suffered a good deal of damage. The blow had been so powerful that one wouldn’t forgive such transgression even if this was acting.
This was why an angry Wind approached Hugo.
[My brother, I know you are acting right now.]
“!”
[However, you don’t have to pretend like you are afraid of the snake god. You are powerful enough— Oohp!]
Wind’s head was once again blown off by the power sent toward him.
“Gun!!! Are you going to let him spout such nonsense?! Kill him! We are enemies! Kill him!” Hugo yelled in desperation. He was afraid of being registered as a monarch in Lee Gun’s eyes. He didn’t want to be killed alongside the other monarch!
At this point, Wind became angry.
[This doesn't suit you. How long are you…]
Kwahng!!!
“Shut up, bastard!! I’m going to get killed because of you! Do you realize how much he hates monarchs?! Once he loses his cool, he’ll kill all the monarchs!”
Wind was slowly reaching the end of his patience.
[Hey. You shouldn’t lose face as a first-generation monarch. I know you’re crafty when it comes to your acting, but you should go easy…]
“I’m not acting!!”
[…?]
Wind’s expression was a sight to behold.
[You aren’t?]
“I’m not! If you keep saying this nonsense, we’ll all get cut down by him!!”
Wind was dumbfounded when he saw the fear-stricken expression on Hugo’s face.
At the end of the day, Eternal Change was one of the four sworn siblings. Aside from the two of them, Underground and Hailey’s mother Flame made up the four sworn siblings among the monarchs. The most dependable and strongest one of these siblings was Eternal Change.
When he had heard Eternal Change was going to be executed in the Divine world, Wind had been bummed, but at the end of the day, it wasn’t a big deal. Eternal Change would be born again.
It had come from his own mouth. He had asked them to wait. He wouldn’t die. They would meet once again and turn the world on its head.
Because of those words, Wind had been waiting for him all these years. Yet what did he just hear? Cut down?
Wind glared at Hugo.
[Do you plan on suddenly breaking our promise like this?]
“What?”
[Do you realize what I went through to raise the kids??]
Lee Gun snorted and raised Heaven’s Punishment. “Oh really? Promise? He even raised kids for you?”
When Lee Gun’s eyes flashed, Hugo screamed. “There are none! There are no kids!”
“Oh wow. You’re trying to swindle us by saying you don’t have any children?!”
“Ahhk!!!!”
Hugo turned pale from fright when Heaven’s Punishment flew toward him. There was nothing false about this.
The power used to defeat Red Eye and the monarchs came swinging toward them! The blade of Heaven’s Punishment barely missed as it brushed past him.
Kwahng!
When Lee Gun stepped on him, Hugo felt like he really was going to die. He yelled, “Gun! I’m innocent. I have nothing to do with him!!”
“Alright. I have nothing to do with you either.”
“Ahhhk!! If you don’t believe me, I’ll get rid of him!”
Lee Gun was about to bring down Heaven’s Punishment, but he hesitated. Hugo had indeed reacted in the right way when he had said he’d steal his wife and children.
Was Lee Gun finally able to trust him as a friend?
“Alright. Get rid of him right now.”
Hugo let out a sigh of relief, as if he had been given a lifeline.
Kahng!!!
“!!”
At that moment, a fierce wind flew toward the back of Hugo’s head.
Hugo used a similar power to cancel out the wind, but he froze when he saw the expression on Wind’s face.
[It is understandable.]
“…!”
Until a moment ago, Wind looked like he was happy to see his sibling. His expression was completely different now.
There was betrayal mixed in his expression. Wind was trying to push down the surging anger that he felt.
He had raised the second-generation monarchs.
As expected of the first-generation monarch who had raised Time, the pressure he gave off was extraordinary.
Hugo felt that if he said one wrong word, the air would cut off his head.
Wind laughed.
[It’s obvious. You are doing this because that god is a Creator.]
“What?”
Lee Gun raised his eyebrows as if he was wondering what nonsense Wind was talking about.
“Hey. This bastard is mine. I’ll make him a slave of humanity. I want no funny business from you.”
It caused Wind to let out an evil laugh.
[Funny business? What’s wrong, brother? It was the same last time. You went to the Creators because you wanted something from them.]
“…!”
Hugo flinched, since it was a topic that had been in his memories.
[Others worked to draw out the Primordial God, the king of the gods. You approached the Creators, who were the only gods working directly under the Primordial god. You did it because you needed something from them. When you failed to achieve your goal, you killed all of them.]
“What? Hey!!”
[Oh, brother. You looked awesome when you killed all the Creators. There wasn’t a single ounce of hesitation! Your cruelty was great!]
“Hey! Shut the hell up!!”
Wind didn’t seem to care. He let out a cold smile since he needed the power of Eternal Change; it was all for the revival of the Cluders.
Wind let out a cold smile. Eternal Change was a first-generation monarch who had been able to wreck the Divine world alone. There was no way Wind would let him get away.
[Well, those Creators are all dead now, so you can’t get what you want. However, that changes if there is a survivor.]
Wind looked at Lee Gun.
[You may have reincarnated as a human, but you chose that Creator. It’s the instinct from the time when you were Eternal Change.]
“!”
Hugo had become a Construct directly under a Creator and chosen a Secretary as his wife. It all had to do with his instinct as Eternal Change.
[Moreover, you have recovered your memories, and you remembered what you wanted. That is why you are pretending to be a human.]
Hugo was afraid as he felt death, so he became desperate. “No, Gun. That isn’t it at all. I can’t act, and I didn’t recover my memories.”
[Do you really think you would have the power to send me flying without your memories?]
“That isn’t it…..”
[Moreover, you played around by pretending to be a god. You said faith is nothing in front of your acting. Didn’t you pretend to have 1,000% Faith toward the Primordial god? You fooled him for your amusement.]
“Hey. Why don’t you just shut up?! Go raise your kids or something! Anyway, I’m a real human, Gun…”
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold as he looked at Hugo. “Ah. You can falsify Faith.”
“…What? That’s not….”
“Ah. I see. You are a swindler.”
There was an odd sense of disdain coming from Lee Gun, which made Hugo aggrieved.
“No! That is all in the past!”
“You didn’t say it was a lie.”
“?!!”
Hugo turned pale when the power of Cycle emanated from Lee Gun. “Wait a moment! Listen to….”
The pure white power headed toward Hugo, and Hugo clenched his eyes shut.
Kwahng!!
However, the power of Cycle detonated against the power of Wind. The enormous power encircled Wind.
Wind laughed in an airy manner.
[It might be the power of the Primordial god, but do you think it’ll work on everyone?]
The monarch’s eyes flashed.
[Moreover, that power isn’t at hundred percent!]
The fierce power of Wind distorted the power of Cycle. There was a reason Wind was a first-generation monarch capable of raising numerous monarchs. He was capable of humiliating the king of the gods and making the elder gods shake in fear.
[You killed Time, whom I treasured a lot. That’s why I’m not too fond of this land. I might catch flack for it, but I’ll destroy everything.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows, intending to use Death’s Instinct. It was something he didn’t want to use since it could cause duress on the earth.
Bbah-gahk!!
[Kuh-huhk!!]
However, Hugo kicked Wind as if he wanted Wind gone.
It seemed Wind felt faint after being kicked by Hugo. Surprisingly, Hugo had kicked Wind with a black foot. His foot had changed into something that wasn’t human.
After being kicked by Hugo, Wind disappeared into a gale.
“It isn’t even his real body!” After landing safely, Hugo approached Lee Gun. “Gun! You saw it, right?”
He was making an appeal. There was no way he was on the other side.
On the other hand, Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold. “Wow! Look at you sending away your sibling because you were worried I would kill him.”
Hugo screamed as if he felt aggrieved.
* * *
“Gun! Trust me! I can’t live without Jiwoo!” After returning home, Hugo clung to Lee Gun’s leg.
Their family was gathered there, and they looked at both of them oddly.
“Lee Gun-nim… You don’t look…so good.”
“Did Uncle and Dad fight??”
Hugo flinched when his wife and children asked the question. “We didn’t fight….”
Hugo recalled the words Lee Gun had spoken as they headed back home.
- It doesn’t matter if I believe or not. I can’t let the father of a newborn baby be sent to the other side.
- Then…!
- I’ll keep it a secret. However, I’ll immediately kill you if you eat a god or a human.
- …!
- If your instinct comes out, you won’t be able to stay next to Miss Jiwoo and the kids.
- I understand. Since you believed me, I’ll help you…
- I don’t need it, you swindler. You can stop being my Construct.
- ?!
It seemed Lee Gun didn’t like the idea of Eternal Change having a hidden motive. At the end of the day, a monarch was a monarch.
This was especially true since Eternal Change had tricked the gods and eaten them. He stayed next to the Creators for ulterior motives and killed them.
What if Hugo was staying next to him for similar reasons? It was an unpleasant thought since it meant Hugo wasn’t genuine in trying to stay with him.
It felt like he was being used by Hugo.
When Lee Gun started going upstairs, Yooha called out in surprise. “Uncle? You are going up without eating?”
“Yes. A guest will be here soon.”
The lowest floor of the Lee Gun tower, which was previously the holy ground of the Sagittarius temple, belonged to Hugo and his family. Lee Gun used the upper floors.
“Anyway, no one is allowed upstairs today. I have an important guess coming.”
“Important guest…?”
“Don’t worry! It’ll go after eating dinner.”
Hugo froze at those words. Of course, he knew the guest was Abyss.
Lee Gun was telling them not to come because there was a danger of a fight breaking out.
“Gun! You got it wrong! Your guest intends to…!” Hugo desperately tried to tell him the truth, but he was kicked by Lee Gun.
“I told you to not speak to me.”
“Kuhk….”
Hugo massaged his forehead after he fell to the ground.
‘It’s Abyss.’
As someone from the same race, Hugo had felt that Abyss was female, but he wasn’t sure about it…
‘Her eating him could be a joke.’
Hugo shook his head as if this was no longer his problem. If he went up to stop Lee Gun, Lee Gun would beat him up.
‘There is no way something will happen, right?’
Two hours passed from that point.
‘What the hell is this situation?’
Lee Gun was alone, letting out a cold sweat. It was a room that no one had business entering.
Moreover, he had placed all kinds of defensive mechanisms and a soundproof system just in case a battle broke out within the building.
He had come to take a nap, yet someone had visited him in the dark room.
[I see. You are here.]
Lee Gun was taken aback by the naked, beautiful woman who had climbed atop him. Moreover, he had never seen her before. He was about to ask who she was when…
[As promised, I am here to eat you.]
Abyss let out a bright smile as she firmly held down Lee Gun’s arms.
[Why are you making such an expression? I had said I’d spruce myself and come eat you. You gave consent.]
…?
…???
Lee Gun’s pupils shook when he realized who this woman was. “……????!!!”
That was what it meant? No, that wasn’t important. This bastard was female?

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - That's not what I meant (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 402 - That's not what I meant (2)
In truth, Lee Gun had made all kinds of preparations for Abyss’s arrival. “Mmm. There might be a fight, so I’ll have to strengthen the defensive barrier.”
A monarch would be visiting him, but it was merely coming over for a night snack. Moreover, it was targeting only him, so the probability of a large-scale battle occurring was low.
‘I won’t let that happen in the first place.’
However, his opponent was a monarch. If he did something it didn’t like, Abyss might lash out in anger.
If that happened, Lee Gun just had to shut it down. It wouldn’t be a big deal except for its size. Abyss was massive, so a fight with it could destroy the building, and there was a high probability that it would cause a commotion.
‘If that happens, everyone will be worried.’
Just the mere news that a monarch had invaded again could frighten humanity. This was why it would be best that the public didn’t know that Abyss had reappeared.
“Alright. I put a barrier up so that no one can come in. I’ll have to strengthen the soundproof barrier too.”
Lee Gun had acquired defensive skills when he had absorbed the Taurus temple. He placed all of them over the entire building.
Flash! Flash! Flash!
‘Also, that idiot is making me worried.’
Lee Gun furrowed his brow as he thought about Hugo. In truth, he had believed Hugo because of his faith. So when Wind stated that the absolute value of faith could be manipulated as well, Lee Gun’s trust in Hugo had hit rock bottom.
Lee Gun clicked his tongue in annoyance.
‘Whatever. I’ll just get rid of him if need be.’
He dusted off his hands as he looked at the enormous pile of fried chicken. If he could get Abyss to get addicted to the taste of chicken instead of his body, he might be able to train it. This was why he was hopeful as he ordered delivery of late-night snacks. He had prepared everything if things turned out bloody.
“What the hell? Why isn’t that bastard coming?” He had waited for a long time, yet Abyss hadn’t come.
When midnight passed, Lee Gun was annoyed. “Whatever. I waited as long as needed.” He turned off the lights and went to sleep.
It was unclear as to how long had passed.
[Are you sleeping already?]
Someone approached him and spoke.
Lee Gun assumed it was Abyss. This was why he let his annoyance known. “Do you realize what time it is? Why the hell would you show up now for a midnight snack—”
Lee Gun flinched. Smooth hands were probing his body, and blue hair spilled atop him.
He saw a gorgeous, naked woman.
[As promised, I am here to eat you.]
Abyss had come to meet Lee Gun.
‘This bastard was female!!’
Lee Gun was in a state of mental panic when he realized the woman’s identity.
Abyss was a whale! That was the form that Lee Gun had known until now! He had vividly seen the crazy whale acting as though it had been at a buffet. It had gone crazy in Olympus. So what the hell was this?
Abyss seemed oblivious to this. She happily whispered near Lee Gun’s ear.
[I never expected you to agree so easily.]
‘If I knew eating me had such a meaning, I would have never agreed to it!!’
[I don’t mind, but I thought you would have a problem with getting together with a monster.]
‘Why the hell was the notification silent? Why didn’t it warn me about this situation!!!’
It had always given him a caution or a warning as if it was a worried parent, so why was it silent now?
Lee Gun was angry, yet the notification remained silent.
‘!’
At that moment, Abyss started to take off Lee Gun’s clothes one by one. He didn’t even have the time to stop her as his shirt was brushed aside. A cold yet gentle finger touched Lee Gun’s firm body.
‘?!’
Soon, her hand started to wander toward the no-go zone.
Lee Gun screamed as he grabbed Abyss’s arms and bared his teeth. “What the hell? Why do you look like that? Have you lost your mind?”
[What? I told you I was going to come and eat you.]
“I didn’t know you meant it that way! In the first place, why are you doing this to someone you consider prey?”
Abyss tilted her head in puzzlement.
[Cluders like to eat. We also like to do it. We are overflowing with an appetite for food and lust.]
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold.
Abyss didn’t seem to care as she smirked.
[Of course, the best is to satisfy both at the same time. That’s why I normally do the deed before I eat my prey, or eat while I do it. Didn’t you agree because you knew this? That’s why I came in the form I’m most confident in.]
Lee Gun looked at her as if something was wrong with her. It also seemed his words weren’t getting through to her. “Also, you are female??”
[Mmm. I changed into a form that I thought you would like. You don’t like it?]
“…?!!”
Abyss was impatient. She tried to escape Lee Gun’s arms. She wanted to eat right now.
[Well, others do get confused because I normally spend my days in my battle form.]
Battle form??
When she saw Lee Gun’s expression, she laughed instead of answering him.
In truth, Cluders had two forms. The first was what the humans called monsters. It was the monster form, called the Battle Form.
The other form was the Hunting Form, which was closer to the gods or humans in appearance.
In other words, it was a version that made them attract prey through beauty and handsomeness.
This appearance either tempted or brought down the guards of their prey. It was used to eat humans and gods. They were like succubuses and incubuses.
Abyss looked at her beautiful naked body as she spoke.
[I like this form because it attracts a lot of prey. However, I cannot eat a lot in this form, and I’m limited to eating only male prey. That’s why I eat everything in my battle form.]
“….”
[Mmm. As the greatest hunter amongst us, Eternal Change can probably eat both men and women. He can’t be satiated, so he can continuously eat…. I might not look it, but I do have a high taste.]
“….”
When Lee Gun’s expression continued to worsen, Abyss smiled in a satisfied manner.
[Anyway, I won’t kill you. I like you, so I’m going to take my time eating you.]
Was she crazy??
In the end, Lee Gun came to his senses and tried to escape from Abyss. However, she was extremely strong. It was expected of a being that ate gods, but that didn’t matter in the end.
Boom!
[!]
Lee Gun instantly flipped Abyss and pressed down on her.
Abyss looked stunned.
[Do you plan on taking the initiative?]
“What?! Stop talking nonsense….”
[Mmm. This feels like I’m being eaten, and I don’t like that. Alright. I’ll make an exception for you.]
“Fuck off! I don’t need...”
[I’m not sure you can do it since you’re a virgin.]
“What did you just say?!!!” An angry Lee Gun reached out toward Abyss when…
As Lee Gun attacked, Abyss let out an embarrassing sound.
[Ahhng. Not there!]
When she moaned, Lee Gun felt like he was having a mental breakdown. However, Abyss seemed to have purposefully aimed for this moment. She immediately put Lee Gun on his back. Then she smiled as she spoke.
[Just let me teach you. Didn’t you put up a strong barrier because you wanted to do this? No one will be able to come in here.]
That wasn’t the reason he had put up the barrier.
Lee Gun tried to bring down the barrier.
‘!’
However, Abyss grabbed Lee Gun’s face gently, yet her strength was immense. She was trying to kiss Lee Gun.
Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jee-jeek!
[Huh?]
Suddenly, the building’s barrier, which should be impossible to break, started to crack. The sound of glass breaking rang out as Lee Gun heard familiar voices.
“Uncle!!!”
“Gun!”
He heard his niece, nephew, and Yeonwoo coming up from the lower floor. Then they clearly saw it.
A naked Abyss had climbed on top of Lee Gun’s body and was about to kiss him. This angered them.
“How dare a monster try to jump Uncle?!”
Lee Gun greeted them. “I’m glad you guys are here. First, get rid of the dangerous—”
“Uncle is ourssssssss!!!”
“Uncle’s first is mineeeeeeeee!”
“….”
It seemed they were more dangerous than Abyss.
Lee Gun particularly beat down Chun Sungjae. He hadn’t called for them, yet they had all gathered here.
It left him puzzled. “Whatever! How did you guys know to come up here?”
“We heard the notification!”
“!”
Yooha brought out her chaotic red spear.
As Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple, they had suddenly heard a notification when they were about to go to sleep. So they had come running in surprise. The content of the notification was simple.
[The Serpent Bearer is baffled.]
[The Serpent Bearer is about to get eaten by Abyss.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s chastity is in danger.]
Lee Gun’s expression became distorted. Why did they get a notification, but he didn’t get any? Anyway, it wasn’t important right now.
“Whatever. Get out of the way. Take your hands off Uncle!”
“How dare a monster do this!”
Lee Gun was somewhat moved by their gesture. “Guys….”
“Change places with me!!”
These assholes…
On the other hand, it seemed the one that was the angriest was Yeonwoo.
“You have no conscience as a monster.” As though she was ready to fight a life-and-death duel, Yeonwoo moved toward Abyss.
Lee Gun spoke up. “You don’t have to go that far, Yeonwoo. We just have to chase her away…”
“Gun!! You shut your mouth!!”
“….”
Yes, ma'am. Lee Gun looked at Yeonwoo as if he couldn’t understand why she was acting this way. His niece and nephew were a given. But he had no idea why Yeonwoo was so angry.
“Ag… I knew this would happen.”
At that moment, Hugo clicked his tongue as he came up. He acted as if he had expected this.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. “What? You knew what she was aiming for?”
“The fact that you didn’t know makes you a bigger idiot— Kuh-huhk!!!”
Hugo received a beating.
“You want to die? Traitor! Why didn’t you say anything?”
“What!! I was going to say something, but you were the one who didn’t want to listen to me!! You made me shut up!!”
When Abyss came face-to-face with Yeonwoo and the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple, she looked offended.
[They are humans who don't even possess Divine status, yet they point their blades at me?]
It meant the only one who could kill her was the snake god.
[I’ll eat everyone except the snake god.]
“What?”
[I won’t kill them. I’ll just torment them.]
When she looked into Lee Gun’s eyes, Abyss changed her course of action. She was about to turn back to her whale form when…
[Where are you, my Creator?]
“…!”
When Lee Gun heard the voice once again, he flinched as he turned his head.
Yeonwoo’s eyes turned cold. She had felt the menacing energy of those that had killed her owner.
[The Creator is here.]
[He is here.]
At the same time, suspicious shadows wearing cloaks rushed into the buildings.
Yeonwoo raised her blade because of this.
‘As expected, they are…!’
It was those aiming for the Creators. After Aslan’s death, they had roamed around graves as they madly searched for his corpse. They had even dug out his grave. Also, they had gone missing when Aslan disappeared.
It seemed they had come for Lee Gun. Yeonwoo was sure of it.
Abyss seemed to recognize them.
[Ah. The Evil Gods.]
The Chun siblings were about to activate their skills when the enemies tried to make their move against the Creator.
At that moment, Abyss flashed a mysterious smile as she used her ability. Her Pond ability swallowed up the evil gods who had been approaching Lee Gun. She had sent them to a different location.
Abyss then looked at Lee Gun.
[There are too many distractions here.]
“!”
[Since I sent away those who were aiming for you, you should let me take you to a nice place.]
“It seems you still haven’t come to your senses..”
Yooha, Sungjae, and Yeonwoo were about to approach Abyss when…
Kwahng!!!
“!”
Someone blocked Abyss’s path.
Everyone was surprised by the newcomer.
“Hailey!”
It was unclear if she had come because she knew what was going on. However, Hailey blocked Abyss’s path. For some reason, she looked furious.
“Why are you here?”
[You are Red’s child. You know, I like you, but it seems you’ve forgotten your standing.]
“If you hadn’t gone over to Time, we would have had the same rank. Why are you here?”
[Why else? If you covet something, you have to call dibs on it. If not, someone else will steal it.]
“!”
[Unlike someone who continues to flitter around him, I’m not an idiot who will just watch him.]
Hailey became angry when Abyss spoke as if she was singling her out.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw this as if he was unable to comprehend what was going on. “Why the hell are they fighting? We just have to chase Abyss away from here. That’s all we have to do.”
Hugo looked at Lee Gun, dumbfounded. “Are you this oblivious?”
“That’s enough, bastards.”
It seemed Abyss didn’t plan on making any concessions. When she approached Lee Gun, he let out a sigh as he tried to use his ability. He planned on sending her to a different land.
Tuhk!
“!”
Abyss had said Lee Gun would be stolen if Hailey didn’t call the dibs on him. It seemed her provocation had worked. Hailey suddenly turned around and firmly grasped Lee Gun’s hand.
“??”
Flash!
“!!”
Hailey and Lee Gun instantly disappeared.
“U-Uncle?!!”
The Serpent Bearer had been kidnapped.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - That's not what I meant (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 403 - That's not what I meant (3)
Lee Gun’s disappearance surprised everyone within the building.
“Uncle?!”
“Gun!”
He hadn’t merely disappeared.
“The Scorpio Saint kidnapped him!”
“!!”
Of course, it wasn’t teleportation. The only ones who could use teleportation were magicians of the Gemini temple and Chun Sungjae. However, the other Zodiac Saints immediately recognized what had happened.
‘That is the Zodiac Saint’s Return skill…!’
It meant there was only one destination.
‘The holy ground of the Scorpio temple!’
However, the problem was that their opponent was the Scorpio temple.
‘The holy ground of Scorpio temple remains hidden.’
The Scorpio temple was different from the famous Leo and Virgo temples, the main buildings of whose holy grounds were known to the world.
The Scorpio temple was known as the temple of thieves. Like how it was with the Cancer temple, this temple’s holy grounds were hidden. Only the disciples knew the location of the holy ground.
In other words, Hailey had gone all-in on kidnapping Lee Gun.
Because of her actions, the Chun siblings were spitting fire from their mouths.
Yeonwoo and Hugo were also taken aback. The one most surprised in this situation was Hugo.
‘I…I never would have expected Hailey to spirit Gun away.’
No, that wasn’t the problem. Hugo had heard it clearly right before they had disappeared.
- If you don’t call dibs on it, someone else will steal it. If you don’t call dibs on it…
It was the words that Hailey had been muttering under her breath as she grabbed Lee Gun’s hand! Obviously, she was worried about what Abyss had said.
‘Maybe… Can it be?’
Would he finally be able to see Gun’s children?! Hugo put his hand over his mouth. Finally, he would be able to see his cute nieces and nephews, who would follow their uncle with 600% faith!!!
On the other hand, Abyss looked furious that Lee Gun had been stolen from her.
[What does she think she is doing right now?]
“!”
She had sourced herself up to come here. A chaotic power emanated from Abyss.
[How dare you steal the snake god in front of me!]
“Wait a moment….”
[Moreover, you disappeared while I was looking?]
“You shouldn’t…!”
[I just came here for my fair compensation!!!]
Hugo became angry when faced with Abyss’s rage. “Damn it! That’s enough. Put on some clothes and get the hell out of our house!!”
Abyss didn’t seem to care as the nightmarish shadow started destroying her surroundings.
Hugo glared at her. “Hey! Didn't you hear me?! Get out of here!”
[I heard nothing, damn Eternal Change!! I won’t agree to it even if a first-generation is asking!]
Hugo flinched, and the Chun siblings tilted their heads in puzzlement.
“First generation?”
“Eternal Change?”
They looked at him as if they wanted to know what she was talking about. However, they didn’t even have time to ask the question.
Kwahng!!
“Koohk!”
Abyss changed back into her original, familiar form.
Kooh-goo-goohng!
It was the whale form, which they had seen in the Pacific Ocean and the Divine world. The enormous whale let out a violent roar as she started destroying the building. It seemed she wanted to get revenge on those who had interrupted her.
Of course, the Serpent Bearer’s barrier was placed over the building, so it didn’t instantly turn into dust.
Hugo got angry. For the past twenty years, he wasn’t treated like one of the twelve heroes, and the only wealth to his name was this building.
‘Of course, I have an excessive amount of wealth accumulated thanks to Gun, but…’
Anyway, Hugo bared his teeth when he saw his precious house being destroyed. “Don’t destroy our house! I paid off the mortgage not too long ago, asshole!”
[Shut up! Get out of the way before I send you to Wind— Oohp!!]
Hugo sent an attack toward her face to shut her up. Then he shouted as he took the plunge, “Let’s negotiate with Gun as the subject!”
[What?]
“You want to do it with Gun, right? I’ll make that happen!”
[!]
The expressions on the faces of Yeonwoo and his children were a sight to behold.
Hugo didn’t care as he confidently yelled, “However, as you saw earlier, someone has Gun set in their sights.”
After having her face suddenly attacked, Abyss furrowed her brows.
[The ones aiming for the snake god? Are you talking about the ones who wanted the Creators?]
“Yes. If you help us get rid of them, I’ll arrange it so that you can meet up with Gun!”
As soon as he spoke, a terrifying killing intent could be felt behind him.
“Dad?”
The terrifying killing intent was coming from three people. Hugo was afraid to turn around, but he spoke firmly. He tried to get them to stand down.
“Miss Yeonwoo. They are enemies that are dangerous to Gun, right?”
Yeonwoo’s eyes turned round when Hugo whispered to her. Hugo’s question had to do with the beings that had appeared earlier.
“There were times in the past when Gun was unable to move. I believe they caused it… They are dangerous, right?”
When Yeonwoo nodded, Hugo followed up. “Please be precise. What are they?”
“In essence, they are evil gods. They are fallen gods. They killed the Primordial god, the king of the gods. They also sold the power of the Primordial god to the Cluders, and they were banished from the Divine world for that sin.”
“!”
In other words, they were fallen gods who had gone through with a coup d'état.
Yeonwoo monitored Hugo as she said, “It was precipitated by Eternal Change… The first-generation monarch defeated the Primordial God. The evil gods took advantage when the Primordial god was weakened…”
The Primordial god was the highest rank god who ruled over the Great Spirits. And the Creators followed him.
If Constructs became subordinates of Zodiacs to receive and use their power, the Zodiacs and Great Spirits had the same relationship with the Primordial god. He had been that big of an existence.
Of course, the Primordial god was killed by the evil gods and had his power stolen by them.
“However, the evil gods were unable to completely steal all of the Primordial god’s power. They were later caught and executed, but…”
“Wait a moment. Gun uses Cycle. Isn’t that one of the powers of the Primordial god?”
“Yes. The other powers, which were ripped away, were recovered from the evil gods and the monarchs by the Great Spirits. However, Cycle and one other power were never found again.”
The Great Spirits and the Zodiacs had gone through a lot of trouble trying to revive those powers.
Of course, all of them had failed. The factions considered the cream of the crop had failed.
The only one who had succeeded in reviving Cycle was Lee Gun, and it was why the Divine world had been in an uproar.
“The evil gods that survived continued to covet the Divine world. They wanted to use the Creators to achieve their goals.”
Even a corpse of a Creator was a source of enormous power. In fact, Aslan’s corpse had been used to create monarchs.
‘The evil gods might have been the ones to float the idea of making monarchs using Creators.’
Monarchs were created using a variety of ingredients as a base, including trash, fragments, beasts, insects, corpses, and chaos.
In the case of the third-generation monarch Time, Aslan’s corpse was used as a base to make the monarch.
This was also true of the second-generation monarch Space-Time. The corpses of Creators from the generation of Aslan’s parents were used as the base to create the monarch.
Who had given out the information that the Creators’ corpses could be used to make monarchs?
‘I’m sure it was the evil gods.’
They were obsessed with Creators. There was a good chance that they wanted to make new monarchs using Lee Gun’s corpse.
‘It’s to be expected since a monarch like Time was made from Master's body.’
She couldn’t imagine what kind of monarch would be born from a corpse of Lee Gun’s caliber.
It seemed he had read her thoughts. Hugo secretly said, “The evil gods want to kill Gun and make monarchs from his corpse. Also, they are why Gun can’t move sometimes…”
“Yes. The evil gods know numerous forbidden techniques that should be left alone. They know how to make the Creators powerless. That’s why Gun can’t move…”
“This is why we should use Abyss.”
“!”
“At the end of the day, evil gods are gods. Monarchs are their mortal enemies. She sent them away earlier. She might be useful to us.”
That wasn’t all.
‘Wind won’t stand back and do nothing.’
Wind was the monarch desperate to create more monarch children. It wouldn’t surprise Hugo if Wind wanted to kill Lee Gun to make the fourth generation of monarchs.
‘It’s best to make a monarch work against another monarch.’
“Dad?”
When Hugo said that he would hook up Abyss with Lee Gun, his children sent dirty looks toward him. However, he told them off. He didn't plan on actually going through with it.
“How can you think so low of me? Of course, I’ll give that whale a clone version of Gun.”
With the power of Hugorodite, he could create as many clones as he liked. That is why he had to get rid of this nuisance first!
“Well? What do you want to do, whale? Will you accept the terms?”
Abyss was still enraged. She became worked up.
[Alright. However, I’ll eat you instead if you send a clone or something like that.]
Hiccup!
Hugo almost choked.
[Before we can make a deal, you guys have to find the Scorpio Saint first, right?]
Hugo shook when he felt Abyss’s gaze. “Ah. That won’t be a problem. I know their destination, so I’ll be able to find them in no time.”
He could find them, but….
Hugo started to sweat since he could guess what was going on in the meantime. It also had to do with the women next to him. Their eyes were flashing violently.
‘Miss Yeonwoo is becoming darker…’
* * *
A while ago…
Hailey had felt the energy of Abyss and had come toward Lee Gun. In the beginning, she hadn’t paid too much attention. Abyss roamed around, so Hailey thought the monarch was merely passing by.
However, the monarch was heading straight toward Lee Gun. Feeling something was off, Hailey had traveled to Lee Gun’s holy ground and found a naked Abyss. Hailey knew Abyss’s goal just from seeing this.
She knew what went through the minds of Cluders better than anyone else. This was why Hailey had gone berserk and kidnapped Lee Gun. This was a good thing, but…
‘I rushed it too much in kidnapping him!’
Hailey had used the Return skill. She groaned as she raised her head. It was supposed to be a skill used only on herself.
When she had moved Lee Gun with her in haste, she had tripped on her own feet.
‘I wonder if Lee Gun is ok. Where is he…’
Hailey was looking at her surroundings when she almost screamed.
‘?!’
For some reason, the ground had felt weird. It seemed she had fallen on top of Lee Gun. Moreover, Abyss had taken off Lee Gun’s shirt, so he was unconscious and wearing only his pants.
Hailey froze “G…Gun!!”
Taken aback, she quickly looked over at Lee Gun, but thankfully, Lee Gun was merely asleep. The reason was the ability of the Scorpio placed over the holy ground.
At that moment, Hailey was anxious.
‘I…I never planned on bringing him here for real.’
In the end, Hailey hugged Lee Gun, planning on returning him. However, her subordinates screamed toward her from her shadow.
[What are you doing? Hurry up and put dibs on him!!!]
“?!”
[This is your opportunity!]
O…Opportunity!
Hailey’s mind went faint.
[It’s an opportunity! Isn’t that why you brought him here?]
In truth, she had thought Lee Gun would be in danger if he was left next to Abyss. That was why she had brought him here without thinking too much! There had been no plan!
[Of course, you had a plan! If you return him right now, he’ll be stolen from you!]
[That’s right. You know what Abyss is like!]
[You have to put dibs on him!!!]
Hailey flinched.
“That’s….” Hailey hesitated as she looked at Lee Gun.
She moved closer before she stopped. She once again moved before she came to a stop. Trying to be brave, she moved her face closer to Lee Gun’s lips.
At that moment…
“What are you doing?”
“…!!!”
Hailey screamed.
Lee Gun yawned as he looked at his surroundings. “Is this the holy ground of the Scorpio temple? The basic defensive skill must be ‘sleep.’”
He had a nice nap thanks to the sleeping skill.
Lee Gun looked at Hailey. “So, why did you bring me here?”
“?!”
Hailey was taken aback by the unexpected question. When she had been told that he would be taken from her if she didn’t put dibs on him, she had kidnapped him on impulse…
She had been agonizing over her answer when…
“Ah! You kidnapped me because of Abyss, right? You didn’t need to do it, but thank you.”
Hailey covered her face as if she felt guilty.
At that moment, Lee Gun looked very interested in the holy ground of the Scorpio temple.
‘This is the first time I’ve visited the holy ground of the Scorpio temple.’
Unlike the other temples, the holy ground of the Scorpio temple wasn’t open to the public.
‘Is this the Zodiac Saint’s room?’
It was tranquil within the very beautiful building, which looked like a temple.
When Lee Gun placed a hand on the wall of the building, he witnessed something bizarre.
[A portion of the Scorpio’s power is entering you.]
[A portion of the Scorpio’s memory is entering you]
“!”
It was the memory of the Divine world.
- Ah. Is it the new houseguest you spoke about?
A father and a very young son made an appearance.
Lee Gun was surprised when he saw the three-year-old child.
‘It’s the past Serpent Bearer.’
The young son was Aslan. A being who looked to be Scorpio spoke to the father and son.
- Yes. He will be staying with us… I might have to leave him with you guys.
Lee Gun was surprised for a different reason when he saw the man Scorpio introduced to the father and son.
‘Taeksoo.’
They didn’t look completely identical, but this man looked similar to Hugo. He was Eternal Change. This was the time when Eternal Change had met the Creator tribe.
At the same time, Lee Gun realized an important truth.
‘The Zodiac of the Scorpio Temple is a Creator. We are from the same tribe.’
He was the first leader of the Creators, and he might have been a Great Spirit.
Afterward, Lee Gun saw the Scorpio taking the short end of the stick from a smiling Eternal Change. The memory came to an end when that horrible scene flowed into Lee Gun.
At the same time, Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he pulled back his hand from the wall.
‘Is that why Scorpio hates Taeksoo?’
Well, it didn’t matter in the end,
“Hailey. I have a question I would like to ask…”
Lee Gun was about to ask Hailey if he could meet Scorpio, but…
“!”
Hailey grabbed Lee Gun’s hand as he tried to get up. She seemed to have something to say, so he looked at her.
“!”
However, Hailey pulled his hand toward her chest, surprising him.
“…??!”
As his face became shadowed, Hailey’s face approached his. Her lips were gently lined up to his lips.
As a good smell hit him, Lee Gun fell over backward.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - That's not what I meant (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 404 - That's not what I meant (4)
Their faces were so close that their noses were almost touching.
“…!”
It was such a sudden move that Lee Gun’s mouth opened in surprise. Soon, Hailey made her move.
The underlings of the Scorpio temple cheered.
[That’s it!! Princess!]
Ecstatic, the Constructs shouted from inside Hailey’s shadow.
[Just like that !! Push harder!! Suck the soul out of the snake god!]
[No, Princess! Move your hand a little lower!]
[Lower!! That’s right! Just a bit lower!! Ohhhhhhhh!]
[Get a little closer! That’s it! Ohhhhhh! That’s it!]
[No, a little more! Be more direct!]
However, their meddling didn’t last long.
Flash!!
It seemed she wanted them to shut up. Hailey used her power to send her underlings somewhere else.
Her underlings screamed as they disappeared.
[Ahhhk! Princessss!]
[You must! You must suceeeeeeeed!]
In the end, the irritants giving advice completely disappeared. The only ones left in the room were Lee Gun and Hailey.
* * *
Around that time.
[What the hell did you sayyyyyyyyy?!!]
Carly was raging on the other side of the phone call.
[You’re telling me the Scorpio Saint kidnapped Lee Gun-nim?!]
Carly was about to shoot laser beams from her eyes as she conversed with Yooha on the phone. Currently, Carly was leading the Libra temple as the Libra Saint. Her holy ground in Australia had been invaded by the angels and the new Zodiac Saints. She was fighting to reclaim her territory.
Moreover, Yooha would never call Carly, yet things had changed right now.
“Anyway, Uncle was sent to the holy ground of the Scorpio temple. The true location of the Scorpio temple’s holy ground is hidden, but won’t you be able to find it if you use your Golden Rule skill? Anything is possible for your temple if the right price is paid.”
Carly was screaming as if something completely unexpected had occurred. She had planned on growing her power, looking for the day when she would be able to take Lee Gun for herself!
[Dad’s chastity…!!!]
“Hey, halfling. Are you listening to me?”
[Alright! I’ll find him right now! I’ll find him and bring him here!]
When the call ended, Yooha immediately looked at the idiot next to her.
Chun Sungjae was letting out killing intent.
“Why are you so angry, Sungjae?”
“How can I not be angry right now!” Chun Sungjae had decided to join hands with Yooha, and he was contacting other people too. “Since those of the Sagittarius temple are geniuses at tracking, I contacted the older brothers and sisters at the Sagittarius temple!!”
A fire was shooting out of Chun Sungjae’s mouth as he showed her his phone.
Currently chatting with 52 members of the Sagittarius temple
[Jaewon: What? You want us to track down the holy ground of the Scorpio temple?]
[Sungjae: ㅇㅇ!!!! Uncle was kidnapped! Chastity in danger!!! Hellllllp!!]
[Jaewon: Ah. Our Zodiac is absent, so we can’t use our power^^]
[Sungjae: ????? You can borrow magical energy from the Serpent Bearer temple though!!!]
[Jenni: We shouldn’t interrupt in such matters ㅎㅎㅎㅎ]
[Jihoon: Lee Gun Hyung-nim has to lose his V-card!]
[Shu: I want to see children that look like Lee Gun-nim!]
[Goat: I don’t want to be cursed by interrupting unnecessarily…]
[Jaewon: Let’s just cheer for them!]
[Sungjae: #*$&$#*!!!]
“Dammit! They are the worst traitors!”
Since they were of no help to him, Chun Sungjae almost broke his phone as he shut it off.
“I shouldn’t have expected much since the original Zodiac Saint of the Sagittarius temple wasn’t helpful…”
Chun Sungjae glanced at Hugo.
After stopping Abyss with his son’s help, Hugo was grinning for some reason.
‘Ah. I’m glad I gave him the information.’
Not too long before Hailey had kidnapped Lee Gun, Lee Gun had beaten up Hugo for not telling him about Abyss’s intention beforehand.
At the same time, Lee Gun had grabbed Hugo’s shoulder and asked that question.
- Hey, Oh Taeksoo. You are a married man, right?
- What? Yes… Of course… You already know this?
- Since you have three kids at that age, you must be good at it as a married man, right?
- …What? God at what?
- Tell me how to do it.
- …What did you just say?
- Tell me how to do it!!!
He had no idea what had happened, but it seemed Abyss had slighted Lee Gun for some reason and made him angry.
- Give me a demonstration!!!! Teach me directly!
- What the hell are you saying, crazy bastard? Why would I tell you anything about that?
- What? I did my best to teach you!!! Did you already forget about the favors that I did you, bastard!!!
- Have you lost your mind? How can you equate that to this? Also, you were never kind to me!
- Why not!! It isn’t as if I can spy on you guys in your bedroom!!!
- Ahhk!!!!
Hugo had cursed up a storm when Lee Gun said things that shouldn’t be said. Still, he had told his friend about everything that he had to know. It was why Hugo had relatively high expectations.
‘This uncle will have a nephew or a niece!’
When Lee Gun had his children, Hugo would get his revenge on him by doing the same thing as Lee Gun had done to his kids.
Chun Sungjae shook as he watched his father keep grinning. Hugo was enjoying this situation, but the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple were angry.
‘Still, how dare she kidnap him in front of his Zodiac Saints?’
His pride was hurt, but she dared kidnap a Zodiac to a different holy ground?
“Really! You are a Construct of the Serpent Bearer, so you should feel the seriousness of this situation! Our Zodiac was kidnapped! It isn’t the time to be smiling!”
Hugo bit his tongue. “I guess you are right. While Hailey might not do it, Scorpio might have ill intent. It might not let Gun go…”
Scorpio was the most mysterious of the thirteen Zodiacs. No one knew its true identity.
“I can see how it might be dangerous for….”
“Damn it! My plan got blown up! I was going to change my body into something glamorous, and I planned on seducing Uncle???”
“Are you being serious…?” Hugo’s expression was a sight to behold.
Yooha ignored them. She snatched away Sungjae’s phone. “I don’t want to contact this person, but this person can get the job done..”
“…?”
Who was she trying to contact?
After the phone call ended, Yooha said something to Chun Sungjae, which made the light in his eyes change. Then he mumbled something.
After a while, he summoned someone.
Flash!
It was none other than the Constructs of the Scorpio temple! They were shocked when they saw the handsome young man in front of them.
[What the hell? Aren’t you the Zodiac Saint of the Serpent Bearer temple!?]
[Shit! How did he bring us here?]
It was supposed to be impossible, but Sungjae had worked as a religious sect leader for two years. He had done it inside an Eden colony, so his ability had increased by a lot.
Chun Sungjae grabbed the monstrous heads of the Scorpio Constructs as he asked, “Tell us the location of the Scorpio temple’s holy ground while we are still being nice.”
[Hmmph. It’s too late. The atmosphere was great!!]
[That’s right! There is no way we’ll let the snake god go! We’ll make him the son-in-law of the Scorpio— Ggoo-ehhk!]
Someone had a bright smile on her face as she grabbed the Constructs’ shoulders.
“Please lead the way.”
Chun Sungjae was surprised when he saw who it was. “Y-Yeonwoo noona?”
“Right now.”
The Divine status appearing from her body made the eyes of the Scorpio Constructs and Chun Sungjae turn round.
She had a bright smile on her face as a new Divine status could be felt from her body.
* * *
Around that time…
A storm hit the quiet holy ground of the Scorpio temple.
Kwahng!!!
[Ahhk!!]
An enormous explosion erupted within the holy ground of the Scorpio temple. The one to find and invade the hidden holy ground of the Scorpio temple was the Gemini Saint Heiji.
“Wow, Hailey! You beat everyone to the punch?”
The Constructs of the Scorpio temple were surprised when a Zodiac Saint suddenly invaded their holy ground.
[How did that woman find this place?]
[How did she enter this place?]
Heiji scoffed as she laughed. “How dare you underestimate a Zodiac Saint.”
At that moment, Heiji made a gesture with her elegant hand. Numerous disciples were summoned within the holy ground of the Scorpio temple.
Flash! Flash!
It was a teleport.
“Uncle!!”
The Serpent Bearer Zodiac Saints, a curious Hugo, and Yeonwoo appeared.
This place was the inner part of the Scorpio temple’s holy ground. A direct summon was supposed to be impossible here. However, Heiji was known as a great magician Zodiac for a reason.
They had invaded the holy ground using the coordinates Heiji had given to Yooha. As if that wasn’t enough, she had summoned many people within the interior of the holy ground.
The only one who could locate and enter the inner part of a holy ground was Heiji. This was why Yooha had called her.
“Find Uncle!”
They started moving busily.
The defenders of the Scorpio temple lamented when they saw the Scorpio Constructs held within Yeonwoo’s hands.
“Our location was revealed to them.”
It didn’t matter. Intruders had entered the holy ground. They ground their teeth. There was no way they would let intruders bypass them.
“Over there!”
[!!]
The intruders(?) quickly located Lee Gun.
“It is Uncle’s energy!”
[Ahhk! No! Right now they are—]
They quickly opened the door to the room.
Kwahng!!
Yeonwoo and Heiji turned pale when they looked into the room at the same time.
“Gun!”
“…?”
Lee Gun looked at them in askance. “Why are you guys here?” He was sitting down, putting on his clothes.
Yeonwoo and Heiji were taken aback by this sight. Yooha looked around, but no one was present in the room.
Hugo, who had followed them, looked surprised as well. “G-Gun? You are alone? What about Hailey?”
“Ah. She was here until a moment ago.”
“?!”
After he finished wearing his outer garment, Lee Gun got up. “I told her that I wanted to meet Scorpio.”
“…!”
“This is great. I was going to call for Sungjae and Yooha.”
The intruders were confused by his words. In truth, there was something more important to them.
‘Is it before or after?’
They had to check. Soon, they approached Lee Gun. Their eyes flashed as they reached out toward him.
* * *
[I never expected my brother Eternal Change to take his acting so far]
[!]
Wind was furious, and the other monarchs started to sweat.
[What do you plan to do, Father?]
[What else? The promised time is nigh.]
A long time ago, Wind had made a promise with the other siblings when Eternal Change was executed within the Divine world.
They were approaching the period when the Cluders would be the strongest. Soon, the sleeping monarchs and the scattered Cluders would all be gathered, and all the life within the dimensions would be eaten. That was the promise.
That period was right now, and it coincided with the revival of Eternal Change, who had been executed. Didn’t Eternal Change predict this before he disappeared?
- I’ll be awake by that time. We’ll destroy them all. Only Cluders will be left.
That was what was supposed to happen, but he never expected Eternal Change to be reborn as a human.
Anyway, Wind had been creating monarchs for this moment. He had raised the ones he considered talented. When he had unleashed Time, it had been a rehearsal for this moment.
[This is good. Eternal Change is someone capable of tricking even us. I’m sure he is working toward hunting down the Creators.]
[That means…]
[I’ll use the snake god to make the strongest monarch.]
The second-generation monarchs flinched.
[That means you want to kill the snake god and use his corpse!]
[It will inevitably lead to fighting Eternal Change…!]
Wind laughed at their words.
[No. Eternal Change wants only the Divine status of the Creators. There is only one thing remaining that Eternal Change wants. Creators have something he couldn’t obtain.]
[!]
[He will be satisfied only if he takes things for himself. That’s why we just need to separate the Divine status of the Creators. There is no reason for him to fight his siblings then.]
Wind and the Cluders planned on eating the colonies of the gods, the humans, and the gods of the Divine world. They would turn the land of the Divine world into the land of the Cluders.
[If I turn the snake god into a monarch, Time wouldn’t be able to hold a candle to him. A monarch that would be considered the greatest of all time will be born. He’ll be quite helpful in our work.]
Wind laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - Thank you (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 405 - Thank you (1)
“What? The evil gods reappeared?”
The Divine world was in an uproar. It was already a mess, thanks to Lee Gun and Abyss. The unexpected name shocked the gods even more.
“Evil gods…”
“Aren’t they the traitors who killed the Primordial god and sold his power to the Cluders?”
The evil gods were criminals that the Divine world would never forgive. They were the traitors who had ultimately gotten rid of the king of the gods.
The Great Spirits and the other gods had worked together and recovered those powers, save for Cycle and another.
Anyway, the gods considered the evil gods calamities. They had sealed these evil gods, yet they had appeared once again?
“They are the enemies of the gods, who want to sell the Divine world to the Cluders. They are dangerous!”
“They’ll attack the gods. We have to gather the fighting-type gods and the Divine army! We have to get ready for war!”
“No. It’ll be better if we let them be.”
“!”
Unexpectedly, the gods were smirking. The reason was the thorn in their sides, Lee Gun.
“That’s right. The evil gods are obsessed with the Creators.”
The gods had already confirmed that Lee Gun had created a strange item using the Divine status of Hermes. It was clearly the power of the god of technique.
“That means the evil gods appeared because of the survivor.”
“Ha ha…. The snake god will die soon.”
Wherever the evil gods had made an appearance, it had led to the death of the Creators. They were vicious enough to camp near the grave of Aslan, the last Creator.
In other words, this was a favorable development for the Divine world.
“If the snake god really is a Creator, he won’t stand a chance against them.”
Creators had been the gods directly under the Primordial god. They had been the Constructs of the Primordial god, who was the Divine world itself.
Moreover, they were high-ranked gods. There was a reason they were once part of the nine great forces. The problem was…
“A god with that much ability deserves to be left alive, but the problem remains that the snake god is the owner of the twelve Zodiacs.”
“…!”
Twelve Zodiacs.
The gods had countless factions, but one with merely a dozen Zodiacs was able to climb to become the ninth great faction. It was a faction with great influence.
The twelve Zodiacs had turned the dimension of the earth into their territory after the death of the Primordial god. They had refused to become subordinates to any other factions and built up their faction on their own. They had turned down offers to become Constructs of the Great Spirits.
Of course, it wouldn’t have been a problem if that was all there was to it…
“Didn’t Ennead and Valhalla say they wanted to take the territory of the twelve Zodiacs for themselves?”
“!”
In the era of the nine great forces, the twelve Zodiacs had laid claim to one of the nine territories of the Divine world.
When the twelve Zodiacs had fallen, the other eight great forces had divided their territory amongst themselves. Their land had been very rich and contained a lot of useful resources.
“If you recognize the snake god, won’t we have to return his land?”
“The Serpent Bearer is the leader of the twelve Zodiacs. Isn’t he the owner of that land?”
When the Great Spirit of Valhalla scoffed, the gods looked at him.
