[Owner? Those lands are already under our stewardship. It’s ours. Didn’t the previous Serpent Bearers agree to the transfer?]
“That’s true. However, they agreed only because the Great Spirit of Valhalla Great Sky Overlord pressured them with his power.”
The Serpent Bearer at the time had been Aslan, and he was the last to manage those lands. After his death, the rights to his land were taken by Valhalla and Ennead.
It had caused the twin snakes, Yeonwoo and Junwoo, the new Zodiacs of the Serpent Bearer, to lodge a complaint.
However, their opinions were crushed, and the Great Spirits had even taken the Constructs under the Serpent Bearer temple.
[Well, all the Constructs possessed by the Serpent Bearer were strong, and they were all famous gods.]
Even the Great Spirits had been covetous of them. What would happen if a new Zodiac of the Serpent Bearer temple were to make an appearance?
[There is no way we’ll give back the land and Constructs to a rookie like him.]
It was why they had agreed with Hades’s plan to kill the snake god and gave a helping hand.
However, the snake god was strutting around the Divine world and stacking Achievements. He could grow to a point where he might fill the seat of a Great Spirit. Then he might try to retake their land and Constructs.
“Normally, they are enemies of the Divine world. We should be helping the snake god…”
“Hmmph. Please think about the damage the snake god caused to the Divine world. Everything will be wrapped up if we use the evil gods to kill the snake god.”
“However, it’ll be a problem if the snake god’s corpse falls into the hands of the evil gods. There is a rumor going around that the monarchs were created using the corpses of the Creators.”
“Monarchs?! What nonsense are you…!”
“Why is it nonsense? There is a rumor that Time was made from Aslan.”
“…!”
They gulped.
Both Aslan and Time had been formidable foes. What did this imply for Lee Gun, who had won against Time?
If framed that way, it meant Lee Gun was a rookie well-qualified to become a Great Spirit. So what would happen if a monarch was created from someone capable of turning the Divine world into such a mess? It was unimaginable.
“In conclusion, we just have to stop the monarchs from acquiring his corpse.”
“That’s right. We’ll use the evil gods to kill the snake god, and we’ll pocket the corpse.”
“We must make sure that faction never rises once again.”
When the god came to an agreement to get rid of Lee Gun, unrest rose among them.
“Why are none of the gods of Ennead attending this important meeting?”
“Can you contact Ennead? For some reason, I lost contact with them.”
“They are impregnable. There is no need to worry about them…”
At that moment…
“This is bad! We received news that Ennead is in ruins right now!”
“!!!”
Shocked, the gods got to their feet.
“It’s in ruins? Was Abyss merely the tip of the spear? Did the monarchs invade them?”
“No! It was razed to the ground by a slime…”
What??
The expression on the gods was a sight to behold.
Slime??
However, it didn’t end there.
“The slime is stealing the treasures of the Divine world right now. They are all being sent to the Serpent Bearer.”
What the hell?!
* * *
The Divine world managed all kinds of colonies, including the earth, and it was in an uproar.
The members of the Serpent Bearer temple were oblivious to this, yet they were still having a mental breakdown.
‘Is it before or after?’
They didn’t care about the Divine world. Something else was more important right now.
‘Is it after?’
The eyes of Heiji and the Chun siblings shook. Hugo also looked to be deeply delving into this issue. He was looking at Lee Gun’s expression.
‘He is acting too cool for it to be after…’
If something more had happened, Lee Gun would either look excited or embarrassed. However, those reactions were missing.
Soon, Hugo did a double take.
‘Ah. Is it because I spoke to him about it??’
Hugo had provided Lee Gun with various pieces of information, and at the end, he had given one piece of advice; he had been adamant about it.
- Oh yeah, Gun. Expression. Your expression is important.
- …Expression?
- You might worry about it, so I’m telling you this now. It’s a point in your favor if you act cool. You must act cool. You should stand in front of the window with a cup of coffee. You should tell her good morning.
-You’re including strange things. Miss Jiwoo is an angel for putting up with all of it, but I get what you’re trying to say.
Hugo’s pupils shook violently.
‘Is it because I told him that? Is he keeping his expression in check? Is that how it is?’
At this point, the Chun siblings dragged Lee Gun’s Constructs into it. The method was easy.
“Hey, you guys are hiding in Uncle’s shadow, right? Hurry up and come to me.”
Chun Sungjae was in charge of managing Lee Gun’s Constructs. When he called for them, it was as if they were moving from Lee Gun’s shadow to Chun Sungjae’s.
Chun Sungjae asked, “What happened? Is it before or after? You guys were inside Uncle’s shadow, so you must have seen everything that happened!”
[Khmm. Khmm!]
[Kuh-hmmmm!]
[How dare you ask about Master’s personal life? Khmm!]
The male Constructs kept clearing their throat. Iaso, a female Construct, screamed.
[Me! I want to be held like that!]
The expressions on the faces of the Chun siblings were a sight to behold. Could it be? Was it after?
The male Constructs rebuked Iaso.
[Hey. Don’t lie. Master sent us away in the middle, so we saw nothing.]
[Whatever. The atmosphere was great! It must be after!!]
At this rate, no one would find out what happened, so Hugo scrunched up his face as he approached Lee Gun. “Gun!”
“What?”
“Be real with me. Will I be able to see a niece or a nephew?”
“…?”
Hugo seriously grabbed Lee Gun’s shoulders.
Lee Gun looked back with a face full of contempt. His brow furrowed when he realized what Hugo was asking. “Is that what you’re curious about?”
Hugo and the Chun siblings vigorously nodded.
“I was wondering why you guys were making a fuss behind my back. Were you curious about that, too?”
This time, his Constructs exited his shadow and vigorously nodded.
“So? What happened? Hmm? Will I be able to see a niece or a nephew?”
Lee Gun snorted. “Of course…”
“Of course?”
“I won’t tell you.”
“?!”
Lee Gun acted as if they were beneath his notice. He turned around in a cool manner.
“Gun?!”
“I don’t want you guys to treat us as a source of gossip.”
The Serpent Bearer Constructs, who were looking forward to the answer, despaired.
For some reason, Hugo suddenly raised his head.
‘Us?’
His face brightened.
‘Lee Gun said us??’
Lee Gun didn’t like to use the word “us.” In their whole lifetime together, Lee Gun had barely used “us” once when speaking to Hugo. And he used it when referring to Hailey and himself?
‘There was progress! I’m sure of it!’
That wasn’t all. Lee Gun returned to Hugo as if he had forgotten something. “Ah. Also…”
“Also?”
Lee Gun whispered into Hugo’s ear, “I need you to explain it in more detail later.”
“!!!”
Hugo clenched his fists and inwardly let out an exultant cry.
‘Victory!!’
There had been an attempt!!!
At that moment, Hailey reappeared. She had gone to call for Scorpio. Her black hair looked a bit windblown, but she looked cool as a cucumber. However, her face turned red when she looked at Lee Gun.
“Those clothes…look…very good on you. I was worried they wouldn't fit.”
Hugo raised his hands into the air when he saw embarrassment between the two.
‘Bravo!!! Victory!’
It didn’t matter if this scene was before or after. There had been progress!
Hugo could finally look forward to a niece or nephew, who would look up to their uncle. He was happy that he’d be able to get his revenge.
When Lee Gun entered the room Hailey pointed out, a hand violently flew toward her.
Boom!
It was Heiji. She planned on grabbing Hailey by the throat, but Hailey easily intercepted it by grabbing the arm.
Heiji let out a bright smile as she used her other hand to grab Hailey’s arm. “Let’s have a conversation.”
“Conversation?”
“So? Did something happen? What happened between the two of you?”
“!”
Hailey took a long look at Heiji. It was unclear as to what she was thinking as she whispered, “He was very manly.”
Heiji grabbed the back of her neck. She had tried to interfere twenty years ago, and she was trying to interfere again now?
Heiji glared at Hailey.
‘Do you think I’ll give up because you said that?’
She looked back to say she wasn’t giving up.
Yeonwoo, who had been staring at Hailey and Heiji, looked at the room where Lee Gun had entered. She was startled.
Kwahng!!
The sound of an explosion came from the room.
“Gun?”
“Uncle!!!”
Everyone was surprised by the menacing power of the Serpent Bearer as they opened the door.
* * *
At that moment, Lee Gun had entered the room of the Zodiac. He was enraged. “What did you just say?”
Hailey had called forth an incarnate form of the monster Zodiac. It was the Zodiac of the Scorpio temple.
The Scorpio was said to be so hideous that one would faint just from encountering it. The monster Zodiac repeated itself to Lee Gun.
[I want you to kill your friend, who’s next to you. No, I want you to kill the monarch.]
The next second, the violent power of the Serpent Bearer surged forth.
“It was unexpected that you were a goddess, but what did you just say to me? Kill whom? Do you want to die?”
Yes, Lee Gun had come to converse with Scorpio about the Creators and a way to get rid of the gods. However, his opponent had spoken some unexpected words.
[Eternal Change is a charlatan. That monster is a killing machine, and he got close to the Creators to use them. He may have been reborn again as a human, but that’s a facade. He merely put on the face of a human to stay close to you. This appearance of mine is proof. If you don’t want to die, you better kill him right now within this holy ground.]
“…!”
Lee Gun thought about the Red monarch. Hailey’s mother was a first-generation monarch, like Wind and Eternal Change. He recalled her words.
- For you and my daughter, it’s best to spare the monarch next to you… Protect him.
Hailey’s Zodiac and Hailey’s mother had given him contrasting advice.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - Thank you (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 406 - Thank you (2)
Lee Gun was dumbfounded.
‘What the hell? They gave advice that goes against each other.’
One had said letting Hugo live would be beneficial for them. The other one said it would be beneficial for them if Hugo was killed. The baffling part was that both figures were on Hailey’s side.
‘Both of them have no reason to tell me something that would cause harm to Hailey.’
Scorpio wouldn’t suggest something that would cause harm to Hailey, her Zodiac Saint.
‘In fact, she would have cherished Hailey.’
It was a problem, but Zodiacs thought of Zodiac Saints as their belongings. If anyone else messed with their Zodiac Saints, it would incur the Zodiacs’ fury.
It probably meant Scorpio wasn’t lying.
‘However, I never expected their opinions to be so opposed to each other...’
As if she had read his thoughts, Scorpio spoke.
[Flame or the Red monarch is Eternal Change’s sworn sibling. Of course, she would say that.]
“!”
Angry, Scorpio moved her face closer to Lee Gun.
[You are a Creator. You should trust someone from your tribe instead of a monarch.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. He conjectured that Scorpio had been the leader of the Creators. Basically, she used to be a Great Spirit.
In other words, she was his remote ancestor.
“It doesn't matter what you say. I believe in my friend.”
Unexpectedly, Scorpio laughed.
[Yes. Aslan’s father said the same thing.]
“!”
She laughed as if she was looking at a poor child as she continued.
[Do you know why the Creators were killed?]
“I do know. Sagittarius and his allies were overcome with jealousy. It was why the Creators were killed.”
The only Creator to survive from that time was Aslan.
[Yes. However, whom did you think instigated Sagittarius? Do you really think the Creators would die so easily under some evil scheme?]
“What?”
[The instigator was Eternal Change.]
“…!!”
It seemed Lee Gun hadn’t even thought about such a possibility.
Scorpio continued to speak.
[Eternal Change deliberately approached the Creators from the start. He became friendly with them to dig out information about the weaknesses of the Creators.]
Scorpio was probably speaking about the memory that Lee Gun had seen, the memory of the day when Aslan and his father had met Hugo for the first time.
[On the day when the Creators were weakened, Eternal Change disseminated their information to the enemies.]
“…!”
It meant that despite having a friendly relationship with Lee Gun’s grandfather, who was the patriarch, Eternal Change or Hugo had stabbed the Creators in the back.
[Eternal Change was ecstatic as he killed all the gods. He even made me into what you see right now. I can vividly remember how he had behaved.]
“…”
Eternal Change was an excellent hunter. By changing into tens of thousands of appearances, he caused confusion and played one side against the other.
‘At the end, he was vicious in hunting everyone down.’
Eternal Change had also morphed Scorpio into a hideous monster. After being changed into a monster incapable of speech, Scorpio had been unable to use her power.
No one from the Divine world had recognized her despite being a Great Spirit. In fact, she was attacked by the other gods when they thought she was a low-rank god of calamity.
[I survived by hiding amongst the insectoid gods.]
Her lot hadn’t changed until Aslan had found her after he became an adult. After boldly showing up in front of her, Aslan spoke to her.
- Oh, leader of the Creators. You are alive. I have been looking for you for a long time.
With Aslan’s help, she had taken the seat of the Scorpio temple. She had helped Aslan get his revenge as well.
On the other hand, she also remembered what Aslan spoke right before his death.
- I have a child. Please look out for him alongside the twin snakes.
However, Scorpio had been incapable of using a Creator’s power back then. It didn’t matter if he asked for such a favor. Moreover, she possessed a hideous appearance, and she couldn't communicate with others. She couldn’t even approach the other gods.
Despite this, she had done as much as she could in secret. This was true when Virgo helped Yeonwoo and Junwoo revive as humans.
Scorpio had worked in the background so that no one would find out that Yeonwoo and Junwoo had been stolen away.
[Eternal Change stabbed his friends in the back, and he wiped out our tribe. You want to trust such a being?]
In other words, he was the culprit at the center of everything. If not for Eternal Change, the Creators would have never fallen.
[That’s not all. If it weren’t for him, your father wouldn’t have died on his path for revenge.]
“!”
[Time would have never been born or led the monarchs to invade the earth. At the same time, Junwoo and Yeonwoo wouldn’t have been murdered tens of thousands of times by Time!]
In other words, Eternal Change deserved death. This was why Scorpio could never accept it. She had kept telling Aslan to kill Eternal Change, yet Aslan always replied in the same way.
- Oh, mighty Great Spirit. Please leave Eternal Change alone.
In the end, that conservation had always ended in an argument. However, she had thought Aslan’s son would be different.
[Eternal Change is the culprit that caused everything. That’s why you should get rid of the bastard who remains next to you…]
Kwahng!!!
An explosion occurred within the holy ground. It was Lee Gun’s doing.
Lee Gun looked oddly pissed off. He narrowed his eyes. “Fuck off! I don't mind if you no longer speak to me.”
Scorpio furrowed her brows.
[Are you saying you can’t trust me?]
“No. I just don’t want to follow the word of a god who neglected me.”
[!]
Lee Gun feigned laughter. “If you knew everything, you could have given me a heads up through Hailey. You could have done it before I was trapped in the Devil’s Tower.”
Scorpio furrowed her brow.
[It would have been impossible in the first place. After I was changed into a monster by Eternal Change, I lost the ability to communicate with others. I only regained it around five years ago. It was only possible because I saved Hailey’s Contribution to grow my power.]
“That does sound likely.” Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
In the first place, Scorpio had been different from the other Zodiacs. She never revealed herself or tried to communicate with anyone.
At this point, he was curious as to how Aslan was able to converse with her.
‘He must have possessed a deciphering ability.’
Aslan had the power to create any skill. He might have made a skill that could decipher the language of the monsters.
It didn’t matter in the end.
Lee Gun furrowed his brow as if he was displeased. In the first place, he hated being ordered around. “I will be the one to make the choice. That’s why don’t order me to kill him. Also, I cannot trust everything that you told me right now.”
Of course, although he said that, the words of Hailey’s mother bothered him too.
- Leave him alive.
‘It doesn’t matter who. They are all trying to give me orders.’
There was a chance that Hailey’s mother had indeed said it because she was on the same side as Eternal Change.
In reality, she had probably told him to leave Hugo alone since it would be good for Hailey and Lee Gun.
‘If Scorpio is speaking the truth, there is no way the thirteenth would leave Taeksoo alone.’
Weren’t they supposed to be enemies? If so, Alsan would have left Hugo alone when Confusion tried to kill him.
‘Why would he go out of his way to swap him out?’
Moreover, Aslan had told Lee Gun how to find Hugo’s soul, which had fallen into the underworld.
‘Was it because he was worth taking advantage of?’
At that moment, the enraged Scorpio backed off for a moment. She no longer went on the offensive.
[Alright. I will respect your choice. However, it will be inevitable. You will learn the true nature of Eternal Change.]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose.
On the other hand, Scorpio brought out an unexpected item and offered it up to him.
Flash!
“!”
Accompanying the blinding light, a Divine status fell in front of Lee Gun. From what he could sense, it was clearly the Divine status of a Creator.
[It’s my Divine status.]
“!”
[You will be able to threaten the gods and the monarchs with this. Moreover, you will be able to end the life of Eternal Change.]
“End the life of Eternal Change?”
[Let me tell you this. Eternal Change cannot attack the Primordial god and the Creators.]
This surprised Lee Gun. “He can’t attack the Creators?”
[Yes. He’s a sinner who ambushed the Primordial god. We were guards in charge of monitoring him.]
“!”
The primordial god was an exalted existence. All the gods of the universe worshiped and followed him. It meant ambushing the Primordial god was a grave sin.
[Of course, we couldn’t let a monarch back into the population. We bound his soul so that he couldn’t attack the Primordial god and his guards. That’s why he used others to kill the Creators.]
He did it on purpose to release the restriction placed on him.
This was why Scorpio was giving this item to Lee Gun.
[It may be my Divine status, but it also contains the Divine statuses of other Creators. I am the first Creator. I am in charge of gathering all the souls of my kind when they die.]
In other words, she was giving him incredible power, which might exceed the Great Spirit rank, a power great enough to make gods lust after it.
[It contains a very strong power.]
[With the power of the Serpent Bearer, you will be able to make a powerful Divine item on the same rank as Heaven’s Punishment.]
All gods possessed a Divine item that corresponded to their Divine status.
Moreover, Lee Gun possessed three Divine statuses. It meant he would be able to handle three Divine items. Of course, Heaven’s Punishment was a Divine item of Life.
[I cannot use it, but you are talented at manufacturing items. You can create anything with it.]
He might be able to make a Divine item that corresponded with either Death or Cycle.
Flash!
As soon as Lee Gun placed his hand on the Divine status, the light transformed into a weapon.
[The Creation power of the Serpent Bearer was applied.]
Well, it couldn’t be called a weapon yet. It was shaped like a bat.
Lee Gun laughed as he held it up. “Alright. I’ll use it well.”
[Great! Then you should get rid of Eternal Change using it—]
“Right. Thank you for giving me this, but…”
[!]
“Why are you insisting on giving orders to me?”
[What?]
“There will be no third strike.” Lee Gun took a big swing with the weapon of light, making Scorpio flustered.
[Wait a moment, my descendant!]
Kwahng!!!
He didn’t care if she was his ancestor or not. A large explosion occurred within the holy ground of the Scorpio temple.
* * *
Lee Gun dusted off his hands as he exited Scorpio’s domain. The members of his household, who were outside the domain, rushed toward him.
“Uncle! Are you ok?”
“We were worried since it took you a long time to come out!”
“What? It wasn’t long. I’ve only been in there for ten minutes.”
“It has been three hours since you entered that place!”
“Ah!”
It seemed the time within the domain of a Zodiac flowed differently.
“Also, what happened? There was an explosion…”
“Ah. I got into it with Scorpio.”
“What?!”
At the same time, a worried voice came from Lee Gun’s shadow. It seemed his Constructs, who were hidden in his shadow, had been listening in on the conversation.
[Are you sure it’ll be ok? She is Master’s….]
“Yes. It’s fine. She won’t die just from that. Moreover, she seems to have an ulterior motive, too.”
Thanks to that, he was able to receive a Divine status from her and he had tested it out on her. He wanted to see if it became the Divine item of Death or the Divine item of Cycle. If he had tested it out at home, there would have been an explosion there too.
[Scorpio Saint might become angry with you.]
Lee Gun bit his tongue as he looked at Hailey, who had been waiting for him outside.
‘I already told her about it beforehand, but did I overdo it?’
However, Hailey wasn’t angry at all. Unexpectedly, she was laughing as if she had expected this. “She didn’t listen to me no matter what I said.”
It seemed she had known what Scorpio would request from Lee Gun. As soon as she had started opening her mouth, Scorpio kept ordering Lee Gun to kill Hugo.
His Constructs were nervous as they asked a question.
[Are you ok despite hearing all of that?]
[Are you sure about not killing Eternal Change and letting him be…]
“He won’t cause harm to humanity, and he won’t betray us. It doesn’t matter for now.”
[Are you sure about this?]
The Chun siblings had no idea who the Constructs were talking about. They tilted their heads in puzzlement.
Lee Gun spoke in a low voice so that the Chun siblings couldn’t hear it. “He might not look like it, but he’s a hero who protected humanity up to this point. There is no way he’ll betray humanity—”
Lee Gun had been surveying his surroundings when his eyebrows rose. “Where is Taeksoo?”
“I don’t know. He went outside. It seemed urgent.”
Heiji pouted as she looked between Hailey and Lee Gun.
[Masterrrr!! This is bad!]
“What is it now?”
He wondered what they had seen.
A desperate voice rang out from Lee Gun’s shadow.
[Pushover!! Pushover is having a secret rendezvous outside!!!]
“Secret rendezvous? He has Miss Jiwoo. I’m sure it’s one of my fans.”
[That isn’t what I meant! He betrayed us! He is meeting…!!]
When an unexpected name was mentioned, murderous intent emanated from Lee Gun’s eyes. He had gone out of his way to shield Hugo, so what was this?

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - Thank you (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 407 - Thank you (3)
Lee Gun had gone out of his way to shield him, so what was this?
‘Monarchs?’
How dare Hugo have a secret rendezvous with such beings?
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed, and his Constructs flinched and trembled.
[M…Master?]
The Constructs didn’t even get the chance to stop him as Lee Gun flew into the air. Lee Gun headed forward, looking like he wanted to beat Hugo to death.
‘Is it Wind? Is he cheating on us with Wind?’
Lee Gun had even destroyed the holy ground of the Scorpio temple to shield Hugo, yet he was turning his efforts into nothing? Lee Gun’s pride had been hurt. He ran full tilt, getting ready to activate Death’s Instinct.
It was unclear how much time had passed.
“!”
Lee Gun passed through the cave road to exit the Scorpio temple’s holy ground, and his eyes turned round. He saw a scattering of ice caps and a clear lake between the mountains.
The sight of the enormous Rocky mountains stretched out in front of him. Scorpio had hidden her base in the Canadian Rocky Mountains. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘That bastard…’
He saw the ant-sized figure of Hugo near the lake. A familiar monarch was facing Hugo alongside others.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose.
‘The ones next to her are…’
[The second-generation monarchs.]
[They are the Wind’s family.]
Murderous intent emanated from Lee Gun’s eyes.
‘Are they here to ally themselves with Eternal Change?’
Was his idiot friend trying to accept their offer? It seemed his assumptions weren’t wrong.
[Pushover is secretly making a deal with the monarchs.]
[Pushover is using the Serpent Bearer as bait. He is secretly attempting to make a contract with them.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he heard the notification. Was Hugo planning on selling information on his friend after having regained his memories?
Was he trying to sell information to his enemies? Was it like Eternal Change selling information to Sagittarius and the enemies of the Creators in the past?
Lee Gun wouldn’t let this stand. He leaped into the air.
Oblivious to this, the angry Hugo faced off against the whale Abyss. “If you guys pretend to have not seen Gun right now, I’ll set you guys up at a later date with Gun!!”
[I don’t need it. Get the hell out of my way. I can’t attack you because Wind will make a fuss.]
“I’ll fix up a meeting between you and Gun!! If you wait a little, you can spend a hot night with him— Poo-hahk!!!!”
A flying kick landed on Hugo, sending him flying. He had been kicked with the power of Death’s Instinct. He flew violently through the air before being buried in the ground like a meteor.
Lee Gun ground his teeth. “Have you lost your mind!! You’re trying to sell me?”
“…#$*#$!”
If he hadn’t awakened to the Divine power and the power of a monarch, he would have died. Hugo felt like dying.
The whale Abyss became furious when she caught sight of Lee Gun.
[Serpent Bearer! Traitor! Cheat!]
Abyss floated in the air, letting out murderous intent toward Lee Gun.
[I am here to eat you!! You will no longer be my night snack! I’ll just eat you whole and turn your bones into nutrients!!]
Abyss immediately attacked Lee Gun.
Lee Gun looked annoyed as he dodged the attack. “Damn it! You still haven’t given up? I’ll make sure you’ll be able to eat other gods, so chill out a bit.”
Abyss roared as if she was trying to shut him up.
[You probably couldn’t do it even if you wanted to! Old virgin god! Do you even know how to do it?]
Lee Gun lost control as he yelled, “Shut up! I’m not an old virgin!”
[Don’t lie! You don’t even know how to do XXX!]
“Of course, I know how to do it!”
It seemed she didn’t care at this point. Abyss let out her power.
“!”
Immense power surged forth.
[I’ll make sure you can’t run away! I’ll take you to my territory!]
Accompanying the angry voice, another shadow shot out from the whale’s shadow. The enormous shadow extended toward Lee Gun’s feet. It was the one that had swallowed Osiris.
The other second-generation monarchs, who had followed Abyss, moved to join in on the attack. They thought this was a good opportunity.
Kwah-jeek!!
At that moment, Hugo kicked the second-generation monarchs, surprising them.
[Why did you get in my way, Eternal Change?]
“Why else? I stopped you because you’re my enemy!”
[What? Didn’t you just say we are allies!]
Lee Gun, who was on top of Abyss’s head, became angry.
“…What?”
In the face of Lee Gun’s murderous glare, Hugo desperately glared at the second-generation monarchs. “Hey! Ally? When did I say that?”
[You said it! You wanted the snake god to have children. You are working toward increasing the number of Creators!]
“!!”
Hugo seemed taken aback. He looked back and forth between Lee Gun and the second-generation monarch. “Hey, you shouldn’t say that here! No! Gun! It isn’t like that!!”
[You said the children born from a Creator inevitably become Creators. That’s why you preferred there be two or three instead of one. You said you’ll make them look up to their uncle first, then you will eat them all!]
“Hey!!”
[You said that to make us go back! Why do you change your tune now that the snake god is here?]
Hugo massaged his forehead.
Lee Gun let out a diabolical laugh. “Is that so? You said that?”
“#$&**#!”
[I was wondering why he wanted you to have kids.]
Hugo screamed when he saw the power of Death stage 6 emanate from his friend.
“No! They suddenly appeared out of nowhere, and they were looking for you. I was just trying to make sure they can’t get to you! If Wind invades, the earth will get damaged!”
[Oh Eternal Change!!!]
“If you have any wits, you should head back! I’m trying to persuade and dupe the snake god!”
[Hey!]
When Lee Gun finally brought out the power of Death, Hugo knew it was all over. He extended his hand. He sent the second-generation monarchs somewhere else out of desperation.
What he had used was Wind’s power. Hugo had used the power of Eternal Change, which allowed him to copy any power.
Then he spoke to Lee Gun. “The gods have you in their sight right now. Do you think you can face the monarchs too? That’s why I was trying to buy time! If I pretended to be Eternal Change, they would have believed me.”
Lee Gun snorted as he tied up Abyss using Serpent Eater. “Is that so?”
“Yes! Why would I betray you when I have Jiwoo and the kids?”
“Can you say the same thing after seeing that?”
“…What?”
Hugo screamed when he looked in the direction that Lee Gun pointed out. “Those bastards are…!”
It was as if they had worn fabric over themselves to hide their appearance. Several dozen flying objects let out a grim sound as they cut through the sky.
[Where’s the survivor of the Creators?]
[Find him.]
[We have to get rid of him.]
They were the evil gods, who had been hounding Lee Gun.
“What the hell? Why the hell are they here?”
They weren’t supposed to be able to appear in this place since this was the holy ground of the Scorpio temple.
Hailey and Scorpio knew what Lee Gun was, so they would never let the evil gods enter this place.
“However, it’s a different story with Wind. He was able to enter our house in secret like the wind. It isn’t an impossibility where his power can reach.”
“No!”
“Also, they are close to the Cluders. They are the ones who sold the Primordial god’s power to the monarchs.”
“!”
“Moreover, you’re the brother of Wind. What if Wind sent them to help his brother? He did it while he was sending his subordinates here.”
“This is unfairrrrrrr!!!”
Hugo looked at Lee Gun. He wanted Lee Gun to believe him. However, Lee Gun’s gaze was cold.
‘As expected, do I have to get rid of him?’
Lee Gun was about to raise Heaven’s Punishment as he looked at Hugo. However, he furrowed his brow when he thought about his niece and nephew. “Well, it doesn’t matter.”
“Gun?”
“From the looks of it, you unlocked your abilities as a monarch.”
“Yes?”
“That means you can get rid of the evil gods, who are tied up with Abyss.”
“Wait a moment. What? No way!”
“I’ll give you a chance. If you don’t get rid of all of them, I’ll kill you with my own hands.”
“Wait…!”
Lee Gun kicked Hugo toward the Evil Gods, then ignoring the angry Abyss, he ran away.
* * *
Lee Gun moved quickly. He had left Hugo with them for a reason. Abyss was a troublesome opponent for him.
‘Moreover, the evil gods that showed up there were minions.’
While they were numerous and possessed powerful Divine power, they were merely Construct-rank beings.
However, Lee Gun had felt a more powerful energy in the distance. It was probably the leaders commanding the minions.
‘Are there four of them?’
This was why Lee Gun had moved to get rid of the commanders. In the end, it was the same as killing the gods and the monsters. He just had to cut the head off the snake, and its body would become useless.
‘That’s why I left the underlings to Taeksoo.’
Above all else, there was a reason he wanted to kill the commanders.
- Where are you, my Creator?
Whenever he heard the voice, he couldn’t use his power. It was merely a guess, but he assumed the voice belonged to the high-ranking leader of the evil gods.
‘I have to get rid of someone with such foul interest. I can’t get rid of the gods without doing it.’
He had a weak point that continued to hang over him.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he instantly moved.
At his sudden move, some suspicious shadows became flustered. They had hidden near the town beside the Scorpio temple’s holy ground.
“What the hell! How is he here?!”
They were the gods who had come to monitor Lee Gun.
“What’s going on? We funneled all the evil gods toward him!”
“What happened to all of them?”
Yes, the ones to send the evil gods here were the gods of the Divine world. In the Divine world’s meeting, the gods had decided to get rid of Lee Gun.
They had used the items left behind by Lee Gun in the Divine world and lured the evil gods here using Lee Gun’s scent. Moreover, they also meddled with the barrier of Scorpio temple’s holy ground.
However, these gods were still wary. It was to be expected.
“Are we sure it’s a good idea to do this to one of the Creators? They are invaluable as gods…”
“That’s right. They are heroic gods who created the Divine world. Furthermore, he might be a candidate to become a Great Spirit…”
“Shut up! Great Spirit, my ass! If that’s true, we have to cough up all his Constructs and land!”
The Great Spirits of the eight great forces and the several dozen pillar gods had all come to an agreement. From this point, the snake god of the Serpent Bearer temple would be the main enemy of the gods.
“Evil gods are hunters of the Creators. They are the ones who dug up the Creators’ corpses to sell them to the monarchs.”
“That’s right. If he’s a Creator, he’ll be weak against the evil gods…”
At that moment…
“Ah! Is that how it is?”
“?!”
Lee Gun suddenly appeared behind the gods who were monitoring him. The gods screamed when they saw him.
“Ahhk! You!”
“How dare you pretend to be human in someone else’s land!”
“Shit!”
“That’s odd. The four energy signatures that I felt weren’t you guys.”
Having been discovered, the gods immediately took a step back.
“Hurry! Let’s head back!”
They intended to return to the Divine world.
Kwahng!!!
“Where do you think you are going, bastards?”
A foot surrounded by flame flew toward them, and the gods screamed. The one to appear before them was none other than Chun Sungjae. Chun Sungjae glared at the gods when they dared to run away.
The gods were shocked when they saw him.
“That human has Divine status!”
“!”
Puzzled, Lee Gun looked at Sungjae. “What about Yooha?”
“Ah…! I have no idea why, but Noona said she can’t be near Uncle right now.”
Lee Gun furrowed his eyes at those words.
‘Does it have something to do with the thing in her arm?’
In the past, Giselle had put an evil god in Yooha’s arm to control Hugo. Of course, she was able to keep it in check using the Leo temple’s Rearing skill.
‘It’s probably from the same tribe as the evil gods who showed up here.’
If beings of the same race appeared in this environment, the evil god within Yooha might go berserk. That must be why Yooha wasn’t coming.
This was exacerbated by the fact that evil gods had caused harm to Lee Gun.
“He’s a mere Construct. We can push through these flames and go back…”
Lee Gun laughed sharply. It seemed he had an idea. “Sungjae. Here is your snack.”
“What? Snack? What do you mean— Kuhk!!”
Lee Gun stuffed something into Chun Sungjae’s mouth.
“Koo-huhk!! What is this? Kuhk!”
“It’s fine. Just swallow it.”
“Ooh-ahhhhhk!”
Chun Sungjae kept his tears at bay as he ate what Lee Gun was feeding him. He wondered if it was some kind of pill that would expand his power.
Unexpectedly, the gods reacted in shock.
“That was one of Olympus’s Divine statuses!”
“Ahhk! It’s the Divine status of a pillar god!!”
Soon, Chun Sungjae looked pained. He looked like he was about to throw up.
Lee Gun took matters into his own hands as he kept Chun Sungjae’s mouth shut. Chun Sungjae’s face slowly started to turn purple.
The eyes of the gods flashed when they saw this. They shouted.
“Have you lost your mind? Do you think a human can survive a Divine status of that caliber?”
“Let him spit it out right now!”
“Look! The kid is about to die!”
However, Lee Gun merely smirked. “It doesn’t matter. His sister did it.”
“!!”
“If you succeed, Uncle will grant your wish.”
Flash!
[Your Zodiac Saint has successfully taken in the new Divine status.]
[Your Zodiac Saint has absorbed the Divine status of God of War Ares.]

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - Thank you (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 408 - Thank you (4)
A no-name, low-rank god possessing the Divine status of a high-rank god was almost unprecedented. Even if such a Divine status were to be transferred to them, their bodies would be incapable of withstanding the powerful Divine status. In the end, they would explode.
‘That makes it all the more dangerous for a human.’
Of course, many human heroes in the colonies had amassed Achievements, and they were able to acquire Divine status. However, they were all low-rank gods!
‘There is no way he can withstand a pillar-rank god’s Divine status!’
Of course, it was obvious why the snake god had fed his Construct this Divine status.
‘Constructs are the main source of a Zodiac’s power!’
'The power generated by Ares’s Divine status can almost rival the power of the fighting-type gods!’
A single Construct would be worth several thousand gods.
Everyone ground their teeth when they saw the light. They were here to prevent the snake god’s power and influence from growing.
‘If he becomes the ninth great force, it’ll be troublesome.’
Despite their worries, they laughed as if they didn’t mind this development.
“It doesn't matter. The problem comes after he swallows the Divine status.”
“!”
All Divine statuses had innate power and properties. Moreover, Ares’s Divine status was vicious.
The advantage was that one would acquire high battle capabilities. However, it contained innate traits of madness and savagery. This was why anyone who had this Divine status transferred to them found their personality changing.
They couldn’t win against their self-destructive tendencies. They either destroyed their surroundings or caused self-harm.
The previous Ares used to possess a calm disposition, yet when Ares’s Divine status was transferred to him, his personality had become tyrannical.
“During the previous transfer, didn’t Ares kill dozens of gods?”
Well, the same thing always happened when a pillar-rank god’s Divine status was transferred.
This was why they clicked their tongue.
“This is the fault of the Zodiac for being greedy. The Divine status won’t be able to stay within the body. It’ll come back out. Get ready to retrieve it. It’s a Divine status of the god of war.”
“Yes. That poor bastard won’t be able to endure this and will die—”
At that moment…
“Ooh-ohhhhhh!! Wishhhhhhhhh!!!!”
“!?”
Chun Sungjae roared as fierce flames erupted from his body.
[The Zodiac Saint has completely absorbed the god of war’s Divine status.]
[New abilities have been granted to the Zodiac Saint.]
[The innate attributes of the Zodiac Saint have combined with the god of war’s power.]
[The Zodiac Saint’s body and technical skills have improved.]
During his stay in Eden’s colony, Sungjae had grown much taller and had built up his body. Still, it was the body of a human.
When he consumed Ares’s Divine status, his speed, power, and battle skill all increased. His fighting abilities and his body were strengthened. It was basically another awakening!
An enormous-sized fire explosion occurred. Chun Sungjae jumped out from the flames, his arms and legs on fire.
“!!”
He sent kicks toward the gods.
Kwahng!!
The enemies were sent flying alongside the powerful flames. They glared at him.
“Bastard…! It really is the god of war’s power…!!”
Chun Sungjae was a long-ranged, magician-type fighter who relied on his knowledge. Now that his physical abilities had increased through Ares’s Divine status, he was optimized to become a close-ranged magician!
[Attachment Increase]
“Wishhhhhhhh!!!”
After putting a buff spell on his body, Chun Sungjae blasted the heads of the gods with his knee.
Kwahng!!
Three straight balls of fire were sent toward the fallen gods to make sure they didn’t get back up.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
The gods gnashed their teeth, and Lee Gun let out a leisurely laugh. These gods had invaded the earth.
‘If we want to attack and defend against the gods, we need Divine statuses. It is a must.’
Anyone with a human body couldn’t contend with the gods.
‘For Yooha, Virgo worked to fine-tune her in various ways.’
Despite her being qualified to possess it, what she had taken was the Divine status of a pillar-rank god.
Therefore, Virgo had helped optimize Yooha’s body for the Divine status of Athena. She had given the young girl various pointers and guidance on how to carry herself with her abilities and position. In other words, Virgo had been a detailed-oriented coach.
‘Detailed-oriented guidance is not needed.’
Things like modification were unnecessary. The ability to smash everything was the only thing needed. He knew he shouldn’t release the Divine status in this fashion, but…
‘He just has to avoid dying. That is all that matters.’
Lee Gun laughed as he pumped the power of Life into Sungjae. In front of the power of Life, dying or becoming a cripple was impossible.
Chun Sungjae possessed the fighting-type Divine status and razed his surroundings into the ground.
The gods ground their teeth as they shouted.
“Call for the evil gods!”
Soon, they took out a shining object. Due to the shine, it was impossible to tell what the object was.
On the other hand, Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. It was unexpected. “Those are my clothes….”
His outfit from the earth had been eye-catching, so he had taken off his clothes inside Sagittarius’s palace.
[Clothes discarded by the Serpent Bearer (SS)]
- All items brushed up against a god are infused with the power of the god.
- It contains the power of Life
- 5% Stamina Recovery per minute
- Defense increase (SS)
They seemed to be using those clothes as bait to lure in the evil gods. Those clothes smelled like him, meaning that the energy of the Creator was left behind in them. They were the ideal bait. And there was only one reason they could possess his clothes.
‘Did the Divine world finally catch Sagittarius?’
The gods lifted one of Lee Gun’s clothes high into the air.
“Oh, hunters. One of the Creators, who you like the most, is here—”
Before they could finish…
“?!”
The item was gone.
“What the hell? Where did it go?”
“Uncle’s hat is mine!!!!”
“…!!”
Chun Sungjae had somehow stolen the item, and he glared at the gods.
Lee Gun was taken aback. “That was a hat?” Even he had no idea which item it was.
The gods were flustered.
‘Damn it! It has to be the god of war’s Divine status.’
The speed at which Chun Sungjae had snatched it away was too fast. However, they soon shrugged it off as they held up a different article of clothing.
“Oh, evil gods—”
“Uncle’s t-shirt is mine!!!”
“Evil gods—”
“Uncle’s jacket is mine!!”
“Evil—”
“Uncle’s pants are mine!!!”
“Ev—”
“Uncle’s underwear is m— Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun had enough. He kicked Chun Sungjae. “Those are all mine.”
Then Lee Gun glared at the gods.
The gods furrowed their brows as Chun Sungjae had stolen all the items they needed to call forth the evil gods.
They gazed toward their shadows with fierce looks in their eyes. They planned on calling for their Constructs.
“Go bring the evil gods that we lured earlier!”
“There are several dozen of them near the lake!”
This was the perfect opportunity for the evil gods to make Lee Gun completely powerless! However, the Constructs sounded like they were in a tough spot.
[We kept calling for them earlier, yet they aren’t coming!]
The gods, who had been ordered by their Great Spirits to come here in the guise of humans, shook.
‘Why aren’t they coming?’
They tried to check what was going on, but they soon caught sight of Lee Gun’s red eyes.
Lee Gun was smirking, and Chun Sungjae appeared in front of him.
The gods retreated when they saw this.
“If you plan on staying in our territory, you have to pay taxes first!”
Chun Sungjae’s fist was already in front of their eyes.
* * *
“That’s nuts…!”
At that moment, the Constructs cursed when they saw their comrades fall in real-time.
“It’s the Divine status of the god of war!”
“What is that crazy snake god trying to do right now?”
They had already fled when they saw what had happened. It had left them dumbfounded. They had never seen anyone activate a Divine status so violently. No, the problem was what came before.
‘A human was able to withstand the Divine status of a pillar rank god?’
One of the gods spoke up.
“It isn’t unprecedented. Athena’s Divine status was taken by a human girl too.”
“…!”
Of course, he had heard about it. The angels residing on the earth had been defeated by someone possessing Athena’s Divine status.
“It’s possible if the Zodiac puts in laborious work. The Zodiac has to manage the process to the minutiae to protect the subject.”
However, they had just witnessed it right now.
‘There was no finesse in protecting the human! The snake god just shoved the Divine status into his mouth!’
There was no special process. Lee Gun merely kept pouring a massive amount of Life’s power into the human.
It also meant that the human already possessed the power needed to withstand the Divine status. Where else could such power have come from?
‘A Construct’s power is the power of its master!’
‘Since the master is strong, his constructs were able to withstand the process.’
If the master was weak, the Constructs were relatively weak too.
They gulped since they knew this.
“The one to take in Athena’s Divine status was one of the Serpent Bearer’s Zodiac Saints?”
“Yes. However, I heard Virgo was the one that put it in her…!”
They had assumed Chun Yooha was able to receive Athena’s Divine status because someone of Virgo’s stature had given it to her. However, that might not be the case.
At this point, their expression had turned grim.
“If we can’t use the evil gods, this puts a wrench into the plan of the Great Spirits.”
The Great Spirits wanted to avoid fighting directly with Lee Gun. Anyone who did that suffered a great loss.
This was why they were trying to use the evil gods, who had appeared after catching the scent of a Creator. All the pillar gods had planned on mobilizing when Lee Gun would get weakened.
However, the evil gods that they had lured out weren't enough to catch Lee Gun.
“We have to use the five great calamities.”
“Do we have to go that far?”
The five great calamities were the leaders of the evil gods. In the past, they had been close associates of the Primordial god.
They had always been powerful gods, yet they had chosen to assassinate the Primordial god, then sold his power to the Cluders. They were traitors.
“Their appearance is proof that they have fallen.”
When gods broke the rules to fall from grace, their outer appearance turned hideous. They looked like evil gods.
Anyway, that wasn’t important right now.
“The five great calamities were able to kill the Primordial God. The snake god won’t be able to do anything in front of them.”
“Shall I go locate them? After their jailbreak, the fighting-type gods continued to track them. It shouldn’t take long…”
“No.”
The gods smiled as they looked somewhere.
“One is already very close.”
They disappeared in a flash, arriving in front of someone. It was Chun Yooha.
* * *
Inside the holy ground of the Scorpio temple, Chun Yooha was a nervous wreck as she paced around the same place.
‘Uncle will be fine.’
She wanted to go to Lee Gun, but she had locked herself in the holy ground when she heard that the evil gods had appeared. The reason was what Virgo had said when Yooha had received Athena’s Divine status.
- In the past, Giselle planted an evil god in your arm. It’s an evil god called one of the five great calamities.
- Five great calamities?
- They are the ones who killed the king of the gods. Moreover, they committed a taboo of selling the power to the Cluders. They might have been close associates of the Primordial god at one time, but they are now the most wanted.
-!
- Also, the corpses of the Creators had been sold to the monarchs. They were known as the villains of the universe.
- Aside from the Pantheon, gods are scattered all over the place. Most of them are unable to enter the Pantheon, and they are considered uncouth. There are a sizable number of them.
- Then….
- Also, the Creators are the ones who made the Divine world, and they are the only gods that can repair the treasures of the Divine world. Their worth is sky high. They are valuable enough that their corpses are excavated.
- !
Anyway, they were the villains who had sold the powers of the Primordial god at an expensive price. There was no way they would leave a valuable Creator alone.
The problem Yooha faced was that one of the leaders of those villains was inside her arm.
‘I’m able to control it with the skill of the Leo temple for now…’
When she had met her uncle for the first time, the being sealed within her arm had gone berserk. It all made sense now.
‘It happened because Uncle is a Creator.’
Still, she had decided to send Sungjae just in case.
“One of the leaders of the evil gods is here.”
“!”
Suddenly, unfamiliar gods landed in front of Chun Yooha. She furrowed her brows as she took up her spear.
‘Valhalla? No, there are gods wearing clothes that I’ve never seen before.’
Were they one of the other members of the eight great forces?
The unfamiliar gods smirked as they spoke.
“The power keeping the evil god sealed in your arm… Is it Leo? Is it the power of Narasimha?”
“I heard Time stole one that had been sealed. I never expected it to be within that girl…”
Chun Yooha didn’t even bother hearing them out. She attacked. It was obvious why they had come looking for her.
[Come out, sealed leader of the evil gods. There is a prey nearby that you will like. A Creator is there.]
They chanted, making Chun Yooha’s arm flash. They planned on breaking the seal of Leo to bring out the evil god.
[Come out.]
Doo-doo-doo-doohk!!
Chun Yooha gnashed her teeth as she stabbed her spear toward the gods. The attack ruthlessly pierced through their necks.
Poo-hahk!!!
The gods bit their lips. There was a reason she possessed the Divine status of Athena.
‘She is strong.’
However, chaotic energy emanated from her arm, and something popped out. The shock caused Yooha pain. She flinched, and her spear missed.
The gods smirked in greeting as they looked toward the roaring shadowy figure.
“You have come out, one of the leaders of the evil gods.”
“With this, we won’t even have to lift a finger to get rid of Lee Gun—”
At that moment, the surging power suddenly attacked the gods.
“!!”
They wondered what was going on, but their eyes widened when they saw the shadowy figure.
“Isn’t that the snake god?”
Lee Gun had appeared from the rising fog.
‘Is it a trap?’
When their gaze was stolen…
Kwah-jeek!!
Someone grabbed their heads.
“I knew you guys would do that.”
It was Yooha, but her eyes were red.

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - Thank you (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 409 - Thank you (5)
“I knew you guys would do that.”
It was Yooha, but her eyes were red.
The gods flinched when they met her gaze, seeing the change in her originally brown eyes. This vivid red color was rare in the Divine world and was considered an ominous color.
This was why they immediately realized her true identity.
“You are… the snake god!”
“Did that bastard use Zodiac Descent…!”
Zodiac Descent was a Zodiac Saint’s greatest technique where a Zodiac possessed the Zodiac Saint!
At that moment, Lee Gun let out a savage laugh. He grabbed their heads as if he was about to crush them. “Did you guys think I wouldn’t know you would be coming for Yooha?”
“…!”
“It was obvious once you lured the evil gods here.”
Lee Gun had long known that something bad had been planted within Yooha’s arm. Although Hugo had never shown it, it was something Hugo had always been worried about.
‘If we don’t take it out, it’ll progressively threaten Yooha’s life.’
Yooha was keeping the evil god under control, but her life force was stolen whenever it went berserk.
But as they had yet to find a way to extract it, the evil god remained sealed. With the power of Death, one would normally be able to kill an unruly evil god.
This was why Lee Gun had chosen Yooha as the Zodiac Saint of Death.
‘The best outcome would be to extract it right now, but there is no way to do that.’
So what was this?
“You guys know how to extract the evil god?”
“…!!”
After hearing the story about Chun Sungjae, Lee Gun had become certain. If one of the leaders of the evil gods had been planted in Yooha’s arms, the gods would try to extract it. They would use it to attack him.
This was why he devised a plan where a signal would be sent to him if the gods tried to take out the evil god. Then he used Zodiac Descent.
“Thanks to you guys, I didn’t even need to say anything. I found out how to take it out.”
“…!”
“You’re going to extract it using the item in your pocket, right?”
The gods flinched when they felt Lee Gun’s gaze. They tried to run away. However, Lee Gun, who had descended into the body of Yooha, sent his fist flying toward the faces of his enemies.
Bbah-gahk!!
“Kuh-huhk!”
One of the other gods sent a long-range attack toward Lee Gun, but Lee Gun dodged them as if it were nothing.
Kwahng!
However, the attack made a rip in the armor that he had made for Yooha, which was styled to look like an everyday shirt. It caused Lee Gun’s eyes to flash.
[Kill Resistance (SS)]
- Death only skill
He rushed toward his enemy. Since he was in his Zodiac Descent state, he couldn’t use Death’s Instinct, but it didn’t matter. Even without Death’s Instinct, he appeared before his enemy in the blink of an eye. He lashed out with a kick!
Kwahng!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Screams rang in the distance as he sent his enemy flying.
Lee Gun smirked when he looked at them. “What the hell? There were two more of you? It seems I missed you guys since this isn’t my body.”
Her long black hair was hanging loose as she laughed. She was eerily beautiful, yet the gods were stricken with fear.
When the hidden gods tried to move, Lee Gun called for the spear that he had just dropped. “My baby!”
Since he had placed a seal on it, Crimson Earth’s Judgment flew straight toward him.
Shoohk!
After regaining his spear, Lee Gun immediately stabbed his enemy in the heart.
Poo-hahk!!
While he was extracting the spear, the other gods used the fallen god as bait and ran away. But it was useless.
‘!’
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he put power into his muscles and threw the spear toward his enemies.
Pah-ahng!
The spear didn’t falter at all as it flew in a straight line. With a roar, it split the sky. The green ray of light pierced through the enemies who had been running away.
Poo-hahk!!
It was like watching a master archer. The aim was perfect.
Having their hearts pierced, the gods fell to the ground.
Lee Gun was impressed. He had moved on reflex like normal, and the distance had been significant.
‘Oh wow! It was a strike once again.’
As expected of Hugo’s daughter, Yooha’s body was much more accurate than his.
Of course, there was no way Lee Gun would have lost his enemies if he were in his original body. However, he would have hit the body, legs, or some other body part instead of the heart. That wasn’t all.
‘She has great reflexes, and she’s more flexible than me.’
Was it because of the bad habit he had picked up during the days when his body was damaged? Instead of dodging attacks in a fight, Lee Gun smashed through attacks. His style was to charge forward.
However, in this form, dodging the attacks was possible.
He did it despite not using Death’s Instinct. Yooha’s movement allowed him to break through the gods when they encircled him.
‘I could learn a lot from this. It’ll be handy.’
Also…
‘She must have worked very hard.’
He decided to compliment her later on.
Lee Gun recovered an item from the fallen enemies.
[Qian that can unravel all seals (SSS)]
- One of the eight Bagua (Treasure of the Divine World)
- It can unravel any seal
- Current Owner: Great Spirit of Kunlun (Fuxi)
It seemed they had planned on releasing the seal of the evil god using this. At that moment, Lee Gun felt the presence of a powerful god behind him.
“!”
He quickly turned his head and heard a familiar voice.
[Don’t mess with me, Snake god.]
“!”
A figure made out of light appeared alongside the voice. It seemed one of the gods that he defeated had a special talent for playing dead.
[Master of Light (Baldur)]
- Belongs to Valhalla
It seemed he had been wearing the outer shell of a human. Now, he displayed a Divine power that couldn’t be compared to before.
[You must think you are worthy to be a Great Spirit because your ranking is a bit high.]
Baldur furrowed his brow. If this bastard could grow his faction, they might be in danger of losing the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple that they possessed.
Thousands of such Constructs were inside Valhalla’s prison, being used as nutrients, which was useful for Valhalla.
[Give up on your rights as a Zodiac. Come under Valhalla, and I will spare you.]
Lee Gun smirked. “A beating is the answer to a swindler.”
He couldn’t go head-first into the fight, as his opponent was strong enough to cause great harm to Yooha. At the very least, Lee Gun would summon someone of a similar rank as the enemy. He would let Hercules protect Yooha while he rushed to this location.
However…
[In the name of Valhalla, I release your seal.]
“!”
[I use the authority of Valhalla to get rid of the power of Leo and the Serpent Bearer.]
Those ominous words were accompanied by a burst of light.
Lee Gun groaned. At that moment, a black fog emanated from Chun Yooha’s body.
“Koohk!”
The seal of the evil god had been unraveled.
The master of light smiled when he saw this. Originally, he was supposed to use the treasure of Kunlun, which he had borrowed. He had to release the seal using Qian.
[Master of light’s high-rank permission ticket (Exoneration) has been used.]
[The number of high-rank permission tickets given to Valhalla has decreased to two.]
Permission tickets had different ranks, and the lowest one was the normal permission ticket. The gods normally used it to avoid karmic debt. It was the one that Lee Gun had used up until now.
However, the high-rank permission ticket was a step above. It wasn’t a personal item. It was an item given to each faction. It erased a much bigger Karmic debt. That wasn’t all. It allowed one to use a special privilege of enormous magnitude through the power of the Divine world.
Erasing the power of Leo and the Serpent Bearer with that ticket was possible.
‘It cuts to the bone to use a high-rank permission ticket for this.’
The Great Spirit of Valhalla had allowed its use. Baldur had been instructed to kill the snake god even if he had to use their force’s permission ticket.
Flash!
As soon as the power of the Zodiacs keeping the seal in check disappeared, an evil god surged out of Yooha’s arm.
The evil god looked straight at Lee Gun. His was blackened to a crisp, and his face was also hideous.
[I’m finally free.]
Lee Gun narrowed his eyes when he saw the menacing gaze. When he had met Yooha for the first time, this evil god had become obsessed with him. They had barely been able to keep it at bay.
He seemed to have no choice. Lee Gun tried to use Death while he was possessing Yooha.
Baldur smiled at this. Lee Gun wasn’t born when the evil gods had been active. This was why he had never seen their power with his own eyes.
[The foundation of Cycle is Life and Death. It’s a power used by the Primordial god. The evil gods were the ones to kill the Primordial god.]
There was no way the power of Death would work on the evil gods.
[I will gladly take the 6-star Achievement that you got for getting rid of Olympus.]
If Valhalla acquired it, becoming the number one force would be a matter of time for them!
Baldur wanted to steal Lee Gun’s Achievement.
Poo-hahk!!!
[…!!!]
The evil god suddenly stabbed Baldur.
[K—Kuh-huhk?]
Baldur looked at the Lee Gun as if to ask what was going on.
[Why?]
Evil gods were sinners who were obsessed with the Creators.
[Do you resent us more than him?]
The evil god let out a menacing laugh.
[No? I have no grudge against you guys.]
[!]
[However, you should never touch what is mine.]
The violent power destroyed Baldur in an instant. He disappeared, leaving behind his Divine status.
A high-rank god of Valhalla instantly ceased to exist. It was done by the hands of an evil god.
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he saw this unexpected development. On the other hand, the evil god merely smirked as he looked at Lee Gun.
[Finally, I get to see you with my own eyes.]
The evil god fiercely approached Lee Gun. The evil gods were able to kill the Primordial god for a reason. They possessed incredibly powerful Divine power.
‘At the very least, he is on the Great-Spirit rank.’
As if to prove his fallen status, he possessed an unsightly exterior, and his menacing Divine power indiscriminately swallowed everything around him.
It seemed he wanted to say something to Lee Gun.
[I have words for you—]
Kwahng!!!
However, Lee Gun didn’t even bother hearing him out. He immediately opened and placed the evil god into the pond.
[#$(*((#$(!!]
An angry voice came from the pond, but Lee Gun ignored him. The evil god seemed to want to say something, but it was none of Lee Gun’s business.
‘If you aren’t going to attack first, I’ll take advantage of it.’
Lee Gun was able to extract the evil god, which had worried Hugo, and he was successful in kidnapping it. Of course, something was off about this.
‘That’s odd.’
The evil god was supposed to be obsessed with him. Lee Gun had expected it to attack to kill him as soon as his seal was broken.
‘Is it like Abyss??’
Or was there a different reason? It didn’t matter in the end.
‘I’ve been possessing her for too long.’
Zodiac Descent was useful, but it caused undue stress to the body of the Zodiac Saint.
In the past, Sungjae had managed to call Lee Gun, but it was more of a summons than a possession of his body. In fact, this was Lee Gun’s first time possessing someone like this.
This was why Lee Gun quickly called for Yooha’s consciousness. “Yooha? Are you ok? Shall I release the Zodiac Descent right now?”
[*Pant, pant.* Zodiac Saint is really liking it.]
[*Pant, pant, pant.* Zodiac Saint is really liking it.]
[Zodiac Saint says you should stay longer.]
[Uncle fighting looks too good.]
[She asks where her brother is. She wants him to take some pictures of you fighting.]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose.
‘Really?’
Thankfully, she seemed to be ok.
Lee Gun immediately summoned his own body. He had engraved a seal on his body so that he could summon it.
As soon as Lee Gun released Zodiac Descent, Yooha despaired as she lay prostrate on the ground. “Why…Why…! You could have stayed a little longer…!!!”
“Be quiet, you little rascal.”
After capturing the evil god, Lee Gun was about to head toward the holy ground of the Scorpio temple.
[Master!! This is bad!]
Since he had been using Zodiac Descent, he had been unable to hear the voices of his Constructs. He heard it now. They were the ones inside the Scorpio’s holy ground.
[Master!]
“What? What’s going on?”
[Ah! We finally made a connection with you! Evil gods are over here, looking for you, Master!!!]
“What?”
[They are the leaders of the evil gods. The five great calamities are going mad looking for you, Master! Our power doesn’t work against them!]
Lee Gun was surprised. “Alright. I’ll come right now.”
[No! You can’t come here!!! These bastards are aiming for you, Master!]
[You won’t be able to use your power like that time…!]
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. Was the one that caused him to be immobilized present?
[Anyway, we’ll keep them at bay by teaming up with the Scorpio Saint…]
“No.” Lee Gun looked at the pond. He looked at the evil god that he had kidnapped. “I have a solution.”
His smile was very evil.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - Thank you (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 410 - Thank you (6)
“I have a solution.”
When Lee Gun laughed, his Constructs couldn’t hide their confusion.
[Master! I don’t know what you’re thinking right now, but you shouldn’t do it!]
[That’s right. With all due respect, the five great calamities are your natural enemies!]
[Of course, we have no idea what kind of gods they are since it happened so long ago. But they are legends even to us…]
[They also served the Primordial god. Of course, they know the weaknesses of the Creators.]
[You weren’t able to use your power when they got close! Since Creators are valuable, they probably want to sell you to the outer gods…!]
If the evil gods were able to get a hold of Lee Gun, there was no saying what they would do to him.
[They are shameless enough to sell the corpses to the monarchs!]
They were saying Lee Gun would be better off avoiding the evil gods. However, Lee Gun unexpectedly laughed. “Don’t worry! I’m not going to fight them directly.”
[What?]
Lee Gun narrowed his eyes as he looked at the pond lying at his feet.
[#*#$&*!!]
Did it want to be out of there, or was it complaining about not being able to see inside the pond? The evil god was letting out a barrage of swear words.
‘I have no idea why this one didn’t try to kill me.’
It was the one that had lived for more than a dozen years inside Yooha’s arm. What if it came to share values with her? What if it had become assimilated?
‘That would be a good thing for my side.’
Anyway, Lee Gun had one of the five.
‘Since they are comrades, it might be able to block them.’
Lee Gun quickly moved as he thought about throwing Yooha’s evil god to the wolves.
* * *
The holy ground of the Scorpio temple was a whirlpool of confusion.
[The evil gods broke through Scorpio’s barrier! They came in!]
[What? How were they able to pierce through it?]
The evil gods wore what looked to be hooded cloaks as they moved around like ghosts. They were ransacking the holy ground of the Scorpio temple.
The Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple ground their teeth.
[As expected, they are looking for our master.]
The one to speak was Disinfectant (Iaso). She remained hidden along with the Constructs of the Scorpio temple. They had no other choice because their attacks didn’t work against the evil gods.
However, it didn’t matter.
‘We just have to wait until Hailey and Heiji put up the barrier again.’
That was what they assumed, but Disinfectant (Iaso) had a serious expression on her face as she looked at Yeonwoo.
[Aren’t they the ones from the past, Master from the previous generation?]
“!”
Instead of answering her, Yeonwoo narrowed her eyes.
Iaso was unlike Eeny, Meeny, and Miny, who came from the Gemini temple.
Yeonwoo had been under the Serpent Bearer temple. Of course, she knew whom Iaso was talking about.
Yeonwoo recalled a very old memory.
- They are here again, Master.
Yeonwoo and Junwoo had been baby snakes back then, and they shook when they frequently heard ghost-like sounds from outside. It caused them to seek the arms of their master. Of course, they had not been brother and sister at the time. They had been sisters.
- Master, who are those ghost-like beings??
- They are revenants.
- What?
- They are revenants that should have died, yet they are here for me now. I am the last one standing.
It seemed Aslan also loathed being near the evil gods. He told the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer to never approach them.
Aslan had died several days later.
‘In the end, the evil gods dug up Master’s grave. It was a location that only we knew about.’
Their goal had been Aslan’s corpse. Of course, this was after Space-Time had transformed Aslan’s corpse into Time.
‘I’m sure they are trying to profit from selling a Creator to the monarchs’
The specter-like beings spoke as they searched the Scorpio’s holy ground.
[Find him. He must be here.]
[He was here until a moment ago.]
[We must find him before the gods.]
The Serpent Bearer Constructs shook.
‘They took our previous master, and now they are coming for our current master.’
These evil gods had been punished for handing over the corpses of the precious Creators to the monarchs. They were sentenced and sent straight to hell. However, they had broken out of hell since they didn’t like their punishment.
‘They can’t have Gun. Not him.’
Yeonwoo almost convulsed as she glared at them. She had lost her precious master before, and once was enough.
“We have assessed the situation.”
Hailey and Heiji, who had gone to regenerate the barrier, arrived near them. The Constructs shot to their feet.
[Did you fix the barrier?]
[If you fixed it, we can chase them out…]
For some reason, both of them had odd expressions on their faces.
“No! There were no signs of the barrier being destroyed.”
“Same thing from my side. They didn’t infiltrate using hypnosis.”
Those words caused the faces of the Serpent Bearer Constructs to turn pale.
“Did they bypass the barrier to enter this place?!”
It made no sense. There was no way they wouldn’t cause any reaction to the barrier.
‘So what happened?’
At that moment…
[Are you here, my Creator?]
“…!!!”
The ones in hiding trembled in fear. An enormous giant with a hideous face appeared there, and a chaotic air surged up behind them. They sensed a murderous intent strong enough that it felt like they would die if they turned around.
At the same time, Yeonwoo had a realization.
‘It’s one of the five.’
She was sure of it. Four of the five were here, looking for Lee Gun.
[Where are you hiding, my Creator?]
Their opponent looked oddly angered that the Creator wasn’t here. Its eyes flashed.
Pah-jeek!!
Suddenly, accompanied by a flash of lightning, the evil spirits threatening them disappeared.
Yeonwoo and her party looked up toward the sky in surprise.
“They are…!”
Countless gods were gathered in the sky. Moreover, they weren’t normal Construct-rank gods.
‘Zodiacs!’
From the look of it, they numbered in the hundreds. However, something more dumbfounding was going on.
[Listen to me, Constructs of the Serpent Bearer. The snake god caused chaos in the Divine world, yet we pursued peace. However, he chose to kill Valhalla’s master of light Baldur and the other gods.]
“!”
[From this moment on, the snake god will suffer punitive actions.]
Punitive actions? Heiji and Lee Gun’s Constructs raised their eyebrows as if these gods were speaking nonsense.
“They aren’t worth listening to.”
“We don’t need to call Gun here. We’ll take care of—”
The gods jeered when they heard that.
[Mere residents of a lowly colony dare fight against Zodiacs.]
They looked at Yeonwoo in contempt.
[The previous snake Zodiac may be here, but she’s a mere human now. She’s a resident of the colony.]
“What nonsense!” A light emanated from Yeonwoo’s body.
This power shocked the gods, then something surprising happened.
[Serpent Bearer’s Construct (Ji Yeonwoo) has awakened her Divine status.]
[A new Divine status has been born.]
This power was much stronger compared to that generated when Chun Sungjae had swallowed the Divine status of a pillar-rank god.
The gods couldn’t believe their eyes, and they were at a loss for words.
Kwahng!!
The powerful light swept over them.
* * *
While this was going on, the high-rank gods who had sent the gods to the earth were laughing in the Divine world.
After luring the evil gods there, these high-rank gods had told their fellow gods to monitor the evil gods and see if the evil gods got rid of Lee Gun. Of course, it didn’t matter to them if the gods monitoring Lee Gun died.
“Since the snake god killed the envoy of a Great Spirit, we have a legitimate cause now.”
“Are you sure we should be using the evil gods?”
“Those bastards dared betray the king of the gods. They betrayed the Primordial god.”
“!”
They had caused great stress to the Great Spirits, who had supported the Primordial god. After the Primordial god’s death, the Divine world and the gods would have disappeared if the Great Spirits hadn’t stepped up.
“They are insects that placed great evil on the Great Spirits. They should be thankful that we deign to use them.”
* * *
At this moment, Lee Gun had arrived near Scorpio’s holy ground. He contemptuously laughed as he discovered the gods who had appeared above the Scorpio’s holy ground.
“Those bastards are all Zodiacs, right?”
[Yes…! They are!]
Meeny, who had remained within Lee Gun’s shadow, let out a cold sweat. While Constructs didn’t bother him, Zodiacs were leaders each of who possessed a colony.
One or two might be ok, but what would happen if Zodiacs came in great numbers to a colony owned by a different Zodiac?
“They want to fight right now? They are declaring war on me, right?”
The Constructs gulped.
‘I wonder if the gods of punishment also came down.’
This wasn’t a war. This was a one-sided effort to eradicate the snake god.
“Uncle! I found you!” Chun Sungjae came to Lee Gun after locating him. He was about to report to Lee Gun, but he screamed when he saw Chun Yooha. “Why is Noona’s energy so different from usual?”
“It is because the evil god was extracted from her.”
“What? It came out?! How?!” Sungjae had been worried about his sister’s arm in his own way. He looked elated.
“Uncle took it out when he possessed me using Zodiac Descent.”
“I see. Zodiac Descent— What did you just say?!!” Chun Sungjae’s happiness vanished. He wailed as he clung to Lee Gun. “I’ll give you my body, Uncle! Do it to me too! Zodiac Descent! Hahk! Descent— Kuh-huhk!”
“You have a wish coupon.”
After beating down Chun Sungjae, Lee Gun glared at the gods above them. His party was instantly surrounded.
[You are a mere rookie god who entered the Pantheon. The Divine world came to the conclusion that we will no longer put up with your tyranny.]
[We will get rid of you here, and we will conduct an inheritance of your—]
Lee Gun didn’t bother listening to them as he released the evil god that he had imprisoned in the pond to act as a tank.
Koo-goo-goong!
The evil god came out, emitting a menacing energy. He let out a savage laugh when he saw the gods.
[I know all of you.]
Lee Gun was then about to use the power of Cycle, but…
[Found the Creator.]
[Found him.]
“…!” Lee Gun’s hand froze. His connection to his power was severed as well.
“Uncle?”
The faces of the Chun siblings turned pale when they turned their gaze.
“Behind you, Uncle!”
Lee Gun narrowed his eyes. He didn’t need anyone to point it out. He had a good idea as to who was behind him.
‘Evil gods.’
The ones at Scorpio’s holy ground were the other four of the five great calamities.
‘It is that bastard.’
The one behind him was the biggest of the four. A familiar voice rang near his ears.
[You were here, my Creator?]
“…!”
It was the one that made him unable to use his power. Lee Gun couldn’t move an inch this time, either.
Seeing this, the Zodiacs laughed as if they had been waiting for it.
[I knew they would be helpful.]
The gods tried to use their punitive abilities while Lee Gun was immobilized.
When the Chun siblings saw this, they planned on risking their lives to move Lee Gun.
On the other hand, Lee Gun glared at the evil god that he had released.
‘If you want to be completely freed, you should protect my Zodiac Saints.’
The evil god should earn his keep. However, the freed evil god said something unexpected.
[I don’t really have to do anything]
What did it just say? Lee Gun wondered if he would just have to get rid of all of them as he had expected when…
Flash!
The gods of punishments, who had been coming for Lee Gun, screamed as they were sent flying. It was the doing of the four evil gods, who had surrounded Lee Gun.
This puzzled Lee Gun and the Chun siblings.
‘The evil gods protected Uncle?’
The gods looked taken aback too.
[Those bastards…!]
[Do they not want us to touch their prey?]
After they had sent the Zodiacs flying with their enormous power, the evil gods’ eyes flashed as if to say the Zodiacs shouldn’t lay a hand on Lee Gun.
[Those who follow the fallen Great Spirits.]
[Do not touch our descendent.]
Descendent?
When everyone was shocked by their words, the evil god from Yooha’s arm spoke up.
[The four of us are Creators who protected the Primordial god.]
What the hell did he just say? Suddenly, the mention of “four” bothered Lee Gun. He looked toward the biggest evil god.
‘Who is that then?’
Their words left one left among the five. This evil god had the power to immobilize Lee Gun, and it had endlessly searched for him.
Looking at this evil god was like looking at Oblivion, yet it also felt like looking at a corpse that was close to death, like Hailey’s mother.
However, Lee Gun was soon able to discern its identity.
It attacked the gods of punishment, who had rushed toward Lee Gun.
[I found you. I will not let you be sacrificed to the Great Spirits.]
The enormous power made the gods scream as it melted them.
The gods of punishment shook in fear when they witnessed the attack.
[Primordial god…?!]
[Why are you here…!]
Lee Gun became interested in its unexpected identity.

chapters.title: Chapter 411- What happened? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 411- What happened? (1)
[He’s the Primordial god?]
The gods who had swarmed this location heard the words of the gods of punishment. All of them were shocked. This included Lee Gun, his Constructs, and the gods that had come to get rid of him.
This name had that much weight.
In that silence, someone let out a forced laugh. It was almost like a sigh.
[Did you say the Primordial god?]
[What nonsense are you talking about?!]
The forced laughter turned into anger.
[He was the king of the gods!]
[As it happens, he was murdered by those evil gods…!!]
The Primordial god was the king of the gods and ranked above the Great Spirits. He was also the god whom the Creators served.
He was the one who had ordered the Creators to create the Divine world, the early Divine items, and numerous systems making up the Divine world.
The Primordial god had been tricked by Eternal Change and was weakened. The five great calamities had taken advantage of the situation to kill him.
‘After stealing the power of the Primordial god, those five sold it to the monarchs.’
As proof of their fallen status for killing the Primordial god, their appearances had turned grotesque.
‘This was why we didn’t bother interrogating them and immediately took them into custody.’
‘They were the reason the Divine world almost faltered and the Great Spirits went through so much hardship!’
What if one of those five was the Primordial god? The gods had a mental breakdown.
[Are you kidding me? How can you say such a thing? There is no way an evil god is the Primordial god…!]
[Shut up. There is no way the gods of punishment would make a mistake in identifying someone!]
[...!!]
The gods who had come to strike down Lee Gun let out a cold sweat.
The gods of punishment needed to have the ability to control the power of the gods. This was why they could analyze their opponent’s power. Their assessment of their opponent’s power would never be wrong.
At this point, the gods stood frozen as they murmured amongst themselves.
[That means we… The king of the gods…]
They couldn’t hide their shock.
Moreover, the ones that they had tried to use against Lee Gun were actually on Lee Gun’s side?
[Master! Are you ok?]
