At this moment, Yeonwoo and the Constructs with her came running toward Lee Gun. Yeonwoo had awakened and gotten rid of the gods who had spoken nonsense about punishing Lee Gun.
However, the problem was the evil gods.
[We heard the five evil gods converged upon you, so we rushed here!]
[Are you ok….]
Their eyes turned menacing when they saw the enormous evil god behind Lee Gun.
[As expected, that bastard is here…!]
“Get out of the way, Gun!”
When Yeonwoo’s eyes flashed savagely, Lee Gun stopped them. He held back their power.
“Gun?!”
“Mmm… You won’t have to attack him. I don’t think he is an enemy.”
[Master!!!]
[What are you saying? How can you say something so treacherous?]
“They say he’s the Primordial god.”
[Still!! Even if he is the Primordial god— What?]
[What?]
“What?!”
Everyone’s face turned pale, and they looked back and forth between Lee Gun and the evil god. They were frozen as if he was speaking nonsense.
[Primordial god…!]
[Are you saying the Primordial god is with the beings that harmed him?]
They were surprised, but they soon realized a startling truth.
“Wait a moment. There were five evil gods in the beginning.”
The five great calamities were the leaders of the evil gods, and there had always been five of them. There had been five aides who served the Primordial god. If one of these evil gods was the Primordial god…
“Where is the remaining one?”
Lee Gun laughed when he heard this. “One went over there. She became the Zodiac of the Scorpio temple.”
“!”
He knew it since he had conversed with Scorpio. The Zodiac of the Scorpio temple used to be one of the first Creators.
Of course, Eternal Change’s machination had ensured that she no longer possessed the appearance and power of a Creator.
“Since these Evil gods are all Creators, the remaining seat is filled by him.”
[What? The Evil gods are all Creators?]
The Constructs were shocked, and Yeonwoo had a realization.
‘That is why they were able to pierce through the Scorpio temple’s barrier.’
Scorpio was a Creator. Since the evil gods were of the same tribe as her, the barrier didn’t register them as enemies. That wasn’t all.
‘The reason the evil gods were looking for Master…’
The evil gods had escaped their prison and come looking for Aslan. They were tenacious enough to look for his grave. Was it because they wanted to protect their descendants?
Of course, it didn’t matter right now.
[Wait a moment. If that’s true, the story doesn’t make sense at all.]
[That’s right. If the evil gods are Creators… they sold the corpses of their members to the monarchs…!!]
Logically, it made no sense. It seemed the punitive force had the same thought. They were flustered as a commotion broke out.
[I doubt they would have gone as far as to sell their own… The Karmic debt from such actions would have made sure that they would cease to exist.]
The appearance of the gods with Karmic debt turned hideous. And when there was enough debt to crush the god under it, the god would cease to exist.
This was why the gods had an easy time finding the apostates. Deceiving this system was very hard.
[Then who killed the Primordial god?]
[Was it a false charge?]
The high-rank gods, who came as a punitive force, glared at them.
[False charge! Don’t you dare say such a thing!]
The Great Spirits were the ones who had suppressed and punished the evil gods. This was why these gods knew the seriousness of this situation and were having a hard time speaking their minds.
In the end, they could only say one thing.
[Look at him!]
[Even the Primordial god became corrupt…!]
The other gods, who had joined forces for this task, let out murderous intent.
[Look here now. That makes no sense.]
[The Primordial god is the standard for the gods, and he’s the absolute ruler of the Divine world. If the Primordial god became corrupt, it means we aren’t normal either.]
Silence reigned over the gods. None of them were able to open their mouths, except one.
“So? Are we done here?”
[!]
“I’m the descendant of the evil gods, so they won’t kill me. Do you want to continue this?”
When Lee Gun smiled, the gods, who came as a punitive force, froze. It was to be expected.
First, Lee Gun was able to use Cycle, the power of the Primordial god. Next, the evil gods also possessed enormous power, and one of them might be the Primordial god.
‘Shit! What is this… what is this shit show…!’
The only one relaxed in this situation was Lee Gun. He laughed since he finally figured out what had happened.
‘I couldn’t use my power against him since he is the Primordial god.’
Hadn’t the Primordial god been the master of the Creators? Lee Gun had no idea how it worked, but maybe, something was left in his blood. It was probably a spell that disarmed a Creator if they tried to attack their master.
Of course, such restrictions didn’t last indefinitely.
“Anyway, he’s the king of the gods, right? Are you sure you are allowed to attack him?”
[…!!]
The gods froze.
“Also, your king seems to be more on my side. Of course, I don’t mind if you want to continue this.”
In the end, they could only bite their lips.
“We’ll head back.”
“Ah. You said you were going to punish me, yet you are going to end it here?”
The gods lowered their heads.
[…We are sorry! W…We’ll come at a later date...]
[…We are sorry about invading the territory of a Zodiac without permission!]
The high-rank gods also lowered their heads when they saw the gods of punishment tremble.
Lee Gun’s Constructs were shocked.
‘I can’t believe they apologized.’
The gods didn’t want to make a big mess, so they decided to return to the Divine world. This was too important of a matter to overlook.
Lee Gun laughed as if that was all he wanted. “Yes. You made the right choice. Ah! Tell the Great Spirits that I’ll be visiting them soon.”
[Alright. We’ll go right now and deliver your words to the elders…]
“What?”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
“You guys better plant it.”
[Plant what?]
“Head.”
Lee Gun’s Death Instinct was released.
* * *
“What did you just say right now?”
“Primordial god?”
Everyone in the Divine world felt faint when they heard unexpected news. They had sent a punitive force to punish Lee Gun and had been waiting for the result. So what the hell was this?
“One of the evil gods was the Primordial god?”
All the factions had moved as one to get rid of the snake god. However, one of the evil gods who had to keep Lee Gun in check was their king! This shocking truth spread rapidly.
As this was happening, the Great Spirit of Kunlun feigned laughter.
[Primordial god? It’s the thing that we planned on using?]
“Yes…! Don’t you think something is off about this? The Great Spirits were the ones who stated that the Primordial god died to the evil gods…”
The Construct nervously looked at its owner. The Great Spirit of Kunlun had tried to make Lee Gun his bride, and his appearance had turned into something weird when he was suddenly dealt a severe blow.
Of course, he had only now been able to regain a little of his original appearance. He smirked.
[Those bastards did something.]
“What? When you say they did something…”
[Among the current Great Spirits, only four remember what happened with the Primordial god.]
“You are correct. They are the Great Spirits of… Ennead, Valhalla, Eden, and Mahabharata.”
Only these four Great Spirits hadn’t inherited their power. They had been here from the beginning.
The other four seats had been passed once or twice, at the very least. At most, one of the seats had been inherited over ten times.
It meant that these four were the only ones who knew the truth about the assassination of the Primordial god.
Soon, the Constructs surveyed their surroundings.
“We must be cautious about this… If those five were falsely charged…”
[No. We can’t be rash in coming to that conclusion.]
If the Great Spirits had falsely charged the Evil Gods and they were the ones to assassinate the Primordial god, there would have been signs.
‘Their appearance would have changed because of the Karmic debt.’
At the time, they had arrested the Evil gods because the evil gods’ appearance had changed.
[I have no idea what happened, but my predecessor must have done something with them.]
“W-What should we do?”
[We suspend our attack on the snake god.]
“What? Are you sure about this?!”
The Great Spirit of Kunlun put on a savage smile.
[I have a conviction that the enemy is the other side.]
Spreading like wildfire, the news finally reached the ears of the Great Spirit of Valhalla. Of course, the Great Spirit of Valhalla looked very uncomfortable.
[You are saying that one of the evil gods was the Primordial god.]
“Yes. From what we confirmed, the Zodiac of the Scorpio temple seems to be a Creator…”
The palace’s pillar immediately exploded.
Kwahng!!!
The God of thunder, who had come to give the report, closed his eyes shut. Then he continued, “It seems Eternal Change was responsible for it. One of the five was turned into a monster. It was why no one noticed her.”
The Great Spirit of Valhalla laughed in contempt. He had wondered why they were unable to realize that the Primordial god was amongst them.
[Since the number matched, it had gone unnoticed.]
At the time, the Primordial god had been nowhere to be seen, but five evil gods were left. Of course, they had assumed that the Primordial god had died, and those five were the five evil gods.
‘At the time, we were satisfied that the Primordial god was gone.’
[That bastard Eternal Change did this rubbish….]
He had made sure the Creators couldn’t use their Divine status. It made the Great Spirits miss what had happened.
[He always worked toward his amusement. That was all that mattered to him.]
The reason Eternal Change had invaded the Divine world on his own had been baffling.
“He had heard a rumor about the Primordial god’s appearance, so he broke into the Primordial god’s bedroom.”
[…]
“He probably turned Scorpio into a monster for his amusement.”
The Great Spirit’s raven had a thought as it heard the conversation.
‘Was it really a coincidence that Eternal Change turned Scorpio into a monster?’
Soon, the Great Spirit of Valhalla sighed.
[It doesn’t matter]
“Great Spirit?”
[Since the Primordial god has made an appearance, we should bring him here.]
“…!”
[He is our king. Be respectful when you are bringing him.]
An odd expression appeared on the face of the Zodiac who had been giving the report.
[What’s wrong?]
“We tried to bring him… But the snake god…”
The Great Spirit’s eyebrows rose when he heard the next part. What the hell?

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - What happened? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 412 - What happened? (2)
The Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple were stunned because of the sight before them.
“Plant your heads on the ground. Repeat after me. I.”
[…I!]
“Greatly.”
[G-Greatly…!]
“Sinned against.”
[Sinned against!!]
“Lee Gun-nim.”
[Lee Gun-nim!!!]
“Your voices are too low, bastards! Who told you to lower your butts!!”
[I…I’m sorry!!]
“Again!!”
Lee Gun was making the gods who had come to punish him plant their heads on the ground with their hands behind their backs.
The Constructs were sweating bullets because of this.
‘The mighty high-rank Zodiacs of the Pantheon are…’
‘They have their heads planted on the ground….’
The Pantheon was the location where the competition between the gods was the fiercest. It was called the best of the best. These high-rank Zodiacs were the ruling class of the Pantheon, yet…
As if such a humiliating sight wasn’t enough, they were being kicked by Lee Gun.
It caused great discontent among the gods, but they couldn’t call for punitive measures at all in front of the Primordial god.
[We are sorry!! We’ll forget this punitive measure ever happened. Let us return to the Divine world— Kuhk!]
“You better keep the right angle while you plant your head!”
[…koo-oohk!]
The Zodiacs acted as if Lee Gun wouldn’t get away with this as they planted their heads.
‘If only the Primordial god weren't here…!’
‘We wouldn’t have to walk on eggshells…!’
Someone was looking at all of this as if he was appalled.
“I went through the trouble of chasing away the evil gods. What the hell is he doing?” It was Hugo.
When Hugo acted awkwardly around the Primordial god, the Constructs of the Scorpio temple cackled in derision.
[Why are you suddenly acting this way?]
[Did you perhaps recall the memory of you entering the bedroom of the Primordial god— Huhk!!]
Hugo stomped on the monster-looking Constructs of the Scorpio temple with a cold look.
At the same time, he recalled a memory from the past. It was a memory from a very long time ago.
- Oh my! He must be the famous one that turned the Divine world on its head, right?
- Yes. This bastard is Eternal Change. He’s the ruffian who entered the bedroom of the Primordial god. Even now, he was trying to lure and eat a god. We were barely able to catch him.
- Hmmph. He truly was bold in trying to climb the walls of the Primordial god.
- Since we work directly under the Primordial god, the Creators are now in charge of monitoring him. For now, we’ll let him stay with us. We’ll be his guards.
- Why don’t we put him in prison?
- His ability is too strong. All prisons are useless against him. That’s why he was handed over to the Creators.
- My god! The power of the forces directly under the Primordial god doesn’t work against him? That’s incredible. Is he a god?
- No. He’s a gluttonous monster that was born from trash.
Because of that, the Creators had to create a sealing technique, which led to Eternal Change’s soul being imprisoned by the Creators.
Whenever he tried to use his power or run away, the Creators neutralized him. He was the criminal, and they were the guards. This was how he came to live with the Creators.
At the time, Aslan’s father, the then leader of the Creators, had conversed with him.
- Mmm. Eternal Change. Let me ask you this question. Why did you go into the Primordial god’s dwelling? Is it because he’s a peerless beauty? Did you try to have a taste?
- …what?! There’s no way he did something, right?
- It truly was a killer….
- What?!!
- His fist…
- …
Eternal Change had spent a fairly long time with the Creators. Of course, it had all come to an end when he found out the weakness of the Creators.
- The Primordial god has been tricked by Eternal Change and has lost his power!
- Eternal Change has killed the Creators, and he’s on the run!! Catch him!
- To break his seal, he tricked the Creators and the Constructs! He ran away!
Hugo clicked his tongue when he remembered the past. In the end, he had killed the Creators, whom he had lived with, and also turned Scorpio into a monster.
Anyway, it was an old, unpleasant memory. It was also inevitable that the Primordial god would hate him.
‘Why is he here….’
As expected, the four great evil gods were furious when Hugo made his appearance.
[Look who it is. Aren’t you Eternal Change?]
The Chun siblings tilted their heads in puzzlement.
‘Eternal Change?’
The siblings wondered what they were saying when the gods became apoplectic.
[Huh! I had heard a rumor that Eternal Change was staying next to the snake god. That bastard really is…!]
While they still had their heads planted, they looked at Hugo and ground their teeth.
[You are the reason the balance of the Divine world started to shift!]
[If it weren’t for you, the Primordial god wouldn’t have suffered such a fate!]
[Do you realize how much hardship the Primordial god suffered…!]
While he may have become a human, there was no way his rotten nature could be forgotten. They cussed at him.
[You already ate so many gods. At the very least, you should have just stayed out of the way.]
[Will you once again betray and hunt down the Creator that sides with you?]
“Shut up.”
[!]
Hugo’s eyebrows rose in anger. “If you guys want, I’ll get rid of all of you in the same way.” A tyrannical energy pressed down on the gods.
Koo-goong!
It mimicked the magical energy of the Serpent Bearer temple, but it clearly was the mighty power of a monarch!
The gods gnashed their teeth, feeling Hugo’s murderous intent.
‘As expected, he is awakening as a monarch…!’
‘This is dangerous…!!’
At that moment, someone seemed bothered by the menacing power coming out of Hugo.
Kwahng!!
[Scorpio is angry. She has used the power of her holy ground.]
[She slams down on Pushover’s power.]
Was it because he was inside her holy ground?
When Hugo’s power was pushed down, he spoke out in annoyance. “Are you doing this because you are a Creator… You want to die?”
The Gods were frightened by what they saw. They looked at Lee Gun.
[S…Snake god! He’ll go berserk!]
[You have to quickly get rid of him!]
However, the gods fell to the ground when Lee Gun stepped on them. “Didn’t I tell you? Keep your heads planted. Do it correctly.”
[Look here!! That isn’t important right now—]
“I told you to keep it planted! Do you take my words to be nothing?! You filthy scums!!”
[Kuh-hoo-uhhk!!]
Bbah-gahk!!! Bbah-gahk! Bbah-gahk!
In the end, all the gods once again planted their heads on the ground.
Lee Gun clicked his tongue as he shook his leg.
Hugo didn’t want to get beaten by Lee Gun, so he hid his power. “Whatever. Let’s talk about something else."
“!”
Lee Gun looked at the evil gods with a displeased expression.
“Anyway, it doesn’t change the fact that you guys are fallen gods, right?”
The four evil gods looked aggrieved.
[Fallen!]
“What? I’m right. You guys tried to kill the Primordial god.”
[The Great Spirits were the ones to do that to the Primordial god!!]
“What?”
[W…What?!]
The gods, who had their heads planted, could no longer stand by. They reacted in anger.
[Nonsense!! Don’t listen to them, Snake god!! They are telling lies!!]
[The evil gods are trying to mislead you. They want to sell you!]
“!”
They all spoke with a single purpose.
[I might hate you, but in this matter, we are partners. This is why I’m telling you this!]
[Yes! When gods become corrupt, you can tell immediately. Their hideous appearance appeared for a reason!]
[I don’t know what their goal is, but they are trying to trick you! Their appearance is proof! They couldn’t win out against their Karmic debt!]
The evil gods almost spat out their words as they shouted.
[This Karmic debt isn’t ours! It’s the Karmic debt of the Great Spirits!!]
“…!!”
They took a deep breath before continuing.
[Do you get what we are trying to say? The Great Spirits transferred their Karmic debt to us!]
The dumbfounded gods reacted in anger.
[Crazy bastards! That’s not possible!]
[As expected, they are trying to trick you using unfounded slander!]
[Snake god! Do not trust them— Kuh-huhk!!!]
The gods were beaten by Lee Gun once again. “I told you to plant your head properly.”
[No… We spoke on your behalf…]
The gods felt aggrieved.
“It doesn’t matter.”
Lee Gun had a more important matter to deal with. He looked at the giant. “First, I can’t use my powers if you guys stay close to me. I have to release myself from that restriction. There is a way, right?”
The evil gods looked at him as if this question put them in a tough spot.
[The Construct contract has to be released, but…]
“But?”
[The Primordial god is not in his normal state.]
[He’s basically a corpse. Only his unresolved emotions were left behind.]
[In other words, he won’t understand your request if you ask him to dismiss you as his Construct.]
It meant Lee Gun’s wish wouldn’t be granted. While the being that used to be the Primordial god still had powerful abilities, no intelligence was left behind.
Lee Gun unexpectedly started to laugh. “I have a good solution to that problem.”
[What?]
“I can fix the Primordial god’s status, and I can erase all the Karmic debt. It will also release the restriction placed on me. I can reset everything.”
[Are you trying to use the power of Life or Time to revive him?]
[Child. That is impossible.]
[Yes. The difference between the Primordial god and you is too vast. You cannot handle—]
“No, I don’t have to do that. It is a much simpler solution.”
[What is it?]
“Inheritance.”
Silence followed his words.
[What the hell did you say?!!]
“That bastard can kill himself, and he can be reborn. It’ll solve everything. Then he can become my Construct. What do you think? It’ll work, right?”
[#*$&*#!?]
Their descendant had lost his damn mind?!!
The evil gods looked at Lee Gun.
[Do you realize what you are saying right now?]
[He has to die! Moreover, you want to turn him into a Construct!]
[What kind of descendant was born to us?!]
They spoke as if such suggestions were off the table.
[Just the Primordial god’s existence itself can create a Dimension! Just messing with him will cause serious trouble. In fact, we won’t stand by and let something like that happen…]
At that moment…
[Alright.]
[Master?!]
The evil gods couldn’t believe what they had just heard.
[I’ll let the inheritance happen. I will become your Construct.]
What did he just say?!
[Whatever method you like…]
Wait a moment!!
* * *
[You are saying… The Primordial god will go through the inheritance process?]
“Yes… That is correct.”
The gods couldn't speak when they heard the news about Lee Gun.
The Great Spirit of Valhalla scoffed as he stood with his hands behind his back.
[I can’t believe I’m hearing such nonsense. This is crazy.]
“Oh, Great Spirit of Valhalla. What if the snake god really takes possession of the Primordial god’s power…”
[Do you even think such a thing is possible?]
“!”
[It may be a momentary event. However, the loss of the Primordial god means the entire universe will also cease to exist. Also, the ones next to him will never allow such a thing to happen.]
“That’s right. He has enough power to kill all the gods in a dimension and all the residents of the colonies that they possess. It’s a move where one pursues the death of everyone. It’s self-destruction.”
“There is no way they will mess with such a method. It’ll be problematic even if they choose to go through it.”
This was why they weren’t worried about what was going on over there.
In fact, the Great Spirits were currently most angry about the presence of Eternal Change. The only reason they weren’t able to detect the presence of the Primordial god was Eternal Change’s fault.
From the reports they had received, it seemed he was threatening the gods as he stood next to the snake god.
[It means you have to bear the responsibility for everything that has happened.]
“…!”
Sagittarius was tied up on a pillar in a spread eagle position, with numerous gods dead around him.
The Great Spirit looked at him in contempt.
[I can’t believe you thought it was a good idea to pick someone like that as a Zodiac Saint.]
“…no….”
[Well, choosing him was probably part of your Karmic debt.]
“…!”
[You don’t need to pay any attention to the Primordial god. Just take responsibility and go kill Eternal Change. Then bring the snake god here after you make up with him. Do you really think I’ll let someone like him have the Primordial god?]
No, that would cause more trouble.
[Since the Primordial god is hanging around the snake god, that can be postponed to a later time.]
Sagittarius let out a twisted laugh after receiving an order from the Great Spirit.
The Great Spirit of Valhalla was one of the top two figures in the Divine world. All gods got on their knees with their heads lowered when he spoke, no matter who they were.
This was also true of Sagittarius, who was affiliated with Olympus. The true authority of the Divine world was the Great Spirit of Valhalla and the Great Spirit of Ennead.
But what was this order? He had to make a conciliation with the snake god and kill Eternal Change?
“Hmmph. There is no way Gun will listen to your words. He doesn’t even listen to me.”
[It doesn’t matter. If you fail, you’ll just get executed.]
“…!”
[In fact, you can’t avoid an execution since you let the snake god into this world and put the Great Spirit of Kunlun in such a state.]
Sagittarius started to sweat.
[However, your sins will be forgiven if you can get rid of Eternal Change and bring back the snake god.]
“Let me get this straight. The snake god joined hands with the Primordial god, and you want me to face Eternal Change? Why don’t you just kill me right now?”
[If the Primordial god is next to the Creator, it’s to our advantage. The snake god won’t be able to use his power.]
“….”
[I’ll give you power. The snake god cannot use his power next to the Primordial god, and it will be impossible for him to possess the Primordial god. The evil gods next to him will never allow the inheritance of his power.]
The Primordial god had fought tooth and nail to live this long. Why would he choose to end his life?
[Don’t worry about them. Just go and come back after you carry out the tasks.]
The one-eyed god gestured with his hand, making a tattoo of a raven appear on Sagittarius’s neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - What happened? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 413 - What happened? (3)
[I’ll let the inheritance happen. I will become your Construct.]
The evil gods screamed at the unexpected answer.
[No! Master!!!]
[What are you saying?]
[You shouldn’t agree to it right now!]
[Why did he have to regain his senses right at this moment?]
[If you’ve regained your mind, you just have to dismiss him as a Construct…]
The Primordial god’s intention was clear. It didn’t matter what his underlings said.
[I’ll let the inheritance happen. I will become your Construct.]
[You don’t have to repeat yourself!]
[If you’ve regained your mind, you just have to dismiss him as a Construct…]
[Oh no! He hasn’t regained his mind!!]
[Master!!]
Despite showing an iron will up to this point, Hugo was also surprised.
Of course, the Primordial god wasn’t well. It seemed only the minimum amount of his intelligence was left behind.
However, in this context, inheritance meant death in this context for the Primordial god. Despite being in this state, the Primordial god possessed great power, and that great power protected his body.
His defensive instinct wouldn’t accept the inheritance process, and the evil gods wouldn’t stand by either.
‘I knew we would fight them, so I planned on killing the Primordial god for him.’
Hugo was slowly regaining his power. It would be tough, but it wouldn’t be impossible for him to kill the damaged Primordial god.
[Except, it cannot be done through self-destruction.]
[Master?]
The enormous dark giant looked at Lee Gun as he spoke.
[If I die, this dimension will be destroyed.]
The Primordial god was basically the source of everything. He was the king of the gods and, at the same time, the foundation holding up the Divine world. This was why his gender wasn’t fixed either.
Soon, the evil gods spoke.
[That’s right. That is the reason we opposed it.]
[The exact second when the Primordial god’s life ends, all life forms will die. The gods, dimensions, and everything else will turn to null. Do you get what I’m saying?]
[You will kill all the humans of the earth, who you treasure!]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. “Damn it! What do you want me to do? Do you want me to get by without using my power?”
[That’s….!]
“If so, all of you should get the hell out of my face. Never appear in front of me again.”
[No!!! The Great Spirits won’t leave you alone!]
[The Primordial god doesn’t wish that to happen!!]
When the evil gods became angry, Lee Gun wanted to flip the proverbial dining table. “Damn it! So what do you want me to do? Should I just kill all of you?!”
[Ahhk! How dare a child speak such thoughtless words toward his ancestors!!]
[How can you call yourself our descendant!!]
[You are breaking the hearts of your ancestors, you asshole!]
“Who cares! Fuck off! In terms of the age gap, you guys are ancestors older than the age of homo sapiens! Why do you keep saying you are my ancestors?”
[W-What the hell did you just say? You little shit?!]
“Or are you guys Australopithecus? Anyway, you guys are apes!!”
The evil gods couldn't believe it. Lee Gun’s ruthless insults had shocked them.
[D-Damn it! This kid was raised wrong! Someone should educate him on morals and character!!]
[Grandma!!!]
[Teacher!!!]
Lee Gun’s Constructs started sweating when they saw the evil gods at a loss for what to do.
[Are all Creators… Did they always have such personalities?]
‘They are supposed to be a famous group of geniuses…’
‘They are supposed to be an incredibly powerful tribe…’
‘They were the object of our envy… They are…!’
The Creators were gods of techniques. They were non-fighters, yet they were insanely powerful.
There was a reason they had been able to capture Eternal Change.
Despite there being a small number of them, they were comparable in power to the Great Spirits, who ruled over tens of thousands of gods.
Yeonwoo cleared her throat when she saw this.
‘Mmm… Our previous master did have a similar personality.’
Soon, the evil gods spoke.
[Anyway, you cannot kill the Primordial god!]
[It will mess up the order of the Universe…!]
The Primordial God interrupted them.
[You don’t have to do that. You have a system itself that turns others into your Constructs.]
[M-Master?]
Lee Gun tilted his head when he heard the Primordial god’s words. “I have a system that turns others into Constructs?”
[I’m talking about weapons.]
“!”
Lee Gun immediately understood what he meant. Every item he made could be engraved so that it belonged to him. It also established a master-servant relationship as soon as he created the items.
The Primordial god explained.
[You don’t have to kill me. You can transform me into a Divine item. This will effectively act as an inheritance and a master-servant relationship will be established.]
[Master!!]
[Also, you like making weapons.]
Lee Gun laughed as if he had accepted the reasoning behind it. “You are right.”
Since the gods coveted his lands, he had to regain his power. When Lee Gun extended his hand, the Evil gods screamed.
[W-Wait a moment!]
[How dare you treat the Primordial god like scrap metal! Masterrrr!!]
However, they didn’t even have the chance to stop him. Lee Gun immediately used his ability.
[Primordial God will be changed into an item.]
[Primordial God will be changed into the Divine item of Cycle.]
[Primordial God has been reborn as No Name.]
Accompanying a light, the enormous giant changed in shape. It became smaller.
When the light disappeared, an unfamiliar-looking Primordial god fell toward Lee Gun.
[M…Master?]
Then enormous energy soaked into Lee Gun.
Everyone was surprised by the new appearance of the Primordial god, who had fallen toward Lee Gun.
“He is…a child?”
A child with long hair fluttering in the air gently fell into Lee Gun’s arms.
[Inheritance has been completed.]
[The master-servant relationship has been flipped.]
[You have become the owner of the Primordial god.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s power and position have changed.]
* * *
[I never imagined you would look like this.]
After the Primordial god entered the hands of Lee Gun, the four Evil gods conversed with Scorpio.
It had been a very long time since the five comrades were able to meet in one place.
[Anyway, we were worried because you were the only one who suddenly went missing that day.]
[I never expected Eternal Change to turn you into this.]
[Well, the more surprising part was that Eternal Change was reborn as a human…]
Scorpio became enraged at those words.
When her Zodiac Saint had asked for a favor, Scorpio had saved Hugo’s wife. However, once she figured out his identity, she wanted to rip him apart. She had barely held herself back.
[If it weren’t for Aslan’s request…]
[Aslan? That child asked that of you?]
[That’s right.]
After Aslan had found her, Scorpio wanted to go and kill Eternal Change as soon as possible. At the time, Eternal Change had been imprisoned within the Great Spirit’s prison. However…
- I owe my life to Eternal Change.
- What?
- He likes Creators more than anyone I know.
Just the thought of Aslan’s ridiculous words made Scorpio angry even to this day.
[He claims to like Creators, yet he caused their downfall. It still doesn’t make any sense.]
The four evil gods became doubtful.
[I’m not so sure. The one that brought down the Creators was that kid, right?]
[Balan’s son… What was his name? Yes, Galan.]
[He was Aslan’s half-brother.]
They were talking about Sagittarius.
[Anyway, we fell to Galan and those who came with him.]
[Well… It happened after we became like this, so we don’t know the exact details. But…]
The five of them were elders who were supposed to lead the Creators. However, they had been chased out of the Divine world when the Primordial god was assassinated. They were left to be in this state.
[That’s right. The one to kill the Creators wasn’t Eternal Change. It was Galan. While Galan was an excellent student, he had a lot of discontentment toward our tribe.]
[Since we were of the same tribe, he would have known the exact date and time when the Creator’s power was weakened.]
It made Scorpio click her tongue.
[No. Galan is collateral kin. While he was the oldest son, he didn’t know much about the Creators. He was excluded from our work.]
It meant the only one who knew the secrets of the Creators was Eternal Change, who had been by Balan’s side.
[The one to spread the information about the weakness of the Creators was Eternal Change. He’s the one who leaked it to Galan and his group.]
Scorpio ground her teeth.
[He probably killed all the Creators since he wanted to be released from his captivity.]
[!]
Eternal Change had been a prisoner, and the Creators had been his guards. The only reason a being of that caliber was imprisoned was that the guards were the Creators.
‘A restriction was placed on his soul, so his true nature was suppressed, too.’
In other words, the restriction wouldn’t disappear completely until all the Creators were gone. That was the Contract.
[While almost all the Creators were killed that day, Eternal Change was unable to run away.]
Aslan had survived, but he was the only survivor.
[This was why the restriction placed on him was still valid. It allowed him to be placed in the Great Spirit’s prison for killing the Creators.]
The proof was in his actions after Aslan had died.
[When even the last survivor died in Aslan, Eternal Change broke out of the jail like a lunatic. He killed and ate the gods with glee. He even called the other monarchs in.]
With Aslan’s death, the old restriction placed on Eternal Change had been released. After being released, the monarch had called for his comrades, and they had smashed the Divine world. It had been a hellish event.
[It was an absolute slaughter. Of course, it was unexpected that such a strong being was caught so easily.]
Everyone still remembered Eternal Change’s public execution. It was such a big deal that all the gods of the Divine world had gathered to watch it. Scorpio had also watched it from the shadows.
The monarch had shown no signs of remorse as he was dragged away to Mahabharata’s Samsara hell.
- Idiot Creators.
She had heard Eternal Change mutter those insults.
- I will be born once again. When I do, I’ll eat all of you.
Now, events were repeating themselves.
[Since a Creator was born again, the restriction spell activated once again. That’s why he wants to kill the last remaining baby snake so that he can take off that restriction placed on him.]
The evil gods had serious expressions on their faces when they heard Scorpio’s words.
[… Still, he was making a big deal about wanting to see his niece or nephew….]
[What?]
[… He was very active in pushing your Zodiac Saint…]
[Also, the Scorpio Saint is… Wouldn’t it be a problem if she gets together with him?]
[Well, she’s pretty.]
Their remarks angered Scorpio.
[Are you siding with a monarch right now?]
[No!]
Well, it didn’t matter.
Scorpio was about to say something when she flinched.
[What’s wrong?]
When the evil gods asked, Scorpio looked toward the outside.
[Damn bastard!]
[!]
[Galan… No, Sagittarius is here.]
* * *
Sagittarius had appeared within Scorpio’s territory, to get rid of Eternal Change. No, he came to get rid of Hugo.
‘I’ll die if I can’t get rid of him.’
The proof was the symbol of the raven tattooed on his neck. It was a surveillance-type Construct.
‘They are the eyes of Valhalla’s Great Spirit.’
They were Huginn and Muninn, raven gods that accompanied Valhalla’s Great Spirit. They were his eyes and ears, and they were now tailing him.
‘If I fail or I cooperate with the other side, he’ll be notified immediately.’
Then Sagittarius would be immediately executed. This was why he had no choice but to come here. The excuse that he was currently a human hadn’t worked either.
- I’ll take care of that part.
Sagittarius had acquired the power of a god, and he sighed as he looked at Hugo. In truth, he never thought his Zodiac Saint would turn out to be Eternal Change.
‘Why did it have to be him?’
During his days as “Galan,” to take down his father, Sagittarius had attacked the Creators on the day they were weakened.
He had come face to face with Eternal Change as he killed his tribe.
Eternal Change had scoffed when he saw Galan.
- Hmmph. You betrayed your father? Interesting.
- …!
Afterward, he had killed the Creator that had accompanied Eternal Change. Of course, his co-conspirator had said Eternal Change had killed the Creators. This allowed them to summon the Great Spirits, and Eternal Change was captured.
‘That bastard is….’
Sagittarius wasn’t sure what he was going to do about Gun, but he had to get rid of Eternal Change.
‘The Divine world won’t let me be otherwise.’
It was his fault for choosing Eternal Change as his Zodiac Saint. Of course, he didn’t have plans to completely screw over Hugo. Since he couldn’t avoid the gaze of the Great Spirit, he’d visit Mahabharata after killing Hugo. He planned on secretly reincarnating Hugo.
‘This is the only way where everyone will get to live.’
Of course, Gun would be apoplectic if Sagittarius killed and reincarnated Hugo. Gun would try to kill him, but it didn’t matter right now.
‘My nephew can’t use his power because of the Primordial god.’
That was how it was supposed to be….
‘…why is the Primordial god under Gun?!!’
Sagittarius had a mental breakdown when he arrived at the Scorpio temple’s holy ground. He pulled at his hair as he looked at the child in Lee Gun’s arms.
“Why are you here?”
“…!!!”
At that moment, Lee Gun smiled as if he had just noticed Sagittarius, and Sagittarius trembled.
“I don’t know how you did it, but you have Divine status now. It doesn’t seem like you came here to play either.”
Sagittarius glared at him. “I am here to get rid of Eternal Change. You won’t suffer any damage from it. Just look the other way.”
“Are you begging to be killed by me right now?”
“He is someone who should have lived and died as a human! But now that he is awakening as a monarch, it’s a different story!”
“You can’t. Go back.”
“It doesn’t matter what you say. The Zodiac Saint contract is still valid. I can retrieve Hugo’s soul. I'll tell you this beforehand. You cannot stop this.”
Lee Gun looked at Sagittarius as if the latter were speaking nonsense. Then he waved something in the air.
Sagittarius froze when he saw the item. “That is…!”
In the past, he had given Lee Gun a wish ticket in return for Lee Gun fixing the Sagittarius temple’s royal holy item!
“Do you remember this? You said you’d grant me any wish.”
Sagittarius became angry. “You are going to use it right now?! Have you lost your mind? You are going to use it for such a trivial matter?!”
“Yes.”
“Are you saying you don’t care if your uncle takes all the blame and dies!”
“Yes. I don’t.”
Sagittarius grabbed the back of his neck. Ungrateful little prick…?!

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - What happened? (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 414 - What happened? (4)
Valhalla.
“In the end, you sent Sagittarius toward Eternal Change?”
The gods of Valhalla found their Great Spirit’s decision odd.
“Sagittarius is Eternal Change’s Zodiac. Even if his life is on the line, he probably has a lingering affection for his Zodiac Saint. Will it be possible for him to get rid of Eternal Change?”
Eternal Change was a troublemaker who had made a mess of the Divine world. Moreover, he was a first-generation monarch. His power was on par with that of the Great Spirits.
‘That’s why it will be for the best if he’s eliminated.’
This was why Valhalla had gone out of its way to win the auction of Pushover. Someone of that caliber being a Construct of the snake god meant that getting rid of him was much more important.
‘If the snake god’s standing grows any further, the original Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple will cause a commotion.’
‘I’ll have to return his land.’
Valhalla’s Great Spirit had gone through a lot to take the Serpent Bearer’s land, Constructs, and all kinds of treasures.
“Sagittarius is skilled enough to be ranked within the top thirty in the Divine world. Still, what if his emotions toward Eternal Change prevent him from killing…”
[It doesn’t matter if he fails.]
“What?”
The Great Spirit of Valhalla laughed as if that was why he had sent Sagittarius there.
[Sagittarius will probably be killed by Eternal Change.]
“What?!”
They wanted to ask how he knew this, but the gods soon fell silent, realizing it was meaningless to ask such a question to the Great Spirit of Valhalla.
‘He must have seen the fate of the gods.’
Valhalla’s Great Spirit could see the moment right before a god’s death.
[Sagittarius picked Eternal Change as his Zodiac because he had Karmic debt amassed from the past.]
“!”
That wasn’t all.
[Moreover, his death at the hands of Eternal Change is part of his Karmic debt.]
It meant Valhalla’s Great Spirit had sent Sagittarius to Eternal Change to kill him.
At this point, the gods were confused.
“Isn't Sagittarius a very useful god? Why would you try to get him killed?”
“With your power, it wouldn’t be easy to use Sagittarius.”
“To face off against the snake god, wouldn’t it be better if…”
[No. If he stays alive, it’ll put us in an awkward position.]
“What?”
Instead of giving an answer, Valhalla’s Great Spirit thought about the past.
Sagittarius’s past form had been Galan. Galan was the older son of the being considered the chief of the Creators. Of course, Galan had been severely lacking in ability compared to his younger brother Aslan, who was a genius.
This had triggered Galan’s jealousy, and he eventually usurped the seats occupied by his tribe members.
Of course, Galan and his group were also usurped by their Constructs later on, but as expected of someone born to a Creator, Galan was able to be reborn when his Construct ate him. He was able to suppress the mind of the Construct.
Moreover, recently, he had started regaining memories of Galan.
‘It’ll be a problem if he recovers more memories.’
This was to be expected, since Galan was the one who had informed the Great Spirits about the weakness of the Creators.
Moreover, Galan had originally been loyal to the Creators and had loved his younger brother. It was the Great Spirit of Ennead, who had breathed jealousy into Galan’s heart.
Therefore, Sagittarius regaining more of his memories would put them in an awkward position. If he regained his memories, he would realize that the Great Spirits had manipulated him from the shadows. Furthermore, he would realize the weakness of the Great Spirits.
‘The Creators are all pain in the asses.’
The Great Spirits hated the Creator tribe.
At that moment…
“Oh, Lord of Heaven?”
“Does this have anything to do with what happened to the Creators?”
“Hmmph. The Creators were always troublemakers. I heard the young Creator put the Primordial god through the process of inheritance.”
It didn’t matter what form he took. The gods couldn’t go against the Primordial god. They didn’t even dare think about turning him into a Construct.
The Great Spirit of Valhalla laughed.
[Originally, Eternal Change and Sagittarius were fated to die at the hands of Time.]
However, the one to change their fate was none other than Lee Gun. This was why it was best not to get directly involved with Lee Gun.
“If Sagittarius tries to kill Eternal Change, Eternal Change will try to kill Sagittarius.”
With the power given to him by Valhalla’s Great Spirit, Sagittarius would cause great harm to Eternal Change. But he could also die in the process.
[Yes. I just have to make them fight for now.]
It didn’t matter which side won. He would benefit nonetheless.
* * *
“Damn it! You are a terrible nephew!! You won’t even allow me to fight him! How can you call yourself my nephew?”
“Fuck off! You are a murderer who killed your own tribe.”
“…!!!?”
Shocked, Sagittarius became unsteady on his feet. He had never expected to hear such words from Lee Gun.
However, although he had suffered emotional damage, he still had work to do. So he approached Lee Gun. “I’ll pretend I didn't hear what you just said. Also, you should hand back the wish ticket right now.”
“Really? Are you going to steal back the present you gave me?”
“I’m not trying to steal it from you! Do you really think a wish ticket is like a voucher that can be traded in for a massage? That represents the promise of a god! As soon as it is used, it’s entered into a contract. It’s an absolute right of order…! No, it’s nothing.
“Anyway, you can use it for something much better. In the meantime, Uncle will store it for you!”
“Fuck off! I’ll use it right now.”
“Hmmph. If you insist on acting this way, I won’t stand back—”
Sagittarius suddenly screamed.
A long-haired child was slowly climbing up Lee Gun’s shoulder.
“Ahhk!! Primordial god!!!”
Sagittarius immediately recognized the child. He stumbled backward, then hid behind a tree. “You! What the hell did you do to the Primordial god?”
Lee Gun pushed the kid to get him off. “What? His appearance changed, yet you recognize him?”
“His energy and power feel the same! Of course, all the gods will recognize him!!!” Sagittarius shook in fear. He didn’t even want to get close to the Primordial god. The Primordial god was such an existence to the gods.
Sagittarius didn’t even dare raise his head as he spoke to Lee Gun. “P-Primordial god… This is foul play. Let’s speak after you send him away— Ahhhk!!”
Lee Gun grabbed the child and pushed him toward Sagittarius. Sagittarius was apoplectic as he hid further.
Lee Gun laughed as if he had found something great. “For some odd reason, the gods don’t approach me if I have him with me. Not even my Constructs try to get close to me.”
“He isn’t someone that you can grab and look at all willy-nilly! You’re the weird one!!”
The Primordial god was an absolute existence, and all gods were afraid of him. No, the scarier thing right now was the status and affiliation of the Primordial god.
‘How dare he turn the Primordial god into his underling!’
To make matters worse, the Primordial god seemed to like Lee Gun. He was rubbing his face on Lee Gun.
This annoyed Lee Gun, who ordered him to change into his weapon form.
Sullen, the Primordial god changed his shape. Then an enormous hammer appeared in his lace.
Sagittarius didn’t even notice his legs lose strength as he collapsed. It was as if he couldn’t believe what he had just seen.
“Did you turn the Primordial god into a weapon?”
“Yes. I avoided killing him this way, and he became my underling.”
“…#*&$#**?!”
As if turning Hermes into an item wasn’t enough, he made the Primordial god into one?
“Well, this kid is too high in level, so he keeps changing into his humanoid form.”
Sagittarius massaged his forehead as if he felt faint. He acted like he had seen nothing as he walked out from behind the tree. “I… I saw nothing. Put away that hideous thing…”
Lee Gun slid the hammer toward him. “What did you just say?”
“Ahhhk!!”
When the energy got close to him, Sagittarius became scared again. He screamed as he once again hid behind the tree.
“What the hell? Who keeps squealing like a stuck pig?”
“!!”
Was it because of Sagittarius’s screams? Hugo appeared near the lake.
Sagittarius’s expression changed as soon as he exchanged looks with Hugo. Both of them took out their bows. It didn’t matter who was first.
Kwahng!!!
Sagittarius’s arrows, which were made of light, clashed against Hugo’s, which were made by Lee Gun.
Both of them were known as gods of accuracy for a reason.
Pahng!!!
The arrows flew toward each other’s heads and exploded. The tip of each arrow accurately met the other’s.
Sagittarius and Hugo immediately moved as they attacked each other once again.
Lee Gun merely scratched his belly as he watched them.
Kwahng!!!
The consecutive arrows they sent toward each other once again exploded as each of them collided tip-to-tip.
Hugo determined this would continue endlessly at this rate, so he was first to approach Sagittarius. Finally, he brought down his bow like an ax.
Kwahng!!
After blocking the bow with his bow, Sagittarius gnashed his teeth. “Hugo! You should be thankful to me for raising you, yet you’re trying to kill your Zodiac!”
“Raise me?! In fact, I’m the one who worked and maintained your lifestyle!!” Hugo created an arrow made out of magical energy and shot it.
Kwahng!!!
It was a shot from up close. An explosion erupted as Sagittarius ground his teeth.
While that arrow might be disguised as the power of the Serpent Bearer temple, it was the power of a monarch.
“Bastard… You regained your memories?”
“I have no idea what you’re talking about.”
“That’s why you’re trying to kill me!” Soon, Sagittarius’s eyes flashed as he was about to use his ability.
However, Lee Gun, who was feeling hungry, tore the wish ticket in half at this moment. It was a signal of the wish ticket being activated!
“Hey. I gotta go eat. Just don’t attack Taeksoo.”
When the powerful red light surged forth, Sagittarius screamed, realizing what Lee Gun had done. “Ahhk! I told you not to use it on such trivial matters!! Also, I might not be able to attack him, but there are many ways to kill him…”
“What are you talking about? My wish was something different.”
“What?”
[Serpent Bearer’s wish ticket has been activated with Sagittarius as the target.]
[Wish: Sagittarius must follow the Serpent Bearer’s orders no matter what they are. Absolute obedience.]
“…!?”
The terms of the wish were more comprehensive than he thought! However, Sagittarius soon scoffed. “You made a mistake. That wish ticket is single-use. You should have given a permanent order like I should never kill Hugo. A wish like that will wear off…”
“Ah! Don’t worry. I changed the wish ticket’s attribute from singe-use to half-permanent.”
“Change… What? Half-permanent? What do you mean?”
“The order that I gave isn’t single-use. It’s half-permanent.”
“… Ah ha. You are saying that the order for absolute obedience to the Serpent Bearer is forever… Forever…” Sagittarius let out a soundless scream.
‘I forgot that his other Divine name is Designer!!!’
Aslan’s other Divine name was the Divine Magician, and he had “Ability Creation.” On the other hand, Lee Gun possessed “Item Creation.”
It meant Lee Gun could freely change the ability, innate attributes, and outer appearance of weapons and items. He could do it as the Designer.
‘All items have a structure, and master craftsmen can fix or destroy it.’
In other words, Sagittarius’s wish ticket was considered an “item,” and Lee Gun had remodeled it. Of course, he needed to pay a price for doing such a thing.
When he saw Sagittarius’s expression, the final boss of this production smirked. “That’s why you should leave any items with me, idiot.”
“…!”
Sagittarius looked like he couldn’t accept it. “You might have paid a price, but that wish ticket was a 4-star item! You would have incurred Karmic debt if you changed the function of an item of such caliber. A normal permission ticket would be useless—”
“Ah. It doesn’t matter since I have this.” Instead of an explanation, Lee Gun shook the Primordial god hammer.
Sagittarius froze.
‘Primordial god?!’
The Primordial god was the king of the gods. One of his original abilities was to issue permission tickets (Exoneration).
Of course, when the Primordial god was gone, the Divine world system, which contained his residual power, had issued the permission tickets (Exoneration). However, the Primordial god was present now…
‘Did he acquire the Great-Spirit-rank permission tickets (Exoneration)?’
Or maybe he acquired something ranked higher. In the end, Sagittarius’s face turned pale.
Until now, Lee Gun had been unable to use his abilities freely despite possessing powerful abilities. It was because he was lacking permission tickets (Exoneration).
What if that problem was solved when he acquired the Primordial god…
‘If we aren’t careful, he might change all the items in the Divine world…’
At this point, Hugo looked at Sagittarius. While Sagittarius couldn't attack him, he could attack Sagittarius.
“Hey. Don’t do it. You can’t touch him either.”
“What? Are you going easy on him again… because he’s your uncle…”
“No? He’ll be taken care of, even if we don’t lay a finger on him.”
“What? How—”
A light emanated from Sagittarius’s neck, and two ravens emerged out of it.
[You failed in your mission.]
[Failed.]
Sagittarius became pale. “Wait…!”
The ravens let out a light as they encircled Sagittarius’s neck. A rope made out of light choked the god of the sun.
“Kuh-huhk! No! Don’t take me away!”
[You are going to be executed.]
[Executed.]
Sagittarius was dragged away by the ravens.
Hugo started to sweat. “Are you sure you should let that happen?”
“It is no problem. Right?” Lee Gun looked at the Primordial god and let out a meaningful smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - Are they useful? (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 415 - Are they useful? (1)
The Divine world was in a state of turmoil. The reason was the news that the Primordial god had appeared in front of Lee Gun.
“The one whom we had been searching for long was with the evil gods!”
“We didn’t know if he was dead or alive until now. Why did he have to go to the snake god?”
“That makes no sense. He’s…!”
“Oh, Great Spirit! What happened!’
All the gods looked up to the Primordial god.
However, the Primordial god had been tricked by Eternal Change and had perished when he was betrayed by those close to him.
“At the time, didn’t the Great Spirits arrest the evil gods for murdering the Primordial god?”
“Why were the victim and the perpetrators traveling together? How does that make any sense?”
“The Primordial god went to the snake god! How are you going to take responsibility for this?”
Gods had gathered at the heart of the Divine world. The eight great forces, as well as the thousands of factions unrelated to them, had come here.
The Primordial god’s appearance before Lee Gun had created a hole in the story.
“Come out and speak!”
“We are asking if the Great Spirits assassinated the Primordial god! Did you place the blame on others?!”
Suddenly, a light surged forth in front of them. The light resolved into fierce purple winds, and a man appeared out of it.
The gods affiliated under Valhalla were surprised by the sight.
“Lord of Heaven!”
He was an old man wearing an eyepatch.
The Great Spirit of Ennead was a young male god, and it felt like he existed only to fight through the whole universe. On the other hand, the Great Spirit of Valhalla gave off a proud air. He was like a great noble.
When the Great Spirit of Valhalla appeared in the flesh, the gods immediately lowered their heads.
At the end of the day, the Great Spirits were the current rulers of the Divine world and the numerous dimensions. They were the highest-ranked leaders. Why would such an exalted being appear in front of them like this?
[Did someone just suggest that we assassinated the Primordial god and placed the blame on the evil gods?]
“…!!”
The question made half the gods tremble in fear; the other half raised their eyebrows as they tried to hide their confusion.
“Then why would the Primordial god hang around the evil gods unless he has lost his mind?”
“Moreover, isn’t it odd that the Primordial god went to the snake god instead of you guys? It doesn’t make sense unless you guys are the perpetrators…”
The eyes of Valhalla’s Great Spirit flashed.
[Shut your mouth! If we killed the Primordial god, we would have turned into evil gods.]
“!”
[When gods fall, it cannot be hidden. We are completely fine. Is that proof enough?]
“That’s…!”
[If you want to accuse us of being the culprits, tell us why didn’t we incur massive amounts of Karmic debt?]
The gods were silent.
The Great Spirit of Valhalla furrowed his brow.
‘There is no way we’ll be found out.’
The only ones that could find out what they had done were Galan and Eternal Change, and both of them were fated to die.
Of course, the Great Spirit of Valhalla had put a temporary Divine status within Sagittarius, but Sagittarius’s opponent was Eternal Change. The fight might drag out a bit, but Sagittarius would be ripped apart and eaten.
‘No one will find out.’
“Hey! Wait a moment! You can’t! Hey! No!”
“You are going to be executed. Executed!”
[!]
The Great Spirit of Valhalla flinched when he heard the unexpected voices. The problem was the owners of the voices.
“No! I’ve been wrongly accused!”
“Follow us.”
The one being dragged here by his pages was none other than Sagittarius.
The gods became agitated when they saw the pages and the golden-haired man.
“Isn’t that Sagittarius?”
“Those are the raven gods…!”
The two children dragging Sagittarius here were the raven gods, the eyes of Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
Muninn and Huginn were considered gods that bore and retrieved news. That was why they caused a commotion.
“This is the first time I’ve seen the gods of retrieval…!”
“Didn’t both of them disappear when the Primordial god was murdered?”
When Sagittarius appeared, the eyebrows of Valhalla’s Great Spirit rose as he tried to keep in his anger.
‘Why the hell did they bring him back here?’
Sagittarius should have already been dead. He should be a corpse.
The Great Spirit of Valhalla looked at the ravens with gold eyes.
[What about Eternal Change?]
“It will be impossible for him to execute Eternal Change.”
[What?]
“The snake god used a wish ticket and turned Sagittarius into his permanent subordinate. He made sure both of them couldn’t fight.”
The Great Spirit almost cursed. It only worked if they fought each other! Eternal Change would kill Sagittarius, who was Galan. Then the Divine status placed inside Galan would kill Eternal Change.
It was supposed to be that way, but the snake god…!
[Did the snake god let Sagittarius go willingly?]
“Yes. He said he doesn’t need someone like him…”
The Great Spirit realized what Lee Gun wanted to do.
‘He purposefully let Sagittarius be dragged away?’
Huginn and Muninn were the eyes of Valhalla’s Great Spirit. He could see through the eyes of the ravens, no matter where they were. It was also his second sight. However, he had currently sealed the clairvoyance since he had to monitor Sagittarius.
‘However, he’ll die 100% if he’s sent here. Does he truly not need Sagittarius?’
Murderous intent appeared within the Great Spirit’s eyes, but…
“Our conversation hasn’t concluded yet!”
[!]
“It was said that the evil gods took the power of the Primordial god. It was said that those powers were sold to the monarchs!”
Including Cycle, a total of five such powers existed. The Great Spirits had recovered those powers from the monarchs. Those powers symbolized the Primordial god. Their presence allowed everyone to accept the Great Spirits as leaders of the Divine world.
“Could that have been a lie too?”
As soon as the high-rank gods spoke, the Lord of Heaven’s eyes flashed menacingly.
[You try to be nice, yet the dregs start taking liberties with you.]
“!!”
[Who do you think allowed you to use your power in comfort? How dare you try to place blame on the Great Spirits!]
Purple flames erupted from the angry Great Spirit. He became larger. After transforming into an enormous giant made out of purple flames, he brought out his abilities.
Koo-goo-goong!
The menacing sight frightened everyone.
“Lord of Heaven!”
[You have noodles in your head instead of brains. I’ll make sure you guys go through inheritance to transfer your power.]
It was clear that he was going to get rid of Sagittarius and the gods barking up the wrong tree. He planned on killing them all.
The flames were about to descend on the heads of the gods when…
Pahng!!!
“!!”
A powerful light deflected the power of the Great Spirit.
The gods and the captured Sagittarius were surprised to see the newcomer.
“A-Aslan?!”
The one who had blasted away the Great Spirit’s power was Aslan.
Sagittarius couldn’t believe his eyes as he looked at the golden-haired man.
Aslan let out a bright smile when he felt Sagittarius’s gaze. “You are still alive, Big Brother.”
Complicated emotions took over Sagittarius’s face. “Did you come to save me—”
“What? Do you think I’ve lost my mind?” Aslan laughed as if Sagittarius was barking up the wrong tree. “It’s fine. Just become a weapon for Gun.”
Sagittarius despaired.
Aslan then glared at the Great Spirit of Valhalla. In truth, Sagittarius had to regain all his memories if they wanted to find a way to defeat all the Great Spirits.
The Great Spirit of Valhalla looked at Aslan in contempt.
[It seems the Great Sinner Aslan, who ridiculed the Great Spirits, is still alive. What did you do to the Great Spirit of Ennead?]
“I made sure he cannot come out from hell fire. An old man like you should be sitting in a heated seat. You might hurt your back.”
The gods talked amongst themselves.
“Wasn’t Aslan best friends with the Great Spirits? I thought they were drinking buddies.”
“No. By the end, they fought like crazy. They tried to kill each other.”
“Why??”
“Of course, it was Aslan’s fault. Creators are all sinners who lost their minds.”
When he heard the murmurs, the Great Spirit of Valhalla looked like he was in a very tough spot.
It was because Aslan knew everything. He knew why they wanted to get rid of the Primordial god and the Creators. Aslan had spoken these words to them in the past.
- I will decline such requests.
- What?
- After the death of the Primordial god, I can see why the Creators refused to become Constructs under the Great Spirits.
- !
- I also understand why you guys killed the Creators.
The Great Spirits still vividly remembered Aslan’s cocky rejection. This was why the Lord of Heaven was boiling with anger.
‘Is this the snake god’s doing?’
As expected, Creators were never helpful. It also was apparent that Aslan hadn’t been reborn. The eye of the Great Spirit could see it all.
‘That is an item.’
However, it wasn’t an ordinary item.
As if messing with Sagittarius wasn’t enough, Lee Gun had revived the damn Aslan.
Aslan was Lee Gun’s item. As Lee Gun grew and became stronger, Aslan was able to regain his original shape. He was able to use his abilities.
The Great Spirit instantly became guarded. Sagittarius didn't seem to care what happened. He was just happy to be alive.
Puhng!!
“!!”
At that moment, Aslan turned into a slime.
Sagittarius’s face turned pale from shock. Lee Gun’s Constructs, who had come to monitor the situation, also screamed.
“Aslan!”
Aslan mentally kicked himself.
‘This is…!’
The duration had come to an end!
Having been returned to his slime form, Aslan started to run away. As he did so, he stole the gods’ items.
Sagittarius was frozen by this sight, and the Great Spirit of Valhalla raged. He could no longer hold it in.
[Bring all the gods who had contact with the thirteen Zodiacs.]
“What?”
[The thirteen Zodiacs ignored that they had seen Eternal Change. They chose to ignore a sinner like Sagittarius. They couldn’t stop the antics of the Serpent Bearer.]
“!”
[All the gods associated with the thirteen Zodiacs are guilty by association. They will be executed. Their existence itself will be erased, and their faction will be expelled.]
It caused a big stir amongst the gods. The gods who had become the thirteen Zodiacs were all pillar gods of the eight great forces. The Great Spirit of Valhalla wanted to exterminate them!
The Great Spirit didn’t care as he looked at Sagittarius.
[Take this bastard to Valhalla’s Hel.]
Hel was Valhalla’s hell prison. All Constructs stolen from other forces and the sinners that could cause harm to Valhalla were imprisoned there.
When the door opened, light exploded forth from the floor. A space connected to Valhalla opened. It was a transport tunnel that moved the prisoners.
The tied-up Sagittarius flinched. This hell prison was notorious. The Constructs that didn’t follow orders were put in there and tortured.
[!]
However, the transport tunnel connected to Valhalla suddenly disappeared. Moreover, none of the guards from Hel responded when the Great Spirit called for them.
This puzzled the Great Spirit, so he tried summoning his Constructs. He sent his Valkyries to go check on Hel.
Soon, he heard something shocking.
“This is bad! Valhalla is under attack!”
[What?]
[It’s the snake god! He’s stealing the prisoners of Valhalla!]
[…!?]
It was Lee Gun. Lee Gun had invaded Valhalla and was taking all the gods imprisoned by the Lord of Heaven. The bigger problem was which gods he was stealing.
[Most of them are gods who used to be affiliated under the Serpent Bearer temple!]
[While letting Sagittarius’s execution distract you, they invaded Valhalla!]
[He’s trying to regain his Constructs, and he plans on releasing all the prisoners that’ll cause harm to Valhalla! I believe that is his goal!]
Valhalla’s Great Spirit realized what had happened and glared at Sagittarius. That damn baby snake bastard…! Lee Gun had purposely sent Sagittarius to him.
* * *
Lee Gun had arrived at Valhalla’s hell.
Hugo nervously looked at his friend. “Hey, are you sure we should be doing this?”
“What do you mean?”
“This is Hel.”
“So what?”
“Why do I have to come here and act as a meat shield for you?”
“Why else? It hurts if I get hit!!”
“#$*&*?!”
Currently, they were on Valhalla’s land. Of course, there was only one reason why they were able to enter this place in secret.
[As expected, Mimir knows everything about Valhalla.]
The Spirit King Mimir, who had attached itself to Chun Sungjae, had been a Construct of the old Serpent Bearer temple.
It had also originated from Valhalla, and it was one of the two great gods of knowledge. This was why it knew about the secret tunnels and the method needed to free the prisoners.
That wasn’t all.
‘I never expected Gemini’s Divine status to be useful here…’
After he had killed the Gemini twins on the earth, Lee Gun had stolen their Divine statuses.
The Gemini Zodiacs were Freya and Freyr. They had been Zodiacs affiliated under Valhalla.
This was why his enemies hadn’t attacked Lee Gun even if he came across them.
- Damn it! It’s a pillar-rank Divine status of Valhalla! Huhk!
- Shit! We can’t attack him! Kuh-huhk!
It seemed they couldn’t attack their superior, so their enemies acted meekly in front of him.
Of course, the Divine status of a pillar god had no effect on some high-rank gods, but it didn’t matter.
- Ahhk! Primordial god!
- W-Wait a moment! Why is he here?
Whenever Lee Gun pulled out the Primordial god, half the high-ranking gods showed reactions similar to Sagittarius’s when he had met the Primordial god. Lee Gun took care of the rest by tossing Hugo toward them.
He was doing this for a simple reason.
- Hel has a lot of Constructs affiliated under the Serpent Bearer temple.
Mimir’s eyes had shone as he spoke.
- Also, the number of Constructs a Zodiac has is equivalent to the power of the Zodiac. Master, you have to grow the size and power of your faction.
In other words, Lee Gun needed to satisfy his internal energy requirement if he wanted to generate power on par with the Great Spirit rank.
‘First, Master has to become a Great Spirit.’
Back to the present, Lee Gun opened each room and pointed inside. “Mmm. Will this one be helpful?”
A nameless Construct was shaking within the room.
Mimir answered when it saw him.
[No. He won’t be helpful.]
Poo-hahk!!
“Ahhk!!”
“What about him?”
[No. Too dirty.]
Poo-hahk!!!
“Ooh-ahk!”
“What about him?”
[You just have to take his Divine status.]
Poo-hahk!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
It seemed all the gods that Lee Gun had killed were wards of Valhalla. The gods glared at Lee Gun as they died.
“Bastards…! Do you think the Lord of Heaven will let you be? He’ll be here soon…!”
Lee Gun laughed at those words. “Let him come. I’ll pluck out his remaining eye.”

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - Are they useful? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 416 - Are they useful? (2)
Lee Gun continued reclaiming the prisoners. This time, he pointed at a god wearing thick armor and having the head of a snake. “What about him?”
[That one’s good. He’s useful. Ah. Only his head is useful.]
“Ok.”
Poo-hahk!!!
Lee Gun sent the snake god’s head flying with his hammer. He didn’t seem to feel any guilt even after sending someone of his own race(?) flying. As if that wasn’t enough, he then blasted everyone that looked to be that god’s comrades.
This was why not even the shadow of a guard could be seen within the prison.
Lee Gun dusted off his hands and looked behind him. Several hundred freed gods stood behind him. “Is that all? Did we gather them all?”
[We still have a bit more left, but… this should be enough.]
The freed Constructs were dumbfounded. They were the gods who used to be affiliated under the past Serpent Bearer.
After Aslan’s death, the Great Spirits had forcefully dragged them away and coerced them to work for the Great Spirits a couple hundred years ago.
However, the Constructs had refused to yield, so they were locked up in this prison for several hundred years.
“I never expected this day to come…!”
“Master…!!”
“Young Master…!”
“I heard the rumor, but I never expected it to be real…!”
These were gods that he had never seen before, yet they looked at him with trust in their eyes. It wasn’t just their gaze.
[You have received enough Faith from the Constructs.]
Lee Gun’s power was being strengthened by the adoration of the gods. The Constructs kneeled in front of Lee Gun and planted their heads on the ground.
“We pay respect to our new master…!”
This amused Lee Gun.
[Wolf of Ruin (Fenrir) pledges loyalty to the Serpent Bearer.]
[Master of Destruction (Sekhmet) pledges loyalty to the Serpent Bearer.]
Every one of them was a high-rank god. That wasn’t all. Some could even be considered pillar-rank gods.
[Master of the Brazier (Hestia) pledges loyalty to the Serpent Bearer.]
Lee Gun laughed as he looked at them. “Are you guys the entirety of the Serpent Bearer’s Constructs?”
“Some more are in the basement here and the prisons of the other forces. However, we can bring them.”
“We will immediately free them and bring them back to you.”
When Lee Gun gave them his consent, the freed Constructs immediately moved. At the same time, something surprising happened.
[You have completed the requirement.]
“!”
Was it because numerous Constructs had pledged loyalty to him?
[Numerous stars are converging toward the Serpent Bearer.]
[Your power as a Zodiac has increased.]
[You have satisfied the requirement to become a Great Spirit.]
Accompanying the notification, a powerful, never-before-seen light emanated from Lee Gun’s body.
The remaining Constructs moaned.
[That light is…!]
[It’s the light of a Great Spirit…!]
A change occurred to Lee Gun’s Divine status.
[Your Divine status is evolving.]
The light encircled Lee Gun’s body. Then lights shot out from his body. They were the Divine statuses of Life and Death. However, something was off.
“Ohhhhh!”
“Finally!!”
The two Divine statuses looked different. They didn’t look like balls of light with expressions on them. They were a young girl and a young boy. Surprisingly, they were both blonde.
The Constructs screamed as if they couldn’t believe what they were saying.
“Personification?”
“Divine statuses can be personified! How can this be…!”
“The rules of the Divine world…!!”
Life and Death didn't care. They screamed as they ran around.
“Finally! I can speak!”
“Finally, I can say something to that damn master!”
“Finally, I can possess Master!”
The girl was Life, and the boy was Death.
Of course, Hugo merely furrowed his brows when he saw them. “Oh no! Those sadists with bankrupt personalities got bodies now.”
One was a beautiful boy, and the other was a beautiful girl. However, Hugo was well aware of their abilities. He had seen them go berserk when they reached stage 6.
Hugo could guess what they would be like. The answer to this was apparent.
Lee Gun’s Constructs realized the identity of those two, so they spoke out in shock.
“They really are Life and Death!”
Death became angry when he heard the shout. He beat the Constructs to the ground. “Master gave me a name! My name is ‘Jun’!”
“Kuh-huhk!!”
“What the hell? Why are they so strong?”
At the end of the day, Life and Death were Lee Gun’s Divine statuses. It seemed they ranked high amongst the gods.
If Lee Gun wanted it, his Divine statuses could become leaders of his Constructs.
The two of them seemed to like Lee Gun very much. They clung to his legs. Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
Lee Gun shook the blood off the hammer as he called for Mimir. “Is that it?”
[Yes. This is it.]
Mimir looked satisfied as it lowered its head.
‘He had the abilities. The only thing missing was the requirements needed to become a Great Spirit.’
Everyone except one was happy as they looked at Lee Gun. It was the Primordial god, who looked dissatisfied.
[Head Smasher says he isn’t a hammer.]
[Head Smasher says he is a book.]
The menacing hammer in Lee Gun’s hand changed shape.
Puhng!
He had turned himself into an antique book!
[Head Smasher (EX)]
- Item made by changing the Primordial god into a Divine item.
Lee Gun immediately spoke up in anger. “Hey! I told you not to take that form!”
The Primordial god complained.
[Head Smasher says it isn’t a hammer. It is a book.]
[Head Smasher just wants to be in its original form.]
[He also doesn’t like the name of Head Smasher!]
“Fuck off! How is a book going to fight?” Lee Gun shook the book in anger.
It made the king of the gods aggrieved.
[He can inflict considerable damage by hitting with the corner of the book!!!]
Lee Gun completely ignored him. “If you don’t change back to being a hammer, I’ll burn you.”
The Primordial god felt aggrieved. In truth, the Primordial god’s original form had been a book.
‘At a basic level, it contains the attribute of all things in the universe.’
The Primordial god was the universe itself. All the abilities and structures of the world were inside the book.
In other words, the book was a reservoir of knowledge, the source containing all knowledge.
It was helpful to Lee Gun when he was making weapons, like a recipe book or a blueprint. However, that didn’t matter.
‘It isn’t helpful in battle.’
Lee Gun was straightforward. His specialty was turning things into a paste. There was no way a book would be very helpful to him. This was why he hadn’t changed just the outer appearance.
At the end of the day, he had turned a Primordial god into a Divine item so that its abilities and durability were overpowering!
‘Its original form suffered greatly when it was killed.’
When the king of gods changed back into a hammer, Lee Gun looked satisfied.
Only one person was watching this. Hugo shook.
‘Gun became stronger.’
The fact that he was treating the king of the gods as his own item was frightening. However, Hugo was shaking in fear because he had seen the gods’ heads get smashed open by the hammer.
For some reason, he felt like that was his future. In truth, he had been threatened by Lee Gun.
- Talk.
- What?
- Why did you kill the Creators?
- …!
Lee Gun had spoken as if he was ready to decapitate him. It seemed Lee Gun had realized that Hugo had recovered his memories as Eternal Change.
- You were with the Creators because you wanted something from them.
- That is…! I can’t talk about that.
- Why?
- If I tell you, you will hate me more.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose when he heard that.
- Then don’t come close to me and your family.
- No! That’s not fair to me. I don’t know what you heard from the Constructs and Scorpio. They don’t know what they are talking about…
- Eternal Change. You went to sexually harass the Primordial god, and in the process, you got caught by the Creators. You lived a life of servitude as a monarch.
- !
- To leave the life of servitude, you spread the information about the weakness of the Creators. You got the Creators killed.
- …!?
- After you made the Creators extinct, you were barely able to be freed from your imprisonment. Then my Fath…. No, you found out the thirteenth survived, so you couldn’t run away from the Divine world.
- …?!
- After several hundred years, you were able to kill the thirteenth. You were finally freed after all the Creators were dead. So you brought your comrades to eat the gods and wrecked the Divine world.
- …!
- How can I trust someone like that?
- …!
Hugo couldn’t say anything. However, Lee Gun spoke as if it wasn’t a big deal.
- Of course, I do trust you.
- …Gun…!
- However, I want to confirm one thing with you. Don’t think about lying to me. Speak the truth to me as a friend.
- W…What is it?
Afterward, Lee Gun had asked a question.
When Hugo gave an honest answer, Lee Gun’s expression had been a sight to behold. In fact, it had been the angriest expression that Hugo had seen from Lee Gun.
In the end, the enraged Lee Gun had punched Hugo and spoken swear words that Hugo had never heard before.
Hugo once again appreciated that Lee Gun’s words were very foul and harsh.
- You son of a bitch. You can’t die an easy death.
This was why he was dragged here as a meat shield; regaining Lee Gun’s trust was a very difficult task.
“Master? Where are you going?”
“You already achieved your goal in coming here.”
They had come here to fulfill the requirement Lee Gun needed to become a Great Spirit.
On the other hand, Lee Gun smirked as if to say they were speaking nonsense. “I have one more goal left to accomplish here.”
“!”
Soon, he started to move.
* * *
“My god! What the hell is happening over there?”
The Divine world was turned on its head for an entirely different reason.
“The thirteen Zodiacs were captured?”
“They are going straight toward the execution ground?”
“What?! Those Zodiacs once used to be the ninth great force…?!’
It was the center of the Divine world. When one passed the bridge connected to the castle, one reached a large stretch of land: an empty plain with rocks and debris.
A surprisingly large hole lay in the middle of this land. It looked like a sinkhole, but it was something much scarier.
Surprisingly, several gods were being held above the hole.
The gods gathered on the bridge were shocked by what they saw.
“They really are the gods of the thirteen Zodiacs…!”
“Gods of that stature were…!”
The captured gods were cuffed by something that looked like cubes, and they were hung from the cubes in the air.
Of course, the captured gods were busy fighting among themselves.
“Why did I get captured? Is it because of you?”
“Don’t ask me about it…”
“Also, where is Scorpio?”
The ones hung here were Virgo (Artemis), Leo (Narasimha), Sagittarius (Apollo), and the slave Aries (Jade Emperor). As if that wasn’t enough, Carly was also there; she was considered Libra. Then there was Goat, Lee Jaewon, Capricorn Saint Taylor, and Aquarius Saint Sophie, among others.
There were six humans who worked as Zodiac Saints without having their Zodiac. These humans had been brought here suddenly, and they were foaming at the mouth.
“Ahhhk! Why am I here?”
“Huh… Huhk! T… This place is….”
As if she was displeased, Virgo gave a side eye to her sibling. “This is your fault for not doing your work properly”
“Don’t blame me….”
“E…excuse me. This doesn’t seem to be the earth. Do you know why we were dragged here…?” Goat was pale with fright.
The gods started to sweat.
The Great Spirits had the special right to call for judgment. These Zodiacs and humans had been caught when a Great Spirit had used his ability.
In simple words, those suspected of having sinned could be captured and summoned once using the ability of judgment.
