This ability worked on all gods except the Great Spirits. The origins of the gods didn’t matter. They could be disarmed, captured, and summoned through this ability.
This was possible because the Great Spirits were the current heads of the Divine world. Moreover, they possessed the Great-Spirit-rank permission tickets (Exoneration).
But why were the Zodiac Saints here…?
Lee Jaewon and Goat were shocked when they saw puzzlement on the faces of the gods.
“Even the gods do not know why?!”
“Uh… We have no idea. Ask the Serpent Bearer. He might have done something…”
“?!!!”
Leo was going mad as it raged. A collar had been placed around its neck that was letting out lightning. “Did Valhalla lose their mind? How dare they mess with us?”
“Shut Up! You guys will be executed by being dropped below, and the inheritance process will start.”
“Who authorized this—”
[I allowed it.]
“!”
The Great Spirit of Valhalla cut off Leo as he appeared. The Lord of Heaven appeared there, along with thousands of gods under Valhalla.
The sky was covered with gods, ranging from Valkyries to giants. It was an incredible number.
The Lord of Heaven appeared as an enormous giant made of purple flame. He looked at them with contempt.
[Execute them.]
However…
[Who gave you the right to execute them?]
“!!!”
Everyone was surprised by the familiar voice.
“S-Snake god!”
“Lee Gun-nim!!”
Lee Gun appeared with his shadow. He settled atop one of the pillars surrounding the scaffold. He was letting out a menacing energy, and it was the appearance of the stage-six god of Death!
The gods flinched.
‘That appearance is…!’
Every god became guarded when they saw the massive power he was emanating.
“Did you say he’s ranked the same as the Great Spirits?”
“That’s correct.”
It had been a rumor. Valhalla’s Great Spirit had also seen the ranking. However, he hadn’t believed it. However, the Great Spirit was sure of it now that he saw Lee Gun for himself.
‘He clearly isn’t a pillar-rank god!’
At that moment, as if he had been waiting for the gods of Valhalla, Lee Gun extended his hand and smirked.
[Finally, I get to use it.]
When he spoke, an enormous light exploded forth.
[You have met the requirements and acquired the power needed to become a Great Spirit.]
[The Divine item of Death has been activated.]

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - Are they useful? (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 417 - Are they useful? (3)
Lee Gun took out the Divine item of Death.
Everyone’s eyes turned round when they saw the item.
“What the hell is that? Is it an item?”
“It can’t be a weapon… Right?”
It was an item made out of black steel, and it looked closer to a manufacturing instrument.
“Isn’t that a tong?”
Yes, his Divine item of Death was unexpectedly shaped like blacksmith tongs. It was a pincer-shaped tool that one used to grab or anchor hot iron. However, it was far from normal looking.
“Why the hell is it so big?”
The handles were twice as long as the legs of an adult male. It was also very thick and looked brutal.
“He can extract a monster’s tooth with that thing!”
No, if he did that, it would be the least of their problems.
The humans who knew Lee Gun’s personality started to sweat, and their gazes headed toward the gods.
Lee Gun ignored them as he infused the tongs with his power.
[Fetters of the Underworld (ex)]
- Manufacturer: Lee Gun
- Divine Item of Death (Tongs)
- Implement of punishment made through the soul of a Creator
- It can be used as a manufacturing tool
Immense power gathered around the tongs. As this power spread, the gods were surprised. It was because the Divine power they had felt was comparable to that of a Great Spirit.
The gods of Valhalla tried to stop Lee Gun from using his Divine item.
‘That brat…’
Did he think that he could catch up to the power of the Great Spirits because he had killed some gods and made a useful Divine item?!
The gods attacked Lee Gun. They weren’t even going to let Lee Gun have the opportunity to use his power.
Hweek!
However, Lee Gun suddenly disappeared from the top of the pillar. He reappeared above the ground!
Puhng!
Puhng puhng puhng!
The gods sent indiscriminate attacks toward him, yet he was unfazed.
Pahng!
Lee Gun landed lightly on the ground and dodged the attacks.
The war gods chased after him, but they couldn’t catch up with him.
“Koohk! As expected of a god with the attribute of the fighting-type god…!”
“He is too fast— Kuh-huhk!!’
The fighting-type gods had reached the zenith amongst the countless war gods! They were the strongest war gods! Most war gods didn’t even stand a chance against them.
“Over there! Chase after him!”
“I got him… Damn it!”
He left the gods in the dust as he dodged their attacks. Then black flames dispersed from his moving body.
After he had changed into his stage six form, black flames spanned his body. Half of his body was covered in black flames. It was an ominous, never-seen-before black.
In the plains, Lee Gun was the only one burning up in flames.
The gods gulped at this sight.
‘His appearance… He is small, but he looks very much like a Great Spirit!’
The Great Spirits had a symbolic form. They appeared in a humanoid form. Depending on their inclination, the color and the shape of their power varied. However, each of them had a different form where they appeared as giants.
The Great Spirit of Ennead, Wheel of Fire, was a giant made of red flames. The Great Spirit of Olympus, Lord of the Sky, was a giant made of blue lightning. Valhalla’s Great Spirit, Lord of Heaven, was a giant made of purple gas. The Great Spirit of Light, Lord of Light, was a giant made of light.
Only the Great Spirits could take such forms!
‘Him!’
The captured Zodiacs were also surprised.
Aside from the eight Great spirits, no gods could take such forms.
The gods felt differently. Although Lee Gun was not as large as the Great Spirits, the god felt a feeling of awe and displeasure.
“Strip that appearance off him!”
However, Lee Gun flew into the sky as if he was mocking them. He activated the Divine item of Death.
Flash!
When Lee Gun tapped the tongs on his palm, an enormous explosion erupted.
Pah-ahng!!!
Enormous spheres of black flame appeared in various locations on the ground.
Kwahng!! Kwahng!
Each explosion had a radius of several hundred kilometers. The explosions engulfed all the gods, and screams rang out.
“Ahhhk!!”
Any god swept up in the explosions instantly perished.
When the black flames dissipated, numerous gems of light fell to the ground. They were all Divine statuses.
This shocked the remaining gods.
“He’s the god of death, and…!”
“Is that an offensive area-of-effect Divine item?”
It was very likely. This Divine item used the Divine status of Death.
Moreover, the advantages that the Zodiacs enjoyed grew larger when they acquired a Divine item.
The Divine item allowed them to drag out more of their abilities. It also allowed them to use their power better, making up for their shortcomings.
Once Lee Gun used the Divine item of Death, the range and power of his attack were beyond imaginable. However, it also meant there was a corresponding big weakness.
The gods of Valhalla were well aware of that. This was why they looked at the gods on the scaffold as if they wanted to attack them.
However, something surprising happened at that moment.
“Kuhk!”
“Huhk!”
“Ahhk!”
The bound gods of the thirteen Zodiacs as well as the oblivious Zodiac Saints were dispersed.
“Kuhk!”
They were hostages. Valhalla’s gods had purposefully spread them around so that Lee Gun couldn’t use his area-of-effect attack.
The gods of Valhalla then yelled at Lee Gun, “If you shoot indiscriminately, they’ll get swept up in the attack too!”
“Throw away your Divine item, or they will be the first to die.”
The gods of Valhalla extended their hands toward the thirteen Zodiacs and the human Zodiac Saints. Divine power infused with murderous intent appeared in their hands.
The thirteen Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints screamed.
They were cuffed right now because of the Great Spirit’s power. Their defensive abilities were basically that of regular humans.
Lee Gun merely laughed.
[You can attack. I don’t care.]
“L-Lee Gun-nim!”
“This isn’t a joke!”
The gods of Valhalla sent the attacks toward the hostages. At this distance, if Lee Gun used his Divine item, his allies would die.
Lee Gun waved his Divine item of Death as if he were fluttering a fan. Screams erupted from all directions.
Kwahng! Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Kuh…Kuh-huhk!”
“Kyahhhk!!”
The eyes of the thirteen Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints turned round. It didn’t matter which direction. The gods of Valhalla rose into the air and became meat shields for them.
It was as if the nearby gods were being pulled by a magnetic force. The gods gathered around the thirteen Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints. That wasn’t all.
“H-Hugo-nim?!!”
Hugo appeared before Lee Jaewon as a meat shield.
The gods’ attacks hit Hugo instead of Lee Jaewon, and he vomited blood.
“Lee Gun… You son of a…!”
“Hugo-nim!!”
Everyone looked at Lee Gun, wanting to know what was going on.
Lee Gun laughed like a fox as he spoke.
[Heaven’s Punishment is a weapon where one has to die for ten thousand to be revived.]
“!”
[Also, Fetters of the Underworld is a weapon where ten thousand have to be killed for one to be saved.]
Lee Gun held up the tongs as he let out a menacing laugh.
[Do you realize what this ability entails now?]
In other words, the name was befitting of what it did. To save one, it ruthlessly turned others into shields and killed them.
In truth, Heaven’s Punishment had killed countless monsters to save the lives of humanity. It was a weapon for slaughter.
However, the Divine item of Death was an implement used for shackling beings. No one could run away from Death. Anyone caught by the item had their bodies and souls shackled.
As proof of this, Lee Gun raised the Fetters of the Underworld, and something surprising happened.
“T…The gods…!”
The gods who had become meat shields moved according to his hand gestures as if something unseen was moving them around.
The Divine item of Death had the attractive force of gravity, a repulsive force, and the power to bind others. It was a tool that could capture its opponent. It had dominion over their death itself.
The gods of Valhalla had been lifted and tossed toward the direction in which Lee Gun had thrown his Divine item.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Ooh-ahhk!”
“Kuh-huhk!”
They flew like a cannonball. After colliding with the nearby buildings, they fell to the ground with grave injuries.
The Great Spirit of Valhalla’s eyebrows rose as he observed this.
[How pathetic.]
He slammed his cane on the ground. Enormous black holes formed beneath the scattered thirteen Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints.
He had created more execution grounds. Just falling into these holes would kill them. Everyone was in free fall as they started falling toward the holes.
“Ahhk!”
“Kyahhk!”
At that moment, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he swung Fetters of the Underworld. A powerful attractive force pulled all of them toward Lee Gun.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Kuhk!”
“Kuh-huhk!!”
They all flew toward Lee Gun’s side as they slammed into the ground.
Jun, the Divine status of Death, showed up. He used his scythe-like hands to cut and destroy the cube-shaped cuffs.
After getting rid of the cuffs, Jun jumped around in joy. “This is great! It’s a success! Master is mine with this!”
“Hey, who told you to become unruly like this?” Lee Gun tapped Jun’s head with the Divine item of Death.
Soon, Jun sniffled as he destroyed the holes being used as execution grounds. Just this act showed his incredible power.
[You won’t be able to execute anyone with this.]
Valhalla’s Great Spirit scoffed at this.
[They aren’t the only ones who were captured.]
Then, familiar faces appeared in front of Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
“Koo-oohk…! Master!”
“I…I’m sorry!”
They were Eeny, Meeny, and the others. They were Lee Gun’s original Constructs, who were left behind in Scorpio’s holy ground.
They were bloodied and close to death. Some looked to be already dead.
When the Great Spirit of Valhalla had captured the thirteen Zodiacs, it seemed they had also been swept up in this matter. They had put up a fight.
However, Lee Gun laughed as he looked at his Constructs. “I said it before. One can save ten thousand.”
Heaven’s Punishment was instantly summoned. Lee Gun took a big swing with his ax. He used the long shaft like a spear and drew a semicircle with it.
Suh-guhk!
Lee Gun then decapitated a giant, who had been sneaking up on him from the back. Something surprising happened the next moment.
“…!!”
Was it because of the power of Heaven’s Punishment? As soon as the giant god died, the power of Light erupted from the weakened Constructs.
[The power of revival is being applied.]
[The power to increase stamina has been applied.]
[All their Divine Power has been restored.]
This surprised everyone.
On the other hand, Lee Gun looked at Valhalla's Great Spirit with contempt.
[I know you purposefully let me use my abilities.]
“!”
Lee Gun knew why Valhalla’s Great Spirit was standing still.
[I can see what you are trying to do. Don’t even think about trying to collect my abilities with your eye. You can’t take them.]
[!]
Yes, Valhalla’s Great Spirit had allowed Lee Gun to do as he pleased for a reason. He could take any god’s power that fell within his field of vision.
It seemed he had planned to steal the abilities used by Lee Gun. This should be expected of a god who collected all knowledge and abilities.
In the end, Valhalla’s Great Spirit feigned laughter.
[Mimir told you.]
He finally started moving.
[You must think you are something because you were able to rescue the prisoners from Hel.]
When he moved, thousands of Valhalla’s gods followed.
[In front of countless stars, you’re merely like the glow of a firefly.]
At that moment…
[It’s all done, Master.]
Lee Gun heard a voice in his ear. He smirked as if he had been waiting for this. He spoke in a low voice.
[Come out.]
As if it were responding to his voice, the ground started to shake.
Koo-goo-goong!
The gods flinched.
Flash! Flash! Flash!
Gods were being summoned into the vast land as if they were responding to his call. There were thousands of them. It truly was a banquet of light.
“…!!”
The gods were unable to shut their mouths when they saw the familiar faces.
The newcomers weren’t just the gods who had been prisoners in Valhalla. They were all the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple who had been imprisoned by the eight great forces. They were the gods recovered by the Constructs who Lee Gun had rescued from Valhalla.
[Master of the Blue Sky is following the new Serpent Bearer.]
[Master of the Scenery is following the new Serpent Bearer.]
…
[Master of the Sword Light is following the new Serpent Bearer.]
Countless gods, including high-rank gods, appeared when Lee Gun called for them. The light they emitted instantly dyed the land. This wasn’t like the glow of fireflies.
Along with this, changes also occurred to Lee Gun’s body.
Flash!
Lee Gun stood at the center of the countless lights, and his power surged forth unlike before; it was the light of a Great Spirit!
Then something surprising happened.
Hwa-roo-roohk!!
The black flames covering half of his body now covered his entire body, and Lee Gun’s body also changed in size.
Flash!
The gods couldn’t believe their eyes.
Lee Gun had transformed into an enormous giant, and he was the same size as Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
“That appearance…!”
“N-No way!”
The gods were speechless. It was the appearance of a Great Spirit!
He was the ninth Great Spirit. The ninth great force had been revived.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - Great Spirit (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 418 - Great Spirit (1)
The eight Great Spirits were beings none of the gods could beat.
Among them were the Wheel of Fire, or the Sun Wheel; the Lord of the Sky, who could see through everything; the Lord of Light, whom evil could never approach; the Lord of Heaven, who delivered the punishment of the heavens; and so forth.
They were the ones propping up the Divine world and the leaders responsible for maintaining order in the Divine world.
They were the nobles among the nobles, who had once served the Primordial god. Moreover, their factions were called the eight great forces. They were considered the immutable powers that led the Divine world.
However, there had once been a time when there were nine great forces. It was a time when everyone had been surprised by their emergence, but they had disappeared in short order. And the ninth force wasn’t expected to appear again.
Hwa-roo-roohk!!
“…!”
Yet, the gods watched the revival of the ninth great force. Moreover, it appeared alongside a Great Spirit that looked completely different from the one before!
Koo-goo-goong!
The gods couldn’t believe their eyes. A violent and ominous black flame was burning up in front of them. The flame possessed a chaotic energy that seemed to destroy anything it touched.
The Zodiacs who had made their names as rulers looked puny before it. The energy was that overpowering.
Lee Gun’s appearance had shocked everyone.
“N…No way…!!”
“That appearance…!”
They couldn’t deny it since it had happened right before their eyes.
“That appearance… Only the gods with the great light can achieve…!”
[Great Spirit]
It was a suffocating feeling. They breathlessly looked at Lee Gun.
“Why the hell would the ninth great force show up now…!”
At this point, the bound thirteen Zodiacs started to tremble. They knew Lee Gun better than anyone and had watched Lee Gun since he was a human. The realization struck them all.
Lee Gun, who was one of the thirteen Zodiacs, had become the true master of the thirteen Zodiacs. His current appearance proved his qualifications and showed them the truth.
‘I never expected he would be capable of doing such a thing.’
The human Zodiac Saints, who were dragged here, also shook.
“T-Those on the earth would have fainted if they saw this.”
“Ha ha ha. They would have already fainted right now.”
When the angels of Eden appeared on the earth, they had set up transmission portals connected to the Divine world all over the earth.
The humans who were watching the transmission had probably fainted as they foamed from their mouths.
Lee Gun looked terrifying, yet he also inspired a sense of awe.
‘That’s the appearance of a stage-six Divine status.’
Lee Jaewon was so thrilled that he couldn’t speak. It really felt as if humanity was nothing before Lee Gun. He wondered if he could even step into Lee Gun’s shadows.
It felt as if Lee Gun would ascend far into the heavens and that no one could chase after him.
However, the gods didn’t seem to like what they were seeing.
“The ninth great force is obsolete in this day and age…!”
“What if you do look like a Great Spirit? It’s irrelevant!”
“Do you think just copying the outer appearance is enough?”
“You kept Eternal Change by your side and learned something useless!”
The high-rank gods glared at Lee Gun as they took out their Divine items. All these Divine items possessed powerful abilities.
Lee Gun merely smirked.
[Outer appearance?]
He lifted his hand high, making the billowing black flames erupt violently. They extended outward as he used his Divine power.
The Divine power, which had extended out in all directions, soon transformed into black lightning, which encircled Lee Gun’s arms.
Then, the Divine item of Death, the Fetters of the Underworld, reappeared.
Since he had become bigger, the Divine item had followed suit. Its appearance and texture turned huge and more brutal.
Finally, Lee Gun held his Divine item in his sixth-stage Divine status form and infused it with his power.
Koo-oohng!
‘!’
The gods immediately felt as if someone were squeezing their hearts. They couldn’t pinpoint what this sensation was, so they stood still. However, Valhalla’s Great Spirit glared at Lee Gun.
[Bastard.]
He seemed to have sensed something. The Great Spirit quickly brought his cane down on the ground, trying to use his ability. However, this gesture was something he didn’t normally do.
[Valhalla’s Great Spirit has used his Divine Achievement (Achievement).]
He had released an Achievement that he had amassed to block Lee Gun’s attack.
[(5 star)]
[(5 star)]
- Neutralizes all attacks
Lee Gun’s attack reached him as soon as he used his Achievement.
‘!’
It was a terrifying black light, which scared the gods. They felt the fear of Death, which they had never experienced before.
Since the Great Spirit of Valhalla was using his Achievement, the power let out a powerful light.
Flash!
The gods possessed a special ability called Divine Achievements (Achievements). They could be used to strengthen a god’s body or wielded like an ability.
The enormous power generated by the Achievement tried to swallow Lee Gun’s power.
Koo-goong!!!
The black light collided with the bright light.
When they saw the clash, the gods felt like they had forgotten how to breathe.
It was unclear as to how long had passed.
Koo-goo-goo-goo!
“…!”
The power of Death sent by Lee Gun disappeared. However, forcefully neutralizing that power seemed to have given the Great Spirit of Valhalla a backlash.
“…huhk!”
Valhalla’s Great Spirit had assumed the Achievement would completely neutralize Lee Gun’s power, but…
“The central area….!”
The power had not been completely swallowed up. Various locations in the central area were destroyed.
The gods were unable to shut their mouths. However, that wasn’t the sole reason the gods of Valhalla were frozen.
‘The Lord of the Sky had to use his Achievement.’
The gods immediately realized what it had been.
‘It was the highest rank Achievement.’
Divine Achievements (Achievement) normally went up to five stars, and the four-star rank was a unique rank. The five-star rank was the legendary rank.
The highest-rank Achievement could turn any attack into null. It was a special power. This was why all gods were obsessed with gathering high-rank Achievements.
‘That was one of the Achievements he rarely uses unless it’s a fight against another Great Spirit…!’
‘The snake god is that powerful?!’
The gods froze in shock. It all pointed toward one thing.
‘He really is a Great Spirit.’
‘He’s a Great Spirit.’
Of course, Lee Gun had met the requirement to become a Great Spirit. He had evolved his Divine status to stage 6. Moreover, he was a fighting-type god and occupied the highest position among the war gods.
‘We have no choice but to accept it…!’
On the other hand, Valhalla’s Great Spirit was trying not to groan for an entirely different reason.
‘My Achievement is gone.’
Yes, Achievements weren’t single use. However, the Achievement he had used ceased to exist when it blocked Lee Gun’s attack!
Valhalla’s Great Spirit glared at Lee Gun.
‘That bastard…!’
The power of Death could get rid of anything. It had gotten rid of the Achievement used by Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed.
[You blocked my power?]
This left Valhalla’s Great Spirit dumbfounded. He looked at Lee Gun.
The Lord of the Sky had taken much more damage. Did the snake god not realize that?
Valhalla’s Great Spirit had lost the extremely precious Neutralization Achievement, but he realized he had made the right choice in using it when he surveyed his surroundings.
If he hadn’t used it, the central region and at least half of the gods present here would have disappeared. The attack was that powerful and surprising.
On the other hand, it was unclear whether Lee Gun knew this or not. Lee Gun merely laughed.
[If I destroy all of you here, will I get sovereignty of Valhalla??]
When Lee Gun moved, the gods of Valhalla felt an unbearable amount of humiliation.
“He awakened not too long ago. How dare he speak such a ludicrous statement to the Great Spirit!”
Valhalla’s Great Spirit was one of the Great Spirits who had never gone through the process of inheritance.
Gods grew stronger in ability and internal force when they maintained their authority for a very long time. That was why…!
“That impudent bastard…”
Valhalla’s Great Spirit also started to raise his Divine power. He had no choice but to use his Achievement early because it had been a surprise attack. However, now that he had experienced it once, he had a grasp of Lee Gun’s power.
Of course, Lee Gun had used the overwhelming power of Death capable of getting rid of an Achievement. However, Valhalla’s great spirit was a resource of knowledge. He collected all knowledge and abilities.
‘I have a way to get rid of him as I keep him in check.’
However…
[Did you think you’re the only one who can use Achievements?]
“!”
Lee Gun let out a wicked laugh. That laugh gave the gods an ominous feeling.
Lee Gun immediately activated his Divine Achievement. Amongst his newly amassed Achievements, this was the highest-rank one, an Achievement that all gods coveted.
[You have used an Achievement that you amassed earlier.]
[(6 star)]
A light erupted alongside those words. The light was on another level compared to the light of the 5-star-rank Achievement.
The gods ground their teeth when they saw the light.
‘We thought he wouldn’t be able to handle it!’
It was very difficult to handle, but the six-star-rank powers had already surpassed the legendary rank. What would happen if this power was used against a Great Spirit?
‘We have to stop him.’
The flustered gods quickly mobilized, but Lee Gun ignored them. He laughed.
[You are too late.]
As he used his Achievement, he once again sent forth the power of Death. It felt as if heaven and earth were shaking violently.
Boom!
Valhalla’s Great Spirit had predicted a backlash, so he used his ability. However, it was useless.
Kwahng!!!
A never-seen-before light appeared before them. This light instantly covered the entirety of the Divine world.
The gods couldn’t remember what happened after that.
“Ahhhk!!”
An unimaginable cataclysmic event occurred.
* * *
It was like watching creation— No, it was like watching a cataclysmic change.
The heavens surged upward, and the ground split apart. The ceiling became the floor, and the floor became the ceiling.
Everything was switched as the power swept through it.
The gods swept up in the light had no idea of what was going on. They were busy protecting themselves, barely preserving their own lives.
“Ahhhk! Help!”
“Shit!”
Screams rang out from all directions. The enormous power had hit the gods like a tsunami.
All the gods gathered in the central region, Valhalla’s Great Spirit, Lee Gun, and the thirteen Zodiacs were scattered toward different locations.
Their screams stopped only after several minutes had passed, only after the horrifying dark clouds that seemed to portent the end of the world disappeared.
“Koo-oohk…! That bastard of a snake god…!”
“Is everyone ok?”
However, the gods had a hard time speaking when they opened their eyes.
“What’s wrong?”
“That is…”
Those who had regained their senses first just sat there with their mouths open. The other gods looked in the same direction when screams mixed with despair rang all around the Divine world.
“What the hell? The sky and the ground are gone!”
“What?!”
Lee Gun had used the six-star-rank Achievement alongside his own power.
All the objects of the Divine world that had gotten swept up by his power couldn’t be seen. Moreover, it wasn’t as if a part of a region had disappeared.
“It’s all the eighth district!”
The only thing they saw was the debris of the Divine world, the debris of buildings floating through space.
Everyone screamed. They were barely clinging to the surfaces. This was true of the thirteen Zodiacs and Zodiac Saints as well.
“What… is this…!”
Sagittarius, Virgo, as well as Leo, couldn’t shut their mouths in this preposterous situation.
The Divine world itself was gone!

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - Great Spirit (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 419 - Great Spirit (2)
“This is crazy…!”
Everyone rubbed their eyes, but the Divine world was still nowhere to be seen. Olympus being blasted away was cute compared to this.
All the regions of the Divine world had been blasted away, including the central district, Valhalla, and Ennead.
The only regions that still existed were specialized regions, such as the underworld and the Samsara Hell. Even these barely had enough oxygen to breathe.
Aside from regions with specialized Unravel spells, Death had swept away everything else.
The gods were beyond frightened. They almost let go of their sanity.
It was unclear if Lee Gun could understand their shock. He had returned to his smaller human form and burst out laughing. “Ha ha ha. This feels awesome! It really feels clean now that it is all gone!”
“…?!!!”Lee Gun was sprawled out in the central district… no, on the land where the central district used to exist.
As he laughed on his back, he viewed space in front of his eyes.
[You have acquired a new Achievement.]
[Destroyed the Divine world (6 star)]
“I should have done this from the start.”
The thirteen Zodiacs were beyond shocked. They had a mental breakdown as they screamed.
“You crazy bastard! You should have left behind somewhere where we can live!”
“I can’t believe you came up with the idea of blowing up the Pantheon!”
“My stuff…! Compensate me!”
“Who cares? Your house is my house, right?”
“#*#$&*#!”
The gods grabbed the back of their necks. How could someone like him be the master of the thirteen Zodiacs? Their blood pressure rose.
It was apparent that he had destroyed the Divine world without a trace, but…
‘How is this possible?’
Pantheon was where the gods lived. It was the largest residential area and was like the holy land for the gods. It couldn’t be destroyed through force.
It was a fortress that possessed special defensive abilities, and it had even stopped the invasion of the outer gods. Yet Lee Gun had destroyed it in one go!
The Great-Spirit-rank Death was beyond imagination. Of course, this destruction had been possible because Lee Gun combined his power with a six-star destructive Achievement…!
‘Is he confident that he’ll be able to handle the Karmic debt?’
However, Lee Gun didn’t look any different. He didn’t show any signs of changing into an evil god. This was why the gods had a realization.
‘Could it be? Destroying the Divine world doesn’t count as Karmic debt?’
‘There is no way…!’
‘It might be possible if he possesses Great-Spirit-rank permission tickets (Exoneration).’
Anyway, it was a relief since nothing bad was occurring to Lee Gun.
“He really was a psychotic bastard.”
“!”
The nearby gods started to take up their weapons once again as they looked at Lee Gun. They had barely kept their lives by remaining out of Death’s way, but they had lost all their land and wealth. Naturally, they were pissed.
It also looked like Lee Gun had expended quite a lot of power. He was no longer a giant and had returned to his original form. Clearly, the gods saw him as someone they could defeat.
Moreover, it did seem like Lee Gun was lying down because he was tired and unable to get up.
Therefore, the gods approached him.
“Did you think there would be no consequences for doing this?”
However, Lee Gun looked at them as if it wasn’t a problem. “What? You just have to fix it. Don’t you guys have hands and feet?”
The gods glared at him. It seemed the bastard was oblivious to the reality.
“Not anyone can fix the foundation of the Divine world!”
“Is that so?”
“It’s possible to repair minor stuff like the outer walls, but the foundation is a different story!”
“Oh. Is that so?”
“That’s right. The ones to make the Divine world are the now-extinct Creators. It cannot be rebuilt or repaired without the Creator tribe…”
“Ah ha! I see. It can’t be fixed without a Creator.”
“Now you know….”
The gods soon became silent.
For some reason, Lee Gun was snickering. The gods wanted him to take responsibility for his action, so his reaction puzzled them. However, they screamed when the trailing gods caught up to them.
“C…Creator?!”
“That bastard is a Creator?!”
It seemed some gods had received the news about Lee Gun, and they had a mental breakdown. Numerous gods looked devastated.
‘It means our building and belongings….’
‘He’s the only one capable of fixing it…!’
Lee Gun grinned as if he had read their thoughts. “Good luck with the recovery. You guys handle it.”
The gods grabbed the back of their necks again.
“Let’s consult the pillar gods!”
“Let’s have a meeting with the Great Spirits!”
The gods immediately went away. A couple of them wanted to capture Lee Gun, but they didn’t dare do it.
Although Lee Gun looked to be lying down from exhaustion, this wasn’t the case. Overpowering Divine power was leaking out of him, and the gods felt as if the power was choking them around the neck.
Moreover, Jun, the Divine status of Death, was also there. His hackles rose whenever the gods looked at Lee Gun.
‘If he is indeed a Great-Spirit-rank…’
They didn’t dare lay a hand on him. The gods could only look, and they soon went away.
Seeing this, the human Zodiac Saints crumpled to the ground; they had almost died.
“We were dragged to the Divine world out of nowhere, and we were almost executed…!”
“If it wasn’t for Lee Gun-nim…”
On the other hand, Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. “Why are you guys here? Are you here to play?”
“Of course not!!”
Seven humans had been dragged here: Lee Jaewon, Goat, Carly, Sophie, Taylor, Kevin, and an unknown reporter.
“Damn it! I was suddenly chosen as Capricorn…!” Kevin, who had been in hiding before this incident, spoke up.
Lee Gun had an understanding when he heard Kevin’s words. “I see. That was why you guys were dragged here.”
“What? Why?!”
Lee Gun acted as if it wasn’t a big deal. He pointed at the Zodiac Saints. “I ate the other Zodiacs. Since the Zodiacs were missing, they automatically dragged the second in charge. They brought the chicken instead of the pheasant.”
“What?!”
Carly screamed since she had been registered as Libra, while Goat tilted his head in puzzlement.
“Why was I chosen as Taurus…?”
Lee Jaewon clutched at Lee Gun. “W…Why was I chosen as Cancer?!”
Lee Jaewon wondered why he was recognized as Cancer among all the Zodiacs.
Lee Gun laughed. “It was my doing. The probability of me becoming a Great Spirit rose as the number of Zodiacs following me rose.”
“What?!”
In other words, Lee Gun had been working toward fulfilling the requirements needed to become a Great Spirit. This was why Iaso was chosen as the Zodiac of the Aquarius temple. Like her, he had designated the others as Zodiacs for the remaining empty temples.
If they were registered with the thrones, they didn’t need Divine status to be perceived as Zodiacs.
Sophie was in awe. “Then I am here because you designated me as Aquarius. Finally, you acknowledged my skill…!”
“No, you were dragged here instead of Iaso. You were dragged here to be executed instead of her.”
“?!”
Everyone despaired when they heard his words.
Lee Jaewon was unsteady on his feet from the shock he felt. But he soon spoke up. “Is it ok to not bring Hugo-nim here? You left him in a nest of gods….”
“I don’t care.”
“Ah! As expected, you trust Hugo-nim. That is why—”
“I ended my relationship with him.”
“What?”
“What?!!!”
Everyone was shocked, but Lee Gun merely furrowed his brows. The Zodiac Saints thought he was lying, but when they looked into his eyes, they realized he wasn’t joking.
‘Lee Gun-nim really ended his relationship with him?’
‘Why??’
Lee Gun seemed disinterested in the topic and turned around. He had more important matters to take care of.
“Master! This is bad! The gods are mobilizing toward us.”
Leo cackled when he heard that shout.
“The snake god is the only one who can fix the Divine world! They are probably coming to kowtow toward you! They should have done that in the first place!”
“No way! He smashed their houses! There is no way they’ll bow their heads before him!”
Sagittarius spoke out in anger. Their intention was obvious.
‘War.’
The Great Spirits were going to combine their strength to put pressure on Lee Gun.
If the evil gods were telling the truth, the Great Spirits had used an unknown method to assassinate the Primordial god. And Lee Gun now possessed the Primordial god in question.
‘There is no way they’ll attack haphazardly.’
The gods had lost their base, so they’d have to go elsewhere to prepare for the war.
“They’ll move to their colonies and try to accumulate as much power as they can.”
They managed their dimensions in name only. There was a reason the lands of the Zodiacs were called Colonies.
Lee Gun was the exception.
Normally, Zodiacs only took things that benefited them from the colonies. They didn’t care if the residents died or not. To the Zodiacs, the residents of their colonies were mere slaves.
For gods, it was a given that their disciples would be sacrificed.
“Your opponents number in the tens of thousands. Let’s say each of them possesses at least ten colonies. They are no joke. Earth is your only colony.”
“You might have acquired Eden’s colonies, but they are too small. In terms of supplies for war, the difference is too much.”
That wasn’t all.
“Master. Some of the enemies’ colonies are filled with overwhelmingly powerful warriors.”
“If we don’t hurry and make preparations…”
Lee Gun laughed. “Why do you think I spent so much time at Valhalla’s prison?”
“!”
Lee Gun took out something from his pocket. It was an envelope. It was filled with gems that looked to be Divine statuses.
This surprised the Constructs.
“Aren’t those magical beast gods!’
The gods had a category of animal gods. They were closer to being fantastic beasts.
Like the Creators, they were gods directly under the Primordial god. If Creators were manufacturer gods, the magical beast gods were like the Primordial god’s eyes. They took on the role of observer and differentiator.
In other words, they were high-rank gods amongst the high-rank gods.
‘However, all those gods had suddenly disappeared.’
Mimir looked surprised. “How did you…!”
“You told me before. The magical beast gods were the ones who originally looked over the colonies.”
“Yes. I did tell you that, but….”
However, Mimir had never expected Lee Gun to actually bring them.
The Constructs were taken aback as they approached Lee Gun.
“We heard a rumor that Valhalla had captured them, but…”
“Those assholes… They killed all the magical beast gods, yet they didn’t let them go through the process of inheritance?”
“No. I killed half of them.”
“What?!!!’
“As soon as they saw me, they accused me of stealing the Primordial god. They tried to kill me.”
“….”
The gods clutched at their faces.
Lee Gun ignored them as he used the power of Life.
This worried everyone.
“There are a lot of them. Are you sure about reviving all of them at once? You’ll have to expend an incredible amount of power since they are the magical beast gods…!”
“What if the enemies attack while you are recovering? It’ll be dangerous!”
Lee Gun merely let out a bright smile as he lifted Heaven’s Punishment. Then he brought it down against the ground.
Kwah-jeek!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
At the same time, a god hiding underground screamed as he vomited blood. He had been spying on Lee Gun to pass on information.
When Lee Gun killed him, an enormous light appeared within the envelope.
[The Divine item of Life is using its power.]
[The death of an enemy has been used as the power of revival.]
Accompanying the notification, revived beasts shot out of the envelope.
[The magical beasts are awakening.]
[The magical beasts are awakening.]
“I don’t have to use my power with this.”
This scene moved everyone.
Lee Gun had revived the magical beasts using the Divine item of Life.
This shocked the gods monitoring him from a distance.
‘He revived the magical beasts!’
‘No! The magical beasts are capable of taking back the colonies!’
‘We have to notify everyone before he revives all of them…!’
At that moment…
‘…!’
Those gods felt chills run up their backs. They met eyes with Lee Gun, who held up Heaven’s Punishment. Lee Gun smirked as he immediately threw the weapon.
Kwahng!!!
The ax flew like a boomerang as it pierced through the gods’ heads. The light of Life surged forth a couple more times.
Flash! Flash!
Finally, all the magical beasts within the envelope had been revived.
Koo-goo-goong!!
“…!”
These magical beasts were gods who were surprisingly strong. However, the Constructs looked on with worry.
“Magical beasts are proud beings. I wonder if they will bow to Master…”
Then, something unexpected happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - Great Spirit (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 420 - Great Spirit (3)
“Oh, great servant of the Serpent Bearer.”
“A-Are you sure you are ok?”
Hugo, who had been thrown aside by Lee Gun, groaned as he walked forward. He had almost died after getting swept up in the great explosion of the Divine world.
‘I have no idea if that bastard thinks things through before using his abilities.’
All of Lee Gun’s allies had been gathered around him. Hugo was the only one left out. This was why Hugo was a bloody mess.
The Virgo Constructs followed Hugo, looking worried.
“Great servant!”
“I heard you plan to give up being Baby snake-nim’s servant!”
“It isn’t too late to change your mind….”
“Damn it! Stop referring to me as the servant— Kuhk!”
The Virgo Constructs had been following Hugo with medicine in tow. When a raggedy Hugo keeled over, they gathered around him.
It seemed they had chased after him under Virgo’s orders. While Hugo might be a first-generation monarch, Virgo had been worried about him as humanity’s Zodiac Saint.
“It isn’t too late. You just have to apologize to Baby snake-nim….”
“No. That’s definitely out of the question.” Hugo started to sweat as he recalled the insults Lee Gun had thrown at him and the question his friend had asked him before pilfering Valhalla’s prison.
- I don’t care about your past life, but I want to confirm one thing. Don’t even think about lying. Answer truthfully as my friend.
- You are on humanity’s side, right? No. You’re on my side, right? I just need to confirm this.
Hugo had hesitated in answering, and it seemed Lee Gun hadn’t appreciated this reaction from him. The Serpent Bearer had immediately taken out Heaven’s punishment.
Lee Gun had realized Hugo was close to recovering all of his memories, so he sensed an ominous feeling.
- You have a family. You aren’t going to suddenly spout nonsense like you’re going to visit your wife’s family or something, right?
- You’re asking the question with that weapon in hand. Aren’t you already making a threat?
- You chose Miss Jiwoo, who is a human. It proves that you’re a different person. You will side with humanity, right?
- I’m not sure. I don’t think I met Jiwoo because I am separate from my past life.
- What?
- It seems Eternal Change’s instinct is why I chose you and Jiwoo.
- What did you just say?
Hugo spoke to a glaring Lee Gun.
- Since you want honesty, I’ll be honest. Jiwoo is a god.
- What?
- She might be a bit different from Kevin, but she also went through the Samsara Hell like him. She was a low-rank god who used to serve the Creators and was reborn as a human.
Hugo continued as if he was annoyed.
- Gods are great prey. That’s why I instinctively chose Jiwoo. It’s like Abyss, who goes nuts when it comes to gods.
- Are you playing with me? If that reasoning holds true, you would have gotten along famously with the eunuch. Unlike the other Zodiac Saints, he used to be a Zodiac in the past.
- He’s a pigeon. He stinks too much to eat.
Lee Gun became angry when Hugo spoke like a monster. However, Hugo didn’t care as he revealed his true self.
- You probably heard it from Scorpio. I was caught by the Creators because I invaded the Primordial god’s quarters. I was turned into a slave, and the death of all the Creators was the only way I would be freed.
- So?
- I killed all the Creators, and I thought I was finally freed from my fetters. That was when I found out Aslan was still alive. I had to rot away in prison for several hundred years more. When he died, I thought I was finally free, but you came along.
- …!
- Once you were born, the restriction placed on me was reactivated. That was why I couldn’t do anything against you. I was pushed around like an idiot. That was why I stayed quiet. I was waiting for you to have a kid to get my revenge. Do you realize how much it sucks to be treated like a dog by the Creators? It’s tiresome.
Lee Gun looked at Hugo to see if the latter were serious.
Hugo clicked his tongue.
- If you don’t believe me, you can check my faith.
Lee Gun checked Hugo’s Faith.
[Hugo Otis]
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 0%]
Lee Gun let out a cold smile.
- You eliminated your Faith. Is that it? I’m disappointed. Is that all you have to say?
- No.
- ?
- I can get rid of your hair at the roots.
Hugo remembered the sight of a furious Lee Gun lifting Heaven’s Punishment into the air. He shook as he had trouble breathing.
This puzzled the Virgo Constructs.
“Servant-nim! Servant-nim! Are you ok?”
“What’s wrong?”
Hugo shook as that memory still scared him. If he were being honest, it was a miracle that Lee Gun hadn’t killed him.
Lee Gun had been so angry that he had come up with inventive cuss words.
- It means you have no plans on siding with humanity. Your faith is proof of this.
- Yes. I’ll be honest. Now that I have recovered my memories, I’m too disgusted to be with you. You can go die as an eternal virgin for all I care!
- Did you finish making your will?
Despite saying those words, Hugo had shaken like a mouse since he had thought he really was going to die.
‘If I didn’t have my kids, I really would have died.’
It seemed Hugo had barely kept his life because Lee Gun didn’t want to turn his niece and nephew into orphans.
Instead, Lee Gun had ended his relationship with Hugo.
“S-Servant-nim? It isn’t too late to apologize…”
“No. This is better for everyone…”
“What?”
It would be for the best if Hugo stopped himself from getting closer to Lee Gun. This was more true now that Lee Gun was the god of Life and Cycle.
While Hugo didn’t give them an answer, the Virgo Constructs immediately realized what was going on.
‘It has to do with the Karmic debt still attached to Eternal Change…!’
‘It probably has to do with the Karmic debt that the Great Spirits placed on him…’
‘I’m sure it was from the time when the Great Spirits captured him…!’
At that moment, Hugo got up. The surprised Virgo Constructs asked him, “Servant-nim? Where are you going?”
“I have to go to Wind.”
* * *
Aside from the Great Spirits of Ennead and Eden, all the gods had gathered in this temporary dimension.
“What? You want us to give up on looking for Aslan?”
The gods were surprised at the Great Spirit’s words. It was to be expected, since the Creators were the only ones capable of restoring the Divine world.
Although Aslan had been in slime form, they had indeed located him, a Creator.
“If it isn’t Aslan, we have to leave the restoration of the Divine world to the snake god!”
“Given his personality, there is no way he’ll obediently fix it for us!”
“The master craftsmen are saying that there is no way they can recover the Divine world. They’ve given up!”
They didn’t want to kneel before Lee Gun even if it meant certain death. The gods wondered whether something could be worked out if they found Aslan.
However, the Great Spirits knew something.
‘Aslan can’t do it.’
Aslan indeed possessed the Creation ability. He could use a variety of skills such as Rewind Object and Rewind Time. It might be possible for him to restore the Divine world.
The problem was that Aslan was now Lee Gun’s item. Moreover, Aslan’s ability didn’t deal with objects. He was someone who wielded abilities. There was no way he would be able to completely recover the Divine world.
On the other hand, Lee Gun was the highest-rank god when it came to manufacturing.
‘Only he can fix the Divine world.’
Still, this didn’t mean they would kneel toward a newly born snake. There was another way.
[Use the colonies.]
“!”
Colonies were sources of power for the Zodiacs. Zodiacs acquired tributes by working with the residents of the colonies and grew their power by receiving the residents’ faith.
[Tell the residents to confess to the Zodiacs. The Zodiacs will gather all the tributes from their colonies.]
This surprised the gods. Faith was a measure of a god’s power.
‘It’s a way for gods to raise their power.’
‘It will definitely increase the power of their Divine items and their abilities.’
However…
“We are already walking a very tight rope in taking from the colonies.”
“Won’t they object?”
[It isn’t worth answering that.]
“!”
Those who didn’t believe and follow the gods would be executed. That was how the Zodiacs ruled over their creations.
[All the residents of the colonies exist to serve the gods.]
[Who do they think allows them to keep their lives?]
“Then…!”
[Set the tax rate as 100%.]
[Take their souls as well as their bodies. Convert all of them into Divine power.]
[The residents of colonies especially exist for situations like this.]
[They are creatures that exist for this.]
The gods lowered their heads at the obvious logic.
“We’ll head out right now.”
However, something bothered even the Great Spirits.
[We have received a report saying the snake god took magical beasts from Valhalla.]
The mood of the gods changed on a dime. The reason was the mention of “magical beast gods.” They were like the Creators—dutiful gods that worked directly under the Primordial god. Moreover, they had a terrible relationship with the Zodiacs.
“They are the ones that monitor the gods.”
In other words, they were like secret agents that acted as inspectors. They were like spirits, and they could discern the good and bad between the gods. They had the ability to forcefully reclaim the colonies.
The gods were worried.
“They are all dead now, but if the snake god revives them…”
[He'll revive them.]
“That’ll be dangerous…!”
The Great Spirits laughed.
[Magical beast gods do not do anything that’ll benefit a Zodiac. Moreover, it’ll be beneficial for the snake god if they reclaim the colonies. There is no way they’ll cooperate with the snake god.]
[They are the dogs of the Primordial god, who hates the Zodiacs. The Primordial god was put through the inheritance process by the snake god. There is no way they’ll cooperate with him since they will consider him their enemy.]
In fact, Lee Gun might lose his colony now that he had revived them.
[No one can train the magical beast gods. They are proud.]
After hearing those words from the highest-rank gods, the other gods lowered their heads.
* * *
“What the hell are you guys doing?” Lee Gun contemptuously looked at the magical beasts before him.
His Constructs were nervous as they looked back and forth between Lee Gun and the magical beasts.
“M-Master…!”
“What is there to like that you guys are exposing your bellies like this?”
“…!”
Several dozen magical beasts were lying down in front of Lee Gun with their bellies exposed. It was as if they were submitting to the pack leader.
The Constructs looked on in shock.
“They usually hate the Zodiacs….!”
“Hey! Why are you doing things that you’ve never done before?”
The magical beast gods held a grudge against the Zodiacs, so they should have attacked Lee Gun instead of exposing their bellies like this.
It was such a shock that Lee Gun’s Constructs cursed.
On the other hand, the beasts exposing their bellies were trembling. The Constructs feigned laughter when they saw this.
“Look at them!”
[Shut up! Damn gods! Shut up before we kill you!]
“!”
Thanks to Lee Gun’s power of revival, they had inherited their power. It meant they looked like young beasts.
Since they had gone through the process of inheritance, it was akin to reincarnation. Normally, they wouldn’t have memories of their past lives.
However, magical beast gods were like spirits; they shared memories. Like beasts, the instincts of their predecessors were infused into their souls.
This was why they remembered the instincts of the previous generation of magical beast gods.
‘We shouldn’t attack that psychotic bastard.’
The instinct of a beast was speaking to them! Obviously, the memories of Lee Gun slaughtering them were ingrained in their souls.
Lee Gun snorted. It seemed crushing the magical beasts’ heads with the Primordial god Head Smasher had been effective. He had done it because they had been disobedient.
“I don’t know what exactly happened, but I guess I don’t have to mentally train them.” Lee Gun swung the Head Smasher in a circle.
Stricken with fear, the magical beast gods exposed their bellies even more. At the same time, the magical beast gods who had inherited their power whispered among themselves.
‘I don’t know what’s going on, but this isn’t it!’
‘I…It’s fine! Endure it until we can bring back the Primordial god!’
‘My instinct tells me to do this! What can I do about it?’
They weren’t sure of it, but they could feel the energy of the Primordial god emanating from Lee Gun. This was why they had decided to bide their time.
[W…We will follow you for now!]
[Please withdraw your weapon!]
The Constructs looked at Lee Gun in surprise.
“It seems they are loyal to you since you possess the Primordial god.”
[That’s right. It will be very beneficial to you—]
Poo-hahk!!!
Lee Gun ruthlessly used Fetters of the Underworld on the magical beasts showing their bellies and sent them flying.
Several of the magical beast gods vomited blood as they fell over. Aggrieved, they looked at Lee Gun.
[N-New master…! Why!]
[Our loyalty…!]
Lee Gun snorted. “I don’t trust others easily.”
[What??]
“Everyone hates my guts when they see me. There’s no way you guys would come toward me like this without an ulterior motive.”
[Just trust us a bit, bastard!]
[We already submitted to you! Well, we might have submitted to you, but I doubt our leader will yield to you!]
Lee Gun chuckled. “Whatever.”
[!]
“If you follow this order from me, I’ll acknowledge your loyalty.” Lee Gun smirked.
The gods were getting ready for war in their colonies. He would make sure they would have to beg him on their knees.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - Great Spirit (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 421 - Great Spirit (4)
Colonies were all the lands, besides the Divine world’s Pantheon, which belonged to the gods. They were places like the earth, lands where creatures went on to live normal lives. However, all these lands had become colonies for the gods.
A land without a god either died off or was invaded by the Cluders. Thus, these lands needed guardians.
As a price for their protection, the residents had to sacrifice faith, offerings, and labor.
Of course, it was no longer a give-and-take relationship. It was a one-sided relationship where the god was worshiped like the king of the planet. This change was seen as reasonable.
In reality, the colonies had been mobilized in the wars between gods, and countless lives had been expended for the gods. The residents also worked hard labor for the gods.
At times, the gods sold them for various purposes to make money, as if they were chips. This was especially true now that Lee Gun had destroyed the Divine world.
[Bring us offerings!]
[Your faith will become the Divine power!]
“Oh, lord. We have nothing to offer!”
[It doesn’t matter. Your lives can contribute to becoming the ability of a god.]
[You should voluntarily sacrifice your lives so that you can become the power of a god.]
The gods had no intention of lowering themselves to Lee Gun.
“It’s only natural to gather resources for war! Open the doors to the colonies!”
If tens of thousands of gods used their colonies to get ready for war, even Lee Gun shouldn’t be able to handle them. At the very least, everyone would be able to increase their powers by a notch. At most, they could increase their power by several notches.
“Don’t play into the hand of that rookie god!”
“We only acknowledge the existence of eight Great Spirits—”
Koo-goo-goong!!
Suddenly, the colonies, which had received orders from all the Zodiacs, experienced changes.
[Your authority as a ruler has been reclaimed.]
[The colonies are being sealed.]
[Seals are being placed over 138,398,990 dimensions.]
[No god can take any item from the colonies.]
[The lands of the colonies have been reclaimed.]
[Reclaimed.]
[Reclaimed.]
…
[Reclaimed.]
As soon as the notification spread, the Zodiacs of the Pantheon lost connection to their colonies. Tens of thousands of Zodiacs were stunned.
“Wait…! We lost connection to the colonies! What is going on?”
“Our authority over them was reclaimed!”
“Reclaimed? That means we can’t take any offerings?”
“Offerings aren’t the problem! Our Faith was severed too! Our powers are dropping!”
“My money…! My wealth…!”
The rights to the colonies were an innate power of the Zodiacs, yet those rights had been taken back. This caused a commotion.
“Who did this!?”
“Only the Primordial god can pull this off…!”
“No! The magical beasts! They seized the Colonies!”
“What? Those beasts did this?”
“Find them!”
When their rights over their colonies were suddenly taken back, the gods couldn’t hide their confusion.
There was one exception: the new Great Spirit. He couldn’t hide his joy and was laughing.
[Magical Beast 38 has reclaimed colony no. 32,893.]
[Magical Beast 39 has reclaimed colony no. 32,894 with great difficulty.]
[Magical Beast 40 has reclaimed colony 32,895 as it whines]
‘Reclaimed. Reclaimed. Reclaimed. Reclaimed!’
Lee Gun laughed as he used the magical beasts to take the wealth belonging to the other gods. “Idiots. Try waging a war without capital!”
Lee Gun’s Constructs were sweating bullets as they watched him laugh.
“I never knew such a thing was possible.”
“Well, the magical beast gods are high-rank civil servants of the Divine world.”
Moreover, they worked directly under the Primordial god! They were the eyes of the Primordial god. And since they were closer to being spirits, they could differentiate between good and evil.
This was why most of them worked as civil servants.
They were either in charge of judging a Zodiac’s promotion or they went out to catch the fallen gods. In the process, they confiscated the gods’ wealth.
Since they were close to being spirits, they held no desire for worldly goods. It was why they had received this job.
‘It was an ability given to them by the Primordial god.’
If the Creators were the Primordial god’s artisans, the magical beast gods were his secret inspectors.
Of course, the reclamation of wealth worked for a limited time. It wasn’t stealing the wealth, but more like freezing the flow of goods.
Nevertheless, their actions were quite beneficial to Lee Gun right now.
[The magical beast gods have used the highest-rank Reclamation.]
[The Zodiacs cannot bring tributes from the colonies.]
[The Zodiacs cannot take Faith.]
[The Zodiacs cannot use any of their power.]
Satisfied with tying the hands and feet of the Zodiacs, Lee Gun laughed.
Of course, the magical beast gods talked amongst themselves as they questioned if this was really a good idea.
‘It seems we can use our abilities, but is it really ok to reclaim everything like this?’
‘Won’t we incur Karmic debt?’
‘We won’t. We merely seized stuff from gods who were violating the rules.’
The problem was that all the Zodiacs had fallen into this category. As if to prove this, one of the magical beast gods extended its hand, making a long roll of paper appear in the air.
[Colony no. 378,378: Non-payment of costs. Non-payment of wages.]
…
[Colony no. 482,939: Non-payment of costs. Non-payment of wages.]
Lee Gun laughed. “Those bastards only took from the colonies. They did nothing for the colonies.”
In fact, this had been going on for several hundred years. Some gods had done it for several thousands of years on the high end.
The Constructs oddly looked at the magical beast gods as if they were talking nonsense.
“What do you mean the Zodiacs have to do something for the colonies?”
“Why would the Zodiacs do such a thing for mere residents of the colonies…”
This angered the magical beasts.
[Shut up, damn gods! Did you think it makes sense that those lands are called colonies!]
“???”
The eyes of the gods turned round. They had no idea what the magical beast gods were talking about.
This made the magical beasts ground their teeth.
[Damn it! How long has it been since we lost our lives?]
“I’m not sure. You guys disappeared alongside the Primordial god…?”
In other words, a very long time had passed. The magical beasts felt indignant.
[I was wondering why the lands were close to being seized. It seems a long time has passed. Anyway, they weren’t originally called colonies. They were called Protected Lands!]
“P...Protected lands?”
[That’s right! Originally, the Zodiacs had to defend each dimension, and in return, they received faith and offerings! It was set up to be like that!]
[Ah-ha. I get it now. Those bastards killed us because they wanted to turn the Protected lands into colonies.]
Lee Gun laughed as if he found this amusing. “Those bastards?”
[I’m talking about the Great Spirits!]
“!”
The gods were surprised.
“Are you saying the Great Spirits killed the magical beasts?”
[That’s right! They were irritated that we were monitoring them.]
The Constructs looked at them as if something didn’t make sense.
“Why would they be irritated? The residents of the Colonies can live because of the existence of the gods.”
“If there are no gods, the residents cannot exist either…”
The magical beasts became angry.
[No! It’s the opposite! Gods exist because the residents exist!]
This surprised the gods. What the hell were the magical beasts talking about?
The magical beast gods spoke as they looked at Lee Gun.
[If the Zodiacs travel to the settlements, the settlements get destroyed. You know this, right?]
“Yes. I was told it’s the rule of the Divine world.”
There was a reason the Zodiacs took on Zodiac Saints. Lee Gun also had to seal his abilities so that his presence wouldn’t destroy the earth.
The magical beast gods said something unexpected.
[‘Zodiacs cannot directly travel to the lands that they rule over. If this rule is violated, the land where the Zodiac is headed to will be destroyed.’]
[The one to make this rule was the Primordial god.]
“!”
They wanted to ask why such a rule was made when the magical beast gods continued.
[At the time, the Great Spirits had killed beings made of flesh and blood. They had tried to squeeze out blood and sweat from the residents.]
[Thus, the Primordial god had decided that beings made of flesh and blood should be protected. The Great Spirits thought of them as slaves that could be used to stabilize their own situation.]
There was a story that mentioned that the Primordial god and the Great Spirits disagreed on this point.
[This was why the Primordial god ordered the Creators to make the Rule Book. It was made so that the gods couldn’t go to the Protected lands…]
Even the Zodiacs wouldn’t destroy something they would profit from.
Lee Gun took notice of those words.
“Ah! The Rule Book was created by the Creators?”
[That is correct.]
Although it was a copy, Lee Gun thought about the rule book that he had taken from the goddesses of fate.
‘I was wondering why I could read it and edit it.’
At that moment…
“!”
Was it because Lee Gun had turned the Primordial god into his Construct?
[There is a remaining Achievement.]
[Took in the Primordial god as a Construct (6 star)]
[The corresponding Achievement can be used to bring the magical beast gods into the Serpent Bearer temple as Constructs. It is possible since they are subordinates of the Primordial god.]
[Would you like to use the Achievement?]
“!”
Lee Gun immediately used it. Then, an enormous light engulfed the magical beast gods.
[All the magical beast gods have been brought in as Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
[You have acquired the ability of the magical beast gods: Eye of the Great Soul.]
[You have used the Eye of the Great Soul.]
However, the light dissipated after engulfing the magical beast gods. Lee Gun realized something as he looked in the direction that the light was traveling in. “Ah. Those crazy bastards…”
“Master? What’s going on?”
Lee Gun took out something instead of giving an answer. It was a Divine status that he had previously acquired, the Divine status of Eco, a Construct of Olympus.
When he used his Creation ability to turn it into an item, something surprising appeared. It was an item that looked like a small microphone.
[Made from someone. Forgot the name. (EX)]
- Mic made from Eco (Echo)
- Anyone within its range can hear your voice
Lee Gun brought the item to his mouth, then something surprising happened.
[Ah ah! Mic test! Hey, you shitty ass gods.]
“!!!”
The nearby gods screamed as they covered their ears.
“M…Master’s voice is…!”
“It’s ringing inside my head…!”
Screams erupted in all directions.
Surprisingly, Lee Gun’s voice had reached the entirety of the Divine world. In other words, anyone within the range of the item could hear Lee Gun’s voice inside their heads. This included the Great Spirits.
Lee Gun could do this because he had achieved the Great Spirit rank.
[Do you hear me, idiots? Ah! For your information, this is a one-way communication. I can’t hear you guys even if you say something. So it’s useless to scream at me.]
“…!!”
[Impertinent bastard….]
The Great Spirit of Valhalla glared when Lee Gun dared to speak directly into their heads.
The gods also raged since whenever Lee Gun opened his mouth, they felt like their heads would burst open.
“Ahhhk! My head feels like it’s going to crack! Stop talking—”
“Damn it! Why the hell would that bastard infuse his voice with the Great-Spirit-rank Divine power— Kuhk!”
Lee Gun didn’t care as he continued.
[You cannot scrape together resources from your colonies. I bet your powers are going down since the colonies were reclaimed. What are you guys going to do now? I bet you planned on waging a war against me to take me hostage. Your plan of making me a slave won’t be happening now.]
“…!”
[Why don’t you get on your knees and beg? Then I might be in the mood for fixing the Divine world.]
“Bastard…!”
[What? Is there anyone else who can fix this place?]
The gods couldn’t say anything; they were mortified. However, they knew Lee Gun was telling the truth.
Lee Gun smirked.
[You guys can struggle all you want, but it’ll be useless. You guys will lose even if everyone from the Divine world attacks me.]
The Zodiacs glared since those words hurt their pride. How dare he provoke tens of thousands of gods!
The gods who had been trying to head toward different sites decided to go toward Lee Gun.
[You’re provoking us on purpose, Snake god.]
“!”
A familiar voice rang throughout the Divine world. It was a different Great Spirit alongside Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
Valhalla’s Great spirit realized Lee Gun’s goal.
[You are trying to provoke us so that we stay here. You are trying to stop us from going to our colonies.]
Lee Gun laughed.
[Shut up! You guys are the ones who killed the Primordial god and the magical beast gods. You guys are murderers who even killed the Creators. You guys killed all of them because they didn’t listen to you, right?]
A commotion erupted among the gods.
“The Great Spirits did what?”
“What?”
“Why?”
The gods directly under the Great Spirits were surprised. However, they soon looked at Valhalla’s great spirit as if they were put in an awkward position.
“Lord of the Sky! Please do not speak any longer with him! His goal is to cause confusion and division among us! He is speaking to us on purpose!”
“At this point, it doesn’t matter if there is a risk of destroying the colonies. We have to go there ourselves to gather power…”
Valhalla’s Great Spirit contemptuously laughed.
[We cannot go there in the first place.]
“What?”
[I caught a glimpse of it. That bastard has another six-star-rank Achievement.]
“…!!”
Aside from “Destruction of Olympus,” Lee Gun also possessed “Took in the Primordial god as a Construct.”
The Lord of the Sky furrowed his brows.
[All gods consider the Primordial god as their king, and he made the Primordial god his subordinate. Do you realize what that means?]
“C-Could it be?”
The gods’ faces froze. Since he had turned the king of the gods into his subordinate, the snake god also possessed the king’s subjects.
In other words, all gods, including the Great Spirits, could become Lee Gun’s Constructs. Of course, this was all in theory. However, the story changed if the magical beast gods became Lee Gun’s Constructs.
‘If we aren’t careful, the Great Great Spirits might become his Constructs too.’
Of course, Lee Gun needed enough internal force to possess gods of such high stature. While he may be strong, he didn’t have enough power to do that.
However, the Lord of the Sky could see it with his eyes. It was still faint, but the snake god’s power of domination was starting to appear near his feet. Moreover, it was starting to climb upward.
[The Lord of the Sky has entered the range where he can become the snake god’s Construct.]
Once the power of domination covered his head, Valhalla’s Great Spirit would become Lee Gun’s Construct.
From the looks of how fast his power was growing, it wouldn’t take Lee Gun long to possess the requisite internal force. It meant…
‘We have to get rid of him before that.’
Lee Gun knew all of this, so he was trying to keep them from running away to different locations. He wanted to keep them in one place.
If he fought the gods, he would be able to acquire Achievements. It would allow him to grow in power, and he would have enough internal force to turn them all into Constructs.
Valhalla’s Great Spirit laughed.
[It seems you tried to be clever, but you are quite simplistic in your approach.]
[?]
[We have the complete Rule Book. There is something we can do if you try to make us into your Constructs.]
The Lord of the Sky immediately used his ability.
Flash!
Accompanying the light, Valhalla’s Great Spirit and the other Great Spirits disappeared.
[The Lord of the Sky and the other Great Spirits are trying to hide on the earth]
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. He laughed.
“Earth is my land. I am in a more dominant position there, yet you plan on going there? Is this a suicide attempt?”
The voice of the vanished Lord of the Sky rang out.
[We know that you no longer have the Construct with 600% Faith.]
“…!”
[If you don’t have the 600%-Faith Construct, there is no reason for us to be afraid of you. It’s also possible for us to gather your residents toward our side.]
“Ah. That means you want to NTR me on the earth?” Lee Gun dared them to go through with it as he let out his power. “There can’t be that much of a difference without the 600%—”
However, he furrowed his brows when he tried to use his power to chase them away.
[You have destroyed the Divine world.]
[You have turned the magical beast gods into your Constructs.]
[You went on a rampage in your stage 6 state.]
[You are very short on Divine power.]
[You are very short on Divine power.]
[Your Divine power has gone up by 0.0000001%]
[Your Divine power has gone up by 0.0000000000001%…]
When Hugo had been with him, his Divine power used to fill up really quickly. Now, the recovery speed was extremely slow.
Lee Gun laughed in anger. “That bastard… I won’t let him die an easy death.”
“M…Master?”
“I have to increase the Faith of my people. What cares about 600%? I don’t need it. I’ll just make it 1000%.”
“Master?!”
Lee Gun seemed to have gotten an idea. He immediately sent a telepathic message to his Construct. “Hey, Yeonwoo. It’s me. Tell the kids to gather up. Uncle will grant them a wish.”
- W…Wish?
“Yes. If you have a wish, you can tell me. I’ll grant everyone’s wish.”

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - Great Spirit (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 422 - Great Spirit (5)
Gods acquired power from Faith and offerings. That was why they always tried to increase the number of their Constructs and disciples, who gave them Faith and offerings. It was a commonality shared by all the gods.
Zodiacs became stronger as they accrued more subordinates with high Faith. The Divine power also filled up much more quickly.
Divine power represented a god’s stamina and magical energy. It plunging to 0% meant death for the god. Moreover, the Divine power took a very long time to recharge.
This was why even the Great Spirits were judicious in using their powers. Stronger abilities consumed more power. It also came with increased costs.
However, Lee Gun had been the exception. He used to have Hugo, a Construct with 600% Faith. He could use his Divine power recklessly, and it would fill up immediately. In other words, Hugo had been an infinite battery that never ran dry!
However, Hugo’s Faith had turned to 0%, and Lee Gun had expelled him from his temple. This was why Lee Gun was having a hard time using his power.
So he came to a decision.
“You should ask for a wish too, Yeonwoo. I’ll grant them all.”
Yeonwoo was momentarily taken aback.
- W…Wish?
“Yes. I’ll grant the wishes of my Constructs too.”
Yes, he was playing it a bit loose, but a god existed to grant their followers’ wishes and prayers. This was why granting wishes was the fastest way for a god to raise the Faith!
“I’ll be going to the earth. Tell everyone to write down a wish. How about you? Do you have any?”
- Me?
“Yes. I’ll grant whatever wish you have.”
- Then I want marriage.
“Alright! W-What?”
- Marry me!
“… Marr… What?”
- Marriage.
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold. As if he had taken a hit in the head, he merely blinked. “Yeonwoo? Be serious…”
- I am being serious.
“What?”
- You said you'll grant me anything. What? I can’t ask for this proposal?
“…#*&$*#&*????” Even the mighty Lee Gun had a mental breakdown. It was an answer that he hadn’t expected at all. “No… You… I mean… It is ok for now… Uh… Let’s talk after I go there.”
Lee Gun felt numb. He decided to end the telepathic connection for now.
The Constructs saw his expression and worriedly approached him.
“Excuse me, Master? Are you ok? We have to hurry and head toward the earth…”
“That’s right. The Great Spirits are heading toward the earth, and they are going to steal the faith of the disciples. They are going to steal humanity…!”
Lee Gun had been shaky on his feet, but he laughed as if they were speaking nonsense. “They are idiots. I’m faster than them.”
“!”
As the owner of the earth, he could immediately move there. But it was a different story for them.
‘They have to travel a new road.’
It was like how Lee Gun had struggled when he had traveled to the Divine world for the first time. The gods would need a while to reach the earth.
This meant he just had to recover his Divine status during that time. He merely had to make preparations.
‘To do that, I have to…’
Lee Gun put power into the rings on his middle finger.
[Confusion Became Nice (EX)]
- Ring created when Confusion became Order
- All phenomena involving confusion can be controlled
- Seal ability. It can be used in a variety of ways.
[Black Ring that eats Divine magical energy (SSS)]
- Seal Divine power
These were sealing items he had created using Confusion and a general-rank monster!
When Lee Gun put power into them, something surprising happened.
[Your power will be sealed by the maximum amount.]
[30%]
[20%]
…
[Your power has been sealed to 5%.]
When the rings were activated, the power of the Great Spirit leaking out of his body reacted strongly.
Koo-goo-goohng!!!
The power of the rings captured the power of the Great Spirit and surged up with great intensity. The intense power swept away the nearby gods, and it was suffocating.
‘Huhk. As expected of a Great-Spirit-rank…!’
Lee Gun was able to generate this much force even after sealing his power.
Soon, he nonchalantly dusted his hands off.
‘It’ll be safe now that I've reduced it to this level.’
If he went to the earth as a Great Spirit, the planet would explode.
His Constructs still looked nervous.
“It’ll be dangerous if you possess that level of power, Master!”
“That’s right. If you are attacked in that state…”
At that moment…
[This time, we will guard you.]
“!”
The Constructs turned their heads around when they heard the voice.
Numerous Zodiacs were bowing toward Lee Gun. They were pillar-rank gods and high-rank Zodiacs. Then there were the Constructs that the Zodiacs individually possessed.
Lee Gun’s Constructs let out sighs of relief as this sight reassured them. On the other hand…
“Master, a-are you sure about this?”
“I’m still worried!”
“What? I have these guys. It minimizes the danger I’ll face.”
“N-No. I’m talking about your marriage…”
“…!”
The Constructs looked worried as they whispered.
“Just right now… She said her wish is to marry you, right?”
“Are you sure that’s fine….”
Lee Gun started sweating.
“Well, my niece and nephew will be different. I’ll raise their faith first.” Lee Gun quickly headed toward his niece and nephew.
* * *
Lee Gun quickly used Holy Ground Return to get back to the earth. Now that he had become a Great Spirit, all the restrictions that the Divine world had placed on him were released.
Lee Gun could freely use all of his abilities.
[Welcome, Master!]
Eeny and Miny, who had been protecting the holy ground of the earth, appeared before him.
Lee Gun immediately asked, “What about those bastards? Are they already on the earth?”
[No! It is as you predicted! They still haven’t arrived.]
Lee Gun laughed. His prediction was correct.
[From what we can discern, they’ll arrive around twenty hours later…]
“That’ll be enough.”
But that wasn’t the only thing that piqued Lee Gun’s interest. When he had told them that he would grant their wishes, the Faith of his Constructs had jumped. At the very least, it was a 50% increase.
[170%]
[250%]
[280%]
His power had become stronger.
‘I just talked about granting them a wish, yet it was effective.’
He satisfactorily laughed. Moreover, it seemed he already knew the wishes of his Constructs from the start.
“First, food for Piggy Bank!”
[Boo-ohhhhhhh!!]
Lee Gun took out a vast amount of goods that he had stolen from the Divine world as a meal.
“I’ll give you guys new weapons!!”
[Ohhhh! Master!!]
[A Divine weapon of this quality is being given to trivial beings like us…!]
He spread around weapons, clothes, and all kinds of wealth that he had stolen from the Divine world.
[The Faith of your Constructs is rising.]
[The Faith of your Constructs is rising.]
[Your Divine power is quickly refilling.]
[Your Divine power is quickly refilling.]
Lee Gun snickered as he headed into his house. The only task left was to make a 1000%-Faith disciple who will allow him to generate unlimited Divine power.
‘If I grant the wishes of my nieces and nephew, I can do it in one go.’
Both of them were candidates with over 300% Faith. He didn’t need Hugo. This move would guarantee the recharge of his Divine power!
Lee Gun smirked as he entered his house, and he was greeted by familiar faces.
“Uncle!!!”
“Uncle!”
It seemed Sungjae and Yooha had received word that he would be granting their wishes.
Lee Gun let out a bright smile as he looked at them. “So? What wish should I grant my niece and nephew? Talk to Uncle. I’ll grant anything. Signature, weapons, whatever…”
“Marry me.”
“Marrrry!!!”
“…?”
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold. For a moment, he wondered if he had misheard. However, the eyes of his niece and nephew were twinkling as they looked at him.
“Marriage!!!!”
“No, I’m first! I have two wishes!!”
This was beyond being hit in the back of the head. Lee Gun screamed. “What kind of wishes are those?”
“What about it? You said you’ll grant any wish!”
“That’s right!”
“I can understand Yooha, but you are a man!!”
Chun Sungjae had a crazy look in his eyes. “It’s fine! There is the power of Cycle!!!”
“Do you really think I’ll use it on you?”
“It’s fine!! I’ll go back and change my chromosome!! We still have some leftover data from Time!!”
Lee Gun massaged his forehead. Why did anyone with high Faith turn psychotic like this? He wondered if this was truly fine or not.
‘They are already acting like this….’
If their Faith increased any more, he wondered if they would jump him.
