However, Lee Gun became stubborn when he felt Hugo’s absence. His eyes flashed. “Alright. I’ll agree to it for now.”
“!??!”
This surprised his Constructs.
[M…Master!]
[There are requests that you should and should not grant…!]
“What do you take me for? I have a way.”
[Y…You have a way?]
Lee Gun seriously whispered to his Constructs. “Listen to me well. When it comes to marriage, you can marry a game character. You can even marry a 2D character. There are replicas made by Sungjae.”
[…??!!]
“Will it be possible?”
[No way!]
[Do you think those treacherous Zodiac Saints won’t figure out your plan?!!]
It was as they had expected.
“Uncle… Are you trying to marry us off to a game character or a replica??”
When they hit the nail on the head, cold sweat appeared on Lee Gun’s back. Would it not work?
At this point, Yooha and Sungjae had odd looks in their eyes as they gazed at him.
“Well, I guess that’ll do for now.”
“Are you sure about that?? Really?” Lee Gun got worried as he looked at the two of them.
‘What are they thinking?’
On the other hand, his efforts seemed to have paid off.
[Faith is rising.]
[Faith is rising.]
[Faith is rising.]
[Your Divine Power is refilling.]
[Your Divine Power is refilling.]
[Current Divine power: 50%]
Lee Gun wiped the sweat off his brows when he was barely able to scrape together half of his Divine power. He had used all the tricks in the book, yet none of his disciples had reached a Faith of over 400%.
Of course, 400% was also abnormally high, so his Divine power refilled quicker than the other gods.
However, Lee Gun had experienced LTE, and he felt like he was using 2G now. It was a terrible feeling.
‘Damn it! I can’t believe he hit 600%. There is no way a human can do that.’
In fact, Hugo really wasn’t human.
Lee Gun was wondering how 600% could be reached by someone when…
Koo-goo-goong!
“!”
[Master!]
The earth started shaking.
[Warning! Intruders have invaded the earth.]
[Your enemy is using the Rule Book.]
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed.
‘They are here.’
The Great Spirits had arrived. He was sure of it.
As a light akin to shooting stars fell from the sky, the Constructs kicked up a gear. The Great Spirits would try to hide on the earth and take away Lee Gun’s disciples and land.
This land was the only one left available to them. There was no way they would be rash enough to destroy this colony.
Of course, Lee Gun wouldn’t let those bastards hide in his land. While the Great Spirits had been traveling to the earth, Lee Gun had made preparations by working his Constructs.
[Master!]
“Alright. Bring out the ones you found."
At that moment…
“!”
One of the six falling shooting stars headed toward Lee Gun, surprising him and his Constructs.
[Master!]
[One of the Great Spirits is coming this way!]
“That bastard…”
Lee Gun had no idea which Great Spirit it was, but this was a declaration of war. He had assumed the Great Spirits would focus on refilling their power, so this development was unexpected.
Lee Gun quickly took out the Divine item of Death. When the power surrounding the enormous shooting star tried to blast away and consume the gods, Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
Koo-goo-goong!!
Soon, the black flames traveled past his hand to encircle Fetters of the Underworld.
[Kill ten thousand to protect one]
Lee Gun swung the weapon. Power clashed against power.
Kwahng!
The Divine item met the power of the shooting star, and it caused a violent roar as they tried to consume each other.
Kwa-gwa-gwahng!!
Normally, this would destroy the surroundings, but Lee Gun had swung the Divine item of Death. The powerful energy of the Divine item of Death quickly snuffed out the energy emanating from the shooting star.
Lee Gun had eliminated his opponent’s attack!
Koo-goo-goong!!!
Finally, the shooting star landed on the ground. A large crater appeared on the ground, accompanied by an enormous earthquake that destroyed the nearby buildings.
“Uncle!”
“…!”
Since Lee Gun had eliminated his opponent’s power, an enormous sinkhole was formed.
[As expected of a Great Spirit!]
Hoo-doo-doohk
A man appeared from the deep sinkhole. It wasn’t the Lord of the Sky.
“That bastard is….”
He was a man with a robust build.
Sagittarius, who had come to check up on the situation, flinched when he saw the man.
“Kuh-huhk! Why is that bastard…!”
[Unlike your status, this is quite a cozy house.]
The one to appear in front of Lee Gun was the Great Spirit of Kunlun.
Lee Gun looked at him in contempt as he raised the Fetters of the Underworld. “How dare you enter someone else’s home? You must have no fear.”
[Oh, Serpent Bearer. I’m willing to become your Construct. I can help you get rid of the other Great Spirits.]
Lee Gun’s hand came to a stop. He was trying to get rid of the Great Spirits. If he had another Great Spirit, it would be a great help. However…
“You must have an ulterior motive.”
[I need something in return.]
“I knew it. What? You want me to become your bride?”
[No way! I wouldn’t ask that of you.]
“Then what is it?”
[What I want is….]
The Constructs were surprised by the shocking offer.
Angry, Lee Gun silently brought out Heaven’s Punishment.
* * *
The land of the Monarchs was a land of monsters, where the first- and second-generation monarchs congregated.
A familiar figure arrived at the land of slaughter.
[T…That bastard is…!]
It was a blonde man without a weapon—Hugo.
“It has been an arduous journey to reach this place, my brothers.”
The monarchs were guarded as their eyes flashed.
[You are a human now. How dare you come here…]
However, Wind stood up in joy.
[You finally came to your senses. Welcome, my precious brother. You finally remembered our promise?]
“Yes. I remember. We promised to eat the gods.” Hugo smiled as he held up something.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - That's a bit... (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 423 - That's a bit... (1)
“What the hell did I just say?”
Yeonwoo clutched her face. As Lee Gun had requested, she had told his Constructs about the wish fulfillment plan. But she also recalled what she had said to Lee Gun.
- Marry me.
When Lee Gun had said he’d grant any wish of hers, she had unconsciously blurted that out.
As she thought back on it, she realized how embarrassing it was. This was why Yeonwoo let out a soundless scream after the telepathic communication ended. The weight of her words finally hit her.
‘What if Gun thinks I’m weird?’
Of course, she had no idea what had made her speak those words. However, something had flashed through her mind when she had heard his question. It was a memory of a time when she had lived with Junwoo and Lee Gun.
- Ah. If there really is a god, I want to hit him.
Junwoo grumbled as he spoke.
- I don’t mind being born as a human, but why did I have to be born a male?
Yeonwoo and Junwoo were twin snakes. Junwoo was younger, but they had been sisters.
Of course, gods could change themselves more freely as they became high-rank gods. They were transcendent beings, so gender didn’t mean much to them. The problem came when the twins realized they had reincarnated as humans.
Of course, they were able to avoid detection from the gods and grow up thanks to the change in gender, but…
- Since I can’t have Gun hyung, I’ll concede him to you, Noona. Don’t let someone else steal him from you.
- I’m just glad that we can live like a family.
- That’s completely different from being able to become a real family. That’s an entirely separate problem!
At the time, Yeonwoo hadn’t thought much about it. She had just laughed it off.
‘Why is Gun so popular?’
After she was reunited with Gun, she realized a lot of people coveted him. There was even a brat who wanted to use the power of Cycle on himself!
Of course, Lee Gun ignored all of them, yet for some reason, Yeonwoo had developed a crisis of awareness when it came to him.
This was why she had spoken what was in her heart without realizing it. Yeonwoo covered her face from embarrassment.
On the other hand, the Gemini Saint Heiji was angry. She had been with Yeonwoo inside the Scorpio temple’s holy ground.
Although she hadn’t heard the conversation between Yeonwoo and Lee Gun, she had seen how the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer had reacted. She picked up on what was going on.
Heiji immediately went to her fellow Zodiac Saint. She grabbed Hailey by the collar. “Why are you standing by and doing nothing?”
“??”
Hailey looked confused, and it made Heiji’s insides burn. She shook Hailey. “Didn’t you hear what’s going on? That woman is a Construct, so she’ll have her wish granted! It’s obvious that she brought up marriage! Are you going to stand by and do nothing?”
Heiji looked at Hailey as if she should be doing something. However, Hailey was calm like an ice princess. “She is his Construct. Of course, he’ll grant her wish.”
“What! You are taking their marriage as a given!”
“What? I think Gun will treat her very well.”
When Hailey said that, Heiji pounded her chest in frustration. They had never been close even as Zodiac Saints, but when it came to such matters, Heiji was extremely incompatible with her.
“Can you watch them act lovey-dovey?” Heiji asked.
“Mmm… I doubt I can see it.”
“See! You won’t be able to stand it either!”
“Although it would be great if I could see it.”
“…?”
Heiji furrowed her brows. What the hell was Hailey talking about right now?
Hailey continued to speak, sounding a bit sad, “By that time, I won’t be in the picture.”
“…???” Heiji looked at Hailey for an explanation.
Instead of answering, Hailey recalled what Scorpio had told her. It was around the time when Hailey had taken on the persona of Black Scorpion and followed Lee Gun to the Divine world.
For the very first time, she had been able to converse with Scorpio in person, and she had heard something unexpected.
- I know how you feel, Hailey. However, I’m telling you this because I consider you as a daughter.
- !
- It can’t be helped that you have feelings for the snake god, but it can go no further than that.
- What do you mean by that?
- You do realize you have a bounty on you, right? Do you know why that bounty was placed?
- It was during the invasion of the Divine world… Is it because I damaged the Divine world…?
- No. It might look like that on the surface, but the reason is the Karmic debt stemming from your origin.
- Origin…?
- You are a Cluder, yet you aren’t able to change into your monster form. Do you know why?
- …?
- You are a forbidden child. You are a half-breed between a Cluder and a god.
- …!
This had surprised Hailey. She had always wondered about her appearance, yet she had never imagined her father to be from the Divine world.
- Your father was my friend.
At the same time, a question was answered.
- Is that why you chose me as your Zodiac Saint?
- That’s correct. There is no way I would make a pure-blooded Cluder my Zodiac Saint.
It made sense. Scorpio had reacted very negatively when she saw Eternal Change. Moreover, Hailey wouldn’t have been able to use the power of the Zodiac unless she had the blood of a god flowing through her.
- When the snake god realized what you were, didn’t he say you smelled like someone from the side of humanity?
- …!
He had said that and declined to kill her. Back then, Hailey had thought she wasn’t fully a monster. She now knew the reason. However, the surprising part was yet to come.
- The Karmic debt is the reason your mother remains captured. It is why the gods can exploit her.
- My mother is currently imprisoned by the gods?
- That’s right. She is the first-generation monarch Flame. She was captured because of that Karmic debt, and she is being fed to the Divine world as a nutrient.
- …!
Hailey didn’t even need to ask the why of it.
- Cluders and gods are enemies. It is forbidden to have a relationship with each other. It is much worse if a child is born between the two.
That was a rule of the Divine world. Since the forbidden child was made, the first-generation monarch Flame was captured, and Hailey, who had still been a child at the time, had a bounty placed on her.
The reason behind the rule was unknown, but the mixing of blood was considered taboo.
- When two races get closer, the weaker one dies
- …!!
It was a type of provision and curse.
- Anyway, let me give you this warning. Forget about having a physical relationship with the snake god. You shouldn’t get close to him. Your lifespan is already very short as a forbidden child (half-breed).
Hailey had already known her lifespan wasn’t long. She knew she had only twenty years left from the time she met Lee Gun for the first time. She had known she wouldn’t be able to protect Lee Gun throughout his lifetime.
This was why she had chosen to become a Zodiac Saint early on and planned on eradicating the monsters on the earth.
Basically, Hailey didn’t have long to live once Lee Gun came back.
Furthermore, Lee Gun was a god now, and he was overwhelmingly more powerful than Hailey. This meant that Hailey would be the one to die if she got close to Lee Gun.
Although she already knew this, Hailey still chose to join hands with Lee Gun. In other words, her lifespan had become much shorter now, yet Hailey didn’t think her life had become shorter.
Instead of sharing the inside story, Hailey discreetly said to Heiji, “I will be satisfied if I can die while I protect Lee Gun like this. It was enough that I was able to kiss him.”
Heiji felt like she was having a mental breakdown. The kiss wasn't the problem right now! It looked like there was a problem with Hailey’s lifespan! She had said she wouldn’t be able to see Lee Gun’s marriage. This implied that she wouldn’t live past a year or two.
“What do you mean…!”
Yeonwoo bit her lips. She had been secretly listening to the conversation from a distance.
‘The reason is her Karmic debt…!’
Yeonwoo knew about the forbidden child.
‘I thought it was only a rumor.’
That wasn’t important right now. If Hailey died, Lee Gun would surely be sad.
‘Hailey purposefully kept this information away from Gun.’
Hailey had accepted that her life would be shortened once she became a Zodiac Saint. It seemed she was prepared for her death, which could happen at any moment.
Yeonwoo became conflicted. At the end of the day, she didn’t want Hailey to die.
‘If we have the Rule Book, we can change the rule itself.’
Valhalla’s goddess of fate possessed it right now. She was the Construct of Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
Yeonwoo’s eyes started to shine as if she had come up with an idea.
* * *
[Ahhk!! Master! Please compose yourself!]
[You shouldn’t kill him! You can’t kill him!]
Lee Gun’s Constructs were desperate as they clung to his arms and legs.
[Master! Please calm down!!!]
[You must not kill him!]
“Fuck off! I’m going to kill him!”
[I get that you don’t like what was proposed, but it’s an exceptional offer!]
[A Great Spirit is willing to become your Construct!]
[That is why—]
“Exceptional offer, my ass!!!”
Yes, the Great Spirit of Kunlun was willing to become Lee Gun’s Construct. He was willing to help Lee Gun get rid of the other Great Spirits. However, there was a catch.
- I don't need to marry you. You just need to live as a goddess.
“You’re courting death!” Lee Gun took out Heaven’s Punishment, planning on breaking open the head of Kunlun’s Great Spirit. His eyes flashed. “Do you think I’ll stand still and do nothing after hearing such words? What did you call it? Exceptional?! How can you call yourselves my Constructs!”
[It is an exceptional offer!]
“What?!!”
[You don’t have to marry him! You just have to change your appearance!]
[That’s right! High-rank gods are transcendent and noble beings! The humanoid form isn’t that important!]
“It’s important!! It’s very important!” Lee Gun let out the power of Death. When it looked like he was going to kill anyone, the Great Spirit of Kunlun sighed as if he had no choice.
[Alright. It’s my fault. I’ll change the condition.]
“Hmmph. Yes. You finally get it…”
[You have to marry my daughter.]
“Damn it!!! I don’t need him!!” Lee Gun would rather kill him and acquire an achievement. He moved to kill the Great Spirit of Kunlun.
Kunlun’s Great Spirit clicked his tongue as he looked at Lee Gun.
[I don’t mind if this is what you want. However, you’ll find that you need me.]
“What?”
[Snake god, do you know what the other Great Spirits are like?]
“…?”
[Anyway, I was throwing out some suggestions. Still, I’ll help you since our goals align.]
Lee Gun’s anger cooled a little. He lowered Heaven’s Punishment. It seemed the Great Spirit of Kunlun had beef with the other Great Spirits.
As proof of this, Kunlun’s Great Spirit did nothing when Lee Gun used the power of the Serpent Bearer.
“I designated you as being on our side. Don’t say otherwise later on…”
[I’ll give you fighting clothes that’ll be helpful to you.]
Kunlun’s Great Spirit took out clothes for a bride.
Lee Gun became angry once again. Should he just kill this bastard?
“Hmmph. I can’t believe he is a god.”
“!”
Lee Gun turned his head when he heard a familiar voice. He saw someone who he hadn’t seen for a while.
“I came out because there was a commotion. What the hell did you do in the Divine world? Why would a god act like that?”
It was the Leo Saint Stevens.
Lee Gun had assumed Stevens had died at the hands of the new Zodiac Saints. But he was still alive.
When the Great Spirits had decided to sneak into the earth, Lee Gun had told Kevin to gather all the remaining Zodiac Saints. It seemed Kevin had found Stevens. At the end of the day, Stevens would be a boon for their side.
Stevens’s Zodiac Leo seemed angry too.
[We will cooperate as well. How dare they try to execute us!]
Leo had appeared in its incarnate form and was grinding its teeth.
[We will take care of that damn Lord of the Sky.]
“Is that so? I might have someone who’ll be helpful to you guys.” Lee Gun gestured with his hand, and a goddess appeared from Lee Gun’s shadow.
It was one of the goddesses of fate, who had her appearance changed because of Hugo.
“Since our opponent has a goddess of fate, this one will be helpful in shielding you. I’ll lend you one of them. Also, you can take the other Zodiac Saints…”
Lee Gun suddenly tilted his head in confusion. “Hey. Are you listening to me?”
He looked at Stevens, displeased. However, Stevens’s eyes remained fixed on the goddess of fate.
“Hey.” Stevens grabbed the hand of the goddess of fate. “Marry me—”
Bbah-gahk!!!
Lee Gun immediately brought down Heaven’s Punishment on Stevens’s head. “Damn it! How come I don’t have anyone normal around me!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - That's a bit... (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 424 - That's a bit... (2)
Lee Gun was flabbergasted.
‘How come I have only wackos around me?’
After beating down Stevens, he became serious. Of all the people to fall for, why did Stevens have to fall for the goddess of fate, who had taken on his appearance?
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. “The only normal person is me.”
Kevin, who had brought Stevens, was dumbfounded. What? He was a normal person? “Where is your conscience?”
“What?”
“Because of your antics, normal people avoid you.”
Lee Gun looked at Kevin, dumbfounded. “Among the Zodiac Saints, you were the most abnormal one.”
“What do you mean? I’m the most normal one!”
“No, I’m the most normal one!”
The Constructs were sweating as they listened to the conversation.
[Both of them aren’t normal in any way!]
Oblivious to all of this, Stevens stood back up, bleeding from his head. “Oh! I fell for you at first sight. Please marry me…!”
Stevens once again tried to approach the goddess of fate. It looked like he would pick the stars out of the sky if she asked for it.
Lee Gun once again picked up his ax.
Virgo, who had accompanied Kevin, burst out laughing.
[Marry… He wants to marry her…!]
Kevin left behind Virgo, who was dying from mirth, and approached Stevens. It seemed Kevin took pity on Stevens since it was a misunderstanding. Or maybe he found it embarrassing that a fellow Zodiac Saint was acting this way.
“Hey, cat. Do you even know who she is?” Kevin wanted to know if Stevens was acting this way despite knowing the identity of the goddess.
It was unclear if Stevens understood what was being asked, but his eyes flashed seriously. “Race doesn’t matter!! I don’t care if she is a god!”
“No. Look closely at her face.”
“What about her face? Her face is more beautiful than the stars in the sky!”
“That’s the female version of Lee Gun.”
“…?”
“It happened because of the Archer Saint’s skill… Anyway, she’s the female version of Lee Gun, idiot!”
Steven looked back and forth between Lee Gun and the goddess of fate. Then he screamed. At first glance, he hadn’t realized it, but once he compared them, they did look similar. “Ahhk! No way!! How? Why? Do you have a younger sister by any chance?”
Lee Gun grabbed the back of his neck as if he was having a headache. He then ordered the goddess of fate, “It’s fine. Just kill him. This will be faster if we grind him up and use him as an ingredient.”
[I will do as ordered.]
The goddess of fate summoned her weapon. The weapon’s handle was as long as a spear, and its ax blade almost looked like a disc. This was a weapon Lee Gun had gifted to her.
The goddess immediately rushed Stevens as if she wanted to get rid of him.
Since Hugo’s “Idolization Skill” was placed on her, she looked exactly like Lee Gun when she swung her ax.
Stevens screamed. The ruthless ax violently flew toward him. It drew an arc as if it wanted to decapitate Stevens.
However, Stevens was having a mental breakdown for an entirely different reason.
‘What the hell?’
Something was off. The way she was using the weapon was similar to Lee Gun’s moves. She attacked in an annoyingly risky manner, yet there was no opening that could be exploited. It was the annoying attack movement of Lee Gun, yet…
‘What is this? Normally, Lee Gun looks like an asshole to me.’
“But why? Why does she look so cute and pretty— Ahhhk!!”
In the end, Stevens was defeated by the goddess of fate. He didn’t even put up a fight; he was powerless in front of his opponent’s beautiful attacks.
After being defeated, Stevens pounded the ground as if he was upset. “Koo-oohk. That isn’t Lee Gun!”
“Yes. She’s not me.”
“That is… Lee Gun’s daughter!!!”
Instead of giving a reply, Lee Gun swung Fetters of the Underworld.
Bbah-gahk!!!
“You finally let go of your sanity.”
“Koo-oohk… No, I was wrong… It is your daughter…son…your wife… No…”
“It seems you are denying reality…”
Kevin pitifully looked at the bleeding Stevens.
However, Lee Gun had benefited from this current situation.
[Leo Saint’s Faith toward the Serpent Bearer has increased.]
[Your Divine power is being refilled.]
[Current Divine Power: 65%]
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. He ordered the goddess of fate to do something.
The goddess of fate went to the fallen Stevens. She patted his back, and something surprising happened.
[Faith is rising.]
[Divine power is refilling.]
[Current Divine power: 70%]
[Current Divine power: 80%]
…
[Current Divine power: 100%]
“That is good enough. Kill him.”
The goddess of fate didn’t hesitate as she swung her ax.
Poo-hahk
Lee Gun dusted off his hands as he turned around. He had been lacking a vast quantity of Divine power, and this was a boon that allowed him to fully refill it.
Flash! Flash!
“!”
It was right on time as the sound of teleports rang in various locations.
The Zodiac Saints who had been dragged to the Divine world and the deputies of the Zodiac Saints protecting the earth appeared. They appeared alongside the main combatants of each temple.
“Lee Gun-nim!”
“Is it true that you are gathering the officers from all the temples?”
They all belonged to the thirteen Zodiac temples, and they ranged from the A rank to the SS rank, numbering in the hundreds.
The ones who had guided them were Chun Sungjae and Chun Yooha. All the six humans who had been dragged away to the Divine world were present here.
Soon, the S-rank generals lowered their heads as they walked on eggshells.
“We did as you asked. The others are on standby in each region.”
“The whole world is waiting for your orders, Lee Gun-nim.”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “As your owner, I command you to come out.”
“!”
As if it was a response to the voice of a Great Spirit, the symbol of the Serpent Bearer temple appeared at various locations on the floor.
The ones to emerge were the six pillar rank gods who he had rescued from prison.
Koo-goo-goong!
The mouths of the disciples fell open when they felt the enormous power and pressure.
“Z…Zodiacs?!”
The disciples were shocked by the enormous power.
The twelve Zodiacs whom they served, as well as the monsters they had encountered on the earth, couldn’t be compared to these six gods.
The more surprising part was that they had lowered their heads toward Lee Gun.
‘What did Lee Gun-nim do during his time away…!’
Lee Gun ignored the disciples as he said, “I want to fill the empty seats of the twelve Zodiacs. It’ll allow you guys to use the power of the disciples on the earth.”
[That shouldn’t be too difficult—]
“Ah. I’m not saying you guys should become the twelve Zodiacs.”
[Excuse me?]
“I selected them to be the Zodiacs. I want you guys to support them.”
[…???]
“??!”
The SS-ranks pointed out by Lee Gun screamed.
“You want us to do the work of Zodiacs?!”
They were the six humans who had been mistaken as Zodiacs thanks to Lee Gun’s designation. They had been wrongfully dragged away to the Divine world.
Carly, Lee Jaewon, and Goat looked at Lee Gun, dumbfounded.
“Lee Gun-nim! This is way too sudden!”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
“It’s fine. I no longer trust gods.”
“!”
“Earth doesn’t need gods. That’s why you should do the work of the Zodiacs as well as the Zodiac Saints. Moreover, you guys developed Divine statuses, so you are qualified.”
“But…!!”
“Since you guys are low-rank gods, you will be lacking in Divine power… That is why I summoned them. They will provide magical energy for you.”
The summoned Zodiacs realized what Lee Gun was saying. Their faces turned pale as they froze.
[M…master. That means…]
[You are asking us to become magical batteries for each temple…!]
“Yes. You guys can be underl— batteries. The temples will be managed mostly by them, so just follow their orders.”
The gods had thought they would be able to become part of the twelve Zodiacs. They despaired.
It was understandable since Lee Gun had summoned the highest-ranked gods amongst the pillar-rank gods. Yet, he had asked them to become mere batteries for magical energy….!
Carly had already been fulfilling the dual role for the Libra temple. However, Goat and Lee Jaewon looked conflicted as they had to take on the role of Zodiac and Zodiac Saint for the Taurus temple and Cancer temple, respectively.
They were part of the Sagittarius temple, and this wasn’t the Serpent Bearer temple, either. They used to be enemy temples…!
“Will the new Zodiac Saints stand for this…?”
“I don't care if they approve it or not. If they don’t cooperate, you guys can kill them all.”
“…!”
It might sound excessive, but they agreed with Lee Gun’s opinion. They could no longer trust the gods.
‘They think of humans as slaves of a colony.’
“Anyway, the Great Spirits and the other gods have hidden inside the earth. They want to NTR our disciples. That’s why you guys should spread out and search for them.”
Lee Gun furrowed his brow.
The gods, who lost their source of power, planned to steal residents of the earth for themselves. However, it would not be easy.
‘There is no way they'll be able to raise their Faith.’
The twelve Zodiacs of the earth had taken twenty years to cultivate their system. So there was only one way the outsider gods could steal Faith from the residents here.
‘They could do it either through fear or brainwashing.’
The existing Zodiacs had used the monsters to instill fear in humans. The Great Spirits and their gods wouldn’t act too differently.
Basically, something on par with the monsters would make an appearance. This was why Lee Gun had placed trustworthy people in the role of Zodiacs and Zodiac Saints.
It was also why he had quickly gathered the disciples here.
‘If the faith of humanity heads toward them instead of me, it’ll be the end of us.’
Faith represented the power of a god.
Lee Gun’s enemies were weakened right now because they couldn’t receive Faith. If people’s Faith toward him fell, Lee Gun wouldn’t be able to use his power as well.
“Take this to heart. If we mess up, the earth will be taken from us.”
“Understood.”
They lowered their heads, but they soon tilted their heads in puzzlement.
“By the way…”
“What?”
“Why is Hugo-nim not present in such a situation?”
“!”
The existing Zodiac Saints as well as the SS-ranks were present here. The officers who were the greatest awakened beings on the earth were all here.
That was why Hugo’s disappearance was odd.
The question caused a great stir amongst the people, and Virgo glanced at her subordinates. The Virgo Constructs, who had chased after Hugo, looked anxious.
[W…We tried to stop him, but in the end, he went to the monarchs.]
[He went to the first-generation monarch Wind….]
[Also….]
They glanced at Lee Gun.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. “Speak.”
[He… he said he’s the enemy of humanity… He said you should do whatever you want…]
[He didn’t merely end his relationship with Baby snake-nim. He ended it with humanity too…]
Shocked, everyone looked at Lee Gun.
“What the hell!”
“Why would Dad say that?!”
“Why would Hugo-nim do that!!”
These words caused a commotion, and the Zodiac Saints couldn’t keep their mouths shut. On the other hand, the Zodiacs, the Constructs, and Kevin merely clicked their tongues.
[As expected, he revealed his true self.]
“I knew this would happen….”
Kevin looked like he had a headache as he spoke to Lee Gun. “I told you so. He can't be trusted. You should have gotten rid of him before his true nature came out.”
Yooha and Sungjae were frozen. They looked at Kevin for an explanation.
Soon, Kevin whispered to them, “He’s a monarch and a slaughterer. When Aslan survived, he was unable to free himself from the restrictions placed on him by the Creators. When he did free himself, he went on a rampage where he killed the gods.”
Kevin had been swept up in that fight as well, and he had been slaughtered by Eternal Change.
“Eternal Change will bring his comrades to feast on us. Preys are in abundance in this place. Also…”
He whispered to Lee Gun, “He’ll use his siblings to try to kill you. He can’t kill you himself since the restriction remains. He’ll truly gain his freedom once he ends the line of Creators once and for all.”
Lee Gun had no expression on his face. He scoffed as if he wasn’t worried about Hugo. He hadn’t laughed even once when Hugo’s name was mentioned. “It’s fine. If they invade, I’ll kill them all.”
Koo-goo-goong!
At that moment, an earthquake suddenly erupted.
[The Goddess of Fate has used the Rule Book.]
[The Rule Book is being used under the orders of Valhalla’s Great Spirit.]
[The great power of the Rule Book is starting to change the laws of the universe]
Everyone screamed. The ground split as the earth surged upward. Light erupted into the sky. It was like a cataclysmic event.
[The goddess has used the Rule Book to change a universal rule.]
[The Divine world and the colony earth are being combined.]
[All gods will be summoned to the earth.]
It seemed the hidden Great Spirit had used the Rule Book.
The situation surprised the Zodiacs.
“The Divine world and the earth…!”
“They were combined…!”
Landmarks and buildings that could be seen in only the Divine world appeared in heaven and earth.
This was clearly the doing of the Great Spirits, which surprised the Zodiacs.
[How will they handle this much Karmic debt…!]
[Even the Great Spirits would become evil gods with this…!]
It didn’t end there.
Kwahng!!!
An unfamiliar shadow appeared in front of them. The Great Spirit of Kunlun laughed as if he found this unexpected.
Another Great Spirit had appeared before them.
[The one who was asleep has appeared]
Lee Gun feigned laughter when he saw the Great Spirit’s face. “Junwoo?”
Yes, a familiar face had appeared.
Everyone looked at Lee Gun in surprise, but Lee Gun took out his weapon in anger.
“Lee Gun-nim?”
“It’s fine. You guys chase after the goddess of fate. Destroy the Rule Book first.”
“What about you, Lee Gun-nim?”
“I’ll take care of those bastards.”
Lee Gun took off the rings, which were sealing his power.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - Ah. I see (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 425 - Ah. I see (1)
Ji Junwoo had been a big part of Lee Gun’s life and one of his precious family members.
The being in front of Lee Gun right now was Junwoo, but Lee Gun found this odd.
‘I confirmed it. Junwoo went to the underworld of Ennead(Duat).’
Through the registry of the underworld brought by Anubis, Lee Gun had confirmed where Junwoo’s soul was. This was why Lee Gun had wanted to recover Junwoo’s soul from that place and revive him. Lee Gun wanted to reunite him with Yeonwoo.
‘He has Junwoo’s face?’
The being before him looked to be a seventeen-year-old young man who resembled Yeonwoo. However, their energy was clearly different.
‘Great Spirit.’
Lee Gun suddenly realized something. He glared at the Great Spirit of Kunlun. “Is this why you came to me?”
[That’s right.]
The answer dumbfounded Lee Gun. His eyebrows rose. The Great Spirit of Kunlun had claimed Lee Gun couldn’t take on the Great Spirits by himself. Did he know about this face?
Did he know that there was one face among the Great Spirits that Lee Gun wouldn’t touch?
However, Lee Gun reacted in contempt. He understood why the other Great Spirits had remained hidden while this one appeared so shamelessly before him.
“Do you think I won’t be able to attack you because you are wearing his face?”
Lee Gun was someone who had gleefully cracked open the heads of beings who had taken on Hugo’s appearance.
However, the Great Spirit of Kunlun spoke up.
[For your information, it isn’t simply the case where they look the same.]
“…!”
[The Ten Heavenly God is part of the eight great forces. He’s the leader of Gehenna and is the Great Spirit who was created by the other Great Spirits.]
“What?”
The eight great forces of the Divine world were Valhalla, Ennead, Olympus, Kunlun, Eden, Mahabharata, Babylon, and Gehenna.
[It was a force formed through an alliance by eight million gods, the Eireann faction, and others.]
“Alliance?”
[That’s right. Seven factions got together to form a family or a clique. It almost felt like a company… Moreover, they monitored and kept the other seven forces in check.]
Since public affairs had to be neutral, around 90% of the Divine world’s public employees had come from this force. However, there was a reason this force was called Gehenna (Hell) now.
[That place collapsed. All the gods affiliated with that force became evil gods.]
“…!”
[There was too much internal corruption. They became evil gods and self-destructed. Their territory is off-limits right now.]
This was why that force was called Gehenna (Hell). Just going to the entrance to this location could get one killed by the evil gods.
[That’s why only thieves who want the Divine statuses and the Divine item of the Ten Heavenly God enter that place.]
Anyway, the Ten Heavenly God is the only one in the Divine world who possesses ten Divine statuses.
It was said that the Great Spirit of Gehenna was trying to purify the evil gods, but it was unclear if this was true.
[However, that is the true form of the Ten Heavenly God, who is supposed to be purifying the evil gods.]
The Ten Heavenly God was a Great Spirit created by the other Great Spirits.
[He’s a puppet of the Great Spirits and their gatekeeper. He exists to make sure none of their secrets leak out.]
The previous Ten Heavenly God had probably been put through the process of inheritance, and the new one was created by mixing different souls. The Great Spirits had needed a fighting-type god of the Great Spirit rank.
[He was a famous Zodiac capable of possessing ten Divine statuses. It was why the Great Spirits could choose the Divine status to their taste. They created a chimera.]
However, Lee Gun was having a hard time comprehending something. He understood the damn Great Spirits had taken Junwoo’s soul to create that thing, but…
“Why Junwoo?”
Junwoo and Yeonwoo were the Zodiacs who had taken over the Serpent Bearer temple after Aslan. However, the two of them were considered one. They didn’t possess Divine statuses that would satisfy the Great Spirits.
The Great Spirit of Kunlun laughed as if it wasn’t a big deal.
[He was once a god of death who Time coveted.]
“What does being a god of death have to do with anything?”
[The Ten Heavenly God possesses one of the Primordial god’s power: Creation.]
“Primordial god’s power?”
[I’m talking about the Primordial god’s original abilities. When the Primordial god was murdered, the evil gods had stolen and given his abilities to the monarchs. The power of Cycle, which you possess, is one of them.]
“!”
The Primordial god was the highest-rank god, who managed the universe. He possessed a total of six abilities. Five of them were Creation, Maintain, Change, Destruction, and Cycle.
[In simple words, the world was first created and maintained. In the process of maintaining the world, change occurred, and the things that weren’t needed were destroyed. Then there was the power that could put these through a cycle.]
These were abilities befitting the Primordial god
[Anyway, the Primordial god’s abilities and his three treasures had been stolen. Each of the eight Great Spirits was able to lay claim to one of them.]
At the time, the Great Spirits had become heroes since they had recovered the Primordial god’s abilities and treasures from the evil gods.
After recovering the power of the Primordial god, the Great Spirits had used each of these powers to bring a balance of power to the Divine world. However, the problem started from that point on.
[While the other powers of the Primordial god were recovered, Cycle wasn’t.]
Since it wasn’t from his era, the Great Spirit of Kunlun wasn’t sure, but he continued.
[The power of Cycle is the last piece that makes up the Primordial god’s power. The other powers can be perfectly handled only if the power of Cycle is present. That’s why an artificial god of Cycle was made, and he’s the result.]
“…!”
Lee Gun had a sense of déjà vu. It was to be expected since Time had attempted the same thing.
‘Can it be…?’
Lee Gun’s expectation was proven true.
[The prerequisite needed for Cycle is the combination of Life and Death. The Great Spirits knew this, and the power taken by the Ten Heavenly God was Creation.]
Lee Gun’s eyes turned sharp.
[They must have thought a combination of Creation and Death would create a power similar to Cycle.]
It was true that there were similarities between Creation and Life.
[They captured a god of Death just in time and combined the soul with the Ten Heavenly God. Of course, they failed to produce the god of cycle. What you see in front of you is the result.]
Murderous intent appeared in Lee Gun’s eyes. “Was it Ennead’s doing?”
[I’m not sure. The one to supply the soul was Ennead, but there is a high probability that Valhalla’s Lord of the Sky was the one to create him. Valhalla’s Great Spirit carried a lot of experiments by squeezing out knowledge from Mimir.]
Lee Gun felt something twitch within his chest. It seemed as if everything had fallen into place. The ones to doggedly chase after Junwoo and Yeonwoo were the Gemini and Pisces temples.
Their Zodiacs used to be affiliated with Valhalla (Frey and Freya) and Ennead (Isis and Nefertiti).
In the end, they had carried out the same experiment as Time. Moreover, the reason Time was able to find out about Cycle’s existence was probably the Great Spirits.
Of course, that wasn’t important right now.
“He’s coming!”
The high-rank disciples became guarded when the Ten Heavenly God unleashed his power. The pressure he generated couldn’t be compared to that exuded by the Zodiacs and monsters that they had witnessed before.
This terrified the disciples. If a being like that used his power, the earth would be destroyed. Also, they could tell the difference between the power of Lee Gun and that of his opponent. After all, they were high-rank disciples. They realized the opponent was a daunting foe even for Lee Gun.
Boom!!
At that moment, Lee Gun took off his rings and unleashed his Divine power.
[Your seal has been dismissed.]
Then something surprising happened.
Hwa-roo-roo-roohk!!!
Black flames erupted from Lee Gun’s body.
The several hundred disciples around him screamed.
“Ahhhk!”
“W-What the hell is that?”
As Lee Gun’s body turned into black flames, he became enormous.
The disciples almost sank to their knees since they were seeing this for the first time. This included the Chun siblings and Stevens, who had been healed after being attacked by Lee Gun.
“U…Uncle?!”
“What the hell did he do over there?!!”
The Great Spirit of Kunlun also released his Divine power.
‘The snake god was given the name of Wicked Lord.’
The nine Great Spirits were gods who stood on the zenith of the hundreds of millions of gods. Since they were powerful gods, their powers had to be sealed if they wanted to visit the colonies. However, the Great Spirits had merged the Divine world and the earth.
‘Without that, it would have been hard for them to use 100% of their power.’
However, this was advantageous for Lee Gun too.
Nevertheless, the earth would be destroyed if a battle was conducted here. So the Great Spirits had assumed Lee Gun would avoid fighting on the earth, but that wasn’t the case.
[Kill one to save ten thousand]
Lee Gun immediately summoned Heaven’s Punishment and swung it toward the Ten Heavenly God. The summoned Heaven’s Punishment became enormous as it scaled up to Lee Gun’s size. Then it roared.
Koo-goo-goong!
Lee Gun used the weapon to cut through the Ten Heavenly God’s attack.
Kwahng!!!
The Ten Heavenly God’s power instantly disappeared, and something surprising happened.
Flash!
As soon as Heaven’s Punishment got rid of the enemy’s power, a light appeared around the damaged surroundings.
[The power of Life is being applied.]
[The power of Life is being applied.]
[The destroyed land is being recovered.]
It was the light of Life. Lee Gun had the ability to recover the land using the Divine item of Life. He activated Cycle in contempt.
[How dare you use the fake Cycle in front of the actual one!]
The black flames turned into white flames.
Hoohk!
As the black flames and the white flames merged, Lee Gun’s appearance changed. He was no longer a giant. He had reverted to human size.
However, black and white wings emerged from his back. It was the power of Cycle being used as a Great Spirit.
The light of Cycle shot toward the Ten Heavenly God and savagely struck him!
Kwahng!!!
The people watching this couldn’t close their mouths.
The Chun siblings had put up a barrier to block the shocks of the battle. They wailed in joy.
The six humans who had already seen Lee Gun’s wicked god form in the Divine world felt electricity run up their spines. They firmly kept their mouths shut.
After sending the power of Cycle, Lee Gun furrowed his brow.
‘They should have separated.’
He had purposefully used Cycle to separate Junwoo’s soul from the Great Spirit’s body. If he had the soul, he could revive Junwoo. He wanted to make his younger brother whole once again.
Lee Gun glared at the Ten Heavenly God, who was surrounded by the light of Cycle.
Kwah-jeek!
“!!”
At that moment, an odd sound rang out.
Lee Gun flinched. The Great Spirit realized what was going on. He immediately moved as if he had expected this.
Kwahng!!!
The light of Cycle was reflected toward Lee Gun.
Lee Gun bit his tongue. If he got swept up in the power of Cycle, he wouldn’t escape it unscathed.
At that moment, the Great Spirit of Kunlun changed his appearance.
Koo-goohng!!
His hair was tied up in one place as if he were a martial artist, and armor with fur trims appeared on his body. It all turned into a red and white flame. He looked like an enormous dragon made of light.
His hands encircled the small Lee Gun as if he were protecting Lee Gun. The range of his power also spread to the humans too.
The Great Spirit of Kunlun let Lee Gun go when the light of Cycle sent by the Ten Heavenly God dissipated.
[The Great Spirit of Kunlun has used the Primordial god’s Treasure of In.]
Lee Gun wondered what had happened, so he looked at the Great Spirit of Kunlun.
[It’s as I’ve said before. That Great Spirit has one of the five abilities of the Primordial god. He has Creation.]
“…!”
[Of course, only the Creators can use the full Creation ability. Despite it being the power of Creation, he can merely create by copying.]
In other words, the Ten Heavenly God had copied Lee Gun’s power.
Since Cycle of the same size was used in response, Lee Gun’s attack had turned into null.
[While it can’t create anything new, it can make exact copies of anything, including abilities.]
This meant Lee Gun would be in a tougher spot as he used more power.
Flash! Flash!
The Ten Heavenly God gestured with his hand, and other gods of Cycle like Lee Gun appeared before him.
“!”
There were eight of them.
This shocked everyone. The mere presence of one was a calamity; if there were eight with that power…!
‘The earth will cease to exist.’
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. It seemed Valhalla’s Great Spirit had sent the Ten Heavenly God first for this reason. He could use the same movement and abilities.
Unexpectedly, the Great Spirit of Kunlun laughed since he had come looking for Lee Gun for the same reason.
[It’s as I’ve said. All the power of the Primordial god was split amongst the Great Spirits.]
“That means…”
When the Great Spirit of Kunlun gestured, a golden marble appeared in his hand.
[Treasure of In]
- One of the three Divine items (Chun-Ji-In) of the Primordial god.
- It can control the body of all creations.
[I told you that I’ll be helpful when it comes to hunting down the Great Spirits.]
Aside from six abilities, the Primordial god possessed three Divine items called Chun-Ji-In
[Chun-Ji-In is made up of three ingredients. Chun is space. Ji is the body. In is the soul.]
In other words, the six abilities and Chun-Ji-In were used as ingredients by the Primordial god. It allowed the Primordial god to use his power.
[I possess the Primordial god’s Ji. It controls the body of all creation.]
The next moment, a surprising power bound the copies and the Ten Heavenly God.
Kwah-jeek!!
[Kunlun’s Great Spirit is using the power of Ji.]
[The power is weakening the bodies of the copies and the Ten Heavenly God.]
Since Ji held control over the bodies of all creation, it could freely strengthen and weaken the bodies.
It seemed Kunlun’s Great Spirit had meant to use this power to help Lee Gun face the other Great Spirits.
As expected, the power weakened the copies.
The eyes of Death’s Junwoo flashed as he got rid of the copies. It seemed he had realized that he was at a disadvantage. The Ten Heavenly God rushed toward a different location.
Kunlun’s Great Spirit furrowed his brow.
[Ji can’t weaken his ability. I can’t affect Cycle. You have to get rid of him using Death.]
However, Lee Gun hesitated. If he used Death, he would be completely destroying Junwoo’s soul. If he did that, he would never get to see Junwoo ever again. Even he couldn’t do anything. Was this also the intent of Valhalla’s Great Spirit?
[You cannot get rid of him as you are now, Snake god.]
“!”
Valhalla’s Great Spirit’s laughter rang in the sky.
[Since the Divine status of Death went over to you, merging him with the Ten Heavenly God was useless. He turned out to be trash, but I never expected him to prove useful now.]
Lee Gun got angry. He could try to use Cycle to separate the soul, but his opponent would copy his power once again, rendering Cycle useless.
Aside from that method, he had the option to use Death, but then he would never be able to save Junwoo.
[Let’s make a deal.]
At that moment…
“!”
An enormous snake shot out of Lee Gun’s shadow and violently wound itself around the Ten Heavenly God.
Kwah-jeek!!
This surprised Lee Gun.
“Junwoo!”
The snake with the beady eye was his Construct, which had been hatched from the Serpent Bearer’s egg.
It had been eating well, so the baby snake “Junwoo” was now as big as a mountain.
Kwah-jeek!!!
“You…!”
The snake didn’t want to hear any nonsense. It encircled the Ten Heavenly God.
[Junwoo (Apophis) says not to listen to him.]
Lee Gun looked at Apophis, who he had named ‘Junwoo’. He suddenly recalled a memory.
- You don’t need to do that. If Hyung became a Zodiac, it means I am alive.
- Of course, Hyung won’t recognize me, but…
When he had fought Olympus’s goddesses of fate, he had met the real Junwoo in the past. Junwoo had said those words to him.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. A particular sentence bothered him.
- Of course, Hyung won’t recognize me, but…
Why had Junwoo said that? Had he been giving a cryptic message that he was within the Ten Heavenly God? However, he had recognized the Ten Heavenly God way too easily. This was why the words bothered him.
‘Is that the real Junwoo?’
His opponent possessed the Primordial god’s Creation ability. Wouldn’t they be able to copy Junwoo’s soul?
‘What if the real soul of Junwoo is somewhere I wouldn’t notice…’
If so, who was it?
At that moment…
“Byaaaaaaaaaah!!”
A familiar baby appeared in front of him. The baby girl instantly shot a beam from her eyes toward the Ten Heavenly God.
Kwah-gwa-gwahng!!!
The Ten Heavenly God took significant damage and was pushed back.
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - Ah. I see (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 426 - Ah. I see (2)
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold.
A baby had appeared in front of his eyes. Moreover, it was a child born less than a hundred days ago, who had just managed to open her eyes.
The Chun siblings screamed like their hair was on fire.
“Ahhhk!!”
“Jisoo!!!”
“Why is she over there?”
Yes, this baby was the youngest child in Hugo’s household!
All the disciples screamed when they saw the baby. Lee Jaewon and Goat, who had been defending the surroundings as replacement Zodiacs, reacted the same.
“Why is Youngest Miss here?”
“Jisoo-nim!!”
The newborn baby was wearing clothes with Lee Gun’s figure printed on it. She was clearly Hugo’s youngest child.
Moreover, Lee Gun had given her the name “Jisoo,” combining the names “Jiwoo” and “Taeksoo.”
Jisoo was also born awakened, so she could use all kinds of abilities. She had a passive levitation as well as teleportation ability! She was able to shoot a weird beam!
They had assumed that her bloodline combined with Lee Gun’s blessing had created her abilities. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Bbyahhhhhhhhh!!”
After appearing out of nowhere, the baby was ruthlessly sending energy beams toward the Ten Heavenly God.
Koo-goo-goong!!
[The newborn baby is shooting Beams of Destruction.]
[The newborn baby is shooting Beams of Destruction.]
The Ten Heavenly God retreated after the beams hit him again. This seemed to be an attack that worked against a Great Spirit.
‘No. I can feel the hint of the Serpent Bearer’s Death from her.’
Lee Gun had used the power of his blessing while the child had been inside her mother’s stomach, so he wondered if his power had seeped in. However, the issue was something else right now.
‘What kind of bizarre life form did he create?’
Or did it have to do with the Chun siblings putting on Lee Gun’s documentary every day as prenatal care? Was that the problem?
Lee Gun started to sweat when the baby’s attack looked very close to a monster’s attack.
It was as if the child was angry that her opponent was copying someone and that her opponent was messing with the wrong person.
Lee Gun was about to say enough was enough, but his phone rang at that moment. He was going to ignore it, but he saw who the caller was and immediately answered. “Miss Jiwoo?”
- Lee Gun-nim! I’m sorry! I know I shouldn’t be calling you right now, but… Jisoo disappeared…!
“Ah!”
- She is developing at an abnormal rate, and she keeps disappearing, trying to chase after you… I was wondering if she did something strange again. Did she go over there?
Lee Gun started to sweat when he heard the worried voice of Chun Jiwoo. “Uh… That is…”
He looked at the baby going berserk and shooting energy beams from her eyes.
- I was thinking she might have been kidnapped by the gods or the monsters…!
“It’s fine. She wasn’t kidnapped. In fact, she’s kicking ass. She is quite a useful talent…”
- What?
“No! It’s nothing! Please don’t worry. I found her. She’s here. I’ll protect—”
At that moment, the Ten Heavenly God’s attack flew toward Lee Gun.
Taken aback, Lee Gun grabbed the baby and shouted, “Beam!!!”
Koo-goo-goo-goong!!
The beam cut through the Lee Gun clones, which the Ten Heavenly God had summoned.
It was a horrific sight, as the bodies looked like they had been cauterized by a laser beam.
Even if Kunlun’s Great Spirit had used the power of Ji to weaken the opponents, they were still Lee Gun clones.
The disciples froze when they saw the beam ruthlessly cutting down the Lee Gun clones.
“That’s an SS-rank destructive power!”
“That’s a baby, right? Is that really a baby?!”
“Uncle! Our youngest…!”
This action looked very similar to Lee Gun cutting down his opponents with the power of Death!
‘No, she’s more bloodthirsty and indiscriminate!’
The baby didn’t seem to care. She let out happy sounds since she liked being in Lee Gun’s arms. She extended her sausage-like finger toward him.
Lee Gun checked the baby at that moment.
[You have used the ability of the magical beasts, who you brought in as Constructs. You have activated the Eyes of a Spirit]
After becoming a Great Spirit, Lee Gun had developed new abilities. He could now see things that he was unable to before.
‘Her soul is…’
The soul looked like a white sphere, and Lee Gun took a closer look at it. The appearance of the soul changed for a moment, and a face that he knew very well showed up. Moreover, he received information as well.
[It is the soul of Ji Junwoo.]
When he heard the voice, Lee Gun unconsciously choked up.
The child let out a bright smile as she extended her hand toward Lee Gun. Her smile was oddly familiar to him.
Lee Gun then furrowed his brows as he looked at the Ten Heavenly God.
Since the youngest was next to him, he could make an accurate assessment. He compared the appearance of the souls. The light of the Ten Heavenly God’s soul was much weaker.
[It is the copy of a soul, which was made using the ability of Creation.]
In other words, the soul of Junwoo within the Ten Heavenly God was a copy.
Now that he had no reason to hesitate, Lee Gun raised his hand. A powerful black flame erupted from him.
Woosh!
He instantly transformed into a giant made out of black flames and summoned the Fetters of the Underworld.
The Fetters of the Underworld usually looked like tongs, but they also transformed alongside the black flame.
The new shape was meant for going all out. Lee Gun wasn’t fooling around. The weapon was shaped for destruction. It had taken on the shape of a sword.
Lee Gun didn’t hesitate as he swung the pitch-black sword toward the Ten Heavenly God.
[Emptiness (6 star)]
It was the power of Death, which could erase a being from existence. The sword swung toward the Ten Heavenly God.
* * *
“Jisoo!!”
Chun Jiwoo screamed when she saw her youngest in Lee Gun’s arms. The youngest laughed in joy, seeing her mother.
Lee Gun had told Chun Jiwoo that her baby was fine, but the baby had disappeared to the battlefield after all.
“I’m glad you are ok!” Chun Jiwoo finally relaxed when she held her youngest in her arms. She sank to the ground as if the strength had drained out of her legs.
It was to be expected since something incredible had happened, and the Chun siblings had almost fainted.
In the end, the disciples got over the sensation of having their hearts in their mouths. They tilted their heads in puzzlement when they caught sight of Lee Gun.
“You look to be in a very good mood, Lee Gun-nim.”
Lee Gun had been in a bad mood ever since the conversation about Hugo had been brought up. However, he was now all smiles as he looked at the youngest child, a rarity for him.
They looked at him as if something was off, but Lee Gun was pleased.
‘Junwoo was reborn as Miss Jiwoo’s daughter.’
Was this why Junwoo had said Lee Gun wouldn’t be able to recognize him?
Lee Gun now knew the story, so he told Jiwoo, “Please raise Jisoo well. She is a good kid.”
Chun Jiwoo and the Chun siblings tilted their heads in puzzlement. He was saying something obvious.
Lee Gun continued to lightly massage the mochi-like cheeks of the youngest child. Being family with Jiwoo and the Chun siblings, she would be able to grow up in happiness.
There was no way she would grow up like they had at the orphanage where they had been beaten.
Lee Gun decided not to tell the family about Junwoo. He didn’t think it was necessary.
On the other hand, the Zodiacs also realized what had happened.
‘I see. That’s what happened.’
Virgo was the one who had snuck out Yeonwoo and Junwoo and helped them reincarnate as humans. She finally received the answer to a question she had for a long time.
Yeonwoo and Junwoo were her friends. They were the baby snakes that Aslan had picked up. When Aslan had found them, the two of them had been close to death after suffering an attack. He had taken pity on them and said,
[They suffered this fate because they went through the process of inheritance as twins.]
[Inheritance? Which Divine status do they possess? They must be low-rank gods since they are so weak.]
[No. I do know who did it, but the original Divine statuses they have were originally one. It was broken into two when they were born as twins. This is why they can’t use their power, and their lifespan is short. At this rate, they won’t be able to breathe on their own.]
It was like being born with a disability. That was why the twin snakes would be in pain their whole lives before perishing alongside their Divine statuses.
Therefore, Aslan had placed entirely different Divine statuses inside the twin snakes. He had given them Life and Death. It was why they were called Ouroboros.
The two of them made up one Divine status. Their existing Divine statuses counted as nothing since their original Divine status had been broken into two, so they became Aslan’s Constructs as Ouroboros.
However, the problem came when Yeonwoo and Junwoo died. The Divine status of Life and Death that Ouroboros possessed was passed onto Lee Gun. Moreover, their fragmented Divine statuses had become one again when they had died.
This Divine status had appeared in front of Lee Gun as an egg.
‘That snake is Apophis.’
Junwoo’s soul was reborn as Hugo’s youngest daughter.
‘Yes. Yeonwoo and Junwoo originally possessed the Divine status of Apophis.’
Virgo realized something. It was said that Apophis had tried swallowing the solar deity Ra, but he had done it during the daytime.
That was why Apophis’s Divine status was the mortal enemy of Ennead’s Great Spirit Ra. It had been a poisonous snake that had threatened Ra.
Why would Apophis’s Divine status be inherited by twins? With it split into twins, the Divine status was weakened.
The answer was simple.
‘It was done by Ennead’s Great Spirit.’
Zodiacs got rid of anything that they didn’t like. Ra had broken Apophis’s Divine status into two and passed it to the twins. Ra planned on starving the Divine status to death through a painful process.
‘There was no way he would get away with doing such a thing without incurring Karmic debt.’
Ennead’s Great Spirit had done something that should have turned his fate wicked.
‘How is he ok?’
That wasn’t all. He and the other Great Spirits hadn’t incurred any Karmic debt despite killing the Primordial god. They were able to live long lives without suffering any consequences. Well, it didn’t matter for now.
“What?! S…She has a Faith of 450%?!”
The Zodiacs turned when the disciples screamed.
Lee Gun looked proud as he gazed at the youngest. “Yes. This child has 450% Faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple. With her, I won’t have any problems with my Divine power.”
For some reason, Lee Gun looked proud as he checked the Faith of the youngest. It was as if he considered this par for the course. He was very happy since he found it praiseworthy.
As expected of 450% Faith, Lee Gun’s Divine power was refilling at a rapid pace.
The disciples were moved.
“She has 450%... A newborn baby has…”
“Right? As expected of my niece—”
“However, you don’t have anyone who exceeds 600%.”
Lee Gun glared at the disciple who had spoken up.
Oblivious to this, the disciple nonchalantly laughed.
“Well, it isn’t as high as Hugo-nim, but this should be enough, Lee Gun-nim— Ooh-ahhhhk!”
The disciple felt his throat go dry when he saw Lee Gun enraged for some reason. It also caused the disciples to whisper amongst themselves.
“There is no way Hugo-nim really betrayed humanity, right?”
“Hey, it can’t be true. This is Hugo-nim we are talking about of all people— Shhh!”
They shut their mouths as they looked at Chun Jiwoo.
Chun Jiwoo saw this and worriedly whispered to Lee Gun, “Excuse me, Lee Gun-nim. Did something happen to my husband?”
“What? Why?”
Lee Gun flinched, but Chun Jiwoo continued to speak calmly.
“He left after packing his luggage. He acted like someone who would never come back….”
Lee Gun waved his hand as if it was nothing. “About his luggage… I told him to pack his bag because the fight might get drawn out. Don’t worry about it.”
“He burned the family photo….”
“….” Lee Gun became angry. Really??
His eyes flashed as if he wanted to decapitate Hugo. “That… I’ll return it to normal. I can recover the picture using Time’s ability.”
Chun Jiwoo nodded.
Lee Gun couldn’t be worried about Hugo right now. He had decided that the immediate problem was the hidden Great Spirits, so he started to move. “What’s the current situation?”
[As expected, the Great Spirits have changed the content of the Rule Book and merged the Divine world and the earth. About 99%…]
“You’re saying that the land of the Divine world combined with the land of the earth… In other words, we are sharing lands with the gods?”
[Yes. Earth changed into the Divine world. The definition and scope of the Divine world were swapped with that of the earth. It is possible if they did this.]
Lee Gun contemptuously laughed when Mimir gave a quick analysis. Blowing up the Divine world had nothing to do with this. They had been aiming for his land from the start.
‘They wanted to plant that strange tree here.’
When he had traveled to the future, the earth had already fallen.
[The Rule Book contains a variety of rules. By doing this, they can change the impossible into possible. They plan on changing the earth to their taste.]
[If we can find out where they are hiding, I think we have a good chance of destroying the Rule Book.]
[Also, there are four Great Spirits. Are you sure you will be fine?]
Lee Gun assuaged their fears as he brought out an object that emitted light. It was something that Lee Gun had ripped out of the Ten Heavenly God.
[Primordial god’s “Creation”]
[Divine status of the Ten Heavenly God]
“It’s fine since I gained something good too…”
Suddenly…
“Kuh-huhk!”
[Master!]
“Lee Gun-nim!!!”
“Uncle!”
Lee Gun fell over in pain. The surprised high-rank disciples and the gods rushed toward him.
“Lee Gun-nim! Are you ok? Lee Gun-nim!”
Lee Gun was in great pain as he gasped. The Zodiac Saints were taken aback by what they saw. It had been twenty years since they had seen Lee Gun in this much pain.
On the other hand, Lee Gun glared. There was a different reason he was being tormented.
[The Faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple is disappearing.]
[The Faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple is disappearing.]
[The Faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple is being transferred]
[The Faith that had been heading toward the Serpent Bearer temple is now headed toward the Great Spirits.]
[The Faith of six billion humans is being transferred all at once.]
[The Serpent Bearer’s power is being weakened.]
“Those bastards…!!”
The Faith of humanity on earth was being moved toward the Great Spirits.
A god’s power changed in proportion to the amount of Faith it had.
Now that Lee Gun had awakened as a Great Spirit, his power had become stronger, but this meant that he needed more energy to maintain his body. With this development, he could no longer do so.
“Uncle!!”
Lee Gun’s appearance started to change. It was deadlier because the Faith had disappeared all at once.
“Lee Gun-nm’s appearance…!”
Lee Gun, who almost looked like a full-grown adult, morphed back into his teen years. His body and height shrunk, and he was boiling hot because of a fever.
Surprised, Iaso shouted.
[This is really bad. At this rate, he’ll atrophy until he ceases to exist!]
They had no idea what was going on, but their question was soon answered.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - Karmic Debt (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 427 - Karmic Debt (1)
[This is really bad. At this rate, he’ll atrophy until he ceases to exist!]
They had no idea what was going on, but their question was soon answered.
[The Great Spirits have used the Rule Book. They have used the Rule Book to steal his Faith.]
The disciples were surprised by the words of Kunlun’s Great Spirit.
“I’m guessing the Rule Book is literally a book… A book was able to put Uncle in this state?”
The gods were having a hard time accepting it too. It was understandable.
[The Rule Book is a Divine item that turns anything written inside it into law. It manifests the law. But the Rule Book never contained this law!]
The Rule Book was made to keep reins on the extraordinary gods. Anything written inside it held a binding power in reality. This Divine item was born because only an item of that caliber could take on the gods.
[However, there is no way the Primordial god would put in a rule that will allow one to steal Faith from others…!]
[That’s right. Faith has a direct connection to a god’s power. If stealing it were possible, the Divine world would have become a battlefield where gods would try to steal each other’s Faith!]
[It is known that Faith cannot be stolen even if a colony is taken away. The gods know that it isn't a very efficient process. This is why they wage fewer wars.…]
[It shouldn’t be possible! The only ones who can make changes to the Rule Book are the Primordial god and the Creators…]
Kunlun’s Great Spirit spoke in an offhand manner.
[The Lord of the Sky possesses Change, one of the Primordial god’s powers.]
[!]
This surprised the gods. It was known that the Great Spirits had divided the eight powers of the Primordial god. Amongst them, Change had gone to Valhalla’s Great Spirit. It meant he was using Change to modify the Rule Book.
[I’m guessing the part that says “Faith cannot be transferred” was modified. The “cannot” was changed to “can.” It allows them to steal the Faith of the Serpent Bearer temple.]
Chun Sungjae furrowed his brow. “However, they shouldn’t be able to steal the Faith of the Serpent Bearer temple merely by fixing the rule.”
[It seems they used Chun and In.]
“!”
Mimir immediately recognized what was going on, and he spoke up. The Great Spirits had divided five of the six abilities of the Primordial god. They had also divided his three Divine items amongst themselves.
This was how six Great Spirits were able to possess eight powers.
If Kunlun’s Great Spirit possessed “Ji” amongst the “Chun-Ji-In…”
[Babylon’s Lord of the Perishing possesses Chun, and Olympus’s Lord of the Sky possesses In.]
“…!”
If the Divine item possessed by Kunlun’s Great Spirit had dominion over the body, Chu had dominion over space, and In over the soul.
[Since “Chun” holds dominion over the space of the universe, it can manage earth to its taste. As for “In,” it holds domain over the soul and was probably used to brainwash humanity.]
Brainwashing.
“Then…”
[This means they changed the rule in the Rule Book and brainwashed humanity. It allowed them to direct the Faith of humanity toward them.]
“…!”
It might be the case where Lee Gun’s presence was replaced by the Great Spirits in the humans’ minds.
With his Faith stolen, Lee Gun taking a big hit was inevitable. After all, to fill up an expanded fuel tank, one needed a constant flow of fuel.
The disciples and the gods were dumbfounded.
[Even if such a thing is possible, they won’t be able to dodge the Karmic debt. Such actions would create enormous Karmic debt for themselves…!]
Gods were incredibly powerful, but that power came with as strong a restriction. It was the Divine Achievement.
If the gods excessively changed the order of the universe, they suffered an equal and opposite reaction.
When the gods incurred enough Karmic debt, they became degenerates and evil gods. They were either executed, or they self-destructed.
Chun Yooha furrowed her brow. “What if they can dodge the Karmic debt because they can change the rule itself….”
[No. That’s probably not it. If they changed the rules for their gain, they would have received a penalty.]
[They won’t be able to dodge the Karmic debt by doing that.]
Virgo and Kunlun’s Great Spirit answered her.
The order of the universe wasn’t something to be trifled with. Anyone who did anything that went against divine providence was punished. They would receive Karmic debt.
However, the disciples had a bigger meltdown when they heard Virgo’s words.
“They can’t dodge the Karmic debt, yet they were able to change the rule and brainwash humans?”
[That’s right. It makes no sense. Even if the Great Spirits have high-rank permission tickets (Exoneration)….]
Some of the gods’ abilities could cause harm to the order of the universe. This was why they couldn’t use their power rashly.
The disruption to the order of the universe would give rise to Karmic debt, and this was why the permission tickets were issued.
When Lee Gun had gone to the Divine world, they were the precious item that Lee Gun kept taking from the others.
[However, a change of this magnitude cannot be smoothed over even if the highest-rank permission tickets (Exoneration) are used!]
[The Great Spirits probably don't want to self-destruct by becoming evil gods. What are they thinking…!]
[I’m not so sure. From how reckless they are, they must have a way to erase the Karmic debt…]
At that moment, the feverish Lee Gun gritted his teeth as he got up. “It’s fine… I can endure this.”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
He just had to find and get rid of the Great Spirits.
Zzuhng!
“Kuhk!!”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
Suddenly, an enormous darkness pressed down on Lee Gun as if it was trying to snatch him away.
The gods were shocked when they realized what this darkness was.
[That’s…! That is the Karmic debt!!]
[Why would the Karmic debt go to Master…!]
[Mimir!]
Mimir ground its teeth after taking a closer look at Lee Gun.
[You just asked how the Great Spirits can get away with what they did? You asked how they can handle the Karmic debt??]
[No way!]
[That’s right. They transferred their Karmic debt to Master.]
[Those bastards!]
It seemed that after killing the Primordial god, the Great Spirits had transferred their Karmic debt to the five Creators who were working directly under the Primordial god. And this time, the Karmic debt was transferred to Lee Gun.
[At this rate, Master will lose his sense of self and power… He’ll transform into an evil god!]
Currently, as Faith had been stolen, Lee Gun’s defense and power were weakened. The Karmic debt was the last nail in the coffin!
[He might self-destruct at this rate…!]
Boom!!!
“Ahhk!”
The chaotic power of the Karmic Debt around Lee Gun started invading his body, and the tormented Lee Gun’s appearance started to change.
“Uncle!”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
Like the evil god Creators, Lee Gun started to turn into a monster. However, he was already a Great Spirit rank.
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhhk!!”
He possessed a power that couldn’t be compared to those Creators. It flung the gods and the disciples away from him.
Koo-goo-goong!
They didn’t even have time to come to their senses.
An enormous power poured out from Lee Gun’s body as he changed into an evil god. The power ruthlessly tried to destroy his surroundings and kill humanity.
“Kuh-huhk!”
The black power surged up like hooks, and these hooks caught the high-rank disciples and the gods.
[Master!]
This power saw them as pretty and was trying to rip them apart.
“Lee Gun-nim… Huhk!”
“Koohk…!”
The power suddenly came to a stop.
Lee Gun, who was barely hanging onto his mind, was trying to control it. However, he was having an incredibly difficult time. In the end, it seemed too hard.
“Ahhhk!”
Lee Gun continued to change into a monster, and he was tormented by the high fever and the pain.
In the end, he couldn’t control his power after turning into an evil god. The power indiscriminately rushed forward.
Everyone realized the danger.
Flash!
Kunlun’s Great Spirit, Sagittarius, Virgo, Leo, and Kevin used their power to restrain Lee Gun.
The strand of light retrained and pushed down the power of Lee Gun, who was now an evil god. However…
“Koo-oohk…! He is so strong!”
[As expected of the Serpent Bearer…!]
Four of the highest-rank Zodiacs and a Great Spirit had combined their powers, yet they were having trouble with the extraordinary power possessed by Lee Gun.
The other gods and disciples added their power, yet Lee Gun’s power still threatened to swallow all of their powers instead!
[No! This is our limit…!]
At that moment.
“Keep him in place!”
“!!”
The gods’ expressions changed because of the familiar voice.
A slime appeared before them. No, it was Aslan.
Then a large pillar of light landed atop Lee Gun’s head.
Boom!!
[The magician of Divine Will has created a binding ability.]
The enormous pillar of light lifted the earth from the ground and imprisoned Lee Gun.
Kwahng!!!
Then a sphere was created. Enormous chains appeared on top of the sphere, encircling it.
Lee Gun was sealed, unable to come out.
“Aslan!”
[Aslan-nim…!]
Aslan landed in front of them. He was glad that his cooldown time had barely ended. During his cooldown time in the slime form, he was unable to use his power.
“This should last a while.”
[Aslan…!]
Virgo couldn’t believe her eyes.
Sagittarius was shocked for a different reason.
At that moment, Aslan looked at Leo since he knew imprisoning Lee Gun wouldn’t solve the actual problem.
“Idiot cat. Hurry up. Go with your Zodiac Saint to destroy the Rule Book. I know you can do it.”
[How dare you call me a cat!!! Damn bastard! I’ll eat you!]
“I’ll give you 100 churu.”
[What the hell did you just say?!!]
Despite its complaints, Leo knew it needed to destroy the Rule Book. The Zodiac grabbed Stevens by the head, and they disappeared.
Suddenly, a familiar voice rang out, mocking the gods’ efforts.
[Do you think that’ll change anything?]
“!”
It was the Lord of the Sky.
The Great Spirits, who had hidden on the earth, could guess what had happened. They were laughing.
[We will recover as the residents of this place send their Faith toward us. In the meantime, Lee Gun will turn into an evil god. He will self-destruct.]
[Earth will be our new temporary home.]
Above all else, they had found out that the disciples were quite useful here. They liked that the disciples here could be used as a fighting power.
Soon, the disciples grated their teeth.
“Will Lee Gun-nim recover if the Rule Book is destroyed?”
[If you get rid of “Chun” and “In,” you can stop the humans’ brainwashing. They’ll no longer be able to steal his Faith.]
The voice scoffed at the words of Kunlun’s Great Spirit.
[Hmmph. It’ll only be possible if you can locate us.]
“!”
The Lord of the Sky contemptuously laughed.
[You want to get rid of Chun and In? You are a traitor. You will never be able to find us.]
[That’s why you should just die.]
The voice of Valhalla’s Great Spirit disappeared.
The Constructs ground their teeth when they realized what the Great Spirits were trying to accomplish.
[They plan to hide until Master self-destructs…!]
[Damn it! If only we knew where they are…!]
“Mister? Why can’t you find them?”
As they spoke, they could feel the Serpent Bearer’s power weaken.
When Chun Sungjae looked at him with desperation in his eyes, Kunlun’s Great Spirit spoke up.
[We can’t find them since they are actively trying to hide. It is perfect. Not even the gods can find them.]
Even if it finding them was possible, it’d take a very long time.
[Since the four of them have combined their powers, it’ll take around fifty years to find them…]
“Are you kidding me? Uncle will be dead before that!”
Boom!!
Suddenly, a booming sound came from the space containing Lee Gun. It was as if Lee Gun was violently kicking the walls from inside.
“L…Lee Gun-nim?”
It didn’t end there.
Boom!!
The disciples started to sweat when the ground started to shake.
“Is he going berserk?!”
Taken aback, everyone raised their guard. They were about to use their power when…
[I can smell the delicious gods here.]
Zzuh-uhng!!!
An unfamiliar voice, accompanied by an earthquake, rang out. The source of the earthquake was in the sky!
They almost screamed when they looked at the sky.
“That’s…!”
A door opened in the sky, and beings that caused goosebumps rushed out.
[I can smell the delicious scent of the gods.]
[Gyah-ha-ha. This is nuts. This place is full of food. I thought there were only humans here. I thought we wouldn’t be able to satiate our hunger here.]
Humanity turned pale from fright as they watched the black shadows of the monsters appear from the gate in the sky.
“M…Monarchs?!”
The gods were also shocked.
[They are the second-generation monarchs…!!]
[Why would those predators come here…!]
Behind the numerous monarchs were hundreds of monsters in shadow forms. They were descending to the earth.
Humanity fell into despair
Of all the times these monarchs could have shown up, they had appeared when Lee Gun-nim was unwell!
“Those bastards are…!”
“Can’t they take a hint after taking a beating from Lee Gun-nim…!!”
The Zodiac Saints and the high-rank disciples gnashed their teeth as they prepared to attack the monsters.
The second-generation monarchs ignored the humans as they uproariously laughed.
[Hey, look! There are eight Great Spirits here!]
[What?!]
[Bring more of our troops! We came here on the orders of the first-generation elder, and we hit the jackpot!]
[That’s odd. Our elders told us not to go to the earth.]
[Did Elder Eternal Change lure them here?]
[Who cares? They are Great Spirits!]
[I think some of them are hiding.]
[Who cares if they are? It isn’t as if they can erase their scent.]
[You are right. We’ll find them in a minute.]
Were they sent here, or were they summoned here? Beings who were best at sniffing out the gods had appeared on the earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - Karmic Debt (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 428 - Karmic Debt (2)
‘This is crazy!’
The monarchs had appeared in front of humanity and the gods, surprising them. Their appearance only created despair. However, it wasn’t the most shocking part.
“What the hell? Why are they bypassing us?”
The black shadows in the sky suddenly moved in a different direction.
‘There is no way they didn’t notice our presence.’
The gods and the humans had met eyes with the monarchs.
Since they had already experienced the power of the monarchs, they knew what the monarchs were capable of. There was no way the monarchs weren’t aware of them. Were the monarchs trying to make them lower their guards?
“I…It seems they aren’t going to attack us, right…?”
“Y…Yeah. They really are passing us by….”
Surprised, Goat and Lee Jaewon glanced at Lee Gun and Kunlun’s Great Spirit.
‘We have Great Spirits too, so why are they moving away from us?’
However, they soon realized the reason.
[What the hell are you doing to the top of my head?]
“It’s nothing.”
Aslan grinned as he dared to snatch Kunlun’s Great Spirit by his head. The heroic figure of Kunlun’s Great Spirit had transformed into a cute baby lizard.
