Virgo started to sweat.
‘He created the transformation magic in such a short time.’
Aslan had made sure the monarchs weren’t able to notice Lee Gun and Kunlun’s Great Spirit. He had placed stealth magic and transformation magic on Kunlun’s Great Spirit.
As for Lee Gun, he was sealed and incapable of using his power. Of course, the monarchs couldn't locate him. On the other hand, Kunlun’s Great Spirit hadn’t put up any resistance and had accepted Aslan’s stealth magic.
‘Well, we are minnows compared to the Great Spirits.’
With the tastiest prey in sight, the monarchs wouldn’t be satisfied with eating the rest of the gods here.
‘Still, I can’t believe they dare go after the Great Spirits…’
It didn’t matter in the end. The presence of the two Great Spirits on their side had gone unnoticed.
So where would the monarchs go now?
‘They are going toward the hidden Great Spirits!’
The color returned to the faces of the gods and disciples.
“I have no idea why they appeared here, but this is our chance.”
[They are the best at finding gods!]
How else was Abyss able to travel to the Divine world from so far away! It didn’t matter how intense or how long the scent lingered. The monarchs were like sharks smelling blood in the water.
They could be several thousand kilometers away, yet the mere scent of a god would send them into a frenzy! They chased after and mauled the gods!
The Chun siblings immediately contacted the observatory.
“What? The monsters are heading toward Europe and Central Asia?”
They laughed.
‘The Great Spirits are hiding over there.…!’
* * *
After finding the Great Spirits, the monarchs were laughing maniacally.
[A gift fell in our laps! They are weakened Great Spirits! Ha ha ha ha!!!]
[Come out! We know you guys took on the forms of humans!]
Boom!!! Boom!
The monarchs were excited by the prey called the Great Spirits. They were indiscriminate in hunting down living beings, but gods were their favorite meal!
Since the Great Spirits stood at the zenith of the gods, the monarchs knew that they could lose their lives while fighting them. However, they considered the hunt worth it.
[I was able to get a bite of Eden’s Great Spirit not too long ago!]
[What?! Really! You ate something so rare?!]
[I was following around the elders, and a scrap fell on the ground. It was the best thing I’ve eaten in my life!]
[Lucky bastard!]
[I also ate the head of a pillar god, who was close to a Great Spirit.]
[What?!]
[The pillar god was delicious. I bet it’ll be blissful to eat a Great Spirit!]
The second-generation monarchs were frothing at their mouths as they hunted down the Great Spirits.
Buildings were destroyed, and people ran away screaming. It caused the disciples monitoring Europe and Central Asia to gulp.
‘They really are monarchs!’
‘Are we sure we should be letting them do this?!’
The disciples in charge of managing Europe were shaking in fear. They had contacted the upper management for guidance, and the answer that came back was ridiculous.
- Just leave them be! In fact, let them make more of a mess!
“What?!”
Their leaders had traveled to Korea when they received a call from Lee Gun-nim. So these disciples wondered if their leaders had lost their minds like Lee Gun, but they soon found out the reason behind the order.
[Meat!!!]
[Highest-quality premium meat!!]
Kwahng!!
The monarchs weren’t interested in the humans who were running away, who the disciples helped evacuate. The monarchs had one goal.
‘They are…!’
Strangers were hiding within a building. The disciples had thought they were civilians and rushed to save them. But…
[These animals are never helpful!]
Now that they had recovered their power, the Great Spirits could stand still no longer. They had been possessing the bodies of humans, which they discarded and revealed themselves.
Koo-goo-goong!
The eyes of the monarchs flashed.
[You finally came out!]
[They are weakened Great Spirits! What a treat!!]
[Ha ha ha ha!!]
Was it because Lee Gun had stolen the colonies from the gods? While they hadn’t lost as much power as Lee Gun, the Great Spirits had suffered a loss to their Faith too. Their power had been weakened.
It was why they had hidden on the earth and changed the rule to steal the Faith of the Serpent Bearer temple. Of course, a big part of it was to get rid of the Serpent Bearer, but…
[Why did those beasts come to the land that they never paid attention to before? Why are they causing trouble?]
[Shut up, meat!!!]
[We did covet this place, but Elder Wind stopped us from coming here until now!]
[For some reason, Elder sent us here this time! There is no way we’ll blow this opportunity!]
The monarchs knew. The Great Spirits were weakened right now, and this was the opportunity of a lifetime!
[Also, this one has been turned into a human? Ha ha!]
Olympus’s Great Spirit furrowed his brow. Thanks to Lee Gun’s power of Cycle, he had become human. However, he was using the power of “In” to recover his Divine power.
The Great Spirits of Olympus, Babylon, and Mahabharata raised their eyebrows. Why the hell did this Wind send so many monarchs?
‘What lit the fuse under Wind…!’
‘He isn’t someone that would usually unleash his subordinates like this.’
While the Great Spirits tried to hide, the humans praised them.
- Monarchs? Who are the Great Spirits?
- They are beings that’ll never retreat. They’ll crush the monarchs once again.
The memories of Lee Gun had been swapped out with the Great Spirits. This was why humanity depended on the Great Spirits now.
Lee Gun was a god that never backed down. It didn’t matter who his enemies were. If the Great Spirits retreated or negotiated with the monarchs, Faith toward them would plummet, and they would suffer.
‘If the Faith drops, it’ll be a big blow to us.’
The fact that they had swapped out Lee Gun’s existence for themselves had consequences. This was why they couldn’t retreat despite the monarchs being troublesome.
‘We were barely able to transfer the Karmic debt to the snake god.’
They had to solve their problems before the transfer of the Karmic debt became useless, yet the monarchs were here to interfere!
The monarchs didn't care about the Great Spirits’ plight. They opened their mouths.
[Meat!!]
Full of vitality, the monarchs attacked Olympus’s Great Spirit first. They bit into his neck.
Kwah-jeek!!
[Master!!]
[Koo-oohk…!!]
The flustered gods attacked, but the monarchs moved like they were connected to each other. Dodging the attacks, they savagely ripped open the throat of the Great Spirit.
Poo-hahk!!!
Of course, the monarchs were dying because of the power used by the Great Spirits, but they showed no signs of retreating.
[Rip them apart!!]
The Great Spirits and the monarchs fought en masse.
Boom!!!
Enormous power clashed against enormous power. The monarchs transformed into huge monsters as they rushed toward Olympus’s Great Spirit like a school of piranhas.
Kwah-jeek!
Boom!!
Then, something surprising happened.
Pah-jeek!!
[…!]
As Olympus’s Great Spirit was bitten, “In” was destroyed. It was the Divine item of the Primordial god, which was brainwashing humanity.
Since it had control over the soul, it could change the memories and awareness of others.
The other Great Spirits ground their teeth. They knew what the destruction of the Divine item portended!
Zzuhng!!
As soon as In was destroyed, a powerful light swept through the world.
[In, which dominates the soul, has been destroyed.]
[The ability of In has dissipated.]
[The brainwashing has become undone.]
As the light extended to cover all of humanity, the humans’ awareness started to shift.
“Uh? What the hell?”
“Great Spirit of Olympus… What the hell? That’s crazy?! Where is our Lee Gun-nim?”
“That’s odd. Why were we cheering for some strange god?!”
[Faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple is being restored.]
Kwahng!!!
A boom rang out from the earth prison, which was keeping Lee Gun sealed. The gods and disciples, who were protecting it, flinched.
Aslan’s power had kept Lee Gun in check, but as soon as Faith returned to him….
Zzuhng!!!
Lee Gun wasn’t a beast that could be caged. He smashed apart the prison.
Koo-goo-goong!
The power of the Divine magician was instantly destroyed, and a monster revealed itself.
Lee Gun walked out, emitting an enormous amount of power.
Aslan became guarded when he saw Lee Gun’s combative stance. “That was strong enough to repel the attacks of tens of thousands of high-rank gods!”
He was able to break through it. As expected, a Great-Spirit-rank evil god was too strong.
The disciples and gods were stunned as they looked at him. The reason was his appearance. Around 90% of his appearance was that of a monster, with the remaining being a human’s.
[That appearance…! He is almost an evil god!]
“Wait a moment! Isn’t this really dangerous?”
“I don’t think he is rational…!”
The only part that looked human was his hands.
When the evil-god Lee Gun extended his hand, everyone froze.
‘We are dead.’
[As if the gods were not bad enough, monsters are here again? They dare come crawling into my land again?]
“!”
A familiar voice rang out, and it didn’t sound as if he had lost this sense of reason. It seemed the thing that antagonized Lee Gun was the energy of the monsters.
[You want to die, bastards!]
Something surprising happened as the menacing voice rang out.
Kwahng!!
“Ahhk!”
Lee Gun started gaining control over his body. The power that had invaded his body was being pushed out by his own power.
Was it because Faith had returned?
It seemed he had regained his rational thoughts, and he took control of the process that was turning him into an evil god.
“Lee Gun-nim!”
“It’s the monarchs!”
It was unclear why they had made an appearance, but if the monarchs killed and ate the Great spirits, they would get stronger. It also wasn’t an ideal situation.
[Fuck off…]
Lee Gun’s monstrous appearance was slowly turning to its original self. His eyes flashed as he used his power.
[From my land!]
A menacing black aura surged up around him.
[Mortality (6 star)]
Lee Gun used a six-star-rank power of Death, and it extended out into the surroundings. Of course, he was simply blasting everything around him.
This ability moved over the mountains and lakes. It crossed countries, oceans, and continents, covering the entire world.
Koo-goo-goong!!!
It was large enough to encircle the entirety of the earth and the sky.
The monsters and gods who had gathered on the earth screamed as they were swept into the black power.
[Wait a moment…!]
[That power is…!!!]
The power of Death encircled all of the earth. It encircled everything, aside from the original residents of the earth.
[The enemies are being exterminated.]
[The enemies are being exterminated.]
[You have gained Divine status EXP.]
[The power of your Divine status has increased.]
In a flash, Death turned the encircled enemies into ash.
When the enormous power rushed toward them, the monarchs gnashed their teeth. They felt aggrieved since they had destroyed In and Chun.
[Hey! We didn’t lay a hand on the humans!]
[Damn it! We almost had them all!]
[Why don’t you overlook this a little?]
The monarchs cursed, and the horde of monsters, which had sneakily attacked humans, were all swept away.
The remaining monarchs and monsters quickly realized the seriousness of the situation, so they moved toward the portal in the sky.
[Dodge it for now!!]
[We’ve somewhat succeeded in our hunt for our prey! This should be enough!]
[We’ll come again later!]
In a flash, Lee Gun had swept away the invaders. It was as if he was getting rid of pests.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. When he gestured with his hand, black ponds appeared beneath the Great Spirits.
Thanks to the developed noses of the monarchs, he had located the location of the Great Spirits.
[You have used Death (3 star).]
The disciples near Lee Gun were surprised.
“That’s…!”
An enormous black space appeared in front of their eyes, and the Great Spirits fell out of it.
Lee Gun had extended his hand and used Pond to bring the Great Spirits before him.
It seemed the monarchs had used their full power to hunt down the Great Spirits. Olympus’s Great Spirit was dead, and the other Great Spirits were full of injuries.
As expected of them, the monarchs had inflicted significant damage on their enemies. Because of them, Lee Gun was in a great position to land the last blow. This was why he had purposefully killed and driven out the monsters.
Also, it would be a problem if the monarchs grew by eating the Great Spirits.
Lee Gun smirked as he looked at the Great Spirits. “So you guys are the only ones left?”
The Great Spirits glared at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - Karmic Debt (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 429 - Karmic Debt (3)
The Great Spirits glared at him, as if he was irritating.
[Did you call in the monarchs?]
Mahabharata’s Lord of Cycle spoke first.
The Great Spirits seemed to be under the impression that Lee Gun had called in the monarchs to attack them.
Lee Gun scoffed. “What nonsense are you talking about? Why would I call them here? Have you lost your minds?”
Why the hell would he ruthlessly cut down the monarchs if he had called them here?
[If not, why would they leave the humans alone? There is no way they would only attack us.]
Olympus’s Great Spirit, who was close to death, objected. After his Divine item of In had been destroyed, his Divine status had been mauled by the monarchs. It was a miracle that he was still alive.
Lee Gun didn’t seem to be connected to the monarchs’ moves. This made the Great Spirits furrow their brows.
[So Wind indeed sent them here.]
[This is the land where Time died. There is no way they’ll help out the snake god.]
Wind was one of the monarchs who had put a lot of effort into raising Time. Moreover, Time had killed his parent, the second-generation monarch Space-Time. Yet, Wind had been ecstatic about that.
Earth was the land belonging to the person who had killed Time. There was no way Wind would order the monsters to leave humans alone.
When Lee Gun gave a definite answer, the Great Spirits started laughing for some reason.
[It’s great that you didn’t join hands with the monarchs.]
“!”
If Lee Gun hadn’t joined hands with the monarchs, they would encounter no further complications in trying to get rid of Lee Gun. However…
“Who cares about that?”
[!]
Humanity had been brainwashed using the power of a Divine item. Therefore, the humans were enraged at the Great Spirits.
The six billion humans as well as the disciples, who had been brainwashed, ground their teeth.
“We caused harm to Lee Gun-nim…”
After regaining their memories, the humans had developed a deep-seated anger toward the Great Spirits.
“How dare you try to take the accomplishments of another in such an underhanded manner? Is that something gods should do?”
The Zodiac Saints lowered their heads as if those words had hit a sore spot.
The whole world was expressing their anger toward the Great Spirits, yet they seemed unfazed.
[It doesn’t matter if we can’t brainwash you, slow-witted colony residents.]
[We tried to rule over you humanely, yet you spurned our goodwill. You have made a mistake.]
[Humans are like farm animals. We shouldn’t even bother trying to guide them.]
“What?”
When the disciples became incensed…
Boom!!
“…kuh-huhk!!”
The energy of the Great Spirits, whom they had thought were injured, changed. An intense killing intent that only gods could withstand pressured down toward the Constructs and the disciples.
[Respect? Mercy? Those shouldn’t be given to livestock.]
[All beings are equal in front of fear.]
It was as if they had revealed their true selves. Humanity and the gods shook when the Great Spirits emitted an overwhelming power.
The gods and the disciples couldn't understand something.
‘Why are they so confident when Lee Gun-nim is here?’
‘The brainwashing was negated, so all the Fath returned to Lee Gun-nim.’
Moreover, they had suffered greatly at the monarchs’ hands.
‘Are they underestimating Lee Gun-nim?’
‘No, that doesn’t seem to be the case.’
In their current situation and given the amount of force they possessed, the Great Spirits shouldn’t be acting in such an overbearing manner.
The Chun siblings and the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple were sweating since they were connected to Lee Gun.
‘Those bastards know Uncle’s status.’
Yes, although Lee Gun looked normal, he wasn’t fine inside.
[Karmic debt is eating away at the Serpent Bearer’s body.]
[His life is in danger.]
[His Divine power is being continuously eaten away.]
[His fever is severe.]
[His body and organs are wasting away.]
Thankfully, the Faith had returned to him, but the Karmic debt that the Great Spirits had transferred to him remained undiminished.
Lee Gun’s frighteningly strong mental state and power might have reversed his change into a monster, but his body was continuing to deteriorate.
‘Uncle is sick right now.’
Lee Gun was acting fine in front of them, but his breathing was breathing oddly fast.
‘Just stopping himself from becoming an evil god should be causing him enormous pain.’
The power of Cycle could be used only if Death and Life were combined. Even thinking that Lee Gun would be able to use it was unimaginable.
Balance was important to Cycle. Any slight imbalance could cause the power to go berserk and blow up the earth.
The Great Spirits seemed to be aware of this.
[You are probably in so much pain that you want to die.]
[The fact that you can maintain this state using only your mind is amazing.]
Lee Gun wanted to shut them up, so he summoned Fetters of the Underworld. The weapon let out black flames and transformed into a sword.
The Great Spirits smirked when they saw blood flowing from Lee Gun’s mouth.
[Don’t try so hard.]
[How long do you think you can hold out against the pain and your deteriorating body?]
[Just give up. It’ll be easier to go through the process of inheritance. Ah! I forgot you can’t do it.]
Lee Gun couldn’t stop his destruction unless he resolved the Karmic debt that had been transferred to him.
The gods and the disciples were surprised.
‘How the hell did they transfer the Karmic debt to him?’
“Is it the Rule Book?”
“Did they put in a rule that says the Karmic debt of the Great Spirits will be transferred to someone else?”
Someone answered Lee Jaewon’s question.
[That can’t happen. Such a rule doesn’t exist within the Rule Book, so it can’t be modified.]
[Only the Primordial god can add a new rule.]
The one to answer him was one of the goddesses of fate who had taken on Lee Gun’s appearance.
If they wanted to stop the Great Spirits from changing the rules of the universe, the Rule Book had to be destroyed, but…
[They must have something else.]
[It allowed them to transfer their Karmic debt.]
If they could discover this method, they could transfer the Karmic debt from their uncle to the Great Spirits.
At that moment, Mimir, who had been observing the Great Spirits, suddenly gave a solution.
[Divine item….]
“What?”
[They have an “item” that transfers the Karmic debt.]
“Item?”
[Yes. It seemed to be a type of Divine item containing an ability… The Great Spirits might be using this item right now. However, I don’t know what that item is.]
“If we bring it back, we can reverse the Karmic debt!”
“!”
Valhalla’s Great Spirit raised his eyebrows as if the conversation between Mimir and Chun Sungjae bothered him.
[It seems you refuse to be helpful until the end, Mimir.]
Valhalla’s Great Spirit immediately transformed into a giant and attacked them.
Flash!!
When he saw the enormous power of Valhalla’s Great Spirit, Kunlun’s Great Spirit’s eyes flashed. He used his ability.
The other Great Spirits used their power at once in contempt. Lee Gun’s eyes flashed, and he also used the power of Cycle.
Finally, the incredible power of the Great Spirits clashed against each other.
Koo-goo-goong!!!
Aslan, Virgo, Sagittarius, and the other high-rank Zodiacs quickly raised their defensive barrier.
The clash of the Great Spirits’ powers was strong enough to destroy the earth.
[Koo-oohk! As expected of power being used by five Great Spirits…!]
[Kuh-huhk!!]
They kept trying to minimize the damage, but the mere backlash was enough to destroy a country.
Aslan immediately used “Ability Creation” to create a barrier, which weakened the destructive power.
Koo-goo-goong!
Thankfully, the destructive power was dampened, but Aslan looked at Lee Gun with worry in his eyes.
‘It won’t last long.’
Lee Gun would be at a disadvantage the longer they fought on the earth.
It was surprising that Lee Gun was able to move this much in so much pain. However, he would encounter a limit if he fought while protecting humanity and this land.
‘He’ll be able to suppress the pain for several hours at most.’
The Great Spirits had indeed been weakened because of the monarchs’ attacks, but they stood at the zenith of the gods for a reason.
For Lee Gun to win, acquiring the Rule Book was a must. The Karmic debt had to be transferred back.
Thankfully, the Great Spirits wouldn’t be able to use their full power for a short time because of the monarchs!
Mimir seemed to have a similar idea. He asked,
[Regarding the item capable of transferring Karmic debt, an item of that magnitude was probably created by a Creator. Did you make it, Old Master?]
Aslan furrowed his brows. “Even I can’t create a skill that can transfer Karmic debt. As soon as I try to create a skill for that purpose, Karmic debt would crush me.”
[That means…]
“It was an item made by someone that already possessed that ability.”
The Constructs looked taken aback.
[An ability capable of transferring Karmic debt? If someone like that had appeared in the Divine world, it would have caused a commotion!]
“Or maybe it isn’t specific to Karmic debt. It might be an ability that can move certain types of matter or power.”
Chun Sungjae gave an answer befitting a teleporter.
Sagittarius scoffed.
[Move? Such a Creation ability doesn’t exist.]
“Or maybe it can create a tunnel…”
[I’ve never heard about that either…]
Suddenly, a peculiar expression appeared on Mimir’s face when he heard Sagittarius’s words. Mimir possessed the ability to see through all the knowledge of the world, and he seemed to have realized something.
Aslan, who had been listening to them, spoke up. “I think this is related to me and Hyung-nim”
[…what? Me?]
“I was too young, so I don’t remember it too well. However, you were decent at using your Creator ability. I remember liking that ability a lot.”
Sagittarius looked at Aslan, dumbfounded.
[Hmmph. It might be possible for you because you’re a genius. However, I didn’t have any abilities as a Creator. That is why I couldn’t join the Creators…]
Suddenly…
- Galan. You are a disgrace to the Creators. You must never use that ability.
As if the image of a ghost had flashed by, Sagittarius flinched.
[Just now… What was that?]
The Great Spirits also flinched for some reason when they saw this.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he kept the Great Spirits occupied. “Sungjae! Use the third skill on that bastard!”
“What? Third? Are you sure? You want me to use it on an ally? Uh… Damn it! Whatever!”
Chun Sungjae activated his skill and immediately charged toward Sagittarius.
[Pain Revival]
[Wait…!]
The lightning bolt looked painful. The frightened Sagittarius tried to dodge, but Chun Yooha grabbed hold of him.
Pain Revival was one of the skills belonging to Life.
When it landed on Sagittarius's head, the god of the sun screamed as he vomited blood. At the same time, he saw an odd memory. The timeline was unclear, but a blonde Creator was looking at him with disgust in his eyes.
- I am Galan, and I am the eldest son. Why am I not being accepted as a Creator?
- You cannot be acknowledged as a Creator with an ability like that. Leave.
- But…!
- You must never use the Steal ability ever again.
Sagittarius clutched his forehead in pain. He was sure of it. They were coming back in bits and pieces, but he was recovering all of his memories of Galan.
Valhalla’s Great Spirit had also realized this. He looked very displeased.
[That useless…!]
Babylon’s Great Spirit, who had been held in place by Kunlun’s Great Spirit and Lee Gun, suddenly flew toward Sagittarius.
Kwahng!!
Everyone screamed at the sudden move. The Great Spirit tried to kill everyone, including the robust young man and Sagittarius.
Flash!
The gods were taken aback by his movement and attack.
Lee Gun chased after Babylon’s Great Spirit, but the Great Spirit’s target was Sagittarius. He risked being stabbed in the back by Lee Gun, yet he continued forward. It meant this task was more urgent.
It looked as if he was trying to stop Sagittarius from regaining his memories.
Lee Gun burst out laughing. “There is something to this.”
[!]
“There was a reason you were in a rush to execute that baldy”
He had always considered it odd. The Great Spirits could have used Sagittarius—he was quite useful—yet they tried to execute him using some nonsensical reason.
Babylon’s Great Spirit snorted.
[You are a snake god on death’s door.]
Babylon’s Great Spirit was about to attack Lee Gun when…
[Ahhk…!]
Sagittarius clutched his head in pain. He felt as if his head would crack open.
As pain racked his brain, memories started to rush through. They were the memories of the time when he was a Creator.
- Why does Father not want you to use your ability, Hyung-nim?
- My ability is to steal. Creators create from nothing. I cannot create. I can only steal from others. Even if I try to make something, I merely move what belongs to someone else to me. Creators create to save and protect life. This might be a shameful ability to the Creator tribe.
- I don’t know. I think Hyung-nim’s ability is great…
-Creator Galan. I heard you have an awesome ability.
- Oh Great Spirits. I don’t have any abilities.
Sagittarius ground his teeth when he remembered a particular memory.
[…I made sure I disposed of all the items I made.…!]
When they heard Sagittarius’s mumbling, the Great Spirits became desperate.
[That bastard….]
While his mumbled words were a problem, the bigger problem was that Sagittarius had started to emanate the power of a Creator.
‘We are dead if he regains his memories.’
Babylon’s Great Spirit changed his course and now headed straight toward Sagittarius. Then he used an ability that made approaching them impossible. Sending the gods and humans flying, he shouted,
[Vish!]
Mahabharata’s Great Spirit used his ability when he heard the shout.
[Mahabharata’s Great Spirit has used the power of Maintain.]
[Chun Sungjae’s power has been stopped.]
[All phenomena have been stopped.]
[The memories have stopped returning.]
This power stopped everything when one was about to acquire what one wanted.
Everyone was surprised by the silence. It was as if the power had stopped time.
Sagittarius also stood still as if he was frozen in time.
Babylon’s Great Spirit smirked.
[I’ll kill him first.]
He was about to head toward Sagittarius.
“!”
Bbah-gahk!!!
It was unclear as to when he had arrived, but Lee Gun moved at a speed that exceeded that of Babylon’s Great Spirit.
Lee Gun kicked Sagittarius’s head. “You are driving me crazy! Just remember everything, asshole!”
Bbuhk!!!
[You have used Time’s “Fast Forward.”]
Light exploded forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - Karmic Debt (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 430 - Karmic Debt (4)
[You have used Time’s “Fast Forward.”]
A light exploded forth.
Since Lee Gun had used the power of Time, the power of Maintain used by Mahabharata’s Great Spirit faltered.
[Time is suppressing Maintain.]
[Maintain has been broken, and the memories have been recovered.]
Sagittarius recalled his past. He used to be Galan, Aslan’s older half-brother, and he was born as the eldest son of the chief of the Creators. Yet he was never accepted into the tribe. He now recalled why.
- I hate you, son. If only you had the ability of a Creator, she wouldn’t have left me.
- What? Are you saying I caused all of this?
- Yes! With this, I am a full-fledged member of the Creators!
Galan had been popular, and he enjoyed a great reputation. He had everything except one thing; he didn’t have the Creation ability, so the Creators treated him as an outsider.
However, he just hadn’t manifested his ability. When he realized he possessed the Transfer ability, he had been elated.
Like his father and younger brother, he would be able to join their tribe. However, he was back to square one when he found out that his ability was “Steal.” No, he was treated more like an outsider compared to before.
Moreover, they always made comments that his genius younger brother had a good ability. Galan hadn’t been sure if they were trying to console him or make fun of him by doing so.
However, some thought highly of Galan’s ability.
- I heard you are a very talented Creator.
They were the Great Spirits.
- Your ability is peerless. It’s something no one else can do.
As the word “Steal” implied, Galan could steal Ability, Attack, Thoughts, and Divine status. He could even take out and transfer a fetus.
It didn’t matter what his target was. He could take out whatever his target possessed and move it from point A to point B.
However, his father and the Creators called the ability useless and something that should’ve never existed.
The Great Spirits thought differently.
- I want to buy an item containing your ability.
Beings who stood at the zenith of the Divine world were paying close attention to him. Galan thought his name would become known, and his road to success would be opened.
Of course, he would also be well compensated. The Great Spirits had offered an exorbitant amount of price for a Divine item containing the Steal ability. However, he chose not to sell it in the end.
- I haven’t made any items. I am a novice who can’t even call myself a craftsman.
Galan knew his ability could be used dangerously. He might hate his father, but he also understood why his father had forbidden him from using that ability.
That was why he dismantled all the items that he had made. He had made them because he wanted to be accepted by the Creators.
In the end, he chose to walk the path of a war god.
- You must never use your ability again, Galan!
He had chosen to use it once more for the last time. He had used it to save Life. However, his father was displeased with him.
- I… I just…
He had taken out a disease to save Life. That was all he did. He had thought his father would be happy when he learned of his actions.
- Get out. Never mention that you are part of our tribe. Never mention that you are my son.
In the end, Galan didn’t even look back as he left.
As he was wallowing in his rage and sadness, Galan coincidentally ran across Ennead’s Great Spirit, Valhalla’s Great Spirit, and Olympus’s Great Spirit at the time.
- Do you hate your father?
A light appeared at the fingertips of the Great Spirits, and irrational anger surged inside Galan.
In the end, he cooperated with beings who hated his tribe. He helped them kill his parents and the Creators.
After wiping out the tribe, Galan saved a single survivor in Aslan. Assuming Aslan was too young to remember what had happened, he placed him on the throne of the Serpent Bearer temple. Galan used his younger brother as a front to act like Creators.
In the end, he and the other Zodiacs were murdered by their own Constructs in the same way.
That had been Galan’s life.
Having regained his memories, Sagittarius screamed.
Flash!
When Sagittarius let out a familiar energy, the Constructs were surprised.
[That’s the energy of a Creator…!]
Lee Gun smirked as if he had sprung a trap. For some unknown reason, the Great Spirits were wary of Sagittarius. To be precise, it wasn’t Sagittarius. They were wary of his original personality of Galan.
Of course, Sagittarius had started to regain the memories of Galan only recently. This was why the Great Spirits hadn’t been able to recognize him earlier. Otherwise, they would have taken care of him much earlier.
It wasn’t still a certainty, but what if Sagittarius was involved in the Karmic Debt transfer? The fact that they had spared him would now be a boon for the other side.
The eyes of Babylon’s Great Spirit flashed.
[That bastard…!]
This situation was the worst for them.
Babylon’s Great Spirit instantly closed the distance and lashed out with an attack.
The disciples’ eyes turned round. The Great Spirit was moving differently from before!
From the outside, he looked injured, but his movement was markedly different from that of the other Great Spirits.
“What the hell? Why is he unaffected?!”
It was as if he was the only one who hadn’t been attacked by the monarchs.
However, that question lasted only a moment as the eyes of Babylon’s Great Spirit flashed. The ability of the powerful water god threatened the gods and disciples.
When Lee Gun heard the screams, his eyes flashed. This was his land, and the Great Spirit dared run wild here?
[Fuck off!]
Kwahng!
Lee Gun’s power clashed against the power of Babylon’s Great Spirit.
The ground was destroyed as the extremely strong power of the Fetters of the Underworld caught Babylon’s Great Spirit.
Although Babylon’s Great Spirit was powerful, this place was Lee Gun’s home field.
[Faith toward the Serpent Bearer temple is rising.]
[Your power is being amplified by the power of Faith.]
[Increased toughness. Increased endurance.]
Lee Gun never showed his back to an enemy, and he was a symbol to the humans. This generated power for him.
Babylon’s Great Spirit looked on in contempt as he brought up the ocean waters.
[You are a mere rookie god who hasn’t even developed any internal force!]
It was enough water to submerge entire humanity.
However, all the water suddenly disappeared as if it had been an illusion. The water had been moved to a different location, and only one being could pull this off…
[Bastards… You guys fixed and used the items that I made and dismantled.]
[!]
Babylon’s Great Spirit flinched.
Sagittarius had moved the water to somewhere else and had immediately figured out what the Great Spirits had done.
[You used my item to steal the Karmic Debt and move it to a different place.]
Karmic Debt Transfer
Yes, Galan had made items containing the Steal ability, and the Great Spirits had made great use of them.
While the Great Spirits weren’t able to possess the sixth ability of the Primordial god, Galan’s ability had been used as a useful replacement. This was why they had plotted to steal his dismantled items.
The Great Spirits furrowed their brows as if they had a headache.
[You are merely a “substitute.” How dare you act high and mighty…]
They tried to get rid of Sagittarius, but the sound of something being destroyed rang at that moment.
Clank!
[?!]
Then, something shiny fell from the Great Spirits’ bodies. It was the dust created by broken items.
The Great Spirits were stunned when they realized what had happened.
[Sagittarius! How dare you…!]
Babylon’s Great Spirit glared at Sagittarius.
Lee Gun laughed as if it served them right. “Idiots. Did you think the person who made these items wouldn’t be able to destroy them”
[…!!]
Since he was a craftsman as well, Lee Gun knew what had happened. He laughed buoyantly.
Sagittarius had remotely destroyed the Karmic Debt Transfer items, which contained Galan’s ability.
One’s Divine power was contained within one’s creations. This was why their manufacturer could use their Divine power in reverse to destroy these items.
This was why the Great Spirits had been guarded regarding Galan, the owner of the ability.
[This probably takes care of the Karmic debt.]
Lee Gun smirked when he heard Sagittarius’s words. Then something surprising happened.
Flash!
[!]
He hadn’t let it be shown, but he had been suffering because of the Karmic debt.
Color started returning to Lee Gun’s face. That wasn’t all.
[The Karmic debt will return to where it belongs.]
[Kuh-huhk!!]
The Karmic debt that had been dumped on Lee Gun returned to its original owners, the Great Spirits.
Kwahng!!
This Karmic debt was the consequence of combining the earth with the Divine world and the brainwashing done to steal Faith from Lee Gun.
When the Karmic debt went back, Olympus’s, Babylon’s, and Valhalla’s Great Spirits shrieked.
[Olympus’ Great Spirit is in pain from the Karmic debt. He incurred the debt when using In to brainwash humans.]
[Babylon’s Great Spirit is in pain from the Karmic debt. He incurred the debt when he used Chun to combine the earth and the Divine world.]
[Mahabharata’s Great Spirit is in pain from the Karmic debt. He used Maintain to help them.]
[Pain is headed toward Valhalla’s Great Spirit.]
They vomited blood as if they felt tormented.
While they each received their share of Karmic debt now, Lee Gun had previously taken on all their Karmic debt combined. This surprised them.
‘How was he able to endure this?’
Moreover, he was even able to use his ability in such a state.
‘No way…!’
In the end, the one to succumb to the Karmic debt was Olympus’s Great Spirit. He had suffered the most damage from the monarchs.
[Olympus’s Great Spirit ceases to exist. He can no longer endure the Karmic debt and pain.]
[Master!]
[Koo-oohk…!]
At this rate, they wouldn’t be able to use their power. It would be tough to maintain their consciousness!
Mahabharata’s Great Spirit lost consciousness because he couldn’t endure the pain. His body had already turned into that of a monster.
Everyone fell over except one.
Lee Gun looked at Babylon’s Great Spirit. For some reason, the Great Spirit was laughing despite being invaded by the Karmic debt.
[Do you think this will end by transferring the Karmic debt over to us?]
“!”
[Idiot. You dug your own grave.]
They were the ones on the losing side, so what was this?
Lee Gun wondered why the Great Spirit was speaking such nonsense, but he soon furrowed his brow.
[Eye of the Magical Beast was activated.]
He discovered something on Babylon’s Great Spirit. It was a letter engraved on his arm.
Lee Gun read what he saw to Mimir. Mimir flinched when he heard that language.
[Master…! That letter is…!]
Mimir’s face froze as if this was a grave matter.
Babylon’s Great Spirit smiled.
[That’s right. I made a contract with a monarch.]
“…!”
[My body will be healed even if the Karmic debt returns to me.]
The letter engraved on the arm of Babylon’s Great Spirit was proof of a soul contract made with a monarch. It was an absolute contract where the party that broke the contract would die.
It was unclear, but the Great Spirit seemed to have secretly made a contract with a monarch behind the backs of the other Great Spirits.
This contract allowed him to shrug off any damage to his body. It was why he had been fine earlier even after being attacked by the monarchs. He also didn’t look pressed even after his Karmic debt was returned.
Everyone became vigilant.
[If he’s telling the truth, we are at a disadvantage.!]
[By the look of its shape, there is a high probability it’s a first-gen…]
Everyone was shocked by Mimir’s words
[First-generation? There is no way a Great Spirit would make a contract with Wind!]
‘He hates the Great Spirits more than anyone.’
They were mortal enemies. The Great Spirits had taken Eternal Change and Flame as slaves.
[That symbol… He made a contract with Eternal Change…!]
“!”
They were shocked for an entirely different reason. Of course, it wasn’t as if they were unable to understand why he made a contract with Eternal Change. Eternal Change could swap out the body when he got injured, and he also could use the Cluders as troops.
‘It’ll allow him to be able to move ahead of the other Great Spirits.’
It seemed Babylon’s Great Spirit had become taken with this idea when he had seen Lee Gun use Abyss.
The Great Spirits of Ennead, Valhalla, and Mahabharata hadn’t gone through the process of inheritance, and the snake god had stolen the power of Cycle.
Babylon’s Great Spirit had realized that if he wanted to obtain all the power of a Primordial god, he needed the help of a third party. He had done it a short while before Hugo had severed his relationship with Lee Gun.
Moreover, Eternal Change was known to be more fickle compared to Wind, but something was off about this.
[Why would Eternal Change make a contract with you…]
[Why else? Eternal Change couldn’t attack the snake god since the Creators placed restrictions on him. He wasn’t able to be free.]
“!”
The cursed restriction placed on Eternal Change was “Suppress the power and instinct to slaughter” and “Absolute Obedience of Orders from Creators.”
The entire Creator tribe had placed the restriction on him. If even one of them was alive, the restriction wouldn’t be released.
[He said that it was causing him a lot of trouble. Instead of joining hands with me, he wanted me to release him from the restriction. So I solved it using the Rule Book.]
Eternal Change wasn’t from his generation, but in the distant past, he had been captured by the Great Spirits.
This was why Babylon’s Great Spirit knew better than anyone what Eternal Change wanted.
The gods and Zodiac Saints were shocked. The Chun siblings tilted their heads in puzzlement since they didn’t know Eternal Change was Hugo. The others started to swear.
[As expected, we can’t trust a Cluder!]
[He may have reincarnated as a human, but his instincts as a Cluder remain.]
[We should have killed him….]
Lee Gun was furrowing his brows when…
“That was the stipulation in the contract? You said you’ll release him from the restriction?”
“!”
Unexpectedly, Aslan burst out laughing.
Babylon’s Great Spirit raised his eyebrows in ill humor.
[What’s so funny?]
“Oh, Great Spirit of Babylon. You are a Great Spirit, yet you were swindled.”
[What?]
Aslan let out a sharp laugh, as if he was implying the Great Spirit should have been more careful in checking the contract.
“I had already released the restriction on Eternal Change when I was young. I did it before he rampaged through the Divine world. He knows this.”
[…!!]
It meant Eternal Change had no reason to make such a contract. He had been free for a very long time.
“If Eternal Change doesn’t need it, why would he make a contract with you?”
The Great Spirit’s expression was a sight to behold. He suddenly got an ominous feeling.
Aslan pointed at the arm of Babylon’s Great Spirit. “Are you sure that the contract made with Eternal Change states it’ll protect your body?”
[…!]
Lee Gun had been holding the Great Spirit in place, and his eyes turned round.
At that moment, a light started emanating from the contract letter engraved into the Great Spirit’s arm. He screamed in pain.
[Eternal Change’s contract has been activated.]
[The body of Babylon’s Great Spirit is being destroyed.]
[The Divine status of Babylon’s Great Spirit is being destroyed.]
[The “Change” ability of Eternal Change has remade the body of the Great Spirit.]
[Babylon’s Great Spirit has lost all sense of self. He has turned into a creature of the Cluders.]
This was the real contract. As if it were clay, the Great Spirit’s body changed into that of a monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - Karmic Debt (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 431 - Karmic Debt (5)
A very long time ago, Eternal Change had snuck into the bedroom of the Primordial god and had been caught by the Creators.
- Damn it. As fighting-type gods, we couldn’t catch him. Yet, the technical gods were able to catch him. It’s time to dust off our business cards once again.
-That Cluder was out of his mind. I know he’s young, but he is quite ambitious. How dare he target the king of the gods?
- Right. To put it bluntly, Even if he did fall in love with the Primordial god, he would die as the weaker side.
- Did he think that he was stronger than the king of the gods?
- No way!
In the end, the Creators had put the captured Eternal Change under surveillance. He lived with them along with a cursed restriction.
- Hey, monster. You should yield to the Creators. You should repent by being a slave to them throughout your lifetime.
In simple terms, they had put a shock collar around the neck of a wild beast.
A young Aslan didn’t like this. Once, while playing with Eternal Change, he had said,
- Hyung, I will release the restriction. You won’t mistakenly cause any boo-boo by using your power, right?
- ?!
Aslan was able to release Eternal Change from the powerful spell placed on him by the elder Creators. He did it way too easily.
Eternal Change had regained his freedom, and he could now escape the Divine world.
The young Aslan had soon realized that he had made a big mistake, but for some reason, Eternal Change hadn’t run away. He didn’t even tell others that his restriction was removed. This was true even when he was charged and imprisoned for killing the Creators.
- As expected, he’s a monster. The Creators spared him, yet he was ungrateful enough to kill them?
- Thankfully, the restriction is still there. It’s why he can’t leave the prison.
- He can rot in there for the rest of his life.
On the other hand, the young Aslan, who was the sole survivor of the attack on the Creators, knew the truth.
Eternal Change hadn’t killed the Creators. The ones to kill them were his crazy older brother and those jealous of the Creators. In fact, Eternal Change had killed those who had killed the Creators.
This was why Aslan went to prison to speak to Eternal Change.
- Hyung? Why are you imprisoned for a crime you didn’t commit?
- Get lost, kid. Do it before I kill you.
Moreover, Eternal Change had been free for a very long time. If he used his power, he could easily escape the prison of the Great Spirits. He could leave the Divine world at any moment.
So the young Aslan asked,
- Did the conversation with the Great Spirits go badly?
- I said to get lost.
- !
- Never show yourself in front of me, damn Creator.
Eternal Change kept chasing Aslan out with a cold look in his eyes.
Aslan wondered if this was because Eternal Change’s power had been weakened.
In the end, Aslan had exited the prison after giving an ability to Eternal Change. It was an ability that would allow the monarch to escape the prison.
However, the monarch never used that escape ability until Aslan met his death. He spent several hundred years in prison as the Great Spirits stole his power.
At first, Aslan had wondered if Eternal Change’s pride and stubbornness had prevented him from using the escape ability. Or did he find the Creators that loathsome? But that hadn’t been the case.
- It somehow worked. He was told to obediently yield to us if he didn’t want to see the death of the last Creator.
- !
Eternal Change had realized something: no one was left to protect the young Creator, who was now alone in his tribe. He also knew that the Great Spirits hated Creators enough to kill all of them.
This was why Eternal Change had brokered a deal where the young Aslan would be spared. Of course, Aslan had found this out after he became an adult. It was around the time when the usurpation was being planned out and he had decided to die.
Anyway, Aslan had died afterward. With the death of the last Creator, Eternal Change had nothing holding him down. He destroyed and exited the prison.
- Idiot Creators.
He cursed the gods who had caused the death of the Creators. Then he called in his comrades and razed the Divine world to the ground.
Of course, this wasn’t important right now. It didn’t change the fact that Aslan owed his life to Eternal Change.
When the gods and humans heard this, they were surprised.
[Eternal Change was already free?!]
“Well, he wanted to keep this a secret, so I didn’t tell anyone about it either.”
[Old Master!]
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. If Aslan’s words were the truth, then whatever Hugo had told him in their earlier conversation was a lie.
Someone else was shocked the most.
[Eternal Change is someone like that?]
Babylon’s Great Spirit screamed in pain. He glared at them.
[There is no way! That bastard is…!]
Aslan laughed at the Great Spirit, who was denying reality. “Eternal Change has ten thousand faces. He is a liar.”
As soon as he said those words, Eternal Change’s contract was fully activated.
[Ahhhk!!]
Lee Gun pinned down Babylon’s Great Spirit so that the Great Spirit couldn’t run away. Then, something surprising happened.
Kwahng!!
Babylon’s Great Spirit changed from looking like a young human male to looking like an enormous monster. He now looked like a Cluder.
The contract letters engraved on his arm started to change as well, revealing the true contract.
This surprised all of humanity, the gods, and the Great Spirits.
“That’s…!!”
[It’s a contract that turns a Great Spirit into a monarch…!!]
Lee Jaewon bit his lips. He had heard it when the angel of Eden invaded their house.
‘The one to turn Eden’s Great Spirit into that was Eternal Change. No, it was Hugo-nim…’
Lee Jaewon had thought that Hugo had said it to break Michael’s mind, but it turned out to be true.
‘Eden’s Great Spirit was changed like this?’
He had heard that Hugo had turned Eden’s Great Spirit into a monarch, and now Babylon’s Great Spirit encountered the same fate!
In the end, Babylon’s Great Spirit lost all sense of reason after turning into a monarch. He started floundering on the ground as if he was in pain.
Since he was strong, he had changed into a monarch-rank Cluder, but it didn’t change his situation.
‘His Karmic debt was returned to him!’
He didn’t become a monarch and gained power. Instead, it felt like he had become a self-destructive beast that couldn’t identify allies or foes.
[Wait a moment…!]
Babylon’s Great Spirit, who had changed into a Cluder, glared at Mahabharata’s Great Spirit, who was on the ground because his Karmic debt had invaded him.
Currently, Babylon’s Great Spirit was weakened. What would a monarch do to fill the power that he had lost?
[N…No!!]
Kwah-jeek!!!
Babylon’s Great Spirit ruthlessly bit into the neck of Mahabharata’s Great Spirit, who was supposed to be his comrade.
Poo-hahk!!
[Kuh-huhk!]
Babylon’s Great Spirit had lost his rational thought and power. He just wanted to fill his stomach, and the most nutritious and tastiest food to the Cluders was the gods! Moreover, nothing was more delicious than a wounded Great Spirit!
Faithful to his instinct, he bared his teeth as if he hadn’t eaten anything in days.
Kwah-dook! Ooh-doo-doohk!
He ripped into the skin and crushed the bones and the face. Babylon’s Great Spirit dug into the body of the Great Spirit of Mahabharata and ruthlessly cut the lifeline so that there would be no resistance.
Poo-hahk!!
[Mahabharata’s Great Spirit has lost his life.]
[Mahabharata’s Great Spirit ceases to exist.]
Boom!
Finally, Mahabharata’s Great Spirit fell over as a mangled hunk of meat.
Valhalla’s Great Spirit furrowed his brow.
[That idiot…!]
In a flash, two Great Spirits had ceased to exist.
Soon, the full Great Spirit of Babylon roared at the sky.
As if he could no longer stand by, Valhalla’s Great Spirit used his magic. He planned on absorbing Babylon’s Great Spirit and making the ability of Eternal Change into his own.
Poo-hahk!!!
Lee Gun knew it was a golden opportunity, so he let out a menacing laugh as he swung Heaven’s Punishment. Moreover, Heaven’s Punishment was a weapon specialized in killing monsters!
[Kuh-huhk!!]
Had the ax developed internal force while killing monsters? Unlike when it killed the gods, the Divine item generated considerably more power against monsters. It was like cutting through the water.
Lee Gun let out a cold laugh as he decapitated the monarch. Then he said, “Are you the only one left now?”
[Babylon’s Great Spirit ceases to exist.]
[Your EXP has increased by a lot.]
[The level of Cycle has increased.]
Valhalla’s Great Spirit was surprised when Lee Gun cut down Babylon’s Great Spirit with a single blow.
[That bastard…]
He was dumbfounded. Of course, he had made all the calculations, and it wasn’t as if he hadn’t envisioned a scenario where a Great Spirit died. Moreover, he had known that Babylon’s Great Spirit had made contact with a monarch.
‘He had ambitions of acquiring the other powers of the Primordial god.’
Babylon’s Great Spirit had an odd inferior complex toward the Great Spirits who had never gone through the process of inheritance. He used any method available to him if it would give him a boost in power in a short period.
While the other Great Spirits might hate the monarchs, Babylon’s Great Spirit held no great grudge against them. That was why he could readily join hands with the monarchs.
What about Mahabharat's Great Spirit, who was eaten by him?
‘He was an onlooker.’
He was like Valhalla’s Great Spirit. They were part of the group that had killed the Primordial god.
But unlike Valhalla’s Great Spirit, he felt guilty for what he had done. Moreover, the only reason he was helping them out was that he wanted to find Hailey.
‘That bitch’s father was the Great Spirit of Mahabharata.’
He had said that she was the child of a friend, but the Lord of the Sky was skeptical of this claim.
‘That dirty bastard sullied the reputation of the Divine world.’
Hailey was the child between a Great Spirit and a monarch. That dirty monarch bitch had caused the death of an exalted Great Spirit, and the gods had suffered a great loss because of her. She was a source of incredible shame.
Anyway, the death of the other Great Spirits was within the calculations of the Lord of the Sky. In fact, it would be a boon for him since he would be able to gather the other powers of the Primordial god, which had been separated.
[You guys have a talent for getting on my nerves.]
He was referring to Eternal Change and Lee Gun. Valhalla’s Great Spirit had gone through the trouble of making all the calculations, yet the maggots had put a wrench in his plan. The Great Spirit’s eyes flashed as he approached Lee Gun.
[You don’t even have a long time to live, yet you dare do this?]
Currently, the hidden Rule Book was under the care of Valhalla’s goddess of fate, and the Great Spirit possessed the power of Change. He was also the one making changes to the Rule Book until now.
[I’ll use the Rule Book to get rid of your existence.]
He planned to change the words within the Rule Book. It would allow him to erase the existence of Lee Gun.
[The changes made to the Rule Book don't count toward Karmic debt.]
While adding a new rule to the Rule Book might incur Karmic debt, changing the rule so that the Divine world could overcome a crisis was acceptable.
Any change with that scope was acceptable, and he would be able to use it to get rid of Lee Gun.
[You destroyed the Divine world. You were registered as an enemy of the Divine world.]
To get rid of the enemy, the rule could be changed. It would be considered self-defense.
[Do not look down on the owner of the Divine world.]
All the Zodiacs became guarded against Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
‘He is considered the top amongst the Great Spirits.’
There was a reason he had wired as a regent to the Primordial god.
Lee Gun was also guarded as he took deep breaths. While the Karmic debt might be gone, he still suffered the aftereffects of the internal injuries that he had suffered earlier.
Kwahng!!
“!!”
It seemed the Lord of the Sky had already messed with the Rule Book.
Puhng! Puhng! Puhng!
[…!!]
All the weapons possessed by the gods were destroyed, and the Constructs clutched their necks in pain as they fell to the ground. That wasn’t all.
“Kuh-huhk!”
The humans were having a hard time breathing. They also fell to the ground.
Zzuh-uhng!
Enormous cracks appeared on Heaven’s Punishment and the Fetters of the Underworld.
“…!”
It was unclear what the Great Spirit had changed within the Rule Book.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows and raised something in his hand.
‘I was hoping I wouldn’t have to use this.’
He was holding the Divine item made using the Primordial god. It was the only weapon unharmed. But if Lee Gun used that in his current state, he would die from the lack of Divine power.
Suddenly…
[!]
As if he wanted to stop Lee Gun from going through with the move, someone grabbed Valhalla’s Great Spirit by the waist.
[Gun! Move me with him! I’ll tell you the location.]
“!”
It was unexpectedly Sagittarius. His eyes held determination. He wasn’t going to let go of the Great Spirit.
When the Lord of the Sky saw the look in Sagittarius’s eyes, a chill ran up his spine. It was to be expected since Sagittarius had a connection to the item that possessed the Karmic Debt Transfer ability.
His hands moved desperately.
[Bastard…!! Act like a pillar god who is supposed to protect the Divine world!]
[Gun!]
Finally, Lee Gun raised something toward Sagittarius and used “Pond.” An enormous darkness swallowed Sagittarius as well as the Lord of the Sky in his arms.
When they disappeared, the surprised gods asked a question.
[Master! Where did you send those two…!]
“Don’t worry. They are still on the earth.”
Sagittarius had given him a location in the Divine world, but the Divine world and the earth were currently combined.
The two gods were dropped off on a desolate black land. Here, everything, including trees and soil, was dead.
It was the place of exile, Gehenna. It was the land ruled by Ten Heavenly God, who had taken on the face of Junwoo. Gods were forbidden to enter this place since the evil gods had been trapped there.
As soon as they arrived there, the face of Valhalla’s Great Spirit distorted.
[Bastard. Are you…!]
Sagittarius laughed in a sleazy manner.
[You placed all the gods with your Karmic debt here, right?]
[…!!!]
There was no way gods would suddenly turn into evil gods. This was why the answer was obvious.
[You used my items for thousands of years. You transferred your Karmic debt to these gods, and they were too unsightly to see. This is why you made this forbidden zone like a prison. You drove them all in here.]
To keep this secret from leaking out, Valhalla’s Great Spirit and the others had created the Ten Heavenly God as a gatekeeper.
The eyes of Valhalla’s Great Spirit flashed. He wanted to break free.
[Let me go!]
[It is useless. I’ve been transferring your Divine power to Gun since a while ago.]
[!!]
[Also, what would happen if I transferred all the Karmic debt of the evil gods to one being? Would it end with that being turning into an evil god? Hmm?]
The Great Spirit’s face turned pale. As expected, Sagittarius was going to do it!
‘He’s going to kill me by transferring all the Karmic debt to me.’
He became desperate.
[Stop! You are the creator of the Karmic Debt Transfer. Originally, the creator of the items is supposed to accrue Karmic debt as the items are used more and more. Why do you think you remained unharmed!]
Usually, the manufacturer of an item was blameless regarding how the item was used. However, it was an entirely different story if the item was used to create an unbelievable amount of damage.
‘The one that releases such items will be punished.’
That might have been why Galan’s father had forbidden him from using his abilities. His father knew it would be used for evil, and the Karmic debt would come toward Galan too.
Since the Great Spirit knew this, he looked at Sagittarius to ask him to stop.
[We made sure to transfer your Karmic debt too! Do you not know this?]
[Who cares? You did it because you didn’t want to be found out by me and the others.]
[…!]
The flustered Great Spirit yelled,
[If you get rid of me, you won’t be able to get out of this unscathed! Your Karmic debt, which I transferred all this time, will return to you too! You will also die!]
Sagittarius laughed instead of giving an answer. He had suddenly recalled an old memory.
- Hyung-nim! I really like your ability!
- What? Are you saying this because you want to steal something?
- Mmm. If I’m being honest, it’s tempting. However, that has nothing to do with this. In the first place, Hyung-nim never stole others’ abilities or items with it.
- Then why do you like it?
- It’s an ability that can save someone.
- !
- You can move wounds, sickness, and even evilness. You can save a lot of people by using your abilities. That’s why I really like your ability, Hyung-nim.
Sagittarius felt bitter. His younger brother had seen his ability as something that saved lives, yet he had used it to kill his own tribe members. He was a murderer.
At the time, he had died while he had committed terrible sins, so why was he allowed to live a second life? This had always puzzled Sagittarius, but he now knew why.
‘I must take responsibility.’
He had things that he had to own up to and fix. He also knew he couldn’t suddenly become a god who saved lives like Lee Gun. However, there was something only he could do right now.
Sagittarius clung to Valhalla’s Great Spirit so that the Great Spirit couldn’t run away.
[Let’s go together, damn old fart!!]
Shouting that, Sagittarius used his ability.
Kwahng!!
[Ahhk!!]
The Lord of the Sky screamed. In this place were gods who the Great Spirits had used as Karmic debt storage. It had gone on for hundreds, if not thousands of years. Now, all their Karmic debt was returned to Valhalla’s Great Spirit.
The amount of the transferred Karmic debt was enormous. Valhalla’s Great Spirit was in great pain when he received it all at once.
[Ahhk!! Stop! Anyone who dies like this won’t be able to revive— Kuh-huhk!]
Flash!
In the end, the Lord of the Sky couldn’t stay alive as an evil god. He ceased to exist, leaving behind his Divine status.
Kwahng!!
All the Great Spirits who had ruled over the Divine world had perished.
Sagittarius made sure that the Divine status of the Lord of the Sky couldn’t be taken by others; he transferred it to Lee Gun.
At that moment, his Karmic debt also returned to his body.
Boom!!
[Koohk…!]
When Valhalla’s Great Spirit ceased to exist, the Karmic Debt sealed by his magic returned to Sagittarius as well.
However, Sagittarius was unable to transfer his Karmic debt to someone else. Even if he could, he had no intention of doing that.
In the end, Sagittarius laughed for the last time as he disappeared alongside a light.
He was sure his siblings and comrades would make fun of him for doing something so unlike him, but he didn’t care. He had never done anything for his nephew, so he was willing to do this.
Kwahng!!!
Sagittarius's body and soul disappeared.
The sun was set forever.

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - Extinction (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 432 - Extinction (1)
[You have received a Divine status.]
[The Lord of the Sky Odin’s Divine status]
Lee Gun was surprised by the item that fell right in front of him. It was the Divine status of the Great Spirit who Sagittarius had disappeared along with. The implication was clear.
[Sagittarius succeeded!]
[We were able to send the Karmic debt back to the Great Spirit!]
However, Lee Gun didn’t laugh; he had felt it.
‘His life energy is gone.’
As a member of the twelve Zodiacs, Sagittarius’s sister Virgo must have felt it too.
Lee Gun immediately used Pond to move. The other disciples and gods quickly followed him.
“Uncle!”
[Master!]
It wasn’t too hard for Lee Gun to find where Sagittarius and Valhalla’s Great Spirit had perished. A large crater lay where the two of them had passed away. That wasn’t all.
“Uncle…! Over there….”
Chun Yooha pointed at something on the ground.
Lee Gun approached that location and picked up the items. They were the wig and various articles of clothing he had made. They were scattered on the ground.
It seemed Sagittarius’s body ceased to exist while leaving behind his clothes. Everyone knew what this meant.
[Did Sagittarius perish too?]
[It seems so. He must have been swept away after getting rid of the Lord of the Sky…]
At that moment…
[What the hell? What happened here?]
[Where are we?]
Countless gods within Gehenna woke up, looking confused. They were the gods who were used as Karmic debt storage and thrown away by the Great Spirits. They ranged from high-rank to low-rank gods.
They had regained their original forms when Sagittarius had sent the Karmic debt back to where it originally belonged.
They were surprised as soon as they saw Lee Gun.
[I…Is he a new Great Spirit?]
[I…I think so!]
[He looks to be human. By the look of his energy, he doesn’t seem to be an ordinary god!]
These gods had spent hundreds of years as evil gods. They had been roaming with no capability of rational thought.
Naturally, they didn’t recognize Lee Gun. However, they could tell that he was a Great Spirit by looking at his aura. Of course, some were unable to accept the truth.
[No way! How could a kid like that be a Great Spirit…]
[You are right. He appears to have less internal force than me…]
But…
[You presume too much! This person is the ninth Great Spirit… Ah. I guess there are no longer nine of us. Anyway, he is the Wicked Lord. He’s one of the Great Spirits!]
[What?! There is no way—]
[I can attest to it.]
When Kunlun’s Great Spirit spoke up, all the gods were shocked. If even he was attesting to this, Lee Gun really was a Great Spirit.
And Kunlun’s Great Spirit speaking in such a fashion meant…
[It means the Wicked Lord saved us!]
[We regained our original bodies! Thank you very much!]
[We swear our fealty to our benefactor.]
Lee Gun felt bitter at those words. He picked up Sagittarius’s clothes and Divine status.
[Creator Tribe: Creator’s Divine status]
It was Galan’s Divine status.
Virgo let out a bitter smile when she saw it.
[You did something that isn’t like you.]
She could guess what Sagittarius had done at the end. And Lee Gun, Aslan, and the others guessed the same.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he held the Divine status. “Who said you could die?”
“Lee Gun-nim….”
He didn’t feel good about it since Sagittarius was his uncle.
[Still, he….]
“I still haven’t taken revenge on him for killing my junior.”
“L…Lee Gun-nim?”
“Hmmph. He also didn’t pay the fee for using the wig and clothes that I made for him. Is he trying to dine and dash? Are you kidding me?”
“L…Lee Gun-nim??”
Lee Gun was called the god of revival. He snorted as he clutched Galan’s Divine status. “I’ll revive him no matter what it takes. There is no way I’ll let you die in peace.”
In the end, everyone clicked their tongues as if they should have expected this.
As Lee Gun put away the Divine status…
“Uncle?!”
For a moment, Lee Gun became unsteady on his feet.
The Chun siblings rushed toward him in surprise, but he waved them away.
“I used too much power. I’m fine.”
Moreover, his body had taken significant damage when the Karmic debt had been transferred to him.
‘Super Regeneration isn’t enough to handle it.’
His Divine status and soul had also been damaged. If he were being honest, he would have been in danger without Sagittarius’s actions. If he had fought the Lord of the Sky in that state, he would have died after the fight.
‘I’m having a hard time recovering despite having someone with 450% Faith.’
His regeneration was very slow. It felt as if his body was crumbling and his soul and Divine status were deteriorating.
‘If I don’t have someone with extremely high Faith…’
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. He had gotten rid of the Great Spirits and acquired the power of the Primordial god that they possessed. However…
‘Will my body last until I get rid of the monarchs?’
The problem was Wind, whom the idiot Hugo had gone to find.
‘If they are hellbent on invading all at once, the earth won’t be able to take it.’
While they were keeping their power hidden, they were archaic beings. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘I have to get my hands on the Rule Book. I have to separate the earth from the Divine world.’
When Lee Gun got ready to move, Aslan brushed his head.
“Your body is not doing well. Don’t overdo it.”
“!”
“I already sent Leo. He’d do well at sniffing out the Rule Book. You should rest.” Aslan was about to say he was going to bring the Rule Book when something surprised him. He quickly turned his head.
Kwahng!!!!
“…kuhk!!”
“!!”
Aslan’s arm was ruthlessly severed, and blood fountained into the air.
[Old master!!]
[Aslan!]
Aslan slumped to the ground as he vomited blood.
Then a being made his presence known.
[I’ll start it off by cutting off your arm.]
“…!!”
No one couldn’t feel his presence.
All the gods became surprised when they saw the handsome man’s sudden attack. Lee Gun became guarded as he immediately activated Death.
Their opponent was the last Great Spirit, who had remained hidden until now.
“The Lord of the Fire Wheel…!!”
He was the Great Spirit of Ennead. The Great Spirit had long hair that was letting out flames, and he had his arms crossed. He was an arrogant-looking young man.
The bloodied Aslan furrowed his brow as he glared at his opponent. “I was wondering when you would make an appearance.”
Aslan had expected this. If one was asked to pick the strongest among the Great Spirits, it would have to be either the Lord of the Sky or the Lord of the Fire Wheel, who was the sun and a king-like figure to the gods.
As soon as he appeared, the air changed. It was clear that he had purposefully been hiding his true power.
[As expected of a slime, you are tough to kill. I guess I would have been disappointed if you had fallen over with that attack. Why do you think I let you beat me? Why do you think I stayed stuck in that basement?]
“…!”
[No one will get in my way now. I can relax and kill you now. I’ll kill you and your kid.]
“!”
Aslan, who had sealed Ennead’s Great Spirit, got up unsteadily. “I didn’t think you would make it easy and die, but…”
For some reason, Ennead’s Great Spirit had pretended to lose to Aslan. He had voluntarily stayed in the underground.
As if to confirm this, Ennead’s Great Spirit smirked.
[That idiot Odin… He got dragged away by his own Karmic debt. That idiot should have stayed hidden like me.]
Ennead’s Great Spirit brushed his hands off. He laughed as if he was complementing Lee Gun.
[Thanks, kid. You got rid of other Great Spirits and the problem child for me.]
The gods looked at him in shock.
[Got rid of them for you… No way!]
[Why do you think I pretended to lose to that bastard? Why would I keep myself hidden in the basement?]
[Could it be….]
[Yes. It had to do with the Divine status that you are holding. The reason was Galan.]
[…!!!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit cackled as he looked at the Divine status in Lee Gun’s hands.
In truth, Galan was a substitute. He was a substitute for one of the six abilities possessed by the Primordial god. He was a substitute for Exoneration.
In other words, it didn’t matter what one did. It didn't matter what sins one committed. The Exoneration ability allowed one to get exonerated.
However, that power couldn’t be taken away, so they had to come up with a substitute.
Anyway, the Lord of the Sky and the others used the Karmic Debt Transfer recklessly as a substitute for Exoneration, but Ennead’s Great Spirit was different. He had long realized it.
‘Sagittarius is Galan.’
It had happened when Olympus’s White Reaper had stolen a precious item of Ennead’s Great Spirit. The whole Divine world had been turned on its head.
The gods had made a big fuss about declaring war, but Ennead’s Great Spirit had felt a chill run up his spine for an entirely different reason. He was the only one who had noticed it.
‘That’s him.’
It might have been done without him realizing it, but only one being could steal something that had been sealed so tightly.
After realizing his identity, Ennead’s Great Spirit had purposefully refused to use Karmic Debt Transfer.
[If he recovered his memories, I knew he would kill the others by using Return Karmic Debt. That’s the kind of bastard he is.]
He also knew that Galan would die afterward because of his own Karmic debt.
The gods felt chills run up their spines.
[That was why you pretended to lose until Galan disappeared…!]
[That’s right. He died a purposeless death. No, he sacrificed himself for me!]
When Ennead’s Great Spirit laughed, the heaven and earth shook violently.
Kwahng!!!
“Kyahhhhk!”
Lava boiled up on the surface, and in a flash, the earth was surrounded by a light. No one could think straight afterward.
Flash!
Accompanying a powerful light, around half of the earth was ruthlessly blown to pieces.
Zzuhng!!!
[Nameless beings have ceased to exist.]
[Nameless beings have ceased to exist.]
[Around 50% of the earth has been destroyed.]
It had happened in the blink of an eye.
The disciples and gods were shocked by the development. They immediately used protection and healing skills, but the damage was too vast.
Ennead’s Great Spirit acted as if he had been under the weather and this action had loosened up his body. He laughed.
The fallen Aslan secretly tried to move his hand, but the overwhelming power of Ennead’s Great Spirit pressed down on him.
Kwah-jeek!!!
“…kuhk!”
[Old Master!]
Aslan’s body was instantly destroyed, and the body of a slime appeared in its place. The slime didn’t move as if it was dead.
Ennead’s Great Spirit contemptuously laughed since he had gotten rid of the most troublesome foe first.
[You failed to kill me before. You can’t do anything to me.]
Ennead’s Great Spirit was about to destroy the slime for good.
Kwahng!!!
However, Lee Gun appeared behind Ennead’s Great Spirit, aiming for the Great Spirit’s neck.
An enormous power clashed against another enormous power as heaven and earth shook.
Ennead’s Great Spirit looked at Lee Gun as if he found Lee Gun admirable. The energy of Life was emanating from Lee Gun’s body, and the entirety of the earth was being revived with Life’s power.
[You are reviving your land while fighting me. You are a commendable child.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
The destruction of the earth spanned 50%. Many living beings were either dead or severely wounded.
With the power of Life, the earth and its living beings could be saved.
However, Ennead’s Great Spirit found this cute. He was having fun. He put on an arrogant smile.
That smile gave Kunlun’s Great Spirit an ominous feeling. He realized something was wrong, so he changed into his dragon form.
[Snake god! Retract your power! You have to protect your body first!]
Ennead’s eyes flashed as if the warning was too late. Then, something unbelievable happened.
Flash!!!
The power that had destroyed 50% of the earth was like child’s play in front of this. The entirety of the earth was surrounded by a light.
Kwahng!!!
All of the earth disappeared. The gods and the disciples were swept away by the powerful shock.
On the other hand, Lee Gun was able to endure the attack. He raised his head, but he couldn’t maintain his expression. He didn’t see any land or city in front of him.
[Hundred percent of the earth’s land is gone.]
[You are unable to feel any life energy from the earth.]
[Number of survivors: 0]
“…!!!”
The blood drained from Lee Gun’s face. Only empty space lay before him. The debris was the only thing left of the earth, and it dispersed like dust.
The only humans alive were the few disciples who had managed to take refuge within the semi-translucent dragon form of Kunlun’s Great Spirit.
“The earth is…!”
“All the people there… Can it be…!”
It truly was the extinction of humanity.
Ennead’s Great Spirit had a thin smile on his lips.
[What? Did you think I’m like the other Great Spirits who became possessive of this colony?]
Lee Gun glared at him.
[Life Stage 6]
When he activated the power of Life, something surprising happened.
Koo-goo-goong!!
[The power of Time has been activated.]
[The past data has been read, and the exact version of the earth will be revived.]
[All life on the earth will be returned to its original state.]
The destroyed earth started to revert to its original form. Even the Great Spirits were surprised by what they saw.
Lee Gun hadn’t merely brought back the land. He had brought back the countless humans too. It was a wonder that something of that size could be reverted to normal.
Ennead’s Great Spirit was impressed with this.
[Oh. You combined Time and Life to restore a land of that size. You are truly an impressive child.]
However, he snickered. As he laughed, he once again destroyed the earth.
Kwah-gwa-gwahng!!
“…!”
He had merely moved a finger, yet the humans burned to death in pain. It was as if they were being burned by hellfire. The earth once again broke apart into pieces. Lee Gun’s enormous efforts to restore it became pointless.
[This universe is like a sand castle. It is like a toy for me.]
Lee Gun glared at him as he tried to send Cycle toward Ennead’s Great Spirit, but Cycle came to a stop at that moment.
[Eliminate]
Ennead’s Great Spirit possessed one of the Primordial god’s powers called Eliminate. He could eliminate even abilities.
This was why he sadistically smiled.
[You can restore it numerous times. I can spend all day destroying it. There is a limit to restoration and revival. You probably know this better than anyone.]
“…!!!”
[Also, it doesn’t matter if you kill me.]
“!”
[I can die over and over again, but I can be revived endlessly through the process of inheritance. Moreover, I can retain my memories. What about you?]
The Great Spirit smiled thinly.
[As gods live longer, they become remembered for a very long time. We become stronger as we are worshiped for a longer period. You have been at this for twenty years. You are a fledgling god who can’t even remember a century. Do you think you’ll be able to go through the process of inheritance? You probably know the answer better than anyone.]
“…!”
It was Lee Gun’s only weakness. His internal force was limited, and he was a god who hadn’t received anything through inheritance.
[Basically, I can kill those insects once more after you die.]
[What is it that you want?]
Ennead’s Great Spirit let out a savage laugh at the question of Kunlun’s Great Spirit.
[Hand it over. I want Ji, which that dragon possesses. I want the power of Cycle. Above all else, I want the Exoneration possessed by the snake god.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed in anger. This bastard was asking for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - Extinction (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 433 - Extinction (2)
Ennead’s Great Spirit could never understand it. The gods were exalted beings, so why did they have to protect the mortals?
‘It’s natural for the strong to stand on top.’
That was why the gods thought the mortals existed for them and were duty-bound to serve them. Gods were overwhelmingly more powerful beings, so why did they have to cater to the mortals? ‘Humans are merely beasts walking on two legs.’
‘Why do beings like us have to be nice to them?’
‘They are no more or no less than livestock.’
Due to this, all gods were dissatisfied with the Primordial god’s strict rules. The Primordial god punished any gods who dominated and killed the humans.
Coexist with humans. Do not rule them with strength. Get to know the humans and protect them.
These were the ironclad rules of the Primordial god.
However, all the gods had complaints about them, especially the Great Spirits who served the Primordial god. They were very dissatisfied with these rules since they were the strongest gods after the Primordial god.
Being told to coexist with the livestock was a disgrace to them. It was also why they hated the Creators.
The Creators supported the Primordial god’s edicts and created items that supported the Primordial god’s wishes. In the end, they strengthened the Primordial god.
Therefore, the Great Spirits got rid of the Primordial god and the Creators. They did it by turning Galan.
Of course, the Creators’ abilities were a waste to lose, but the Creators had refused the Great Spirits’ orders when they had asked them to create a new Rule Book.
After the Primordial god’s death, the Great Spirits had gone to order the Creators to make a new Rule Book. However, Aslan’s father, the then-chief of the Creators, hadn’t bothered answering the request. Instead, he had said,
- You used my son’s Steal ability.
- …!
- Are you using it as a substitute for the Primordial god’s Power? Are you substituting it for Exoneration?
Exoneration was the sixth and final ability of the Primordial god. It also had a different personality than Creation, Transformation, Elimination, and Maintain.
