It was the ability most coveted by the gods dissatisfied with the imposed restrictions. However, they could never possess this ability.
The Great Spirits had stolen the abilities when they had killed the Primordial god, but they couldn’t steal all of them.
This was why they had been eyeing Galan’s Steal ability and had used it as a substitute.
In the end, Aslan’s father had glared at the Lord of the Fire Wheel.
- The Great Spirits were the ones who drugged the Primordial god’s food, right?
- What are you talking about?
- You tried to weaken the Primordial god’s power to steal his abilities.
- I have no idea what you are talking about. The Primordial god became weakened at the hands of Eternal Change. I heard that filthy beast committed a brutal act when he invaded the Primordial god’s bedroom.
Aslan’s father had a bitter expression on his face.
- I see you plan to place all blame on others. This includes your sins and Karmic debt.
Arrogant Creators! They were mere artisans, yet they dared chastise the Great Spirits.
It was why the Creators got on their nerves the most. And so, they had used Galan’s anger to make him kill the Creators.
It was an easy task for Olympus’s Great Spirit, who possessed the Divine item of In. He could easily turn rage into killing intent. Galan had been brainwashed to kill the Creators.
When Galan and the Primordial god were both gone, Ennead’s Great Spirit had thought he would never get to use the precious Exoneration skill ever again.
* * *
[Snake god. You have the Exoneration skill, right?]
Ennead’s Great Spirit burst out laughing.
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. By Exoneration, he was probably referring to the weapon Lee Gun had created using the Primordial god, the Head Smasher.
It was true. The basic ability of Head Smasher was Exoneration. This was why Lee Gun could blow up the entire Divine world without receiving any Karmic debt. It didn’t matter how much he rampaged.
‘Of course, there are limitations.’
The system was set up in a way that Head Smasher’s durability suffered depending on the size of the Karmic debt being exonerated. For reference, the weapon’s durability had taken a 60% hit when he had destroyed the Divine world.
Ennead’s Great Spirit had caught onto this, so he let out a menacing laugh. Exoneration was no longer an ability. It was easy to use now since it had taken on the form of a Divine item. Naturally, he coveted it.
[Hand it over. I want that hammer.]
Actually, it wasn’t a hammer. It was a book.
Lee Gun inevitably reacted in anger.
[Life cannot be felt.]
[There are zero survivors left on the earth.]
It was to be expected since the entire planet had been blown away.
Of course, it wouldn’t be difficult for him to revive the earth once again like before, but he needed an extreme amount of power. Still, he would be able to recover the earth to normal if he used Life and Time.
However, Lee Gun knew he shouldn’t regenerate the earth.
‘He’ll kill it even if I revive it once again.’
It was easier to destroy than create. Moreover, humanity wasn’t just dying. The humans had died a painful death as they were burned alive by the fire of Ennead’s Great Spirit.
It had lasted only a moment, but Lee Gun wasn’t someone who would just stand by as humans burned alive.
‘I might be able to revive the earth ten more times. That’s probably my limit.’
The regeneration wasn’t unlimited. While his power was a problem, there was a limit to the life force possessed by the earth and the humans’ souls.
Well, he could sacrifice his own life using Exoneration, and he could make it so that the earth got revived forever. But…
‘That won’t solve the problem.’
Unless he put an end to Ennead’s Great Spirit, the Great Spirit would repeatedly blow up the earth whenever he got bored.
If that happened, the only one to suffer would be humanity.
The Great Spirit’s victory was assured if he kept coming back to life.
The Constructs had realized the score, so they started to let out cold sweats as they looked at Lee Gun.
[Master…!]
[The goddesses of fate said the Master had no future. Were they referring to this…]
Lee Gun was a Great Spirit, but he was too young. He hadn’t developed enough internal force that would allow him to be reborn again.
‘At the very least, he needs several hundred years.’
To go through the process of inheritance, one’s data needed to remain with the universe. However, the trace left behind by Lee Gun’s life was too short. Not enough data was amassed.
In simple words, reviving something that the universe couldn’t remember was impossible.
In contrast, Ennead’s Great Spirit had built up his internal force for the past several thousand years. This was different from Time. There was no limit to how many times Ennead’s Great Spirit could be reborn.
Even if Lee Gun died, Ennead’s Great Spirit would continue to be reborn, and the earth would be destroyed every time.
[Do you understand now? You cannot be compared to me. You are like a clump of cells that hasn’t been fertilized!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit extended his hand toward Lee Gun.
Kwahng!!!
Kunlun’s Great Spirit blocked Ennead’s Great Spirit. Ennead’s Great Spirit glared at him.
[Damn dragon! You want to die alongside him!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit threatened him, but Kunlun’s Great Spirit didn’t back down as he protected Lee Gun.
[You are the one that has to die!]
[Hmmph. You always like them young. You have no standards now!]
The next moment, enormous powers clashed against each other.
Kwahng!!
The one to appear first from the enormous explosion was none other than the Lord of the Fire Wheel. The gods were taken aback.
[No way. Did Kunlun’s Great Spirit lose…?!]
Lee Gun let out a cold smile as he watched Ennead’s Great Spirit let out overwhelming power.
[I won’t kill you until I acquire Exoneration. Of course, the transfer of ownership has to happen. It’ll allow me to use the item without any problems.]
It seemed Ennead’s Great Spirit had experience with this. When the Primordial god had been killed, he had been able to partially steal the Exoneration ability. However, he wasn’t the owner, so he had been unable to use it.
Ennead’s Great Spirit wagged his finger.
[What are you doing, Goddesses!]
His overpowering voice rang out. He had given an order to Valhalla's goddess of fate, whom he was overseeing.
At the same time, something surprising happened.
[All gods cannot possess Divine items. Only the king of the gods may wield the Divine items.]
A sound rang in the sky as all the Divine items owned by the gods fell to the ground.
[No way…!]
[My Divine item!]
A change had been made to the Rule Book.
The gods tried to pick up their Divine items, yet it was useless. They had lost the rights to their weapons. They could never pick those weapons ever again. However, it didn’t end there.
[Every god must worship the king of the gods]
[Kuh-huhk!!]
The Constructs got on one knee as if they were about to pledge their loyalty to Ennead’s Great Spirit.
“Ji,” which was in the possession of Kunlun’s Great Spirit, fell to the ground.
Ennead’s Great Spirit blew a whistle, and a hawk appeared out of his shadow. It snatched up all the Divine items.
When Ennead’s Great Spirit held Ji, he smirked. Since the Primordial god was gone, he was the strongest Great Spirit, so he was considered the King of the Gods. It seemed the universe had registered to be true.
As he leisurely picked up the Divine items, he gave an order to the hawk, which was absorbing the Divine items into itself.
[I don’t care about those trash items. Go and bring me the most important one.]
[I’ll bring it right now!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit wanted Lee Gun’s Exoneration ability the most. In other words, he wanted Head Smasher.
‘If I possess it, I’ll be the Primordial god.’
[Uh? Where is Exoneration?]
The hawk became flustered.
Hweek!
[…!!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit, who had his arms crossed, flinched. Lee Gun had appeared above his head.
He had to uncross his arms to block Lee Gun with both arms.
Kwahng!!!
That wasn’t all.
‘This bastard…!’
Lee Gun wasn’t empty-handed. He had Head Smasher. In other words, he was aiming for Ennead’s Great Spirit with a Divine item.
Ennead’s Great Spirit held an uncontrollable anger when he saw Lee Gun swing the hammer.
[Why can you pick up a divine item?]
The Rule Book had been changed. Only the greatest god or the king of the gods could pick up the Divine items!
Ennead’s Great Spirit was supposed to be the only one capable of picking up the Divine items. However, his shock lasted only a moment. He let out a harsh laugh when he realized something.
[Can it be? Are you also considered the king of the gods?]
Ennead’s Great Spirit glared at him. He looked exasperated.
[You are being registered as being the best amongst gods?]
“What else could it be!” Lee Gun contemptuously laughed as he summoned the Fetters of the Underworld.
The cracked Fetters of the Underworld was restored in a flash. The power of Creation possessed by the Ten Heavenly God interacted with Lee Gun’s power and fixed the weapon.
Ennead’s Great Spirit also used his Divine items, but this scene left him exasperated.
A brat who hadn’t received any inheritance was considered to be on the same level as him.
Ennead’s Great Spirit was pissed as he used the ability of Ji, intending to control Lee Gun’s body.
Kwahng!!
However, Kunlun’s Great Spirit, whom he had assumed to have been defeated, ruthlessly bit into the neck of Ennead’s Great Spirit.
[Koohk!]
Kunlun’s Great Spirit stole Ji and tossed it to Lee Gun.
Tuhk!
[Aside from Elimination, you possess all the abilities of the Primordial god!]
Angered, Ennead’s Great Spirit let loose the power of Elimination.
[Maggots!!!]
He shouted as Kunlun’s Great Spirit was swept up by the power of Elimination.
[What are you doing, goddesses of fate!!! Change the rule! Put in an age clause that says any gods under a hundred years old will be turned into humans!]
It was enough to have one king of the gods.
“They did a good job.”
As those words rang out, the sound of the Rule Book breaking reverberated in the sky.
Kwah-jeek!!!
[The Rule Book has been damaged]
[A partial change occurred to the clause.]
[All gods over a hundred years old will become humans.]
Ennead’s Great Spirit glared at them in anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - Extinction (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 434 - Extinction (3)
Around half an hour ago, the Leo Saint Stevens, who had gone looking for the Rule Book, was surprised. “Wait a minute. This makes no sense. What the hell!!”
Stevens and Leo had chased after the Rule Book and arrived outside of the earth, specifically the Middle world between the Divine world and the earth.
Valhalla’s goddesses of fate were hiding in a haven.
Stevens and Leo had also met up with Yeonwoo, Heiji, and Hailey. Those three knew the Rule Book would cause them trouble, so they had come looking for it early on. They wanted to either destroy it or take it back to Lee Gun.
‘Even if we destroy the Rule Book, Lee Gun would be able to fix it.’
With the help of Yeonwoo, they were able to enter the haven.
- What the hell? Why is that woman, Giselle, here?
Stevens's eyes turned round. This woman used to be number one among the twelve Zodiac Saints. Moreover, she was the one who had destroyed Hugo’s family!
- Why is that crazy monarch here?
Heiji clicked her tongue at his reaction.
- Idiot. She’s the human who used to be the Zodiac Saint. The monarch had eaten her and pretended to be the Zodiac Saint. That one over there is the human who had gotten eaten.
- What?!
She was supposed to be their comrade. However, she had been killed alongside her Zodiac before she could even meet the other Zodiac Saints. She had her body stolen by a monarch.
Hailey explained,
- Anyway, her human soul must have entered the Divine world, and she must be living with the goddesses of fate. I believe she is the goddesses’ Construct…
- Oh. Would she help us then?
- I’m not sure. She is a human who has lived for a long time in the Divine world. I have no idea if she’ll be of help…
They were about to approach Giselle, but their presence was noticed.
- Oh my!
- Who the hell are you guys?
- How dare you approach Verdandi-nim!
- ?!!
Yes, their old comrade was one of Valhalla’s three goddesses of fate.
After they realized this truth, Stevens was dumbfounded. “Isn’t Verdandi their goddess of the present? Damn it! Instead of receiving help from her, we entered the tiger's den!!”
In other words, she was their enemy. The ones who had changed the Rule Book to torment Lee Gun were them!
They tried to get ready for a fight.
“You guys are here! I’ve been waiting for you!”
“…????”
Unexpectedly, she grabbed the hands of their party members and greeted them.
They wondered if it was a trap, but that didn’t seem to be the case.
[Verdandi-nim? What is going on….]
“Ah.”
Giselle ruthlessly decapitated the Constructs who had accompanied her, leaving the group flustered.
She acted as if she had been waiting for their group, then headed toward them.
“When I foretold my fate, it said, ‘An awesome guest will come looking for the Rule Book. It will lead to the fall of the gods.’ That was why I was waiting for you guys.”
“You were waiting for us??”
“Yes. I am Lee Gun-nim’s fan. No, no. I knew the gods would destroy the earth.”
“…???”
The Libra Saint originally came from a family of politicians. She was the daughter of the president, and she was interested in bringing about world peace. She also seemed to be a fan of Lee Gun.
This was why she had been sad when she saw the Zodiac Saints fight each other like cats and dogs. She was also the one to realize what the monarchs were doing, and she had been helping Lee Gun even after her death.
However, her meddling had been found out by the Crab Saint Jean-Louis. And when she was on the run, she had been swept into the Divine world.
“T…The Divine status you possess right now is…”
“Ah! I did my best to gain their trust, and I stole it. I wanted to help Lee Gun-nim… I meant to say I wanted to help humanity.”
“….”
It was admirable since she had been working from an unseen place.
Giselle let out a sigh. “The prophecy said that an awesome guest will come looking for the Rule Book. I never expected it to be Stevens…”
“Are you disappointed because it wasn’t Lee Gun?”
Instead of answering, Giselle nodded.
Yeonwoo asked, “You had a prophecy? If that’s true, won’t we be found out?”
“Ah. I falsified any prophecy that would cause harm to Lee Gun-nim. I am in charge of storing the paper containing the future. I am the goddess of the present.”
“Oh!”
“Anyway, Future has the Rule Book right now!”
After the death of Valhalla’s Great Spirit, the other Great Spirits had disappeared as well. This meant that the goddesses of fate no longer wanted to use the Rule Book.
“They are scared of incurring Karmic debt now.”
“!”
The goddesses of fate had used the Primordial god’s Change ability to change their bodies. They possessed the bodies of Creators and could change the rules using them.
“They are deceiving the Rule Book.”
The only ones who could make changes to the Rule Book were the Primordial god and the Creators, who had created the book.
This was why Olympus’s goddesses of fate had sought a Creator.
Anyway, although the group was uncertain about the situation, they decided to believe her. Moreover, the snake Junwoo (Apophis) became guarded only toward those with low Faith toward the Serpent Bearer. Yet he had followed Giselle without a fuss. He seemed to be ok with her.
However, the situation completely changed when Ennead’s Great Spirit blew apart the earth.
[What are you doing, goddesses? I want you to change the clause regarding the Divine items. I want you to change it to “all gods cannot possess Divine items.”]
When Ennead’s Great Spirit had reappeared, the goddesses of fate had been forced to use the Rule Book. The goddesses were surprised.
[We are glad that the Lord of the Fire Wheel is still alive. However, a rule change of that magnitude will incur Karmic debt. Since the Karmic Debt Transfer cannot be used, we cannot—]
[You dare go against the order of your king?]
[!]
[Instead of dying by the Karmic debt, you’ll die faster by my hands.]
[…!!]
[Don’t worry! When I recover Exoneration, I’ll pardon you from the Karmic debt. Just change it enough to a point where you guys don’t die. Even if you do weaken and die, I’ll make sure to put you through the process of inheritance. Your memories will be included.]
In the end, the goddesses risked the Karmic debt as they changed the rules.
[All gods can possess Divine items.]
[All gods must help the king of the gods keep order in the Divine world. The gods may be compensated in return.]
[All gods over hundred years of age will receive an ability that’ll help them protect the humans.]
The goddesses had changed these three rules. They had roughly changed the rules into “All gods cannot possess Divine items,” “Every god must worship the king of the gods,” and “All gods under a hundred years of age will become humans.”
Anyway, Hailey and Heiji had then defeated the goddesses, and Yeonwoo was able to steal the Rule Book. However…
[It is already done!]
The goddesses smirked as they looked at Yeonwoo and her party.
[By the time you take it to the snake god, the snake god will already be a human.]
“…!”
[It’ll be useless to torture us to make more changes. We no longer possess the bodies of Creators right now.]
Now, Ennead’s Great Spirit just had to kill either Aslan or Lee Gun. He planned on making a new Rule Book after taking their Divine status.
[You won’t be able to fix the Rule Book—]
At that moment…
“Fix it!!! Right now!!”
“Ahhhk!!”
“???”
An expected face appeared in front of them.
“You guys are…!”
“Ahhk! I was just revived from the dead. Isn’t that enough? Where the hell am I!?”
The ones to appear in front of them were the Chun siblings and Secretary Guisoon!
The Chun siblings had realized that things were going poorly when Ennead’s Great Spirit had appeared. This was why they had made a quick judgment call.
Since a Great Spirit had survived, they knew the Great Spirit might try to mess with the Rule Book.
‘We should mess with it before they can mess with it!’
This was why they had come to this place by chasing after Stevens. Of course, Guisoon had been fixing Lee Gun’s Bible when she had died.
She had been swept up in the explosion of the earth, and as soon as she was revived, the Chun siblings had kidnapped her.
“Hey! Leo Saint! Rule Book! You took it away from them, right?!”
“Yeah. I…I have it right here…”
Chun Sungjae quickly took the Rule Book and gave it to Guisoon “Alright! Here! Hurry up and change the rules! The Rule Book is supposed to be similar to the Bible! Hurry!”
“Damn it! Do you really think my power will work on an item belonging to the gods?!”
No, there was a problem that had to be answered before she did anything.
“Won’t I receive Karmic debt if I use this?! I might die or my body might rot like them…”
“Uncle will solve it by using Revival or Exoneration.”
“Call my lawyer!! I want to report you guys to the Employment and Labor Administration!” Guisoon cried aloud. She scoffed at the idea that she would be able to fix the Rule Book, but…
[Secretary Guisoon is editing the Rule Book]
[!?]
She had thought it would be impossible, but…
[Wait a moment. That fountain pen… Can it be?!]
[Boo-ohhhhhh!!!]
The fountain pen Guisoon was using had been made by Lee Gun, a Creator. Since it contained the power of a Creator, it could be used to make edits to the Rule Book!
[Can it be? It counts as a Creator making an edit?!]
“Why not! You guys deceived the Rule Book using the body of the Creators! Why wouldn’t this work?”
Yeonwoo had a different thought.
‘No. It might be possible because the Primordial god is being ordered around by Gun, and she’s Gun’s Secretary.’
At the end of the day, Lee Gun was now the owner of the Primordial god. As Lee Gun’s secretary, Guisoon was able to act as his proxy.
Moreover, Guisoon had plenty of experience in making changes to the Bible, so she needed to just change one word to edit the rule.
[All gods under a hundred years of age will become humans.]
▶ [All gods over a hundred years of age will become humans.]
“Ahhhhk!!”
When Guisoon received her Karmic debt, her arm was blown off, and she became bloodied. However, Chun Yooha eliminated her pain, then Sungjae immediately activated his Regeneration ability.
“Are you ok, Guisoon?!”
“Damn it! Look! I told you I shouldn’t be doing this!!”
When Guisoon spoke out in anger, the Chun siblings felt terrible.
“I’m sorry….”
“We shouldn’t have asked you to….”
“No! I had to do it! If I hadn’t, God-nim as well as humanity would have died!” Guisoon huffed.
Flash!!
Her arm regenerated at an unbelievable speed.
“Oh…!”
“It’s Uncle!”
Lee Gun’s power had immediately healed Guisoon.
The faces of the goddesses of fate became distorted. They knew what this meant.
‘Our change to the Rule Book failed.’
It was as expected. The goddesses started to scream.
[Ahhhk!!]
All gods over a hundred years of age became human. So, the bodies of the goddesses of fate changed to that of humans as well.
They immediately tried to take Guisoon’s fountain pen to make changes to the Rule Book.
Yeonwoo took the Rule Book for herself, intending to run to Lee Gun.
[Look out!!]
Kwahng!!!
Leo threw its body in front of the powerful hellfire. He screamed as he fell.
“Zodiac!”
Leo glared at the figure in front of it.
[Wow. Crazy… What a cheat!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit stood in front of them, looking enraged.
They were shocked to see him emit a chaotic Divine power.
“The Rule Book failed on him?”
“No, I think it had some effect…”
The arms of Ennead’s Great Spirit had turned into human arms. While the other gods had transformed into humans immediately, Ennead’s Great Spirit had too much internal force. His change was happening slowly.
‘He is powerful enough to slow down the power of the Rule Book….’
Ennead’s Great Spirit was way too strong. There was a reason even Aslan had been unable to kill. However, even he would suffer damage if the rule remained the same.
This was why he glared at Guisoon. He also became apoplectic when he realized Guisoon’s identity.
[You are a Secretary. You guys are the ones who those damn Creators created.]
“!”
The Secretaries and Bible were created by the Creators.
The Bibles forever recorded the records of the gods. When the Creators had noticed the scandals perpetrated by the Great Spirits, they had created the Secretaries. These low-rank gods were supposed to monitor and record the Great Spirits’ actions.
Ennead’s Great Spirit got angry when he was confronted by remnants of the damn Creators.
‘I keep killing them, yet they keep appearing in front of me like cockroaches.’
[Change it if you don’t want to die, human.]
“…!!!” Guisoon froze.
Everyone there knew they faced a certain death. He was that powerful as a god.
In the end, Stevens desperately yelled, “Hey, Serpent Bearer Zodiac Saints! Summon Lee Gun! Use Zodiac descent!”
However, Ennead’s Great Spirit answered Stevens.
[You can summon him, but it’ll take him a while. I put him in hell.]
“……!”
Clearly, Ennead’s Great Spirit had done it to buy some time.
The bloodied Leo shouted,
[Destroy the Rule Book for now! Don’t allow him to fix anything! Keep the current rules unchanged!]
“You want us to destroy it?”
[If you don’t, that secretary will be tortured until death! She’ll be made to change the rules!]
Everyone immediately used their power to destroy the Rule Book.
Kwahng!!
“!”
However, the Rule Book was too sturdy. They couldn’t even scratch it. Leo joined in as well, but it didn’t change anything. They started grinding their teeth.
[Does it have to be a more powerful attack?]
Ennead’s Great Spirit let out a cold smile. He was about to approach them when…
Kwahng!!!!
“…!!!”
Someone appeared at the scene, destroying the haven of the goddesses. The group didn’t know if they should laugh or cry when they saw who it was.
[You were here, Great Spirit!]
[There is the prey! Eat him!]
“Abyss…!!”
The whale form of Abyss had appeared in the sky, and she had brought along the other monarchs.
The eyes of Ennead’s Great Spirit flashed in annoyance.
‘Did Wind send them?’
No, that shouldn’t be the case. He had made a deal with Wind beforehand. This was why he couldn’t understand what was going on, but he merely laughed in contempt.
[What do you think a monarch can do here?]
However, Hailey knew this was a golden opportunity, so she shouted, “Abyss! Destroy that book-like item. Then you’ll be able to easily capture and eat the Great Spirit!”
[Oh. Really?]
The menacing gazes of the monarchs headed toward the Rule Book.
However, Ennead’s Great Spirit wasn’t nervous at all despite the monarchs trying to aim for the Rule Book. The reason was simple.
[You are ignorant. Only the Great Spirits can destroy the Rule Book.]
“…!”
The Rule Book wasn’t something that could be destroyed using strength. It wasn’t about Great-Spirit-rank power.
The Great Spirits were given eligibility. It was a special function placed on the Rule Book so that invaders couldn’t change or destroy the rules. No one could do anything to the Rule Book. This was the rule of the universe.
In other words, the only ones who could destroy the Rule Book were Ennead’s Great Spirit and Lee Gun.
[I’ll end this quickly before the snake god arrives.]
Given his power, Lee Gun would be here in short order. This was why the Great Spirit had to accomplish his goal before then.
Ennead’s Great Spirit immediately tried to steal the Rule Book. He planned on kidnapping Guisoon alongside it.
He would move when Lee Gun chased after them. In the meantime, he would torture Guisoon and have her edit all the rules.
[Yes. This reminds me of the old days. It’ll be fun playing hide-and-seek.]
“Huhk!”
Ennead’s Great Spirit smirked as he was about to move.
Kwang!!!
At that moment, Abyss sent an attack toward the Rule Book.
Ennead’s Great Spirit was dumbfounded. He snorted.
[Damn maggot has no brain. Only the Great Spirits can destroy it—]
Zzuhng!!!
[…!]
The eyes of Ennead’s Great Spirit widened.
Hoo-doo-doohk!
[…?]
Abyss’s attack had destroyed the Rule Book. He had no idea what had happened.
‘How?’
He couldn’t explain this through logic. However, he heard a familiar voice at that moment.
“Idiot. Do you really not know who she is?”
It was Guisoon’s voice, but the way she spoke was completely different. Ennead’s Great Spirit glared at Guisoon, whom he had kept by his side.
‘No way!’
Lee Gun hadn’t used Zodiac Saint Descent to occupy his Zodiac Saints; he had used Guisoon! However, that wasn’t important right now.
[Did you give the Divine status of a Great Spirit to her?]
“Of course not.”
[….]
Yes. Ennead’s Great Spirit knew better than anyone that such an act wasn’t possible. Moreover, there hadn’t been enough time to pull it off. Then why? How?
“Think hard about it. There is one Great Spirit that I didn’t get rid of. One is left.”
[There is no way….]
His face soon stiffened.
Valhalla, Mahabharata, Babylon, Gehenna, Olympus, Ennead…. One was left—Eden.
The expression of Ennead’s Great Spirit froze.
From the still air, Lee Gun’s laughter rang out.
“I heard it from my underlings. A Great Spirit was turned into a monarch by Eternal Change.”
At that moment, the Great Spirit’s hands trembled, and his ominous feeling became reality.
“Who do you think she is?”
[…!!]
Damn Eternal Change!!!
At that moment, Abyss sent another attack toward the Rule Book since it wasn’t fully destroyed.
Kwahng!!!
This time, the Rule Book was ruthlessly destroyed, and the explosion swept across the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - Extinction (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 435 - Extinction (4)
Abyss sent her power toward the Rule Book. The enormous power swept across the land, and everyone in the Middle world screamed as they were sent flying.
“Ahhhk!!”
The Chun siblings, who had brought Guisoon, and Yeonwoo’s party were flung out of the Middle world, which was being destroyed.
Koo-goo-goong!
It was all thanks to Abyss’s attack.
Ennead’s Great Spirit, who was being attacked, raised his eyebrows.
‘The Rule Book cannot be destroyed only by those who possess the qualification of a Great Spirit.’
Whether the ones attacking it were gods or monarchs didn’t matter. They wouldn’t be able to scratch it. That was one of the universal laws placed on it.
Yet Abyss was boldly able to destroy such an item. What else could it mean?
‘She’s the Great Spirit of Eden? That’s the White Light?’
The Lord of the White Light was Eden’s Great Spirit. After suffering at the hands of Eternal Change, he had fallen into sleep. This was why all the angels worked hard to wake him up. And he became Abyss?
‘How does that make any sense?’
Of course, Eternal Change was a being that made a fool of others by using his Change ability. He was fully capable of doing this, but why would he go out of his way to turn a Great Spirit into a monarch?
It was a waste of his ability. Wouldn’t it be better for Eternal Change to eat the Great Spirit, who would have been a significant source of nutrition?
‘Is it revenge?’
No, there was no way that would be true. Why would a monarch do such a thing?
Ennead’s Great Spirit didn’t have the time to mull over this question.
Kwahng!!
He immediately gave an order to the subordinate hiding in his shadow.
‘Bring me Aslan’s body right now!’
He planned on making a new Rule Book and kidnapping Guisoon. However, Abyss wouldn’t let him do as he pleased.
[Fire Wheel! I never liked you!]
[Koo-oohk!!!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit glared at Abyss when the monarch attacked him. Eden’s Great Spirit had always been incompatible with him. The two of them had a terrible relationship.
This was why Ennead’s Great Spirit hadn’t paid any attention to what had happened to the Lord of the White Light. He had let things be.
It seemed Eternal Change knew this, so he had sent Abyss. Or did he turn Eden’s Great Spirit into a monarch for that very reason?
In the end, Abyss let out a savage attack as she clashed against Ennead’s Great Spirit.
[Die, troublemaker!! I’ll kill you, and it’ll make the snake god indebted to me! I’ll take him with me afterward!]
[Have you lost your mind?]
[You are the one who has lost his mind!]
In the end, Ennead’s Great Spirit didn’t have the chance to fix the Rule Book as he was swept up in a light along with Abyss.
The Chun siblings quickly picked up the fragments of the Rule Book, which Ennead’s Great Spirit had tried to take. They had no idea what was going on, but this was a gain for them.
* * *
Around that time, in a remote location where the monarchs had gathered to grow up, Wind laughed as he approached Hugo.
[It’s as you said, Brother.]
“!”
Wind let out a light laugh.
[When you asked me to release the monarchs on the earth, I thought you had lost your mind. However, the result speaks for itself. My cute underlings were able to eat the power of the Great Spirits.]
Yes, Hugo had requested Wind to send the second-generation monarchs to the earth. They had just been in time when the Great Spirits were weakened. Hugo had given them information that this would be a great opportunity to get rid of them. That wasn’t all.
[I never expected you to send Abyss to get rid of the Rule Book. If I’m being honest, I wasn’t sure if you knew her identity.]
“I gave her to you. Why wouldn’t I know?”
[I guess so.]
Wind was tickled that Eternal Change already knew Abyss’s identity. He laughed.
Yes, Time had created Abyss. However…
‘Eternal Change was the one who gave me the ingredients.’
At the time, Eternal Change had been falsely charged with killing the Creators, and he was imprisoned.
Wind had tried to free Eternal Change in secret.
- I am here to save you, my brother. Let’s quickly get out of the Divine world.
However, Eternal Change had refused to leave the prison. Instead, he had handed over a lump that he claimed to be the Great Spirit.
- Take this.
- What is it?
- It’s Eden’s Great Spirit, who I caught a long time ago.
- What??
- He was being so noisy that I changed him into a Cluder. Later on, I kept him in this form as emergency food. I used it to make dumplings.
- Huh.
- If I had kept him as a Great Spirit, the gods would have found out.
- That’s true, but… Why now?
If Eternal Change ate it, he would be able to recover and make himself stronger. Eternal Change spoke.
- I want you to take it instead of me. I’m fine if you make a new monarch with it.
- …!
Cluders were like wild grass. They appeared naturally. It was how the first-generation monarchs came to be.
However, Wind was able to create monarchs as if they were crops. That might have been why Eternal Change had handed it over to Wind.
- If you don’t want to use the Great Spirit to make a monarch, you can just eat it. I don’t care.
Wind had no choice but to bring back the meat dumpling. He had put it in storage because he thought eating it was a waste.
In the end, the exceptionally smart Time had recognized its worth. Of course, no one outside of Wind had been able to make monarchs, but Time was different.
Wind had to spoon-feed the recipes to the others, and they were barely able to make a monarch. But Time was different.
‘That child was extraordinarily intelligent.’
Time gathered the ingredients on his own and made his own comrades. Then Time had used the meat dumpling (Eden’s Great Spirit) to create a third-generation monarch in Abyss. Time molded it as he attached teeth and a tail, and Abyss was reborn in the form of a whale.
‘It seems the Rule Book doesn’t register the Great Spirit to be dead. That was why she was able to destroy the Rule Book.’
That wasn’t all. With each passing generation, Cluders became better and more talented.
Abyss possessed the already strong power of a Great Spirit, and she was of the latest generation.
‘It means she is stronger than the second-generation monarchs.’
Wind knew this very well, so he laughed as he looked at Hugo.
[Well, you did surprise me when you went to meet the Primordial god. I thought you were trying to get yourself killed. You surprised me again this time for an entirely different reason.]
It was why the Rule Book, which was the gem of the Divine world, was destroyed.
The incredibly prideful Lord of the Fire Wheel was about to lose his mind with anger.
[Well, this incident turned out to be beneficial for the snake god, but it is fine if you were able to gain something from the destruction of the Rule Book. I am willing to do anything for you.]
Wind let out a good-natured laugh as he looked at his sibling.
[You should keep your promise now.]
“Promise?”
[Yes. Did you forget about our other sibling Underground, who is asleep? I’m talking about your blood kin.]
Hugo furrowed his brows when he heard the familiar name.
Eternal Change didn’t have a form like water. Wind could travel anywhere. Flame was a fire that was life itself. Then there was Underground, who kept itself treasured deep beneath the ground.
The four of them were first-generation monarchs, and they were blood siblings who got on well.
[Currently, Underground is in deep sleep, and only you can wake him up. You asked me to send the monarchs in exchange for waking him up.]
“….”
Underground was created from the same matter. He was Eternal Change’s blood sibling. But he had lost his power because of an accident, so Eternal Change had put him to sleep.
Wind laughed as he spoke.
[By now, Underground would have recovered his power somewhat. Let’s wake him up, and we can once again eat everything as we did in the past.]
When Wind gestured with his hand, a familiar monster appeared in front of them. It was none other than Underground.
Hugo chuckled at the enormous monster.
“Yes. It’s time for me to wake him up.”
[You made the right choice…]
At that moment, Hugo raised his hand toward the monster, and Underground was instantly destroyed.
It was as if Underground was someone he had never planned on awakening. Underground turned into trash and dispersed into the air.
Taken aback, Wind looked at Hugo.
[Wait. What are you…!]
“It seems you want to awaken your sibling to grow your force once again. However, Underground has been gone for a very long time.”
[What?]
“I already killed Underground. I killed and ate him in the distant past.”
[What?!]
The shocked Wind looked at Hugo with rage in his eyes. Of course, he knew what that implied.
If the story about Underground was a lie, Eternal Change’s reason for sending the monarchs toward the Great Spirits and the Rule Book...
However, Wind couldn’t bring himself to believe this, so he glared at Hugo.
[Didn’t you say the Rule Book contained a rule that suppressed your power? You said you cannot use your power until it’s destroyed.]
“There is no way such a thing would be written in the Rule Book.”
[What?]
“Unless the gods lost their minds, why would they want to write about the Cluders within the holy Rule Book?”
Wind glared at him.
[Does that mean you’ve been doing all of this for the snake god…!!]
“You finally figured it out? Idiot.”
Wind couldn’t hold back his anger when he realized that he had been duped.
[Why? Why would you do this?]
Hugo burst out laughing as if he was dumbfounded. “Are you an idiot? Do you really not know why?”
* * *
Hugo, as well as Eternal Change, hated the existence called Cluders.
‘To eat, they are willing to throw away even their family.’
They ate what belonged to others. They only knew how to pig out by stealing from others. They only knew how to destroy.
They were despicable beings.
‘That includes me.’
The Cluders had killed countless beings and invaded countless lands. As he lived such a life, Eternal Change felt doubt. He hated himself, so he tried to starve himself. However, his instinct as a predator didn’t let him be.
To make matters worse, his instinct as a predator had made him eat his family member.
[It’s fine, brother. You aren’t at fault.]
Underground had been wounded all over and was close to death. Eternal Change’s damn instinct as a Cluder saw his weakened family member, and he didn’t think of it as his familial member was about to die. His instinct had taken priority, and Underground was registered as prey in his mind.
So, because of his instincts, Eternal Change ate a family member whom he loved. To make matters worse, his starving stomach was happy to eat his older brother Underground. His stomach accepted it as if he was eating something delicious.
Eternal Change felt so tormented that he threw up. He made a grave and even tried putting offerings there. However, his starved instinct was unforgiving, as it overrode his sorrow.
His hands were unable to place an offering on his sibling’s grave. In fact, he started destroying the grave to check if he could eat any leftovers. His hands were voracious.
The Cluders were truly trash that only knew about eating. They didn’t feel the need to create graves for their family members. They found it natural to eat their own. They were beasts that only knew how to destroy.
This was why Eternal Change wanted to die, but his instinct as a Cluder didn’t allow him to kill himself. While he had been going through this, he had heard something.
- Did you hear? If a god and Cluder get together, the weaker one dies.
This was why Eternal Change had aimed for the Primordial god. The king of the gods was supposed to be the strongest. However, Eternal Change’s plan had failed, and the Creators had caught him.
- The Creator tribe will be in charge of watching over you.
Creator tribe?
‘Creator tribe, my ass.’
Gods were the same as the Cluders. They only knew how to destroy.
‘They show off their powers and suppress the residents of the colonies.’
However, Eternal Change soon realized that the Creators were different. They were unlike the Cluders, who only knew how to steal and kill. They were a tribe capable of making something. They were a tribe that could create life.
This was why Eternal Change liked them. One could say he fell for them at first sight. Of course, the more he got to know them, the more he realized that the Creators were very laid back and that they could be idiots.
This was why Eternal Change was enraged when the Creators were slaughtered. Moreover, he had realized that the Great Spirits were behind this evil plot.
He promised himself that he would get rid of all of them someday, and countless years had passed like that.
* * *
Wind shook when he saw the look in Eternal Change’s eyes.
[My brother!]
Hugo laughed as he looked back at Wind. He knew the truth.
Wind kept calling him “brother” and acted affectionately toward him. However, he merely wanted the powerful ability of Eternal Change.
Moreover, Wind was the one who had pushed Underground to become stronger and made Underground suffer an accident. He had also sold Flame, their older sister, because she had fallen for a god.
Also, why would Hugo throw away the connections he had made in his current life for the ones from his past life? He had planned on doing this from the start.
Hugo laughed as he looked at Wind. “Thanks. You got rid of the Great Spirits and the Rule Book for Gun.”
[!]
With his objective achieved, Hugo brought out his power. In the first place, he had come here to kill Wind since he knew only he could get rid of Wind. If Hugo killed him, the Cluders had no reason to come to the earth.
“You will die by my hands.”
[Brother!!!]
“Fuck off! You are no longer my brother.”
[!]
“The only brother I have in this world is Gun.” Hugo sent a death strike toward Wind.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 -Die (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 436 -Die (1)
Abyss’s attack destroyed the Middle world, where the goddesses of fate had been hiding.
“Ahhhh!!!”
The first ones to disappear to an unknown location were Abyss and Ennead’s Great Spirit. Then the disciples who had invaded the Middle world with the help of the Zodiacs were sent flying.
Koo-goo-goong!
“Damn it! The castle is falling.”
The ground split, and everyone fell toward an unknown underworld. It was a world from which chaotic pillars of black light were rising out.
The bloodied Leo saw these pillars of light and shouted,
[You must not fall there! You must avoid it at all costs!]
“What? Where does it lead to?!”
[It’s an entrance connected to the World of Emptiness!]
“Where the hell is that? Is it the Divine world?”
Leo shouted at Stevens.
[Just do as I say! Let’s head up!]
“Kuhk!”
The Zodiac grabbed Stevens and the Chun siblings with its mouth, then threw them upward. Leo had used all of his power, and he was about to fall toward the World of emptiness.
Chun Sungjae tried to teleport Leo, but his hand wouldn’t reach Leo.
Since he had suffered at the hands of Ennead’s Great Spirit, Leo was at his limit. He waved his paw.
[I’ll go through the process of inheritance, so it doesn’t matter. Protect that shabby snake god, who can’t go through inheritance!]
Leo was about to cease to exist, but…
Guisoon— No, Lee Gun quickly dove downward.
Tahk tahk!
“Guisoon!!”
She was extremely agile as she stepped on the debris to move toward Leo! Since Lee Gun was possessing her body, Guisoon displayed a movement that she could never achieve by herself. She grabbed Leo’s tail.
[Kuh-huhk!]
“You are my underling! How dare you try to loaf around on the job! Go back up and return to work!”
As if he was admonishing Leo for thinking about dying, Lee Gun threw the enormous Leo.
[Ahhhk!]
“Sungjae!”
Chun Sungjae nodded and activated his teleportation with everyone in tow.
And so Lee Gun was able to drag everyone back to the earth.
After returning to the earth, the group lay on the ground, gasping for breath.
When the possession through Zodiac Descent was released, Guisoon slumped to the ground.
The Chun siblings then looked for Lee Gun.
“Where’s Uncle?”
“Where is he that he couldn’t come himself instead of possessing Guisoon?”
[I’m over here.]
“!!”
A familiar voice rang out as a building exploded. Lee Gun walked out with annoyance written all over his face.
“Gun!”
Lee Gun had been imprisoned inside a small bottle. He came out as he kicked the broken bottle. However, his appearance was quite unusual.
“Uncle…is really small….”
They had been wondering why Lee Gun had used Zodiac Descent instead of coming himself. Now they had their answer.
Lee Gun was as tall as a thumb. It was a spell of Ennead’s Great Spirit.
Everyone got on their knees and lowered their heads as they tried to get on the same level as the thumb-sized Lee Gun.
“Gun!”
“Are you really Lee Gun?”
“Are you ok, Uncle?”
“Yes. There are no adverse effects on my body. But I’ll have a hard time fighting, so I’ll have to wait until it returns to normal.”
His words made Chun Sungjae rip open his shirt and roar, “I’ll sacrifice my body to you!!! You can come in anytime you want!!”
“?!”
Chun Sungjae cried out as he turned into a stacked blonde woman. Chun Sungjae was jealous that Lee Gun had possessed his sister and Guisoon.
“I’ll bathe and purify myself!!! No, the problem is that we have too many disciples in the Serpent Bearer temple! That is why you should excommunicate everyone except me— Kuh-huhk!!”
In the end, Demonic Sect Leader Chun Sungjae fell over after being hit by his sister.
Chun Yooha then handed pieces of paper to Lee Gun. “These are the leftovers of the Rule Book, Uncle. Will they be enough?”
“!”
Lee Gun laughed as he saw the remnants of the Rule Book. The Rule Book was a Divine item. Of course, Lee Gun could repair the Rule Book with the remnants. In fact, it would be much easier if he decided to create a new Rule Book with the remnants.
Flash!!
Lee Gun applied the Ten Heavenly God’s Creation power to his ability and created the Rule Book in a new form.
[A completely new Rule Book has been born.]
[It is a Rule Book with nothing written in it.]
The new Rule Book emerged, accompanying an enormous light.
Flash!!
An event that would build up the order of the universe had once again occurred.
The newly made Rule Book looked like a blank encyclopedia. That wasn’t all.
[The Rule Book has developed a sense of self.]
[The Rule Book will follow its parent. It is waiting for its parent to write a rule.]
[The newly born and young Rule Book would like you to give it a name.]
All the Constructs were surprised.
[The Rule Book has a sense of self…!]
[It’s also a blank Rule Book…!!]
[Does that mean Master can make new rules for the Divine world?!]
In other words, Lee Gun would be occupying the role of the Primordial god! Lee Gun would basically be the owner of the Divine world!
“I guess the name can be ‘Lee Gun-nim Says.’”
[The Rule Book has been named “Lee Gun-nim Says.”]
[“Lee Gun-nim Says” really likes its name. It is fluttering in joy.]
The mouths of the gods fell open.
‘He named it “Lee Gun-nim Says”…!!!’
‘The noble Rule Book contains tens of thousands of years’ worth of history, yet he named it that…!!’
Lee Gun didn’t care for their reactions. He called for one of the goddesses of fate who had taken on his image. “You guys managed over the Rule Book, so you must remember all the laws, right?”
[We do, but do you plan on writing the same rules? Any rule that Master writes from now on will become the new rule of the Divine world.]
“First, I want to separate the Divine world and the earth.”
When Lee Gun wagged his finger, the fountain pen in Guisoon’s hand came toward him in joy.
After taking the fountain pen, he used it to add content to the Rule Book.
- The Divine world doesn’t exist. It doesn’t exist at all. I don’t need it. Fuck off ㅗㅗ
[Master?!!!]
When the rule was added, an enormous change occurred to the earth.
[The existence of the Divine world has been annihilated.]
[The existence of the Divine world has disappeared from the universe.]
[Any trace of the Divine world disappeared from the earth.]
[Ahhhk!!!]
The gods screamed.
Lee Gun had made sure to annihilate the Divine world, so it wouldn’t even exist in the lexicon. Therefore, all the objects and land that seemed to belong to the Divine world started to cease to exist.
When the Divine world started to truly disappear, the Constructs as well as the gods cried out in despair as they looked at Lee Gun.
[Master!!!]
[If you do that, our homes…!]
[You crazy bastard!!! I told you to separate the earth and the Divine world! What are you doing eliminating the existence of the Divine world?]
This wasn’t about their desire to restore the Divine world. The gods were refugees, and their homeland no longer existed. They were in despair.
[Where do you want us to live if you do this…!!]
“It’s none of my business. You guys can live by putting up a tent outside in space.”
Lee Gun only cared about the earth becoming normal. He continued to add rules to the Rule Book.
- All gods will be expelled outside of the earth.
(Serpent Bearer temple is exempt)
[Ahhk?!!]
The first one to disappear was Leo. The affiliates under Lee Gun weren’t exempt.
All the gods who had come to the earth screamed as they disappeared. They were exiled from the earth.
Nothing happened to the Constructs of the Serpent Bearer temple, yet they looked taken aback.
On the other hand, Lee Gun shamelessly kept adding rules.
- Gods can never enter the earth (the Serpent Bearer temple is exempt).
- Gods can never cause harm to the earth (the Serpent Bearer temple is exempt).
- Gods who enter within 100 km of the earth will have to give everything they own (the Serpent Bearer temple is exempt).
(…etc…)
(…etc…)
He was satisfied after putting in a total of a hundred bad laws and brushed off his hands. “Alright. With this, those bastards can’t do anything to the earth."
[M…master.]
Mimir was sweating since he had never seen such a Rule Book.
‘Well, Ennead’s Great Spirit won’t be able to torment the earth with this, but…’
Lee Gun smirked when he felt Mimir’s gaze. “I told you before. This is temporary.”
[!]
“In the first place, laws are just wordplay. There are many loopholes if one wants to misuse them.”
This was the case with laws on the earth too. In many cases, laws were useless despite existing.
However, Lee Gun didn’t want to go through all the rules and patch all the loopholes. Even if he got rid of all the loopholes, it wouldn’t accomplish much.
“What if I am no longer here?”
“!”
Lee Gun was well aware of his weakness. “I am too young a being to be remembered by the universe. That’s why I can’t go through with inheritance.”
Chun Sungjae became angry. “What? Is the universe an idiot? Does it not realize Uncle is a god with great Achievements? Does it not realize how much you accomplished in such a short time? Shouldn’t it remember you better??!”
Chun Sungjae emphasized the point by saying that the universe had already stored Lee Gun’s data. It had already taken root.
Lee Gun said, “Anyway, the Rule Book is a stopgap measure. It isn’t the true solution.”
He had to get rid of Abyss and Ennead’s Great Spirit. Above all else, the Rule Book contained laws for the gods. It wouldn’t work against the Cluders. He was thinking about getting rid of them…
Kwahng!!!!
“!!”
A large explosion occurred at a nearby location, surprising everyone.
“Is it a Zodiac?”
“There is no way…! Uncle chased out all the gods that might cause harm to the earth!”
They soon realized the source of the explosion.
“I think it’s monsters!”
“Monsters?!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he heard it was the Cluders.
It was correct. The ones who had caused the explosion were the monarchs. However, Lee Gun furrowed his brows for an entirely different reason.
He just had to get rid of the monsters invading them. However, he had heard an unexpected name.
- Lee Gun-nim! It’s Hugo-nim! He’s here with monarchs!
The problem was the eyewitness account of the disciples who came with the news. In essence, Hugo had appeared on the earth with the monarchs.
- It seems he came to hunt down humanity with the Cluders, right?
They anxiously asked for Lee Gun’s opinion. It was for no other reason.
- It seems Hugo-nim attacked the disciples. Jaewon-nim was also…
Lee Jaewon had seemingly fallen off a cliff when Hugo had attacked him.
Naturally, this was a worrying development for humanity.
Lee Gun had to raise his eyebrows.
‘That bastard attacked Jaewon of all people?’
After he had heard the story from Aslan, Lee Gun had thought there was a bit of misunderstanding regarding Hugo, but it seemed Hugo was a Cluder through and through.
So everyone scattered to kill the monsters, searching for Hugo.
“Ahhhk!!”
“Sungjae!”
Suddenly, Chun Sungjae’s scream rang nearby. It wasn’t a normal scream.
Surprised, Lee Gun moved toward where the sound came from. Murderous intent appeared in his eyes.
“That bastard…”
He found both Sungjae and Hugo bloodied.
The disciples were shocked by this sight.
“Hugo-nim…!! He attacked the Serpent Bearer’s Zodiac Saint!”
Chun Yooha checked her bloodied younger brother in surprise.
With a cold look in his eyes, Lee Gun chased Hugo, who was leaving the scene. The Serpent Bearer couldn’t suppress the murderous intent in his eyes; Hugo had gone so far as to attack his own child.
Chun Yooha looked at her bloodied younger brother. “Sungjae! Are you ok? Did Dad really do this to you? Wake up!”
“My god! I can’t believe he attacked his son. Did he switch sides?”
At that moment, a pained Chun Sungjae grabbed his sister. “Noona. No… It wasn’t dad. Dad saved me…!”
“What?!”
By this time, Hugo had moved away from his children. He arrived at a deserted location.
‘Damn it! I never expected there to be leftovers here.’
He had a big fight with Wind, and he had come here, clutching at his stomach. It was a wound that he had received while fighting Wind.
That was why the second-generation monarchs were chasing Hugo. Of course, they were without reigns, so several of them had come to the earth to rampage.
Therefore, Hugo had rushed here to clean up the mess, and he had gotten rid of the ones going on the rampage.
‘Anyway, I should hurry up and leave the earth…’
Hugo checked if no one was nearby, then he was about to leave.
Bbah-gahk!!!!
“Kuh-huhk!!!”
However, a flying kick came toward him from nowhere. Receiving a kick in the face, Hugo was sent flying.
Hugo was confused when he looked at his surroundings. “What the hell! No one is here— Kuh-huhk!!!”
This time, something came from the sky and struck him at the crown of his head. Despite having the power of a monarch, Hugo felt an impact that made him feel as if his body would be destroyed. He vomited blood.
Hugo also realized who the culprit was.
“You little maggot.”
“?!”
It sounded like a mosquito, yet his ears had picked up a familiar voice! “Gun— Kuh-huhk!!!”
Hugo was finally able to see him. The one kicking him was a thumb-sized Lee Gun!
At the same time, Lee Gun changed his appearance.
Puhng!!
“…!!!”
He returned to his normal size, but Hugo didn’t even have time to be surprised.
“Kuhk!!”
After returning to his original size, Lee Gun immediately grabbed Hugo by the throat. Then he slammed Hugo to the ground.
Lee Gun raised Heaven’s Punishment. “Die, immoral bastard.”
Hugo screamed.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 -Die (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 437 -Die (2)
A while ago, Lee Gun had a conversation with Aslan, who had regained consciousness.
- Ennead’s Great Spirit is a formidable foe. He’s the strongest among the gods. It’s why I couldn’t kill him in the end.
- !
- I’m sure he has a secret, but even I couldn’t figure it out. If I’m being honest, I have no idea how to kill him.
Aslan had said that Ennead’s Great Spirit was a god that even the Primordial god couldn’t kill.
- It’ll be a tough task.
Aslan was worried about Lee Gun.
However, Lee Gun wasn’t worried about his own well-being right now. “Die, immoral bastard.”
“Ahhk!!!!”
Hugo screamed when he saw Heaven’s Punishment fly toward him. However, the weapon didn’t stop.
Kwahng!!!
Heaven’s Punishment fell right next to Hugo’s ear. Having barely dodged the ax blade, Hugo felt a certain part of his shrink.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. Unlike his normal self, he wasn’t laughing right now.
A flustered Hugo yelled, “Ahhhk! Wait a moment. Listen to me…!”
However, Lee Gun acted as if he wasn’t worth hearing him out; he brought down his ax again.
Kwah-jeek!!!
“Ahhk!” Hugo felt like he was going to die.
Heaven's Punishment was a weapon that became stronger when the opponent was a monster.
So in front of the current Hugo, Heaven's Punishment roared in a manner more psychotic than usual.
Kwah-jee-jeek!!
“Damn it!”
In the end, Hugo screamed as he bent his head backward. Folding his legs and twisting his waist, he barely dodged the weapon.
Lee Gun became a bit angry when he saw Hugo dodge everything as if he were a mole in a whack-a-mole game. “You dodged all of them?”
“Of course, I can dodge them! You were the one who taught me how to do it!”
This was an attempt to get on the good side of Lee Gun, but it failed.
“Ahhhk!!!”
The next moment, black flames erupted from Lee Gun’s body. Hugo screamed when he realized it was Death stage 6. He was a mere fly, yet Lee Gun was using the power of a Great Spirit. It seemed Lee Gun was enraged.
[It doesn’t matter what you say to me.]
“!”
[You dare cause damage to the people around you?]
“…!”
He didn't care if Hugo verbally abused him or betrayed him. He was used to hearing abusive language. Moreover, another betrayal at this point wouldn’t faze him. He just had to kill the betrayers, and the problem would be solved.
However, the story became different because Hugo had spread pain to his family and those who supported him.
[You burned your family picture. You basically put a stake through your wife’s heart. You made those around you worry about you!]
“No! That’s not…!”
[I’ll give you a chance to explain yourself.]
“Great. So what happened is—”
[Right. You didn’t say anything worth hearing.]
“Hey! I didn’t even get to say anything—”
Kuh-huhk!”
It seemed Lee Gun hadn’t planned on hearing him out from the start. He wagged his finger back and forth.
[Are you on the side of humanity or the other side?]
“!”
[Just give me that answer.]
“…!”
It was a question that got to the heart of the matter.
Lee Gun didn’t feel the need to hear an excuse, an explanation, or other trifling reasons. He was asking Hugo to choose a position unequivocally.
If Hugo said he was on the side of humanity, some tacit meaning could be gleaned from it.
However, Hugo didn’t open his mouth.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows twitched in anger.
‘That bastard…’
From the perspective of a being protecting humanity, was it the right choice for him to spare a monarch who had attacked the earth?
Had Lee Gun let his temper decide for him, he would have turned Hugo into ashes already, but the faces of his niece and nephew kept floating around in his head.
Lee Gun released his stage 6 mode. “This is your last opportunity. Are you going to return or not?”
Hugo sighed when he heard this. “Alright.”
“You should have said so from the start…”
“I have no plan on returning.”
“…???”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. He couldn’t believe his ears. “What the hell did you just say?”
“Why would I go back? It’s as I’ve said before. You piss me off so much that I want to slap your mouth off your face.”
Lee Gun’s eyebrows spasmed. What the hell did he just say?
With a dumbfounded expression, Hugo continued, “What? You want to give me an opportunity? After you became a Zodiac, your arrogance became high enough to pierce the sky. Idiot.”
“….”
“Originally, I planned on following you. I would have taken my time in infiltrating humanity, and I would have razed their lands to the ground. I no longer want to do that. I can't even do that because I don’t want to see your face. It’s nauseating.”
Lee Gun attacked when Hugo revealed his true colors. He didn’t even feel the need to give a reply. He just tapped the ground with the Fetters of the Underworld.
Tahk!
As if he had been attracted by a magnet, Hugo was lifted into the air.
“Kuh-huhk!”
The Fetters of the Underworld was a weapon capable of dominating the fate of one’s opponent.
Lee Gun had robbed Hugo’s freedom of movement. When Hugo crashed onto the ground, Lee Gun put power into the Fetters of the Underworld, which was shaped like tongs.
A black flame erupted as the weapon changed its form into a sword. Lee Gun called forth Death. He had a cold look in his eyes as he grabbed Hugo by his head. “Is that all you have to say?”
Hugo laughed in resignation. “Kill me. However, I have one last request.”
There was no reason to grant the request, but Lee Gun furrowed his brow. “What is it?”
“Don’t let the world know that you killed me.”
Lee Gun feigned laughter. He had burst out laughing because these were the most ridiculous words spoken by Hugo.
However, his reaction lasted only a moment. His eyes became colder and angrier than ever before. “I was wondering what you were going to say.”
It seemed Hugo’s words had the effect of further pissing off Lee Gun. “Why? Are you embarrassed to die by my hands?”
“This is my request. You can say I rampaged before I died. You can say someone else took care of me. It must not be you. Even if I die, Jiwoo and the children must never find out. At the end of the day, I am Jiwoo’s husband. I am the father of my children.”
Lee Gun scoffed. “What? Your pride won’t allow it? You want to be remembered as a great father?”
Hugo responded, “I want you to forever be a hero to my kids.”
“…?”
Lee Gun blinked. For a brief moment, he couldn’t comprehend what Hugo was trying to say.
Soon, Hugo spoke as if he was in pain. “Since it will be something done by you, my children will accept your decision, but at the end of the day, you would have killed their father. While they might accept it in their heads, their heart wouldn’t be able to accept it.”
“……”
While they might accept it in their heads, they were human, after all. Would they truly be able to wholeheartedly love someone who had killed their father? Could it be guaranteed that not even a bit of hate would appear within their hearts?
Hugo didn’t want Lee Gun to be hated for something so inconsequential as him dying. “They started liking you from a young age. I would like you to forever be their hero like right now.”
It wasn’t just the children. Hugo knew what Lee Gun had to do to come back as a hero.
“I don’t even want you to become the topic of gossip. I’m at fault, so please grant my request.”
Lee Gun was silent. By the looks of it, Hugo didn’t seem to be lying. In fact, his current expression was something he knew very well.
‘That’s right.’
It was the face of his idiot friend, who had waited for him for twenty years. He had done it by himself because he trusted Lee Gun.
When everyone had thought Lee Gun was dead, they tried to sell him for power and wealth. Hugo had been the only one who stood firm as he kept a clean conscience.
It didn’t matter if he was a monarch. He was someone who Lee Gun knew. This was why he looked at Hugo as if he couldn’t comprehend something. “Why are you being like this, Taeksoo?”
“…!”
Lee Gun released Hugo.
Hugo looked at Lee Gun in surprise. His friend’s murderous intent was gone.
Lee Gun was having a hard time comprehending it. Everything indicated that the man in front of him was the pushover friend he knew, yet he kept doing things that were out of character.
Hugo said, “Hmmph. You are so easy to dupe—”
“Talk, asshole. Sungjae just telepathically messaged me. He said you took out a parasitic monster from his body.”
“…”
Now, Hugo had no way to dupe Lee Gun.
In the end, Hugo sighed as if he had given up. “If I don’t act like this, I can’t trick Wind.”
“Wind?”
“Yes. Wind secretly put an observer on me.”
Lee Gun’s murderous intent was nowhere to be seen. He scrunched up his face, immediately realizing what was going on. “Is that why you burned the family picture???”
Lee Gun looked like he wanted to beat up Hugo.
Hugo screamed as he tried to hold back Lee Gun, “If it’s you, you can recover the burned picture!!! Also, I’ll be gone in the future! I didn’t want Jiwoo to cry while she looked at my picture!! Kuh-huhk!!”
“That is why you burned it all??? Also, what do you mean, you’ll be gone?”
“That is…” Hugo hesitated before saying, “Karmic Debt.”
“Karmic Debt?”
“I found out about it after I recovered my memories. Eternal Change has an enormous amount of it.”
Eternal Change had ruthlessly killed and eaten countless gods, and he had been taken to court over it.
After being caught by the Creators, he had lived as a resident of the Divine world. This was why the Karmic Debt system applied to him too. That wasn’t all.
Hugo clearly remembered it. He might have done it for revenge, but his actions had been too depraved and inhumane even if one considered that he was letting his instinct as a predator take hold of him.
The weight of the blame and sins for his action was too heavy.
Did the Great Spirit of Mahabharata know about Eternal Change’s motive behind his actions? Or was his sense of guilt for killing the Primordial god and the Creators still existed within him?
Whatever it was, instead of sentencing Eternal Change for his Karmic debt, the Great Spirit gave him a sentence where he would be reincarnated.
If the monarch had been sentenced for his Karmic Debt, it would have caused harm to the Divine world.
Being sentenced for Karmic debt would mean a situation like what the Lord of the Sky and the other Great Spirits had just gone through. They ceased to exist when they couldn’t overcome their Karmic debt.
However, Hugo wasn’t a god. Since he was a monarch, he had no idea what kind of monster would appear once he received his Karmic debt. His case was unprecedented.
Unlike the gods, he had a sturdy body. It wouldn’t cease to exist. Instead, a rare monster would be born.
In other words, Hugo’s demise might destroy the Divine world or cause a calamity-rank event.
- That’s why Samsara Hell’s harshest sentence of human reincarnation will be given to you. While you are human, your Karmic Debt will be deferred.
Eternal Change’s punishment had been to live as a human, like a lowly bug. It would be humiliating, and the Great Spirits preferred that he died in pain as a human.
However, things were currently different now. Hugo had recovered his memories and power. He had returned to being Eternal Change.
“The Karmic debt that was deferred for several thousand years will be activated.”
In other words, he was a ticking time bomb. So, how could he stay next to his friend and family?
This was why Hugo had planned on getting rid of all the troublesome figures. Then, he would go to a location unrelated to the earth and pay for his sins there. That was how he would disappear.
Lee Gun raised his eyebrows as Hugo’s plan had left him dumbfounded. “So you planned on dying? You planned on creating a single-family home for the kids? You did this despite having a newborn baby?”
“It’s better than being swept up in my Karmic Debt and suffering the same fate as me! Also, I have life insurance, and they’ll receive my pension!! It’ll be plenty enough!! Also…!”
“Also, what!!”
“You can make anything. You are a god of Creation, so I thought maybe you might keep my death a secret. I was hoping you would make a clone of me as a replacement!!”
“What the hell are you talking about, idiot?” An enraged Lee Gun spit fire from his mouth as he kicked Hugo.
After beating up Hugo, Lee Gun turned around in anger. “Damn it! I acted like a moron because I had to deal with that bastard.”
“Gun?”
“Let’s go.”
“What?”
Lee Gun spoke as if he wondered why Hugo had a stupid look on his face. “Don’t worry about the Karmic Debt that was placed on you.”
“What?”
“I can cover that up with the exoneration ticket.”
“W…What? But I…”
Hugo had too much Karmic Debt. There weren't enough exoneration tickets to erase all that debt.
Lee Gun snorted as if he read Hugo’s thoughts. “Kill Ten Thousand to Save One.”
“…!”
Lee Gun was a god who could kill ten thousand to save one. It didn't matter who the target was. It also didn’t matter how weighty or how numerous the Karmic debts were. He just had to get rid of them all.
“It isn’t too hard for me to save you.”
Hugo put a hand on his forehead as he swooned.
[Hugo Otis’s Faith is rising]
[Serpent Bearer Faith: 1000%]
Flash!
Accompanying the notification, a light erupted from Lee Gun’s body. After having a heart attack(?), Hugo could no longer hide his faith.
A change occurred to Lee Gun’s body as the Faith rose.
“!”
His body, soul, and Divine status had been damaged, yet all of them instantly regenerated. His ailing body immediately felt light.
‘As expected, he’s a cheat code.’
Hugo’s Faith had been unexplainable in the past, but it seemed this was possible thanks to all the internal force he had accrued as Eternal Change.
Lee Gun turned around coolly, and Hugo got up in joy.
“I can really go back now?”
“That’s right, you moron.” Lee Gun nodded without hesitation, but then suddenly came to a stop. “Except.”
“...except?”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “You have to die once before you go back.”
Hugo’s scream rang out.

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - One Solution (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 438 - One Solution (1)
It was 6 o’clock, and the sun was setting.
After the monsters had been gotten rid of, civilians and countless disciples gathered at a gymnasium.
Everyone was surprised by the shadow that had appeared there.
“Lee Gun-nim!”
“What? Lee Gun-nim?”
“My god! I’ve never seen him in real life!”
The disciples let out a bright smile when they saw Lee Gun’s shadow. The reason was his return, but they had also heard an additional piece of news.
“I’m pretty sure Hugo-nim will be coming with him…!”
“What? Did he make up with Hugo-nim?”
“As expected of Lee Gun-nim, he’s bringing Hugo-nim back into the fold…!”
The high-rank disciples were very interested in this topic, so they gathered here.
At the end of the day, Hugo was a Zodiac-Saint-rank fighter. Nothing good would come from him heading over to the monarchs’ side.
Lee Jaewon and Goat were here as well.
“Welcome back, Lee Gun-nim.”
“You said you will be coming back with Hugo-nim…”
“Yes. He is here,” Lee Gun answered.
“Where….”
Lee Gun pointed at something with his chin. The disciples screamed when they followed it with their gaze.
“Ahhk!! Hugo-nim!!!”
They had wondered what Lee Gun had been dragging along with one hand.
“Ahhhk! It wasn’t a monster that he butchered?!”
“It wasn’t a monster that he cut up!”
Yes, everyone had thought the item Lee Gun was dragging along was a monster that he had butchered. But it was Hugo.
It was unclear as to how far he had dragged Hugo here like this, but Hugo’s legs were dragging across the ground.
In the end, the high-rank disciples screamed when they couldn’t even recognize Hugo.
The fact that a Zodiac Saint’s body could be damaged this much was surprising, but…
“Are you sure he’s alive?!”
“Hugo-nim!!!!”
When Lee Gun saw their reactions, he stared at Hugo. Then he furrowed his brow.
“…”
It seemed he had become self-aware that this didn’t look great.
Puhng!!
Lee Gun extended his hand and used the stage 5 Revive.
“Look. He’s healed now.”
“H-Healed….”
“Didn’t you just use Revive…”
At that moment…
“Gun! You…!!” The fallen Hugo opened and closed his mouth as he opened his eyes. Shaking with anger, he extended his hand toward Lee Gun. “Bastard… You said… You’ll kill me once…!”
It seemed Hugo hadn’t suffered only once at the hands of Lee Gun.
“You…liar…!!”
Hugo was enraged, but Lee Gun had a shameless smile on his face.
“What? You said your Karmic debt will decrease if you died as a human. I bet we got rid of more Karmic debt by killing you several times, right?”
“#*$#*!!!” Hugo let out an alien sound as he grabbed Lee Gun by his collar.
After he had regained his power, his physical stats had been upgraded to that of a monarch. It meant that the durability of his body had increased.
This was why using Super Regeneration on him instead of Revive would not have been enough. Still, it was a matter of principle!
Lee Gun ignored him. He tossed aside Hugo, then checked the city’s restoration. When he realized the disciples were doing a good job, he was pleased.
He then asked, “What about the inheritance? Did it succeed?”
“Ah.”
The Constructs lowered their heads.
When he had disappeared, he had tasked the Constructs to carry out a task. It was the inheritance of Sagittarius.
[We did as you instructed, and we were successful in carrying out the process of inheritance.]
If the Divine status survived, it could be used as the foundation, and a god could be reborn. In such cases, everything, including abilities, could be transferred to the reborn god. In other words, it was reincarnation.
However, the process of inheritance that Lee Gun had ordered wasn’t a simple inheritance.
The Divine status of Galan and the soul left over within the Divine status had been scraped together to revive him.
[This child is him.]
All the disciples were impressed when the Constructs brought a seven-year-old child.
“Oh! Sagittarius!”
“He looks the same!”
Despite his young appearance, this boy was clearly Sagittarius. He also had the same abilities, but…
[He can’t remember anything. Master did put his soul inside, but…]
“Really?”
[Yes. The process of inheritance is like this.]
“Really?”
[He does have thinner hair than usual.]
“Is that so?”
The reborn Sagittarius shook in fear when he saw Lee Gun’s fierce eyes.
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “That’s too bad. I planned on bringing back his memories too.”
“…!”
The Lord of the Fire Wheel had said that he could go through the process of inheritance while retaining his memories.
This was why Lee Gun had conducted this inheritance. “How long does it take for someone who became a god through inheritance to grow into an adult?”
[It varies a little by each individual… In the case of inheritance, it’ll take him around five years to grow into his original self. This is possible since the data was stored in the universe.]
“Is that so? Take care of him until that time.”
Everyone, including the Constructs and disciples, was shocked.
“D-Do you plan on tormenting him?!!”
“Are you going to use him as a slave when he grows up?!”
Dumbfounded at their shocked gaze, Lee Gun spoke up. “Hey. I’m not terrible enough to torment someone who can’t remember anything.”
“W…What?”
“Even if I had a bad relationship with him in his past life, I’m not psychotic enough to torment someone who doesn’t remember anything.”
They looked at Lee Gun, dumbfounded. Was this some ploy into working Sagittarius as a permanent slave?
Suddenly…
“Lee Gun-nim! This is bad!”
The magicians of the Gemini temple who had gone to Lord of the Fire Wheel to mark him returned with pale expressions.
“Abyss seems to have lost.”
“…!”
“Also, Ennead’s Great Spirit is moving with the gods who serve him.”
Lee Gun had thought this might happen. There were countless gods, and Lee Gun had absorbed around half of them. It was possible because he had absorbed the force of Kunlun’s Great Spirit.
Anyway, he had taken half, so who would the other half follow?
‘I got rid of the Divine world, and they cannot enter the earth now. They must be pissed.’
Virgo was worried about this, so she asked,
[Aslan. You said you cannot kill Ennead’s Great Spirit, right?]
“Yes.”
Leo, who had been chased out of the earth earlier, had been invited back in by Lee Gun. The Zodiac smirked.
[When I heard that you tried to kill them, I found it to be unexpected since you were close to the Great Spirits! You were especially close to Ennead’s Great Spirit! You guys were drinking buddies!]
Aslan spoke coldly and mockingly. “I’m not sure ‘close’ is the right word to describe it.”
He thought about what had happened with Ennead’s Great Spirit in the past. It was a bit before Aslan had carried out his revenge.
- I heard your human wife was killed by unidentified assailants. I’m sorry!
The Fire Wheel Lord had called a broken-hearted Aslan to Ennead. He consoled Aslan as he poured alcohol for him.
At the time, Aslan would sometimes visit colonies of other gods, and he had met Lee Gun’s mother in one of them.
She had been killed when some unknown assailants had attacked her. At the time, Aslan had been on a mission for the Divine world, so he had been unable to protect Lee Gun’s mother.
He was sure that the culprits were connected to the Divine world, but he had no idea who had done it.
- You had a child.
- Yes…
- I’m sure you are devastated at losing a precious child. If he were alive, he would have been a talented child. I’ll pray for the soul of the mother and son.
Aslan had flinched. Others would be too brokenhearted to notice, but…
- How did you know my child was a son?
- !
- I asked how do you know this?
- How else? You just told me.
- I don’t remember mentioning the sex of the child.
Aslan felt a murderous intent develop within himself as he figured out something. He had realized the identity of the culprit who had killed his wife while she had Lee Gun in her stomach.
He had realized who had given the orders and who had released his wife’s location and the information about his child to his enemies!
“No one should have known the location of your mother, but he did. I have no idea how, but… Anyway, he is a god that I was unable to kill. I have no idea how to kill him either.”
It didn’t matter which power or spell Aslan used. None of it worked against the Great Spirit of Ennead.
The gods despaired since Aslan was meticulous, yet he was unable to find a way to kill him.
“No. There is a way to kill him for good."
[What?!]
[Are you sure about that?]
“Are you being serious?”
“There is only one way.” Lee Gun smirked.
* * *
“Are you sure about this plan?”
After a short meeting, Hugo, who had secretly heard Lee Gun’s plan, wanted to confirm something with Lee Gun.
Lee Gun responded as if it was no problem. “I’m sure it’ll work. Of course, it’ll be changing the rules of the universe itself.”
“You aren’t talking about the rule of the Divine world. You are going to change the rules of the universe… Are you sure about doing something at that scale? What about the Karmic debt?”
Instead of answering, Lee Gun laughed as he looked at Head Basher (Primordial God). “I’m fine since I have this.”
Hugo had the memories of being hit by the Head Smasher. He started shaking from the trauma. He soon pointed toward the hammer. “T…This is it? It’s the exoneration ticket?”
“Yes. It’s possible to settle your Karmic debt with this too.”
Soon, the hammer transformed into a young child, and he started rubbing his cheek against Lee Gun.
Hugo glared at Lee Gun as if he found this claim unreliable.
Feeling Hugo’s gaze, Lee Gun answered, “Don’t worry. If it fails, I’ll make a substitute, and I’ll hand him over to the Chun family household. From top to bottom, I’ll make him better than their real father.”
“What the hell??!!”
“Anyway, with this, it doesn’t matter if you kill Ennead’s Great Spirit. Hailey will be fine too.”
Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement. “Hailey?”
He understood why he was being mentioned in the plan to get rid of Ennead’s Great Spirit, but why Hailey as well?
“Hailey has nothing to do with Karmic debt.”
Lee Gun had a bitter expression on his face. “She won’t be able to live long.”
Hugo screamed. “What?!!”
Lee Gun kicked him to shut him up.
Soon, a flustered Hugo whispered, “What are you talking about…!!”
“Be quiet. I just found out not too long ago.”
Of course, Yeonwoo and Heiji hadn’t told him about it. He already knew it beforehand, when Hailey had kidnapped(?) and taken him to the Scorpio temple’s holy ground.
As he had mingled his body with Hailey, he naturally was able to touch her. He had gotten a sense of her lifespan then.
He was the god of Life and Death. It was child’s play for him to find out someone else’s lifespan by mere touch.
Hugo was trying to determine which piece of information surprised him the most, so his mouth hung open. He slapped himself to close it. “You can tell a person’s lifespan through touch?”
“I might not look like it, but I am the god of Life.”
“How can you say that with a straight face? You probably meant to say you are the god of calamity— Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun kicked Hugo’s shin.
His ability to read lifespan wasn’t known to anyone. Anyway, it was unclear who had made it to be this way, but all forbidden children didn’t live long lives.
