Moreover, Hailey’s already-short lifespan had grown shorter because she had gotten close to Lee Gun.
Of course, Lee Gun could extend it using the power of Life. However, her getting close to a god was considered a sin. Hailey was destined to die as an evil god because of her Karmic debt. Lee Gun had no idea who had made it that way.
“Anyway, I’ll be able to take care of the Karmic debt already on the books.” Lee Gun merely had to make a new book and get rid of her Karmic debt. It would allow Hailey to return to normal.
Hugo nodded as he knew about this rule better than anyone. He had tried to use this rule to kill himself. It was why he had visited the Primordial god.
At the time, he thought that it was a useful rule that he could exploit.
“Right. That can never happen. I want to see my niece or nephew. I want to turn them into fans of their uncle. Exonerate her right now and marry her. You have to choose me as the host for the ceremony.”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile when he heard this.
It was unclear what the item was, but one could tell he had something up his sleeves by looking at his smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - One Solution (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 439 - One Solution (2)
Hugo happily spent time with his beloved wife and daughter. He kept grinning because of his beautiful daughter, who looked like him. “Her name is Jisoo. I can’t believe Gun gave her such a great name. This isn’t like him.”
His two mean(?) children looked at their dad as if he were an insect(?). Hugo would raise this child to be a daddy’s girl. He could imagine his young daughter grabbing her father’s hand and having this conversation with him.
- Jisoo, who do you like more if you had to choose between Dad and Uncle?
- Dad!
- When you grow up, who will you marry?
- Dad!
Hugo soundlessly roared in joy when he thought about what would happen in the future. He also made sure to keep his mouth shut. His wish would finally come true. He’d be able to hear words that he never heard from his other two children!
Moreover, he wouldn’t make the same mistake again. And so, Hugo ordered several documentary DVDs of himself and did his best to order the worst(?) of Lee Gun.
While he was doing this, Chun Jiwoo carefully asked him, “Are you really ok?”
She had heard about everything that had happened from Hugo.
Of course, she had known he had a reason for burning their family picture. He wasn’t someone who would just pack up and leave.
But this didn’t mean she hadn’t been worried. She had been vexed that Hugo had done all this secretly, and she had even slapped him on the back.
Hugo said as if she should no longer worry, “Gun has an item that might be a solution to my problem.”
It would allow him to get rid of the Karmic debt that he had accrued as Eternal Change. He would be able to live his life as a normal human. He could once again be with those that he loved.
Hugo was very happy about this. He got up as if to say she shouldn’t worry about anything.
“Wait a moment. Dad will go get something delicious that we can eat with Mom.”
He activated Wind’s ability, which he had stolen, and disappeared somewhere.
Tahk!
He once again appeared at Lee Gun’s workshop. He was inside the warehouse-style safe. Wind’s ability was quite useful. It allowed Hugo to move instantaneously, and he also could invade any space.
‘It doesn't matter where I go using this. Gun won’t be able to track me.’
It had a stealth function too. Hugo had come here to acquire a rare chocolate that Lee Gun had stolen(?) from the Virgo temple’s holy ground. He rooted through the safe.
Hugo stole all the snacks even though Lee Gun had threatened violence against anyone who took anything from here.
He was about to head back when…
“I see. You think everything will be fine if you use that ability.”
‘Kuhk!!’
A familiar voice rang within the safe.
Hugo was shocked to hear Lee Gun’s voice. He quickly hid among the treasures.
When Hugo turned to look, he saw Lee Gun moving with the Primordial god sticking to his neck.
Lee Gun had come into the safe to take out something.
“I know that using Exoneration affects your durability depending on the size of the Karmic debt. You can only use Exoneration two more times, right?”
“!”
Lee Gun was having an unexpected conversation with the Primordial god.
The Primordial god was now called Head Smasher, and he was a Divine item with the Exoneration ability. However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘It can only be used twice? That’s the limit?’
Hugo leaned forward to hear what they were talking about, and the Primordial god said something unexpected while rubbing his face against Lee Gun.
[Karmic debt can be divided on top into the SS rank, S rank, and A rank.]
“Is that so? What does each rank represent?”
[The SS rank is on the level of destroying the order of the Divine world. The S rank is at the level of destroying the order of society. And the A rank is an offense against public morals.]
The permission ticks that gods traded for can absolve Karmic debt of Rank A or below.
“What rank of Karmic debt did I incur in destroying the Divine world?”
[The SS rank].
“What about the Great Spirits killing you?”
[The SS rank.]
“What about the miscellaneous actions that I carried out within the Divine world?”
[All of them incurred S-rank Karmic debt.]
In other words, Lee Gun had caused an incredible amount of trouble. This was why he had to ask, “The number of Exonerations that can be used is two because I got into so much trouble?”
[No, that’s not it.]
“Then?”
[The first thing you want to do is acquit the great sinner Eternal Change. Second, you want to ensure the survival of the forbidden child, who shouldn’t exist. Third, there is the plan you want to employ to get rid of Ennead’s Great Spirit and his gods.]
The Primordial god continued,
[Those three tasks are beyond the Divine world. They will harm the order of the Universe. If you carry them out, you will receive Karmic debt of the SSS-rank, a disaster rank.]
“!”
Each of the tasks that Lee Gun wanted to accomplish had a connection to the order of the Universe.
It was almost a miracle that Exoneration could be used on something of that magnitude.
“This makes sense. Let’s put aside Hailey for now. I tried beating up and killing Taeksoo several times, but his Karmic debt didn’t go down.”
Lee Gun had killed Hugo several times(?) as an experiment.
Well, it wasn’t as if Hugo was killed by a monarch. Maybe, it was considered as a reward(?). That might be why the Karmic debt didn’t decrease.
[Anyway, it’s useless for him to die multiple times. It might not be possible unless he dies at the hands of Time. He has to be killed numerous times like a bug.]
Originally, Hugo was destined to be killed tens of thousands of times like a bug by Time.
It seemed Lee Gun was referring to that.
Mimir exited from the shadows and spoke in a quiet voice.
[That’s why we are lucky. We were given two opportunities to get rid of SSS-rank Karmic debt…]
Mimir had already realized what his master’s plan was.
[However, you cannot save both your friend and girlfriend. You have to choose one or the other. With your exoneration, only one Exoneration will be left.]
“What if I don’t get exonerated?” Lee Gun asked.
[Both Eternal Change and the forbidden child will live. You will also receive the SSS-rank Karmic debt and will fall into the World of Emptiness.]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. He remembered that Leo had mentioned it.
- You must not fall there! You must avoid it at all costs! It’s an entrance connected to the World of Emptiness!
At the time, he hadn’t paid much attention to it.
Lee Gun looked at Mimir as if to ask where it was. Mimir answered him.
[You saw what happens to those that get crushed by Karmic debt, right?]
“Yes. They become evil gods, and most of them can’t take it. They die in the end.”
The Great Spirits had turned into monsters, and they got what they deserved. They ceased to exist in the end.
Mimir continued as it brought up an important point,
[Their demise is linked to the Karmic debt that they receive. However, the Karmic debt isn’t the only reason. There is something a bit more to it. Their demise is a self-made choice.]
“What?”
[It’s because evil gods are sinners that get sent to the World of Emptiness. They become slaves for eternity.]
“!”
[Unlike the sunny Divine world and the colonies, the World of Emptiness exists in an alternate dimension. It’s a land where repeat offenders who weren’t exonerated go to. It’s an internment camp where beings full of the original sins are kept.]
No one knew for sure, but it was a place akin to hell.
“Is it different from Tartarus, which exists in the Divine world?”
[Places like Duat and Tartarus are under the management of the Divine world. In the strictest sense, they are lands of the Divine world. They are colonies.]
Like how modern society had the penitentiary, Tartarus was an affiliated facility of the Divine world.
So Lee Gun asked, “Is it similar to the World of Torture where Yeonwoo had resided?”
That was the lowest floor of the Divine world, and it had been the land of the sinners.
Mimir let out a light laugh.
[The Divine world received consultation from the World of Emptiness to make the World of Torture. The World of Torture is an internment camp, but it’s part of the Divine world.]
When Lee Gun had gone there to rescue Yeonwoo, he had seen the public employees of the Divine world. They had even bowed to him because he was a Zodiac.
[If one has to make a comparison, the World of Torture is like kindergarten compared to the World of Emptiness.]
“!”
It was kindergarten in comparison?
[Anyway, it isn’t a place where gods want to live. In short, it’s a land full of eternal pain… When those who take on Karmic debt become evil gods, they are forcefully dragged over there.]
“The reason they decide to kill themselves…”
Soon, the Primordial god spoke,
[Those that never become evil gods will never find this out, but when one becomes an evil god, you are given a choice. You can choose to kill yourself, or you get dragged into the World of Emptiness. You will live a life worse than a bug, and you will receive eternal pain.]
All of them had chosen to kill themselves. It was why the Great Spirits ceased to exist. This was like the difference between life imprisonment and the death penalty.
“Now that I think about it, I did hear something odd when I became an evil god…”
So why were the Creators and the Primordial god able to wander around after they became evil gods?
As if he had read the question on Lee Gun’s face, the young Primordial god spoke as he rubbed his face against Lee Gun.
[It wasn’t our Karmic debt. We became evil gods because the Great Spirits transferred their Karmic debt to us.]
It had lightened the weight of their sins, so they were able to run away. Anyway, most chose the death penalty instead of life in prison.
When Lee Gun had all the information, Mimir lowered his head deeply.
[It’s up to you to choose between your friend or your girlfriend. However, you must never forget that you can save only one of them.]
“Understood.”
[You must leave behind enough so that you become exonerated, Master! You must!]
“Jeez. Alright!” Lee Gun exited after gathering ingredients from the safe.
On the other hand, the hidden Hugo had a shocked expression on his face as he watched them exit the safe.
‘Exoneration can be used only twice…’
Lee Gun had been clear when he had spoken about it before. He had said he’d use it three times to exonerate himself, Hugo, and Hailey. So what was it about using it to save only two people?
‘There is no way…!’
Hugo dropped the snacks that he had stolen as he left the safe. He used Wind’s ability. Then he called out to Lee Gun, who was heading to his room. “Hey!”
“Damn it! You surprised me!”
Hugo was unable to use teleport, yet he had exited the safe.
Lee Gun’s eyebrows rose. “Why the hell did you come out of my safe?”
For some reason, Hugo furrowed his brows. Mistrust was written all over his face. “I want to hear your plan.”
“Plan?”
“How do you plan on getting rid of the remaining gods? Is it really possible? Are you sure about it? Do I have to just trust you to take care of it?”
“What? Are you getting a bit uppity now that you are a monarch-rank? Don't worry about it. I have a way to get rid of all of them.”
Hugo didn’t care about that. “You won’t do something like throwing your own life away, right?!”
“!”
Lee Gun flinched. He realized Hugo had heard the conversation within the safe. “You….”
“You won’t do something where you're the only one who’ll die, right?”
Lee Gun was about to berate him for eavesdropping on such a conversation, but he soon struck Hugo’s head. “Why are you so hellbent on putting me in the grave?”
“!”
“I have a plan. Just trust in your hyung. When have my plans ever failed?”
“Gun…”
“Don’t worry about it. I want you to make preparations for the wedding. You’ll get your wish. I’ll make you the host.”
“…”
Hugo became silent, but suddenly…
Boom!!!
The ground shook.
They quickly looked outside.
Hugo was surprised by the sight. “Those bastards are…!”
With a smirk on his lips, Lee Gun looked at the sky. “I was wondering why they weren’t coming.”
The sky was filled with gods. They were gods that served Ennead’s Great Spirit. However, something was more shocking than that.
“Cluders…!”
Yes, Gods were not the only beings to invade the earth. The monarchs and Cluders were together. Moreover, they weren’t attacking each other. They looked at the people of the earth as if they were looking at a common enemy.
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. “What did you do to Wind?”
“I got rid of him. Did they join hands with the gods because their highest leader is gone?”
[Did you expect no repercussions for blowing up the Divine world?]
“!”
An enormous light appeared alongside a familiar voice.
Koo-goohng!!!
It was none other than the powerful sun! It was the light of the Fire Wheel!
The sunlight, which threatened to blind everyone, swept across the earth. The light tried to erase all life from the surface of the earth.
“Kyahhhhk!!”
“Ahhk!”
Like before, all life on the earth was being burned to death.
Kwahng!!
The sunlight was strong enough to evaporate the ocean water.
Zzuhng!!
The enormous power pushed the earth to the brink of death.
[The power of the enemy is destroying the earth.]
The power of Ennead’s Great Spirit once again tried to take the lives of all creatures on the earth. When the shaking settled down, all the buildings on the earth fell. They evaporated into thin air as if a bomb had detonated there.
Ennead’s Great Spirit leisurely landed in front of Hugo’s house, which had completely evaporated. He had come to destroy the earth through brute force, yet he had an amused smirk on his lips.
[You used your head this time around, Snake god.]
While all the buildings had been destroyed, no life had died on the earth.
As proof of this, Chun Jiwoo was glaring at him with her third child in her arms.
Hugo looked at them. He had rushed toward them as soon as Ennead’s Great Spirit had sent his attack.
“Are you ok?!”
“It seems I have Lee Gun-nim to thank.”
Yes, a barrier of Life was present around her, protecting her. It wasn’t just her.
“Huh-huhk…!”
“I’m alive.”
All living beings on the earth had received Lee Gun’s barrier, so they were alive. They had survived the attack.
Moreover, Lee Gun was in his stage 6 form after he had imbued each individual with the power of Life.
Unlike Death stage 6, where he emitted black flames, his current appearance was very different. He was still in flame form, but Life was made out of warm golden flames instead of black.
Ennead’s Great Spirit was in awe as he smirked.
[I’ll acknowledge your strength. Not a single resident of the colony died.]
Lee Gun was clearly different from the other Great Spirits.
[As a sign of respect, we came in full force.]
As soon as he spoke, something flew in at frightening speed and embedded itself in the ground.
Kwahng!!
“!”
Everyone was surprised by the item.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - One Solution (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 440 - One Solution (3)
Corpses had fallen in front of them. And they belonged to none other than the Chun siblings and the disciples of the Sagittarius temple!
A shocked Hugo looked toward the sky. He saw a familiar face there.
“You…!”
[I never expected you to leave like that.]
“…!!”
Wind was there, and he didn’t look like his normal self. All the skin on his body was peeled, and his face was incredibly damaged.
Hugo was surprised, but Lee Gun merely raised his eyebrow. The marks all around Wind’s body made it look as if his body parts had been stitched together.
“What the hell? Why does he look like Frankenstein?”
“When I left, I killed him by chopping him into pieces!” Hugo seemed to be telling the truth.
Wind’s expression was that of someone who had been betrayed. He glared at Hugo.
[In the end, that was your choice? I never expected you to ruthlessly chop up your only sibling.]
Sibling, my ass! Hugo ground his teeth. He immediately realized what was going on. The gods had appeared alongside the monarchs. What else could this imply?
“Damn it! I was close to finishing him, yet that bastard saved him.”
Yes, Eternal Change and Wind were siblings. They were intimately familiar with each other’s abilities and weaknesses. That was why Hugo was able to get rid of Wind. This didn’t mean that Wind was weak.
This was the reason Hugo had fully committed to his acting and had been thorough in his preparations before unleashing the fatal blow.
‘I ripped him into pieces and incinerated him like the trash of the universe.’
It seemed Ennead’s Great Spirit had discovered Wind and revived his tattered self.
Ennead’s Great Spirit smiled.
[For some odd reason, our goals alight. The enemy of my enemy is my friend. I thought we could help each other.]
Wind, the leader of the Cluders, had joined hands with the gods. He laughed.
[This is the price of making me feel pain.]
“…!”
Hugo looked at his children and the disciples of the Sagittarius temple. Wind had thrown their corpses in front of him.
He ground his teeth. The earth was destroyed, and his children and precious underlings were dead. It was a familiar sight; it was one of the two prophecies that he had seen before.
‘Is this what I saw at that time….’
Was it this moment?
The scale of this invasion from the unknown civilization was completely different from the ones that they had experienced before. It was a scene of chaos.
Of course, he had seen the prophecy when Sungjae was still a short kid, so he hadn’t put much thought into it. But this was no longer the case.
This was the same scene where his children and the Archer disciples were dead. And an unknown monarch who looked like a young man spoke these very words.
[The plan was a success.]
“!”
Wind continued,
[That attack right now just destroyed the barrier of the Serpent Bearer. We ate all the Constructs that you turned into proxy Zodiacs around the world. It seems you guys didn’t pay attention to them because you were too focused on protecting normal humans.]
Hugo glared at him. Until not too long ago, Hugo had worried he would cause this event when he turned into Eternal Change.
‘But it was him?’
As if this was settling debt for betraying him, Wind had purposefully chosen Hugo’s family members and close ones.
The monarch laughed.
[How is it? Do you feel some of the pain that I went through?]
“That bastard…!!”
Hugo couldn’t hold back the uncontrollable anger surging within him. He was about to use his power.
But Lee Gun smirked. “Hey. How long are you guys planning on lying there like that?”
“!”
“Don't pretend as if you guys are dead. Get up.” Lee Gun spoke as if it was no big deal.
“Kuh-huhk!”
Chun Sungjae was the first as everyone started to cough and get up.
Wind looked a bit surprised.
“That bastard is a psycho! He suddenly got rid of air to torture us!”
“I guess so. If it weren’t for Ms. Yooha, we would have been in deep trouble.”
“!”
Yes, while they had been getting rid of the monsters, their group had come across Wind. They had tried to put up a resistance, but Wind had let out a chilling laugh.
- If you want to blame someone, blame your father. I’ll torture you guys in front of his eyes.
Yooha had immediately realized what Wind planned to do when she heard that. She also could guess why.
There was no way this monarch would let them die easily. He’d inflict continuous pain until the end. This was why she had quickly used Death to put everyone into suspended animation.
She knew that the only one who had the ability to bring the dead back into this world was her uncle. Since this being had a grudge against her dad, he would take them in front of her father. That was what she chose to do.
As they were his disciples, Lee Gun had immediately realized that they were in suspended animation, so he laughed. “A mere monster like you shouldn’t underestimate my subordinates.”
His mocking laughter made Wind move, but Hugo decided to step forward.
‘He is my responsibility.’
However, Lee Gun blocked Hugo. “It’s fine. Don’t use your power.”
“Why?”
Lee Gun leaned in and whispered, “If you use more of your power as a monarch, your Karmic debt will activate. You will cease to exist on the spot.”
“!”
It seemed Hugo’s Karmic debt had been deferred because he had been a human. Moreover, he had been destined to die tens of thousands of times under the hands of Time like a bug.
However, Time was dead, and Hugo’s power and memories had returned. It meant his Karmic debt would be returning at a frightening speed. His Karmic debt would make itself known once again.
This was why Lee Gun said, “Just wait. After I get rid of them, I’ll use Exoneration on you.”
“But…!”
“It’s fine. Use my abilities. I’m a Great Spirit now. Your Faith is 1000%. You probably powered up.”
“!”
Hugo was a Construct of the Serpent Bearer temple, and he also had the Divine status of Hugo-rodite. Lee Gun was telling him to use either one of them. Hugo was worried nonetheless.
‘Exoneration should be saved for a later time. He might need it.’
Lee Gun was going up against psychotic foes. It wasn’t as if Hugo didn’t trust Lee Gun’s plan, but if it failed, there had to be a contingency plan. That wasn’t all.
‘I’m sure of it. Gun plans on using Exoneration on Hailey and me.’
Lee Gun planned on sacrificing himself. While Lee Gun might deny it, Hugo had observed him for a very long time. He could see it.
- Why do you keep wanting to put me into an early grave?
Twenty years ago, the day before Lee Gun had gone to kill Red Eye, Hugo had seen the same expression.
- I have a plan. Trust in hyung.
They had promised each other that both of them would come back alive, yet Lee Gun inwardly had a feeling that it would be his last journey. He had known his life was on borrowed time.
Since Lee Gun had the same expression on his face now, Hugo didn’t believe him.
He was glaring at Lee Gun when…
Zzuhng!!!
“!!”
Ennead’s Great Spirit, Wind, the countless Cluders, and the gods attacked at the same time. It seemed they planned on causing as much havoc on the earth as they could.
[There is no need for two kings under the sky!]
[Kill the snake god! Take him away from the humans!]
[Get rid of the traitor Eternal Change! We'll turn humanity into our food!]
As soon as the troublesome foes joined hands, Ennead’s Great Spirit changed his form.
Woosh!!
Ennead’s Great Spirit, who had looked like a young man, transformed into an enormous giant made out of flames.
At the same time, white flames surged into the air. It was Lee Gun’s Cycle. The white giant of Cycle clashed against the red giant.
As if a signal had gone off at this moment, the disciples stepped forward and countless Constructs surged out of Lee Gun’s shadow. There were countless pillar-rank gods.
[Do not fear death!]
[If we die, we can go through the process of inheritance! We will be able to fight again!]
[Protect Master!]
[Let’s see who wins even if this takes several hundred years!!]
Yeonwoo and the enormous serpent Junwoo (Apophis) threatened Ennead’s Great Spirit.
Ennead’s Great was displeased by the presence of the two of them. From the start, they had a Divine status that wasn’t compatible with him.
Ennead’s Great spirit smirked in disdain.
[I was merciful in breaking your Divine status in two. You guys should have been graceful enough to die. You keep crawling back out like maggots.]
When the gods and the disciples clashed against each other, several Cluders laughed as they secretly disappeared.
Hugo furrowed his brow. While the gods were fighting, the Cluders were showing odd movements. It was as if they had a different plan.
Of course, Hugo could guess what it was. This was why he glanced at Lee Gun before using Wind’s ability to secretly disappear. He kidnapped one of his kind and read its memories. Then he moved to a suspicious location.
Hugo scrunched up his brows.
‘It’s as I had expected.’
He had arrived at the colony of Ennead. The problem was the buildings built within the underground cave.
‘These are all items that steal power from the Serpent Bearer.’
In other words, the more Lee Gun used his power on the earth, the more this system would leech his power from him.
Moreover, Lee Gun wasn’t fighting by himself. He was currently protecting the humans and imbuing countless Constructs and disciples with his power.
As this was happening, some beings were eating away his power bit by bit?
‘I have to get rid of them.’
At that moment…
[What the hell! Why is that traitor here!]
The Cluders bared their teeth when they located Hugo.
As he looked at them, Hugo smirked. The heads of the Cluders exploded.
Poo-hahk!!!
[Kuh-huhk!]
[Kuhk!]
In a flash, all the Cluders there were killed. Hugo planned on killing all the Cluders even if his body burned out.
After getting rid of the enemies, he frowned.
‘Well, there is a way I can get rid of all the monarchs.’
He didn’t know about the naturally occurring Cluders, but he might be able to get rid of the monarchs created by Wind.
This was fine because most of the remaining monarchs were those that were created by Wind. But if he wanted to do this, he had to…
[They were desperately calling for me, so I came. I should have known it was you.]
Hugo smirked when he saw the figure that had appeared in front of him.
‘I need his heart.’
Wind had come here after receiving news of an intruder, and he had an expression of betrayal on his face as he looked at Hugo.
[You disappeared after ruthlessly cutting me apart. You have business with me?]
“Yes. This time I’m going to take your Core.”

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - One Solution (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 441 - One Solution (4)
Dumbfounded at first, Wind jeered.
[What? core?]
A monarch’s core existed deep in its body.
For some odd reason, Time hated turning into his monster form, but most Cluders turned into their monster form in battles.
‘The human form is used to lure in prey.’
Anyway, Eternal Change wanted to pierce through the vital point of his monster form? The vital point was much sturdier than other parts of a monarch’s body, yet he wanted to pierce through it to reach the core? It was a tough task.
‘The bodies of the first-generation monarchs are much tougher.’
The flesh of the third-generation or even the second-generation monarchs was soft because they were young. The first-generation ones were literally fossils.
Even Gun’s Divine weapon would have a hard time piercing through it.
Hugo knew this better. This was why when he had fought Wind, he hadn’t used physical attacks to attack Wind’s core. He had injected his power into the core to bring it to a stop.
Although Wind had been alive, Hugo made sure the monarch was unable to move, then diced him around the core.
The problem was that Ennead’s Great Spirit had saved Wind.
Wind let out a sharp laugh as if he found Hugo contemptible.
[You want to take out my core? Wasn’t it enough that you took my power? Now you plan on using the core to kill the other monarchs?]
Wind immediately discerned Hugo’s plan. The monarchs that he had made were connected to his core. These monarchs could be made to self-destruct if one used the core. One could even place a curse on the core and defeat them all at once through that.
There was a reason the second-generation monarchs referred to Wind as an elder. While his power may be overpowering, his core also had an influence on them.
[What nonsense!]
Wind smirked.
[Did you forget how we were born? We passed through the winds of the null world. We were born with a body harder than anything in the world.]
Underground had died a long time ago, and Hugo had heard Flame had died after performing her duty. The only ones left were Wind and him.
[There are no more remaining first-generations, so who would be able to destroy me at this point?]
However, Hugo laughed. There was someone.
“I’m the same as you, and I’m here.”
[!]
Hugo immediately used his power and started to transform.
Flash!
Wind flinched. His eyebrows rose as if he hadn’t expected this.
Hugo was abandoning his human form and trying to return to the Cluder form. Until now, he had changed only a portion of his body for a brief amount of time. This was different.
Wind laughed in derision.
[Have you truly lost your mind?!]
“No, I haven’t.”
[Didn’t you run to the snake god because you wanted to receive exoneration? If you change back into Eternal Change, you will no longer be able to receive it.]
The deferred Karmic debt would return, and Hugo would cease to exist before he could receive the exoneration.
[That was why you purposefully didn’t transform into Eternal Change. You got rid of me in your human form!]
“Yes. However, I realized I had it wrong from the start.”
[…!!]
“It was wrong of me to think that I should let someone else exonerate me for the sins I committed.”
[!]
Hugo had been blinded by the sweet happiness of having a family and an overwhelmingly dependable Lee Gun.
Lee Gun was unexpectedly cavalier about his own life. That was his personality. Lee Gun originally had a limited lifespan, and his occupation meant he could die anytime. So he wasn’t afraid of death.
However, this was different.
‘For me to discharge my sins, I would have to make my friend, who has nothing wrong with him, to die.’
Hugo preferred a great hero like Lee Gun survive instead of him.
Moreover, Lee Gun had flinched when Hugo had exited the safe and failed to sense Hugo’s presence.
‘It means his body has yet to fully recover.’
If Lee Gun were to die first, enough exoneration would naturally be left for Hailey and Hugo.
Yes, only two of those exoneration tickets were available. The problem would be solved if one of the three people who needed it disappeared.
Despite his family being on his mind, Hugo was ok with this. There would be no problems stemming from going through with this. If he failed, Lee Gun had said he would make a substitute with better stats than him.
Moreover, his replacement would also have a Faith of 1000%, and he would support Lee Gun.
Flash!!
[Bastard!]
Hugo had completely changed into the form of Eternal Change. His human skin split apart as a monster revealed itself.
Wind was taken aback since Hugo pursued mutual destruction. He quickly changed into his monster form as well.
Eternal Change’s eyes flashed.
[This will be my last present to Gun. I’ll leave him two SSS-rank ingredients with the highest durability. He’ll love it since it’ll be the only two ingredients in the world that won’t break.]
[Stop!!]
Eternal Change pierced Wind’s chest.
[Kuh-huhk!]
Crunch!!
No Divine weapon could pierce through his incredibly hard heart, yet Eternal Change’s hand had parted Wind’s heart to reach the core.
[Ahhhk!]
At the same time, Hugo felt a change occurring in his body.
[The chain placed on Eternal Change as a human has been released.]
[All the stacked Karmic debt will return to Eternal Change.]
Only a part of his Karmic debt had returned, yet his extended hand crumbled as it ceased to exist.
Hugo let out a bitter laugh. It didn’t matter whether his aim was happiness, life, or an item. There was nothing the treacherous Eternal Change couldn’t steal.
This was why he had liked the Creators, who did not steal from others but instead created something for them.
This was why he felt thankful to Lee Gun. Originally, he had struggled to kill even a single monster, yet Lee Gun had turned him into a hero.
‘Thank you!’
He was thankful that Lee Gun had allowed him to meet Jiwoo and his children. He was thankful for being made into a hero.
He used to be a being that knew only how to steal from others, yet he had become a man who could protect others.
‘Please be happy with Hailey.’
Eternal Change did not hesitate.
‘I should have done this from the start.’
Hugo held Wind’s core and blew it apart.
Kwang!!
[Ahhhk!!]
Wind screamed. As a secondary effect, the inner facility that was stealing power from Lee Gun blew up too.
Flash!
At the same time, having received his Karmic debt, Hugo ceased to exist. Light surrounded him, and nothing remained where he used to be.
* * *
Something surprising happened when the first-generation monarchs ceased to exist.
[Ahhhk!!!]
All the monarchs connected to Wind screamed as they self-destructed. When the monarchs turned into dust, the other Cluders looked taken aback.
[What the hell— Kuh-huhk!!]
The Cluders that had received influence from the monarchs clutched at their throats as they crashed toward the ground. All the Cluders around the world were behaving abnormally. That wasn’t all.
[That Eternal Change bastard— Kuhk!]
The Cluders started to die.
[Kuh-huhk!]
[Ahhhk!]
Lee Jaewon smiled when the Cluders disappeared as they swore. All the Cluders that had been flying around with impunity fell over as they had problems breathing. The monarchs also turned into dust!
“Young master! Miss! Hugo-nim must have done something!”
In contrast to the bright face of Lee Jaewon, the Chun siblings furrowed their brows.
“Hugo? Who is that?”
“Is that an Archer disciple?”
“What? Who is it— Uh? Whom was I talking about?”
The memories of Hugo were starting to disappear from the world.
Ennead’s Great Spirit snorted when he saw the phenomena. He immediately realized what had happened.
Grabbing his stomach, he laughed out loud and mocked Lee Gun.
[Your friend chose the worst option.]
“!”
He had brought the Cluders here, but he never expected them to die this way.
Ennead’s Great Spirit had known that Lee Gun possessed the exoneration tickets, and he had been dissatisfied that his item would be used on a Cluder to get rid of his Karmic debt.
Now, he was relieved that the precious exoneration ticket was still unused. He let out a scornful laugh.
[I wondered what plan you had concocted, but I guess this was it. Is this how you fight? You let others sacrifice themselves for you?]
Ennead’s Great Spirit smirked. It didn’t matter in the end.
‘Since the memories of Eternal Change are gone, his Karmic debt went away with him.’
Depending on how much Karmic debt a sinner possessed, even the sinner’s existence was erased upon their death.
In other words, the universe wanted to erase even the fact that they existed in this world. This was especially true for an SSS-rank sinner like Eternal Change.
Only a tiny number of gods would remember him. Unless one was a Great Spirit or a sinner, one wouldn’t remember the existence called Eternal Change. The universe had made it so that he had never existed.
The only ones who remembered Hugo or Eternal Change were Lee Gun, Ennead’s Great Spirit, and the Primordial god.
Ennead’s Great spirit snickered.
‘This is great.’
Eternal Change had been a thorn in their sides. For killing the Creators, Eternal Change had foolishly raised his sword against the Great Spirits.
[I don’t know which crafty words you used to make that dirty monarch kill himself, but I’ll commend you for it.]
At the end of the day, Eternal Change had been obsessed with the Creators. He had obviously fallen for Lee Gun’s words and killed himself.
[Your acumen for using a monarch will be a great example for others. I was worried you didn’t know your duty and place as a Zodiac. It makes me feel relieved.]
Unexpectedly, Lee Gun let out a light laugh. To be honest, Lee Gun had never expected that idiot to die first, so he couldn’t use the Exoneration on him.
“It doesn’t matter. That idiot’s action was within the scope of my plan.”
[What?]
When he had realized that Hugo had been inside the safe, Lee Gun had known there was a possibility that Hugo would do this. Moreover, he told Lee Gun what he should do if exoneration failed.
Still, Lee Gun never wanted this to happen.
“It means there is no change in my plan to kill you.”
Lee Gun’s menacing red snake eyes looked toward Ennead’s Great Spirit.
Ennead’s Great Spirit snorted.
[You were able to get rid of the Cluders thanks to Eternal Change. But don’t be too happy about it. This doesn’t make your weakness disappear.]
Lee Gun’s power had a weakness. It was that he couldn’t go through the process of inheritance.
[The only ones who remember you from the past twenty years are humans. If I kill those humans, no one would be there to remember and worship you. Your record as a god will disappear.]
The universe started writing a god’s record when the god became a hundred years old. That was the minimum age.
If the god disappeared from the memories of humans, the time started when the records were left through oral tradition or documents. This was why gods fought tooth and nail to survive for at least a hundred years. The reason was that a fight between gods wasn't short.
[It can take one or two hundred years at the very least. Or maybe several thousand years at most. The gods keep fighting on the same land as they go through the process of inheritance.]
This was why the gods who couldn’t go through the process of inheritance were lost. They were mere blips that the other gods passed by.
[It doesn’t matter if a god was born a genius. They keep their heads down for at least a hundred years! They don’t go on a rampage using their power like you!]
[Are these your last words?]
[Don’t pretend to be strong. I know your body isn’t in great shape. If we fight, you will surely die.]
Ennead’s Great Spirit gathered the power of destruction.
[Even if we kill each other, I can go through the process of inheritance. If that happens, I can take my time taking everything that is yours, including your Achievements, your Divine statuses, and the Primordial god.]
Moreover, this land was not too bad. He could use it as a base to make a new Divine world for the gods.
The snake god possessed enough qualified disciples who could become Constructs, and their faith was high.
[This is the last chance that I’ll give you.]
The eyes of Ennead’s Great Spirit flashed. It seemed he didn’t even want the possibility of Lee Gun doing something funny that could eat away at the durability of the exoneration ticket.
[If you don’t give up, the gods will find humans for hundreds and even thousands of years. That is nothing to the gods. The only ones who’ll suffer are the humans who reside here. Do you understand what I’m trying to say?]
Lee Gun had a weakness for humans. Since he had lived as a human, he identified himself as a human. So he treasured the humans so much that he instinctively let out the scent of a human.
This was why he didn’t see humans as residents of his colony. He felt a sense of kinship with them, and it was his biggest weakness!
Therefore, the Great Spirit was telling Lee Gun to give up and hand over the exoneration ticket. It would allow him to avoid seeing the humans being tormented.
[So? What is your answer?]
Lee Gun cackled. “Fuck you! If you want to do it, do it. Damn bitch!”
[What?]
“I’m going to make sure the gods will never be able to touch the humans.”
[What nonsense are you talking about…]
At that moment, Lee Gun used his Creation ability and summoned something. Accompanying a powerful light, the Rule Book appeared in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - Destroyer of Gods (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 442 - Destroyer of Gods (1)
Accompanying a powerful light, the Rule Book appeared in his hand.
This item surprised Ennead’s Great Spirit. It looked different from the Rule Book that they had possessed.
‘He made a new one.’
Lee Gun was part of the Creator tribe, who could create any item.
That was why Ennead’s Great Spirit became vigilant at first, but he soon started laughing.
[What use is there to creating that item anew right now?]
Ennead’s Great Spirit already knew what was going on. Lee Gun’s plan was obvious. He had made a new Rule Book probably to make some crappy rules that’d allow him to suppress the gods!
The Great Spirit assumed Lee Gun would take the same actions as the other gods! However, everyone who had done this had failed, including the previous Great spirits, rebellious factions, Creators, Aslan, and even the Primordial god. So his eyes flashed.
[It doesn’t matter what kind of law you created. There will always be a loophole that’ll allow me to escape. Do not forget this. Rules are meant to be circumvented.]
“No. You will never be able to escape it.”
[Are you going to add such a rule?]
“What?”
[Are you going to add a rule that says all gods must submit to the Serpent Bearer temple? Or are you going to permanently imprison those who do not have 100% Faith toward you?!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit laughed as if Lee Gun shouldn’t do something so arrogant.
[Listen to me. If you kill all the gods that don’t submit to you, they’ll merely be born again! If they are suppressed and imprisoned through the law, their power won't be able to circulate. As a result, the order of the universe will stagnate! This will be the worst outcome!]
It didn’t matter what Lee Gun planned on doing. The gods were in an advantageous position. Whether or not Lee Gun used exoneration on himself and suppressed the gods, it wouldn’t matter. The gods would just be born again and again. And eventually, gods capable of dodging the rules would be born.
How did the Great Spirit know this? It was because he was the prime example!
[Aren’t you curious about why I kept my memories despite going through the process of inheritance?]
“!”
[That’s right. It’s rare, but mutants are sometimes born among the gods. You cannot predict such a thing. Do you think you’ll be able to keep writing rules for each of these instances? You won’t have enough exoneration tickets!]
The gods were exalted beings.
[As long as the existence called gods continues to exist, the fight won’t end. Do you not realize this?]
He had said this to break Lee Gun’s morale a bit, but Lee Gun unexpectedly laughed. “Yes. The problem is that gods exist.”
[What?]
Lee Gun let out a sharp laugh. “Do you get it now? This new Rule Book isn’t the Rule Book that was restricted to the Divine world. You’d be making a big mistake by thinking that.”
[What??]
The Rule Book existed to punish the gods. It provided codified rules that kept the gods in order. If the Rule Book wasn’t limited to the Divine world, what else could it be…
“Universe.”
[!]
“I changed the Rule Book into the Rule Book of the Universe.”
[Wait a… What??]
“And it will turn all you bastards into tools.”
The face of Ennead’s Great Spirit stiffened. Of course, he knew what Lee Gun was referring to.
[Tool…]
He unconsciously glanced at the Primordial god, who was next to Lee Gun. In other words, this rule book would turn all the gods into weapons or other items.
Is that how Lee Gun planned on becoming the master of all the gods? It wasn’t just one or two. He wanted to change all the gods?
Ennead’s Great Spirit scoffed.
[It doesn't matter if you carry a petty trick like that. We’ll just discard the body that was changed into a tool. We just have to be born again—]
Lee Gun cut him off. “I already said it. I’ll change the rules of the universe.”
[…??]
“I had this thought. Does this world really need gods?”
[…!!]
Lee Gun had ruminated on this for a long time. He had started thinking about this when the monsters had invaded the earth.
Of course, humans could get rid of the monsters because they received power from the gods. However, it turned out that the Zodiacs and the monsters had been on the same side.
The monsters evoked fear in humans, and the gods used this fear to increase humans’ Faith toward them.
The other gods considered that their given right. This was why the Zodiacs’ actions were overlooked.
No, they were all doing something similar in their own colonies. They did it all for Faith.
‘In the end, gods only thought of humans as tools.’
Lee Gun’s opinion had become crystallized after he had visited the Divine world. If he let them be, this endless cycle would just repeat.
In fact, the gods had admitted themselves. Their lifespan was too long, so they could invade and torment humans whenever they wanted. Of course, they stated that humans couldn’t exist without the gods, but Lee Gun wasn’t sure about that.
‘Humans aren’t beings that merely want help from the gods.’
Humans were willing to mobilize and fight when it came to protecting their fellow humans and their families.
In other words, humans just needed power that would allow them to protect themselves.
‘Gods aren’t needed.’
This was why Lee Gun had come to a solution. “I’ll make a world where gods do not exist.”
[Are you kidding me!!!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit became angry. He had wondered what nonsense Lee Gun would talk about.
[You plan on bringing the downfall of the gods! You are too young and inexperienced! That is why you can say such a thing! The existence of the gods is the source of power that allows movement within a universe! Yet you want to do what!]
“It isn’t as if your powers will disappear even if gods disappear.”
[!]
“We’ll use your powers as tools, so you don’t have to worry about what happens afterward.”
Lee Gun immediately activated his power of Creation
[The ability of the Beginning and End Serpent has been activated.]
[The ability of the Designer has been activated.]
[The Divine status of a Creator has been activated.]
A powerful light surged into the sky. It was the activation of Lee Gun’s true Divine status, which had been masked by Life and Death: the power of a Creator, which had created the Divine world in the past.
Boom!!
At that moment, the land— No, the universe violently shook. Then, powerful light surged up from the ground.
[Ahhhk!!!]
The light swept up hundreds of millions of gods.
In the past, Lee Gun had made bizarre items from Hermes and Kunlun’s Great Spirit, who had kidnapped Sagittarius as a bride. It was as if those instances had been practice runs for what he was about to do.
[All gods will be recreated as items.]
[Their cores will be used to recreate them into items.]
All the gods started to turn into items. They took on forms that went with their powers. It was like what had happened to the Primordial god.
Ennead’s Great Spirit was swept up in the power as well.
Lee Gun let out a cold smile toward the flustered Great Spirit. “Humans exist for the gods. I’m pretty sure you guys said this to me.”
[!]
“I’ll make sure the opposite is true.” Lee Gun waved his hand. Gods exist for humans.
[You bastard…!!!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit glared at Lee Gun and tried to use Eliminate to get rid of him. However, Lee Gun planned on showing no mercy; he quickly took out the Fetters of the Underworld.
Hwa-roo-roohk!
The red flames clashed against the black flames. The incredibly strong power of Eliminate tried to swallow Lee Gun, but the power of Death offset it and sent Ennead’s Great Spirit flying.
Poo-hahk!!!
The sword of Death flew toward Ennead’s Great Spirit.
The Great Spirit’s eyes flashed as if he found Lee Gun’s actions impertinent.
Bbah-gahk!!!
His power ruthlessly destroyed the Fetters of the Underworld.
[How dare a novice—]
At that moment, Ennead’s Great Spirit vomited blood; a sword had pierced through his body. It wasn’t Death’s Fetters of the Underworld, and neither was it Life’s Heaven’s Punishment. It was Cycle.
[…!!]
The Primordial god’s weapon form had transformed into a sword, and Lee Gun had stabbed the Great Spirit with it. The Great Spirit glared at the item since he had been stabbed by the power of the Primordial god, whom he had killed.
[Bastard!]
He gritted his teeth. Then, with a smirk, he grabbed the sword in his stomach.
[Even if you turn all the gods here into tools, do you really think it’ll end there? Gods are born endlessly if they have the hopes and hearts of their worshippers. Their worshippers merely have to remember them.]
Gods were beings that were continuously reborn through the process of inheritance! It meant they would come back endlessly no matter how many times they were destroyed.
However, Lee Gun merely smirked. “Didn't you hear me right now? I said I’m going to change the order of the universe, idiot.”
Lee Gun would basically make a new system.
“It doesn’t matter if I disappear from this world. It doesn’t matter if you guys are reborn afterward. I’ll make sure you guys will never be able to mess with us.”
[What?]
“Did you think you guys are the only ones I’ll turn into tools?”
[…!!!]
Lee Gun immediately called forth Life and Death. Life took on the form of a female child, and the Divine status of Death turned into a male child.
When Lee Gun used the power of Creation, a light headed toward the two. Then something surprising happened.
[Life and Death will be turned into Divine weapons.]
[Would you like to name them?]
“Cradle.”
[…!!]
Lee Gun let out a menacing smile. “From this moment on, all gods trying to kill me will be sent to Death to be dismantled. They will die.”
Death’s appearance changed. A large black hole appeared there as if Death was pure chaos and distorted the surrounding space.
Koo-goo-goong!!
The gods that were hostile toward Lee Gun screamed as they were dragged away.
[No! Wait!!!]
When Lee Gun had reached Great Spirit rank, his Divine statuses had reached that rank too. They had turned into Divine weapons, like the Primordial god, and under the order of their parent, Death dragged the gods toward it.
Kwahng!!
Lee Gun spoke as he looked at the flustered Great Spirit of Ennead. “As their parent, who created them, I can add rules to those items.”
[!]
The Rule Book of the Universe flashed in his hand. A rule that would change the order of the universe had been added to it.
“First, Cradle is in charge of the beginning and end of all the gods. Death will destroy the Divine statuses that aren’t needed, and Life will create them into tools.”
[…!]
In other words, all Divine statuses would go through Life and Death. They would be reborn as tools.
It didn’t matter if the being in question was a nameless low-rank god or a famed high-rank Divine status. There was no discrimination in rank. Lee Gun had designed the system of the universe that way.
It might have been impossible to pull off, but except for “Eliminate,” Lee Gun possessed all the powers of the Primordial god.
Moreover, Life and Death had to be combined to make Cycle. Now that they were combined in Cradle, they could maintain the system even if Lee Gun died.
Cycle would move endlessly even without anyone controlling it.
Currently, the gods were being ripped apart by Death and being reborn as tools. It was similar to the process of inheritance.
Lee Gun said, “I’ll mention this. When you guys turn into tools, you will have power, but it doesn’t mean you guys will be gods.”
[…!]
“Since you will be tools, you will all act as powers of humans.”
The existence of the gods would cease to exist.
“The tools will all exist for humans and life.”
[You bastard!!!]
The eyes of Ennead’s Great Spirit turned bloodshot. He suddenly remembered a conversation he had with the Primordial god.
- What? You want us to treasure the humans?
- Yes. It might be unbelievable, but we are beings made by humans. We cannot exist without them.
- I will hear this no longer. You should stop speaking such nonsense. Do you understand me?
Humans exist because gods exist!
The Primordial god was the first who had appeared in the universe. A rumor said that this god was born through a child’s wish and faith.
However, the truth didn’t matter to Ennead’s Great Spirit. He thought the exalted gods had fallen for his ruse…!
Ennead’s Great Spirit angrily extended his hand, but Lee Gun was also a Great Spirit with formidable power.
“This will be the first and last thing I will make as Lee Gun and a Creator.”
[Do you think you will be able to handle the Karmic debt for bringing down the gods?! An SSS-rank exoneration ticket might not be enough!!]
“If we are being strict about the definition, I won’t be killing you guys. SSS-rank will be enough.”
The next moment, Death violently roared in its black hole form. Its enormous powers sucked Ennead’s Great Spirit, who had turned into a tool, into the Cradle.
Because of the change in the rule, Ennead’s Great Spirit had been in the form of a human, so he had been a bit lacking in power.
All the Constructs who had followed him screamed as the chaos of Death sucked them in.
[Ahhhhk!!!]
It was a terrifying amount of power: an endless power that no one could escape from.
As he was being sucked in, in his last moment, Ennead’s Great Spirit glared at Lee Gun.
‘Yes. The problem was letting him into the Divine world in the first place.’
There had been a prophecy in the Divine world. Sagittarius, one of the prophetic gods, had spoken it in a tongue-in-cheek manner.
- The goddesses are having a hard time seeing the future of the Divine world. They said something about a calamity that could wipe out the gods. It must be nonsense since we have the amazing Great Spirit of Ennead.
It seemed the prophecy had mostly been correct. A god of calamity had indeed brought disaster to the Divine world. He was a calamity who had wiped out all the gods.
‘Damn it!’
They had been referring to Lee Gun.

chapters.title: Chapter 443- Destroyer of Gods (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 443- Destroyer of Gods (2)
All gods hostile toward Lee Gun were dragged toward Death.
[Ahhhhk!]
Running away was futile. Death had acquired the power of chaos, and it didn’t miss anyone. It ruthlessly kept sucking in anyone who possessed a Divine status.
Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jeek!
That wasn’t all. Cluders that were pretending to be dead and barely clinging to their lives were dragged in too.
Kwahng!
[Shit! Damn snake god!!]
Death didn’t leave anyone behind as it dragged away Lee Gun’s enemies.
To check up on them, Lee Gun even went inside Death. He entered a space akin to the universe. It was a space of darkness and stars.
The Primordial god looked at Lee Gun, as if he was asking whether this was really ok.
[It was a good idea to turn them into tools, but the time within the Cradle differs from the earth’s time.]
In other words, it was unknown when they’d be reborn after being dragged into the Cradle. That wasn’t all.
[The inside of the Cradle is like the universe. There are countless dimensions in it, and they are connected to countless timelines.]
In other words, they might reappear in places other than the version of the earth where Lee Gun resided. They might appear on earths in different timelines. They could also appear in the past or the future.
In fact, they might be sent to the distant past or even a timeline where monsters had never appeared.
[Basically, they can cause trouble in places where you can’t monitor them.]
Lee Gun laughed. “That’s why I gave Death the abilities of Space-Time and Time.”
[!]
It didn’t matter which dimension or timeline they were in. If they got out of line, they could be shoved back into the Cradle.
“If push comes to it, Jun can exterminate all of them.”
If they got out of line, they could be destroyed and made again. They could also be imprisoned forever.
‘I won’t let the gods get out of this so easily.’
After entering Death, they were basically going through the process of inheritance. They would lose their memories, and that would stop most of their shenanigans.
At the same time, Lee Gun realized he had forgotten something. He looked at his Constructs.
“Ah. If you guys don’t want to become tools, I want you to tell me beforehand. I’ll release you guys from it.”
Since he had turned all gods into tools, his Constructs would suffer the same fate. However, his Constructs laughed as if it was unnecessary.
[Master, you told us of this plan earlier, and you carried it out only when we all agreed to it.]
[Also, we’ll be able to use our power. It isn’t as if we have to stay in the form of a tool all the time.]
[Since we are Constructs, we continue to follow the mandate of “Work for the humans” and “Do not go against the wishes of our parent.” Nothing will change.]
[We merely gained an ability to transform, so we find it novel.]
[It isn’t just the transformation ability! Look! We have new abilities!]
[We became more handsome!!!!]
[We are taller!!!!]
[In fact, this is more relaxing since we don’t have to monitor our lifespan and Divine power.]
The gods looked excited. However, they did have a different worry.
[We aren’t the problem. We are worried about the tools that went into Death. Humans will interact with them. I wonder if humans will be fine.]
“!”
Will those gods behave now that they would become tools?
Lee Gun’s Constructs were tasked to be watchers, and they would do their best to prevent any problems. However, some gods held a grudge against the humans. They might try to torment or entice the humans away from the eyes of Lee Gun. They might try to revert to their normal selves.
[Also, do you think normal humans who aren’t disciples can handle tools containing the power of the gods?]
This made Lee Gun laugh. “I believe in humans’ strength. If they do discover the tools, I believe they’ll be able to use them well.”
[!]
Lee Gun shook the Rule Book. “I made it so that normal humans will be able to use them.”
[What?!]
[That’s possible?]
“Yes.”
The exact details were a secret, so he didn’t show what he had done. “Now that they have become tools, they can never go against the humans. Still, this doesn’t mean I won’t put in safeguards.”
[What kind of safeguards…]
At Lee Gun’s gesture, the thrones of the thirteen Zodiac temples appeared. Since both the Gemini and Pisces temples had two Zodiacs, they each had two thrones. So a total of fifteen thrones appeared.
‘The thrones originally belonged to the thirteen Zodiacs.’
They had the basic ability to bring in and control Constructs.
‘I’ll use these to make the safeguards.’
When Lee Gun gestured with his hand, the fifteen chairs turned into cores.
[M-master, what do you plan to do with those?]
Instead of answering, Lee Gun summoned some beings. They were the beast gods.
[You called for us, Master!!!]
“Yes. You guys can proceed by picking fifteen volunteers among yourselves.”
[What…?]
[Volunteers… For what purpose….]
The beast gods were taken aback by the sudden order, but Lee Gun merely smirked. Beast gods had always been great at discerning corruption. This was why they were chosen to punish the fallen gods. They would be perfect for this task.
“I want you guys to mingle with those that became tools and pick humans that’ll be useful.”
[What??]
“I want you guys to choose human leaders who will be in charge of tools that entered the Cradle.”
[What?!]
“I’ll grant the power of the throne to the guys you choose.”
[This is….]
“Anyone that became a tool can be considered as a Construct-rank. These Divine items used to turn gods into Zodiacs. Now, they will allow the humans to command the Constructs as if they were Zodiacs. The mere possession of these items will give the humans a power beyond themselves.”
The Constructs were surprised. They had no idea why Lee Gun was going so far as to put in a safeguard like this.
[Master! You don’t have to ask us to do this. You can keep the tools in line!]
[Master, you are the only Great Spirit that exists in this current universe!!]
“!”
Yes, Lee Gun was the one to turn those gods into tools, and of course, he hadn’t become one himself.
While he had separated Life and Death himself as Cradle, they were his Constructs. If he wanted to, he could easily command them.
[That’s right. If you want, you can travel to any timeline that you want… Why would you want human managers…!]
[Can’t you keep the tools in line and protect the humans?]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as if they were talking nonsense. “Have you lost your minds? Hey. I’m the one who made them. I’m not the one who is going to use them.”
[!]
The gods were weapons and tools now. He was their manufacturer, and there were better-qualified people who could handle those items.
“I’ve done my duty. I made the weapons, and it’s up to the users to use them. You want me to carry out the after service too?”
[Master?!]
Mimir looked at Lee Gun with a bit of worry.
The beast gods didn’t know the implication behind Lee Gun’s words, so they shook as they spoke.
[You want to pick fifteen among us… Are you saying we will pick fifteen human managers too?]
“Yes. Each of you will choose a bold human who will stand up to the gods who became tools. If they turn out like the twelve Zodiac Saints, you can pick someone strong like me and trim the fast. You guys are free to do as you want.”
[W-Wait a moment! A task like this should be given to the highest-rank gods among the beast gods! We will go ask them!]
[They are all headstrong, but powerful. Of course, there will be a big fight since they'll try to gain approval from you, Master, but…]
“Let them do it. If they die during the fight, they can go through the process of inheritance. Tell them to do it in moderation.”
Something seemed to be bugging Mimir. As the God of Wisdom, he couldn’t deny that Lee Gun was coming up with the perfect safeguards. However, he felt as if Lee Gun was preparing for things that would come after his death. Was he mistaken?
[Master, excuse me, but would you…]
He was about to ask something when Lee Gun called for Life and Death. The two Divine statuses were in their human forms, and they seemed to really like Lee Gun. They hugged Lee Gun as if they were koalas.
This was especially true with Jun, who looked at Lee Gun with a twinkle in his eyes. It was as if he was asking Lee Gun if Lee Gun had seen what he had done.
[Did you see, Master? Did you see it? I got rid of all your enemies!]
He spoke as if he wanted a compliment.
Lee Gun patted his head as if Jun had done a good job. “Good! From now on, you will have to manage them in my stead.”
[?]
The smile on the faces of the two Divine statuses faltered a bit.
[Master?]
“Also, you will someday meet a new master. I want you to treat that master well and protect humanity.”
Lee Gun’s Divine statuses of Life and Death were like his alter egos in some ways. This was why he trusted them the most, and he was saying that he would leave everything to them.
For some reason, Jun started crying. He desperately clung to Lee Gun as if he had sensed something as the Divine status of Death
[No. I don’t want a new master! I like you, Master! I don’t need another master!]
“Yes. I’m sending you guys away so suddenly, and I get you might not like this. That is why I’ll give you a choice.”
[!]
“If you don’t like your new master, you don't have to follow him. If you think he’ll be harmful to humanity, you can get rid of him. You will continue to have a choice to pick your master. You guys just have to protect the one you choose.”
Life didn't answer him as she continued to hug Lee Gun, while Death kept crying.
[I will never pick anyone. I will wait for the day when you come back to us, Master. I will continue to wait.]
Lee Gun patted their heads as he turned them around. He was telling them to go back to work. He also sent the other gods away so that they could help restore the destroyed land.
At the moment…
Throb!
Lee Gun, who was alone inside the Cradle, furrowed his brows when he felt the pain in his arms. He immediately turned the Primordial god into his book form.
‘It’s time for me to use the exoneration tickets.’
He would revive his idiot friend and save Hailey.
Hearing this, the Primordial god spoke in a worried voice.
[Are you sure you don’t need to use the exoneration tickets on yourself?]
“Yes. I made this decision from the start.”
[But….]
“It’s fine. I won’t be able to last long either way.”
Lee Gun hadn’t told anyone about this, but his body was a problem.
‘I guess there really is a difference from not being over a hundred years old.’
Gods became stronger as they aged. Since Lee Gun possessed a body that wasn’t even a hundred years old, a Great Spirit’s power was too strong for him.
He had grown way too fast, and his power was excessively strong. This was why his body, which was considered newly born, couldn’t stand it.
He could use the power of Life, but that would be like trying to pour water into a jar with a hole in the bottom.
‘It would have been a different story if some of my data was written into the universe.’
Lee Gun had thought he had caused a lot of trouble, but unexpectedly, the universe considered him a speck. Or maybe it was asleep.
Anyway, Lee Gun’s body was breaking down, and if it continued, he would take his Divine statuses and Constructs with him. They were considered to be joined at the hips.
This was why he had separated Life and Death from himself. He had also separated the Constructs from him by turning them into tools. He didn’t want them to be swept up in his demise.
‘If I’m going to break down, it’s advantageous for me to save everyone I can.’
This was how Lee Gun had always felt, yet Hugo had preemptively dragged away the Cluders to save him. His friend had died before him, leaving Lee Gun with mixed emotions. However, he was thankful for Hugo’s gesture.
Lee Gun quickly moved to use the exoneration tickets on Hugo and Hailey. He put up a barrier so that no one could bother him. He had to do this before Mimir came since Mimir was very quick on the uptake.
But…
“!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he felt a presence. When he unleashed his power, a figure surrounded by blue light, who had been hiding, came into view.
Lee Gun flinched when he saw that face. “Yeonwoo.”
Yeonwoo had her head lowered, and she was making small sounds as she cried.
“You heard it all.”
The gods had been defeated, and Yeonwoo had learned a new skill. She had planned to surprise Lee Gun. But right now, she was unable to raise her head.
Lee Gun let out a bitter laugh as he approached Yeonwoo. He hugged her as he patted her back. “I’m sorry, Yeonwoo. I won’t be able to marry you.”
Yeonwoo buried her face further into his chest as he held her. “You don't have to accept me. Just don’t die. Please…!”
Lee Gun let out a bitter laugh. He finally realized how his father would have felt back then. When his father had died, the baby snake would also have been on his mind like this.
“Mmm. I’ll try my best”
“Gun….”
Lee Gun kissed Yeonwoo on the forehead and grabbed her face.
[Sleep.]
Yeonwoo suddenly went stiff. She was Lee Gun’s Construct, and she couldn’t disobey her master’s order.
As expected, Yeonwoo’s eyelids became heavy. She tried to fight it off and stop Lee Gun, but it was useless.
Flash!
When she fell asleep, Lee Gun opened Pond underneath her feet. After falling into the Pond, Yeonwoo immediately disappeared from the Cradle.
Then, Lee Gun called for his Construct. It was none other than Piggy Bank Pixiu.
[Boo-ohhh!!]
When it saw Lee Gun, the Construct assumed its stomach was going to be cut open again. It started to sweat as it tried to run away.
However, Lee Gun merely apologized for cutting its stomach open all this time. He patted it as he gave it eight crystals.
These crystals were all the power of the Primordial god, except Eliminate, which Ennead’s Great Spirit had taken for himself.
[Boo-oh?]
“I want you to store this in your stomach and give it to Yeonwoo later. I want you to take care of it instead of me.”
[B…Boo-oh???]
Pixiu looked taken aback. It was asking why Lee Gun was letting someone else do such a thing.
“There might be a time when she’ll be in danger, and she might have to use them. I would have liked to have given all nine to her, but I couldn’t acquire the last one as Eliminate has already fused with Death. I’m sure not having it won’t be a big deal. It isn’t as if an artifact will appear if she has the entire set.”
When Lee Gun put his hand into Pixiu’s mouth, the Construct suddenly got an ominous feeling. It shut its mouth and refused to eat the items.
“What the hell! Hurry up and eat it, pig! I know you like to eat!”
[Boooooo-ohhhhh!]
Lee Gun forced Pixiu’s mouth open. He was about to force-feed it when…
Kwahng!!!
“!”
From within the universe-like space that Death had created, a black shadow shot out from the chaos.
[Give me that ability!!!]
“!”
It was none other than Ennead’s Great Spirit! Was it a last-ditch effort? Or was there some reason behind this move?
Despite being unable to use his power after being turned into a tool, Ennead’s Great Spirit went crazy. He tried to take the power of the Primordial god, which Lee Gun had been trying to put into Pixiu’s stomach.
The Great Spirit was almost dead, and half of him had turned into bones. Yet, he grabbed Lee Gun’s foot. This was true spite on display.
‘Is it the grudge left behind in the Divine status?’
This was the power of the Divine status without any rational thoughts left behind!
Lee Gun couldn’t comprehend what was going on, but he let out an ugly laugh. “This is great.”
Ennead’s Great Spirit possessed Eliminate. Since the Divine status of Eliminate had entered the Cradle, Lee Gun had known it would be turned into a tool. This was why he hadn’t been bothered by its absence.
However, it was a different story now that the Great Spirit had appeared in front of his eyes.
“I’ll make it a set of nine!”
Lee Gun liked this development. He shoved the eight crystals into Pixiu’s mouth.
This bastard Great Spirit was a mutant that could escape the rules! So Lee Gun quickly put a headlock on Ennead’s Great Spirit.
Kwah-jeek!!
Lee Gun shouted, “Piggy Bank! I’m going to extract the Divine status! Keep your mouth open!”
[Boo-oh?!!]
Lee Gun finally extracted the Divine status from the body of the Fire Wheel Lord and held it up.
Poo-hahk!!!
“Eat it!”
[B-Boo-ohhhhh!]
Pixiu reflexively ate the crystal of Eliminate.
Ennead’s Great Spirit despaired. He had planned on escaping the Cradle after killing Pixiu.
Lee Gun grabbed his head. “Where do you think you are going? I’ll take you with me to the afterlife.”
[?!]
Lee Gun bared his teeth and laughed. He looked at the Primordial god (Book), which Pixiu held in its mouth. “Hurry up and activate the exoneration tickets! Both of them!”
[Are you sure about this?]
“Yes.”
Lee Gun laughed. He had planned on saving Hugo and Hailey from the start. Since one of them was destined to die, he chose the better option. He was about to jump into the Cradle with Ennead’s Great Spirit.
‘It isn’t too bad to meet my end using the item that I made.’
Of course, he was the parent of Death. He doubted he would turn into a tool despite jumping into Death. Still, he thought living as a tool that he had made wouldn’t be a bad life.
However, he heard Mimir’s voice at that instant.
- Master? Master? What are you doing right now? Please let me enter the Cradle!
It seemed he had been found out. Lee Gun ignored Mimir. He had put up a barrier and made sure no one could come in here.
‘Let’s do this.’
However…
“You shouldn’t do that.”
“!”
Lee Gun heard a familiar voice, and this voice came from Pixiu’s stomach.

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - World of 1% Possiblity (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 444 - World of 1% Possiblity (1)
“You shouldn’t do that.”
“!”
Lee Gun heard a familiar voice come from Pixiu’s stomach. He felt like he had been sucker-punched. His reaction was understandable.
“Hailey?!”
Why was he hearing her voice in this place? Moreover, why was her voice coming from Pixiu’s stomach?!
“Why are you in there!?”
Lee Gun was taken aback as he continued to hold on to the Great Spirit of Ennead. However, that wasn’t the only shocking part.
“Daughter-in-law… You agreed to stay hidden! You shouldn’t have said anything!”
“?!”
Lee Gun heard Aslan’s voice this time! Although he couldn’t see their faces, he had heard their voices. It made him angry. How dare they!
“Why are you two over here? Also, why the hell are you hiding inside Piggy Bank’s stomach?”
“Why else? I knew you would do this, so we came here!”
“What?”
Hailey was the one to answer. She continued, “Since only two exoneration tickets were left, we knew what you would choose to do. How can we not?”
“…!”
Flustered, Lee Gun tried to chase the two of them out of the Cradle.
But Aslan snorted. “Your efforts will be in vain! You can try to chase us out, but it will be useless since we aren’t your Constructs.”
They really were going to act this way? An angry Lee Gun glared at Piggy Bank, who was keeping its distance from him.
“Spit them out! Spit them out before I cut your stomach open!”
A terrified Pixiu whined and retreated. Its action didn’t matter.
Lee Gun decided to take advantage of this situation since he had heard his father’s voice.
“I'm glad you’re here. I want you to look out for Yeonwoo and Junwoo. Also, I want you to take care of the Primordial god’s power.”
Lee Gun immediately activated the book and used an exoneration ticket. Now, only one was left.
Lee Gun looked at the space of Death that had unfolded beneath the feet of the Fire Wheel Lord. In this space, everything was ripped apart. It was the destination before one passed through Life.
Death within Cradle looked different from what it usually did outside in the light. Here, it looked like the galaxy. However, the lights were so bright that it was almost shocking.
While he held Ennead’s Great Spirit, Lee Gun’s body also started to break down.
“Koohk…!”
One of his arms was destroyed.
Ennead’s Great Spirit had only a deep-seated grudge within him, so he let out a fierce laugh.
[What did you think you could do with such a body? Yes! I knew something was off! You are a baby who hasn’t even reached the age of a hundred years, yet you thought you could use a power of that magnitude!]
Lee Gun was still relatively young. The universe was unable to remember him.
[You being able to handle that much power is amazing in itself! Since things have turned out like this, I can admit it! I’ll give you this compliment!]
Lee Gun grabbed him as if he could go to hell. Of course, he knew Ennead’s Great Spirit was trying to take him and the entire earth as his travel companions to the afterlife.
So Lee Gun yelled as he suppressed the power of Ennead’s Great Spirit.
At this rate, his body would break down before he could use the exoneration tickets. That was why the best course of action for him was to use all the exoneration tickets. Then he would jump toward Death with this bastard in tow.
Lee Gun activated the last exoneration ticket.
‘It is…the last one…’
This one was reserved for Hailey.
“Wait a moment, Daughter-in-law! No!”
“!”
Aslan’s desperate voice came from Pixiu’s mouth.
When Lee Gun turned his head, he saw Hailey trying to exit Pixiu’s mouth and Aslan trying to stop her.
“You promised to do nothing. I’ll take care of—”
Aslan couldn’t speak any further.
Flash!
“!!!”
When Hailey placed her hand on him, Aslan turned into his slime form, surprising the former Creator. To make matters worse, he couldn’t move.
Seeing this, Lee Gun ordered Pixiu to swallow Hailey. He would then send Pixiu out of the Cradle.
Flash!
“…!”
Lee Gun’s field of vision suddenly changed. He had been transferred to a different location, and instead of Ennead’s Great Spirit, he was now holding a powerful flame!
This surprised Lee Gun.
‘It’s the Red Monarch’s Flame….’
He was wondering why the power of Hailey’s mother had appeared here when soft fingers grasped his face and turned his face to the side. It was Hailey.
Lee Gun became surprised when he met eyes with her. “Hailey— Oohp!”
As soon as he turned his head, Hailey kissed him. It was a deep kiss.
However, Lee Gun realized something. This wasn’t a simple kiss. Through Hailey’s body, a certain power was passing into him. Lee Gun realized what this power was.
‘The Red Monarch’s power.’
Since had seen it before, he was sure of it. This power belonged to Hailey’s mother, who had been captured by the gods and had her sweat and blood squeezed out of her.
The power of the Flame monarch was entering his body. Lee Gun had previously saved Hailey’s mother, but she had been in a very poor state.
After the incident, he had heard that she had ceased to exist. So he had assumed she had died after passing on her power to her daughter.
‘Why now?’
At that moment, the shadow of Ennead’s Great Spirit tried to snatch away Hailey and Lee Gun. It flew toward them, unleashing a fierce attack.
Poo-hahk!!!
‘Koohk!’
A tentacle shaped like a hook extended out from the shadow and ruthlessly attacked Lee Gun’s back.
It was an attack aimed at a vital point, so Lee Gun instantly hugged Hailey as if he was covering her up. He was in pain, but the pain lasted for just an instant.
“!”
‘It doesn’t hurt.’
It hadn’t pierced him. The attack should have been strong enough to pierce through his skin to reach his stomach, yet it couldn’t. It had bounced off his skin!
He was wondering what was going on when…
Flash!
[Your body has become sturdy now that the power of a first-generation monarch has entered it.]
[The power of the powerful Life Flame has strengthened your body.]
[Nothing can pierce through your body.]
It was as if Flame had created life.
The enormous power was strengthening his body. It looked similar to the regeneration of Life at a glance, but it was different.
[You will be able to withstand the enormous power of a Great Spirit.]
The monarchs possessed incredibly strong bodies that didn’t easily lose to the gods. In fact, their bodies were sturdier than gods’.
Among the monarchs, the ones with the strongest bodies were the first-gen monarchs.
Basically, right now, Lee Gun’s body was like that of a newly born god, and it had been strengthened by the power of the monarch. He could now withstand the power of a Great Spirit.
This was something the Divine status of Life couldn’t accomplish, but it was another facet of life.
It was like a flame that could endure any situation and which emitted powerful life energy.
[Body Strengthening]
Lee Gun’s body became as sturdy as the body of a monarch.
[Your body has stopped breaking down.]
“…!”
Ennead’s Great Spirit was surprised.
[That damn woman…!!]
Hailey looked at Lee Gun. “This is my mother’s power. It was the last thing she left me.”
“!”
The monarch of Flame had given her power to her daughter before ceasing to exist. She knew her daughter would die because of her Karmic debt. So she gave her power to her daughter as a tool that would extend her life.
The characteristic of Eternal Change was imitation, and that of Wind was movement. For Flame, it was never-ending life energy. That was why the gods had used her power.
“You’ll be able to withstand your power with it. There won’t be a problem.”
Lee Gun no longer had to think about sacrificing himself because his body was breaking down. If he used the exoneration ticket that created the tools, he would be able to live a long and happy life.
But…
Hailey vomited blood at that instant. Lee Gun immediately realized Hailey’s body had weakened because of the power transfer. Moreover, she couldn’t withstand the power of Ennead’s Great Spirit, so her body was breaking down.
Lee Gun tried to use the power of the Creator to reconstruct her body. “Hailey!”
However, Creation was unable to regenerate her body. Her body was breaking down at an extremely high speed.
Lee Gun was taken aback. When he had a realization, he tried to take something out of her chest. “What do you think you were doing?”
She had used the Primordial god’s “Eliminate” on herself. The power of the Primordial god couldn’t be used by just anyone. It was why the greedy Great Spirits had split the powers.
