Someone who wasn’t a Zodiac had used the power. However, that wasn’t important right now.
Lee Gun tried to use the power of Elimination, yet Hailey seemed to have planned this out from the start. She grabbed Lee Gun’s arm. “Do not try to save me. I want you to use the exoneration ticket on yourself. I want you to live a happy life with Hugo and Yeonwoo.”
“What?”
Lee Gun couldn’t accept it. “I was going to save you. Why the hell are you trying to die?”
Hailey laughed as if she was rejecting such an idea. “A world without you is meaningless.”
“!”
“You have no idea what emotions go through someone’s heart when they are left behind. I don’t want to feel those feelings again.”
“…!”
Twenty years ago, Lee Gun had disappeared into the Devil’s Tower. Since then, Hailey’s life had been lonely. She felt a sense of guilt and loneliness. And the thought of Lee Gun no longer existing only gave her pain.
“Gun. Without you, everything feels meaningless.”
Lee Gun sighed as he watched Hailey’s breathing get weaker.
The day Yeonwoo had died, Time had brought Oblivion along with him, and Oblivion had consumed Lee Gun’s emotions.
This was why his emotions always seemed dull, but for some reason, his heart started hurting right now. He finally felt the reality of her death, and this experience allowed him to realize something.
Lee Gun had always been on the frontline; he was the first to lead and leave. So he had never realized this. The people whom he had left behind felt differently, and he had never paid attention to their emotions.
If he thought about it, two people had been distressed and tormented by his death for twenty years. Yet he was planning to do the same thing to them again. No, everyone else would be in the same boat too.
‘It’s meaningless unless everyone lives.’
Lee Gun had this realization. He carried Hailey into his arms and nodded. He had to find a way to save all three of them.
As he got up, however…
Koo-goo-goohng!!
“!”
The floor roiled as an unknown black shadow appeared on it. The shadow was trying to take Hailey.
An angry Lee Gun tried to grab the black shadow, but his hand merely passed through it.
“!”
The power of the gods didn’t work against the shadow, and it wasn’t because Lee Gun’s power had weakened.
[You cannot touch it unless you are a resident of the World of Emptiness.]
[It’s the power of a world that you cannot meddle in.]
“…!”
In the end, the shadow took Hailey and disappeared somewhere.
Lee Gun tried to chase them down, but the dying grudge of the Fire Wheel Lord laughed.
[You cannot go there. It came from the World of Emptiness.]
“What?”
[She is the forbidden child. You wanted to save her using the exoneration ticket, but you couldn’t save her with it in the first place.]
“What?”
[The King of the World of Emptiness won’t forgive the forbidden child.]
The World of Emptiness was a world of death, which was worse than the World of Torture. It was a place where even gods suffered eternal pain and labor.
Evil gods, monsters, and those with Karmic debt were sent to this world of sinners. It was the world of Yang, which was different from the Divine world, the earth, and the other colonies—a world of eternal labor where there was no light.
[Who do you think made the rule that said a god and a monarch cannot mate?]
It wasn’t a rule made by the Primordial god, but one made by the King of the World of Emptiness.
[Anyway, there is no way a god can go to the World of Emptiness.]
In general, only those with Karmic debt could go there. Everyone who went there was crushed by their Karmic debt, and they became slaves to the king.
[That is why you are useless— Kuh-huhk!!]
Ennead’s Great Spirit was ruthlessly ripped apart. After cutting down the Great Spirit, Aslan showed up. He was barely able to regain his human form.
He furrowed his brows. “In the end, things turned out like this. I never wanted this, so I planned on taking on your Karmic debt."
“What?”
Aslan had planned on using Galan’s power. “If you had used the exoneration ticket on Hailey, I would have taken your Karmic debt.”
Aslan planned on becoming an evil god and dying instead of Lee Gun; it would allow him to save all three.
“I never would have expected that child to use the power of the Primordial god.”
In a flash, Hailey had suppressed and sealed his power. It might have been possible because she was a forbidden child.
‘There is a reason for the rule that forbids Cluders and gods from mating.’
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. It didn’t matter in the end. “Is using the exoneration ticket on Hailey useless? What is he talking about? Is it true?”
“He’s half-right and half-wrong. The exoneration ticket would have gotten rid of all her Karmic debt that… However, the same problem would have repeated itself unless the rule was destroyed.”
In other words, her Karmic debt because of being born as a forbidden child and the Karmic debt of getting close to Lee Gun would have been wiped clean.
“However, she would’ve incurred Karmic debt once again if she merely joined hands with you. It’s because you guys are a god and a Cluder.”
“…!”
The one to make this rule was the King of the World of Emptiness. In simple words, Hailey would be cursed again until this rule was present.
Of course, Hailey probably knew this. Even if she was exonerated, she wouldn’t be able to get rid of her love for Lee Gun.
“The more you like someone, the more you want to touch them. You want to stay next to their side. That’s an instinct.”
Lee Gun raised his eyebrows as if he was dissatisfied. “Who the hell is the King of the World of Emptiness? Is he different from the Primordial god?”
“You know him too.”
“What?”
“Universe.”
“!”
It was a being that remembered the existence of the gods. Universe was the King of the World of Emptiness.
This was why the gods were averse to going there. Universe was a being that transcended the gods.
However, Lee Gun merely laughed in contempt. Universe? “Ah. He’s the imbecile that couldn’t remember me despite me causing all kinds of trouble? ”
“Uh… Yes. That’s right”
Lee Gun smirked as if he had thought of something.

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - World of 1% Possiblity (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 445 - World of 1% Possiblity (2)
Lee Gun smirked as if he had thought up something. “I see. That idiot Universe is the King of the World of Emptiness.”
Universe was the being that used sinners as slaves. And Hailey had been dragged away to that place because of her Karmic debt.
Normally, if a being was crushed by their Karmic debt, they were given a choice: head toward the World of Emptiness to serve a life sentence or choose immediate death
Hailey didn’t even get those choices. Aslan seemed to have realized the reasoning behind it.
‘There is no way the king of the World of Emptiness would forgive a forbidden child.’
He was an ill-natured being that would find any fault within Hailey and torment her.
Lee Gun dared to have gone on an incredible verbal tirade to call the King of the World of Emptiness an idiot and imbecile, but it didn’t matter in the end.
“Don’t worry about her. I’ll bring back my daughter-in-law.”
“What?”
Aslan seemed to have a plan. Lee Gun had found a path to life through Hailey’s death, but Aslan knew Lee Gun would never accept such an exchange.
“I’ll go to the World of Emptiness. I want you to be prepared to use the exoneration ticket on her.”
“I thought not everyone was allowed to go there. Is it possible for you?” Lee Gun asked.
Aslan laughed. “I have my old brother’s Steal ability, which he left behind. I just need to take your Karmic debt, and I’ll be able to go there.”
Most of the gods were scared of the World of Emptiness, so they chose execution. However, the story changed if they chose the life sentence. They would become a slave to the King of the World of Emptiness.
“It’ll be possible for me to enter the World of Emptiness, and I’ll steal her away. That’s the least I can do.”
He would have to take a slightly different route from his original plan, but Aslan had always planned on going to the World of Emptiness.
Aslan had planned on taking Lee Gun’s Karmic debt onto himself after Lee Gun had saved Hailey, then he would die.
Of course, this method would have allowed him to save all three, but it also meant Lee Gun and Hailey would never be able to touch each other ever again.
Because of the rule regarding the forbidden child, Hailey would be cursed again if she got close to Lee Gun.
However, Aslan called Hailey his daughter-in-law for a reason. It wasn’t as if he was envisioning a future for those two for nothing.
“Originally, I planned on turning you into a human,” Aslan said.
“!”
If Lee Gun weren’t a god, he could clasp hands with Hailey. He could do all kinds of stuff with her. He could even marry her, and they could have kids too.
Cycle allowed him to change into a human for a short time, but Lee Gun wouldn’t be able to dupe the universe.
However, this was different.
“You are a mixed blood of a human and a god. I can help you give up on traveling down the road of a god. Of course, you’ll never be able to become a god after that.”
This was Aslan’s plan where everyone would get to live. Of course, he himself would forever live as a slave within the world of pain. However, he was willing to go through it for his son’s happiness.
Universe was a formidable foe, but Aslan had heard about how the World of Emptiness was structured.
“I’ll just have to do it away from the King of the World of Emptiness. I’ll secretly steal her away.”
Lee Gun snorted. “You don’t need to do that.”
“What?”
“I’ll go there. If I don’t use the exoneration ticket, I’ll become an evil god. I’ll be able to go to the World of Emptiness.”
“What?!”
Lee Gun looked at his surprised father, then brushed off his hands as if it was nothing. “Also, I caused this. If I hand over my Karmic debt to you, I will be no different from the bastards that I killed.”
“!”
“Don’t turn me into someone who got his father killed.”
Aslan was at a loss for words. Flustered, he looked at his son. “But Gun…”
“Also, that plan also doesn’t let everyone live.”
“!”
Was it worth living if he had to kill his father to do so?
Lee Gun would never be able to mention such a thing proudly no matter where he went.
Even the mighty Aslan was shocked by Lee Gun’s words. He tried to stop his son. “If you go to the World of Emptiness, you might be able to sneak out Hailey. However, you won’t be able to leave!”
He had the skill that could steal away Hailey, but getting both of them out was impossible.
“Even if you go there, it doesn’t mean everyone will get to live…”
“Hailey will endlessly suffer unless I get rid of the curse, right?”
“Do you plan on finding and destroying the rule? The rules of the World of Emptiness are different from the rules of the Divine world.”
Lee Gun was able to create the Rule Book of the universe, but he was unable to save Hailey with it.
“In the first place, a Rule Book doesn’t exist in the World of Emptiness. The king is the rule.”
“Then I’ll take the head of the World of Emptiness’s King. Oh. I like that. That simplifies it for me. It’s a tidy solution.”
“What?!! No!”
“That damn Universe. I caused a lot of trouble, yet he couldn’t remember my face? I can’t go through the process of inheritance because of that.”
“?!”
“Ah! This is great. If I cut off his head with my face right in front of him, will he remember me? Even an idiot will be able to remember the face that killed him.”
“Gun!!” Aslan angrily shouted.
Lee Gun just smirked. “Also, I’m not ready to become a human yet.”
Aslan looked tired as he massaged his brows. “I’m not even sure if that’s possible. I don’t think you’ll be able to live if you decapitate Universe.”
“No. There is a way. There is exactly one.”
“What?”
“A way to save everyone without sacrificing anyone.” Lee Gun smirked as if he had come up with a plan.
* * *
A light flashed. It was a warm light, the only light within the darkness.
The man headed toward the light as if he was drawn to it. His head was telling him that he shouldn’t head toward the light, but his body wanted to go toward it. For some reason, he felt he would be beaten to a pulp if he didn’t go toward the light.
After an indeterminate time had passed, the man extended his hand toward the light.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Hugo violently exhaled. He coughed and clutched the ground as if he was in pain. “Shit… What the hell….”
He was in pain. It felt as if his lungs were filled with water.
Soon, Hugo did a double take. “Uh? Uh?”
He realized that he was still alive. “What the hell? Why am I alive?!”
Taken aback, Hugo looked at his surroundings as he felt all over his body. He had no idea where he was, but it was as if he was in an empty space. “What the hell? Is this the World of Emptiness?!”
Hugo had been looking at his surroundings when he suddenly screamed. The reason was Lee Gun’s face in front of him. “Ahhhk!!! I’m in hell!! Kuhk!”
Hugo received a hit.
Lee Gun angrily made a fist. “You want to die??”
“Uh, uh??”
A flustered Hugo wondered if Lee Gun was really in front of him. He tried touching his friend and even pinched his cheek. “Uh? You are the real Gun? Uh? How?”
Hugo was sure he had received his Karmic debt after he had gotten rid of the Cluders. He was sure he had died! “Did I fall into hell with you— Kuh-huhk!!”
“I saved you, idiot.”
“What?!”
“I used the exoneration ticket on you.”
“?!”
Lee Gun had revived Hugo, who had disappeared after receiving his Karmic debt.
“Don’t worry about your Karmic debt. It doesn't exist. You can now live a normal life as Hugo Otis.”
Hugo froze. Of course, he knew what those words meant.
“What the hell are you doing!! Why do you think I died first!!!”
Hugo knew it. He had ceased to exist, so Lee Gun reviving him meant that his Karmic debt was…
“The exoneration tickets were supposed to be used on the two of you!! Only two were left!! I wanted you to live with Hailey… That is why I…!”
Hugo became angry, but Lee Gun just snickered. “I didn’t want to turn my nieces and nephew into orphans.”
“…!!”
“We weren’t able to do anything for your latest born. Her present was ruined. I can’t take her father from her in good conscience.”
That wasn’t all.
“Also, I realized you trusted in me and waited twenty years for me, but I never gave you anything as thanks.”
“!”
“That’s why I want you to live a happy life with your family. This is my present to you.”
Hugo was at a loss for words. Twenty years was nothing. He had already received too much from Lee Gun.
Feeling a sense of guilt, Hugo was unable to lift his head.
Lee Gun slapped his head. “Do you realize your data was almost all gone? I had a hard time reviving you. I had to use a variety of abilities, including the ability of Time. You should say thanks to me for the rest of your life.”
“… I….”
Lee Gun laughed as he looked at Hugo, who seemed tormented.
“I want to disappear in a cool manner after saying that, but I won’t. Don’t worry! I won’t die without a fight, and I have a reason for saving you.”
“…!!” Hugo jerked his head up.
Lee Gun let out a bitter laugh. “Originally, I planned on using them on Hailey and you. I planned on going away in a cool manner… However, Hailey changed my mind.”
When Hailey had chosen to die, Lee Gun had a realization. It was meaningless unless all of them lived.
“Hailey protected my life, so I’ll work to preserve it until the end.”
“…!”
“Also, I can go to the World of Emptiness if I take on Karmic debt as a sinner.”
“You’ll steal away Hailey from there?”
“Well, it was my father’s plan. He said he’ll go, but…”
“But?”
The curse wouldn’t be solved if they used that plan.
“That’s why I’m going to go there and kill Universe. I’ll solve the problem at the source.”
“Oh, I see. Such a solution exists— What? Whose head do you want to take???”
“The head of the World of Emptiness’s King. He’s the one who made that rule. I don’t need to steal her away. I don’t have to think too hard about what I have to do. I’ll just make it so that the rule never exists in the first place. Then there will be no problems. It’s simple to understand, right?”
It was way too simple…
Hugo looked like he wanted to cry. He clutched at his face. He had so many words to say, but he had no idea where to start.
‘I was wondering why he was so confident in using the exoneration ticket!’
Did he know what kind of opponent he was talking about?
“You are talking about the Universe!! The World of Emptiness is the homeworld of the Cluders! All kinds of monsters aside from the Cluders are there. Then there are prisoners stronger than the Primordial god….”
“You did call me the god of disaster.”
“!”
Lee Gun let out a sharp laugh. “Who cares about monsters?”
He’d just become a being that the monsters called a calamity. In some aspects, he had become the strongest being in existence.
Hugo pounded his chest when he realized what Lee Gun planned on doing. But even if he could cleanly wrap everything up by killing the King of the World of Emptiness and send Hailey back to earth…
“How do you plan on coming back? Even if you do kill the King of the World of Emptiness, how are you going to get out of there?”
That place was called the World of Emptiness for a reason.
“You may be able to go over there, but you will never be able to come back!”
Why else would Aslan say he would be able to steal away only Hailey?
“Let’s say you sent Hailey back here. Who is going to send you back?”
In other words, Lee Gun would be stuck in a very deep hole. If one person helped the other get out of the hole, what would happen to that person?
“Will you die a lonely death over there?”
This was why Hugo wanted the exoneration tickets to be used on Hailey and Lee Gun. He wanted them to live a happy life even if Lee Gun had to become a human.
However, Lee Gun merely laughed. He patted Hugo’s shoulder as if to say Hugo should know his worth. “You have a Faith of 1000%.”
“…!”
Lee Gun looked at Hugo with trust in his eyes. “The gods always bragged about it. Gods need subjects to believe and worship them. That way, the gods can be reborn again and again.”
“…!”
“I’m a god. If even one person remembers, I can be born again.”
Hugo looked dumbfounded. “Do you not remember yourself cussing everyone out for not being able to go through the process of inheritance?”
“That’s why I want you to remember my face, and I’m going to decapitate Universe.”
He’d make sure to write his record all over Universe’s face before coming back. Above all else, he had a reason to be so sure.
When the magic temples had called forth Oblivion to erase all memories about Lee Gun, everyone had forgotten about him except Hugo. Hugo eventually remembered him, and that was how Lee Gun was able to regain his power.
And when he had killed Time, he had used Hugo’s Faith to come back to the original timeline.
‘If I get rid of Universe, the World of Emptiness will disappear too. There is a high probability that I will die.’
With this method, he at least had some probability of coming back.
“I don’t want a 0% future where one of us has to die. I don’t care even if the probability is 1%. I want an outcome where everyone lives. That line of thinking was why I revived you.”
“Gun.”
“There is no way I’ll let one of the residents of my territory be taken away. Who do they think is protecting this place? My pride will get hurt even if one dies.”
If a possibility allowed everyone to come out of this alive, Lee Gun would take the gamble.
Lee Gun laughed. Although he spoke like this, he was half in doubt as well. In fact, Aslan had tried to stop him until the end.
- Alright. Let’s say you succeed, and you defeat the King of the World of Emptiness. You might even become stronger as a god. However, the problem is time.
- Time?
- How many enemies do you think are within the World of Emptiness? Why do you think it is called that? Your existence itself can be erased there.
At that moment, Hugo said, “Alright. I’ll wait until you come back. I won’t forget you. That’s why you can send Hailey ahead. You can acquire power there, then I want you to come back to us.”
Lee Gun let out a bitter laugh. “It might take me a while… It might take longer than the last time.”
“I’ve waited twenty years for you in the past. I don’t care if that time is multiplied by several folds. I’ll be sure to pay off my debt to you when you come back.”
Lee Gun nodded. “I guess it can’t be helped since you’re insisting. When I come back, I want you to pay that debt back to me. Ah. I’ll write it down so that I can remember.” Lee Gun wrote on his palm with a pen.
Hugo had no idea what Lee Gun was writing, but it was a lot of stuff. It made Hugo sweat.
Oblivious to this, Lee Gun laughed. “When I meet you next time, I’m going to ask a lot of things from you.”
Hugo was dumbfounded, but he just nodded. “Alright. I’m willing to make it all up to you if you come back.”
Lee Gun nodded again as he pushed Hugo away. At the same time, his Karmic debt rushed toward him.
As an enormous power encircled him, Lee Gun heard a voice.
[Do you want to choose death? Or do you choose to become a resident of the World of Emptiness?]
Lee Gun laughed. “I’m going to go take the head of your leader.”
As if Universe had sent it, when those words rang out, an enormous shadow encircled Lee Gun.
Lee Gun laughed toward a flustered Hugo.
[This is goodbye.]
Hugo extended his hand in panic, but he soon nodded. That was how Lee Gun disappeared. He disappeared alongside the small item that he had made for Hugo.
It was as if he had never existed at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - I'll wait even if a thousand years passes
chapters.content:
Chapter 446 - I'll wait even if a thousand years passes
The World of Emptiness was the opposite of the World under the Sun. There was no freedom, power, or honor here. It truly was a place where nothing existed. Even gods were afraid of this world of sinners.
In other words, all beings in this world were slaves of Universe. It didn’t matter if they were malignant spirits, gods, kings, or fairies; sinners from all dimensions had to serve the King of the World of Emptiness.
They lived their lives here as slaves, having no idea when their sentence would end. They lived as they pined for the world with the light.
[The world under the sun is great. We can do anything over there.]
[Who cares if this is a high-rank dimension that includes the World under the Sun? It’s still a prison.]
However, there was a being that even they showed interest in.
[I heard a new member joined us.]
[What is his deal?]
[I heard he has SSS-rank Karmic debt.]
The prisoners screamed.
[What? There is someone other than the forbidden child, who had Karmic debt of that magnitude??]
[I heard he’s a Great Spirit of the Pantheon.]
[Great Spirit?! Wow! It has been a while since we got someone nice like him.]
[If he’s from the Pantheon, he’s a big shot!]
The residents of the World of Emptiness were abuzz with the news about Lee Gun.
[It has been seven hundred years since we received a new member in this infamous place.]
Here, everyone was equal as slaves. It didn’t matter if one used to be the ruler of a dimension. Of course, the beings here were petty enough to divine themselves into ranks.
However, the gods of the Pantheon were in a league of their own! Pantheon was the place with the largest population of gods, and its gods were considered the strongest.
This was why everyone was interested in Lee Gun. It was the same when he was called for the assignment ceremony, which everyone had to go through.
[Prisoner No. 695,156, kneel in front of your king.]
[!]
Cuffed, Lee Gun was dragged here by the guards.
The subordinates of the king were surprised when they saw him.
[What the hell? He’s just a brat.]
[Don’t underestimate him. It didn’t take him long to get into trouble. He destroyed the transit camp.]
[Oh wow! We got a lively one. Well, it doesn’t matter. He’ll get crushed by the king eventually.]
[It’s to be expected. All the slaves exist to serve Universe.]
Finally, the King of the World of Emptiness saw Lee Gun. The king laughed.
[You are the culprit that wiped out the God race by yourself.]
Lee Gun smirked when he heard the voice. The red eyes looking at Universe curved as he smiled with his eyes. He had finally found the being he had been looking for.
* * *
In an entirely different timeline from the earth where Lee Gun had resided, Life and Death were carrying out their master’s orders.
They were monitoring and managing the gods that were born again as tools. These gods had gone through the process of inheritance and were reborn as tools, so they had lost all memories of Lee Gun. But this wasn’t the case with Life and Death.
Since a lot of time had passed, the Divine statuses had grown up in appearance. But they still missed Lee Gun. They continued to skip dimensions as they chased after the tools.
Protect the humans. Protect the person that’ll become their king.
Obedient to the will of their master, they looked forward to the day they would reunite. When they had heard Lee Gun had fallen into the World of Emptiness, they had cried once again.
[No! Even if Master went to the World of Emptiness, we’ll meet him again.]
[It’ll happen if we don’t forget Master. It’ll happen if we continue our mission.]
Several gods who had retained their memories, like the Fire Wheel Lord, had tried to fight them. Some had tried to get rid of Life, but Jun, the Divine status of Death, had subdued all of them. He became the leader of the tools, but that would happen in the far distant future.
“Ooh-ahhhk! A strange item appeared!”
“M-My king! A strange kid is floating in the sky!”
“What is he? Is he a god? Is he a messenger of the heavens?!”
[Yes. He must be the majesty candidate who will become our master.]
It had been roaming endlessly when it discovered the traces of Lee Gun. It caused sadness, but this was also a story that would happen in the far distant future.
* * *
[This is breaking news. A mysterious fire appeared yesterday afternoon…]
Hugo sighed as he watched the TV. When the monsters had disappeared, he had thought there would be fewer incidents, but it didn’t seem to be the case.
‘Well, it’s much more peaceful than the times when we were unable to travel between countries because of the monsters.’
Humans could now move freely through the skies, oceans, and lands. They no longer lived within domes. They weren’t like birds living in a birdcage. They had returned to a peaceful time akin to the days before the monsters and gods had invaded the earth.
‘Well, small monsters do appear from time to time.’
However, they were weak enough that spraying holy water could defeat them. But that wasn’t the problem right now.
[Dad? Dad? Are you listening to me right now?!]
“Ah. Yes. I'm sorry. I was watching the news for a moment.” Hugo was on a call with Sungjae. He fixed his grip on his phone. “You said you won’t be able to come home today? We decided everyone would gather here and have dinner together.”
[Uh! I’m sorry! I’m going to have to stop a fight between gangs of awakened beings!]
Hugo sighed. The real problem that had appeared recently was the children of the awakened beings.
This might have happened because the earth once believed in Lee Gun, who had been the god of Creation. The children of the original awakened beings were causing issues.
In simple words, the third-generation children, like his daughter Jisoo, were born with abilities despite not receiving a blessing.
In the past, humanity had a common enemy: monsters. So awakened beings had been united. However, this era of awakened beings liked fighting against each other from time to time. It was an attempt to show off their power.
‘It’s why all the Zodiac Saints have a headache dealing with this problem.’
In reality, the number and size of such groups were getting larger.
It was why Sungjae was being called to various locations.
[Dad! Since I’ve relayed this information, I’m going to end the call! Tell Mom that I’m sorry!]
Hugo furrowed his brows. Taking down gangs, my ass! “Chun Sungjae, you plan on drinking alcohol since it’s the end of the semester for you? This is an excuse to not come home, right?”
[Damn it! It isn’t like that! What happened that time was—]
“Whatever. I’m fine if I get to see Yooha’s face. I don’t care if you never come back home.”
[Whatever. I bet Noona won’t be able to make it there either.]
“What??? Why?!!” Hugo grabbed the phone in consternation.
Chun Sungjae laughed.
[Ah! Noona is really popular right now. Men have been following her around in front of the library.]
“Who is it? Who dares to chase after our Yooha? Where is she?”
Click!
When his son ruthlessly ended the call after having said what he wanted to say, Hugo screamed alien words.
“He became more impertinent after he went to college!!! He really isn’t taking his father seriously!?” Hugo didn’t need children who thought about only Lee Gun. He sat back on his desk.
‘Of course, I don’t have time to have dinner with everyone either.’
Hugo glared at the manuscript before him. The deadline was fast approaching.
Lee Jaewon, who had been watching all of this from the side, laughed. “Still, you achieved your dream of becoming an author thanks to Lee Gun-nim.”
“!”
Hugo was writing a memoir of Lee Gun. He pouted when he heard Lee Jaewon, who was there to help him. “You know this isn’t a novel. This is Lee Gun’s biography.”
“It might be non-fiction, but people might think it’s a novel.”
Hugo became silent.
‘Gun is gone.’
When Lee Gun had gone to the World of Emptiness, the presence called Lee Gun had disappeared from the world. All the items that he made also disappeared.
The wristwatch that was used as a badge for the Sagittarius temple had been created by Lee Gun as a talisman-type holy item. However, his engraved seal, a proof of his power, had disappeared from it.
In fact, Aslan and the Primordial god were also gone.
‘At least, Gun’s Constructs are still around.’
However, they had dispersed since their master was gone. Some had left to monitor the gods that had turned into tools. Some had left to look for Lee Gun. The rest either went looking for the invading monsters, or they had reincarnated as humans.
It was how the world continued to forget Lee Gun. Of course, this didn’t mean the existence of Lee Gun was completely gone.
‘His existence is fading away slowly.’
It was like how people from several hundred years ago continued to fade from people’s memories.
This was why Hugo was putting so much more effort into writing the biography. He kept pushing out content about Lee Gun into the world, trying to make sure people didn’t forget about Lee Gun until he came back.
As proof of this, he religiously showed a picture of Lee Gun to his youngest daughter. “Yes, Jisoo. This is Gun. You must never forget him.”
However, Jisoo pouted as if she was dissatisfied with the picture.
This made Hugo pleased; he had raised her well. He put a hand over his mouth. “As expected of my pretty Jisoo…! You like your dad better than Gun, right?”
“I’m not so sure. I think she doesn’t like the pictures where Hugo-nim can be seen clearer than Lee Gun-nim.”
Hugo glared at Lee Jaewon. “For your information, Jisoo likes her father more than Gun.”
“Do you really think that’s true…?”
“Whatever! What about Sagittarius? Does he remember Gun?” Hugo asked.
Most of the Constructs had gone their own way. And since Hugo was trying to write a memoir about Lee Gun, he needed accounts from a Zodiac. That would have a bigger impact.
The Archer disciples clicked their tongues as they brought the research material.
“We are taking care of Sagittarius-nim, but he has no memories of his past life.”
“When he went through the process of inheritance, his ability was transferred, but all his memories are gone now…”
Hugo grumbled, saying Sagittarius was always useless.
Only Lee Jaewon had an odd expression on his face. His eyes twinkled. It was said that the process of inheritance made one forget the memories of one’s past life, but…
‘Is it really true that he’s unable to remember Lee Gun-nim?’
Sagittarius didn’t look like someone who couldn’t remember Lee Gun. He looked more like someone who was pretending to not know Lee Gun. Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
“It has been three years since Lee Gun-nim disappeared. Last year, Yeonwoo-nim and Virgo went looking for Lee Gun-nim’s traces. Have you heard anything from them?”
“Nothing.”
When Hugo became sullen, everyone sighed. Their reactions were understandable.
“Hailey-nim was able to come back. So why has Lee Gun-nim not returned yet?”
Yes, Hailey had already returned to the earth around three years ago. She had even reincarnated, and when Hugo had gone looking for her, he had been surprised.
The reason for his surprise was the parents who were raising Hailey. At a glance, they looked like humans, but Hugo could clearly see it.
‘They are Flame and the god named Shiva…!’
They were Hailey’s original parents: the old Great Spirit of Mahabharata, Shiva, and the first-generation monarch Flame.
He had no idea how Shiva had died, but both of them had been accused of tarnishing the name of the Great Spirits. They had bought the enmity of the gods.
Anyway, they had ceased to exist, and they weren’t supposed to be able to come back. It should have been impossible, yet they had returned as humans. They also had a young Hailey with them!
This was why everyone had thought the same thing.
- It is Lee Gun-nim!
Lee Gun must have done something within the World of Emptiness.
Anyway, Hailey was growing at a ridiculous speed, and her parents had returned with her. This was why everyone had high hopes.
‘Lee Gun-nim will be back soon!’
However, that hadn’t been the case. They had received no news of Lee Gun even after three years.
Lee Jaewon sighed.
‘Since there was the future prophesied by Hugo-nim, we expected this to be a rocky road, but…’
Hugo had received two prophecies back then. One was a future where they were all dead. The other was where Lee Gun held a woman in her arms with sadness.
‘I’m pretty sure it was Hailey-nim.’
This was why Lee Jaewon had sighed when he had heard Lee Gun had gone to the World of Emptiness. He had gone there to save the woman he loved.
Lee Jaewon understood his feelings, but… “You should have stopped him. Why did you let Lee Gun-nim go there?”
Only Hugo had been within the Cradle. Had the rest of them been there, they would have done everything to stop Lee Gun. They would have insisted Lee Gun find a different solution.
“He could have used Karmic debt transfer to somehow….”
“Gun said he didn’t want to use that.”
“!”
That wasn’t all. In reality, Hugo had tried to stop him. He was Lee Gun’s friend. Lee Gun was choosing a certain death by jumping into the ocean. Of course, Hugo couldn’t just stand by.
- Gun, do you really have to go? Hailey is important, but you are more…
- If it were you, I would have gone too.
- !
In the end, those words had put Hugo into submission.
‘Shit! Damn Creators!’
It was his fault for falling for that tribe.
Anyway, it didn't matter who it was. Lee Gun would have gone there for either one of them. And since Hugo knew Lee Gun’s resolve, he had sent Lee Gun on his way.
The disciples had been sighing when they heard those words. They were sad since his absence left too big of a hole.
Hugo then asked, “Why are you guys here? Do you have something to report?”
The disciples who had entered the room scratched their cheeks with awkward expressions.
“Now that you mention it….”
When Hugo heard their story, he screamed for them to leave the office.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - I'll wait even if a thousand years passes...?
chapters.content:
Chapter 447 - I'll wait even if a thousand years passes...?
Hugo screamed, “What?! That damn thing fell again?!”
“...Yes…! Lee Gun-nim’s house was destroyed once again.”
“Damn it! That damn money sink!”
They referred to it as Lee Gun’s house, but it was none other than the old building of the Sagittarius temple, the place that Lee Gun had invaded and turned into his living room.
They were referring to Lee Gun’s Building, which Lee Gun had remodeled using his power.
As soon as he had gone away, the building had turned dangerous.
‘Well, it started breaking down after Gun’s power went away.’
In the end, it was determined humans couldn’t live within this building. So Hugo and the Archer disciples had to acquire a new house and office.
However, Hugo didn’t want to bulldoze the building; he didn’t want to erase the trace of his friend. Therefore, every time the building was destroyed, he asked the Capricorn temple to restore it to normal!
“It fell again?!”
“Yes…! It seems only Lee Gun-nim’s power can fix it for real.”
Hugo grabbed the back of his neck. It meant nothing would be solved until Lee Gun returned with his items and memories.
“Damn it! It can't be helped. Let’s fix it again.”
“A-Are you sure about that? This is the seventeenth time. The funds needed to fix it just once are quite high…”
Hugo groaned as he pinched the bridge of his nose. Of course, he had asked for funding from the other Zodiac Saints to restore the building. But was it because the memories of Lee Gun had faded away?
[Kevin: Lee Gun? 그 Who the hell is thatㅋ? I don’t know who that isㅋ? ㅋ?]
[Stevens: Lee Gun? You mean that goddess?]
[Sophie: Who is that???]
They seemed to be unable to remember(?) Lee Gun. As for Heiji…
[You destroyed it again?!!]
Heiji had helped him a lot, but Hugo had gotten into a fight with her not too long ago. She still seemed miffed, so he was unable to reach her.
“I also have a lot of expenditures. Problems keep cropping up…”
When Hugo groaned, his disciples laughed awkwardly.
“P-Please do not worry too much about it! Like Hugo-nim, we are working hard on leaving behind the records of Lee Gun-nim. The disciples of the Serpent Bearer temple are doing the same thing. Lee Gun-nim will be back in no time…!”
“That’s right. We just have to hold out until Lee Gun-nim comes back…”
“No.”
“!”
“At the very least, we won’t be able to see Lee Gun within this century.”
“…!”
“My only wish is for Gun to be able to retire and live while doing nothing.”
Lee Jaewon was unable to say anything.
The disciples knew what going to the World of Emptiness meant.
While others might be unaware, Hugo already had a prediction that he thought would come true.
‘Even if he’s able to come back, it'd take at least a couple hundred years. No, it might take a couple thousand years.’
This was why some said, “Lee Gun is already dead,” “His memories would disappear faster than you can preserve them,” and “Give up.”
What was the point of Hugo working hard if everyone forgot about Lee Gun? Still, Hugo didn’t plan on giving up. He promised to wait until the end.
With the power of Eternal Change, Hugo could live for hundreds, if not thousands, of years. This was why it didn’t matter if everyone forgot him. It didn’t matter if everyone who remembered Lee Gun died.
‘I just have to never forget him.’
The people of this generation would no longer be able to see Lee Gun, but Hugo would wait for Lee Gun. He would wait even if he had to spend thousands or tens of thousands of years. That was his resolve.
“This time, I’ll make sure you’ll be able to live an idle life. It’ll be as you wanted.”
“What? Hugo-nim? What did you just say…”
“Ah. It’s nothing. Let’s go see it. We have to see how damaged the building is to get an estimate on the cost of fixing it.”
“Yes!”
Hugo was about to follow his disciples outside when…
Boom!!!
An incredibly loud noise rang out. Along with the loud noise, a large earthquake erupted.
Boom!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
It was such a powerful earthquake that they were barely able to stay upright. That wasn’t all.
Puhng-pung-puhng!
“Kyahhhk!!”
The light bulbs popped, and cracks started to appear on buildings. The city had instantly turned into a scene of mayhem.
Everyone wondered what was going on when a hair-raising sound rang throughout the entire city.
Ehhhhhhng!
The residents of the city froze. It was to be expected.
“H...Hugo-nim!! This sound is…!”
“Red Zone alert?!”
It was an evacuation order: a sound that rang out when monsters appeared within the city. And since this was a Red Zone alert, a monster capable of wiping out at least half the country must have shown up. It was the sound of death!
The sound had never rung out after peace had returned to the earth! And it would ring out for only one reason.
“I…It must be a monster!”
There was no mistaking it. When Lee Gun’s power had disappeared, the power protecting the earth had weakened too.
Beings like the Cluders invading the earth again wouldn’t be odd.
‘Cluders naturally come into existence within the World of Emptiness.’
Koo-goo-goohng!!
A chaotic aura surged up from the ground, making everyone gulp.
“Zodiac Saint-nim! As expected, that power is…!”
“Damn it! It is the enemies!”
A new round of invasion was starting. At that moment, an enormous shadow appeared as if it was trying to cover up the earth.
The disciples became frightened when they looked up at the sky.
“M…Meteor?!”
Infused with killing intent, an attack was falling toward the earth. Then there was the shadow of an unknown monster in the sky!
At that moment, a meteor fell toward the earth.
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhhk!!!”
Then a pillar of fire surged into the sky.
Several years had passed since they had been confronted by a calamity. But the disciples naturally gathered when it was time for war.
“Get ready for battle!!!”
“Monsters have appeared once again!”
All the countries around the world received an emergency alert. There was no mistaking it. It was similar to the first invasion when the general-rank monsters and the monarchs had appeared on the earth.
The murderous intent they were feeling right now was comparable to that present back then!
Hugo checked his badge, which used to contain Lee Gun’s power, just in case. He was hopeful that Lee Gun would appear in this situation. However, that didn't happen.
Lee Gun’s power didn’t reappear.
“Damn it!”
Hugo and Lee Jaewon rushed to their warehouse for weapons and searched for their bows.
“Damn it! Since we had no reason to fight monsters, the bows for fighting monsters were put away…!”
Where did he put them away? They were desperately trying to search through the warehouse for weapons when…
Sssk!
As if they knew Hugo was looking for this bow, someone threw the black bow toward Hugo.
After taking up the bow, Hugo immediately said, “You were there. Thank you, Jaewon…”
However, he was surprised to see who it was. It had happened in a flash, but the one to throw the bow and disappear was none other than a slime!
‘Aslan?’
It was the slime, which had disappeared without a trace when Lee Gun had ceased to exist.
Hugo wondered if he had been mistaken when…
Flash!!!
A familiar green light surged upward from the warehouse. Accompanying the light, something appeared in the empty air.
Everyone was shocked by the sight.
“H…Hugo-nim!”
The objects that had suddenly appeared in the air were Lee Gun’s items! They had been lost once Lee Gun disappeared! All the items that Lee Gun had manufactured had returned!
However, something more surprising happened at that moment.
Brrr.
“Hugo-nim. Phone!! Your phone…!!”
Hugo’s heart sank when he felt the vibrating phone. It was an unregistered number. Hugo had experienced something similar before.
In the end, Hugo used his shaking hands to answer the phone.
“Hello?”
[Husband!!!]
Taken aback by the voice, Hugo looked at his phone’s screen. “J-Jiwoo? Why are you calling from this number?”
[When my phone broke, Jisoo brought it to me! That’s not important right now!! Something big happened!! A child…!]
Hugo froze when he heard Jiwoo’s desperate voice. “What! Did Jisoo get into trouble again?! Did she fly over there and cause trouble?!!”
[No! I have a child here!!!]
Silence ensued for a second, and Hugo turned pale for an entirely different reason. “You are pregnant?!!”
[No! A child appeared in front of our house!]
Hugo’s expression was a sight to behold. “…???”
A child had appeared in front of his house? What did she mean by that?
In the end, Hugo and his disciples quickly headed toward Hugo’s house.
And when the owner arrived at his house, he screamed. A single-family home, which had been standing by itself on a large plot of land, had been destroyed.
“Ahhhk!!! I still have five years left to pay off the loan!!!”
Everyone was abuzz as they looked at the scene before them. It seemed the house had been destroyed by the meteor that had fallen from the sky.
Hugo and the disciples rushed toward Chun Jiwoo when they located her.
“Darling! Are you ok?!”
“Ah. yes. I came back from buying groceries, and it was already like this…”
Thankfully, no one was hurt. Hugo’s next-door neighbors seemed fine too.
Still, Chun Jiwoo looked way too calm for this situation.
“We have a child!!”
“A child??!”
“Yes. Over there!”
Yes, the sound of a baby crying came from the deep crater that had formed in the garden. The disciples became guarded when they saw the child.
“It seems the monster alert system is pointing at that baby!”
“He must have fallen with the meteor…”
“Is he a human-type Cluder?!”
In contrast to the others’ reactions, Hugo’s expression changed when he heard the cries of the newborn baby.
‘Could it be…!!’
It couldn’t be.
‘I was sure it was the murderous intent of a monster.’
An alert notifying a calamity had been sent out, so the power had to be enormous! However, the urgent alarm had already stopped.
The item that he had thought was a meteor falling from the sky had broken up and scattered across his garden. It appeared to be a mysterious-looking skin that had sloughed off.
Seeing this, Hugo felt a surge of emotion.
‘No way! There is no way he defeated all his enemies in the World of Emptiness in just three years…!’
He was the one who had said it would take more than twenty years!
The others were abuzz as they looked at the baby. This baby possessed enormous power. Just the thought of approaching him made them feel fear.
“I…Is he a monster?”
“I’m sure of it. He’s a monarch… Primordial god… No, he’s a strange monster that far outstrips them! He isn’t human!”
One person among them reacted differently. Hugo looked like he was crying and laughing at the same time. He then stepped forward, shocking everyone.
“Hugo-nim?! No! It’s too dangerous! You shouldn’t approach him!”
Hugo merely laughed as he approached the child. He suddenly remembered something. They were the words he had heard along with Lee Gun’s laughter for the last time.
- When I meet you next time, I’m going to ask a lot of things from you.
Hugo touched the words on the baby’s small hand.
All your wealth belongs to me.
VAT and childcare costs are excluded.
“When you said you’ll ask a lot from me, this is what you meant?”
Crazy bastard!
At that moment…
“Zodiac Saint-nim! Are you ok?”
“Dad!!!”
“Hugo!”
Various people came running to Hugo when they heard Hugo’s house had been attacked.
Heiji, the Chun siblings, and all the other Zodiac Saints had gathered here, worried for him.
“What the hell happened to your house?”
“What is up with that kid?!!”
“Is that a monster?! What’s up with the sudden calamity?”
“This kid is the culprit!”
The power emanating from the child was the power of a monster that they had never sensed before.
“Get out of the way! I’ll get rid of him right now!”
Hugo stopped them as he held the baby’s hand. “It’s fine. You don’t need to do that.”
He laughed as he looked at the child, who was peacefully sleeping after destroying someone else’s house.
“It really is the return of the disaster-class hero.”
The damn hero had returned.
<Fin>

Author’s Note:
Hello. This is SAN.G.
First, I want to thank the readers for accompanying me on a long journey in telling the story of “The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero.”
Also, I would like to give credit to the team leader and producer for keeping me on track from Book 1 of “The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero.” I was able to publish the series on time. I would like to take the opportunity to thank them.
Book 1 included the Revenge arc, where Gun awakened as a god and grew as a Zodiac. Book 2 included the Divine world arc, where the relics of the “Tomb Raider King” were created.
While these are two different stories, I thought this information might act as a spoiler, so I wasn’t able to tell the readers about it.
As you have probably guessed, “The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero” was written with it being the prequel to my previous work “Tomb Raider King.” It was a story written with the birth of the relics in mind.
This is why the gods within “The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero” are the same as the ones within “Tomb Raider King.” (For example, the Egyptian gods and the imprisoned gods are the same. The Cluders within “The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero” become the Cthulhu relics within the “Tomb Raider King.”)
Moreover, the story of Life and Death, which couldn’t be handled within “The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero” is resolved in the latter part of “Tomb Raider King.”
Spoilers for Tomb Raider King
(In truth, these parts fall between the two novels, so I had no idea where I should unwind those stories. It was regrettable that these topics fell into a gray area….)
In my previous novel, I dealt with tradition and belief. In this novel, I tried to use faith as the groundwork. That is why the causes behind the birth of a god and the birth of a relic share similar mechanisms.

While “The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero” ends on chapter 447, the stories that couldn’t be told within the main story and the behind-the-scenes stories will be written as short supplemental stories.
I will probably create short stories from topics that were briefly discussed in the main story. I will also freely write occasional stories about the heroines. Please think of them as stories separate from the main story, and please enjoy it in a light-hearted manner!
If you have a scene that you want to see aside from that, please leave a comment. You can read it when it is included in the supplemental stories.
I am still lacking in many ways as an author as I write my stories, but I want to thank you for staying with me until the end.
I will upload the <Epilogue/Supplementary Stories> with other goodies. The dates will be updated on further notice.
Thank you very much!

chapters.title: Chapter 448: Book 1, Epilogue 1 - Let me be your student (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 1 - Let me be your student (1)
“This is crazy!”
March 2003.
People around the world were in a state of shock. The reason was the public statement put out by the US.
[As of today, we acknowledge the existence of the unknown civilization. According to the Declaration of Boston, the US cannot claim independence and sovereignty within the territory of the US. We promise not to exercise any other of our rights.]
In reality, it was a declaration of surrender, and this declaration had stunned humanity.
“Hey, did you hear? The government will send ten thousand civilians to them as food.”
“What? Is that really true?”
“Damn it! I heard our armed forces have no chance of winning against them…”
“Shit. This is the end!”
Not even three months had passed since the unknown civilization had appeared. Yet, their attacks had made the powerful nations of the earth raise their white flags. People were ruthlessly taken as food. Humanity had no choice but to despair.
However, something changed after the fourth month.
[Did you see it? The superhuman of the north, Stevens, killed the monsters!]
[The Saintess from the west, Sophie, is healing the wounded!]
[The witch of the east, Haiji, is holding off the monsters!]
“Ohhhhhhhh!!”
Inside the Korean International exhibition hall, a variety of goods related to survival were on display, and the exhibition hall was filled with cheers.
“I should have expected this from the superhuman of the north!!”
“There is no way they are human!”
“Justice always prevails!”
People yelled in delight when they saw the news on the electronic display. Of course, everyone had different reasons for coming to the expo, but at that moment, they were united as one.
This was also true for the two men who were playing a fighting game against each other at a game booth.
“Hey, Junwoo. Did you just see that?!”
“Wow! Boss! Did you see that? When you make your next game, you should model it after them!”
The two young men playing against each other were the twenty-year-old Lee Gun and Hugo Otis. They weren’t awakened beings yet, and they still didn’t know each other at this stage.
The two of them forgot that they were playing a game as they started cheering.
“They are the best! We won again!”
“Hey. The east has a witch, and the west has a saintess! And the north has a superhuman! I wonder who’ll represent the south?!”
“No way! I doubt we’ll get anyone from the south.”
The three people on the news were currently the most famous people on the earth
The eyes of the two young men twinkled as they watched the display.
“As expected, the superhuman of the north, Stevens, is awesome!”
“Indeed, the witch of the east is amazing!”
The two, who had been playing against each other, turned to look at each other. They furrowed their brows when they saw each other’s faces.
At this point, Hugo was still clumsy when it came to speaking Korean, but he could fully understand what others said.
“Superhuman of the north?”
“Witch of the east…?”
In the end, the two of them looked at each other with dumbfounded faces. Then, they both snorted.
The first one to open his mouth was Hugo. “If you have sense, you should be cheering for the superhuman of the north!”
“Hmm! How can you say that musclebrain is great?” replied Lee Gun.
“It’s obvious. You probably got bewitched by how the witch dresses.”
Hugo and Lee Gun glared at each other. The two of them were angry and about to argue when…
“Hyung… You are about to move past that line.” The young teen standing next to Lee Gun pointed at the monitor. He was the sixteen-year-old Ji Junwoo.
Hearing his younger brother’s words, Lee Gun screamed as he moved his joystick. He immediately re-centered the character that was trying to go out of bounds and moved it further into the ring.
After saving his character, he laughed as he looked at Hugo. “You have a bad eye when it comes to taste. I can see why you are bad at playing games.”
Hugo got angry; he and the guy in front of him had played twenty matches, and Hugo had lost all of them. He angrily asked, “What did you just say?”
“I’m asking why you are so bad at this game when you like that macho guy? You aren’t supposed to use your character like that.”
Hugo was about to say something in response, but…
“Really? Hyung, I thought you really liked the superhuman of the north. Why are you acting like this?”
Junwoo’s innocent words made Lee Gun’s face turn red. He retorted, “Hey! I don’t like him!”
“What? You said Stevens is the best. You started a scrapbook of his new articles, and you record all his appearances. You said the same thing yesterday.”
“I…I didn’t do that!! I recorded it because you liked him!”
“Uh. I don’t like him at all?”
“What? Who do you like the best?”
“You. I like you the best, Hyung.”
Faced with his younger brother’s laughter, Lee Gun decided to drop the subject. He took up his joystick once again.
Junwoo had wanted to come to this game booth, but somehow, Lee Gun had started winning. He was on a seventy-game win streak.
“Anyway, the witch of the east is the best! Her costume is the best.”
Hugo put down his joystick as if Lee Gun wasn’t worth dealing with.
“Anyway, the game was really fun. I’ll be sure to buy it when it is released, boss.”
Lee Gun playfully whispered to his younger brother, “See, Junwoo? He is running away because he isn’t confident that he could win.”
In the end, an angry Hugo rushed toward Gun.
Beep!
“Ahhhk!!”
He pressed the button that turned off the power to Lee Gun’s station.
Lee Gun’s game screen instantly reset, and he shed tears of blood. “Ahhk! That was my best record! I didn’t even get to save my name!”
Hugo didn’t care. He snorted as he turned around.
From a distance, he could hear Lee Gun saying, “That foreigner is acting like a bully” and other angry ramblings. However, Hugo ignored them.
He didn’t even bother remembering Lee Gun’s face since it wasn’t as if they would ever meet again. Instead, he answered a call.
“Ah, Noona. What’s going on? Shouldn’t you be busy at this time of day?”
It was a call from New Zealand.
Hugo had come to a Korean university as he wanted to help out his grandmother in Korea. However, he got an ominous feeling when he received the sudden call.
- Hugh. Have you tried contacting Grandpa?
“Yes. I talked with him yesterday. Why? Grandpa is in Australia.”
- Listen to me, Hugh. Grandpa’s company was attacked!
“What?! Grandpa’s company?”
- I’m not sure if the monsters did it or if it was something else… However, the loss of life and property was heavy. It was enough to endanger the company's existence.
“…!”
Hugo was shocked. It was to be expected since his grandfather’s company wasn’t small at all.
The company was large enough that people in Australia knew its name.
Hugo had heard that the company had poured a lot of money into its defense and made thorough preparations. A company of that magnitude was on an uncertain footing right now.
‘I thought monsters haven’t appeared in Australia yet.’
This was why Hugo had planned on taking his Korean grandmother there. It was the reason he had come here.
- Anyway, that isn’t important right now, Hugh. I can’t get in touch with Grandpa.
“…!”
- We want to hurry up and go check up on him, but there are too many patients here. I can’t go outside.
“Patients are coming in right now?”
- Yes. We just had a terrorist attack.
“…!”
Hugo’s grandfather was a businessman, while his parents and his older sister were doctors at a university hospital.
Hugo was the youngest son of a family of doctors. His family was also wealthy.
‘Of course, I don’t have any interest in following in their footsteps.’
However, if it weren’t for the monsters, Hugo probably would have followed the path of his parents and siblings.
- Hugh? Are you listening to me?
“Alright. I’ll head over there.”
- Wait a moment, Hugh!!
Hugo immediately ended the call and headed toward the airport.
‘The world has changed because of the monsters.’
Hugo dreamed of becoming an author, so he grabbed his face at this unbelievable situation. Anyway, he just wished nothing bad had happened to his grandfather, but his hopes seemed to have been in vain.
“What? What did you just say?”
“I said there were no survivors.”
He had rushed to his grandfather’s company, but he fell into despair when he reached it. He found out that the person he couldn’t contact would never return.
The more shocking part was that his grandfather’s corpse couldn’t be located.
“M-My god! What is that!!!”
“The capital is gone.”
Yes, parts of Canberra were nowhere to be seen. Buildings and people were missing. And an enormous hole lay where they used to be. It was as if someone had dug out the capital with a shovel. Half of the capital city was gone.
The taxi driver shook from fear as he held onto the steering wheel. The road in front of him was gone.
“W-What the hell? It wasn’t like this a minute ago…!!”
In the end, people screamed as they exited their cars. They started running away as fast as they could. But…
Koo-goo-goong!
“Ahhhhhk!!!”
The people screamed.
Hugo also couldn’t keep himself upright when the sudden earthquake hit them.
“What is going on…!”
“Shit! Stop blocking the road. Get out of the way!!!” A man was about to push aside Hugo.
Poo-hahk!!!
“…!!”
However, Hugo’s face turned pale when blood splashed on him from the side. The man who had been about to push him had been bisected. That wasn’t all.
Kwahng! Kwahng!
“Ahhhhk!!!”
People screamed as large orbs fell from the sky.
The black orbs encased the humans and turned them into clumps of meat.
Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jeek!
“Ahhhk! Help!!”
Hugo sank to the ground.
“Ah… Ah….”
A monster was spitting out those orbs from the sky.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!]
Hugo was sure of it. This monster had made the capital city like this.
‘The only ones who can defeat it are the three superhumans…!’
Hugo wanted to call the police to relay this information to them when he heard a voice.
“Hugh!”
“!!!”
Hugo was surprised by the familiar voice.
“Noona!”
It was his older sister, who was riding along with their parents.
“Hugh! Hurry up and get in!”
Hugo trembled as he clumsily got to his feet. “How… How did you know to come here—”
Suddenly, Hugo vomited blood.
“Kuh-huhk…!”
A monster hiding under the surface had pierced through his stomach.
Hugo’s older sister and parents got out of the car and ran toward him.
“Hugh!!”
Hugo screamed at them, “No! Hurry up and get out of here!”
“!”
As soon as he spoke, a black orb fell from the sky. The sphere was falling on top of his family! Hugo couldn’t watch what happened next.
Kwah-jeek!
It was because a black sphere had fallen on top of his head too.
In the end, the bloodied Hugo shed tears.
‘I’m also going to die.’
At that moment…
[Oh. It seems you have the best face in this city.]
“…?”
[Alright. I choose you.]
“…???”
Hugo's crappy life as a slave started at that instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Book 1, Epilogue 2 - Let me be your student (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 2 - Let me be your student (2)
[Alright. I choose you.]
That day, twenty-five years ago, Hugo had never dreamed he would become the servant of a narcissist.
Unaware of this, Hugo awakened to his power for the first time.
“Koo-oohk…!”
His eyes widened as he saw the black sphere around him destroyed.
‘The monster’s attack is…gone?’
However, he didn’t even have time to be surprised.
[Idiot servant. Look behind you.]
“!”
Hugo was shocked to suddenly hear a voice. When he turned his head, a scream escaped his lips.
“Ahhk!! Get out of the way!!”
“Ahhhk!!”
Screech!!
A taxi was moving toward him at an extremely high speed. The eyes of the taxi driver were rolling back with fear. He had planned on driving past Hugo, who sat on the road.
“Get out of the way, idiot!!”
The people who had been running away screamed in fear.
“Ahhk! Look out!”
Hugo didn’t even have time to dodge as the taxi crashed into him.
Kwahng!!!
“Kyahhhk!!”
Everyone clenched their eyes shut when they heard the incredibly loud sound.
“Ahhhhk!!”
When they reopened their eyes, they almost fainted for an entirely different reason.
Hugo was unscathed. In fact, the car had been crushed instead!
“K…Kuh-huhk…??!!”
“Kyahhhk!! What the hell is he!!”
The one most shocked by this was Hugo himself.
‘Why was the car sent flying to the side when it rammed into me?!’
The car had slammed into him at 120 kilometers an hour at the very least! However, he was merely bleeding a little from a contusion?!
At that moment…
[Look above, my lowly servant.]
‘L…Lowly?’
Dumbfounded, Hugo looked at the sky. Soon, he had no choice but to grit his teeth.
Kwah-jeek!!
“Koo-oohk…!!!”
An enormous monster tried to stomp him into a pancake.
[Kee-ehhhhhk!]
“Ooohk…!”
Hugo reflexively blocked the monster’s feet by extending his arms. He felt like dying as he felt the strain.
‘Damn it! This is on a different level than being hit by the car…!’
It felt as if he were holding up the weight of a building!
‘I’ll be crushed at this rate…!’
Hugo clenched his eyes shut, but…
[Idiot servant. What are you doing?]
“????”
He heard the bizarre voice once again, and the voice started saying words that sounded like nonsense.
[Hurry up and worship me. Then a lowly being like you will be able to use my great power.]
Worship? What kind of nonsense was that?
[I am Sagittarius. Hurry up and worship me.]
“Damn it!!” Hugo got worked up when he realized he was going to be crushed to death. “Oh great Sagittarius-nim! Huzzah, huzzah, huzzah!!! I love you! I’ll do whatever you want!”
The next instant, something surprising happened.
Ssssss…!!!
“!!”
It sounded as if meat was being cooked on a metal plate.
Hugo’s hands, which were staving off the monster, roiled as if they were lava. Then a scream rang out.
[Kee-ehhhhhk!!!]
The monster that was stepping on Hugo suffered a severe burn wound on its foot. It fell backward.
Koohng!
Hugo looked at his hands, confused. Surprisingly, his hand was red as if he were holding bright red lava. The light was blazing. It was like looking into the core of the sun.
This made the nearby humans panic.
“Huh…!! T…That person isn’t human!”
“I…Is he a monster too?”
However, they soon started to cheer when they realized they had been saved.
“That person saved us!!”
“What is he?!”
Hugo ground his teeth.
‘Shit! I have no idea what is going on, but…’
Hugo charged toward the monster. After he had awakened, most attacks could inflict only superficial wounds on Hugo. His strength, senses, and reflexes had become much better than that of normal humans.
Of course, his movement and experience were that of a normal civilian, but it didn’t matter.
“Koo-oohk!”
When he ran, his form was a sight to behold; he looked clumsy like a high schooler doing a physical fitness test.
This was why all the attacks and the building debris that flew toward him successfully hit him. “Ooh-oohk…! It hurts like hell!”
However, it didn’t matter since his body had reached superhuman status.
Bbah-gahk!!!
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!!!]
Hugo put all his strength into his fist as he swung. A powerful flame engulfed his fist and detonated against the monster.
Kwahng!!!
Of course, he experienced side effects. “Ahhhk!! My arm!”
Was it because he wasn’t properly trained? Hugo moaned as he clutched his broken shoulder.
Someone snorted when he saw Hugo’s actions.
[Where the hell did you see such a thing? Why would you do something so dumb?]
“What did you say, you bastard? Are you badmouthing the superhuman of the south!! He’s a man’s man!”
Well, it didn’t matter right now.
“Noona! Father! Mother!”
Hugo desperately ran toward his family.
* * *
The hospital was full of people. Normally, it was filled with patients’ cries and moans, but today was different.
“We are from ABC!”
“We are from the Herald Sun!”
The hospital was filled with reporters, all of them here for Hugo.
“Another superhuman has appeared?”
“Could it be that he brought along the monster?”
“That person is the devil!”
People treated Hugo as if he were the devil, and he had almost been dragged away to prison.
However, everything was cleared in one go when a particular person appeared in front of them.
“He is a superhuman like us.”
“!”
At that moment, Hugo had been in front of the surgery room, close to being dragged away by the police.
He turned his head in surprise. His and his sister’s mouth fell open when they saw who it was. “T-the Saintess of the West!”
“Didn’t she say her name was S-Sophie Mardi? She is incredibly famous right now…!”
Yes, the one before them right now was the twenty-year-old Sophie Mardi, who would become the Zodiac Saint of the Aquarius temple in the future.
“I’ll go heal your parents.”
“!”
Sophie was interested in Hugo.
‘That person was chosen by Sagittarius. He’s the superhuman of the south.’
However, Sophie’s eyes turned round when Hugo ran toward her.
‘He is incredibly handsome…!’
The man was a bit dirty right now, but Sophie felt her heart pound at the sight of his face.
Of course, Hugo had no way of knowing this. He laughed as he held Sophie’s hand. “Thank you very much for saving my parents!”
Sophie’s heart felt like it was about to explode. She felt like dying. “W-Wait a moment! It’s too early to become complacent! The wound inflicted by the monster is severe! It…It was also contaminated, so it’s a matter of time before the wound worsens!”
“No! Saintess-nim! I’m extremely grateful for what you have already done!”
“…!!!”
In truth, Hugo’s parents would die not too long after, but at that moment, Hugo was thankful to Sophie.
It made Sophie anxious.
‘I’m only here because of my Zodiac…!’
It was for no other reason.
When she had heard this, she had come to treat the victims as well as greet her comrade. Yet…!
‘My god! I never expected him to be such a magnificent person…!’
Sophie fiddled with her fingers before she shyly brushed a strand of hair behind her ear. “I…If you don’t mind, would you like to have some tea with me…”
However, Sophie scrunched up her face when she turned.
“Hee hee. If you will have me, I would love to…”
“?!”
Yes, the one shyly laughing in front of Sophie right now wasn’t Hugo. It was a journalist who had come to collect news. Sophie screamed.
Around that time…
“What did you just say?” Hugo had walked up to the hospital’s roof following the mysterious voice, and he was surprised. He had been told eight more superhumans will show up. That in itself was surprising, but…
“I’m your servant?? I want to become an author! I’m shocked that I was able to defeat the monster! Now you suddenly want me to work for a god…!”
The voice didn’t seem to care about Hugo’s opinion.
[You are the servant that I personally picked. That’s why you have to work as an apostle for me.]
So why was he a servant?
‘Also, he placed a contract on me without consulting me.’
Well, it wasn’t all bad.
‘A god specifically chose me.’
He had been chosen among countless people. Hugo made a fist. “I’ll protect anyone near me no matter what happens. It seems you chose me because you saw my potential. I promise to work very hard!”
[Potential? What the hell are you talking about?]
“What? I thought the Zodiacs were looking for representatives who would allow the Zodiacs to use their power through them? In other words, you chose me because I have enough potential to handle such power…”
[What nonsense are you spouting? I chose you only because of your face.]
“What?”
[You will be the human who’ll represent my temple. You are a figurehead, and such a person needs to be a looker. It’ll allow me to grow the number of my disciples. Also, you will be my apostle, whom I’ll be seeing every day. The idea of someone too ugly is…]
What the hell did he just say?!!
“What a crazy god…!!!”
Hugo had been wondering why he had been chosen. It was for a trivial reason!
[Whatever. Go get some alcohol. Prepare a feast for me.]
“Hmph. Why would I set up such a thing for you?”
[I lent you your abilities. You have to pay the price, and you have to continue paying the price if you want to use more of my power.]
“Ah. It’s fine. I don’t need it! Find someone else— Koohk!”
A stigmata appeared on Hugo’s shoulder before he could speak any further. It was Sagittarius’s stigmata!
“…!”
However, it was incomplete. It was split into five sections, and only one was letting out a light. In other words, among the five levels, he was on the first.
Poo-doo-doohk!
At that moment, a crow appeared alongside the flames and called forth a bow.
[The Sagittarius temple is a temple that uses flame and the bow as weapons! I will give you your basic weapon!]
“Excuse me… I have no plans on doing this!”
[Whatever. Hurry up and prepare a feast for me! Also, I want you to create a song for your exalted master! I want food that is considered a delicacy in this world! I want you to prepare rings and gems befitting your master!]
Hugo became angry as soon as he received the bow. “W…Wait a moment. This is a child’s toy!” It was an arrow with a suction disk at the tip.
[You are a lowly servant who can’t even use your power! This bow goes well with you! If you want to receive something better, work harder!]
“There is no way I’ll do this!!”
[If you don’t do this, I’ll make sure you live the rest of your life as a baldie!]
“Damn it!!”
This was how Hugo became Sagittarius’s apostle… No, he was forced to become a slave.
Anyway, it would be one year after this incident when he would meet Lee Gun again.
By then, all twelve superhumans had appeared, and his stigmata had reached stage 4.
Also, half a year had passed since the thirteenth awakened being, who shouldn’t exist, had made his appearance.
“Shit…! Is this my limit…!” Hugo had been captured by a monster, and he was dying.
‘Damn it! Stevens and Ivan gave up on clearing this place despite being the highest ranked among us….’
The location was Saudi Arabia, which had been sealed because of the monsters.
Several superhumans had been called in, but even the strongest level 5 superhumans had to retreat. They clicked their tongues as they retreated from this location.
“What kind of affinity does it have? If we fight against it, we’ll be killed.”
“But…! It took a hundred humans!”
“We paid a small price if it went away after eating only a hundred humans. How many lives do you think our lives are worth?”
“…!”
Hugo had gnashed his teeth when he heard the laughing Taurus Saint and rushed into the sealed region.
“Hey! Archer! Come back! It only took a hundred people! If we let it eat them, it’ll fall asleep from being full!”
In the end, Hugo was punished for entering the place despite their objection.
‘Damn it! Am I being penalized for being a know-it-all as a level 4?’
It was the day when Hugo had met him.
“Who the hell is this idiot?”
“…!”
“You aren’t dead yet, so why do you look like all is lost?”
Unlike a year ago, the thirteenth awakened being had a different air around him. The look in his eyes and his entire face was different. He was now a being that even the gods would never be able to forget.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Book 1, Epilogue 3 - Let me be your student (3)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 3 - Let me be your student (3)
Hugo had heard about the existence of the thirteenth around half a year ago, in January 2001.
“What?! Korea is looking for mercenaries?”
Seoul was overrun with monsters, so Hugo had received a request for support.
“Damn it! Hey! In my current predicament, how the hell would I get there?!”
[You idiot!]
“What?! You and the Zodiac told me to come this way!”
After receiving the message through the raven, Hugo furiously shot his arrows. He was in Africa, surrounded by monsters.
Because of the several monsters gathered there, he was unable to leave the cave for several days.
However, Hugo soon let out a sigh of relief when he received a piece of news.
[The other heroes have decided to go to Korea!]
“Really? Thank goodness…!”
However, the thirteenth awakened being had appeared in the location where the heroes were scheduled to arrive, shocking the heroes and the Zodiacs alike.
[My god! It’s the thirteenth apostle! This should be impossible!]
[There should be only twelve heroes! Ominous! This is ominous!]
Normally, Sagittarius was busy ordering Hugo around, but at that moment, he was silent. The fiend was frantic and restless. The other apostles were probably going through the same thing.
However, something unexpected happened. Hugo heard no further news about the thirteenth.
The other heroes also asked around for the thirteenth, but the thirteenth seemed to have appeared and vanished too quickly. This was why this person couldn’t be located.
Therefore, one of the twelve heroes spoke up after the thirteenth had gone underground for half a year.
- What about the thirteenth? At the end of the day, he’s a civilian. He was probably exposed to the power of the Zodiacs by chance. That’s how he acquired his power.
- Also, why hasn’t he revealed himself? It’s because he’s already dead.
- There is no way there can be thirteen superhumans.
- I understand that you’re looking forward to meeting him. It’s understandable that you’re interested in him, but that person isn’t an apostle of a god.
- You shouldn’t needlessly show too much interest in him. The disappointment will be bigger if you have high hopes.
This was how everyone spoke about the thirteenth. The heroes had heard from the Zodiacs that the thirteenth could never exist, so they knew better than anyone else.
No one had caught sight of the thirteenth after that incident, so everyone assumed he was dead. But…
Poo-hahk!!!
“Huh-uhk…!!”
Hugo shook when he looked at the scene before him. He was in the middle of the ruined city.
Hugo had been captured by the monster that had been attacking the nearby resident; he was inside its mouth, and the monster was about to swallow him.
“What’s up with this idiot?”
Hugo was about to die when he heard a voice. This person had opened the monster’s mouth with their bare hands.
Hugo scrunched up his eyes since the sun was behind the person.
“You aren’t dead yet, so why do you look like you gave up on everything?”
“…!”
Hugo shook as he looked at the person looking down at him.
‘That person is….’
It might have had to do with the fact that Hugo felt faint and the light in the background was dazzling, but Hugo couldn’t tell if this person was a man or a woman. His ears were ringing, so he couldn’t tell it by the voice either.
The only thing he could make out was something that resembled long hair and a blazing fire around it. However, he saw one thing clearly.
“This bastard should try to differentiate between what it can eat and what it cannot.”
The next instant, Hugo saw the monster’s upper jaw being ripped away.
Kwah-jeek!!
[Kee-ehhhhhk!!!]
The monster’s upper jaw was sent flying, and Hugo, who was rolled up inside its tongue, looked up with wide eyes.
The person with the sun behind their back held a weapon bigger than Hugo, and they cut off the monster’s arm with it.
Poo-hahk!!!
It was a bizarre weapon. Hugo couldn’t tell if it was an ax or a greatsword. Its head looked like a flaked stone tool in the shape of a blade. The handle was very long, like that of an ax.
However, the surprising part was that this person could move quickly while holding something so large. The person held it as if it were as light as a feather and moved at a speed not visible to the naked eye.
‘My god!’
Hugo thought this person wasn’t human. As a speed-based archer, Hugo was considered the fastest among the twelve heroes.
‘His movement is on a different level.’
The twelve superhumans were considered the hope of humanity. They were supposed to save the world.
In truth, the other eleven superhumans were very strong, but they all worked on their own. Hugo could count the number of times he had met the others on the fingers of his hand.
However, he felt the difference in their levels when he saw their exploits. It was to be expected since they had reached level five, unlike him, who was at level four.
This was especially true of Stevens, who was called the superhuman of the north, and Ivan (Taurus), who had been the last to appear. Ivan possessed destructive battle capabilities.
The apostle of Virgo was called a prodigy and a genius. Then there were the magicians, who were called the ultimate weapons of humanity.
These eleven were superhumans that the world had high hopes for. Every country was clamoring to scout them.
‘I can’t even hold a candle to them.’
Hugo was level four, so it wasn't something he should be saying. However, the difference between him and the other superhumans was too large. It was like comparing a human trying to act as a superhuman to gods.
Koohng!!!
Hugo gaped as watched the scene before him. He couldn’t hear the roar of the monsters or feel the poisonous gas sting him.
He just watched the god of light descend from the heavens and rip apart the monsters.
It was unclear as to how long had passed.
“Hey, are you ok? Are you alive?”
Lee Gun approached Hugo, who was about to faint.
Hugo looked at Lee Gun, who was surrounded by a bright light, and unconsciously mumbled, “God.”
“What?”
“God-nim.”
Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold. “You must have lost your mind. Hey, get a hold of yourself. This is water. Hurry up and drink it. Ah! Your innards are spilling out. I wonder if you should even be drinking any water? Whatever. Just drink.”
Lee Gun took out a water bottle and shoved it toward Hugo’s mouth.
It allowed Hugo to come to his senses, and he coughed. He then clutched his stomach, where his innards were falling out.
While doing this, he grabbed a firm hold of Lee Gun. “Let me…”
“What?”
“Let me be….”
Hugo was about to ask this person to take him in as their student when…
[Kee-ehhhhhk!!!]
