A monster dove toward them. It was a monster bird that looked like a black eagle. Despite being in a befuddled state, Hugo shook from fear when he saw the enormous monster.
‘That’s the Neck Snapper…!’
This monster was considered one of the most dangerous monsters to have appeared until now. It was an unwelcome guest that appeared from the sky and decapitated its prey!
‘Damn it! There is nothing we can do if we are the target of its attack.’
But…
“Ah! That thing is really annoying,” Lee Gun said and picked up an item. This item wasn’t a weapon, but a frypan!
Lee Gun brought down the frypan on the head of the unwelcome guest.
Boohoo-gahk!!!
[Kee-ehhhhk!!]
The monster bird’s head was blown away, and its body fell to the ground.
Lee Gun calmly parted the monster bird’s stomach and took out an egg. “The monster is inedible, but its egg seems edible.”
“….” Hugo was speechless.
‘T-this person killed the unwelcome guest with a single swing of the frypan.’
Moreover, this person was in the midst of a battlefield, where food could be scarce. Yet, they had easily created their own provision.
Lee Gun said as he took out the eggs one by one, “So? What did you say before?”
“Marry me!”
“What?”
Hugo suddenly grabbed Lee Gun’s leg. “Please marry me!!!!! I’ll do anything you want!”
With his innards hanging out of his stomach, Hugo clung to Lee Gun.
It made Lee Gun angry. “Hey! Let go!”
“Please marry me, big sis!”
“Have you lost your ever-loving mind?”
Bbah-gahk!
* * *
Lee Gun had a dream. It showed a scene of him losing his family.
- Help. There is someone here!
- Mom! I want to get out of here…!
- Be a bit patient. They said it’ll be more dangerous if we head outside. We just have to wait a little more, and the heroes will be here.
Their surroundings were a raging inferno. Within the flame, Lee Gun kept hearing voices that tormented him.
- People are still alive. Are you sure we shouldn’t be going out right now?
- It’s fine. If we drag our feet, the Korean government will get more desperate. They’ll up their offer. We just have to follow the orders of our apostles.
- Ha ha! Are you sure about saying those words here?
- It’s fine. One has lost his hearing, and the other one is dead.
- I guess there is no hope for the other floors either.
- Are you sure the other apostles will come here?
- No way! The monsters appearing in this place are the strongest ones we’ve ever seen. They know it’ll be certain death if they come here. Certain death.
- What? Then why did they tell everyone to evacuate into this building?
- That’s…
Then the voices would disappear, and Lee Gun would always see Yeonwoo being eaten by a monster made out of a fog. The nightmare ended as he watched Yeonwoo get ripped apart in front of him.
Lee Gun once again had the same dream. He rapidly breathed as he woke up. “Damn it.”
He was inside an abandoned building. It was a ruin that he had temporarily borrowed to treat Hugo.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. Hugo, who had been knocked out until now, was causing a great disturbance.
“Ahhk! My stomach! My stomach! Why are there needle marks here?!”
Lee Gun let out a sigh. He approached Hugo, who was lying down on the bed. “Are you up? Your innards were falling out. Since it was an emergency, I did surgery on you.”
“Surgery??!!!”
“You don’t have to worry about it getting infected. I experimented on my body, so I’m good at it now.”
Hugo’s eyes turned round when he saw Lee Gun. “Uh. Who the hell are you?”
Lee Gun lashed out. “You don’t recognize the person who saved you?”
“You were a man?”
“I’ll forgive you since you’re a patient.”
Hugo accepted it as a fact. Earlier, he had been out of his mind, so he had thought Lee Gun was a woman because of his long hair.
‘It wasn’t hair. He was wearing the leather of a monster…’
Lee Gun also had the build of a normal man.
‘He’s a scary person. He doesn’t laugh at all.’
His face, which had burn wounds, was terrifying. However, it didn’t matter in the end.
“I’ll do anything you want!! Let me be your student!”
“!!”
Lee Gun was taken aback by Hugo’s sudden declaration. “You really are…”
Hugo didn’t seem oblivious as he kowtowed. “Please take me on! I am lacking in skill, so I’m unable to kill monsters well!”
“Monsters? …civilian…why….”
“Civilian? Ah, you’re right! I am lacking so much compared to the other eleven that even a civilian is surprised!”
“Eleven?”
“Yes! Ah!! However, I’m confident about my speed! The other apostles can’t win against me in terms of speed…!”
“You are an apostle?” Lee Gun’s voice was cold enough to freeze the air.
Oblivious to the change in the mood, Hugo let out a bright smile. “Yes! I never expected to meet the famous thirteenth here—”
Hugo couldn’t finish.
“Ahhhk!!”
A terrifying ax flew toward his neck.
Kwah-jeek!!
“Damn it! What an unlucky day. I couldn’t feel the energy of the Zodiac from you, so I was tricked.”
“M-Mr. Thirteen?!! Why are you suddenly—”
“Whatever. You can die again.”
“What??!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 451: Book 1, Epilogue 4 - Let me be your student (4)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 4 - Let me be your student (4)
“Whatever. You can die again.”
“What??!!!”
Hugo was taken aback. However, he didn’t even have the time to be flustered as the hand ax flew toward him.
Kwah-jeek!!
The hand ax landed exactly next to the head of the fallen Hugo. There had been no hesitation in Lee Gun’s movement.
Hugo almost cried; his ear was a hair's breadth away from getting cut off. “Shit! I’m going to die! I’m going to die!”
The ax embedded beside him in the bed was the one Lee Gun had used to chop firewood.
Before Hugo could say anything, the deeply embedded ax was raised once again.
Hwheek!
The ax once again descended toward Hugo!
“Ahhk!”
Hugo quickly bent his waist to the side to dodge.
Kwah-jeek!
“Ahhk! Why are you suddenly acting this way after saving me?!”
“That’s why I want you to die again. How dare you dupe me into thinking that you were a civilian?”
“I didn’t?! You were the weird one for not noticing that I was an apostle! What kind of crazy person thinks a normal person could live when his innards are falling out?”
“Ah! That’s true, but it doesn’t change the fact that this is your fault.”
“What— Ahhhk!!!”
Kwahng!
The ax once again came crashing toward the bed.
However, like an eel, Hugo dodged the attack.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. He seemed pissed now. He ruthlessly kept hacking away toward the bed!
Kwahng! Kwahng! Kwahng!
It was as if he were playing Whack-a-mole. When he missed every attack, he furrowed his brows. “It seems your being fast wasn’t a lie.”
“Yes! It’s useful, right? That’s why you should stop doing this. This is useless. Please accept me as a student— Ahhh! It’s foul to use a weapon that you killed the monsters with!”
Despite his cries, the attacks didn’t stop. Hugo became aggrieved. “What did I do to warrant this?! My only sin is that I came here to hunt down the monsters— Kuhk!”
“I see. Are you here trying to make money? You are paid to come here, but I bet you don't plan on killing any monsters, right?”
“What? What are you talking about? I am an apostle! I exist to save people…!!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed more menacingly. “You guys? Save people??”
He started choking Hugo as if the latter were telling an extraordinary lie.
Kwahng!
Since the apostle kept squirming away like an eel, Lee Gun was doing this to keep him in lace. “It doesn’t matter what you were trying to do. You won’t be of help to me since you almost died to a small fry. You were basically killed by the monster. I’ll just finish the job here.”
“…!!!”
Lee Gun was about to get rid of Hugo, but…
Kwahng!
“Hey! Otis!”
“!”
The door to the ruined building was opened.
Hugo and Lee Gun were surprised to see who had busted through the door.
“Mr. Ivan!”
It was a muscular, silver-haired man. This man was none other than Ivan Kruger (26), the Taurus Saint.
Among the twelve Zodiac Saints, he was the tallest, most muscular, and most macho, alongside the Leo Saint.
While Stevens gave off the image of a freewheeling wild beast, Ivan gave off the image of a monk.
The man possessed a skin color that was a shade of brown different from Stevens’s, and he glared at Hugo. It seemed he had been going around looking for Hugo.
“You should know your place, you little insect. Why would you go off and attack this place?”
“!!”
Ivan’s blue eyes flashed. When Ivan approached Hugo, he started to shake. Ivan’s reaction was understandable since he had told Hugo not to enter this region.
And Hugo had ignored that and arrived here to kill the monsters.
‘H-He had said he’d get back at me if I entered this place…!’
Ivan had told him to let the monsters eat the hundred human hostages. However, Hugo couldn’t follow those orders.
Thankfully for Hugo, the hand squeezing his neck loosened when Ivan stormed in.
But Lee Gun stood before him with a blade in his hand, and Ivan was about to raise his blade behind him!
‘I’m screwed either way!’
As if he was as angry as he could be, Ivan approached Hugo. “We are in a tough spot because of you. Who the hell do you think you are? You are trying to lower our standards!”
“…!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brow as he looked at Ivan.
Hugo was dirty and had unkempt hair. So Lee Gun was unable to match him with the Zodiac Saints, whom he saw on TV.
However, Ivan was different. He looked exactly as he was presented on TV, so Lee Gun immediately recognized him.
On the other hand, Ivan let out a bright smile when he caught sight of Lee Gun. He saw the bandages around Hugo’s body and the medical equipment strewn around him. It was easy to piece together what had happened.
“You saved our comrade. Let me thank you first. By the look of your hideous face, you seem to have gone through a lot of hardship. I pity you.”
Clearly, because of how Lee Gun had dressed, Ivan had assumed Lee Gun was a beggar living here.
Ivan contemptuously looked at Hugo. It was as if the bright smile, which he had directed toward Lee Gun, never existed. “You are the weakest amongst the twelve of us, and you’re an idiot.”
“!”
Instead of English, Ivan spoke in French. It seemed he didn’t want Lee Gun to understand what they were talking about. “You keep trying to go around saving civilians. It puts us in an awkward position.”
Normally, the twelve Zodiac Saints spoke in English, but at times, they had to take Sophie’s lead since she was the healing Saint. This was why they spoke French the most after English.
“You keep going wherever you want to save people. Do you realize we are unable to set up shop because of you?”
“…!!”
Lee Gun seemed to have understood the conversation. He glanced at Hugo.
Hugo felt a surge of anger. He wanted to say something.
However, Ivan merely laughed in contempt. “Why are you looking at me like that? We put our lives on the line to save them, so of course, we should ask for payment. You are a moron who should stay out of the spotlight.”
“But…!”
“God Bow.”
“!”
“You are way too weak to have such a nickname. Do you understand me? You aren’t the God Bow. You are a water gun! You can't even properly kill a monster!”
Hugo bit his lips. He ground his teeth in humiliation, but couldn’t come up with a retort.
The Sagittarius temple was a fighting-type temple. In other words, Hugo was supposed to be a fighter, yet he wasn’t able to rub shoulders with the other fighter Zodiac Saints. In fact, he sometimes lost to the non-fighting Zodiac Saints.
Of course, it wasn’t as if he was inferior in terms of ability. He had enough stats to be able to kill monsters. He just didn’t have the know-how.
Still, this didn’t change the fact that he had the least accomplishments among the twelve Zodiac Saints. This was why he kept his silence.
Ivan laughed when he saw Hugo’s expression and took out his wallet. He took out a roll of fifty hundred dollar bills.
“You did something unnecessary, but you did well. Just don’t tell anyone that he was hurt, and he never entered this place.” Ivan acted as if he was showing kindness while handing money over to Lee Gun.
“Fuck off! Bastard!”
“?!”
Tahhk!
Ivan was surprised.
Lee Gun slapped away Ivan’s hand. “Get your hand away from me, you soy-sauce marinated shrimp-looking bastard. You annoy me.”
“…!” Ivan was surprised because of how Lee Gun was looking at him.
‘Hostility.’
This was why he was stumped. Most of humanity saw the twelve Zodiac Saints as saviors, so they looked at him with admiration in their eyes.
‘Why would a civilian look at me like this…?’
So he asked, “Do you not know who I am?”
Lee Gun contemptuously lifted his ax, and Ivan looked on in shock.
“You shouldn’t do this, Thirteenth-nim!”
“!”
Hugo became desperate when he felt Lee Gun’s killing intent.
On the other hand, Ivan was surprised for an entirely different reason.
‘What the hell did he just say? Did he say that man is the thirteenth?!’
Ivan, who had looked proud, now had a shocked expression on his face.
‘Is he the one who appeared half a year ago and went underground?’
Of course, Ivan remembered him.
‘The thirteenth is the mutant. The Zodiacs said he is someone who shouldn’t exist at all.’
After turning the world on its head, the thirteenth had suddenly gone missing. Everyone had thought he had either died or lost his power.
‘So why is he here?!’
However, Ivan didn’t even have time to be surprised.
Kwah-jeek!
“Koohk!”
Lee Gun fiercely attacked Ivan, flustering him.
‘What the hell is up with his movement?’
Ivan’s eyes flashed. At the same time, his thick brown arms destroyed Lee Gun’s weapon.
Kwah-jeek!!
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round in surprise when his newly made prototype number 2 had been destroyed.
Lee Gun had seen only one of the twelve Zodiac Saints fight. So he had assumed Ivan would have fighting capabilities similar to Hugo's.
‘He’s different.’
Hugo turned pale.
‘As expected of a level-five Zodiac Saint…!’
The twelve Zodiac Saints ranged between levels one and five. Those who had reached level five (transcendent) possessed power on a different level.
Of course, it wasn't as if Hugo had met all twelve members of the Zodiac Saint, but…
‘Level five (transcendent) is on another level compared to level four.’
Sophie was the one who kept the network of contacts, and according to her, only four of them had reached level five.
‘They are the Taurus Saint, Leo Saint, Pisces Saint, and Scorpio Saint.’
In other words, Ivan was one of the four strongest among humanity! Moreover, he was the adamant superhuman, who possessed the highest defense…!’
Suddenly, Lee Gun picked up an item covered with cloth. This item had been leaning against the wall.
‘!’
Both Hugo and Ivan furrowed their brows because they got an ominous feeling
“Wake up, Heaven’s Punishment.”
“!?”
The long item reacted to Lee Gun’s voice by letting out a light. At the same time, the cloth wrapped around it fell away, surprising both Zodiac Saints.
“W-What the hell is that weapon?”
Still in its infancy, Heaven's Punishment didn’t look anything like how it would twenty years later.
The weapon was almost as long as a staff, and it looked more like a blunt weapon than an ax. It looked like a stone tool.
However, Ivan felt a chill run up his spine when Lee Gun held up the weapon. Unlike the sword from before, this weapon was on a different level.
‘Is it a weapon given by a god?’
Ivan didn’t know why, but he felt as if he was in danger. This was why he quickly extended his hand.
‘It’ll be best to get rid of him instead of dragging him along.’
A brown light appeared in Ivan’s hands.
Flash!
[Worship of the Holy Cow (Royal Skill)]
- Absolute invincibility for 1 minute (All attacks are deflected). Has a counterattack function. When moving, a powerful charge buff is activated.
After activating his Royal Skill, Ivan aimed for Heaven’s Punishment.
‘A mere weapon like this…!’
Like what he had done to Stevens’s weapon, he would destroy it.
“!!”
However, the weapon didn’t break. That wasn’t all.
“…!”
Ivan felt a chill run up his back when he met eyes with him.
Lee Gun was laughing. Before this, Lee Gun hadn’t even smiled! Yet, Lee Gun coldly laughed with his eyes as if he had expected this move.
Hoohng!
Lee Gun made a fist with his left hand. It was the hand that wasn’t holding Heaven’s Punishment.
Then his fist smashed into Ivan’s thick arm!
Bbah-gahk!!!!!
The explosive sound almost made Hugo’s eardrums burst. However, the sound wasn’t the surprising part.
Hoo-doo-doohk.
“…!!”
Ivan froze for the first time.
After Lee Gun’s fist had collided with his forearm, a crack appeared on his forearm as if his forearm were made out of stone.
Ivan’s skin broke apart like candy, revealing his red muscles. He possessed the adamant body, which was supposed to be the strongest, yet it had been broken.
Lee Gun then said, “You call it the adamant body when it was broken by a fist? A passing dog would laugh at your claim!”
For the first time in his life, Ivan felt something called fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 452: Book 1, Epilogue 5 - Let me be your student (5)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 5 - Let me be your student (5)
Called the world’s strongest shield, Ivan possessed the strongest body that nothing could pierce through. And this so-called strongest body had been pierced by a bare fist. Moreover, it was done by a simple mutant who did not have any backing from a god!
Kwah-jeek!
The mutant smirked as he said, “Don’t go around saying you are the shield. It’s embarrassing. Your body is like glass!”
Those words were incredibly humiliating and insulting to Ivan.
Hugo was unable to pick up his jaw off the floor.
‘His body was fine even after being kicked and stomped on by monsters…!’
There was a reason Ivan always mocked the Leo Saint.
- Hey, wild beast. You broke your weapon again? This is why you’re a useless idiot who can’t fight when you lose your weapon.
- What? Do you believe I’m unable to fight without a weapon? You want to settle this right now?
The two greatest fighters routinely fought each other to see who would break first.
However, it didn’t matter if the opponent was Stevens, who boasted savage destructive power, or the magician Heiji, who was as destructive as weapons of war; they couldn’t even leave a scratch on Ivan’s body.
All of them inwardly acknowledged Ivan as their leader.
“My god! That damn body of the stone buddha was destroyed! As expected of the thirteenth…!!” Hugo wailed in joy.
Normally, Ivan would have lashed out at Hugo and told him to shut his mouth. However, he didn’t even have the presence of mind to go after Hugo.
‘What the hell is he…!!’
Ivan had no interest in the thirteenth. Since the thirteenth wasn’t a Zodiac Saint, Lee Gun had been beneath Ivan’s notice.
‘What the hell is this power?’
Ivan ground his teeth.
‘None of the Zodiac Saints were able to scratch my body!’
He had been confident in the fact that his body was his weapon. This was why he was enraged. He was about to call for his Zodiac to descend into him!
Puhk!!
“Koohk!”
However, something hit Ivan in the back of his head. The pain was akin to being hit by a toy hammer.
Ivan became angry when he realized who it was. “Did you really just attack me?”
Hugo was letting out a cold sweat after kicking Ivan.
‘As expected, my attack doesn’t work against him at all…!’
It had been an attack containing all of his power.
Ivan grabbed Hugo by the neck and slammed him into the ground.
“Kuh-huhk!”
Ivan was so strong that the ground cratered. The shock caused a crater that was five meters deep! Impressed by his own destructive power, Ivan laughed in satisfaction.
Lee Gun snorted. Thanks to Hugo, he had found an opening. “Don’t worry! I’ll get rid of both of you like the good teammates that you are.”
A surprised Hugo quickly got out of the crater and clung to Lee Gun. “Ahhhk! Teacher! You can’t kill him!”
Lee Gun had been heading toward Ivan, but this surprised him. Hugo keeping up with his speed in a fight was out of his expectations! However, his surprise lasted only a moment.
Lee Gun kicked Hugo. “Don’t get in my way! I thought you didn’t like him because he’s all about money! Are you covering for him because he’s your comrade?”
It seemed Hugo had his reasons as he kept clinging to Lee Gun. “Damn it! Yes! His personality sucks! He is a douche! I do hate him, but without the Zodiac Saints, humanity will die! They’ll die to the monsters!”
“…?”
Dumbfounded, Lee Gun looked at Hugo. “I’ll kill the monsters.”
“It’s impossible to do it alone! You aren’t a god!”
“Alright.”
When Lee Gun looked as if he was conceding the point, Hugo’s face brightened.
“Then…!”
“I’ll kill you first.”
“Ahhhk!!”
Lee Gun brought Heaven’s Punishment down toward Hugo. Hugo dodged like a squirrel, but Lee Gun’s power hit the floor.
Koo-goo-goohng!
“Huhk!”
The floor cracked, and Hugo fell into the hole.
“Ahhhhhhhh…!”
He fell a distance of at least a hundred meters, letting out Tarzan-like screams.
Ivan felt a chill run up his spine.
‘What kind of power does this crazy bastard possess…!’
Ivan almost couldn’t tell if Lee Gun was a human or a monster. Although the attack had missed its target, it had caused so much destruction.
Even if Lee Gun had purposefully been aiming for the ground, it shouldn’t be possible to create a crater several hundred meters deep.
Ivan didn’t want to do it, but he had no choice. He compared the crater he had made against the one created by Lee Gun. Then he gnashed his teeth. For the first time in his life, he felt humiliated. He was also scared.
Oblivious to this, Lee Gun dusted off his hands, having gotten rid of the annoying Hugo. “You are next.”
“!!”
“Well, I will spare you if you are worth sparing, like what that wheat-headed bastard said. However…” Lee Gun’s eyes flashed menacingly. “I’ll spare you only if you’re stronger than me.”
“!!!”
Was it because he was confident in his skill? Lee Gun tried to take off Ivan's head.
“Ahhhhhhhh!!!!”
However, Lee Gun’s eyes widened in surprise when he suddenly heard the Tarzan-like scream. The sound was coming from the bottom of the hundred-meter-deep sinkhole. Moreover, the voice was moving toward the surface!
“!”
Lee Gun’s mouth fell open. An enormous monster had appeared from the large hole, and it had Hugo in its mouth!
“Ahhhhk!! Teacher! Save me!”
“…???!”
The monster looked like a worm, and as soon as it came out, water erupted from the hole.
Kwahng!!!
The worm, which held Hugo in its mouth, ate him.
Kwah-jeek!
Ivan shook in fear.
‘That monster belongs to the Danger group!’
In this era, the monsters had yet to be categorized as belonging to zones. The Zodiac Saints had currently divided the monsters into groups of Caution - Evacuate - Flee - Danger.
Their success at killing monsters in the Danger group was less than 40%, so the Zodiac Saints had given up trying to kill them.
But why was such a monster here? Moreover, that wasn’t the most shocking part.
“Oh! This is awesome. I’ve been staying here for a month trying to chase it down. It came out on its own.”
“?!”
Ivan couldn’t believe his ears.
‘What? He chased it for a month?’
Why would he chase after a monster in the danger group??
Both Ivan and Lee Gun seemed to have forgotten about Hugo, who had been eaten by the monster.
As if he had been waiting for this moment, Lee Gun jumped with Heaven’s Punishment in hand, looking ecstatic. “I used all kinds of tricks to drag you out, yet you refused to come out!”
The mere presence of Hugo had made the monster immediately come out of hiding!
“He’s a great bait!”
Lee Gun swung Heaven’s Punishment and bisected the worm.
Kwak-jeek!
As if he were cutting open an eel, he cut open the worm from head to tail in one stroke.
Suh-guhk!!
Hugo, who had been stuck inside the worm’s gullet, was able to see light once again.
“Kuh-huhk…!”
Covered in sticky liquid, Hugo fell to the ground and writhed. Despite his current state, he seemed moved as he looked at Lee Gun. “My god! Teacher! You saved your student once again— Ahhhk!!”
Lee Gun used Hugo’s head as a stepping stone and launched himself into the air.
Koo-goo-goong!
It was because another worm had shot out of the same hole. This worm wasn’t brown like the other one. It was purple.
[Kee-ehhhhhk!]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw the differently colored monster.
‘I can’t use that one as a food ingredient.’
This worm possessed an extremely potent poison that could melt weapons. Moreover, it had an annoyingly hard exterior.
‘If I’m unlucky, my weapon will break.’
He was wondering what he should do when he saw Ivan.
Ivan seemed dumbfounded by what was going on, and he was exiting the building.
‘Damn it! He’s a psycho!’
On top of having stranger powers, Lee Gun had chased after a monster in the Danger group for a month. That was why Ivan decided it would be best if he avoided all of this mess.
‘I’ll just pretend I didn’t see him.’
Ivan hated everything about Lee Gun. Just talking with Lee Gun made him feel disgusted and dirty.
‘Also, my Zodiac wants me to pay up.’
Although he had canceled it, he had tried to use a Royal skill. So his Zodiac was making a fuss.
[Give me alcohol and a beautiful woman.]
If he let things be, his god would go on a rampage.
‘I should notify that bastard’s existence to the government and make them bury him—’
“?!”
Ivan had been about to exit when Lee Gun grabbed his foot. The Taurus Saint didn’t even have time to cuss.
“Ahhhk!”
His head was basically plowing the ground as Lee Gun dragged him away.
Ivan yelled, “Crazy bastard!”
He planned on getting up and grabbing Lee Gun by the throat. However, he groaned the next moment.
“Kuhk!”
Lee Gun took the rope on Ivan’s waist and bound him with it.
‘!!’
The speed at which he made the knot made it clear that he was adept at this. “Great. Your body is sturdy enough to be used as a blunt weapon.”
Ivan almost vomited blood.
Bbah-gahk!!!
Lee Gun ran toward the worm and swung Ivan like a baseball bat.
There was a reason the Taurus Saint boasted about his sturdy body.
“Kuh-huhk…!!!”
Ivan, who had become a baseball bat, was able to pierce through the hard shell of the purple worm. He made contact with its flesh.
Poo-hahk!
This was possible only because Lee Gun had put his power behind the attack.
As the shell of the worm fell off, it emitted a liquid with an extremely foul smell—its poisonous blood.
When the poisonous blood touched Ivan, Ivan’s skin started to melt away. He was the Taurus Saint, known for having the highest defense. So his bone didn’t melt away. However, he had still suffered heavy damage.
Ivan almost lost consciousness as he remained stuck within the monster’s body.
Lee Gun didn’t care as he poured magical energy into his foot. He kicked the monster toward the sky as if it were a soccer ball!
Bbuhng!!
Lee Gun looked very satisfied as the monster and Ivan were both sent flying into the sky. “Good! I got rid of the bastards that’ll stink up the house.”
Lee Gun looked at the geothermal spring water and the first worm that he had killed with a satisfied expression.
With them, he could make something from the blueprints that he had stolen from the Capricorn temple. He would be able to make Furnace(S) and Treatment Bath(D).
Hugo, who was still here, looked at Lee Gun with twinkling eyes. “As expected, you’re amazing! I admire you, Teacher— Kuh-huhk!!!”
Hugo received a kick.
As if the pleased look on his face had never existed before, Lee Gun coldly swung the hand ax. “Don’t talk to me as if you’re close to me, bastard.”
“…!!!”
“Well, you seem different from the other one. You aren’t the type to commercialize your work,” Lee Gun then said.
“Uh… D-Did you understand what we were talking about?”
Lee Gun looked at Hugo with a displeased expression. He had traveled to many lands, so he was able to understand the gist of various languages.
“Anyway, I don't plan on taking on a student. If you don’t want to die, you can fuck off!”
When the hand ax flew toward him, Hugo screamed as he fell to the ground. He had no idea why Lee Gun hated the Zodiac Saints so much.
* * *
“Did you just say it was the thirteenth apostle?”
One of the four strongest superhumans, the Scorpio Saint Hailey, narrowed her fine brow. Of course, she had also heard that a strange mutant had appeared in Korea.
‘That was the attack where Time had taken his underlings.’
During then, she had gone to a different dimension, so she was late in finding out about the incident.
Of course, whenever Korea was mentioned, she could only think about the nameless young man.
Three years ago, a high school boy had put all his heart into healing an injured Hailey. Hailey’s face turned red when she thought about him.
In truth, she had hovered near him before becoming the Scorpio Saint. She had wanted to protect him, but at some point, she had lost track of the young man. She wondered where he was and whether he was alive or not. It made her worried.
‘Please be safe. I hope he is living a good life in a safe location.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
“I’ll have to check him out.”
[Then…!]
“I’ll go myself to meet the thirteenth.”

chapters.title: Chapter 453: Book 1, Epilogue 6 - First Love (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 6 - First Love (1)
Around four years ago, Lee Gun had taken in a cat. She was a black kitten with blue eyes. The black cat had been on the verge of dying, but Lee Gun had brought her back to health.
After saving her, Lee Gun raised the cat and treasured her.
“Does kitty like oppa that much? Do you want to grow up and get married to oppa?”
The cat had been shy. She looked oddly different from a normal cat, but Lee Gun didn’t care.
After a close friend had died, Lee Gun had kept his emotions bottled up even from Yeonwoo and Junwoo. During that one of the roughest points in his life, the cat had been his only source of comfort. It had been precious to him.
However, his precious cat had also disappeared after leaving behind a trail of blood. It was unclear if she was dead or not…
Then his younger brother Junwoo, whom he loved very much, had also died.
“Hyung… Don’t cry… I’m fine. It isn’t your fault.”
“I’m sorry! If only I went to get you earlier…!”
“…No. I wish you wouldn’t cry.”
Junwoo had been killed by monsters.
In truth, those monsters were Pisces and Gemini, who had transformed themselves.
Of course, there was no way Lee Gun knew this at the time.
Then Yeonwoo, who was all he had at that point, had died as well.
“…Gun. It’s fine. I’m sure people that you really like will come.” Yeonwoo had left behind those words before dying.
Moreover, Lee Gun couldn’t forget the faces he saw as the building burned around him.
“Let go. Are you deaf? Do you realize how busy the Zodiac Saints are?”
“They said they would come…! They told us not to worry….”
“How dare you believe your lives are worth the same as the Zodiac Saints. All of them said they won’t be coming.”
“…!”
The temples had received massive amounts of public donations from the civilians, yet the disciples had demonically laughed as they spoke.
“If the Zodiac Saints weren’t coming, why did they tell us to evacuate into the building?”
“If the monsters eat people, the responsibility falls on the Zodiac Saints. If the building collapses, the deaths would be counted as an accident.”
“Anyway, let’s head back. We’ll report that this place is empty. We’ll rejoin the Zodiac Saints. They aren’t in Seoul. They already went to the neighboring country. That country is richer than Korea and is offering a staggering amount of money. Moreover, the monsters there are classified under the Caution group, so they are easier to kill than the ones here.”
Lee Gun couldn’t forget their faces and words. Moreover, he remembered what kinds of news reports had been sent out on the next day after his awakening.
[They were holding back the monsters, so they were late.]
[“The traffic delayed us. We were unable to arrive in Seoul in time.”]
[The Zodiacs Saints have expressed their thanks to the mutant awakened being.]
Lee Gun’s heart had changed as much as his face had.
‘They are trash, who wore the mask of heroes.’
He would kill them. As soon as he saw them, he would kill them all!
Back to the present.
“…t…t.”
“….”
“Teach…er….”
“….”
“Teacher!!”
“…!”
Lee Gun had fallen asleep inside the hot spring. He opened his eyes.
Currently, he was in a city in Jordan. He had arrived here after his business in Saudi Arabia was done, and he furrowed his brow when he saw the young man in front of him.
“Why is that insect still here?”
“Teacher!!”
Yes, the one before him right now was Hugo Otis.
Lee Gun had been sure he had dumped Hugo in Saudi Arabia. Since Hugo kept madly following him, Lee Gun had left him behind in the desert.
‘How is that bastard still alive??’
Lee Gun wanted Hugo dead, so he had thrown Hugo into quicksand.
Despite looking grubby, Hugo had a bright smile on his face as he waved something. It was a torn piece of Lee Gun’s shirt.
“Despite how I look, I’m a Zodiac Saint of tracking! If a scent is left behind on an item, I can chase the item’s owner to the other side of the earth! It doesn’t matter where you go, Teacher! I can find you if I have this!”
Damn it? Was he some kind of dog? Lee Gun became angry.
On the other hand, Hugo was interested in the bathtub that Lee Gun had entered. “This doesn’t seem like an item provided by this lodging. What is this?”
Lee Gun scrunched up his face. What else could it be?
[Bathtub used to heal skin (D)]
Lee Gun had made this item using the by-products from the monsters that had appeared in Saudi Arabia.
Using the blueprint he had stolen from the Capricorn temple, he was able to create a variety of holy items.
He had a total of nine prototypes. Of course, the first one he had made was Heaven’s Punishment, but he was unable to create any more useful equipment afterward.
‘Their power and durability were too weak. They quickly broke down.’
The only effective items he had made were random items like the bathtub and the furnace. The reason probably was that he didn’t possess a good kiln and good ingredients.
That was why he had been trying to kill the worm monster inside Saudi Arabia. That monster was an ingredient needed to create an S-rank kiln. Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
“Wow! Is this the hot spring water that I dug out? I can feel magical energy from it. Does it have a special function?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. It seemed the desert wasn’t enough. He’d have to kill Hugo by tossing him into the ocean.
Hugo brought out something that he had readied as soon as Lee Gun exited the bathtub. “Teacher! Please eat this! I bought some good food on the way. I was worried you would be hungry!”
“…!” Lee Gun was shocked by the items stacked on top of the table: steaks, wine, bread, cookies, fruits, and all kinds of other tasty foods.
An odd look entered his eyes as he looked at Hugo. “Why would you…”
“Why else?! If I want to serve you, this is the least I could do, Teacher!”
What the hell? This bastard was a pushover.
Of course, it wasn’t as if Lee Gun didn’t take rewards for the monsters that he killed, but he had spent it all on buying food. So he was poor right now.
In the end, Lee Gun ate everything.
Hugo was shocked because even the food he had bought for himself had been stolen. “Y-You ate it all already? I brought enough for three people so that there would be enough…!”
“It isn’t. I have to eat fifty servings a day at the very least.”
“Are you sure you are human?”
Hugo took a beating until he became a bloody mess.
“Anyway, you can fuck off now if your business with me is done. I have to go out.”
“D-Don’t you need dinner and midnight snacks?!”
“…”
“What about cleaning and laundry? What about making reservations for lodging? I’ll do it all. This includes procuring your meal! The expense will be the payment for taking me on as a student!”
“Hmmph. Do you really think I’ll take you in as a student if you do that?”
“You don’t have to accept me! Let me assist you from your side! Please don’t kick me out!”
“!”
When Hugo grabbed his pant leg, Lee Gun was taken aback. He glared at Hugo. Why the hell was this man willing to go so far to learn fighting techniques from him?
“All you guys have to do is kill the easy monsters to make money, right?”
“No! I want to save people! I don’t want anyone left out!”
Lee Gun became silent at those words. At that moment, he recalled a scene from the TV. It was something that he had seen in the past where three superhumans had saved the dying humanity.
[Please do not worry! We will save all of humanity! We will leave no one behind!]
- Wow, Junwoo! Did you see that? Those people are amazing!
For some reason, he recalled the emotion that he had forgotten. “Do as you wish. But I’m not going to teach you anything.”
“Thank you!!!”
“I really won’t teach you anything, but you have to keep feeding me. I want enough to feed fifty people. After two hours, I want a snack…. Ah. My watch is broken.” Lee Gun looked at his wristwatch in annoyance.
Hugo suddenly unclasped his wristwatch and gave it to Lee Gun. “Please use mine!”
Lee Gun didn’t think much about it as he took the watch, but he was shocked.
‘P…Patek Philippe?’
Even he had heard about this extremely expensive luxury watch. The cheapest of these watches were expensive enough to buy a car…
“My grandfather gave it to me when I was in high school. It’s a bit old, but it’ll do the job for you.”
“???”
What kind of grandfather would buy such an item for a high schooler?
Lee Gun did his best to calm himself. “Isn’t this a precious present to you? Are you sure about giving such an item?”
“Ah! It’s fine. I have many similar watches. I’m actually tired of it already.”
Lee Gun kicked Hugo. “Die, you rich bastard!!!”
“Ahhk! I’m not that rich!”
“How are you not? I already didn’t like you! Now, I hate you even more! You should just live as a momma’s boy! Why are you trying to kill monsters?”
“Ahhhk! I can’t! My parents are all dead because of the monsters. Grandfather’s company went bankrupt! The only blood relative I have left is my older sister. We are poor— Ahhhk!!”
“Shut up, you filthy insect!”
Hugo’s image in Lee Gun’s eyes, which had been rising a bit, instantly fell to the same level as that of a bug.
* * *
“What? Level five superhuman?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he munched on the bread.
When Lee Gun expressed his interest in the Zodiac Saints, Hugo squeezed out all the information he had about the Zodiac Saints.
“The one I used as a bat was level five? Strong, my ass! He was pure trash.”
“Ah! The other three are different. The Zodiac Saint of the Scorpio temple is…!”
“Scorpio temple?”
“Yes! She’s a cold-blooded Zodiac Saint who is hard as nails! Her skills are monstrous, and she is incredibly powerful! Also… Despite being so powerful, she is a beautiful woman. Her beauty is almost not from this world. All the male Zodiac Saints have fallen for her. Ah. Not me! I only have eyes for Teacher!”
“Is that so?”
Lee Gun became interested in her since she was that strong.
* * *
Around this time…
“This is where the thirteenth is right now?”
The subject of Lee Gun’s interest had arrived at the city where Lee Gun was. After her subordinates had located him, Hailey wanted to see the thirteenth for herself.
However…
“What a coincidence! I can’t believe we ran across each other here.”
“!”
Hailey turned when she heard the voice coming from the market. She caught sight of the Leo Saint Stevens (23), who was famous for being the superhuman of the north.
Like Stevens, Hailey was an awakened being who had reached the highest level. She was one of the strongest among the Zodiac Saints.
“Did you already have a meal, Hailey?”
“Are you here looking for the thirteenth?”
There was no mirth. Stevens became a bit embarrassed by her cold attitude. “Ah! Thirteenth? I did hear about him. I heard the Taurus Saint called the Saintess, but any work regarding the thirteenth was handed over to the Magician of the East. I have other business here.”
“Other business?”
“I heard something strange is occurring nearby. I thought it might be the doing of the Virgo Saint.”
“Ah!”
The Virgo Saint was an eccentric Zodiac Saint, who had yet to reveal himself. No one knew what he looked like, and no one knew where he was. Moreover, he hadn’t been cooperative with the other Zodiac Saints.
“As per the general information, he’s a high school student from France. From rumors, he’s a genius swordsman…”
A subordinate of his had caught sight of the Virgo Saint’s face. According to her,
- It was a blonde ghost!
- Moreover, the Virgo Saint tried to kill us!
“I’m pretty sure the Virgo Saint is a girl. That’s why we are looking for a high-school-age blonde girl.”
“You think that person is related to the bizarre incidents occurring here?”
“Yes. Anyone who believes and praises the Zodiacs was attacked here. It matches the Virgo Saint’s modus operandi.”
“What? A Zodiac Saint is attacking the worshippers of the Zodiacs?”
It made no sense, but Stevens waved it away as if it wasn’t important.
He smiled as he glanced at Hailey. “Anyway, it’s fate that we were able to run across each other. Would you like to have lunch with me?”
“Do you not know how to read your watch? It is well past 3 P.M.”
“If not, let’s have some tea…!”
“I don’t like tea.” Hailey was about to turn around as she ignored Stevens.
“Heyyyyyyy! Give it back! That belongs to my teacher!! I bought that whole hog barbeque to give to Teacher!”
“!!”
A strange pair was running toward them. One seemed to be a thief, and the other was chasing after the thief.
However, Stevens and Hailey were surprised when they saw who was chasing after the thief.
“W-What the hell? Why is that idiot here?”
“Hugo?”
Hugo didn't realize that they were nearby. He attacked the thief. “Give it back!”
The thief, who looked like a beggar, didn’t want to let go of the barbeque. He curled around the barbeque and started eating it.
“Hey! No! Don’t eat it! I have to give it to my god!”
The thief flinched when he heard this. As if his attempt at eating the meat was completely forgotten, his eyes flashed as he looked at Hugo. “What the hell? You are a worshiper of the Zodiacs?”
His long blonde hair had been hiding his cold blue eyes.
“Die!!!”
“???!!!”
The thief suddenly took out the skewer from the meat and tried to kill Hugo.
Everyone was surprised by the appearance of the thief, who held up the weapon(?).
“Ah…!!!”
Silver magical energy violently flashed from the thief’s body. Moreover, the stigmata of the Virgo temple could be seen on the back of the hand holding the skewer. This man was none other than Kevin Hazard (18).
“What the hell? That thief is the Virgo Saint?!”
Oblivious to their reactions, Kevin tried to attack Hugo. “The gods and their disciples can all die!!”
At that moment…
“What the hell is that maggot doing? He said he was going to go buy meat.”
Hailey was surprised when she heard a familiar voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Book 1, Epilogue 7 - First Love (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 7 - First Love (2)
[Look over there. It’s the princess.]
[Isn’t she the prisoner that our monarch brought back? The one taken from the monarch of Red Flame?]
[Prisoner? No, I heard he brought her in as his daughter.]
[What?]
Hailey Olga Elsteine was the daughter of the Red Flame, who was also called the Red Monarch.
She was also one of the thirteen Knights, who were considered the highest-ranked beings amongst the general-rank monsters.
As one of the thirteen Knights, Hailey had been protecting Red Flame. However, Time had suddenly appeared one day, claiming that he was her father. After defeating Red Flame, he had dragged Hailey away.
Hailey was barely able to retain her life, but she had to put herself into a deep sleep akin to death. She did it in hopes of recovery.
After being dragged away by Time, Hailey’s power of Red Flame had been sealed, and she had dedicated herself to her endless work.
It was around this time that she had met Lee Gun.
When Time no longer had a use for Hailey, he used Hailey as a suicide bomb. He had sent her out to human society to destroy the camps of the other monarchs, who wanted the earth for themselves.
[Someone dares to hang around my territory.]
Earth belonged to Time and his faction. Naturally, he would be pissed when outsiders entered the earth.
In the end, Time’s suicide bomb did its job in destroying the enemies. However, being a general-rank, Hailey didn’t die immediately. But she had lost all her power.
After roaming endlessly, Hailey had fallen over, waiting for her eventual death, when…
“Are you ok, kitty? Are you still alive?”
She met a high school boy. He was a kind and affectionate boy, who was very warm.
“That’s odd. Why is my cat so hell-bent on running away when it’s bath time?”
Of course, the boy was clueless, but Hailey considered those times when she had been the happiest in her life.
She couldn’t reveal what she was, but she always wanted to be with this warm and affectionate boy. However, it didn’t last long.
The underlings of Time had caught wind of her being alive, and they had come close to finding her. Moreover, Lee Gun had started receiving threats from external forces.
“I’m fine, kitty. Don’t worry about me. There was an accidental explosion, and I was caught up in it. I’ll be fine in a couple of days.”
Lee Gun had bandages around his arm, and he spoke about it as if it was no big deal. However, the chance that Lee Gun would get involved in her business as time passed was increasing.
‘I have to leave.’
This was why Hailey had no choice but to leave Lee Gun’s side.
Soon, she had recovered all her power. But she continued to secretly hover around Lee Gun and kill any monster that approached him.
However, such a method eventually met a limitation: the great invasion of the monsters
It was when monsters brought to the earth by Time, Confusion, Abundance, and Abyss had started to eat the humans in earnest.
At that moment, the Zodiac of the Scorpio temple had visited Hailey.
[Oh, young female, become my apostle.]
Why would a god choose someone who wasn’t human? Why would she choose an enemy? It made no sense, but Hailey decided to walk the path of a Zodiac Saint.
At the time, Time had given her an order.
He had said, “Since I am going around different dimensions, I want you to kill the apostles in my stead.”
‘I can protect him better if I become an apostle.’
Lee Gun had a family. If Hailey wanted Lee Gun to achieve happiness, she couldn’t continue to stay next to him and kill monsters one by one.
She thought that instead of a temporary solution, saving human society by getting rid of the monsters at their roots was the better option.
This was why she stayed where Lee Gun couldn’t see her and ignored Time’s order. It was what she had planned…
“What the hell is that maggot doing? He said he was going to buy meat.”
“????”
When she heard the familiar voice, Hailey’s expression was a sight to behold. She wondered if she had heard wrong. However, her heart kept beating harder as Lee Gun came closer.
‘That person is…!’
He was taller than before. His clean-cut hair was now messy, and the skin from his left eye to his cheeks was severely damaged. It was hard to recognize him, but she was certain. He smelled the same.
“Let me through.”
When Lee Gun brushed past Hailey, Hailey almost screamed without realizing it.
It was rare to see Hailey’s expression change, so Stevens was a bit puzzled. “H-Hailey?”
This was unlike the ice princess. Her expression kept fluctuating, which made Stevens worried and anxious. “What’s wrong, Hailey? Are you feeling under the weather?”
Hailey completely ignored Stevens. She didn’t realize it, but she was laughing as her face turned red.
‘It’s him!’
After becoming an apostle, she had secretly visited Lee Gun’s home, but couldn’t find his whereabouts. It had caused her to despair.
‘He is alive…! That’s great…’
However, her happiness lasted only a moment. She suddenly became serious. The reason was Lee Gun’s appearance.
‘Wait a moment. What happened to his face?’
He had such an ugly burn mark on his face that he almost didn’t look human. Moreover, the energy that she could sense from him was…
‘He’s a superhuman?’
She was wondering what had happened when…
[Princess! That’s him. He’s the thirteenth, who we saw before!]
“…!!?”
Hailey was shocked when she heard the voices of her subordinates from her shadow. Thirteenth…! He was the thirteenth?
Hailey’s face froze.
Oblivious to her reaction, Lee Gun approached Hugo. “Hey, maggot. What are you doing? I told you to go buy some food, yet why are you here playing with your friend?”
Hugo, who was pinned under Kevin, lashed out at him. “How can you see this and say that I’m playing with a friend!?”
“Everyone who worships the Zodiacs and the gods can all die!!!”
“Your friend seems to have a bit of an eccentric personality.”
“He isn’t my friend!! Why would a friend of mine try to kill me with a weapon?!”
“You might have borrowed money from him and didn’t pay it back?”
“Teacher!!”
“Did you steal his fiance?”
“Who is that son of a bitch?”
At that moment…
“Koohk!”
Stevens, who had been watching from the side, charged at Kevin. His original goal was to find the Zodiac Saint of the Virgo temple.
Boom!!
Stevens climbed atop the fallen Kevin and activated the power of Leo. The golden light suppressed Kevin’s magical energy. This was possible because they were both apostles.
Stevens’s move had an effect on Kevin. “Hey. Stop it. It seemed the rumors were true. You were the one going around attacking the gods and their worshippers!”
“…? Who the hell are you? Let me go!”
“It’ll be fine. You can come along with oppa!”
The eyes of Kevin, who looked like a skinny wolf girl, flashed when he saw this.
At that moment, Stevens almost suffered a bleeding nose.
“Kuh-huhk!”
After head-butting Stevens’s face, Kevin got up. Despite his small stature, Kevin was very strong.
After being kicked by Kevin, Stevens felt a bit faint.
‘My ribs broke…!’
In terms of fighting skill, Stevens was at the top, but Kevin was terrifyingly powerful enough to make him feel faint.
The whites of his eyes flashed as Kevin went to the nearby fish shop and took out a knife from the stall.
“Let’s all die together as eunuchs!! Dickheads!!”
“??!!”
Kevin aimed for the no-go zone of Hugo and Stevens!
“Ahhk! Where the hell are you aiming that thing?”
“Why are you being like this? We are comrades…!”
“Who says we are comrades? Any idiots who follow gods can all die!”
As soon as Kevin grabbed the knife, his movement changed. As expected of a once-in-a-generation genius, he was confident in using weapons. Even Stevens was close to being overwhelmed by Kevin.
However, that wasn’t the most surprising part.
“What the hell? He is only level one!”
“What?!”
Yes, all the other apostles had reached at least level four.
But the stigmata engraved on the back of Kevin’s hand told them that he was a level one!
“This is crazy! How low is your faith that you’re still a level one?”
“How can a level one produce such power?! This is equivalent to level five— Kuh-huhk!”
Despite being only a level-one Zodiac Saint, Kevin sent the level-five Stevens flying.
Kwah-jeek!
“Kuh-huhk…!”
The ice cream stand was smashed to pieces when Stevens slammed into it.
Stevens desperately yelled, “Hailey! I’m sorry, but can you help us a bit?”
A surprised Hailey extended her hand to catch Kevin.
“?”
However, Lee Gun stared at Hailey with his head tilted in puzzlement, which made Hailey scream. “Kyahhk!!”
Then…
“Kuh-huh-guhk!!”
A whip made out of magical energy, which had extended from Hailey’s hand, hit Stevens instead of Kevin.
Charred like a piece of coal, Stevens opened and closed his mouth as he fainted.
When Stevens fell over, Kevin aimed for Hugo. “You are next!!”
Kevin’s knife was about to slice between Hugo’s legs when…
Bbah-gahk!!!
“?!”
Someone sent Kevin flying.
Kwahng!
The movement was as quick as the speed of light.
It was Lee Gun!
After being kicked in the face, Kevin slammed into a store located across from them.
boom!
Hugo’s mouth fell open.
Kevin was a genius, who was able to react to every minuscule move of Stevens! And someone like that was unable to react at all to Lee Gun’s movements. He was sent flying by a single blow!
“As expected of Teacher…!!” Hugo wailed out loud.
His teacher had saved him. His heart felt so full. “You saved me because I’m your student…! Thank you very much….”
“Why the hell would that bastard eat someone else’s barbeque? Also, he didn’t even think about apologizing to me. He ignored me.”
Ah! Barbeque! Hugo became solemn.
Lee Gun had moved to take revenge on Kevin, who had stolen and eaten his barbeque.
In the end, Hugo shed a tear. “I…It is ok. I’ll buy it again.”
“Damn maggot!”
“Ah! He’s so cool even though he’s ignoring me.”
Lee Gun ignored him as he headed toward Stevens, who was buried under the ice cream stand.
When Stevens saw the shadow, he laughed out loud in a welcoming manner. “Y-You are the civilian who came with Otis? Do you mind helping me get up?”
Bbah-gahk!!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Stevens was kicked by Lee Gun.
“Who the hell are you to destroy the ice cream store that I was about to visit? Hmm?! You want to die?!”
“…?!!”
After being suddenly kicked in the leg by Lee Gun, Stevens felt his consciousness start to fade. It was like being kicked by a monster in the Danger group. This shocked Stevens.
‘Who the hell is he?’
While being beaten all over his body, Stevens yelled at Hugo, “Hey, squirt gun!! Why are you traveling around with a psycho?”
“He isn’t a psycho! He is my teacher!”
“T…Teacher?!”
Stevens wondered what nonsense Hugo was talking about, but Hugo was too busy filming. Lee Gun had beaten a level-five apostle as if he were squashing a cockroach.
“You’re amazing, Thirteenth-nim! You demonstrated each move for me! I will do my best to learn from this…!”
Stevens was shocked.
‘What? He’s the thirteenth?’
That psycho was the thirteenth?
‘Wait a moment… What happened? How can a civilian overwhelm the power of an apostle?’
Lee Gun ignored all of them as he went toward the last person. “Are you an apostle too?”
“…!”
Hailey was surprised by his low voice. His eyes were frosty. They were completely different from the eyes that belonged to the person she had known. There was no warmth in them, only hate and loathing.
Stevens yelled, “Hey! Get the hell away from Hailey! I won’t forgive you if you lay a finger on her!”
Hailey’s eyes shook violently.
‘What happened to him while I was away?’
At that moment, Lee Gun looked at Hailey with a puzzled expression. He suddenly moved his face closer to her.
“!”
Lee Gun sniffed at the side of Hailey’s neck. “Have we met before?”
“W-What?”
“That’s odd. You have a familiar scent.”
“…!!”
Lee Gun was close enough that she could feel his breath. Hailey turned red from head to toe.
“Hail—”
Hailey couldn't take it anymore. She fainted.
Koohng!
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round as he grabbed her without thinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Book 1, Epilogue 8 - First Love (3)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 8 - First Love (3)
Stevens was looking at a madman. No, that person was beyond mad.
“Ahhk!! I’m going to die! I’ll really die! Don’t do it!” Stevens was frightened by the pond filled with boiling lava.
When Stevens did everything he could to avoid going into the lava, Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
“What the hell? Do apostles die if they are dunked in lava?”
“Of course!? Any human would die if you do that!?”
All the apostles that Lee Gun had encountered at Jordan’s marketplace had become his prisoners. The first to be tormented was Stevens.
Since this region had been invaded by monsters, lava ponds of mysterious origin had formed all over here. They were akin to puddles formed after rain.
Of course, these lava ponds couldn’t be compared to puddles. At the very least, they were deep and wide enough to submerge one or two people.
Stevens was in danger of falling into the lava.
“What the hell? I wanted to boil the apostles in the lava to extract magical energy. If what you’re saying is true, you guys are completely useless.”
“Why the hell do you want to boil someone? Why?”
“I’m doing that because he’s fine?”
“!”
Stevens was shocked when he followed Lee Gun’s gaze.
Hugo was letting out a bright smile as he took a bath in the lava. He seemed to be enjoying his lava bath. “It’s great. It’s warm, Stevens-nim. You should hurry up and come in too.”
“No, your face is burning! Your hair is catching fire! Hurry up and get out of there!”
“I can’t. Teacher told me to get in here.”
“Your teacher is a crazy bastard!”
“All words spoken by my teacher are correct.”
“What the hell did he witness that he turned out like this?!”
While Hugo might be the weakest among them, he wasn’t a dope of this magnitude. He wasn’t a fanatic!
Stevens was dumbfounded, but Lee Gun didn’t care. The thirteenth was satisfied to see the light of the Zodiac emanate from the lava.
‘As expected, the Zodiacs send all kinds of stuff to their apostles when the apostles are in great danger.’
Lee Gun smirked when he saw a variety of protection items float around the lava. Since he didn’t have a Zodiac, he was penniless. He possessed no equipment or items.
This was why he planned on tormenting the apostles so that he could steal items from them.
Lee Gun quickly took up a stick with a net attached to it and fished out the equipment. “Ha ha ha! What a catch! I’ll be able to hunt for a month with this! There is a reason I refer to you as my wallet!”
Stevens seethed when he learned Lee Gun’s evil laugh.
Hugo was the apostle of the god of the sun. He had high fire resistance. It was why he dared to take a bath in the lava.
“See! That bastard is using you!” Stevens said.
“Ha ha ha. It doesn’t matter what Teacher says. He’s always right.”
Stevens decided to drop the subject. He was about to run away when he glanced next to Lee Gun.
“I wonder if gods will die if the apostles are killed.”
Stevens saw an enormous slime next to Lee Gun trying to eat the unconscious Hailey. The Leo Saint screamed when he realized he could see only Hailey’s head. “Ahhk! I wondered where she went! Hey! I’ll kill you if you lay a hand on Hailey!”
“What the hell? Do you perhaps like this person? It seems you’re a romantic at heart.”
“Shut up! You are a vicious thief!”
At that moment, Hugo cheekily shouted, “Teacher! Stevens-nim’s sense of smell is his weakness! You can incapacitate him just by using smell!”
“Damn it! Hey, squirt gun! Whose side are you on?”
“Ah! Hailey-nim should have a stimulant mixed with poison for this reason…! That’ll put him down!”
“Fuck off! Do you really think Hailey will sell out her comrade?”
At that moment…
“?!”
Hailey, who had been pretending to be dead, discreetly took out the bottle of poison. It was the poison specifically made for Leo.
Stevens knew this as well, so he had a mental breakdown. “H-Hailey?!!”
“What the hell? You were awake?” Lee Gun stared at Hailey.
Despite her actions, she still pretended to be dead. The only difference was that she was letting out a cold sweat.
Lee Gun approached Hailey. He was already puzzled because of the familiar scent coming from her. Although he couldn’t place it through his memories, he knew this scent steadied him greatly.
However, Hailey fainted as soon as he approached her.
‘Is she sick?’
In the end, Lee Gun tapped Hailey’s shoulder. “Hey, are you listening to me?”
Hailey refused to raise her head and pretended to be dead. She had no plans on matching eyes with him.
This made Lee Gun pout.
‘Is it my face again?’
She didn’t want to see his face at all. Of course, his face had indeed become monstrous. After being awakened, he had surprised many people with his face. It was bad enough that people thought that he was a monster that had escaped from a haunted house.
Well, it didn’t matter.
Kwah-jeek!
Lee Gun stepped on Stevens. “Whatever. Let me ask you a question.”
“Kuhk! Bastard… How dare you… Kuh-huhk!”
Lee Gun glared at him. “In the Seoul invasion from half a year ago, you were scheduled to go there, right?”
“…!”
Stevens’s face froze at the unexpected question. He should have expected it since the thirteenth had awakened during the invasion of Seoul. Of course, they had no idea what had caused his change, but…
‘Is that why he’s hostile toward us…!’
Stevens might be simple-minded, but he wasn’t dumb. It was as he had expected.
“You guys told people to wait for you. Tens of thousands of people waited for you. Why didn’t you come? Your actions caused so many deaths.”
‘As expected, he was one of the civilians there.’
Stevens quickly yelled, “It isn’t that we didn’t go! We couldn’t! When we reached the halfway point, monsters clogged the roads— Kuhk!”
“People donated to you guys so that you could teleport. Why didn’t you use teleportation at that time?”
“The teleportation wouldn’t work!!”
Lee Gun contemptuously smirked. It was a sadistic smile. “Then why did you save the rich people?”
“What? What are you talking about?”
“I’m talking about the rich people in the neighboring country. You said it’s easier to make money by killing monsters in the Caution group in the neighboring country.”
Hugo was shocked. “Stevens-nim! Did you really do that?!”
“No way! I continued to kill monsters at the entrance to Seoul! The business with the neighboring country was carried out by the Cancer temple! I know nothing about that!”
“Cancer temple?” Lee Gun furrowed his brows. Were they the disciples that looked like beggars?
Stevens didn’t care as he showed hostility toward Lee Gun. He ground his teeth. “Anyway, don’t let it get to your head because that idiot took you in as his teacher! We won’t acknowledge your presence! Right, girl from the Virgo temple?”
“Shut up!! Fuck off! I’ll turn all the disciples into eunuchs!”
“Why the hell is she being like this??”
At that moment, Hailey, who had been pretending to be dead, flinched. A large earthquake hit the city, and the city’s buildings fell.
Koo-goo-goo-goong!!
Everyone looked outside in surprise.
The epicenter of the earthquake was a government building. Monsters had suddenly appeared there, and they violently roared as they destroyed the city.
“Ahhhk! The kingdom is under attack!”
“Our king…!”
“Ahhhh! Save us!”
The monsters were destroying not just the government buildings. They also destroyed the buildings where the king resided. It truly was pandemonium.
Thankfully, the Zodiac Saints were present in the city, so they arrived at the epicenter. Of course, Lee Gun was the first one to move when he felt the earthquake. The rest of the Zodiac Saints were able to come only because Hugo had let them go.
Stevens and Kevin huffed in anger when they finally caught up to Lee Gun.
“Why the hell is this bastard so fast?”
“Where is he? I’ll cut open that bastard!!”
“Where did he go—”
At that moment, something suddenly fell from the sky.
Kwah-jee-jee-jeek!!
“?!”
It was the head of a monster that was as big as a building.
This surprised them. The monster’s head had been cut off way too clearly.
“W-Who can do such a…”
Hugo immediately cheered. “Who else? My teacher did it!”
“What? That bastard killed this monster?”
Kevin and Stevens were in disbelief. There was no way it could be true.
“What kind of psycho would take on such a large…”
“I’m telling the truth! There is a reason I consider him my teacher! If I learn battle techniques from Teacher, I’ll be able to stop being the absolute last—”
“Hey, what did you just say?”
“…!?”
A menacing voice that was as cold as ice rang behind Hugo. As Hugo whipped his head around in surprise, Lee Gun roughly squeezed his neck. “You said you wanted to learn the techniques to save people. So what is this? You merely want to get out of being last?”
“!!”
“How dare you lie to me?”
“N…No! It isn’t like that…!”
Lee Gun looked angrier than ever before. He roughly pushed Hugo away. “It’s fine. Buzz off! Never call me Teacher again. If you show your face again in front of me, you’re dead.”
Lee Gun seemed to feel betrayed. He was glaring at Hugo when…
“Ah! Stop it! These monsters aren’t yours to kill!!”
“!”
A group of men ran toward them. Everyone was surprised to see them.
These men were wearing suits, and they looked to be from the government.
“Prime Minister of Jordan?”
The men quickly tried to make Lee Gun’s party leave.
“We already called in the strongest weapon. You will bring us misfortune if you touch them!”
“Strongest weapon?”
Lee Gun scrunched up his face, but unlike him, Stevens did a double-take. “Are you talking about the witch of the east?”
The Gemini Saint Heiji was one of the four apostles who had reached level five. Among the apostles, only she could be called the strongest weapon.
She truly was a living weapon that possessed the world’s most powerful destructive capability.
“What? Those monsters aren’t a big deal to me.”
“!”
A beautiful woman with long hair appeared in the sky. She had a high-voltage smile as she floated. This woman was the strongest weapon of humanity—the witch of the east.
She was an absolute beauty with a sleek look. It was like looking at the top actress in China.
She boasted of having the strongest firepower among the twelve Zodiac Saints. The magician of destruction activated her magic circle.
“I’ll be taking care of the prey here.” Heiji let out a bewitching laugh as she flicked her finger. She used her Fairy King as a medium to activate a powerful magic of destruction.
Koo-goo-goohng!!
Flaming meteors fell from the sky.
As they felt the incredible impact, the politicians who had called her cheered.
“As expected of the strongest weapon, she is on another level than the mercenaries of the other temples— Uh?”
However, their faces turned pale from fright. Heiji’s attack hadn’t worked at all against the monster.
“W-What the hell? Why is it unhurt?”
Heiji was also taken aback. “My attack failed on that monster… What’s going on?!”
“What the hell? Some crazy lady interfered with my work, yet she can’t even scratch it?”
Kevin looked on in shock.
Stevens was surprised as well.
‘She can destroy a country with one attack, yet her attack failed against that monster?’
Heiji kept attacking the turtle-like monster, but it just made the monster destroy the city more violently.
Hailey, who had been watching from the side, was about to step forward when…
Hweek
“!!”
Kevin, Stevens, Hailey, Hugo, and Heiji couldn’t believe their eyes. This was also true for the prime minister, who had invited Heiji.
Like a flying squirrel, Lee Gun surged upward and landed atop the turtle’s head like a feather. Then he swung Heaven’s Punishment and bisected the turtle.
Kwah-gwa-gwa-gwahng!!!
Every single movement of his was inhuman.
This was the incident where the name “Lee Gun” became known to the world for the first time.
The reporters had even forgotten to trigger their cameras.
The Zodiac Saints who had seen it with their own eyes were unable to close their mouths.
“Crazy bastard…”
Stevens, who had refused to acknowledge Lee Gun, had his gaze stolen by him.
This was Hailey’s first time seeing Lee Gun fight, so her face turned red.
“Wow… That hyung is so cool. I might fall for him.”
“He isn’t too bad. I want him to be mine.”
“…!”
Unfortunately, Kevin and the Gemini Saint had also fallen for Lee Gun, so Hailey had to immediately raise her guard.
The Gemini Saint approached Lee Gun.
“I want dibs on him.”
Hailey became desperate.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: Book 1, Epilogue 9 - First Love (4)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 9 - First Love (4)
“What? He’s the thirteenth?”
“His name is Lee Gun?”
“My god! The one we thought was missing or dead was catching monsters all this time?”
“I thought the thirteenth wasn’t an awakened being?”
“How can he not be? He killed those monsters in public! Look at the footage!”
In the summer of 2001, the name “Lee Gun” spread across the world like wildfire.
Until now, the thirteenth was called a mutant and a one-off awakened being. However, things had changed.
- It seems Lee Gun is a proper awakened being like us. His abilities are beyond reproach.
The Leo Saint Stevens, who was famous as the superhuman of the north, gave an interview that surprised the world. The world learned about Lee Gun’s existence through him.
Stevens said,
- The thirteen of us will work for all of humanity. Please call for us. It doesn’t matter where you are. We’ll go there and help you.
- Stevens! Stevens!
- Please cheer for the new thirteenth apostle.
The other apostles started to show great interest in Lee Gun. While the twelve Zodiac Saints were independent, they were united in how they felt as they looked at Lee Gun.
In fact, the Cancer Saint Jean-Louise couldn’t tear his eyes away from the TV despite being very busy.
“He is the thirteenth? That’s interesting.”
It didn’t matter if they were the apostles, countries, or society at large; everyone was interested in Lee Gun.
However, one person found the apostles’ interest in Lee Gun problematic. It was Hailey, and her reaction was understandable.
“Oh. He’s really cool. His face is a bit scary, but he’s bold.”
The Gemini Saint Heiji Grey (25) seemed to fancy Lee Gun. Of course, over half of the twelve Zodiac Saints were men, but none of them had caught her eyes.
Yang Wei was a pig who liked only money. The Cancer Saint was a good-looking man with smarts. However, something was creepy about him. Heiji found him off-putting.
Hugo had a cute face, but he was the weakest. He was like a paper doll.
The Zodiac Saints did have strong men, such as the Taurus Saint and the Leo Saint. However, Heiji found the Taurus Saint narrow-minded and the Leo Saint domineering.
In contrast, although Lee Gun had a ghastly face, she could overlook it since his face bore wounds of honor. Above all else, he was extremely skilled.
“How can I not fall for him when I witnessed how competent he could be?”
Heiji didn’t care if the other person was a woman or a man. She liked someone strong. It didn’t matter if the person was strong of heart, strength, or knowledge.
When she saw Lee Gun, she became sure of it. He possessed the nerve to act without hesitation and excellent judgment that allowed him to move in a way that minimized damage.
Lee Gun possessed the intelligence to discern the weak point of the monsters, and he could kill monsters using the least amount of power possible.
He even had knowledge about anatomy, which allowed him to butcher monsters in one blow! Moreover, he possessed an overwhelming power that tied everything together!
So, Heiji bought two drinks from the beverage stand. Putting on a friendly smile, she then approached him. “Your name is Lee Gun, right? Do you mind having a short conversation with me? I have a question to ask you.”
“You want to ask me something?”
Sparks flew from someone’s eyes when she saw this. It was Hailey, who was hiding next to the beverage stand.
Heiji handed over a beverage to Lee Gun. She was about to drink her beverage when…
Pahng!!
In the blink of an eye, Hailey flicked her finger. It was as if she was shooting something with her fingers.
At the same time, something small shot into Heiji’s beverage cup.
Splash!
However, Hailey had hidden well, so no one noticed what she had done.
As soon as Heiji drank the beverage…
“K…Kuhk…!?”
She clutched her stomach.
“Ah… M…My stomach…!”
The politicians and their bodyguards, who had invited Heiji, reacted in surprise.
“Z-Zodiac Saint-nim!”
“W…We should hurry and take her to the hospital!”
In the end, Heiji was transported away by a black van.
Hailey’s eyes flashed. She had used the Royal skill of the Scorpio temple, Poison Manufacturing, to create a drug and had slipped it into Heiji’s drink.
With this skill, she could make a variety of drugs, ranging from a simple sleeping draft to a poison that could kill a monster with a single drop. The skill allowed her to create any poison that existed in this world.
For Heiji, she had created the “Extra Special Laxative.” It was supposed to be used only on monsters, and Heiji wouldn’t be able to leave the restroom for around three days.
Anyway, Hailey had gotten rid of Heiji. The next person was…!
Hailey’s eyes headed toward her second target. Her gaze landed on Kevin.
Kevin was stuck close to Lee Gun. To be precise, Kevin was hanging onto the enormous Heaven’s Punishment, which Lee Gun was holding over his shoulder.
Anyway, Kevin looked like a koala. He had taken such a fancy to Lee Gun that it seemed as if a spirit were haunting Lee Gun.
Lee Gun shook Heaven’s Punishment in annoyance, but the koala-like Kevin refused to fall off.
At this time, Kevin was 162 cm tall and skinny. He really was bite-sized. Despite this physique, Kevin was very strong. He was like an immovable rock if one tried to push him away.
In the end, Stevens couldn't watch it any longer. He came over to peel Kevin off Lee Gun. “Stop being an inconvenience to him! I came here for you! Let’s go!”
To pull Kevin off, Stevens had to use a significant amount of power. “Damn it! She’s small as a mouse, so why is she so strong? Hey! Get down from— Ahhhk!! That bitch bit me!!”
Stevens became angry when Kevin drew blood from his hand. “Hey, why the hell do you act as if you’re a wolf? You’re only a small girl!”
“Why the hell do you keep saying that, idiot?”
“Ahhhk!!”
The angry wolf boy bit Stevens’s arm again. “I’m not a girl!”
“?!!”
Stevens, as well as the other Zodiac Saints gathered there, were surprised. Hailey, who had been hiding near the beverage stand, also blinked.
Stevens scoffed. “Are you playing with me? Why would the Virgo Saint be a dude?”
These words pissed off Kevin. He climbed down from Heaven’s Punishment and grabbed Stevens’s arm. “If you don’t believe me, you can check it yourself, you muscle-brained idiot!”
“??!!” Stevens despaired when he felt something he didn’t want to touch. “This is crazy!! Why do you have that between your legs?”
“!”
The others were shocked too.
“Why would the Virgo Saint be a male?”
“I-Is such a thing possible?”
According to the Zodiacs, they picked the apostles based on how well the apostles got along with the Zodiacs.
Virgo was a cruel goddess who didn’t allow men to approach her. Men were forbidden from becoming disciples of the Virgo temple, so why???
At that moment, Leo spoke to Stevens, who was having a mental breakdown.
[If he’s male, he’s extremely lucky! All the Constructs of the Virgo temple are women!]
In fact, they were all beautiful, and they were very capable. This was why the other gods coveted the Constructs of the Virgo temple.
[He’ll be surrounded by goddesses. They’ll serve him.]
It seemed Hugo had heard something similar from Sagittarius. His mouth fell open.
“He’ll be surrounded by goddesses….”
“They’ll serve him….”
They were incredibly jealous of Kevin. However, this also brought up a question. It was something they couldn’t understand.
“Ahhk! They can all die! Both the Zodiacs and the Zodiac Saints can die!”
“He was blessed. So why is he acting this way?”
“I have no idea. If possible, I would love to switch Zodiacs with him.”
When Hugo pouted, both Sagittarius and Kevin became angry.
“Blessed? Did you say I was blessed?”
“?”
Kevin looked aggrieved. He grabbed Hugo by the collar of his shirt, and one could feel the urgency in his eyes.
“Do you know this?? The Zodiacs are psychopaths. I was about to spend my first night as a man when Virgo suddenly kidnapped me. She said I have to maintain my virginity for the rest of my life! In fact, she said I can’t even hold hands with the opposite sex!!! If I go against that rule, she’ll make me die through sickness!”
“…!?”
“Moreover, my sex changes if I use her abilities! So why did she choose me? She said my looks were to her taste!” Kevin was about to spit fire from his mouth. “Die!!! Die Zodiacs!!”
Lee Gun, Hugo, and Stevens finally understood why Kevin had turned out like this.
Hugo and Stevens had also been chosen for some of the flimsiest reasons.
‘You looked the best among the bunch.’
‘You look like you’ll be able to debone fishes the best.’
They felt a weird sense of kinship with Kevin. Kevin was still young, yet he would not even be able to hold the hand of the opposite sex. They truly felt pity for him.
‘Since it’s a stipulation made by Virgo…’
Each of the apostles followed their own god, and each of them had things they were forbidden from doing. They would not want such a ban placed on them.
Lee Gun was hostile against all the apostles, so he didn’t show any signs of going easy on Kevin. In fact, Kevin had tried to turn all of them into fellow(?) eunuchs, so Lee Gun glared at him.
Of course, Kevin no longer attacked him, but he had attacked him before. However…
“I’ll cut him some slack.”
“?!!”
In the end, Lee Gun turned around as if he was disinterested.
This made Stevens aggrieved. “You tried to stick me into the lava. Why not him?”
“He’s basically a eunuch.”
“??!!”
Dumbfounded, Stevens turned to look at the hostile Kevin. “What about you? Why leave him alone? You said you’ll make all the apostles be like you!”
“It’s fine. He’s already like me. He looks like someone who’ll never get laid.”
Lee Gun, who had been walking away indifferently, suddenly came to a stop. Then he coldly turned his head. “What did you just say?”
“There is your face, but I can also tell that you’ve never dated before.”
Lee Gun felt a surge of anger. Kevin was right. Yet Lee Gun got furious for some reason. “I’m not someone who’s forever alone! I have experience!!” Lee Gun threw aside Kevin.
His statement surprised Hailey, and Kevin, who had been thrown aside, looked stunned.
“You aren’t? Really?” he said.
Hailey’s ears perked up when she realized that Lee Gun might be talking about his ex.
Of course, Lee Gun was bluffing, but Kevin was too young to realize this. His mouth fell open. He had developed respect for Lee Gun as a whole package.
“Hyung! I’ll serve you as my teacher!”
Another rival had appeared for Hailey and Hugo.
* * *
Several days later, in Greece…
“Teacher!!”
Lee Gun had traveled through the land to reach the coast, and he was scrunching up his face. The reason was Hugo, who was chasing after him.
“Teacher— Kuh-huhk!”
“I told you not to show yourself in front of me. I said I’ll kill you if you do.”
“I…It isn’t what you think!” Hugo felt aggrieved. He wanted to resolve the misunderstanding between them.
But as soon as he approached Lee Gun, an attack came flying toward him.
Kwah-jeek!
“!?”
The attack had come from above the tree!
“That bastard…!” Hugo was surprised. The one sitting atop the tree like a sloth was Kevin.
“Don’t get close to Hyung, asshole.”
“W…Why is he here… Ahhk!” Hugo was busy dodging the attacks.
He was truly in danger, but then…
“Come here!”
“!”
Someone hiding in the bushes yanked Hugo toward her.
“!”
It was none other than Hailey.
“That was dangerous.”
Hugo was surprised.
“Why are you here, Hailey-nim? I thought you were going north.”
“Why else? I…”
“Ah! Could it be? You also came chasing after Teacher…”
Those words startled Hailey, and her face turned red. “No! It isn’t like that!”
At that moment, a young man appeared in front of Lee Gun. “Please buy this, Hyung.”
“!”
His name was Lee Jaewon (16). In the distant future, he would become the general of the Sagittarius temple, but currently, he was a swindler.

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Book 1, Epilogue 10 - It is mine (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 10 - It is mine (1)
- It seems Lee Gun is a proper awakened being like us. His abilities are beyond reproach.
- Please cheer for the new thirteenth apostle.
Notre-Dame de Paris, France.
In the future, the territories of France and Western Europe would be taken over by the Virgo temple, but currently, the Saintess of the Aquarius temple occupied those locations.
The Taurus Saint Ivan was inside this cathedral, grinding his teeth. It was for no other reason.
- The thirteenth is the new superhuman acknowledged by the Leo Saint!
- The thirteenth’s name is “Lee Gun”! Mr. Lee Gun has become the hope of humanity!
- Waaaaaaaaaaa!
Ivan was watching the DMB (Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) on his phone.
He was angered by Stevens’s interview and the news coverage around this topic.
“Why did you do something unnecessary?”
