“What do you mean?” Taken aback, Stevens looked at Ivan. He had come to the cathedral to give a report, yet Ivan suddenly came at him as if he wanted to kill him.
An enraged Ivan threw the DMB toward Stevens. “Why would you acknowledge that mutant as our peer?!”
“What’s the problem? He’s a great fighter.”
This time Ivan was surprised. “Are you kidding me? That bastard doesn't even have a Zodiac! He’s a fake, so how can he be called an apostle?”
“Who cares about that?”
“What?”
Stevens snorted. “Humanity is in pain right now. Who cares about his origins? It’s great to have a reliable ally. Am I wrong?”
“Hmmph. You’re an idiot who can’t comprehend what’s going on!”
“What the hell? Are you afraid of him?”
“…?!”
Stevens let out a vicious laugh as he approached Ivan. “Is it because he broke your air of superiority? Isn’t that why you are acting weak and afraid right now?”
“…!!” Ivan felt an unbelievable amount of humiliation, so he immediately released his magical energy.
Ivan extended his hand, aiming to kill Stevens. “You are an idiot who is useless without a weapon!”
“Shut up! At the end of the day, you’re only good at being a meat shield!”
The main fighters of the Zodiac Saints were about to use their power. They were getting ready to rip into each other.
“Stop! What are you doing in the royal palace of a god?!”
“…!”
The two men flinched at Sophie’s sharp words. They broke apart. This cathedral was considered a base for the Zodiac Saints. The Zodiac Saints were spread out across the world, so they gathered here if there was a need to.
Sophie always resided here and provided any resources the others needed. She also acted as a middleman if the Zodiac Saints wanted to contact each other.
Sophie tried to mediate a resolution between the two Zodiac Saints.
Ivan ground his teeth as he glared at Stevens. “You are acting high and mighty right now. However, will you be fine if you and your Zodiac aren’t given the proper due because of that Lee Gun?”
Steven furrowed his brows as if Ivan wasn’t even worth talking to. “I'm glad there is someone strong enough who’ll make me want to chase after him. It’ll allow me to become stronger.”
“…!” Ivan gritted his teeth.
Stevens didn’t even want to bother dealing with Ivan. “I get why you’re on edge. You reached your highest level, yet the number of monsters that you can’t defeat is increasing. Anyway, it’s ridiculous to cut down someone excellent because you have an inferiority complex.”
Those words had Ivan glare at Stevens. “Alright. Let’s see how long you’ll be able to say such words.”
“What? Do you plan on getting rid of Lee Gun? It’ll be impossible for you. He is incredibly strong.”
“!”
“Also, he won’t take it lying down if you try to kill him.”
Stevens’s carefree laughter made poison appear in Ivan’s heart.
* * *
“Please buy this, Hyung.”
“!”
On a forest trail that branched off from the road heading into the city, Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when a young teen appeared in front of him.
The teen before him looked like a wanderer. However, he was too dirty and beggar-like to be one of the gypsies who lived in this region. That wasn’t all.
‘Asian?’
His exact nationality couldn’t be pinpointed, but he didn’t look like a native. Of course, that wasn’t important right now.
‘What does he want me to buy?’
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he saw the item being pushed toward him.
Zzuhk!
The slime, who had been riding on top of Lee Gun’s head, tried to eat the star candy that the teen had pushed forward.
The slime was a mutant that Lee Gun had created when he was trying to create a shampoo to prevent his hair loss.
A surprised Lee Gun quickly pulled back on the slime. “Hey. You have no idea what that is. You shouldn’t eat it.”
Of course, the slime never ate something that didn't look appetizing.
“Hey!! That’s a health-recovery item!” Hugo’s shout could be heard from a distance.
Hearing Hugo’s voice, Lee Gun glared at him for refusing to go away. However, that wasn’t important right now. “Health-recovery item?”
Lee Jaewon let out a bright smile when he heard this. He pushed the star candy toward him. “Yes! You guys are apostles, right? I thought this might be of help to you…!”
Lee Gun could clearly feel powerful magical energy emanating from the candy. He wondered why such a kid would have this item.
“Some parts of a monster’s corpse are helpful in recovering health!” Hugo brought out his wallet as if he had hit the jackpot. “If those parts are used, they can create a substance that accelerates one’s health recovery. The saintess told everyone to gather those parts and sell them…!”
“Right. I worked very hard to gather the ingredients to make this. This item has a thousand condensates in it, so it should be very effective.”
“Oh! There are over a thousand in it! I’ll buy it all for you, Teacher! I can guarantee its effectiveness! When I ate one with a hundred condensates, I was able to fight without sleeping for three days!” Hugo tried to approach Lee Gun, but…
“Ahhk!!”
He screamed when an attack came from the tree. “Ah! Really!”
Kevin had used the tree’s fruit as a projectile. His eyes flashed. “Go away! I’ll buy it for Teacher.”
“What?”
“That’s why you should buzz off, you weakling!”
Kevin took up a blade and tried to attack Hugo. This spurred Hailey to make an appearance.
Everyone thought that she was trying to save Hugo, but unexpectedly, she took out her wallet. “I’ll buy them all.”
“H…Hailey-nim?!”
It seemed she planned on giving them to Lee Gun.
Kevin became angry as he looked at Hailey. “Hey, why are you getting in my way?”
Hailey gave him a side eye. In truth, he was one of the reasons she had followed Lee Gun.
‘The Gemini Saint will be hovering between life and death in the restroom for the near future.’
That meant only Kevin was left. She had no reason to be worried about Kevin since he was male, but…
Hailey didn’t want Kevin close to Lee Gun for another reason.
Flash!
In the end, an angry Kevin instinctively used his magical energy.
Hailey flinched.
Whenever Kevin used his magical energy, he would turn into a gorgeous girl. Currently, Kevin didn’t have much control over his power. So it didn’t take much for him to change into the sex that his Zodiac preferred.
Moreover, his Zodiac was mischievous. She made it so that most guys would fall for Kevin’s looks.
This was why Hailey had come to clean out the trash(?) in Kevin.
In this current company, she was the only one who had seen Kevin’s female face!
‘Damn it! Before he sees Kevin, I have to…!’
There was malice(?) within Hailey as she tried to send Kevin into a different time-space.
“I won’t buy those items. Also, I want you to come here, blondie,” Lee Gun said.
Thinking that Lee Gun was calling for him, Hugo approached him as if he were a dog.
However, Lee Gun menacingly said, “Not you!”
“I’m also a blonde…!!”
Lee Gun kicked Hugo, then stroked Kevin’s head as if he found Kevin cute.
Hugo couldn’t believe this. He felt aggrieved. He had also served Lee Gun, so why was he treated differently? Also, why was Lee Gun cutting Kevin slack when Kevin was shadowing him?
“I had to endure so much hardship…”
At that moment, Hugo felt a chill run up his spine as he looked at Kevin and Lee Gun. It was to be expected since Hugo could see something.
‘T-Teacher is stealing his magical energy!’
Lee Gun was pretending to pet Kevin as he sucked magical energy out of Kevin!
Of course, Kevin was oblivious to this. He was just happy to be accepted.
At that moment, was it because Lee Gun had sucked Kevin dry of magical energy?
“Teacher! I’ll go buy some food— Kuhk!!!”
Bbah-gahk!
After being done with Kevin, Lee Gun kicked Kevin over the cliff.
“Oooh-ahhhhhhhh!!!”
Kevin felt toward the bottom of the cliff.
Lee Gun then dusted off his hands. “I’m pretty sure he won’t die.”
Hugo’s mouth fell open.
As if he were done with his business, Lee Gun turned to Lee Jaewon. “I want to buy the magical energy version of the item from before. Show me—”
However, Lee Gun was surprised. “What the hell? Where did he go?”
Something was even more surprising.
“Ahhk!! What the hell? Where’s my wallet?”
Hugo had planned on settling the account when he started to search his pockets.
Lee Gun also reflexively checked his waist.
‘My belongings are gone too.’
At that moment, Hailey became surprised as she looked at the star candy that had fallen to the floor.
“Wait a moment. That kid was trying to sell us a fake item.”
“What?!”
It was obvious who the thief was.
* * *
In an empty storehouse hidden on the outskirts of the city…
“Hey, why the hell would you bring such items?”
Lee Jaewon groaned as items were thrown in his face.
A lot of gang members who looked like they were bad news were standing in front of him. Then they started beating him up.
“At the very least, you should have brought us the holy items of the Zodiac Saints! We sent you because we got the news that they were nearby!”
“Why the hell do you think these herbs will be of help to us?”
“It’s pretty obvious you failed, so you probably picked up whatever was nearby!”
Lee Jaewon was beaten to a bloody pulp as he fell over.
“Damn it! Do you realize how much people pay for items of the Zodiac Saints?!”
“Useless bastard! You’ll receive no food today!”
At the same time, they became anxious. They had planned to steal the items of the other Zodiac Saints as they had promised to send them to the Cancer Saint Jean-Louise. The reason they had made that promise was Lee Jaewon.
That kid had been nearby when the Zodiacs had descended on the earth, and he had acquired a power by luck.
He wasn’t an awakened being, but in terms of sensing someone’s presence, his ability was monstrous.
- You’ll get the occasion to use him.
The Cancer Saint Jean-Louis had spoken those words as he had tossed this kid to them.
“What should we do? At this rate, we’ll be…”
“We have no choice. We’ll use this kid to lure in the Zodiac Saints.”
“Yes. The Zodiac Saints won’t be able to stay back if they see a kid about to get eaten by a monster.”
The men grabbed Lee Jaewon’s legs.
Lee Jaewon violently shook as he desperately tried to run away.
‘Damn it! I’ll be thrown to a monster!’
He’d suffer the same fate as the others.
‘Please! Anyone…! Please save me…!!’
“While apostles might be idiot pushovers, it doesn’t mean I’ll help a pickpocket.”
“?!”
A voice suddenly rang out.
The surprise of the gang members lasted only a moment as the ceiling caved in.
Crunch!
They screamed as they were crushed by the ceiling.
“Ahhhhk!!”
Lee Jaewon was surprised. The ceiling of the storage room had been destroyed, and sunlight came through the gaps.
Then Lee Gun appeared in front of Lee Jaewon as a sublime golden light shone on him. Lee Jaewon was unable to look away from Lee Gun.
‘He is like a god.’
Then…
“Kuhk!”
“How dare you steal my bag? You’re asking for a beating.”
It was unclear if he was a hero or a calamity. The man grabbed Lee Jaewon.

chapters.title: Chapter 458: Book 1, Epilogue 11 - It is mine (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 11 - It is mine (2)
“Ah! He isn’t like a god. Let me take that back.”
Lee Jaewon was appalled. The sight unfolding in front of his eyes was a scene of torture. It was something he couldn’t see with his eyes open.
“Ahhhk! Stop!”
“Kuh-huhk!! Help!”
Hung backward on their feet, the gang members were being beaten in front of the young Lee Jaewon. They were the ones who had tormented him.
Of course, they weren’t being brought to justice because they had used a child for their work. Moreover, the one beating them to death was none other than the hero…
Lee Jaewon was sure it was the hero Lee Gun, who had appeared in the news a day or two ago. He was supposed to be the new hope who’d save humanity.
“Ha ha ha! Give me your money, idiots!”
“…I really want to take back my statement. He isn’t like a god.” Lee Jaewon’s face turned pale from fright, and he averted his gaze.
Lee Gun ignored Lee Jaewon as he kept kicking the men hanging upside down. He also took the healthy recovery items from them. Some items that shouldn’t be in their possession also came out.
“Wow! Why the hell do you guys have drugs and nudie magazines?”
“Ahhk!!”
“Also, your tastes are terrible! I’m confiscating these!”
“No!”
In the end, Lee Jaewon realized that he had gotten caught up with someone crazy. Avoiding Lee Gun’s gaze, he tried to secretly exit the storeroom.
‘I already emptied this gang’s safe a long time ago.’
Today had been the last day he would do this work, and he had already been planning on running away. However, he had been caught by Lee Gun of all people.
‘I can still get out of this.’
Currently, Lee Gun’s attention was occupied somewhere else. It was a great opportunity to run away.
Lee Jaewon was about to secretly leave when…
Kwahk!
“!?”
A noose-shaped rope flew toward Lee Jaewon and caught him.
“Where do you think you are going?”
“Kuhk!!”
The Sagittarius temple was a temple of hunting. In terms of tracking down and capturing their prey, they never missed.
After stealing as much as he could from the gang members, Lee Gun looked at Hugo. He furrowed his brows. “Why are you dragging in that dirty kid? He’s no longer of use to me.”
“He isn’t useless to me! Teacher, you might have recovered your items, but I haven’t!”
“Ah! You said he stole your wallet.”
“Anyway, this kid took my money! I need it back! Give it back to me!”
Lee Jaewon, who had been caught by Hugo, snorted. “How much time do you think has passed since I stole it? I sold it a long time ago. Also, you had only thirty dollars there.”
The wallet had been a named brand, so he had sold it for a decent price.
Hugo grabbed Lee Jaewon by the collar. “How dare you sell that! Even when I had to sell the items in my house, that was one of the few items I kept for myself until the end!”
“You should have taken good care of it then…”
“What the hell did you just say?”
When Hugo despaired, Lee Gun smirked. “Right. You brought it on yourself. If you didn’t want it stolen, you should’ve kept a better eye on it. That’s why you’re a pushover…”
“Master’s precious ID is in there too!!”
“??!!!”
Lee Gun, who had been laughing in derision, turned his head. After checking his empty wallet, he grabbed Lee Jaewon by the collar. “You little shit! Why the hell would you steal the wallet of someone who did nothing?”
Lee Jaewon was choking.
At the same time, Lee Gun grabbed Hugo by his collar. “You want to die! Why would you have my ID in your possession?”
“Teacher, you entrusted it to me! You said to stop annoying you and waking you up!”
Lee Gun flinched. Before he had gotten into a fight with Hugo, he had drunk alcohol. That night, he had been in a good mood as he slept. However, Hugo annoyingly kept trying to wake him up to confirm a reservation. So Lee Gun had given his ID to him.
Lee Gun glared at Lee Jaewon. “You have a bad habit of stealing things, kid?”
Lee Jaewon clicked his tongue as if he didn’t know what the problem was. “You can get your ID reissued.”
Sparks of anger flew in Lee Gun’s eyes. The issue wasn’t getting it reissued. The ID that had been stolen was unique.
- Hyung! I put this on there!
It had photo stickers on it that the three of them had taken. One of them was a picture Lee Gun had taken with only Yeonwoo. The other one had all three of them. These were the only pictures Lee Gun had left of Yeonwoo and Junwoo.
Junwoo had told him to never lose the stickers. That was why Lee Gun had put the stickers on the back of his ID.
Lee Gun shook Lee Jaewon by the neck as he tried to kill(?) him. “Tell me right now where you sold it, you little shit!”
Lee Jaewon immediately smiled. “If you let me go, I can guide you to— Ahhk!”
Lee Gun grabbed the small face of the impertinent Lee Jaewon. “Did you think I didn’t know about your ghost-like ability to hide? I know you will run away if I do that."
“Uh! Is that true?” Hugo asked.
“Idiot. Why do you think this kid was able to steal from us?”
“!”
They weren’t normal people; they were superhumans who possessed senses far more developed than that of regular humans.
However, Lee Jaewon didn’t possess the scent of a human. It was as if he was dead.
Lee Gun didn’t know the reason for that, but he was having a hard time sensing Lee Jaewon’s presence.
Lee Jaewon’s expression darkened slightly. An odd sense of murderous intent flashed in his eyes.
However, Lee Gun didn’t care as he dragged him away. “Whatever. Just tell me where you sold it. After I get the wallet back, I’ll hand you over to the police.”
Suddenly…
Hweek!
Something flew down in an arc and descended on the ground.
Hugo was surprised to see the item. “Ah! It’s my wallet!!! My money is still in there!”
“!”
Both Lee Jaewon and Lee Gun were surprised.
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he looked at where the wallet had come from. The one to throw the wallet was Hailey. It seemed she had recovered the wallet for them.
However, Hailey had pressed a hat over her face, and she pretended as if she wasn’t the one who had thrown the wallet. She pretended to look at a statue.
Of course, she had disguised herself so that she wouldn’t be found out by Lee Gun. She did her best to pretend to be doing something else, but she couldn’t dodge Lee Gun’s gaze.
This puzzled Lee Gun.
‘Why does she keep following me around?’
He couldn’t feel any hostility from her, so he had been letting it slide.
When Hailey met eyes with Lee Gun, she jumped in surprise. Then she started wiping the sculpture of a fat man.
Dumbfounded, Lee Gun shook his head from side to side.
‘I guess it doesn’t matter.’
“Anyway, it’s fine since we found the wallet. Since your money is still there, my ID should be in there too…”
“It isn’t! The only thing missing is your ID, Teacher!”
“What the hell did you just say?!”
“Uh?? Why is there more money than before??”
Flames erupted from Lee Gun’s mouth as he choked Lee Jaewon around his throat. “Bastard! I should sell your organs as recompense!”
“!!”
An angry Lee Gun was about to drag away Lee Jaewon when…
“Leave that kid alone.”
“!!!”
Lee Gun was annoyed to hear an unfamiliar voice.
Lee Jaewon froze.
The one to suddenly appear before them was a young man in his twenties. He was Jean-Louis Morin (26). Clad in a fancy suit, he laughed as he looked at Lee Gun.
Lee Gun scrunched up his face. “Who the hell is that weasley bastard?”
“Ah! He’s Mr. Jean-Louis. He’s an apostle like us! He’s the Cancer temple’s…!”
“What? The Cancer Saint that I know doesn’t look that young?”
“Ah! He sends out a stand-in to the media…”
It didn’t matter in the end.
Lee Gun glared at Jean-Louis. It was to be expected because of what he had heard from Stevens.
During the Seoul invasion, Jean-Louis had said he would come there, yet he had shamelessly left behind the others. He had gone to the country next to Korea to save the rich.
He might have a part in how that incident turned out, so Lee Gun naturally didn’t look kindly toward him.
On the other hand, Jean-Louis let out a big smile as if he had only good intent toward Lee Gun. “It’s nice to meet you for the first time, Thirteenth-nim. I have no thoughts or plans to make you my enemy. Please do not be so guarded toward me.”
At the time, Jean-Louis didn’t know anything about Lee Gun. He had come here under orders. So he had no ill feelings toward Lee Gun.
‘He’s a talent that might be able to help us.’
He tried to become friendly with Lee Gun. “I’m sorry if that child caused you trouble! I’ll apologize in his stead. I’ll give you plenty of recompense for your trouble, and I’ll take care of the clean-up too. Please hand him over.”
When Jean-Louis moved closer, Lee Jaewon started trembling. At the same time, it felt as if Jean-Louis’s voice was falling on the shoulders of Lee Jaewon.
“Hey, kid. I know you want to make some money, but you shouldn’t do something illegal like this. Right?”
A cold murderous intent was infused within his words.
Lee Jaewon shook in fear before Jean-Louis’s presence. Of course, he knew what this man meant.
- I told you to make me some money. You put me in a difficult situation by being caught.
The incredible fear made him reflexively try to grab the clothes of Hugo and Lee Gun. However, he soon gave up.
In the end, Jean-Louis was about to drag away Lee Jaewon.
“No! I won’t let you take him. I need this kid to find Teacher’s ID.”
When Hugo pulled Lee Jaewon toward him, an annoying look appeared on Jean-Louis’s face.
“I wondered where you ran away. It seems you were here. I didn’t notice your presence because you’re so weak.”
Hugo felt a surge of anger, but Jean-Louis smirked in contempt.
“Stop being so nosy. You should focus on your own affairs. You have to hurry up and become a level five.”
“!”
“If you want a position in a government, you have to quickly join the same rank as us. You’re the only one who wasn’t able to acquire a spot. If you take too long, they’ll all be taken.”
“…?”
Lee Gun glared at Hugo. He was asking if this was true.
Hugo was about to deny it when…
“That’s odd. It just seems like yesterday when you ran away because you were anxious about it. Ah! Is that why you asked Thirteenth-nim to take you under his wings, since you’re the lowest-ranked?”
Lee Gun looked fed up as he turned around. Of course, it wasn’t as if he trusted what the Cancer Saint was saying, but…
“You bastards are mad about money and political power.”
Flustered, Hugo tried to grab Lee Gun. “No! You keep misunderstanding my intentions from before! It really isn’t like that! I just want to save people…!”
Lee Gun scoffed in disbelief. “Is that so?”
“Yes!”
“Then you should try saving him too.” Lee Gun immediately threw Lee Jaewon off the cliff.
Lee Jaewon screamed as he fell. At the bottom of this cliff was an enormous lake of poison capable of killing even an apostle in short order!
Jean-Louis was surprised by this, but he soon smiled. It didn’t matter since Lee Jaewon didn’t have any parents who would miss his absence. The kid was merely a little thief.
“Thank you for taking care of him. That’s one annoying task I don’t have to do.”
Lee Gun looked at Jean-Louis in contempt. “I should have expected this from you guys.”
He then turned to look at Hugo. “Anyway, you should—”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round. “Where the hell did he go??”
“Ahhhhh! Look out!!”
“?!”
Lee Gun was shocked to hear the sound coming from the base of the cliff. He had no idea what Hugo was banking on, but the Archer Saint had jumped off the cliff to catch Lee Jaewon.
Therefore, a shocked Lee Gun also jumped off the cliff. When he kicked the surface, he moved at a speed greater than that of a missile.
He overtook Hugo in a flash. His enormous power destroyed the surface and created wind pressure.
Kwahng!!
It truly was a speed that couldn’t be achieved by a human.
Jean-Louis’s eyes turned round as he watched this. Lee Gun grabbed Hugo and threw him toward a tree.
Kwahng!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Ruthlessly thrown to the side, Hugo collided with a tree vine. His back almost folded. “Kuh-kuhk! M-My back!!”
Lee Gun landed next to him and hit him on the head. “You’ve lost your mind!”
“Kuh-huhk!! Please stop! I just acted on reflex. If you continue to hit me, I’ll die— Kuhk!”
“Why the hell would you jump off the cliff?”
“Then why would you try to kill an innocent kid?”
“Idiot! I didn’t kill him!” Lee Gun pointed downward.
Hugo was shocked when he looked below. The slime had turned into an enormous ball, and he was bouncing Lee Jaewon up and down on its body.
It seemed Lee Gun had done this to find out what kind of person Jean-Louis was. However…
“Why the hell would you jump off? If you die, you won’t be able to receive a spot in the government!”
“I’m really not interested in that! It’s true that I want to win against the other apostles, but if I become strong, I’ll be able to make my voice be heard…!”
“Voice?”
“I’m the weakest right now, so no one listens to what I have to say. I protested when they said we should abandon the hostages… However, they said I was acting sanctimonious and treated me as if I were a sandbag…”
Only if he became stronger could he make his voice be heard.
An odd look entered Lee Gun’s eyes as gazed at Hugo. He seemed to have taken a liking to Hugo.
Lee Gun didn’t say anything as he took the two young men and ran up the cliff. “That weasel ran away.”
At that moment…
“!”
Lee Jaewon, whom they had assumed to be unconscious, took out something. He didn’t say anything. It was none other than Lee Gun’s ID.
“Ah!”
Lee Gun’s face was almost erased from the ID, but it still had the sticker.
It seemed Lee Jaewon had seen the picture and was unable to bring himself to get rid of it.
“Thank you, and I’m sorry!”
After taking back the ID, Lee Gun didn’t say anything. He hit Lee Jaewon’s head, making him unconscious.
Lee Gun then turned to Hugo. “Hey, maggot. I want you to bring me what I ask starting tomorrow.”
“What?”
“I’ll help you escape your title of the weakest.”
“…!”
While this would allow Hugo to become the highest-ranked fighter, it was the moment when the road to hell had opened for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 459: Book 1, Epilogue 12 - Pushover Maker (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 12 - Pushover Maker (1)
“Hmm. This is baffling!”
Watching the scene before him, Lee Gun furrowed his brows. He looked at Hugo as if Hugo were pathetic.
In the end, Lee Gun let out a long sigh. “Are you an idiot? Why can’t you do this?”
Those words made Hugo aggrieved. “Ahhk! Of course, I can’t do this!! How do you expect me to shoot a person?”
Hugo was practicing archery, but his target wasn’t an object; it was a human, a sixteen-year-old kid!
Hugo expressed his anger at the target. “Hey, Jaewon! Why did you agree to become the target? Have you lost your mind?!”
Lee Jaewon tilted his head in puzzlement as if Hugo was talking nonsense. “I’m not the target. It’s the apple on my head!”
“Tomato-tomahto!”
Unable to take it anymore, Hugo looked at Lee Gun. “Teacher! Shooting a living target like this is too dangerous!”
“Why? I’ve seen other sharpshooters snipe an apple.”
“No! You saw them in movies! Also, what do you think the distance is? It has to be at least several hundred meters!”
“You can't do it? I thought you were called the Divine Archer. That means you aren’t an archer with perfect marksmanship?”
“He’s right. Why can't you hit it? Are you an idiot or something?”
“Hey, Lee Jaewon!! You shouldn’t be saying that! The normal thing to do is to run away!”
“No, I’m fine. Lee Gun-nim will compensate me. Each arrow will net me a million won. He said he’d give the money out of Hugo-nim’s pocket.”
“Hey!!” Hugo ground his teeth.
Lee Jaewon was someone who Lee Gun had determined would prove useful. This was why they had started taking Lee Jaewon everywhere.
Of course, Lee Jaewon was a regular human, so they hadn’t planned on bringing him along to dangerous locations.
‘However, monsters can’t sense Jaewon’s presence.’
They had wondered why this was the case, but the answer was quite simple.
‘He said that while running away from a site of monster subjugation, he accidentally brushed against the magical energy of Cancer.’
Lee Jaewon was the reason everyone thought the thirteenth was born in the same fashion.
It was why Jean-Louis had been interested in Lee Jaewon and was growing him as a thief.
However, Lee Jaewon wasn’t like the superhumans, who had awakened completely. He was a normal human with extraordinary senses.
It was why Lee Gun thought Lee Jaewon would be useful to him.
‘I heard you became orphaned after following your parents on a business trip. You can help us by working as our porter. We’ll feed you if you’re willing to do that.’
Hugo had been moved when he had seen that side of Lee Gun, but now…
“What kind of target is that?! Give me a proper target! This is too dangerous...”
Annoyed by his words, Lee Gun took Hugo’s bow. He aimed toward Lee Jaewon as if it wasn’t a big deal and shot an arrow.
Shweeng!!
There was zero hesitation.
The next instant, the arrow destroyed the apple on top of Lee Jaewon’s head.
Poo-oohk!!
Both Lee Jaewon and Hugo were surprised.
“H-He hit it?”
Lee Gun tossed the bow back to a surprised Hugo and said, “At this distance, his safety is guaranteed. You can do this, right? Hurry up and shoot.”
Hugo despaired. He wailed as he pounded his fist on the ground. “Damn it! He’s so cool… No, it’s dangerous to shoot at a human… Teacher is a close-range fighter, so why is he so good at shooting an arrow… No, it’s still dangerous… As expected of Teacher…!!!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he watched Hugo.
‘Something is off.’
When he had tested him, Hugo’s stats weren’t that bad. Although they were terrible as per Lee Gun’s standards…
‘They aren’t so poor that he can’t kill monsters.’
Above all else, Hugo’s speed was his best attribute. It surprised even Lee Gun sometimes.
‘His accuracy isn’t bad either.’
Since Hugo was called the weakest of the bunch, Lee Gun thought Hugo was useless and couldn’t hit the side of the barn with his bow.
However, Hugo was unexpectedly good with his bow. He was still inexperienced when hitting long-distance targets, but his accuracy was 100% for targets within three hundred meters’ range. He wasn’t bad enough to be derided by the other Zodiac Saints.
If Lee Gun could point out a problem…
“Ahhhk!”
“!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when Hugo finally shot his arrow. The distance between Hugo and Lee Jaewon was a hundred meters. Hugo’s accuracy should have been 100%. Yet the arrow had flown in the wrong direction.
Lee Gun clicked his tongue.
‘His accuracy is terrible if a human is present.’
Yes, Hugo’s accuracy would plummet if living beings were near his target.
Lee Gun asked, “Why are you so scared to shoot the bow if people are there?”
“What?”
“The difference in your accuracy is too stark when you’re shooting non-living targets and when you have human targets. I’m asking if there’s a reason behind this?”
Hugo awkwardly scratched the back of his head. “I guess… It might be related, but I made a mistake before.”
“Mistake?”
“I was trying to save a hostage from being eaten by a monster when I mistakenly shot the hostage in the leg.”
“Ah!”
“Of course, it wasn’t a life-threatening injury, and I was able to save the hostage. However, my accuracy falls whenever humans are nearby…”
Lee Gun immediately accepted the excuse.
‘I see! That’s what happened.’
When eliminating monsters, coming across humans who were running away was inevitable, and Hugo’s accuracy would drastically fall in fights where monsters and humans were mixed.
‘This is why he’s called an idiot.’
It was better off not having a marksman if the marksman’s accuracy was this low. That left close-ranged fighting, but Hugo was a bit too…
“Hey. Sit down.”
“Yes!”
After bringing a small table, Lee Gun positioned himself for an arm wrestling match. Hugo hesitantly sat on the other side.
Lee Gun smirked. “I’ll relax my arm, and you will use all your strength. If you move my arm by one degree, you win.”
“Hmmph. One degree? Wow! You really are underestimating me. I’m a fellow superhuman like you!” Hugo laughed as he grabbed Lee Gun’s hand and put strength into his arm.
‘He isn’t even putting strength into his arm!’
“I’ll gain your approval by pinning your… Ahhhhhhk!!!” Hugo yelled as he tried to pin Lee Gun’s arm. “Ahhhk! It won't move at all…! Teacher!! You broke the rule by putting strength into your arm!”
“What are you talking about? I’m not flexing at all”
“This is you not putting strength in your arm?! Ooh-ahhhhhk!!” Veins started bulging on Hugo’s forehead. He squeezed out all his strength as he tried to move Lee Gun’s arm.
In the end, he found himself unequal to the task. So he deployed his other hand and his shoulders to try to pin Lee Gun’s arm. However, Lee Gun didn’t budge at all.
In the end, the only thing that happened was Hugo’s feet dug into the ground. “H…Huh-uhk…!! You’re like a rock, Teacher.”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue as he looked at the fatigued Hugo. The other problem with Hugo was his strength. Hugo was extremely weak when it came to strength!
‘This is why they call him squirt gun.’
Of course, it wasn’t as this was a surprise to Lee Gun.
‘This is why he’s useless even if he has good accuracy.’
This would be akin to inflicting damage of 1,1,1,1,1… on a monster with a health of ten million.
That was why Hugo was stuck at the bottom. Then there was the last problem…
“Ahhhk!! Help me! I’m going to be eaten!”
Lee Gun had instructed the slime to turn into a rabbit monster, and the slime was chasing after Hugo. Lee Gun shook his head from side to side when he saw what happened.
‘He’s fast, but his battle sense is completely lacking…’
Basically, Hugo had three problems: lack of power, extreme fear, and terrible battle sense.
He was basically a piece of trash that could run fast…. No, he was an idiot.
On the other hand, the solutions to these problems were easy.
“Alright. I’m going to build you up as a strength-based archer from now on.”
“S-Strength-based??”
“Yes. We just have to raise your power. That’s why I want you to follow my strength training regimen. Also, I’ll force-feed battle sense into you.”
“U-Understood. What about my last problem? Fear? How are you going to solve that?”
Lee Gun let out a bright smile. “That? That’s the extremely easy part”
“E-Easy? Wait a moment. Why are you raising your fist?”
“Fear can be treated if something more terrifying is introduced to overwhelm the original fear.”
“What? What do you mean by that— Ahhhk??!!”
The sound of his head being cracked open rang out.
Bbah-gahk!
Hugo vomited blood and fell over. He was close to being a vegetable. “K…Kuh-huhk….”
“I’ll be attacking you without warning from time to time. You better be on your guard if you don’t want to die. After we finish your strength training today, you’ll prepare dinner. Then, you’ll do the laundry. Your skill-strengthening training will start tomorrow morning.”
“Kuh-hoo-uhp… I understand… Ah. What should I do? Jaewon took all my money today, so I don’t have enough to buy ingredients for dinner. The bank is already closed, so…!”
Lee Gun was about to respond when…
Boom!
“!”
An incredibly large number of food ingredients appeared nearby. It started with ten kilograms’ worth of prime beef. Then there were lamb, vegetables, fish, ham, and even fresh frogs that were still jumping.
“What the hell? Who would do this…”
Lee Gun saw her at that moment.
He saw Hailey walking by while pretending to be a passerby. She had her face buried in a newspaper.
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement and yelled, “Hey! What’s this all about?”
Hailey was surprised when he called out to her. However, she acted as if nothing was wrong and sat on a nearby bench. She started to page through the newspaper.
“I found them on the streets! I didn’t have a place to get rid of them, so I just dropped them off here!”
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. “Food ingredients can be found on the streets?”
Well, it didn’t matter, since this was good for them.
Puhng!!!
“!”
Suddenly, a light erupted from the sky as something fell toward him. It was a letter.
To be precise, letters appeared above the heads of Lee Gun, Hugo, and Hailey.
“What the hell is this?”
Lee Gun scrunched up his face when he saw the content of the letter.
“Libra Saint…?”
* * *
Around that time…
[We have done as you’ve asked, Zodiac Saint-nim. We sent an invitation letter to all the Zodiac Saints, and all of them have agreed to attend the meeting.]
“Oh my! Really? That’s great.”
The Zodiac Saint of the Libra temple was named Giselle Lawrence (27). Giselle had been very happy when she had heard the news about Lee Gun. “I’m sure he’ll become the hope of humanity.”
Giselle had seen the videos of Lee Gun’s exploits multiple times. She let out a bright smile.
She was a daughter of a politician, and her family had been in politics for generations. So she was interested in the eradication of monsters more than anyone. Her heart had bled when she had watched governments be powerless in front of the monsters.
“If we have Lee Gun-nim, we’ll be able to achieve the impossible wish of humanity.”
[Yes. We agree with your opinion. We will wholeheartedly support Lee Gun-nim.]
“Thank you!”
That was why she had sent invitations to the other Zodiac Saints.
Giselle was excited at the thought of meeting Lee Gun. However, something happened that day.
“…!”
Giselle became surprised when she looked into the mirror. The reflection in her mirror didn’t match her own. It was laughing.
[Yes. You’ll do.]
A monster shot out from the mirror.
“Ahhhk!!!!”
That day, Giselle died at the hands of the monster. It was the day when the monarch of Negligence became the Libra Saint.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: Book 1, Epilogue 13 - Pushover Maker (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 13 - Pushover Maker (2)
A month had passed since Hugo’s training had started.
“Ooh-ahhhhhhhh!”
Hugo was screaming as he vomited blood. He truly was living hell on earth.
One day, Lee Gun wanted to eat shaved ice, so Hugo was told to climb Mt. Everest. On another day, Lee Gun suddenly wanted to drink coffee; in the dead of the night, he made Hugo swim in the ocean and told him to go to Papua New Guinea to acquire coffee beans.
On another day, Lee Gun said he couldn’t fight a monster because its breath was terrible. He tossed Hugo into the monster’s mouth and told him to brush its teeth.
On another day, Lee Gun didn’t want to walk. Hugo had to put Lee Gun and the food ingredients in a rickshaw, then pull the rickshaw across mountains and borders.
And for today’s request from Lee Gun, Hugo was digging into the ground for all his worth. The reason was…
- I want you to make Disneyland for me.
- … What do you want me to make?
- Disneyland.
- What do you want me to make?
- Disneyland.
- So what do you….
- I want you to make an amusement park that can fit ten thousand people!
In the end, Hugo couldn’t even give a rebuttal. He started digging into the empty land that had been cleared of monsters. He moved the monsters’ bones and the rocks that weighed several tons. Then he started in earnest.
After creating a waterway, he built something similar to a log ride. He laid down train tracks and created something that resembled a train.
Hugo was doing a job that would need several thousand workers. He went at it for a week, and in the end, he finally finished the amusement park.
Hugo roared toward the sky. “I finished it, Teacher! It’s done!”
Lee Gun picked his ear as he looked at the finished Disneyland (?). “It looks decent.”
“Right? I put a lot of work into making it!”
“Alright. You did well. Now, you can destroy it.”
“… Yes!! Understoo— What? What do you want me to do?”
“I want you to destroy it. I got a good look at it.”
Hugo’s face was a sight to behold. “Wait a moment… You want me to destroy it? You don’t want me to bring civilians to this place?!”
“Civilians? Why would we call civilians here?”
“What do you mean, why? Didn’t you ask me to make this for that purpose?!”
“Why?”
“All entertainment facilities were destroyed by the monsters… I thought you were looking out for the children.”
“Are you kidding me? These are rides made by an amateur. They are dangerous. Why the hell are you thinking about making people ride them?”
“What?! Then why did you ask me to make these?”
“I did it just for the hell of it? I've never been to an amusement park before. So I was curious what it would feel like.”
Hugo despaired.
This was how Hugo was trained like a dog.
“Ooh-ahhhh. Teacher! I’m at my limit! I can no longer emit fire without burning my hands! How long do you want me to do this?”
“Continue it for eight more days.”
“Ahhhhhk!!”
Currently, Hugo was emitting flame from his hands and melting the bone of a monster. Hugo was an awakened being capable of handling fire.
Lee Gun referred to him as a high-performance blast furnace. He sometimes used Hugo to melt ingredients needed to make weapons. That wasn’t all.
“Your speed is suffering. Do a proper squat.”
“Kuh-huhk! If you squeeze my neck with your legs… I… I can’t breathe…! Kuhk!”
While Hugo did his work, Lee Gun sat on his shoulder and made him do squats. Lee Gun didn’t want Hugo to slack off in strength training.
Of course, Lee Gun sat on Hugo’s shoulders as if he were sitting on top of a sofa. He was also reading a manga.
At the end of the day, Lee Gun’s training seemed effective.
“Ggoo-ahhhhhhhhh!”
After a month, Hugo arm-wrestled with Lee Gun again to gauge his strength. This time, he was finally able to move Lee Gun’s arm.
“Alright. You moved it by 0.01 degrees. Good job!”
“T…Thank you….” Hugo cried because he was barely able to budge the arm, but Lee Gun was satisfied.
‘He is still lacking.’
However, the reason for this result was that Hugo's opponent was Lee Gun.
‘The ones who ignored him will be shocked when they see what he can do now.’
Lee Gun was looking forward to that. He laughed triumphantly. Of course, one issue still bothered him.
“Oh right. I am curious about something,” Lee Gun asked.
“Yes!!!”
“What’s your name?”
Hugo went silent. “… What did you just say?”
“What is your name?”
Shocked, Hugo screamed, “Teacher!! You didn’t know my name all this time?!”
“Your name was none of my business.”
“My name should have been mentioned on the TV a lot…”
“Not at all. You aren’t even mentioned alongside the others.”
Hugo despaired. Since he was known as the weakest among the awakened beings, the reporters and the civilians no longer held an interest in him.
Hugo cried as he said, “My name is Hugo Otis!”
Hugo’s sadness lasted only a moment. “Ah! Are you going to call me by my name? You weren’t doing so because you didn’t know my name…!”
As Lee Gun looked at the happy Hugo, a sour expression appeared on his face. “Hugo? I don’t like it. It somehow makes you look better than you are.”
“W-What?”
“It’s fine. I’ll just call you maggot.”
“No. That is a bit…!!”
“What about Oh Taeksoo?” Lee Gun asked.
“T-Taeksoo??”
“Yes. I converted Otis into Oh Taeksoo. What? You don’t like it?”
“It isn’t like that!”
“Then….” Lee Gun was about to say something else, but…
“Koohk…!”
When Lee Gun clutched his chest, Hugo was surprised. “Teacher! What’s wrong? Are you hurting somewhere?”
Lee Gun told Hugo not to worry. “I sometimes have chest pains. I’m fine”
“D-Do you have a chronic illness?”
“I don’t… Before I met you, I used all kinds of methods to heal my body. It might be a side effect of that.”
After awakening, Lee Gun had been like Hugo. He didn’t know how to fight at all. This was why his stomach was pierced daily. His bones were crushed, and his innards would fall out. He had suffered a hellish existence every day on repeat.
‘The bodily pain might be a side effect of using my abilities…’
Well, it didn’t matter. Lee Gun looked at his scars. Despite it being summer, he had to wear long sleeves because of them.
“I don’t mind the chest pain, but I wish I had something that could regenerate my skin. It doesn’t matter which medicine I use. I can’t heal them. I might need proper treatment for them.”
“Ah! Would you like to come with me? It’s nearby.”
“What is nearby?”
* * *
“… H-Hugo!!”
Sophie was beside herself when she met Hugo.
It had been a while since he had visited the Cathedrale Notre Dame.
Hugo scratched his cheek. It was for no other reason.
“Y-You should have sent word if you were coming here!”
“Ah, yea. I’m sorry about that. Also, could you let go of my hand…”
Sophie was unable to look away from Hugo.
‘Who built you up like this?’
After receiving training from Lee Gun, Hugo had transformed from looking like a nerd to looking very manly. His narrow shoulders had widened, and hard muscles had appeared on his arms and legs.
‘In just a short while, he became dashing…’
Sophie had an ulterior motive in hugging Hugo. Of course, it looked as if the Saintess was giving a benevolent hug to Hugo by patting him on the back.
“You must have gone through a lot of trouble to travel so far! You grew a lot in the meantime!”
She almost drooled in Hugo’s arms.
‘It doesn’t look like it, but Hugo’s body is quite hard…!’
Enraptured, Sophie lifted her head. “I want to greet you on your return— Kuhk.”
However, Sophie froze when she looked up. She hadn’t met eyes with Hugo. The one in front of her was a frowning Lee Gun.
“Who the hell is this perverted lady?”
“Kyahhhhhk!!!”
Yes, the one Sophie had hugged was Lee Gun.
Sophie almost foamed at the mouth when she saw Lee Gun’s face. “Ahhhk! Monster! Monster! Ahhhhk!!”
“???”
Lee Gun was taken aback when Sophie was frightened out of her wits.
Before she could run out of breath, she screamed, “Ahhhk!! Get off me! Get off me right now, monster!!! Where do you think this is? H-H-Holy water! Where’s the holy water?!”
“Sophie-nim! That person is…!”
“Ahhhk!!”
Sophie was close to fainting as she took up a chalice with holy water. She tossed it toward Lee Gun.
Lee Gun got angry since he had been greeted by water as soon as he met her.
Hugo froze in place. “T…Teacher!!!”
“Damn it! Just my luck. She’s the one who hugged me first. That came out of nowhere.” Lee Gun’s expression was a sight to behold as he swept back his wet hair.
When Lee Gun emitted a chaotic murderous intent, Sophie fell on her butt.
“Hugo!! What is that monster?!!” she asked.
“What? He’s not a monster. He’s my teacher…”
“What?! That can’t be! How can that be the face of a human?!!”
‘What is wrong with my face?’
Lee Gun became angry.
‘It isn’t that bad…’
However, given the voices he heard around him, his opinion didn’t matter.
“Ahhh! What is that monster?”
“He’s so scary!”
“D…Don’t look at him! It is bad manners!”
There was no ill intent behind their actions, but Lee Gun got angry when those people turned their gazes away in surprise.
‘My face… It shouldn’t be bad enough where people would avoid looking at me…’
At that moment, Lee Gun turned his head and met eyes with a particular beauty. It was none other than Hailey, who was sitting inside the cathedral and pretending to be a disciple.
As soon as she met eyes with Lee Gun, Hailey turned her gaze away.
“!?”
Lee Gun flinched. The final nail in the coffin was the girls who were screaming as they looked at Hugo.
“Kyaa! Are you really the Archer Saint? You look much more handsome in real life!”
“I don’t remember you being this great when I met you last time!”
“Kyaa! You’re so cool! Please sign this for me!”
“Heh he he! Thank you. I’ll work harder,” said Hugo.
In the end, Lee Gun exploded. “Hey, maggot!!! Who told you to flirt around? Get back to training!”
“W-What?! You said I can rest today since we are meeting the Saintess.”
“Stop speaking nonsense! Run right now!! Or should I make you do it myself?!”
“Ahhhk!”
* * *
“Oooh-ahhhk!!!”
Lee Jaewon turned his head from side to side when he heard Hugo’s scream. And when he saw Lee Gun fuming, he tilted his head in puzzlement. “Lee Gun-nim… Why are you wearing a mask?”
“Shut up! I always wear it when there are a lot of people.”
“There aren’t that many people here—”
“Shut up!” Lee Gun pouted as he pulled down his mask further. Then he suddenly came to a stop. “Hey, why do you keep following me?”
Hailey, who had been following Lee Gun, was startled. She reflexively took something out of her pocket. It was the skin healing poultice for Lee Gun, which she had bought from Sophie.
Since Lee Gun had no way of knowing this, he looked at Hailey. “Why do you keep following me? You’ve been following me for a month straight."
“W-What are you talking about? I’ve never followed you around.”
“You have been following me. You left me food to eat. You left me washing tools and blankets.”
“That’s…” Hailey was on eggshells as she tried to disappear.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. “I’ll use it well, but have you been following me to monitor me?”
“!”
Lee Gun remembered what Sophie had said earlier.
- W-We have to put surveillance on him right now! I’m sure he’s a monster!
Still, he had thought people were going too far in treating him like a monster. So he asked, “What were you mixing in with the food that you gave me? What is your motive?”
Hailey realized something had gone wrong. She stopped herself from running away. “I meant nothing by it!”
Lee Gun fiercely furrowed his brows. “What? You meant nothing by it?”
“That's not what I meant! I thought you were working hard teaching him, so...”
Lee Gun’s fierce gaze relaxed a little. “Since I’m teaching him…?”
Hailey’s face turned red as if she was confessing something. “Yes. I’m sure it’s extremely tough to teach an awakened being…”
Lee Gun finally realized why Hailey had been following them.
‘It had to do with the maggot.’
It was understandable since Lee Gun had seen the reaction of the Saintess and the civilians.
For the first time, Lee Gun realized that maggot was popular. He felt a bit aggrieved, but he accepted the answer and nodded. “Mmm. Alright. I’ll pass this on to him. Don’t worry about it.”
“…???”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
For some reason, Hailey got an ominous feeling.
The next day…
“T-Teacher? What is this?” Hugo froze when he saw the item before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: Book 1, Epilogue 14 - Pushover Maker (3)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 14 - Pushover Maker (3)
“Hey! How come someone handsome can’t do this properly?!”
“Ahhk!”
“I’m sure you’re tickled by the fact that you are loved by the female disciples, right?”
“Ahhhhhhhhk!”
“This is food the Scorpio Saint sent to you because she likes you. You have to eat it all in one minute! If you can’t, you will have to march for a hundred kilometers!”
“Ooh-huhhhng!!!”
* * *
Several months had passed since Lee Gun had started berating Hugo like this.
- What? What did you just say?
The one on the other side of the phone call was dumbfounded. He answered back with a question.
Lee Gun expressed his annoyance. “Are you deaf? I’m asking if you guys stole our good-for-nothing!”
The one on the other side of the call was so taken aback that he was about to grab the back of his neck.
- Why would we steal your good-for-nothing?
The person on the call with Lee Gun was the Leo Saint Stevens.
In truth, Stevens had been elated since Lee Gun had called first. Steven wanted to become close to Lee Gun, so he had given him his phone number Lee Gun. He also periodically sent texts to Lee Gun.
Of course, all his attempts had been ignored, but today, Lee Gun had gone out of his way to call him! So he had quickly answered the call, but Lee Gun had asked him to hand over the good-for-nothing! It had come out of nowhere!
- Who the hell is the good-for-nothing?
“Who else? I’m talking about the maggot who shoots the bow!”
- What? Hugo Otis? Why would you look for me if you’re trying to find him?
“Why else? I gave an order to the good-for-nothing a couple of days ago. He should’ve gone to you guys, but I lost all contact with him.”
Lee Gun was annoyed as he thought about what had happened a few days ago. He had been brushing his hair when a bunch of hair had fallen out. So he had called out to Hugo in fright. “Hey, maggot. Go get some hair loss potion from that pervert!”
“H…Hair loss potion?”
“Yes. I want something effective! Ah! I want her to put it on my tab again.”
In the end, Hugo had headed toward China as he had heard that Sophie had gone on a business trip there.
As events would conspire, monsters that Lee Gun had been looking for appeared where Hugo had traveled to. These were monsters that spat out a special type of gold.
However, the Chinese government had requested Stevens and Kevin to take care of these monsters. Therefore, Lee Gun had given a special order to Hugo.
“Steal it. Do whatever you have to do to steal it. I want you to take the gold that they gathered too.”
Anyway, Lee Gun had told Hugo to steal from the other Zodiac Saints and lost contact with him afterward.
This made Lee Gun angry and impatient, so he contacted Leo Saint.
“I’m sure you stole the good-for-nothing from me as revenge! Hurry up and hand him over!”
Stevens was truly taken aback.
- My god! You guys are the ones who stole the gold?! Hey! Do you realize how much our relationship with the Chinese government deteriorated thanks to you guys…
“Who cares? If you lay a finger on the good-for-nothing, you guys will pay for it!”
- What the hell? When did you get so close to him?
“Since his absence, I have had to eat ramen for three meals a day. Do you realize how great a cook that maggot is?!”
One could imagine what kind of expression had appeared on Stevens’s face on the other side of the call. However, that wasn’t important right now.
- We didn’t take him?!
“What? Then where the hell has he gone?”
- How should I know? He probably ran away!! I heard you were tormenting him a lot!
“What? I’m treating him very well. Who told you that nonsense?”
- Sophie did!
Lee Gun became angry. That perverted woman said that?
However, Lee Gun wasn’t quick to cuss. He did berate the maggot a lot because the maggot had gained popularity in recent days.
For example…
“Hey! Why are you signing stuff for fans? Hurry up and go to France! Bring me some baguettes!”
“France? We are in Korea right now!”
“Hey! I want to make a clambake. Go underneath the water and bring me the clams.”
“What?! We are in the middle of the Pacific Ocean right now!”
“Open it. It’s a present. It’ll help you improve your body.”
“This is poison!! Ooh-huhhhhng!”
Lee Gun had used noble(?) training methods to grow Hugo. He felt a pang of guilt, which gave validity to his next thought.
‘… Did he really run away?’
Was it because he had tormented Hugo too much? In the past, Hugo would always cry, saying his teacher was the best. But recently, Hugo continued to complain and push back on what Lee Gun said.
At that moment, Stevens laughed as if he had an ulterior motive.
- You should drop that weakling. Why don’t you go shopping for weapons with me?
“Weapons?”
- Yes. We have someone called the Capricorn Saint among us. He’s the only manufacturer among us. He’s making all our equipment. I’ll introduce you to him…
“I have no business with him. Everything he makes is trash.”
Stevens snorted as if he was dumbfounded. He thought Lee Gun was being conceited.
- Anyway, let’s please meet up sometime. It’ll be great for the apostles to get closer to each other…
“Buzz off! I don’t want to see you guys! If my rice cooker isn’t there, I’m ending this call! Jaewon says the food I made is trash, and he’s starving himself!”
- Wait a moment! Alright! Food! I’ll buy you guys food! I’ll buy you fifty servings of steak from an upscale hotel!
Lee Gun, who had been eating ramen for the past few days, furrowed his brows. “Hundred servings.”
- Alright! I’ll buy you food, and in return, you can tell me stories about your exploits of killing monsters…!
Click!
Aside from the part about the food, Lee Gun didn’t feel the need to speak any further. He ended the call.
It was because a familiar number had called him while he was on the call with Stevens.
“Hey, maggot. Where are you right now—”
- Teacher!!! Why aren’t you answering my call??? I heard you are teaching techniques to the squirt gun!!!
“….”
Lee Gun became angry since the one calling him was Kevin.
It was great that Kevin had graduated from being a wolf boy after encountering Lee Gun, but he had somehow gotten a hold of Lee Gun’s number. He kept pestering Lee Gun, as if he wanted to become friendly with him.
Of course, the texts that Kevin sent Lee Gun contained valuable information. If he didn’t respond at all, Kevin would send presents and coupons, so Lee Gun hadn’t blocked Kevin’s number.
“Why do you have the maggot’s phone? Did you kidnap him?"
- You’ll find out once you come here! Anyway, I’ll buy you a house, Teacher. Let me see your face for a moment.
“Buzz off! It’s time for me to eat.”
Click!
Lee Gun’s stubbornness was beyond imagination.
* * *
“My god! How were you able to make him come here?”
Heiji, who had arrived at the hotel, was shocked by the sight before her: Lee Gun was eating steak in front of her.
“No way! I tried to seduce him, yet he was like a brick wall…!”
She wasn’t the only one to be surprised.
“I tried to entice him with money and women, yet he refused to show up.” Jean-Louise was in disbelief as he looked at Lee Gun.
Ivan, Yang Wei, Sophie, Giselle, and Hailey were there too, and they were also surprised by Lee Gun’s presence.
While Ivan hated Lee Gun’s guts, the others had attempted to get closer to Lee Gun several times. However, Lee Gun never showed up no matter what they tried.
“Teacher!! You didn’t even respond to me when I called for you! Why would you agree to that bastard Leo Saint’s call?!”
Lee Gun found Kevin’s words annoying, so he kept chewing on his steak. “Stop bothering me. Go away. I have to eat.”
“If it’s food, I’ll buy it every day for you!!! I want you to spar with me in return!”
“Alright. Deal.”
The other Zodiac Saints were shocked.
‘We could have enticed him if we had offered food.’
It didn’t matter in the end. Lee Gun looked at his surroundings. “So? Where’s the maggot? You said I’d be able to find out about his whereabouts if I came to you.”
Kevin let out a bright smile. “Of course, it was a lie! If I didn’t do this, Teacher would have never shown up in front of us— Kuh-huhk!”
“You’re dead if you call me one more time.” Lee Gun was annoyed. He stood up after packing up the steak that he would give to Jaewon.
Stevens quickly moved to grab him. “Wait! You’re already here! Just stay a little longer! He should be here soon.”
“What do you want? I’m going to sleep.”
Boom!
‘!’
The door to the hotel’s restaurant was opened. At the same time, a familiar face made an appearance.
“I’m sorry for being late. I had a lot of items to bring.”
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round since the newcomer was the Capricorn Saint Sergeyevich (37).
Sergeyevich laughed when he saw Lee Gun. “I did as Stevens asked. I brought weapons that the thirteenth might use. Please slowly look at them. The price starts at a billion won.”
Lee Gun glared at Stevens.
Stevens clicked his tongue. “If I don’t do this, you’ll continue to use old and rustic equipment. Someone like you has to swap weapons frequently.”
It seemed he truly felt Lee Gun’s skills were going to diminish.
When he heard what Stevens had to say, the Capricorn Saint laughed as he moved closer. “That’s right. The thirteenth doesn’t have a Zodiac, so you probably have a hard time acquiring items. Why don’t you leave an order with me so that my Constructs can manufacture items for you?”
Lee Gun suddenly let out a murderous intent. “What? You want me to leave it to your Constructs?”
The Zodiac Saints flinched when they saw his cold gaze.
Heiji asked, “Did something happen between you and the Capricorn temple?"
Yes, he had a lot of beef with them. It was right after Lee Gun had awakened. He didn’t know why, but monsters were chasing after him. Moreover, he was a newbie who didn’t know how to fight.
“Ahhk!! Get away from me!”
Since he was a superhuman, he didn’t die from a single blow, but Lee Gun didn’t even know how to properly grip a knife. That was why he was a good sandbag for the monsters.
Moreover, he didn’t want civilians to get swept up in his troubles, so he couldn’t even go near a city even if he had a high fever. These were desperate times when he was just trying to survive, and in the land of the monsters, Lee Gun had met the Constructs of the Capricorn temple.
[What the hell? Is that a human?]
Lee Gun was captured by a monster, so he took this opportunity to ask for help from the Constructs.
[Poo-ha-ha-ha! The sight of you getting beaten up by the monster is quite funny!]
[What is that toy-like weapon? Did he make it himself?]
[Ha ha ha! Does he think he can kill monsters with such a shoddy club?]
[Ha ha ha! Look! He’s getting beat up as expected. It was a chore trying to run errands for our master. Thankfully, we ran across something entertaining.]
The Capricorn Constructs had laughed and watched as the monster used Lee Gun as a sandbag.
Of course, there was no way the Zodiac and this bastard wouldn’t know what their Constructs had previously done to him.
It seemed Sergeyevich had indeed heard about it. He laughed out loud. “I heard you took our blueprint. You studied it on your own, and now you can manufacture items. These are the items you have currently, right?”
“!”
Sergeyevich looked at the clothes, gloves, and shoes worn by Lee Gun. “They are amateurish, but you did well. However, they can’t be compared to what the pros make.”
He confidently brought out a brilliant ax and a greatsword. “I heard you like using heavy weaponry. These are power-type weapons that I picked out for you. The starting price is three billion won. We put extra effort into the exterior since Stevens ordered this one.”
Stevens was impressed with the cool-looking ax. “I like this! I’ll help you purchase this. Let’s go with this one!”
However, Lee Gun merely snorted. “Get that trash out of here. The stuff I make is a million times better.”
Sergeyevich’s expression scrunched up. It was subtle. “Look here, Thirteenth-nim. You keep overstepping your bounds, but we are pros. There are things you should and shouldn’t compare.”
“What? Pros?” Lee Gun looked dumbfounded as he took a fountain pen out of his pocket.
In the distant future, he would give this fountain pen to the Secretary.
Lee Gun stabbed the cool-looking ax with the pen, and something surprising happened.
Kwah-jeek!
A mere fountain pen was brought down on it, yet the ax was destroyed.
Sergeyevich was surprised, but Lee Gun merely looked at him in contempt. “It’s a cheap item that can be destroyed with a mere fountain pen.”
“What? Cheap?” A pissed-off Sergeyevich raised the greatsword. “Alright. Take out your mighty weapon. Let’s see if you can block this!”
When he swung the greatsword, Lee Gun smirked as he took up the fountain pen again. Then something surprising happened again.
Che-che-cheng!!!
“…!!!”
Lee Gun blocked Sergeyevich’s greatsword with his fountain pen, and the greatsword broke into pieces.
The mouths of everyone fell open.
Lee Gun smirked as if something obvious had happened. “If I use weapons with poor durability like these, they will get damaged after I kill a couple of monsters. Ah! I guess it’ll benefit you if they break down quickly, right? Pros, my ass!”
Lee Gun got up with scorn on his face.
A flustered Stevens quickly grabbed Lee Gun. “W-Wait a moment! What is that fountain pen? Is it a weapon?”
“Weapon, my ass! It’s a pen that I use to sign. I made it for the day when I’m famous enough to sign autographs.”
“??!”
When Lee Gun tried to leave, the Zodiac Saints made a commotion. The first one to grab Lee Gun was Kevin.
“Teacher! I’ll buy you food for a month! Please make me a weapon!!”
“One month? Alright. Give me your weapon. I have to measure the size…”
Lee Gun fell for the promise of food, so he didn’t hesitate as he held out his hand.
“Waaaaa! I should have expected this from Teacher!!!”
“?!”
Everyone was surprised to hear the sudden cheer. The sound had come from the hotel’s window.
“What the hell? Squirt gun?!”
“Hugo!!”
Yes, Hugo, who had been missing, was stuck close to the window.
In truth, he had suddenly been kidnapped to the future, and he had made it back right now. Moreover, it was as if his Faith had changed. The look in his eyes had changed, and he ran toward Lee Gun.
“Ooh-uhhhhhh!! I’m not sure why, but I’ll follow you forever, Teacher!”
“What the hell? You suddenly went missing, and now you’re acting this way? Why are you being like this?”
“For a moment, I doubted you, Teacher! Please marry me— Kuh-huhk!!!!”
Lee Gun ruthlessly kicked Hugo. Then he tossed aside Kevin’s sword.
Kevin was dumbfounded. “What are you doing? You said you’ll make me a weapon if I buy you food!”
“Ah. I don’t need it. The one in charge of making food is back.”
“?!!”
“Anyway, don’t look for me, idiots”
Kevin glared at Hugo as if he was Kevin’s nemesis.
The commotion among the other Zodiac Saints got louder.
“Lee Gun! Can you perhaps make magical equipment?”
Ivan was taken aback when he realized Lee Gun also had a manufacturing ability. Hailey and Heiji became further infatuated with Lee Gun. That wasn’t all.
“Lee Gun! Wait a moment! Can you make a sword instead of a fountain pen?” When Stevens, the Capricorn Saint’s best repeat customer, tossed aside his weapon to chase after Lee Gun, Sergeyevich ground his teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Book 1, Epilogue 15 - I like you (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 15 - I like you (1)
[What? You’re worried about Lee Gun?]
The Zodiac Crab was known as Cancer, and it was the one that had tried to kill the great hero Hercules. It was Karkinos’s constellation.
Cancer was a constellation located in a place where the days were shorter. So it was accompanied by the image of Death.
Anyway, the Constructs of the Cancer temple were surprised by the words of their master.
[Your opinion on Lee Gun has worsened.]
[Master, didn’t you like Lee Gun not too long ago?]
“I thought he might be of help to us. I never liked him.”
[Then…]
“That person is slowly becoming a threat to our abilities.”
[…!]
The Zodiac Saint of the Cancer temple, Jean-Louis, had infiltrated the human camp under the orders of the monarch Time.
It was possible because the Cancer Zodiac was a fallen evil god. A transaction had taken place where the Zodiac had chosen Jean-Louis as its Zodiac Saint for a price.
In the future, the evil gods related to Yooha’s arms would become good negotiation partners for the unknown civilization.
Anyway, Jean-Louis was truly the leader overseeing the Cancer temple. He was called the best strategist among the twelve Zodiac Saints. However, Lee Gun worried him. It was for no other reason.
- Lee Gun! He once again saved a sealed-off city!
- Is anything impossible for him?!
- Lee Gun doesn’t know the definition of defeat. His fans are increasing in number all over the world!
“Lee Gun is very popular with the people.”
[Yes… He suffers more injuries because he doesn’t have a Zodiac. However, this works in his favor as it pulls at the heartstrings of the people.]
[We are fortunate that he doesn’t have a Zodiac or the Faith of the humans might have headed toward his Zodiac.]
Jean-Louis furrowed his brows. While Faith might be a problem…
“Lee Gun is too good at killing monsters.”
[Yes. He truly has the requirements needed to become the perfect hero. Wasn’t that supposed to be helpful to your plan?]
[To gather money, you needed someone to take on the role of a star…]
Jean-Louis snorted. Lee Gun was supposed to be helpful to his plan?
“That’s been a bit nebulous in recent days.”
It was unclear if this was intentional or not, but Lee Gun was recently killing all the monsters related to Jean-Louis’s plan, causing him losses. Of course, these losses weren’t significant, but they bothered Jean-Louis.
‘Also, the other Zodiac Saints are starting to follow him a bit too much.’
“The ones supposed to be useful in bolstering our power are starting to develop positive feelings toward Lee Gun. It isn’t a good development.”
He was referring to Kevin, Stevens, and Heiji. They were quite powerful, so they were supposed to be useful to his plan in many ways.
The Constructs gulped when they read his expression.
[Then there is the incident with the Capricorn temple. The Capricorn temple was a good source of income, but the incident with Lee Gun might decrease the influence of the Capricorn Saint…]
This Construct was referring to the incident from a couple of days ago, when Lee Gun had humiliated the Capricorn Saint at a hotel.
[Who would have expected his manufacturing ability to be better than the Capricorn Saint’s?]
[Stevens is their greatest source of income, yet he’s now trying to move toward Lee Gun.]
The Cancer temple supplied weapon ingredients illegally and received a cut in return.
[Is it ok to leave Lee Gun alone when we are taking losses like this?]
Jean-Louis let out a subtle smile. “I heard those who fly too high toward the sun don't survive for long.”
[What?]
Jean-Louis merely shrugged as he turned around. “It’s nothing. Lee Gun hasn’t overstepped his bounds yet, but we do need to keep an eye on him.”
Jean-Louis’s eyes turned sharp like the eyes of a monster. “If he does overstep his bounds, it’ll be a different story.”
* * *
At that time…
“Ooh-ahhhhhh!!!”
Hugo let out a blood scream as Lee Jaewon’s mouth fell open.
“Oh. It moved!”
Hugo was currently arm-wrestling Lee Gun.
Lee Gun smirked as he looked at the red-faced Hugo. “Good. You moved it around 0.05 degrees.”
As soon as he let go, Hugo despaired. “Ahhhk!! I can’t believe this is all I can do! I couldn’t even move Teacher’s arm by five degrees…!!!”
“It’s because you’re incompetent.”
“Ahhhk!! Teacher finally taught me the way, so why?!” Hugo could barely say anything as we wailed.
On the other hand, Lee Gun was grinning inside. It looked as if Hugo had made no progress, but that wasn’t the case.
‘When he fights the others, he’ll feel the difference in power.’
Oblivious to this fact, Hugo despaired. “I can’t let this be! At this rate, I’ll be a nuisance to you, Teacher!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when Hugo brought up this subject again. After going missing(?) for a couple of days, Hugo had returned as a slightly(?) changed man.
“Teacher!! You will become someone big in the future…!!!”
“He’s talking nonsense again.”
The cause was unknown, but Hugo now kept saying things that didn’t make sense. For example…
“Teacher will become someone much bigger!”
“Oh! Is that so? What will I become?”
“Uh. I have no idea!”
“What?’
“I can’t remember it, but I’m sure you will become someone amazing, Teacher!!! That’s why I want you to marry me!”
“Damn it! What the hell is he talking about? He’s acting like the time when we first met!! Did he lose his memory?”
“I’m fine! This time, I acquired a potion that’ll change your sex!! It’ll all work out if you use this, Teacher! Here!”
“You want to die!!!”
It could be a side effect of Oblivion’s skill. Hugo’s memories were mixed up, and he was acting strange.
Lee Gun had a tough time making Hugo come to his senses.
‘Which asshole made him like this?’
He would kill the culprit if he found out who did it.
Of course, the 1,000% increase in Faith started to fade away after a couple of days, and Hugo returned to normal.
“As expected, something is off about him.”
Lee Gun asked Hugo where he had gone, but Hugo said he couldn’t remember.
“I’ll give you a shoulder massage! You haven’t been feeling well in recent days. You seem stressed out. A bald path is forming near your forehead— Kuh-huhk!!”
“You don’t have to say such unnecessary things.”
“Ah! I learned physical therapy and physiotherapy for you, Teacher. I’m sure it’ll be of great help to you.”
He wasn’t wrong.
Lee Gun found this development quite convenient, so he let Hugo work on his shoulders.
‘I know that the stress on my body increases as I use my abilities, but…’
In the past, he just had to go to sleep, and he would wake up feeling recovered. But recently, there was no recovery. In fact, he felt worse.
In reality, Lee Gun’s body was getting damaged bit by bit. Of course, Lee Gun didn’t worry about it too much at this point.
‘It won’t get in the way of me killing the monsters.’
It was all that mattered.
‘I have to find that fog monster so that I can find Yeonwoo’s corpse.’
That was Lee Gun’s only wish.
During the manual therapy, Lee Gun started feeling great pain when an out-of-position bone was manipulated.
Seeing this, a worried Hugo asked, “Are you ok? I know you’ve been destroying facilities related to Mr. Jean-Louis. Are you sure you aren’t picking an unnecessary fight with a Zodiac Saint?”
Lee Gun furrowed his brow. “Something is fishy about that Crab bastard.”
“…!”
While none of the Zodiac Saints were to Lee Gun’s liking, a couple of them smelled dangerous. Jean-Louis was one of them.
‘It bothers me that he tried to use Jaewon.’
“It feels as if he’s merely trying to make money using monsters. That’s why you can’t go easy on him either. I’m also acting as if it’s a coincidence that I’m interfering with his plan.”
“Uh. What do you want me to do with them?”
“What?”
Instead of answering, Hugo pointed out the living room window.
Unexpectedly, Heiji and Hailey were standing across from each other, and an odd air was present between the two of them.
“Mmm… Did you not hear what I just said?” Heiji let out a bright smile as she looked at the beautiful woman facing her. “If you didn’t, I’ll say it again. Get out of my way.”
Hailey was barring Heiji’s path, without a single ounce of mirth in her eyes. “Why should I comply?”
Heiji became angry at Hailey’s prompt reply. Hailey was a cold-blooded witch who had no interest in men. So why was she being like this?
Heiji had a beautiful smile on her lips, but murderous intent emanated from her face. “Do you understand me? I’m not here for you. I have business with the man inside that place.”
“That’s quite the coincidence. I have business with him too.”
The smile on Heiji’s face vanished.
The two of them were well aware of what the other wanted. But something didn’t make sense for both women.
“Hailey, you’ve never shown interest in men. Why don’t you do as you’ve always done? Go play with your monstrous subordinates.”
“What about you? Why don’t you put flowers in your hair and go play with your fairies in the flower garden?”
What did this bitch say? Heiji didn’t lose her elegance as she became angry. She couldn’t understand why Hailey was acting this way.
Hailey was extremely popular with the male Zodiac Saints. Aside from Kevin and Jean-Louis, all the rest had hit on her. However, she lived up to her nickname as the ice princess.
She ruthlessly turned them down and didn’t even treat them as if they were human. It was as if she had no interest in humans.
‘Was I mistaken?’
It didn’t matter in the end. While they were comrades, there was no reason to be nice if they were rivals.
So Heiji laughed as she asked, “Are you interested in him?”
Hailey flinched when she felt the murderous intent. She looked at Heiji.
Heiji laughed. She seemed to have extracted some meaning from Hailey’s silence. “Yes. There is no way. There is no way you are interested in him—”
However, Heiji’s eyes flashed when she saw the look in Hailey’s eyes.
Heiji, who had her arms crossed, raised her finger. She made a sign that would summon the fairy monarch that possessed the greatest firepower!
Hailey also wagged her finger.
Kwahng!!!! An explosion erupted outside the lodging. The lodging had a defensive barrier placed over it, so it didn’t suffer much.
The two women started brawling against each other. The magician Heiji used telekinesis to raise and throw items, while Hailey used her sword energy to destroy the items thrown at her.
In the end, Hugo screamed when he saw the mess taking place outside. “Ahhk! Teacher! Stop the two of them!”
“Why would I do that? If you want to stop them, you have to do it. They are your guests, right?”
“You’re right. What??!!” Hugo looked at Lee Gun, dumbfounded. “Why are they my guests? Of course, they are your guests, Teacher!!”
“Idiot. If you’re so oblivious, you won’t be able to get married. It’s why that perverted woman keeps sending you gifts. You should have taken care of it immediately.”
“What?? Sophie-nim? I received nothing?!”
“Of course. I sent them all back to the sender.”
“?!!”
Lee Gun cackled as he thought of the gifts sent by Sophie that he had ripped open. The Saintess had even written scandalous hand-written letters.
So Lee Gun and Jaewon had filled the envelopes with bugs before sending them back.
“We sent her presents of rejection in your stead so that you don’t have to worry about it.”
“What?! What did you send her?”
“You don’t need to know that. Anyway, you should choose between those two beautiful women. There is no way you’ll choose that bedwetter.”
Lee Jaewon, who was eating a rice ball next to Lee Gun, was in a predicament.
‘Would it be better if I tell him the truth?’
No matter how Jaewon cut it, it seemed Heiji and Hailey liked Lee Gun. However, he stopped himself, because it would be too much work. Lee Jaewon continued to eat his rice ball.
Kwahng!!!
In the end, the fight wasn’t resolving itself. Heiji burst through the smoke as she appeared in front of Lee Gun. Her magician robe outfit had a thigh slit, and her confident walk was very beautiful.
“Lee Gun! Would you like to team up with me? I received a big commission from Russia! You received it too, right?”
When Heiji grabbed Lee Gun’s arm, Hailey rushed up from behind and grabbed Heiji by her arm. “Heiji! I’ll team up with you!”
Heiji was dumbfounded. “Hey. I wasn’t talking to you!”
At the same time, Hugo had a realization. “Ah! Is that why the two of you are here? Because of the commission sent by Russia?”
In the future, this commission would be known as a legendary raid. It would be dubbed the great raid of Russia.
Anyway, Russia was vast and dangerous. So even the independent Zodiac Saints tried to form a team of two.
Lee Gun scratched his head. “It would be great to have support there. I’ve thought about it, and it could be great to have someone who could place a buff on us…”
Both Hailey and Heiji grabbed Lee Gun’s arm.
“I’ll do it!”
“I’ll do it!”
The two women glared at each other.
“You’re a thief Zodiac Saint, Hailey. You’re far from being someone who can fill the role of support.”
“What about you? You’re better at breaking things than being a support, right?”
Hugo groaned when he saw this. “Ah! Excuse me… For your information, I’m going in his stead to the raid… Teacher is injured right now…”
Heiji was surprised. “What? You’re the weakest among us. Have you lost your mind? Do you realize how dangerous that place is? You’ll die immediately!” Heiji shook her head. She looked at Hugo as if she was worried about him.
Lee Gun patted Hugo and Heiji on the shoulder as if he understood what was going on. “Yes. I’ll go with Jaewon. The two of you should team up since you guys are interested in each other.”
Heiji grabbed Lee Gun as if he were talking nonsense. “What are you talking about? I’m interested in you!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round.

chapters.title: Chapter 463: Book 1, Epilogue 16 - I like you (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 16 - I like you (2)
“What are you talking about? I’m interested in you!”
Heiji’s unexpected statement shocked everyone.
Pieces of the rice ball that Lee Jaewon had been eating fell out of his mouth. He thought, ‘Uh. She finally said it out loud.’
Hugo’s mouth fell open so much that his jaw was about to dislocate.
The one hit by this most terribly was Hailey, who stood next to Heiji. She had never expected Heiji to take this route, and she looked devastated.
The man in question was also surprised. Lee Gun kept blinking since he found this very unexpected. “Uh… You are interested in me…?”
“Yes.” Heiji brushed her hair back and expectantly looked at Lee Gun.
She had always been a confident woman, but she seemed a bit embarrassed to reveal her true feelings at that moment. And it looked as if her feelings had been conveyed to Lee Gun.
Lee Gun blinked at Heiji, then said, “Uh. I see.”
“!”
He didn’t sound disagreeable, so Heiji’s face brightened a little.
Lee Gun nodded as if it was understandable. “I know you’re interested in my abilities, but the good-for-nothing… Taeksoo has become incredibly strong. He’ll be useful as your teammate.”
“?!!” Heiji’s face froze.
Hugo was shocked. He grabbed Lee Gun as if to say the man was mistaken. Hugo knew Heiji’s temper. She would summon a meteor from the sky while laughing if she became angry.
“T-Teacher!!! She’s not talking about being your party member. Ms. Heiji— Kuhk!”
An angry Heiji grabbed Lee Gun by his collar. “Idiot! It isn’t that kind of interest!”
She spoke near Lee Gun’s face. “I like y— Kyahhhhk!!”
Before Heiji could finish, Hailey kicked her and sent her flying.
Hailey panted as if she had just averted a big crisis.
Lee Gun watched this with his eyes round. “S-Scorpio Saint?”
“Monster!!”
“?”
“There was a monster. Yes. I sent her flying because there was a monster on her. Don’t worry about it.”
“… A-are you sure about that?”
No matter how they searched, they couldn’t feel the presence of a monster.
“I-It’s a monster that humans can’t sense.”
“… Aren’t you human too?”
