That remark surprised Hailey, and she was about to reply when…
Flash!
“?!”
Hailey screamed when Heiji fell on top of her head.
“Koohk!”
Heiji had appeared there using teleportation. Panting, she placed a hand on Hailey. “Stop getting in my way!”
Hailey disappeared to someplace unknown. Heiji had used teleportation to send her irritant away. Then she said to Lee Gun, “Listen to me well. I like you! I like your abilities, and I like you as a woman! I like your bold actions, and I like your grumpy personality. I like your appearance and face. I like everything about you! Do you understand me?”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round. Was this some kind of psychological attack? He was baffled.
Seeing Lee Gun stand there dumbfounded, Hugo poked him. “Teacher…!”
“Huh? Oh yeah. Thanks.”
“!”
Heiji’s heart was pounding as she waited for his next words in anticipation.
One second, two seconds, three…
No matter how long she waited, there was no response. In the end, Heiji blinked. “T-That’s it?”
Lee Gun, who had been silent, tilted his head in puzzlement. “…I hope you meet someone good?”
“…!!!!” Heiji looked shell-shocked. She became unsteady on her feet, then disappeared using teleportation.
The one to scream was Hugo. “Teacher!!”
“What?”
“What do you mean? Why are you so calm?!”
“What are you talking about?” Lee Gun asked.
“She just confessed her love for you!”
Lee Gun scrunched up his face as if Hugo was speaking nonsense. “Did you really think that she gave a real confession?”
What?”
“The Zodiac Saints are making a big fuss about my items. They’ll say anything to get them. She should have said something a bit more believable.”
“Something more believable…”
- I like your bold actions, and I like your grumpy personality. I like your appearance and face. I like everything about you! Do you understand me?
Hugo froze. C-Could it be?
Lee Gun shook his head from side to side. “Who the hell would like my personality and a face like this? Let’s go. The air in this neighborhood isn’t that great.”
“…!!!”
Hugo was shocked as he looked at Lee Gun. Hugo couldn’t comprehend Lee Gun’s reaction at all.
In the end, Hugo was full of questions as he disappeared alongside Lee Gun.
[Whew! It was a success!]
At that moment, two beings hidden underneath the floor revealed their heads. They were the monster subordinates serving the Scorpio Saint.
They were elated as they watched the retreating figure of Lee Gun. He had turned down Heiji.
[Good. We protected that human in the place of our princess!]
[If we hadn’t interfered, I’m sure he would have fallen for her confession!]
[She’s the Gemini Saint, right? At the end of the day, she can’t hold a candle against our princess, but… she is dangerously beautiful for a human like him…!]
[That human male is a virgin. I’m sure of it! If we had left them alone, he would have 100% fallen for her feminine wiles and the possibility of sex!]
Yes, they had taken measures to make sure that Lee Gun wouldn’t fall for Heiji.
[This is an ultimate deadly skill! It’s a poison that dulls the feeling of affection!]
[It’s called “Celibate Time”!]
The Constructs of Scorpio cheered in joy.
[In front of this poison, sexual desire and sexual dreams are useless! These desires won’t be able to dominate Lee Gun’s thoughts!]
While the Scorpio Constructs disappeared as they cheered, some beings were monitoring them.
[Those Scorpios are sly.]
[They hurt our Zodiac Saint using such an underhanded trick…!]
They were none other than the fairies under the Gemini temple, who traveled with Heiji.
[Hurry up and inform her!]
The eyes of the fairies flashed.
* * *
“What? Heiji did what to Lee Gun!?”
Harbin, China.
Sophie, who was heading to Russia, almost screamed when she heard the shocking story that Yang Wei told her.
“Are you sure that’s true?”
“Yes. I distinctly heard it!”
Currently, Red Eye had yet to appear on the earth. In the future, there would be four great raids, and right now, the Zodiac Saints were moving in teams for one of them, which would later be dubbed the great raid of Russia.
A monster was occupying Russia and threatening the entire continent. So all twelve Zodiac Saints had been invited.
Steel Wall with an Adamant Body—the Taurus Saint
Humanity’s Final Weapon—the Gemini Saint
The Greatest Strategist—the Cancer Saint
The Wild Man of Destruction—the Leo Saint
Peerless Genius Swordsman—the Virgo Saint
The Ingredient Producer—the Libra Saint
God’s Blacksmith—the Capricorn Saint
Everchanging Magician—the Pisces Saint
The Savior of Healing—the Aquarius Saint
Lastly, the Savior of Affluence—the Aries Saint.
As his name implied, Yang Wei was in charge of acquiring supplies.
Yang Wei whispered to those who he had teamed up with for this venture, “Do you really think that Humanity’s Weapon confessed to Lee Gun?!”
“Does that woman even have functioning eyes?! How can she like that monster?”
“That’s beside the point. How did you find out about it, pig?”
The voice of a woman came from the back. Yang Wei rubbed it in their faces as he triumphantly said, “Eh-hehm! I thought Lee Gun would make me money, so I put a tail on him! I stole things like Lee Gun’s clothes to resell them. Anyway, I think I’ll make a great deal of money if I sell this piece of news to the tabloids— Ahhhk!!!”
Yang Wei suddenly screamed. It was to be expected since he realized that the one who had asked him that was the Gemini Saint Heiji.
“Ahhhk!! Y…You— Kuh-huhk!”
“Should I roast you and sell you in the market?” A smiling Heiji angrily grabbed Yang Wei’s face.
Sophie burst out laughing. “Is it true that you like Lee Gun, Heiji? Your standards are so low that it is in hell. The world’s greatest man is beside Lee Gun, so how can you like that orc— Kuh-huhk!!!”
Sophie fell over when a phone hit the back of her head. A familiar face had thrown the phone.
“You are going too far with what you say, bedwetter.”
“L-Lee Gun! Hugo Otis!”
Yang Wei was surprised.
When Lee Gun appeared there, Heiji was happy but embarrassed to death at the same time. She wanted to get out of there. However, she didn’t even have the time as other familiar faces appeared in the square.
“Why is he here?”
“I thought he couldn’t participate because his arm was injured.”
“!”
They were Stevens and Kevin. Next came the Taurus Saint Ivan and Jean-Louis. The Pisces Saint Liv and Sergeyevich followed suit. The last to arrive was the Libra Saint Giselle.
All the Zodiac Saints had gathered in one place.
Heiji and Hailey glared at each other.
The stand-off lasted a moment before Ivan spoke in annoyance. “What the hell? Why do we have so many of us looking like they’ve been starving themselves? At this rate, it’ll eat into how much we can bring in. We are already distributing cuts based on contribution.”
Ivan snorted as he looked at Lee Gun, who was applying his bandages. “You won’t be able to swing your fist this time, Lee Gun. You should stop hanging around us and go back.”
Lee Gun sneered. “This was sent to me personally, so how could I ignore it?”
Everyone was surprised when Lee Gun brought out an item. It was a personal seal of the Russian President.
The seal allowed one free entry to all the sealed regions in Russia. It also gave Lee Gun the carte blanche power to move the army in the Eurasia region. Then there was a letter that asked him to save Russia.
In reality, Lee Gun had been given the position of commander.
Ivan glared at him. “What the hell? We never received such a thing…!?”
“I guess he finds you guys unreliable.”
“What the hell did you just say?!”
“What? Just compare our achievements. It’s true.”
“Son of a bitch!”
When the air between the two started to get violent, Hugo got in between them. He tried to calm them down and shouted, “Ah! Please don’t fight! Teacher is here as support! He gave me the authority to carry out this mission!”
Everyone’s mouth fell open. Of course, they knew what this implies.
“That means Hugo is the leader of this mission…?”
Stevens and Kevin, who had been watching from the sidelines, spoke up. They were unable to accept this arrangement.
“Hey? Are you kidding me? He’s the weakest among us, and he can’t even cause damage…!!”
“While Teacher might have approved it, you can’t be the leader!”
“Lee Gun!! What are you thinking? How can you make him your proxy?”
“He’ll die. Please stop this.”
Jean-Louis clicked his tongue as if he pitied Hugo. Heiji and Yang Wei shook their heads from side to side. Sophie, who was a fan of Hugo, couldn’t say anything.
They all knew the truth. Hugo might be a fighting-type Zodiac Saint, but he was called squirt gun for a reason.
While he was a fighter, he was too weak. Ivan, who had monstrous power, would beat Hugo up on the regular. Hugo was a weakling.
So the non-fighters looked at him in pity.
Sophie carefully tried to talk him out of it. “H-Hugo. Why don’t you let Ivan take over…”
Ivan was a defensive-type Zodiac Saint. As a tanker, Ivan stood at the very front. He was the spearhead.
This made Lee Gun laugh in derision. “Do you not realize that the monster in Russia has a very high attack? It’s the highest-rank monster we’ve encountered so far. You have a body made out of glass, so you’ll probably be the first to run away. Why would I leave it to you?”
“You’re such an asshole, Lee Gun!” An angry Ivan tried to punch Lee Gun.
The surprised Heiji and Hailey tried to stop Ivan, while Jean-Louis smirked as if he found all this funny.
However, at that moment…
Kwahk!!
“…?!”
Someone grabbed Ivan’s arm.
Everyone’s mouth fell open when they saw who it was.
“H-Hugo?!”
Hugo had grabbed Ivan’s arm with one hand. Ivan was normally the first or second Zodiac Saint in terms of power. Even a weak blow by him would usually send Hugo to the ground!
“Please use your words. If you lay a hand on Teacher, I won’t stand back.”
Ivan was flustered for only a moment. He ground his teeth. “You’re a lousy bastard with a big mouth! You always took a beating from me, yet you dare try to stop me!”
Ivan put magical energy into his body. As always, he planned on beating Hugo half to death.
Hugo flinched when he saw the fist flying toward him like usual. However, he was surprised when he caught the look in Lee Gun’s eyes.
‘!’
In truth, Lee Gun had guessed how events would play out. So he had given instructions to Hugo beforehand.
‘If that angry cow charges toward you, don’t be afraid. Just meet him with your fist.’
‘What?! My fist? Are you playing with me? Do you realize how strong Ivan is? In terms of strength, he is ranked 1 or 2…!’
‘It’s fine. Just trust me. Don’t say anything. Swing at him as hard as you can.’
When Hugo recalled these words, his eyes turned sharp. He already possessed excellent speed and visual acuity, so dodging Ivan’s fist wasn’t hard.
‘!’
Then he made a fist and took a swing!
Boohoo-gahk!!!
Hugo’s fist struck Ivan’s face.
As if a fist made out of stone had hit him, Ivan was sent flying like a paper doll.
Absolute silence descended into the square. Everyone’s expression was a sight to behold.
The weakest of them had sent the strongest flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 464: Book 1, Epilogue 17 - I like you (3)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 17 - I like you (3)
Bbah-gahk!!!
An incredible sound rang out.
The Taurus Saint Ivan had fallen to the ground, and the mouths of the other Zodiac Saints fell open from surprise.
“T-That weakling….”
“He sent Ivan flying?!”
This was especially true of Jean-Louis. His usual mirth was nowhere to be seen as he looked at the two men.
When he checked again, Ivan remained down, and Hugo had his fist out.
“No way!!”
“We know his skills better than anyone!”
There was a reason Hugo was called a paper doll.
Despite being weak, he had a strong sense of righteousness. And this led to him being beaten up by the monsters. He was all bark and no bite!
“Hugo…!! So cool!”
Sophie put a hand over her face as if she was about to have a bloody nose.
Ivan was having a hard time getting back up. He wasn’t injured, but he had suffered psychological damage.
‘I was hit and sent flying by that bastard??’
Hugo had been his personal sandbag. Ivan merely had to grab Hugo by the face, and Hugo wouldn’t be able to escape. All the Archer Saint could do was take a beating!
On the other hand, Hugo was also in disbelief. He merely stared at his fist. His reaction was understandable since he couldn’t even move Lee Gun’s arm by five degrees…!
“Teacher!”
“It’s as I've said. You just have to do as you were taught.”
“You were right, Teacher! He was slower than you!”
“Yes. I’m glad you reaped the result of being beaten by me.”
When Hugo yelled in delight, Jean-Louis glared at Lee Gun.
The other Zodiacs looked stricken with fear as they gazed at Lee Gun.
“Beaten… No, he did as taught…?”
“My god! I did hear he was learning under Lee Gun, but…”
“It has only been four months.”
Changing someone to this degree in mere months wasn’t possible.
“What kind of magic did you work on him, Lee Gun?”
Jean-Louis had an expression of disagreement when he heard Stevens’s words. He furrowed his brows. “There is no way to accomplish that through training. Did you guys secretly place a buff on him?”
When Jean-Louis looked at Heiji and Sophie, the two women became angry as if he were speaking nonsense.
“If such a thing were possible through buff skills, I would have long sold it to you guys!”
“If that was possible, I would have switched to being a close-range fighter!”
Their words made sense.
In truth, there was no sign of Hugo receiving a buff. That was why all of them felt chills run up their spines.
Lee Gun was able to build up a weak person like Hugo to this degree.
“If I ask Lee Gun to teach me, will I be able to get the same result?”
“Shut up, cat! I’m going to ask Teacher to instruct me first!”
Lee Gun smirked as he looked at Ivan, who was still in a state of shock. “Idiot! It seems an archer is a much better tanker than you.”
“…!!!”
“I’ll stick to my original plan. I’m delegating the mission to Taeksoo.”
Ivan felt a surge of anger, yet he couldn’t say anything. He was already having a mental breakdown because of the counterattack from Hugo, who used to be his sandbag.
At that moment, Jean-Louis let out an odd laugh. “You shouldn’t fly too close to the sun.”
As if it had read Jean-Louis’s thoughts, his shadow started to move.
‘I have to get rid of him before he oversteps his bounds.’
Heiji furrowed her brow when she saw this.
* * *
The night before they entered Russia, the Zodiac Saints broke off into their teams as they each made preparations.
At that moment, Sophie was biting her lips as she looked at Jean-Louis, who had called her out.
“What did you just say?” Sophie glared at Jean-Louis.
Jean-Louis laughed as if he was wondering whether Sophie was deaf. “I didn’t ask you a hard question. I’m merely asking about the current state of Lee Gun’s body.”
Sophie looked guarded. She furrowed her brows. “That orc… Why are you asking about the status of Lee Gun’s body?!”
“I’m asking because I’m curious.”
“I…I cannot discuss the health information of a patient with others. You must know this, right?”
“From what I know of you, you aren’t a stickler for the rules.”
“What did you just say?!” Sophie became angry, but she soon glared at Jean-Louis as if something bothered her.
Jean-Louis was considered the best strategist among them. Thanks to his plans, the Zodiac Saints could avoid taking damage during difficult raids.
Jean-Louis was someone they should be grateful to, yet that wasn’t the case.
‘He is a scary person.’
Since countless people approached her, Sophie was great at reading people through their auras. While Jean-Louis was exceptional, he emanated a dangerous smell.
So she said, “Lee Gun is being treated by me, but I cannot reveal any information about him.”
“I’m a bit hurt that you’re so guarded toward me. The monsters in Russia are strong, and I’m trying to come up with a plan. I’m just trying to calculate if I’ll be able to count Lee Gun as a fighter or not.”
“If it’s something like that, why don’t you ask him yourself?”
“You know Lee Gun’s personality. He’s a psycho who’ll jump into a fight as if he is a moth drawn to a flame. He’ll do so even if his arm is broken. How can I expect to receive a normal answer from that crazy man?”
“Are you sure you won’t use the information I reveal to lure Lee Gun into a trap?”
“!”
Jean-Louis’s eyes turned round when Sophie made a pretty sharp observation. He burst out laughing. It was a condescending laugh, as if he hadn’t expected her to be able to think so far.
“I thought you didn’t like Lee Gun. I thought you wouldn't care if he gets hurt or not.”
“While I might not like him, I do not play with the lives of others!”
“Oh?”
“Anyway, you should never call me out again for this reason. It leaves a bad taste in my mouth.” Sophie huffed in anger as she turned around.
Jean-Louis snickered as if he found this funny. It was obvious. She was saying this because of Hugo.
“She is foolishly pretending to be a hero.”
It didn’t matter in the end. He had many ways to find out about Lee Gun’s status. He didn’t need Sophie.
‘I’ll just have to check with Aquarius. That’ll be the end of it.’
Currently, everyone was looking up to Lee Gun, and Lee Gun was becoming the focal point of their group. A mutant was spoiling the mood.
Therefore, Jean-Louis laughed as he summoned his underling.
[Come out, servant that travels under the surface of the world.]
A black whale surged up from his shadow. This whale was a special Construct that could travel to the world of the gods. Jean-Louis was about to enter the whale’s mouth when…
Kwahng!!!
“!!”
A laser beam shot through the sky, piercing through the forehead of the whale. The whale let out a horrible scream as it went back into the shadow.
At the same time, a woman’s voice rang out. “How dare you try to lay hands on Lee Gun?”
Jean-Louis was dumbfounded to hear the familiar voice. He burst out laughing.
“Oh wow!”
The one to get rid of his Construct was Heiji. Moreover, she was using Fairy Monarch Raeriqueen, so she possessed a considerable amount of magical energy.
“If you try anything funny against Lee Gun, I’ll kill you first.”
Jean-Louis couldn’t help but laugh at her threat. “Can it be? You do like Lee Gun?”
“!”
Heiji’s face turned red as she nibbled at her lips.
“Pfft! I heard it from Yang Wei. Was it true? It seems you have a very low taste for a normal person—”
Kwahng!!!
Before he could even finish, a meteor fell on top of his head.
Thankfully, he was quick in dodging. If the meteor had flattened him, he would have been crushed to death.
An angry Heiji glared at Jean-Louis. “I’m going to kill you.”
“Oh my! How scary.”
“Anyway, I have no idea why you don’t like Lee Gun. You shouldn’t bother someone ailing.”
When he heard Heiji’s words, Jean-Louis let out a sigh as if he had no choice. “Alright. I’ll do as you wish.”
“Really?”
“In terms of destructive capability, you are number 1 or 2. Why would I go against someone like that?”
When Jean-Louis nodded, Heiji lowered her hand. “You promised.”
Heiji seemed to believe him. She disappeared using her teleport spell.
Jean-Louis smirked in contempt. “That makes it one more to get rid of.”
* * *
It was the second day, and they had reached the sealed eastern part of Russia.
Lee Gun became angry as they traveled through China to enter Russia. “What nonsense did you spout right now?”
“I’m saying you should give up on the eastern region. We should head west, where the capital is.”
Jean-Louis had suddenly stopped the group, and his words left Lee Gun dumbfounded.
The other fighters had already left for the south and west. The only ones left there were Lee Gun’s team (Lee Gun and Hugo) and Jean-Louis’s team (Jean-Louis, Sophie, Yang Wei, and Liv).
Out of nowhere, Jean-Louis’s team had blocked the path of Lee Gun’s team.
Lee Gun grabbed Jean-Louis by his collar. “Have you lost your mind? Do you not realize the situation right now? The most dangerous monster is located at the heart of Russia. The west is relatively safe because of the barrier around that region. On the other hand, the east is about to be overrun. It’s where the monsters are breeding!”
“Yes. That’s why the eastern region was sealed. We did it since we can’t let the monsters escape toward other countries.”
“Yet you want to ignore the east and go to the west?”
“Do you have a problem with that?”
“Do you not realize the newly hatched monsters consume a lot of humans?!”
“I never expected you to be so dumb. Why are you trying to go and save people who are already dead? We have no idea what’s going on inside the eastern region. It makes more sense to go through the west to reach the central region.”
“It seems my words aren’t getting through to you. Get out of my way. I don't care if you guys head toward the west. I’ll enter through the east.”
Jean-Louis laughed in derision as he looked at Lee Gun. “We were barely able to seal the eastern region. If you enter through there, the monsters will be able to come out. It will harm other countries.”
“I’ll kill them all before they can exit that place.”
“Wow! I’m not sure if you’re full of yourself, brave, or bordering on stupid. Are you always this confident?”
“I wouldn’t have moved like this unless I was sure I could take this place. I’ve already assessed the level of the monsters inside. Buzz off!”
“Ah. Is that so?”
Lee Gun didn’t want to waste any more time, so he pushed Jean-Louis aside and entered the sealed region.
The politicians and the soldiers murmured to each other, looking worried. It was to be expected.
While countless Russians were stuck inside this region, it had been sealed, so it wouldn’t threaten the rest of humanity around the world.
“Are you sure we should let him go in there? He was barely able to seal that region. If things go sideways, it’ll endanger the outside.…!”
“The one entering the place is Lee Gun. We can trust him.”
When Jean-Louis tried to get in the vehicle, a flustered Sophie ran up to him. “A-Are you sure it’ll be fine? The monsters in the east are young. While they may be easy to kill, there are too many of them! Just two of them won’t be enough!”
Jean-Louis let out an odd smile. “I already gave him a warning. You heard what he said. He insisted on going in, so if he fails, he’ll take responsibility for his actions.”
“What?!”
Sophie quickly tried to chase after Lee Gun and Hugo, but Jean-Louis grabbed her. “I’m joking. He is someone who hasn’t lost yet. Moreover, do you think he’ll fail the raid when several countries may be endangered?”
“Well, I do agree he’s skilled even if he is ugly.”
“Yes. If he fails, it would be mud on his face. They’ll call him the arrogant fallen hero.” Jean-Louis smirked as he walked towards the west.
Around that time, Lee Gun had entered the sealed region through the east, and he was killing the monsters without much difficulty.
Kwah-jeek!
“Teacher!! We finished cleaning up after you! At this rate, we’ll be able to finish our work in two days. We’ll be able to rejoin— Ah! Teacher!!”
“!”
A monster shot out from the bog. It was a high-level monster.
Lee Gun laughed as he held up Heaven’s Punishment. “This is nothing—!”
At that moment…
Throb!
“Oohk!!”
“Teacher?!”
Lee Gun lost his grip on Heaven’s Punishment and collapsed to the ground.
“Teacher!!” A surprised Hugo ran toward him.
Lee Gun clutched at his chest in pain and vomited blood.
“Kuh-huhk…!!”
“Teacher! What’s wrong?”
Lee Gun ground his teeth as he had trouble breathing. The pain was emanating from his chest!
‘Shit! Why is it…!’
Suddenly, Lee Gun remembered what Sophie had said.
- Yes. Overall you’re in good health except… Cysts have grown inside your chest. Here, here and here.
- Cysts?
- Yes. They won’t cause you too much trouble if you drink the medicine I give you. Unless you pop them, you won’t feel much pain. You must never pop them. Alright?
- You think I’m crazy? Why would I pop them?
- Why else? You are a masochist— Kuh-huk!!
- I’m just good at enduring pain. I don’t like pain.
At that moment, Lee Gun gritted his teeth. Of all the places, the locations pointed out by Sophie were causing him pain. He couldn’t even move.
‘Shit! Did the bedwetter do something to me?’
No, it wasn’t Sophie. It was faint, but this energy felt like…
‘That damn crab bastard…!!’
For some reason, Jean-Louis had grabbed Lee Gun when he had been trying to convince Lee Gun to go to the west.
‘He’s trying to make me fail this raid by weakening my body.’
As expected, the monsters attempted to eat Lee Gun and Hugo before they could exit the barrier.
Lee Gun tried to grit his teeth as he tried to get up, but he fell over when he felt the horrible pain.
“Huh-uhk…!!”
“Teacher!”
In the end, Lee Gun’s consciousness was about to fade when…
[My blood flows in you. Rise.]
Scorpio appeared in front of him.
Favorite

chapters.title: Chapter 465: Book 1, Epilogue 18 - Rare Genius (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 18 - Rare Genius (1)
Lee Gun could feel a warm power circulate inside him. The excruciating stabbing pain that he felt all over his body started to fade away.
So he wondered if the healer Sophie had come.
‘This isn’t the ability of the Aquarius Saint.’
When he raised his head, the suffering Lee Gun didn’t see the blue light of the Aquarius. He saw the black light of Scorpio.
The black light spoke to Lee Gun.
[You are my only remaining comrade.]
“…!”
A hum was drowning out the voice, so Lee Gun had a hard time hearing the words.
The black light continued to speak.
[Among my blood relatives, Aslan was the most outstanding genius and our chosen one. He decided to sacrifice his life to protect you.]
“…?”
[He begged us not to kill you, so we decided to monitor you. What was the point in that if you are destined to die here?]
The voice sounded as if it had planned on making Lee Gun’s father its successor.
Scorpio looked a bit disappointed as it monitored Hugo. To be precise, it was looking at Sagittarius, whom Hugo served.
[Well, you’re better than the idiot who was enticed to kill his parents and younger brother.]
Sagittarius seemed confused and shaken.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows.
Scorpio was a mysterious Zodiac. It was one of the two Zodiacs that didn’t like revealing itself. According to rumors, Scorpio was a monster.
Scorpio was a mystery even to the other Zodiacs. It refused to reveal itself as if it considered itself above the other Zodiacs. However, while being a Zodiac, Scorpio was also the head of the Creators.
It continued.
[At the end of the day, you’re merely a mayfly with human blood flowing in you. I feel pity since I have to watch my last remaining comrade suffer. That’s why I can put you to rest if you want.]
Lee Gun ground his teeth. The hum in his ears made it hard to hear the Zodiac’s words, and the part that he could hear was hard to comprehend. However, he did decipher one part.
- I can put you to rest if you want.
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed. “Bastard. You want to kill me?”
When Lee Gun got up, Scorpio seemed amused.
[Oh. Are you worth watching?]
At the same time, a familiar voice rang near him.
“Lee Gun! Are you ok? Snap out of it!” Hailey quickly took Lee Gun in her arms and took out a potion.
Scorpio laughed when its Zodiac Saint looked after Lee Gun.
[Well, I guess watching you a bit longer won’t be too bad of an idea.]
Then something poked into Lee Gun’s side.
Kwah-jeek!
“Koohk!!”
“Teacher!!”
It appeared to be a black light shaped like the tail of a scorpion. This was the doing of Scorpio.
Lee Gun felt pain as if he had been injected with poison.
Hugo turned pale as he grabbed Lee Gun. “Teacher!”
“Calm yourself. He’s fine.”
“But…!”
“It’s an anesthetic that’ll reduce his pain."
Hailey seemed to be right. Lee Gun, who had been in extreme pain, started to recover some color to his face.
However, Hailey was soon surprised.
‘It’s the magical energy of my Zodiac that is being given to Lee Gun.’
Besides injecting an anesthetic poison inside Lee Gun, Scorpio also gave Lee Gun its power. Of course, this wasn’t anything special. It was another poison related to “Immunity.”
At the very least, Scorpio didn’t want Lee Gun to die so easily; it had decided to grow Lee Gun’s immunity at the very least.
Now, it didn’t matter if others tried to curse him or made him sick like currently. He’d be able to resist it on his own.
It also made him resilient enough to endure dozens of years of damage. The powerful blessing of Scorpio would allow him to survive even in the worst environment.
As proof of this, Lee Gun, who had been unable to get up, started to groan as he got back to his feet.
“T-Teacher! Are you ok?”
“Yes. I’m alive thanks to you guys.”
Hailey was relieved. “What a relief—”
Her relief lasted only a moment as she realized she was holding Lee Gun in her arms. When she met eyes with Lee Gun, she inwardly screamed as she disappeared.
Lee Gun’s head hit the floor, and he felt like dying.
“*#$&#$*!”
“Teacher!!”
“M-Mask. Give me my mask.”
“What?”
It didn’t matter in the end.
After Lee Gun put on his mask, his eyes flashed as he looked at the rampaging monsters.
* * *
“What?! Monsters are appearing from the east?”
“The west was a failure. Does this mean east failed too?!”
“What did you just say?!”
Central Russia, Novosibirsk—a city located in the vast expanse of Siberia.
It was the only central Russian city that could be accessed by humanity in the land of the monsters. It was also the frontline.
“Yes. It’s as you have heard. Lee Gun must have failed his raid of the east. It’s the price of him being arrogant.”
Jean-Louis’s words at the press conference created a commotion. The reactions were understandable since the raid through the western route had failed already.
The Zodiac Saints who had entered through the western route had many injuries. The western route was thought to be the relatively safer route, yet the difficulty level had skyrocketed as they traveled further in.
After trying to go to the problematic central region, they had to retreat to this city when they got tangled with the monsters of the western region.
And when they failed their raid, Jean-Louis had suddenly called for a press conference as if he needed to notify the public of something.
“We placed a barrier in the west, so there is no danger of monsters invading through from there. The problem is the east where Lee Gun messed with the hornet’s nest.”
“…!!”
“The monsters in the eastern region will soon spread across the world. If Lee Gun were with us in the west, things would have turned out differently. However, he was too stubborn, and things turned out like this. The Russian president gave Lee Gun the power of authority because he trusted Lee Gun. It’s too bad that things turned out like this.”
The government officials and the reporters fell into a state of panic.
“We thought it would be possible if it was Lee Gun…!”
Jean-Louis laughed when he saw the chaos. “In the end, Lee Gun is human.”
The reporters quickly disseminated the news.
As the news of Lee Gun’s defeat spread across the world, Jean-Louis smirked. Crippling a hero wasn’t hard.
“Anyway, we need to rethink Lee Gun’s leadership skills since he put the entire world in danger.”
Some people laughed in derision as they watched the press conference.
“This should be expected from that asshole.”
“He’s in for a rude awakening for being so brash.”
They were Ivan and Sergeyevich. They hated Lee Gun.
“It was obvious he would fail, so why would he go to the east? He wanted to stand out so much that he caused harm to those around him.”
“Of course, the east is in bad shape, so it would be great if we can save it. However, it would be great if he could recognize what’s possible and impossible before he takes action. I don’t know if he is an attention whore or a psycho.”
When Kevin heard this, he let out murderous intent as he grabbed Sergeyevich by the collar. Making a fist, he said, “You don’t have the right to yap your gums. You should be more discerning in who you make fun of.”
“What? You aren't even an adult. How dare you…!”
Jean-Louis let out a smile of victory when he heard the commotion. “Anyway, this incident is very important since humanity might be wiped out. This is unfortunate for the people trapped in the east, but we have to look at the greater good. We must destroy the nest itself. I believe that is the right course of action.”
“T..Then…!”
“We will do as we originally planned. We’ll ask each of the Zodiacs to bombard the eastern region. We will completely destroy the entire region…”
At that moment…
“Do you want to be boiled, crab bastard!!”
Bbah-gahk!!
Lee Gun opened the door as he entered the room and drop-kicked Jean-Louis.
The reporters didn’t even have time to scream.
“L-Lee Gun?!”
“?!”
“We were told you were eaten by the monsters of the east, so how are you here…!”
After sending Jean-Louis flying, Lee Gun took the mic. “I killed all the monsters in the east. If you have nothing better to do than listen to that asshole and write reports, you should take the healing kit to the people I brought out!”
The mouths of the Zodiac Saints fell open, and the press conference turned into a madhouse.
“Lee Gun saved the eastern region!”
“Send this out as breaking news!”
“What the hell?! Did he save the eastern region on his own?!”
The eastern region of Russia had been close to being erased from the face of the world, and it was saved thanks to Lee Gun’s actions.
Jean-Louis looked dumbfounded. He glared at Lee Gun. How could a human have such a malevolent light in his eyes?
Lee Gun ignored him as he exited the press conference room, but the surprised reporters tried to keep him in place.
“Mr. Lee Gun! Where are you going right now?”
“Get out of my way, or do you guys want to join me on the way to the central region? Stop interfering with my work.”
“What?! The others failed in entering that place… They are planning to reattempt the raid in one week…!”
“Who cares about that? I’m going by myself.”
“Ah! Teacher! I want to go with you…!!”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he left.
Kevin and Stevens, who had been sitting with their mouths open, quickly got up.
“I want to go too!”
“Me too!”
This raid in the central region would later be dubbed the Great Raid of Russia. It would birth the legendary video that awakened beings around the world would become obsessed with.
* * *
[Lee Gun succeeded in the Russian Raid!]
[The twelve Zodiac Saints also joined in.]
[In reality, Lee Gun was the one who made all the contributions.]
[Good job, mutant!]
The news programs were boisterous.
After the Great Raid of Russia came to an end, the Zodiac Saints gathered at the Notre Dame de Paris to be healed. They all had complicated expressions on their faces as they watched the news.
- The other Zodiac Saints are dashing and they are putting up stronger performances, but Lee Gun…! His personality is terrible, but he’s the hope of humanity!
- No way! Stevens is still the hope of humanity! Did you not see the video from the raid?
- Lee Gun is the best!
After the raid in Russia, the Zodiac Saints had a change of heart. It was understandable since they had seen Lee Gun for themselves in the battle.
Genius!
They saw a genius that no average being could surpass.
Stevens looked appalled as he leaned against the sofa. “Hmmph. Lee Gun is crazy.”
Lee Gun’s actions in the Central Russia raid showed that he wasn’t human. On the battlefield, the monsters were completely in the palm of Lee Gun’s hand.
The Zodiac Saints had encountered monsters that they had never seen before, yet Lee Gun was able to overwhelm them.
Stevens, who had always been confident in saying that there was no ceiling to his potential, felt something for the first time. It was the wall of futility. He realized that he could never overtake Lee Gun.
It wasn’t just him. Everyone probably felt the same thing.
- Ah. He is indeed a “mutant,” and he really is different from us.
Kevin, who was called a rare genius swordsman, possessed overwhelming skill, yet the look in his eyes changed. He also felt something.
Of course, the one with the most extreme reaction was someone else. He was beside himself with anger.
“Oh my! Your plan was a complete dud. What are you going to do, minion of Time?” The Libra Saint Giselle laughed as she looked at Jean-Louis, who was boiling with anger. “You planned on sinking Lee Gun’s image in Russia, yet people are praising him more now.”
It was rare to see Jean-Louis not laugh. He glared at her.
Giselle snickered when she felt anxiousness in him. “Who cares? It wasn’t as if the plan failed because it was a bad one. Lee Gun merely transcended above your plan.”
“It isn’t the time to be laughing. The Faith of the Zodiac Saints isn’t going to the Zodiacs right now. It’s heading toward Lee Gun. Do you realize this? It’s headed toward a mere human.”
“This has caused a big fuss among the Zodiacs, right?”
“It doesn’t matter. I have a plan to deal with that problem.”
“What kind of plan?”
“I’ll have to make some allies first.” Jean-Louis smirked as he picked up the scissors next to the potted plant. Including Hugo, he planned to turn all the Zodiac Saints into enemies of Lee Gun.
An odd light appeared around Giselle when she saw this. The light was none other than the soul of the original Libra Saint, who had been consumed by Negligence. She was anxious as she headed somewhere.
* * *
“H-Have you lost your mind?”
“What about it, bedwetter?”
Sophie couldn’t close her mouth when she inspected Lee Gun’s body. “You were able to fight when your body was in this state? You did all that in Russia?!!”
“Hmmph. What if I did?”
“You crazy orc!!”
The state of Lee Gun’s body was shocking.
‘This is beyond causing harm to his body. His lifespan was cut short too.’
The cysts, which she had warned should never be disturbed, had burst, causing extreme damage to his body.
‘Who would do this…!’
Sophie said, “I told you not to touch your wounds! You are a masochist who can’t hold back— Kuh-huhk!!”
Lee Gun growled after he rapped Sophie’s head. “Do you think I’m an idiot? I’m not the one who broke them open.”
“Then who…!!!” Sophie gasped and started to shake.
Didn’t Jean-Louis ask for Lee Gun’s medical records not too long ago? This strangely bothered her.
Lee Gun seemed oblivious as he calmly asked, “So? How much did I lose?”
“Excuse me?”
“My life expectancy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 466: Book 1, Epilogue 19 - Rare Genius (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 19 - Rare Genius (2)
“So? How much did I lose?”
“Excuse me?”
“My life expectancy.”
Sophie wondered if she had heard right. The reason was the expression on Lee Gun’s face as he asked the question.
Sophie looked at Lee Gun with a serious expression. “Are you sure you aren’t asking me about what I ate for lunch?”
“I didn’t?”
“Are you sure you’re talking about your own life?”
“I am.”
Sophie had to pound her chest in frustration. “The fact that you can ask such a question means you get the severity of your situation, right? How can you ask it in such a calm manner…”
“Uh. That’s why I’m asking in a serious manner. How long do I have left?”
Sophie didn’t think Lee Gun’s expression matched that of a person asking such a serious question. She let out a sigh.
In the first place, Lee Gun had a cavalier attitude. He didn’t seem to care if he died or not. And someone like that was asking about his lifespan, so she assumed Lee Gun had realized the severity of his situation.
She bit her lips. “It’s really bad. You won’t be able to live long.”
“How much?”
“Your lifespan has been shaved by almost half. At this rate, forty… No, you’ll die an early death around your mid-thirties.” Sophie clenched her fists.
However, she was soon surprised.
It was because Lee Gun burst out laughing as he clapped. “What the hell? I still have a lot of time left.”
“?!”
“You want to die, idiot? You spooked me because you became unnecessarily serious.”
Sophie was taken aback. “What the hell! I just told you right now that you have only ten years left to live?! Mid-thirties is—”
“I’m twenty-two years old right now. It’s incredibly long if I can live ten more years..”
“Excuse me?! How can you say dying in your thirties is long? In comparison, the Zodiac Saints will live a very long time thanks to their Zodiacs!”
“That has nothing to do with me.”
“!”
Lee Gun got up as if it wasn’t a big deal. “There is a chance that we can die today while we fight the monsters.”
A complicated expression appeared on Sophie’s face. “That’s… It applies to only you since you don’t have a Zodiac…”
“Five years.”
“!”
“I’ll eradicate all the monsters within that time. I just need to live until I can accomplish that task. I don’t care how many years I can live after that.”
“…!”
“That’s why ten years are enough. I’ll work for five years and enjoy the remaining five.”
Sophie gritted her teeth. “That’s… You’ll be able to extend your lifespan if you take some drugs. Don't worry too much about it! I’ll make sure to look for something good. I promise…”
When it seemed like Sophie was having a hard time dealing with this, Lee Gun rapped her head as if she was being foolish. “You’ve never done such a thing for me, so don’t start now, bedwetter.”
“Please call me by something else! I’ve never done such a thing!”
“Then I’ll call you a mongrel that barks.”
“I’m being serious! I’ll help you, so please don’t overdo it!”
“Don’t try so hard to get in my favor. I won’t let you have Taeksoo no matter how nice you are to me.”
Lee Gun smirked as he left.
Sophie grumbled and called him rude. “He acts like that even if I’m nice to him!”
Sophie was grumbling to herself when…
“How’s Lee Gun’s status?”
“?!!”
Jean-Louis appeared next to Sophie without making any sound. She almost screamed.
Then she glared at Jean-Louis. “It was your doing!”
“What are you talking about?”
“Don’t deny it. You’re the one who worsened Lee Gun’s condition, right?”
Mysterious cysts had been growing within Lee Gun’s body. They had adhered themselves to all the important organs, such as his lungs and heart. These masses were dangerous enough to kill Lee Gun if he wasn’t careful.
While she called them cysts, they weren’t malignant. So they shouldn’t have been a problem.
“The cysts were messed up with in the raid in Russia! They turned from benign to malignant! It harmed his vital organs, and now Lee Gun’s lifespan is…”
“I know nothing about that. It seems Lee Gun’s body isn’t in a great state. It’s quite unfortunate that those masses burst.”
Sophie glared at him. “I’ll tell the others.”
“I have nothing to do with it. Are you sure you want to do that?”
“What do you mean?”
“The only one who knew about Lee Gun’s health status was you. You were the only one who knew he had cysts inside his body, right?”
“…!”
“If someone burst those cysts, isn’t it logical that you’re the culprit?”
“Don’t try to frame me! I would never do such a…!!”
Sophie bit her lips. A thought appeared in the corner of her mind.
‘Can it be? My Zodiac could have…’
Her Zodiac had been trying to use Lee Gun to make more money.
Jean-Louis let out an odd laugh. “What would happen if Hugo Otis found out about this?”
“…!?”
“I know it all. The medicine that Aquarius gives to Lee Gun isn’t effective. You knew this, yet you kept your silence. You passed on those medicines.”
Sophie was flustered. “That’s not true! Without those medicines, Lee Gun’s body would…!!”
“You know this, yet you keep stringing him along, saying he’ll be able to live longer.” Jean-Louis laughed in derision. “Anyway, Hugo is righteous, and he looks up to Lee Gun. If he finds out about this, it’ll be a sight to behold.”
Jean-Louis let out a cheeky smile as he disappeared.
Sophie ground her teeth and immediately called for her Zodiac. “Oh, my Zodiac! Did you really pass on information about Lee Gun to Jean-Louis?”
While she couched it as a question, it wasn’t a question at all.
“The only one who would have known about the status of Lee Gun’s body is you!”
As soon as she spoke, a water spirit appeared above her head. It was none other than Aquarius.
When Aquarius saw the enraged apostle, she laughed at Sophie for daring to act impudently toward her.
[He is a gnat who’ll die soon. Why do you foolishly show such interest in him?]
“What?”
[As soon as he awakened, Lee Gun was destined to live a short life. Unlike the chosen ones such as you, he’s a lowly mutant. He dared to use the power of the gods as a human. It’s the price of showing no fear toward us.]
“Still, I don’t think you should have—”
[You have to choose.]
“What?”
[You can keep your mouth shut, and it’ll allow you to keep the status quo in your life. Or else…]
Aquarius contemptuously laughed.
[You can advocate for someone who won’t even be able to live long. You can return to your life before you became a Zodiac Saint. You can return to living the life of a bum.]
Sophie’s face turned pale when she thought about her past life.
However, as soon as her Zodiac disappeared, she ground her teeth. While she had been threatened, she couldn’t turn a blind eye to Lee Gun’s death. Therefore, Sophie secretly created a message and called for her Construct.
“Please deliver this to Lee Gun. Please tell him that he has to do everything written there.”
[All of it?]
Jean-Louis contemptuously laughed when he saw Sophie’s rebellious action.
* * *
The next day…
“What? I can take all of this?”
After he met up with Heiji, Lee Gun’s eyes turned round. In truth, Lee Gun had gone looking for Heiji after he had received the note from Sophie.
[You’ll be able to heal your body if you have the tears and blood of fairies belonging to the Gemini temple. It won’t be easy, but please talk to Heiji about it.]
Of course, it wasn’t a normal note. On the surface, it said, “Please wait for me after you purify yourself.” On the inside, the note held a secret message about Heiji.
Despite the possibility of being tricked, Lee Gun had decided to meet Heiji. Of course, he didn’t expect Heiji would hand over the tears and blood of the fairies.
It was to be expected since fairies became weaker if they became corrupted. Blood symbolized corruption for the fairies, so it was a subject that shouldn’t be broached. Moreover, the fairies were a race that Heiji treated with extreme care.
As soon as he told her his request, he had been prepared to fight Heiji.
“Alright. If it’s only that, you can take it.”
When he saw Heiji’s extremely easygoing reaction, Lee Gun looked at her as if he were looking at a bug. “How high of a fee are you going to charge me that you’re acting like this…?”
Heiji felt a surge of anger. She pouted. “I’m not asking for anything! I also received a note from Sophie! I’m not sure what’s going on, but she said you were hurt a lot this time around! I’m not someone who would charge you right now when you’re in such a state!”
“Right now? How much debt are you planning on putting on my tab?”
When Lee Gun looked at her with contempt(?), Heiji pounded her chest in frustration. “Damn it! I’m saying I’m not going to take any money from you!”
“????”
Lee Gun tilted his head in confusion. It was as if this situation didn’t make any sense the more she talked.
“You’re meticulous about taking money from others down to the cent, so why?”
While all the Zodiac Saints loved money, Heiji was one of the ones who really loved money.
Of course, Heiji wasn’t in the waste or parasite category of Lee Gun (Sophie, Yang Wei, Sergeyevich, Ivan, and Giselle), who viewed the lives of humans as money.
But she was meticulous when it came to transactions involving money. That was why Lee Gun looked at Heiji with suspicion.
Heiji’s face turned red at Lee Gun’s reaction. “I…I do have one request…”
“Request?”
The light in Lee Gun’s eyes turned violent. It was a cold look, as if Heiji was about to reveal her true colors. “Alright. I knew this was coming. What do you want? You want me to be your slave? Servant or….”
“Date.”
“Da… What?”
“Date!!!”
Lee Gun blinked in surprise. Flustered, he took a step backward. “…uh…ah…with Taeksoo?”
Heiji angrily tossed the ingredients at him. “Not him! You! I want a date with you!”
“…?????” Lee Gun looked shell-shocked, but he soon nodded as if he had realized something. “Alright. Let’s go on a date.”
Heiji became full of unadulterated joy. However, her happiness lasted only one minute. The reason was the place Lee Gun had taken her to.
“W-Why are we in the forge? Also, there’s no one here?”
“I rented it. Anyway, you don’t have to beat around the bush.”
“W-What?”
When Lee Gun started taking off his clothes, the pouting Heiji almost screamed.
Lee Gun then got close to her and grabbed Heiji’s arm. “We don’t have much time. Let’s do this quickly.”
“Uh??!!”
Did he act ignorant all this time while knowing what she wanted from him? Heiji didn’t mind his approach, so she started taking off her outer clothing. “I…I don’t like the location, but if you don’t mind…”
However, she soon screamed.
After pulling on her arm, Lee Gun poured plaster on her hand.
“Ahhk! What the hell are you doing right now?”
“What else? I’m trying to make a model so that I can make you a weapon.”
“What?!!”
“It won’t take me long. Just wait here.”
When Lee Gun lit the kiln, a ferocious heat hit them. It was so hot that one couldn’t help but take off one’s clothes.
Heiji spat fire from her mouth when she saw Lee Gun’s actions. “Hey! Did you think I seduced you to get a weapon out of you?!”
“Uh? You did not?”
Heiji felt her insides boiling. No, she did gain a lot since she had seen Lee Gun without his clothes, but still…!
“Damn it! I don’t need a weapon! I want to be with you… I like you enough that I want to do it with you!”
Finally, Lee Gun’s face turned slightly red. He seemed to have finally realized what was going on.
As this was going on, a monster monitoring them raised an alarm.
[Ahhhk! It’s an emergency! The Celibate Time skill has lost a bit of its effectiveness! We have to place another one on him!!]
A hidden subordinate of Hailey had been monitoring Lee Gun. It screamed as it coughed up blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 467: Book 1, Epilogue 20 - Sworn Enemy (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 20 - Sworn Enemy (1)
[Emergency! That virgin human is about to fall for a human woman!]
The monster Construct of the Scorpio temple screamed bloody murder as it called for its allies.
To stop Lee Gun from falling for other women, one Scorpio Construct had been nominated to monitor Lee Gun. It was supposed to run interference.
Of course, it remained hidden since it didn’t want to be found out by Lee Gun.
However, the current situation could turn romantic. Furthermore, if the Construct did nothing, this might become a lewd erotic movie!
[Ahhhk!! Leader! You have to come quickly! Kuh-huhk!]
The Construct had been invisible up until now, but Heiji crushed it before it could call for its comrades.
She then approached the hesitant Lee Gun. “Really? Do I have to spell this out for you?” Heiji grabbed Lee Gun’s face.
When her long and elegant hands touched his face, Lee Gun started to sweat. “I mean… Heyh…”
It was rare for Lee Gun to be this flustered. He tried to detach himself from Heiji’s hands, but Heiji roughly pushed him against the wall.
Kwahng!
“Ahhhk!”
Lee Gun didn’t even have the chance to feel pain. Heiji took off another layer of her clothes until her skin showed.
“?!”
When her outer clothing was discarded, her bare shoulders and collarbones came into view. Lee Gun was unsure where to place his gaze.
Heiji was very aggressive. It seemed she was furious that the Scorpio temple’s Celibate Time skill had interfered with her affairs.
As she took off Lee Gun’s mask, she said, “Anyway, I’ll help you acquire the blood and tears of the fairies since your life's on the line.”
“I thought you treasured your fairies.”
“I do treasure them. I raised them as if they are my children.”
“Yet you’ll let me acquire their blood and tears?”
“I can gather their tears if I tickle them. Drawing blood from them won’t be too hard either. They’ll cooperate if I’m with you.”
Lee Gun immediately knew this was true. If Heiji were next to him, the fairies wouldn’t attack him. There was no downside if they could acquire what each of them wanted without any loss.
As if she had read his thoughts, Heiji’s face moved closer to his. It seemed she was trying to kiss him.
“That is why you can trust—”
“Kuhk!”
However, Lee Gun suddenly grabbed Heiji’s chin. He pushed her away as if he didn’t like her coming onto him without permission. “Get off me! Don’t come closer to me.”
Heiji angrily replied, “Are you dead down there?!”
“It isn’t!”
“Then why? Do you not like me?!”
“It isn’t about liking you or not. Why would I trust you guys?”
“What?”
“You guys are like merchants who only know about money.” Lee Gun held out his hand. “Whatever. Just hand over the items.”
“Hey!”
“I’ll think about it afterward”
“…!”
Heiji was surprised by the answer. It wasn’t all that bad, so she let out a bright smile. While his actions and words were rude, it couldn’t be helped; she was dealing with Lee Gun after all.
‘He didn’t like us from the start.’
She said, “Alright. I’ll show you that you can trust me. I’ve been persuading them. The fairies will come to meet us.”
Lee Gun nodded. While he hated the existence of the twelve Zodiac Saints, it wasn’t as if he didn’t get along with all of them. Of course, Heiji was one of them.
So he might be able to make her his comrade, like Hugo.
* * *
“That was what I was hoping for.”
Three hours had passed.
Lee Gun sighed when he saw the figures before him. They were the fairies.
Around a dozen minutes ago, a single fairy had come out to greet him, and he had followed it. In the end, he had arrived in a desolate forest.
The place was full of fairies as big as his forearm. These fairies had called Lee Gun to this place, yet their eyes flashed as they looked at him.
[How dare a mere human want our blood and tears.]
[We’ll have to teach him a lesson so that he can come to his senses.]
Lee Gun sighed. He should have expected this.
As he furrowed his brows, he looked at his surroundings. “Where’s your Zodiac Saint? She was supposed to ask you guys for blood. She said she would ask only a drop from each one of you.”
[Hmmph. Do you think we’ll listen to the words of a mere human?]
[She didn’t know her place. She dared to ask us to hand over our blood and tears to you.]
Lee Gun clicked his tongue.
‘That idiot failed in her negotiation.’
It didn't matter how much she treasured them and treated them well. The base nature of Constructs was like this.
Lee Gun turned around. “If you guys don’t want to give it up voluntarily, it’s fine. Also, it isn’t as if I know if the bedwetter was telling the truth.”
Lee Gun didn’t want to waste his power. Annoyed, he tried to leave the forest.
“!”
However, the fairies got in his way.
Lee Gun came to a stop. He snorted as he looked at them. “What are you trying to pull?”
[You dared to enter our territory, yet you think you can just leave?]
“I’m pretty sure you shouldn’t be doing this. Your leader is the partner of the Gemini Saint.”
He was referring to the Fairy Monarch Raeriqueen.
“If the Fairy Monarch finds out what you guys are up to—”
At that moment.
[Monarch? Are you looking for me?]
“!”
Lee Gun’s eyes turned round when he heard the voice coming from behind him. When he turned his head around, he saw a beautiful fairy with long hair floating in the air.
It was much larger than the other fairies and was as big as a human child. She was the Fairy Monarch Raeriqueen, whom Heiji used as a familiar.
Raeriqueen had heard an interesting story from Jean-Louis, so she smirked as she looked at Lee Gun.
[You will become a good nutrient for us.]
“Hmmph. Nutrient?”
[At the very least, that idiot Heiji lured a decent prey. That’s quite the achievement, so I won’t suck out her vitality this time.]
“Vitality?” Lee Gun turned back around as if he couldn’t ignore that. “What are you talking about?”
The fairies surrounding him let out evil laughs.
[We dare not drain and consume magical energy from our master, right?]
Lee Gun immediately realized what was going on. To manifest here, the fairies needed magical energy. He had wondered where they had acquired that amount of magical energy.
“You little insects basically tapped your Zodiac Saint and are draining her.”
The fairies rushed Lee Gun to kill him.
[An awakened being without a Zodiac is a great meal!]
[It’s great since Heiji isn’t enough!]
The fairies tried to consume everything, including Lee Gun’s flesh. They looked like evil spirits coming toward him.
Lee Gun was dumbfounded. He took out Heaven’s Punishment. “These bastards are like monsters!”
He brought down the heavy ax on a fairy.
Kwah-jeek!
[Kuh-huhk!!]
Fairy Monarch Raeriqueen ground her teeth when one of her subjects fell. The angry fairy monarch snorted as she summoned someone.
‘!’
It was none other than Lee Jaewon! The summoned Lee Jaewon didn’t even have time to be surprised.
“…kuhk!!”
“!!”
The fairy monarch stood behind the summoned human, and her hand shot out of his stomach. Lee Jaewon vomited blood, and she threw him away as if he was trash.
[Eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. I returned the favor.]
Sparks flew from Lee Gun’s eyes.
When Lee Gun disappeared from sight, the fairy monarch knew everything was going as planned. She intended to use her next spell, knowing an angry Lee Gun would attack her.
‘I’ll use a counter to get rid of him.’
However, Lee Gun unexpectedly appeared next to Lee Jaewon. After taking Lee Jaewon in his arms, he was about to go straight toward Sophie. He was as angry as he could be, but he knew his priorities.
‘If I let him be like this, he’ll die.’
Lee Jaewon wasn’t like them. He was a normal human. If Lee Gun used his legs, he could reach Sophie in a couple of minutes! He would be cutting it very close!
When Lee Gun tried to exit the forest, the Fairy Monarch gnashed her teeth.
[I won’t let you!]
She sent a spell in the direction of a city.
Kwang!!!
The fairy monarch’s attack destroyed the mountain next to the city.
Lee Gun came to a stop when he saw the incredible destructive power. He furrowed his brows.
[If you leave, I’ll send the next one toward the city. Come back here while I’m still being nice.]
He heard Raeriqueen’s laughter as he held onto Lee Jaewon. His eyes were bloodshot. “You dare…!”
At that moment, Lee Jaewon grabbed Lee Gun. “Lee Gun-nim… I’m fine… I don’t mind if you leave me behind.”
“What nonsense are you…”
Lee Gun was surprised when he saw Lee Jaewon. Was it thanks to the blood of a fairy?
The locations where the blood touched the wounds were quickly healing.
‘What the hell? Fairy blood does have regenerative abilities?’
It seemed Sophie had recommended the blood and tears of the fairies for a reason.
Lee Gun put down Lee Jaewon.
When Lee Gun came back toward her, the fairy monarch laughed.
[Good. As expected, you’re a hero. You don’t like the idea of humans dying. You made the right choice— Kyahhhk!!]
Raeriqueen screamed. It was as if blood bags were being popped in front of her.
After returning, Lee Gun was ruthlessly cutting down the fairies.
Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jeek!
[Ahhhhk!!!]
[Help— Kuh-huhk!!]
The fairies tried to use offensive and defensive magic spells, but they were all useless.
“Did you think I stood back and did nothing because I was powerless? I took your Zodiac Saint into consideration, so I planned on negotiating with you idiots!”
[Ahhhhk!!!]
As if he preferred this outcome, Lee Gun cut down the fairies. “She wanted you guys to donate blood, and she wanted you to shed tears through laughter. It was all nonsense. This is a much easier way to gather your blood and tears!”
Lee Gun held up his ax and brought it down on the fairies in a fury.
Kwah-jeek!!
An incredible amount of blood was being shed, and her subjects were being ruthlessly killed.
Raeriqueen shook in fear. Lee Gun wasn’t just killing her comrades.
“I’ll turn you all into ointments!!!”
A variety of fairies were being turned into something unrecognizable. Raeriqueen felt like she was about to lose her mind.
[S…Stop!!!]
Lee Gun ignored her as he wrung out all the fairies amid the chaos. “Hurry up and cry! Cry! Do it now!”
[Ahhk!! Please stop!!]
“Give me your tears!!!”
Fairy Monarch Raeriqueen fell to her knees as she watched Lee Gun slaughter her people.
In the end, Lee Gun turned all the fairies into a paste. He then approached Raeriqueen, who looked like she was out of her mind. “If you threaten the humans once more, I’ll find all the remaining fairies and turn them all into paste.”
[…!!]
“What is your answer?”
[Yes…!]
“Also, you shouldn’t leech from your Zodiac Saint. Serve her well.”
[U-Understood!!]
“Also, you better tell her straight what you guys did.”
[…yes!!]
This event would leave an incredible trauma on the fairy monarch, which lasted into the future. It was the reason why she had submitted so easily when she had reunited with Lee Gun.
* * *
Not too long before Lee Gun had fought against the fairies, Heiji had received an unexpected text, and she ran toward the forest.
‘There is still an hour left until the promised time.’
Yet Lee Gun had sent her a text message.
[I taught a lesson to your ill-mannered fairies.]
Heiji got an ominous feeling as she ran toward the promised location. When she almost arrived at the location, she couldn’t believe her eyes.
“You are already here?”
“…Lee Gun!”
Lee Gun was walking toward her, drenched in blood. Moreover, the blood belonged to the fairies.
Heiji ground her teeth. “What the hell did you do?!”
“I told you. They were ill-mannered, so I taught them a lesson.”
“Hey!!”
“Of course, I never planned on doing a blood drive to take their blood. What can I do with so little? It wouldn’t have been effective.”
“What?”
Lee Gun arrived next to a shocked Heiji and patted her shoulder. “Thanks for gathering so many fairies in one place. I was able to heal my body thanks to you.”
Heiji was dumbfounded. “Hey. I told you that I’ll acquire the ingredients with you. You said you’ll trust me by waiting for me…”
“You believed that? Idiot.”
“…!”
“Still, I saw something entertaining. I was able to see someone with a terrible personality like yours act shy. You were a bit cute when you confessed to me. I should have recorded it and sold it for some money.”
“…!”
“I was dying inside from laughter. Who the hell would like someone like you?”
When Lee Gun whispered those words, Heiji felt something snap within her.
At that moment, Lee Gun— No. Jean-Louis, who had changed into Lee Gun, smirked.
[Thread of Connection (S)]
An odd sight was unveiled in front of his eyes. Strange threads appeared from Heiji’s body. These threads represented trust, loyalty, love, friendship, and other connections.
If he cut these strings, he could cut the connection between two people. If one’s connection and feelings were deep, these threads were thicker and harder as they twisted to form a rope.
Jean-Louis was aiming for the red strings. It was a connection related to love, and Heiji’s red strings were directed toward Lee Gun.
‘They are quite thick.’
Normally, he wouldn’t have been able to cut them easily, but he had shaken her trust in Lee Gun. So his skill was effective.
‘The strings have weakened.’
Jean-Louis smiled as he brushed past her and wiggled his finger.
Paht!
The bundle of red threads had been cut. He had used his Royal skill called “Cut of the Abyss (SS).”
Afterward, Jean-Louis disappeared, and Heiji arrived at the location.
She saw the frightened and surprised Raeriqueen, who kowtowed to Heiji.
[I’m sorry, Zodiac Saint-nim! We did something we weren’t supposed—]
“Lee Gun did this?”
[Yes…! I’m sorry! We’ll never attack humans! We’ll never take them hostages!]
“No, it’s fine.”
[What?]
Hate surged in Heiji’s eyes. “He’s a bastard. Your actions against him are understandable.”
While it was her negligence that had gotten the fairies killed, she couldn’t stand being violated like this by Lee Gun.
Jean-Louis cackled at this sight. He knew he had succeeded. “The biggest obstacle is gone now.”
The connection that represented trust and love was cut. Heiji's heart had only hatred left toward Lee Gun.
Now only three Zodiac Saints who followed Lee Gun were left: Kevin, Stevens, and Hugo.
“The next target will be Hugo Otis.”
Jean-Louis headed toward the one with 600% Faith.

chapters.title: Chapter 468: Book 1, Epilogue 21 - Sworn Enemy (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 21 - Sworn Enemy (2)
“M…My god! What is all this?”
“Teacher…!”
Hugo and Sophie were sweating. The reason was the items Lee Gun had brought along.
Sophie’s face froze as she looked at Lee Gun. “What the hell are these mysterious pastes….”
“What else? They are the fairies you asked for.”
“Ahhhk!!! These are fairies?!” Sophie thought Lee Gun was out of his mind as she looked at the enormous jar.
The jar contained lumps of flesh in a variety of colors, including yellow and blue.
Sophie knew Heiji would have never allowed this to happen, so she shook as she grabbed Lee Gun. “I told you to negotiate with them to bring the ingredients! Why did you bring the ingredients by killing them?!”
“I tried to negotiate with them, but they attacked me with the intent to kill.”
“They attacked with the intent to kill you?!”
“They were rotten to the core. They even attacked a city and almost killed Juwon.”
“It’s Jaewon… When will Teacher’s poor memory improve— Kuhk!”
After kicking Hugo, Lee Gun looked at Sophie. “Anyway, is it possible to revive them? It’s possible, right?”
“What?? You aren’t going to turn them all into medicine?”
“I have enough left to make my medicine.” Lee Gun took out a small bottle. “I don't need their corpses to heal myself. Since I still have their Core, reviving them should be possible, right?”
“Well… It should be, but… why would you want to do that? You said they tried to kill you, right?”
“They did, but this goes against the promise I made.”
“Promise?”
Originally, Lee Gun had promised to go with Heiji, and they were supposed to collect the blood together. But he had gotten rid of the fairies before that could happen.
“That’s why I want you to save them if you can.”
A dumbfounded Sophie looked at Lee Gun. “I should have known from the start when you refused to take on work for money. Now that I get to know you, you really are too nice…”
“What nonsense are you talking about? I’ll revive them and use them as paint this time around.”
“?!!”
Sophie looked shocked, but Hugo merely smirked. He knew this was how Lee Gun liked to joke.
“Anyway, I want you to revive them—”
Kwahng!
Suddenly, an explosion rocked the Notre Dame de Paris.
“Ahhhk!”
Everyone was surprised to see who had entered the damaged building.
“Ms. Heiji?”
“Heiji!”
Moreover, this Heiji looked different from usual.
Kwahng!!
A terrifying attack flew toward the side of Lee Gun’s face.
“Teacher!!!”
Lee Gun dodged the attack like usual, but his face hardened. This wasn’t just a threat. The attack was infused with murderous intent.
If he hadn’t dodged, the attack would have 100% killed him. Moreover, the attack was dangerous enough to cause collateral damage to the people near him.
Lee Gun’s eyes turned fierce. “Hey, what the hell are you doing right now?”
“Isn’t it obvious? Die, bastard.”
“Why….”
He was going to ask why she was suddenly going crazy, but Lee Gun furrowed his brows as he sighed. From Heiji’s perspective, her precious fairies had been killed.
While they did try to kill him first, it didn’t change that Heiji had lost her subordinates.
So he changed what he had been about to say. “Damn it! They are the ones who broke their promise and tried to kill me! I get why you are angry, but you should wait a bit. The mutt who likes to mark her things will revive them…”
Heiji attacked once again.
Kwahng!
Lee Gun was taken aback.
Heiji let out a cold smile. “I don’t care about the fairies.”
“What?”
“I don’t care if you use them to heal your body or not. All I want to do is kill you.”
“!!”
Hugo, Sophie, and Lee Gun screamed as soon as she spoke.
A spell flew toward Lee Gun; it was a caliber of spell that should never be used against a human.
Lee Gun became angry as he dodged the attack. “You want to kill me! I thought you liked me! You said you’ll show me that I can trust you!”
“?!”
Lee Gun’s words surprised Hugo and Sophie. Who liked whom?!
Heiji didn’t care what he said. She gnashed her teeth as she glared at him. “Idiot. Did you really believe that?”
“…!”
“Who would like a monster like you? Don't get it twisted. I don’t like you. I just said it because I wanted to use you. I merely found your abilities useful.”
Lee Gun was beyond speechless. He was dismayed. He remembered how Heiji had acted earlier. Lee Gun wasn’t naïve enough that he couldn’t differentiate if someone was acting or not. Heiji’s expression had been something that couldn’t be faked.
“Did your Zodiac— Kuhk!!”
“Teacher!”
This time, Hugo and Sophie were surprised.
When Heiji wagged her finger, Lee Gun vomited blood and sank to the ground. His cysts, which Sophie had barely sealed off using her power, had ruptured once again.
Lee Gun clutched his stomach in pain since his organs were being ripped open. “Huh-huhk…!”
His life was truly in danger.
Sophie ran toward Heiji and glared at her. “What are you doing right now, Heiji?”
“What? He messed with my fairies. I merely paid him back. What’s the problem?”
“…!!” Sophie flinched.
Lee Gun tried to keep the blood down as he glared at Heiji. “Didn’t you hear from the fairy monarch? Those bastards were tapping your power— Kuhk!”
“My god! You are pretending to be kind because you’re in front of Hugo and Sophie. It’s too bad that I can’t kill you with my fairies.”
“…!” Lee Gun ground his teeth.
At that moment, Heiji brought her hand down. Lee Gun fell to the ground and vomited blood.
Hugo couldn’t stand back anymore. He charged Heiji. “Please do it in moderation, Miss Heiji!”
Heiji glared at him. Only hatred was left within her. “Get your hands off me!”
When Heiji tried to strike Hugo, murderous intent appeared in Lee Gun’s eyes. “Have you really lost your mind, you crazy bitch?” He had lost his patience.
Lee Gun and Heiji clashed against each other. Lee Gun used Heaven’s Punishment, and Heiji used her magic spells.
Both of them had lost their ability to reason, and they were about to kill each other when…
[No!]
Someone appeared between them. It was the real Libra Saint Giselle, who had been eaten by Negligence. Of course, she was a soul, so others couldn’t see her.
But although she didn’t have much, she could still use her power. It was possible because her contract as a Zodiac Saint hadn’t ended yet.
The monarch Negligence had eaten Libra and absorbed its power. In simple words, Giselle was contracted to Negligence. Of course, Negligence and Jean-Louis had yet to notice this.
Giselle quickly used her ability.
[Equivalent Exchange]
The Libra Saint was able to acquire something new in exchange for sacrificing something. It depended on what she sacrificed, but at times, she could create something out of nothing.
At that moment, Giselle gave up on her lifespan and her vision.
Jean-Louis’s ability allowed him to see the connection between people, which couldn't be seen using a normal ability.
After paying the price, Giselle was given a new reward.
[Clairvoyance]
A strange sight unfolded in front of her. She saw the Thread of Connection, which only Jean-Louis was able to see.
Giselle flinched at the sight. The threads related to trust and love toward Lee Gun had been severed from Heiji.
Moreover, the connection severed by the Cancer Saint couldn’t be repaired. The Cancer’s ability to cut wasn’t normal. It meant…
‘Ms. Heiji will forever hate and curse Mr. Lee Gun.’
The only emotion left inside Heiji was the feeling that made her want to kill Lee Gun. One could try to mend their relationship in the future, but the severed connection would never reattach itself.
However, it was too early to despair.
‘That’s…!’
Giselle discovered something within the severed bundle of thread that represented love. The single strand was very thin, so she hadn’t been able to see it.
Although this thread hadn’t been severed yet, it looked like it would snap at any moment.
[With this, I might be able to…!]
Giselle used her power to tie the thread. She made sure it wouldn’t break. Then something surprising happened.
Flash!
“!”
Heiji’s hand, which had been trying to kill Lee Gun, flinched. It was the effect of the strand that had barely survived.
“…!”
The hand squeezing his throat started to loosen. Lee Gun was having a hard time moving his injured body. And when he opened his eyes…
Kwahng!
Instead of killing him, Heiji let go of Lee Gun.
“Teacher!”
“Yes. I’ll be a laughing stock if I kill an opponent who can’t even put up a fight.”
“!”
Heiji ground her teeth as she turned around.
Thanks to the single thread that Giselle had weaved together, Lee Gun had avoided death. However, Heiji’s hatred was too high to call it love. Her relationship with Lee Gun had turned into a love-hate relationship.
Still, the thought of killing Lee Gun at all costs had dissipated from inside her.
Giselle and Jean-Louis were watching this, and they had different reactions to this. Giselle reacted with joy, and Jean-Louis reacted with anger.
The reaction was stronger for Jean-Louis since he had intended to use Heiji to kill Lee Gun. He couldn’t understand what had just happened.
‘She was supposed to kill Lee Gun, yet she spared him?’
“Did I not cut all the threads?”
His Royal skill “Cut of the Abyss (SS)” couldn’t be used against the same person again. In other words, he couldn’t cut the connection between Lee Gun and Heiji anymore. He couldn’t do it even if he wanted to cut the thread of hate instead of the thread of love.
Therefore, Jean-Louis had to be very careful in choosing the thread to cut. But it didn’t matter in the end.
“It isn’t as if her desire to kill Lee Gun is gone.”
He had achieved his goal.
Unlike the happy Jean-Louis, someone was shaking in fear.
‘This problem started because of me.’
It was Sophie.
“I gave him the information. I told him to acquire the blood of a fairy…!”
She still couldn’t forget the sight of Heiji trying to kill Lee Gun.
[Do you understand now? It’s useless to struggle.]
“!!!”
Aquarius laughed while hugging Sophie closer.
[You are unnecessarily being dumb in fighting against me. That’s why you are in this position. You broke up the relationship between your comrades. You are solely responsible for this.]
Sophie trembled. Her Zodiac seemed angry since she had taken independent actions.
The Zodiac’s eyes flashed.
[If you dare do this again, I’ll tell everything to Hugo Otis. I’ll tell him everything you did to Lee Gun in the past.]
It caused Sophie to cry as she prostrated herself. “I’m sorry! I’ll never do it again…! I will never get involved with anything related to Lee Gun. Please…!”
[You promised.]
Aquarius smirked.
* * *
Around this time, within Notre Dame de Paris, Jean Louis approached Hugo, who was with Lee Gun.
Jean-Louis’s next target was Hugo, who was always with Lee Gun. The Cancer Saint wished to sever the connection between them.
‘I don’t know why, but there was a small hiccup with Heiji.’
He would never make the same mistake again. With a laugh, Jean-Louis activated his skill.
[Thread of Connection (SS)]
He was aiming for Hugo’s thread. It was none other than the thread of Faith. As soon as he cut it, Hugo and Lee Gun would split.
‘This will hurt Lee Gun a lot.’
Jean-Louis took in as much power of his Zodiac as possible, planning on cutting the thread in one fell swoop.
‘I won’t make the same mistake as I did with Heiji.’
He wouldn’t make the mistake of not cutting it all the way. This was why he kept sharpening the blades. Finally, he smirked as he activated his cutting skill.
Koo-goohng!
However…
Kwah-jeek!!!
“…koo-ahhk!”
When Jean-Louis tried to cut the thread, he clutched his hand and screamed.
‘My arms…!’
The arm trying to cut the thread had been destroyed. His fingers were supposed to act as the blades of a scissor, but the bones in them were broken, dislocated, and crushed.
Jean-Louis fought through the extreme pain. Gritting his teeth, he activated the skill again.
Ting! Ting! Crunch!
“Ahhhk!”
Jean-Louis moaned as he sent a death glare toward Hugo. “What the hell?? Why can’t I cut it??”
It seemed this was the benefit of Hugo visiting the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 469: Book 1, Epilogue 22 - You are excommunicated (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 22 - You are excommunicated (1)
“Koo-ooh-oohk!! I’ll do it this time! Ooh-ahhhhh!!”
Hugo roared toward the sky. He was once again clasping his teacher’s hand and arm-wrestling him.
Hugo was trying to test how much his strength had grown since the last time.
Lee Gun smirked at his roar. “You really are a try-hard. It doesn’t matter since I’ll win again today.”
“No. Today will be different!! I have a month until I take the last test!!”
“Give me your best. You can squeeze out all the strength you can muster, but you won’t be able to win against—”
‘!’
When Hugo used his strength, Lee Gun was taken aback.
“…!!!”
Hugo’s strength was different from normal. Normally, Lee Gun’s arm wouldn’t even budge, but right now, he was being pushed back.
‘Really?’
Lee Gun quickly put strength into his arm.
“!!”
Up until now, he had never put strength into his arm during arm-wrestling with Hugo. So when Lee Gun genuinely put strength into his arm, it was very effective.
Hugo’s arm started to be pushed down.
“Koohk!”
The Archer Saint’s veins popped as if a loss wasn’t an option.
“Ooh-ahhhhhhh!”
At the same time, Lee Gun’s arm started to move in the other direction bit by bit.
“…!”
When Lee Gun’s arm started to lose ground, Hugo knew this was his opportunity. He put more strength into his arm. “Ooh-rahhhhhhh!! This will be my victory!”
Doo-doo-doohk!
Lee Gun was taken aback. Even though he was using all his power, Hugo was pushing back his arm, making him ground his teeth.
‘This is getting risky.’
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as he infused his hand with magical energy.
Boo-oohng!
But he didn’t infuse it just in his right hand. He also infused the energy into the left hand, which was gripping the desk! Then, a strange pattern appeared on Lee Gun’s palm.
Boo-oohng!!!
Finally, the side of the table where Hugo was putting his weight on started to crack.
Crunch!
“Uh, uh?!”
Lee Gun had secretly activated a skill called Dismantle. It was one of the manufacturing skills under the “One-room Workshop” skill. This skill could destroy an item or an ingredient.
Thanks to the destruction of the table, a flustered Hugo lost strength in his arm for a moment!
Lee Gun immediately used this opportunity to pin Hugo’s hand.
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhk!!”
The table was destroyed as well. Hugo was tossed to the ground as the evidence was destroyed.
“Alright. I won. As expected, I’m strong.”
When Lee Gun laughed in satisfaction, Hugo was infuriated. “No way! You cheated!!! I won!!”
“What? There is no way you won.” Lee Gun snorted and brushed off his hands.
Aggrieved, Hugo grumbled.
On the other hand, Lee Gun pouted.
‘He’s grown a lot in terms of power.’
Even Lee Gun was in danger of losing to Hugo in terms of strength. The thought made him flinch as he looked at his hands.
‘Or did I get weaker?’
Hugo did get stronger, but was Lee Gun’s power deteriorating at a more rapid rate? After the raid in Russia, Lee Gun’s body had been getting worse. However, he didn’t show his emotions. In the end, it didn’t change what he had to do.
* * *
At that moment, someone was perturbed by Lee Gun.
‘Why can’t I cut it?’
It was Jean-Louis.
He had tried to cut Hugo’s thread, and he had failed. That was why he was grinding his teeth.
‘Damn it! I have to separate Hugo from Lee Gun at all costs.’
Despite the failures, he had other ideas. He was about to contact someone when…
“Hey, you want to die? You dare work on that pushover this time?”
“!!”
Jean-Louis was surprised to hear a voice behind him. It was none other than Kevin.
As if he knew he had caught Jean-Louis red-handed, Kevin mockingly said, “Recently, I noticed Teacher has been in a terrible mood. In the beginning, I didn’t think much about it, but his mood has worsened much more these days.”
