Jean-Louis was dumbfounded. “What the hell do you want me to do about that?”
“If you want to do something naughty, you should lock yourself in the restroom and play with yourself. Stop messing with a person who did nothing to you.”
Jean-Louis innocently replied, “Something naughty—”
“You did it, right?” Kevin cut him off.
“What?”
“You did something to mess with Teacher and that magician.”
“…!?”
It was rare to see Jean-Louis flustered.
Kevin contemptuously laughed. “What? I’m right. While that magician might have a terrible personality, there is no way she would have wanted to kill Teacher.”
Jean-Louis looked at Kevin as if the latter were a nuisance.
Kevin was an outsider who didn’t like getting along with others, yet he was always quick on the uptake. So it was hard to predict his movement.
This was why Jean-Louis would get caught and tortured by Negligence in twenty years. It was all thanks to Kevin.
In other words, Kevin was the number one obstacle among the twelve Zodiac Saints. There was a reason Jean-Louis would later try to frame Kevin as the guilty party.
Anyway, the cheeky Kevin headed toward Lee Gun. “I’ll spill everything to Teacher.”
Jean-Louis’s eyes flashed as he tried to stop Kevin, but he couldn’t.
‘!’
As soon as he was about to lay a hand on Kevin, Kevin terrifyingly unsheathed his sword. As expected of the rare genius swordsman, he was about to decapitate Jean-Louis!
Kwah-jeek!
“…!”
However, Kevin suddenly froze in place.
A surprised Jean-Louis looked behind Kevin and caught sight of a familiar woman.
“You should be careful. It would be a shame if our plans unravel because of this.”
“Monarch of Negligence….”
This monarch had taken on the form of Giselle, and she could use a variety of debuffs. One of her names was also the name of her ability: Negligence.
In simple words, this debuff demoralized her opponent. It also messed with the memories and the will of the target.
The Indolence debuff made Kevin’s eyes glassy as if he were a doll.
Jean-Louis laughed as though this gave him a headache.
“Since it’s a skill that can’t be overused, I wanted to use it at the perfect moment.”
Jean-Louis smirked as he looked at the threads of connection emanating from Kevin’s body. He was aiming for the one called “Admiration.”
Kevin admired Lee Gun so much that he referred to Lee Gun as his teacher. What if Jean-Louis got rid of that?
Jean-Louis made a hand gesture and cut Kevin’s thread.
Suh-guhk!
At that moment, Kevin lowered his sword, which had been pointed at Jean-Louis.
Jean-Louis laughed. “Virgo Saint. What did you say about your teacher??”
“Teacher….”
“What will you do to your teacher?”
“Why am I referring to Lee Gun as my teacher?” Befuddled, Kevin turned around. “Ah! It suddenly makes me feel dirty.”
Jean-Louis cackled. Since his ability hadn’t worked against Hugo, he had been worried. It seemed his worries were unfounded now that he saw what had happened to Kevin.
‘It was a temporary problem.’
Jean-Louis wasn’t a human. He was an enemy of the Zodiacs. Since he was a monster, he sometimes lost connection with his Zodiac. Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
‘It won’t take long for that bundle of trouble to look at Lee Gun as if he’s a bug.’
Since he had gotten rid of Kevin’s admiration for Lee Gun, Kevin would treat Lee Gun as a bug. That wasn’t all.
“I also used my Negligence (Scorn) ability. There is no way he’ll treat Lee Gun as a human.”
“Yes. That’s how it should be.”
Negligence and Jean-Louis cackled as they disappeared.
The hidden Giselle had been watching this. She clasped her hands as if she was praying.
‘I hope it was effective.’
She had used a skill nullifying ability. The real Giselle kept praying over and over again.
* * *
“Lee Gun! Lee Gun!”
“Hugo! Hugo!”
Two weeks had passed since the raid to Russia had ended. All the people around the world were calling out Lee Gun’s name. Everyone knew who he was now.
However, the darkness became deeper as one received more light. As his reputation grew each day, useless noise followed as well.
[Lee Gun is too focused on killing the monsters. He is too scary.]
[There have been times when he prioritized killing monsters over saving humans.]
[Is Lee Gun really a hero? Or is he a hunter who is obsessed with killing monsters?]
The reporters also became dogged in asking questions to Lee Gun. This was true today as well.
“As Lee Gun’s partner, haven’t you ever thought Lee Gun’s actions are a bit off?”
After a monster raid, the reporters came rushing in like wraiths and punched on Hugo.
Lee Gun always hated the media, so if he caught sight of reports, he chased them away with a stick.
“Didn’t Lee Gun leave the rescue of humans to Mr. Hugo today? Lee Gun wasn’t interested in saving humans. He seems to focus on only killing monsters.”
“It’s because Teacher trusts me…”
“Ah! You guys shared duties?”
Hugo flinched. If he were being honest, this bothered Hugo too.
‘It’s true. Recently, Teacher has been more focused on killing monsters than rescuing humans.’
It made Hugo worried, so he had asked Lee Gun about it. Lee Gun had merely snorted.
- Are you kidding me? Of course, we should be prioritizing killing the monsters.
It seemed a reporter had read the uncertainty in Hugo’s eyes. The eyes of this reporter flashed as he moved closer to Hugo.
“Many speculate that Lee Gun isn’t getting rid of monsters for humanity. It’s said that he’s addicted to fighting, and he feels a thrill from killing monsters. What do you think about this?”
“There is no way that’s true.” Hugo looked offended as he got out of there. However, he also seemed anxious.
The reporter who had just interviewed him— No, Aquarius snickered as it looked at Hugo.
It seemed the Zodiac’s attack had worked. After returning to their lodging, Hugo didn’t even bother washing. He glared at Lee Gun. “Teacher.”
“What?”
“Why did you prioritize killing monsters today?”
“I told you to eat your food, so why are you bringing up this nonsense?”
“Have you seen the recent news about you, Teacher?”
It seemed Lee Gun had lost his appetite when the news was mentioned. “Idiot. Now that you’re famous, you are worried about what the media says?”
“I’m not trying to worry about it. However, I have no choice but to pay attention to it!!”
“!”
Hugo glared at him. “I’ve told you this several times before, but I believe you ignore the hostages a bit too much!”
“What?”
“Today is a great example. The hostages were in danger, so why did you choose to kill the monsters first?”
“You rescued the hostages.”
Hugo’s face brightened a little. “That means you would have saved them first if I wasn’t present?”
“No.”
All the humor left Hugo’s face. He had felt the frostiness in Lee Gun’s answer. It made the constant worry change into distrust a bit.
“May I ask why you prioritized killing the monsters first?”
“It’s a feeling I had.”
“What?”
“I can’t explain it with words. It’s like asking you to describe how you can raise your arms. You can’t explain it.”
“Huh! You made a judgment call because you had a feeling that the monsters had to be prioritized over the hostages. Why?”
Lee Gun clicked his tongue. “When have you understood my intentions because I explained them? You should do as always. Just follow my orders..”
“Are you sure you don't just enjoy killing the monsters?”
At that moment, all humor disappeared from Lee Gun’s face. “What did you just say?”
The question continued to bother Hugo, so he spoke up. “In my opinion, you like killing monsters more than saving humans.”
“Hey.”
“This is reflected in the commissions you take on. You’re the first one on the battlefield because you don’t like your prey being stolen by the Zodiac Saints— Koohk!”
A piece of meat, which Lee Gun had been eating, struck Hugo’s face.
Lee Gun never threw food. Murderous intent emanated from him. “Fuck off! Get out of my face.”
“No…!”
“It seems you let it go to your head because you almost won a couple of arm-wrestling matches.”
“Teach—”
“Don’t call me teacher. You’re excommunicated.”
“…!”
“Our values have always differed. There is no reason for incompatible people to stay together. I hope to never see you again.” Lee Gun had an expression as if his mood had been spoiled.
Dumbfounded, Hugo gritted his teeth. “Alright, Lee Gun. You are full of yourself. You are a psycho who is crazed about fighting.”
Finally, Hugo packed his belongings and left.
Lee Jaewon, who witnessed this, looked anxious. However, another person was even more anxious.
[No! The Faith thread is disappearing!]
It was the real Giselle. She had believed Hugo would be fine, but that seemed to have been a mistake.
She tried to tie the two of them once again, but…
“I knew something funny was happening.”
[?!]
The real Giselle jumped in surprise. Jean-Louis and Negligence were standing behind her.
“I never expected you to be still alive after I consumed you. That’s why I never thought about exploring this possibility. Ah. I guess you’re a soul, so does that mean you aren’t alive?”
Jean-Louis was flabbergasted. He had worked on Heiji, Kevin, and Hugo. He had finally made it so that they looked at Lee Gun as if he were a bug. He even made one of them want to kill Lee Gun.
However, he had always felt that his work hadn’t been as effective as he wanted it to be. And now he knew why.
“It seems you’ve been secretly working against us. Despite dying to a monarch, you’re still acting heroic. ”
[…!]
The real Giselle quickly tried to run away.
[Koohk!]
Jean-Louis yanked the real Giselle back by her hair. “The monarchs will love being given the soul of a Zodiac Saint.”
Negligence laughed.
“You weren’t that tasty, so I’ll let the other monarchs have you.”
Along with those words, a monster appeared behind Jean-Louis. It was none other than the monarch that followed Abyss.
“Please take her to the world of monarchs. If she is taken to Time, she’ll never be able to die. She’ll become a useful source of nutrition for the monarchs.”
The monster nodded as it summoned dark holes in the ground. There were a total of six holes, and the one at the center was connected to the world of the monarchs.
Giselle was about to be dragged away by the monster when…
“Damn it! That maggot should’ve taken all his items!!” An angry Lee Gun threw a bag toward the sky. It was a bag containing Hugo’s belongings.
The bag hit the monster holding Giselle.
Kwahng!!!
“!!”
It had happened in an instant, so Jean-Louis and Negligence were surprised.
Since Lee Gun was powerful, the trash bag had turned into a cannonball. In the end, the monster holding Giselle fainted, and they fell into a different hole.
[K…Kuh-huhk…!]
Instead of the one in the middle, they had fallen into the one in the 12-o’clock position.
A flustered Jean-Louis and Negligence rushed toward them, but they didn’t even have the chance to catch her.
Koo-oohng!!!
‘!’
The monster and the soul fell into the 12-o’clock hole and disappeared.
Jean-Louis and Negligence were shocked since they knew where this hole led to.
“That one is connected to the Divine world…!”
“What? We won’t be able to chase after her there!!”
On that day, the Libra Saint Giselle fell into the Divine world. She had fallen into the Underworld, the crappiest part of the Divine world.

chapters.title: Chapter 470: Book 1, Epilogue 23 - You are excommunicated (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 23 - You are excommunicated (2)
“What? You came here because you had nowhere else to go?”
The dumbfounded Stevens looked at Hugo.
They were in England, at Stevens’s barracks. This barrack was full of beast Constructs under the Leo temple. Though it might look like a barrack, it also resembled a zoo.
Hugo had come here for a simple reason.
“You had a fight with Lee Gun?”
“It wasn’t a fight. I cut off my relationship with him.”
“Ah-ha! You came here because you were chased out by Lee Gun??”
“That’s… Yes. You were the closest one to me, Mr. Stevens.”
Flabbergasted, Stevens kicked his desk. “Hey. Why the hell are you acting as if it’s a domestic dispute? Why the hell would you pack up your stuff and come running here??”
Hugo grumbled. In truth, he didn’t want to come here, but he had no choice.
‘I don’t have any money.’
His wealth had disappeared when his family had collapsed. And although, after becoming an awakened being, he had received commission fees for raids he was hired to conduct, he had used all the money to pay for Lee Gun’s food, medical fee, and living expenses. He had also donated the money too.
Hugo could work as a mercenary to pay for his livelihood, but he had left behind his weapon, equipment, and items. He could return to Lee Gun, but he didn’t want to do that.
‘Moreover, there is no way he would’ve kept my stuff.’
This was why he had come to Stevens, who was closest to him. He wanted to borrow equipment from Stevens.
While all the other temples had weapons, the Leo temple was the one that used the most variety of weapons; it was a fighting-type temple after all.
Moreover, they received the most commission for raids, so they were incredibly rich.
Like Lee Gun, Stevens was the ideal target to mooch off from.
Stevens was dumbfounded when he heard Hugo's words. “You really are a pushover. You donated your money and supported Lee Gun? That’s the reason you’re broke? You do realize the others are rich now, right?.”
“That is…!”
“Well, it’s understandable since you served someone like him as your teacher…” Stevens looked at Hugo as if something was off. “You were serving him without any problem, so why did you suddenly get expelled?”
Hugo felt aggrieved. He started pounding his chest. “Mr. Stevens. Can you comprehend the actions of Teach…Mr. Lee Gun?”
“Comprehend?”
“I’m asking if you can comprehend the reason behind his actions?”
“How could I? Of course, they make no sense.” Stevens replied.
“Right?! I can’t comprehend his personality, and this is more true about his actions…”
“He’s an unparalleled genius who we cannot comprehend.”
“W-what?”
“Lee Gun is a genius. You can tell by watching him kill monsters.”
“He’s a genius at killing monsters. However, he doesn’t pay attention to people at all.”
Stevens tilted his head in puzzlement when he saw Hugo’s expression. “Did something happen to you guys?”
Instead of answering, Hugo furrowed his brows. In truth, Lee Gun’s recent actions were very off. Lee Gun had always been eccentric, but recently, he seemed obsessed with killing monsters.
Hugo had tried his best to comprehend Lee Gun’s actions.
- It’s more important to kill the monsters than to rescue the people.
- What? Do you really mean that?
- Yes. I’m the only one who can kill the monsters.
- …!
- Killing monsters is like a drug for me. If I stop, my body becomes restless. I can’t help myself.
It was unclear as to how Stevens perceived Hugo’s silence. He merely snorted. “I don’t know what happened, but one thing is for sure. Lee Gun is the one person who can’t disappear.”
“…!”
“Do you understand me? I don’t know what makes him tick, but he’s an incredible genius who we can’t comprehend. He’s someone who humanity needs.”
Each Zodiac Saint felt a different emotion when it came to Lee Gun.
Stevens possessed a feeling of awe toward Lee Gun. In front of Lee Gun’s goosebump-inducing talent, he felt fear. At the same time, his heart felt deep acceptance and awe for Lee Gun.
“Do you know when hope disappears?” he asked.
“What do you mean?”
“It’s when the being that deserves our faith disappears. If humanity wants to win, Lee Gun must be the symbol of victory. He’ll make us believe that humanity will win in the end.”
It didn't matter which monster Lee Gun faced. He would never lose. He would come back alive no matter what situation he found himself in.
In other words, Lee Gun was a spiritual leader who made sure humanity wouldn’t lose hope.
Stevens continued, “Also…”
“Also?”
“Lee Gun can’t disappear until he makes me a weapon.”
Hugo shook his head from side to side as if he found Stevens’s feelings understandable. He respected Stevens, so when Stevens acknowledged Lee Gun, he felt proud of Lee Gun inside. It also filled Hugo’s heart with complicated emotions.
But recently, Lee Gun had changed too much.
On the other hand, Stevens looked at Hugo with an odd expression.
* * *
“Hmmph. I wonder why he has been so quiet recently?” Lee Gun looked at his phone, feeling odd.
He was reviewing the record of Kevin’s attempts to contact him. “Damn it! I’m getting close to getting sick of eating ramen ten times a day.”
After Hugo had left, Lee Gun had gone back to eating only ramen, and he felt like dying. While it was annoying to have Kevin glom on to him, Kevin did send him coupons. It had been a great help in living comfortably.
“However, he suddenly stopped contacting me. It does hurt.”
Lee Jaewon seemed surprised. “H…Hurt? You feel hurt, Lee Gun-nim?”
“Of course. He’s my financial supporter.”
“Ah!”
“Also, you don’t have to keep coming here like this.”
“!”
Lee Gun looked toward a tree a hundred meters away from him.
Hailey was there, with a bag full of daily supplies. It seemed the situation had surprised her.
“D-Did you really expel Hugo?” she asked.
“Yes. That’s why you have no reason for coming here now.”
“!”
Lee Gun still thought Hailey was chasing around Hugo.
Unlike a flustered Hailey, Giselle (Negligence) was laughing inside. She had come here searching for Lee Gun earlier.
‘Did Pisces make its move? Did it get rid of Hugo?’
The situation had been extremely troublesome because Jean-Louise’s skill had failed on Hugo. So they had to ask someone else for help.
Negligence kept her true thoughts off her face. She put on a worried expression. “My god! I was wondering why I didn't see Mr. Hugo. My heart hurts from finding out that your relationship with him has worsened.”
At this point, Negligence had yet to reveal her true self. She acted as if she were a warm-hearted person. She acted as a supporter (Alchemist) who helped her comrades in silence.
Using the Equivalent Exchange of the Libra temple, she could acquire new abilities, materials, and ingredients. So she took on the role of a creator as she supplied the other Zodiac Saints.
“Please do not worry. We’ll help you more now that Mr. Hugo isn’t here.”
Negligence let out a benevolent smile as she grabbed Lee Gun’s hand.
However, Lee Gun broke free from her grip with an odd expression.
‘!’
This surprised Negligence a bit. Lee Gun and Giselle (Negligence) didn’t have a bad relationship.
Giselle came from a family of politicians, and she was the daughter of a president who was elected not too long ago. She had a much better personality and temperament than Sophie. She was an alchemist that worked for her comrades.
However, Lee Gun always felt oddly repulsed by Giselle. This was true when he was first invited to her mansion. So he kept his distance from her despite not having a bad relationship with her.
Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
Hailey looked at Lee Gun with worry. “Are you sure it’s ok to expel him like this?”
Lee Gun possessed a personality that could make others his enemies. This was why he didn’t have any allies or friends. Moreover…
‘It feels as if Lee Gun’s movements have started to slow down recently…’
She was asking if he didn’t need long-range support. However, Lee Gun got up as if it wasn’t nothing. “It doesn’t matter. I taught the good-for-nothing everything I have to offer. It’s better for him to become independent even more now.”
“Even more now?” Hailey’s fine forehead became furrowed for some reason. Quick on the uptake, she seriously looked at Lee Gun. “Can it be? You….”
Lee Gun read the look in her eyes, so he quickly tried to change the subject. “If you don’t have any urgent matters with me, you can go back—”
At that moment.
“…koohk!”
Lee Gun scrunched up his face when his heart started to hurt. He did his best to not show any outward signs as he approached the bag containing his medicine.
Looking a bit labored, he waved his hand. “The raid… If you’re here for the commission, I know about it now! You can go back. I’ll contact you later— Kuhk!”
“Lee Gun!!”
“Mr. Lee Gun!”
Lee Gun finally had a seizure. He clutched his chest as he fell over. He was in excruciating pain, as if his entire body were being ripped apart. He was barely able to take out his drug bottle.
This surprised both Hailey and Negligence.
‘I heard he’s been buying a lot of medicine from the Aquarius temple recently…!’
It seemed his body was in a much worse state than everyone had expected.
Lee Gun ground his teeth as he swallowed the drug for his seizure. The intervals in which the pain came toward him had reduced. And he remembered Sophie’s warning.
- You should decrease the frequency with which you kill monsters. Your body has worsened… Your lifespan has decreased further from last time.
- How long do I have? The last time, you said I had ten years.
- Half…
- Five years?
- Y-Yes….
- Damn it! That messes with my plan. I planned on killing all the monsters in five years and spending the remaining five in retirement. I planned on living an easy life. At this rate, I’ll die before I have any fun.
- It isn’t something you should minimize!
- There is nothing I can do about it. It’s fine if I can last five years. I’ll be able to kill all the monsters.
At that moment, Lee Gun gritted his teeth as he fought through the pain.
‘No… There is a chance that I might not last even five years.’
He had to kill all the monsters before that time.
Unlike Hailey, Negligence was enjoying seeing Lee Gun in pain.
‘What the hell? At this rate, he’ll cross the river of Styx on his own’
The monarchs had planned for Confusion to bring Red Eye to the earth soon in the future, and Lee Gun was a troublesome rival capable of getting rid of their army. But given how he looked right now…
‘Things might go easier than we thought.’
At that moment, two people were in deep thought as they looked at Lee Gun, who was in pain.
‘I’ll have to prepare it faster.’
Hailey was planning on preparing restorative herb medicine for Lee Gun. Then there was Kevin, who was standing outside the door. He had come looking for Lee Gun and had seen this.
Due to Jean-Louis’s actions, Kevin’s admiration for Lee Gun was gone, but thanks to the actions of the real Giselle, the disdain skill hadn’t taken hold. It was why Kevin had come to meet Lee Gun.
[It seems Lee Gun isn’t looking too great.]
[In the first place, he had used his abilities without a Zodiac. The fact that he lasted this long is admirable.]
Kevin furrowed his brows when he heard the conversation between the Virgo Constructs. This was how everyone except Hugo picked up on the fact that Lee Gun was dying through sickness.
* * *
“What? I said what to that maggot?” Lee Gun furrowed his brows after taking a call from Stevens.
After leaving home, Hugo had headed toward the Leo Saint of all people. That was baffling in itself, yet what was this nonsense?
“Let me get this straight. He said I thought killing monsters was more important than saving humans? Is this what that bastard said?”
- Yes. You said your body becomes restless if you don’t kill monsters. It drives you nuts. Did you really say that to Hugo?
Lee Gun grabbed the back of his neck. “That idiot. I was wondering why he kept arguing with me recently. It was for that reason?!”
- What the hell? Did you really say that to him?
“Are you kidding me? Where the hell did he hear such garbage?”
- Hmmph. I knew it. Don’t worry about it. Maybe that idiot dreamed up the conversation. Or maybe he took your words the wrong way and misinterpreted them.
Lee Gun furrowed his brows in disgust. “No. I have a suspicion that someone is behind this.”
- What? Really?
Only one person could have done this. It was Jean-Louis.
It seemed Jean-Louis had a grudge against him for messing up his plans. He had continued to work to separate Hugo and Lee Gun.
“It’s obvious. He probably copied my voice. The Cancer Saint has such a skill. It’s called voice proliferation or something like that.”
- What? Really?
That Crab bastard was dead the next time he saw him. Lee Gun’s eyes flashed.
- That means the misunderstanding is no more. Hurry up and come get your student.
“What? Why?”
- Why else! My Zodiac and Constructs ate the snacks that he prepared, and they don’t want to eat feed anymore!!! They are so fat that they are unable to hunt! He’s committing an act of terror on my temple! Come here right now and take him!
“It doesn’t matter what you say. It doesn’t change the fact that he’s excommunicated. I have no plans to bring him in as a party member.”
Stevens seemed to have heard something in his voice. He became sober as he asked,
- Are you perhaps sick?
“!”
- You are in such a hurry to kill the monsters, and you chased away your student. You look like someone trying to settle your affairs. You are acting like someone who doesn’t have long to live.
Lee Gun was silent, then snorted. “Are you playing with me? You guys are so slow that I moved quickly. Don’t put me in an early grave.”
- I’m glad if that’s not the case. Yes. You have to live a long time. You have to make me a weapon.
Lee Gun became angry when he heard the arrogant voice. This was why he didn’t like Stevens. Stevens spoke as if it was a given that Lee Gun would make him a weapon.
- Anyway, I understand. We should—
Suddenly…
- Kee-ehhhhhhk!!!
“!!”
The sound of a monster came from the other side of the phone.
- Ah! Hey! What the hell is he doing? Hey! It’s dangerous! Come back! Hey! You can’t use that bowl!
“!”
The call ended.
At that moment, the Archer Saint’s energy weakened. It was one of the twelve energies that Lee Gun could always sense.
This made him grind his teeth. “That idiot…”
Lee Gun quickly made himself scarce, and the floor was wet with dark blood. It was the blood of a dying man.

chapters.title: Chapter 471: Book 1, Epilogue 24 - Gun, Not Teacher
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 24 - Gun, Not Teacher
The southern plains of England…
While Stevens had been on a call with Lee Gun…
Koo-goo-goong!!
“!!”
Hugo had been distributing snacks to the Leo temple’s Constructs inside the barrack when something surprised him. “Shit. That’s…!”
Monsters had appeared above the plains of England.
[Kee-ehhhk!]
These monsters looked like mantises with wings. They were clearly coming from a nearby city. The numerous humans that they were holding as they flew toward some unknown destination were proof of that.
They were headed toward Asia, specifically the place where Confusion resided.
To destroy humanity, Confusion had been raising his children. And the humans were nutrients for them.
Right now, Confusion was putting great effort into rearing Red Eye, which was yet to be born.
Anyway, the monsters were gathering food from various locations for Red Eye.
Of course, Hugo wasn’t one to stand back.
“Damn it!” He rushed toward a box filled with weapons.
However, the Leo Constructs said, “O’, weak Zodiac Saint of the Sagittarius temple, if you give us more snacks, we’ll let you borrow a weapon!”
This was why he had been working hard to provide snacks for them. He had been waiting for them to give him a weapon, but he no longer had the time to wait.
Hugo took a bow from the Leo temple’s barrack without permission. Then he ran toward the monsters, surprising Stevens.
The Leo Saint said, “Ah! Hey! What the hell is he doing? Hey! It’s dangerous! Come back! Hey! You can’t use that bow!” He ended the call with Lee Gun.
On the other hand, Hugo had a scary look in his eyes as he chased after the monsters.
‘I am better off without Teacher.’
Hugo was more famous for being Lee Gun’s supporter, but it wasn’t as if he was incapable of killing monsters on his own.
Moreover, he wouldn't just focus on killing the monsters. He’d act while prioritizing the hostages’ wellbeing.
‘I’ll prove that Teacher was wrong.’
Hugo’s eyes flashed as he sent the Constructs of the Sagittarius temple into the sky.
Woosh!
These Constructs were the ravens that followed the god of the sun. The ravens weaved in the air as they created threads of light.
Flash!
[Sun’s Net (A)]
These were nets made from light. When the hammock-like nets formed in the air, Hugo immediately took up his bow, aiming for the monsters’ arms and legs.
If he made the monsters drop the hostages, the ravens would use the Sun’s Net to catch the humans.
Of course, Lee Gun wouldn’t have cared if there were hostages or not. He would have attacked before Hugo could shoot his bow.
‘I’m different from Teacher, who only attacks the monsters no matter what!’
In one fell swoop, he’d be able to save the hostage. After hiding his presence, Hugo was about to stealthily shoot the arrows.
“!”
However, Hugo shook from fear. As he was about to let his arrows fly, he met eyes with the monster.
It was as if the monster had read Hugo’s attack. Hugo didn’t even have time to process his surprise as the monster suddenly attacked him.
[Kee-ehhhhhk!!]
Kwahng!
The powerful strike washed over the surface.
“Koo-oohk!!”
“Hugo!”
Stevens, who had rushed over, swung his greatsword.
[Lion’s Voice(S)]
Accompanied by the cry of a savage beast, a golden wind flew toward the monster.
Koo-goo-goohng!
However, the attack did nothing at all.
“Koo-oohk!”
The monster seemed to have sensed the energy of the skill. It instantly disappeared.
The Zodiac Saints ground their teeth; just a while ago, a monster of the same species had been killed by Lee Gun.
It had been trying to eat the humans, and Lee Gun had decapitated it as soon as possible.
Normally, one would cut off its arms to save the hostages. One would use a skill that would aim to save the hostages.
However, Lee Gun was different. His actions meant that the hostages would usually plummet several hundred meters through the air. Thankfully, Hugo was able to catch all of them. It was a close shave.
There had been cases where hostages had almost died from the fall, so everyone cussed out Lee Gun whenever such a thing happened.
They accused him of being too obsessed with killing the monsters and not paying any attention to the hostages.
“Hey! Hugo! Behind you! Behind you!”
“!!”
Hugo bit his tongue because the mantis had appeared right in front of him. A flustered Hugo tried to shoot a close-range arrow.
“Hey! I told you not to use that bow!”
As soon as Stevens gave a warning, the bow started to flash.
“W-What the hell! It’s a bomb?” A surprised Hugo immediately threw the bow!
The exploding bow sent the monster flying. The explosion rocked the monster, and the hostage in its mouth fell.
Fortunately, Hugo was able to throw his body toward the hostage and catch them.
Then he became angry at Stevens. “What the hell is that crazy bow?”
“What else?! It’s a bomb your teacher sent to me!”
“What?!”
“He didn’t want to make us weapons, so we asked him to upgrade the weapons we sent him. He sent it back like that!”
“?!!”
“Since they are holy items of our Zodiac, we couldn’t destroy them… Whatever! Hey! Behind you!”
“!”
The mantis appeared behind Hugo. He didn't even have time to dodge as the monster bit into him and dragged him away.
“Kuh-huhk!!!”
“Hugo!”
All he could do was hand off the rescued hostage to Stevens.
“Koo-oohk…!” Hugo desperately grabbed for the teeth that were biting into his neck. However, the monster was much stronger than it looked.
‘Damn it!’
Above all else, his strength was being sapped away.
‘They are eating away at the Divine magical energy…!’
This was to be expected since these monsters followed Abundance. They were similar to the toad monster that Lee Gun and Hugo would kill in the future. They could drain Divine magical energy. That wasn’t all.
‘The hostage…!!’
The hostage in Stevens’s arms was in rough shape.
Was he able to see it because he was captured by the monster? Hugo saw a strange light emanating from the woman’s body. The monster was sucking the strange light.
It was as if her vitality was being drained.
‘Is her life force being stolen?’
Moreover, this was happening despite Hugo having separated the hostage from the monster. The vitality of the hostage would continue to be drained and she would weaken unless the monster was killed.
Hugo had an understanding at that moment.
‘Is that why Teacher always aimed for the monsters first?’
No, he was sure of it. Had Lee Gun rescued the hostage, he would have been delayed in killing the monsters. By that time, the hostages might not be able to open their eyes ever again.
Hugo felt embarrassed.
- You prioritized killing monsters over saving hostages.
- You feel joy in killing monsters.
Hugo ground his teeth when he realized he had said words he couldn’t take back. Of course, he didn’t really know if Lee Gun had focused on killing the monsters because he knew that. Still, it was worth finding out.
If Lee Gun had acted that way because he knew this piece of information…
‘Damn it! I can’t believe I said that.’
He would have to apologize and ask for his forgiveness.
[Kee-ehhhk!!]
“Kuhk…!!!”
At that moment, the monster squeezed Hugo’s neck, and he was deprived of oxygen. His consciousness was fading away.
‘Damn it! At this rate…’
He might die before he could ask Lee Gun for the truth. Just as he was about to lose consciousness, however…
“Idiot!”
“…!”
As a familiar voice rang out, the monster lost its head.
Poo-hahk!!
“!!”
Blood sprayed into the sky, and Hugo couldn’t believe his eyes. “T…Teacher!”
Lee Gun was in front of him.
Looking annoyed, Lee Gun clicked his tongue as he shook off the blood. “I trained you until you could kill them, so what kind of nonsense is this?”
“…!”
“At this rate, you won’t be able to save anyone after I die.”
“What?? What do you mean….”
Instead of answering him, Lee Gun remained silent. He knew he didn’t have long to live.
While he didn’t care about the others, he wanted Hugo to become the hero of this world even if he died.
Even if he was unable to kill all the monsters, he planned on killing them until only the monsters that Hugo could take care of were left in this world. It would allow Hugo to take on his mantle.
This was why Lee Gun moved tirelessly to increase the odds of Hugo being able to clear the monsters. That was all he could do right now.
Stevens didn’t know this, so he was impressed. He looked at the monster Lee Gun had defeated.
“Look at that crazy bastard’s skill….”
He had felt it in the raid in Russia, but Lee Gun was overwhelmingly powerful. It made Stevens think that there was no monster in the world that Lee Gun was unable to kill. It also reinforced his feelings about Lee Gun.
‘He is someone who must not disappear.’
Of course, the thought of Lee Gun disappearing was unimaginable to him.
‘He’s a treasure who’ll save humanity. He’s the support holding up humanity…’
Suddenly, Hugo’s and Stevens’s faces turned pale.
“Teacher!”
“Hey! Lee Gun!”
Lee Gun vomited black blood. They didn’t even have time to catch the hero as he fell.
* * *
“What? Teacher is sick?”
“Lee Gun is sick?!”
Hugo and Stevens couldn’t believe their ears.
As soon as Lee Gun had fallen over, they had taken him to the hospital. Both men were in a state of panic; they had never seen Lee Gun fall over before like this. So they grabbed the doctor by the collar, but Lee Jaewon’s words surprised them.
“What? He’s sick? I never knew this. Since when?”
Lee Gun was lying down, wearing an oxygen mask. Lee Jaewon monitored him as he answered, “I found out about it through coincidence. It seems Lee Gun-nim’s lifespan has been reduced by a lot. From what I heard, it happened after the raid in Russia.”
“What?!”
“I believe someone is gunning for Lee Gun.”
Hugo and Stevens gnashed their teeth.
“It was around the time when we were in Russia… ”
“Is it Jean-Louis?” A surprised Hugo looked at Stevens.
At that moment, Lee Jaewon looked at Hugo with a bit of reproach. He didn’t like that Hugo had been suspicious of Lee Gun and had fought with Lee Gun.
“There is no way a sick person would like killing monsters. The reason Lee Gun seemed obsessed with killing monsters might have something to do with his lifespan…”
A furious Hugo grabbed Lee Jaewon’s shoulders. “If you knew this, why didn’t you say anything? You knew about Teacher’s status, yet you said nothing to me!”
“That’s…!”
“I told him not to say anything. Don’t attack the blameless kid.”
“Lee Gun-nim!”
Surprised by the familiar voice, Stevens and Hugo looked at the bed.
After waking up, Lee Gun ripped off the oxygen mask and the needles. They were a hindrance to him.
“They went overboard with all of this,” he said.
“Teacher!”
“Buzz off! I’m not your teacher. I’ve already excommunicated you.”
Hugo felt a lot of mixed emotions. He had been completely unaware about Lee Gun’s condition, yet had run his mouth. “I’m sorry! I’ll work hard to help you, Teacher! I’ll stand on the frontline from now on!”
It seemed Lee Gun felt as if Hugo was looking down on him. He didn’t want to be treated like a patient, so he threw a pillow at Hugo. “Get out of there. I’m not weak enough where I need help from someone who I taught. I can go on raids. I can continue my work without any problem…”
“No! I’ll help you!”
This seemed to have offended Lee Gun. Letting out murderous intent, he grabbed Hugo by the throat and slammed him to the ground. “Do you not get what I’m saying? Stay in your lane. I don’t like being treated like a has-been. How dare you say you’ll help me…”
“No! I won’t do it as your student! I’ll do it as your friend and comrade! I’ll do it as your equal!”
“…!”
Lee Gun was surprised by those unexpected words, but Hugo was sincere.
Why hadn’t Lee Gun told him about the status of his body? Hugo was his student, someone Lee Gun had to teach. It was Lee Gun’s duty as a teacher to protect his student.
Hugo hadn’t ever tried to understand Lee Gun. He had just looked up to Lee Gun.
‘It’s a chaotic world. In his eyes, there are only two types of people. Those who have to be protected, and those who have to be killed.’
Lee Gun seemed like someone who did as he liked according to his emotions, but the weight on his back was much heavier than what others carried.
“Since I’ve been excommunicated, I’m not in a position to take care of you. If we are friends who are equal, your burden will be reduced, right?”
“….”
“Gun.”
Lee Gun flinched when Hugo called out his name; only Yeonwoo and Junwoo called him that. He felt a wave of longing, and at the same time, he felt embarrassed since it was the first time being referred to as a “friend.”
Lee Gun snorted when he suddenly felt these odd emotions. “Asshole! It seems you’re eager to drop the honorifics.”
“It doesn’t matter. Our ages are the same.”
Lee Gun let out a chuckle. “Do as you like.”
It was at this moment that Lee Gun and Hugo became true friends.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: Book 1, Epilogue 25 - Devil's Tower (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 25 - Devil's Tower (1)
A week had passed since Hugo and Lee Gun became true friends.
“This is nuts!”
“What the hell am I watching right now?”
The twelve Zodiac Saints were dumbfounded when they came to the hospital to visit Lee Gun.
They watched as Hugo whined while delivering snacks, meals, and games for Lee Gun, who remained lying down on the bed.
Lee Gun was pointing out the trash strewn around him. “Hey. Hurry up and clean this. I can’t game because I’m running out of space.”
“What the hell? Do you not have hands and feet of your own? Why are you making me do it?”
“Why else? You’re the easiest to boss around!! Can’t you do such a small favor for a friend?!”
“What the hell did you just say?! Hey!!”
The Zodiac Saints were flabbergasted. Of course, it was rare for them to visit Lee Gun at the hospital, but things had changed.
‘Lee Gun has never stayed in the hospital beyond a day.’
Moreover, they had heard rumors that Lee Gun wasn’t doing well.
While the Zodiac Saints hadn’t officially acknowledged it, Lee Gun was the strongest awakened being among them. Many countries were trying to poach Lee Gun for themselves.
In other words, his absence would change the order of the world. This was why they had come to check up on Lee Gun’s status.
“Hey. I thought they were friends now? I thought Hugo wasn’t his student anymore?”
“It feels as if he’s working Hugo harder now than he did when Hugo was his student.”
Hugo seemed to be serving Lee Gun instead. It was called patient care in name only.
“Hey, Taeksoo. I’m out of snacks. Hurry up and buy some snacks for me in Taiwan.”
After becoming friends, Lee Gun exploited Hugo much more. It was for no other reason.
“If I had slaved around someone under me, I would’ve looked too small. However, that’s not true if I make a friend work like this.”
“Normally, you wouldn’t make a friend work like this!”
“Ah. I should’ve made you my friend in the first place. This is very comfy for me.”
An angry Hugo threw a bundle of trash toward Lee Gun. His respect(?) toward Lee Gun was about to plummet.
‘At the very least, he looked cool when he was my teacher.’
In the past, when Hugo looked at him, Lee Gun always had an aura around him; he always looked cool and admirable. But right now…
“Hey, Taeksoo. I have to take a dump. Go and check if there is anyone in the restroom.”
“Just take one here!”
“Also, I want some food.”
“Get your own food!” Huffing in anger, Hugo delivered two bentos to Lee Gun. One was in a black bento case, and the other one was in a white case.
Lee Gun tilted his head in puzzlement. “What the hell are these? The cases look expensive. Are you sure you bought these?”
Hailey and Kevin jumped in surprise. They were the ones who had brought these bentos, each having bought one. The bentos contained ingredients that held medicinal properties.
Of course, Hugo was unaware of this. He said, “They were among the items delivered in front of the hospital room. I’m sure a fan left them behind as a present. I checked their content, so you can eat them.”
Lee Gun nodded. When he opened the bentos’ lids, Hailey and Kevin looked on with expectant gazes as their hearts beat faster.
Hailey was excited about Lee Gun eating a bento she had prepared. Kevin was excited at the prospect of his abilities being recognized.
‘While I used medicinal ingredients, I made sure the bento was tasty.’
‘I acquired the best ingredients from various sources. I went through a lot to get them. Only one such bento exists in the world.’
Both Kevin and Hailey had gone through extreme troubles to make their bentos. However, when Lee Gun opened the lids, an odd expression appeared on his face. “…uh. Are you sure these were presents sent to me?”
“Yes. That’s why you should enjoy your meal.”
Lee Gun gloomily looked down at the bentos. The black one contained cans of spam, a set of cooking oil, and a cup of ramen.
“What the hell… This is like a holiday gift set…. I like spam, but who would send such a thing…”
Hailey almost screamed. She wondered why the content of her bento had been switched out.
Kevin snickered; he was the one who had swapped out the content of Hailey’s bento earlier.
‘There is no way I’ll let Lee Gun eat your bento.’
When Lee Gun opened Kevin’s bento, Kevin seemed proud.
‘Give as much thanks as I’ve put work into it! Acknowledge it!’
Kevin almost screamed when his bento was revealed. The white bento was supposed to contain western food, yet it had dumbbells and protein powder inside it.
Hailey’s eyes flashed. She had swapped out the content of Kevin’s bento.
‘Do you think I’ll let you feed poison to Lee Gun?’
Dumbfounded, Lee Gun picked up the protein powder. “Yes… I guess protein is also important…”
Hugo had burst out laughing when he had checked the content of the bentos earlier. “Right! Muscle loss is dangerous. You’ve been in bed for a week. This is a very good present… Kuh-huh!”
“You can eat it, asshole.”
At that point, the Virgo Constructs and the Scorpio Constructs started to fight each other. They were the ones that had to gather the ingredients for the bentos.
On the other hand, Yang Wei used this opportunity to sell food to Lee Gun, and the Capricorn Saint was busy installing something odd inside Lee Gun’s hospital room.
Sophie was trying to steal Hugo’s items, and Stevens was trying to take the slime and Heaven’s punishment.
When the atmosphere within his hospital room turned into that of a bustling market, Lee Gun glared at them. “Everyone, get out!”
All the Zodiac Saints were chased out, and Lee Gun left as if he had things to do.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief. “Finally, everyone left. It was so loud that it was driving me nuts.”
“Nope. Someone is still here.”
“What? Who else could be here…”
Instead of answering, Lee Jaewon took out a needle from his belongings and stabbed the sofa. The next instant, a scream emanated from the sofa.
“Ouch!!”
Hugo’s surprise at the sound lasted only a moment as something surprising happened.
Flash!
The sofa emitted light and transformed into a familiar face.
“Ms. Liv!”
The Pisces Saint Liv Rich (19) was called the ever-changing magician. In the future, she would have her body stolen by her Zodiac. She was the young female magician that Chun Sungjae would encounter within Abundance’s stomach.
It seemed the needle had pricked her rear.
Rubbing her rear, Liv glared at Lee Jaewon. She was asking what he was doing.
Lee Jaewon let out a bright smile as if he had done nothing wrong. “You’ve always been stalking us by transforming into objects, right? Hugo and Lee Gun-nim might have not noticed, but I won’t let it be. Stabbing you with a needle will be the least of your problems.”
Liv pouted as she looked at Hugo. “I just had a question for Hugo.”
“What? Me? Not Gun?”
“I heard the Cancer Saint tried to come between you and Lee Gun.”
“Ah, yes! We both had a misunderstanding, and we almost fell for it.”
Liv looked at Hugo with an odd look in her eyes. “Has Jean-Louis ever appeared in front of you looking like Lee Gun?”
Hugo burst out laughing as if she was talking nonsense. “I thought the transformation skill can only be used by the Pisces Saint.”
Lee Jaewon interrupted him. “Huh? I thought the Cancer Saint and the Aries Saint can use techniques that can make copies, right? I’m pretty sure the Cancer Saint can make copies using his Cloning skill. Then there is the DNA Clone skill of the Aries Saint, who can mass-produce stuff. If they cooperated, I’m sure they could create a doppelgänger…”
Hugo shook his head from side to side. “The Zodiacs are prideful. They would never share skills with other temples. Moreover, there is the risk of information about the temple leaking out, and even if they were able to make a doppelgänger like that, it would be obvious that it is fake. Other Zodiacs will be able to see through it.
“The only one that can pull it off is the Pisces temple. There is no way you would do such a thing, right?”
“!”
Hugo understood Liv very well. She was a hikikomori and someone who got very annoyed easily. She wasn’t one to cooperate with the Cancer Saint.
At that moment, the shapeshifter Liv became silent.
“Ms. Liv?”
“Ah. Yes. The Pisces temple wouldn’t do something like that.” Liv looked at her Zodiac’s mark in suspicion.
* * *
To monitor Lee Gun and Hugo, Jean-Louis had come to visit Lee Gun at the hospital. He stood outside the hospital room, looking furious.
“Hmph. As if the trust between the two being revived wasn’t enough, a new thread was created?”
He was dumbfounded by the newly created thread of connection within Hugo.
‘The Pisces should have gotten rid of Hugo’s trust.’
However, a thicker thread called Faith had appeared. Mover, the severed Trust thread was starting to repair itself, as if the Faith was fixing it.
‘What the hell happened?’
However, he didn’t have time to be surprised.
“Hey, why the hell do you keep stealing glances at us?”
“?!”
As a familiar voice rang out, a punch in the face sent Jean Louis flying.
Kwahng!!!
Jean-Louis almost lost consciousness as he slammed through the building. He vomited blood and groaned as he tried to get back up.
“Koohk!!”
This time, a foot sent him flying. The eyes of the one who had sent Jean-Louis flying flashed ruthlessly.
“You copied my voice to play both sides against each other?”
Hearing the familiar voice, Jean-Louis glared at the man before him. “Lee Gun!!”
The reporters and the other Zodiac Saints rushed toward the commotion. The mouths of the Zodiac Saints fell open when they saw Jean-Louis being beaten up by Lee Gun.
“Hey, Lee Gun!”
“What the hell are you doing?”
They couldn’t believe their eyes as they looked at Jean-Louis, who was a bloody mess.
It didn’t matter how bad Lee Gun’s temper was. He had almost never attacked the other apostles before. Moreover, Jean-Louis wasn’t one to lose so easily, yet…
“If you pull this nonsense one more time, it won’t end with this.”
Lee Gun furrowed his brow when he saw Cancer’s energy emanate from Jean-Louis’s body.
‘I wonder what price that idiot is paying.’
The suit was covering it up, but Lee Gun could see Jean-Louis’s body rotting away. So he said,
“You’ll die a quick death if you keep this up. You better find out what’s important to you. Oh, yeah. I don’t need your dirty get-well present. Take it back with you.”
Lee Gun turned back as he tossed the fruit basket that Jean-Louis had brought him.
Jean-Louis had become a bloody mess in front of the other Zodiac Saints and the media. His body shook from the humiliation.
In truth, he had to temporarily sacrifice his power to Pisces to use its power. This was why Jean-Louis couldn’t use his power. As luck would have it, Lee Gun had attacked him during this period. Moreover, someone like him of all people was giving Jean-Louis that advice?
‘He’s the one who looks like a corpse who’ll die at any moment!’
Jean-Louis glared at him.
‘Let’s see who dies first.’
* * *
On the same night…
“It was your doing, right?”
The Pisces Saint Liv expressed her anger toward the Zodiac of the Pisces temple. It was the Zodiac of the magic-type temple and the culprit who had killed Junwoo and the thirteenth Zodiac.
“I’m asking you if you loaned out your transformation skill to the Cancer Saint.”
Liv had gaps in her memories. When a Zodiac possessed the body of their Zodiac Saint, the Zodiac Saint couldn’t remember what happened during that time.
This was true for Liv as well. That was why Liv had an epiphany.
“I thought Jean-Louis changed his voice to sound like Lee Gun and Hugo. In truth, you borrowed my body and transformed Jean-Louis. Am I right? Jean-Louis used the transformation to pit Hugo and Heiji against Lee Gun.”
Among the two Pisces Zodiacs, the older sister responded.
[What will you do if that’s true?]
“I’ll talk. I’ll reveal everything.”
[You’ll talk?]
“Yes. Also, I’m ending my contract with you.”
[Oh. You want to end the contract?]
“At the end of the day, a Zodiac cannot manifest its power without the Zodiac Saint.”
[Is there a reason you should go that far? Aquarius’s Saintess accepted her place. She kneeled before her Zodiac.]
“I like Lee Gun.”
Liv couldn’t help but feel attracted to him. However, she just liked him as a human being. She thought he was a good person.
“I have a feeling that the Zodiacs are sketchy.”
Liv realized something important about the Zodiacs, so she intended to end her contract with her Zodiac. However…
[I can really eat your Zodiac Saint?]
“!!”
Liv froze as she heard an unfamiliar voice. Someone stood behind her. It wasn’t a Zodiac or a human.
It was a demon. It was one of the monarchs called Abundance. In the future, Lee Gun would kill Abundance by piercing through its stomach.
[You can.]
Liv screamed.
At that moment, Abundance ripped out Liv’s soul and started to eat it.
Then the fallen body of Liv got up.
“I have a body now.” Pisces smirked after taking her Zodiac Saint’s body for herself.
It was one month before Red Eye would appear.

chapters.title: Chapter 473: Book 1, Epilogue 26 - Devil's Tower (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 26 - Devil's Tower (2)
Time continued to pass, and soon, it was the fourth year since Lee Gun appeared in the world; it was January 2005.
Three years had passed since Lee Gun and Hugo had become friends, and the world had changed a lot in that time.
[Lee Gun was the one who stood out among the thirteen.]
[Lee Gun once again recovered land for humanity!]
Thousands of hostages taken by the monsters had been given a new lease on life thanks to Lee Gun. He had also taken back half of the land taken by the monsters.
This was the period when Lee Gun had gone on his various famous raids. The four great raids that would be posted on YouTube in the future had occurred during this period.
Moreover, Hugo had gained his “Prophecy” ability, and it had been very helpful to Lee Gun. While Hugo’s prophetic ability didn’t work when it came to Lee Gun, Hugo could see where monsters would show up and the direction in which they would run away.
Of course, Red Eye had appeared in 2004 and had overwhelmed humanity. Yet people continued to praise Lee Gun.
“Lee Gun and the twelve Zodiac Saints will somehow be able to kill Red Eye!”
“They are the hope of humanity!”
“Lee Gun! I believe in Lee Gun!”
Lee Gun had a foul mouth, and he had a habit of sometimes kicking leaders with his foot. However, no one cared about that.
“With Lee Gun, it feels as if we won’t lose.”
“That’s right. It doesn’t matter what the situation is. He always comes back alive.”
“According to what he has achieved, he is the strongest person.”
However, the public was unaware of something: the other Zodiac Saints were getting stronger, and as Lee Gun’s exploits grew, he was getting weaker.
Lee Gun was like a car tire that kept being worn down with more use. He was like a boat that broke through stormy waters to take everyone to safety, yet the waves would batter the vessel into becoming junk. He was the only one taking damage.
On January 1st, 2005, Lee Gun’s health problem became a topic of discussion at a press conference that announced the raid of the final boss called Red Eye—a monster that made the world groan.
“What? All thirteen, including Lee Gun, will enter the Devil’s Tower??!”
“Yes. We can no longer stand back and do nothing about Red Eye.”
“In one week, all thirteen of us will enter Red Eye’s nest! We plan on entering the Devil's Tower.”
The twelve Zodiac Saints’ words caused a commotion amongst the reporters.
“Thirteen? Didn’t Lee Gun suffer an injury recently? Hasn’t he checked himself into a hospital?”
“Yet you’re talking about raiding Red Eye…!”
In response to the commotion, Jean-Louis laughed as he picked up the microphone. “I know why you are all worried, but the one who called for this raid was none other than Lee Gun.”
“What?!”
“It was a month ago when Lee Gun had to be hospitalized. In the battle, Red Eye expended a lot of its power. That is why it flew to its new nest to recuperate. This action is unprecedented. It’s an opportunity for us to kill it once and for all.”
Stevens continued from where Jean-Louis left off. “Lee Gun isn’t here right now, but he believes that this is the only opportunity we’ll get to kill Red Eye. We agree with his opinion.”
“Then…!”
“Yes. We will come back with the severed head of Red Eye.”
When he made that declaration, people cheered with tears in their eyes.
At that moment, one of the twelve Zodiac Saints spoke up.
“Are you sure Lee Gun is ok?” It was Kevin, who looked leery.
His reaction was expected since Lee Gun had suffered a significant injury when he fought a life-and-death battle against Red Eye only a month ago.
The twelve Zodiac Saints hadn’t been present at the scene, so they had no idea how weakened Red Eye had become.
“Will Lee Gun be able to do this?” Kevin worriedly asked.
The Taurus Saint Ivan laughed for an entirely different reason. “Right. In recent days, all he does is clean up after us. Are we even sure he’ll be helpful to us in the Devil’s Tower?”
“Hey.”
“What? Did I say anything wrong?”
Everyone became silent when they heard Ivan’s words.
In the past year, Lee Gun’s body had worsened to a worrying degree. The raid to Russia had occurred three years ago, and Lee Gun hadn’t been in great shape ever since. In the past year, Lee Gun was barely able to participate in fights.
Ivan, who disliked Lee Gun, laughed as if Lee Gun deserved it. “An attack from a low-rank monster sent him flying. In fact, he’s a hindrance now. It has gotten so bad that even the cat bastard became angry. He told Lee Gun to sit out the battle. Am I the only one who remembers that?”
When the spotlight was put on Stevens, he let out a sigh. He did say something like that to Lee Gun, but… “Hey. At the time, I….”
“He’s a knife sharpener now! All he does is fix our weapons!”
“What? Knife sharpener?” As a fellow blacksmith, Sergeyevich gave Ivan a side-eye.
Ivan spoke as he patted Sergeyevich. “I’m not talking about you. I’m talking about Lee Gun.”
“….”
“Anyway, I don’t mind taking Lee Gun to the Devil’s Tower, considering our opponent. However, we are taking him as a knife sharpener. I want everyone to be on the same page when we come up with a plan tomorrow. It’s annoying that he’s being treated as an equal to us.”
The Sheep Saint Yang Wei, who was in charge of gathering supplies, tilted his head in confusion. “Even if Lee Gun is no longer a fighter, isn’t he useful?”
Lee Gun was a demon when it came to sensing things. It wasn’t something they should discard.
Sophie agreed with that. “The only one capable of guiding us through the Devil’s Tower is Lee Gun. That damn man was the one to notice that Red Eye has been weakened too.”
“Guide? Are you telling me that we should give that knife sharpener the role of leader?!” Ivan became angry and agitated.
Jean-Louis talked him down. “Please calm down. When one has to climb to the top of Everest, one needs a sherpa.”
“!”
Jean-Louis smirked. “We are merely asking him to be a guide. Lee Gun should be able to do it.”
Everyone nodded. While Lee Gun wouldn’t be helpful in a fight, he would be perfect as a guide. He could tell them which monsters were dangerous and which path would be optimal.
While they didn’t want to admit it, Lee Gun had beast-like senses. He was the best among them. It would be fine if Lee Gun entered the Devil’s Tower as a guide instead of a fighter.
So Kevin, who had broached the topic first, agreed to that arrangement.
However, two Zodiacs disagreed. Hailey and Hugo were adamant that Lee Gun shouldn’t enter the Devil’s Tower.
Hailey already knew that the Devil’s Tower belonged to the Time monarch. Then there was Hugo…
‘He’d have a tough time guiding us in his state.’
Hugo knew better than anyone about the state of Lee Gun’s body.
‘Gun is at a stage where he can barely hear the sound of a car’s honk.’
Not too long ago, when Hugo had met up with Lee Gun, Lee Gun had almost been hit by a car. Hugo clenched his eyes shut.
‘If he were his normal self, he could dodge a car in his sleep.’
On the other hand, Lee Gun might do ok in a monster raid. While his hearing and other bodily functions were deteriorating, he could still sense the energy of monsters very well. However, Hugo didn’t think that would last long either.
* * *
Korea.
“Gun. Are you home?”
Normally, Lee Gun and Hugo traveled around the world through land routes while taking care of commissions. However, a year ago, they had decided to acquire a house. As Lee Gun’s body worsened, he could no longer travel far for raids.
‘Thanks to this decision, his body has gotten much better.’
It seemed Jaewon was also given a room.
Anyway, Hugo looked after Lee Gun while they lived in the same house.
Hugo opened the door to the house. “Gun. The press conference is done. I should’ve been live on TV. Did you see— What the hell? He’s sleeping.”
Lee Gun had been watching the press conference using the TV, but currently, he was lying down on the sofa.
After seeing this, Hugo went to the fridge. He was hungry, so he spoke as he took out some food. “Anyway, we’re doing as you recommended. We came to a decision to move in a week. We’ll meet up tomorrow to create a plan. You should... Gun?”
Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement when he got a closer look at Lee Gun. His face froze when he confirmed something.
He headed toward Lee Gun. “Gun?”
Hugo desperately shook Lee Gun to wake him up. “Gun! Wake up! Breathe! Gun!”
Hugo shook Lee Gun and even slapped his cheek, but Lee Gun didn’t budge at all. It was more than not moving. Lee Gun wasn’t breathing despite Hugo thumping him.
Finally, the hand holding the remote control fell to the ground.
Kwahng!
When the hand fell to the ground like the hand of a corpse, Hugo felt his heart sink. “Gun!!”
His face turned pale from fright. He was like a madman trying to wake up Lee Gun. “Gun. Hey, Gun!! Wake up! Gun! Please!”
It was unclear how long he tried to tap him awake. In the end, a desperate Hugo was about to call for an ambulance.
“Damn it… What the hell? Why are you being so noisy?”
“Gun!”
Relieved, Hugo threw aside his phone.
Recently, the thought of Lee Gun never waking up from his sleep had been heavy on Hugo’s mind. “You surprised me! You didn’t wake up, so I was about to call for an ambulance— Kuhk!”
“Hey. You want to die? Don’t overdo it, idiot. Why the hell would you call for an ambulance?”
Hugo was dumbfounded after being hit by Lee Gun. “Don’t overdo it? Hey! Are you kidding me? You weren’t breathing right now! You wouldn’t wake up even when I tried to wake you up!”
“Why are you being like this? Don’t do something unnecessary like that ever again.”
“Unnecessary….” Hugo almost cursed, but held himself back. That wasn’t important right now.
“Gun. I don’t want you to enter the Devil’s Tower,” he said.
“What?”
“I don’t want you to go! Your body isn’t in a state where you can participate in the raid!”
“What the hell did you just say?”
“You fell into a manhole not too long ago because you couldn’t see the under-construction sign! Even your eyesight has deteriorated, yet you want to go to the nest of the boss monster? Do you not realize what kind of place that is— Ahhhk!!”
“Shut up. It was temporary. It won’t get in the way of me killing monsters.”
“Damn it!”
In the end, Hugo went looking for a doctor. He wanted to check if what Lee Gun had said was true and if Lee Gun was really ok.
After going through several days’ worth of tests, Hugo heard something shocking.
“What? What did you just say right now?”
“I was talking about Lee Gun-nim’s lifespan. He has only a year left.”
“What?”
“I also received data from Sophie-nim. Have you ever taken a close look at it?”
The doctor somberly looked at Hugo. “He looks fine on the outside, but his body has aged. It’s already over 80 years old. It’s a miracle that he’s alive when you look at his organs… At best, he has one year… I’m saying one year, but he won’t last a month in reality.”
“A month…! He still has five years left…!”
“He continued to kill monsters during that time.”
“…!”
“In his state, it would have been painful for him to kill the monsters. I can’t even imagine how much pain he would have been in.”
Hugo looked shell-shocked as frozen.
The doctor let out a bitter laugh. “Of course, he has less than a month if he continues to fight monsters like he always does.”
“That means…!”
“Please do not worry. If he gives up on fighting monsters, he could extend his life by five years. He just has to live a normal life. Moreover, he’s an awakened being. It might be possible to extend his life further by ten, twenty, or maybe thirty years.”
It meant Lee Gun had less than one year if he fought monsters. But if he lived as a normal human, he could live for several dozen years at the very least.
“Hugo-nim. You do realize what’s the right choice, right?”
Of course, he knew.
“Devil’s Tower… From humanity’s perspective, it would make us feel more relieved if he went… However, it would be best for him not to go. He’s already like this, killing low-level monsters… If he goes into the Devil’s Tower…”
Hugo nodded.
‘If he goes there, he might die.’
If Lee Gun retired, he would be able to extend his lifespan. He could live to a ripe old age.
After learning this, Hugo was happy. He was going to pass this information on to Lee Gun when he received a text.
- All thirteen of us will enter the Devil’s Tower as planned.
- We are going to leave Jaewon behind, so you’re in charge of packing our stuff.
Hugo gritted his teeth.
* * *
The day before they would enter the Devil’s tower, Lee Gun had gone to a pub to eat chicken. Hugo said to him, “Gun. You want to see my child, right? That’s why you shouldn’t go to the Devil's tower.”
Lee Gun looked dumbfounded. “What the hell? You said you won’t marry. Did you have an accident?”
“What? Have you lost your… Ah. Whatever! You and I have to enter a retirement home together! Instead of going to the Devil’s Tower, let’s join a retirement home!”
“What the hell is wrong with you?”
“Gun.” In the end, Hugo couldn’t hold it in.
“You’re going to die tomorrow.” With a grave expression, he spoke as a fortune-teller.

chapters.title: Chapter 474: Book 1, Epilogue 27 - You are my nephew
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 27 - You are my nephew
“You are going to die tomorrow.”
The day before they entered the Devil’s Tower, his best friend said those words. Moreover, it seemed Hugo wasn’t satisfied with just handing a death sentence to Lee Gun.
“Do you understand me? If you go to the Devil’s tower, you will die after being hit by a beam that’ll make you lose your hair!!! You must not go there!”
“Do you want to die?!”
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Hugo tried to stop Lee Gun for three hours straight, and in the end, Lee Gun exploded in anger. “Why are you being like this? Your prophecies about me never come true, so why are you being so adamant?”
“No! It’s different this time!” Hugo was frustrated. Even his own Zodiac had been serious.
[Idiot servant. You have to make sure Lee Gun never enters the tower.]
A Zodiac was giving such a stark warning; something was guaranteed to happen.
Moreover, Hugo had seen it for himself.
‘I saw a bleeding Gun fall over inside the tower.’
Of course, Hugo didn’t know the time and floor at which this event would happen. He had no idea whom Lee Gun had fallen to. But what caused it didn’t matter.
The vision had merely reinforced the fact that Lee Gun would suffer a grievous injury inside the Devil’s Tower.
That was why Hugo was tenaciously trying to stop Lee Gun.
“Anyway, we’ll be the ones killing Red Eye”
Lee Gun became angry at Hugo’s shout. He threw a chicken bone at him. “Buzz off! Do you really think you guys will be able to kill that monster on your own?”
“!”
For a change, Lee Gun didn’t laugh; he glared at Hugo. “Why do you think I’m insisting on taking all twelve of you into the Devil's Tower?”
“…!!” Hugo flinched when he saw the contempt in Lee Gun’s eyes.
If he were being honest, it was a unique situation where Lee Gun would team up with all twelve Zodiac Saints.
Aside from Hugo, Lee Gun hated all Zodiac Saints.
Sergeyevich and Ivan were evil men Lee Gun didn’t like to be associated with. Yang Wei was a trader at heart; he only thought about money. Heiji was a psycho who wanted to kill him on sight.
Sophie was obsessed with Hugo and tried to pick a fight with Lee Gun whenever she opened her mouth. Stevens and Kevin got on Lee Gun’s nerves and kept pestering him.
Also, Lee Gun didn’t know when, but at some point, he started to feel a coldness coming from Liv and Giselle.
Among all eleven of the remaining Zodiac Saints, Lee Gun had the least trouble with Hailey, but she hated him so much that she always averted her eyes from his.
Of course, the other Zodiac Saints and Lee Gun had worked together before, but those occasions had been coincidences.
They had never intentionally teamed up, yet Lee Gun was talking about entering the Devil’s Tower with them.
“You guys are acting this way because you have no idea what Red Eye is like.”
The mighty Lee Gun was saying that all the twelve Zodiac Saints had to be present in the raid.
The Devil’s Tower was that dangerous, yet they wanted to take care of it on their own?
“It’s a precarious situation where we might not make it past the tenth floor even if all thirteen of us are there. Do you really think you guys have the instinct needed to reach the hundredth floor on your own?”
Lee Gun had already scouted the tower’s difficulty. The tower had several floors that they had to bypass without fighting. The only one who could lead them to the hundredth floor was him.
However, Hugo clutched at his face as if he was losing his mind. He wasn’t oblivious to their current situation. He wasn’t being naïve in saying they would go to the tower on their own.
“Gun. If we rehabilitate you, you might be able to live ten more years. No, it might be possible to live for more than twenty years. However, if you use your abilities, you won’t last a year…”
“…!”
“If you go to the tower, it doesn’t matter if the raid was successful or a failure. When you come out, you might not be able to last even a day.”
Hugo wanted Lee Gun to have even a little bit of happiness in his life. He had been by Lee Gun’s side. He knew better than anyone how much damage and pain Lee Gun had suffered.
“Gun. If you retire, you’ll be able to live at least twenty years.”
“Bullsh—”
“If I’m honest, it’s what I wish. I would like to have alcohol with you even after twenty, thirty years.”
Hugo had met Lee Gun when the latter was the strongest. Lee Gun was his friend and idol. His heart had ached as he watched his idol gradually weaken.
“I want you to be alive.” Hugo’s head was lowered, so his face wasn’t visible. However, the wetness in his voice was apparent.
Lee Gun, who had been about to lash out, remained silent as he looked at Hugo. Then he solemnly said, “It doesn’t matter if I live. If the world ends, the end result is the same.”
“!”
“Also, it’ll be fine. I’ll do my best to not use my abilities if possible. I did as you asked. I made a plan with the idea that I would provide support from the backline.”
“Even if it’s a plan with you in the rear—”
Lee Gun cut off Hugo with a chuckle. “After we kill that lizard, let’s have a drink once again.”
“…!”
“This is my promise to you. As soon as we leave the tower, we’ll have a drink here once more.”
Hugo gritted his teeth. “Alright. In return, I won’t let you have my chicken leg next time.”
“Just order a chicken leg combo, idiot.”
* * *
The night before the raid to the Devil’s tower, an odd scene was unfolding in a mansion in the US. This mansion was the residence of the Libra Saint.
[Finally, it’ll happen tomorrow.]
The Zodiacs had gathered at the mansion. It was for no other reason.
[I never expected it. He awakened because he had inherited the power of the thirteenth.]
All the Zodiacs were present there except Virgo and Scorpio.
[If we let Lee Gun live, the thirteenth Zodiac might be born again.]
Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Capricorn, and Aquarius were the ones raising their voices.
[Above all else, Lee Gun is too good at killing monsters.]
[That’s right! The Faith, which should be coming to us, is all directed toward him! This includes my Zodiac Saint…!]
[How dare a human receive worship over a god?]
[We don’t need a real hero who’ll get rid of all the monsters.]
[Humans are naturally stupid, so they only look for someone they want to worship when they are terrified. It’s the only way they’ll acknowledge and serve the gods.]
Gods were beings that could exist only if humans believed in and worshiped them. This was why Lee Gun was considered a hindrance in the Zodiacs’ attempt to rule over the humans.
[My Zodiac Saint was elated that we wanted to get rid of Lee Gun. He’ll give his full cooperation.]
When she learned that Ivan and Sergeyevich would cooperate with their plan, Giselle smirked. “That is good news.”
For Negligence, Lee Gun was a nuisance too. She had been living the good life after finally attaining the power of Zodiac when Lee Gun had suddenly asked her one day,
- Are you really human?
- W-What? W-What are you talking about? You’re too much, Mr. Lee Gun.
Yes, Lee Gun was suspicious of her. If things went wrong, it’d endanger the honest peace that she had barely scraped together for herself.
‘I have to get rid of him before he figures everything out.’
Time seemed to be eyeing Lee Gun for himself, but that didn’t matter to her.
“I doubt Lee Gun will be able to climb past the tenth floor, but as an insurance policy, I would like you guys to place curses on him.”
[Curse?]
Sagittarius had come here by possessing Hugo’s body. He flinched. It was to be expected since he had no choice in coming to this scene of treachery.
He spoke as he ground his teeth. “He’s going to die soon even if we let him be. Do we have to go through all of this to kill that human?”
Giselle’s eyes flashed. “Sagittarius. You have been favoring Lee Gun for some reason recently.”
Sagittarius furrowed his brows. He wasn’t favoring Lee Gun. He just couldn’t kill him.
‘That child is my nephew.’
It had been only a week since he had recovered his memories.
‘If only I had recovered my memories earlier…’
The current situation would have developed a bit differently.
“Anyway, this has nothing to do with me. I won’t go along with such a vulgar plan…”
At that moment…
[Stop talking nonsense. You have to walk the walk. Each of us will place ten curses on him.]
“!”
The eyes of Gemini and Pisces, the magic-type Zodiacs, flashed.
[Do not forget that the twelve of us are under a pact.]
[If you betray us, you and your Constructs are dead.]
In the end, Sagittarius let out a sigh as he tossed black seeds into the brazier. These were the gods’ curses.
[Hair Loss], [Erectile Dysfunction], [Decreased Attractiveness], [Stench], [Ugliness], [Obesity], [Repulsiveness], [Rhinitis], [Bad Breath], [Athlete’s Foot], [Hemorrhoid], [Dandruff].
Among the curses that he could place, he picked the ones that wouldn’t threaten Lee Gun’s life.
‘I’m sorry, Aslan.’
He would also do his best to protect Lee Gun in the tower. Above all else, he believed in Lee Gun. It didn't matter if they ran interference on him. His nephew would survive. He must.
* * *
That was what he had thought.
“Hey, bedwetter! Hurry up and heal me properly!”
“Ahhk, Lee Gun! You stink too much! Get away from me!!!”
“You want to die!!”
“Kyahhhh!! Your breath stinks!!”
“Ahhk!!”
“Gun!!!”
The group was on the fiftieth floor of the Devil’s tower.
Sagittarius was sweating as he watched them. He had placed curses on Lee Gun, thinking they wouldn’t cause any threat to Lee Gun’s life, yet…
“Hey, cat! Why did you join in on that attack? I almost died!”
“Ah… I don’t know why, but you’re very repulsive today.”
“You want to die, bastard!!”
After receiving the curses from Sagittarius, Lee Gun was experiencing a struggle of a different nature. This made Sagittarius nervous.
‘At this rate, Lee Gun really might die.’
Of course, at times, the effects of the curses showed their effectiveness in unexpected ways.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!!!]
“What the hell? Why is it running away from me? Hey! Come back!”
[Kee-ehhhhhk!!!!]
Some of the monsters started to run away because of the stench emanating from Lee Gun. The curses saved Lee Gun’s life in those times.
Moreover, he was the only one who didn’t fall to the monsters that used charm to entice their enemies…
In reality, the monsters showed zero interest in Lee Gun. He was able to safely cut down those monsters to advance to another floor. Of course, Lee Gun was losing his mind at that moment.
“My god! Look at that. He lost the lid on his head…”
Heiji looked at him with contempt.
Lee Gun ground his teeth as he further pulled his hood over his face.
Sagittarius trembled as he watched the rage swirling within Lee Gun.
The other Zodiacs were frightened for a different reason.
[What’s going on? You said he won’t be able to get past the tenth floor!]
The Zodiacs were shocked when Lee Gun was leading their Zodiac Saints to the fiftieth floor.
[They are supposed to exit the tower as soon as they kill Lee Gun!]
[If they climb further, our Zodiac Saints will be in danger too!]
Two of the Zodiac Saints were reacting the same way as the Zodiacs.
‘What the hell? How is that zombie still alive?’
‘Didn’t the Zodiacs place curses on him?’
Ivan and Sergeyevich were dumbfounded as they looked at Lee Gun. Ivan had gone as far as to redirect monsters toward Lee Gun from time to time, yet Lee Gun didn’t back down at all.
Of course, it helped that Sagittarius and Hugo were supporting Lee Gun.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief as he watched Lee Gun.
‘At this rate, Gun will be able to leave unharmed.’
However, Hugo’s relief lasted only a short time. They soon reached the seventieth floor of the Devil’s Tower.
“Lee Gun! This is bad! The tower’s monsters are starting to head toward the city!” as if on schedule, Sergeyevich yelled.
Lee Gun glared at him. “What nonsense are you talking about? I thought we made sure the tower’s monsters wouldn’t be able to go anywhere!”
“How should I know? T-The monsters must have been too strong! They must have pushed through the barrier to escape!”
“Damn it!”
Lee Gun gnashed his teeth as he turned around.
Sergeyevich smirked.
‘You must be frustrated that your plan went awry.’
As the leader, Lee Gun had created the perfect plan for the raid. He had even made sure the nearby cities wouldn’t suffer any damage.
However, Sergeyevich wanted to mess with Lee Gun’s plan, so he had installed a holy item in the city. It was an item that let out something like a pheromone to attract the monsters.
Lee Gun wouldn’t be able to turn a blind eye to the people.
‘Let’s see you wrack your brain. Will you be able to clear the tower like this?’
The leader of this raid and the one to come up with this plan was Lee Gun. Of course, the world was focused on him. What would happen to Lee Gun’s honor and pride if he failed?
‘Genius, my ass! I hope your honor falls as much as mine fell.’
For a moment, Lee Gun looked like he was in a predicament, but he unexpectedly didn’t panic at all.
“Hey, Taeksoo. You should go and stop them.”
“What?! Have you lost your mind?”
“You’re the only one who can do it.”
Sergeyevich laughed when he saw this. Lee Gun planned on sending out Hugo, which was within Sergeyevich’s expectations.
‘Do you think Hugo will be able to defend the city by himself? It means Lee Gun’s raid is a failure.’
At that moment…
“Take this.”
“!”
Lee Gun unexpectedly tossed a bow toward Hugo. “I thought giving you a new item would be bad luck, so I planned on giving it to you after we left this place. This is an early birthday present from me.”
“Gun!”
“You always complained that you wanted to solo fights. I made this bow with that in mind. You’ll be able to become a solo player.”
It seemed Lee Gun had planned on doing as Hugo had asked. He was going to retire after this matter came to a close.
Therefore, he had created a graduation present. It was payment for all the hardship that Lee Gun put Hugo through.
On the other hand, Hugo seemed frustrated. “No, I don’t need to become a solo player! I’ll always be your support! I’m not going to leave this place! Since the barrier was placed over this place, I can’t come back in if I leave…”
“Hey, Taeksoo.”
“!”
“Wait for me. When this all ends, we’ll go have a drink together.”
In the end, Hugo accepted the request and left the tower.
The group then reached the eightieth, ninetieth, and finally, the hundredth floor.
“Ha ha! Stand back, Lee Gun! I’ll be the one to kill Red Eye!”
“Ivan!”
“Hey! Come back!”
“Hmmph. You must be scared because you were the only one beaten up by Red Eye. However, we are different!”
With Red Eye in sight, Ivan and the other Zodiac Saints confidently activated their skills.
“I don’t know how strong it is, but Lee Gun was able to live after taking a hit from it…”
[Kee--ehhhhhk!!!]
“W-what the hell is that?”
“Ahhhk! Run!”
Everyone ran with Red Eye in sight.
The Zodiac Saints had ignored the plan set up by Lee Gun, so everything turned into a mess.
Among all the commotion, Lee Gun glared at the rampaging monster. “Alright, bastard. Let’s do this.”
It was January 15th, 2005, the day when Red Eye died.

chapters.title: Chapter 475: Book 1, Epilogue 28 - Where is Gun?
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 28 - Where is Gun?
[Kee-ehhhhhhhk!!]
Letting out an extremely loud roar, Red Eye finally fell.
Boom!
Lee Gun also fell as well.
“Huh-uhk…!”
