If he were being honest, he could only describe it as good luck.
‘It was the strongest monster that I’ve killed to date.’
His still being alive was a miracle. It was understandable as the plan that he had created for Red Eye had gone into the dumps when the ten Zodiac Saints beside him had run away. He had no items and no healer, and his body was a mess, on the verge of breaking down.
Lee Gun had used all of his abilities, and he hadn’t held back at all. He coughed up blood.
‘I’ve almost used up all my magical energy.’
His body was such a mess that even walking was hard for him. Despite this, Lee Gun felt great.
“This is it. I’ve done it.”
Feeling a sense of accomplishment, he tapped the severed head of Red Eye. He had killed the biggest threat to humanity. The only thing left was to kill the remaining monsters, which had consolidated under Red Eye.
‘Those monsters can be cleaned up in stages.’
While he did disparage the Zodiac Saints, they were capable of getting rid of these monsters. These monsters’ boss was now gone, so their morale would be at a low. Defeating them would be much easier.
‘I can be at ease and rest now.’
Lee Gun had killed Red Eye. He wondered if he was eligible for some form of pension.
‘I hope what I did will be recorded in textbooks and Wikipedia.’
Anyway, he’d live off Taeksoo after leaving this place. He would eat and play for the rest of his life.
If Taeksoo married, Lee Gun would reveal the black history of his friend while officiating his wedding. He would reveal that Taeksoo used to follow him around as a student.
Of course, it was a shame that he had been unable to find Yeonwoo’s corpse, but he would take his time in searching for it.
For the first time, Lee Gun chuckled out loud. Feeling unencumbered, he left Red Eye’s room.
Clank!!
However, when he came out of the room, he shocked and frightened the people before him.
“L…Lee Gun?!”
The ones shaking outside the door were none other than Ivan and Sergeyevich. Then there was Jean-Louis, who had transformed into Kevin, and Jean-Louis’s clone.
“Y-You’re Lee Gun, right?”
“Y-You haven’t changed into a monster, right?”
Lee Gun became enraged. With a wicked smirk on his lips, he said, “You guys decided to run away to the other side of the door??”
“L-Lee Gun!!”
“What?! Once you decided to run away, you should have left the earth! You guys forgot about the plan and ran away. How dare you come back here!”
“It isn’t …!”
Ivan, who was always full of bluster, was at a loss for words. He had been pompous and was the first to charge toward Red Eye, as if Red Eye were nothing.
The other Zodiac Saints had also confidently stepped forward, but they had run away from the battlefield when they became afraid of Red Eye.
In the end, Sergeyevich and Ivan spoke as they stole glances at Lee Gun.
“W-What about Red Eye? It’s quiet right now. Did you make it fall asleep?”
“Are your eyes there for decorations only? What do you think I’ve brought out here?”
“What do you mean— Ahhk!!”
They were shocked when they saw the item Lee Gun was dragging out.
“W-What the hell? Red Eye?!”
“You guys all ran away and abandoned the plan. That’s why I had to kill it.”
“C-Crazy…! You killed that on your own?”
“If you knew killing Red Eye would be hard, why didn’t you come back earlier? It took me almost three days because I had to kill the monster on my own.”
“That’s…”
They trembled. They had run away into the corner of the hundredth floor in fright. However, Red Eye continued to roar like crazy, and they had been unable to open their eyes.
It was like a normal human being paralyzed from hearing the roar of a tiger. Red Eye’s roar had paralyzed these Zodiac Saints’ minds and the ability to reason.
This was why they had waited for the sound to subside.
‘Red Eye is dead. That’s why we could no longer hear it…!’
They were in disbelief as they looked at Lee Gun.
They had been in denial regarding Lee Gun, but even they had to admit it. At that moment, they felt the difference in the skill level between Lee Gun and them. They felt it in their bones.
“That is… I’m sorry. We were…”
“You guys can get bent. What about the others?”
Everyone had run away in fright and scattered in all directions. Yang Wei had made a hole to hide, yet his butt was sticking out. He was shaking in fear.
“Hey, hurry up and come out. The one in charge of food shouldn’t run away! I’m starving right now!”
“Ahhhk! I’m sorry! Spare me, Red Eye! Ahhhk!”
The one to run away first was Stevens, and he was found in a storage room containing weapons for the monsters.
“Y-You killed it? You did? O-On your own?!”
“Yes, I did. You realize how hard it was since the one in charge of immobilizing Red Eye ran away first?”
“…!”
Liv had transformed herself into a dead monster. She looked at Lee Gun as if she had seen a ghost.
“H-How are you still alive?”
“Why does it sound as if you’ve been hoping for my death?”
“!”
Heiji, who had used teleport to hide, couldn’t bring herself to raise her head.
“Hurry up and come out. You have to open the gate if we want to leave.”
Sophie, the only healer in their party, was on a floor below, crying. “The path suddenly closed itself! I couldn’t get back up!”
“What about the Scorpio Saint? Wasn’t she with you?”
“S…She saved me when I was falling. We were split up when the monsters attacked her. For some odd reason, the monsters only attacked her…!”
“What? Where is she right now?”
“I have no idea. However, I did see the Scorpio Constructs take her out of the tower when she suffered a grievous injury…”
“Is that so? I’m glad she was able to exit this place.”
After finding all the Zodiac Saints, they returned to the room of Red Eye. They were going to use the magical energy of Red Eye to teleport themselves out of there.
“The floors below us are full of monsters that we bypassed. I can’t guarantee our safety if we encounter the middle bosses that are located every ten floors.”
Lee Gun’s plan had barely allowed them to bypass those monsters, and he kept moving them to the next floor. However, the same plan wouldn’t work twice.
“That’s why we have to leave from this floor.”
Then, they would do as planned. They would permanently seal the tower, and the Zodiacs would wrap it up by sending the tower to a pocket dimension. Also…
“You guys are all dead when we get out of here.”
“!”
Everyone shook from fear when they heard Lee Gun’s angry voice.
Lee Gun was furious because he had to kill Red Eye on his own. Still, he didn’t think the Zodiac Saints hadn’t been trying to do anything nefarious.
At the end of the day, the group was able to climb to the hundredth floor because everyone had pooled their power and worked together. The only bad part was that they were useless in the end.
So Lee Gun planned on working them to the bones. “I killed the most problematic monster. I’m going to retire, and the only role I’ll play from now on is to make plans for you guys. That’s why you guys will work for the next five years without pay to kill the remaining monsters. You guys also have a lot of work to do to take back our lands.”
“…!”
“I’ll work you guys very hard from the back. Be prepared to shed blood, sweat, and tears.”
The Zodiac Saint froze at the same time.
‘We ran away as soon as we saw Red Eye..’
They had done it in an unsightly manner, and when they left this place, the truth would spread across the world.
The media would have a field day. They would write the headlines saying Lee Gun had killed Red Eye on his own.
‘If it’s Lee Gun, he might give them all the details.’
Ivan’s hands shook since he had said he didn’t care about humanity. He had said saving their own lives was more important.
‘We will be labeled cowards who messed up the plan. Lee Gun will become the hero who cleaned up everything.’
Of course, some among them looked favorably on this development.
Stevens was the first to run away. Heiji had run away alone in fright. Then there were the support units Yang Wei and Sophie, who could deflect the blame from themselves.
‘Damn it…! We can’t let that bastard leave this place.’
On the other hand, Ivan, Sergeyevich, and Liv were shaking in fear. Ivan was afraid of the criticism that would be directed at him. Sergeyevich and Liv had each done something they shouldn’t have.
‘If it’s Lee Gun, he might notice the holy item that I installed inside the city.’
‘He might notice that I changed Jean-Louis into Kevin.’
Their eyes flashed menacingly, but the rest of the group didn’t notice this.
Finally, Heiji was close to finishing her teleportation portal when…
Koo-goo-goong!!
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!!!]
“Ah!”
The monsters on the lower floors started to ascend.
Kwahng!!
It seemed they didn’t want to let the Zodiac Saints leave unscathed.
Kwahng!!
“Damn it! They destroyed the exit gate!”
“I need you guys to buy me some time! I’ll remake it in no time— Ooh-oohk!”
All of a sudden, a strange black hole appeared on the floor
“W-What the hell? Is it a trap?!”
The dark hole, which was akin to a black hole, started to drag in the Zodiac Saints, letting out an enormous power.
“Ahhhk! Help!”
The structure started to fall as monsters rushed toward them. The hundredth floor was turning into a scene of absolute mayhem.
Then, a smirk appeared on the face of Jean-Louis, who was disguised as Kevin and who had called the monsters here.
As if he had been waiting for this moment, he took out a dagger hidden in his breast pocket.
At that moment, everyone’s gaze was off Lee Gun, and Lee Gun had lost all of his senses!
Poohk!
“Kuh-huhk!”
Jean-Louis stabbed Lee Gun in the back.
Lee Gun lost all strength as he faltered on his feet. He was being sucked into the black hole.
“Lee Gun!!”
He barely grabbed a nearby pillar. It was for a moment, but the twelve Zodiac Saints had a chance to grab Lee Gun.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!!!]
“!!”
However, they all froze when they heard the monsters’ cries, and they were unable to catch Lee Gun. Moreover, the ones nearest to him, Ivan and Sergeyevich, didn’t even think about grabbing him.
After a few seconds, Lee Gun lost his hold on the pillar and fell into the black hole.
“Lee Gun!!”
A flustered Stevens and Heiji intended to chase after Lee Gun when Jean-Louis yelled, “What are you doing? Hurry up and jump into the gate!”
“But…! What about Lee Gun!”
“Take a good look at our current situation! It’s too late for him!”
“That’s right! We should prioritize our lives!”
In the end, the Zodiac Saints jumped into the teleport portal as if they were being chased. Then, they appeared in front of the entrance to the Devil’s Tower.
“H…Huh-uhk…!”
They were in disbelief since they had barely escaped from the mayhem. They looked up at the familiar sky.
At the same time, they heard familiar voices.
“T-They came back out!”
“It’s the Zodiac Saints!!!”
“!”
The reporters cheered when they saw the item that the Zodiac Saints had dragged out.
“Red Eye! That’s the head of Red Eye!!!”
“Huzzah! The heroes did it!!”
The people were happy, but their joy lasted only a moment.
“Uh? Where’s Mr. Lee Gun?”
“You’re right. I don’t see Mr. Lee Gun.”
“…!”
“Ah! Did he come out earlier like the Archer Saint and the Scorpio Saint?”
“No way! The Archer Saint would have known already since they are friends.”
“Where is Mr. Lee Gun right now?”
The faces of the Zodiac Saints froze.
* * *
- Red Eye is dead!!
- Humanity is saved!
- The heroes exited the tower after decapitating Red Eye!
Around that time, Hugo had successfully protected the city. He had killed tens of thousands of monsters on his own, and he had fallen from exhaustion. He woke up inside the hospital.
As soon as he woke up, he moved to go back into the Devil’s Tower. However, he saw the breaking news on TV at that moment and let out a sigh of relief.
“Great! They killed it…!!”
The group had succeeded in the raid, so Hugo called Lee Gun in a great mood. However, Lee Gun didn’t answer his phone.
Hugo let out a chuckle.
“He must be worn out.”
It was understandable since they had gone through a lot of hardship to reach the last floor.
“If I ask Mr. Stevens or Mr. Kevin, I’ll be able to find out where he is hospitalized.” Hugo laughed as he was about to call Stevens.
- What? Lee Gun was unable to make it out of the tower?
- What do you mean? Why wasn’t Lee Gun able to come back out?
Hugo’s face hardened. Frozen in shock, he watched the breaking news unfold. He was about to leave his hospital room when…
“!”
As soon as he opened the door, he met eyes with a man trying to enter the hospital room. It was none other than Jean-Louis.
He looked like the grim reaper as he wore a suit worn for a funeral. Jean Louis smiled as if he pitied Hugo.
* * *
“Wait a moment! What happened to Mr. Lee Gun? What happened to the thirteenth? Why did only twelve of you return?”
“I’m pretty sure thirteen people went into the Devil’s Tower! Lee Gun! What happened to Korea’s awakened Lee Gun?”
The world was in turmoil. It all had to do with Lee Gun.
“Are you sure Lee Gun voluntarily jumped into the trap on behalf of mankind?”
“He did it to save the other Zodiac Saints?”
“Are you sure Mr. Lee Gun is really dead?!”
Aside from Hugo and Hailey, all the Zodiac Saints were present at the press conference.
Yang Wei and Sophie were unable to look into the camera. Giselle and Liv were trying to hide their tears. Heiji and Stevens could only look down at their knees. Kevin sat there as if his soul had left his body.
This press conference was heated more so than ever, and Ivan spoke with a sad tone in his voice. “Our thirteenth member chose death of his own accord.”
Sergeyevich shed tears as he continued, “We will not let Lee Gun’s noble sacrifice go to waste. Please trust us and leave it up to us.”
“Please praise our noble hero, who chose to sacrifice himself to save his comrades…”
Boom!!!
“Ahhk!!”
The door to the press conference room was suddenly destroyed.
“Stop lying, you bastards!! Stop trying to scam us!” An angry Hugo held a bloodied Jean-Louis by the neck and stormed into the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 476: Book 1, Epilogue 29 - Let's All Die Today
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 29 - Let's All Die Today
“Stop lying, you bastards!! Stop trying to scam us!” An angry Hugo held a bloodied Jean-Louis by the neck and stormed into the room.
Pandemonium erupted within the press conference room.
“H…Hugo-nim!”
“Hugo!”
They were surprised by Hugo's sudden entrance, but above all, they were shocked by who he held.
“C-Cancer Saint?”
“Jean-Louis!?”
Jean-Louis seemed to have taken a beating from Hugo. His face was smashed, and he was groaning. Him being a bloody mess was a surprise, but also…
“W-What the hell? Jean-Louis is over there?”
The Leo Saint and the reporters naturally looked at the platform in the front. The Zodiac Saints were sitting on this platform, and Jean-Louis had been holding the mic.
However, Hugo was dragging Jean-Louis in from the other side of the room.
This baffled the reporters.
“Wait a moment! What the hell? There are two Jean-Louis…?!”
The Jean-Louis who held the mic looked shocked.
Of course, the other Zodiac Saints immediately realized that Jean-Louis had split himself.
‘What the hell? Which is the real one?’
However, the answer came immediately.
“Ah! The Jean-Louis in the front is…!”
“He’s melting!”
The version of Jean-Louis near the other Zodiac Saints melted into mud.
The only one left was the bloodied Jean-Louis, whom Hugo was holding.
Jean-Louis had said he wanted to personally deliver the news of Lee Gun’s death to Hugo.
‘That bastard didn’t make a call? He went to meet Hugo in person?!’
Of course, Hugo knew that he had beaten the real one close to death.
‘There is no way this bastard would let a clone deliver the news of Lee Gun’s death.’
Jean-Louis was the type of man who enjoyed others’ pain. He was a nasty piece of work who felt pleasure and a sense of superiority when he saw someone crumble in front of him.
Clearly, Jean-Louis wanted to see the despair on Hugo’s face when delivering the message of Lee Gun’s death.
That was why Hugo had pummeled Jean-Louis as soon as the latter had opened his mouth.
The bloodied Jean-Louis had been unable to move an inch as he coughed up blood.
‘Damn it! I never expected him to suddenly punch me in the face.’
He had been beaten to the point where he had broken bones and was having a hard time breathing.
The surprised doctors and nurses had rushed forward, trying to stop Hugo. However, they couldn’t stop him.
After he barged into the press conference while dragging in Jean-Louis, Hugo’s eyes flashed. “What kind of scam is this?! What did Gun do? He sacrificed himself for you guys?”
“H-Hugo!”
Hugo was threatening to do the same to them if they continued talking this nonsense.
“Stop the bullshit! Tell the truth! Where did you abandon Gun?”
The Zodiac Saints were surprised since Hugo normally had a bubbly personality. He was always polite and didn’t like causing any inconvenience to his comrades. So his current actions shocked them.
“Hey, we understand what you’re going through. Let’s talk outside.”
“That’s right. We are being broadcast live now…”
Ivan and Sergeyevich tried to take Hugo outside. However, Hugo swung his fists toward the other Zodiac Saints as if he wanted to shut them up.
Puh-uhk!!!
Ivan and Sergeyevich lost their teeth as Hugo’s hits landed on them. They spat blood.
“Wait a moment! Hugo! Kuhk!!”
“If he fell into a trap, the first thought on your mind should have been to find him! Bastards! In the first place, Gun isn’t someone who would fall into a trap!”
In a flash, pandemonium descended into the press conference room, as this scene was being broadcast live.
This mess caused an uproar around the world as people watched the broadcasting accident live.
[Lee Gun’s death caused a fight among his comrades.]
[Did Lee Gun really sacrifice himself for his comrades?]
[Did they exit the tower after abandoning Lee Gun?]
[The opinion of Lee Gun’s best friend lends weight to that idea.]
In the end, Hugo and the other Zodiac Saints got into a big fight in this state of confusion. The power of the Zodiacs transported them to the outskirts of the city, and they started to fight each other.
Kwahng!!!
It was for no other reason.
“Hurry up and unseal the Devil’s Tower! I’m going to find Gun!”
“Have you lost your mind?! Do you realize what the Zodiacs went through to seal that place?”
“Are you saying you don’t care if monsters come out of the tower?”
“Then are you saying that it’s fine to leave behind Gun in the tower?”
“!”
“They don’t have to unseal it. Just open the entrance! I’ll go there by myself!”
“We aren’t crazy enough to—”
As soon as those words were spoken, arrows flew toward the other Zodiac Saints.
Kwahng!!!
This was a fight between Zodiac Saints; the only way they could fight each other on equal grounds was by using their Royal holy items and Royal skills.
The battle destroyed the uninhabited island they were on, and the continent shook. The exchange of terrifying attacks continued for some time.
Kwahng!
The Zodiac Saints shook when they were barely able to dodge Hugo’s attack.
“Have you lost your mind? Do you intend on killing us?!”
“What? Are you afraid that the media will talk about you guys if I went looking for Gun? In fact, I bet you guys weren’t the ones to kill Red Eye, right?!”
All the Zodiac Saints flinched.
Ivan glared at Hugo. “A-Are you really doubting us about that?”
“If I’m being honest, you guys probably conspired to kill him.”
“You have lost your mind!” An angry Ivan charged Hugo with the intent to kill.
Stevens and Heiji didn’t want to fight Hugo, but they had to stop Hugo from entering the tower.
‘It’ll be suicide if he enters that tower.’
Sophie and Yang Wei, the non-fighters, trembled from fear. Ivan, Sergeyevich, and Liv tried to get rid of Hugo.
“Kuh-huhk!!”
After being kicked by Hugo, Ivan and Stevens clutched their broken ribs and coughed up blood.
‘That bastard…!’
Hugo had been Lee Gun’s student, and he was very strong. They hadn’t noticed it because he always acted as Lee Gun’s support.
However, something ground on Hugo’s nerves. Kevin, whom he trusted, said he didn’t remember anything. The others kept saying Lee Gun fell into a trap.
“You guys are traitors! Hurry up and open the door right now!”
Faced with Hugo’s anger, a bloodied Ivan gnashed his teeth.
‘At this rate, we’ll all be defeated by Hugo.’
The Zodiac Saints battered by Hugo were strewn about around Ivan.
Hugo pulled back the head of a bloodied Yang Wei. “Follow me. You were in charge of sealing the tower, right? You open it.”
“Hoo-Hoo-ahhhk! N…No! I…!”
Ivan jumped Hugo when he saw Yang Wei being dragged away. “Why are you pulling this nonsense on us? Why the hell did you go out in the middle of the raid?!”
“…!”
Ivan put a headlock on Hugo from behind.
Hugo let out murderous intent as if he couldn’t believe what he had just heard. “What kind of bullshit—”
“If you were so dissatisfied, you should have stayed behind!”
“What?”
“Lee Gun’s chance of survival rate would have gone up if you hadn’t left.”
“…!”
“While you were sleeping away your exhaustion outside, Lee Gun died. You should have protected your friend.”
Hugo was about to push Ivan aside when he flinched. Of course, he knew those words weren’t worth listening to, yet for a moment, his heart inevitably shook.
When strength started to leave Hugo’s hands, Ivan grinned. In a battle between Zodiac Saints, a 0.1-second opening was enough. Naturally, Ivan wouldn’t let such an opportunity slip by.
Boom!!
“Kuhk!”
Ivan used this opportunity to strike Hugo’s head.
Puhk!
“Kuh-huhk!”
It didn’t end there.
Kwahng!!
Ivan ruthlessly kicked Hugo in the head and sent Hugo and his bow flying in different directions.
“Koo-oohk…!”
When Hugo went to pick up his bow, Giselle wagged her finger. White vines burst out of the ground and encircled Hugo.
Kwah-jeek!
Ivan triumphantly approached Hugo’s bow. It wasn’t just him. Sergeyevich, Liv, and Giselle went there too. They all stood in front of Hugo’s bow with their Royal holy item in hand.
The bloodied Stevens and Kevin glared at them. It was obvious what those four were about to do.
“Hey! Stop!”
“I know what you guys are trying to do!”
Ivan smirked as he looked at Hugo. “Do you understand now? You are just like us. You are responsible for Lee Gun’s death too!”
Then the Zodiac Saints attacked Hugo’s bow. Hugo’s Royal item, the Sun’s Bow, was broken at this moment.
Kwah-jeek!!
Despite being a Divine treasure, it couldn’t win against superior numbers.
Hugo coughed up blood. This Royal holy item was one of the pillars that supported his temple.
If a pillar of a building was destroyed, the building would become unstable.
As the blessing of the Sagittarius temple weakened, Hugo’s power also weakened.
When Hugo fell over, Ivan let out a sigh of relief. It was finally over.
“This should make him behave a bit…!”
However…
“Fuck off!”
“!!”
Ivan felt faint. Hugo was supposed to be powerless. He was supposed to be down on the ground, yet he was charging toward them.
In the end, Ivan lost consciousness.
An enraged Hugo beat up Ivan, Sergeyevich, and Liv. He stood there panting afterward.
Yang Wei shook from fear as he looked at the bloodied Hugo and the fallen Zodiac Saints.
Hugo being able to smash the other Zodiac Saints on his own was scary in itself, but him remaining standing even when his body was in such a mess was the most terrifying part.
Hugo ignored them. He wiped away his blood as he walked toward the tower. “I don’t need any of you. I’ll go rescue Gun on my own.”
Sophie sobbed when she saw this. She grabbed Hugo. “N-No! Hugo! Your injuries…!”
Hugo contemptuously pushed her aside. “You disgust me. Get out of my face.”
“…!”
Sophie froze when she saw his cold eyes. She realized that the relationship between Hugo and the other Zodiac Saints had come to a complete end when they had decided to leave behind Lee Gun.
At that moment, the bloodied and fallen Stevens threw something toward Hugo.
‘!’
It looked to be a key.
“You’ll be able to enter the tower using it. Don’t die there. Come back out alive.”
It was an item of the Leo temple—one of the eleven keys used to seal the tower.
Hugo ground his teeth as he looked between the key, Stevens, and Kevin.
‘What the hell happened in there?’
In the end, Hugo took the key. Gritting his teeth, he headed toward the Devil’s Tower.
However, he had a realization when he entered the Devil’s Tower. He understood why Stevens had sighed as he handed over the key. Stevens wanted Hugo to enter the tower and see it for himself.
‘The interior layout of the tower changed completely.’
The layout seemed to have changed after Lee Gun had fallen into the trap. Hugo had entered the first floor, yet the monsters had become unimaginably stronger. Moreover, the layout was more complicated. It was like a maze.
In the end, Hugo continued to roam around. He was finally able to find Lee Gun’s arm when he was close to death.
Hugo roared in sadness after having experienced it for himself. No one could survive in this place. His friend was already dead.
In reality, Lee Gun hadn’t died. He was madly cutting down monsters in some unknown location within the tower. Naturally, Hugo had no way of knowing this at the time.
In the end, Hugo was about to die in the Devil’s Tower when Hailey rescued him.
During the raid, as she had gone to save Sophie, the only healer of their group, the minions of Time had attacked her. Hailey’s life had been in danger, so she had to leave the tower with her subordinates.
As soon as she regained consciousness, she had re-entered the Devil’s Tower despite not being in great condition.
But she didn’t find Lee Gun. Instead of Lee Gun, she found an unconscious Hugo and rescued him.
Then she realized that the Zodiac Saints were camping outside the tower, waiting for Hugo to come out to get rid of him.
Therefore, she left them behind to bring Hugo to the territory of the Scorpio temple.
* * *
Lee Gun’s state funeral surprised the world. It started in Korea, but the other countries did their own tributes. It continued for a fortnight. The largest crowd had gathered for Lee Gun’s funeral, and that was enough to surprise the media around the world.
Moreover, the media continued to be loud despite the ongoing funeral.
“It’s odd. Why did the twelve of them come out without Lee Gun?”
“Did the twelve Zodiac Saints really kill Red Eye?”
“The dead cannot speak.”
The Zodiac Saints were rewarded for killing Red Eye. They became stars, but they couldn’t escape the suspicion related to Lee Gun.
Lee Gun’s stature among the populace seemed to be larger than anyone had imagined.
* * *
Around a month after the state funeral, in the national cemetery…
“Oh man! That person is here again.”
“What? He came again?”
“Yes. He comes every morning and leaves only at night. Sometimes, he’ll stand in the same place for several days.”
It was a day when rain was pouring down. A woman encountered Hugo, who stood in front of Lee Gun’s grave without an umbrella.
“Excuse me. You shouldn’t be here like this every day.” Chun Jiwoo gave Hugo an umbrella.
Hugo sighed. “Ah… You don’t have to worry about me. This might look idiotic, but I’m scolding myself as I self-reflect.”
“I don’t care about that. I want you to get out of the way.”
“W-What?”
“I want to pay respects too.”
This was how Chun Jiwoo and Hugo met for the first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 477: Book 1, Epilogue 30 - Will you marry me? (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 30 - Will you marry me? (1)
A month had passed since Lee Gun had died.
Hugo spent his time as if his spirit had left his body. It was to be expected since Lee Gun’s death was a huge shock to him.
Lee Gun was his closest friend in the world. They were like close brothers, and Hugo felt closer to Lee Gun than to his real family.
Of course, Lee Jaewon also mourned Lee Gun’s death as if he had lost a family member. Both of them would run to the door in surprise if someone rang the doorbell on rare occasions.
In the end, Hugo became dejected as he visited Lee Gun’s grave every day, where Lee Gun’s arm that he had found was buried.
Everyone around him said, “You are the hero who saved our country. We will give you a reward for saving the world. There are talks that you will be the recipient of Lee Gun’s insurance money. Please come to our country. We’ll give you a massive amount of money to write the life story of Lee Gun” and other similar stuff.
All kinds of attractive offers poured in, but they fell on deaf ears. Hugo didn’t need a reward. He just wanted his friend back.
‘Of course, he was such an elusive person that he always surprised others.’’
Hugo wouldn’t have been surprised if Lee Gun had suddenly shown up and said, “Hey. What the hell is this state funeral? Don’t overdo it, idiots!"
So Hugo went to the bar where he had promised to meet up with Lee Gun. He waited there every day, yet Lee Gun never showed up.
In the end, the reality of his friend’s death slowly penetrated his skin to reach his bones. It was then…
“Excuse me. You shouldn’t be here like this every day.”
“Ah… You don’t have to worry about me. This might look idiotic, but I’m scolding myself as I self-reflect.”
“I don’t care about that. I want you to get out of the way.”
“W-What?”
“I want to pay respects too.”
Surprised, Hugo turned his head and caught sight of a gorgeous woman who was around the same age as him. “Wait. What…”
“Do you own this spot or something?”
Hugo almost shouted in surprise when he heard Chun Jiwoo’s words. But he quickly came to his senses and moved from his spot.
“Ah. I’m sorry!” He finally realized that he was being a nuisance to the other people who had come to pay their respects.
In the end, Hugo felt embarrassed and awkward and lowered his head.
However, as he was about to leave Lee Gun’s grave, Chun Jiwoo placed a box containing a certain food item on top of Lee Gun’s grave.
Hugo reacted in surprise.
‘That’s a box of chicken.’
He wasn’t surprised because she had placed a type of food that didn’t belong at a grave.
‘That’s the brand that Gun likes.’
When Hugo stared at the box, Chun Jiwoo became embarrassed as she paid her respects. She let out a bitter laugh. “Ah! I know it isn’t an item suitable as a tribute. However, I had a feeling that Lee Gun-nim would have liked it more if I brought this.”
“What?”
“If I had brought fruit, I can imagine him being angry. He would say something like, ‘I’m not a rabbit that would graze on greens like this.’”
Well, she was right. His friend’s taste was very much like that of a child, so he would complain if he saw fruits and vegetables. He would pout while eating them.
However, this was something not even the other Zodiac Saints knew about. Moreover, this woman had brought chicken from a brand that Lee Gun liked.
‘It’s something only someone intimately familiar with Gun should know about.’
Hugo couldn’t look away from Chun Jiwoo as he approached her. “Excuse me. Do you perhaps know Gun—”
Puhk!
“Ah!”
“Ahhk!”
As he moved her, Hugo hit the box of chicken by mistake, and the box’s content fell on Chun Jiwoo. The oil from the chicken and the marinade spilled on Chun Jiwoo’s dress.
Hugo screamed. “Ahhk! I’m sorry! I’m sorry! I’m so sorry!!!”
Hugo didn’t know what to do with himself as he took out the napkin from the bag that had contained the chicken. He handed it to her, then picked up the chicken pieces and put them back into the box.
“I’m sorry! I am a bit out of it today…”
“It’s fine…”
Growl!
The smell of the chicken was hard to ignore. An incredibly loud sound came from Hugo’s stomach.
He purposefully coughed and cleared his throat as he put the chicken pieces back into the box. Now that he thought about it, he hadn’t eaten in four days.
After putting the chicken in the box, Hugo was about to wipe Chun Jiwoo’s shoes.
“Ah. Mom! That foreign man stinks! He must not have bathed!”
“O-Oh my! Shhh!!!!!!”
“He smells like trash! Barf!”
“I-I’m very sorry about that!”
Hearing the words of the people around him, Hugo discreetly moved away from Chun Jiwoo.
He realized that it had been over a week since he had taken a bath.
Hugo’s face turned red after he distanced himself from her. “I’m sorry! Let me give you some money for dry cleaning… Damn it. My wallet…”
Hugo massaged his face. After Lee Gun’s death, nothing had been normal for him.
“Please give me your phone number! I’ll give you the dry cleaning fee later…”
When Hugo started searching for his phone, Chun Jiwoo laughed. “It’s fine. I don’t need the dry cleaning fee.”
“What? Ah! Would you like dinner…!”
“I don’t want food….”
Chun Jiwoo stared at Hugo as she laughed. “What about a drink?”
* * *
Clank!
It was five in the afternoon, a bit too early to be drinking.
When a particular customer entered the pub, the owner’s mouth fell open in surprise. “What the hell? He came with someone else today?”
It was as if he had seen a ghost. The ones entering the store were none other than Hugo and Chun Jiwoo.
The personable male owner quickly took the appetizer as he pounded Hugo on the back. “Hey, what’s going on?”
“What?”
“What do you mean, what? You always come here to drink while you look for Gun. You’ll fall asleep, and when I wake you up in the morning, you start drinking again since Gun isn’t back.”
“Damn it! I never did that!”
Hugo gestured for the owner to just take the order, but the owner continued to whisper.
“She’s a very pretty lady. Is she your girlfriend?”
“She’s not!!!”
The owner looked disappointed as he turned around. “Alright. Do you want the chicken leg combo?”
“What? Ah….”
“Why are you suddenly looking at the menu? You’ll do as you always do. ‘Gun~ The food you like is here~ Gun~ If you don’t hurry up and come back, I’m going to eat all the chicken legs~’ You’ll empty your glass and eat from our restaurant’s special menu. You’ll eat the ‘Chicken that Gun Likes,’ right?”
“Damn it! Please stop!!!”
The owner uproariously laughed as he looked at Chun Jiwoo. “Miss, he might look like a beggar right now, but he’s the Zodiac Saint of the Sagittarius temple. Of course, it’s hard to tell when he is in this state…”
Chun Jiwoo laughed. “Ah. I already know that.”
“Oh! You do know. He might look like this, but he’s amazing…”
“Ah. Right. Amazing…”
When Chun Jiwoo let out a bright smile, Hugo was touched. He started drinking his cup of water. Well, it was all thanks to Lee Gun that he could be complimented as being amazing…
“I don’t know if you’re amazing or not, but I do know you were Lee Gun-nim’s sidekick, right?”
“Pffft!!!”
Hugo choked on the water that he had been drinking. He coughed.
The owner was also surprised as he looked at Chun Jiwoo, but she merely smiled.
“You always charged the monsters, yet got beaten up! That’s you, right?”
“Pffft!!!”
In the end, the owner burst out laughing, and Hugo couldn’t raise his head in embarrassment.
“That is…!”
“What?”
“It isn’t like that…!! I did get beaten up by monsters, but that happened a long time ago…!”
Chun Jiwoo also looked embarrassed as she laughed. “Ah! I’m sorry! If I’m being honest, I’m not interested in the other apostles aside from Lee Gun-nim…. You are Hurie Orison-nim, right?”
“Cough!!”
Hugo once again coughed up blood. He finally realized how she was perceiving him.
‘Well, Gun was extremely popular.’
Lee Gun had been as famous as Stevens, Hailey, and Kevin—the three most popular Zodiac Saints.
‘In certain scenarios, he was the most popular.’
Because of his character and careless personality, he had a lot of enemies. However, most knew Lee Gun was a hero working for humanity.
When everyone had given up, Lee Gun had been the hero who had snatched victory from the jaws of defeat. He had become a paragon for the world.
It was why so many people had gathered at his funeral.
In the end, Hugo kept drinking his beer as he looked at Chun Jiwoo. “Ah! Didn’t you say you have something you want to give me…”
“Ah.”
As if she had remembered something, Chun Jiwoo opened her bag. In truth, a certain item was the reason Chun Jiwoo had asked for a drink with Hugo.
“I have an item that belongs to Lee Gun-nim, and I couldn’t think of anyone else to give it to.”
Hugo was surprised. “Gun’s item? How do you know Gun…!”
Chun Jiwoo laughed as she held a small box. “In truth, Lee Gun-nim is our family’s benefactor.”
“What?”
“Do you perhaps remember the incident at the Yanghwa bridge?”
“Ah… Yes! A monster appeared there and destroyed the bridge…”
“My father and I were there. I was kidnapped by the monster, and I was almost eaten by it, but Lee Gun-nim had saved me at that moment.”
“Ah…!”
Hugo remembered it. He had called Lee Gun to find out where Lee Gun had gone. Lee Gun had been injured at the time and told Hugo that he was exercising after a meal.
As if slicing up the monster wasn’t enough, Lee Gun had salted the monster before eating it on-air, something that couldn’t be aired!
Hugo suddenly felt nauseous. He put a hand over his mouth.
On the other hand, Chun Jiwoo was pleased as she recalled the memory. She touched the box. “At the time, my father bought Lee Gun-nim a meal… Lee Gun-nim put me in charge of keeping this item. He said he’ll come back for it after returning from the Devil’s Tower… In the end, he wasn’t able to take it back…”
“Ah….” Hugo couldn’t say anything.
It seemed the item in her possession was why Chun Jiwoo had come to pay her respects to Lee Gun.
“I’ll be leaving Korea soon, and I didn’t have a good place to store it. This was why I was looking for someone to hand it over to. Thankfully, I met the owner of this item.”
Seeing Chun Jiwoo’s smile, Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement. “Owner?”
“Yes. The item that Lee Gun left in my possession… It wasn’t for himself. He said it was an item that he would give to his precious partner.”
Hugo was surprised when he opened the box. The box contained a watch. Moreover, it was a very familiar watch.
A couple of years ago…
- Do as you wish. But I’m not going to teach you anything.
- Thank you!!!
- I really won’t teach you anything, but you have to keep feeding me. I want enough to feed fifty people. After two hours, I want a snack…. Ah. My watch is broken.
- Please use mine! My grandfather gave it to me when I was in high school. It’s a bit old, but it’ll do the job for you!
It was the watch that Hugo had given to Lee Gun in the past. However, Lee Gun had said he couldn’t use it because it smelled like a young master from a wealthy family. He had said he sold it because he had been running low on money.
- What? You said you had a lot of watches similar to that one. I sold it because it was broken. What about it?
- Hey!! I had only that one left…!
- Ah. Whatever. I used the funds to buy food.
Chun Jiwoo explained, “My father runs a watch repair shop. This was why Lee Gun-nim left it with us. He wanted us to swap out the watch strap for something special.”
Hugo closely looked at the watch strap. It was glossy as if it was new, and Hugo realized that it wasn’t a normal watch strap.
‘It is a talisman-type holy item.’
He became sure of it when he saw the letters engraved on the inward side of the watch strap. Lee Gun had upgraded the watch for him using a talisman-type holy item.
- You always complained that you want to be able to solo fights. I made this bow with that in mind. You’ll be able to become a solo player.
Lee Gun had already made him a bow that would allow him to solo fights. It seemed Lee Gun wanted to make sure that Hugo would be protected after he had retired, so he had made this item.
When Chun Jiwoo saw the expression on Hugo’s face, she grabbed his arm. “I don’t know much, but I do know Lee Gun-nim wanted his partner to be safe even if he wasn’t present. That was what he said.”
Hugo shed tears as he looked at the watch. He was crying in front of others as a grown man. He didn’t care if they made fun of him.
“Idiot. You did something that is like you.” He laughed as he wiped away his tears.
In the future, this watch would become the badge of the Sagittarius temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 478: Book 1, Epilogue 31 - Will you marry me? (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 31 - Will you marry me? (2)
As time passed, Chun Jiwoo and Hugo became closer and closer. In the beginning, they merely texted each other questions like, “Did you eat?”
However, Chun Jiwoo’s texts asking how he was came daily. If he hadn’t eaten, she would ask him to buy her a meal. It was enough to cover the dry cleaning fee.
Chun Jiwoo had probably done it on purpose since Hugo had started to ignore his meals after Lee Gun’s death.
Even if people around him prepared food for him, he would rather drink alcohol than eat food to fill his stomach.
However, Chun Jiwoo was aware of something. Whenever Hugo ordered food meant for two servings, he inevitably had to have a drink.
But she also knew that his personality wouldn’t allow a woman to eat by herself. Hugo found it too awkward, and Chun Jiwoo’s assumptions were correct.
“Uh… Miss Jiwoo. You’re having the Hangover Soup set again?”
“Yes. Why?”
“You had the Hangover Soup yesterday too. Order something more expensive. I’m buying. You can order some meat or pasta…”
“Oh my! What’s wrong with this?”
“Miss Jiwoo.”
“Yes?”
“Do you perhaps drink daily?”
Of course, the problem was that Hugo said unnecessary things. Still, the Hangover soup was good for Hugo, who had become an alcoholic.
Chun Jiwoo also dragged him outside and stopped him from drinking.
Hugo slowly distanced himself from the life of someone dejected. In fact, he was disgusted as he looked in the mirror. He looked at his own body.
“Wow! This is crazy! I have a gut now.”
It was the result of his being overconfident that an awakened being’s body was sturdier than a normal person’s body.
When he had lived the life of a hikikomori, he had been unaware of it. However, his body was in worse shape than he had thought.
His body, which used to be muscular, was now the body of a prototypical drunkard with a potbelly. His hair and beard were bushy. His skin and eyes looked sunken as if he were on drugs.
However, Hugo was able to work himself out of his alcoholism thanks to Chun Jiwoo. He worked out to regain his former figure and cleaned up his hair and face.
Hugo was able to return to living his normal life, and over time, he and Chun Jiwoo became quite close.
“Oh my! It’s the Hero’s Museum. I never knew they built something so amazing!”
“Hmmph. Yang Wei is amazing at sniffing out opportunities to make money. I never expected him to really make this place…”
Hugo was embarrassed by the museums of the twelve Zodiac Saints, which had been built in various locations around the world.
Each of the twelve Zodiac Saints was called a hero and was given a special exhibition room. Despite liking it, Hugo couldn’t raise his head. Still, he wanted to look good in front of Chun Jiwoo.
“Um… Miss Jiwoo! Let’s go over there! There is something cool about me over there…!!!”
However, Hugo thought twice about this as he changed direction. “No! Instead of mine, we should go to the one that has a cool special exhibition room of Gun!! Miss Jiwoo likes Gun, right?!”
Chun Jiwoo burst out laughing when she saw Hugo, who didn’t know what to do with himself. Hugo seemed very conscious of the words she had spoken before.
She had said, “I’m not interested in anyone other than Lee Gun-nim.”
It was the same when they were buying some goods at the museum.
“What are you buying, Miss Jiwoo?”
“Kyaa. W-What?! Ah! It’s a random figurine. The quality was great, so I…!”
Chun Jiwoo, who had been inside the store, became flustered when Hugo approached her.
Hugo started to sweat when he saw the display listing what Chun Jiwoo had bought.
- Lee Gun Random Figurine x 1,000
- Hugo Figurine x 1
“Ah. As expected, you were buying Gun’s figurine. T…Thousand...”
“What? Ah. Yes…!”
Hugo felt a bit disappointed since Jiwoo had bought only one of his figurines, but he didn’t outwardly show his disappointment.
However, something happened when Hugo approached to buy the Lee Gun figurines too.
“Customer Chun Jiwoo! I’m sorry for making you wait for so long. It’s because not many people look for this item!”
“Ah! No!”
“Here is Hugo-nim’s Special Custom-built Premium Figurine!”
“Kuhk…!!”
Hugo was shocked by the incredibly high-quality figure of himself, and Chun Jiwoo’s face turned red.
The surprised Hugo asked, “W…Why would you get a custom figurine… Isn’t this really expensive?!”
“That is… I thought this version of Mr. Hugo’s figurine was too cute……”
Hugo’s face turned beet red.
Chun Jiwoo didn’t know what to do with herself when she saw his reaction. “T-This is an investment! Investment! Mr. Hugo, you refused all insurance money related to Lee Gun-nim. I’m just looking out for you…!”
“Uh… My figurines don’t resell for a premium. Unless it’s Lee Gun or the top three members of the Zodiac Saints… At most, it sells for only a hundred…”
“Kyaa! Younger brother!! It’s for my brother! I’m giving it to him as a present because he likes you!”
“I’m pretty sure your younger brother likes Stevens...”
“Kyaa! Father! It’s for my father!!”
“Pfft!”
Hugo laughed. After losing Lee Gun, this was the first time he had laughed.
* * *
Of course, it didn’t mean only happy moments transpired. In reality, the world became noisy once more after Lee Gun’s death.
- Ivan-nim! Stevens-nim! You guys suffered a complete loss! You failed in the raid once again! Please give us a statement!
- Isn’t it true that you are missing the loss of Lee Gun?!
- Are you sure you killed Red Eye?!
The world was unsettled that the Zodiac Saints continued to fail in their raids. The Zodiac Saints were becoming a laughingstock.
“Wow! How are they unable to recover any land after Lee Gun’s death??”
“That’s what I’m saying. Lee Gun recovered countless lands.”
The Zodiac Saints were starting to feel their limitation as well.
‘Damn it! We can’t kill the monsters without Lee Gun.’
‘I thought we would be able to take care of them on our own, but…!’
They realized that Lee Gun’s absence had created too large of a hole. It made them grind their teeth.
They almost admitted that leaving Lee Gun behind in the tower was a mistake.
It was around that time that Chun Jiwoo started having trouble.
“Uh, Miss Jiwoo. You seem to have a delivery? What is it?”
“Ah! It was delivered to the wrong place.”
Chun Jiwoo laughed as she threw away the parcel addressed to her.
A while ago, some nameless blackmailer had started sending her a variety of items, including a bloodied toy, a knife, tacks, and a vermin-shaped doll.
At the end of the day, it was like a child’s prank, so she had been ignoring it. She didn’t know the purpose of her actions, but she knew who the culprit was.
- Hurry up and break up with Hugo.
That message narrowed down the list of culprits, and Chun Jiwoo didn’t even think responding to such a person was worth it.
‘She tried to put on a kidnapping just for show to scare me. It seems she doesn’t get tired of sending these. This is a waste of boxes.’
In truth, Chun Jiwoo had almost been kidnapped by a suspicious person. Of course, it was all for show and Hugo was able to save her immediately.
So it was considered an attempted kidnapping.
Despite having such things happen to her, Chun Jiwoo continued to ignore it all. However, in the end, the one behind the threatening letter appeared in front of Chun Jiwoo.
“Look here. Did you not receive my letters?”
The blackmailer was none other than Sophie. After she had gotten on Hugo’s bad side, Hugo cut all contact with her.
Sophie glared at Chun Jiwoo.
When she had heard that there was a woman in Hugo’s life, she was shocked. She tried to separate Chun Jiwoo from Hugo’s side.
Sophie glared at Chun Jiwoo. “Have you been ignoring my warnings?”
“Yes. I have.”
“?!!”
They were in a cafe, sitting opposite each other. Sophie looked at Chun Jiwoo with shock. Her expression said that she thought Chun Jiwoo had lost her mind.
However, it didn’t take long for Sophie to throw liquid medicine and an envelope full of money toward Chun Jiwoo. “I heard your family is in a tough financial spot, and your father’s leg isn’t doing well.”
“…!”
“Break up with Hugo. You’re the one who is getting in the way. You’re stopping him from meeting with us, right?”
Sophie furrowed her brows. Since the Zodiac Saints had lost consecutive raids, they had been looking for Hugo.
As Lee Gun was gone, they decided Hugo had to join them if they wanted to conduct a successful raid.
They had thrown all kinds of bait toward Hugo to meet him, yet he continued to either ignore or hide from them.
Of course, Sophie had an additional motive fueling her: jealousy. It was why she had come to meet Chun Jiwoo.
“How dare a civilian try to seduce a Zodiac Saint?”
Chun Jiwoo looked at Sophie with contempt. “Ah. You really are an ugly and uncivilized bitch.”
Sophie’s eyes turned round like those of a surprised rabbit. “…what?? W…What did you just say?”
Chun Jiwoo let out a chuckle as if she had made a mistake by letting those words slip out. “Oh my! I’m sorry about that. I meant to say I understand why Mr. Hugo hates the Zodiac Saints.”
“W-What did you just say?!”
“Anyway, thank you for the letters and items. I’ll also take the money and medicine with thanks.”
Sophie laughed as if this was how it should be. “Finally, you get my drift. You’re going to keep yourself away from Hugo from now on, right?”
“What? Why would I do that?”
“W-Why else? You took my money and medicine! So why?!”
“What does breaking up with Mr. Hugo have anything to do with me taking these items?”
“W-What the hell did you just say?!”
“Why should I follow your instructions? I just have to dine and dash.”
“W-What?! Look here…!”
“I’m joking.” Chun Jiwoo tossed several photos on the desk. The pictures contained the threatening letters Sophie had sent her. It also had pictures that she had taken when she had been kidnapped for show.
“Just think of it as you paying me for damages.”
“W-What?”
“If not, you can call it a fee for making me keep my mouth shut. How’s that?”
Sophie shook from fear when she saw Chun Jiwoo’s angry eyes. It was a threat.
Chun Jiwoo had flipped the table, and she was threatening Sophie! With an elegant smile, Chun Jiwoo took up the glass cup in front of her.
The water inside the cup was mixed with a tasteless and odorless drug that Sophie had put in there beforehand. Chun Jiwoo seemed to be aware of this. That was why she had purposefully avoided drinking from the cut.
Chun Jiwoo smiled as she finally stood in front of Sophie. “Listen to me well, Saintess.”
“What are you—”
Sophie screamed.
Chun Jiwoo held the cup of water and poured it on top of Sophie’s head.
“Kyaaa!”
Sophie froze. She looked like a mouse that had fallen into the water.
Chun Jiwoo didn’t care as she coldly looked at Sophie. “I don’t care what nonsense you pull on me. However, I’ll really kill you if you make Mr. Hugo shed blood, sweat, and tears.”
As she spoke those words, she broke the glass cup.
Sophie shook when she met eyes with Chun Jiwoo. Her opponent was a civilian, yet possessed a tremendous spirit.
It flustered Sophie. However, that wasn’t important right now.
“Kyaaa! I put a laxative in the water! It got in my mouth! Ptooey! Ptooey!!”
Sophie cried as she looked for a towel.
Chun Jiwoo’s eyes turned round as she turned around. It was as if she found it unexpected.
‘What the hell? I thought she put poison in the cup. It was only a laxative?’
However, that didn’t matter to Chun Jiwoo, so she left the cafe.
Hugo had been waiting for her outside. He quickly approached her. “Are you ok? Did she try to bully you?”
“It’s fine. I’m fine.”
“I should have gone in. I would’ve taken care of it. Why did you stop me from going in…!”
“If you went in, Mr. Hugo, you would have 100% fallen for what they were offering.”
“?!”
The Zodiac Saints were chomping at the bits to add Hugo back in as an ally. They were already missing Lee Gun, and they had a falling out with Hugo. It had put them in a precarious situation.
If Chun Jiwoo had let Hugo meet them in person, they probably would have used the opportunity to kidnap her and made Hugo join them by force.
Since Hugo had a soft heart, he would have folded. This was why Chun Jiwoo had told him not to make direct contact with them. She asked him to stay outside and just be ready.
“Did the Aquarius Saint say something foul to you?”
“She didn’t say much.”
Hugo let out a huge sigh of relief. “I’m sorry! Just because you got involved with me…”
“I don’t care. You already used the blessing of your Zodiac on me, and you’ve done a good job protecting me.”
“But…!”
Instead of saying anything, Chun Jiwoo grabbed Hugo’s face and shyly kissed him, leaving Hugo flustered.
Blushing, Chun Jiwoo said, “I can choose to be safe without you, Mr. Hugo, but I would much prefer to be with you and be in danger.”
Hugo didn’t know if he should laugh or cry. Thanks to her, he was finally able to laugh again. Chun Jiwoo was an existence too precious in his eyes.
No. Maybe, they might have fallen for each other. They had fallen so hard that they wanted to spend the rest of their lives together.
On that day, the two of them drank some alcohol and became honest with each other.
Then they might have gone home and made passionate love to each other that night.
* * *
“What? You decided to date her?” Lee Jaewon’s eyes turned round at the unexpected confession. “I thought you were so intimidated by her that you were unable to confess to her?”
“No! I confessed and succeeded!”
Lee Jaewon smiled. If the two of them were happy, it was all that mattered to him.
Not too long after that meeting, Lee Jaewon witnessed something shocking.
“Ah. Miss Jiwoo. Over here! This guy is Jaewon. He’s the one I told you about. He’s taking his college entrance exam, so I couldn’t introduce you to him.”
After gathering at the chicken house, they exchanged greetings.
“It’s nice to meet you for the first time. So when will you two be marrying?” Lee Jaewon asked.
Both Hugo and Chun Jiwoo were embarrassed by the question, yet they let out bright smiles.
“What are you talking about? We are still in our mid-twenties. Jiwoo and I laughed about it when we had that conversation. We decided that we’ll wait until our thirties.”
“That’s right.”
For some reason, Lee Jaewon kept tilting his head as he looked at Chun Jiwoo. “You should probably marry real soon.”
“What? What do you mean?”
“What else could it be?” Instead of answering, Lee Jaewon looked toward Chun Jiwoo.
“…oohp!”
“?!”
Hugo and Chun Jiwoo became surprised when Jiwoo had a bout of morning sickness.
Whether it was in the future or the past didn’t matter. Lee Jaewon was able to sense the presence of a fetus. He laughed.
After realizing that the two of them had made an accident, Hugo and Chun Jiwoo immediately got married. And the child they had was named Chun Yooha.

chapters.title: Chapter 479: Book 1, Epilogue 32 - Making a Fanatic (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 32 - Making a Fanatic (1)
Hugo and Chun Jiwoo’s marriage happened under a great deal of secrecy. Hugo didn’t want information about Chun Jiwoo to be spread through the media. However, despite no information about the bride having gotten out, rumors about his marriage slowly spread.
The world was undoubtedly surprised.
- Kuhk. I thought the Archer Saint became dejected after Lee Gun died? I thought he became an alcoholic pig.
-ㄴㄴㄴHe returned to his normal selfㅠㅠㅠㅠ If he overcame it by meeting his spouse, it’s a relief
-There is a rumor that he married the daughter of a wealthy supporter
-No ㅠㅠㅠㅠ Not our oppa
- Aren’t they breaking the speed limit?ㅋㅋㅋ
-ㅋㅋㅋThat is an awkward position to be in if he did marry someone like that. Still, I’m looking forward to their kids.
- No one knows who the mother is. There is no way she is pretty.
- If an awakened being has a child, would the kid be an awakened being?
- Are we sure the marriage is legitimate?
The media was also in disarray. If anyone tried to look into Hugo’s personal life or marital status, Hugo acted like a ghost as he stole away his wife and disappeared.
Only one group of people was sure that Hugo had gone through with his marriage.
“Hoo-uhhhhhhng. Hugoooo. Hugooooooo….!!!”
The Cathedral Notre Dame.
Sophie was crying ever since she had heard the news about Hugo. “I kept telling her that I wouldn’t let her do it! I told her to get away from him! Wehhhh!”
The rest of the Zodiac Saints didn’t need to hear or read the news. They were sure of it when they saw Sophie sobbing.
‘That bastard did marry.’
‘He did it.’
‘He’s married.’
Otherwise, there was no way Sophie would cry until her eyes were puffy. She wouldn’t be lamenting at the top of her voice.
Moreover, him deciding to marry when there were uncertainties with the monsters meant...
‘That bastard made an accident.’
‘He had it.’
‘He had an accident.’
It was unclear if Sophie knew this or not, but she couldn’t stop crying. She had Hugo stolen(?) from her.
“Hoo-uhng! Men are all the same! He pretended to be uninterested in women! Yet he fell head over heels for a pretty face! Hugo is a stupid idiot!! Ooh-uhhhhng!”
When Sophie was about to convert all the water in her body into tears, Stevens and Ivan became angry.
“Shut up, bedwetter! Hurry up and give me the liquid medicine I ordered! We didn’t come here to hear your story about being dumped.”
“If you were going to cry so much about it, you should’ve just killed that woman! How the hell did a Zodiac Saint lose to a civilian? Aren’t you embarrassed?!”
When the other Zodiac Saints gave her similar looks, Sophie felt more aggrieved. She cried harder.
“But that woman was too scary!! She had such a delicate face, yet harsh words kept pouring out of her! Also, what kind of person pours water over someone’s head?! Her eyes were so fierce that she looked like a predator! Ooh-uhhhng! Our innocent Hugo will be eaten by her! I’m sure of it!”
In the end, the Zodiac Saints sighed as they covered their ears to block out Sophie’s wailing. However, they were surprised.
‘Despite how she’s acting right now, Sophie is the Zodiac Saint of the Aquarius temple.’
Of course, Yang Wei and Sophie were the two weakest and the most cowardly Zodiac Saints. Still, she was a representative of her god. Someone like that felt pressured by a regular person?
‘It makes no sense.’
If one had to make a comparison, a Zodiac Saint was a tiger, and a civilian was a rabbit. Even if the tiger was cowardly, it was a tiger. A single roar from it should make a rabbit shake in fear.
In truth, Sophie was also surprised that she felt pressured by the other woman.
“Something is different about that woman. It felt as if I would die by her hands if I slipped up! It felt as if she was going to erase my existence!”
Chun Jiwoo’s spirit had a connection to the power of the Secretaries. However, the other Zodiac Saints merely snorted at Sophie’s claims.
“Hmmph. That is why she is called ‘bedwetter.’ She gets scared at the sight of monsters.”
“You’re being rude! I didn’t wet myself! How long will you believe Lee Gun’s lie…!”
“So? Is she really pretty? I bet she looks plain compared to Hailey and Heiji, right?”
Sergeyevich’s words made Sophie grumble. She called him a hedonist.
“She wasn’t that pretty. Also, even I’m on the plain side when compared to the Scorpio Saint and the Gemini Saint!”
“Hmmph. It seemed she was pretty enough to make him give in.”
Sophie shook her head from side to side when he dared make such a comparison. She also became angry at the reactions of the other Zodiac Saints.
Their interest always seemed to linger on either Hailey or Heiji. While she was always interested in it, their presence made her become more interested in her appearance. At the end of the day, it didn’t matter.
The Zodiac Saints ground their teeth when they heard the news about Hugo.
‘That damn Hugo dared end his relationship with us, yet he’s going out on dates as if nothing is wrong.’
The situation was already at a point where the world was looking at them with extra scrutiny. Were they really the ones who had killed Red Eye? Would they be able to recover the land of humanity?
These were the current topics of discussion.
‘Damn it! Lee Gun is being raised higher and higher…!’
‘Isn’t it a bit too much to prefer a dead man to us?’
The Zodiac Saints had once come across Hugo by coincidence when they visited a government facility. They were barely able to keep him in place long enough to ask for help. However, his response wasn’t what they wanted.
- Really? I thought you guys killed Red Eye. Why would you look for someone who exited the tower? Why don’t you guys do it yourself since you guys killed Red Eye?
In truth, they were shocked since they hadn’t expected Hugo to come at them in a cockeyed manner.
‘That damn Hugo. He has a grudge against us because we left Lee Gun behind.’
Anyway, Hugo ignored their request for help and got rid of the monsters by himself, which increased Hugo’s esteem in the world.
“At this rate, we’ll be crushed under Lee Gun’s shadow!”
Those words made someone laugh.
“Then we’ll have to erase Lee Gun’s existence, right?”
“!”
The one to speak was none other than Giselle.
Surprised, the Zodiac Saints looked at her. Giselle let out a chuckle as she approached Sophie.
‘It won’t be easy to erase the mighty Lee Gun.’
He was that big of a deal, and bringing Oblivion was too risky right now. Moreover, brute-forcing it and erasing his presence right now would be useless.
Why?
‘The Zodiac Saints are too weak.’
They were too lacking to become the stars of humanity. Of course, the Zodiac Saints weren’t weak even from Negligence’s point of view as a monarch. The only problem was that Lee Gun had been way too strong.
‘Then there’s the plan enacted by the monarchs.’
Half of the reason the Zodiac Saints were having a hard time against the monsters after Lee Gun’s death was that the monarchs had stolen the Data of the Zodiacs.
‘There are the ones that I stole, and Time also stole a lot of it.’
She had no idea how Time was able to gather so much data belonging to the twelve Zodiacs, but she assumed it was related to his ability.
Anyway, the data was used in a way where the attacks of the Zodiacs didn’t work well against the monsters. As the Zodiac Saints received more power from the Zodiacs, this put them at a disadvantage.
In other words, it was as if the Zodiac Saints were fighting a bugged mob.
‘Even if one takes that into consideration, Lee Gun was too dominant.’
Lee Gun was gifted with natural senses, mental strength, and guts. He was a crazy person who could roll through a steel wall created using a bugged mob. Of course, it didn’t matter in the end.
In fact, Lee Gun’s presence had been a blessing for her.
‘With his DNA, I might be able to make living weapons greater than him.’
Sophie was crying as he took out the liquid medicine.
Giselle took this opportunity to sit behind Sophie. “Sophie. You have Lee Gun’s biodata, right?”
“Kyaaaaa!!”
Sophie shook in fear when she heard Giselle’s whisper.
When she turned her head, she saw Giselle smirk and look like a goody two shoes.
“Hand it over. Lee Gun’s data…”
“I won’t!!!”
“!”
When Sophie started looking at her surroundings, Giselle continued to whisper to her.
“I-I’m already hated by Hugo because of you guys. What more do you want from me?!”
“Don’t you feel resentment toward him? He ignored your feelings and married someone else.”
“No…!”
“Did you already forget what you did at the tower?”
“…!!!”
Sophie froze.
“I heard the liquid medicine you gave Lee Gun had poison in it.”
“T…That’s…!”
“You’re no different from us. You threatened a regular person because you fell for a man.” Giselle snickered as she touched the hiccuping Sophie. “If you don’t want me to reveal everything, you should hand over Lee Gun’s DNA.”
In the future, this DNA would become the key ingredient used in making Carly.
* * *
“What? You want me to teach you how to fight?!” Hugo was surprised by Lee Jaewon’s words.
At the time, Chun Jiwoo was five months pregnant.
Hugo had been busy buying food that she wanted to eat. He looked at Lee Jaewon in surprise. “Are you being serious?”
“Yes. I want to be a fighter like Lee Gun-nim and Hugo-nim.”
After entering college, Lee Jaewon suddenly wanted to become an awakened being. Hugo was taken aback. In his view, it was something that had no precedent.
At that time, there had been no awakened beings aside from the thirteen. No one even thought such a thing was possible. However, Lee Jaewon was serious.
“Hugo-nim, many countries are calling you for mercenary work, but you have to protect your wife and the child. I’ll go on the raids instead of you.”
“But…!”
Of course, it wasn’t as if Lee Jaewon was unqualified. He had traveled with them and studied the tendencies of the monsters. Above all else…
‘It’s faint, but Jaewon does have the power of an awakened being.’
Hugo didn’t know if it was caused by Cancer, but while Lee Jaewon had been running away from the battlefield when he was young, the power of the Zodiac had brushed up against him. Unlike normal people, he possessed other forms of power.
While his body was akin to that of a normal human being, he could read the presence of other beings. He could also hide his presence. It wasn’t a coincidence that he possessed this power.
Lee Jaewon said, “Back then, a different Zodiac’s power brushed up against me for a moment. What if I receive a good amount of Sagittarius’s power? Wouldn’t I be able to develop new powers?”
“No! You will regret it. You might become crippled or die…”
“It doesn't matter! When Lee Gun-nim passed away, I was filled with regret for not being able to help you guys!!”
“…!”
One could tell by looking into Lee Jaewon’s eyes that he was being sincere. If he could fight like an awakened being, Lee Gun wouldn’t have left him behind.
It didn’t matter if Hugo had left the tower or the other Zodiac Saints had abandoned Lee Gun. Lee Jaewon wondered if he could have saved Lee Gun if he was there.
Hugo raised his hands in surrender when he saw the look in Lee Jaewon’s eyes. “Just don’t die.”
Then he let his Zodiac’s power descend into Lee Jaewon.
Flash!
Until this moment, the Zodiacs hadn’t known how to increase the number of their disciples. It was why Jean-Louis had taken an interest in a young Lee Jaewon when the latter had developed his odd ability.
Of course, Sagittarius did warn them that this would be dangerous.
“Ahhhk!!”
But Hugo believed in Lee Jaewon. He imbued Lee Jaewon with the power of his Zodiac.
Instead of pouring the power directly into Lee Jaewon, Hugo channeled the power through his body, as that would be a bit safer.
“Just endure it a little longer, Jaewon!”
Lee Jaewon was in excruciating pain, but the attempt seemed to be well worth it.
[M-My god…!]
The Constructs were surprised. It truly was a historical moment that shook the fabric of human society.
[A-Aside from the apostles, a new follower of the god has been born!]
“…!!”
This was how Lee Jaewon became humanity’s first awakened being. He was also the first human disciple, and he became the first general of a temple.
Soon, another notable thing happened.
“Weh! Weh!”
After a couple of months, a daughter was born between Hugo and Chun Jiwoo. It was a beautiful daughter that looked like her mom.
Having become a father, Hugo was moved as he looked at the child. He shouted, “Alright. Your name is Gun from now on!”
Shocked, Lee Jaewon tore into Hugo to stop him. “Zodiac Saint-nim! What kind of name is Gun for a girl?”
“What? I like it!”
“You cannot do that!!”
“W-What about Gunsoon! Your name is Gunsoon— Kuh-huhk!!”
Bbah-gahk!!
“Gunja— Kuh-huhk!!”
Bbah-gahk!!
“How about Gunsook— Ehhk!!”
“Please!! That’s enough!!”
Lee Jaewon beat Hugo down to the ground.
After a hard and desperate affair, in the end, the name “Yooha” was chosen and defended.

chapters.title: Chapter 480: Book 1, Epilogue 33 - Making a Fanatic (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 33 - Making a Fanatic (2)
In the end, Lee Jaewon’s desperate effort changed the name “Gunsook” into Yooha.
“Uh? Chun Yooha? She will not take on your last name?” Lee Jaewon looked at Hugo in surprise.
Hugo was running around in joy. His daughter had a social security number now, and she had been put into the family register. “Yes. Her name is Chun Yooha. It’s pretty, right? Right?”
“Yes. It’s tens of thousands of times better than Gunsook, Gunja, Gunji, Gunmi, or Gunok. However, I thought she would take on your last name, Hugo-nim. That is why I’m surprised.”
“She’ll be living in this country. There is no need for her to take on the father’s last name. It’ll also unnecessarily complicate things.”
Hugo had a point. After marrying Chun Jiwoo, he was thinking about becoming naturalized as a Korean citizen. He would confer citizenship from Australia to the country of his wife and Gun.
Of course, that wasn’t the biggest reason the couple had given the mother’s last name to their daughter.
“It’s better for my children. It has to look like they have zero ties to me. I have no idea what might happen to them.”
“Zodiac Saint-nim….”
Hugo was well aware of it. He knew it was tiring and dangerous to be the offspring of a famous person. Moreover, he had a falling out with the other Zodiac Saints. He didn’t think they would do anything, but it would be best if his family stayed out of the spotlight.
“Also….”
“Also?”
“Her mom’s last name is a billion times prettier than mine!!”
“…?!!”
Hugo’s seriousness was gone as pink hearts seemed to float above him while he watched his newborn daughter. This might be the true reason behind his decision.
Hugo was overflowing with love for his daughter. He sounded like a parent who loved his kid to death.
“My name was changed into Oh-Taeksoo instead of Otis! If I give her my last name, it’ll sound like Yooha Oh-Taeksoo!!!”
“…?!”
“That can’t happen. No way.”
“Then why don’t you change your last name to Oh?”
“I don’t like Oh Yooha!!!”
“….”
‘But he liked Gunsook, Gunja, Gunji, Gunmi, and Gunok?’
“This is fine!!!” Lee Jaewon decided to drop the subject.
* * *
[T…This is amazing! Another apostle seems to have shown up!]
[I…Is he perhaps a mutant like Lee Gun-nim?]
[No, I do not think so! He’s using the power of Sagittarius! In other words, he’s an awakened being belonging to the Sagittarius temple!]
[What?!]
[However, he’s different from an apostle! It’s as if he’s a guard that protects the apostle…!]
The world was shocked by Lee Jaewon’s appearance for an entirely different reason. It was to be expected since Lee Jaewon was humanity’s first “disciple.”
The world became excited at the prospect that awakened beings could be born through the power of the Zodiac Saints.
[Won’t we be able to fight against the monsters if we can increase the number of fighters like this?]
The ones who were shocked the most, however, were none other than the Zodiac Saints.
‘This is crazy! Can we create more awakened beings?’
‘Hugo. That bastard…!’
Ivan and Sergeyevich suddenly became afraid. What if their worth decreased if the number of awakened beings increased? What if someone like Lee Gun appeared among them? However, they soon shook their heads.
‘No. This is an opportunity to increase our fighting power.’
The Zodiac Saints knew they couldn’t get rid of the monsters alone. At the same time, they had a realization. As the number of disciples grew, the burden on them would get reduced, and their Zodiacs could grow much stronger.
Of course, the Zodiac Saints of the magic-type temples already seemed to have known about this possibility.
Liv said, “We haven’t tested it out on humans yet, but we did experiment on animals.”
“What?”
“We were close to trying it on a human. That bastard…. Hugo dared to steal the title of the first disciple from us?”
Had Pisces been trying to take the reward for achieving that first title?
Liv ground her teeth. It doesn’t matter what one achieved. The first title in anything was recorded in the Bible. It had a substantial reward.
The reason the Sagittarius temple later became so powerful with a small elite group of disciples was this reward for creating the first disciple.
In the end, this was how “Awakened Beings” and “Temples” were born.
Disciples received the power of the Zodiacs through the Zodiac Saints, so their abilities were inferior to the Zodiac Saints, the direct contractors. However, even that was enough.
- Come join the Leo temple!! You can become a beast and run across the battlefield! ※Diet Guaranteed
- Let us all join hands in the magic-type temples! Everything you dream of is at your fingertips! ※Fix Hair Loss
- The only thing that protects families and the world is the power of healing! ※Aphrodisiac of Love sold separately
The world now operated under the “Faith” and “Reward” system. It brought in a new era.
* * *
Four years had passed since Lee Gun had died.
The “Apostles” had become “Zodiac Saints” in name, and they were busy expanding their power. It was their sole focus.
Holy grounds had been declared, and as countries were added to the territory of the Zodiacs, they started fighting for territories.
This was how the temples grew in terms of countries they controlled, and most expected Stevens’s or Ivan’s temples to become the number one temple.
In terms of financial backing, they were the strongest, and they were rivals on the battlefield. They fought for the spot of the top fighter.
“Oh my! Why aren’t you attacking? Are you unable to attack me?”
‘T…This is nuts…!’
However, the situation changed completely when Giselle joined the fray.
“Do you now know who is on top?”
At a martial arts hall, Stevens and Ivan were shocked since Giselle had beaten them to a bloody pulp.
Up until this point, Giselle had remained in the backline as support. She acted as an alchemist. Supposed to have zero martial prowess, she was a nerd who supplied them with supplies.
‘What is this overwhelmingly large power difference?!’
As if she was mocking their assumptions, Giselle cut off her long hair and threw away her image of being a goody two shoes.
“This makes me number one now.”
“…koo-oohk!!”
“Do you understand me now? It’s time for you to use your simple minds. Who is the king? Whom do you have to kneel to?”
They shook from the humiliation.
Giselle let out an angry laugh as she stroked the chin of the two men. “Don’t drag this out. Hurry up and end this. I’m already angry because of Hugo. You guys better not make me angry too.”
Stevens flinched. It was for no other reason.
“Don’t you guys think it's disgraceful to be treated like this? I made the proper moves to ensure that we benefit from Lee Gun’s achievements. Hugo doesn’t know his place.”
“…!”
There was no mistaking it. Recently, a lot of articles trying to undercut Lee Gun had appeared in the media.
‘Did she have a hand in it?’
In reality, Giselle was slowly working on her “Erase Lee Gun” plan. She started buying media and sent out fake news. Swindling the world wasn’t difficult at all.
- Lee Gun’s achievements until now were possible only thanks to the power of the twelve Zodiacs.
- Lee Gun was stealing and using the power of the Zodiacs.
Of course, Hugo denied all the drama-inducing rumors, so people continued to praise Lee Gun. Moreover, there seemed to be more people besides Hugo who were trying to take down the rumors.
‘It’s obvious who they are.’
They probably were Hailey and Kevin, who had hidden after Lee Gun’s death. Or…
Giselle smirked as she looked at Stevens. “Stop this nonsense. Why don’t you come work under me?”
She grabbed Stevens’s chin.
The other Zodiac Saints were beneath her notice except Hugo since her “Royal skill” didn’t work against him.
“We are all on the same side, right? Did you already forget what happened at the tower?”
“…!!!”
“Hugo will be taken care of soon. Don’t worry about him.”
Stevens immediately realized something when he heard her laughter, which was full of danger.
‘Hugo is in danger.’
This woman might kill Hugo.
Giselle laughed when she heard something from a bloodied Ivan. “Yes. Taurus is throwing in the towel. He’s on my side now. The only one left is Leo… It’s a given that you'll come under me, right?”
When he heard those words, he flipped her off. “Fuck off, idiot!”
An angry Giselle kicked Stevens.
* * *
A couple of days later, Yang Wei and Stevens were sweating bullets. The reason was…
“E…Excuse me. Are your parents home?”
The two men had come to Hugo’s house, but the appearance of the child before them surprised them.
The one staring at them from the yard was Yooha, who was around four years old.
Chun Yooha stared at the two men who had intruded(?) into their home. She didn’t cry or laugh. She merely looked at them as if they were thieves.
The two adults started to sweat.
“H-Hey, kid. We aren’t weirdos.”
“I…is Mr. Hugo in there? We are here to meet him…. He hasn’t responded…”
“Hoo-goh? Dahd?”
Yang Wei and Stevens screamed when they heard the clear voice of a lark. She was cute. She was really cute!
No, that wasn’t the important part!
“Dad?! You’re Hugo’s daughter? Wow! This is crazy!! Why is his kid so pretty? I thought she was a moving doll!!”
“…!!!”
They were already having a hard time believing Hugo had a kid, yet she was too pretty! If they were being honest, they had never seen a kid like her before.
However, Chun Yooha didn't seem to care. She just looked at the two of them with suspicion.
In the end, the two of them were pushed out by her gaze. They decided to leave.
“T-There is no way he would leave his kid like this and go far. Let’s wait for him outside.”
“A…Alright.”
At that moment, it seemed Yooha disliked the two men. She took out a strange remote from her pocket.
At a glance, it looked like a smart key for a car. But its shape was a bit odd as if it was something from a horror movie.
The two men screamed when they saw the remote.
“Ahhk! What the hell? That’s Lee Gun’s holy item!”
“Why does she have that?”
In the past, Lee Gun had created it to screw over… made it to chase away the Zodiac Saints. It was an item that Lee Gun made by combining the Archer Saint’s tracking skill: the Tracking Missile.
They turned pale from fright when they recognized the familiar remote controller.
“That’s crazy! Why would Hugo give that to a kid?!”
“No, no, no! You must not press it! If you press it, we are dead!”
They had suffered several times under the effects of the item. They ran toward Yooha in fright.
“K…Kid? D…Don’t get it twisted! W…We aren’t bad uncles!!!”
“That’s right. You are a good girl, right? That thing is dangerous. Hand it over to me. Hmm?”
Chun Yooha’s delicate eyes scrunched up when she heard this. She had decided that they were bad guys, so she moved to press the remote’s button. To make matters worse, she was about to press the lowest of the three buttons!
“Ahhhk!! Third!! She’s going to press the third button!”
“If we get hit by it, it’ll take us twenty weeks to recuperate!”
The two men grabbed each other’s hands as they nervously moved their feet.
“Hey, pig! Hurry up and do something!”
“Hey, kid! You’re a good kid, right? I’ll give you this!” Yang Wei quickly took out a candy from his bag. “Here! This is the 'Leo Saint' candy! It’s the most popular candy among kids! You want to eat it, right!!”
“…when the hell did you make that?”
“I made it a month ago! It’s at the height of its popularity now!!”
“…did you buy our license?”
“No way!” Yang Wei ignored Stevens as he waved the Leo Saint candies in front of Yooha.
“Look! This is the most popular one among the line of thirteen heroes’ candies! It’s called the Lion~ You can have the one that looks like the face of a lion or the paw of a cat! What do you think? You want to eat it, right? So why don’t you give that dangerous item to me? Let’s trade.”
Yooha glared at the candy as if she found it very lacking. The candy she loved the most was either the one of her father or Lee Gun-nim. Stevens and Yang Wei flinched when they read her expression. She was about to explode.
“Hey. Hey hey, hey! I don’t think this is the one.”
“W-What are you doing? Hurry up and take out another one!”
“Damn it. Alright—”
Crack!
Yang Wei had been retreating backward when he froze. He had stepped on something and broken it. It was…
“Ahhk!! Figurine?!”
