To give them a sunbath, Yooha had carefully placed a Lee Gun figurine and a Hugo figurine on top of a towel, and Yang Wei’s foot had destroyed them.
Yooha’s expression was a sight to behold. “Bwoken.”
“W-Wait a moment!”
“Dead.”
“N-No! Ahh! Look here! Lee Gun’s face was destroyed, but your father is unharmed! Uncle will replace the broken one with a new one…”
“You killed Lee Gun-nim.” An enraged Yooha pressed the button on the remote.
Click!
“Ahhhhk!!!”
In the end, Yang Wei was sent flying after being hit by a missile.
The enraged Yooha was about to press the remote as she glared at Stevens.
“Yooha? When did you go out to the yard?”
“!!!!”
Stevens was relieved to hear the familiar voice. He turned his head.
Hugo’s eyes turned round when he discovered a trembling Stevens. “What the hell? What are you doing here?”
“Hugo!!” As if he had met his maker, Stevens hugged Hugo. However…
Click!
Yooha pressed the button.

chapters.title: Chapter 481: Book 1, Epilogue 34 - Making a Fanatic (3)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 34 - Making a Fanatic (3)
“I never expected you guys to come here of all places.”
They were in the living room of Hugo’s house. Hugo looked displeased as he threw a glass of whiskey through the air.
Hweek!
Stevens took the glass out of the air. He sat on the other side of Hugo, looking intimidated.
Hugo had opened the expensive whiskey that they had brought as a housewarming gift. It was a whiskey that sold for fifty million won.
“I don’t know why you are here, but I’ll allow you to stay until we drink all of this. Hurry up and tell me why you are here. Then you can leave.”
Stevens nodded as he looked at Hugo in fear. To be precise, he was scared of Yooha, whom Hugo held in his arms.
Yooha sat on Hugo’s knee, pressing the remote control’s button. Her rage could be felt through her hand gesture.
Click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click!
She kept glaring at Stevens. Her eyes asked, “Why isn’t this working?”.
Stevens was shaking in fear.
‘Damn it! I have no idea why the missile isn’t coming for me.’
Yang Wei had been sent flying after being hit by the missile, yet no missile had come for Stevens. The Leo Saint had no idea why, but he did know one thing…
‘Hugo gave that to his daughter.’
Stevens felt a surge of anger as he protested to Hugo. “Have you lost your mind? Why would you give that to a kid?!”
“What’s wrong with it?”
“What’s wrong with it? Hey! You know what that item was used for, right? You watched from the sidelines as Lee Gun frequently used it to blow us up! You know its killing power, yet you gave it to a little kid?!”
Hugo looked dumbfounded. “What nonsense are you talking about? It’s broken. It isn’t activating right now.”
“It did activate! Didn’t you see Yang Wei being blown away?”
“Hmmph. You idiots are probably at fault for doing something stupid.”
Aggrieved, Stevens as he looked at Yooha. “It isn’t like that! Your daughter sent a missile!”
“Shut up! My kid sent nothing your way! My kid gets frightened by the sound of thunder and jumps into my arms! There is no way a timid girl like her would send a missile your way!”
“Damn it!” Stevens pounded his chest in frustration, but he also could guess why the missile hadn’t come for him.
‘It’s because Hugo was next to me.’
He wasn’t certain, but the remote control didn’t activate if he was next to Hugo. This was why Stevens discreetly moved closer to Hugo.
When she saw this, Yooha’s mochi-like cheeks puffed out as she continued to press the button.
Click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click!
Yooha pouted as she hugged the broken Lee Gun figurine.
Hugo laughed as he kept his eyes on Yooha. “Hey, Yooha. Dad will buy you a new Gun figurine. Please stop being angry. Ok?”
With unshed tears in her eyes, Yooha shook her head from side to side. “No. No.”
“No?”
“Lee Gun-nim alwedy dwed. New one is useless…”
It was rare to see Yooha cry. A surprised Hugo patted her back. “I understand. Then I’ll take it to a hospital and ask the doctor to save Gun. Will that be ok?”
“Wheally? We can swave him?”
“Yes. We can save him.”
Of course, they couldn’t bring back the real Gun.
Yooha seemed to have accepted his father’s words, but…
Click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click, click!
“Hey! Stop pressing that thing!!!!”
Yooha completely ignored Stevens’s shout. She continued to press the button.
Hugo looked at Stevens as if he were pathetic. “So? Why are you here?”
Stevens flinched. It seemed he finally remembered why he had come here. “I heard you’re going around shooting down rumors about Lee Gun. We would like you to stop it.”
Hugo’s eyes flashed as if he hadn’t expected something like this. “Get out! Right now!”
“Hugo.”
“You guys are a bunch of cowards. If I nip the rumors about Gun too quickly, are you afraid of being criticized?!”
“I’m sorry, Hugo.”
“…!”
Hugo’s eyes turned round at the unexpected words, but Stevens truly meant it.
“If only we had carried out the plan…”
What would have happened if they hadn’t run away from Red Eye in fear?
“Lee Gun might not have fallen into the trap.”
It was the mighty Lee Gun that they were talking about. He had recovered over 50% of humanity’s territory, and he was a monster that had killed Red Eye. How could someone like that fall into a trap?
In truth, someone had spoken up about it. That person was the one who Lee Gun called the rotten Crab.
- That trap was strong, but it wasn’t strong enough that he wouldn’t have been able to run away from it. Yet Lee Gun fell into the trap. Why do you think that happened?
- T…That’s… Isn’t it because Lee Gun weakened over time?
- Do you really think that’s true? You are shameless. We didn’t follow the plan. As if that wasn’t enough, everyone ran away in fright. The plan was almost unraveled, and the world almost came to an end.
- !
- Thankfully, Lee Gun was able to kill it. However, he was supposed to act as our support only. It put too much stress on Lee Gun’s body. He was weakened to a point where he couldn't even dodge the trap.
- …!!
- Everyone who ran away is responsible for Lee Gun’s death.
None of them had anything to say in response.
Stevens couldn’t raise his head because he had been the first one to run away.
“That is why I’m sorry. We are basically responsible for Lee Gun’s death.”
Hugo became angry. He violently grabbed Stevens by his throat. Murderous intent was written all over his face and eyes. “It has been five years, and now you’re admitting it…!!!”
An angry Hugo was about to punch Stevens’s face, but he stopped himself. He saw his daughter’s face. It seemed he had scared her.
“Whatever. It isn’t as if my relationship with you guys will improve just because you’re doing this.”
“…!”
Hugo was still being highly sought-after by the other Zodiac Saints. He looked at Stevens with a cold look in his eyes. “Why did you guys claim to have killed Red Eye?”
Stevens thought about what had happened at the time. When the reporters were asking a slew of questions as to who had killed Red Eye, Stevens had been about to answer, but someone else had beaten him to the punch.
- Stevens killed it!
The one to speak was Sergeyevich.
Surprised, Stevens had grabbed Sergeyevich. However, Ivan spoke up next.
- That’s right. It was Stevens. We all helped in killing Red Eye, but Stevens was the one to decapitate it.
- Hey!
They put pressure on Stevens to keep him in line. It seemed they needed a sacrificial sheep who would represent them.
They chose Stevens since he had the most support amongst the populace, and he was the most likely one among them to have pulled off such a feat.
Hugo fiercely asked, “Then why didn't you say anything at that time?”
“Do you remember what I said before Lee Gun died?”
Hugo furrowed his brows.
- Do you know when hope disappears? It’s when the being that deserves our faith disappears. If humanity wants to win, Lee Gun must be the symbol of victory. He’ll make us believe that humanity will win in the end.
That was what Stevens had said.
The Leo Saint said, “I was more afraid of hope disappearing than the criticism.”
“You thought hope would disappear?”
Stevens groaned. Red Eye was dead, but the problem remained that a great number of monsters had yet to be killed.
To make matters worse, the one to die among the awakened beings was the true hero, who had killed Red Eye. The ones to survive were the fake heroes, who had run away.
If the truth of this matter became known, the world would despair. They would ask why the fake ones were spared instead of Lee Gun.
Humanity would lose hope when the war hadn’t yet come to an end. They would start to panic.
At that point, the Zodiacs would have a hard time using their power, and all of humanity would be destroyed.
“People can freak out after all the monsters are gone.”
“That’s why you kept your mouth shut?”
“Yes. Humanity needs hope. That’s why I kept my mouth shut, and I planned on telling the truth after we got rid of all the monsters.”
“What nonsense! Do you really think I’ll believe such a story?”
“Then you can tell everyone about it.”
Hugo mocked Stevens. “You’re an idiot. Do you not realize why they put your name on all the accomplishments? They are trying to cut off their tail. If anything goes awry, they can put the blame on a single person. They’ll put it all on you.”
“That’s a problem that I’ll deal with when it happens.”
However, that wasn’t important right now.
‘Giselle.’
“That woman is gunning for you.”
It was because Hugo was aggressively striking down the recent rumors about Lee Gun.
Hugo contemptuously looked at Stevens. “You came here to give me that warning?”
“Yes. You have a family now. You should refrain from standing out too much.”
Giselle’s power wasn’t normal. Of course, Stevens had tried to interfere not too long ago when Giselle was trying to get rid of Hugo….
“Anyway, you can look me up if you’re in a tough spot. You don’t even have any good weapons.”
“Get out of here. There is no way I’ll ask for your help. Also, you came here in vain if you are here looking for forgiveness.”
Stevens wasn’t looking for one. He laughed as he patted Yooha’s head. “Hey, kid. If you need anything, Uncle will help you.”
“Don’t need chu. My dad is stronger than you!”
Stevens snorted. “Yes. That’s right. Your father is the strongest in this world. That’s why you should meet someone like your father.”
Hugo became furious. “He’s talking nonsense, Yooha. Don’t fall for his lip service.”
Hugo looked at him as if Stevens had said something he didn’t mean.
This left Stevens dumbfounded. “I went out of my way to praise you in front of your daughter, yet…”
“Listen to me, Yooha! Dad isn't the strongest! Gun is the strongest in this world!!!”
“?!”
It seemed Hugo was disgruntled by that particular claim. He grabbed his daughter and started brainwashing(?) her.
“Do you understand me?! Gun is the strongest in the world! Don’t try to meet someone like Dad! You must find someone like Gun!!”
“Wheally? Lee Gun-nim is the bwest?”
Stevens looked at Hugo in shock. Since Hugo’s face looked fine, Stevens hadn’t noticed it, but Hugo was drunk!
“Yes, Yooha! Follow after me! Gun is the best!”
“Gun is the bwest!”
“One more time!!”
“Bwest!”
Stevens started letting out a cold sweat as he looked at Hugo. W…Was this really ok???
* * *
A couple of months passed, and Yooha’s younger brother was born.
It was a healthy boy, and after the mother and the child were discharged, the family gathered to celebrate in happiness.
“Ha ha ha! Since he’s a boy, no one will stop me!!!” Hugo ran toward the community service center to register the birth of his child.
Lee Jaewon, who had tenaciously interfered with Hugo when Yooha was born, was out on a mission for a short period. Of course, he had been very worried before leaving.
- Zodiac Saint-nim. You must not. I repeat. You must not name your second child Gun, Gundol, or Gunshik. None of them is ok!!!
- I understand. Hurry up and go.
- You really must not!!!
As the date of the birth approached, Lee Jaewon had kept a watch on him. However, he was gone right now! And Hugo had received permission from his wife!
“Please write down my kid’s name as Gun!!!”
“?!”
Taken aback, the employee of the community service center looked between Hugo and the paperwork. “Y…You really want this?”
“Yes.”
The employee of the community service center kept an eye on him as he went over the paperwork.
In the end, the employee let out a bitter laugh as he looked at Hugo, who seemed a bit drunk. “Excuse me… There are too many letters…”
“How about this?”
[Genius-Throughout-Heaven-and-Earth-Cool-and-Handsome-Gun]
“That one is a bit too….”
“Let’s make it simple.!”
“Excuse me… You have to match the last name…”
“Chun Lee Gun!!!”
The employee of the community service center was sweating as he laughed. Going ahead with the paperwork wouldn’t be too hard, but something about Hugo’s state seemed off.
“Excuse me… Why don’t you come back tomorrow after you get the alcohol out of your system?”
If the employee let this proceed, he would be creating an embarrassing moment for the man in the morning.
However, Hugo was stubborn. “It’s fine! Do it before the obstructer comes back! Hurry!”
Hugo ignored the call he received from Lee Jaewon, who had said, “I’m going there right now. Wait for me.”
Hugo quickly stamped his seal and handed over the documents.
However, it didn’t take long for the sweating employee to speak up. “I’m sorry, but you won’t be able to use this name.”
“What?! Why!!!”
“Recently, we have discovered cases of identity theft. People used Lee Gun-nim’s name to conduct phishing and commit crimes. So, Lee Gun-nim’s name has been designated as a special name. We won’t be able to give that name to a newborn for a while.”
“What? What kind of nonsense is that?”
At that moment…
“Zodiac Saint-nim!!!” The fuming Lee Jaewon dragged Hugo away. “Here! This is the real paperwork drafted by your wife! You should sit here and do nothing!”
“Wahhhh!”
In the end, Hugo failed to name his second child Lee Gun. Instead, the second child received the name “Chun Sungjae.”

chapters.title: Chapter 482: Book 1, Epilogue 35 - Fanatics are scary (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 35 - Fanatics are scary (1)
Hugo’s children grew quickly. As fast as they grew, their fandom of Lee Gun grew faster. Their fandom was high enough to pierce the sky. It was enough to surprise their parents and the people around them. For example…
Boom!!!!
“Sungjae!!”
“Young master! Are you ok?!”
The three-year-old Sungjae was clumsy. He frequently banged his head against the wall by mistake.
“My god! That sound was incredibly loud. Are you ok? Sungjae…?”
Hugo ran toward Sungjae, but the sight of his son surprised him. “Is he crying or not?”
Despite having a large lump on his head, Sungjae was hiccuping while holding in his tears. No, he was crying, but was forcing himself to laugh. It could make one feel sorry for him.
“Good. I didn’t cwhy! Lee Gun-nim can still come bwack!”
“W-Why is he being like this? Lee Gun-nim? What are you talking about?”
Lee Jaewon started to sweat. “That is… He kept crying so much that we told him Santa won’t bring Lee Gun-nim back if he kept crying….”
“Ah….”
On the day of Christmas, Hugo and Lee Jaewon had dressed up as Santa and Rudolph, Hugo being Rudolph. That wasn’t all.
“Dad! Dad!”
“Hurry up and pway it! Pway it! That, that!”
“Again?” Hugo put on the video of Lee Gun on his phone and sighed. “You two probably account for one-fourth of the views on those videos.”
Chun Yooha was seven years old, and Chun Sungjae was three. The two children were obsessed with Lee Gun. They especially liked the video where Lee Gun drop-kicked the Zodiac Saints!
“Kyaa Kyaa! Amazing! Amazing!”
“Dad! One more time! One more time!”
“Sigh! I wish my kids would like something more normal."
Lee Jaewon started to sweat. “Does Lee Gun-nim have any video that can be considered normal?”
“…I guess not.”
Any video related to Lee Gun was considered to be against the law and hazardous material. The uploaded videos were considered normal, but the videos displayed something far from heroic.
Anyway, those in their late teens, twenties, and thirties liked Lee Gun, but young children like these two weren’t supposed to like Lee Gun. In fact, Sungjae had caused numerous troubles not too long ago.
To help the less fortunate ones, his kindergarten had hosted a toy giveaway.
“The one who does the kindest gestures will be number one, and the winner will receive the coolest of the thirteen Zodiac Sants!”
After hearing this, Sungjae diligently worked to receive stickers for good behavior.
“My god! Sungjae gathered three hundred stickers. He’s number one!”
“Woo!”
“We will give Sungjae the toy of the coolest one among the heroes!”
Sungjae’s heart was beating fast in anticipation. He ripped open the wrap around the present.
“Look! It’s the hero who everyone loves! He’s our hero the Leo Saint Stevens…!”
“Wehhhhhhhhh!!! This isn’t it!”
“??!!”
Sungjae wept as he held the doll.
His friends and teachers were flustered, not knowing why he was crying.
“W-What’s wrong? The Leo Saint is popular among the children these days…!”
At the time, ten out of ten children would say that they liked the Leo Saint the most. Of course, Lee Gun would be the last.
Anyway, Lee Jaewon had realized the truth, so he started to sweat when he was taking Sungjae back home.
It seemed Sungjae had to take a group picture with the doll of Stevens in his arms.
“Y-Young master. I’ll buy you a Lee Gun doll once we get home. Please don’t cry.”
Since it was a present from his teachers, Sungjae was unable to throw it away. He sniffled as he held the Stevens doll.
“The coolest person is Lee Gun-nim. It isn’t the cat.”
Hugo shook his head from side to side. “My children are quite the anomalies. Why do they like Gun so much?”
Lee Jaewon didn’t think that question deserved a response. Anyway, that wasn’t important right now.
“Z-Zodiac Saint-nim. Look who is trying to contact you.”
Hugo became angry when he saw the caller. It was a call from an association that monitored awakened beings.
This association was in charge of the observatories and its planetariums (Registry of Disciples). They also tried to mediate disputes between the temples.
- Hugo-nim! You must have your TV on right now, right? Currently, the Scout is being broadcast all over the world. Are you sure about sending only one employee there to participate in the event? Ah! I should have realized sending even one would be a tall task for the Sagittarius temple.
Hugo became angry when he heard the voice making fun of him. The Scout was an official yearly event where talented people picked the temple that they wanted to enter.
“Zodiac Saint-nim. This year… Will the number of members entering our temple be zero again?”
Hugo flinched at Lee Jaewon’s words. Yes, seven years had passed since the temples had been established, and it had brought sudden changes to the world. Each of the Zodiac Saints had become integral to each of their communities.
“The Virgo temple is already opening up branches in other countries….”
“What?! Branches?”
“Moreover, the amount of land he has taken for himself is no joke…”
“Damn it! I can’t believe that idiot Kevin is good at expanding his business…!!”
Anyway, the Zodiac temples picked out the most talented prospects and took them into the temples to grow the power of their Zodiacs.
According to rumors, they had several thousand fighters considered the first string.
On the other hand, the Sagittarius temple had a total of three members.
“There is me, Zodiac Saint-nim, and the unruly girl. One left yesterday.”
“Ughh….”
“We somehow made it through last year, but at this rate, we’ll be last again. Our profits will be stolen.”
“Ughh...”
As a Zodiac temple gained more disciples, the temple grew in terms of power, faith, and wealth. However, none of this mattered to Hugo.
- Now that I think about it, the Sagittarius temple has the lowest number of people nominated to it, right? Ah. I pray you will be able to gain even a single B-rank if possible. You won’t be able to survive solely using the sympathy card for much longer.
Hugo glared at his phone, but the person on the other end was telling the truth. Normal disciples were supposed to be a reflection of the public’s approval rating for a temple.
In other words, a temple was able to run smoothly if it had a high number of patrons and normal disciples. Elite disciples were the most important, and the Sagittarius temple had none of them.
‘Not having direct disciples places a huge limitation on us.’
Unfortunately, a rumor was going around the elite disciples that the Sagittarius temple was a place where flowers died before they could bloom. The Sagittarius temple was known as the number one temple to avoid!
“Do we have any applicants…?”
“Zero.”
“What about the aptitude test?”
“What?”
“The aptitude test for the newcomers should be out now, right? S rank! A rank!”
“Ah. Yes. Their names are Carly, Goat, and Oliver… Ah. They are showing the S-ranks on TV.”
“!”
Hugo and Lee Jaewon directed their gazes toward the TV.
“According to rumors, two of them were determined to be SS rank…”
“What? SS rank? That’s amazing! They are like you! What about the results of the compatibility test?”
The Constructs had stepped forward to check humanity for their compatibility. If a person was able to receive the power from a god, roughly predicting how much they would grow was possible.
The prediction probability was 95% and above. Therefore, it was normal for the temples to madly scout these prospects.
However, the Sagittarius temple had a criterion that was separate from the ability of a person. The most important criterion was compatibility.
It didn’t matter how strong an individual was. The person would receive less support from the Zodiac if the compatibility was low.
In other words, the number of bread crumbs dropped from the gods decreased if one wasn’t to their liking. On the other hand, the support from the gods exceeded 500% if one was compatible with the god!
It was why a C-rank with high compatibility could be treated like an S-rank. The one with high compatibility had a chance to receive a massive amount of wealth.
So compatibility was the best negotiating tool to use when trying to engage with a talent.
Hugo’s eyes twinkled. “So what is their compatibility?”
Ah. That is… The S-rank Oliver is compatible with the Leo temple and the Aries temple. The SS-rank Carly is most compatible with the Libra temple. The two of them have already chosen their temples.”
“W-What about the kid called Goat? There is a rumor going around saying he is an SS-rank like Carly. What’s his compatibility with the Sagittarius temple? Will we be able to bring him in?”
“G-Goat has a D-rank compatibility with the Sagittarius temple. He’s the least compatible with our temple. There’s almost a zero chance he’ll come to us when you take compatibility into account.”
Hugo despaired. “SS rank… He’s an SS rank….”
“Anyway, Goat is compatible with the Leo temple and… especially compatible with the Taurus temple… The Taurus temple is celebrating right now.”
“T-The Taurus temple must be overjoyed… They’ll be able to take in an SS-rank.”
If Lee Jaewon were a measuring stick for a compatible SS-rank, Hugo could see how much the Taurus temple would grow in terms of fighting power.
‘Just a single S-rank can shift the dynamic.’
It seemed the person on the other side of the phone realized that Hugo was in a state of despair.
He spoke in a weasley voice.
- Anyway, I believe the Sagittarius temple will have a barren year again. That’s why I contacted you in concern, Hugo-nim.
“What the hell did you just say? You’re concerned?”
- Yes. No A-rank or B-rank disciple wants to join the Sagittarius temple since their compatibility with your temple is mediocre at best. There is no way they’ll want to join. Thankfully, a D-rank with compatibility of an A-rank has appeared. Wouldn’t you like to take that person?
Hugo rested his head against the table. A D-rank would want to become a normal disciple or join a support-type temple. Why would a D rank want to choose a battle-type temple, where he would fight at the frontline?
Lee Jaewon let out a bitter laugh. “I guess this year is a dud too. In the first place, it’s hard to find someone with high compatibility with the Sagittarius temple. I’ll somehow find a way to bring a B-rank into…”
“Shit! This is the fault of our damn Zodiac! He should lower his standards! That damn god cares about only appearance! What’s wrong with the appearance of those SS-ranks? She’s pretty! He’s handsome! What’s the problem? Why doesn’t he like them?”
Sagittarius apathetically responded.
[That girl will be taken by Libra. Those men have no artistic and intellectual sense. They are better off going to those savage gods.]
“$#*$#&#*!”
Hugo wanted to choke his Zodiac’s neck when…
- Now the three candidates will choose their temples! I would like all three to come up on stage… What? Benjamin Goat never showed up at the event hall? Where is he?
“What the hell? He is missing? Did Ivan already take him?”
“I’m not sure….”
The sudden incident on live TV took the world by surprise. Hugo and Lee Jaewon were also taken aback.
Kwahng!!
“!!”
At that moment, someone barged into the office of the Sagittarius temple. It was as if a bear had charged into the room.
Hugo and Lee Jaewon grabbed each other as they screamed.
“W-What the hell? Why is he here?”
Yes, the one to charge into the small office of the Sagittarius temple was Benjamin Goat (16)!
“Is this the Sagittarius temple?”
“I…It is….”
The enormous man lowered his head. “My name is Benjamin Goat! I received an aptitude of S rank! Please take me into the Sagittarius temple!”
“?????”
Hugo and Lee Jaewon didn’t know what was going on. Why would he come here? What was he so lacking that he wanted to join the Sagittarius temple?
Goat ignored their expression as he let out a bright laugh. “I fell for the Sagittarius temple when I saw Hugo-nim and Lee Jaewon-nim fight! If you would have me, I’ll work very hard!”
Hugo and Lee Jaewon blinked. One second, two seconds, three seconds!
“Zodiac Saint-nim!!”
Hugo was ecstatic. “Here! Sit here! I have the contract right here!!”
“Z-Zodiac Saint-nim! That’s the promotional Lee Gun-nim pamphlet!”
“Ah! Here!”
Of course, Sagittarius didn’t seem to like Goat.
[You should expel someone like that….]
“Ahhhk!! No! I’m not going to give you any food if you do this, Zodiac bastard!”
This was how Goat entered the Sagittarius temple, shocking the world.
“Hey, did you hear about it? Goat entered the Sagittarius temple!”
“What? Aren’t they ass? Why would he enter the Sagittarius temple?”
“If Goat went there, it must mean the Sagittarius temple is legit.”
“That’s right. There is no way he entered that place without any thought…! He must have some kind of vision with them!”
Thanks to the move, the stock of the Sagittarius temple made an upward move. Regular disciples and patrons rushed toward them, and they went up to number one in the public approval rating.
This made disciples rush toward them, and the Sagittarius temple underwent a phase of explosive growth.
Ivan, who had been ready to welcome in an SS-rank, had been getting ready for a big party. When things didn’t work out, he went on an angry rampage.
***
Not too long into the future, in the US…
It was Chun Sungjae’s fifth birthday, but something happened that day that made him hate his birthday.
Chun Jiwoo’s Lab.
Knock knock!
“Chief researcher. You have a guest.”
“Guest? Who is it?” Chun Jiwoo answered.
“It’s Sergeyevich… The Capricorn Saint has come to meet you.”
“!”
Chun Jiwoo greeted an unexpected guest.

chapters.title: Chapter 483: Book 1, Epilogue 36 - You have to trust him completely (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 36 - You have to trust him completely (1)
Chun Jiwoo was surprised by the unexpected guest. This middle-aged man with an unruly beard had a special identity.
‘Capricorn Saint.’
Chun Jiwoo raised her guard.
‘Did they find out that I’m investigating the Devil’s Tower?’
Yes, Chun Jiwoo was currently investigating if Lee Gun was still alive or not. Hailey and Kevin were also investigating Lee Gun’s death, but Jiwoo was doing it for an entirely different reason.
- Lee Gun-nim might still be alive, dear.
- What? Gun might be alive?
Hugo was Lee Gun’s best friend. This was why Hugo possessed a lot of random holy items made by Lee Gun. The Archer Saint was using most of them for marketing(?) purposes.
- Look at this, kids! If I activate this, it’ll blow up a mountain! Lee Gun made all of this!
- Kyaa, kyaa! Lee Gun-nim is amazing! Amazing!
- Right? Gun is the best!
- Wow! You have a lot of Lee Gun-nim’s holy items.
Currently, the Zodiac Saints had taken all of Lee Gun’s holy items, so his items couldn’t be researched. They also didn’t approve of the research…
However, Chun Jiwoo had more access to Lee Gun’s holy items than anyone. She had always been a talented scientist, so she had a massive interest in Lee Gun’s holy items. The reason was obvious.
‘My god! The holy items from the Capricorn temple can’t hold a candle to Lee Gun-nim’s holy items!’
The holy items from the Capricorn temple were shoddy compared to Lee Gun’s holy items. They were inferior in all facets, including durability and power.
This was why awakened beings knew something was off.
‘What’s going on? Did the Capricorn temple really make holy items for Lee Gun-nim?’
Was this why awakened beings were trying to acquire Lee Gun’s items through the black market?
‘Lee Gun was that powerful with those items. What would happen if an awakened being used them? Wouldn’t they be that much stronger?’.
That was roughly the line of thinking in their minds. Of course, Chun Jiwoo knew the truth.
- Ha ha. Gun isn’t an awakened being who only derived his power from his weapons. The weapons were a tool that allowed him to kill monsters faster. Do you know how many monsters he killed with his bare hands?
In the end, it didn’t matter.
- Dear. I was researching Lee Gun-nim’s holy items, and I think I might be able to create special support items with them!
The survival rate for the disciples in the early days of temples was dismally low.
While they had the Capricorn temple’s weapons and the defensive abilities of the Taurus temple, the weapons weren’t durable and the skills were limited. So Chun Jiwoo started designing a variety of support items using Lee Gun’s holy items as the foundation.
She did it for humanity, and she wanted the safety of the disciples of the Sagittarius temple, which were small in number.
In doing this, Chun Jiwoo realized something.
‘Lee Gun-nim’s holy items are still alive.’
These were holy items with a sense of self. So their still working meant that they were still receiving Lee Gun’s magical energy.
Of course, they were operational, but merely breathing.
So she asked Hugo,
- Dear. You said Lee Gun-nim didn’t receive power from a Zodiac, right?
- That’s right. Gun was self-sufficient. He could refill his magical energy by eating and sleeping…
His words confirmed something for Chun Jiwoo.
‘Lee Gun-nim might still be alive.’
Hugo hadn’t noticed it, but those items were alive and breathing. It was as if they were waiting for their owner.
Therefore, Chun Jiwoo was creating a plan to search the Devil’s Tower.
“I heard you’re making something very interesting.”
‘Why did the Capricorn Saint, who was in charge of the manufacturing temple, have to show up?’
Chun Jiwoo furrowed her brows. It seemed Sergeyevich had realized that she had come up with a way to create support items.
“It’s illegal for anyone outside the Capricorn temple to create holy items. I’m sure you know this.”
“They aren’t holy items. They are merely support items.”
“Anything made without the approval of the Capricorn temple is illegal.”
Hearing his laughter, Chun Jiwoo looked at him in contempt. It was obvious what he wanted her to do. “Are you saying I should scrap my items?”
“I’m not that heartless. You can transfer the blueprints on how to make them to the Capricorn temple, or you can join the Capricorn temple. I don’t care what you choose, but I’m willing to compensate you enough for the move.”
“Hmmph.”
Chun Jiwoo was dumbfounded, but Sergeyevich was inwardly gnashing his teeth. Of course, he had also been surprised by her blindingly beautiful appearance.
‘Damn it! Why did a woman like her show up after Lee Gun?’
In truth, his subordinates had previously informed him that Chun Jiwoo was making support items by using Lee Gun’s items as a foundation.
At the time, he had merely snorted. What could a normal human do?
However, he was shocked when he saw part of the blueprint that his Constructs were able to steal.
‘T-This woman is better than me at designing items!’
He felt threatened.
‘Damn it! If these items are released into the world, it’ll undercut the power of the Capricorn temple in one fell swoop…!’
It would lead to the rise of the Sagittarius temple! The lay of the land around the world would completely change.
‘Above all else, I heard this woman is investigating the Devil’s Tower.’
She had probably realized something when she researched Lee Gun’s holy items. Lee Gun’s items were superior to Sergeyevich’s items.
Due to all this, Sergeyevich had become distrustful of her despite knowing that Lee Gun was dead.
‘She’s Hugo’s wife. I bet she heard all kinds of stories from him.’
Anyway, she was a troublesome opponent. This was why Sergeyevich acted nonchalantly as he looked at Chun Jiwoo. “It isn’t a bad deal, right? I bet you can’t spend money to your heart’s content since you live with a poor husband.”
When Sergeyevich made a gesture with his hand, his subordinate brought out presents. They were designer bags.
Chun Jiwoo let out a cold laugh. “I have no intent on speaking to those who killed Lee Gun-nim.”
“I-I have no idea what you’re talking about.”
“My husband was tormented for a long time by the fact that he had to come out of the tower in the middle of the raid. Despite the city being attacked, he believes the problem started because he left behind someone who was sick.”
“He’s not wrong. What about it?”
“What if this was found in the city?” Chun Jiwoo took out a corroded piece of metal.
Sergeyevich froze. “…!?!”
When they were raiding the Devil’s Tower, he had placed this pheromone holy item in the city to attract the monsters to the city!
‘I got rid of it without a trace, so why is that here…!!’
Chun Jiwoo let out a bright smile. “Of course, I found it using Lee Gun-nim’s holy item.”
“…!!”
That damn Lee Gun! Sergeyevich ground his teeth; Lee Gun was getting in his way even from his grave.
Still, the Capricorn Saint wasn’t one to retreat from such accusations. “I have no idea what that is…”
“Please do not deny it. It won’t make a difference since I found DNA on this. I already handed the info over to the media and the police.”
“?!!”
“While it isn’t proof that you killed Lee-Gun-nim, it’s proof that you attacked a city.”
A violent expression appeared on Sergeyevich’s face as he looked at Chun Jiwoo. The frightening energy of his Zodiac also emanated from him. “You’re going too far. Do you want to become a cold star like Lee Gun?”
Chun Jiwoo let out a bright smile. “Nuclear fusion powers the star. It doesn’t cool.”
This woman was really going to be like this???
“Anyway, this was a fun conversation.” Chun Jiwoo unlocked her phone. It contained the recording of their recent conversation.
“Are you sure you have the time to dawdle around here? Don’t you have to chase after the material I sent to the media? Wouldn’t that be the prudent thing to do?”
“…!”
“I hope you get my drift.” Chun Jiwoo dumped the designer bags into the trash can and handed the trash can over to Sergeyevich. “Do you mind emptying the trash on your way out?”
Sergeyevich grated his teeth.
* * *
“Sis! Sis! Look at this!” Chun Sungjae ran toward his older sister with a bright smile. “It’s Lee Gun-nim’s chewy candy! Chewy caady!”
It had been a week since Sungjae had received a sweet, so he was all smiles.
“I got it because I did something good! Lee Gun-nim’s chewy candy!! Aren't chu jealous!”
Currently, Chun Sungjae was five years old, and Chun Yooha was nine. The siblings were foes who kept stealing Lee Gun’s items from each other.
Therefore, Sungjae was happy as he shook the enormous chewy candy, which was bigger than his head, in front of his sister. “I’m going to eat it all by myself! Noona is jealous, right? You are jealous!”
However, his older sister reacted differently from usual. She looked at her younger brother as if he was pathetic. “Hmmph. An adult doesn’t eat something like that. It’s beneath me.”
“?!”
When her younger brother’s eyes widened in surprise, Yooha proudly raised something. It was milk with Lee Gun’s chocolate-flavored powder. “An adult drinks this.”
It was a popular item made in collaboration with the thirteen heroes. Moreover, the stick with Lee Gun’s face printed on it was quite rare.
Since not many of these items were being produced, adults had purchased all of them when they saw the Lee Gun stick.
Seeing the chocolate powder mixed inside the sippy cup, Sungjae cried as he charged forward. “I want to drink that too! Jaewon hyung! Give it to me! Lee Gun-nim!”
“No, Young Master! You’ll get cavities!!”
“Wehhhhh!”
Lee Jaewon patted Sungjae’s back. “I’ll give you something better on your birthday. Just wait a bit.”
Chun Sungjae became dejected. “I don’t need it. I want to see Mom for my birthday”
Lee Jaewon was compassionate as he looked at Chun Sungjae. For the past one to two years, Chun Jiwoo was very busy searching for Lee Gun and developing the support items.
‘Hugo-nim is busy doing mercenary work and cutting down rumors about Lee Gun-nim.’
This was why Lee Jaewon was the one who had been taking care of a young Sungjae for the most part.
However, at times, even he had to make himself scarce, and when Yooha went to school, Sungjae would have to stay alone by himself.
Yet Sungjae never threw a tantrum since he knew his parents were busy.
“I want to go see mom.”
It might have been the reason they had worked to make that wish come true.
Shwahhhh.
It was Chun Sungjae’s birthday, and it was raining. They were on the road near the airport.
“Mom, Mom! Look at this! Jaewon hyung gave it to me! It’s Lee Gun-nim’s chocolate milk mix!”
It would be for only two days, but Chun Sungjae was overjoyed about being able to meet his mother, who had returned from the US.
Lee Jaewon was driving the two of them. He was also happy as it had been a while since he had seen Sungjae laugh like this.
“Are you sure you will leave in two days? Since you’re here, it would be great if you stayed long enough to meet Zodiac Saint-nim….”
“It’ll be fine. I’m here for a short visit. It wouldn’t be right to call for someone busy.”
“I guess you’re right. Zodiac Saint-nim is conducting an important mission in Australia—”
Suddenly, an expression appeared on Lee Jaewon’s face. He looked at Chun Jiwoo. “Did you perhaps meet another Zodiac Saint before coming here?”
Chun Jiwoo was surprised. “What? Ah. It was the Capricorn Saint. I met him a couple of days before I got on the plane…”
“The Capricorn Saint?” Lee Jaewon immediately became guarded. He wasn’t sure, but the Capricorn Saint had placed some kind of skill on Chun Jiwoo.
She seemed to have read his expression. “It’s fine. I have this talisman on me.”
The item around Chun Jiwoo’s neck was Lee Gun’s holy item.
“Zodiac Saint-nim gave it to you, right? However, only Lee Gun-nim can use it.”
“I believe it’ll work out somehow if I have faith in him.”
“Faith? Haha.”
Anyway, they briefly stopped by a fast-food restaurant when Sungjae said he was hungry.
“Hey, what the hell? Did this person really die because of us?”
“N-No way!”
Chun Jiwoo and Chun Sungjae witnessed the sons of the Libra Saint at the corner of the parking lot.
“Damn it! Hurry up and get rid of that woman and the kid! Use the item that Mother said she used to get rid of Lee Gun!”
They summoned a toad. It was the toad that would be called the Blood Fog in the future.
At the same time, Chun Jiwoo realized who had been responsible for Lee Gun’s death. The problem was what came next.
“Mom!”
The toad targeted Chun Jiwoo.
[Kee-ehhhhhhk!]
The reason was the item that the Capricorn Saint had planted on Chun Jiwoo. It was an item that looked like a small bug.
It was the same pheromone holy item that had made Hugo come out of the tower, a holy item that attracted monsters.
Sergeyevich had planted it to kill Chun Jiwoo. He wanted to steal her research material for himself.
Kwahng!!!
In the end, the outdoor parking lot turned into a scene of carnage.
Lee Jaewon rushed toward them.
“Madam!!”
The general of the Sagittarius temple ground his teeth when he saw the monster chase after only Chun Jiwoo.
Quick on the uptake, Chun Jiwoo tried to move away from them. “Mr. Jaewon! Take Sungjae!”
“Mom!”
After taking Sungjae, Lee Jaewon placed the Sagittarius temple’s protection necklace over Sungjae’s neck, then sat Sungjae inside the car. “Young Master, it doesn’t matter what happens. You must not exit this place.”
“…!”
“It’ll be fine. Your father will soon be here to rescue us. Please believe in your father.”
“…!!”
Afterward, Lee Jaewon was eaten by the monster as he tried to protect Chun Jiwoo.
Sungjae witnessed it. As he was panicked at the time, he wasn’t able to recall this later.
Flash!
As the monster ate Chun Jiwoo and Lee Jaewon, Lee Gun’s necklace-type holy item around Chun Jiwoo’s neck started to shine. It was as if the item was protecting the souls of the two.
This was why the two of them would be able to reunite with the others ten years later.

chapters.title: Chapter 484: Book 1, Epilogue 37 - You have to trust him completely (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 37 - You have to trust him completely (2)
Hugo couldn’t believe his eyes. The city in front of his eyes had turned into a site of mayhem. It truly was a great panic downtown.
[Warning! Warning! A Red-zone monster has invaded the city.]
[Please hurry and evacuate…!]
There were already tens of thousands of victims.
Hugo, who had been doing mercenary work in Australia, had received a message from Lee Jaewon around twenty minutes ago.
- Zodiac Saint-nim! Please hurry up and return right now! Your wife is in danger! An unknown monster is going after her— Koohk!
After receiving the message, Hugo had immediately used a teleporter to return to Korea.
“Jiwoo!!”
However, he couldn’t find his wife or Lee Jaewon.
‘What’s going on? There is no way Jaewon would leave with a monster present….!’
Hugo glared at the monster trying to attack an apartment complex. He sent a Binding Arrow toward it as he surveyed his surroundings.
‘That’s…!’
He discovered a car in the parking lot that was letting out a red light. It was none other than Lee Jaewon’s car.
Hugo ran toward the car and opened the door. “Jiwoo! Jaewon! Are you here?”
The sight of his son inside the car surprised him. “S-Sungjae?!”
“Dad…!!”
His son was shedding tears as he clutched a Lee Gun chocolate mix in his hand.
Sungjae was wearing a necklace that was in the shape of the Sagittarius temple’s symbol, which was letting out a red light. This item had been protecting him.
Hugo was having a hard time understanding what was going on. “Why are you here…!”
He had heard about only Chun Jiwoo from Lee Jaewon, so this surprised him. But he soon realized what was going on.
‘Today is Sungjae’s birthday.’
This incident had happened while his wife came for a brief visit to meet her son.
“Dad! Mom and Jaewon hyung…!”
Hugo stroked the back of his son, who remained frozen. “Everything will be fine now. Where are your mom and Jaewon hyung? Are they somewhere else?”
Sungjae flinched. He clenched his eyes shut as he pointed at the monster. That was enough of an answer for Hugo.
Hugo’s face turned pale from fright as he closed the car door. “Stay right here! You must not come out no matter what happens!”
“Dad!!”
Hugo immediately ran toward the monster.
‘Damn it! I was wondering why I couldn’t feel their presence…!’
Hugo arrived near the monster and saw awakened beings in a state of total confusion.
“Damn it! What kind of monster is that?!”
“Help! We don’t stand a chance against it!”
“If even an S-rank can’t do anything against it, who will be able to fight it?!”
Several dozen awakened beings from the Leo temple, Gemini temple, and Virgo temple were crowded around the monster. By the look of things, they were going to be wiped out.
Moreover, although it was faint, Hugo could feel the energy of Lee Jaewon and his wife from inside the toad’s body.
When he realized this, Hugo’s feet naturally moved on their own.
This shocked the disciples.
“Hugo-nim! You shouldn’t get near it! Something is off about that monster!”
“It absorbs all the power of a Zodiac!”
Hugo charged the toad despite everyone around him trying to stop him.
And as they had said, the power of his Zodiac failed against the monster. However, that didn’t matter to Hugo.
Poo-oohk!!!
“!!‘
It wasn’t as if the training he had received from Lee Gun was all for naught.
As if to prove this, Hugo didn’t use his skill. He used his bow to stab the monster’s eye.
Due to the blow, the toad momentarily opened its mouth in a violent manner.
Zzuh-uhk!!
Hugo’s enormous strength shocked the Leo disciples.
“H-He did it with his bare hands?!”
However, there was no time to be surprised.
After opening the toad’s mouth, Hugo placed his shoulder against the top of its mouth. Then he propped up the bow so that the monster couldn’t close its mouth.
Kwah-jeek!!
It was like seeing someone keep an alligator’s mouth open.
Hugo immediately entered the toad through its mouth, making all the disciples turn pale from fright.
“Hugo-nim!!!”
It was basically an act of suicide.
After Hugo entered through the monster’s gullet, his skin started melting and his lungs took damage.
Since it was a serious situation, Sagittarius quickly gave him a warning.
[If you push it further, your life will be in danger. This bastard is eating your Divine power!]
If the blessing of the Zodiac disappeared, Hugo would become a normal human. There was no way he could last inside the monster’s body.
[Hugo!]
Despite this, Hugo ignored his Zodiac. The thought of rescuing his wife and Lee Jaewon was the only thing occupying his head.
It was unclear how long had passed.
‘!’
Hugo let out a sigh of relief when he reached the stomach. It seemed he had reached them before they could be digested. He had discovered his wife and Lee Jaewon, and they were unharmed.
‘They have no wounds, and they haven’t been digested yet.’
Hugo immediately called for his raven Constructs and used the Construct to send the two outside.
When two people appeared out of the toad’s mouth, the disciples were shocked.
“T-That’s crazy! How are people able to come out of that thing?”
“It’s Hugo-nim!”
“How the hell is that bow not breaking?”
Hugo laughed as he held the toad’s tonsil.
‘There is no way it’ll break considering who made it for me.’
The disciples quickly moved to extract Hugo.
“Koo-oohk!!”
“Hugo-nim!!!”
However, as Hugo was trying to exit through the gullet, he was dragged back into the monster’s stomach.
Hugo quickly called for his Zodiac, but his god wasn’t able to respond.
[Damn it! My power…!]
It seemed Sagittarius’s power had been consumed by the toad. In the end, Hugo fell to the very bottom of the toad’s stomach.
Splash!
“Kuh-huhk!!”
Drenched in digestive fluid, Hugo thought he was about to die. However…
Flash!
‘!’
Light erupted from Hugo’s wristwatch. It was the watch that Lee Gun had given him as a present. Then, something surprising happened.
“Kuh-huhk!!! Wait a moment…!”
Did it have some kind of emergency escape ability? The watch, which was clasped around his left wrist, raised his arms. It dragged him somewhere.
“Ahhk! Wait a moment! It hurts!”
Struggling was useless. After dragging Hugo along, the wrist unceremoniously threw him out of the toad’s mouth.
Kwahng!!
“Ahhhk!!”
Having been tossed to the ground, Hugo felt like dying.
“Hugo-nim!! Are you ok?”
“K…Kuh-huhk. I’m not ok… Damn it! My arm…! That Gun bastard…! This isn’t a protection-type holy item!”
“Hugo-nim??”
The watch didn’t seem to care if Hugo was in pain or not.
After throwing Hugo, the watch seemed smug about itself. It acted as if it had done the job well and went back to sleep. Clearly, the watch had a sense of self.
Normally, it increased Hugo’s luck a little so that he wouldn’t get hit by an attack. However, if he faced a danger above a certain threshold, it could send Hugo away to a different location by brute force.
But that wasn’t important right now.
[Kee-ehhhhhk!!!]
It seemed the light emitted by the watch had damaged the toad on the inside.
The toad was in pain as it disappeared.
Everyone sighed in relief when they saw this and rushed toward Hugo and the two people with him.
“Jiwoo! Jaewon!”
“Please don’t worry about them! We called for an ambulance!”
“Thankfully, nothing is wrong with their bodies! We believe the two of them fainted from shock! They should wake up soon!”
“I see.”
Hugo had previously seen the status of the two, so he nodded. They should wake up soon if they received treatment. That was what he had believed.
* * *
“What? They haven’t regained consciousness?”
“Yes… There is nothing wrong with their bodies, yet…!”
The hospital was in a state of turmoil. The reason was Lee Jaewon and Chun Jiwoo.
“It isn’t just the two of them. The other victims are also…”
“Sophie-nim says she doesn’t know why this is the case either.”
This meant their bodies were empty husks of their original selves, and they were unable to breathe by themselves.
This caused a commotion among the public.
“My god! This incident occurred within the district covered by the Sagittarius temple’s dome, right?”
“What the hell? It’s a region protected by the Archer Saint, yet a Red-zone monster appeared there?”
“How did he maintain his barrier that such a tragedy could happen in the middle of the city?”
The world disparaged Hugo.
The Taurus Saint, who considered Hugo a thorn in his side, was overjoyed as he disparaged the Sagittarius temple.
However, their words couldn’t reach Hugo’s ears.
“I’m sorry! We are running tests, but you should prepare your heart for…”
As Hugo gritted his teeth…
“Poor Hugo. I heard you lost the person you love the most and your precious subordinate?”
“!”
The one to appear at the hospital was none other than Giselle.
“Thankfully, my sons were able to survive that fiasco.”
When Giselle sent a peculiar gaze toward Sungjae, Hugo immediately hid his son. “Get out of my face right now.”
“Oh my! I'm here because I'm worried about a comrade. You’re being too cold. By the sound of it, the barrier of the Sagittarius temple hadn’t performed well. That was why the monster was able to come in. In other words, you’re at fault, right?”
Hearing this, Sungjae flinched. He immediately grabbed his father. “No, it wasn’t Dad! The barrier wasn't broken! Someone else did it! The criminal was…!”
At that moment, Giselle glared at Sungjae as if she wanted to kill him.
“!”
When Giselle let out an odd sense of killing intent, Hugo looked at her as if something was off.
On the other hand, Giselle acted calm and smirked. “Anyway, my sons were there. It’s the fault of the Sagittarius temple that they got involved in this, right?”
“That’s….”
When Hugo ground his teeth, Sungjae angrily said, “No! Her kids called out the monster! They drew a summoning circle like this!”
“!?”
Both Hugo and Giselle were surprised.
However, the first one to react was Giselle. She had never expected such a young child to remember all the symbols in such exact detail.
‘Damn it! They did a horrible job of cleaning after themselves.’
Giselle ground her teeth as she approached Chun Sungjae. “My god! I have no idea what this kid is trying to say.”
“Of course, you know! I’ll show this to the police! Those older kids used this to summon the monster….!”
Surprised, Giselle let out murderous intent as she extended her hand. “L…Little kid. You shouldn’t lie. If you lie, the police will arrest you.”
“It isn’t nonsense! I saw it! The monster came from the Libra temple’s summoning circle…!”
Giselle stood in front of Sungjae, but…
Crunch!
“If you lay a hand on my son, you’re dead.”
“…!!”
Hugo broke Giselle’s arm. “I never want to see any of your faces. Buzz off right now!”
Giselle snorted. “I’m sorry, but I won’t leave! I have to make sure—”
“You guys have a hand in this.”
“What?”
“You guys are responsible for Gun’s death, and you guys are responsible for this incident.”
“What nonsense are you—”
“As soon as my wife was attacked, the Capricorn Saint took all her research material. There is no way that is a coincidence.”
Giselle blanched.
‘That Goat bastard is always unhelpful…!’
She had told him to avoid doing anything that would attract attention.
Giselle quickly turned around. In reality, she was afraid. It was as if she was seeing Lee Gun through Hugo’s face. “Alright. You are in shock because you lost your wife and subordinate. I’ll go for now.”
When Giselle exited the room, a surprised Sungjae shouted at his father, “D-Dad! No! I really saw it! Believe in me! I’ll bring her to justice…”
“Will you stop it, Sungjae?!”
“!”
It was rare for Hugo to raise his voice like this. He gritted his teeth. “If only you hadn’t called your mom here in the first place…!”
“…!”
Hugo looked to be in excruciating pain.
When Sungjae saw his expression, he couldn’t say anything. While he couldn’t understand everything his father was going through, he was sure of one thing.
“…I’m sorry!” Sungjae held back his tears as he went to the next room.
Hugo bit his tongue.
‘Damn it! Why the hell did I say such a thing to a kid…’
He was about to chase after Sungjae to give an immediate apology, but…
“Excuse me, Hugo-nim. You should prepare yourself.”
Hugo froze when he saw the people who had entered the hospital room.
* * *
Hugo tried countless things to save the people precious to him.
- We’ve finished all the tests… I’ll be honest. The probability of them surviving this is none…
- We believe it is prudent for you to make funeral arrangements.
- In a couple of days, we’ll have you meet the funeral director.
Hugo was experiencing the same thing that he had experienced ten years ago. He had to go through this for his friend, and he knew extremely well what would happen after this.
‘Should I give in?’
Like what had happened with his friend, would he have to go through the same thing for his wife and subordinate?
However, the one to snap him back to his senses was none other than Yooha.
“Dad… Dad!”
Hugo was surprised when someone’s voice shook him out of his current state. He was in a dark room. When he raised his head, he saw Yooha turning on the light. A tray of food had been placed next to him.
“You haven’t eaten anything, Dad. Let’s eat.”
“Dad doesn’t need to eat….”
However, Hugo immediately came to his senses when he caught sight of Yooha. “Yooha. What happened to your hands? Why are they like this? You are hurt!”
“Ah. I cut myself when I was chopping up the vegetables.”
“…!”
Hugo bit his lips. Since he was an awakened being, his body didn’t send any signals even if he didn’t eat food for several days. So the days had blurred together. He didn’t know what day it was.
When he saw the date on his phone, Hugo sighed.
‘Damn it! I didn’t pay any attention to the kids for four days…’
To make matters worse, he had allowed Yooha to injure her hands.
Hugo quickly got up. “What about Sungjae!”
“Ah… Sungjae says he doesn’t deserve to eat anything. He said he doesn’t want to eat, so...”
“What?!”
Hugo’s face turned pale from fright as he rushed out of the room. It seemed the sense of guilt made the young one not be able to eat anything.
Hugo headed toward the children’s room. He wanted to make them healthy food.
“Ooh, ooh, ooh…!”
“!!”
But when he entered the room, he saw fish covered in ketchup. Seasoned vegetables, cucumbers, and peppers covered in ketchup were placed over rice. The bowl had been eaten clean and was strewn across the floor.
Hugo caught sight of Sungjae crying because he had eaten too much. He gawked. “I-I thought you didn’t want to eat food…?”
“Yes, but I was forced to eat it.”
He was forced to eat it?
“Uh… Why are Gun’s figurines all over the floor?”
“Ah. He refused to eat, so I said I’ll break a figurine of Lee Gun-nim each time he refused to eat.”
“?!!”
Hugo was shocked, but Yooha’s eyes twinkled. In truth, her method had been very effective.
- Eat it. I will hurt Lee Gun-nim every time you refuse to eat.
She had pushed the spoon toward him with one hand and raised the Lee Gun figurine with the other. Sungjae had despaired when he saw what Yooha was doing.
- Wehhhhh! You can’t break Lee Gun-nim!!
- Here. If you want to save Lee Gun-nim, you should eat this.
- Wehhhhh!!!
- Have another spoonful!
Her method was very effective. She kept feeding and feeding her brother until the five-year-old felt like his stomach was about to explode.
Sungjae desperately gathered all his Lee Gun figurines as he cried.
- Noona’s food is terrible! My stomach feels like it’s going to explode! It feels like I’m going to die, but I was able to protect Lee Gun-nim…!!
Hugo didn’t know if he should laugh or cry as he watched his son in tears.
‘Yes. I can’t give up.’
He had to do it for his wife, subordinate, and the friend he trusted the most in this world.
That was why Hugo went to visit someone, and this was when Lee Gun’s holy item suddenly flashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 485: Book 1, Epilogue 38 - How dare you make a move? (1)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 38 - How dare you make a move? (1)
Paris, France.
“What? You want me to spread this in the media?”
Sophie, who had been a fixture in France, had been chased out to England. Kevin had taken her place there.
Kevin let out a feigned laugh. Hugo had come looking for him in Paris and brought an unexpected proposal, a proposal related to Lee Gun and Chun Jiwoo.
To put it simply, some among the Zodiac Saints were spreading rumors about Lee Gun, and the Capricorn Saint had taken Chun Jiwoo’s research material.
Hugo brought up the possibility of some of the Zodiac Saints having a hand in the death of Lee Gun. That was the gist of what he had to say, and Hugo wanted to use Kevin to get this information out into the media.
Kevin looked at Hugo, dumbfounded.
‘After Lee Gun’s death, he made himself scarce. The others couldn’t even find him.’
Of course, Kevin hadn’t shown much interest in finding Hugo, yet Hugo had come looking for him with this important problem.
“Why are you asking me to do this?”
“Why else? There is no one else that I can trust.”
“…!”
Kevin scrunched up his face. “I’m not close enough to you that you should be revealing these secrets to me.”
It was true. If one was being honest, Hugo and Kevin hated each other.
Before Kevin had started to distance himself from Lee Gun, he used to chase after Hugo with a blade, saying things like, “Damn bastard! Get away from Teacher!” and “Why do you always get special treatment from Teacher! Get away from him!”
‘Of course, I have no idea why he started to distance himself from Gun.’
Hugo had assumed it was a case where a young man had turned into an adult and, in the process, just stopped liking Lee Gun.
It was understandable since his friend did have a bad temper and was a taskmaster.
However, Hugo didn’t care if Kevin didn’t like Lee Gun. “You’ve been taking down rumors about Gun. Right, Kevin?”
“!”
Kevin flinched.
Hugo’s eyes turned sharp. “Someone among us is trying to slander Gun. If you were the one to spread the slander, you wouldn’t be the one to take it down unless you were an idiot, right?”
“…”
“I cannot trust the others. It doesn’t mean I trust you, but at the very least, I know you aren’t someone who would cause harm to Gun. That’s why I came to you. The media won’t move unless a Zodiac Saint asks. You’re the Zodiac Saint of the second-ranked temple, so your credibility must be high in the eyes of the media, right?”
“Hmmph.” Kevin got up as if responding to Hugo wasn’t worth it. “I’m sorry, but I won’t do it.”
“!”
“If I spread this news, I’ll basically turn the other Zodiac Saints into my enemies. It will instantly put a target on my disciples. You might not get this since you don’t have much to protect.”
“You’ve been killing off rumors about Gun, so why are you suddenly…”
“I already gave up on doing that around a year ago.”
“…!”
Kevin looked at Hugo as if he wanted Hugo to get out of his presence. “Nothing will change if I work for a dead person.”
Also…
“Those who are alive should have the chance to be happy.”
Murderous intent appeared in Hugo’s eyes. “Are you talking about you guys, who lived by throwing away Gun?”
Kevin sneered. “Why don’t you forget about him since he’s already dead?”
“Gun is still alive inside the tower.”
“Stop speaking such nonsense. You lost your wife and subordinate. Why don’t you look after your children?”
“…!”
“Also, you’re claiming the Capricorn Saint stole your wife’s research material? If I recklessly spread such information, you do know that I’m the one who’ll suffer the backlash, right?”
“….”
Kevin looked sick and tired of Hugo. He exited toward the sitting room, and the disciples of the Virgo temple approached him.
“He’s leaving. You should escort him out of the castle.”
“Hmmph. There is no need.” Hugo left as if his low expectations of Kevin had borne true.
Virgo spoke to Kevin as she watched a seething Hugo exit the castle.
[He was your comrade at one point. You’re being very cold to the Archer Saint.]
“Are you stupid or something? If that powerless moron takes action, he’ll become targeted by the others.”
[Oh. Does that mean you chased him out on purpose?]
“You saw his personality. His personality makes it very easy for others to read him. He’s completely useless when it comes to politics. It’s better that he stays in the corner doing nothing.”
[Are you looking out for your comrade?]
“If you have time to say such nonsense, you should read the data he brought.” After saying that, Kevin unsheathed his sword and headed away.
His subordinate asked in surprise, “Where are you going, Zodiac Saint-nim?”
“I’m going to attack the Capricorn temple.”
“What? Does that mean you’re going to help the Archer Saint…?!”
“Be careful what you say. The Archer Saint was never here today. We acquired all this information in secret. We are mobilizing to crush the other temples that got too smug.”
“…!!”
Kevin let out a savage smirk. “The Capricorn Saint dare climb up in standing by stealing someone else’s research? As one of the highest-ranked temples, we have a duty to put him in his place.”
* * *
“What? Are you being serious?”
Hugo was shocked. He had come looking for Stevens and given him a similar proposal.
Kevin was always someone who did as he liked. He didn’t care about the affairs of the others, so Hugo had known that he would be turned down.
However, he had been banking on Stevens.
“Say it again.”
“There are no lies being told in the rumors, so why should I correct it? Lee Gun was a low-level awakened being, and the power of the twelve Zodiacs allowed us to kill the monsters. That’s the truth.”
“Really!! You son of a…” An enraged Hugo grabbed Stevens by his collar.
Stevens had always said that no awakened being could touch Lee Gun in terms of abilities. He had called Lee Gun the hope of humanity! Yet he dared say this now!
“Were you paid off?”
“I don’t need to take such things. I am already overflowing with money.”
“…!!!”
“Anyway, I’m sorry to hear what happened to your family. If you plan on having a funeral, I’ll provide the funeral fee. If you plan on doing life-sustaining care, I’ll introduce you to a hospital that I know. The only thing I ask is that you drop this subject.”
“…!!!”
“You can leave if your business with me is done.” Stevens got up.
Lee Gun was already dead, and as the number of disciples under them grew, the power of the Zodiacs would also grow. At this rate, they’d be able to get rid of all the monsters.
‘Yes. It’ll be enough.’
It’d be fine if everyone thought they had killed Red Eye. The effect might be temporary, but he would do this if he could prevent the faith and hope of humanity from fading away.
“Do you understand what I’m saying? We are the ones who killed Red Eye. We cleared the tower.”
Stevens got up from his seat and looked at the box next to Hugo. It contained money and precious holy items. “I know you’re in a bad spot, so I put a lot in there. You should look after your temple now. How did you allow yourself to be last in place? You are talented— Kuhk!”
A hit from Hugo sent the Leo Saint flying.
Hugo clenched his fists. He felt an uncontrollable amount of betrayal. Hugo had been a fan of Leo Saint before he became an awakened being, and he thought Stevens felt the same about Lee Gun as he did. This was why the sense of betrayal cut deeper.
“I hope to never see your face ever again.”
Hugo exited the Leo Saint’s territory. He then traveled in all directions, trying to find a way to save his wife and Lee Jaewon.
As he did so, the other Zodiac Saints kept dropping hints he should give up. Moreover, the hospital was becoming reluctant to let the two remain hospitalized, yet Hugo never gave up.
‘I won’t give up on my wife, Jaewon, and Lee Gun.’
He would save them all. However, someone didn’t like his efforts.
A fortnight later, Hugo had been visiting the sickbed of his wife and Jaewon when…
“I told you before! You should stop acting as you please!” An angry Giselle finally visited Hugo.
Of course, he would have ignored her if that was all she did.
“Yooha!” Hugo ground his teeth as he looked at his ten-year-old daughter, who was in pain.
Yooha was gasping as she clutched her arm. Her arm had turned black, and it was threatening her life.
It seemed Giselle had planted something harmful in Yooha’s arm, and it didn’t matter what treatment he tried. He couldn’t fix his daughter’s arm.
[Damn it! We never would have expected that woman to use such a thing!]
The raven Constructs gnashed their beaks.
[It would have been easier if it were a monster!]
Yes, Giselle had planted the fragment of an evil god within Yooha’s arm!
The Constructs looked at Giselle in contempt.
[In the Divine world, there is a taboo called the “Five Great calamities.”]
[They are the gods of calamity who consumed universes and gods in the past! They are the worst!]
[Damn it! I have no idea where you acquired the sealed fragment, but…!!]
The only thing certain was that the human body couldn’t withstand the presence of this calamity.
‘She’ll get consumed by this calamity in an instant.’
Sagittarius was ready to do everything within his power to extract the evil being from Yooha’s arm, but he failed.
[I’m sorry, my servant. I can’t do anything about this.]
“…!”
The calamity had taken root in Yooha’s arm, and Sagittarius could only prevent it from attacking her organs.
‘She won’t last long.’
At this rate, she would last two days at most. The black energy climbed up her arm and reached her neck in no time.
‘She’ll die once it covers her entire body.’
Until this point, Hugo was like an unfaltering steel wall. However, with his child in pain and danger, his mental state became frayed.
Giselle triumphantly laughed. “Choose, Hugo. Choose either A or B.”
“…!”
With bloodshot eyes, Hugo glared at Giselle.
Giselle approached him. “Choose. Will you choose your child or will you choose to pursue life-sustaining care for your hopeless wife and subordinate?”
Hugo ground his teeth as he held his daughter, who was in pain. “I’ll… Give up… On the life-sustaining care…”
Giselle laughed.
“Second, your son accused my sons of being the culprits behind the toad incident. What about that?”
Hugo shook in anger. Strength entered the hand holding Yooha. He could see the face of his son, who wanted to be believed, and he recalled the faces of the two people who remained in their hospital beds.
“…my kid was mistaken. I’ll…caution him about saying such a thing.”
“Good. What about the last one? What about the matter regarding Lee Gun?”
Instead of answering, Hugo bit his lips as he glared at Giselle. His eyes said she had touched on a subject that shouldn’t have been messed with.
Giselle clicked her tongue as she looked into his bloodshot eyes. “Hugo? Hurry up and give me an answer. Will you choose your child or your friendship?”
In the end, Hugo choked down his rage. “Regarding Gun… I will no longer dig into his case.” He sounded almost breathless.
However, Giselle was satisfied. She laughed. “Alright, that’s enough, but I need one more thing.”
“!!”
As if this was what she had truly wanted, Giselle put a hand on Yooha’s shoulder. “I want you to rejoin the Zodiac Saints as our comrade. We will treat you very well.”
“…!!”
Giselle laughed since Hugo’s ability was too good to throw away. Hugo just had to keep his mouth shut about Lee Gun and his family. If he kept silent, he was an awakened being beyond reproach in terms of ability.
“Nothing good will come from turning me down. If you don’t agree to work under me, your daughter is dead.” Giselle aggravated the fragment of the evil god.
“Ahhhk!!”
Hugo loved his children very much. He wouldn’t last if he heard the scream of his daughter!
“If you want to save your daughter— Kyahhhk!!!”
Suddenly, Giselle screamed. She clutched her face as if she were in pain. She had tried to aggravate the fragment of the evil god, but it had attacked her.
Giselle wondered what was going on. She whipped her head around, and the sight left her surprised.
“Yooha!” Hugo was surprised.
Giselle screamed as she gnashed her teeth.
‘That kid…!’
Yes, the one to attack her was none other than Yooha herself!
Yooha violently pulled at the hair of Giselle, who kept her hand on Yooha’s shoulder.
“Don’t…bully…my dad…!!”
“Ahhhk!!!”
That wasn’t all. The black power that had been trying to swallow Yooha climbed up toward Giselle and threatened her life.
“Kyahhhk!!”
This surprised the raven Constructs.
[H…Hugo! Your daughter is starting to impose her will against the fragment of the evil god!]
[N-No way!]
Giselle glared at Yooha.
‘Damn it! A small human child is able to steer the fragment of an evil god? Are you kidding me?’
It should have been impossible to do with normal mental power.
‘Damn it! I thought she would die if I left her alone…!’
The current situation put her at a disadvantage instead.
‘No! The power I put in to kill the kid will become the source of her power!’
Kwahng!!
“Kyahhhhk!!”
Yooha’s attack blew a chunk out of Giselle’s face and scalp.
Pahk!!
Giselle clutched her bloody face as she fell over.
“Ahhhhhhk!!!”
Feeling excruciating pain, she glared at Yooha and Hugo and called for a teleport. “Wait… I’ll be back for you guys!”
Goat tried to capture her before she could disappear, but he failed. “Damn it…! She ran away!”
“It’s fine. Don’t chase after her too far!”
“But…!”
Hugo carefully looked at Yooha. Yooha, who had been in pain, was nowhere to be seen. She was surprisingly breathing easily now.
She was starting to control the fragment of the evil god, which had been placed inside her to kill her. The Constructs of the Sagittarius temple couldn’t keep their mouths shut.
[She conquered the fragment of an evil god…!]
The black power, which had been trying to cover her entire body, started to contract. It returned to her arm. Then something incredible happened.
“Dad….”
“Yes! It’s Dad! Are you ok, Yooha? Are you in pain?”
“Yes… I’m fine. That is why you shouldn’t listen to others, Dad. I don’t want you to be in pain because of me. I would like you to continue to tell us stories about Lee Gun-nim.” Yooha let out a timid smile as she hugged her father’s neck.
Hugo embraced his daughter.
Goat gritted his teeth. “Zodiac Saint-nim, even if it comes to all-out war, we will protect you and your children as your disciples. That is why….”
“No. We’ll do as the Libra Saint asked. The Sagittarius temple will let this matter go.”
“What?! Are you saying you’ll give up on your wife and Jaewon hyung-nim?!”
“No. I won’t give up on them.”
“Then what are you….”
Hugo stood up as he held his sleeping daughter. The look in his eyes changed. “Libra Saint asked me to take a step back. She didn’t say others couldn’t carry out the work.”
“Then…!”
At that moment, Goat heard something.
Clack, clack!
“!”
It was the sound of footsteps. Someone was walking toward Hugo.
Goat was shocked to see the newcomer. “That person is…!”
She was a beautiful woman with jet-black hair, and the lovely silhouette of the full moon was behind her.
“You waited a long time, Hugo. The preparation is complete.” The only one to take his hand amongst the rest of the Zodiac Saints was Hailey.

chapters.title: Chapter 486: Book 1, Epilogue 39 - How dare you make a move? (2)
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 39 - How dare you make a move? (2)
“No one will be able to find this place.”
They were inside an isolated island in Canada, within the Scorpion Saint’s holy ground. A hospital had been built there, and Hugo had hospitalized his wife and subordinate there.
“It took a while to build a hospital that can hold almost five thousand people. I’m sorry.”
Hugo shook his head from side to side when he heard Hailey’s words. After he had asked this favor of her, she had built a hospital in a fortnight. She had been incredibly fast.
Moreover, doctors around the world had given up on treating these patients to appease the Libra Saint, the first-ranked Zodiac Saint.
Since the hospitals had turned away the patients in vegetative states, their guardians had to give up on them. However, Hugo was able to accommodate the victims with Hailey’s help.
“I won’t forget your kindness in the tower, the incident with the toad, and your help right now.”
While he felt thankful, Hugo also felt worried. “If the others find out that you helped me, they won’t forgive you.”
He had already made enemies with the other ten Zodiac Saints.
However, Hailey said as if it wasn’t a big deal, “You don’t have to think of me as your benefactor. I’m helping you because this is beneficial to the Scorpio temple too.”
“I…Is that so? I’m glad if that’s true.”
“Also, I don’t deserve your thanks.”
“What? What did you just say right now?”
Hailey secretly clenched her fists. Instead of answering him, she bit her lips. She had spoken with the intent to absolve him of any debt to her, but there was another intent behind those words.
‘I wasn’t able to protect Lee Gun.’
Hugo was Lee Gun’s best friend, whom Lee Gun treasured. She didn’t want harm to fall on Hugo too.
This was why she had saved Hugo inside the tower and lent him her skill when he fought against the toad. This time, she would keep his family safe.
Of course, this didn’t mean she wasn’t facing significant opposition.
- Zodiac Saint-nim! I can’t believe you made a hospital of this size for people unrelated to us…!
- That’s right! Why are you willing to suffer such losses to help the Archer Saint?
The Zodiac of the Scorpio temple was disgruntled too. For some other reason, Scorpio seemed to hate the Archer Saint.
However, Hailey didn’t pay any attention to them.
- If you can’t accept my decision, you do not need to stay by my side. I won’t stop you.
- Ah! Zodiac Saint-nim! We didn’t mean it like that!
However, they weren’t what was on her mind.
“Hugo. These people might never wake up. Are you sure you’re ok with that?”
Instead of answering, Hugo laughed. Answering such a question wasn’t worth it.
Hailey nodded. “I see. But Giselle might notice that we are performing life-prolonging treatment on them.”
“Don't worry. I have a plan in mind.” Hugo wouldn’t let the others do as they pleased. His eyes flashed.
* * *
“Mom…! Hyung…!”
On the day of the funeral, Yooha and Sungjae were dressed in funeral black. They couldn’t hold back their tears. Chun Jiwoo and Lee Jaewon were supposed to be cremated on this day.
Of course, although it was a funeral, fake corpses would be burned. In fact, the Constructs of the Sagittarius temple were inside the coffins, and they were angry.
[Hugo! You bastard! I’ll make you pay for this! Ah! Hot! Hot!!]
Anyway, this was how Hugo deceived the world.
A bigger reason why he hid the truth was his children. Waiting for an indeterminate amount of time would only bring pain. It was enough for only him to suffer through the long period of pain.
Someone among the Zodiac Saints managed to realize the corpses were fake. It was Sophie. She could discern this truth through her eyes, which could see power in energy form.
- If you tell Giselle about this, I’ll have no choice but to kill you and her.
Hugo grabbed Sophie by her throat and growled violently.
Sophie cried when she received the death threat from Hugo.
Anyway, the other Zodiac Saints were unable to act rashly because everyone was sympathetic toward Hugo, who had lost his wife.
Everything was going as per Hugo’s plan up to this point. However, one incident didn’t make any sense to him.
“What? Jiwoo’s research data was returned? Do you mean the data stolen by the Capricorn Saint?”
Hugo was shocked by the news. He was unable to close his mouth.
“That’s odd. There is no way he would give back such a thing.”
“Maybe he returned it considering the current circumstances.”
“No. There is no way he would do such a thing.”
There had been no decisive proof that the Capricorn Saint had stolen his wife’s research. Someone shameless like him wouldn’t voluntarily give up the research data under such circumstances.
His wife’s research had reached a stage where prototypes had been produced, so it wouldn’t have been hard for the Capricorn Saint to steal her research.
However, the Zodiac Saint in question was currently a bloody mess on the floor.
“That damn Virgo Saint!”
Kevin had appeared out of nowhere with his soldiers and plundered Sergeyevich.
Sergeyevich gnashed his teeth. He was dumbfounded by the reason behind the attack.
- I received information that you covet my territory? You are merely the manufacturing Saint, yet you dare?
- W…What? What are you talking about? We aren’t stupid. Why the hell would we try to attack you? It’s a false rumor! It’s a lie!
- It doesn't matter if it is a false rumor or a lie. Once it entered my ears, it became the truth.
- What?!!! Ahhk!! You crazy bastard!
Kevin was a one-of-a-kind person, but for a different reason than Lee Gun. He razed the main holy ground of the Capricorn temple to the ground.
And he was known as one of the fighting-type Zodiac Saints for a reason. Kevin brought devastation to the entire Capricorn temple. He also didn’t forget to take the spoils of war.
“I want you guys to take all his items and data. I want you guys to take everything.”
“Yes!!”
This was how he was able to acquire Chun Jiwoo’s research data. He then tossed the research data to his subordinate. “These are useless to me. Throw them away.”
“W…what? You want me to throw them away?”
“Yes. Give them to the Sagittarius temple.”
“What? Why the Sagittarius temple?”
“Why else? It’s the garbage incineration plant.”
“Ah… I…I guess it’s an incineration plant. Yes, it’s a solar-powered incineration plant.”
Anyway, this was how Chun Jiwoo’s important research data was returned to the Sagittarius temple.
Due to this incident, the Capricorn temple lost the opportunity to gain wealth and fame from producing the support items.
Thankfully for him, the Capricorn Saint was able to hold on to the missile research among Chun Jiwoo’s research data. In the future, he would use this research to float missiles over each planet like satellites.
It was the missile that Sophie would get hit with in the future.
Anyway, Hugo thought everything would be fine. It was supposed to be fine.
* * *
“Yooha!”
Two weeks after the funeral, Hugo was faced with an entirely different problem. It had to do with Yooha.
“Zodiac Saint-nim! You’re in danger! Please get out of the way!”
