Yooha suddenly started to attack Hugo and the disciples of the Sagittarius temple. The culprit was her arm, which Giselle had tampered with.
Kwahng!
The out-of-control arm was causing a great amount of trouble for the Archer Saint and his disciples
“Damn it! She is a kid who hasn’t even awakened, so why is she so strong…!”
“Zodiac Saint-nim!”
Hugo ground his teeth.
Yooha was powerful enough that a Zodiac Saint was having trouble with her. Moreover, the Zodiacs avoided the evil gods.
Malice and corrupt energy started emanating from Yooha’s arm. Her arm was full of murderous energy that only knew how to destroy.
The evil god had already taken control of Yooha’s mind, and it was running amok.
[Ha ha ha! It’s small, but it has a pretty good body. I can operate inside this! I’ll kill all the Zodiacs and the humans!]
“Zodiac Saint-nim! Ahhhk!”
The power of the evil god injured Hugo and his disciples. At that moment, Giselle appeared at the scene.
“What a mess, Hugo! The people you loved became ashes. Now your daughter is like this.”
“…!!!”
It seemed Giselle still suffered the after-effects of Yooha damaging her face. Her face was covered with bandages.
However, she had come here even in that state for a reason. “I am here to take that child into the Libra temple.”
“What?!”
“If left alone, she’ll become a god of destruction. We’ll make it so that she'll be able to control that power.”
“…!!”
Hugo gnashed his teeth when he realized Giselle’s goal.
Giselle’s eyes flashed.
‘Do you think I’ll let go of a child with that much talent?’
Originally, she had planned on using the child since the child was Hugo’s weakness. She had planned on tormenting Hugo using the child. No human could withstand being invaded by an evil god.
So she would offer him a pain-reducing skill, and Hugo would work under her in return.
‘However, the story changes since she possesses a body that didn’t reject the evil god.’
Awakening the child and then using her would be much more beneficial for Giselle. Yooha could be a great opponent for Carly, whom Giselle was pouring a lot of effort into raising. No, that child might become a nutrient for Carly.
Giselle smirked as she watched Hugo gnash his teeth. “Don’t worry. I won’t let her die. We won’t let a kid with so much talent die. If she becomes a disciple of the Libra temple, she’ll become one of my people. Of course, I’ll treasure her.”
Hugo violently grabbed Giselle by her neck.
Giselle merely let out a chuckle. “Ah. I’ll tell you this because you’re my comrade. If you plan on asking for help from the other Zodiac Saints, you should give up on it. When it comes to the problem of the evil god, none of the other Zodiacs will help you.”
“…!”
Evil gods were an existence that all the gods avoided. This time, not even Hailey would be able to help him.
To catch the rampaging evil god, Giselle smiled as she looked at the tormented Yooha. “I’ll be taking that child. If she’s left alone, she’ll die. The rampaging evil god will take her life energy. The sooner I take her, the better.”
Hugo ground his teeth. The Libra Saint had a unique skill called Equivalent Exchange. It would be able to suppress the evil god. It was a solution that only the Libra Saint possessed.
‘However, I know how Yooha will be treated if she enters the Libra temple!’
She would be a disciple in name only. The Libra Saint would use her like a slave for the rest of her life. Despite knowing this, he had no way of saving Yooha.
‘There has to be another way aside from the Libra Saint…!’
[Binding Chains]
Kwahng!!
“?!”
At that moment, golden chains fell from the sky. They caught the rampaging Yooha.
Kwah-jeek!!
This development saved the Archer disciples from Yooha’s attack.
Hugo and Giselle were shocked.
“That bastard…!”
“Why is that cat here?!”
The one to appear was none other than the Leo Saint Stevens.
Hugo was puzzled by his appearance.
Stevens furrowed his brows as he looked at Hugo. He remembered the last words Hugo had spoken to him.
- Hmmph. What? You’re doing this for the hope of humanity? Don’t try to justify your actions, coward!
It seemed Hugo’s words had evoked some unknown emotion within Stevens.
Giselle smirked. “I don’t know why you are here, but that kid is a disciple of the Libra temple. Hurry up and loosen those chains…”
“The Leo temple will be taking his daughter.”
“W-What?!”
“Do you think my temple would stand by when a talent of her caliber exists?”
He also knew Hugo’s daughter would have a rough time if she was allowed to go to the Libra temple.
On the other hand, Giselle looked dumbfounded. “What nonsense are you talking about right now? That’s an evil god! A calamitous power that all the Zodiacs avoid! In fact, they hate it!”
Giselle was a monarch. So she wasn’t repulsed by the power of the evil god. But the Zodiacs were an entirely different story.
‘It’s a power that the gods hate!’
The mere presence of Yooha was destroying the holy ground of the Sagittarius temple. The other Zodiacs would either banish her from the earth or order the Zodiac Saints to kill her.
However, Stevens snorted. “Did you already forget the distinct features of the Leo temple?”
“!”
“If the Gemini temple has domain over the fairies, the Leo temple can tame beasts and use their power as our own. A beast of that caliber would be considered the highest-rank beast in the Leo temple. There is no way we’ll let such a talent slip by.”
“Even if you take her, what do you think you can do for her? Only the Libra temple can control that….”
“Do you have dementia? I said the Leo temple is a temple that ‘trains’ beasts.”
“…!”
“Our rearing technique will allow us to train that thing.”
“…!!”
Giselle’s face scrunched up.
When Stevens saw her expression, he smirked.
‘If I bring Hugo’s daughter to my side, that woman won’t be able to do anything funny to her.’
Leo was the god of beasts and was known to have the worst personality among the Zodiacs. It had a bad temper, and it couldn’t be reasoned with. This was why the other Zodiacs avoided the awful Leo.
However, this was the first time Leo had heard about this plan.
[Hey! Stevens! What are you doing right now? That’s an evil god! Have you lost your mind? How dare you bring her in without my permission!! Hey!]
If the girl was brought home, Leo threatened to eat Stevens and the girl. It hissed as its hackle rose.
Leo hated the idea of bringing in Yooha, but Stevens ignored his Zodiac.
Hugo seemed to have read Stevens’s intent. He didn’t say anything as he glared at the Leo Saint. Currently, he had only two options to save Yooha: send her to either the Libra temple or the Leo temple.
He hated both their guts, but he had to choose one of them…
Hugo bit his lips hard enough to draw blood.
Stevens laughed when Hugo didn’t attack him. “Anyway, that’s why I’ll be taking this little girl.”
When Stevens picked up Yooha, Giselle became apoplectic. “Cat bastard! The others are standing by and doing nothing, so why are you being like this? Are you trying to help the Archer Saint? Do you want an all-out war with the Libra temple?”
“Buzz off! Why would I let you do something that’ll benefit you? I’ll use the Archer Saint’s daughter to acquire power, then smash you to pieces.”
Giselle became angry. “Hugo! Are you going to do nothing? Your daughter is being taken away…”
Hugo ignored her. In fact, he attacked her.
Giselle became angry. “Damn bastards!!!”
Later, Hugo attacked the holy ground of the Leo temple by himself and beat Stevens to a pulp.

chapters.title: Chapter 487: Book 1, Epilogue 40 - I miss you, my friend
chapters.content:
Book 1, Epilogue 40 - I miss you, my friend
The next day, inside the main palace of the Leo temple.
“Hey, what happened to Zodiac Saint-nim’s room?”
The disciples who had come to work early in the morning stood with their jaws on the floor. The holy ground had been fine the previous day.
“What is this…!”
Stevens’s room, which had been fine the day before, was a mess.
“What the hell? Did a monster appear in the night?”
“That makes no sense. Why would a monster attack only Zodiac Saint-nim’s room?”
It was a valid point.
‘The other locations are fine. Only the floor used by Zodiac Saint-nim was razed to the ground…’
The main palace of the Leo temple was a golden palace, where the Zodiac resided. It was also the building where the first-string members of the temple gathered.
The Leo Temple’s holy ground contained four luxurious buildings with forty floors each. It housed a total of two thousand households, and the top floor of the building was a space used by the Zodiac Saint.
The faces of the disciples turned pale as they looked for Stevens.
“Hey. You guys are being noisy. Go back to your original posts.”
“Zodiac Saint-nim!!”
The disciples were shocked when they saw Stevens. It was to be expected since Stevens appeared with braces around his neck and arms.
“W-What happened, Zodiac Saint-nim?”
“Who did this to you?”
“Who else?! It was that damn bastard Hugo!”
“What?!”
Someone whispered to the shocked disciples, “The Archer Saint came here by himself and destroyed this place throughout the night….!”
“What? He came on his own?! He got past all the security?”
“Yes. The ones in charge of security at night were all sent to the hospital.”
“T…That’s crazy…! This place has the strongest security!”
As expected of a Zodiac Saint, the Archer Saint was on a different level.
However, at that moment, they saw a problem bigger than their holy ground being razed to the ground.
“Zodiac Saint-nim! What is that?”
The disciples who had been at the bottom floor came to Stevens as a group. It seemed they had just come from the training ground.
Seeing their expressions, Stevens lashed out at them. “I told you guys to be quiet! How dare you…!”
“That’s not the problem right now!”
“What is it?!”
“We are talking about the little girl in the training ground!!”
“!!”
The other Leo disciples were surprised by the unexpected news, so they all rushed toward the training ground. And when they reached the training ground, they were shocked.
“T…There really is a little girl here…!”
The girl inside the training ground was a ten-year-old Chun Yooha. She stood out in an organization with rough-looking men.
The small Yooha was bound tight with chains. It seemed she had regained consciousness, and she looked sullen. Her cheeks were puffed up as she pouted. Moreover, Yooha looked cute and very pretty.
The disciples were almost mesmerized by her appearance, but that didn’t matter.
‘That’s the Archer Saint’s daughter!’
‘There are no two ways around it! She was kidnapped!!’
The frozen disciples screamed.
“Damn it! She’s the reason the Archer Saint attacked us!!!”
“Zodiac Saint-nim! You should think about her age! It doesn’t matter if she’s pretty! You shouldn’t take on a child bride— Kuhk!”
After beating up his disciples, Stevens said, “Shut up! That kid will be brought in as one of the first-string members. Teach her well.”
These words shocked the disciples.
Oliver, who was an S-rank at that time, became angry. He would become an SS-rank in the future. “You want to let a female into the Leo temple?”
The Leo temple was quite famous for not letting female disciples enter their temple. Picking disciples for the temple was under the discretion of the generals.
This was why Oliver, a general, was angry when Stevens made this arbitrary decision. “I’m the one who created the guideline for the temple. You may be the Zodiac Saint-nim, but…!”
“I don’t care. Just let her in.”
“…!!”
Oliver ground his teeth. What kind of contribution could a girl like that make to the Leo temple…!
Leo also seemed angry. It threw a tantrum.
[Ahhk! Stevens! I told you not to bring her in! I don’t like having to deal with Libra! Hurry up and send her away!]
“Oh, Master. If we can somehow tame the fragment of the evil god within the child, it’ll become the highest-rank beast. It’ll be a Divine-Beast rank.”
[Uh? Is that so?]
Divine Beast, Predator, Beast, and Herbivore—these were the ranks of the beasts that had a parasitic relationship with the Leo temple.
While the fragment of the evil god in Yooha’s arm posed a great risk, it was still a Divine-Beast-rank being in terms of ability.
Moreover, the only one capable of handling a Divine-Beast-rank being was Stevens. This was why the proposal interested Leo.
“Also, the Sagittarius temple made a pact that they would never cause harm to the Leo temple.”
[What? Really?]
In turn, Stevens was unable to lay a hand on Yooha.
Stevens recalled the events that had occurred in the night.
- Are you here to kill me because I took your daughter?
- I really want to do that.
Despite those words, it seemed Hugo preferred Stevens over Giselle. The only way his daughter would be able to control the fragment of the evil god was to become an awakened being and learn the skills of the Leo temple.
- I’ll leave Yooha in the hands of the Leo temple.
Hugo knew what would be best for his daughter, so he gritted his teeth.
- Instead, I would like to make a contract with you. If you lay even a single finger on Yooha, I’ll immediately kill you.
Hugo growled with a cold look in his eyes.
Anyway, the two Zodiac Saints made a blood pact where both sides wouldn’t touch each other. It offered Hugo a way to protect his daughter, and Stevens would be able to use her power in exchange.
‘Anyway, it was a win-win situation for both sides.’
It was tens of thousands of times better than his daughter being handed over to Giselle.
‘Of course, this will be possible only if the kid can acclimate to this place.’
To suppress the evil god, Yooha would at least need the S-rank taming skill. Reaching that rank would make her a general, and becoming an S-rank in the Leo temple was very difficult.
Among all the Zodiac temples, the Leo temple was one of the three most difficult temples to join. The reason was that the generals of the Leo temple were dreadful and unfriendly.
‘I doubt she can become an S-rank. She might even have a hard time reaching the B rank.’
Oliver’s eyes flashed. He looked at Yooha with a disgruntled expression.
* * *
This was how Yooha grew up within the Leo temple. Her brother Sungjae also grew up, but there was a bit of a problem during his growth process.
Was it because his household was poor? Sungjae was very savvy when it came to economics. He started purchasing and selling items to make money when he was in elementary school.
By the time he reached middle school, he used to do homework for money. He tutored other students and even took mock exams in their place. However, a problem cropped up whenever he did this.
“Hey!! You scored too well on the test!”
“What? What about it? You asked me to do my best since you wanted to dupe your parents. You said this is your third try at your college entrance exam, and your parents can’t find out that you’ve been playing around.”
“The problem is you took it too well! You got the number one score in the country! What the hell am I supposed to do with that mock exam score? What the hell am I supposed to do for my main exam? Anyway, I can’t pay you for this!”
People complained even when he did well on the test! Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
Aside from academics, Sungjae created problems in other fields…
“What?! You received an invitation? You’re being admitted to Harvard?”
“Yes. I made a machine and submitted a dissertation about it. They read it and contacted me.”
“W-What kind of dissertation…”
“Ah! It isn’t a big deal. It was something I was researching in the fan club.”
“F-Fanclub?”
“Lee Gun-nim’s fanclub.”
The disciples were silent.
“Anyway… congratulations! Will you be accepting the invitation to Harvard?”
“Ah. That thing? I already turned it down.”
“What?! Why!”
“The US is busy sucking up to the cat. I can’t buy the latest Lee Gun items there.”
“….”
Chun Sungjae was a fanatic who turned down the opportunity to study at Harvard. He did it for his fandom. It was why everyone was worried about how he would develop. Of course, that wasn’t the biggest problem.
“What?! The Gemini temple? Why would you want to go there?”
This happened after Sungjae became a middle schooler.
Hugo was shocked to hear that his son had joined the Gemini temple. The fact that his son had become an awakened being in secret was also shocking. However, the bigger shock was the temple he chose…!
“If you planned on joining a temple, you should’ve joined your father’s! Why would you join the Gemini temple of all places?!!”
“Dad, you can’t even give your disciples a monthly salary. How can you say that with a straight face?”
“What the hell did you just say?”
Sungjae had become a bloodied mess as soon as he joined the Gemini temple. Hugo was as frustrated as he could be when he witnessed his son’s appearance. Why did he have to join the Gemini temple?
‘Heiji hates Gun more than anyone.’
What would happen if a Lee Gun fanboy went to work under a Zodiac Saint like that?
“That’s all well and good, but you’ll leave that temple as soon as you’re discharged from the hospital. You should study at home! Do you realize how shocked I was when I saw your score? I didn’t expect you to be number one, but how can you get last place in the entire school? How can you get last place when you had a mother who was very smart in school?”
Chun Sungjae pouted.
‘I was dozing off during the entrance exam, so I couldn't bubble in the answer. That’s why I came in last.’
Normally, Hugo wouldn't even check Sungjae’s report card. This was why Chun Sungjae grumbled when Hugo had seen his test score this time. Anyway, Sungjae wasn’t phased at all.
‘I’m sorry, dad! You lost everyone precious to you because of me.’
Chun Sungjae had entered the Gemini temple to search for a way to find his mother’s soul and a way to fix his older sister’s arm.
Hugo was a person traumatized from losing three people precious to him at the hands of the monsters. His daughter’s case couldn’t be helped since she had to learn the skill that would put the evil god to sleep. However, his son…
“Whatever. I want you to leave that temple! I don’t want you getting close to any monsters! If you don’t do as I say, I’ll throw away all the Lee Gun figurines at home!”
“What?! Lee Gun-nim did nothing wrong! Why would you mess with Lee Gun-nim?”
“Anyway, you should give up on being an awakened being!”
“There is no way I’ll give up! I want to be like Lee Gun-nim! I want to become a hero like Lee Gun-nim, who bowed down to no one! I’ll enter the Devil’s Tower!”
“Why are you being like this?”
After having a fight with Sungjae, Hugo threw away all of Sungjae’s Lee Gun collection.
“Dad! What happened to all the Lee Gun-nim in my room?”
“I threw them all away. That’s why you should stick to studying. You shouldn’t look for Lee Gun.”
“What?!”
Due to this incident, an angry Sungjae ran away from home and started living in a villa that his sister used as a storage house. It was the house that Lee Gun would visit in the future.
Anyway, two years had passed since his son had run away from home. Hugo felt complicated emotions as he looked at his son’s Lee Gun collection, which he had hidden in the storage room.
In the beginning, he had been so angry that he wanted to throw them all away. However, he couldn’t bring himself to get rid of these items since he liked Lee Gun as much as his children.
Still, he had mixed feelings in his heart; this would be the twentieth year since Lee Gun had died.
- This is the twentieth year since humanity was freed from Red Eye. It’s the twentieth special anniversary since the death of the thirteenth.
- Some people still claim that Lee Gun is still alive within the Devil’s Tower. What’s your opinion about this?
- It’s nonsense. It’s all wishful thinking.
- I guess you’re right since Lee Gun was a B-rank awakened being. Still, he was an awakened being who did his best with what he got. Ha ha ha.
The world had changed in twenty years. Fake evidence. Fake news. Fake witnesses. Giselle had headed the efforts to fabricate countless pieces of information about Lee Gun. She pulled down Lee Gun’s status as a hero.
In the end, people spoke about Lee Gun in a derogatory manner. Those who were old enough to remember and follow Lee Gun were branded as instigators.
All the Zodiac Saints had their own reasons to either be silent or slander Lee Gun. Some even took his inheritance. Twenty years was enough to change people.
Hailey had disappeared without a trace around five years ago, and all contact with her had ended. In reality, she had been trying to find Time and the true culprit who had killed Lee Gun.
However, Hugo had no way of knowing this. He did his best to stop the misinformation, but it was too late.
- I’m sorry, Hugo-nim… I would like to quit.
- That’s right! Those who have been investigating Lee Gun-nim suffered mysterious deaths! We don’t want to die!
Everyone who had been on Lee Gun’s side was either demoted or went missing.
The media wrote fake articles after taking money. The fake witnesses brought out accounts and evidence that were way too believable.
Lee Gun was erased.
- The Archer Saint is his friend, so he’s delusional. From what I’ve heard, he had been very close to Lee Gun.
- Ha ha. Is he doing all of this to acquire his friend’s inheritance? Birds of a feather do flock together.
Hugo gritted his teeth. Lee Gun was alive. However, a span of twenty years was too long to claim such a thing, and those years had been too long and arduous.
‘I’m past the age where I should be believing in a hero.’
Hugo looked tired as he took out his phone. It was a 2G phone that couldn’t function as a smartphone. An old phone from twenty years ago, it could only make calls or send texts. This made everyone curious.
- Oh my, Hugo-nim! That’s a very old phone. You should hurry up and get the newest model.
- Ah. I have to change my number if I want to use the latest phone…
It was the phone that he had been using since he had met Lee Gun. Basically, it was the number that Lee Gun knew.
Changing his number was easy, but…
‘He might call me someday.’
Hugo knew he was being an idiot. Still, there was a chance that his friend was alive, and there might come a day when his friend would call him. He might call like always and nonchalantly ask Hugo to have a drink with him.
This was why Hugo couldn’t get rid of the phone.
‘Is it time for me to forget about him?’
Despite getting such thoughts, he was unable to get rid of Sungjae’s Lee Gun figurines again. He merely cleaned them before putting them away in storage.
Hugo got up.
‘I’ll get rid of this phone after I finish the commission from England. This time, I will do it.’
It was just in time for the twentieth anniversary. He thought it would be a good time to get rid of the phone and put everything behind him.
However, Hugo experienced something shocking soon after.
“Ah. Yes… I saw it too. I saw the destruction of the Devil’s tower. I saw it, but…”
Two days later, the world was in a state of turmoil; the Devil’s Tower had been destroyed.
Because of his commission, Hugo had arrived at the UK airport, and he was being bombarded with calls.
- Hugo-nim!! The Devil’s Tower was destroyed! Destroyed!!! Could it be Lee Gun-nim’s doing?!
- How do you feel about this?!
Hugo became angry when he heard this.
‘There is no way Gun is alive.’
Moreover, they were the ones who had laughed off the idea of Lee Gun being alive, so why were they acting like this now?
“Such a thing isn't possible. My friend is already dead.”
In the end, Hugo’s mood turned foul, so he got up and ended the call. The reason for his bad mood was the media looking for him.
- Hugo Otis-nim. Please come to the front desk for a moment. We need to check your luggage.
“What is it this time? Is it the reporters?”
He had already given up on everything related to his friend, so Hugo was irritated. He was about to leave his seat for a moment when…
Brrr!
The old phone inside his bag rang.
It had come after twenty years. He had received a call from his friend who he couldn’t wait to see for the longest time.

chapters.title: Chapter 488: Book 2, Epilogue 1 - Return of the Hero(?) (1)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 1 - Return of the Hero(?) (1)
Hugo still couldn’t forget what Lee Gun had said to him three years ago. Lee Gun was voluntarily choosing death by leaving the earth.
“What? Have you lost your mind? You really plan on going to the World of Emptiness?”
“Yes.”
“Why would you go there? Do you plan on dying a lonely death there?”
The World of Emptiness was a world where sinners were sent. The sinners would become the slaves of the Universe and work eternally.
In other words, one’s status didn’t matter there. It was a prison camp where one was tortured for the rest of one’s existence.
It was so bad that even the highest-ranked gods like the Great Spirits would decide to perish instead of going to that world.
Hugo knew what kind of place it was, and there was no way he would let Lee Gun go there. He was steadfast in stopping Lee Gun.
However, Lee Gun laughed as he said, “Don’t worry about it. I’ll be back.”
“Gun.”
“When I meet you next time, I’m going to ask for a lot of things from you.”
Leaving behind those words, the hero disappeared from the world. It was as if he had never existed in the first place.
And three years passed just like that.
“Will Lee Gun-nim be able to really come back?”
“I’m not so sure. The chances of returning from the World of Emptiness is said to be less than 0.001%….”
“Still, it’s Lee Gun-nim we’re talking about.”
“!”
“That’s right. Also, the other goddesses went to the World of Emptiness to look for Lee Gun-nim.”
Everyone who remembered Lee Gun earnestly prayed for his return. This was the same for Hugo, who was indebted to Lee Gun.
‘Gun.’
Lee Gun had saved a sinner like him. Hugo was resolved to wait for Lee Gun’s return until his life was over.
‘Please, just come back. That’s all I want.’
It didn’t matter if Lee Gun would break his back by asking for a lot of things from him. If Lee Gun came back, Hugo was willing to do anything for him. He was willing to overlook any of Lee Gun’s actions.
At least, that was what he had promised himself.
In the present…
[Hugo!!!]
“?!”
Hugo shook when he realized someone was looking for him by screaming his name. He wondered who was screaming when he saw a flock of frightened ravens flying toward him.
They were the Constructs of the Sagittarius temple.
[Hugo!!! Are you listening? This is bad!]
[Lee Gun-nim is…! Lee Gun-nim is…!!]
Hugo’s face turned pale when he heard the name. He stood up from the dining table. “What? What’s going on? What about Gun? Did he destroy a room this time? Did he kill someone? Did he burn someone? What did he do?”
[No! He opened the wrappers to the chocolates!]
“W…What?”
[He opened the poisoned chocolate that you made to kill the cat!]
“What?!”
[He even opened the liquor-filled chocolates! They contain vodka!!!]
Hugo screamed. “Ahhhk! I put them in the safe so that he wouldn’t be able to eat them!!! How the hell did he get to it?”
Hugo almost cursed, but he knew he didn’t have time to dawdle. He immediately headed somewhere. He ran to the attic, which contained the safe.
The safe contained weapons. It also contained all the tributes Hugo had gathered and planned on offering to Sagittarius.
It was a treasure warehouse with all kinds of superb items. However, the treasures weren’t what was important.
“Ahhhk! Gun!!” Hugo quickly entered the room with the safe.
A baby who hadn’t even reached his first birthday was eating something. The baby had destroyed the safe into dust. Chocolate wrappers with skulls and crossbones printed on them were lying around him!
At one time, Sagittarius had worked Hugo without paying him. Hugo had detested Sagittarius so much that he had created poisonous chocolates. He had planned on mixing them into the tributes so that Sagittarius would get a stomachache.
Hugo almost lost his mind when he saw this. He picked up the small baby, who was the size of his forearm.
“Gun! No! Spit it out!! Ptooey!!!”
However, the baby had eaten it all. The baby’s soft cheeks were full like that of a hamster. To make matters worse, both his hands were grasping chocolate that contained alcohol!
Hugo turned pale from fright. He grabbed the baby’s soft cheeks and squeezed them. “Spit it out, Gun!!! It’s way too early for you to eat this!! You’re a good boy, right? At the very least, you should eat it after you get your ID. Ok?!”
The baby completely ignored him. He started swallowing everything in his mouth, making Hugo and the ravens scream.
[Ahhk! He swallowed it!]
[Get the doctor!!!!]
“Honey!!! Look what Gun did!”
Familiar faces appeared when they heard Hugo’s screams from the second floor.
“What’s wrong?”
“Hugo-nim!”
“Dad!”
They were Chun Jiwoo, Goat, Lee Jaewon, and the Chun siblings.
Seeing his family, Hugo shouted as he fought the baby using his strength, “Yooha! Sungjae! You guys have Time’s Data left behind by Gun, right?! Bring it here! I have to make it spit it out!”
Chun Jiwoo immediately realized what was going on. She laughed. “Ah. It’s fine. The outer packaging is still the same, but I swapped out all the contents already.”
“W-What?!”
“There is no way Lee Gun-nim would do something wrong. He’s merely a one-year-old child without any of his memories.”
“…!”
Yes, it had happened half a year ago. Lee Gun, who had disappeared into the World of Emptiness, had come back to the earth.
In the beginning, no one thought it really was Lee Gun. This was to be expected since a newly born baby had appeared in front of them. However…
‘He does act like Gun.’
His return had been very noisy since he had set off the alarm for Red-zone-rank monsters. Due to that, the baby had been mistaken for a monster. This was why Hugo had a hard time taking Lee Gun back to his place.
Anyway, it didn’t matter in the end.
- It’s Uncle!!!!
- Lee Gun-nim!!
Everyone shed tears of joy when Lee Gun made his return. Of course, they weren’t sure if the baby was Lee Gun in the beginning. However, they became more sure as they took care of the child.
Whether it was the ears, eyes, mouth, or nose, the baby had Lee Gun’s features.
Hugo wailed as he spoke.
- That’s right, Gun. I’ll raise you well! I don’t care if you break my back! You can spend whatever you want! Just grow up healthy! You can do whatever you want now!
Hugo and his family were happy to take on Lee Gun’s infant care… But the infant care was…
“Excuse me, Hugo-nim. Are you ok? What about this month’s living expenses?”
“….”
When Goat whispered those words, Hugo grabbed the back of his neck. His friend had returned with an angelic face, and it was great to have him back. However, this didn’t change the fact that the baby acted like the damn Lee Gun.
‘How much do I have to spend a month on feeding him?’
He was a baby who hadn’t even celebrated his first birthday! He should be eating baby food and a baby-like portion!
- Ahhk! Hugo-nim! Lee Gun-nim ate all the Korean beef inside the fridge!
- Kyahhk! Hugo-nim! Lee Gun-nim just tried to open the bottle of alcohol!!!
- Ahhk!!! Hugo-nim! Lee Gun-nim drank all the formula! We refilled a hundred servings yesterday…!
Lee Gun had always been a big eater. Since he recharged his own magical energy, he ate several times more than the others.
‘The rate at which he’s eating is no longer in the realm of a human.’
Sometimes, when Hugo lost track of Lee Gun, Lee Gun would display bizarre behavior. He would try to stuff raw meat into his stomach. That wasn’t all.
‘He’s very picky about what he eats.’
Hugo was entirely in charge of Lee Gun’s infant care. Whether it was baby food or powdered milk, Lee Gun would somehow know if the food contained inferior ingredients. He would torture Hugo by abstaining from eating or drinking those products.
In fact, Hugo had tried to lower his food bill. He had bought lower-quality formula and baby food containing low-quality meat. He had tried to feed it to Lee Gun.
- Ptooey!!!
- ?!
- Ptooey, ptooey, ptooey!
- Hey!
- Ptooey!!!!!!!!!!!
Lee Gun spat it all back out as if he wouldn’t even entertain eating the cheaper stuff!! He even glared(?) at Hugo for daring to feed him such food and slammed his small hand on the ground!! Then he slammed the small bowl shaped like a bird’s nest on the ground in protest!!
‘Damn it! He’s acting like this despite being still wet behind his ears!!’
Moreover, Lee Gun refused to wear cheap clothes or diapers!!!
To cut back on child-rearing expenses, Hugo had bought clothes that wore out quickly and cheap disposable diapers.
But, as soon as he wore them, Lee Gun kicked the diaper bag and the garments. It was as if he was complaining about Hugo cutting corners.
That was why Hugo ground his teeth as he forced himself to buy baby suits made with quality fabrics and high-quality diapers.
Of course, Hugo’s bad name had been cleared thanks to Lee Gun, and his earnings potential had grown. He had less monetary stress in his daily life. He could afford to pay these infant care expenses, but this was too much!
‘He’s merely a baby, yet he wants all the good stuff.’
Lee Gun was reborn as a baby by going through inheritance.
‘Since he’s newly born, there is no way he remembers us.’
Therefore, Hugo couldn’t treat Lee Gun as usual. He had to hold back his temper.
Gnashing his teeth, Hugo thought about what he had gone through in recent days.
It seemed the Chun siblings had read his thoughts. The Chun siblings, who had come running when they heard their father’s scream, grumbled.
“That’s why I said I’ll look after Uncle.”
“I’m confident we’ll do a much better job in raising him, Dad.”
“!”
When Lee Gun had been mistaken for a monster, Hugo had a very difficult time bringing the baby into his household.
In the beginning, the Chun siblings had stepped forward in their desire to raise Lee Gun. Their mother was too busy taking care of their youngest sister Jisoo, who was three years old. The Chun siblings didn’t want their father or someone else raising Lee Gun, so they volunteered themselves.
However, Hugo went wild in chasing them away.
- There is no way I’ll let you guys do that!!!
He went far as to bar them from approaching the baby. Everyone wondered why Hugo refused to let the two take care of raising the child.
Hugo’s answer was simple.
“Since it’s Uncle, didn’t you say he’ll grow into an adult faster, right?”
“!”
Yooha had been standing near the doorway. When she heard Chun Sungjae’s words, her eyes twinkled.
“I’m confident that I can raise him by myself. I’ll raise him into someone who won’t be able to marry anyone except me.”
“?!”
“No. I can raise him as a daughter. Or maybe I can make myself a young girl. I’ll be his childhood friend. I can steer Uncle’s ideal type to being his childhood friend…”
“There is no way I’ll leave him to you guys!!! The fact that you guys are saying such things ensures it!!!!”
Hugo became angry at his children’s impure intentions(?).
This was why Hugo hadn’t entrusted Lee Gun to them.
‘Even now they are trying to brainwash(?) him whenever they get the chance.’
He was most worried about his son, who was twisted(?) in the head.
Anyway, Hugo felt bad about letting his busy subordinates take care of Lee Gun. This was why he chose to raise Lee Gun since he had a lot of experience raising children. That was all well and good, but…
“I give up.”
Yooha hadn’t caused any trouble as a child. Sungjae might have been fussy, but Hugo knew Sungjae’s one soft spot…
Moreover, anything related to Lee Gun held both their interests. He was like the final boss that made them docile!
This was why Hugo and Jaewon had reached peak levels in raising a child. Due to this, Hugo had thought raising an infant wouldn’t be too hard.
However, for the past half year, Hugo had gone through hell in raising the child. No, it was a torment worse than hell.
‘It would be easier to kill a monarch than to raise him’
On the other hand, everyone’s eyes turned round when Hugo expressed those thoughts.
“Lee Gun-nim is fussy?”
“He is. He’s very picky about his food, and he won’t even look at anything cheap. He likes only meat. Even if there is a hint of vegetable in his food, he’ll throw it away. He throws a tantrum if it isn’t to his taste. Can’t you tell by looking at his temper tantrums? I’m sure you guys are having trouble too…”
Everyone looked all the more puzzled.
“Really? That’s odd. He eats whatever we give him…”
“W-What?”
“There are some times when Hugo-nim lets us look after him. When you told us that he was a picky eater, we were worried. However, those worries were for nothing. We had to make the baby food in haste, yet he ate it all.”
“That’s right. He didn’t complain about the food at all. He was such an angel…”
“What the hell?!!”
Unable to believe it, Hugo entered the kitchen with the baby in his arms. He had already prepared baby food made out of spinach and potato.
Hugo had planned on teaching Lee Gun a lesson(?). He would feed vegetables to Lee Gun since Lee Gun needed the nutrients. Hugo had made the food with the resolve that he would be going into a bloody battle against Lee Gun.
Hugo gave the spoon to Jiwoo. “Here. Try feeding him! He’s so picky about his food that he throws it away if he gets a whiff of vegetables in it. You have to see how nasty his temper is….”
However…
“Oh my!” Chun Jiwoo touched her face as if she was surprised.
The baby Lee Gun ate from the spoon that Chun Jiwoo held up. He ate the spinach baby food as if it was delicious.
“He's asking for more.”
Hugo was dumbfounded. His mouth fell open. “Hey!!! When I gave you the same thing, you kicked the dining table! You destroyed the gas stove!?”
Lee Gun acted as if he had never done such a thing. He ignored Hugo as he ate the baby food that the others gave him.
“Oh my! He’s too cute!”
Everyone was dying from happiness. They started fighting each other to feed Lee Gun.
Hugo shook as he snorted. “It seems he’s willing to eat anything since he’s hungry. Let’s see when it comes to his nap time. He’s a demon.”
“When you put him down for a nap?”
“That’s right! His true nature comes out! He doesn’t like to sleep at all. It doesn’t matter what I do! He only complains!”
Everyone once again looked puzzled.
“…really? We just need to sing one lullaby to make him fall asleep…”
“What? That’s nonsense! If I could have solved it with that, I wouldn’t have gone through so much trouble in the past six months! Look! He becomes most tyrannical right after he eats—”
Hugo couldn’t believe his eyes when he saw Lee Gun.
“Oh my! Lee Gun-nim is taking a nap. He must be full.”
“?!!”
This was more than sleeping. Lee Gun had an angelic expression on his face.
Feeling a great sense of betrayal, Hugo grabbed Lee Gun by the collar(?), “Hey!!! Wake up!!”
“H…Husband!”
“You aren’t normally like this!! No matter how full you are, you never go to sleep!! Hey!! Wake up! I tried everything to make you go to sleep for the past half year. I couldn’t even go to sleep at night!!”
“Zodiac Saint-nim!!”
“You also never stay still when I change your diaper!!!”
Everyone’s eyes turned round when they witnessed Hugo’s anger. The reason for their surprise was one word.
“Diaper?”
Everyone looked at Hugo as if he was being weird.
“Why are you looking at me like that? What’s wrong with using diapers?”
“We’ve never changed diapers for him.”
“W…What?”
“Oh my! It really is true now that I think about it.”
“Is it the same for you, Madam?”
“Uh? It’s the same for us.”
“That’s odd. Why does he never go potty when we look after him?”
“He is such a mild-mannered and kind person, so why…”
They murmured among themselves as they looked at Hugo.
On the other hand, Hugo’s expression was a sight to behold. At this point, he realized the truth. “You little shit. Did you act that way toward only me??!! You complained about the food and the naptime with only me?! You went on a power trip and screwed with only me?!”
“M…Maybe?”
“H…Hugo-nim?”
An enraged Hugo grabbed Lee Gun. “Hey. Say something! Don’t act like you don’t remember anything! In fact, is it even true that you don’t have your memories?! Hey! Answer me!”
The baby pretended not to hear anything. Lee Gun had an angelic expression on his face as he slept, making Hugo scream.

chapters.title: Chapter 489: Book 2, Epilogue 2 - Return of the Hero(?) (2)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 2 - Return of the Hero(?) (2)
“Oh my! Lee Gun-nim is sleeping very well today.” Chun Jiwoo looked at the baby Lee Gun with surprise. “Normally, he would be hungry by now. He would be awake, and…”
If one observed Lee Gun’s actions, it would become clear that Lee Gun wasn’t human. The size of his stomach was inhuman. He frequently woke up because of hunger.
This time, it was different. Four hours had passed, yet Lee Gun kept sleeping without becoming fussy!
Hugo was surprised.
‘Whenever I looked at him, he would wake up every thirty minutes and torment me.’
The Chun siblings commented as well.
“Uncle is sleeping well thanks to me. That’s why you should let me change his diapers.”
“Stop lying, Noona. This is all thanks to my special massage. That’s why you should let me be in charge of educating him.”
“….” Hugo looked at his children, dumbfounded.
His reaction was understandable since each of the Chun siblings was holding half of Lee Gun.
The head of the baby Lee Gun was resting on Yooha’s thighs, and his short legs were placed on top of Sungjae’s knees. The siblings were roughly sharing half of Lee Gun as they allowed Lee Gun to sleep.
Hugo realized his children were scary. They looked for every opportunity to pounce on Lee Gun. When he saw them each hold half of the sleeping Lee Gun, he said, “I’m just throwing this out there just in case. If you take half of him, not even Gun would be able to survive. You guys can’t do it because he will really die.”
“What are you saying?”
“Why would you tell us such an obvious thing?”
What do they mean “why”? Hugo had said it because they really looked like they would split Lee Gun in half!
Hugo pretended as if it didn’t bother him, but he was anxious.
Chun Jiwoo burst out laughing. “Still, it’s a relief. At one point, I wondered what would happen.”
“….”
Hugo still seemed appalled as he looked at Lee Gun. The events of that day were still vivid in his mind.
* * *
It was around half a year ago.
“Get out of the way, Hugo!”
Alongside the monster alarm, a baby had appeared on the earth and destroyed Hugo’s home. To make matters worse, a big fight had erupted because of the baby. It was enough to mobilize forces from all over the world.
“Hugo! Get out of the way! Didn’t you hear the Red Zone alert?”
“That’s right. That child is a monster!”
The monsters had been finally pushed out of this world, yet the monster alert system had run once again. Naturally, it caused great tension around the world.
In fact, several hundred armed disciples were gathered in front of Hugo’s house. High-ranking officials from various countries had appeared alongside the Zodiac Saints.
“We finally found peace. If we don’t get rid of the baby, it might be the situation with the monarchs all over again…!”
They raised their blades against Hugo and his household, who held the child. They wanted Hugo and his household to hand over the child.
Moreover, Hugo and his household were the only ones trying to protect the baby of unknown origin. If Hugo hadn’t protected the baby, the nations would have already given the order to get rid of Lee Gun.
Stevens and the disciples from various countries tried to go after Chun Jiwoo, who held the baby in her arms.
“Give us that child, Hugo.”
“No, I can’t let you have him. That child is Gun”
“What?!”
“Hugo-nim!”
After sending his wife toward the back, Hugo glared at the others. He was warning them to stand back.
Stevens sighed as he confronted Hugo. “I know you were the closest to him, so I understand the emotions you must be feeling right now. However, there is no proof that this infant is Lee Gun. Also, don’t we have the duty to protect the earth instead of Lee Gun? What if that child is an intelligence-type monster pretending to be Lee Gun?”
“It is Gun.”
“Do you have proof?”
“I doubt you guys will believe me even if I did tell you.”
“Then…!”
“If you come any closer, I’ll kill you.”
“!”
Hugo’s eyes flashed. “You’ll have to face me before you try to get rid of this child.”
“Wait…!”
Kwahng!
“!”
The Zodiac Saints and the disciples flinched as Hugo didn’t hesitate to release the power of Eternal Change. The chaotic energy of a monarch fiercely emanated from his body.
In front of the power of a first-generation monarch, everyone naturally became guarded.
‘Is he willing to put his life on the line for this fight?’
‘He has finally lost his mind thanks to Lee Gun!’
Since they had faced off against the old monarchs, they gulped. Hugo had previously been charged with betraying humanity before.
It had all been an act to dupe Wind. He had done it to drive out the monarchs. When this truth had come out, the suspicion toward Hugo had dissipated, but…
‘You still haven’t moved public sentiment to your side, yet you’re trying to protect a monster.’
‘There is no way the people around the world will believe you.’
At that moment…
“If you don’t plan on contributing to the money needed to buy powdered formula, you guys can buzz off.”
“!”
Kwahng!!
In a flash, Yooha’s spear brushed past their faces.
The Zodiac Saints flinched.
“If you plan on taking Lee Gun-nim, all the members of the Sagittarius temple will declare war on you.”
Lee Jaewon and the Archer disciples had their bows aimed. Even Chun Sungjae was letting out flames from his body.
A terrifying air of tension hit the people gathered there. Amid this tension, murderous intent emanated from some of them.
However, before a war could break out, unexpected figures stepped forward.
“Let’s leave it at that.”
“Hey! Virgo Saint!”
“Right. Let’s just say Hugo is right.”
“Heiji!”
“It probably is Lee Gun.”
“Liv!”
When the three of them sided with Hugo, Sophie looked shocked. These three were the ones who had the worst relationship with Lee Gun and Hugo. Now that they had decided to take Hugo’s side, Sophie had no idea how she should respond.
Kevin spoke as if he found all this tiresome. “There is no way that idiot pushover will fail to recognize his own god. Above all else…”
Kevin shook his head from side to side as he looked at the Chun siblings, who were literally panting in joy as they looked at the baby.
“Also, they won’t be forgiving if it’s found out that he’s a fake.”
“…”
They immediately agreed with that take. The Chun siblings were already saying things like, “Ha! His nostril looks the same as Uncle’s,” “His eyebrows and ears look the same too,” and “Let’s try counting his eyelashes!”
When the Chun siblings started to geek out, the conversation was over.
Of course, there were conditions to the retreat.
Kevin said to Hugo, “If he’s really Lee Gun, the world will be happy. However, it’s as you’ve acknowledged. Lee Gun doesn’t possess his memories. There is no way we’ll be able to really confirm if he’s Lee Gun or not.”
“…”
“The energy of a monster can be sensed from him, and we have no idea if he’s an ally or not. That’s why you’ll keep watch on him and give us periodic reports. Those terms are a must, and if he becomes a being that threatens humanity…”
Hugo sighed when he heard Kevin’s cold words. He knew why Kevin was saying them.
While Kevin might be speaking like this, Hugo knew Kevin was working to save them. Hugo was already being monitored by the world for being a traitor. So those next words were inevitable.
“Alright. If that child becomes a monster, I’ll take responsibility. I’ll get rid of him. You guys won’t have to do anything.”
As if he had heard an answer that was 100% correct, Kevin turned around after patting Hugo’s shoulder.
“Did you hear that? If something bad happens, the Sagittarius temple will take responsibility for it. We won’t have to do anything tedious. Let’s head back.”
“What?! This is a bit…!”
“That’s right. How can we let someone still under suspicion— Kuhk!”
Kevin roughly grabbed the necks of the disciples who protested. He let out murderous intent, as though he was ready to wring their necks. “Zodiac Saints are busy people. Do you plan on blowing this out of proportion? Do I need to shed the blood of idiots like you guys?”
“N…No. I’m sorry. Kuhk!”
In the end, the order to retreat was given.
Stevens discreetly moved toward Hugo. “We’ll be monitoring you in name only. Everyone will be happy if you’re right about him not being an enemy. I hope he’s Lee Gun. Just don’t forget to send a report. I don’t mind if you send it in private.”
“What? Report?”
Stevens had a serious expression on his face as he placed his hands on Hugo’s shoulders. “That’s right. Above all else, let me know if he still has his memories! That’s the most important part!”
“…??” Hugo looked at Stevens as if the latter were speaking nonsense.
Stevens was grabbing Hugo’s shoulders hard enough to break them, and he was sweating. He looked afraid of something.
When even Stevens went along with it, his subordinates shouted in surprise.
“Why are we handing him over? We have to ascertain his identity!”
“Also, Hugo Otis is still under watch!”
“That’s right. What if Hugo Otis is trying to raise a monster in secret from humanity…!”
“No, we are handing him over.”
“What?”
“Do you guys not see that?”
“W-What? What are you…”
Stevens felt a chill run up his spine as he looked at the baby. He couldn’t see the baby’s face, but the baby was letting out the aura of a monster.
For some reason, it felt as if they would all be killed if they didn’t agree to hand him over to Hugo.
Anyway, this was the situation that Hugo found himself in. The baby hadn’t been recognized as Lee Gun, and they were under surveillance. This was why Hugo couldn’t take steps to adopt the baby. It was also the start of Hugo’s happy(?) days of child-rearing.
Anyway, Hugo had thought he would be able to have a happy time geeking out about Lee Gun, but…
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhk!!”
Happy time, my ass! Hugo was woken up at dawn when he heard the sound of his house breaking. He ran toward the room that Lee Gun was in.
As soon as Hugo entered the room that had the sound-dampening skill placed over it, he clasped his ears shut. The sound of the baby crying was destroying the room.
“Weh! Weh! Wehhhh!”
Lee Gun’s wails were loud enough to almost destroy the eardrums of a Zodiac Saint! It was like watching a monster cry, but Hugo acted as if he was used to this. He picked up a new diaper.
“Woah, woah! That’s right! Your cool and awesome dad will change your diaper right now!”
Kwahng!!!
“Ahhk!!”
It seemed the baby disliked what Hugo had said. He slammed his cute little hand against the ground, making the floor crack.
Hugo changed Lee Gun’s diaper and said, “You’re all clean now. Now you can go back to sleep— Huh? Ahhhk!!!”
Hugo screamed. “Damn it! You should go all at once!!!”
As soon as he had cleaned number 2, the baby had peed. Hugo was a clean freak, so he grumbled as he changed diapers again.
Bboo-jeek!
“Ahhk!!!!”
In the end, the baby alternated between peeing and pooping. The process repeated around ten times.
Moreover, Lee Gun kept staring at Hugo as if he expected Hugo to change him again.
“Not yet. I won’t change it until you go again. This time, you can go all at once! Go on and do it! Diapers these days have good absorbent material. You can go number 1 again!”
“….”
The baby held his rattle and looked at Hugo as if he was unsatisfied.
“Ha ha ha. Once you go around ten more times in there, Dad will change it tomorrow! Ha ha ha ha! You can’t change diapers on your own, right? Uh?”
At that moment, Hugo almost fainted from surprise.
“Ahhk!!”
As if he was calling out Hugo’s nonsense, Lee Gun was about to slam the small rattle against the ground.
For some reason, Hugo’s face turned pale at this. “Alright! I’ll change it, my dear Gun! Dad was wrong! I was wrong!”
It didn’t take long for the floor to crack, and the second floor cratered.
Kwahng!!
In the end, a single strike was enough to destroy the floor, and Hugo fell to the first floor.
It didn’t take long for Chun Jiwoo to come running in surprise. “Husband! Are you ok? Dear!! What happened?”
Hugo felt like dying. He let out a hollow smile. “I…I’m fine. Do you mind changing Gun’s diaper for me? He’s having a hard time falling asleep because of it…!!!”
“What? What are you talking about? Lee Gun-nim fell asleep… He’s sleeping like an angel…”
It seemed the baby didn’t want Chun Jiwoo to take his diapers off and had run away. However, Chun Jiwoo was experienced in child-rearing. She just had to touch the diaper to realize something. It puzzled her.
“His diaper is fresh. Did you change it?”
“What? There is no way….”
At that moment…
[Ah! I changed his diaper, servant.]
“!”
A female Construct appeared next to Hugo. It was Disinfectant (Iaso).
[Lee Gun-nim tasked us to take care of his business.]
“W-What? What do you mean take care of his business?”
[He put me in charge of changing the diaper.]
“?!!”
Until now, no one other than Hugo had to change Lee Gun’s diaper. The answer to this mystery was solved now.
[While he may not remember us, he instinctively knows that we will take care of him if he is in discomfort.]
When Iaso said that, Eeny, Meeny, and Miny made their appearance. They wailed in joy.
[That’s right! It just took a couple of times for him to see us! He caught on that we would change his diaper if he signaled with his hand! As expected of Master, he’s smart!]
[We are usually scattered conducting missions. However, he just has to give the signal, and we’ll come running to him!]
[That’s right! We even bring him food! He does make a fuss if anyone other than Iaso changes his diaper, but anyway, we take care of all the other things he needs!]
“…?!”
Hugo’s pupils shook.
‘What? He just needs to signal with his finger, and his Constructs will come to him?’
‘They were changing the diapers already? I didn’t need to change it?’
That meant the baby had been tormenting him despite having his Constructs…
The Constructs didn’t know what Hugo had been going through, so they spoke proudly.
[We’ve been looking after all of Master’s needs. You must have had an easy time since you had nothing to do, right?]
[Hurry up and bow to us in thanks. We made it so that you wouldn’t have to do much.]
“What did you just say!!!”
[???]
Feeling aggrieved, Hugo pounded his chest. Bow down in thanks, my ass! Do they not realize how much he…! How much he….!!!
Hugo grabbed the back of his neck. At this point, Hugo realized something was off. He looked at Lee Gun. He was raising the young Gun as an amazing dad(?), but…
‘That bastard, Gun’
What was going on? The baby was acting like Lee Gun in messing with him. No, this surpassed whatever had happened in the past.
Hugo looked at the kid with suspicion in his eyes. There was no way Lee Gun had his memories since he went through inheritance…
Was he doing all of this on instinct…?

chapters.title: Chapter 490: Book 2, Epilogue 3 - Return of the Hero(?) (3)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 3 - Return of the Hero(?) (3)
“You deserve it.”
“What the hell did you just say?”
“I said you deserve it.”
Hugo became angry at the man and woman correcting him.
The ones visiting him were none other than the Virgo Saint Kevin and Gemini Saint Heiji. They were the only two around the world who had helped Hugo bring Lee Gun into his household.
This was why Hugo didn’t chase them out. He had invited them into his house, yet they dared say such a thing??
“I deserve it? I deserve being dropped into parenting hell?” Hugo, who was using a rocking bed to put Lee Gun to sleep, got angry.
Kevin smirked as he drank his coffee mix. “You reap what you sow. Who let Lee Gun go to the World of Emptiness on his own? I was disgusted by it, so I ignored your request for funds. I’m surprised you went through it without going bankrupt. It would have been great if you had died from bankruptcy.”
“I see. That’s why you turned down my request…” Hugo’s eyes flashed as he grabbed Kevin by his collar. “Bastard. You still have memories of Lee Gun! You didn’t forget about him!”
After Lee Gun had disappeared into the World of Emptiness, most of humanity had lost their memories of Lee Gun.
The Zodiac Saints with a low amount of Faith toward Lee Gun had also forgotten about him.
Hugo didn’t want the evidence that his friend had lived in this world to disappear. This was why he had asked for monetary support in the upkeep of the Lee Gun’s building.
[Kevin: Lee Gun? Who is that? ㅋ? I don’t know who that is. ㅋ?]
[Stevens: Lee Gun? Is it a goddess?]
[Sophie: Who is that???]
Kevin was one of those who had asked him who Lee Gun was. Thankfully, Heiji had remembered Lee Gun, so Hugo was able to borrow the repair fee from her.
“Bastard. You acted as if you forgot Gun. You didn’t help me on purpose!”
“Hmmph. You reap what you sow.”
“Why the hell would you say that?!”
Kevin clicked his tongue as if Hugo could say nothing to justify his actions. “You allowed Lee Gun to die. Who the hell are you in the first place to allow Lee Gun to go to the World of Emptiness alone? Lee Gun is someone I have to kill.”
“…?!”
“Thankfully, Lee Gun is back. The fact that he went to the World of Emptiness meant he was going to die. You didn’t put up much of a fight. You let Lee Gun go alone.”
Kevin had developed a grudge against Hugo for this. It was why he had ignored Hugo’s request for help.
Despite this, Kevin had used political power and money to crush anyone who suggested demolishing Lee Gun’s Building.
Kevin glared at Hugo with eyes full of resentment. “If we were by his side, we would have never let Lee Gun go to the World of Emptiness. We wouldn’t have allowed it even if we would have had to transfer his Karmic Debt to someone else.”
Kevin had recovered the memories of his past life. Since he used to be a pillar-rank angel, he knew what kind of place the World of Emptiness was.
“The fact that he was able to come back through inheritance was a miracle.”
Kevin held such a big grudge that he didn’t even bother making eye contact with Hugo.
Back then, Hugo’s children and subordinates had expressed feeling a similar type of grudge, so Hugo had nothing to say. Still, he thought it was a step too far.
‘He acted as if he had lost his memories???’
As he had that thought, Hugo looked at Heiji.
Kevin was snobbish. He acted as if he was the only one who existed in this world. He wasn’t close to anyone, and Heiji was one of the people that he had a terrible relationship with.
“You heard him. You suffered damage because of him. Don’t you want to take revenge on him?”
“….”
“Heiji?”
When Heiji gave no response, Hugo furrowed his eyes. “What the hell? This isn’t like you. Why are you so quiet…”
However, Hugo was at a loss for words when he saw her.
Heiji’s gaze was rooted on Lee Gun, who was sleeping inside the rocking bed. The baby had a small face, large eyes, and long eyelashes. His cheeks were milky and soft.
Lee Gun was peacefully sleeping as he made little fists. Heiji didn’t know what to do with herself when she saw this. Her face was flushed.
‘H…He’s so cute.’
How could a child be so pretty like this? She wanted to touch Lee Gun once. She kept extending her hand before pulling it back, looking conflicted.
Hugo started to sweat. “H-Has she been like this since she arrived here?”
“Yes.”
If this weren’t someone else’s house, Heiji would have hugged Lee Gun to her bosom. No, she might have tried to kidnap him.
Anyway, she agonized over what to do for a very long time before she looked at Hugo with a serious expression. “You must be struggling since you welcomed a third child, right? I’ll take on all the monetary burden. Do you think I can take and raise him— Kyaa!”
Heiji screamed when a spear was thrown at her from an unknown direction.
“How dare you?” It didn’t matter that her opponent was a Zodiac Saint; Yooha looked very annoyed.
Heiji was shocked by the look in Yooha’s eyes. She got up and touched the wound on her cheek. “Have you lost your mind? How dare you lay a hand on me?” Heiji approached Yooha as if she wanted to throw down.
On the other hand, Yooha remained serious. Heiji was a Zodiac Saint who had impure thoughts toward Lee Gun.
‘I can’t let her find out that Uncle will grow up in no time.’
She wouldn’t make the mistake of letting the number of her foes grow!
“I’ll raise Uncle into a fan of mine. No, he’ll be a young groom. No, I’ll raise him to be a fan of his older sister!!!”
As he glanced at his daughter, Hugo looked like he wanted to die. Why did all his children turn out like this?
At that moment…
“Let’s get to the point.”
“!”
Kevin pointed at the baby Lee Gun as he asked, “What’s your verdict?”
“!”
The reason the two Zodiac Saints were visiting Hugo was simple.
“We gave you a grace period of half a year. Did you find out the identity of the child?”
“…!”
Hugo started to sweat.
‘I still haven’t dispelled the idea that he is a monster.’
The world had barely become reacquainted with Lee Gun, and there was a chance that some people around the world would try to kill him. This was why he had worked very hard to ascertain Lee Gun’s identity.
‘I can’t feel any Divine energy from him.’
The energy of Life and Death couldn’t be felt from the baby, and neither could the energy of a Creator.
It also wasn’t the case where he was connected to the Constructs. Therefore, it was understandable why the world was abuzz regarding the baby Lee Gun.
“Is he really Lee Gun?”
“It is.”
“Did he go through inheritance?”
When asked that question, Hugo looked tense. He monitored the two. “H-He did go through inheritance.”
“Then why is he letting out the energy of a monster instead of a god?”
“T…That is…” Hugo started to sweat as he remembered a certain incident.
* * *
Not too long ago…
‘Does Gun have his memories?’
Why does he possess the energy of a monster?
Everyone was curious, and Hugo was being asked for a report as soon as possible.
“Damn it! If I knew the answer, I would’ve already answered it! I’m the one who is the most curious to learn the answer to these questions!”
Hugo violently shook the baby bottle as he headed toward Lee Gun. He was able to keep the child under the guise of monitoring him. That was all well and good, but Hugo felt frustrated by the deluge of questions being sent his way.
‘I’m sure he is Gun.’
Of all the people in this world, there was no way Hugo would fail to recognize Lee Gun. However, the only evidence he had was his instinct telling him that it was Lee Gun. It was a terrible situation to be in, but he knew the baby was Lee Gun.
Moreover, Hugo didn’t care if Lee Gun had his memories or not; his loss of Divine power wasn’t important at all. The important part was that Lee Gun had come back! It didn’t matter what shape he took.
At the end of the day, Hugo didn’t care what form Lee Gun took. He just wanted to love and take care of Lee Gun. However, the world didn’t feel the same way as him.
‘If they aren’t sure, they’ll try to take him away from him.’
Lee Gun smelled like a monster, and his identity was unknown. Some people would either try to kill him, study him, or do something unspeakable.
It would cause his poor Gun to cry and look for his dad! Of course, Lee Gun wouldn't cry in reality. He would take the opportunity to crush the others, yet that possibility didn’t exist within Hugo’s head.
Anyway, Hugo needed to make a report if he wanted to continue to keep Lee Gun. This was why he needed to conduct an investigation. So he sought the one person who was supposed to have all the answers.
Hugo asked Aslan,
- Gun’s memory? What do you think, Hyung? Do you think he has it or not?
Aslan had reappeared alongside Lee Gun. He had a bright smile on his face. It seemed he enjoyed Hugo’s reaction.
Moreover, Aslan had gone out of his way to call Hugo the way he called him when the latter used to be Eternal Change!
Hugo hated that part of his life. It was his shameful past, so he feigned ignorance as he spoke to Aslan.
- Please don’t act out like this, Gun’s father. Please give me an answer.
- This hurts me, Hyung. You search me out only when you have a problem. He might or might not have his memories. Why do you want to know?
‘This bastard has no intention of giving me an answer.’
Hugo knew patience was a virtue when faced with Aslan’s playfulness.
- Let’s put aside Gun’s memories for now. What happened to the Divine power he used to possess? Did Gun really become a monster? Or something else…
- Wouldn’t you know the answer to that question better than anyone else, Hyung? He became a resident of the World of Emptiness. You should be able to tell if he’s a Cluder or not since you used to be one.
Aslan truly had a terrible personality! While he had an innocent face, he was a wily and black-hearted person inside. It seemed he hadn’t changed at all!
‘He’s a doctor with a bankrupt character!’
How could someone like him possess the Divine status of Asclepius, who was supposed to be a virtuous god of medicine?
Hugo shook. He wanted to throttle Aslan as he used to in the old times, but Hugo had promised himself to keep Eternal Change and Hugo separately.
Anyway, Hugo continued to follow Aslan around as he asked the questions. Aslan merely laughed and used his son to torment Hugo.
- Gun. Daddy Hugo plans to eat meat without you. Isn’t he too much?
- Ba…?
- Ahhk!! I was finally able to put him to sleep, yet you did this!!
In the end, Hugo gave up on getting an answer from Aslan, who marched to his own beat.
‘Since Hailey returned ok, Gun must have gotten rid of Universe….’
Hailey’s soul had been imprisoned by Universe. There was no way it would have been freed unless Universe no longer existed.
On the other hand, Hugo was well acquainted with what kind of being Universe was.
‘There is no way he could have done something against such a being.’
The World of Emptiness was the home ground of the Cluders. This was why Hugo had seen Universe when he was a child. Universe was the world itself.
While Hugo did let Lee Gun go to the World of Emptiness because he trusted him, he still had been curious about whether Lee Gun would be able to get rid of a foe of that caliber. That wasn’t all.
He hadn’t told the others about it, but he viewed Lee Gun as a first-generation monarch. This was why he knew this truth.
‘There is no mistaking it. He is….’
[Yes. He is a monster.]
“Ahhhk!!!”
Hugo had been about to put the baby bottle in Lee Gun’s mouth when he screamed and dropped the bottle. Baby Lee Gun pouted as if he found this unacceptable.
The one to appear in front of them was Lee Gun’s Construct—Fairy King Mimir, who possessed the greatest trove of knowledge within the Divine world.
Shocked, Hugo looked at the Construct. “Mimir! Where have you been? You haven’t shown yourself since Gun went missing for the past three years…”
[Where else? Didn’t you hear it from my old master? I went to the World of Emptiness with Yeonwoo and my old master. We went there to rescue Master.]
“!”
Mimir’s attitude was cold. He didn’t seem too happy to deal with Hugo after the latter had regained his memories as Eternal Change.
[Old master said I should visit you. That’s why I’m here. Do you not need me?]
“No! I do need you! What did you just say right now? Monster? Gun is a monster?”
[Yes. It was a risk factor.]
“Risk factor?!”
Hugo became serious, but Lee Gun merely wanted his fallen meal. He sat in a high chair and pounded the table with his short arms.
He started to protest, but Hugo didn’t even pretend to listen to him. This made baby Lee Gun scrunch up his face as he extended his chubby hands toward the baby bottle.
A strange magical energy emanated from him. It was strong enough to blow away the house that Hugo was barely able to acquire.
It was unclear whether Hugo knew what was going on or not. With a serious expression on his face, he looked at Mimir. “Give me the details. What do you mean by risk factor? Is it perhaps the Karmic Debt from getting rid of Universe? Is that why he became a monster?”
[Well, yes. He did become like that because he got rid of Universe…]
“What?! I’m right!?” Hugo looked shocked. “I was wondering why Gun was reborn with all his memories missing…!”
[Wait a moment. That’s not it at all.]
“Damn it! That means his appearance is a form of punishment.”
[It isn’t like that, servant. Just listen to me until the end.]
Hugo wanted Lee Gun to be happy in this life. “This time, I didn’t want him to suffer. That’s why I’m trying to raise him as my child.”
Mimir was about to say something, but his eyes turned round from surprise. He found what Hugo said quite unexpected. He looked at Hugo.
‘Servant…’
While he might have expected such a thing from the previous Hugo, this version of Hugo possessed the memories of Eternal Change.
Mimir held no love for a monarch, who had slaughtered the gods.
Hugo continued, “I thought Gun would finally be able to live a life devoid of fights. However, he would once again get dragged into the fight against the gods if he possesses such power. It doesn’t matter if he wants it or not.”
Mimir was surprised as many thoughts ran through his mind.
‘He’s someone who looks after the interest of Master to this degree.’
Mimir looked at Hugo with compassionate eyes.
[…oh, servant. It seems I’ve greatly misunderstood you. You really wanted to raise Master as if he were your child. Thank you for being so considerate toward Master—]
“This time, I wanted to make him fanboy over Daddy Hugo. I would have made him grow up as a fanboy of his father!”
[Hey!!]
“What!! Daddy’s boy is great!!!!”
[This monarch bastard was raising Master for his own interest and desire?!?]
Mimir looked at Hugo with contempt, as if he couldn’t understand what was going through Hugo’s mind.
Soon, Hugo’s eyes flashed. “Anyway, Gun turned into a monster because of his Karmic Debt?”
[Have you not been listening to my words? It isn’t Karmic Debt! In fact, he acquired a new power! He acquired Universe’s power!]
* * *
Back to the present…
Hugo relayed to the Zodiac Saints what Mimir had said.
Kevin scoffed. “What? Power of the Universe?” He looked at Lee Gun with doubt in his eyes. “Since he got rid of Universe, Lee Gun is letting out the energy of a monster?”
“Yes.”
“He doesn’t have his memories?”
“Y…Yes.”
Heiji, who held Lee Gun tightly, also furrowed her brows. “What if he did acquire the power of Universe?”
“I’m not so sure. We’ll have to monitor him, but the probability of it being true is low. The power of Universe is something that can be used only within the World of Emptiness. Once he came to the earth, that power should have disappeared.”
“If that’s true, why can we feel the energy of a monster from him?”
“That’s…. In reality, Universe is the ancestor of the Cluders. They might be related to each other….”
“What? Ancestor??”
“Yes. To be precise, other dangerous types of monsters like the Cluders exist, and Universe is the master of all of them.”
Kevin and Heiji became serious. They didn’t really know what Hugo was talking about, but at the end of the day, Lee Gun wasn’t human anymore once he got rid of Universe. That was a certainty. Also, they were talking about the power of Universe.
Lee Gun was already someone who was nuts as the Serpent Bearer. Now he possessed the power of Universe? Merely possessing such a power was a problem!
‘Will the earth be safe?’
To make matters worse, that power was in the hands of a newly born baby.
In the end, Kevin had only one thing to say. “Raise him well.”
“Thank you!”
“I’m not being facetious. You really have to raise him well or the earth might be blown apart!”
“Don’t worry! I’m the only father among the Zodiac Saints.”
Kevin and Heiji scrunched up their faces in doubt.
Hugo furrowed his brows. “Why are you looking at me like that? Unlike you guys, I’m experienced.”
The two of them scrunched up their faces further when they thought about the “Chun siblings.”
“At the very least, you should try to make him regain his memories.”
“Yes. If he has his memories, the earth won’t be destroyed.”
They had spoken those words because they were truly worried. However, Hugo reacted very poorly to it. “Memories? Have you lost your mind? That must not happen!”
“What? Why? It’ll be good for you if he regains his memories, right?”
Hugo hugged the baby Lee Gun as if he were precious. Then his face suddenly turned serious as he looked at the two Zodiac Saints. “Nothing good will come from Gun regaining his memories.”
Heiji and Kevin bit their lips.
‘Hugo wants Gun to grow up happy.’
It might be better if Lee Gun didn’t have the memories of fights and pain.
Heiji let out a bitter laugh. “Hugo. If that’s your wish, you can forget what we just said…”
“If he regains his memories, I can’t turn him into a fanboy of me! Don’t say something so disastrous!”
Their expressions were a sight to behold.
Hugo didn’t care as his eyes flashed. “Do you realize how much effort I’ve put into making Gun into a daddy’s boy?!”
An enraged Hugo brought out a tablet PC in front of them.
Kwahng!
Hugo brought up pictures, videos, articles, blurbs from textbooks, and memoirs. They weren’t something that could be spoken all through words, but they contained everything that he had accomplished in the past twenty years. All the pictures and articles were compiled with them centered around Hugo.
“See? His father’s accomplishments are sung to him as a daily lullaby. I read them to him and educate him about them! Like Yooha and Sungjae, I’ll be able to create my own fanatic!!! I learned the importance of learning by rote!”
“…”
“…”
This was beyond losing his mind. His brain had turned smooth.
“What do you think? Do you understand me now?”
“Yes. I now understand that you’re an incorrigible person.”
“Why!! Do you guys not realize how noble this revenge is? Do you understand the sorrow of having your children stolen from you?”
The two Zodiac Saints ignored him.

chapters.title: Chapter 491: Book 2, Epilogue 4 - Return of the Hero(?) (4)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 4 - Return of the Hero(?) (4)
‘That’s Gun?’
Sagittarius Lewis. He used to be Galan, and he had gone through the inheritance process when he died.
He was tense as he looked at the squirming Lee Gun in Yooha’s arms.
‘I…Is it really him?’
The baby had a pretty face, and his little hands wriggled. He had a full cheek like that of a hamster. The baby was so cute that it was hard to think of him as the tyrannical monster Lee Gun.
‘By the look of his eyes, he does seem to be Gun.’
Lee Gun didn’t resemble his father, but he probably resembled his mother, who was known to be an absolute beauty.
Sagittarius became surprised when he met eyes with Lee Gun.
“Byaa?”
Sagittarius put a hand over his mouth when he saw Lee Gun babble.
‘What a cute little…!’
As he was enjoying himself, he became startled. He suddenly shook his head from side to side.
‘Don’t be fooled! That’s Lee Gun…!’
After having gone through inheritance, the young Saggitarius was meeting baby Lee Gun for the first time. It was understandable since he was currently being raised by other gods, the Constructs of the Virgo temple, who remained on the earth.
- You might not have your memories, but you’re still a pillar-rank god. You will grow up in no time.
All the gods who opposed Lee Gun had been sent to the Cycle. On the other hand, the allied gods went from being gods to being part of the Divine Race.
In other words, they were “Gods who didn’t go through the process of inheritance.”
The process of inheritance was possible if a god possessed a Divine status. However, all the gods with Divine status had been sent into the Cycle (Cradle) by Lee Gun.
In other words, the Divine statuses of the remaining gods were copies, which Lee Gun had made.
This was why his generation of gods was the last. Once they died, it would be the end of the gods. The genealogy of gods would no longer continue. So they chose to spend their time on the earth by becoming part of the Divine Race. They were now a special race possessing Divine rank abilities.
They had said to him.
- Sagittarius-nim. You have to quickly grow up to fill the seat of Baby snake-nim.
Sagittarius had gone through the process of inheritance before Lee Gun got rid of all the gods. Thanks to luck and timing, Sagittarius was able to go through the process of inheritance. That was all well and good, but this posed one large problem.
‘I went through the process of inheritance, so why do I still have my memories!!’
In a normal inheritance process, gods were reborn without their memories. For some reason, Sagittarius possessed all his memories from his past life!
So he wondered if Lee Gun was able to keep his memories like him.
‘Yes. He’s the mighty Lee Gun. Gun was able to consume all the Great Spirits.’
There was no way Lee Gun lost his memories because of inheritance. It may look like he didn’t have his memories, but he was probably tricking everyone into thinking he had lost his memories. He had also fallen for the act right now.
In truth, Sagittarius was in a precarious situation.
‘Damn it! It’s all over if they find out that I still have my memories…!’
Sagittarius hadn’t told anyone that he still had his memories. The reason was simple.
“Uh? When did you arrive?”
“!!”
Sagittarius was surprised as Hugo approached him. Normally, it would be unimaginable to see Hugo give him such a kind smile. Sagittarius started to sweat.
“Baby god-nim, are you comfortable appearing in front of us now?”
“…!”
Yes, everyone, including Hugo, treated Sagittarius with kindness. In their mind, the current Sagittarius was a separate person from the previous Sagittarius.
‘They are treating me like this because they think I’m a different person…!!’
In truth, he was right.
When Sagittarius had opened his eyes for the first time, he had screamed and fainted as soon as he saw Hugo. Later, Hugo became cautious in how he treated Sagittarius.
Hugo seemed to think that a young god was startled by the energy of a Cluder. At the end of the day, Cluders were predators and natural enemies of the gods.
In the end, Hugo scratched his cheek.
- I guess I have no choice. I’ll have to be careful in how I approach you.
However, the truth was completely different! Sagittarius had screamed as soon as he saw Hugo because he had never expected to be reborn!! However, he had been reborn. Moreover, he had been scared of being killed by Hugo, who had regained his memories!!
That was why he had fainted.
‘I was the culprit who killed his friend! Now that he has regained his memories, there is no way he’ll spare someone he considers an enemy!’
Eternal Change had a great love for the entire tribe of Creators, and he had been a friend to Sagittarius’s father. However, Sagittarius had killed his father and tribe members! There was no way Hugo would let Sagittarius live!!!
‘Also, he isn’t the only problem!’
Sagittarius’s younger sister was the goddess of the Virgo temple. Normally, Virgo would make fun of him by saying he was bald and impotent. She pitied the wife that he would take on in the future. So how were things right now with her?
- Are you in any pain? If you need anything, you can tell me. You can ask for anything from my subordinate.
Hugo said the same thing!
- If you need anything, you can just tell me. Ahjussi will buy you anything.
In the past, when facing him, his Zodiac Saint would grumble with a sour expression. That same person was treating Sagittarius with kindness and gentleness…!
Sagittarius was moved, but also scared.
‘If my identity is revealed… It all ends!!’
If he was caught, he’d receive a group beating. No, he would be tied up and thrown into the ocean!
Despite knowing this, he had come to visit Lee Gun. Ignoring the risk of being found out, he wanted to see his one and only nephew! Also, he came because of the curse that won’t be lifted!
‘I received a new body through inheritance, yet my nephew’s curse remains...’
At this rate, people might pick up on the fact that he was the same person as the old Sagittarius!
In fact, someone already suspected him. It was the Serpent Bearer’s mole!
‘That damn Jaewon…!!!’
