The Constructs would say, “Oh my! The new Sagittarius doesn’t have a lot of hair. Is it because he’s a kid?”
The Constructs merely felt pity for him. It was different for Lee Jaewon, who was quick on the uptake.
The shrewd Jaewon’s eyes would flash in suspicion. He even said,
- Unless they are the same person, there is no way a god would have the same flaws as the previous generation did, right?
- What? Of course. They are newly born. In some cases, gods chose to go through inheritance when they died during the war. They were given completely new bodies.
- I see. If a god inherited a previous defect, there might be a chance that he might have inherited his memories too.
Moreover, Sagittarius had let something bad slip in the presence of Lee Jaewon.
- I wonder if my nephew still has his memories.
- What? Nephew?
- Ahk!!!
By coincidence, Lee Jaewon had heard the words mumbled under his breath. Afterward, Lee Jaewon took every opportunity to show up to test if Sagittarius still had his memories!
After catching the god, Jaewon would report this news to Hugo! Sagittarius was sure of it!!
This was why the seven-year-old Sagittarius had sought Lee Gun.
‘If I can extract a bit of Gun’s power, I might be able to lift the curse.’
In other words, he had to get rid of anything that would cause anyone to become suspicious of him!
Previously, Sagittarius had been unable to approach Lee Gun because Lee Jaewon was always near the baby whenever he tried. But Lee Jaewon wasn’t here today!
‘I’ll be able to extract Gun’s power!’
He didn’t need a lot. He needed a pinch! That was all!
‘I’m still not sure if Gun still has his memories, but…’
It did look like Gun didn’t have his memories. The mighty Lee Gun was ill-tempered! However, the current Lee Gun was too cute and was innocently laughing like a baby. There was no way he had his memories.
‘Gun isn’t the type of person who is capable of schooling his expression.’
While others might not notice it, Sagittarius would have, since he was a god. Above all else, Gun wouldn’t smile so brightly toward him if he had his memories!
‘His expression would give him away. If it were his normal self, he would have shown his contempt toward me.’
This was why Sagittarius decided Gun didn’t possess his memories and continued with his plan.
The young Sagittarius was tense about being found out by Hugo as he approached Lee Gun.
“I came because I have a present for the new baby god-nim.”
“Byaa?”
Sagittarius handed a golden water bottle to Lee Gun. It was a holy item that would allow him to extract a small amount of Lee Gun’s power.
Was Lee Gun interested in the present? Lee Gun extended his hand toward the shiny present.
Sagittarius inwardly cheered.
‘Yes. That’s it. Just grab that item! He just has to grab it…!’
However…
“Ahhhk!!!”
“Gun?!!”
Instead of the present, Lee Gun grabbed Sagittarius’s hair.
Ooh-doo-doohk!
Sagittarius screamed when Lee Gun pulled the golden hair hard enough that it felt like it would be ripped out.
Hugo turned pale from shock. “Are you ok, Baby god-nim?! Stop, Gun!!! No!”
Lee Gun refused to let go.
Ooh-doohk!
“!”
It sounded as if Sagittarius’s scalp was going to be ripped off!
Hugo and Sagittarius became desperate when they heard the ominous sound.
“Ahhk!!”
“Byaa!”
“Ahhhk!!”
“Gun! Snack!”
“Ahhk!!”
“Gun!!! Snack!!!!!!!!!”
It was unusual to see Hugo be angry. He pushed a bar of chocolate in front of Lee Gun.
The baby Lee Gun casually grabbed the chocolate instead of Sagittarius’s hair.
“Byaa!”
Lee Gun acted as if it had gone as planned(?). He sucked on the chocolate since he didn’t have many teeth. It seemed to have been a ploy to get some chocolate since he wasn’t usually able to eat them.
Hugo felt like he had been duped for some reason. He despaired, but he soon started checking up on Sagittarius. “Are you ok? You already don’t have a lot of hair, yet the baby did something terrible to it…”
Hugo was very kind as he looked at Sagittarius.
On the other hand, Sagittarius was a ball of emotions because of Hugo’s kindness and attentiveness.
‘My Zodiac Saint is…!’
At the same time, his eyes started to roll around once again. Evil(?) thoughts started to appear in his head.
‘It seems he hasn’t noticed yet. Wouldn’t it be better if I take advantage of his kindness?’
His servant always told him that he didn’t have any money. Hugo told him to eat whatever he could scrape together or that he could eat poison. Hugo said spending money on him was a waste, so he could eat tree bark. His servant always made it seem he was in the wrong.
This was why Sagittarius pretended to cry as he grabbed Hugo. “Hyung! I want to eat something tasty!”
“Uh! Is that so? You want something tasty? Do you like meat? Or…”
“I really like sea urchin eggs!!”
“S…Sea urchin egg? Alright. It’s expensive, but sea urchin eggs are great…”
At that moment…
“Byaa!”
“Ahhk!!”
Lee Gun, who had been sucking on the chocolate, pulled on Sagittarius’s hair again. His gesture seemed to say, “How dare you steal from Hugo’s wallet?”
Ooh-doohk!
“Gun!!!”
“Ahhhk!!!”
“Gun!!! Stop!”
However, something more surprising happened at that moment.
“Lee Gun-nim? Does that god’s hair bother you? Is it a wig?”
“?!!”
Sagittarius turned his head when he heard that nonsense, and the sight frightened him.
‘Jaewon?!’
What was he here?!
Lee Jaewon waved his phone as he approached Lee Gun. “Lee Gun-nim called me using Hugo-nim’s phone.”
“What? Gun did that with my phone??”
“Ah! I believe he was touching your phone and called me by mistake. I came because I wanted to meet him.”
“Is that so? That’s great. The baby god wants to eat sea urchin eggs. Let’s eat together.”
“What? Sagittarius asked for sea urchin eggs?”
Sagittarius turned pale when he met Lee Jaewon’s eyes; he started to backpedal.
‘Damn it! He was already suspicious of me.’
The fact that he had his memories would be found out!
On the other hand, Hugo brought up the hotel food delivery app and tilted his head. “Baby god-nim? I’m going to order the highest-quality sea urchin eggs. Do you need anything else….”
“No! Ooh… Uh… I’m fine with eating tree bark!!!”
“What? What do you mean by that?”
Desperate, Sagittarius ran away.
Lee Gun finally looked satisfied as he continued to eat his snack. A smudge of chocolate was spread around his mouth. He had acted as if he knew Sagittarius.
* * *
“What? Sagittarius came looking for Lee Gun-nim again today?” Lee Jaewon looked at Yooha with surprise.
It was time for Lee Gun’s nap. He had been put to sleep after being fed milk.
Of course, Hugo was worried Lee Gun’s teeth would rot, so he thoroughly brushed them.
“Anyway, Sagittarius came because he said he had a present for Uncle.”
“He had a present?”
“Mmm. It looked like something Uncle made in the past…”
When Lee Jaewon heard this, an odd light flashed in his eyes.
Lee Jaewon remembered Hugo grinding his teeth and saying, “He went through the process of inheritance before I could get rid of him” and “He lost his memories. I forever lost the opportunity to sort out my problems with him.”
“Did Jaewon oppa find them?”
“Ah.”
In truth, Lee Jaewon was searching for some people. They were Hailey and her family.
‘He’s looking for Shiva, the Flame Monarch, and Hailey-nim.’
Hailey’s father was Shiva, the Great Spirit of Mahabharata. He had died several hundred years ago, yet he was reborn through some unknown mechanism. The three of them were able to return to the earth.
‘Lee Gun-nim must have done something in the World of Emptiness, which allowed them to come back.’
However, that wasn’t important right now.
Yooha soon asked with a serious expression, “Are you sure they are ok? You said the three of them went missing as soon as Uncle reappeared.”
“Ah. You don’t have to worry about that. I was able to locate them again. They merely ran away from the west to the east of the US. That idiot cat. It seemed they collaborated with the Leo Saint to make the move, but it was useless.”
“…?!”
The disciples found it odd, so they asked the question.
“Why would they move in secret from us? We aren’t enemies….”
“Ah. Shiva seems to be an idiot for his daughter. He’s in a struggle to cut ties with anyone who has any ties with Lee Gun-nim.”
“…?”
He was an idiot for his daughter? What the hell did he mean by that?
On the other hand, Lee Jaewon let out an odd laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 492: Book 2, Epilogue 5 - Return of the Hero(?) (5)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 5 - Return of the Hero(?) (5)
The eastern part of the US…
“You guys are too weak.”
A tall man using crude English dusted off his hand within the Leo temple’s training facility. Two hundred Leo disciples lay unconscious around the man…
Two hundred?!
Stevens was surprised when he came upon this scene. It had been well past assembly time, and his subordinates hadn’t shown up. So he had come here to punish them and personally put them through drills.
However, he found all his subordinates beaten to a pulp by a single person! “What the hell is going on….”
The tall man turned around when he heard Stevens’s voice. “Ah. You are Cargo’s steward?”
“S-Steward?”
It was a young man with black hair and bronze skin. The tall man walked toward Stevens like a model.
The man’s handsome face was revealed when he took off his sunglasses. He had sharp elongated golden eyes and a booming laugh, looking striking.
“Cargo has a fussy personality. The fact that you were able to stick it out with him proves that you’re useful as a steward.”
Stevens had never seen this man before, but deducing the man’s identity wasn’t too hard. “Great Spirit Shiva-nim…?”
“Just call me Caram.”
“Hailey’s father?”
“Ha. That’s good too.”
“Father-in-law?”
“You want to die? No, you can just die!”
“Ahhhk! Joke! It was a joke!” Stevens was frightened as Caram tried to kill him using a knife hand strike. He ran away.
Stevens wanted to test how much of a fool Caram was for his daughter. He never knew it was this bad!
‘I heard he was a fool for his daughter, so he was dodging anyone who had anything to do with Lee Gun.’
Moreover, he was incredibly strong! Shiva was a fighting-type god like Lee Gun. Just a slip of a word in front of him could get Stevens killed!
Anyway, Stevens had become acquainted with Shiva around three years ago. It was understandable since Shiva had decided to live in the US with a newly born Hailey. He had chosen to live in a land under the Leo temple.
Of course, Stevens had been on his guard when an energy equivalent to a monarch rank had shown up in his territory.
- What the hell? This energy is…?
Unexpectedly, Leo was the one to move. Leo was a homebody that couldn’t be pestered to move, yet it had gone out somewhere. Then it abruptly said to Stevens,
- This is how it’ll be. For the foreseeable future, my friend will take root in the US. Just know that he’ll be living here.
Stevens had no idea what was going on. He never knew the ill-tempered cat even had a friend. Still, this was the event that alerted everyone to something.
‘Hailey is back.’
She was back with Shiva and the Flame Monarch, her parents. Of course, everyone found out who her parents were for the first time.
‘Shiva came from Mahabharata, like my Zodiac..’
No wonder the freeloader cat had moved. There was a reason Shiva was close to their great Leo.
‘Anyway, that was why they came to the US.’
Moreover, no one had known that Hailey’s whole family had been present in the World of Emptiness.
This was especially true of Hailey’s mother. They had heard she had died not too long after Lee Gun had rescued her.
‘Was she dragged into the World of Emptiness during that time?’
Stevens had no idea what kind of Karmic Debt would send all three of them to the World of Emptiness as prisoners.
Stevens asked, “Caram-nim. I thought you didn’t like the east coast of the US because it was too noisy. What brings you to a place that you don’t like after three years?”
“It’s because unwanted guests keep looking for us.”
The unwanted guests probably referred to Hugo’s household.
‘Hugo’s household is tenaciously trying to make contact with Shiva.’
Since Lee Gun had been in the World of Emptiness with them, Hugo and his family wanted to ask Shiva about Lee Gun’s whereabouts.
Of course, Shiva didn’t seem to welcome the presence of Hugo’s household.
- Stay the hell away from us!
He had even verbally assaulted them, so he seemed to be on bad terms with Hugo and his household. It was still the case right now.
Stevens furrowed his brows. “Despite their attempt, you haven’t moved for the past three years. If you really didn’t like them, you would have moved already.”
“My wife and Hailey like them, so we stayed there.”
Stevens watched Shiva do as he pleased as he opened the training facility’s refrigerator. Shiva really seemed to like the western part of the US. He said something about being able to feel the energy of the ground.
Yet, around half a year ago, he had disappeared without a trace. He went away as soon as Lee Gun appeared on the earth. It was as if he had evaporated into thin air. His whole family had also disappeared as if they had been a mirage!
This event had surprised everyone.
That was why Stevens had almost fainted a while ago in New York. He had been inside the Leo temple’s main palace, naked in the public bath, when Shiva came for a visit.
- Kuh-huh. The temperature of the water here is great.
- Ahhk!!!!!
It seemed he had been celebrating Halloween with his young daughter. Shiva wore a princess mask and held a bloodied knife, frightening everyone.
- Ahhhhk!!!
- You guys are men. Why are you screaming like that? It isn’t cute at all. Is this your first time seeing someone in costume? You want to die?
- Ahhk!!!
Stevens had never expected such a face to be behind the scary princess mask. “Why did you make yourself scarce as soon as Lee Gun appeared?”
Shiva took out an expensive alcoholic drink. He scrunched up his face as he drank it. “Don’t ask such questions, steward. You’re going to get hurt.”
“As expected, it has to do with Lee Gun?”
“I said you’ll get hurt!”
Stevens sighed. He had heard that the relationship between Hailey and Lee Gun had progressed quite far. “Both of them do not have their memories any longer. I doubt anything will suddenly happen between them…”
“My daughter…”
Crack!
“In recent days…”
Crack!
“She said she likes snakes.”
“…?!”
After Shiva opened an expensive bottle of whiskey, a calm murderous intent emanated from his eyes. “I was going to eradicate all the snakes from this world, but I held myself back.”
“….”
Stevens started to sweat. What sin did the snakes commit?
Shiva started laughing as if he was mad. “I’ve always hated gods related to snakes. Do you think I would let that kid have my daughter?? I’ll even eradicate all the worms!”
“Worms have nothing to do with this…”
At that moment…
[Don’t you guys owe a debt to Lee Gun?]
“!”
Leo showed up.
“Cargo.”
[What? Am I wrong? Lee Gun saved you guys, who were slaves in the World of Emptiness, right? You were able to escape the World of Emptiness and come here thanks to him.]
Shiva scoffed. “He didn’t save us. While he was going on a rampage decapitating Universe’s head, we escaped on our own.”
“What? Lee Gun killed Universe?”
“Yes. In return, he lost all his memories.”
“What? What do you mean by… No, are you saying Lee Gun really doesn’t have his memories?”
“How could he have them? In the first place, he shouldn’t have been able to leave the World of Emptiness.”
“…???”
Stevens wanted to ask what he meant, but Leo merely clicked his tongue.
[It seems Aslan wants to make your daughter his daughter-in-law. He doesn’t seem to care if she doesn’t have her memories. I saw him pick clothes for his grandchildren.]
“What? That ungrateful bastard wants to bring who as his daughter-in-law?!”
[Wow. It seems you guys are still close.]
“We aren’t close! I’d rather have Hailey live by my side for the rest of her life if the alternative is to send her there as his daughter-in-law!”
[Does that mean you like Lee Gun as her husband?]
“He is not her husband!!!”
Stevens was letting out a cold sweat.
Should he say something about Aslan already picking out clothes for his grandchildren?
‘He’s picking out clothes for his grandchildren when his son isn’t even one year old.’
How many steps were Aslan skipping? No, that wasn’t important right now.
Stevens was sweating as he looked at Shiva. “I…I’m bringing this up since you mentioned his memories. From the stories I heard from Hugo, Lee Gun’s actions are a bit out of the ordinary. His actions aren’t the ones of a child with no memories…”
Stevens looked at Shiva with an oddly expectant gaze.
However, Shiva didn’t respond. However, he scrunched up his face further as if he had a thought that bothered him more. “He doesn't have his memories. Why do you keep believing in that monarch? He is a liar.”
“I've always wondered about this. Why do you hate Hugo so much? You always slam the door in their faces whenever they come calling.”
It was why the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple and the Archer disciples hated them, including Stevens.
It was a very tough and frustrating situation for Stevens because he really liked the Serpent Bearer temple and the Sagittarius temple.
Leo clicked his tongue at the question.
[Why else? It’s obviously because Hugo killed the Great Spirit of Mahabharata when he was Eternal Change.]
“That’s part of it.”
Originally, there had been three Great Spirits of Mahabharata. The three gods were a triumvirate. Among the three, Shiva was dragged into the World of Emptiness, Brahma was killed by Eternal Change, and the remaining god Vishnu was killed by Lee Gun.
“Caram-nim doesn’t like Hugo-nim because he killed your precious comrades…”
“No. In fact, I’m thankful that he killed Brahma. The only thing that pisses me off is that bastard killed Brahma before I could.”
“…”
“Also, that isn’t why I dislike him.”
[Huh? There is another reason? What is it?]
The tiger-like eyes of Shiva tilted upward more savagely, but he didn’t give an answer. “Anyway, I will never let Hailey meet anyone related to the snake god. If they don’t meet, no relationship will be able to develop. That’s why I’ll be hiding my wife and Hailey in this palace.”
“…I don’t mind it, but are you sure you’ll be able to pull it off? They aren’t much better than you expect…”
In terms of searching and sensing, they were scarily strong…
“Don’t worry. I put a plan in place. They won’t be able to get close to us.”
The father, who was a fool for his daughter, smirked in a sleazy manner.
* * *
Around that time, Hugo was also having problems, like Stevens. In the end, he slapped his forehead.
‘Yes. There is no need for me to go visit Aslan! I have Yeonwoo!'
The one who knew most about Lee Gun wasn’t Aslan. It was Yeonwoo!
‘Unlike that sly fox, she won’t hide anything related to Gun from me!’
Hugo clenched his fist because he supported(?) Yeonwoo more than Hailey. According to Mimir, Yeonwoo had traveled to the World of Emptiness to save Lee Gun. She would know what had happened to Gun over there! Of course, there was a problem…
‘I have no idea where Miss Yeonwoo is right now.’
In truth, Hugo had last seen Yeonwoo three years ago. It was after Lee Gun had ceased to exist in this world.
At the time, Yeonwoo had tried to disappear from their sight. It was as if she was going to follow Lee Gun. She had tried to leave in the middle of the night.
However, Hugo had discovered her. Feeling uneasy, he had tried to grab her. “Miss Yeonwoo? Where are you going?”
A swirl of light had flashed behind her as if she had made a connection to some location. “I’m going to go find and bring back Gun!”
“What?! But…!”
Outsiders couldn't go to the World of Emptiness. It was a world where only sinners could go.
“I found a way to travel to the World of Emptiness!”
This had surprised Hugo.
‘No one would choose to go to the World of Emptiness even if one was capable of going there.’
Hugo knew what kind of place it was, so he desperately tried to stop her. “No! If normal gods go there, they will die!”
Moreover, Lee Gun had promised that he would be back someday. He would come back even if one person remembered him. He would if Faith toward him remained. He would be able to return to the humans as a god.
“That’s why we should believe in him and wait…!”
Hearing this, Yeonwoo unexpectedly put on a serious expression. “No. If our prediction is right, Gun will get rid of Universe. Once he solves all the problems over there, he won’t be able to return to the earth. He’ll be tied down to the World of Emptiness.”
“What? What do you mean by—”
Instead of answering him, Yeonwoo put on a sad smile as she disappeared into the light.
“Koohk!”
Three years had passed since she had disappeared. Lee Gun, whom they had missed so much, had returned as a baby.
So they assumed Yeonwoo, who had gone to look for Lee Gun, would return soon. However, half a year had passed, yet she hadn’t shown up.
They were starting to get worried that something bad had happened to her when…
Kwahng!!
“Who is it?”
A being with a serious amount of energy invaded the room where the young Lee Gun slept. The energy was clearly aiming for the child.
‘Who dares go after my son?’
Hugo’s eyes flashed coldly as he immediately moved to defend Lee Gun. “Gun!!”
An enraged Hugo was about to decapitate the intruder, but…
“M…Miss Yeonwoo?!”
The one hugging the young Lee Gun was none other than Yeonwoo.
Hugo was taken aback. “M…Miss Yeonwoo! Where have you been all this time?”
That wasn’t important right now.
Yeonwoo looked at the sleeping young Lee Gun. The beautiful woman looked flushed with happiness.
Hugo let out a sigh of relief.
‘It really is Gun.’
There was no way he would mistake Gun, but it was nice to get confirmation. It made a big difference.
“Thank you for looking after Gun.” Yeonwoo treated Lee Gun as if he was very precious. She rubbed her face against young Lee Gun’s cheek, looking elated.
Hugo was relieved. “I’m glad you are back. Gun will be happy…”
“Ah! I’m just visiting. I have to go back soon.”
This surprised Hugo. “Y…You have to go? You just came here. Where will you go?!”
“It was good that Gun was reincarnated from the World of Emptiness, but that damn stalker of Gun is… I have to track down an enemy who’s looking for Gun.”
“E-Enemy? Stalker?”
“Yes. I have to annihilate this person so that this person never shows up in front of him again. Please look after Gun until that time.”
“Annihilate???? W-Wait a moment!”
“Oh yeah… If you don’t mind, I would like you to be the only one to raise Gun, Mr. Hugo. To be precise, could you prevent other women from approaching him?”
“What??”
“You can allow Miss Jiwoo and the Constructs to get close to him. It won’t be long. Please do this for me!”
“W-Wait a moment!!?”
Yeonwoo had once again disappeared.
This had happened only a week ago. It was why Hugo was taken aback.
“Did something happen in the World of Emptiness?”
What happened there that Gun returned as a baby? Lee Gun also didn’t seem to have his memories, and he possessed the energy of a monster.
It was unclear what had happened to his Divine status. Lee Gun had become a weird being that was neither god nor human. Also, where had Ms. Yeonwoo gone in the meantime?
“Are you curious about that?”
“!”
A sudden voice surprised Hugo.
“Aslan!”
Before he knew it, Aslan was sitting on the sofa watching the TV. He propped up his chin on his hand as he ate the chicken.
As if he were on a bit of a hot seat, Mimir sat next to him.
Hugo massaged his forehead. “You…! Show your presence when you show up!”
“I’ll tell you everything that happened to Gun. In return, I have some questions for you.”
Hugo’s face was a sight to behold. My god! Of all the people in the world, this guy wanted to ask him a question? Was he really going to “question” him?
Aslan thought of himself as a gifted genius and everyone else as an idiot. That person wanted to ask someone else a question?
“You have a question you want to ask me? Really?”
“Yes. It’s something I am curious about as a father with a child.”
“…???”
Hugo became puzzled. It was a parenting question???
Him??? Aslan was like the king of the gods, who ruled over heaven and earth. He was almost sociopathic in not caring about others. Unexpectedly, Aslan had a serious expression on his face.
Hugo had his arms crossed as he looked dubiously at Aslan. “O…K. I’ll answer it if I know the answer. Before I do, you have to tell me what happened to Gun.”
It was rare to see him laugh brightly like a child. Aslan opened his mouth as he looked toward the TV. “Gun became a monster, because…”
“….”
“…”
“…”
“Aslan?”
“What are you doing, Mimir? Hurry up and retell the story while I watch the movie.”
It seemed he found telling the story himself irritating.
‘Like father, like son.’
When his terrible old master exerted his power, Mimir sighed and started to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 493: Book 2, Epilogue 6 - No, Not You (1)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 6 - No, Not You (1)
Three years ago…
Lee Gun spoke to his one and only best friend in the world.
- Don’t worry. I’ll be back.
Then he said,
- When I meet you the next time, I’m going to ask a lot of things from you.
“Damn it! My back is going to get blown out before I can ask a lot of things from him!!!”
This was the time when Lee Gun was in the World of Emptiness, which was a world of sinners.
‘Fuck this bitch ass place! Shit!’
When he became a slave in the World of Emptiness, his way of speaking changed. It almost seemed like his personality had turned more coarse, which was understandable.
‘Why the fuck does a shitty place like this exist?’
The monarchs were almost gentlemanlike in comparison. In the World of Emptiness, common sense went out the window. It was a savage world with no law and order.
Everything was shitty. The guards tormented and swindled the slaves to line their pockets. The slaves, who had once been supreme rulers of their dimensions, had capitulated early when they became scared of Universe’s power. So the slaves tormented those lower in the pecking order.
Rules and common sense seemed to change at a moment's notice. Everything was shitty.
- Ha ha ha! You’re the lowest rank now! Follow me!
- Ahhk! No! Please! Just kill me!!
The slaves who were considered the lowest-ranked ones were dragged to the arena. They became eye candy for the nobles from various dimensions and died a gruesome death for the purpose of entertainment.
Of course, it would be great if they could remain dead after being dragged away like that. The dead ones were remodeled into beasts, and they had to live the life of pets raised by Universe and the nobles.
It didn’t matter if one used to be a fierce king of a dimension or a monarch, who was the king of monsters.
[Slave Rank System]
If one fell to the bottom, everyone was treated equally; they were humiliated and abused. They became a laughingstock for the nobles from other dimensions.
In the end, they weren’t even given a chance to put up much of a fight before they were ripped apart by monsters. Afterward, they were humiliated even when they were turned into non-humanoid toys.
Lee Gun hadn’t even sniffed the lower ranks, yet he had several of his organs stolen. This place was that terrible.
Universe, the owner of the slaves, had said,
- Anyone capable of wounding me will be given his freedom!
However, no one dared attack this being. Instead of attacking Universe, the cowardly slaves used underhanded methods to ensure that they didn’t fall into the lower ranks.
If they could maintain their ranking to a certain extent, they would become district leaders and could live decent lives.
However, one among them wanted to take Universe’s life. It was Lee Gun. He ground his teeth; he knew Hailey had been dragged into this place.
He wished Hailey was fine, and he hoped Hailey’s name wouldn’t appear among the lowest ranks, which was updated each month.
He had no idea how long had passed when…
- Hailey!
- Gun!
Lee Gun and Hailey were miraculously reunited in that place. Moreover, Hailey looked shocked to have met Lee Gun there.
- Gun! Why are you here?
She hadn’t suffered much damage, but Lee Gun had been dropped in the trash region directly under the control of Universe—a place where public order was nonexistent.
Hailey touched him all over the place to check if he was hurt. Lee Gun laughed when he saw this.
- I’m fine. I did have a bit of a tough time because I became roommates with your father of all people.
- !
- I came to get you.
Hailey was surprised by his laughter. Her face and neck turn red. In fact, she turned red from head to toe.
It seemed she hadn’t realized that she had basically been pawing at Lee Gun’s body. So when he grabbed her hand, she didn’t know what to do with herself.
Lee Gun mischievously laughed as he refused to let go of her hand. He continued to hold her hand in the morning and night.
Lee Gun had lived with Hailey for a good amount of time before he sent her back to the earth.
Some time later, he was successful in killing the absolute ruler of that world!
“You really were disgusting, bastard!” Drenched in Universe’s blood, Lee Gun was laughing like a madman.
He kept stomping on the groaning Universe. “Just hurry up and die! You have to die for Hailey to be free! Ah! Before you die, you should remember my name and face. I want to go through inheritance with my memories intact.”
Universe, who had lost to Lee Gun, unexpectedly started to laugh. He had never imagined he would be killed by an insignificant creature like him.
[I made it clear. You need to only wound me to gain your freedom.]
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed violently as if Universe were talking nonsense. He ground his teeth when he thought about what he had suffered because of this being.
“Fuck off! Did you really think I wouldn’t know that freedom means eternal death to you? Everything only ends when you are dead.”
Universe laughed at those words.
[Yes. I do remember there being creatures in this universe capable of going through the process of inheritance. It’s possible for you to go through inheritance now that I remember you. However, if you kill me, it won’t all be positive. This is especially true of someone like you, who wants to go back to your birthplace.]
“Hmmph. I decapitated you, yet your tongue is still wagging. Do I have to cut out your tongue?”
[Hmmph. You do have a bad temper.]
“Whatever. Just die! When I go back, I’ll suck Taeksoo dry. I’m going to catch up on all the sleep I missed! I couldn’t sleep for a year because you placed a curse on me! Do you know this? I feel like dying because I’m sleepy!”
Universe spoke.
[When you kill me, you will take my throne. In other words, everything I own will be transferred to you.]
Lee Gun snorted. He wondered what this being was going to say, but he was talking about the transfer of his power?
Lee Gun’s red eyes turned violent. “That’s nonsense. Your death means all the slaves will be freed. It means I’ll be able to return home.”
[Are you sure it’ll turn out that way?]
Universe let out a lazy laugh.
Flash!
“!”
At that moment, light erupted from Universe’s body. This light hit Lee Gun.
“Koohk!”
He heard Universe’s voice.
[Do you understand now? The one who kills me cannot turn down my throne. The ruler of the next generation will be you.]
“…!”
As those words rang out, Lee Gun was put under full custody. He realized why Universe had said he wouldn’t be able to return to the earth!
‘My soul is being tied to this world.’
An unknown power was tying down Lee Gun.
Universe spoke.
[As soon as you killed me, it was determined that there will be a generational shift. You now possess the power of Universe (Overlord of Rules). You can no longer leave this world. You will stay in this world as its new owner.]
“!”
[You may look at me as if I’m a cockroach, but you won’t be able to escape. This world is quite clingy. You should just give up and follow the will of this world.]
Lee Gun looked at Universe as if he were indeed a cockroach. “Have you lost your mind? Why would I do that?”
Universe spoke as if the answer was obvious.
[As the successor, you will soon forget everything. You will lose all the memories you treasure the most. The same thing happened to me before.]
If Lee Gun lost his memories, he wouldn’t have any place to return. He would forget who he was.
However, Lee Gun snorted. “Memories? It doesn’t matter. I would have lost them all if I went through the process of inheritance.”
Universe let out a thin smile when he saw the oddly confident attitude of Lee Gun. It was as if he had expected this.
[You must be banking on your Divine status, right?]
“…?”
Lee Gun’s expression changed when he heard the laughter.
Universe smirked as if he knew this world wouldn’t let Lee Gun do as he pleased.
[Do you still not get it? You will no longer be a god. You will acquire a different body that’ll live forever. It’s the greatest of bodies. The body of a god cannot compare to it.]
“…!”
Lee Gun flinched. It was a body other than that of a “god.” Could it be?
It was rare to see Lee Gun taken aback.
Universe laughed as if he could guess what was going through Lee Gun’s mind. Lee Gun hadn’t been shaken even when he heard about the loss of his memories, yet…
[You planned on storing your memories separately, right?]
“…!”
All gods who went through inheritance lost memories of their past life. However, Lee Gun was different. He had prepared a mechanism that’ll allow him to regain his memories after he was reborn.
This was why, Universe spoke.
[You changed the other Divine statuses into some strange artifacts, and you sent them to the other dimensions… However, you have one Divine status left.]
“…!”
Lee Gun had sent the Divine statuses of Life and Death that Yeonwoo had given to him to a faraway place.
He turned the two of them into the Cradle so that they could watch over the items of the gods (Artifacts). This left Lee Gun’s original Divine status.
[The Man Who Pounds All Creations (Creator)]
It was Lee Gun’s innate ability. It allowed him to make anything into items. It was weak, but it was an innate ability that Lee Gun possessed as a “Manufacturing” god—the Divine status of a Creator.
Lee Gun had planned on using it to preserve his memories.
[You planned on turning your memories into an item and keeping it, right?]
“…!”
Universe laughed in derision as an incredible power entered Lee Gun’s body.
“Kuhk!”
This power was ripping apart Lee Gun’s body by force and evolving his body into something else. Lee Gun writhed in pain.
Universe laughed as he watched this.
[I could pretty much guess what you planned to do. Gods are given their Divine statuses even if they are reborn. If you hid the memory item within your Divine status, you might have been able to recover your memories after the inheritance. You were aiming for that.]
Universe laughed. He considered Lee Gun shrewd, but…
[I’ll tell you in on something. Universe isn’t a god.]
“…!”
It was a much higher existence.
[You will soon turn into a being greater than a god, and your Divine status will disappear. So where will you store your memories?]
Despite suffering through the pain, Lee Gun let out a crooked smile. “Hmmph. You’re going to give me a brain for free, and I’ll be able to experience the best TV shows once again. I really want to thank you for that.”
Lee Gun was being nonchalant, but he ground his teeth as if he was in a pickle. Losing his memories at this stage would be regrettable, but he decided it didn’t matter even if that happened.
Everything would be fine if Hailey and Hugo were able to live. He had nothing more he could ask for.
To be honest, he had only one thing he wanted to do with his memories intact. He had no other regrets.
‘The big problem is that I can’t leave this place even if I die.’
He had promised his friend that he would return. He promised to return even if he had to go through the process of inheritance. It was why Hugo had allowed him to go by himself.
He couldn’t break that faith in him. He couldn’t betray that trust. He didn’t want to betray his friend!
‘The process of inheritance in itself isn’t difficult.’
He had the Faith of Hugo and his nephew and niece. He’d be able to be reborn again as a god. However, leaving the World of Emptiness was impossible for him….
‘Even if I go through inheritance, I won’t be able to return to the earth.’
He wanted to stop the transfer of power, but he couldn’t reject that power.
‘Damn it!’
It was an incredible power. Despite being a Great Spirit, he felt insignificant in front of this power.
‘Damn it! This is crazy!’
At that moment…
“Koohk!”
After the transfer of power ended, Lee Gun screamed. The Divine status of a Creator separated from his body. The Divine status of Creation turned into a small gem and flew into the sky toward an unknown destination.
Afterward, an enormous explosion erupted. The space containing the previous Universe started to cease to exist. When the building disappeared, Lee Gun fell toward the distant ground.
Koo-goo-goong!
He clearly sensed it as he fell.
‘It’s disappearing.’
The power of manufacturing, which he had always possessed, faded away. His memories faded away as well. Even his implicit memories of his body were gone. At the same time, he heard an unfamiliar voice inside his head.
[Transfer complete. Congratulations on being the new ruler.]
[You will be able to rule over your subjects. You will be able to rule over your space.]
Lee Gun fell from the highest floor, where Universe had resided. The countless beings gathered at the surface of the World of Emptiness became surprised.
“Lee Gun!”
“Hyung-nim!!”
“Elder brother!”
They were the residents of the World of Emptiness, whom Lee Gun had brought to their knees. They were now subordinates of Lee Gun.
The problem was that Lee Gun had brought only the highest-rank beings to their knees. They were all Great Spirit ranks.
Naturally, his enemies were also gathered nearby. They had gathered to attack Lee Gun.
When they saw a defenseless Lee Gun fall toward the ground, they knew it was their chance. Their eyes flashed.
“Get rid of him!!”
“If we kill him, we will be ranked first!”
“I don’t know where you came from, but how dare you aim for the seat of the ruler!”
They were about to attack when….
Kwahng!!!
“Don’t overrate yourselves.”
“!”
An enormous power sent the group attacking Lee Gun flying.
The group looked around in surprise and saw someone glaring at them with violence in their eyes.
“Buzz off! He’s my prey.”
It was none other than the monarch of Abyss. Her eyes flashed as if she would kill anyone who would dare lay hands on Lee Gun.
“Serpent Bearer!” Abyss ran toward Lee Gun, who was defenseless as he fell. She snatched Lee Gun out of the air. As she held him in her arms, Abyss immediately realized the changes that had occurred to Lee Gun.
‘This is….’
Lee Gun’s body was limp as it continued to evolve. It wasn’t the weak body of a god, which the Cluders liked to eat.
‘It’s as if his body is a fusion of god and monster…’
It was the strongest body, so powerful that even she coveted it. However, this power came at a price. It was clear that Lee Gun was in serious condition.
Right now, it seemed as if Lee Gun had no goals, beliefs, or even memories. He lay limp, and his eyes were empty. It was as if he was unable to find a reason to live.
‘As expected, all his memories were erased.’
Realizing what was going on, Abyss asked, “Do you know who I am?”
“You’re the stalker who chased after me… I don’t know where you came from.”
When she was called a stalker, Abyss became angry. However, it didn’t matter in the end.
Abyss had purposefully come to the World of Emptiness to meet Lee Gun, and she had helped him take down Universe. “Don’t forget the promise you made to me, honey. You said you’ll grant me any wish if I helped you get rid of Universe.”
“Yes.”
It seemed Lee Gun remembered everything after he had entered the World of Emptiness. But any memory that would get in the way of him ruling over the World of Emptiness was erased.
“Then you should fulfill your promise. I want your body.”
Of course, she hadn’t meant it when she said it. She expected Lee Gun to get angry, call her crazy, or tell her to buzz off. She thought the anger would make him come to his senses.
“Alright. I don’t care.”
“…!”
Abyss was surprised by the unexpected answer. She looked at Lee Gun.
Unexpectedly, Lee Gun had lost too many important memories needed for him to live his life. To be precise, he lost the memories of the times he had spent with someone.
When he lost all his memories, it seemed Lee Gun had lost the will to live. It was why Abyss wondered if this was really fine.
“Do as you please.”
Lee Gun’s words snapped something within her. Originally, she was going to hold herself back. She merely wanted to snap Lee Gun out of this mental state, but she no longer cared about that right now!?
Lee Gun had given her consent!! She had kept giving and giving, yet Lee Gun had always taken it for granted! He had only used her(?).
It didn't matter how good she was to him. He thought about a different woman! He had always kicked Abyss out!!
At this point, Abyss had lost the ability to reason. She immediately used her shadow ability to move Lee Gun to a different space.
When the two of them were the only ones left, Abyss extended her hand toward Lee Gun. Her eyes flashed as if she had been waiting for this moment. “Thank you for the meal—”
Flash!!!
“!”
However, someone appeared inside Abyss’s space.
“Damn hyena.”
It was Yeonwoo.

chapters.title: Chapter 494: Book 2, Epilogue 7 - No, Not You (2)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 7 - No, Not You (2)
Abyss was stunned. “Why are you here?!”
“I came because I knew you would do this.”
“…?!”
Yeonwoo grabbed Abyss by the collar.
Bbah-gahk!
Then she head-butted her.
Abyss fell over in pain.
Yeonwoo had regained her former power, so she was very strong. Her eyes flashed at Abyss for daring to aim for Lee Gun. “You probably planned on taking advantage of Gun’s body and dominating his mind. Did you think I wouldn’t find out about it?”
Abyss didn’t like that a prey like Yeonwoo was trying to get in her way, so she intended to change back into her original form.
Flash!
“!!”
However, a flashing silver light came flying from behind Yeonwoo. A cold beam of silver light ruthlessly kicked Abyss.
Kwahng!
Abyss became angry. “You guys have lost your mind as a group!”
This attacker was Virgo. It was Ines, the master of the Full Moon.
The female swordsman with long silver hair smirked. Her demeanor implied that Abyss should get lost.
This left Abyss dumbfounded.
‘Gods lose their power in the World of Emptiness. They almost become humans.’
How were these two able to enter this place without fear? Moreover, they were here to take Lee Gun away from her?
“Get out of my face! Serpent Bearer has already accepted me as his companion.”
Yeonwoo’s smile widened in a more feral manner. “How dare a whale try to become his companion? You should know your place.”
“?!”
All the women here had come looking for Lee Gun in the World of Emptiness. They did so despite knowing they could lose their lives. Danger didn’t phase any of them.
“Ines!”
As soon as Yeonwoo spoke, Virgo blocked Abyss.
Yeonwoo used this opportunity to quickly scoop up Lee Gun. “Gun! Do you know who I am? Gun!”
Lee Gun stared at Yeonwoo for a while before he answered, “I remember your face, but… I don’t know your name. I’m sorry.”
“…!” Yeonwoo’s face became distorted in pain. Just those words gave her excruciating pain. However, it wasn’t time for her to be sad.
‘At this rate, Gun will never be able to return to his normal self.’
Right now, he still remembered her face; it wasn’t too late.
Yeonwoo yelled, “Mimir!”
Mimir, who had come with her, appeared from Lee Gun’s shadow.
Yeonwoo asked, “What happened to him, Mimir?”
“I looked into it, and as expected, Master has already ascended to the seat of Universe. Aside from the memories he had inside the World of Emptiness, everything else has been erased.”
Mimir had already investigated his master’s body, and his brows furrowed. He could see Lee Gun being eroded by a dark power. “As expected, this world is trying to keep Master tied to this place. He is being given power, and in exchange, he’ll never be able to leave this place.”
The level of bondage could be described as almost obsessive. No one could deflect this world’s obsession with Lee Gun.
Yeonwoo’s face crumpled in despair. “Then…!”
“It’s fine. We aren’t too late. Since his memories aren’t completely gone, it means…” Mimir immediately put some kind of power into Lee Gun.
Flash!
Then a change happened to Lee Gun’s body. Accompanying a light, the black power eroding Lee Gun’s body started to waver.
Abyss scoffed when she immediately realized the source of the power. “Oh. You plan on using Time’s data? You’re trying to turn back Serpent Bearer’s time to a point before he inherits the power of Universe.”
Abyss ridiculed them. “That’s low-rank data that survived after Time’s death. You need the original-rank data. You won’t be able to go against the power of the Universe using petty tricks…”
However, Abyss was soon at a loss for words.
“!!”
Lee Gun’s body was reverting to its original form.
Pah-jee-jeek!
‘Time is being wound back.’
This wasn’t the low-rank data of Time. It was the intact power of the Time monarch! This surprised Abyss.
‘Why would a mere Construct possess the original power of Time…’
She wondered what was going on, but she soon realized something. Then she glared at Mimir and sent a telepathic message to Mimir.
[You are Aslan?]
Mimir flinched. An odd smirk appeared on his lips. He replied through telepathy.
[It’s easy for me to copy Time’s ability if I have the original ingredient.]
[Oh really?]
[Let’s put that aside. Did you really think I would let the Bright Pearl have my son?]
[What the hell did you just say?!!]
When Lee Gun had gone to save Hugo in the Divine world, he had visited a past created by the goddesses of fate. It had allowed him to kill Time there, and Lee Gun was able to bring back Time’s core.
Aslan was called the Ability Creator. He was a genius magician capable of creating any type of ability. It didn’t matter if the ability was imagined or if he had heard about it through a rumor. He could recreate an ability 99% similar to what he knew.
But what would happen if he actually saw the original ability? In that case, creating an ability that was a 100% copy would be easier than breathing for him. Moreover, his target didn’t matter.
This was why Great Spirits were vexed with Aslan. They ran away from Aslan, hiding their abilities.
Anyway, Aslan had secretly possessed Mimir and activated the ability of Time.
Boom!
“Kuhk!”
“Mimir!”
Yeonwoo looked at Lee Gun, who was in pain, with worry. This made Aslan, who had possessed Mimir, look at her warmly.
“It’s fine. My old master lent me his skill. You can trust me.”
“…!”
Aslan created Time’s ability and turned back the time of Lee Gun’s body. Something surprising happened.
Flash!
It seemed his body had returned to the state before he had inherited the power from Universe.
“Huhk!”
“Gun!”
Life returned to Lee Gun’s aimless eyes as his memories were returned.
With liveliness in his eyes again, Lee Gun looked at the person in front of him. He was surprised. “Yeonwoo!”
“Gun! Your memory is back!”
“Why are you here?” A surprised Lee Gun grabbed Yeonwoo’s shoulders. “Have you lost your mind? Do you realize where this is—”
He was about to ask why she did something so reckless when…
Pah-jeek!
“…!”
The fading power of Universe returned once again.
“Time is…!”
The power rewinding time started to flow back toward the original timeline. It was proof that the power of this world or the power of Universe was vast.
In other words, Lee Gun would once again lose his memories and be trapped in the World of Emptiness.
It was also why Aslan and Yeonwoo had come here.
Aslan, who was pretending to be Mimir, spoke, “We were able to enter this place because you got rid of Universe, Master. You should use this opportunity to enter my body!”
“!”
“If your soul enters my body, the power of Universe will chase after my body, Master.”
In the meantime, the goddesses would take Lee Gun’s body toward the exit. Sufficient distance would have to be created.
“Master, you will no longer possess my body, and you will be returned to your original body. You will escape using the route we used to get here.”
“Wait a moment. That means…”
“You must get rid of the passageway once you leave. You don’t have to worry once you exit the World of Emptiness. The power of Universe won’t be able to follow you, Master.”
Lee Gun furrowed his brows. In other words, Mimir would occupy Universe while Lee Gun was spirited away.
Of course, Lee Gun knew what this meant. “If we use that method, you won’t be able to leave this place. Are you saying you’ll be trapped in the World of Emptiness instead of me?”
Aslan laughed. “No, it’ll be fine. This body is a clone. I am the repository of knowledge. There is no way I’ll move so thoughtlessly.”
“….”
In other words, Aslan would use the clone to dupe the eyes of Universe. A clone was like a mirage. Once the spell was released, the clone would disappear. This was why it was the ideal dummy.
“So you shouldn't worry about me. You can return to the earth with the goddesses. I believe up to three people can return. It should be fine.”
When the opposing force reverting time to its original state became stronger, Aslan quickly yelled, “Master! Hurry! I’m trying to turn back time, but I won’t be able to last long.”
Aslan quickly held out his hand. He was asking Lee Gun to hold his hand. Lee Gun also held out his hand. If their hands clasped each other, Lee Gun’s soul would possess Mimir’s body.
Then Universe would chase after Lee Gun’s Soul, and Mimir would run to the depths of the World of Emptiness. At that time, he would use that opportunity to release Lee Gun’s soul from the possession, and Lee Gun’s soul would return to his body near the exit.
The power of Universe would try to chase after Lee Gun once again, but it would need some time. It might be a sliver of a moment, but that would be enough time to spirit away his son to the earth!
‘Once Gun exits the World of Emptiness, it’ll all work out.’
Of course, he was lying that he was using a clone. A clone couldn’t fool Universe, but Aslan didn’t care what happened to him.
He didn’t care if he was trapped here forever. He didn’t care if an angry Universe turned him into a slave. He was willing to go through it to save his son. This was why he had pretended to be Mimir and had duped everyone.
“Hurry!!”
However, Lee Gun, who had been reaching out toward Mimir, suddenly came to a stop.
“Master?”
Lee Gun stared at Mimir as if he had caught on to something. For some reason, he let out a chuckle, then unexpectedly slapped the hand to the side.
Tahk!
This surprised Aslan. “Master…!?”
Something shocking happened next.
Poo-oohk!
Lee Gun didn’t hesitate as he stabbed his own heart.
Virgo, who had been blocking Abyss, and Yeonwoo became pale from fright when Lee Gun tried to kill himself,
“Gun?!”
“Serpent Bearer!”
“Master!”
Lee Gun was laboring as he looked at Mimir. No, he laughed as he looked at Aslan. “No. I won’t let you. I went through the trouble of setting this up.”
“…?!”
No one had any idea what he was talking about.
Lee Gun was in pain as he vomited blood. It made Aslan flustered, and he tried to heal Lee Gun. But his hands shook, which was unlike him.
Lee Gun spoke as if to say everything was fine. “My Divine status is back right now… I can go through the process of inheritance.”
“…!”
He had left an impression on Universe so that it would remember him. Now he could go through the process of inheritance.
Since this time was before his body had inherited the power, he would rather kill himself to go through the inheritance. Lee Gun considered his method a more surefire way.
“Still, I want to say thanks to you all. I acquired the opportunity to leave this place thanks to you guys.”
“…!”
Lee Gun stroked the side of Yeonwoo’s crying face. “I’ll be fine. Trust me. We’ll be able to see each other again.”
Then Lee Gun crushed his heart. At the same time, a powerful light encircled the World of Emptiness.
* * *
“What?! Suicide?! Gun killed himself?! That was how he was able to go through the inheritance?!!!” Hugo yelled, having heard Mimir’s story. He had wanted to know what had happened to his son. Hugo looked like he was going to choke Mimir.
On the other hand, Mimir spoke to calm Hugo down.
[It’s fine. He came back safely through the process of inheritance.]
“What kind of nonsense are you #*$#$*!!” Hugo grabbed the back of his neck.
He remembered the time right before Lee Gun had gone to the Devil’s Tower. His body had been a mess, and Hugo’s heart would sink whenever Lee Gun looked like he would stop breathing!
So what the hell was this?
‘Suicide?!’
The word made Hugo’s heart sink. He almost stopped breathing. On the other hand, it was unclear whether baby Lee Gun knew Hugo’s feelings.
The short baby kept tapping the tiny teaspoon against the ground in protest. He wanted Hugo to pick up the baby bottle.
Hugo was fuming as he looked at Aslan. He had wondered why Aslan hadn’t wanted to tell the story and why he had ordered Mimir to talk about it.
‘He did it because it was about his son killing himself.’
Aslan’s refusal now seemed understandable.
If it were Hugo, he would have already developed trauma from such an event.
“Anyway, you guys realized Gun would be trapped forever in the World of Emptiness if he killed Universe. This was why you went looking for him three years ago.”
“Yes.”
He finally understood Yeonwoo’s reason for leaving.
Mimir said, “Originally, the plan was for me to save Master, but Old Master said I would have a hard time controlling the clone. So he said he would do it instead. In turn, he told me to tell no one about it.”
“That’s why Aslan possessed your body?”
“Yes. Old Master’s control of magic is much better than mine. It’s quite hard to get rid of a clone.”
Hugo suspiciously looked at Aslan, who was watching TV.
‘He was going to use a clone?’
Would it be possible to trick the World of Emptiness with a mere clone? There was no way a genius like him would be unaware of this.
When he was Eternal Change, Hugo had been in the prison of a Great Spirit. Aslan had calmly broken through impregnable barriers that kept everyone out. He was a genius that had taken the monarch out of prison.
When pandemonium had broken out at Eternal Change’s absence, the cheeky kid had laughed, baldly lying that another Great Spirit had broken through the prison.
This was why Hugo immediately realized what had happened.
‘It’s obvious he tricked Mimir. He planned on being trapped inside the World of Emptiness.’
Aslan would prevent others from getting involved and would save his own son through his sacrifice. Someone like him would have already prepared a new body for Mimir on the earth.
However, Gun taking his own life had turned Aslan’s plan into waste.
Soon, Mimir spoke as it looked at the baby Lee Gun. “I still have no idea why Master refused Old Master’s offer. I have no idea why he killed himself…”
“You don’t know why? There is no way Gun would have done something like that without any reason.”
Hearing Hugo’s words, Aslan flinched as if he had been pricked by a needle. It seemed Aslan had been pretending to be watching the TV. His gaze fell to the ground, and his face scrunched up a bit.
These words seemed to have brought up great pain inside him.
This was why Hugo asked, “I heard everything I wanted to hear. What do you want to ask me, Aslan?”
“….”
“Aslan?”
“No, it’s fine. I don’t want to do this anymore.”
“Aslan?!”
Aslan became temperamental. It seemed he was no longer having fun.
Hugo wondered why Aslan was acting this way, but he soon screamed as if he had remembered something. “Wait a moment! You forgot to answer the most important question! Hey! Come back!”
Mimir responded instead, “What important problem?”
“I’m talking about Gun’s body! You said he gave up on Universe’s power, and he went through inheritance. So why’s he like a monster?”
“Ah! It was close, but he was successful in going through inheritance as a god, but… Since time was rewound, it was a weird time to go through inheritance.”
“That means…!”
“Yes. The power of Universe and his Divine power was mixed. He did give up on the throne since he left the World of Emptiness, but he was born with a portion of Universe’s power.”
The power of Universe and that of a god had been mixed.
“Wait a moment. What about his memories?! If what you say is true, wouldn’t he have some of his memories left?”
“Ah! His memory is—”
Tahng!!!
“!!”
Crunch!
Before he could say the rest, the sound of a table breaking rang out. The surprised Mimir turned his head. He saw Lee Gun silently glare at him. It was as if Lee Gun was threatening to beat him up if he spoke any further.

chapters.title: Chapter 495: Book 2, Epilogue 8 - No, Not You (3)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 8 - No, Not You (3)
Ttahng!!
Lee Gun struck the dining table and glared at Mimir.
Mimir started to sweat.
“Mimir?”
Hugo was also taken aback by his reaction. With a serious expression, he looked at Mimir. “Can it be… Gun’s memories are…”
At that moment…
“Byaaaaaa!!!”
“!”
Crunch!
Lee Gun’s eyes were filled with anger. Since he was unable to talk, he had destroyed the dining table.
It was as if he was trying to interfere with their conversation. Or maybe he was really hungry and wanted them to give him the baby bottle instead of them talking. Or maybe he was trying to stop Hugo from asking about his memories.
Anyway, Baby Lee Gun’s actions looked a bit urgent.
Hugo still had a serious expression as he grabbed Mimir’s shoulders. The question about Lee Gun’s memory was really important. It was extremely important to him.
“Mimir? Does Gun have his memory?”
For some reason, one could feel madness(?) from his gaze.
Mimir was sweating. “T…That is…”
“So?”
Instead of answering, Mimir discreetly glanced at Lee Gun. He was met with Lee Gun’s flashing eyes. However, Mimir didn’t back down.
‘I should tell at least one person….’
Lee Gun’s constricted pupils turned menacing.
Seeing this, a flustered Mimir picked up the fallen baby bottle. He quickly gave it to Lee Gun as he spoke. “H…He has no memories.”
“Is that so?”
After receiving the baby bottle, Lee Gun held it with his small hands and drank the formula.
Keeping an eye on Lee Gun, Mimir continued, “As I’ve said before, his body turned into the body of Universe. It changed a lot, and his Divine status went away.”
“If his Divine status is gone…”
“The Creator’s Divine status of Creation (Manufacturing) is gone now.”
“!”
Lee Gun’s power had been sent to a strange place when he inherited the power of Universe. Aslan’s Rewind Time had temporarily brought back Lee Gun’s Divine status, but after the process of inheritance, Lee Gun had reverted to a state where the Divine status was separated from him.
The power of Universe was that strong.
“The memory data supposed to be left inside the Divine status is gone, and there is no way to bring it back. He lost all his memories when he went through inheritance.”
“I see. What about the power of Universe?”
“Since he gave up on the throne, he cannot use that power. M…Maybe?”
Hugo immediately let out a sigh of relief. If Lee Gun possessed such power, the earth would be destroyed! They were much better off without it!
As for the missing Divine status, he could order the Constructs to locate it. Of course, Hugo didn’t really care if the Divine status stayed missing!
He wanted Gun to be kind and innocent in this life. He wanted Gun to grow up as a normal child who looked up to his father!
“That means Gun’s body will have no ill effects?”
“Y…Yes. Instead, the fact that his body is so strong might be a problem…”
“Strong…?”
“Don’t worry about it. You have seen it for the past six months. His body may not be human, but he doesn’t have his Divine status. He no longer has enough power to destroy the earth like before.”
While he hadn’t destroyed the earth, Lee Gun had already destroyed Hugo’s rooms, safe, ceiling, and floor!
“B-but his destruction is limited to this house.”
The problem was that Hugo was losing an astronomical amount of money in repairing his house!
“T…That might be true…. Aside from that, he’s a normal child who can’t use any abilities. Maybe.”
If he were able to use his abilities, his mere presence would be a calamity! He would be someone who shouldn’t reside on the earth!!
“Hmmph. The problem is his incredible strength, but… the Zodiac Saints would be able to keep him in check. Maybe.”
Hug was bothered by the “maybe” that kept popping up at the end of each statement. Still, he let out a sigh of relief. “I’m fine with that. I’m glad that Gun doesn’t have his memories. I prefer it.”
“What? You prefer it?”
Hugo looked at Lee Gun and smiled ear to ear. He laughed heartily. “If he has his memories, I won’t be able to see this cute version of him. Also, I will make sure that he’ll become a daddy’s boy in this life.”
His original plan was to turn Lee Gun’s children into fanatics of Hugo. He planned on getting his revenge that way. However, he now planned on making Lee Gun into a fanboy of his own. This route would bring more pleasure to him!!
“Do you understand now, Gun? From now on, I’m your step-father…”
Was it his words? Or was Lee Gun turned off by Hugo’s expression?
Lee Gun, who had been sucking on the baby bottle, looked oddly disgruntled. His expression changed.
“My son— Ahhhhk!!!” Hugo screamed when he was electrocuted by a strange(?) power.
“Wait a moment. What the hell is this…!! You said he won’t be able to use his abilities!!!!”
Mimir bit his tongue at the sight. He spoke as if he had forgotten to mention it. “Yes. That’s not an ability. When the power was being transferred, it created a rebound. I forgot to mention that you’ll have to be careful until that rebound dissipates. Since it’s a rebound, the power shouldn’t be too strong.
“Still, it would cause great pain to even a monarch if they touched it. Mmm. It should feel like you’re having a severe cramp in your leg?”
“What the hell?! Tell me that sooner! You’re a Daddy’s boy, right, Gun— Ahhk!!!”
Lee Gun sent an electric attack every time Hugo spoke.
Hugo screamed. “Ahhhk! Cramp! I really got a cramp in my legs!”
“That’s… That’s what happens when your muscles seize up… It won’t cause any permanent harm. Just endure it. If you keep getting hit by it, it hurts. However, your muscles feel relaxed afterward.”
“What the hell did you just say?! Ahhk!” Hugo couldn’t shake off the feeling that something was off. “He really doesn’t have his memories?!”
“T…That’s right.”
“Then why is he acting like this?”
Mimir gauged Lee Gun’s reaction, then said, “That’s… He doesn’t have his memories since he went through the process of inheritance, but it’s the same body…. What if his body remembers?”
“What the hell!?”
That must be it! Wait a moment. Wouldn’t it be a problem even if that was the case?!
* * *
Hugo’s body was aching all over. He groaned as he lay down. Mimir had told him to be careful until the rebound disappeared from Lee Gun’s body.
Hugo had to ask a question just to make sure. “Are you sure he doesn’t have a special power?! He’s just a kid with enormous strength?!”
“Y-Yes. I don’t think Master inherited the power of Universe. Just endure it for a little longer. Don’t worry. M-Master is a normal child…” Mimir had monitored Lee Gun while answering Hugo.
Hugo groaned as he acknowledged Mimir’s words. It was as Mimir had said. His knotted muscles relaxed. It felt like the difficulties one felt the day after getting an extremely powerful massage.
“Damn it… I haven’t been exercising recently because I have to take care of Gun…”
At that moment, Sagittarius entered the small room.
‘Whew! Finally, no one is here.’
Sagittarius had secretly visited Lee Gun, who was taking a nap. Baby Lee Gun was sleeping soundly on top of a thick blanket.
‘I should have come in secret from the start.’
Sagittarius was relentless when it came to dispelling the curse placed on him. This was why he had come looking for Lee Gun. He assumed Lee Gun was the only one capable of releasing him from the curse.
‘He might not have his memories and Divine Status, but it doesn’t change the fact that he is Gun.’
Sagittarius had failed last time because of Lee Jaewon, but this attempt would be different.
‘Jaewon isn’t here today. He went to ask for permission so that Hailey and Gun can meet each other.’
It was why Sagittarius had come looking for Lee Gun.
In front of Lee Gun, Sagittarius took out an item. It was the hair growth solution that Lee Gun had made before his death. No, it was the item of Life.
‘It was supposed to become useless after Gun’s death.’
However, the story changed once Lee Gun had returned from death. As soon as Lee Gun appeared on the earth, all his holy items had regained their original forms.
‘The only problem is that they won’t activate.’
Was it because their connection to Lee Gun’s soul was severed when he went through inheritance? For example, it was like buying a new TV and needing to plug in the TV.
On the other hand, Sagittarius had witnessed something.
‘They were revived.’
As soon as Lee Gun’s chubby hands had touched Hugo’s bow and the weapons of the Chun siblings, they had started to work once again! It probably had to do with the fact that the weapons had touched Lee Gun’s soul.
‘It means the hair loss solution will activate once again if he touches it.’
Sagittarius would be able to recover his deficiencies with this item. He’d escape suspicion from others with this!
‘Of course, it’ll be for nothing if Gun possesses his memories.’
There was no way the mighty Lee Gun would stand by and let him live the good life! Therefore, this was his golden chance as Lee Gun didn’t have his memories right now! He would also take the opportunity to pluck out some of Gun’s hair and make other items with it!
Sagittarius was about to put the item in Lee Gun’s hand when…
“Baldie!”
“!?”
Sagittarius suddenly shook in surprise when he heard the sudden voice. His reaction was understandable since “Baldie” was a nickname coined by Lee Gun.
He turned his head in surprise, but he soon let out a sigh of relief. “What the hell? It was the TV….”
He quickly tried to activate the item using Lee Gun’s power.
“Hey, Baldie.”
“!!”
Sagittarius felt his heart fall into his stomach when he turned to look at where the sound had originated. The one to make the noise was none other than Lee Gun!
Sagittarius had thought Lee Gun was asleep, but Lee Gun was staring at him with his round black eyes.
“D-Did you just talk to me?” Sagittarius’ face trembled as he looked at Lee Gun. His black eyes were like glass that looked deeper than space. For some reason, it was much harder to see what he was thinking on that day.
“Hey, Baldie! Baldie!”
“!”
Something fluttered as it popped out from Lee Gun’s side. It was a Construct shaped like a parrot.
“Baldie!”
When he witnessed the parrot speak, Sagittarius clutched at his surprised heart. “What the hell? It was the Construct that had been speaking right now— Wait a moment!!!”
Where the hell did the Construct come out from?! Flustered, Sagittarius looked at his surroundings.
‘I didn’t feel its presence.’
The probability of a normal child like Gun summoning a Construct was nonexistent. He had heard from others that Lee Gun didn’t possess any power.
‘Did Hugo assign it to him in secret?’
It was a Construct that Sagittarius had never seen before, so that was possible.
In the end, he told them to not surprise a god. Then he reached out to place the item in Lee Gun’s hand.
Kwah-jeek!
“?!”
Lee Gun grabbed Sagittarius’ fingers, and Sagittarius felt like he would break them.
“G…Gun?”
The parrot spoke. “Hey, baldie.”
Sagittarius snorted as he started to sweat. “Hmmph. I won’t be fooled again. The parrot is speak—”
“You want to die?”
“?!!”
The parrot laughed as it spoke in Lee Gun’s speech pattern. That wasn’t all.
As the parrot spoke, Lee Gun looked at Sagittarius. There was an odd smirk on the baby’s lips.
Sagittarius felt faint when he saw this. Was it a coincidence? It had to be a coincidence, right????!
Sagittarius was shaking. In front of him were the parrot and Lee Gun. He had no idea who was speaking to him at that moment.
‘Is the parrot supposed to be his Construct?’
The parrot spoke too similarly to Lee Gun for that to be true! Then there was that odd smirk on the child’s face!
Sagittarius felt his heart drop into his stomach.
‘Can it be?’
Lee Gun has his memories?! He also had them?
‘That’s right. I have my memories. There is no reason why that shouldn't be true of that child.’
Sagittarius looked stricken with fear as he looked at Lee Gun. He gulped as he watched the baby Lee Gun stare at him. “Do you really have—”
“Byaa? Byaa!!”
“!”
The baby laughed when he saw the bird fly outside.
Sagittarius flopped backward.
‘Y…Yes. There is no way that’s true.’
The god almost felt embarrassed to have been suspicious of Lee Gun. He watched as Lee Gun played with his rattle.
‘If he had his memories, he would have already caused mayhem.’
It was the mighty Lee Gun. His rough and violent personality would have been revealed a long time ago. He would have shown signs.
‘His personality wouldn’t allow him to suck on a baby bottle and be loved by everyone.’
Sagittarius found it very hard to be treated like a kid when he possessed his memories. Moreover, the Zodiac Saints had clashed against each other as they debated whether he was the real Lee Gun.
Lee Gun’s personality would have made him discipline the Zodiac Saints on the spot.
‘Yes. It’s a coincidence. There is no way….’
At that moment…
“You have your memories, right?”
“Ahhhhhk!!!!”
Sagittarius screamed when he heard a voice once again. “As expected, you…!”
A surprised Sagittarius clutched his heart, then turned his gaze to see Lee Gun. He couldn’t believe what he saw.
“You have your memories, right?”
“…!”
The one to speak wasn’t Lee Gun. It wasn’t the parrot either.
“You have your memories, right?” You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right?”
The voice came from the tablet PC in Lee Gun’s hands. Surprisingly, Lee Gun had used the device to play a clip from a movie.
Sagittarius grabbed the back of his neck. “You surprised me… Wait a minute. A baby can use electronics!!”
“You have your memories, right?”
“Ahhk!!”
Lee Gun had opened YouTube, and the app had saved short clips with famous lines from movies. Lee Gun was replaying one of the clips on a loop.
It seemed the videos were all something Hugo had saved. It was done for Lee Gun’s education. No, it was done for his brainwashing(?).
Sagittarius took a peek. He could see the clips of Hugo, which Hugo had worked hard to compile.
Clearly, Hugo was brainwashing(?) Lee Gun by making him watch the clips daily.
“What the hell is he doing to a kid… Whatever! It seems I was mistaken. That’s great…”
“You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right?”
“Ahhhk!!!!!!”
Lee Gun played the clip on an infinite loop, giving Sagittarius a mental breakdown.
Sagittarius wanted to check his sanity by looking at Lee Gun, and he witnessed Lee Gun pressing the replay button repeatedly as he watched him.
Was it a coincidence? It looked as if Lee Gun was enjoying Sagittarius’ reaction!
‘Damn it…!!! Why the hell would Hugo let a kid watch that?’
Sagittarius cursed at the timing of that line. Why did it have to be that clip of all things?
‘Is it a coincidence?’
Sagittarius’s face froze. How could there be a clip with a line perfect for this situation? He had no choice but to think that Lee Gun had used some unknown power to create the video.
However, he had been told that Lee Gun had no power. Moreover, which Divine ability was capable of pulling such a thing off? Was it the power of Universe?
‘Damn it! What is it? Does he have his memories or not?'
Was Lee Gun purposefully tormenting and making fun of him?
‘Is he using the electronic on purpose because he can’t speak?’
Sagittarius’s eyes shook as he monitored Lee Gun. However, he soon shook his head from side to side.
‘No…!!! There is no way!’
If Lee Gun had his memories, he wouldn’t pretend to be a baby in such a well-behaved manner!!!
“Yes. It can’t be Gun from before—”
Suddenly…
“You want to die?”
“?!”
Lee Gun played a different clip. The timing was so impeccable that it was hard to call it a coincidence!!
Sagittarius clutched at his head. “Which is the truth….”
“Byaa!”
“Yes! There is no way that’s Gun!”
“You want to die? You want to die? You want to die? You want to die? You want to die? You want to die? You want to die? You want to die? You want to die? You want to die?”
“Ahhhhhhhhk!!”
Sagittarius fainted in front of a laughing Lee Gun.

chapters.title: Chapter 496: Book 2, Epilogue 9 - I became a slime one day (1)
chapters.content:
Book 2, Epilogue 9 - I became a slime one day (1)
“What the hell?”
Aslan’s eyes turned round when he saw the sight in front of him. Before him was the unconscious figure of Sagittarius. At a glance, he looked to be a seven-year-old boy.
Aslan tilted his head in puzzlement. He wondered why Sagittarius was unconscious in the middle of the floor, but he soon found out the reason.
“You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right? You have your memories, right?”
“!”
“Byaaaaa??”
Baby Lee Gun was looping the sound on the tablet PC and plucking out the hair from the young Sagittarius’s head. It also looked as if Lee Gun was checking whether Sagittarius was dead or alive.
Aslan let out a chuckle as he looked at Sagittarius.
‘I can guess what happened here.’
There was a possibility that Sagittarius had been caught unawares by Gun’s strength, but…
‘As expected, he had his memories.’
After sending Lee Gun off to the World of Emptiness, Aslan had researched to find a method that would allow him to extract Lee Gun from that world.
During this time, he had heard about Sagittarius going through the process of inheritance.
‘I did expect it.’
It was normal for gods to lose their memories when going through inheritance. Inheritance was reincarnation, like a reset. But there was an exception.
Ra!
Basically, the Lord of the Fire Wheel was an irregular. He was able to keep his memories as he went through the process of inheritance.
And Sagittarius could keep his memories like him because of one reason.
‘He possesses the Steal ability.’
In the past, Sagittarius had stolen the Fire Wheel Lord’s treasure from Ennead. This treasure had been the Fire Wheel Lord’s power, and in stealing it, Sagittarius had gotten some of the Fire Wheel Lord’s power as well.
‘That’s why Hyung-nim was able to retain his memories.’
Of course, this wasn’t an oddity, but…
‘He should be careful. Eternal Change must not find out about this.’
Eternal Change was a fanatic of the Creators. If Eternal Change found out about Sagittarius’s situation, he would kill the god.
Also, it seemed Gun had already found out about him.
“Byaa!”
When Sagittarius didn’t get back up, Aslan laughed as he looked at the pouting Lee Gun. “Oh, my! Is Gun mad because he isn’t getting up? You want him awake?”
“Byaa! Byaa!!”
Lee Gun babbled as he slapped Sagittarius’s head with his small hand.
Aslan found this so endearing that he hugged Lee Gun. “I like that my son is in this form.”
“Byaaaaaaaaa?!!!” Lee Gun didn’t like the tight hug from Aslan. He squirmed. “Byaa! Byaaaaa!!!”
The baby used his chubby hands and feet to hit Aslan and threw a tantrum.
The outcry made Aslan loosen his hold on Lee Gun, and he looked displeased. “Do you hate being hugged by your father that much?”
“Byaa!!!” The baby acted as if this was a given. He protested by tapping on Aslan’s arm. “Byaa! Byaa!! Byaaaa!”
It seemed he wanted Aslan to stop this nonsense and put him down.
As his father, Aslan was hurt by Lee Gun’s reaction. He pouted as he lowered Lee Gun to the ground. Of course, Aslan didn’t just put him down.
“Byaa?!”
He flipped over Lee Gun.
Having been suddenly flipped on his back, Lee Gun whined as he struggled. He couldn’t roll over. “Byaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!”
Aslan smirked as if he was making a point. “See? My son is still a cub incapable of flipping over, right?”
“Byaaaaaaaaa!!!”
“Mmm? You want me to raise you back up?”
Aslan was a god with “Ability Creation.” He could easily make an ability related to translation.
This was why he could understand the speech of monsters, animals, and other races. Translating the babbling of a baby was easy for him.
Of course, he didn’t need to use his Translation ability to figure out what his son wanted.
Aslan flipped over Lee Gun with a smile. “This is the second time I’m seeing you like this. You were much cuter back then.”
“Byaaaaa….” Lee Gun finally was able to see the ceiling. He looked humiliated and angered, and his brows were furrowed. Moreover, his forehead had turned red.
Seeing his son glaring at him, Aslan mischievously laughed. “What? Are you saying I should act as if I’m your father?”
“Byaaaa!!!”
“You’re too much. I’ve watched over you since you were born.”
“Byaaa?” Lee Gun tilted his head as if Aslan were talking nonsense.
His eyes said that they had met when Lee Gun was an adult. He was implying that Aslan was trying to play tricks on him by saying he had watched over Lee Gun since his childhood.
Only three years had passed since Lee Gun and Aslan had met each other. After Lee Gun had gotten rid of Time, he had met Aslan, who had presented himself as the former Serpent Bearer and thirteenth Zodiac. That was their first meeting.
Aslan laughed. “You might not know this, but I’ve been with you since you were young.”
In the past, Aslan had lost his family and friends. He had even lost his wife, whom he treasured the most in this world. He took his revenge on those who were the reason he lost his most treasured person, then he had died.
‘I thought that was the end for me.’
However, he had suddenly become a slime. He had become one thanks to his damn son. It was quite an absurd turn of events.
* * *
Aslan had found out about the existence of his son after his wife had died. When he had held the bloodied corpse of his wife, he had realized that there was a child inside her stomach.
It was Lee Gun. Despite his mother’s death, the child was still alive inside her stomach. It might have had something to do with Aslan’s Divine status. The Divine status of Asclepius (Life) might have strengthened Lee Gun’s life force.
Anyway, Aslan sent his yet-to-be-born son into the flow of the universe. His child might be born hundreds or thousands of years in the future, and he had no idea where. Aslan didn’t know which dimensions and country his child would be born into. He just hoped his child would survive somewhere.
Aslan wanted his child to live a normal life with good parents. He sent his child away with that wish in his heart. Of course, he had never thought he would be able to see his son again.
“This boy’s name is Gun.”
When his son met Yeonwoo at the orphanage, Aslan had wordlessly placed his hands over his face.
He had immediately recognized him since his son was a splitting image of his beautiful mother.
It had left Aslan speechless.
Thousands of dimensions and countless numbers of timelines existed in the universe. So him meeting his child among the countless crossroads was fate. It was a miracle.
Aslan was inside the Divine status of Life, which Yeonwoo possessed, and he watched Lee Gun grow up.
‘Of course, I never expected Yeonwoo to hand over her Divine status to my son before she died.’
Moreover, he had never expected to see his son get beaten up by the Cluders. At the time, Lee Gun didn’t know how to use his power well.
“Kuh-huhk!”
Kwahng!!!
