Lee Gun had just awakened, and he was a novice. He didn’t even know how to kill the Cluders. To make matters worse, he had no decent weapons! He was an idiot who charged the Cluders with a knife!
“Ahhhk!! Gun! A kitchen knife won’t work against them!!”
“Guuuuun! They won’t die because you burn them… Ahhhk!!!”
“Gun!! They won’t fall unconscious because you hit them on the head!!! It’s useless to hit them between their legs!!!”
Aslan was a nervous wreck as he watched his son hunt with his life on the line.
“They are trash!! Damn it! Are you really my son?!”
He wasn’t even fighting a monarch!
‘He lost a fight to a slime, a low-rank Cluder?!’
It was devastating! If he had it his way, he wanted to kill the monsters for his son!
‘I had hoped he wouldn't possess any power, but…!’
The look of his son told him that it was out the window. He thought this when he saw the weapon Lee Gun had made.
‘Yes. It seems he’s my son by the look of it.’
Lee Gun possessed the blood of the Creators. In the beginning, he hadn’t known how to manufacture weapons. However, he had backstabbed the Constructs of the Capricorn temple to steal their basic blueprints.
Lee Gun worked hard to teach himself how to manufacture weapons, and he was able to create Heaven’s Punishment through his self-study.
The blueprints had been C-rank, yet Lee Gun had created at least an S-rank item. His tenaciousness, talent, and effort were commendable even in Aslan’s eyes.
‘What the hell? He made a weapon with a will of its own??’
Aslan was sure of it now.
‘That’s the Item Creation ability.’
If Aslan had Ability Creation, his son had Item Creation.
If someone asked him whether the manufacturing ability was good, Aslan would have been ambivalent about the answer.
‘The manufacturing ability is considered cursed among the Creators.’
Of course, the manufacturing ability was a rare and good ability. The Creators with this ability were the ones to create the Divine world. They had made holy items for the Primordial god and the Great Spirits; created the Rule Book, the foundation of the Divine world; and created the core of the Divine world.
In other words, manufacturing was the backbone of the Creators. They had been treated like heroes by the other Creators as well as the Divine world. They were called legends for a reason.
‘However, no one capable of succeeding them had appeared. Their line was cut short.’
Aslan had been the last generation of them, and by the time he had appeared, the Creators were only capable of conducting repairs. They were unable to create new items.
His father, the chief of the Creators, had been sad that no new Creators with the manufacturing ability had appeared for a long time.
- The one born a thousand years ago was the last, but he could create only junk…
- The Great Spirits will be disappointed.
- Still, he was more skilled than the manufacturing gods.
- The blacksmith gods will be angry if they hear you.
- It is what it is.
While the manufacturing ability was rare, it was much more difficult to develop an ability with depth.
If the Creators were flowers, they had become extinct. This ability was supposed to be the backbone of the Creators.
Aslan had never expected his son to be born with such a precious ability! Moreover, Aslan could tell his son had untapped potential when he made Heaven’s Punishment. Lee Gun wasn’t destined to create junk items.
‘If father were alive, he would have shed tears on finding out that his grandson was a Creator with the manufacturing ability. He would have bragged about it everywhere he went.’
A manufacturing ability was like the air breathed by a Creator. It was the root of their tribe.
So his son possessing such an ability made Aslan feel an odd sense of pride.
‘Of course, he might have the ability, but he has a long way to go.’
When it came to manufacturing, one had to learn to become good with one’s hands. However, his son couldn't focus solely on manufacturing items. He had to fight at the same time.
Aslan had to watch his son get injured over and over again as he used his clumsy weapon. It was painful, yet the only thing Aslan could do was watch.
Until Lee Gun was able to meet Hugo, Lee Gun didn’t go to the city because he didn’t want the monsters chasing after him to harm the humans residing in the city.
This was why Lee Gun spent his nights in ruins, which had no heat. Aslan felt like his heart was being ripped apart as he watched Lee Gun shake from the cold while sleeping alone.
‘If only I had a body…’
He would be able to teach Lee Gun to do better. He would be able to show Lee Gun the proper way to manufacture items.
While his specialty wasn’t manufacturing, he would be able to help Lee Gun make higher-ranked weapons. It would allow Lee Gun to get hurt less.
However, Aslan was a soul, so no one could see him. It was impossible for him to touch anything. Aslan couldn’t even place a blanket over his son, who was shaking from the cold.
‘It doesn’t matter what it is. I just want a body!’
Aslan kept praying for it, and on that day, he was watching over Lee Gun. It seemed his son had realized his weapons were too weak.
‘If he wants to make a Divine weapon, he needs to put great effort into it. It isn’t just about talent.’
In truth, it was almost a miracle that Lee Gun had created the SS-rank Heaven’s Punishment. Afterward, he wasn’t able to make a decent weapon. The highest-rank weapon he created after that was B rank.
Lee Gun had realized this fact too, so he kept his research going. That day was the same.
‘Mmmm. It seems he isn’t making a weapon today. It looks like he’s making medicine of some sort…’
Was he going to work in vain today again…? No, it seemed he was trying to make a poison. Lee Gun had acquired a water tank that could fit forty people, and he was busily putting ingredients into the water tank.
The water tank was filled with the innards and eyes of monsters. There were powders created from unknown mushrooms. He had even included hair pulled out from somewhere unknown.
‘Is it poison he’ll use to kill monsters?’
It looked to be a powerful poison that could kill a monster with a single drop.
Of course, what Lee Gun was making didn’t matter to Aslan since he wouldn’t be doing anything. No, it was more accurate to say he couldn’t do anything. He was an existence that couldn’t be seen, heard, or touched.
‘I can only put faith in my child and watch.’
It didn’t matter if Lee Gun succeeded or failed. Only he could make the choices.
Still, Aslan was curious about what Lee Gun was making, so he kept looking over Lee Gun’s back. However, he soon became shocked when he saw the blueprint in his son’s hands.
[Beauty Skin Care Medicine (For Massage Use) (A)]
- Even a monster’s skin will be made smooth in an instant!
- It is extremely popular among gods and goddesses!
Aslan felt like dying because he had coughed through the wrong pipe. His son wasn’t making poison. He was making a skin product?!
‘He’ll plaster that on his skin?!!!’
He’d die as soon as he applied it!!!! He’d die because it was truly a deadly poison!!!!!
Soon, Lee Gun was finished putting in all the ingredients. He let out a satisfied smile as he tapped his hideous face.
“This will clear up my skin.”
It won’t clear up your skin!!!!! Aslan’s face was pale as he looked at his son. It was rare for him to have a mental breakdown like this.
‘I…I have to stop him!!!’

chapters.title: Chapter 497: Book 2: Epilogue 10 - I became a slime one day (2)
chapters.content:
‘I have to stop him!!!’
Aslan became desperate.
‘He really is thinking about applying that to his face!!!’
Why the hell did he think such an item would be good for his skin? No, that wasn’t important right now.
‘Did he steal the recipe from the Aquarius Constructs?’
Aslan had wondered why Lee Gun had gone out of his way to pick a fight with Constructs from the Aquarius temple last time!
‘Did he use that opportunity to steal the drug recipe?!’
As a side effect of his awakening, his son no longer looked like his mother. Aslan felt bad for his son’s changed appearance.
It was understandable why Lee Gun would want to make cosmetic medicine, but this wasn’t it!
“No! Gun! Those ingredients are no good! This isn’t it! You shouldn’t do this!!!”
Aslan was a magician, but he possessed the Divine status of Asclepius. So he was one of the top gods of medicine in the Divine world. He was also a master of pharmacology.
“Damn it! This is not fine!!!!!”
Aslan, who was known for being extremely level-headed, was stumbling over his words. He wondered what had precipitated this situation. It seemed his son had mistranslated the words of the gods.
From a human’s point of view, the letters used by the gods looked very similar to each other.
‘Those aren’t the ingredients needed to make an effective cosmetic medicine...!’
It wasn’t time to dawdle! If Lee Gun made a medicine using those ingredients as a base, his face would melt!!!
Oblivious to this, Lee Gun dusted off his hands. “I put the ingredients into the container for mixing medicine... Now that I think about it, I didn’t disinfect the container. Disinfecting it is a must since it’ll be touching my skin.”
Aslan screamed. Someone who cared about disinfecting the container was going to use such ingredients for medicine! In fact, what was the point of disinfecting it if he had already put in the ingredients?!
His son was the type of person to stitch his wound back up using a needle sterilized with fire. He used such half-assed methods because he didn’t have any disinfectant. Should he be praising his son for having better hygiene compared to before?!
“Y...Yes. As his father, I want him to use disinfectants...”
“Ah! I don’t have any disinfectants. Let me just pour in some soju.”
“Ahhhhhk!!!”
The god of medicine screamed as he watched his son pour in soju with 20% alcohol content.
“At the very least, you should use vodka!!!”
Of course, a higher alcohol content wouldn’t be more useful in this situation, but that wasn’t important right now.
‘What should I do? He really is trying to put that on his face.’
Aslan was having a mental breakdown as he quickly climbed atop the water tank. This enormous water tank could fit around forty people.
The mixture of ingredients that Lee Gun had put inside it was letting out a noxious fume. It was a poison that was out of this world.
Aslan grabbed the back of his neck. He had no idea where Lee Gun had acquired this water tank. It was a marvel that he had decided to use the water tank as a bowl to mix his ingredients.
“L...L...Look at that amount of noxious gas coming off of it! Also, the number of ingredients he used makes it a toxic substance. Also, why the hell did he bring this container? How much skin ointment is he trying to create?”
Aslan hadn’t paid attention to all that because he had assumed Lee Gun was making a poison to use against monsters!
Lee Gun yawned as he sat at the entrance to the water tank. He held a pole, which he used to mix the ingredients. “I wonder if it’ll take long for this to mature?”
Aslan felt faint. “He is going to mature it?? It’s already dangerous. I have no idea what will be created if he matures it... Ahhhk! Gun!! Get up! Don’t sleep! You can’t let it mature! Stop it!!!”
Lee Gun, who had been stirring the ingredients with the pole, started to nod off. He had been spending his mornings and nights trying to manufacture weapons and the daytime to kill the monsters.
He hadn’t slept for a week straight. Lee Gun’s head nodded back and forth like a metronome.
“You shouldn’t fall asleep, Gun...!! No. Is it better if he falls asleep?”
While Gun was falling asleep, Aslan wondered if he could get rid of the poisonous ingredients.
‘I’m pretty sure Heaven’s Punishment can hear me.’
Aslan entered the water tank. The water tank was deep enough that it would be difficult to climb back out.
‘Mmm. It’ll be tough to get rid of everything here.’
Aslan decided to take out the most dangerous ingredients first.
‘If I take this and this out, the poison will be neutralized. While it won’t become medicine, it’ll become a harmless lotion if I mess with the ratio.’
As expected of an expert in pharmacology, Aslan immediately made changes to the recipe. Then he yelled toward the water tank’s entrance, “Heaven’s Punishment! You can hear me, right?!”
When Aslan shouted, the bundle next to Lee Gun flinched. It was Heaven’s Punishment, the first holy item created by Lee Gun.
Aslan had no idea why Heaven’s Punishment was able to hear him, but he decided to not think too deeply about it. “Heaven’s Punishment! Come over here for a moment. I want you to mess with some things that I point out! Can you do that for me?!”
Heaven’s Punishment was an item created to hunt down monsters. A weapon of its caliber could turn monster carcasses into ashes by mere touch. Moreover, Heaven’s Punishment had a will of its own. If it had enough magical energy, it could move on its own.
“If you don’t help me, your owner will be in danger!”
As soon as he spoke those words, the indifferent Heaven’s Punishment moved.
Doo-doo-doohk!
It used magical energy to move. Seeing it about to enter the water tank, Aslan laughed. “Yes. That’s right! You’re doing well! I want you to come here and get rid of this and that—”
At that moment...
“Bad Heaven’s Punishment.”
Kwah-jeek!
“!”
Despite having his eyes closed, Lee Gun must have felt the weapon’s presence. The sleeping Lee Gun propped up his chin. He used one hand to grab Heaven’s Punishment, which had been trying to enter the tank.
“You shouldn’t enter it by disinfecting yourself. Bad boy.”
Both Heaven’s Punishment and Aslan were taken aback by Lee Gun’s firm touch.
“No, Gun! Send Heaven’s Punishment in here! You have to send him in!”
“Ah-ha! You must want to coat yourself with it too. Don’t worry! After I make it, I’ll apply it to you. You’ll have a fine luster.”
“No! If you apply it to Heaven's Punishment, it’ll die!!!!”
“Since the ingredients have matured, I should start mixing them.”
“Damn it!!! It has been less than a minute, so how could it mature... Uh? You’re going to mix it?”
Aslan’s face turned pale from fright. If he were in here while it was being mixed...
‘Will I become an ingredient too....?’
Asllan started to sweat. His reaction was understandable since Lee Gun possessed Item Creation, an ability that could turn “any ingredient” into an item.
‘He can even use a soul as an ingredient...!’
Aslan had a realization, and he quickly tried to exit the water tank. However, Lee Gun had already put the pole into the water tank.
Splash!!!
Lee Gun imbued magical energy into the pole as he consciously chose to start the manufacturing process.
Lee Gun had the magical energy of a smith, which could turn anything into an ingredient. It pressed down on Aslan.
“K...Kuh-huhk...!”
Until now, Aslan had been a soul that could pass through anything. He had missed feeling physical sensations. However, it wasn’t the time to be moved by such a thing right now!
“Wait! No! Stop mixing! Don’t mix me in!!!! Gun! Hahh!”
Lee Gun had been stirring the extremely toxic ingredients, which included Aslan, when he tilted his head in puzzlement. He felt an energy that was completely different from the one that he had put in.
“What the hell? Did something weird get mixed in?”
“Pffft! Yes! Gun! It’s me! Please listen to me!”
“Whatever! I’m not going to die because one more foreign substance is added to it.”
What the hell!!! He should have stopped everything when a foreign substance was detected!!! Even one foreign substance could change how a drug could be used!
Despite that, Lee Gun didn’t seem to care as he injected his magical energy into the ingredients.
Flash!!!
A powerful light erupted from the water tank. The light was like clay as it kept changing its shape.
Lee Gun let out a yawn as he checked the manufacturing recipe once again. “Mmm. Alright. It’ll be finished in three hours.”
Happy about the result, Lee Gun lay on top of the water tank. He could finally go to sleep.
In the end, only Heaven’s Punishment was able to hear the cry of despair emanating from the water tank.
A flustered Heaven’s Punishment wondered if it should go save Aslan, but Lee Gun kept a firm hold on it.
“Don’t do that, Heaven’s Punishment.”
[!]
“We just have to wait a little longer, and we’ll acquire a great skin ointment. I’ll make sure your skin will be shiny.”
[....]
And so, no one even attempted to save the poor soul. Aslan got combined with toxic ingredients inside the water tank, all thanks to Lee Gun’s power.
Koo-goo-goong!
Aslan felt faint as he was mixed in with the toxic ingredients. He had no idea what was happening. Darkness was all around him, and he felt as if he was swept along by a wave. He jostled around in various directions.
‘Damn it! Is this how it all ends?!’
In the end, he was fated to become his son’s skin ointment?! He had been a fierce leader within the Divine world with great power. He had gone through all kinds of ordeals throughout his lifetime, yet even he was afraid of becoming an item made by his son!
Aslan had gathered all kinds of knowledge, yet it was impossible for him to predict what his son was going to do!
‘W...What am I changing into?’
At a basic level, Lee Gun could combine the ingredients. However, the recipe was crap, and Aslan’s soul was being mixed in...
‘Will I change into some kind of monster chimera...?’
Monster parts were also included in the ingredients. Aslan thought it wouldn’t be too bad if he possessed the body of a monster.
‘It will be better than not having a body! I hope it is a cool-looking body!’
Yes! He would man up and boldly put himself on the line! It didn't matter what he would become! He would accept the result! He wouldn’t be afraid!
Aslan clenched his eyes shut when he saw the enormous light.
* * *
Some time passed
“...?”
After six hours, Lee Gun woke up and looked inside the water tank. A serious expression appeared on his face. It was as if he couldn’t comprehend what was going on.
Lee Gun tilted his head as he slowly looked back and forth between the water tank and the recipe. He checked it multiple times, yet he couldn’t comprehend what had happened. With his head still tilted, he looked at the result. “Why did I get this result?”
Yes, the water tank didn’t contain the clear and pretty liquid medicine that the recipe was supposed to create. Instead, a squishy liquid monster was inside... It was a slime.
This confused Lee Gun. “I don’t remember creating such a thing.”
Of course, he didn’t!!!
Aslan, who had become a slime, despaired. After some time had passed, he had regained consciousness. He had realized that he possessed a body that could move, so he had been very happy.
- I have a tactile sensation! I have a sense of touch!
He had no idea how long it had been since he could feel something.
Aslan was moved by this.
- Yes. It doesn’t matter if I changed into a monster. I have a body now...
However, Aslan screamed when he checked his body.
- What the hell is this body!!!!
His hands were like jelly. No, he couldn’t even call them hands! It was just a body!
Slime! He was a slime!
‘Damn it! Why the hell would the body of a slime appear from there!!!’
Aslan couldn’t believe what had happened. He decided to ignore reality. He tried slamming his head on the floor and shocking his body.
By the time his son discovered him, Aslan had given up on everything. He despaired as he lay on the floor.
With a puckered expression on his face, Lee Gun looked at his father. No, he was looking at a slime. “What kind of creature is this?”
It was neither a weapon nor the skin ointment that he had been trying to create. This creature was long past the point where one could call it medicine.
Thanks to his creation ability, Lee Gun had created a new item completely unrelated to the recipe.
Realizing this, Lee Gun let out a deep sigh.
‘That shape and magical energy...’
He was sure of it.
“Ha! I made something weird again.”
He had failed in creating a skin ointment. The slime had an energy similar to that of all the failed items that he had created up to this point.
Lee Gun took a hit to his ego. “Ha... It seems I have no talent for making medicine.”
“No!! That shouldn’t be your first thought!!! You should realize your ingredients were wrong in the first place!!!!!” Aslan shouted in anger.
Of course, his wicked son couldn’t hear those words.

chapters.title: Book 2: Epilogue 11 - Why the hell is he here? (1) Prev Chapter       Next Chapter
chapters.content:
That was how Aslan became a slime. When he thought about that time, it still baffled him. But he didn’t mind what had happened.
“I was able to protect you thanks to it.”
With a loving expression, Aslan stroked the head of Baby Lee Gun.
Of course, those times had been very uncomfortable for Aslan because he couldn’t use his original abilities as a slime.
‘Still, that’s how I became Gun’s item.’
[Clump of Creation Clay]
Aslan became a tool and gained the ability of Transformation (Copy). He assumed it was a variation on his “Ability Creation.”
‘I’ve always been able to copy other’s abilities just by looking at them.’
Unlike his original ability, the slime Aslan could only materialize something he ate. He couldn’t materialize items through imagination.
However, he was able to change into his original form when Lee Gun became a Zodiac. Furthermore, he was able to regain his original power when Lee Gun matured in his power.
On the other hand, Lee Gun’s expression turned sour after he heard Aslan’s story.
“Byaa, byaaa...”
Although Lee Gun had been listening to Aslan, his expression said he thought all that was rubbish.
Aslan laughed. “I didn’t do enough to act as if I’m your father?”
Well, it didn’t matter in the end.
“So how long are you going to eavesdrop on us, Hyung-nim?”
“?!!”
The little Sagittarius, who had been pretending to be unconscious, became restless as he felt himself almost have a heart attack.
‘How did he know?’
Aslan acted as if it wasn’t a big deal as he coldly looked at Sagittarius. “I knew it from the start. Eavesdropping while pretending to be unconscious isn’t a good hobby.”
“I didn’t eavesdrop...!” Sagittarius shot up, sweating.
Aslan was up there with Hugo among the people who Sagittarius was ashamed to meet. He had played a part in engineering the death of Aslan’s parents. So, he naturally had a guilty conscience.
This was why he didn’t act like he had lost his memories in front of his younger brother. He wouldn’t do something so cowardly.
“I...I woke up, but you were having a good time conversing with Gun. I just didn’t want to get in the way.”
When Sagittarius couldn’t even look him in the eyes, Aslan let out a chuckle. “You don’t have to walk on eggshells around me. I already carried out my revenge on that day. I don’t hold on to grudges.”
“You....”
“Also, I don’t have to do anything. You’ll probably die at the hands of Eternal Change.”
He did hold a grudge!!!! It was peerless!!
Sagittarius despaired when he saw the bright smile on Aslan’s lips.
Aslan had the face of someone who wouldn’t be able to pass by a grandma carrying a heavy item without helping her. Yet he was the same as his son. No, he was worse. He was a sadist(?).
‘Is he like that toward only me and the other gods?’
When it came to humans and Constructs, Aslan was kinder and sweeter than anyone.
“Anyway, you shouldn’t talk about the past with a child who has no memories. If you want to talk about it, you should go talk to Eternal Change, Flame, or Shiva. They’ll be more receptive to what you have to say.”
Aslan had an odd smile on his lips as if Sagittarius was talking nonsense. “Do you still think Gun remembers nothing?”
“...?!”
Sagittarius’s face stiffened.
Aslan wasn’t guessing. He spoke as if he knew it was the truth. The reason was obvious.
‘He has the “Translation” ability...!’
The Translation ability was made using Ability Creation!
Aslan could translate every language in existence. His target could be animals, objects in nature, monsters, or babies. It didn’t discriminate. In other words, Aslan understood the indecipherable words spoken by Gun!
Others considered the baby’s coos and gurgle cute and dismissed them as nothing! However, Aslan could understand them all!
Starting from his legs, Sagittarius felt as if all the blood was draining out of him. “There is no way... How!”
Aslan let out a bright smile. “How? Hyung-nim, someone like you remembers your past life. Why wouldn’t someone smart like Gun not remember it? You can tell just by looking at how he acts, right?”
Sagittarius became angry, but it lasted only a moment. He tilted his head in puzzlement. “Wait a moment? How he acts? Did you not use your Translation ability?”
“I didn’t need to. I can tell without using my ability. You can tell by how he acts that he remembers his past life.”
One just had to look at how Lee Gun treated Hugo.
Sagittarius became desperate. He grabbed Aslan. “Use it! Right now! Do it just in case!”
“Hmmph... I can tell by how he reacts to the photo of my daughter-in-law. It’s obvious, so why should I...”
Whenever Aslan showed Hailey’s picture to Baby Lee Gun, the baby’s eyes would become glued to the picture.
Lee Gun treated his father as if he were non-existent. He showed zero interest in Aslan. It was so bad that even Aslan had to use Hailey’s photo as a way to attract Gun’s attention. It was his secret tool of affection(?).
Sagittarius glared at him. “Use your Translation ability! See if he really has his memories!”
In the end, Aslan clicked his tongue as he activated his skill.
[Language Translation]
Lee Gun furrowed his brows when he saw the light. “Byaa?”
“[Bright]”
“Byaa, byaaaaaaaaa!!!!”
“He’s probably cussing me out... Huh?” An odd look appeared on Aslan’s face as he continued to translate.
“Byaa! Byaaaaa! Byaaaaaaaaaa!!”
“...????” Aslan’s expression continued to change for the worse. It was rare to see him this surprised.
“Aslan?”
“N-No. There is no way this is true.” Aslan was known for his poker face, yet he looked flustered.
Sagittarius became tense too. “What? What’s going on?”
“Uh... That’s odd. Why doesn’t he have his memories?”
“What?!”
Aslan checked several more times, but the baby wasn’t saying things Lee Gun would usually say.
“[That looks shiny and bushy.] [Want to eat Beau Beau!] [Amazing! World is shiny!]”
“???”
Aslan was shocked as he looked at Baby Lee Gun. The baby was talking about their heads when he mentioned shiny and bushy. It seemed he wanted to eat shaving cream...
“???” Aslan was stunned.
The Translation skill didn’t translate only the words. It was closer to reading someone’s heart.
This was why Aslan’s shock deepened. “D-Does he really not have his memories?”
By the look of Lee Gun’s actions, that couldn’t be true.
‘What’s going on?’
Aslan wondered if Lee Gun was tricking him, but he dismissed that idea.
‘He can’t dodge this ability.’
He had even used it against Great Spirits. This ability had never failed no matter which creature in the universe he had used it on. That wasn’t all.
Aslan had seen it for himself. He came up with it when he saw Lee Gun crawl away from Yooha, who had tried to change his diaper for the wrong reason!
Aslan planned on bringing Hailey here. The reason was simple. Didn’t Hailey like Gun? What if he brought together baby Gun and Hailey, who still had their memories?
Wouldn’t numerous embarrassing memories be created? Aslan would be able to capture many entertaining scenes. He had a wicked smile on his face when he had planned on acquiring a camera.
Despite all his plans, he realized he couldn’t read Lee Gun’s memories. Aslan had a mental breakdown.
Sagittarius snorted when he saw this. Aslan was someone who routinely hit the Great Spirits and the Divine world in the back of their heads. He was a master at it.
Someone who hit others in the back of their heads had instead gotten hit in the back of his head.
It was a refreshing sight for Sagittarius, but...
“See? I told you he didn’t have his memories. Unlike me, Gun doesn’t have his Divine status, and his body has changed. There is no avenue that would allow him to keep his memories.”
“Huh huh....”
Aslan was sweating.
In its own way, it was good that Gun didn’t have his memories. Aslan felt that for a similar reason as Hugo did.
‘It’s better for him if he didn’t have his painful memories.’
Suddenly, a peculiar smile appeared on Aslan’s lips.
‘I’ve always had a question I wanted to ask Gun...’
Aslan had always wanted to ask this question, but had been unable to. He was afraid of asking it.
However, it was something he wanted to confirm. No, it was a question that he must ask. It was a question that he had stopped himself from asking Hugo too.
‘I guess it can’t be helped.’
Aslan knew he had to give up on asking it, so he laughed. Now only one thing bothered him. If Gun didn’t have his memories, he shouldn’t have his memories of Hailey.
This would change various things, including what might happen with his daughter-in-law...
‘I can’t allow that to happen.’
Aslan smiled.
* * *
[What? Are you crazy?! Get bent!!!!]
Hugo covered his ear when he heard the angry shout coming across the phone. He glared at his phone. The call had already ended.
Hugo cussed at the rude person, who had been on the other side of the call. “Do you think having a loud voice is all you need, idiot?”
Chun Jiwoo and his subordinates carefully approached him.
“What’s wrong?”
“Did it not go well?”
Instead of giving an answer, he drank the cold water handed Jiwoo gave him. Then he ground his teeth. “I should have known it would be like this. There will be no meeting with him. If Shiva had any intention of meeting with us, he would have never run away in the first place.”
Hugo had made contact with Hailey’s family. For the past three years, Hailey’s family hadn’t wanted to get involved with them. It was understandable.
‘Those two were chased around by the Zodiacs.’
Hugo’s side had worshiped the Zodiacs. So it was understandable that Hailey’s family didn’t want to share space with them. Moreover, they had quickly moved away without a trace when Lee Gun had reappeared.
‘It’s as I’ve told him numerous times. There is no way they want to meet us.’
This was the fault of that idiot, Aslan!! Aslan had requested Hugo to arrange a meeting between Gun and Hailey!
‘There is no way that bastard Shiva will allow Gun to meet his daughter!’
Aslan knew this, so he was asking Hugo to make this happen!!!
In the end, Hugo pounded his fist on his chest in frustration. Naturally, he would have ignored Aslan’s request if not for what had happened the previous night.
Aslan had suddenly appeared and said,
- I have a favor I want to ask, Hyung.
- You call me by that title only when you want something weird from me. Also, you make me remember things that confuse my family tree!
- This is the contact info for the god of destruction. Do you mind contacting him for me?
- Stop ignoring me.... Wait a moment. The god of destruction is Shiva. He ran away because he doesn’t like us. Why would I contact him?
- Gun doesn’t have any memories.
- Memories?
- Yes. Gun hasn’t graduated from using his diaper, so I thought he would be embarrassed to meet his girlfriend. I thought he would seek her out on his own after he grows up, but...
- Seek her out on his own... Ah. Are you trying to make Gun and Hailey meet each other right now?
- Yes. That’s why I want you to make the two of them meet each other. Gun’s father isn’t me. It’s you, Hyung.
- What the hell are you talking about? Also, you should negotiate directly with Shiva if you know his contact info.
- Ah! I’m not on good terms with that muscle-bound idiot. In fact, I told him of a way where he and his wife would have been able to survive, yet he didn’t listen to me.
- What? What are you....
- Anyway, Shiva is living off Leo right now since they are both gods from Mahabharata. Since I told you the info, you can do it.
- Hey!!!
- That muscle-bound idiot likes alcohol. You should buy and send him some good alcohol. I’ll pay for the alcohol.
- I don’t want to do it! Why should I?
- Are you sure you want to do this, Hugo?
- What?
- I’m talking about Ms. Jiwoo.
- Hmmph. Jiwoo is doing well. Why would you... Huhk.
- You remembered? I’m glad the two of you reincarnated as humans, but... I never expected you to take a Construct I treasured for yourself. You did it without any notice... In fact, you took her while I was trapped in the museum, and you married her?
- N-No. That’s not...
Aslan was referring to the time when he had been stuck inside Yang Wei’s museum for twenty years as a toothpick!!
- It has been a while, but I should have a conversation with Ms. Jiwoo. She might recall many memories. For example, she might realize you’re the unruly and moody Eternal Change.
- I’ll do it!!!!
Hugo was sweating profusely. As expected of Lee Gun’s father, Aslan was threatening to use Hugo’s sordid past against him???
This put Hugo in a pickle. Of course, he also thought it would be good to arrange a meeting between Hailey and Gun.
“The only problem is that idiot Shiva. He’s a fool for his daughter.”
He probably hid his daughter so that no one could find her.
‘She’s probably hidden somewhere inside Leo’s house.’
On the other hand, Shiva seemed to hate Lee Gun.... Could it be? Maybe....
‘Did they already come to blows in the World of Emptiness?’
Hugo didn’t need to see it to draw a picture of what had happened. He massaged his face.
Please, Gun. He better not have done that. Yes, there was no way he did that. It couldn’t be.
Anyway, Hailey’s mother seemed to really like Lee Gun, so she should be a problem. If things went sideways, Hugo could beat up Shiva and sneak out Hailey.
After making this resolve, Hugo immediately went looking for Baby Lee Gun. “Gun! Where are you, Gun? We have to go to the US to see Hailey! Let’s take a portrait photo for your passport! I wonder if you’ll get air sickness...”
As Lee Gun was too young, Hugo planned on taking a picture of him lying on the floor for the passport photo.
His children and subordinates became surprised by what he said, so they came rushing toward him.
“Passport photo? You plan on taking him overseas?”
“Yes. We’re going to meet Hailey. I think it’ll be too dangerous for Gun to use Teleport, so we’ll take the plane.”
“...uh... Are you sure they’ll give you permission to meet her?”
His subordinates started to sweat since they had heard Shiva had joined hands with the Leo temple.
“You won’t be able to enter the building of the Leo temple. In fact, they won't even let you off the plane...”
“It’s fine. I know their weakness. Also, I’m going to take him way later on.”
“What?”
There was a chance that Lee Gun would get into trouble. This was why Lee Gun had to be prepared before he could go to the US.
He needed to know that there were places where he could and could not go. He had to know where the dangerous places were. He needed education on manners. He needed to be able to converse about business in English. He needed to learn how to ride the plane, and he needed to learn what to do when a plane was in distress. He needed to learn how to deal with a terrorist attack on an airplane. He needed to know how to resuscitate the pilot if the pilot fainted. He needed to learn how to deal with pickpockets. He needed to learn where the best restaurants were. He needed to know the best places to take pictures. He needed to learn how to turn down peddlers. He needed to learn what to do if he suddenly met an Arab prince in the middle of the street.
Hugo would give Lee Gun a thorough education.
‘This is Gun’s first foreign trip.’
His subordinates started to sweat when they saw the sheer amount of books Hugo took with him.
“Lee Gun-nim... I wonder if he’ll be able to make it outside of this country before he reaches adulthood.”
“He’ll never be able to leave...”
He loved his children too much.
‘I hope he doesn’t insult Shiva.’
Hugo’s subordinates were aghast when they saw Hugo come up with an education plan that seemed endless.
“Husband! This is bad!”
“What’s wrong? Gun has a lot to do before he can go to the US....”
Chun Jiwoo was pale as she came running in. “I don’t see Lee Gun-nim anywhere! He was here until a moment ago!”
“W-What?!”
“D-Did he get kidnapped?!”
“What!!!!!”
* * *
Across the Pacific in the US...
The Leo Saint’s office was inside the Leo temple’s building, which was hiding Hailey.
Stevens had returned after being harassed by Shiva, and he froze when he saw the small living being in front of him.
“Byaa....”
This baby had no ties to this place. Stevens had made sure Lee Gun had no connection to this place. Not even Lee Gun’s shadow or the baby’s shadow had anything to do with this place. He had put in a lot of work, and he ran away and dodged even if he saw Lee Gun’s name.
Stevens knew that it would be calamitous to meet Lee Gun. Yet the lifeform sleeping on top of his desk was...
Stevens let out a cold sweat when he saw the fast-asleep baby. “Damn it. Why is he here?”
Why was Lee Gun inside Leo's home? Why did this disaster-class monster cross the ocean to come here?

chapters.title: Chapter 499: Book 2: Epilogue 12 - Why the hell is he here? (2)
chapters.content:
If ten people were asked to name the coolest Zodiac temple in the world, six would reply, “The Leo temple.”
The Leo temple was considered both impressive and valiant. It was always one of the top three temples that youngsters wanted to join.
The leader of this temple, Stevens, was considered a man among men. Men wanted to be like him.
He was especially known for his fearlessness in front of the monsters! He was courageous as he never bowed down to any enemies! Moreover, he always maintained a poker face. He knew no fear...
“Ahhhhhk!!!!”
But it was all bullshit.
Stevens screamed when he saw a baby, who was as big as his fist.
Yes, a baby was sleeping on top of Stevens’s office desk. The baby’s face was smaller than Stevens’s fist.
Of course, the baby wasn’t Stevens’ child. Since Stevens had cultivated a very manly persona, an endless number of women wanted to marry him. However, he was single.
Stevens should have absolutely no links to a baby, yet he tried to go through his sordid past at that moment. However, he soon saw the name written on the baby's bib, then he screamed in terror once again.
[Gun]
“Why the hell is he here!!!!!!!!”
Surprised by the scream, his subordinates rushed toward him. They had to climb fifty floors, and their faces were pale.
“Zodiac Saint-nim! What’s wrong?”
His subordinates were tense and guarded. They were even holding their weapons. Their reaction was understandable since they had never heard Stevens scream before. It didn’t matter what kind of enemy he had faced!
“What kind of monster is it?”
“This is the holy ground of the Leo temple... How dare it invade—”
However, their eyes turned round when they looked inside the room.
“Byaaaa....”
“...??”
“Byaaaa...!”
“????????”
The only ones inside the room were Stevens and a baby soundly sleeping atop the desk.
‘Baby?’
The subordinates tilted their heads in confusion. It was a baby, yet Stevens seemed terrified of it.
“C...Could it be....”
“Did you have an accident?!!”
“Did the baby’s mother drop him off here?!!!”
“Child support!!!!!!!!”
“What the hell are you guys saying?” The angry Stevens pointed at the baby. “That’s Lee Gun. Lee Gun!!!”
“Should we call the lawyer— What? Lee Gun-nim?”
“Yes! His name is written right there!!”
“What?! The mother of your child named him Lee Gun?!”
“Damn it! You guys want to die!!!!”
His subordinates lowered their weapons when they were told the baby was Lee Gun. However, they became raucous for an entirely different reason.
“Ah. I remember now...! This baby was dropped in front of the Archer Saint’s house! He’s that child! Everyone went to kill him because they thought he was a monster....”
“What? That baby grew this much? He already has so much hair.”
“Wow! He’s so small!”
“He still doesn’t have any teeth!”
The officers of the Leo temple didn’t know what to do with themselves because they found Lee Gun adorable.
Stevens was the only one afraid of the child. He remained hidden.
“When did you bring Lee Gun-nim here, Zodiac Saint-nim?”
“That’s right. You should’ve told us beforehand!”
When the officers became angry, Stevens wished they would listen to him. He was petrified with fear.
“I didn’t bring him here.”
“What? Then why’s he here?”
“That is...”
“What?”
“When I came to work, he was here by himself.”
“I thought this whole region was locked down overnight, so not even a cockroach could enter this place.”
“That’s what I’m saying.”
His subordinates’ expressions turned serious. The smile on their lips had been wiped clean when they realized the seriousness of this situation.
“That is... What’s the chance that the Archer Saint sent him here?”
“There is no way that fanboy would send him here!”
His subordinates became silent.
One second. Two seconds. Three seconds.
Realizing what was going on, they screamed at the top of their lungs. They knew their lives were in danger.
“What are you doing? You have to contact the Archer Saint right now!!!”
“You’ll be seen as a kidnapper!!!”
“Was Yooha not enough!!”
“You do realize that the Zodiac Saints of the Serpent Bearer temple are psychos, right?! Do you want to burn the Leo temple into the ground?!”
“Also, how the hell did a baby come to the US?”
“Does he have a passport?!”
Everyone was shocked. They quickly looked for their phones at the same time.
“We have to quickly notify the Serpent Bearer temple about what happened!”
“That’s right! If not, we are all dead! We have to tell them before we are labeled as kidnappers....”
At that moment...
“Byaa...?”
It seemed they were being too noisy. Baby Lee Gun, who had been sound asleep, opened his eyes.
Surprised by the sound, the officers looked at Lee Gun. On the other hand, Lee Gun seemed very displeased.
“Byaaaaa....”
Since he had slept on the hard surface of a desk, his back was sore. That wasn’t all.
Growl!
He was awakened in the middle of his nap on an uncomfortable surface, and he was hungry.
“Byaaa....”
His diaper hadn’t been changed. Since it smelled, he was in a foul mood.
“Ddoo-ah. Ddoo-ah. Byaaa.”
As Lee Gun spat out each babble, it was as if his aura became progressively more chaotic.
The officers of the Leo temple were surprised by this sight, and they rushed toward Lee Gun.
“Ha ha ha, Lee Gun-nim! Do you remember me? It is me. I was next to you when Red Eye made its appearance again!!”
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed as if he didn’t care.
At the same time, one of the officers was sent flying as he screamed.
Kwahng!!
“Harry!”
In the blink of an eye, the enormous man was sent flying to the wall. An unknown superpower had sent the disciple flying.
The officers turned pale from fright. H...He was sent flying?!
“W...What is going on? Lee Gun-nim was supposed to have lost his powers? He’s supposed to be powerless!”
“So how— Hoohp!!”
Stevens quickly placed a hand over his subordinate’s mouth before he could speak any further. “Don’t provoke him! Idiot!”
“...!!!”
Lee Gun had just woken up, and he was cranky. He was like a demon king who had descended in front of them. Their bodies shook when they saw Lee Gun.
Stevens had his back turned to Lee Gun, and he didn’t want to imagine what kind of expression Lee Gun had on his face.
“Do you understand me? He’s a living being that was classified as being at least a Red-zone-rank monster”
The fact that he was Red-zone rank didn’t matter right now.
“He’s a child who destroyed Hugo’s house!”
They would be lucky if Lee Gun merely destroyed their home!
The officers gulped as they watched Lee Gun emanate a chaotic aura.
“We have to stop him, right...?”
“That’s right. Let’s put him back to sleep before he causes any trouble...”
At that moment, Stevens and the officers heard a voice behind them.
“Byaa...?”
“!!!”
They gulped as they turned their heads around. Lee Gun’s head was on a swivel as if he were looking for someone.
“I...Is he looking for the Archer Saint?”
“He’s Lee Gun’s guardian.”
Or did he come here looking for someone else?
Stevens became nervous as he quickly gestured with his hand. “Just make him go back to sleep again! You can do it by force!”
“Y-You want us to use the Sleep skill?!”
Lee Gun became angry when he heard this. The strident voice of the baby ripped through the building.
“Byaaa!!!”
Crash! Crash!
Crunch, crunch!
The baby’s voice caused the building to shake as items fell to the floor.
Stevens and his officers screamed.
“Ah!! What the hell? I thought Lee Gun-nim didn’t possess any magical energy!”
“He’s supposed to be a normal human! What’s going on?”
Just a single scream was able to put the holy ground in this state?! The building, which was under the protection of the Zodiac, started to show cracks.
Taken aback, the men rushed toward Lee Gun. They had failed in putting Lee Gun to sleep, so they would do the next best thing. They rushed to appease Lee Gun.
“You are a good boy, right? I’ll give you food!”
“Yes! Food! Which food do you like?!”
“Byaa?”
Lee Gun became slightly less cranky when he heard the word “food.”
Stevens and his officers were glad to see this.
“Milk? Do you think milk is ok?!”
“Should I go buy it right now?”
Lee Gun’s crankiness eased a bit more.
“Ah! I’ll go down and get it! We have expensive and high-quality milk, which is quite popular!”freeweɓnøvel.com
“Byaaa?”
Lee Gun’s ire went away, and his eyes started to twinkle a bit.
“It’s the highest grade ‘animal’ formula used in the farm housing the Constructs...!!”
“Byaaaaaaa!!!!!!!!!!”
“Ahhhhk!”
The angry voice assaulted them.
Stevens clasped his ears as he shouted. “Idiots! How can you feed animal formula to a person?”
“It’s something the gods drink!”
“Whatever!! Just go buy some regular milk! Buy some baby food! It can even be ready-made food!”
“I’m already searching! Ah, I found it! This brand seems to be the most popular!”
“Oh! It has 4.99 stars out of 5! Professionals recommend it! Moms recommend it! It’s the number one bestseller!”
The corner of the baby’s lips rose a bit.
“Eco-friendly Organic Minced ‘Vegetable’ Baby Food....”
“Byaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!!!!!!!!!!”
The baby seemed to take issue with something. He started to slap the ground in anger.
When the ceiling of the sturdy holy ground of the Leo temple started to crumble, Stevens screamed.
Whenever the angry baby slapped the ground, the building shook violently. It almost felt as if the baby’s cry would collapse the foundation of the building.
‘At this rate, our Leo temple’s holy ground will be destroyed!!’
As the lord of this place, Stevens was disgusted by his subordinates. He told them to bring anything available. “Just bring anything a kid might like! You can even bring whatever you guys had been eating!”
“What? There is nothing we eat that’s suitable for a baby!”
“Go check the breakroom. Is there nothing inside the fridge?!”
“It contains a hamburger that I was going to eat as a midnight snack!”
“What else is there?!”
“Aside from that, fries, cola, and beer...!”
At that moment, Lee Gun suddenly stopped crying. He just stared at them, making them very uncomfortable!
They were sure he had stopped crying when they had mentioned “hamburger”! Stevens and his officers knew what this meant, yet they started to sweat.
“No way! A baby shouldn't eat such food! That burger is a ball of cholesterol!”
“Byaa??”
“You can’t have it! I’ll get you some milk! Just wait a bit!”
“Let’s take you back home!! Ok?”
Lee Gun’s cheeks were puffed up like a frog.
They grabbed Lee Gun, intending to send him back home.
“Hey! What are you guys doing? Hurry up and contact Hugo— Ahhk!! Zodiac Saint-nim!”
Stevens flinched as his subordinates screamed.
“Something is next to Lee Gun-nim...!!”
From each side of Lee Gun, black auras appeared as if something had been summoned.
They were unknown monsters, with their sizes ranging from that of humans to that of giants. Some wore armor, and some didn’t have anything equipped.
The only common trait between them was that they were wearing helmets.
The disciples freaked out when they saw this.
“That’s a summoning skill!!!”
“Ahhk!!! He isn’t supposed to have any powers, so how can he use the summoning skill?!!”
“What the hell? The report said nothing of this!”
“Hey! That isn’t important right now! Those are monsters!!”
“T-They don’t have the energy of the Cluders!”
The unknown monsters let out chaotic energy as they approached the disciples.
Confronted with the violent magical energy, the disciples froze.
‘They are all Black-zone-ranks!!’
While these beings weren’t Cluders, they were a match with the monarchs in terms of abilities and killing intent.
The flustered disciples summoned their weapons. They immediately used their skills to bind the monsters.
“!?”
However, the skills merely passed through the monsters.
In the end, the monsters appeared right before them and extended their hands toward the Leo disciples.
Stevens froze.
‘W...What the hell are they...!’
Finally, the menacing hand extended toward Stevens as if it was about to take out a chunk of flesh from his neck.
‘Damn it! We are going to die....’
Rustle, rustle!
“...?”
Instead of attacking with their extended hands, they frisked the bodies and the pockets of the disciples. They took out all the candies, including chocolate, which the disciples carried around. The monsters even scolded the disciples as if there weren’t enough candies.
The disciples were dumbfounded after having all their snacks stolen. That wasn’t all.
Boom!
“?!”
It seemed more monsters had been summoned. These monsters brought something out of the other room.
They held the hamburger, fries, and cola!
“Ahhk!!! That’s my night snack, which I put inside the breakroom fridge!”
“What?!”
After stealing the food, the monstrous beings acted as if they were giving an offering. They approached Lee Gun and got on their knees, presenting the food to Lee Gun with care.
Baby Lee Gun became overjoyed to see the hamburger offered to him.
“Byaa! Byaa!”
It was an American-style hamburger, and it looked fantastic. It was a quadruple-decker burger with thick, well-cooked patties. Each patty was coated with yellow American cheese, which had melted like a waterfall. It also had crispy bacon and ketchup!
Lee Gun’s eyes twinkled as he immediately bit into the hamburger. The waterfall of cheese melted inside Lee Gun’s mouth, and he looked elated.
Stevens and the officers looked shocked.
“Should a baby be eating that...?”
“Will he die if he eats it...?”
“He doesn’t have any teeth. How is he eating it?”
“I never expected a baby to like a hamburger so much...”
Stevens started to sweat. When he thought about it, Lee Gun had always liked the American-style burger and cola. He always ate it when he stayed in the US. In fact, Stevens had used a hamburger to lure out Lee Gun in the past.
Anyway, it seemed the baby also liked hamburgers. While he didn’t have any memories, it didn’t change the fact that they possessed the same body. Or maybe...
An odd expression appeared on Stevens’s face as he looked at Lee Gun. He furrowed his brows before letting out a sigh; he had dismissed the idea he just had.
‘Anyway, I’m thankful for the fact that he’s satisfied with a single hamburger’
That bastard who was obsessed with Lee Gun...
Hugo would forgive him for feeding Lee Gun a hamburger.
“Zodiac Saint-nim! What is going on?”
His subordinates from the other buildings had come to this location. They had been preparing for a company dinner, and they came running here when the building started to break.
“We felt a strange aura emanating from this place. What is going on—”
The subordinates screamed when they entered the room.
“Ahhk! What the hell happened here?”
Stevens got frightened when his subordinates shouted. He put a forefinger on his lips as if to silence them.
The hamburger had finally calmed Lee Gun down. It would be troublesome if Lee Gun had a tantrum again.
“It’s nothing! We were just babysitting for a bit!”
“What? Babysitting?”
“Yes. The baby destroyed the building a little! It’s nothing!! Get out of here!”
“What????”
How were they babysitting the baby that they let him destroy the building?
“Things just happened to turn out like this! Thankfully, he quieted down after eating a hamburger...”
At that moment...
“Byaa?”
“?!”
It was unclear as to what he had seen, but Lee Gun’s voice became very upbeat.
Stevens felt a chill run up his back when he heard the laughter.
The flustered men quickly looked toward the item that had taken hold of Lee Gun’s attention.
Lee Gun’s gaze was fixed on the subordinates who had just entered the room. To be precise, his eyes were fixed on the boxes they held!
Stevens and his officers turned pale when they recognized the boxes.
‘Alcohol!’
The boxes contained expensive whiskey and brandy. Lee Gun’s eyes twinkled like a pair of diamonds.
The subordinates who had brought the boxes were oblivious to what was going on. They let out a bright smile.
“Ah! You told us to open these up. You wanted to check the expensive alcohol since we’ll be offering them to our god...”
He couldn’t even finish his sentence. Baby Lee Gun extended his hand toward the box as if he coveted it.
Stevens and the officers screamed.
“No!! You can’t have alcohol!!!!”
“Stop him!!!!!”
They still had no idea why Lee Gun had come here.

chapters.title: Chapter 500: Book 2: Epilogue 13 - Why the hell is he here? (3)
chapters.content:
“What? You don’t think Lee Gun has his memories?”
Several months ago, Stevens had heard something unexpected. Of course, it was a bit unusual because the one to bring news about Lee Gun was Sophie. It wasn’t as if he couldn’t guess why she knew this information.
“Are you still stalking Hugo?”
- W-What?! That’s rude! Lee Gun’s Construct makes me work very hard, so I don’t have enough hours in a day!
“Oh? You’re saying you would have done it if you had time.”
- #&$^#&!!!
Sophie wailed on the phone. She said she wouldn’t do something like that anymore.
The current Aquarius Iaso was making the Aquarius Saint Sophie work very hard. She had confiscated all of Sophie’s wealth and would give her breaks for only lunch and dinner, both lasting thirty minutes each.
For the rest of the twenty-three hours, Sophie worked without any respite.
‘Well, it’s fixing her temperament.’
Iaso was also Lee Gun’s Construct, and she was very very competent. That was why she had managed to clean up the mess created by Sophie and the previous Aquarius.
The Aquarius temple became a net positive, and everything had been returned to the people. The city was almost fully restored, and the civilians regained their everyday life.
Sophie was being rung dry, and she had tried to run away crying. However, Iaso responded,
- Oh my, sister! You still have the energy to move. That’s great!
- Kyaaaaah!!!
As expected of Lee Gun’s Construct, Iaso made Sophie work until the cusp of death; she was terrifying.
Of course, that wasn’t important right now.
Stevens’s golden lion-like eyes flashed. “You’re saying the baby doesn’t seem to have his memories, but for some odd reason, he acts like Lee Gun?”
- Yes. Also, he’s stronger than the time he was a Great Spirit. He possesses chaotic power now.
Stevens flinched. Lee Gun became stronger than before? Still, he was a baby, so he should be more beholden to his nature than his rational thought.
‘Maybe he wet himself while he was sleeping???’
Even if he weren’t a baby, Lee Gun wasn’t someone one could let one’s guard down in front of.
‘Lee Gun’s drinking habits weren’t tame at all.’
In terms of drinking, Lee Gun was number one among the thirteen; the weakest was Hugo.
This was why when the Zodiac Saints gathered to drink alcohol, it took Hugo only ten minutes to start praising Lee Gun. It would become background music. However, there was something else behind it.
‘Hugo was the only one who didn’t know about it, but Lee Gun mixed hard liquor into his beer.’
Lee Gun would do that whenever Hugo was distracted or had vacated his seat. He would slowly sneak hard liquor into Hugo’s drink. This was why Hugo went into Praise Lee Gun mode after ten minutes.
‘He’s a fanatic.’
Anyway, Lee Gun was strong when it came to alcohol. He was so strong that some thought he would be fine even after drinking 100% alcohol.
‘However, a specific type of alcohol was an exception.’
Lee Gun could drink straight hard liquor, and he wouldn’t be drunk. But alcohol fermented with fruit could get him drunk.
During the Great Raid of Russia, as a prank, they had snuck some weak homemade wine into Lee Gun’s drink.
After drinking it, Lee Gun had gone around taking care of the innocent neighborhood gangs!!
- I don’t like your hair color. You can get bent.
- What?!!
- I don’t like that you have two eyes. You can get bent.
- Ahhk!!!
The people of the town were happy that the gang members had turned over a new leaf, but Lee Gun had also tried to get rid of the Constructs and Zodiac Saints who had come with him for the raid!
- Ahhhk!! Why the hell are you doing this to us, you mutant?!
- I don’t like how your eyes are positioned.
- I-I’m a god without eyes! That’s why—
- You have a mouth!! Get bent!!
- Ahhhhhk!!
The Zodiac Saints blanched when they thought about the acts of brutality Lee Gun had carried out on that day.
If Heiji and Hailey hadn’t been present there, the other Zodiac Saints would have been destroyed alongside the town. Anyway, he was like that as an adult.
This was why Stevens had been frightened when the menacing Lee Gun had come back as a baby. However, he soon dismissed such feelings.
‘Yes. The ones who’ll have a hard time will be Hugo and his allies. It won’t be us.’
On the other hand, Yooha looked to be enjoying herself as she intended to carry out a scary plan.
Still, it didn’t change the fact that they had nothing to do with Lee Gun... Nothing to do with Lee Gun... They were supposed to have no connection to him...
“Ahhk!!! Stop him!!!!!”
Stevens screamed as he watched Lee Gun head toward the boxes of wine and cognac. What did the baby think the shiny boxes were?
“Byaaa!!”
Did he mistakenly think that it was a tasty fruit juice? Or was he going crazy because he had always liked alcohol?!
“I don’t care what you do! Just make sure he doesn’t drink those!!!”
If news of the baby drinking alcohol entered the ears of Hugo and his family, Stevens and the others were dead!
Of course, Lee Gun wasn’t human. Unlike a human baby, alcohol might not be fatal to him. However, there was a different problem!
“He can’t have the fruit wine!!!”
If the baby was fundamentally the same as the previous Lee Gun, he would be weak against fruit wine!
Stevens imagined a scenario where the US was wiped off the map. He screamed as if his hair were on fire, “Hey! Stop... No! You guys should throw those away right now!!!”
“What?!!”
“Go to the restroom and dump it all down the drain!”
“What?! Each bottle costs a hundred thousand dollars!! You told us to save them for today...!”
“It’s fine!! Throw them all away, so he can’t drink the wine!”
At that moment, the baby’s eyes flashed, and he brought forth his magical energy once again.
Koo-goo-goo-goo.
Stevens and his subordinates turned pale from fright. The chaotic black aura from before started to encircle the baby.
“Byaa! Byaa!”
The baby’s eyes didn’t say that he wanted the boxes because they looked pretty. Those were the eyes of an alcoholic who had caught sight of expensive alcohol!
Stevens started to sweat.
‘He’s not a kid! I’m sure he has his memories!’
The officers quickly brought a donut from the break room.
“I have a treat here!!! This is tasty, right!?”
“Hey, baby! Why don’t you eat this instead!!!”
They used a donut to tempt Lee Gun, trying to catch Lee Gun’s gaze.
However, accompanied by a powerful magical energy, Lee Gun levitated.
‘Ahhk!!’
“H-He is floating!!?!”
They had been less worried since he was a baby who couldn’t walk yet!!
“Hugo! That son of a...!!! I thought he didn’t have any abilities!!!!”
“What the hell is happening?”
When Lee Gun headed toward the alcohol, Stevens decided to sacrifice his body. He snatched Lee Gun out of the air.
“Byaa?”
Stevens hunched over Lee Gun as if he were covering a grenade, then told his subordinates holding the alcohol to leave. “Hurry! Run away!”
“Yes!!”
He then glanced at the officers who were using their phones. “What about the Serpent Bearer temple!!!”
“They aren’t picking up! Yooha isn’t picking up! The Sagittarius temple isn’t picking up either!”
“What?!!”
What the hell were they doing that they were not picking up the phone? It was driving him nuts!!!!
“Byaaaaa.”
Lee Gun, who had been caught by Stevens, scrunched up his face. He was already hungry, and he was unable to drink any delicious-looking alcohol.
The men in front of him kept enticing him with the donut, yet they hadn’t given it to him. Lee Gun seemed angry.
Growwwwwwl!
“Byaa...!”
Or was he angry because someone like Stevens had caught him?!
Lee Gun’s eyes flashed like that of a monster. Then...
Zzuhng!!!
“?!”
An enormous power split the wall in half.
“Zodiac Saint-nim!!!”
Stevens was sweating because his head had almost been decapitated by an unknown power.
Koo-goo-goo-goo!
“!”
The sound of an enormous beast running toward them rang out.
Kwang!!
The door to the office was smashed.
[Damn it! Do you want to die? Keep it down! Not even I can sleep through this!]
“!!!”
The one to burst through the destroyed office door was none other than an enormous lion. It was the Zodiac of the Leo temple.
After the Divine world had ended, Leo was renting out a room in the Leo temple’s building. He had been having sweet dreams while sleeping somewhere on this floor. Unable to tolerate the ruckus anymore, he had come here.
[You guys call yourselves my servants, yet you can’t even catch a mouse that snuck into the holy ground?! Hmm?!]
Stevens and the officers felt aggrieved.
“It isn’t a mouse!”
“That’s right! Lee Gun is here, you fat cat!!!”
[Hmmph. You dare talk short with me— What? Lee Gun?]
The eyes of Cargo, the Zodiac of the Leo temple, became round. He wondered why Lee Gun’s name would suddenly be mentioned here.
At that moment, Leo met eyes with Baby Lee Gun. This baby looked and smelled like Lee Gun, confusing Leo.
[Why is he here?]
No, that wasn’t important right now.
“Byaa...?”
A grave look entered Lee Gun’s eyes as he looked at Leo!
“!!”
Taken aback, Leo raised one paw without realizing it.
[W-What the hell? Why are his eyes like that?]
Lee Gun wagged his finger. The knives and the high-rank weapons around the waists of Stevens and his officers were unsheathed.
“?!”
The weapons started floating.
“T-The weapons are floating in the air?!”
“He does have an ability!”
The sharp end of the floating weapons headed toward Leo, surprising the Zodiac.
[W...Wait a moment!!!]
Leo didn’t even have time to say stop. The sharp weapons flew toward him as if they wanted to butcher him.
[Ahhhhk!!!!]
“Ahhk!!! Our god...!”
“Fat cat!!!”
“Byaa!”
Leo found himself suddenly being chased by flying weapons.
It seemed Lee Gun wanted to make a lion salami as a side dish for his drink.
“Byaaa!”
Even a Zodiac would find being stabbed by SS-rank blades painful! Moreover, Stevens’s blade had been looked over by a Creator not too long ago!
A couple of days ago, Aslan had suddenly appeared inside the Leo temple’s holy ground and looked at their weapons!
- Do you want me to look at your weapons, Cargo?
While he might not be a manufacturing-type god, Aslan was a Creator. Repairing weapons was no big deal to him.
- It’ll be great for us, but... why are you suddenly doing this?freewebnσvel.cѳm
- Help begets help.
A troublemaker like him was suddenly offering his service to repair all the weapons of the Leo temple.
Leo hadn’t understood why he had done so until now. Did he do such a thing for this event? No, that couldn’t be true!!
[Ahhk! My hide is being skinned!!!!]
Seeing the possibility of himself getting butchered, Leo screamed. He expressed his anger toward Stevens.
[Stevens! Is it a baby or a monster?]
“I told you it is Lee Gun, idiot!!”
[What?!! Why is he here?!!]
“That’s...!!!”
Stevens had no idea. A baby who couldn’t even walk couldn’t have come here by coincidence. He had come here for a reason.
‘Why is he here?’
Stevens’s face became pale as he watched Lee Gun stare in a certain direction. He knew who was present in that direction.
‘Can it be?’
Is he here looking for Hailey? As luck would have it, Lee Gun was looking toward the building where Hailey and the Flame monarch were hidden.
‘Only Hailey and her mother should be inside that building.’
No changes occurred to Lee Gun’s expression as he stared at the building. However, it seemed as if he was trying to check if anyone was living within the building. It was as if he could see through the building.
In fact, the color of Lee Gun’s eyes changed when he viewed the building.
‘...red?!’
Stevens shook since it truly had been a while since he had seen eyes of that color. Lee Gun having those eyes meant he had been hiding his abilities?
There was a chance that Lee Gun had pretended to not have any abilities or memories. He might have kept them hidden.
If Lee Gun had come here with the intent of meeting Hailey...
‘This place might be reduced to ruin.’
[Ahhhk!!! My tail!!!]
No, it seemed his goal had changed. He planned on turning Leo into a side dish.
Lee Gun seemed to be done with looking through the building. The floating blades drew closer to Leo’s neck.
The Leo temple’s disciples screamed.
“No! Stop!”
As those shouts rang out, Lee Gun escaped from the disciples and landed atop Leo’s head. Lee Gun slapped the Zodiac’s head with a solemn expression.
“Byaa. Byaaaaa!!”
Donut! He also wanted alcohol.
In the end, the disciples gave up. They offered up the food and drinks that Lee Gun had wanted. An expensive bottle of alcohol was produced.
The subordinates monitored Stevens with worried expressions.
“Is it ok to give the baby alcohol, Zodiac Saint-nim?”
“Of course, I swapped out the content.”
Baby Lee Gun was happy as he chewed on the donut. He also sucked on the baby bottle containing alcohol(?).
Stevens was a bit disappointed as he looked at the baby. “He doesn’t realize it’s fake alcohol. He really doesn’t remember anything...”
His subordinates were puzzled.
“This has been bothering us for a while. Do you want Lee Gun-nim to have his memories?”
“What....”
“That’s quite unexpected. While it doesn’t matter to us, wouldn't it be better for you if Lee Gun-nim didn’t regain his memories?”
Stevens had been robbed by Lee Gun over and over again. The Leo Saint scrunched up his face as if that wasn’t the case. “I want Lee Gun to make me a weapon again.”
“????”
The expressions of his subordinates were a sight to behold. He still hadn’t given up on that????
Their eyes turned round as they looked over at Stevens.
“You....”
Stevens’ eyebrows rose. “You?”
“You’re a really cool Zodiac Saint...!”
“You guys are starting to get uppity with me.”
“I...I’m sorry.”
Their reactions were understandable! Why did he have such an obsession with items manufactured by Lee Gun?!
“A new manufacturing god arrived at the Capricorn temple.! Also, a Creator appeared not too long ago to look at your weapon!”
Stevens seemed glum.
When the disciples saw his expression, they were dismayed. They whispered among themselves.
“Wow! This is crazy! He isn’t satisfied with their work...!”
“Now that I think about it... That bone which was worth a billion... Didn’t he put it back in his office?”
“Yes. In the end, he bought it back from Yooha. He had to pay her a million dollars. The deal also included a rare picture of Lee Gun-nim from twenty years ago.”
“He didn’t buy it.... He had to rent it from her.”
“What?! He didn’t buy it, yet the cost was a million dollars!?”
The disciples grabbed the back of their necks. They looked at Stevens with baffled expressions.
“Why are you so obsessed with Lee Gun-nim’s work?”
“We understand Lee Gun-nim was skilled, but....”
Leo snorted.
Lee Gun had pulled out all of his manes.
‘Why else?’
It was a bit of a nonsensical reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 501: Book 2: Epilogue 14 - Why the hell is he here? (4)
chapters.content:
This incident had happened over twenty years ago in a village near the Amazon. Stevens was annoyed by the person who kept trying to contact him.
[Hey, Stevens. Don’t trust Lee Gun too much.]
It was the Goat Saint Sergeyevich.
‘I can understand why he’s so desperate in trying to contact me.’
Two weeks ago, Lee Gun had destroyed the weapons made by the Capricorn temple, surprising everyone. This had happened despite Sergeyevich being a secretive weirdo who had concealed his full name, the Zodiac Saint of blacksmiths.
Anyway, everyone had lost trust in the Capricorn temple because of Lee Gun.
But the Capricorn temple didn’t want to lose any clients. So the Goat Saint spoke through the mouth of the communication-type Construct.
[There is no way I would purposefully weaken the durability of my weapons, unlike what Lee Gun claims! If you die, I’ll lose a very important client!]
That was true. The Leo temple and the blacksmiths had a symbiotic relationship. Why?
‘Damn it! The Leo temple is useless without weapons!’
Since it was connected to their survival, this was an absolute secret kept away from the other Zodiac Saints. In reality, Leo Saint couldn’t activate his skills unless he held a weapon. It wasn’t a lie. He really couldn’t use any skills.
In other words, Stevens was screwed if lost his grip on his weapon. Of course, he was a superhuman, so he could survive up to a point without his skills. However, it was a dangerous affair where his life would be at risk.
Anyway, this was why the Leo temple needed a good relationship with the blacksmiths. However, Stevens was in a situation where he couldn’t fully trust the Capricorn temple...
[I guess I have no choice.]
Flash!
A light appeared before Stevens as a Construct from the Capricorn temple made an appearance. The Capricorn Construct held a great sword.
“That is...!”
Sergeyevich soon spoke through the line of communication.
[This is a weapon especially made by the Zodiac. I’ll let you borrow it. This is an attempt to regain your trust, so you don’t have to pay anything.]
Stevens became infatuated.
‘A Z...Zodiac made it himself?!’
The weapons that he had received from Sergeyevich were weapons Sergeyevich had made using Capricorn’s power. And they were A-rank and S-rank weapons.
If this was a weapon made by Capricorn... Stevens’s eyes shook.
Sergeyevich spoke.
[Of course, it’s on a different level. How about it? Will you use it?]
“Don’t look down on me. I...” Stevens was about to say he wasn’t someone to be trifled with.
[I like that you’re honest.]
“...”
Both of Stevens’s hands were clutching the great sword offered by the Capricorn Construct.
The Capricorn Construct cackled.
Feeling embarrassed, Stevens stamped his feet.
“Ahhk!! Damn it!” he yelled as he tried to throw the blade into the lake, but he couldn’t bring himself to do it. He merely cut wood with it. “If! Only! I! Didn’t! Become! Impotent! When! I! Lose! My! Weapon!”
Stevens’s pride had been extremely hurt. He kept cutting wood with his blade. “Damn it! The other fighting-type Zodiac Saints have weapons as their Royal holy items! Why isn’t Leo’s Royal holy item a weapon?!”
The Royal holy item of the Leo temple was a necklace that increased his luck!
Stevens was already pissed off at Leo since he had heard why the Zodiac had picked him as his Zodiac Saint!
‘He chose me as an apostle because I looked like I would be good at acquiring food? If I don’t bring him food, he’d use me like emergency food? He’d eat me?’
“Damn it! That cat is senseless! Why the hell can’t the Leo temple use our skills if there are no weapons!!!”
“What the hell are you talking about?”
“Ahhhhhk!!!”
Stevens screamed when he heard a voice behind him. Turning his head, he was faced with Hugo, who had a bright smile on his face.
Appalled, Stevens asked, “Why are you here?! No!! Did you hear what I just said?!”
“What? What are you talking about?”
Stevens let out a sigh of relief when he saw Hugo’s reaction. He had been worried his weak point had been leaked.
‘The Sagittarius temple is like the Scorpio temple. They are Stealth-type temples. As expected, I can’t sense his presence...!’
“Alright. It’s fine if you didn’t hear it—”
“It must be a big pain since you can’t use a skill without a weapon.”
“Ahhhk!!!” Stevens took up his sword when he saw Hugo’s bright smile.
The Zodiac Saints were already jockeying for ranks against each other, yet his greatest weakness was revealed!
‘I have to shut him up before he tells the others...!’
At that moment...
“Hugo, the ingredients Lee Gun is looking for aren't over there. They are over here.”
“?!”
When Stevens heard the familiar voice, he turned around in surprise and caught sight of Hailey.
She had jet-black hair, and her face was devoid of mirth. The woman looked so beautiful that a picture wouldn't do her justice. She seemed to be from out of this world.
This was around the time when Hailey had packed up her belongings and had been secretly following Lee Gun and Hugo.
Stevens’s face turned red when he saw Hailey, but he soon became interested in the ingredients that she had mentioned.
“Ingredients? Are you taking it to Lee Gun?!”
“Yes. He plans on making weapons. Why?”
Stevens almost lost his mind. He wanted to ask Lee Gun to make him a weapon, but he soon clicked his tongue. “Whatever. Lee Gun makes weapons for only himself. He refused my request several times....”
“What? Teacher makes weapons for other people.”
Stevens’s head turned in a robotic manner. He stomped toward Hugo and grabbed his shoulders as if he couldn’t believe what he had just heard. “What are you talking about? Lee Gun refuses to make weapons for anyone else!”
“What? He made them for Miss Hailey and me...”
“Don’t lie to me!!! Lee Gun said he can’t make it! He said his manufacturing skill doesn’t work like that! He can't make it!!! He shouldn’t make it even if he can!!”
“Y...You should look at it for yourself....” The surprised Hugo unsheathed a dagger from his belt.
Feeling Lee Gun’s energy from the blade, Stevens looked at Hugo with jealousy in his eyes. “Why did Lee Gun make this for you? Why you!?”
“I...I’m his student......?”
In the case of Hailey, she had fed them, so Lee Gun felt thankful toward her. This was why he had created a more beautiful dagger with better specs for Hailey.
When Lee Gun had held up the dagger toward her, Hailey had stiffened and ran away.
This had hurt Lee Gun a little.
- Does she hate me enough to run away?
- What?
- Whatever. I’ll use it for myself.
Of course, Hailey had run away because she had hidden as she watched Lee Gun, yet Lee Gun had found her as if it were no big deal.
She truly didn’t want to be found out. So when he nonchalantly appeared in front of her, her brain had short-circuited.
Anyway, Hugo became serious as he thought about the incident where Hailey had run away.
‘Is that why he doesn’t make weapons for others?’
Hugo's guess was completely wrong, but it didn’t matter at that moment. Stevens’s gaze was overbearing, and it made Hugo sweat.
‘Now I understand why he’s obsessed with Teacher’s weapons.’
The skills of the Leo Temple were too violent. The durability of regular weapons couldn’t withstand their power for long.
This issue was so bad that Stevens had to pack fifty weapons for each raid.
Hugo looked at Hailey. She was picking up the ingredients that Lee Gun wanted. She was economical in her actions, as if she was putting potatoes into her sack.
At that moment, Hugo had a weird misunderstanding.
‘Huhk. Is that why Miss Hailey has been following us? She wants a weapon like Mr. Stevens?’
Now that he thought about it, Hailey had frequently looked at Stevens’s weapons!
‘Yes. That’s what’s going on!’
In truth, Hailey had been looking at the Capricorn temple’s weapons to see if they’d be of help to Lee Gun.
If one of them looked useful, she either copied it or stole it. She would place it in the pack that she gave to Lee Gun.
Kwahng!!!!
“!!!”
“Kee-ehhhhk!!!”
Suddenly, several hundred monsters broke through the ground. The three Zodiac Saints were taken aback as they took up their weapons.
“Damn it! There was a nest here?! There are so many of them!”
“Should I bring Teacher here?!”
It didn’t matter if several hundred or even several thousand monsters gathered here. Lee Gun could kill them all in short order. He was humanity’s strongest weapon.
Their work would be much easier if Lee Gun were here, but Stevens declined that option.
‘I have a weapon made by a Zodiac! This will last for a long time!’
Normally, his weapon would be destroyed when he killed twenty monsters, yet this sword was fine even when he had already cut down fifty monsters!
‘Good! I might be able to use my Royal skill with this.’
Stevens had never been able to use his SS-rank skill, the Royal skill that others could freely use.
If he used an S-rank skill using an A-rank weapon, the weapon would be instantly destroyed. Stevens generally used S-rank weapons, but they wouldn’t last if an SS-rank skill was used.
However, this was a weapon made by Capricorn!
‘I might be able to my Royal skill!’
This was his opportunity to gain points with Hailey!
[Roar of the Beast King (SS)]
Leo was amused when a powerful golden energy emanated from Stevens’s body.
[Oh! That idiot is finally using his killer move.]
‘That is right!’
[I kept demonstrating it for you and even taught it to you, yet you’re always wishy-washy about using it.]
‘Things are different now!!!’
Stevens confidently swung the sword...
Bbah-gahk!!!
“?!!!”
However, it broke.
Stevens’s face froze.
Leo clicked its tongue as if it had expected this.
[Hmmph. I should’ve expected this from you. You’re on your own. I’m going back to sleep.]
“?!!”
No, why the hell would you go back to sleep!! It was a situation where Leo’s Zodiac Saint was weaponless and surrounded by several hundred monsters! However, the damn Zodiac had made himself scarce.
Stevens cussed as he quickly looked for anything that resembled a weapon.
‘Damn it! Did the Goat Saint dupe me?!’
He had said the blade was made by a Zodiac. Stevens never imagined it would be destroyed because he used an SS-rank skill!
‘Or maybe it can’t withstand Leo’s skill?’
It didn’t matter in the end.
‘Weapon! Weapon!!!’
All the weapons that he had brought had been discovered and destroyed by the monsters.
Hailey sighed when she saw this. She swung her tachi as she saved Hugo and Stevens. Her skill was overwhelming.
Stevens’s male pride didn’t allow him to ask Hailey for a weapon. He looked at Hugo, who was being crushed alongside him. “Hugo! Do you have any weapons left?”
“I don’t! I only have the one that I gave you earlier!”
“Damn it! Are you talking about this?!”
Stevens was grasping at straws. He unsheathed Lee Gun’s dagger. This dagger was something Hugo used to keep enemies in check.
‘It won’t last against powerful enemies!’
More powerful weapons would break when faced with these types of monsters. This was why Stevens didn’t expect much, as he blocked a foot flying toward him. He thought it would be the end of the weapon...
“Kee-ehhhk!!!”
However...
“Kee-ehhhk!”
Huh? Why wasn’t it breaking?
Stevens reflexively swung his blade.
After he had killed over a hundred monsters, Stevens’s face was a sight to behold.
‘What the hell? Why isn’t it breaking???’
Much more expensive and reinforced weapons would’ve broken much earlier!
“Stevens-nim! Look up!”
It was as if Hailey considered the weak Hugo a hindrance. Hugo screamed as she carried him like a straw sack.
Stevens looked up in surprise at Hugo’s shout.
‘I’ll die if I don’t use my SS-rank skill!’
It wasn’t a normal monster.
Stevens knew the skill wouldn't work, but for some reason, he took a firm grip on the dagger.
‘Capricorn’s weapon was destroyed when the SS-rank skill was used...!’
Stevens didn’t know why, but he found himself using the skill.
[Roar of the Beast King (SS)]
Something surprising happened this time.
Flash!
