A blinding golden tornado surged into the sky. The golden light entered the tail of the enormous monster and pulverized its skin, muscles, and bone. The remnant flew into the sky within the tornado.
Hailey and Hugo, who was being treated like luggage, looked at Stevens in surprise.
‘I’ve never seen that skill before...!’
The one most surprised was Stevens. “It...It succeeded? I did it?!”
Moved by this sight, Hugo looked at Stevens. “You have an AOE attack!”
He bit his tongue as he looked at Hailey, wondering if Hailey was following them at Stevens’s request. “Did you see it, Miss Hailey? Mr. Stevens did it! He killed numerous monsters with his Royal skill!”
“...huh?”
Hailey was expressionless. She furrowed her brows as she tilted her head in puzzlement. “He didn't kill them all.”
“What? What are you—”
Hugo turned pale from fright when he saw the pile of monsters stacked behind Hailey. Hailey had killed 95% of the monsters. It was embarrassing that the two male professionals had killed only 5%.
“Hmmph. If it were Lee Gun, he would’ve ended it in an instant. I wouldn’t even have the opportunity to fight...”
“...koo-oohk.”
Hailey ruthlessly attacked him with facts, making Hugo vomit blood.
The Scorpio Saint held the position of a stealthy elite unit. As expected, she was on a different level. She was one of the few people who Lee Gun acknowledged.
Stevens despaired when Hailey looked at him as if he wasn’t that big of a deal. However, it didn’t take long for his body to start shaking.
‘Still, I used it. I used the SS-rank skill!'
He had used 100% of his power with a low-rank dagger supposed to be used to keep attackers at bay.
Stevens couldn’t understand what had happened as he looked at Lee Gun’s dagger. He soon grabbed the back of his neck when he had a realization.
On that day, Stevens had gone looking for Lee Gun. “Lee Gun! Sell this dagger to me!”
Lee Gun’s expression soured when Stevens made an appearance. He became angry. Instead of answering, he glared at Hugo with gold eyes. “Hey. Why does he have the dagger?”
“What? I wasn’t supposed to?”
Hugo received a blow from Lee Gun. “I gave it to you. Why is a different apostle holding it?”
“I...I’m sorry!”
Lee Gun was furious as he took the dagger away from Stevens.
Stevens laughed when he saw this. It was as he had expected.
‘Yes. That’s how it was.’
Lee Gun must’ve told Hugo that it was a B-rank dagger, but in truth, it was an amazing SS-rank weapon!
‘Yes! He must have made a good one since Hugo is his comrade!’
Stevens’s eyes flashed. “Lee Gun. This should be beneficial to you too. I’ll pay a high price. Just sell me this! No, you have to sell me this!”
“What did you say, idiot?!”
“W-What?”
“XXX XXX XXXX. XXXX.” Lee Gun sent Stevens flying with a kick. Afterward, he entered his quarters.
Hugo stuck close to Lee Gun.
Lee Gun seemed to not like the overbearing Stevens, and such beatings were commonplace...
“It’s too bad. I don’t think it’s a bad deal if we think about our finances...”
Hugo took a hit again.
“Hey, maggot. I told you before. I don’t plan on taking commissions from those bastards, who only know about money. I don’t plan on selling anything I’ve made. The only one I’ll make items for is you and only you. Understood?”
“Stevens doesn’t work only for money... That’s why you’ll be better off selling him a weapon for living expenses.... Ahhk!”
After taking another blow from Lee Gun, Hugo screamed.
Lee Gun had ruthlessly destroyed the dagger that Stevens had returned.
“Why would you destroy that?”
“It’s dirty since that Leo bastard touched it.”
“What?! Wasn’t that an SS-rank weapon? I was moved because of it... You didn’t want me to be burdened by receiving such an item, so you purposefully told me that it was a cheap weapon. Am I right?”
After destroying the blade, Lee Gun looked at Hugo as if he was speaking nonsense. “Why would I make such an item for you?”
“From what I saw of its durability, I thought it was an SS-rank!”
“Look at you being so hopeful. That’s a D-rank junk item. The cost to make it was twenty won.”
Hugo seemed shocked. His mouth fell open. “Twenty... Twenty... You gave your student a D-rank item worth twenty won... What about the one you tried to give Miss Hailey? It was a really good one!”
“She’s given me a lot. If I combine all the stuff that she has given me, a single blade isn’t enough to repay her.”
“I gave you a lot of things too....”
“Yes. It’s worth twenty won.”
“#@$*$#&*!”
Although Lee Gun was saying this, his personality wouldn’t allow him to jeopardize the lives of others. There was no way he would give something that couldn’t be used in a fight to Hugo.
Unaware of this, Hugo despaired as he spoke. “Still, it’s a shame. Mr. Stevens did say he would pay at least two million dollars for it...”
Lee Gun, who had been looking for some table salt, came to a stop. What? Two million dollars?
His eyebrows moved violently as if he regretted destroying the dagger. However, it lasted only a moment.
Lee Gun smirked as he glanced at the broken dagger.
* * *
After that incident, Lee Gun always brought around cheap-looking toys and clubs and sold them all to Stevens.
Lee Gun found it a shame to waste ingredients on Stevens, so he made the items by using the ingredients from the trash heap. He swindled Stevens for several million each time.
Moreover, the items were more like children's toys than weapons... They were junk items... Still, Stevens had made good use of these items.
Of course, the other Zodiac Saints thought he was nuts because he unsheathed a toy hammer or toy sword on the battlefield. Nevertheless, the Leo Saint was able to use his Royal skill using the junk items, so he didn’t complain.
‘How great would it have been to use a weapon properly made by Lee Gun?’
Stevens sighed as he thought about the past. He had patched up his weak points by now, and when it was an important task, Lee Gun allowed Stevens to borrow his weapons.
Still, he wanted a weapon that Lee Gun made for only him. He wanted to use a proper weapon fitted for him even if it was just one time. He wanted to use it like Hugo.
In reality, Stevens had been able to kill monsters too well using the toy hammer, but... he couldn’t throw away his desire to use a weapon specifically tailored for him.
This was why Stevens had mixed emotions as he had this thought.
It had to do with Baby Lee Gun. Baby Lee Gun was ecstatic as he drank the apple juice. Stevens had swapped out the alcohol with the apple juice.
‘It would’ve been great if he had retained his memories.’
Lee Gun loved alcohol. However, this was a child who didn’t know the difference between alcohol and juice.
Yes. He was a child that couldn’t differentiate between alcohol and juice... He was a baby....
“Uh?”
Stevens started to sweat when he closely looked at Lee Gun.
‘Wait a moment.’
Stevens suddenly sniffed the air. He had sensed a strange smell. The smell was coming from the baby bottle with the juice. Lee Gun held it in his hands as he drank from it.
A slightly sweet smell of apple juice was supposed to be coming from it... Yet for some reason, it smelled like alcohol.... Wait a moment, alcohol??!
“Alcohol?!!!”
He was sure of it! This was the distinct smell of whiskey and brandy! Moreover, Lee Gun’s face was oddly flushed as he sucked on the bottle...
Stevens was taken aback. He snatched the baby bottle away. Popping the top, he took a sip! “Hey!!!!!!! Why the hell is there alcohol in here!!!”
He had wondered why Baby Lee Gun had been drinking it with such joy. Baby Lee Gun had been drinking alcohol?! Also, how did this baby know about alcohol that he was able to swap it out?!

chapters.title: Book 2: Epilogue 15 - Why the hell is he here? (5) Prev Chapter
chapters.content:
“Ahhk! This is alcohol!!”
The Leo temple’s officers almost fainted when they heard Stevens’s scream.
“What?!! Alcohol is in there?”
Stevens glared at his subordinates. “Who did it? I told you guys to put apple juice in it! Who put alcohol in it?! Is it you?! Alec!”
“What?! What are you talking about? I didn’t even touch it!”
“Was it you?”
“No way! We didn’t touch it at all! You were the one who filled it before giving it to Lee Gun-nim, Zodiac Saint-nim!”
“Wait a moment! None of you really touched it?!”
“Yes! We would be crazy to give him alcohol!”
Stevens was sweating. None of them had touched it. Did the apple juice turn into alcohol by itself? Moreover, a baby looked ecstatic while drinking alcohol?
At this point, the subordinates seemed to have wised up to the situation too.
“C...Can it be? Lee Gun-nim swapped the content by himself....”
“That isn’t possible!”
“He can fly and summon monsters. Why would it be impossible?!!”
“Damn it! What the hell is going on? We were told Lee Gun-nim doesn’t have any abilities!”
“Doesn’t this count as him being able to use his abilities?”
“Also, what kind of ability is that?! It isn’t the ability that he normally uses!”
“Is it the power of Universe?!”
Whether Lee Gun was using his abilities or not wasn’t important right now.
Stevens’s brain short-circuited. He recalled a face. It was after he had kidnapped(?) Yooha. Hugo had attacked the Leo temple on his own. Stevens remembered the expression on Hugo’s face at that time. How could he forget it?
The fact that Hugo wanted to destroy the holy ground of the Leo temple was a given. On top of that, he wanted to destroy everything related to Leo. It was as if he wanted to go back to the beginning to erase its presence.
The expression on Stevens’s face was a pure nightmare!
Of course, that incident was related to Yooha, Hugo’s daughter, but Hugo loved Lee Gun as much as his daughter. This would certainly anger him...
No! This was worse than before!! Hugo wasn’t the only Lee Gun fanatic! Damn it!!
The blood drained from Stevens’s face when he thought about the Chun siblings. The Sagittarius temple and the Serpent Bearer temple already hated him! That wasn’t all! There was Yeonwoo.
Stevens had briefly met Yeonwoo not too long ago while carrying out a commission. She seemed to treasure Lee Gun as well. In some ways, she was as scary as Eternal Change. She had sent even Leo, who had tried to mess with her, flying.
Wasn’t she somewhere in the US right now?
No! It wasn’t just Yeonwoo. All kinds of Lee Gun fanboys and fangirls existed out there...!!
Stevens’s face turned paler.
On the other hand, Baby Lee Gun looked dissatisfied about something.
“Byaa.”
His face said he would like side dishes with his alcohol. His small mouth pouted before he floated. He wasn’t even bothering to hide his abilities anymore.
Baby Lee Gun started hiccuping as he kicked with his short legs. It looked as though he was trying to swing through the air and trying to open the window to leave the building.
“Byaaa.”
Numerous high-rise buildings could be seen out the window. The place drawing Lee Gun’s gaze was the first floor of one of these buildings.
Hamburger food trucks, ice cream food trucks, donut stores, fried potato food trucks... It was food trucks galore...
The drunk Baby Lee Gun smirked nefariously. That wasn’t all.
Beyond the food trucks, he saw the Leo temple’s treasure warehouse. Treasure warehouse... Wouldn’t Hailey and Yeonwoo like that?
Grin!
Lee Gun finally used his ability to open the window.
“Byaaaa! Hiccup!”
It was a double-paned window that even a Zodiac Saint had a hard time opening. When Lee Gun opened it easily, the disciples of the Leo temple were shocked.
“Ahhk!! No!”
When the baby tried to exit through the window, they were shocked.
“You can’t go outside!!!”
“Hey! Stop him!”
Baby Lee Gun was already acting like this in here. If he went outside, it would really be the end!
“He’s a calamity!!!”
They tried to grab Lee Gun, who was about to leave.
The baby kept gurgling and hiccuping as if he didn’t understand why they were doing this. He resisted.
On the other hand, the Leo disciples hung on for dear life as if they were trying to protect(?) the earth. They grabbed Lee Gun’s legs, waist, and even his neck.
Stevens became sober.
‘He’s trying to head out toward the building where Hailey is!’
He couldn’t let him leave at all costs! Stevens barely kept a struggling Lee Gun at bay as he shouted, “Contact the Archer Saint!”
“Is Hugo still not answering the phone?!”
“We are trying! Ah! He answered it!”
Someone who had been trying to contact Hugo let out a bright smile.
Stevens looked over in relief. “Is that so? You got through?”
“Yes! We were finally able to contact him!”
“Where is he right now?”
“He is... Uh?”
The subordinate who had his phone up to his ear turned pale.
Stevens furrowed his brows. “What is it? What’s wrong?”
“That is....”
The subordinate froze when he looked behind Stevens.
Stevens wondered why he was acting like this when...
“What the hell are you guys doing right now?”
Eh?
Stevens and his subordinates, who were grabbing Lee Gun around his neck, froze.
“I ask again. What are you guys doing?”
The voice was cold enough to freeze the building.
Stevens slowly turned his head around. He saw Hugo, the Chun siblings, and several disciples of the Sagittarius temple...
Archer disciples?!!
A flustered Stevens and his subordinates acted as if they had seen a ghost. They looked at Hugo’s party.
“H...Hugo! Why are you here?!”
Hugo glared at Stevens with a scary expression. His angry gaze headed toward Lee Gun, who was being restrained by his neck.
“What the hell...are you doing...to my kid?”
Each phrase was infused with killing intent.freewёbnoνel.com
It didn’t matter who saw this. The situation made it seem as if they were keeping Baby Lee Gun in place and tormenting him.
Stevens knew he was screwed. He quickly tried to fix the misunderstanding.
“Hugo! This isn’t what it looks like! We aren’t bullying him! It’s because he was going on a rampage!”
However, Hugo and the Chun siblings couldn’t be reasoned with. They were already enraged.
“You dare kidnap Gun?”
“What? Whoa! Whoa! It isn’t like that. We didn’t kidnap him!”
“If you didn’t kidnap him, why would the baby be here on the other side of the world?”
“Why else? He came here himself!” Stevens protested, and his subordinates nodded along.
However, Hugo’s party appeared dumbfounded.
Yooha furrowed her brows. “You should make your excuses more believable.”
“That’s what I’m saying. How can a baby with no ability reach this place?”
Stevens felt aggrieved when the father and daughter looked at him with contempt in their eyes. “What are you talking about? He can use his abilities! We should be the ones to have an issue with you guys. You said the baby can’t use his ability!”
“What?”
“He can fly!”
“What?”
When Hugo looked at him with contempt, Stevens pointed at Lee Gun. “Here! Look at him! He’ll start floating around in the air soon!”
Everyone focused their gaze on Lee Gun.
Hugo skeptically observed Lee Gun. He didn’t believe Stevens, but Lee Gun was someone who did inconceivable things.
Moreover, the Leo Saint looked aggrieved, and his claim was plausible. There wasn’t a downside to trusting his claim.
Everyone focused their attention on Lee Gun.
Stevens wanted a favorable outcome, so he waved a snack in the air. “Here! This is the snack you wanted to eat! Go! Fly! Fly!!”
“...!”
Everyone gulped as they looked at Lee Gun.
One second.
Two seconds.
Three seconds.
....
Ten seconds.
Only silence reigned.
Lee Gun didn’t start flying. In fact, he didn’t even react at all.
Hugo mocked Stevens. “Oh. Is that so? He can fly?”
Stevens froze when faced with Hugo’s terrifying smile. The Archer Saint’s mouth was smiling, yet his eyes weren't.
Stevens became desperate. “Damn it! Why isn’t he flying?!”
He picked up the baby and tossed him into the air. “Fly! Do it like before! Hurry!”
“!!!”
When Stevens threw the baby upward, he went soaring toward the sky.
This shocked everyone. They screamed as their faces turned pale from fright.
“Kyaaaaa!!”
Everyone was appalled except Stevens.
“Yes. Hurry up and fly....”
At that moment, gravity was about to take hold. However, as Lee Gun was starting to fall, Chun Sungjae used his teleportation skill to snatch him out of the air.
Tuhk!
As if taking a cue from her young brother, Yooha aimed her blade at Stevens’s throat. “Do you want to die? What the hell are you doing???”
She looked furious, and her eyes flashed. Moreover, she wasn’t the only one. All the disciples of the Sagittarius temple who had gathered here were enraged.
Then there was Hugo, who had seen Stevens throw a newborn baby in the air. A terrifying black energy emanated from his body.
“I see.”
Stevens was terrified when he heard the cold voice. It seemed Hugo had unleashed the power of a monarch. Stevens almost screamed when he saw this.
“As if kidnapping my kid isn’t enough, you’re now abusing him?” Hugo’s rage was so great that it pierced the sky.
Steven yelled as if he was aggrieved, “Damn it! It really isn’t like that! He did use his ability! In fact, he even summoned monsters! He made this building like this too!”
“Hmmph... Now you’re claiming Gun summoned monsters of all things?”
“It’s true! This is driving me nuts!”
A desperate Stevens approached Lee Gun. “Hey! Hurry up and summon them again! Summon the monsters like before!!”
Despite seeing Stevens’s desperation, Lee Gun acted innocent as he tilted his head. He also stuck his thumb into his mouth, and his cheeks looked like that of a hamster.
“Byaa?”
It was as if he was feigning ignorance.
Stevens got angry. “Hey, asshole!!! Don’t act dumb! Hurry up and summon them like before!!”
When Stevens raised his voice, Baby Lee Gun looked startled. He was on the verge of tears. “Byaa...!”
Yooha, Hugo, and Sungjae got enraged when they witnessed Stevens threaten Lee Gun. One could practically hear their veins pop from anger.
An aggrieved Stevens grabbed Lee Gun. “Hey! You laughed like the devil earlier. You beat us up, and you drank alcohol. You destroyed the building, and you took whatever you wanted from us! How can you pretend to cry like this? It’s detestable!!!”
Hearing Stevens’s angry shout, Lee Gun finally started to sniffle as he looked for someone. It was as if he was looking for his guardians. “Byaa, byaa...!”
When they saw the child’s tears(?), the eyes of Yooha and Lee Gun’s stepfather were already seeing red.
“Really? You kidnapped a baby, and you tormented him enough that he destroyed the building. To make matters worse, you let a baby drink alcohol?”
“No! Hey! This is all a misunderstanding! Yooha! Why are you taking out a rope? Stop tying me up! This is a misunderstanding!”
“It’s a misunderstanding?”
“Yes! He wanted to drink alcohol, so we swapped it out for apple juice! Turns out it was alcohol in the end! I’m telling the truth! Please believe me!”
Hugo finally exploded. “How can you spout such nonsense!!! How can you call yourself a human!!?”
In the end, it was like the time when Stevens had kidnapped a young Yooha. The hands of the Archer Saint once again razed the holy ground of the Leo temple to the ground.
Kwah-gwah-gwahng!
It seemed Lee Gun had dust in his eyes. After he rubbed his eyes, the baby’s tears were nowhere to be seen. He glanced at the building housing Hailey. Then he put on a goofy expression as he hugged Yooha. He was still drunk, so he let out a small burp.
While this was going on, the Leo temple was going through a burning ceremony.
“Zodiac Saint-nim!!”
“Ahhhhk!! Help!”
Stevens and the Leo disciples screamed. They still had no idea why Lee Gun had come here.

chapters.title: Chapter 503: Book 2: Epilogue 16 - Truth (1)
chapters.content:
“This is not fair!”
“We really didn’t kidnap him!”
The Leo disciples screamed after being apprehended. They were tied up, and the disciples of the Sagittarius temple held torches before them as if they were about to carry out a witch burning.
Stevens had been severely beaten by Hugo to a point where death would have been preferable. Afterward, Yooha had placed a rope around him before stringing him up on the building. Stevens and the Leo disciples were hung like giant banners.
The guardians of the child walked out of the collapsed building. They had recovered Lee Gun.
“Gun, were you scared because these scary-looking men kidnapped you? Let’s hurry up and go back home. We’ll eat a lot of tasty food.”
“Byaa.”
After recovering the kidnapped Lee Gun, Hugo and his party let out sighs of relief and exited the holy ground of the Leo temple. However...
“What a mess.”
“!”
When they arrived at the entrance to the Leo temple’s holy ground, a familiar face greeted them.
“Jaewon oppa!”
Lee Jaewon stood near the entrance, wearing a crisp suit. His cleaned-up version looked striking.
“If you had told me about it, I would’ve helped destroy this place.”
Hugo laughed. He was surprised to see Lee Jaewon, who was smiling brightly. “Why are you here? I thought you went to negotiate with Shiva to meet Hailey.”
“Yes. That’s why I’m here.”
“...huh?”
When the three of them looked at him in askance, Lee Jaewon pointed somewhere. It was one of the still-standing buildings of the Leo temple.
“Shiva hid his family in that building, including Hailey-nim.”
“What?”
“Hailey-nim is inside that building.”
“What!!!”
Hugo and his family looked at the building in surprise. This was especially true of Hugo since he had planned on destroying all the buildings belonging to the Leo temple.
“Why would you tell me this important piece of information right now? Ahhk! I have to tell the others to not destroy that place!”
“That building is under the direct protection of Shiva. We won’t be able to destroy it easily. It won’t be possible with human power.”
Hugo groaned as he felt conflicted. He started sweating. “Hailey is in that building. Should we visit her?”
“You want to go there after you razed the holy ground?”
“Ughh... Yes. Today isn’t a good time. Let’s head back since we found Gun. He should be exhausted. We need to give him his rest...”
At this point, Lee Jaewon looked confused. He let out a bitter laugh. “I’m sorry for interrupting you, but you mentioned that he needs his rest. Where is Lee Gun-nim?”
“What?”
“Lee Gun-nim isn’t here.”
Surprised at those words, everyone looked toward Hugo’s arms.
The Chun siblings screamed when they realized Hugo’s arms were empty. Hugo was cradling a rock instead of Lee Gun.
“Uncle is...!”
“He’s gone!!”
The baby had been in his arms a moment ago! He had been docile when food was mentioned!
Surprised, Hugo tried to drop the stone before looking for Lee Gun.
“Kuhk!”
However, the stone wouldn’t separate from his arms! It was stuck to him as if super glue had been applied. In the end, the weight of the stone toppled Hugo.
The stone suddenly gained a weight that even the strongest superhuman would have a hard time lifting.
“Dad!”
“Zodiac Saint-nim!”
“What the hell? I can’t get it off you!”
Hugo’s face turned pale in fright as he held the stone in his arms. “Gun!! Where did you go!!!”
* * *
Kwahng! Kwahng!
As this was going on, next to the building housing Hailey, a line of Leo disciples was standing guard on the first floor.
They kept glancing toward Shiva. The reason was the Sagittarius temple and the Serpent Bearer temple causing a ruckus outside.
Of course, Shiva didn’t take it well when he realized they had invaded this place. His own residence was destroyed, and above all else, they would try to meet with Hailey. Shiva looked a bit uneasy.
The disciples who had been walking on eggshells spoke up.
“Will we be fine? I doubt they’ll go without messing with this building...”
“They probably realized your daughter is here.”
Shiva had been off to the side, making a toy for his daughter. One of his eyebrows rose.
“Humans won’t be able to force themselves into this place. I put up a barrier.”
“There is a monarch on their side...”
“It’s fine. A monarch won’t be able to enter this place. I set up something here that the monarchs hate. Anyone who doesn’t possess my power won’t be able to enter—”
Clank!!!
“!?”
Suddenly, the door and the windows on the first floor were destroyed. That wasn’t all.
Puhng puhng puhng!
The interior of their building started to crumble as well.
“I...Is it an intruder?!”
“Is it an attack from the outside?”
Shiva furrowed his brows when he heard the shouts. No, this wasn’t an attack from the outside. The disturbance had started from inside the building!
“If it’s from the inside, is it your wife and daughter?”
“No....” When Shiva turned his head, he caught sight of items flying around the interior of the building.
“Huhk! That’s...!”
Several hundred items had descended from the top floor. They were all weapons!
“My god! Those are all from the weapon storage on the fourth floor!”
“W-Wait a moment! Weren’t those weapons serviced by the Creator not too long ago?”
“That’s right— Ahhk!!”
It was as if someone was controlling the weapons through telekinesis. Each weapon caused mayhem. They started destroying the barrier, doors, and windows from the inside.
Kwahng! Kwah-jeek! Kwah-jee-jeek!
At that moment, the highest-ranked weapon in the storage flew through the air to pin itself to the first floor’s door.
Kwahng!!
The weapon exploded in a flashy manner and destroyed the building and the front door.
Koo-goo-goong!
Shiva had been guarding the building against outside intruders. He hadn’t paid much attention to the defense inside the building. His eyebrows twitched.
As the mouths of the surprised disciple fell open, a young blonde man leisurely entered through the opening. “Where is my daughter-in-law?”
Green magical energy surrounded him.
“That person is...!”
“He’s a Creator! He was the previous Serpent Bearer!”
Shiva’s face became red from anger when he witnessed Aslan’s entrance. “Aslan... You sneaky thief....”
Aslan cheekily mocked him by kicking the broken front door. “I’m glad I serviced those weapons. You should’ve managed the internal defense as well as the outer defense. This is why fighting-type gods are dumb..”
The Leo disciples descended into a panic. A while ago, Aslan had appeared unannounced at their temple and offered to service the temple’s weapons!
‘He did it to pull this off?!’
Leo had already been leery because he knew that Aslan wasn’t someone to do a generous act for no reason. Leo claimed something was off! That no longer mattered.
Aslan waved two bags in front of Shiva. “I brought presents for my daughter-in-law and your wife. Where is Hailey?”
“Did you suddenly fix Cargo’s weapons because you wanted to pull this off?”
Aslan and Shiva had always been hostile toward each other. No, they were closer to being enemies who tried to take each other’s lives.
However, Aslan snorted as if he was offended. “Cargo may be your comrade, but he’s also my friend. Of course, I did proper work in upgrading his weapons. As a price, I made a bit of change that would allow me to use them for a bit.”
There was a good reason the Leo temple was so obsessed with the durability of their weapons.
‘Cargo always uses his power in excess.’
Leo was a high-rank fighting-type god. Like Lee Gun, Leo was an extremely strong god.
When a disciple wanted to use a Zodiac’s power, the Zodiac had to control their power before sending it.
However, there was no way Leo would control its power. If one had to make a comparison, it was like converting electricity for commercial use. Leo chose to send a direct shot of lightning instead when one needed electricity.
This was why Aslan had become angry at Leo.
- If you send your power like that, you will burn out your disciples!! You’re supposed to send them your power, not kill them!
Aslan kept telling Leo to modulate his power before sending it. However, the young Leo had refused to listen.
- I don’t want to. Why do I have to control my power for mere humans? It’s annoying!
- Damn it!
This was why Aslan had placed a limiter on Cargo.
- If you ever acquire people for your colony, your power must manifest through their weapons.
At the very least, the weapons would take the brunt of the damage from the Divine power.
However, as Cargo sent excessive power each time, the weapons weren’t able to last long. Cargo was a beast god, so he didn’t use weapons.
The weapons were not meant to be used. The power was sent for destructive purposes. Naturally, those weapons wouldn’t last!
It was why Capricorn felt aggrieved.
‘Only a Creator can make weapons that can safely contain Cargo’s power.’
It was a problem with compatibility. While Lee Gun developed high-rank skills, his weapons had been durable despite him making them when he was young. It had to do with the power of “Life.”
While manufacturing weapons, Lee Gun would unconsciously put the power of Life into his weapons. It increased the life energy of his weapons.
Aslan had used a similar principle. He filled the weapons with the power of Life to upgrade them. Aslan possessed the Divine status of Asclepius, a power similar to Lee Gun’s power of Life.
“Anyway, my business isn’t with you. I want to arrange a meeting between Gun and Hailey.”
His son didn’t have his memories. Aslan wondered if meeting Hailey would be like shock therapy. He hoped it would return Lee Gun’s memories.
There was a reason he was so desperate to return the memories to his son.
When he had realized his son didn’t have his memories, he had gone looking for Yeonwoo and Virgo. He had found them having a serious conversation.
- Serpent Bearer no longer has his memories. Isn’t this an opportunity for you, Yeonwoo?
- W-What?
- That’s right. If he doesn’t have his memories, you are at an advantage compared to the Scorpio Saint. If you start raising him right now, Lee Gun might grow up looking only at you. Also, you grew up with the Serpent Bearer. You know better than anyone what Lee Gun likes!
Virgo cheered for Yeonwoo, but Yeonwoo didn’t want such a thing.
- You don’t have to say it. I already know Gun has his heart set on a different person.
- !
- I know the truth. The cat that Gun kept wasn’t really a cat.
- What?
- Gun liked that cat more than I had imagined. He treasured that cat, and I saw that cat change into a human.
- What?!
Virgo’s mouth kept opening and closing. Yeonwoo rested her chin on her hands as she sighed.
- She was very young and pretty. Of course, I found out she was the Scorpio Saint after I was revived.
- ...?!!
Virgo didn’t know what to do with herself. She became restless.
Yeonwoo let out a bitter laugh.
- You don’t have to look at me like that. It’s true that I’m insanely jealous of her, but I’m also thankful to her.
The relationship between Yeonwoo and Lee Gun was quite complicated. At the time, Yeonwoo had been traumatized because Time had killed her and her brother again.
‘If Time finds us, he’ll kill Gun for being next to us.’
This was why she thought about ending her own life when Time’s shadow was cast over them. She had planned on giving up on revenge for her master. She planned on destroying her Divine status and soul so that she could end this tiresome and endless cycle.
Moreover, her early death would save the man whom she loved. She could end all of this while no harm would come to him.
Despite her resolve, Yeonwoo was unable to tell the full truth to Lee Gun even as she died. However, Lee Gun probably knew. He knew that Yeonwoo and Junwoo had been hiding something from him.
- When I tried to die when I was young, Gun was the one who stopped me from doing it. He told me to become his bride when we grew up.
Lee Gun had said that when he was young, so Yeonwoo had no idea if there was any big meaning behind his words.
In hindsight, Lee Gun had instinctively realized that she had given up on life and thrown her a lifeline in his own way. He did it to keep Yeonwoo in this world.
Both of them had grown up as parentless orphans. They could rely on only each other. This was why Yeonwoo felt a large sense of guilt for dying. It also made her that much angrier when she found out why Time had appeared.
- That cat... No, Hailey appeared when we were struggling the most.
This was why Yeonwoo felt thankful to Hailey. The cat had saved Lee Gun, who had been unable to laugh. In reality, Hailey had been saved by Lee Gun, but it didn’t matter who was saved.
- When Gun was struggling the most, I wasn’t the one to save him. It was Hailey. That’s why I don’t want to use such an underhanded tactic.
But the status quo kept tempting her, so she thought it would be best if Gun regained his memories.
Anyway, Aslan had heard this conversation.
‘I thought him having his memory wasn’t important.’
However, memories were more important at times, and their absence could make it hard for others.
Aslan loved his son; he wanted Lee Gun to live a happy life until the end with the person he loved. It was something Aslan hadn’t been able to achieve for himself. He had to send away his loved ones before they could achieve happiness.
“Ha ha ha. Just wait a little longer.” Aslan let out a cheeky smile as he teleported toward the upper floors.
Shiva immediately chased after him. “Stop right there, you little thief!”
Aslan laughed when he heard the barrage of curse words from behind him. “Idiot! Give it up! I’m going to make Gun regain his memories! I’ll bring Gun here soon!”
“I won’t let you bring your son here!”
“Hmmph. What nonsense—”
At that moment...
Flash!
Accompanying a green light, Mimir appeared next to Aslan. “This is bad, Old Master!” Mimir looked flustered. “As per your order, I was going to bring Master here. However, Master was suddenly gone! I tried looking for him, but he was nowhere to be found!”
“!”
Aslan, who had been heading upward, came to a stop. He furrowed his brows. Looking a bit angry, he glanced at Shiva. “I see. As if hiding Hailey isn’t enough, you kidnapped Gun?”
Aslan called forth his magic.
Shiva, who had caught up to Aslan, became angry as well. “I didn't kidnap him. In the first place, he isn’t someone I can mess with.”
“Hmmph. You’re just saying that because you don’t want him to regain his memories....”
Shiva glared at him. He didn’t want to say this, but he had to. He raised his voice. “You really don’t know!”
“What?”
“Your son has his memories! He had them as soon as he arrived on the earth! Do you still not know this?”
Displeased at Shiva’s angry shout, Aslan furrowed his brows. “What nonsense are you talking about? I checked it with my translation ability. Also, the conditions needed for him to retain his memories weren't there. When the power of Universe was transferred, his Divine status was sent flying. There was no place for him to store his memories, so how...”
“Damn it! Of course, it’s possible!”
“How...!”
“He entrusted his memories to me, idiot!”
“...?!”
Aslan was stunned. His eyes turned round. What? What the hell did he just say?

chapters.title: Chapter 504: Book 2: Epilogue 17 - Truth (2)
chapters.content:
Aslan was dumbfounded at Shiva’s shout. He was at a loss for words. The powerful magical energy that had been emanating from his body was long gone.
Aslan didn’t know which part he should tackle first. He looked lost. “Wait a moment. He entrusted what? Who gave what to you...? What? Gun has his memories?”
Shiva looked at Aslan as if he found explaining it tiresome.
Aslan was a renowned genius magician in the Divine world. At an early age, he had made all the sage gods submit under his feet. He was an incredible being.
- Sage? Is that all you have to show for your age? You guys consider yourselves top-tier gods with so little knowledge? It’s unjustified. You guys will be more useful by dying and coming back as cat litter.
The sage gods had lived for thousands to tens of thousands of years. Some of them shed bitter tears as they came to the Great Spirits such as Shiva. They cried and asked the Great Spirits to punish Aslan. Others decided to crawl under the rule of Aslan.
Mimir was one of those who decided to serve Aslan.
He was almost like a bull in a china shop.
Anyway, Aslan was so talented that he was arrogant and he got away with being deceitful.
Shiva found it funny that such a god was at a loss for words because of his son.
“No way... It can’t be...” A confused Aslan glared at Shiva as if the Great Spirit were talking nonsense.
“Don’t give me that nonsense. There is no way Gun has his memories. I already checked it. There is no way I would’ve failed to pick up on it...!”
Shiva snorted. As a Great Spirit, he acknowledged Aslan’s skill level. If he were being honest, Aslan was the most talented god in the Divine world. No creature from any world could escape Aslan’s magic. However, this fact was useless.
“Your son is a being that transcends the gods. Why would your ability work against him?”
“!”
“It’s a simple concept. He’s a being that can manipulate divine providence. Why would your abilities work against him? If you look into his head, he can show you fake memories. If you try to translate his words, he can just create a fake language.”
“...!”
“Your son used his abilities to dupe you, idiot.”
Aslan couldn’t close his mouth. All of Baby Lee Gun’s thoughts and words he had read through the Translation ability were faked.
There was probably only one thought that he had read correctly.
- Byaa?
- [It’s so bright.]
Afterward, Lee Gun had used his abilities to dupe Aslan.
Aslan was so shocked that he was unable to say anything. However, it didn’t last long. “Why should I believe you? Why would Gun go through such a cumbersome and useless act? Also, you said he entrusted his memories to you! That sounds like nonsense!”
Aslan had gone to the World of Emptiness to find his son. This was why he didn’t want to believe Shiva’s words.
An annoyed Shiva tapped the back of his neck when he saw the confused Aslan. “Damn it! You’re such an idiot.” He hadn’t planned on telling this story.
* * *
It was an incident before Lee Gun went to fight the final battle with Universe.
In the gutter of the World of Emptiness, where they kept the troublesome prisoners, Lee Gun had been placed under special observation because he had tried to fight Universe. It wasn’t just once. He had done it multiple times.
Of course, he wasn’t alone.
“Oh wow! This is a record. You lasted longer than usual.”
“Ha ha ha.”
Lee Gun had been brought here by the guards. He looked at his roommate after being tossed into the room. It was a man with long unkempt black hair who looked full of madness. His smirk was uncanny.
Lee Gun was locked up in a room that housed someone rumored to be crazy. This being had been here for several hundred years, and the guards could do nothing to him. This was why he was permanently confined to this region.
He was vicious, powerful, tyrannical, and also nuts. He killed all the guards and residents of the World of Emptiness who got close to him by biting into them. It was a mess.
All his powers had been sealed, yet he couldn’t be controlled. That was why Lee Gun was designated to be his roommate.
Every one of this being’s roommates had not lasted a day. Their bodies were ripped apart and sent out as corpses.
The stronger beings had lasted a week before they were sent out as corpses. It was as if the owner of the room chose to play around with them.
Anyway, it was an infamous room.
- We don’t want to do this, but you give us no choice. I don’t know how long you’ll last inside that place, but while you’re alive, try to get along with him.
- Who knows? He might look kindly at you since you guys share the same origin.
Origin? At first, he didn’t really believe that claim.
Anyway, that madman was Shiva. Shiva was tickled by the fact that Lee Gun was a fellow Zodiac.
- I got an important guess. It has been a while since I’ve been able to hear news about my homeland.
Shiva was having so much fun that he planned on destroying Lee Gun with great care.
In the end, Lee Gun had to fight the Great Spirit with his life on the line for three straight months. He didn’t even get to rest and had almost died.
Lee Gun had fought most of the gods in the Divine world, but Shiva had been one of the strongest.
After almost dying, Lee Gun finally beat Shiva. It led to the two men introducing themselves to each other.
Soon, Lee Gun told Shiva why he had come to the World of Emptiness.
- Is that so? You went looking for your friend in the Divine world, and you killed all the Great Spirits. It led to you becoming the new Great Spirit. Then you came here because you wanted to save some people? You really are crazy.
- Yes. That’s why you should kneel to me too, idiot.
- Hmmph. You’re a brat who is still wet behind the ears, yet you speak like that?
- Buzz off! Now that I think about it, I killed your comrades. What place were you affiliated with? Don’t resent me too much for it.
- I was the Great Spirit of Mahabharata.
- Ah. It was the place with those imbeciles...
- I had a wife and an unborn daughter that I had to leave behind.
- Hmmph. I don’t know who they are, but I bet they are glad you’re here. Your wife and daughter are probably happy since they don’t need you. I’m sure the two of them are leading a new life after meeting their new daddy. Don’t worry too much about them.
- If they can be happy, I don’t care about that. I just hope they are still alive. The only thing that worries me is that my wife is a monarch. There is no way the Zodiacs would leave her alone.
- Hmmph. You really are a crazy Zodiac. You dare hook up with a monarch— Huh?
Lee Gun suddenly became uneasy. Monarch? ...monarch?
Wait a moment. Didn’t an incident like that happen to someone close to him? A forbidden love between a Zodiac and a monarch.... One Great Spirit was sent to the World of Emptiness as a consequence...
Lee Gun suddenly felt an uneasiness wash over his body. He glanced at Shiva, whose entire body was wrecked, and asked, “The unborn daughter of yours... Did you perhaps give her a name?”
“Yes. We agreed to name her Hailey when she was born.”
“....”
Lee Gun started to sweat as he looked at Shiva. He had beaten Shiva until the god was half dead.
Damn it!
Lee Gun knew he was screwed.
This was how Lee Gun and Shiva had met each other.
Anyway, the two of them had shared several adventures, and right before he finally went to kill Universe, Lee Gun said something to Shiva.
“What? You want me to hold on to something for you?” Shiva asked.
“Yes.”
“I wondered what you wanted to say to me when you created this space.”
Lee Gun had used an ability he had acquired in the World of Emptiness and created a subspace that no one could eavesdrop on.
Inside the subspace, he placed a hand over his head to create an item. It looked like a small bottle that contained a liquid.
“After I kill Universe, I don’t think things will end there.”
“You don’t think it’ll be the end?”
“I don’t know. It’s just a feeling that I have. After fighting him several times, I realized he oddly doesn’t have memories before a certain point.” Lee Gun was sure of it.
“From what I gleaned from my conversation with him, Universe wasn't Universe from the start. I’m pretty sure a previous Universe existed before him, and the current one doesn’t seem to have memories before he ascended to that seat. It’s strange.”
Lee Gun thought something that he couldn’t see was going on. This was why he decided to copy his memories. As a manufacturing god, he had the ability to do this.
“Something might happen to me, so I want to entrust this to you.”
“You want to entrust it to me?”
“After I kill Universe, a crack will form in the World of Emptiness. I want you to use that opportunity to escape this place. If I lose my memories, I want you to give them to me after I return to the earth.”
Shiva scoffed as if Lee Gun was being ridiculous. “What if I say no?”
Lee Gun took out another bottle.
The look in Shiva’s eyes changed when he saw it. “You bastard....”
The bottle contained Hailey’s memories.
“I’ll give you this. Of course, it’s your choice as her father if you want to give this to the reborn Hailey.”
The dumbfounded Shiva snatched the bottle away. He furrowed his brows. “Did you make any copies?”
“There is only one. I wouldn’t do such a thing.” Lee Gun looked at it with a bit of bitterness.
When Lee Gun killed Universe, Hailey would be reborn on the earth. After being reborn, Hailey would have the right to lead a new life.
He wouldn’t give Hailey’s memories from her past life just because he wanted to satisfy his own desire.
Lee Gun held up his memories, which he had copied. “I want you to keep my ‘true’ memories. Then I want you to use your ability of destruction to attack my head and destroy the memory of this conversation.”
Universe was a monster that was beyond imagination. It could read the memories and feelings of its opponent at will.
If Universe found out that a copy of Lee Gun’s memories existed out there, he might intervene in some way.
This was why Lee Gun made it so that he didn’t remember the “real” plan.
He went to meet Universe after this memory about the conversation was destroyed. The only one who knew the plan was Shiva.
It was unclear as to how long had passed. Shiva, who had taken Lee Gun’s memories, furrowed his brows. “Of course, I don’t plan on returning Hailey’s memories to her. I especially don’t plan on returning your memories to you. When I return to the earth, I’ll keep it in storage. It’ll be calamitous if someone like you regains your memories.”
“Yes. That’s enough.” Lee Gun grinned.
At the time, Shiva didn’t know why Lee Gun was laughing. He learned the reason behind it long after, when Lee Gun had reappeared on the earth.
At that time, the world was in a state of turmoil because everyone thought a Red-zone-rank monster had invaded the earth.
Shiva, who had been residing in the US, bit his tongue when he discovered a flashing light coming from his house’s storage room. As soon as he ran to the storage room, he flinched.
‘It’s gone.’
Lee Gun’s memories, which he had hidden in the corner of the storage room, were missing.
Realizing what had happened, Shiva ground his teeth. “That bastard...”
Shiva had wondered why Lee Gun had been so confident in entrusting his memories to him. The memories would automatically return to Lee Gun as soon as he returned to the earth.
Anyway, that was what happened.
* * *
After he had heard the entire story, Aslan’s mouth fell open. From what he had gathered, Lee Gun had regained his memories as soon as he had landed in front of Hugo’s house!
“Is that why you...!”
Was this why Shiva had gone underground with his family? It was because he knew Lee Gun had regained his memories?!
That seemed to be the case. Shiva gnashed his teeth. “I still have Hailey’s memories, but there is no way I’ll let your son meet my cute daughter.”
Shocked, Aslan was unable to close his mouth.
* * *
Around that time, a hiccuping baby arrived on the top floor of a building. The room that Lee Gun had sought held a three-year-old girl who was sound asleep.
“Byaa.”
Lee Gun smiled when he saw Hailey peacefully sleeping.
Hailey was sleeping while clutching a doll that looked like a snake.
“Byaa... Byaa....”
A content Lee Gun had been watching Hailey when he suddenly flinched. He received a physiological signal.
‘Damn this body of a baby!!’
It was great that he was able to reincarnate. The problem was that he possessed the body of a baby!
‘Damn it! It doesn’t matter if I have my memories if things are like this!’
While his head contained the real Lee Gun, his body was that of a baby. He wasn’t potty trained. It also meant his physiological activities, such as sleeping, were that of a baby. He couldn’t control his bodily functions, so...
‘Damn it! How many times do I have to eat and poop in a day!!’
He knew it in his head, but he never imagined a baby had to eat and poop so much in a day! Of course, it would be bad manners to go in front of Hailey. So Baby Lee Gun groaned as he tried to fly out of the room.
However...
“!?”
The sleeping Hailey suddenly grabbed Lee Gun.

chapters.title: Chapter 505: Book 2: Epilogue 18 - Truth (3)
chapters.content:
In the beginning, Lee Gun had just wanted to hide the truth about his memories for a short while to torment(?) Hugo. He never planned on hiding it for this long.
‘I never expected this!’
Hugo’s house had become Lee Gun’s foster home, and Lee Gun ground his teeth. After destroying his heart in the World of Emptiness, Lee Gun had returned to the earth.
His body had somehow retained his memories, and he had instinctively fallen to Hugo’s house instead of other regions. That was all well and good. However, it was a moot point!
‘Damn it! I have the body of a baby! I can’t even flip myself over!!’
Lee Gun had fallen off the sofa by mistake. His forehead rested against the floor as he struggled.
‘Who cares if I have my memories! My body is like this!’
He needed help, and it didn’t matter from whom.
Lee Gun had recovered his memories by the time Hugo had seen the words written on his palm and realized he was Lee Gun. As soon as Lee Gun had fallen to the earth, his memories, which had been turned into an item, had been activated. The Seal (Summon) function had activated, and the item hidden in Shiva’s storage room had disappeared.
Thanks to the item, Lee Gun had regained his memories. When he saw Hugo and his family, they looked like they didn’t know if they wanted to laugh or cry.
Lee Gun let out a sigh of relief.
‘I’m back.’
He had one resolve. He wanted to come back and break Taeksoo’s back by buying expensive items. He had subjugated the World of Emptiness. He had killed Universe. He had rescued Hailey. And as he had planned, he had regained his memories after returning to the earth!
In the end, he had succeeded! He could rest without worry!
Of course, he did encounter some problems along the way. Some people wanted to take Lee Gun away from Hugo and his family. They claimed that they wouldn’t be able to trust Hugo, who had betrayed humanity.
When Lee Gun heard this, he wanted to beat them all to death, but he held himself back. Thankfully, Kevin and Stevens tactfully backed off. Otherwise, Lee Gun might have destroyed the earth.
‘At the end of the day, I have the body of a baby.’
Lee Gun had thought everything would be solved if he was able to regain his memories. However, it was more inconvenient to be in the body of a child than he had assumed.
A baby’s body couldn’t fight off sleep if he was sleepy. He couldn’t freely turn his head, and he couldn’t walk. To make matters worse, he couldn't even flip his body over. His hand muscles hadn’t developed, so he couldn’t hold items properly!
He tried to speak, but his damn tongue seemed to be paralyzed and he would become tongue-tied! That wasn’t all!
“Ahh-ooh-ahh!!!”
Damn it!
Lee Gun wanted to watch a channel on the TV. It took him an hour to move thirty centimeters, and getting the remote was an epic struggle.
He proceeded to struggle to press the buttons until he finally landed on the channel that he wanted to watch when it happened!
- What the hell? Gun is asleep. Who had the nerve to turn on the TV?
However, that bastard Oh Taeksoo was oblivious. He kept saying a good child should sleep and would turn off the TV!!!
“Ah-ya!!!!!!!!! (You want to die, asshole!)”
To make matters worse, this idiot didn’t give him proper food! At the very least, he should’ve included meat in it! It was always vegetables? Veggggggggggies??
“Byaaaaa!!! Byaa! Byaaaaa?! (Do you want me to beat you up so bad that you can no longer chew meat? Hmmm?!)”
They always ate grilled meat for themselves!
“Byaaaaaaaa!!(I didn’t come back for this!)”
Moreover, the ungrateful bastard dared to bring inferior-quality clothes and formula because he was short on money!
Hugo had also tried to make Lee Gun go multiple times in his diaper before changing it.
“Byaaa Yaaa!!!!!(Damn it! This is child abuse!!!! I’m going to report you!)”
As expected of a baby’s body, Lee Gun ate, slept, and pooped... No, that was what he always used to do too.
Anyway, his thoughts were all grown up, yet his body wouldn’t take any orders from him. It was an inconvenient situation.
For example, he craved alcohol and snacks. But as his body was still undeveloped, he easily got a stomachache from eating such food. This was why he grudgingly ate the baby food and formula.
In the early days, Lee Gun had tried eating in secret at night. He ate whatever he wanted, but it gave him stomach aches the next day.
- Byaa... Byaa...!!
- Gun!! Get the doctor!!!
Damn it! It didn’t hurt this much even when he was beaten up by the monsters!
For some reason, a stomachache as a baby hurt Lee Gun more than when he was beaten up by the monsters as an adult!
Of course, he was used to pain, so he could ignore it. However, his diaper would become filled with what looked like a wet puddle of mud!
It oddly attacked his dignity as a man. This was why he decided to be selective about what he ate. Above all else, Hugo went crazy if he had a stomachache. For the next twelve hours, Hugo would go into overdrive in being a father... To nurse the baby, Hugo would sit near him and talk to him.
This was why Lee Gun decided to go easy on the food since the only topic Hugo talked about was turning Lee Gun into a fanboy for his adoptive father.
Hugo would play an infinite loop of videos that contained only his exploits. He tried to brainwash Lee Gun and try to dupe Lee Gun by saying Gun only trusted Daddy Hugo. Hugo lived off the praise that Lee Gun had sometimes given Hugo in the past.
It was ridiculous... What an asshole.
He shouldn’t have saved Hugo. He should have left Hugo in the World of Emptiness. Hugo was worse than the Zodiac Saints.
Anyway, all kinds of unusual things were happening to him, but these weren’t the true problems. These were minor troubles! The real problem existed elsewhere.
“Dad. I’ll change Uncle’s diaper.”
The number-one dark horse candidate causing his troubles was Yooha!
Lee Gun could have never expected this. When he returned as a baby, his niece and nephew went crazy. While he could ignore Sungjae, Yooha was acting crazy!
She wasn’t trying to change his diaper because she merely wanted to take care of him. That didn’t seem to be her purpose.
Whenever Lee Gun saw Yooha, he had to run away like a madman.
‘Why do her eyes twinkle when she’s changing my diapers? What’s she seeing that makes her eyes twinkle?!’
His saving grace was that she thought he was a normal baby who had lost his memory. If they found out that he had his memories....
Lee Gun was still unable to properly control his body. He felt a chill run up his spine. Yooha was a given. However, Taeksoo’s eyes would flash in delight too.
- Really? Gun has his memories? That means you can change your diaper, right? Gun is an adult, right? We don't have to look after you. You can do it all for yourself, right?
In the worst-case scenario, he would be left to fend for himself as they ignored his dignity as a man.
Lee Gun had decided to give as good as he got. This was why he had destroyed Taeksoo’s home and was having fun breaking Hugo’s spine by draining his resources.
If Lee Gun considered what he had done, he knew how he would be treated. At the same time, he hadn’t gone to meet Hailey for a slightly similar reason.
‘At the very least, I’ll meet her after I potty train myself.’
He had already experienced all kinds of indignities in Hugo’s household, so he was quite serious about this point. That was how it was supposed to be.
“Byaaa!!”
Back to the present.
Lee Gun, who had gone to the Leo temple’s holy ground to see Hailey, felt like dying for a variety of reasons. He had planned on taking a peek at Hailey’s face and leaving!
“Byam...!”
Hailey let out a bright smile as she hugged Lee Gun from behind. It wasn’t just the warm and snug body temperature unique to children. A familiar scent and warmth were being transmitted to his skin.
It had been a very long time since they were able to meet each other and touch each other. Lee Gun was having a hard time schooling his face. However, that wasn’t important right now!
“Byam!”
“Byaaa!”
‘Damn it! This is great, but I can’t do this right now, Hailey!’
Lee Gun felt like dying for a different reason; he was receiving a physiological signal. He was already having a hard time controlling this bodily function as a baby! He didn’t want to make an oopsie in front of the person that he wanted to meet the most!
He was supposed to be humanity’s greatest hero! Please cut me some slack!!!
‘Hailey! I’ll be back! This isn’t the time to be...!’
Lee Gun struggled as he tried to escape. However, Hailey seemed to be pleased as she hugged Lee Gun closer to her. She shouldn’t have her memories, yet she looked extremely pleased to see Lee Gun.
Lee Gun also enjoyed seeing her. However, he would enjoy it more if she let him go for one minute!
‘Damn it! What’s going on? Why is Hailey so strong?’
Hailey was a child who had inherited the blood of a god and a monarch. Since she wasn’t human, her body should be different from a human body, yet wasn’t she a bit too strong?
‘I have to use teleport to get out of here for now!’
Since Lee Gun had the body of a baby, there was a limited number of times he could use this ability. Still, he had come here after consuming Universe’s power. Using teleportation wouldn’t be too hard.
However, before Lee Gun could use teleport, Hailey turned Lee Gun toward her and kissed him on his lips.
Lee Gun’s head went blank. For a moment, he had his concentration stolen. Then he almost screamed.
‘That was dangerous!’
He had liked it, but he had almost lost his dignity as a man by a razor-thin margin. He was barely able to hold it back as he avoided immediate danger. However, he was still in a precarious situation.
‘Damn it! I can’t use teleport like this...!’
The damn body of a baby didn’t allow him to focus on two things at once.
Hailey seemed to have read Lee Gun’s expression. She tilted her head in puzzlement, wondering why Lee Gun was making such an expression. Soon, she realized something and quickly laid Lee Gun down.
She took a firm hold of his diaper as if she were saying she would take care of it. She waited for him.
Seeing this, Lee Gun became desperate. He inwardly screamed.
‘No! It’s fine! I’ll come back after taking care of my own business!’
At that moment, a light of salvation appeared in front of a troubled Lee Gun.
[Master! Are you here!]
“!!”
Mimir had appeared right on time.
Hailey had a firm grip on Lee Gun.
Lee Gun extended his small hands as if he had been saved. “Byaaaaa! Byaa! (Save me! I’m in a hurry!)”
Mimir let out a sigh of relief. He clicked his tongue as he realized what kind of position Lee Gun had found himself in. “Master. This is why I said you should tell those close to you that you still have your memories. You’re being punished for hiding it.”
“Byaa?”
Lee Gun wanted Mimir to shut up and help him. His gaze had been gentle when he was looking at Hailey, but his eyes soon turned cold.
Mimir was the only one who knew that Lee Gun had his memories.
Mimir had found it out by coincidence, and this was why Mimir was the only one who had been harassed by Lee Gun.
Mimir felt aggrieved, so he wanted to tell Hugo or one of the guardians about Lee Gun’s memories. However, whenever Mimir tried to do so, his young master kept threatening him like a gangster... It was quite the low blow.
Seeing the look in Lee Gun’s eyes, Mimir sighed and tried to take Lee Gun from Hailey. “Let him go for a moment.”
At that moment, a surprised Hailey hugged Lee Gun even more tightly. A scary look entered her eyes as she raised her guard toward Mimir. “Byam. Where are you taking him?”
She had never seen Mimir before, so she mistook him for a kidnapper.
Mimir was briefly taken aback when he felt an immense power from her. “Uh... That’s... Master has urgent business... He has to go take care of it.”
“No. Byam. Won’t let him go to the dangerous place again.”
“He isn’t going to a dangerous place again... It’ll only be for a brief moment.” The surprised Mimir then asked, “Again...? What do you mean by...!”
This should be the first time Hailey was meeting Lee Gun.
In the end, the one who wanted to take Lee Gun away and the one who wanted to keep Lee Gun in place were having a staring match.
“Ah!”
At that moment, someone snatched Hailey up from behind. The one to lift her was none other than Shiva.
Shiva’s eyes turned violent when he saw Hailey and Lee Gun stuck close to each other. For some reason, Aslan stood in the doorway, trying to hide that he was convulsing with laughter.
Mimir ignored his old owner. He looked at Aslan as if he had lost his mind and tried to leave with Lee Gun in tow.
“Master. I’ll take care of your diaper in no time... Master?”
“Byaa...”
Lee Gun had a blissful expression on his face, and he also looked as if the world was ending.
Aslan’s face was full of merriment. He placed a hand over his mouth, pounding his hand against the wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 506: Book 2: Epilogue 19 - Truth (4)
chapters.content:
Hugo tilted his head in puzzlement as he looked at Baby Lee Gun. He seemed worried because Baby Lee Gun was acting very differently from his normal self.
“What is wrong with Gun? He isn’t crying, nor is he making a fuss. For some reason, he’s very quiet today.”
It was beyond being quiet.
“Why is he so glum?”
As Hugo said, Baby Lee Gun was lying on his back, appearing lifeless. His expression looked oddly resigned. This was why Hugo wondered if something was wrong with Lee Gun.
In truth, the fallen Lee Gun was cursing.
‘Damn it!’
He had met Hailey after several years, and it was a great experience. Everything had been great except...
Damn this body of a baby!
Lee Gun despaired as he flailed his small body.
Hugo’s curious expression turned even more curious. Why was he being like this?
After meeting Hailey, Lee Gun was acting a bit strange.
An oddly suspicious look entered Hugo’s eyes as he looked at Lee Gun. When he and the others had gone searching for the missing Baby Lee Gun, they had arrived upon Mimir changing the diaper of a humiliated Lee Gun. They saw Aslan uproariously laughing as he pounded on the wall.
Moreover, Hailey was watching Lee Gun, and Shiva was trying to distract her.
Hugo found this odd. Why was Aslan suddenly laughing while watching Lee Gun’s diaper change? He had seen that numerous times before.
Anyway, Lee Gun had become sullen after that incident. Why was he acting this way?
Despite the odd look of suspicion in Hugo’s eyes, Lee Gun didn’t care. The look in his eyes became more vicious.
‘Divine status! I have to find my Divine status!’
In strict terms, he didn’t possess the body of a human. Naturally, he grew up faster than a human.
However, Aslan had told him something while trying to hold back his laughter.
- Yes. Gods do grow faster until the age of ten.
Ahhh!
After they reached the age of ten, it takes a god several hundred years to look like an adult!
What kind of nonsense was that? No, he was putting the cart before the horse.
- You can grow faster, but it’s done in stages.
- Byaa?
- Mmm. For example, it’s like you suddenly grow into a ten-year-old body from being a one-year-old.
- Byaa??
- I’ll make it simple. You will have to be a baby for three years.
Ahhh!!! Damn it! This meant Lee Gun had to live like this for three more years! What kind of nonsense was that? That was nuts! He hadn’t come back for this!
Lee Gun was almost about to spit fire in anger.
‘I have to regain my Divine status.’
If he could recover the Divine status of a Creator, he could easily create a growth-type item. He could become an adult in one fell swoop!
‘I can’t live like this!’
There was no way he would meet Hailey without being potty trained!
In reality, that wasn’t the true reason for his desperation. The biggest problem was the erosion of his brain.
Was it because he had his memories? Lee Gun possessed the body of a baby, yet he was using too much brain capacity, so his brain fatigued faster. If he used his brain too much, it wouldn’t function. He would almost pass out. In other words, he would black out.
Of course, it didn’t matter if he blacked out in front of Hugo. The problem was if it happened in front of others.
This was why Lee Gun wondered if he should tell an ally that he had his memories in case of the unknown. Of course, Hugo was excluded from the list of allies that he would pick.
Lee Gun had done all kinds of things to Hugo after his return. If Hugo found out that he had his memories, he would try to get even. There was no way Hugo would take care of him.
So he needed an ally he could trust in absolute terms. He needed someone who would never neglect him and a trustworthy person who could protect him from Hugo, who could turn evil toward him!
Chun Jiwoo was trustworthy, but it was embarrassing to ask her. Therefore, Lee Gun discounted her.
‘Yes. Yooha should be good enough.’
After becoming a baby, he felt embarrassed by how much other people tried to touch him because he was cute. It was excessive.
If it’s Yooha, she would be able to stop it.
In truth, Heiji, the Virgo Constructs, and the Lee Gun fans had tried to touch him. It didn’t matter if they were male or female; every time, Yooha stopped them like a brick wall.
So Lee Gun thought about telling Yooha that he had his memories. He thought about forming an alliance with her...
- Noona. Do you really think Uncle doesn’t have his memories?
- I don’t think he does, but if he did...
It was unclear what Yooha was imagining, but she kept grinning. Her following words made Lee Gun’s soul leave his body. He was struck dumb.
‘I’m screwed if I tell her that I have my memories.’
He gave up on Yooha. In turn, he also became worried about Sungjae after hearing Yooha’s words.
This left only one person: Yeonwoo. Yeonwoo was gone often because she was tracking down his stalker. However, she visited Lee Gun from time to time.
This stalker was Abyss, and that was why it was taking Yeonwoo time to track down the stalker. However, Yeonwoo came whenever she had time. She would sneak into Hugo’s house to meet Lee Gun.
Lee Gun always relaxed when Yeonwoo made her appearance.
‘Yes. I can trust Yeonwoo.’
She was his only family, who would never betray him. Yeonwoo had been away, so he hadn’t had the chance to tell her. However, Lee Gun was sure she would help him if he told her the truth.
Lee Gun planned on calling for Mimir while Hugo and his family were asleep. He would ask Mimir to tell the truth to Yeonwoo.
That was what was supposed to happen...
- Ah. If only Gun had his memories, I would do xx, xx, and xxx to him.
...Y...Yeonwoo?
Lee Gun had thought Yooha had been scary, but Yeonwoo’s temperature had suddenly shot up!
Yeonwoo thought Lee Gun didn't have his memories. So she was talking to herself and revealed her true feelings. The temperature raised to a point where she was talking about stuff inappropriate for those under 19.
Lee Gun felt his soul leave his body.
‘Wait a moment!’
He couldn’t reveal the truth for an entirely different reason! Lee Gun massaged his face.
Just like that, half a year had passed, yet Lee Gun had given up telling those around him that he had his memories. He didn’t know how long he could hide it, but he had to look for his Divine status. He had to use it to grow...
“Oh my, Lee Gun-nim! It’s time for you to have your diaper changed.”
“I’ll bring it.”
“No, I’ll do it.”
“Ah. While we’re at it, should we give you a bath?”
Ahhhk!
Heiji and other guests had come to see Lee Gun again. Lee Gun became angry when they threatened him.
‘Wait a moment. I can take care of this myself... No, I can’t! My Constructs...! Ah. I sent them away to find my Divine status. Damn it! I don’t want this. Call Taeksoo for me!’
At that moment...
Slam!
Someone seemed to have heard the voices of the guests approaching Lee Gun and violently opened the door.
Lee Gun’s face brightened.
‘Yes! Taeksoo is here....’
Lee Gun became surprised by who had entered through the door.
“Byam. I’m going to take care of him.”
No, it was Hailey!
Hailey had come to Hugo’s house to play. She let out a bright smile as she approached Lee Gun.
Unable to stand this sight, Heiji tried to pick up Hailey. She tried to chase Hailey away, yet something surprising happened.
Flash!
“Huhk! Heiji-nim!”
When Heiji laid her hand on Hailey, she turned into a baby.
“W...What the hell just happened right now?”
That wasn’t all. Along with a flash of light, all the guests were sent away using teleportation. They reappeared on the roof of Hugo’s house!
“Kyaa. Why are we here?”
Lee Gun’s black eyes blinked. What the hell? Was that Hailey’s ability? No, that wasn’t important right now.
“Byam!”
It seemed Hailey had wanted to see him. She let out a bright smile as she approached him.
Lee Gun was glad to see her, but something happened at that moment.
‘Kuhk.’
“Byam. It’s time to change your diaper!”
When Hailey took off his pants, Baby Lee Gun screamed inwardly. No! Wait a moment!
When a flustered Lee Gun struggled, Hailey used her small hands to put Lee Gun on her knees and took a firm grip on him.
“You shouldn’t move. Byam. He told me to always change it for you. Byam. He said you’ll be uncomfortable at night if I don’t do this.”
What the hell? Who the hell would tell Hailey to do this?
“Pfft. Ke ke ke.”
“...!”
Lee Gun became angry as he heard suppressed laughter coming from near the window. With a violent look in his eyes, he glared at the window.
As expected, Aslan was there, bursting with laughter and pounding his fist against the window frame.
It had recently started with the disciples of the Sagittarius temple. Then it expanded to all the guests who visited him. Lee Gun had found it odd that they kept doing things that embarrassed him.
‘It’s his doing.’
Feeling Lee Gun’s murderous intent, Aslan stopped laughing and looked at Lee Gun. “You deserve what you get. Why would you pretend not to have your memories? Who told you to hide the truth from your father?”
While he was able to laugh thanks to Hailey, Aslan felt hurt that Lee Gun had hidden the truth about his memories.
“I never expected you to use your power to pull it off.”
Lee Gun had used the power of Universe to confuse Aslan’s Translation skill. No, he made fake words and fed them to Aslan.
Aslan knew Lee Gun had to go through a lot of hassle to pull this off, so he felt disappointed. What was so hard about revealing that he had his memories? Why would he go through all the hassle to hide the truth even from him?
“Did you plan on doing this from the start?”
“....”
Aslan didn’t laugh. It wasn’t simply about Lee Gun hiding his memories. Naturally, Aslan felt a bit disappointed that his son had decided to hide the truth about his memories. Still, his decision was understandable.
Lee Gun had entrusted his memories to Shiva. He had used his abilities to hide this.
However, what shocked Aslan was that Lee Gun had tried to hide all this until the end. He had plenty of opportunities to speak up.
This made it seem that Aslan didn’t engender the feeling of trust in Lee Gun. It was the same when Lee Gun had acquired his Karmic debt.
Originally, Aslan had planned on going to the World of Emptiness instead of his son. However, Lee Gun had turned down this offer before going there himself.
Then Aslan decided to save his son by going to the World of Emptiness. But when he arrived there, his son killed himself by destroying his heart.
Whenever he recalled that moment, Aslan felt a sense of loss and a feeling of helplessness.
Aslan bit his lips as he looked at Lee Gun. “Do you even see me as your father? I wonder.”
“...”
When there was silence, Aslan laughed as if he was embarrassed by what he had just said. “Yes. I already know. I’m not fit to be your father. I’m sorry!”
Aslan was unable to protect his wife, whom he had loved. He had sent his son into the flow of the Universe. He had watched over Lee Gun as a soul first, then as a slime. However, he had never acted like his father.
As if his lack of being a father wasn’t enough, he had been the reason why Time had appeared. He was the source of all the torment Lee Gun had gone through in his life.
Aslan knew all of this, so he let out a deep sigh. “Forget what I just said. I just... If you have your memories, I have one question for you.”
He had wanted to ask this to Hugo, but had been afraid of the answer. So he was unable to ask the question in the end. “Do you resent me?”
“!”
Aslan had felt a great shock when he had gone to the World of Emptiness to find Lee Gun. It was when Lee Gun had taken his life in front of him.
Lee Gun should have found out midway that Mimir wasn’t Aslan. This was why Lee Gun had been about to accept Aslan’s offer when he turned him down. Lee Gun had said,
- No. I won’t let you. I went through the trouble of setting this up.
What did those words mean? Like how he wanted revenge against his older brother, his son wanted revenge against him?
There were too many reasons why his son might hold a grudge against him. Aslan couldn’t guess which one was behind this move.
His son was born because of him. He was the reason his son grew up alone. He was the reason the Divine status of the Serpent Bearer had been transferred to Lee Gun. He was the reason Time appeared in this world. He was the reason his son had to travel a path in life that he didn’t want to travel.
In some ways, Aslan was the source that started all these events. This was why it seemed like Lee Gun wanted Aslan to feel despair and helplessness. It was why he had ended his life in front of Aslan.
“Weren’t you talking about me when you said you went through the trouble of setting it up?”
“...”
“I ruined your life, and it caused pain for those around you. So you developed a grudge against me. Is that why you ended your life as revenge? Is that why you said those words to me?”
Aslan had lowered his head as he asked the question, and Lee Gun was unable to say anything. His eyes were round as he looked at Aslan.
When the deep silence felt like it would go on for eternity, Aslan could wait no longer. He raised his head. “You can curse me. I can handle it all. Just say something!”
[That’s crazy! How the hell did you come up with that from what I said?]
“!”
It was a familiar voice that Aslan hadn’t heard in a while.
Lee Gun looked dumbfounded as he gazed at Aslan. It was as if he could have never imagined this.
Lee Gun had forcefully activated Aslan’s Translation ability as he continued to speak.
[How twisted can you be that you would think dying in front of you would be a form of revenge?]
“Uh... Uh...?”
[Wow! This is shocking! I know you’re a twisted psychopath who would come up with such a revenge plot. That doesn’t mean others think like you...]
“What?” Aslan couldn’t comprehend what was being said. He had a dumbfounded expression on his face.
Lee Gun sighed.
[I didn’t want you to be trapped in the World of Emptiness because I went through all the trouble of setting things up.]
Aslan put on a pained expression. “Yes. I get it. You wanted the image of you dying to be replayed over and over again. You wanted me to taste the feeling of helplessness and despair for eternity...”
[My goodness!]
At that moment, Lee Gun gestured with his hand, and Aslan’s vision suddenly changed.
Lee Gun used his ability to show a different place in the concurrent timeline. Aslan had no idea which country was being shown, but he saw a newly born baby in someone’s home.
This child was a girl. She was growing up while receiving immense love from her parents.
Aslan immediately recognized the identity of the child. At the same time, his vision returned to him. Lee Gun spoke as if he knew what Aslan had seen.
[She’s your wife.]
“....”
[No, she’s my mother.]
Lee Gun spoke as if he had gone through a lot of work to find her.
[When I was saving Hailey from the World of Emptiness, I had the opportunity to look over the registry. I found her by coincidence. That’s why I looked for her at the same time as Hailey. I thought it would be great if everyone could reincarnate.]
“Ah!”
Aslan was speechless.
Lee Gun had revealed the true reason he had declined Aslan’s offer. He had revealed why he had ended his own life.
[I went through the trouble of reviving my mother. It’ll be all for nothing if you die.]
Lee Gun had said, “I won’t let you,” in the World of Emptiness for this very reason. He had revived his mother, who had died a long time ago, and wanted to show her to Aslan.
Aslan was at a loss for words. He could only place a hand over his face, feeling himself choke up.
His son spoke.
[I went through a lot of trouble in finding her. That’s why I had to wait there for longer than necessary.]
“....”
[At this point, shouldn’t you be thanking me? Are you going to say nothing when you’re receiving something?]
Aslan pressed firmly on his wet eyes. “Yes. Thank you.”
[I won’t tell you where she is since I can tell that you will stalk her.]
“Hmmph.”
[You should meet her at a later time. Don’t even try to act as if you know her. At your age, you will be committing a crime.]
“Yes. You’re right.” Aslan soundlessly shed his tears. “Thank you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 507: Book 2: Epilogue 20 - Truth (5)
chapters.content:
A while later, Hugo looked somewhere with a dumbfounded expression. To be specific, he was looking at Aslan, who was walking around while humming.
“Huh? Why is he in such a good mood?”
It took a lot to put Aslan in good spirits. Moreover, he wasn’t the type of person to outwardly express his emotions.
This made Hugo nervous. Aslan was a person with a broken personality. Whenever he was happy, something big always happened.
This was why Hugo became leery as he looked at Aslan with suspicion.
Regardless of the attention, Aslan kept making rounds. While walking, he would suddenly stop and look at the sky with a grin. He would grin on seeing the flowers in the garden. Then he would grin as he looked at the wall.
Everyone else would think he had gone mad, but one person smirked as he looked at Aslan’s antics.
[Are you that happy?]
“!”
[I said are you happy?]
It was his son, Lee Gun.
Aslan was the only one who could talk to Lee Gun because of the Translation skill.
After telling Aslan the truth, Lee Gun continued to converse with him. It was mostly Lee Gun cussing Aslan out instead of a conversation.
It was a wonder how Lee Gun had held himself back from talking, but Aslan merely smirked. At the end of the day, he was in an excellent mood.
Aslan didn’t plan on meeting his wife, who was reborn. He didn't plan on stealing her away from her family. He was just happy that she was alive. Even if they would not be able to form a connection in this lifetime, Aslan planned on protecting her until she died.
Above all else, he had learned that his son didn’t resent him. It made him relieved and thankful. This was why he didn’t get angry at what Lee Gun said. Nevertheless, Lee Gun was still spewing hateful words.
“Gun, you shouldn’t speak like that to your father, right?”
With a sour expression, Lee Gun looked at Aslan. His eyes said, “What are you going to do about it?”
Aslan snickered. “I can guess why you didn’t tell others about your memories, but are you sure about this?”
[What?]
“Others finding out about it will be a problem, but you should be worried about the one near you. You’re dead if Hugo finds out about it.”
“...!”
Lee Gun started to sweat when he saw Aslan’s sly smile. He had a good idea why Aslan was bringing up Hugo’s name.
“As soon as you returned, you made a big accident in destroying Hugo’s house. You tormented him and broke his back by consuming all his resources. It was so bad that I saw him almost in tears. I forget. How much did Hugo say he had spent...”
“...”
Lee Gun started to sweat again.
“While you guys have been friends for dozens of years, there are things that a friend should and should not do. Right? What would happen if he finds out that you did all this despite having your memories?”
“...”
“Moreover, what would the girls who like you do if they found out?”
Lee Gun started to sweat harder.
Aslan let out a bright smile. “I do owe you a debt, so I won’t tell anyone.”
“!”
“You should be careful so that you aren’t found out. When they find out... You know what happens, right?”
Lee Gun continued to sweat.
* * *
Shiva was faced with the biggest concern of his life.
